Subject: Abraham; Isaac; Ishmael
Quotation: Abraham was forced far from His homeland, but that remoteness became the cause of joy

Subject: Abraham; Isaac; Ishmael
Quotation: The children of the Friend [Abraham] and the heirs of Him Who conversed with God [Moses] are mentioned in the presence of the Wronged One.

Subject: Abraham; Isaac; Ishmael
Quotation: I inquired as to the genealogy of Baha'u'llah, and 'Abdu'l-Baha said that He was of Abraham's blood -- not through Isaac or Ishmael, but through one of his other sons by Katurah by whom he had six sons.

Subject: Abraham; Isaac; Ishmael
Quotation: Although this request came from the tongue of the people, yet Abraham attained complete faith in the Glorious Lord... Otherwise Abraham was illustrious, a soul at rest, pleasing and pleased, a holy soul.

Subject: Abraham; Isaac; Ishmael
Quotation: Know thou that when Ishmael, son of the Friend of the All-Merciful, desired to set foot in the wilderness of love that he might reach the Sinai of divine nearness - which is the station of complete sacrifice - at the moment he intended to proceed to his destination, he observed one adorned in the garments of knowledge and piety. This person drew near to Dhabih [Ishmael] and, with utmost cunning, sought to prevent him from the places of divine destiny and to turn him aside from that which he had intended. When that Luminary of the horizons caught the odor of hypocrisy from him, he informed the Friend of the All-Merciful [Abraham], who said: "O son, pay no heed to him for this is Satan. Beware of his deception and take refuge in the protection of the King of Grandeur. Choose thy dwelling in the secure abode which is the precinct of divine protection." When that lover of the Beauty of the All-Glorious heard the melody of the Friend of the All-Merciful, he drove him away and took refuge in God's protection.

Subject: Abraham; Isaac; Ishmael
Quotation: When Abraham was expelled from his homeland, the True One addressed him saying "Do not grieve, I shall give you the best lands of the world - a part grows roses, another piece violets, elsewhere basil, and in another narcissus."

Subject: Abraham; Isaac; Ishmael
Quotation: Abraham was born in Mesopotamia of a family that was ignorant of the oneness of God; He opposed His own people and government, and even His own kin; He rejected all their gods; and, alone and single-handedly, He withstood a powerful nation.

Subject: Abraham; Isaac; Ishmael
Quotation: When the honored Abraham was suspended in the air, the great angel came to him and asked "Hast thou any need?" He replied "Not from thee!" This word set all ablaze - weakness was transformed to strength, silence to speech, and muteness to utterance.

Subject: Abraham; Isaac; Ishmael
Quotation: O descendant of the illustrious Abraham! That noble one was the prince of the righteous and the leader of the free. He offered a prayer on behalf of his progeny, saying: O Lord, make my offspring distinguished, and O Kind One, make my descendants honored throughout the world.

Subject: Abraham; Isaac; Ishmael
Quotation: Your namesake in the field of sacrifice proclaimed "O my father! Do what thou art commanded. Thou wilt find me, if God so willeth, of the steadfast," and attained unto "We ransomed him with a mighty sacrifice." In that instance a lamb was offered as a sacrifice at the altar of Isma'il, peace be upon him.

Subject: Abraham; Isaac; Ishmael
Quotation: Verily it was revealed aforetime in the Furqan: "And We ransomed him with a mighty sacrifice." This was revealed at the time when Abraham desired to follow what he had witnessed in his vision from his Lord - that there is no God but Him, the Supreme, the Self-Subsisting. When he desired to follow the command of his Lord regarding his son, God sent down from His presence a ransom for him, as a grace from His presence.

Subject: Abraham; Isaac; Ishmael
Quotation: By what means would Joseph of Canaan have risen from the depths of the well to the heights of the moon? How would Moses have beheld the burning fire in the Sinai tree? How would He have been sent forth with the manifest serpent and the white hand? How would the people of Israel have become dominant over Judea, Palestine and Galilee? From where would the carpet of Solomon have been spread? Where would the kingdom of David have been established?

Subject: Abraham; Isaac; Ishmael
Quotation: When the fire of Nimrod's tyranny was aflame and the decree to burn the temple of the Friend of that time - may our soul be a sacrifice for Him - issued forth from that dayspring of polytheism, there appeared from His Holiness that whose fragrance shall never cease from the worlds of inner meanings, utterance, wisdom and knowledge. When they suspended Him in the fire, Gabriel, by God's command, came to Him and asked: "Hast thou any need?" He replied: "No, not of thee."

Subject: Abraham; Isaac; Ishmael
Quotation: Therefore both Isaac and Ishmael were sacrificed, indeed all the servants of God, and this is one of the stations that is among the requirements of the stars of unity. Furthermore, in the station of unity, Ishmael and Isaac have the status of one being - the title of each may be applied to the other. However in the Torah Isaac is mentioned, and likewise in the traditions of His Holiness the Messenger there is mention of Isaac and also mention of Ishmael - both of them. This servant mentioned Ishmael according to the convention of the people, since on the tongues and lips of the people of the Furqan [Quran] Ishmael is mentioned, therefore correspondingly in the course of the exposition each of the loved ones of God who are named Ishmael were guided to this most glorious and exalted station.

Subject: Adam; Adam and Eve
Quotation: Every Manifestation is the Adam of His time. (Adam means the type man, the perfect man.) There were one hundred thousand Adams before the Adam of biblical records each being the Manifestation of His own time or cycle. This cycle in which we are living and which has come to its full expression today having ended thus, is the long Adamic cycle, being five hundred thousand years. Five hundred thousand years ago a Great Manifestation came and founded it. From that time to the present we have had lesser cycles, such as the Adam of record, Noah, Abraham, Moses, Jesus, Muhammad, etc,." Today, which culminates this long cycle - Baha'u'llah being, in the words of 'Abdu'l-Baha, "The expression of maturity and perfection of humanity." In the time of Adam, the first prophet of record, we have the seed of Christ consciousness deposited embryonically by Adam.

Subject: Adam; Adam and Eve
Quotation: because of his quarrel with Satan, Adam was banished from Paradise

Subject: Adam; Adam and Eve
Quotation: As God has repeatedly mentioned Adam's transgression in all the heavenly books

Subject: Adam; Adam and Eve
Quotation: As for Adam and Eve, they were husband and wife and the progenitors of the human race

Subject: Adam; Adam and Eve
Quotation: Consider that His Holiness Adam and others were in paradise, but as soon as conflict arose between His Holiness Adam and Satan in the Garden of Eden, all were expelled from paradise

Subject: Adam; Adam and Eve
Quotation: The substance of Adam's physical life was dust. In the Torah it is written that the Lord God formed man of the dust of the ground, and breathed into his nostrils the breath of life; and man became a living soul. Observe that it states Adam came into being through the breath of life.

Subject: Adam; Adam and Eve
Quotation: In terms of truth and the eating of the tree by Adam, as recorded in the Torah, God placed Adam in the garden of Eden to work and tend it, and said to Him: "Eat freely of every tree of the garden, save for the tree of good and evil, for if thou wert to eat thereof thou wouldst surely die." Then it is said that God caused Adam to sleep, took a bone from His ribs, and created a woman to be His companion. Further on it is said that the serpent tempted the woman to eat of the tree, saying: "God has forbidden you to eat from the tree, that your eyes may not be opened and that you may not discern good from evil." Then Eve ate from the tree and gave unto Adam, who also ate. Whereupon their eyes were opened, they found themselves naked, and they covered their nakedness with leaves.

Subject: Adam; Adam and Eve
Quotation: As for the matter of "Adam disobeyed" and the verse "that which preceded of thy sin and that which followed" - this station is where "the good deeds of the righteous are the sins of those drawn nigh" and "thy very existence is a sin that no sin can encompass." A breath on the mirror appears, and imaginary dust in the eye causes distress. The Exalted One says "even thy seeking nearness to Me is like the polytheism of others." Now, God forbid one should say that seeking nearness to God is sin and polytheism, and therefore the Holy Manifestations are not the embodiment of the Most Great Infallibility. I seek God's forgiveness from this! They are infallible, protected, holy and preserved.

Subject: Ascension of Baha'u'llah
Quotation: Though the Ancient Beauty and Most Great Name has ascended from this world and raised His pavilion in the hidden realm

Subject: Ascension of Baha'u'llah
Quotation: From that time on He lived in Bahjee till the day of departure dawned upon us and threw us into the depth of despair and sorrow.

Subject: Ascension of Baha'u'llah
Quotation: After the ascension of the Blessed Beauty, may dust be on the head of anyone who seeks a moment's rest or reclines on the couch of ease.

Subject: Ascension of Baha'u'llah
Quotation: But when we recall the ascension of the Ancient Beauty and the Greatest Name, all of our other troubles will vanish, for deprivation from His sunlike face maketh separation from a shining lamp easier to bear

Subject: Ascension of Baha'u'llah
Quotation: Verily the Most Great Luminary that shone forth upon the horizons of the nations has set from the dayspring of the world and now gleams and radiates from His Most Glorious Horizon and His Supreme Kingdom upon all beings

Subject: Ascension of Baha'u'llah
Quotation: You had inquired about the Kitab-i-Aqdas - it is the same one that has been published. There are several supplementary ordinances in the Blessed Handwriting, but the Covenant-breakers stole 'Abdu'l-Baha's papers and that document was among them. A few days before the Ascension of the Blessed Beauty, may my spirit be sacrificed for His loved ones, He commanded 'Abdu'l-Baha to gather the papers in His blessed chamber and put them in a satchel. According to His blessed command, the papers were collected and placed in two satchels. He said "These papers are entrusted to you." When these words issued from His pure lips, the condition that arose is indescribable - all my limbs trembled and tears flowed like rain. It is better to be brief about this as it causes intense emotion.  In any case, I left those two satchels in the blessed room as I could not take them, until the Ascension occurred. When we wanted to wash the pure body, Mirza Muhammad 'Ali said "Perhaps the water will affect this. You give this to us and we will safeguard it until the washing is complete and the pure body is enshrouded in its burial shroud." In such a state where I had absolutely no consciousness or thought, and the possibility of anyone's treachery could not occur to me, I handed them over. He gave them to Mirza Badi'u'llah to place in his trunk and safeguard. But they seized everything along with all the trusts and blessed seals and rings, and did not give me a single page from the two satchels. They remain with them to this day.

Subject: Ascension of Baha'u'llah
Quotation: Things will come to pass wonderfully after my departure. God has brought about this situation that I should be on earth and at the same time not be in order that the beloved ones may not relax in their work abroad. There will be a slight silence after my departure, and after that there will be a great blaze.

Subject: Ascension of Baha'u'llah
Quotation: After the death of the Blessed Perfection, one day, the chief Muhammadan priest of Akka came to our Lord and said he had seen the door of his room open and the Blessed Perfection came into his room. This was the Truth and Cause of the Blessed Perfection which manifested itself and it's continuous to him in this way.

Subject: Ascension of Baha'u'llah
Quotation: Although the Greatest Name hath passed on to the Invisible Realm, although the Daystar of the Ancient Beauty, may my spirit be sacrificed for the dust of His Threshold, hath set on the horizon of this contingent world... Although the Ancient Beauty and the Most Great Name -- may my spirit be a sacrifice for the dust of His resting place -- has set from the horizon of contingent being, has departed from the dawning-place of this world, and has hastened to the realm of the invisible

Subject: Baha'u'llah in Sulaymaniyyih
Quotation: My banishment from My homeland was for the sake of none but the Beloved; My exile was in no other path save that of His good-pleasure. From the land of Ta, after countless afflictions, We reached 'Iraq, at the bidding of the Tyrant of Persia, where, after the fetters of Our foes, We were afflicted with the perfidy of Our friends. At length, abandoning My home and all that was therein, and renouncing My life and all that pertained thereunto, I retired alone and companionless. I roamed the wilderness of resignation. For two years or rather less, I shunned all else but God, and closed Mine eyes to all except Him.

Subject: Baha'u'llah in Sulaymaniyyih
Quotation: During the first years of our stay in Bagdad Baha'u'llah suddenly departed for the mountains of Soleymanieh. At this time we did not know His whereabouts at all and so it happened that there was no one to teach the Cause or muster the scattered Babi forces; The fire of search was almost extinguished and the interest of the public waned. There was no one to assuage the fear of the few or attract the hearts of the many. The voice of divine authority was hushed and the thunders and lightings of spiritual revelations did not roll and flash across the heavenly track.... At this juncture two young men from Meelan came to Bagdad. They were enkindled believers and they brought cheer and happiness to our despondent and sorrowing hearts. It was now a long time that we had heard no news from the Blessed Perfection. The fire of spirituality and activity was put out of every soul. The hearts were bewildered and the spirits drooped. No amount of exertion whatever could in the least stir the spirits of a few fearful Babis with courage or self-sacrifice. At that time I was very young. These two new believers from Meelan came and knocked at the door. I went and opened it. I observed they are two young men from Meelan. Their faces were luminous, their eyes radiant. They were shining like unto two suns. I asked them to come in. …….. After a while they asked about the Cause. I told them the Cause is extinct, there is no Cause. They asked about Mirza Yahya, I told them he is concealed and no one knows his whereabouts. They asked about Baha'u'llah. I told them I do not know where he is. As soon as they heard this sad news they looked at each other and began to weep and weep. For nearly one hour they sat down on the floor and wept bitter tears of regret and disappointment. I tried to console them, but I could not succeed. My own heart was sad when observing the chaotic conditions of the Cause, and the absence of any life. Then they arose from their seats, and without any remarks left the house in utter silence. They did not any leave any address and I never heard from them afterwards. How different it is now!

Subject: Baha'u'llah in Sulaymaniyyih
Quotation: In the days of Baghdad and Sulaymaniyyih, Shaykh 'Abdu'l-Husayn was told that the Blessed Beauty was attracting the Kurds to Himself by quoting Sufi and gnostic terms. This poor Shaykh obtained a copy of the Futuhatt-i-Makkiyyih and committed its passages to memory. But wherever he quoted them, he saw that none lent an ear to him. He was greatly puzzled as to why people did not listen to him. The Blessed Beauty said, 'Tell the Shaykh that We are not in the habit of reading the Conquests of Mecca but We impart to them the verses of True Civilization. We are not propounding the writings of the Shaykh [Ibn al-'Arabi], we are propounding the Holy Writ.'

Subject: Baha'u'llah in Sulaymaniyyih
Quotation: At the time that His Holiness Baha'u'llah was in the mountains of Sulymanieh one of the young rugged, illiterate kurds inhabiting in the valleys came to see Him. The Blessed Perfection is kind to him and his love grows for Baha'u'llah. His name was Mollah Ali Mardan. Although he had the title of "Mullah" yet he was illierate. He did not know anything about faith but ardently he adored Baha'u'llah. Everyday he would leave his flock and go to the cave to hear the Blessed Perfection speak. Finally the time came that Baha'u'llah through the pleadings of the friends returned to Bagdad and a new life and hope were infused in the bodies. Shorty after the return of Baha'u'llah, the father of Mulla Ali Mardan tells him I see thee in depression and gloom. If thou desirest to go to the "Holy Man" thou mayst go." The young man is beside himself with joy and leaves his humble home instantly. When he arrived in Bagdad he came right to Baha'u'llah. He had a round felt hat on his head and rough woolen-camel clothes, very picturesque. As he was a most simple man he mixed his Persian with Kurdish dialect and the result was very amusing. Baha'u'llah received him with graciousness and open arms. As the inspector of the custom-house was a devoted follower of the Blessed Perfection He sent for him. When he arrived, Baha'u'llah pointed Mulla Ali Mardan to him "This is my friend" He said "I hope you will give him a position in the custom House." "Very well" the inspector respectfully answered. and the "friend" of Baha'u'llah was properly installed in work with fair wages.

Subject: Baha'u'llah in Sulaymaniyyih
Quotation: The Blessed Beauty used to say that during the Sulaymaniyyih days, His food was mostly milk and sometimes rice pudding.

Subject: Baha'u'llah in Sulaymaniyyih
Quotation: Three days after his return from Soleymanieh he walked out in the Bazaars of Baghdad. One of the shopkeepers, seeing Baha'u'llah walking with such majesty and glory raised his head in astonishment and called aloud to his friends: "Look! how the Baha'is are appearing on the scene again."

Subject: Baha'u'llah in Sulaymaniyyih
Quotation: When Baha'u'llah left Bagdad and without the knowledge of the friends went to Soleymanie...he retired to the mountains where nobody could reach him.

Subject: Baha'u'llah in Sulaymaniyyih
Quotation: Baha'o'llah departed to Sarkalu alone. Nobody knew just where he was, even we were not informed. Two years he passed at Sarkalu. Some of the time he passed in the mountains, some of the time in grottoes, and some of the time in the city of Sarkalu.

Subject: Baha'u'llah in Sulaymaniyyih
Quotation: I departed from among the servants alone and wandered for two years in the wilderness, detached from all who dwell in the realm. When the appointed time came, He returned me to the people once again, and the matter was decreed by Him, not by my self and desire.

Subject: Baha'u'llah in Sulaymaniyyih
Quotation: When Baha'u'llah left Bagdad and for two years no one knew where he was, because of his absence the Cause became extinct. There was no life and enthusiasm in the hearts of the believers. On His return he exclaimed:- What is this: open the door! Let every one come in! He infused in them a new spirit. He rekindled the fire.

Subject: Baha'u'llah in Sulaymaniyyih
Quotation: When we were exiled from Teheran to Bagdad we remained there one year. Then, suddenly, Baha'o'llah disappeared. We endeavored to find him but were not successful. For two years there was no news of him...During the day he remained within the cave, but the moonlight nights he spent outside chanting and praying, as he was greatly charmed by the moonlight.

Subject: Baha'u'llah in Sulaymaniyyih
Quotation: During this period of retirement none, whether among My brothers or any other soul, sought to investigate the matter, let alone to grasp its significance, though its import surpasseth the creation of earth and heaven. At last the divine decree prompted certain spiritual souls to remember this Canaanite Youth. Armed with a number of petitions, they searched in every place and enquired from every person, until they found in a mountain cave a trace of this traceless One.

Subject: Baha'u'llah in Sulaymaniyyih
Quotation: When some mounted guards who were accompanying him on the road wounded him and took his possessions, this news and report reached Baghdad and came to the ears of the friends that Aqa Abu'l-Qasim's property and belongings should be delivered to Darvish Muhammad. From the circumstances, we surmised that because Aqa Abu'l-Qasim-i-Hamadani had previously been with the Blessed Beauty and had also set out on a journey when the Blessed Beauty disappeared, then surely Darvish Muhammad was the Blessed Beauty and must be in the vicinity of Sulaymaniyyih.

Subject: Baha'u'llah in Sulaymaniyyih
Quotation: In a short time Kurdistan was magnetized with His love. During this period Baha'u'llah lived in poverty. His garments were those of the poor and needy. His food was that of the indigent and lowly. An atmosphere of majesty haloed Him as the sun at mid-day. He was so resplendent that the people said this is how the Messiah must have looked. Many people from various places flocked to meet Him - philosophers and mystics of different faiths sought His presence. All became His ardent admirers. Frequently they gathered at His home engaging in deep spiritual discussions late into the night. They marveled at His knowledge, grace and brilliance. In truth, His radiant personality, His profound wisdom, and His compelling spiritual power drew all who met Him. Not only the common people, but scholars and officials found themselves irresistibly attracted to His divine presence.

Subject: Baha'u'llah
Quotation: I inquired as to the genealogy of Baha'u'llah, and 'Abdu'l-Baha said that He was of Abraham's blood -- not through Isaac or Ishmael, but through one of his other sons by Katurah by whom he had six sons.

Subject: Baha'u'llah
Quotation: Baha'u'llah is not from the line of Ishmael, but rather from the lineage of other brothers who migrated to the regions of Iran and Afghanistan. For Abraham had six other sons besides Isaac and Ishmael, and they went to Iran and Afghanistan.

Subject: Baha'u'llah
Quotation: This is verily the Beauty of the heavens and earth, wert thou of them that are assured. This is the Beauty the like of which hath never appeared in all creation. These are days the like of which the eye of creation hath never seen, and in the like of which none of God's Messengers hath appeared save this most wondrous and incomparable Revelation. Through this Revelation is the decree of origination made manifest, were ye of them that are assured, and through this Revelation hath the power of God been established among His servants and His sovereignty manifested unto all possessed of keen insight and knowledge.

Subject: Baha'u'llah
Quotation: Baha'o'llah did not speak one word in Arabic, although He wrote it.

Subject: Baha'u'llah
Quotation: Baha'o'llah had enjoyed great affluence. By exiling us and confiscating all our estates the government hoped to blot out the family.

Subject: Buddhism and Hinduism; religions of the East
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/Buddhism and Hinduism; religions of the East.txt
Quotation: Q: Was Confucius a prophet?  A: Yes, though not so great as Buddha.

Subject: Buddhism and Hinduism; religions of the East
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/Buddhism and Hinduism; religions of the East.txt
Quotation: Those people who have harkened to the teachings of BAHA'O'LLAH-Hindus, Mohammedans, Christians, Zoroastrians, Buddhists, Jews-such people have discarded their past rancour and are associating with the utmost love and unity... All these different faiths are merging into one great faith.

Subject: Buddhism and Hinduism; religions of the East
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/Buddhism and Hinduism; religions of the East.txt
Quotation: In the estimation of the people of Turkey, Arabia and Persia there is nothing worse than Buddhism. The Buddhists are shunned as makers of images, and Buddha is considered a founder of heathenism. Notwithstanding this extreme prejudice of the Mohammedans, I often proved to them in their meetings the prophethood of His Holiness Buddha.

Subject: Christ; Christianity
Quotation: At stated periods souls are sent to earth by the Mighty God with what we call 'the Power of the Great Ether.' And they who possess this power can do anything; they have all Power...  Jesus Christ had this power. The people though him a poor young man whom they had crucified but he possessed the power of the Holy Spirit; therefore he could not remain underground. This ethereal power arose and quickened the world.

Subject: Christ; Christianity
Quotation: This is what Christ said: "I am the bread which came down from heaven: whosoever eateth of this bread shall live forever"

Subject: Christ; Christianity
Quotation: Know verily that the reign of Jesus was a spiritual reign, penetrative in the hearts and the spirits and not ever the bodies, rocks and earth. The fetters which Christ put on Satan's neck meant the breaking of his power, the hindering of his dominion and the dispersing of his assemblage through the power of Inspiration and Revelation.

Subject: Christ; Christianity
Quotation: Open the eye of wisdom and close the path of pride, That thou mayyst see Mount Sinai circling here in worship, That thou mayst see the Spirit of Christ restless from His love

Subject: Christ; Christianity
Quotation: One man is so exalted that others bow down before Him and He is adored by them like Christ or Moses...But observe what a banner of unique being Christ unfurled without friend or helper.

Subject: Christ; Christianity
Quotation: Our Lord said the Muhammadans were accustomed to think Mahomet the greater because of his title "Seal of the Prophets," but in the time of Jesus spirituality and spiritual life was far greater.

Subject: Christ; Christianity
Quotation: Someone asked about Christ healing the blind, and 'Abdu'l-Baha quoted Isaiah saying that they have eyes but do not see, ears but do not hear, hearts but do not understand - but I will heal them.

Subject: Christ; Christianity
Quotation: In the Koran are many things referring to Christ not mentioned in the Gospel. It is said that Christ took a bit of clay and shaped it into the form of a bird. Then he blew upon it, and it flew away.

Subject: Christ; Christianity
Quotation: Similarly, Christ at the beginning of establishing spiritual law and arranging teachings, education and counsels, withdrew for forty days from physical requirements and abstained from food and drink.

Subject: Christ; Christianity
Quotation: Baha'o'llah established Christ in the East. He has praised Christ, honored Christ, exalted Him, called Him the Word of God, the Spirit of God, raised the Name of Christ to supreme summits of glorification.

Subject: Christ; Christianity
Quotation: The greatness and exaltation of Christ is clear as the sun from the Books and Tablets of Baha'u'llah, and likewise in the letters of 'Abdu'l-Baha...And the Baha'i belief regarding the station of Christ is that Christ is the Word of God.

Subject: Christ; Christianity
Quotation: His Holiness Christ said: The Father is in me. This we must understand through logical and scientific evidences, for if we do not conform religious principles with science and reason, they do not inspire the heart with confidence and assurance.

Subject: Christ; Christianity
Quotation: Christ's nobility and greatness lie not in His fatherlessness but in His divine perfections, bounties and effulgences. If Christ's greatness were due to being fatherless, then Adam would have to be greater than Christ, for he had neither father nor mother.

Subject: Christ; Christianity
Quotation: As for the glorious Christ, the Word of God and Spirit of God supported by the Gospel - God sent him among a people whose necks were humbled and voices subdued under Roman authority. He breathed into them the spirit of life and revived them after death...

Subject: Christ; Christianity
Quotation: Likewise did His Holiness Christ  - " upon Him be peace  - " He brought together such hostile and heterogeneous peoples like Greeks, Romans, Serbians, Caledonians, Assyrians and divers aliens around a single Fount and established close ties of fellowship among them.

Subject: Christ; Christianity
Quotation: Consider His Holiness Christ: He appeared in the world as one of the poor. He was born of a lowly family. All the apostles of Christ were of humble birth and His followers were of the poorest in the community. This testimony of Christ of the exaltation of the poor ones in the sight of God is sufficient.

Subject: Christ; Christianity
Quotation: Through Christianity the greatness of Moses became known among all nations. Through the instrumentality of Christ, through the translation of the New Testament, the little volume of the Gospel, the Old Testament, the Torah, has been translated into six hundred languages and spread everywhere in the world.

Subject: Christ; Christianity
Quotation: As ye have heard of the former times, when Christ - "glory be to Him! - "appeared, a storm of trials arose, afflictions appeared, the winds of tests blew, the thunder of temptation descended and hosts of people (Pharisees) surrounded the houses of the friends; then the weak ones were shaken and were misled after once being guided.

Subject: Christ; Christianity
Quotation: They said: "The people are very heedless. They must be made to understand by force how agitated people became in the time of Christ - even Peter denied Him three times. But in this Most Great Cause, the companions and loved ones remained so firm and steadfast that they gave up their lives dancing and stamping their feet in the field of sacrifice"

Subject: Christ; Christianity
Quotation: That sweet Being Jesus Christ one night offered up this prayer: O Lord! I commune with Thee from a place such as this, where my bed is the dust of the earth and my food the grass of the fields and my night lamp the stars of heaven. Yet who is there richer than I? For Thou vouchsafed unto me what the rich and the wise are deprived of having; Thou hast granted me what Thou did not give unto the princes, the kings and the nobles."

Subject: Christ; Christianity
Quotation: Hast thou not seen how Christ, radiant and alone, with no helper, assistant, intimate friend or supporter, achieved divine conquests in Western realms, causing their peoples and nations to bow in submission and humility before a Word that appeared from the Orient? He was like a sun that rose from its dawning-place and shed its light upon those vast regions and distant lands. Neither the barriers of nations nor the might of states could resist His conquests.

Subject: Christ; Christianity
Quotation: Consider Christ: when the Jews put Him to death, this martyrdom appeared so insignificant to them that they made no mention of it in their books. Yet because the aforementioned sign existed in Christ's being, it did not remain hidden beneath the earth, and thou canst observe what revolution it created in the world. Although Christ shunned bloodshed, observe how the Master dealeth with all people with such forbearance and kindness, and behold how great His influence shall be.

Subject: Christ; Christianity
Quotation: They say that one day Christ - "may my spirit be sacrificed for Him - "passed by a dead animal with His disciples. One said, "How fetid this animal is!" Another said, "What an ugly appearance it has!" Another said, "How repulsive it is!" Christ said, "Look at its teeth, how white they are!" Observe that Christ saw none of that animal's defects but searched until He noticed that its teeth were white. He saw only that whiteness of its teeth, overlooking its decay, fetidness, and ugly appearance.

Subject: Christ; Christianity
Quotation: When Christ ascended, only a small number had become believers and were assured, and the greatest of the apostles was Peter the renowned. Despite this, he denied Christ three times. Quotation: The meaning [of speaking in tongues] is that the Apostles taught in a spiritual tongue, a tongue that embraces all tongues. For the Word of the Kingdom comprises spiritual meanings and divine mysteries, and whoso attains to this Word will find the realities and mysteries of creation to be clear and evident. The divine inner meanings are the all-encompassing reality of all tongues. Therefore, the Holy Spirit endowed the Apostles with the tongue of the Kingdom, and they spoke with all peoples as if in their own tongue; that is, whenever they conversed with a person of any faith or nation, it was as though they were speaking his own tongue. Were it otherwise, there are at present more than a thousand known languages and it would be fair to expect that the Apostles would have written at least one Gospel in the language of one of the other nations. It is, however, well established that the Gospel was written only in Hebrew and in Greek. No Gospel was even written in Latin, though that was at the time the official language of the land. Yet, as the Apostles were not proficient in Latin, no Gospel was written in that language.

Quotation: The Covenant-breakers produced a tablet, which they attributed it to the Ancient Beauty. Therein it was clearly stated that the numerical value of Kull u Shay (all things = 361) indicated the time limit when the Cause of Baha'u'llah would, God forbid, be disbanded or dispersed.

Subject: Covenant-breaking and Covenant-breakers
Quotation: the onslaught of the Covenant-breakers and their corruption before the disordered government, their continuous calumnies, their boundless secret persecution...The more the Cause of God was exalted, the more intense grew the hatred, envy, malice and rancor of the Covenant-breakers

Subject: Covenant-breaking and Covenant-breakers
Quotation: This servant had so moved that person with the divine fragrances that it defies description, but when the Covenant-breakers caught wind of it, they went and met with him in Qum, his place of exile. They told such tales and stories that he became completely dispirited and withered.

Subject: Covenant-breaking and Covenant-breakers
Quotation: When he committed what he committed, God expelled him from His sanctuary of glory. Therefore he arose in opposition, taking unto himself a bellowing calf of flesh and calling the people unto it in opposition to the Manifestation of God Himself and to establish authority for himself.

Subject: Covenant-breaking and Covenant-breakers
Quotation: praising those who held fast to it while chastising and reproaching those who vacillated, violated and broke it... Despite all this, woe to these foolish people, for we became the target of various doubts and suppositions, indeed were pierced by the arrows and spears of suspicions.

Subject: Covenant-breaking and Covenant-breakers
Quotation: As for Kheiru'llah, his letter still exists. He asked to be appointed the supreme leader. In answer, I wrote: leave aside mentioning leader and followers, governor and subjects. This made him feel badly, and he and his guide Haji Abdul Karim became upset. That is why he turned away.

Subject: Covenant-breaking and Covenant-breakers
Quotation: the followers of Yahya have infiltrated among the friends and gather news which they relay to the outside with a thousand embellishments. This letter of refutation will, God forbid, fall into the hands of the followers of Yahya who will send it to Najaf with a thousand embellishments.

Subject: Covenant-breaking and Covenant-breakers
Quotation: For some it is fresh and thirst-subduing waters, for others bitter salt. For some it is sweet ecstasy, for others an efficient venom. The righteous are filled with joy and the wicked flee from it. The upright in heart have achieved delights that endure and the evildoers a mighty Fire.

Subject: Covenant-breaking and Covenant-breakers
Quotation: Description of covenant-breakers: "the dead of hypocrisy, the base of discord, and the vile of the croakers, preventing them from ascending to the zenith of the Covenant, that they might remain deprived and forbidden from eavesdropping and hearing the mysteries of the Day of Gathering"

Subject: Covenant-breaking and Covenant-breakers
Quotation: Now some capricious ones have appeared who have secretly started whispering, and when confident of someone, they openly mention it too... Outwardly they say "We are the first to hold fast to the Covenant" while inwardly they strike an axe at the root of the tree of the Covenant and Testament.

Subject: Covenant-breaking and Covenant-breakers
Quotation: O Shirzad, offspring of a lion! True manliness consists in showing such courage to the hosts of violation that the group of Covenant-breakers, like bats, will not dare raise their heads from their hole of oblivion, and the army of hesitation will remain hidden in the grave of silence like blind mice.

Subject: Covenant-breaking and Covenant-breakers
Quotation: Some in certain places have outwardly clung to one of the branches of this Tree, thereby drawing weak souls from the shore of divine unity into the wasteland of polytheism and error. In truth, these souls' secret purpose was never and is not the branch of the Tree, but rather their own selfish desires.

Subject: Covenant-breaking and Covenant-breakers
Quotation: the Covenant-breakers in London have caused some of the friends to waver. They have risen up with utmost hatred and enmity...All those who arose to break the Covenant were obliterated. No power can resist the power of the Covenant - ultimately it must be debased and overthrown, as experience has shown.

Subject: Covenant-breaking and Covenant-breakers
Quotation: Now, certain souls through subtle schemes are contemplating the violation and breach of God's Covenant and the breaking and severing of the mighty Testament of the All-Merciful, thinking they shall achieve some result. But evil is that which they imagine! Soon shall they find themselves in manifest loss.

Subject: Covenant-breaking and Covenant-breakers
Quotation: When my brother felt secure in himself and saw this land at peace, he secretly commissioned one of the servants to kill me. When God revealed what was hidden in his breast, he became agitated, denied it, and attributed it to that servant himself. Some letters in his handwriting appeared which still exist.

Subject: Covenant-breaking and Covenant-breakers
Quotation: Although physical illnesses are severe, the difficulty lies in treating spiritual diseases and symptoms that have absolutely no cure or remedy. Consider that there is no chronic ailment of J. No, by God! If all the physicians of the world were to gather together, they could not find a treatment or solution.

Subject: Covenant-breaking and Covenant-breakers
Quotation: In all the divine Scriptures, mention hath been made, in most explicit terms, of the cawing of the hypocrites which ariseth after the setting of the Sun of Truth. The croaking of words that oppose the explicit Text of God's Book of His Covenant, which was taken from all the divine Scriptures, is such a cawing.

Subject: Covenant-breaking and Covenant-breakers
Quotation: Now there are souls whose whisper and breath are like the cold of December and winter, spreading pages of doubts in all directions, hoping that through intense coldness of violation they may cause the grounds of hearts to freeze and destroy those seeds of divine wisdom which are a trust from the All-Merciful.

Subject: Covenant-breaking and Covenant-breakers
Quotation: However, a scheming mouse moves about that settlement, occasionally sending messages seeking to make it desolate and ruined, for it is an ill-omened owl that seeks decrepit ruins rather than prosperous dwellings. And if it enters a flourishing place, it reduces it to demolished, buried and destroyed nonexistence.

Subject: Covenant-breaking and Covenant-breakers
Quotation: The illness of Covenant-breaking is clear and evident, yet how difficult is its treatment! The decisive text of the Kitab-i-Aqdas and the explicit command of the Book of the Covenant are like the supreme remedy, yet they have absolutely no effect on the illness of the Covenant-breakers, but rather increase their malady.

Subject: Covenant-breaking and Covenant-breakers
Quotation: The matter of Mirza Badi'u'llah has reached a strange and peculiar stage... all these recent disturbances, from the Commission of Investigation and others up to now, have all stemmed from Mirza Badi'u'llah, who continuously reported the activities of Mirza Muhammad-'Ali and is now in a state of utmost enmity and hatred.

Subject: Covenant-breaking and Covenant-breakers
Quotation: Then the test appeared and the fires of trials blazed forth, the foundations were shaken, and the tribulation of the year of shidad emerged. Among the people were those whose faces became dust-stained and those whose faces became radiant, those who remained firm and grew, and those who wavered and broke their covenant.

Subject: Covenant-breaking and Covenant-breakers
Quotation: But for now, show thou some patience, for we have forbidden all from attaining unto Our presence, and the people of weakness, through their mischief, are preventing the bounty of attainment unto His presence. Shame upon the people of loss! Destruction unto the Covenant-breakers! Misery unto those who break their pledges!

Subject: Covenant-breaking and Covenant-breakers
Quotation: The servants must be made aware of the wickedness, malice, lies and calumnies of the previous people, lest they again fall into the snare of the people of the Bayan. By the life of Our Purpose and the Purpose of all who are in earth and heaven! They dig a pit but know it not, and hasten to the evil one but understand not.

Subject: Covenant-breaking and Covenant-breakers
Quotation: "...you who have seen Yahya and know full well that he was never worthy to speak in the presence of the Face - observe now the same condition. That We mentioned his name was so that the hosts of the oppressors would remain veiled from the Seat of the Cause, lest harm touch him before the Command of thy Lord was delivered."

Subject: Covenant-breaking and Covenant-breakers
Quotation: Yes, some apostates like Mirza Mehdi Beg, among the waverers, obtained it and published it, but this was included in the writings of apostates. Since their hatred and enmity is well-known to all, their words and accounts are regarded as dubious and unclear. But if the Baha'is were to publish it, it would be quite another matter.

Subject: Covenant-breaking and Covenant-breakers
Quotation: Mirza Yahya, who is the center of violation and oppression - surely you know in what state he is. His outward condition clearly shows his manifest loss. All his children are each in a strange state - one has become a Christian, another devout in the synagogue, one is devoted to the tavern, and another serves in the house of idols.

Subject: Covenant-breaking and Covenant-breakers
Quotation: Yahya and Shaykh Muhammad have sought after their own kind and are engaged in corruption. Among them, he met with Khalil in Sabzivar and said that which God is aware of. Yet how strange of Khalil to give way to one so heedless! Say: O Khalil! Know that the deeds of Hadi were first deceit and guile, which have entered into this Cause.

Subject: Covenant-breaking and Covenant-breakers
Quotation: And thou, villain, because of the hatred in thy breast, when just this much was revealed from the heaven of the Supreme Most Glorious Will - may the spirit of all else be sacrificed for Him - thou remained silent while inwardly burning in the fire of envy. And this servant was aware, for I observed the dust of hell upon thy countenance.

Subject: Covenant-breaking and Covenant-breakers
Quotation: Be not disturbed by the tumult of the followers of Yahya and others. These matters are like the foam of the sea - they come and go. However, it is not appropriate for the followers of Yahya to be present in your gatherings, for they have no purpose save casting doubts. Conduct yourselves in such a way that they themselves will not attend.

Subject: Covenant-breaking and Covenant-breakers
Quotation: That serpent gazeth with an eye of wrath and rancor, while that lion looketh with a tender and loving eye upon the children of the Kingdom... Soon shall its mighty claws - that is, its spiritual power - destroy those serpents writhing one upon another, namely, the souls who have broken the Covenant and are heedless of the remembrance of God.

Subject: Covenant-breaking and Covenant-breakers
Quotation: That package of nonsense from Dahaji sent from Alexandria was dispatched by Ali-Akbar, who sought to accuse Haji Ali so that he might gain a reputation for Covenant-breaking there, and news would reach the Holy Land, causing the friends to turn against the mentioned Haji, leading him to turn to Covenant-breaking, thus fulfilling Ali-Akbar's aims.

Subject: Covenant-breaking and Covenant-breakers
Quotation: He does not know that Mirza Yahya's father, the late Mirza Hadi of Dawlat-Abad, repeatedly ascended the pulpit in Isfahan to denounce the Bab and curse Him, which became widely known...How then can a family who explicitly recanted the Bab to preserve their mortal life now consider themselves a mighty pillar and even the successor to His vicegerent?

Subject: Covenant-breaking and Covenant-breakers
Quotation: The negligent ones imagined they could invert the banner of the Covenant and disappoint the saved communities. They have spread rumors among tongues and mouths and arranged fabrications, so that by these means they might darken the light of the divine Sun of the Covenant and mix the cup of the Covenant's "Am I not?" with the bitterness of violation.

Subject: Covenant-breaking and Covenant-breakers
Quotation: If any Iranian comes from the East to those regions, even if - impossible supposition - it were my son or 'Abdu'l-Baha's daughter, and does not have a document of permission with my writing and signature, meeting and conversing with them is forbidden, for whoever comes without permission has no purpose except corruption and violation of the Covenant.

Subject: Covenant-breaking and Covenant-breakers
Quotation: 'Abdu'l-Baha closed all doors, left no opening through which anyone could draw a breath. He arose with such selflessness, evanescence and servitude at the Sacred Threshold that it has no equal or likeness. He is even shy to mention himself as a Branch. His name is 'Abdu'l-Baha and his initials are 'A.A. How then can base souls make claims to existence?

Subject: Covenant-breaking and Covenant-breakers
Quotation: The schemes and plots of Siyyid Mahdi Najaf-Abadi were evident before the Most Holy Court. We had previously revealed verses for him whereby the cities of wisdom, utterance, knowledge and mystic truth were perfumed, and whereby the hearts of those near unto God were attracted. Glory be to God! Like a solid rock, he was not and is not capable of hearing the Word of God.

Subject: Covenant-breaking and Covenant-breakers
Quotation: Tell the divine friends not to become distressed by the frightful events and shocking news from the Holy Land, for danger is constant at all times, enemies are attacking from all directions, and the faithless Covenant-breakers do not hesitate for a moment in spreading calumnies. They constantly open their tongues in slander and confuse the minds of those in authority.

Subject: Covenant-breaking and Covenant-breakers
Quotation: And thou, O thou who hast tasted the sweetness of the honey of the Covenant, turn not thine eyes from the light of effulgence. By thy life! The Sun of Truth from the kingdom of its invisibility bestoweth its lights and rays upon all horizons, but those who are veiled remain in a dark, intense, pitch-black veil - three darknesses, one above another - and they are not guided.

Subject: Covenant-breaking and Covenant-breakers
Quotation: I have aided Thine enemies, who have broken Thy Covenant, who have cast away Thy Book, disbelieved in Thee, and repudiated Thy signs... Indeed, I am he that hath failed in duty towards Thee, and hath broken Thy Covenant and Thy Testament, and committed that which hath made the dwellers of the cities of Thy justice, and the dawning-places of Thy grace in Thy realms, to lament.

Subject: Covenant-breaking and Covenant-breakers
Quotation: How many of those who were considered among the most exalted and virtuous of servants were, with a single word, seen to become more erring, rebellious and wretched than all the peoples of the earth! How many pure and confident souls were martyred at the decree of the leaders of that people! And now this base and vile party has followed in the footsteps of those heedless ones.

Subject: Covenant-breaking and Covenant-breakers
Quotation: Some souls claim adherence to this exalted path, yet commit deeds that were and are unworthy, attributing to this blessed and exalted path every reprehensible act they commit. My affliction is not My imprisonment and what has befallen Me from My enemies, but rather the deeds of those who profess their love for Us, yet commit that from which even Satan would dissociate himself.

Subject: Covenant-breaking and Covenant-breakers
Quotation: But they, meaning the Covenant-breakers, in utmost comfort and freedom associate with all people in gatherings, happy, delighted and pleased, each looking upon us with extreme derision and mockery. I swear by the Blessed Beauty, if you knew what they have done, you would surely weep blood. And now this wronged one is in grave danger every moment, until God wills what will be.

Subject: Covenant-breaking and Covenant-breakers
Quotation: In America you may chance to meet one or two people wavering in the Covenant. Tell them that today it is the power of the Covenant that moves souls to attraction and motion, not vain imaginings. If someone wavers in the Covenant, what else can they rely upon? They become lifeless and hopeless... How honored was the center of violation, adored by all - now see what state he is in.

Subject: Covenant-breaking and Covenant-breakers
Quotation: This party, when they retreat to their hidden dens, meet in utmost fear and dread and self-preservation, and praise each other - one says to another "You are a fierce lion," another says "You are a roaring tiger," and another says "You are an Indian elephant." They display courage and valor, but in the field of testing they are like foxes - fearful, trembling, terrified and fleeing.

Subject: Covenant-breaking and Covenant-breakers
Quotation: Through mendicancy and hoarding money, he has caused destruction. Several times, I concealed his misdeeds as I wished not to witness his abasement. Now he says that he was wronged and that the friends around Me were jealous of him and caused sedition, whereas the truth is that all were his well-wishers. Even his parents have aversion towards him. He stole My seal, and I said nothing.

Subject: Covenant-breaking and Covenant-breakers
Quotation: It was repeatedly written before that the foul odor of the Covenant-breaking would reach Khurasan. Now that odor has reached Khusf and will continue to spread. Tell the divine friends to be vigilant and aware. God willing, through Haydari determination they should resist and guide the dispatched Umari, who is from Khusf and corresponds there, that perhaps he may be mindful or fear God.

Subject: Covenant-breaking and Covenant-breakers
Quotation: Concerning Ahmad-i-Kirmani, it was written that he had not chosen for himself any proof, path, way, religion, fairness, or truth. He changes color like a chameleon and turns like a spotted snake. His being is not like wax - though I have said this before - but rather like clay, accepting any form at any moment. May God and the company of the unitarians protect us from that sinful liar.

Subject: Covenant-breaking and Covenant-breakers
Quotation: How long shall the people of violation remain in their delusions, and how long shall the people of discord remain intoxicated with the wine of dissension? Yet despite all this clarity, the people of violation cling to delusions flimsier than a spider's web and are deprived of the gift of the Covenant. The ignorant and the unjust are raised and gathered in the valley of loss and abandonment.

Subject: Covenant-breaking and Covenant-breakers
Quotation: Therefore God expelled him by His sovereignty and he joined with the evil ones, namely Siyyid Muhammad and Aqa Jan. Some time passed, then one day he sent a petition to the Most Holy Court expressing repentance for his past sins, and likewise another petition some days later. But since he had repeatedly repented and then violated God's covenant and testament, the petitions were not accepted.

Subject: Covenant-breaking and Covenant-breakers
Quotation: They tampered with the writings of the Blessed Beauty and are determined to have me killed. Who would pay attention to him or follow him after such actions? Even if there had been no Covenant, who would pay him any heed after such deeds? Now this one too, what does he pride himself on? He had one connection and he severed even that, and as for his handwriting, it is only fit for tombstones.

Subject: Covenant-breaking and Covenant-breakers
Quotation: And to establish what was said before regarding the island - and you and all know that no one but this servant was or is aware of its circumstances. Indeed these few words that were submitted were out of heedlessness, for man in his heedlessness from the Truth occupies himself with such words. But the Exalted Truth is aware. The purpose is that perhaps some souls may observe and become aware.

Subject: Covenant-breaking and Covenant-breakers
Quotation: As to the matter of Mrs. Kirchner, when I was in Chicago she had the utmost connection with Dr. Nutt and the enemies of the Covenant. Outwardly she avoided them, but inwardly she was in complete agreement with them. Despite this, I dealt with her with forbearance, hoping she might become aware, and I counseled her and showed kindness, but it proved ineffective. This is the truth of the matter.

Subject: Covenant-breaking and Covenant-breakers
Quotation: By God, the Truth! He cries out from the depths of hell: O my grief for what I neglected in regard to God's Covenant, and was proud before the Center of God's Covenant, and turned my face from the beauty of God's Testament, and followed falsehood, and allied myself with the Covenant-breakers, and loved those who demolished the Covenant, and corresponded with the chief of the people of discord.

Subject: Covenant-breaking and Covenant-breakers
Quotation: They who denied Him prided themselves in their titles. The mute one named himself the Most Holy and claimed within himself what the slinking whisperer claimed, while another named himself the Sword of Truth and declared "I am the conqueror of lands." God raised up one who smote him upon his mouth, that all might be assured that he was but the tail of Satan, severed by the sword of the All-Merciful.

Subject: Covenant-breaking and Covenant-breakers
Quotation: You have written regarding the Yahyais who are in motion. This motion is a death struggle that neither nourishes nor yields any truth. The people of lethargy could achieve nothing. At most, they caused the people of pride to gain some life. However, this life of the Yahyais is like the movement of a spirit in the garments of the dead - it is quickly passing. Verily thy Lord is severe in retribution.

Subject: Covenant-breaking and Covenant-breakers
Quotation: Certain souls speak such calumnies that one is bewildered - exactly the same allegations as before have resurfaced. They also say that they have taken verses from those of the Primal Point - may our souls be sacrificed for His sake - and publish them in their own name. Equal indeed, triple equal are the Revelations vouchsafed, and the distinction between their utterances is as clear and evident as the sun.

Subject: Covenant-breaking and Covenant-breakers
Quotation: Akhtar hath manifested an oppression that hath no equal in all the world, despite the fact that from the first appearance of Akhtar until now, those around him showed him the utmost kindness and repeatedly accepted his fabrications to assist him. That shameless and unjust one sold his trust, faith, truthfulness and fairness for a few dirhams from those whose wickedness he himself had repeatedly testified to.

Subject: Covenant-breaking and Covenant-breakers
Quotation: This is like acknowledging "In the Name of God" but denying "the Merciful, the Compassionate." It is cause for astonishment and fear of the retribution of the Divine Unity...From the beginning of creation until now, such a wondrous Cause, such an explicit Covenant, and such an eloquent Testament by the pen of the Most High has not occurred, nor has such a proximate violation and strange breach been heard of.

Subject: Covenant-breaking and Covenant-breakers
Quotation: And His loved ones found a measure of comfort. Then the lifeless divines of Persia and government leaders set about cutting down the Divine Tree to such an extent that, by God besides Whom there is none other God, none of the loved ones and members of the exalted household were for a moment secure about the life of the Divine Beauty, for the enemies arose with utmost cunning to practice deception and trickery.

Subject: Covenant-breaking and Covenant-breakers
Quotation: Briefly, in the clear writing of the Blessed Perfection it is said 'every soul though he be in the highest station of a Branch, as soon as he breaks the Covenant he is cut off.' This is an evident statement. It is not only that this man broke the Covenant; but he became the 'Cause of harming and abasing the Cause of God in all regions, and sought to shed the blood of Abdul Baha: we have the proof of it in our hand.

Subject: Covenant-breaking and Covenant-breakers
Quotation: The benighted attackers have been shaken to their core; they are now as ruined sepulchres, and even as blind creatures that dwell beneath the earth they creep and crawl about a corner of the tomb, and out of that hole, from time to time, like unto savage beasts, do they jibber and howl. Glory be to God! How can the darkness hope to overcome the light, how can a magician's cords hold fast 'a serpent plain for all to see'?

Subject: Covenant-breaking and Covenant-breakers
Quotation: Consider that the leader of this group, for the sake of merely four dinars, went and gave allegiance to those same persons against whom he himself had previously issued a death sentence in his own book. And I know not whether the deniers will deny this too or mention it in some other guise. By God! By God! By God! He sent his wife to the palace in public for the sake of dirhams and dinars, and spoke of nothing but a stipend.

Subject: Covenant-breaking and Covenant-breakers
Quotation: Despite this, the people of weakness, like flies and wasps, are busy buzzing, and like a wheel they are moaning and groaning, that perchance they may find someone foolish and cast doubt. Alas! Alas! The palate that has been sweetened by the honey of the Covenant will not seek the bitterness of violation, and the ear that has heard the melody of the Covenant of the Luminary of the horizons will not turn to croaking and cawing.

Subject: Covenant-breaking and Covenant-breakers
Quotation: In this divine Dispensation some faces are illumined like unto a candle to the horizons with the light of the Covenant, while others are darkened and gloomy through weakness and doubts...In any case, through the bounty of the Ancient Beauty, may my spirit be sacrificed for Him, there is intense hope that ye may succeed in causing every violating menstruant to become disappointed, barren and despairing. Say: Die in your wrath!

Subject: Covenant-breaking and Covenant-breakers
Quotation: As for the violators, these unfortunate ones are regretful, but when an arrow has left the bow its return is difficult... Observe what the violators have manifested in these years and months. They have done nothing except cast doubts into the ears of a few weak unstable ones, and from another direction they beat the drum and cymbal of discord in the gatherings of the horizons and made the Cause of God a laughingstock to the world.

Subject: Covenant-breaking and Covenant-breakers
Quotation: O people of God! The enemies have invented calumnies and made these the means of their own associating partners with God, seeking thereby to ensnare heedless and ignorant souls...Yet these shameless people - the followers of the Bayan - display no modesty but cling to the cord of falsehood and grasp the hem of calumny, that perchance they might deprive helpless servants of the rain of divine mercy, even as they did aforetime.

Subject: Covenant-breaking and Covenant-breakers
Quotation: The Covenant-breakers stole 'Abdu'l-Baha's papers and that document was among them... Mirza Muhammad 'Ali said "Perhaps the water will affect this. You give this to us and we will safeguard it until the washing is complete and the pure body is enshrouded in its burial shroud."... But they seized everything along with all the trusts and blessed seals and rings, and did not give me a single page from the two bags. They remain with them to this day.

Subject: Covenant-breaking and Covenant-breakers
Quotation: From every direction, through various whispers and schemes, they did not allow him to open his eyes and compelled him to opposition. Among these, they said, Until now you have distributed papers everywhere and in all places, spoken against the Covenant, and made various statements and reports. Now what will you say and what will you write - that everything I said and wrote was all lies and hypocrisy and slander against the Center of the Covenant?

Subject: Covenant-breaking and Covenant-breakers
Quotation: You say that everyone is steadfast, but beware lest this steadfastness be like that of the Christians to Christ's covenant, or like the firmness of the Muslims to the Covenant of the Messenger, or like the steadfastness of the Babis to the Covenant of the Bab. Do any of these claim to be covenant-breakers? The purpose of this example is that steadfastness cannot be achieved by mere words, not that the wavering ones are like the people of the Bayan.

Subject: Covenant-breaking and Covenant-breakers
Quotation: These events and incidents were only due to the passions and desires of Yahya, Siyyid Muhammad Isfahani, and Mulla Ja'far Naraghi, who darkened the pages of history of those days and defiled the most pure hem of the Cause... But the followers of Yahya were present in every reprehensible matter, and still their evil aims and deeds are evident within and without Iran, and their interference and corruption in Iran's political offices is known and present.

Subject: Covenant-breaking and Covenant-breakers
Quotation: Before the coming of 'Abdu'l-Baha to New York, innumerable complaints were received from the believers in New York in his regard, that this person has secret intentions; outwardly he is a believer but inwardly he is against the Covenant of God. The result was that while in Chicago he secretly met the Nakezeens and promised them the promotion of their ideas. After his return he corresponded with the Nakazeens and expressed gratefulness and co-operation.

Subject: Covenant-breaking and Covenant-breakers
Quotation: He went and became friends with the illustrious personages [i.e. Covenant-breakers]. For a while, he was engaged in confusing thoughts. Afterwards, he threw burial shrouds over his neck and raised the standard of meekness. However, he noticed that I was not paying him any attention. At last, one day I was at a carpentry shop. He came and said, The Covenant-breakers say that they are able to prevent You from building the Shrine of the Exalted One [the BÃ¡b].

Subject: Covenant-breaking and Covenant-breakers
Quotation: However, certain capricious individuals who were at first firm in the Covenant and wrote treatises about firmness and disassociation from the Covenant-breakers, considering them rejected from the threshold of the Almighty (and these treatises still exist), have now, for the sake of their personal desires, deviated from the Covenant and followed the people of hypocrisy, like Judas Iscariot who, for the sake of a few dirhams, participated in shedding Christ's blood.

Subject: Covenant-breaking and Covenant-breakers
Quotation: What can the Covenant-breakers, who are but a group of weak souls, accomplish? For thirty years they have strived, yet in the end they have only succeeded in attracting to themselves a few mindless people and some women of loose character. Soon you will see these few souls scattered as well. In America, the Covenant-breakers do nothing but flatter and express false love. Consider what they did to the poor editor of the journal, and how unfaithful they were to him.

Subject: Covenant-breaking and Covenant-breakers
Quotation: When the Most Great Luminary set from the horizon of the world, the time of doubts arrived and the dominion of ambiguous verses appeared. The appointed Center was forgotten and independent judgment and derivation arose. The Covenant was forgotten and the Testament fell into the corner of forgetfulness. The Center of the Covenant became detested while he who observed circumstances became the center of the foundations, principles and branches of the religion of God.

Subject: Covenant-breaking and Covenant-breakers
Quotation: And as for the pamphlet of doubts that the new Covenant-breaker has sent to Egypt, the reason for this is that this person had a purpose and illness and all the divine friends were aware of it. For several years he wanted to promote his purpose through various intrigues but for three years he would plead with utmost supplication and entreaty. After he became disappointed, for some time he was threatening that if his request is not fulfilled there would be a great corruption.

Subject: Covenant-breaking and Covenant-breakers
Quotation: As for Mirza Yahya, the Arab says: Adi followed his father in generosity, and whoever resembles his father is not unjust. This person has followed his guide in deafness and muteness. Indeed, this Yahya compared to that other Yahya is as a nightingale of meanings that sings spiritual melodies from the rose branch. There is a famous saying: The walnut tree with such greatness - the melon vine, Allah-u-Akbar! Would that thou hadst seen it! Deaf, dumb, blind - they will not return.

Subject: Covenant-breaking and Covenant-breakers
Quotation: One hath made the Most Great Infallibility a pretext and girded up his loins to belittle the station of the Center of the Covenant. Another hath raised the banner of emphasizing unity and pronounced the believers in unity to be infidels, intimating by hints and allusions that this servant is the chief of polytheists. Another, like the second Caliph, hath declared "The Book of God sufficeth us" and proclaimed no need for an Interpreter, calling like one of old to the Book alone.

Subject: Covenant-breaking and Covenant-breakers
Quotation: And among the people of the Bayan are those who have united with the Persians and denied God, the Protector, the Self-Subsisting. Such a one is of Satan's hosts and hath ever been a polytheist, associating partners with God, the Mighty, the Loving. When he appears before the contemptible rabble who claim to be of the Bayan, he says "I have believed in God," but when he sees the polytheists he says "I am with you and have denied God, the Protector, the Mighty, the All-Forgiving."

Subject: Covenant-breaking and Covenant-breakers
Quotation: Before that, he was in a corner of the mosque claiming inheritance, and in this religion he caused much destruction and every kind of corruption until he finally reached his place of extinction. They themselves know what they have done, as they have testified to their own deeds. What this recluse has heard were accounts from their own people. It is verified that they stole that casket. Their purpose was the complete destruction of this Cause and the establishment of their own existence.

Subject: Covenant-breaking and Covenant-breakers
Quotation: He whom the heedless had taken as lord besides God would flee from land to land and from place to place. Then when the Cause was made manifest he came forth and pronounced judgment against Him through Whom the Trump was sounded, the Standard of the Manifestation was raised, and the Straight Path of God appeared. By God! He could not speak in the presence of the Face and was as one of those who circled round the Throne, yet Satan led him astray and made him to be among the perishing ones.

Subject: Covenant-breaking and Covenant-breakers
Quotation: You must be extremely careful in those Western regions lest a soul may disseminate the seeds of doubt and violation. Direct everyone at all time to the necessity of firmness in the Covenant so that the tests may not shake them. Do thou make a trip to the cities of California, Oregon and Seattle. Perhaps someone secretly has disseminated the seeds of doubt and violation. Investigate this and call everyone to the firmness of the Covenant, so that they may stand firm and steadfast as the mountain.

Subject: Covenant-breaking and Covenant-breakers
Quotation: This ignorant person is so cowardly that despite secretly claiming the successorship of Yahya, he writes to Chihrih-Numa and openly and evidently denies the Exalted Lord and his own guide... the amazing thing is that these worthless souls, who are more fearful than jackals and still tremble in extreme fear... By God, the bereaved mother laughs at the delusions of the party of Yahya and the doubts of the Covenant-breakers who, like night birds, seclude themselves in the pits of regret and the depths of stupor.

Subject: Covenant-breaking and Covenant-breakers
Quotation: During the dispensation of the Bab there was a man by the name of Mollah Mohamad Taki. He was one of the most active, energetic Believers; his faith was perfect. He even wrote a book establishing the proofs and evidences concerning the appearance of the Bab. From every standpoint he was a distinguished man with marked ability; he was learned and well-informed and his services conspicuous and various but the unfortunate man was afflicted with a 'sad end' and the results of all his former services neutralized...

Subject: Covenant-breaking and Covenant-breakers
Quotation: Now the covenant-breakers are manifestations of such foolishness and ignorance that a hundred thousand Greatest Names would have no effect, let alone exhortation and counsel. They have employed such deceptions that cannot be described - as soon as someone greets them, they secretly spread that this person is also their confidant, so as to cause the friends to shun them and create enmity and hatred toward that person. And when the fire of hatred is kindled, violation of the Covenant immediately becomes certain.

Subject: Covenant-breaking and Covenant-breakers
Quotation: Then when circumstances became so constricting for this servant that all joy and fragrance was cut off, and arrows of cruelty rained down like drops of rain, I saw no choice but to completely disappear from the land of destination... Now he writes complaints to various quarters that I have wronged him and raises lamentations. "I endured being slain while my slayer complains." This person is like the enemies of the Blessed Beauty who complained about the Blessed Beauty while His blessed breast was torn to pieces.

Subject: Covenant-breaking and Covenant-breakers
Quotation: Now there exists an explicit Covenant. It is not mere tradition but flows from the Supreme Pen, first addressing the Covenant-breakers directly in what they named the Book of the Covenant, with these words inscribed by the Supreme Pen at the head of the Tablet. What weight then can be given to the movements, stillness, hints, allusions, implications, alterations and interpretations of the doubtful ones? At most they only deprive themselves and will ultimately fall into the dark pit of loss in this world and the next.

Subject: Covenant-breaking and Covenant-breakers
Quotation: That some have mentioned that Siyyid Muhammad-i-Isfahani, despite being a man of deeds, turned away from the Truth - if deeds were of any avail, they should have preserved him from polytheism, turning away and denial. O beloved of my heart! This Siyyid Muhammad was in Karbila during the days when the Ancient Beauty departed alone, without anyone's knowledge. Several times he came to Baghdad and was with this servant day and night. I swear by the Sun of Truth that naught was manifest from him save discord and dissension.

Subject: Covenant-breaking and Covenant-breakers
Quotation: One said that to believe in the unity of the brilliant Sun required hatred for the radiant moon. Another claimed that to prove the truth necessitated and depended upon believing in the lack of infallibility and chastity and in the rebellion and revolt of the Center of the Covenant. Another said that consultation and opinion required that we attribute claims to the Pivot of the Divine Covenant, then write a decree for his execution and consider him the fulfillment of "God will soon raise up one who will show him no mercy."

Subject: Covenant-breaking and Covenant-breakers
Quotation: A trouble-making person will turn towards that land with letters of doubt and distorted, altered pages. The friends of God must arise with such strength and firmness that the light of the Covenant will disperse the darkness of doubts...That land is pure and holy - do not let it be contaminated with the stain of doubts, for the trouble-makers have strange schemes. At first they show steadfastness, then little by little, until they find a receptive ear, they secretly cast doubts and make others swear not to reveal but conceal it

Subject: Covenant-breaking and Covenant-breakers
Quotation: They have sold the Joseph of God, the All-Compelling, the Self-Subsisting, for a few dirhams. They have strayed from the path of God, the Lord of what was and what shall be. Glory be to God! The love of the friends and loved ones for Muhammad-'Ali is evident and clear, and most are aware of it. Nevertheless, he has united with one like himself and they have fabricated calumnies for the sake of the possessions of the servants. And now they cry out that the wealth has been stolen and they have set about to subvert the Cause of God.

Subject: Covenant-breaking and Covenant-breakers
Quotation: Diligence in the Cause of God is most essential, for the bats are flying about in every corner and though outwardly steadfast yet inwardly Covenant-breakers, they are scattered about like locusts in all regions to cast doubts. They have named pure polytheism as monotheism and have called the greatest violation the Most Great Infallibility, for they have considered the Covenant and Testament as error and deemed the appointment and designation of the Beloved of all worlds as mistake and oversight. Destruction and misery be upon them!

Subject: Covenant-breaking and Covenant-breakers
Quotation: Regarding the matter of Aqa Mirza Muhammad-'Ali, wherein Nabil ruled that the Most Great Branch had said such and such - would that thou hadst been present before the Throne of Revelation and heard the words of God, the Self-Subsisting, addressing the aforementioned Nabil. Among other things He said: "Thou hast made the Branch My partner. By God, the Self-Subsisting! If anyone were to slay one of the Branches, I would not consent to his execution. Thou hast set aside all these divine utterances and accepted the word of the Branch."

Subject: Covenant-breaking and Covenant-breakers
Quotation: For the waverers have desired to scatter the unity of the monotheists and to divide the Word through interpretation, commentary, independent judgment and deduction, while the garment of Baha is still moist. Oh, what sorrow for the servants because of this manifest wrong! By the life of God, I am in grievous sadness because of this dust that hath risen in the atmosphere, dimming the faces of some of the weak ones, blinding the eyes of some of the foolish, healing the breasts of the ignoble, and gladdening the hearts of God's enemies.

Subject: Covenant-breaking and Covenant-breakers
Quotation: But the purpose of the slackening in correspondence and communication was that the reality of matters might become evident and the intentions of souls might become clear and known. Praise be to God that you are now aware of the true intentions of certain persons and know that they had and have no purpose except corruption. Surely you have become informed of their dealings with the ambassador, their intermediary relationship with a follower of Yahya, their alliance with him, their representations to the embassy, and several calumnies that waste one's breath.

Subject: Covenant-breaking and Covenant-breakers
Quotation: You had written about meeting Dr. Pease. Kheiralla had cast doubts upon him. Several years ago, Dr. Pease wrote a letter to Mirza Muhammad Ali saying that despite these details you had written, how is it that the Blessed Beauty explicitly commands in the Book of the Covenant to turn to Abdu'l-Baha? Then he had written that this matter is surely for the purpose of test and trial. Observe how limited his sphere of thought is. In any case, the Center of the Covenant is the dawning-place of confirmation and the Covenant is under the protection of the Blessed Beauty.

Subject: Covenant-breaking and Covenant-breakers
Quotation: Adverse winds have encompassed the Lamp of the Covenant, and the birds of pride have surrounded the Nightingale of the Rose-garden of the Testament. The oppressors have stretched forth the hand of tyranny, and the wrongdoers, like ravens of malice, lie in ambush. The waves of rebellion have assailed the Ark of the Covenant, and the mere babes in the cradle have, from every direction, opened their tongues in derision against the Temple of the Covenant. The arrows of calumny fly from every direction, and the armies of tyranny advance from every quarter in oppression and hostility.

Subject: Covenant-breaking and Covenant-breakers
Quotation: Consider how the banner of the Cause of God has been hoisted upon the apex of the world, and yet the honored Mirza Muhammad-'Ali wants to bring it down. Truly this is humorous! "By God, besides Whom there is no god," they will never be able to harm the Cause in the least, but if they wish, they can injure Me any way they like. At the time of the ascension of Baha'u'llah, as we were otherwise occupied, I gave him two boxes containing divine Writings. He has concealed them. He has kept them so that after my passing he might bring them out and use them in accord with his personal inclination.

Subject: Covenant-breaking and Covenant-breakers
