Quotation: Only the Nakazeen remained untouched by the Word of God. There is a Mohammedan tradition that once a man met Jesus Christ [] hastily from a town to the mountains. When the man inquired why this way, Jesus replied "I am fleeing from a foolish man". Then the man said "why do you not breathe upon him, and give him the power to leave off being foolish?" Then Jesus answered, "God has given Me the power that by my breath I can open the eyes of the blind, and cause the deaf to hear, but more than one thousand times have I tried to breathe understanding into this foolish man without success; I can do nothing."

Subject: Covenant-breaking and Covenant-breakers
Quotation: Had what was witnessed not been witnessed of the deceit, trickery and corruption of the leaders of the Bayan, and had all been seen united and gathered upon the Cause of the previous Manifestation, nothing would ever have been mentioned except servitude. Moreover, they have engaged in corruption and committed what they have committed without God's permission. The harm of everyone's deeds has returned to the Root of the Divine Tree, just as that one who associates partners with God went to the great city and attributed to the Truth all that he, his companion, and the people of the Bayan committed in these numbered years.

Subject: Covenant-breaking and Covenant-breakers
Quotation: During the year following the Ascension, a letter was dispatched to Iraq whose contents were replete with such themes as the following: Know that servitude to the exalted Threshold is my resplendent crown, my most precious adorning, that whereon I pride myself before the dwellers of the realms above. From the early days following the Ascension, the fire of mischief was kindled and the Centre of opposition fostered the art of Covenant-breaking. Little children made pretense of greatness, seeking after their foolish designs to exalt themselves, and endeavouring by every means to sow confusion in the hearts and minds of the friends.

Subject: Covenant-breaking and Covenant-breakers
Quotation: We hope that such matters will not occur and such whisperings will not emerge into the arena. First, because the mighty Covenant and the edifice of the Pact are of hardened steel. Second, because this servant has no ill feeling toward anyone nor any opposition, I have no obligations and seek no distinction. I am but an evanescent servant at the threshold of the Blessed Beauty and a lowly guardian at His sacred court. I will not contend or dispute with anyone. I bow my head in submission and possess a pure heart. Whosoever wishes, let him hold fast to God's firm handle and His strong cord, and whosoever wishes, let him waver in His mighty Covenant and His manifest Cause.

Subject: Covenant-breaking and Covenant-breakers
Quotation: However, these people (the Covenant-breakers) exert efforts night and day, to cause tumult in 'Akka. And if there is turmoil in that city and it results in My capture, imprisonment and death, it is of no consequence! They [i.e. the Covenant-breakers] sent Mirza Majdi'd-Din to Jamal Pasha claiming that I am against [the Committee for] Union and Progress. They advanced many calumnies, including: "Whenever there has been a problem or disturbance, we have become entangled with it. Therefore, now, in order to protect our lives and possessions, we are presenting a deposition that it was He [i.e. 'Abdu'l-Baha] Who committed these deeds. So, if a difficulty occurs, we are not to blame."

Subject: Covenant-breaking and Covenant-breakers
Quotation: O Lord! Make firm the leaves of this Tree, lest they be scattered by the winds of trials. Verily, Thou art the Mighty, the Powerful, the Bestower. Deprive not Thy servants who have turned unto Thee, but cause them, O my God, to acknowledge Thy unity, confess Thy singleness, and submit to Thy sovereignty and power, to turn unto the sanctuary of Thy glory and majesty, to take refuge in Thee and seek protection in Thy presence. O Lord! Drive them not away through Thy bounty, and withhold them not from this Spring which hath flowed from the right hand of the throne of Thy oneness. O Lord! Make them not of those who have violated Thy Covenant, cast away Thy Testament, shown pride before Thee, disputed Thy right, denied Thy favor, and turned away from Thee

Subject: Covenant-breaking and Covenant-breakers
Quotation: Thereafter, He spoke at length about the Covenant-breakers and the followers of Yahya, saying that the enemies of the Cause encourage these people [...] and show them love and friendship so they might thereby create a breach in the Cause. When Siyyid Muhammad went to Istanbul, the Persian ambassador showed him great respect and seated him in the place of honor at gatherings, praising and commending him so that he would rise up against the Blessed Beauty. But when he achieved his purpose, he was the first to banish both him and Azal. Now this Mirza Muhammad-'Ali does not understand that these people who show him friendship and love are enemies of the Blessed Beauty, not my enemies. They say, Why do these people have such belief in the Blessed Beauty? and thus make him their instrument.

Subject: Covenant-breaking and Covenant-breakers
Quotation: O God! Heedless of this grievous trial and dire tribulation, friends too have arisen with the greatest malice, and entered upon the field of battle with darts and spears, with swords and spikes, training their arrows at Thine unarmed and defenseless servant. They believe, O Lord, that therein lieth success and salvation. They shall weep and lament for having failed in their duty towards God, for having violated His honour, broken His Covenant, reversed His standard, divided His Word, dispersed the assemblage of the Centre of His Covenant and scattered that which the hand of His bounty had gathered together. O God! They have taken Thy Covenant for a mockery and Thy Testament for a plaything; they have regarded Thine ascension as a propitious moment and the Centre of Thy Covenant as an object of ridicule.

Subject: Covenant-breaking and Covenant-breakers
Quotation: According to your command, you must act with great wisdom in this journey, and strong emphasis has been laid on this matter. God willing, this has been and will continue to be observed. Furthermore, among the incidents that have occurred is that two individuals and their sister in the Land of Sirr exhibited such behavior that, by God besides Whom there is no other God, the like of it has never been heard of in creation. When God forbade them from what they did, they turned away and objected until they denied God, the Master of the Day of Judgment. In all days and nights they engaged in what they were forbidden from. They mocked God's messengers and emissaries, and from them appeared that which caused the dwellers of Paradise and those who circle around thy Lord's throne, the Mighty, the Generous, to lament.

Subject: Covenant-breaking and Covenant-breakers
Quotation: Siyyid Ali-Akbar's papers of doubt which he sent to those regions - Abdu'l-Baha deems his papers unworthy of mention, for this person has developed a mental disturbance and cast himself into this pit of eternal degradation. In the blessed days he made a request which modesty prevents mentioning, but due to the authority of the Cause he retreated to the corner of silence and stillness. After the blessed Ascension he thought to raise another cry, and with this thought made a show of sacrificing his life in the path of the Covenant, sending and spreading those early letters affirming steadfastness in the Covenant. Then he revealed his true desire. Abdu'l-Baha responded that according to God's law this depends on the consent of both parties. In short, when his vain imaginings were not realized he became agitated and began writing such papers of doubt.

Subject: Covenant-breaking and Covenant-breakers
Quotation: That obtuse soul for many years imagined himself a herald of the Covenant and wrote treatises in his presumed proof, explicitly describing the Center of Violation as possessing all vices and counting him as a breaker of the Covenant. Shamelessly and brazenly he spoke and counted him as the croaker mentioned in the Book. For several years he passed his days thus until he made an unwelcome proposal, insisting with the utmost persistence and implying threats. And now all those papers exist in his own handwriting wherein he explicitly makes his request and threatens in case of non-acceptance. When he found himself disappointed and at a loss, he seized upon an excuse and raised a loud clamor. Among other things, the Center of Violation whom he used to disparage and vilify, he now glorifies and praises; and the Center of the Covenant whom he used to exalt and sanctify, he now disparages and declares an infidel.

Subject: Covenant-breaking and Covenant-breakers
Quotation: Despite these bounties and confirmations from the Kingdom to all horizons, the people of discord remain in an unbearable state of lethargy, crawling like insects in the corner of hatred, their eyes veiled from this universal light. Each day they circulate northern writings, raise howls and barks, make objections against the Center of the Covenant, and complain about the Pole Star of the zodiac of the Covenant and Testament. What foolishness is this, and what stupidity! What dullness is this, and what folly! Can it be possible that the lightning of the Morn of the Covenant could be concealed by such a cloud of discord, or that the lights of the Sun of the Covenant could be hidden by the ravings of those in the cradle? Far, far from it! The ocean of the Covenant will raise one wave and cast out these straws and twigs. Soon you will see these children fall into manifest loss and into what a well of humiliation and failure they will plunge.

Subject: Covenant-breaking and Covenant-breakers
Quotation: In this Manifest Cause and His mighty Announcement, twenty-five years ago in His Most Holy Book, which was the preserved Tablet of God and the Mother Book of the Lord, He clearly and conclusively explained the ancient and straight path and made evident its glorious proof. He left no partner or associate in this mighty Cause and manifest sovereignty, and for this extended period He nourished all His loved ones like suckling babes from this precious breast, and made clear and evident the mighty pillar. Then by the effects of the Most Exalted Pen, He took a covenant and made a solemn pledge with the Concourse of Creation, the denizens of the highest Paradise, and the dwellers of the holy pavilions behind the veils of eternity, that He would assist the steadfast with the hosts of the Abha Kingdom and protect the firm ones with legions of angels from the highest horizon, would make the violators captive to abasement and the waverers slaves of Satan.

Subject: Covenant-breaking and Covenant-breakers
Quotation: `Abduâ€™l-BahÃ¡ often used to say, â€œOne day, MÃ­rzÃ¡ Diyaâ€™uâ€™llah came to see me. I noticed he was looking at his fingers, which were stained with ink, expecting Me to comment on them. I did not say anything, so he volunteered the information, saying, â€˜Last night until the early hours of the morning, we were engaged in writing letters and gelatin printing. Consequently, my fingers are stained. My brother [MÃ­rzÃ¡ Muhammad-`AlÃ­] had written a letter, and we printed several copies and sent them away this morning.â€™ I asked him, â€˜Did you really write and dispatch them?â€™ And when he answered that he had, I said, 'I swear by the Righteousness of God! A day will come when MÃ­rzÃ¡ Muhammad-`AlÃ­ will wish that his fingers had been cut off so that he could not have taken the pen to proclaim his break with the Covenant. For four years, I have concealed this matter so that the beloved of God may not learn of your unfaithfulness to the Covenant. It is now beyond My power to hide it any longer. You have announced it yourselves to the believers.â€™â€

Subject: Covenant-breaking and Covenant-breakers
Quotation: That censured people's foundation is as a spider's web, their edifice built upon loose soil like the frailest of houses. Their drink is a mirage, their food from the Zaqqum tree on the Day of Reckoning. Their life is death, their refuge the source of afflictions. They are inexperienced children and those whose breath is cut off in sleep. Like foolish ones, they are proud of pottery, not pearl-filled shells; like dung beetles intoxicated with the stench of ash-heaps, not the fragrance of the perfumed rose-garden. They are earth-worms dwelling in the lowest depths, not birds of the highest heaven; bats of darkness, not light-diffusers of the manifest horizon. At every moment they bring forth some pretext, and like ravens of cruelty make their nests in the ash-heap of autumn. With blind eyes they cry out Where is the light? and with deaf ears they raise objecting cries against these melodies of the birds. They are in the lowest earthly plane yet wish to observe the shining moon; they are upside down in the pit of doubts yet seek to hear the evident verses. They are lost in the desert of uncertainty yet count themselves on the highway of certitude; they are wandering in the wilderness of ignorance yet consider themselves on the shore of the sea of assurance. They are violators of the Covenant yet call themselves the pole of all horizons; they are destroyers of the Testament yet deem themselves builders of its edifice.

Subject: Covenant-breaking and Covenant-breakers
Quotation: Now the respected believers in Khusf must stand firm like an immovable and solid foundation, so that Covenant-breaking in Khusf may be swallowed up and the banner of the Covenant may be raised high.

Subject: Covenant-breaking and Covenant-breakers
Quotation: The Covenant-breakers have no doubt about the Covenant, but personal motives have brought them to this point. It is not that they do not know - they know and still oppose. In any case, the ocean of the Covenant is undulating and at its widest expanse casts out the foam of differences.

Subject: Covenant-breaking and Covenant-breakers
Quotation: Moreover, is not that person's statement to you before the Ascension sufficient regarding the Center of violation - that he was a mirage with no reality, mere fancy? And his publications about him, his testimony to the loftiness and sublimity of the Cause of God, and his complete reversal afterwards - are these not sufficient proof? Now there exists, in that person's own handwriting, the utmost contempt and disparagement toward the source of vacillation, while expressing steadfastness and firmness in the highest degrees of belief in the Center of the Covenant.

Subject: Covenant-breaking and Covenant-breakers
Quotation: Confirm the people in the Covenant and warn them when thou findest in them the odor of violation

Subject: Covenant-breaking and Covenant-breakers
Quotation: The waverers will say: "Would that I were dust! Would that my mother had never borne me! Would that I had not violated the Covenant! Would that I had not opposed the Lord of Guidance! Would that I had not taken so-and-so as my friend!" Despite this, you must be the manifestation of the Most Merciful and respond to every soul with gentleness and utmost joy.

Subject: Covenant-breaking and Covenant-breakers
Quotation: O thou who art firm in the Covenant! The winds of tests are blowing from every direction, and the whirlwind of trials is uprooting the trees of human existence...For the Cause is mighty and the test is severe. The army of the violation of the Covenant will advance and attack the fortresses of weak souls, and the storm of wavering will encompass all

Subject: Covenant-breaking and Covenant-breakers
Quotation: Abdul-Baha said that he had seen the faces of the American believers and he was very glad--for their faces were radiant with the light of the Covenant of God, for the faces of those who violated the Covenant of God would appear veiled in darkness. "I pray to the Blessed Perfection that he will so turn their faces to the Covenant, that all America may be enlightened by the brightness of their light."

Subject: Crimson Ark; the Ark of God
Quotation: If thou art among the people of the Ark upon the ocean of grandeur

Subject: Crimson Ark; the Ark of God
Quotation: Verily he is one of the people of the Crimson Ark in the Presence of the Lord of the Greatest Throne.

Subject: Crimson Ark; the Ark of God
Quotation: O Holy Mariner! Bid thine ark of eternity appear before the Celestial Concourse, Launch it upon the ancient sea, in His Name, the Most Wondrous

Subject: Crimson Ark; the Ark of God
Quotation: This is the Most Great Glad-Tidings for the Concourse on High and the companions of the Crimson Ark and for whosoever is in the heavens and the earths.

Subject: Crimson Ark; the Ark of God
Quotation: Board the crimson ark in My Most Great and Most Exalted Name, then sail upon the ocean of grandeur that thou mayest be recorded among the people of Baha in the Mother Book.

Subject: Declaration of Baha'u'llah
Quotation: He resorted to every means and wrote in his own hand to Sultan Abdu'l-Aziz, requesting the Blessed Beauty's banishment from Baghdad, claiming that Iran was in danger, the government was apprehensive, and ultimately both states would suffer harm. Thus came Sultan Abdu'l-Aziz's decree, and the Blessed Beauty's departure was arranged. Although it was a matter of exile and banishment, He moved to Najib Pasha's garden with utmost authority. During those twelve days there, the Cause of God was so exalted that the Governor Namiq Pasha, all military and provincial officials, religious scholars, and notables of the nation would come day and night to attain His presence. Though it was ostensibly an exile, due to the penetrating influence of God's Cause in those few days, the exaltation of God's Word, and the diffusion of the divine fragrances, those days passed with such joy and delight that they became the Festival of Ridvan, and He departed with perfect sovereignty, to which all the people of Iraq bear witness.

Subject: Declaration of Baha'u'llah
Quotation: For twelve years We associated and consorted with the people of Iraq with perfect love, harmony and favor. At the time of Our departure from the house and arrival in the garden which was named Ridvan, most of the officials and notables of the government and country were grieved to witness it, and some of the princes wept. In truth, a new resurrection arose. From every soul radiated the light of love.

Subject: Declaration of Baha'u'llah
Quotation: The title of Baha'o'llah was given by himself. The Blessed Beauty gave the name 'Baha'o'llah' to himself and He wrote it to his holiness The Supreme (The Bab).

Subject: Declaration of Baha'u'llah
Quotation: In Baghdad He proclaimed himself as the One whom God would manifest, but Baha'o'llah was known to the believers (before this time) as the manifestation of Huseyn.

Subject: Declaration of Baha'u'llah
Quotation: "He hath come, He at Whose mention Paradise and the Most Exalted Garden were attracted."...This is He at Whose appearance the Books of the peoples bowed down in submission."

Subject: Declaration of Baha'u'llah
Quotation: That illumined Orb hath risen from the horizon of sanctity and holiness to shed Its Rays upon the expanse of the universe and that mysterious Beloved hath rent asunder the veil of concealment and appeared in the Assemblage of Humanity

Subject: Declaration of Baha'u'llah
Quotation: His Holiness, BAHA'O'LLAH, like unto the sun, shone forth from the horizon of the East and with radiating splendor He illumined the Orient. The light of that Sun of Reality consisted of heavenly teachings which were spread in the Orient

Subject: Declaration of Baha'u'llah
Quotation: This is the day when the Ancient Beauty moved toward another palace, despite those who denied the Day of Judgment - the Day in which the veils were rent asunder, the clouds were dispersed, and the lights of the Face appeared from this luminous horizon.

Subject: Declaration of Baha'u'llah
Quotation: This is the Day wherein that which lay hidden in God's knowledge, the Lord of the Day of Judgment, hath been made manifest, and wherein the Dove of Knowledge hath warbled upon the highest branches. The gate of heaven hath been opened, and the Lord of Names hath come with such authority as the hosts of earth and heaven cannot withstand.

Subject: Declaration of Baha'u'llah
Quotation: The Baha'o'llah stepped forth from his tent and explained the birth of a new cycle - that the horizons were flooded with new ideals - the antiquated laws were no longer valid - that a new revelation, a new light had come. He exhorted them to sacrifice themselves for it. From that moment the cause of Baha'o'llah leaped into a flaming torch.

Subject: Declaration of Baha'u'llah
Quotation: This was then the beginning of the memorable days of Rizwan. For twelve days He was in this garden. The Door of Meeting was open to all the inhabitants of Bagdad. The Clergy, the theologians, the noblemen, the poets, the Pashas, the laity, all those who came were ushered into His Divine Presence and listened to His Words. No one was sent away, not one soul was excluded.

Subject: Declaration of Baha'u'llah
Quotation: The Sun of the heaven of the Glorious Lord and the unique Light has risen from the horizon of the world with a world-illumining ray that brightened the infinite expanse of the material and spiritual realms and made the plane of contingency the envy of rose gardens and meadows. The cloud of January poured down, the spring breeze wafted, the light of truth shone forth, the glad tidings of attainment arrived, and the Blessed Beauty became the witness of the gathering.

Subject: Declaration; advent of the Bab
Quotation: The spirit of prayer which animates My soul is the direct consequence of a dream which I had in the year before the declaration of My Mission. When I awoke, I felt that the Spirit of God had permeated and taken possession of My soul. My heart was thrilled with the joy of His Divine presence, and the mysteries of His Revelation were unfolded before My eyes in all their glory.

Subject: Declaration; advent of the Bab
Quotation: The Bab was banished from Shiraz to the banks of the Araxes, but this exile was full of blessing

Subject: Declaration; advent of the Bab
Quotation: He was in the prime of youth, having completed twenty-five years of His blessed life, when He arose to proclaim His Cause.

Subject: Declaration; advent of the Bab
Quotation: Regarding what you wrote about the Day of the Declaration of the Bab (may my spirit be sacrificed for Him), it is recorded in the Questions and Answers that the Day of Perfection falls in the Month of Greatness

Subject: Declaration; advent of the Bab
Quotation: This day is a blessed day. Many Tablets have been revealed for this day by Baha'u'llah. The Blessed Beauty celebrated this day every year, for this day of the Bab's Declaration is the dawning of the advent of this Cause.

Subject: Declaration; advent of the Bab
Quotation: On the Day when God caused me to speak by His command, eight and twenty years had elapsed from my life, and three months save a few days. On that Day I was upon the mountain. This excludeth the time I spent in the womb, which God had ordained for me as nine months and nine days.

Subject: Declaration; advent of the Bab
Quotation: That which Mirza Abu'l-Fadl stated is proven by the Sacred Text. In the Ahsanu'l-Qisas, which is the first Book of the Bab, He addresses Siyyid Akbar. The Speaker is the Bab, and He says regarding who this Siyyid Akbar is: "By God the Truth! I am verily a Houri whom Baha gave birth to in a palace of moist crimson ruby" and "I and those who dwell in Paradise yearn for the soul who is martyred in His path."

Subject: Declaration; advent of the Bab
Quotation: "According to the text of the Religion of God and the irrefutable command, the fifth of Zamadi-Avval (May 23rd) is the day of the Declaration of His Highness the Supreme (the Bab)--may my life be a sacrifice to Him! Consequently, they must celebrate and adorn that Blessed Day in the name of the Declaration of that Orb of regions; make rejoicing and happiness, and impart the glad-tidings of heavenly beatitude to each other."

Subject: East and West; communication between East and West
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/East and West; communication between East and West.txt
Quotation: I, a Persian, am delighted to meet an eminent Westerner like you in utmost harmony and fellowship. This meeting of ours is an example of the joining of the East and the West.

Subject: East and West; communication between East and West
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/East and West; communication between East and West.txt
Quotation: This interaction and cooperation between the East and the West is a sufficient and irrefutable proof of attaining unto this blessed goal.

Subject: East and West; communication between East and West
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/East and West; communication between East and West.txt
Quotation: Baha'o'llah brings East and West together. Go back, search history, you will not find a precedent for this.

Subject: East and West; communication between East and West
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/East and West; communication between East and West.txt
Quotation: Now if the believers were to travel and give glad tidings to the friends and stay a night or two in each place and share the news of the Holy Land and other parts of the East and West with the people of that place and associate with them with the utmost happiness, joy and love, the result will be enkindlement and attraction. Souls will be trained and become stirred and enraptured and all this will encourage the diffusion of spiritual fragrances and raise of the Word of God in every land.

Subject: East and West; communication between East and West
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/East and West; communication between East and West.txt
Quotation: Shed splendours on the Orient, And perfumes scatter in the West, Carry light unto the Slav, And the Turk with life invest

Subject: East and West; communication between East and West
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/East and West; communication between East and West.txt
Quotation: Soon this will cause a great connection to be established between East and West.

Subject: East and West; communication between East and West
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/East and West; communication between East and West.txt
Quotation: unity of the East and West... Lord Curzon's talks regarding the unity of East and West

Subject: East and West; communication between East and West
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/East and West; communication between East and West.txt
Quotation: It shall become the tree of the unity of the human world and cast its shadow over both East and West.

Subject: East and West; communication between East and West
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/East and West; communication between East and West.txt
Quotation: Baha'o'llah established Christ in the East...Throughout the Orient Bahais have illumined the lamp of Christ

Subject: East and West; communication between East and West
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/East and West; communication between East and West.txt
Quotation: Thy letter was received, and the copy of the message from the friends in the West to the loved ones in the East was perused.

Subject: East and West; communication between East and West
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/East and West; communication between East and West.txt
Quotation: The East and the West have embraced, distant lands have drawn near, and all on earth have become even as a single assemblage.

Subject: East and West; communication between East and West
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/East and West; communication between East and West.txt
Quotation: I want the misunderstanding between Eastern and Western peoples to be removed so we may all find complete love for each other

Subject: East and West; communication between East and West
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/East and West; communication between East and West.txt
Quotation: Regarding travel to Iran, if possible beneficial results will be achieved and it will be a cause of connection and commingling between East and West.

Subject: East and West; communication between East and West
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/East and West; communication between East and West.txt
Quotation: Now we have a glorious purpose before us and a mighty goal in our hearts, which is that the horizons be illumined with the light of harmony, and that East and West embrace like two beloved ones.

Subject: East and West; communication between East and West
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/East and West; communication between East and West.txt
Quotation: By its power and strength it hath conquered the East and the West. The East proclaimeth: 'Sanctified be Our Lord the Most Exalted One!' The West declareth: 'Sanctified be Our Lord the All-Glorious!'

Subject: East and West; communication between East and West
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/East and West; communication between East and West.txt
Quotation: Now, praised be God, the light of love hath spread in both East and West, and the tabernacle of fellowship amongst hearts and souls is raised in the midmost heart of the world. The teachings of Baha'u'llah have been spread in the East and the West, the fame of the Kingdom hath encompassed the earth, and the tidings of the world’s Great Peace have created tumult in the realm of the hearts.... It is because the East and the West are illumined by the one sun, all races, nations and creeds are the servants of the one God. The whole earth is one home, and all the people are bathed in the ocean of God's mercy.

Subject: East and West; communication between East and West
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/East and West; communication between East and West.txt
Quotation: The world-illuminating Sun is turning toward the West, while this servant gazes toward the East...Though we are people of the West, yet in intelligence, knowledge, freedom and wisdom we are leaders over the people of the East.

Subject: East and West; communication between East and West
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/East and West; communication between East and West.txt
Quotation: The East and the West are becoming one and showing the signs of Unity and Love. The hopes of Baha'o'llah are that there be no more separation or discord, for ye are all the waves of one sea, the birds in one heaven and mirrors of the same Bounty.

Subject: East and West; communication between East and West
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/East and West; communication between East and West.txt
Quotation: I fervently hope that the same self-sacrifice, spiritual attraction, and the flame enkindled in the heart and soul will be manifested in the regions of the occident, so that the East and the West may embrace each other, may be filled with blissful rapture, and that divine light may illuminate and enlighten the whole world.

Subject: East and West; communication between East and West
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/East and West; communication between East and West.txt
Quotation: This is a very joyous evening, an evidence in itself of the possibility of uniting the East and the West -- an eastern man appearing before an assemblage of reverent western people. The East and West, the Orient and Occident, shall be united. The Orient and Occident will be conjoined, and the banner of international peace will be unfurled.

Subject: East and West; communication between East and West
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/East and West; communication between East and West.txt
Quotation: The East and the West must unite to give to each other what is lacking. This union will bring about a true civilization, where the spiritual is expressed and carried out in the material. We must pray that by the Bounty of God, Persia will be enabled to receive the material and mental civilization of the West, and by Divine Grace to give in return her spiritual light.

Subject: East and West; communication between East and West
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/East and West; communication between East and West.txt
Quotation: The Occident on the contrary is the place of expansion. The West applies and solidifies that which the East suggests. It gives physical form and shape to the ideals of the East. Yet the Word of Christ has been developed in the West. It was the Occident which unfolded the teaching of Christ into a great civilization, which shows how wonderful was the Word of Christ, and how wonderful is the West.

Subject: East and West; communication between East and West
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/East and West; communication between East and West.txt
Quotation: The feeling that existed between the East and the West is changing in the Light of Baha'o'llah's teaching. It used to be that if a Westerner drank from the cup of an Easterner the cup would be thought polluted, and the Easterner would break it. Now it is, with believers, that when a Westerner dines with an Easterner, the vessels and the plates that he has used are kept apart and reverenced in his memory.

Subject: East and West; communication between East and West
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/East and West; communication between East and West.txt
Quotation: All speak in praise of the East, its illumination, its nations, its parties, its kings and its ministers. They look upon them with admiration and show them true respect, after having previously ridiculed them and looked upon them with contempt, believing the nations of the East to be the barbarians of the earth, devoid of intelligence - mere rabble without opinion, reason, determination or understanding. Now the situation has reversed.

Subject: East and West; communication between East and West
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/East and West; communication between East and West.txt
Quotation: The Orient is the germinating place for the soul. It is here that the Breeze of God is felt. Here Moses' Law was given, here Christ's Word was spoken, here Mohammed's banner was flung to the air. The Breeze of God is no longer felt in the West. Its power is stilled, while in the East it is again forceful, fragrant, alive. Once more the West must receive the Breeze of God from the East. It cannot be stayed or hindered, it will blow from the East to the West.

Subject: East and West; communication between East and West
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/East and West; communication between East and West.txt
Quotation: This is the dawn of the light of unity between the Eastern and Western people. In Persia the English language is being studied widely and in America the Persian tongue is beloved by some dear souls. In both countries the respective languages are being studied. This is in itself a proof that the East and West (literally, place of sunrise and sunset) shall clasp hands as two families. The standard of unity shall be raised, and the means of love and friendship will be accomplished.

Subject: East and West; communication between East and West
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/East and West; communication between East and West.txt
Quotation: An Oriental personage, having come from the most remote part of the Orient, were he to inhale the fragrances which are wafting from the distant parts of the West, he would say: "How fragrant are they! Evidently the rose garden of the West is most beautiful...Most magnificent flowers have become apparent therein. Variegated flowers can be seen there. White flowers have grown in it; colored flowers have grown in it; red flowers can be seen in it; and yellow flowers can be seen in it, and all of these together are in the utmost of freshness and verdure, and each lends a charm and harmony to the others."

Subject: East and West; communication between East and West
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/East and West; communication between East and West.txt
Quotation: This book [Some Answered Questions] hath been written for the people of the West, not for the divines. For the divines, the Fara'id is most suitable. This book hath been penned for the Europeans, and the discourse therein hath been fashioned according to their disposition, as though spoken at their table. The divines have their own disposition, the mystics have theirs, and likewise the Christians, Zoroastrians and Jews have theirs. This Cause embraceth the aspirations of all souls. It is for the spiritualists, the theosophists and all the peoples of the world, that they might have no argument before God. The Cause must needs be all-embracing, that every afflicted one may find therein his remedy - a divine elixir. The metaphysical concepts of Mulla Sadra and Muhyi'd-Din are largely fanciful. For instance, the concept of the Universal Spirit is but fancy and imagination, not reality. For example, Mulla Sadra's ten intellects were derived from the idol-worshipping Greek philosophers. When Aristotle would go forth with Alexander, they would carry nine idols before him. These ten intellects are Aristotle's concept. For example, [he says] motion is of two kinds: forced motion and circular motion. Circular motion is evidence of will. Since we observe circular motion in these spheres, they possess will, and therefore in these spheres there exists an intellectual force which is the governing force of that sphere. In each of the spheres there is an intellectual force which is the source and governor of that sphere. There are eight spheres, each containing one intellect, comprising the eight intellects, and in the ninth sphere there is an intellect under whose shadow all others exist. There is one Supreme Intellect governing all in the tenth sphere. This is but imagination. Now it is known that all motion is forced motion. This sun is compelled to move, even these other spheres are compelled to move. All motion is forced, not volitional. Man is distinguished from all created things; nature - all things are its captive. The sun, for all its greatness, is its captive. But man, whose body is so small, God hath created within him a sacred power that can break the laws of nature. Speaking of the philosophers, they said: What hath illuminative philosophy accomplished in all this time? It could not produce even a match or a needle. It is all talk. But observe how natural philosophy hath yielded the telegraph, the steam engine, electricity and so forth. For instance, had Murtada applied in mathematics the same careful study he devoted to jurisprudence, what discoveries he would have made! The first intellect influenced the second - the fish rotteth from the head, not the tail. There is no circular motion; that connecting force that exists between all created things is one single motion. From the first day of Mulla Sadra until this day, what result hath been achieved? Man must strive in matters that give him life. What [use] are matters that cause lethargy and lifelessness?

Subject: God as immanent vs. transcendent reality
Quotation: Nothing can comprehend Him, but He comprehendeth all things by His command. There is no God but Him, the Mighty, the Exalted.

Subject: God as immanent vs. transcendent reality
Quotation: The (Holy) Spirit is encompassing and surrounding all. It is present everywhere and at every time. It exists in all places, yet is placeless.

Subject: God as immanent vs. transcendent reality
Quotation: Verily God is near in His remoteness and remote in His nearness. Will ye not stand in awe? Say: Were there an atom in a rock beneath the seventh sea, verily God would know it and would be nearer to it than itself, and would know its secret and its whisper and its beginning.

Subject: God as immanent vs. transcendent reality
Quotation: Say: God manifesteth Himself through all things, if ye would but see. Say: God is nearer than all things, if ye would but witness. Say: God is more hidden than all things, if ye would but perceive.

Subject: God as immanent vs. transcendent reality
Quotation: The essence of God is not a body like water to be contained within the body of the earthen bowl - man - a body within a body...it has not left its transcendent station in order to find an entrance into the mirror, but it is ever stationed in its own center of grandeur and perpetuity.

Subject: God as immanent vs. transcendent reality
Quotation: The ancient philosophers of Greece, Persia, and Egypt believed that God manifested in material things His final and supreme Reality. This supreme reality has been likened to the water of the sea, and material things to its waves. This view of the universe is wrong. Because the One is perfect, while all material things are imperfect.

Subject: God as immanent vs. transcendent reality
Quotation: The Prophets, however, hold that there is the world of God, the world of the Kingdom, and the world of creation: three things. The first emanation is the outpouring grace of the Kingdom, which has emanated from God and has appeared in the realities of all things, even as the rays emanating from the sun are reflected in all things. And that grace--the rays--appears in infinite forms in the realities of all things, and is specified and individuated according to their capacity, receptivity, and essence.

Subject: God as personal vs. impersonal reality
Quotation: One day at table, he [Sutherland Maxwell] said to 'Abdu'l-Baha: The Christians worship God through Christ; my wife worships God through You; but I worship Him direct. 'Abdu'l-Baha smiled and said: Where is He? Why, God is everywhere, replied Sutherland. Everywhere is nowhere, said 'Abdu'l-Baha.

Subject: God's love for His own Essence
Quotation: He is the Describer of Himself and the Praiser of Himself. He hath no need for mention by anyone. His is the creation and the command, and He is the Mighty, the All-Choosing.

Subject: God's love for His own Essence
Quotation: In every condition Thou dost unify Thine own Essence through Thine Essence, and at every moment Thou dost magnify Thine eternity through Thine eternity, for all that appeareth from contingent beings is as naught before Thee, and whatsoever cometh from created things befitteth not the majesty of Thy holiness.

Subject: God's love for His own Essence
Quotation: The Purpose of the world is worthy of mention, but what manner of mention should it be and from whom should it come? There has never been any doubt that mention other than His own is not befitting Him as it should be. Thereby it is established that His mention is acceptable only unto Himself and His utterance is befitting only unto His Essence.

Subject: God's oneness [ahadiyyih and wahidiyyih]
Quotation: That which ye imagine to be the unity of God is but fancy - profess not His unity except with certainty. This is the Tree of Affirmation - take shelter in its shade that your profession of unity may be raised unto God.

Subject: God's oneness [ahadiyyih and wahidiyyih]
Quotation: So that all may acknowledge His oneness and confess His unity, and all may attain unto every good through recognition of His oneness, and all may achieve every excellence through confession of His unity.

Subject: God's oneness [ahadiyyih and wahidiyyih]
Quotation: Say: There is none other God but Me, the All-Knowing, the All-Wise

Subject: God's oneness [ahadiyyih and wahidiyyih]
Quotation: May Mr. Haji Muhammad Ibrahim have hope in the grace of the Lord of Oneness.

Subject: God's oneness [ahadiyyih and wahidiyyih]
Quotation: Glorified art Thou, O God! Thou art the God besides Whom there is none other God.

Subject: God's oneness [ahadiyyih and wahidiyyih]
Quotation: The servant doth witness, and will continue to witness, that there is none other God but Him.

Subject: God's oneness [ahadiyyih and wahidiyyih]
Quotation: God bears witness that there is no God but Him... maintaining justice; there is no God but Him

Subject: God's oneness [ahadiyyih and wahidiyyih]
Quotation: by Thy Name through which the pavilion of polytheism was destroyed and the canopy of divine unity was raised up

Subject: God's oneness [ahadiyyih and wahidiyyih]
Quotation: There is none other God but God... God beareth witness that there is none other God but Him, before and hereafter

Subject: God's oneness [ahadiyyih and wahidiyyih]
Quotation: I testify that Thou art God, there is none other God but Thee...acknowledging Thy oneness and confessing Thy singleness

Subject: God's oneness [ahadiyyih and wahidiyyih]
Quotation: Say: God hath ever been one God, Single, Eternal, Self-Subsisting, Living, the Self-Sustaining, and there was none with Him.

Subject: God's oneness [ahadiyyih and wahidiyyih]
Quotation: the King of Your Oneness...the Presence of Your Singleness...the Beauty of Your Unity...the Kingdom of Your Self-Subsistence

Subject: God's oneness [ahadiyyih and wahidiyyih]
Quotation: The first matter that leads to faith, certitude, sanctification and detachment is My oneness, free from all peers and equals.

Subject: God's oneness [ahadiyyih and wahidiyyih]
Quotation: There shalt thou see what thou lovest - thou shalt love none save God. Is it not enough that thy Lord encompasseth all things?

Subject: God's oneness [ahadiyyih and wahidiyyih]
Quotation: Say: Your God is one God, Lord of the heavens and Lord of the earth and whatsoever is between them, Lord of the East and of the West.

Subject: God's oneness [ahadiyyih and wahidiyyih]
Quotation: and the Peacock of the Paradise of Oneness utters its cry with holy eternality's might...and the Cock of Glorification sings in the gardens of Divine Unity

Subject: God's oneness [ahadiyyih and wahidiyyih]
Quotation: The Rose-garden of Unity was ornamented, and the Flower-bed of singleness was arrayed. The Feast of the Bounties was celebrated, and the Banquet of Eternity was spread.

Subject: God's oneness [ahadiyyih and wahidiyyih]
Quotation: Worship none but God, the Lord of the heavens and the Lord of the earth, the Lord of all worlds, Who created all things by His command, and unto Him is the final return.

Subject: God's oneness [ahadiyyih and wahidiyyih]
Quotation: acknowledgment of "the oneness of God and His singleness, and that He is the First and the Last, the Manifest and the Hidden. There is no God but Him, the Single, the One"

Subject: God's oneness [ahadiyyih and wahidiyyih]
Quotation: God beareth witness that there is none other God but Him. That is the Lord of all worlds. God beareth witness that there is none other God but Him, the Mighty, the All-Wise.

Subject: God's oneness [ahadiyyih and wahidiyyih]
Quotation: The essence of the question of unity is this: The Sun of Truth has shone forth from the horizon of oneness upon all regions. All created things are made manifest through the light of that Sun.

Subject: God's oneness [ahadiyyih and wahidiyyih]
Quotation: Say: Unity is the recognition of a Self that is sanctified above all who are in the world and exalted beyond the conditions of created things. Verily He is the One besides Whom there can be no numbers

Subject: God's oneness [ahadiyyih and wahidiyyih]
Quotation: Thou hast taken unto Thyself neither consort nor son, nor hast Thou been associated with aught in the kingdom of earth and heaven. Thou hast numbered all things and encompassed all things in Thy knowledge.

Subject: God's oneness [ahadiyyih and wahidiyyih]
Quotation: ...from your words wafted the fragrance of the oneness of God, the Mighty, the Praiseworthy... We testify that he has testified to the oneness of God, His singleness, His might, His greatness and His sovereignty.

Subject: God's oneness [ahadiyyih and wahidiyyih]
Quotation: Thou, Thou art our Lord! Send down upon this one who seeketh refuge at the gate of Thy oneness, from the outpourings of the heaven of Thy glorious unity, and attract him through the holy fragrances of Thy singleness.

Subject: God's oneness [ahadiyyih and wahidiyyih]
Quotation: To God belong the uniqueness of the heavens and the earth and whatsoever is between them, and God is possessed of subtle oneness. His is whatsoever appears by night and by day, and He is the Single One, the All-Subtle.

Subject: God's oneness [ahadiyyih and wahidiyyih]
Quotation: Thou art One besides Whom there is none other God, and none among Thy servants can bear witness to this truth. From everlasting Thou hast had no equal, no likeness, no peer, no companion, no similitude, and no associate.

Subject: God's oneness [ahadiyyih and wahidiyyih]
Quotation: True spiritual oneness consists in acknowledging and confessing the unity of God, exalted be His glory, sanctifying His Essence from all likeness and purifying His Being from all similitudes. This has ever been and shall ever be the case.

Subject: God's oneness [ahadiyyih and wahidiyyih]
Quotation: Such is God, your Lord. His is the creation and the command. There is none other God but He, the Most High, the Most Great. Such is God, your Lord. His is the creation and the command. There is none other God but He, the Mighty, the Well-Beloved.

Subject: God's oneness [ahadiyyih and wahidiyyih]
Quotation: Glorified be He in Whose grasp is the dominion of the oneness of the heavens and the earth and whatsoever is between them! Glorified be He in Whose grasp is the dominion of the uniqueness of the heavens and the earth and whatsoever is between them!

Subject: God's oneness [ahadiyyih and wahidiyyih]
Quotation: God beareth witness that there is none other God but Him. Say: All testify to His oneness. God beareth witness that there is none other God but Him. Say: All magnify Him. God beareth witness that there is none other God but Him. Say: All extol His greatness.

Subject: God's oneness [ahadiyyih and wahidiyyih]
Quotation: "There is no God but I, Who created all contingent things from nothing through My Will, and brought all beings into existence from naught through My Purpose. I am the One with power over whatsoever I desire, and I am the All-Encompassing, the Self-Subsisting."

Subject: God's oneness [ahadiyyih and wahidiyyih]
Quotation: O my God! I beseech Thee by the most resplendent of Thy Oneness, though all Thy Oneness is resplendent with Thee, then in the Mother Book, O my God! I beseech Thee by all Thy Oneness... We shall assuredly cause to descend, O God, Thy light upon the Tree of Oneness

Subject: God's oneness [ahadiyyih and wahidiyyih]
Quotation: This is the Day wherein the Mystery of Divine Unity hath proclaimed: The Kingdom belongeth unto God, the One, the All-Powerful, the All-Choosing. With Him did the Day begin and with Him shall it end, and from Him have the lights appeared and unto Him have they returned.

Subject: God's oneness [ahadiyyih and wahidiyyih]
Quotation: God beareth witness that there is none other God but Him. Say: All are submissive unto Him. God beareth witness that there is none other God but Him. Say: All prostrate themselves before Him. God beareth witness that there is none other God but Him. Say: All worship Him.

Subject: God's oneness [ahadiyyih and wahidiyyih]
Quotation: Say: God is the Creator of all things, and verily unto Him do all turn. Say: God is the Provider of all things, and verily unto Him shall all be raised up. Say: God causeth you to die, then giveth you life, then will He raise you up on a Day about which there is no doubt.

Subject: God's oneness [ahadiyyih and wahidiyyih]
Quotation: Extinguished be the spirits that recognize not the Sovereign of Thy holy Oneness, and abolished be the bodies that prostrate not before the Monarch of Thy Unity. Glory be unto Thee! Glory be unto Thee from my heart turning to any but Thee or to one whose heart turneth to aught else but Thee!

Subject: God's oneness [ahadiyyih and wahidiyyih]
Quotation: If thou seekest the essence of numbers, lay hold of the hem of the True One, for all numbers are impotent and deficient, but the True One is the Doer, the Powerful, and the Penetrating. As far as thou art able, reveal among the peoples the mysteries of the True One, which is the eternal bounty

Subject: God's oneness [ahadiyyih and wahidiyyih]
Quotation: Through the manifestation of Thy oneness and the proclamation of Thy uniqueness, I shall reach those who have not recognized Thy unity, though they claim to be among the guides to Thy oneness and witnesses to the proofs of Thy sanctity. Thou hast ever been the One God, Single, Eternal, Self-Subsisting.

Subject: God's oneness [ahadiyyih and wahidiyyih]
Quotation: Glory be unto Thee! There is no God but Thee. I have known Thee through Thee alone. There is no God but Thee. Glory be unto Thee! There is no God but Thee. I have affirmed Thy unity through Thee alone. There is no God but Thee. Glory be unto Thee! There is no God but Thee. I have loved Thee through Thee alone.

Subject: God's oneness [ahadiyyih and wahidiyyih]
Quotation: O Ali-Qabl-i-Akbar! We hope that thou mayest be illumined with the true light of divine unity and not ascribe any likeness or peer unto God, glorified be His majesty. Glory be to God! Those who considered themselves steadfast, learned and wise are found to be somewhat tainted with idle fancies and vain imaginings.

Subject: God's oneness [ahadiyyih and wahidiyyih]
Quotation: The ocean of oneness hath surged... Bear thou witness unto that whereunto God hath testified in this most exalted Station, this most sublime Summit, and this most glorious Horizon, that there is none other God but Him, the Single, the One, the All-Powerful, the All-Compelling over what hath been and what shall be.

Subject: God's oneness [ahadiyyih and wahidiyyih]
Quotation: He is the One, matchless in numerical calculation... He is the One Who hath borne witness unto His own Self by His own Self, and Who is sanctified from association with aught else through the loftiness of His names and attributes. He beareth witness that there is none other God but Him, and all are His worshippers.

Subject: God's oneness [ahadiyyih and wahidiyyih]
Quotation: Glory be unto Thee, O my God! I bear witness, and all things bear witness, that Thou art God, there is no God but Thee. Thou hast ever been the One God, Single, Self-Subsisting, Eternal, the All-Wise, the Just, the Holy. Thou hast taken neither consort nor son, and Thou hast no partner in Thy creation, nor any helper in what Thou hast fashioned.

Subject: God's oneness [ahadiyyih and wahidiyyih]
Quotation: The deluded one is concealed yet not hidden, for He made it an established word of four parts together, none of which precedes another. He revealed three of them as Names due to creation's need for them, and concealed one of them - the Hidden and Treasured Name. These Names are pillars and veils of the One Hidden and Treasured Name through these three Names.

Subject: God's oneness [ahadiyyih and wahidiyyih]
Quotation: Say: God is the First of all firsts, if ye be of them that glorify. Say: God is the Last of all lasts, if ye be of them that praise His remembrance. Say: God is the Manifest of all that is manifest, if ye be of them that testify to His oneness through His remembrance. Say: God is the Hidden of all that is hidden, if ye be of them that magnify His remembrance.

Subject: God's oneness [ahadiyyih and wahidiyyih]
Quotation: acknowledging that which the tongue of Thy grandeur hath spoken when Thou didst establish Thyself upon the throne by Thy command and will - that Thou art God, Who hath ever been One, Single, Alone, Self-Subsisting, and will forever remain as Thou hast been. There is none other God but Thee, the Self-Sufficient, the Most Exalted, the Ruler of the beginning and the end

Subject: God's oneness [ahadiyyih and wahidiyyih]
Quotation: Thou hast ever been alone in the heights of oneness, sanctified in the exaltation of Thy unity, inaccessible in Thine own sovereignty, and elevated in the sublimity of Thy holy dominion. Thou hast ever been one God, single, individual, ever-living, self-subsisting. Thou hast taken neither consort nor son, and Thou hast had no partner in dominion nor any helper in command.

Subject: God's oneness [ahadiyyih and wahidiyyih]
Quotation: Consider the relation between the craftsman and his handiwork, between the painter and his painting. Can it ever be maintained that the work their hands have produced is the same as themselves? By Him Who is the Lord of the Throne above and of earth below! They can be regarded in no other light except as evidences that proclaim the excellence and perfection of their author.

Subject: God's oneness [ahadiyyih and wahidiyyih]
Quotation: All who adore Thy unity have been sore perplexed to fathom the mystery of Thy oneness, and all have confessed their powerlessness to attain unto the comprehension of Thine essence and to scale the pinnacle of Thy knowledge. From everlasting Thou has been alone with no one else beside Thee, and to everlasting Thou wilt continue to be one and the same. No God is there beside Thee, the God of power, of glory and wisdom.

Subject: God's oneness [ahadiyyih and wahidiyyih]
Quotation: For at the mention of aught else but Thee, how can Thy unity be established, and in the presence of Thy creation, how can Thy singleness be veiled? Thou hast ever been one God, Single, Alone, Self-Subsisting, Ever-Living, Self-Subsisting, All-Wise, Just, Holy, Eternal, Self-Dependent. Thou hast taken unto Thyself neither consort nor son, and Thou hast no partner in what Thou hast fashioned, nor any helper in what Thou hast decreed.

Subject: God's oneness [ahadiyyih and wahidiyyih]
Quotation: Say: From all eternity there hath been and shall be but one Divine Unity, for in names there appeareth naught but the Named One Himself, even as thou sayest there is no sun but the true Sun, shouldst thou observe. Yet consider thou the degrees of unity in relation to the degrees of names and attributes, for in the presence of every true soul that which is contrary to it hath been and shall be negated, and unto God is the journey's end.

Subject: God's oneness [ahadiyyih and wahidiyyih]
Quotation: God testifieth that there is no God but Him, the King, the Sovereign of sovereigns. In the First Gate hath been ordained the mention of His own Self unto His own Self. There is no God but Him. His are the most excellent Names. All that are in the heavens and on earth and whatsoever lieth between them glorify Him, and all within the kingdoms of Command and Creation and whatsoever lieth between them bow down before Him. All are His servants and all bow down before Him.

Subject: God's oneness [ahadiyyih and wahidiyyih]
Quotation: God beareth witness that there is none other God but Him. Say: All glorify Him. God beareth witness that there is none other God but Him. Say: All proclaim His oneness. God beareth witness that there is none other God but Him. Say: All sanctify Him. God beareth witness that there is none other God but Him. Say: All exalt Him. God beareth witness that there is none other God but Him. Say: All magnify Him. God beareth witness that there is none other God but Him. Say: All give thanks unto God, their Lord, the Most Merciful, and in His remembrance do they praise Him.

Subject: God's oneness [ahadiyyih and wahidiyyih]
Quotation: O God! I beseech Thee by the sovereignty wherein Thou art unique... O First One in Thy uniqueness... O Most Glorious in Thy uniqueness... O Most Majestic in Thy uniqueness... O Most Exalted in Thy uniqueness... O Single One in Thy uniqueness... O Most High in Thy uniqueness... O All-Sufficient in Thy uniqueness... O Possessor of Majesty in Thy uniqueness... O Creator in Thy uniqueness... O King in Thy uniqueness... O Light-Giver in Thy uniqueness... O Almighty in Thy uniqueness... O Manifest One in Thy uniqueness... O Most High in Thy uniqueness... O All-Knowing in Thy uniqueness... O Most Great in Thy uniqueness... O Most Wondrous in Thy uniqueness

Subject: Greatest Name
Quotation: "except through the power of the Greatest Name and the hosts that ye cannot see"

Subject: Greatest Name
Quotation: Be thou known for thy love of thy Lord and for giving voice to this Great Name... I beseech Thee by Thy Most Great Name

Subject: Greatest Name
Quotation: All praise be to God Who hath exalted His verses in His glorious Book, and He is God, the Ever-Watchful over all things.

Subject: Greatest Name
Quotation: "However, today the cry of the Supreme Concourse is "Allah-u-Abha" and the spirit of this servant is stirred by this call."

Subject: Greatest Name
Quotation: This is the power of the Greatest Name that makes the great ones conquered by little children and renowned hawks subdued by lowly mosquitoes.

Subject: Greatest Name
Quotation: the influences of the Most Great Name will become so manifest in the soul and consciousness, even in bone and flesh, that the mind will be bewildered and confounded.

Subject: Greatest Name
Quotation: The mention of the name of Baha'u'llah is the cause of the expansion of hearts and the joy of spirits, from whatever tongue thou hearest it, but it does not become a personal name.

Subject: Greatest Name
Quotation: This revered name was, in the Dispensation of the Furqan, a banner raised for the Wronged One who was honored, and in this Dispensation it is the first element of the Greatest Name.

Subject: Greatest Name
Quotation: Write thou that these verses are the Most Great Name, which if God should place it upon a mountain, He would make it Sinai, and if upon the earth, He would make it the Sacred House through His command.

Subject: Greatest Name
Quotation: Verily the Most Great Name consisteth of four elements if ye but knew: To believe in God and His signs, then in the Prophet and those who are witnesses after Him, then in the Gates of Guidance. Thus have ye fulfilled the command of God and discovered the Most Great Name.

Subject: Greatest Name
Quotation: This sovereign remedy is none other than the love of the Blessed Beauty and His Sacred Dispensation ordained by the One True God for it will speedily restore true health. This patent medicine is the Love of the Greatest Name because it embraces all the perfections and conditions of existence.

Subject: Greatest Name
Quotation: To those possessed of insight it is clear and evident that the station of the mention of the Most Great Name must be at the beginning, for it precedes all names and is the source and dawning-place of all remembrance...Blessed art thou for having adorned thy letter with this Name, through which the limbs of the divines trembled and the hearts of the ecclesiastics were troubled

Subject: Greatest Name
Quotation: The Most Great Names and the One possessed of Supreme Might, and the One endowed with Purpose in all things, and the One with All-Conquering Dominion, and the One with Far-Reaching Power, and the One whose Word is Well-Pleasing, and the One with Unshakeable Proofs, and the One with Everlasting Sovereignty, and the One with Glorious Dominion, and the One with Exalted Grace, and the One with Lofty Praise

Subject: Greatest Name
Quotation: This is the Name which, were God to place it upon that mountain, would make it Sinai, and were God to send it down upon the land wherein thou wast born, would make it a House - a House of security for all the worlds, for those who believe in God and His signs and who circle round about it. This is the Name which, were God to send it down upon Muhammad, would make him a Messenger, and were God to send it down upon Ali, would make him an Imam from His presence, then upon those who are witnesses after him as Letters of Truth from His presence, then upon all things to make them God's creation.

Subject: Greek philosophers; Greek civilization
Quotation: The first person who devoted himself to philosophy was Idris. Thus was he named. Some called him also Hermes. In every tongue he hath a special name. He it is who hath set forth in every branch of philosophy thorough and convincing statements. After him Balinus derived his knowledge and sciences from the Hermetic Tablets and most of the philosophers who followed him made their philosophical and scientific discoveries from his words and statements...' In the Qur'an, Sura 19, verses 57 and 58, is written: 'And commemorate Idris in the Book; for he was a man of truth, a Prophet; And we uplifted him to a place on high.'

Subject: Greek philosophers; Greek civilization
Quotation: Even Plato at first proved through rational arguments the immobility of the earth and the movement of the sun, and then subsequently established, again through rational arguments, the centrality of the sun and the movement of the earth. The Ptolemaic theory became widespread and Plato's theory was entirely forgotten until a modern astronomer revived it.

Subject: Greek philosophers; Greek civilization
Quotation: The sages aforetime acquired their knowledge from the Prophets, inasmuch as the latter were the Exponents of divine philosophy and the Revealers of heavenly mysteries. Men quaffed the crystal, living waters of Their utterance, while others satisfied themselves with the dregs.... Empedocles, who distinguished himself in philosophy, was a contemporary of David, while Pythagoras lived in the days of Solomon, son of David, and acquired Wisdom from the treasury of prophethood. It is he who claimed to have heard the whispering sound of the heavens and to have attained the station of the angels.... Consider Hippocrates, the physician. He was one of the eminent philosophers who believed in God and acknowledged His sovereignty. After him came Socrates who was indeed, wise, accomplished and righteous. He practised self-denial, repressed his appetites for selfish desires and turned away from material pleasures. He withdrew to the mountains where he dwelt in a cave. He dissuaded men from worshipping idols and taught them the way of God, the Lord of Mercy, until the ignorant rose up against him. They arrested him and put him to death in prison. Thus relateth to thee this swift-moving Pen. What a penetrating vision into philosophy this eminent man had! He is the most distinguished of all philosophers and was highly versed in wisdom. We testify that he is one of the heroes in this field and an outstanding champion dedicated unto it. He had a profound knowledge of such sciences as were current amongst men as well as of those which were veiled from their minds. Methinks he drank one draught when the Most Great Ocean overflowed with gleaming and life-giving waters. He it is who perceived a unique, a tempered, and a pervasive nature in things, bearing the closest likeness to the human spirit, and he discovered this nature to be distinct from the substance of things in their refined form. He hath a special pronouncement on this weighty theme. Wert thou to ask from the worldly wise of this generation about this exposition, thou wouldst witness their incapacity to grasp it. Verily, thy Lord speaketh the truth but most people comprehend not. After Socrates came the divine Plato who was a pupil of the former and occupied the chair of philosophy as his successor. He acknowledged his belief in God and in His signs which pervade all that hath been and shall be. Then came Aristotle, the well-known man of knowledge. He it is who discovered the power of gaseous matter. These men who stand out as leaders of the people and are pre-eminent among them, one and all acknowledged their belief in the immortal Being Who holdeth in His grasp the reins of all sciences.

Subject: Greek philosophers; Greek civilization
Quotation: Such was their progress that the philosophers of Greece would come to seek knowledge from the learned men of Israel. Among them was Socrates, who came to Syria and acquired from the children of Israel the teachings of the oneness of God and the immortality of the spirit. He then returned to Greece and promulgated these teachings, whereupon the people of that land rose up in opposition to him, accused him of impiety, arraigned him before the court, and condemned him to death by poison....  The materialistic thinkers, the Greek philosophers, and the great men of Rome who became renowned in the world were each versed in but one branch of learning. Thus Galen and Hippocrates were celebrated for their skill in medicine, Aristotle in logic and speculative reasoning, and Plato in ethics and divine philosophy.

Subject: Greek philosophers; Greek civilization
Quotation: It is recorded in eastern histories that Socrates journeyed to Palestine and Syria and there, from men learned in the things of God, acquired certain spiritual truths; that when he returned to Greece, he promulgated two beliefs: one, the unity of God, and the other, the immortality of the soul after its separation from the body; that these concepts, so foreign to their thought, raised a great commotion among the Greeks, until in the end they gave him poison and killed him. And this is authentic; for the Greeks believed in many gods, and Socrates established the fact that God is one, which obviously was in conflict with Greek beliefs. Eastern histories also state that Hippocrates sojourned for a long time in the town of Tyre, and this is a city in Syria.

Subject: Hands of the Cause
Quotation: Therefore, the Hands of the Cause of God must spend all their time in teaching.

Subject: Hands of the Cause
Quotation: O Hand of the Cause of God Ibn-i-Abhar, upon him be the Glory of God, the Most Glorious

Subject: Hands of the Cause
Quotation: The Hand of the Cause of God, Jenabe Ibn-Abhar, upon him be the Most Glorious Glory of God.

Subject: Hands of the Cause
Quotation: And blessing and peace be upon the Hands of His Cause, through whom His commandments and laws were spread among His servants

Subject: Hands of the Cause
Quotation: The letter references "His Honor Afnan of the Sacred Tree" as an intermediary figure of high station, referring to one of the Afnans who served as a Hand of the Cause.

Subject: Hands of the Cause
Quotation: But all must show the utmost consideration toward the honored veteran Hands, for these souls are the manifestation of the favors, bounties and grace of the Blessed Beauty.

Subject: Hands of the Cause
Quotation: The text establishes that the Hands of the Cause should be permanent members of the temporary Spiritual Assembly and that "showing them consideration and respect is obligatory upon all"

Subject: Hands of the Cause
Quotation: And salutation, glorification and splendor rest upon the Hands of His Cause, whom neither the affairs of men nor the might of rulers deterred from drawing nigh unto God, the Lord of all mankind.

Subject: Hands of the Cause
Quotation: The text explains that "the Hands of the Cause of God are permanent members while others are elected" and that they "must, like this servant, focus all their thoughts on teaching the Cause of God."

Subject: Hands of the Cause
Quotation: O Hands of the Cause of God, teach the friends love and piety, fellowship and faithfulness, that you may be the root of righteousness and the seed of prosperity and signs of servitude to God between the people

Subject: Hands of the Cause
Quotation: the Hands of the Cause of God are arising with complete dedication to serve the Cause...I beseech Thee...to ordain for each one of the Hands of Thy Cause that which will enable them to raise the standards of Thy guidance

Subject: Hands of the Cause
Quotation: Through the blessing of the Blessed Perfection health was granted to me. Immediately I began to write Tablets so that the "Aiadi" of the Cause of God would give the Glad-tidings to the friends that Abdul-Baha is not weak.

Subject: Hands of the Cause
Quotation: O ye who are the hands of His power in the kingdom of creation and the manifestations of His grandeur between earth and heaven! Ye are the hands of His Cause in His lands, and the stars of His bountiful care amidst His servants.

Subject: Hands of the Cause
Quotation: Convey with the utmost joy and fragrance greetings and messages from 'Abdu'l-Baha to the Hands of the Cause of God, to his honor the Trustee, and likewise to the kings of firmness and steadfastness in the Covenant and Testament.

Subject: Hands of the Cause
Quotation: 'The hands of the Cause' are the hands of Truth. Therefore whosoever is the promoter and the servant of the Word of God he is the hand of Truth. By 'the hands of God' certain definite meanings are connoted. It is not only a verbal expression.

Subject: Hands of the Cause
Quotation: so that the Hands of the Cause of God may give the glad tidings to all the friends... I await divine confirmation on behalf of the Hands of the Cause of God - may God illumine their faces and may the favors of their Merciful Lord be upon them.

Subject: Hands of the Cause
Quotation: Whatever the Hands of the Cause deem advisable is the very truth and must be carried out...Today, whatever the Hands of the Cause deem advisable is implemented by this servant...this matter is being referred to the Hands regarding whatever manner they deem advisable to implement.

Subject: Hands of the Cause
Quotation: The Hands of the Cause of God must arise with such a condition, such delicacy, and such warmth as to dispel the freezing cold of lethargy and the scorching wind of pride, guide the people to divine characteristics, bestow spiritual sentiments, and deliver them from the fetters of perverse schemes.

Subject: Hands of the Cause
Quotation: O ye Hands of the Cause! Supplicate ye and pray on my behalf as I do pray on yours that a heavenly power, a divine bounty, a celestial assistance, and victory from on high be vouchsafed on us all...O Hands of the Cause of God! Every possible means has been employed to strengthen and empower the Hands of the Cause of God, beyond what could be imagined

Subject: Hands of the Cause
Quotation: From the first day of the establishment of the Revelation upon the throne, this most exalted Word issued forth from the Kingdom of Utterance: for whomsoever among the names that is present before the Throne, a wondrous and sublime Tablet shall be revealed specifically for him. Thereafter We commanded the Hands of the Cause to act according to the requirements of wisdom.

Subject: Hands of the Cause
Quotation: In your letter you expressed some displeasure with the Hands...completely erasing the dignity and respect of the Hands...This servant's intention and desire is that all the Hands of the Cause of God become as one spirit, one heart and one soul, so that day by day their loftiness and elevation increases in people's eyes and all show complete obedience and absolute submission to them

Subject: Hands of the Cause
Quotation: Regarding writing a refutation of the misleader about the Suriy-i-Haykal, such refutations do no harm but rather confirm the Cause of God. However, the Hands of the Cause must take up his refutation and write a response. Likewise, by whatever means possible, the unity and accord of the Hands of the Cause is a matter of utmost necessity and the most complete objective. If this unity is not achieved, great harm will result - nay, the Cause of God will fall into grave danger.

Subject: Hands of the Cause
Quotation: I hope, through divine grace and bounty, that such fellowship may be established among the Hands of the Cause of God as has never been witnessed from the beginning of creation, nor shall be witnessed hereafter. For this Cause is mighty, mighty indeed, and in the future the institution of the Hands will attain the utmost importance, such that all mighty affairs, both general and specific, pertaining to the Cause of God will be discussed in consultation among the Hands of the Cause of God.

Subject: Hands of the Cause
Quotation: Regarding what you wrote about renovating the resting place of the Afnan at the site where the sacred remains were deposited in Tehran...this matter could be discussed in Tehran at the spiritual gathering of the Hands of the Cause of God. Whatever you consider appropriate and suitable to the time, place and circumstances, implement it by majority vote. For if matters, especially in the gathering of the Hands of the Cause of God, are not decided upon, that gathering will become completely weak and foundationless, and many problems will arise.

Subject: Hands of the Cause
Quotation: Through His prevailing Will, He hath established the edifice of His Cause upon the foundation of exposition and the elements of explanation, and hath created for it guardians and protectors to preserve it from every heedless betrayer and ignorant speaker - they who transgress not what God hath revealed in the Book and who speak naught except that which He hath permitted them in the final abode. I bear witness that they are the Hands of His Cause amidst all creation and the Lamps of His guidance between earth and heaven. They are they who stand at His gate and drive away such as unworthy to enter His court.

Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/He Whom God Shall Make Manifest; the Bab and Baha'u'llah.txt
Quotation: And as for your inquiry about Him Whom God shall make manifest, if thou shouldst attain unto His Revelation, thou wouldst attain unto a wealth beyond which there is no poverty, and thou wouldst witness a glory beyond which there is no abasement, and a joy beyond which there is no sorrow, and an independence beyond which there is no weakness, and a power beyond which there is no submissiveness.

Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/He Whom God Shall Make Manifest; the Bab and Baha'u'llah.txt
Quotation: Regarding the Tablet you had inquired about: That is the Tablet which the Bab wrote to be presented in the school of "Him Whom God shall make manifest." The Babis have made this a means of confusing minds, saying that "Him Whom God shall make manifest" must be a child so that this petition could be presented in school. Therefore, since the Blessed Beauty was not a child, He is not "Him Whom God shall make manifest." The Blessed Beauty states in the Book that the school of "Him Whom God shall make manifest" is not a children's school or a place for ignorant pupils - it is the school of meanings and exposition that is sanctified above the comprehension of all possibility. He states that in that school I beheld the Tablet of the Bab which was a wondrous divine gift. In any case, the Babis have imagined that the school of "Him Whom God shall make manifest" is a school for ignorant children. Shame upon them! Curse upon them! Woe unto them for this great ignorance! That blessed Tablet of the Bab - may my spirit be sacrificed for Him - this servant one day in Iraq by chance presented it to the Blessed Presence in a school, meaning I was the bearer of this gift.

Subject: He Whom God Shall Make Manifest; the Bab and Baha'u'llah

Subject: He Whom God Shall Make Manifest; the Bab and Baha'u'llah
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/He Whom God Shall Make Manifest; the Bab and Baha'u'llah.txt
Quotation: All this is a mercy from God that ye may believe in Me on that Day, then in Him Whom God shall make manifest through clear signs, for He is the Manifestation of God
