Subject: He Whom God Shall Make Manifest; the Bab and Baha'u'llah
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/He Whom God Shall Make Manifest; the Bab and Baha'u'llah.txt
Quotation: And My guides in the Bayan are they who recognize Him Whom God shall make manifest and believe in Him. Then upon all My names after that Name who shall, on the Day of Resurrection, guide others unto Him Whom God shall make manifest.

Subject: He Whom God Shall Make Manifest; the Bab and Baha'u'llah
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/He Whom God Shall Make Manifest; the Bab and Baha'u'llah.txt
Quotation: Therefore prepare yourselves for the Day of Him Whom God shall manifest, that you may love Him. Verily, on the Day of Him Whom God shall make manifest, most of the people will be divines, but they will have no knowledge unless they believe in God and His verses.

Subject: He Whom God Shall Make Manifest; the Bab and Baha'u'llah
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/He Whom God Shall Make Manifest; the Bab and Baha'u'llah.txt
Quotation: O creation of God and all that you possess on earth! You are all bondservants to Him Whom God shall make manifest with clear signs, and should He accept you as such, you would pride yourselves therein. Verily there is no God but Him, and all else beside Him are His creation.

Subject: He Whom God Shall Make Manifest; the Bab and Baha'u'llah
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/He Whom God Shall Make Manifest; the Bab and Baha'u'llah.txt
Quotation: Know Him then on the day of His appearance, and exalt Him, and glorify Him, and honor Him, and magnify Him, and protect Him as ye would protect your own eyes - nay, with greater protection still. For your eyes were not created save to behold Me or Him, and to prostrate before God their Lord.

Subject: He Whom God Shall Make Manifest; the Bab and Baha'u'llah
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/He Whom God Shall Make Manifest; the Bab and Baha'u'llah.txt
Quotation: He Whom God shall make manifest shall appear so that all may bow down before His presence, for He is a Light that speaks of none but thy Ancient Lord. He has appeared in this Star so that the monotheists may perceive the mystery of precedence and witness the decree of what the Family of God and their followers did

Subject: He Whom God Shall Make Manifest; the Bab and Baha'u'llah
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/He Whom God Shall Make Manifest; the Bab and Baha'u'llah.txt
Quotation: Through Our bounty shall be made manifest He Who shall appear after Him Whom God shall make manifest, then He Who shall appear after Him Whom God shall make manifest, unto the end that hath no end. Never shall My heart cease to rejoice in love of the mention of Him Who shall appear after Him Whom God shall make manifest.

Subject: He Whom God Shall Make Manifest; the Bab and Baha'u'llah
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/He Whom God Shall Make Manifest; the Bab and Baha'u'llah.txt
Quotation: O people! If ye believe in Him Whom God shall make manifest with clear signs, then shall ye confirm that for which ye wait. Otherwise ye shall be separated and shall find no command save that God shall manifest Me and through Me shall the Resurrection come to pass; then on that Day shall ye remember, if ye remember.

Subject: He Whom God Shall Make Manifest; the Bab and Baha'u'llah
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/He Whom God Shall Make Manifest; the Bab and Baha'u'llah.txt
Quotation: O people of the Bayan! You are tested like those given the Qur'an. Have mercy on yourselves! You will find yourselves one day clinging to sayings of the witnesses of the Bayan, while God manifests His Cause with clear signs as you wander in search of a drop of living waters, like camels roaming hoping to possess something.

Subject: He Whom God Shall Make Manifest; the Bab and Baha'u'llah
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/He Whom God Shall Make Manifest; the Bab and Baha'u'llah.txt
Quotation: And after Him, should God manifest One like unto Him, that would be a proof and it would end with Him. Otherwise the Cause is in the hands of the martyrs of the Bayan, who transgress not the bounds of what hath been revealed in the Bayan until the Day when He Whom God shall make manifest appeareth in the next Resurrection.

Subject: He Whom God Shall Make Manifest; the Bab and Baha'u'llah
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/He Whom God Shall Make Manifest; the Bab and Baha'u'llah.txt
Quotation: Verily at this time, and before this time, and after this time, He Whom God shall make manifest is alive with God, and none knows the throne upon which He is established save Him. When God causes Him to speak, then all shall know. He is the Truth, there is no God but Him. He gives life and causes death, and unto Him do all turn.

Subject: He Whom God Shall Make Manifest; the Bab and Baha'u'llah
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/He Whom God Shall Make Manifest; the Bab and Baha'u'llah.txt
Quotation: God verily giveth you glad tidings of Him Whom God shall make manifest. Will ye not, then, rejoice? Say: God verily giveth you glad tidings of the glory of Him Whom God shall make manifest. Will ye not, then, rejoice? Say: God verily giveth you glad tidings of the beauty of Him Whom God shall make manifest. Will ye not, then, rejoice?

Subject: He Whom God Shall Make Manifest; the Bab and Baha'u'llah
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/He Whom God Shall Make Manifest; the Bab and Baha'u'llah.txt
Quotation: And whatsoever thou seest in all the circles of the temples is the mention of Him Whom God shall make manifest, exalted be His mention. And verily on the day of His manifestation, that which returneth unto Him is of the temples of truth and the circles of glory, and that which returneth not unto Him - its fruit of existence hath indeed been wasted.

Subject: He Whom God Shall Make Manifest; the Bab and Baha'u'llah
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/He Whom God Shall Make Manifest; the Bab and Baha'u'llah.txt
Quotation: When ye hear of a command from Him, say not Nay except that ye say God is greater than all things, and all creation belongeth to Him, and all worship Him. For on the Day of Him Whom God shall make manifest, ye shall see yourselves like unto the proud ones, and ye shall behold Him with a countenance before which all, out of awe, prostrate themselves.

Subject: He Whom God Shall Make Manifest; the Bab and Baha'u'llah
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/He Whom God Shall Make Manifest; the Bab and Baha'u'llah.txt
Quotation: This is the Book from God, the Help in Peril, the Self-Subsisting, unto Him Whom God shall make manifest. Bear thou witness that there is no God but I, the Mighty, the Well-Beloved. I have created all things, both before and after, that they may believe in Thee on the day of Thy manifestation, and in Thy signs, that they may be among the guided ones.

Subject: He Whom God Shall Make Manifest; the Bab and Baha'u'llah
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/He Whom God Shall Make Manifest; the Bab and Baha'u'llah.txt
Quotation: God will assuredly cause you all to return unto Him Whom God shall make manifest, if ye would turn back yourselves. This would be better for you than all your works in the Bayan, would ye but reflect a little. If ye return, if ye return unto Him Whom God shall make manifest, perchance He will forgive you your sins and pardon you and improve your deeds.

Subject: He Whom God Shall Make Manifest; the Bab and Baha'u'llah
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/He Whom God Shall Make Manifest; the Bab and Baha'u'llah.txt
Quotation: I counsel you concerning that which God hath created of Him Whom God shall make manifest. I bear witness unto the greatest of that which they attain, not unto that which they desire... And until the days of Him Whom God shall make manifest - and verily He is God, there is no bound to His attributes, and His are the bounds of God's qualities which they shall behold.

Subject: He Whom God Shall Make Manifest; the Bab and Baha'u'llah
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/He Whom God Shall Make Manifest; the Bab and Baha'u'llah.txt
Quotation: Verily, he who awaits a Manifestation after Me shall be written in all places, that is, in the veil of the Temple and in the Temple itself, and By the power of His Manifestation, the All-Glorious, the Most Holy, Lord of the angels and the spirit and By His signs, the All-Glorious and the Most Holy, Lord of the angels and the spirit and Him Whom God shall make manifest.

Subject: He Whom God Shall Make Manifest; the Bab and Baha'u'llah
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/He Whom God Shall Make Manifest; the Bab and Baha'u'llah.txt
Quotation: Know then, O My creation! I have created neither heaven with its loftiness, nor earth with its expanse, nor sea with its depths, nor mountain with its height, nor anything with its might, except for Him Whom We shall manifest. And naught is possessed of the power to withstand, except for Him Whom We shall make manifest on the Day of Resurrection through these My verses and My Being. Follow ye Him, for He, verily, is the Certain Truth.

Subject: He Whom God Shall Make Manifest; the Bab and Baha'u'llah
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/He Whom God Shall Make Manifest; the Bab and Baha'u'llah.txt
Quotation: Verily on the Day of Resurrection if He Whom God shall make manifest does not say I am well-pleased with thee, all one's deeds shall be rendered null, as though one had performed nothing, for they shall possess no glory. But prior to the Day of His Manifestation, let all observe carefully the precepts of the Bayan. For thou desirest that He Who beholdeth thee should be pleased with thee - He Who knoweth thee while thou knowest Him not.

Subject: He Whom God Shall Make Manifest; the Bab and Baha'u'llah
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/He Whom God Shall Make Manifest; the Bab and Baha'u'llah.txt
Quotation: This is the recompense of the entire Bayan from God, and it sufficeth them. They should take pride in what God their Lord hath accepted from them. And should He write Nay, then verily all that they possess in their religion hath been concealed. And if the heaven of the Bayan be concealed within the self of anyone after the appearance of Him Whom God shall make manifest and the elevation of that which He revealeth, then verily thy very essence doth herald that Name.

Subject: He Whom God Shall Make Manifest; the Bab and Baha'u'llah
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/He Whom God Shall Make Manifest; the Bab and Baha'u'llah.txt
Quotation: And is there any greater matter than Him Whom God shall make manifest, if ye did but know! Take ye your name; and if ye believe not therein, ye shall come to know the way God hath taken it.... Take ye all that behooveth you from God, your Lord, ere the angels of divine chastisement seize you while ye are unaware. And take ye those who believe not in Him Whom God shall make manifest, who, when they hear mention of Him, arise not, nor present themselves before Him, nor prostrate themselves as ye are able.

Subject: He Whom God Shall Make Manifest; the Bab and Baha'u'llah
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/He Whom God Shall Make Manifest; the Bab and Baha'u'llah.txt
Quotation: And the earth of His love in God was cleft asunder for the manifestation of Him Whom God shall make manifest. Thus when there reaches you from the ray of that Name what shall hold fast your heart - for God is exalted above any who would indicate His creative essence by what pertains to His luminous glory, His supreme dominion, and His transcendent power - verily all wherewith He has sanctified His Self and revealed in the Book, or what is possible or can be named, He revealed not for the creatures to know Him Whom God shall make manifest and the paths of their servitude to God through Him.

Subject: He Whom God Shall Make Manifest; the Bab and Baha'u'llah
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/He Whom God Shall Make Manifest; the Bab and Baha'u'llah.txt
Quotation: O my God! Do Thou send Thy blessings upon Him Whom Thou shalt make manifest on the Day of Resurrection with all Thy glory of which Thou art cognizant, then with all Thy majesty of which Thou art cognizant, then with all Thy beauty of which Thou art cognizant, then with all Thy grandeur of which Thou art cognizant

Subject: He Whom God Shall Make Manifest; the Bab and Baha'u'llah
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/He Whom God Shall Make Manifest; the Bab and Baha'u'llah.txt
Quotation: He states that in the Manifestation of "Him Whom God shall make manifest" you should not be veiled by a Vahid-i-Bayani - and the Vahid-i-Bayani refers to the Bab Himself and the eighteen Letters of the Living. Similarly He states not to be veiled by what was revealed in the Bayan.

Subject: He Whom God Shall Make Manifest; the Bab and Baha'u'llah
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/He Whom God Shall Make Manifest; the Bab and Baha'u'llah.txt
Quotation: There are two matters which in the Most Great Exposition stand above all else: first, the mention of the Divine Manifestations and the dawning-places of the Suns of Eternity; and second, the divine laws and ordinances. As to the first, which is the most important, most exalted and most evident - it is mentioned throughout all the pages that He counseled the Letters, the Mirrors, and all people, both high and low, that should a Manifestation appear and make a claim, they must not remain veiled by what they possess, and thus be deprived of that manifest Beauty.

Subject: He Whom God Shall Make Manifest; the Bab and Baha'u'llah
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/He Whom God Shall Make Manifest; the Bab and Baha'u'llah.txt
Quotation: The Bab wrote another book, called the Beyan, which is divided into nineteen vahids (unities) of nineteen babs (chapters) each. In this book he mentioned Baha'o'llah by the name of "Him whom God will manifest," and one of his commands was "If any soul should displease another he must give nineteen drachmas of diamonds as atonement. He believed this would train people in such wise as to hinder them from injuring the feelings of "Him whom God will manifest," when he should appear. In a word, every chapter culminates in the mention of "Him whom God will manifest."

Subject: He Whom God Shall Make Manifest; the Bab and Baha'u'llah
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/He Whom God Shall Make Manifest; the Bab and Baha'u'llah.txt
Quotation: He educated a large multitude through divine knowledge and exerted a marvelous influence upon the thoughts, morals, customs and conditions of the Persians. He announced to all His followers the glad tidings of the manifestation of the Sun of Baha and prepared them to believe and be assured.

Subject: He Whom God Shall Make Manifest; the Bab and Baha'u'llah
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/He Whom God Shall Make Manifest; the Bab and Baha'u'llah.txt
Quotation: Those are they who understand, whether they know anything or not, for the fruit of understanding and comprehension in the Book of God is that the servant should know God and act according to His good-pleasure. You cannot know God and His good-pleasure except by knowing Him Whom God shall make manifest and His good-pleasure. This is the primordial mystery for all the worlds.

Subject: He Whom God Shall Make Manifest; the Bab and Baha'u'llah
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/He Whom God Shall Make Manifest; the Bab and Baha'u'llah.txt
Quotation: The Promised One is My Own Self, and were He not My Own Self, by God, He would still circle round Me, and that which hath appeared from Me is My proof, My testimony, and My evidence. Naught was revealed in the Bayan save mention of Me, and all that was ordained therein was held within the grasp of My power, as attesteth all that was sent down aforetime unto 'Ali from One mighty and beauteous.

Subject: Hermes; Balinus
Quotation: O Hermoz! We hope that in the divine school you will be engaged, like Hermes, in learning the meanings of realities.

Subject: Hermes; Balinus
Quotation: They call Hermes the triple one, and say he combined prophethood, wisdom and bounty together, and was confirmed and assisted with these three gifts. That was the Hermes of ancient times.

Subject: Holy Days and the Baha'i calendar
Quotation: On days that are connected to the Blessed Beauty and the Primal Point, meaning these nine days, engagement in business, commerce, crafts and agriculture is not permitted, and likewise carrying out official positions and duties, meaning government service.

Subject: Holy Days and the Baha'i calendar
Quotation: The matter of wisdom is mentioned and accepted before God to such a degree that this year [1299 A.H.] the Most Great Festival of the Birth was not celebrated. He said: "We have prohibited this festival to exalt the station of wisdom and to elevate its rank." From this comprehensive, decisive and blessed word, the significance of wisdom becomes clear and evident.

Subject: Holy Days and the Baha'i calendar
Quotation: celebration of the Day of the Declaration of the Bab with the utmost joy and glory

Subject: Holy Days and the Baha'i calendar
Quotation: This is the Day whereon the Hidden Mystery hath appeared, governing what was and what will be

Subject: Holy Days and the Baha'i calendar
Quotation: This day is celebrated as New Year's Day. I am extremely glad to see you on this Nau Rooz occasion.

Subject: Holy Days and the Baha'i calendar
Quotation: on the day of Naw-Ruz with utmost ceremony and perfect majesty and beauty... This gathering took place on Naw-Ruz

Subject: Holy Days and the Baha'i calendar
Quotation: This is the Day wherein all things have been adorned with the raiment of My remembrance and the garment of thy Lord's loving-kindness

Subject: Holy Days and the Baha'i calendar
Quotation: You attained the blessing of kissing the dust of the purified shrine and were honored to inhale the life-giving fragrance and spirit-increasing perfume from the pure and holy earth.

Subject: Holy Days and the Baha'i calendar
Quotation: These are the Days of Ha whereon We have commanded all to be generous unto themselves and unto those who have turned towards this most Sublime Vision... Verily, We have designated these days to come before the Fast.

Subject: Holy Days and the Baha'i calendar
Quotation: This day is a blessed day. Many Tablets have been revealed for this day by Baha'u'llah. The Blessed Beauty celebrated this day every year, for this day of the Bab's Declaration is the dawning of the advent of this Cause.

Subject: Holy Days and the Baha'i calendar
Quotation: "This Blessed Day must be known as the Day of the Declaration of His Highness the Supreme (BAB) and the beginning of the effulgence of the Sun of Reality. You must on this account be engaged in rejoicing, happiness and gladness."

Subject: Holy Days and the Baha'i calendar
Quotation: Thy letter, concerning the celebration of the anniversary of the declaration of His Holiness the Supreme --may my spirit be sacrificed for Him!--which was held on the land of the Mashrak-el-Azcar, was read... I am hopeful that, during the coming of Rizwan, a great feast shall be held in the land of the Mashrak-el-Azcar

Subject: Holy Days and the Baha'i calendar
Quotation: The Festival of Ridvan begins from the afternoon, not the morning. However, all work must cease from the morning - engagement in trade and commerce is forbidden. Therefore it was said that on the first day, work must be suspended from the morning - not that the beginning of the Festival is from morning of the first day.

Subject: Holy Days and the Baha'i calendar
Quotation: Is the calendar as revealed by the Bab to be used in this Dispensation? A. --Yes; but later on modifications will be made. From what year does the era of the New Dispensation date--from the Declaration of the Bab or from that of BAHA'O'LLAH? A. --From the Declaration of the Bab, 1260 A.H. or 1844 A.D.

Subject: Holy Days and the Baha'i calendar
Quotation: As to what was asked about the Most Great Festival, it begins after the passage of thirty-two days from the Festival of Fasting, with the first day of the month of Baha being counted as the first of these thirty-two days. On the thirty-second day, at the time of the afternoon prayer, the Ancient Beauty entered the Garden of Ridvan. That moment marks the beginning of the Most Great Festival, and that day together with the second day of the Festival are reckoned as one day. It is strictly forbidden in the Book to engage in work on the first, ninth and twelfth days, but there is no objection to working on the other days. As to the matter of the Festival of Fasting, the intercalary days fall before the days of fasting, after which one enters into the Fast. One must fast for the full nineteen days. As to the matter of the Most Holy, Most Glorious Birth, it is at the first dawn of the second day of Muharram. However, the first day, which is the day of the birth of the Herald, together with the second day, is reckoned as one day in the sight of God.

Subject: Holy Days and the Baha'i calendar
Quotation: Regarding what you wrote about the Day of the Declaration of the Bab (may my spirit be sacrificed for Him), it is recorded in the Questions and Answers that the Day of Perfection falls in the Month of Greatness, and the Day of Martyrdom falls on the Day of Sovereignty in the Month of Mercy. This is definitive text which no matter can contradict. This will be implemented later. However, since in the blessed days these two holy days were observed on the fifth of Jumada I and the twenty-eighth of Sha'ban, and the loved ones would present themselves in the Most Holy Court, expressing joy on the Day of Declaration and showing intense grief and sorrow in the countenance of the Blessed Beauty on the Day of Martyrdom, we therefore continue to observe these two days on these two dates until now. But what is in the texts will be implemented later. On the Day of Martyrdom of the Bab and the Day of the Ascension of the Ancient Beauty, engagement in worldly affairs is not permitted. As for the two Birth Days, the text specifies the first and second days of Muharram.

Subject: House of Justice
Quotation: Regarding your mention of the House of Justice, it is clear and evident to you that the upheavals of this earth, its tribulations and its afflictions have been revealed beforehand in the Tablets of God. Therefore, whenever a decree was revealed, this servant strove to have copies sent to all regions lest the upheaval and turmoil of this earth become a barrier between God's ordinances and His servants. For this reason, a copy of that Tablet was sent, and the intention was not for it to be implemented in these days, for it is known that the loved ones are few and the enemies many.

Subject: House of Justice
Quotation: The National Houses of Justice are entrusted with fostering public morality on the religious basis of the Baha'i Teachings. Theirs also is the duty to carefully cultivate the lower and higher educational systems. Public administration is to be organized, beginning with the Local Houses of Justice up to the National Houses of Justice. Supranational questions are under the jurisdiction of the International House of Justice. Through such a hierarchically graded local and national administration a dependable, unbribable class of administrators will also be trained.

Subject: House of Justice
Quotation: His Holiness BAHA'O'LLAH-May my life be a sacrifice to his friends-hath expounded and fully explained everything in the manifested Book, hath not given any soul the chance to be confounded, hath designated the Expounder of the Book that he may fully explain and expose the manifest teachings of God; and hath devolved the ordinances which are not literally recorded in the Book, upon the Universal House of Justice which, whenever it is organized, will engage in the service of promulgating those ordinances which are not manifestly mentioned.

Subject: House of Justice
Quotation: The House of Justice must be obeyed in all things because it has been established by the Blessed Perfection... The House of Justice will be appointed by the people. It must be obeyed because it is the Law of God expressed through the people by their own will and voice... After the Departure of Baha'u'llah we are commanded to obey the House of Justice... The Law of God will be vested in nineteen men who will compose the House of Justice and render decisions.

Subject: House of Justice
Quotation: The "Blessed Perfection Baha'u'llah" ordained, in the days of His corporeal existence (i.e. during His lifetime), that the Holy Book of Laws and Ordinances (Kitab-i-Aqdas) should not be translated into other languages. The time will come one day when the International House of Justice will decide when and into what western languages the "Holy Book" of the "Most Exalted Pen" (Baha'u'llah) may and should be translated.

Subject: House of Justice
Quotation: Political affairs are referred to the House of Justice. Whatever they think wise according to the requirements of time and place ought to be carried out. The members of the House of Justice will be inspired. Whenever it is established it will be under the protection of the Blessed Beauty. Whatever the House of Justice decides is the will of the Blessed One.

Subject: House of Justice
Quotation: The Mashriqu'l-Adhkar must be free from cashier or treasurer's office. However, there is no objection to placing a box at a certain spot for contributions. The decision rests with the Universal House of Justice. The sum of money thus received as contributions must be expended according to the directions of the House of Justice.

Subject: House of Justice
Quotation: He has referred all matters to the House of Justice that everyone may strictly obey whatsoever that Body will prescribe. Even if the Baha'is were to split up into two groups, 'Abdu'l-Baha has warned, each forming a House of Justice of its own, one in opposition to the other, both would be false.

Subject: House of Justice
Quotation: Q. When the Beit-ul-Adls are fully established will there be one supreme king for the whole world? Abdul Baha: There will be constitutional monarchy, but they will have no independent power. Baha'o'llah says that in each country there should be one head (king) but there will not be a supreme king for the whole world. The universal Beit-ul-Adl will be the supreme authority.

Subject: House of Justice
Quotation: The Universal House of Justice, if properly elected by the entire community, will be under divine protection and guidance. Its decisions, whether unanimous or by majority, will be guarded from error through conferred infallibility.

Subject: House of Justice
Quotation: 'Abdu'l-Baha is the interpreter of the Book and not the enactor of laws not revealed in the Book...For any ordinance that is not explicitly revealed in the Book must be referred to the House of Justice.'

Subject: House of Justice
Quotation: The decision to dispose of the site of the Mashriqu'l-Adhkar in order to build another Mashriqu'l-Adhkar rests with the House of Justice. Whenever it is formed, it will make a decision.

Subject: House of Justice
Quotation: Nothing causes me more unhappiness than disunity, and this can only be remedied by obedience to the command of the Universal House of justice. Even before the establishment of the House of Justice, the friends must be obedient to the existing Spiritual Assemblies even if they know of a certainty that their judgement is flawed. If this were not complied with, the mighty citadel of the Faith of God would not be safeguarded. All must obey the Universal House of justice. Obedience to it is obedience to the Cause. Opposition to it is opposition to the Blessed Beauty. Denial of it is denial of God, the True One. Renouncing any word of the House of Justice is like unto the renunciation of a word from the KitabiAqdas. Observe, how important this matter is! The Blessed Beauty has ordained the House of justice as the lawmaker. If the votes of the members are not unanimous and there are differences of views, then the vote of the majority is the vote of the Blessed Beauty.  Take this very moment. Should the Universal House of justice be operating, by the one True God, beside Whom there is no God, I would have been the first to obey its decree, even if it should be against me. It is true that that Body does not possess inherent infallibility, but it is under the shadow of the protection and shelter of the Blessed Beauty. Its command is the Blessed Command. Discuss this matter amongst yourselves, so that it may not be forgotten. Speak of it to one another; even, make a written note of it.

Subject: House of Justice
Quotation: The House of Justice legislates on unspecified laws, and this servant is the interpreter of specified laws, not the legislator.

Subject: House of Justice
Quotation: The House of Justice must be obeyed in all things... It must be obeyed because it is the Law of God expressed through the people... I myself will obey the House of Justice because it is founded upon the Commands of the Blessed Perfection... It is the center of true government and must be obeyed in all things.

Subject: House of Justice
Quotation: 'Abdu'l-Baha is the Expounder of the Word, not the law-giver. 'Abdu'l-Baha has explained the divine law - whoso wishes may accept it, and whoso wishes not need not accept it. In any case, it is incumbent upon us to explain God's law and interpret the meaning of the concise verses. As for ordinances not mentioned in the Book, these all revert to the House of Justice, not to 'Abdu'l-Baha, for He is the Interpreter of what is mentioned in the Book, not the Author of unrevealed laws.

Subject: House of Justice
Quotation: These council boards are not Houses of Justice. That is a universal affair to be organized in time by all. Now is not the time. The man who would build must first get material and then begin erection. But if he has not right material he cannot build. This is the time for teaching; you must get material. Therefore the board has for its main duty teaching. May it be confirmed to teach many and thus prepare for the House of Justice! It is a spiritual gathering and should remain such until political affairs are adjusted. Houses of Justice must attain to the potency to be such. Abdul-Baha hopes that in time the Board may attain to a condition like that.... Question: Should we organize into a legal body now, with a constitution? Answer: The time for organization is not yet. At present the work must be entirely spiritual.

Subject: House of Justice
Quotation: Endowments dedicated to charitable purposes, prior to the formation of the House of Justice, are referred to the Spiritual Assembly which is pure and sanctified from any trace of self, otherwise they are not valid.

Subject: House of Justice
Quotation: The divine civilization that will result from the House of Justice

Subject: House of Justice
Quotation: As for the House of Justice, by explicit texts in God's law it is confined to men - a wisdom from God which shall become as manifest as the sun at high noon.

Subject: House of Justice
Quotation: Who is to decide upon the plans of the Mashrak-ul-Askar? That rests with the delegates to the Convention- not all those present at the Convention, the delegates only - not strangers.

Subject: House of Justice
Quotation: Regarding the House of Justice, in the Kitab-i-Aqdas the address is to men, saying "O men of the House of Justice." However, in election and voting the rights of women are established.

Subject: House of Justice
Quotation: In the cause of Baha'o'llah there is the Beit-ul-Ad'l (House of Justice). Political affairs are not explicitly settled in the tablets. They are referred to the House of Justice. Whatever the House of Justice decides is obligatory.

Subject: House of Justice
Quotation: Furthermore, Baha'o'llah has commanded the organization of an universal house of justice, which shall have power to legislate regarding all questions not elucidated in the books, and the decisions of this body are to be accepted as the law.

Subject: House of Justice
Quotation: The Covenant-breakers produced a tablet, which they attributed it to the Ancient Beauty. Therein it was clearly stated that the numerical value of Kull u Shay (all things = 36 indicated the time limit when the Cause of Baha'u'llah would, God forbid, be disbanded or dispersed. Somehow the friends managed to obtain a copy of this tablet and sent it to the presence of 'Abdu'l-Baha, Who said there were numerous tablets corrupted like this one and that it was unimportant. "The House of Justice will put things right," He said. "It will gather together all the Sacred Writings, scrutinized them carefully, and pronounce its conclusive findings, and should any make contradictory remarks, he would be severely dealt with." Then He gave an explanation about how such a tablet never existed and was not from the Ancient Beauty and was not in His blessed idiom.

Subject: House of Justice
Quotation: Likewise, the Universal House of Justice is the remover of all differences. Whatever the House of Justice says is accepted, and whoever opposes it is rejected. But the Universal House of Justice which is the legislator has not yet been established.

Subject: House of Justice
Quotation: The House of Justice has not yet been formed: Its formation is conditioned upon universal suffrage. By this is meant the Universal House of Justice; and in the election of the members of the Universal House of Justice women have the same voice and vote as men.

Subject: House of Justice
Quotation: The House of Justice will be appointed by the people... The House of Justice has been established by the Manifestation of God. It is the center of true government... The kings and rulers of the world will find their true authority under the rulings of the House of Justice.

Subject: House of Justice
Quotation: You wrote about the Spiritual Assembly of Washington that it has progressed well in these few months. This news brought joy, and the relocation of the Spiritual Assembly will surely increase attraction, as more will gather and the spaciousness of the place will bring spiritual delight.

Subject: House of Justice
Quotation: He has ordained and established the House of Justice, which is endowed with a political as well as a religious function, the consummate union and blending of church and state. This institution is under the protecting power of Baha'u'llah Himself. A universal, or international, House of Justice shall also be organized.

Subject: House of Justice
Quotation: The House of Justice is free from error or blunder. In other words, it is under the care and protection of the Abha Beauty Who has commanded all to be submissive to it, and has affirmed that it receives divine inspiration and is under the protection of the Wise, the Potent, the Powerful God.... Who opposes this body has indeed opposed God.

Subject: House of Justice
Quotation: There shall not be any separation among the believers because Baha'u'llah has appointed the House of Justice to be the authority. In the future many false traditions and untrue statements will appear, but the men of the House of Justice will with great power stop the mouths of the liars. All difficult problems must be referred to the House of Justice.

Subject: House of Justice
Quotation: However, there is no objection to placing a box at a certain spot for contributions. The sum of money thus received as contributions must be expended according to the directions of the House of Justice.  When the Universal House of Justice is established, it will reconsider all these matters, be they essential or secondary, and will lay down conclusive rulings according to the needs of the time.

Subject: House of Justice
Quotation: The term of service for the trustees of the House of Justice must be determined by the House of Justice in the future, since there is no divine text on this matter, and whatever is not explicitly revealed must be decided by the House of Justice. If a member of the House of Justice is absent, passes away, or is removed, the full membership of the House must be completed through a new election.

Subject: House of Justice
Quotation: Understanding among peoples should be ensured through a Supranational House of Justice (Baytu'l-'Adl), which will at the same time and above all serve to guard and preserve universal peace. The just administration on a religious basis in the divinely-inspired bodies of the Local, National (and the Supranational) Houses of Justice will also ensure the loyalty of the citizens of the state, so that no more revolutions, upheavals of the state and civil wars can come about.

Subject: House of Justice
Quotation: The Universal House of Justice is under the shadow of the Most Great Infallibility and the Blessed Beauty preserves it from error. For instance, Baha'u'llah has said that the House of Justice is the law-giver and must legislate on matters that have not been explicitly recorded in the Book. Now, were the House of Justice to err, that error would revert to Baha'u'llah Himself and would subvert the Religion and Law of God. The Universal House of Justice is divinely ordained and operates under divine infallibility. Their decisions are perfectly infallible and under the shadow of divine infallibility; not subject to that which pertains to their own persons.

Subject: House of Justice
Quotation: The Universal House of Justice has only the legislative function; the executive power belongs to the administrative department of government. The House of Justice cannot fulfil two functions at the same time--legislative and executive.   At first, National Houses of Justice will be established in every country, and they will elect in turn members to the Universal House of Justice. Again I repeat, The House of Justice, whether National or Universal, has only legislative power, and not executive power. For example, in Europe and America the Parliament or Congress enact laws, while the Government executes these laws. The House of Justice cannot fulfil two functions at the same time--legislative and executive.

Subject: House of Justice
Quotation: The community should buy large tracts of land from the Zakat (capital tax) and from the voluntary endowments (but not from legal fines), maybe also from estates without heirs. The most beautiful places one should give to the House of Worship (Mashriqu'l-Adhkar); the House of Justice (Council Hall) may be built adjoining it or else opposite it. In a circle around these two central buildings there should be built an orphanage with two sections for boys and girls, a university, a hospital, a dispensary and a guest house. The maternity hospital, the insane asylum, an asylum for irredeemable cases and incurable cases, an old-age home, a home for the crippled and the blind, should be established in another place, far from there. All these and other institutions are in the first instance placed under the House of Justice.

Subject: House of Justice
Quotation: The limit of proximity to the Kaaba is mentioned in the writings of the Primal Point, may my spirit be sacrificed for Him, and whatever is not mentioned in the Divine Tablets refers to the Universal House of Justice which will be established after the proclamation of the Cause of God. The House of Justice legislates on unspecified laws, and this servant is the interpreter of specified laws, not the legislator.

Subject: House of Justice
Quotation: Regarding the House of Justice the Master said: "It is a great mistake to suppose that there will be a House of Justice established in each city. The fact is there will be but one House of Justice for the whole world, to be composed of individuals from each country. In each city there will be a Spiritual Meeting, or Board of Council, composed of nine or more, whose function will be to attend to the business of the Assembly. This Spiritual Meeting will have no power to control or make laws. The members of the council are merely the servants of the Assembly or community."  Continuing in this connection the Master said: "A house is never furnished before the structure is erected. So with the Cause of Baha'o'llah. It must be first built up; afterwards it will be furnished with justice and then it will be called the House of Justice. When this time comes and the universal House of Justice is once established, its commands will be obeyed by all."  "Many minor laws not mentioned in the Kitab-el-Akdas will be made by them, but no laws contained in the Kitab-el-Akdas can be abrogated by them. We have to regard the Cause of Baha'o'llah as a house in the process of building and that we are the builders; in other words, we are simply the servants building the house. The house is not ours. We simply contribute the labor." When asked who would elect the individual members of the House of Justice, the Master said: "They would be elected similar to the plan adopted in electing members of Congress in the United States, each country electing a representative, the same as each state does in the union."

Subject: House of Worship [Mashriqu'l-Adhkar]
Quotation: The esteemed delegates requested that 'Abdu'l-Baha accept the presidency of the Mashriqu'l-Adhkar Association and that honorary members for the Western Mashriqu'l-Adhkar Association be elected from among the friends of the East. God willing, honorary members for that respected association shall be appointed from the East. But 'Abdu'l-Baha's wish is to be the servant of that gathering, not its president, and to render service rather than hold membership. This is the cause of my joy and I hope to succeed in achieving this aim and desire.

Subject: House of Worship [Mashriqu'l-Adhkar]
Quotation: Since this Mashriqu'l-Adhkar in Chicago hath been instituted, thousands of Mashriqu'l-Adhkar's will be instituted in the East and in the West, but this will be the mother and they the children. This hath the same significance as the Mashriqu'l-Adhkar being the mother.

Subject: House of Worship [Mashriqu'l-Adhkar]
Quotation: This Mashriqu'l-Adhkar is the first divine establishment of this new age; therefore, it will gain most great importance in the future centuries and will become a place of pilgrimage for the peoples and nations of the world

Subject: House of Worship [Mashriqu'l-Adhkar]
Quotation: Therefore, this blessed deed of the East supporting the West is praiseworthy and commendable and is an attribute of this Day of Revelation. Thus far, such deeds have assuredly not occurred that the East offer contributions to the West; that is, for Persia to assist in the building of the Mashriqu'l-Adhkar in America.

Subject: House of Worship [Mashriqu'l-Adhkar]
Quotation: With the utmost love and sincerity, they elected a committee, and that committee attended to the establishment, planning, ordering, and form of the Mashriqu'l-Adhkar.

Subject: House of Worship [Mashriqu'l-Adhkar]
Quotation: Whatever is public is divine, and whatever is private is devised of man. Therefore, whatever is established by the friends of God must be public, whether a Mashriqu'l-Adhkar, or other institutions. Whatever is public is divine, and whatever is private is manmade. The efforts of the friends must benefit all people. Recently, [the Baha'is] have founded a school and plan to build a hospital associated with the Mashriqu'l-Adhkar [of 'Ishqabad]. If the believers undertake philanthropic efforts, it must be public and not exclusionary against anyone. For instance, if they establish a school, none must be denied entrance.

Subject: House of Worship [Mashriqu'l-Adhkar]
Quotation: Although in the future thousands of Mashriqu'l-Adhkars will be erected, this Mashriqu'l-Adhkar, because it is the first to be built in America, is very important, and its impact and effect shall be boundless. Soon some results will become evident and manifest.

Subject: House of Worship [Mashriqu'l-Adhkar]
Quotation: Mention of financial contribution for the American Mashriqu'l-Adhkar

Subject: House of Worship [Mashriqu'l-Adhkar]
Quotation: Reference to laying cornerstone of and service to the Mashriqu'l-Adhkar

Subject: House of Worship [Mashriqu'l-Adhkar]
Quotation: If any Huquq becomes available, use it for establishing the Mashriqu'l-Adhkar.

Subject: House of Worship [Mashriqu'l-Adhkar]
Quotation: Your presence on the consultative committee of the Mashriqu'l-Adhkar has surely been beneficial.

Subject: House of Worship [Mashriqu'l-Adhkar]
Quotation: The text discusses singing and chanting in the Mashriqu'l-Adhkar through a question posed to 'Abdu'l-Baha.

Subject: House of Worship [Mashriqu'l-Adhkar]
Quotation: These people have built their mosque in Chicago and erected their Mashriqu'l-Adhkar in the mid-heart of America!

Subject: House of Worship [Mashriqu'l-Adhkar]
Quotation: Then he entered Merv and called all to establish the Mashriqu'l-Adhkar that they might worship Thee in mornings and dawns

Subject: House of Worship [Mashriqu'l-Adhkar]
Quotation: You should think about promoting the cause of the Mashriqu'l-Adhkar and preparing means for the diffusion of the divine fragrances.

Subject: House of Worship [Mashriqu'l-Adhkar]
Quotation: The news of the Divine praise and glorification at dawn in the Mashriqu'l-Adhkar with spiritual melodies brought much joy and delight.

Subject: House of Worship [Mashriqu'l-Adhkar]
Quotation: How wonderful it would be to establish a Mashriqu'l-Adhkar and a universal school on this mountain. Mashriqu'l-Adhkars will be established.

Subject: House of Worship [Mashriqu'l-Adhkar]
Quotation: Regarding the matter of the Mashriqu'l-Adhkar, two letters were previously written to Jinab-i-Aqa Musa - proceed according to those instructions.

Subject: House of Worship [Mashriqu'l-Adhkar]
Quotation: The friends in Husaynabad, having established a Mashriqu'l-Adhkar, are worthy of praise and are the recipients of the favors of the Manifest Light.

Subject: House of Worship [Mashriqu'l-Adhkar]
Quotation: Praise be to God, five hundred pounds and three hundred pounds arrived from Baghdad and were immediately sent to Baghdad for the repair of the House.

Subject: House of Worship [Mashriqu'l-Adhkar]
Quotation: The Mashriqu'l-Adhkar must be free from cashier or treasurer's office. However, there is no objection to placing a box at a certain spot for contributions.

Subject: House of Worship [Mashriqu'l-Adhkar]
Quotation: The Mashriqu'l-Adhkar assembly is the dawning-place of lights, and the assembly for the diffusion of divine fragrances is the manifestation of clear signs.

Subject: House of Worship [Mashriqu'l-Adhkar]
Quotation: Details about construction and administration of the first Mashriqu'l-Adhkar in Ishqabad, including committee members, architectural plans, and progress reports.

Subject: House of Worship [Mashriqu'l-Adhkar]
Quotation: What should be done about the 'Liberty Bonds' that were sent as contributions to the Mashrak-ul-Askar fund? Who is to decide upon the plans or the Mashrak-ul-Askar?

Subject: House of Worship [Mashriqu'l-Adhkar]
Quotation: This structure shall be remembered eternally, for it hath been reared up in the name of God and during the days of God, and hath been adorned with the ornament of approval.

Subject: House of Worship [Mashriqu'l-Adhkar]
Quotation: And the House is the sanctuary of justice, and its day is like my house, like the Ka'bah in the Sacred Mosque, and it is a sanctuary of peace for all who humble themselves.

Subject: House of Worship [Mashriqu'l-Adhkar]
Quotation: However, if they wish to construct and establish a special building, that construction would be most fitting if it does not hinder contributions to the Chicago Mashriqu'l-Adhkar.

Subject: House of Worship [Mashriqu'l-Adhkar]
Quotation: Your letter was received and its contents brought the utmost joy, that you have sent Mrs. Mabel Geary as a delegate to Chicago and are striving to establish the Mashriqu'l-Adhkar.

Subject: House of Worship [Mashriqu'l-Adhkar]
Quotation: Hold in utmost reverence the House of God, for the holy breezes of My grace blow forth and pass through My House - verily I pass by My House in the nights and days, did ye but know.

Subject: House of Worship [Mashriqu'l-Adhkar]
Quotation: In the Mashrak-el-Azkar services will be held every morning, and the words of Baha'o'llah only are to be read. Mashrak-el-Azkar means "Dawning Point of Mention" (Where God is mentioned).

Subject: House of Worship [Mashriqu'l-Adhkar]
Quotation: Therefore strive with all power and generosity until you build this first structure in the name of Baha in the continent of America. This edifice has a mighty effect upon the hearts of the faithful ones.

Subject: House of Worship [Mashriqu'l-Adhkar]
Quotation: I want to know if my home in Berkeley may become a Baha'i Center with your blessing? Very good. The very fact that you wish to have your home in Berkeley as a Baha'i Center is an indication of capacity.

Subject: House of Worship [Mashriqu'l-Adhkar]
Quotation: The resolve shown by the assembly in their intention to contribute to the Mashriqu'l-Adhkar brought great joy and delight to hearts. I hope that all the friends of God will be successful in this service.

Subject: House of Worship [Mashriqu'l-Adhkar]
Quotation: If we build the Temple quickly, and send a ship for You, will you come to America? I will come of My own volition to America if they build the Mashriqu'l-Adhkar quickly. But, they will not build it quickly.

Subject: House of Worship [Mashriqu'l-Adhkar]
Quotation: O Afnan! Upon thee be my Baha! Praise be to God that thou hast succeeded in constructing the Mashriqu'l-Adhkar of God, whose remembrance and fragrance shall endure and persist as long as the Kingdom endureth.

Subject: House of Worship [Mashriqu'l-Adhkar]
Quotation: Now a spiritual gathering is being formed there and the verses of unity are being chanted... the contribution that thou hadst sent for the Mashriqu'l-Adhkar of Chicago has been received and will be forwarded.

Subject: House of Worship [Mashriqu'l-Adhkar]
Quotation: As to what you wrote about the Mashriqu'l-Adhkar being designated in the land of Ta, and likewise being established and becoming established through God's grace in other lands - these matters were presented at the Most Holy Court. This is what the Tongue of Grandeur spoke in reply: "Blessed is the spot, and the house, and the place, and the city, and the heart, and the mountain, and the refuge, and the cave, and the valley, and the land, and the sea, and the island, and the meadow where mention of God hath been made, and His praise glorified." This binding decree was revealed in the Most Holy Book. However, these matters are contingent upon wisdom. In all cases one must look to the horizon of wisdom, for the corrupt ones and troublemakers lie in wait, seeking to find a pretext to raise an uproar.... The raising of Mashriqu'l-Adhkars in the cities and regions of the land of Kha is beloved, for it accordeth with the Book of God and His ways. But it must be concealed from all save trustworthy, steadfast souls.

Subject: House of Worship [Mashriqu'l-Adhkar]
Quotation: May the Mashriqu'l-Adhkar in that region be established and secured with the utmost wisdom. O Lord! Make Hisar a haven for the righteous, a center for the Mashriqu'l-Adhkar, and a source for the emanation of lights.

Subject: House of Worship [Mashriqu'l-Adhkar]
Quotation: Discussion of suitable ground for the Mashriqu'l-Adhkar, suggesting it would be better to have wider ground with the building in the middle surrounded by a flower garden, though the present ground is also permissible.

Subject: House of Worship [Mashriqu'l-Adhkar]
Quotation: Utmost joy was obtained from the establishment of the Mashriqu'l-Adhkar...I hope they will be successful in serving the divine friends and the spiritual beloved ones and in arranging and organizing the Mashriqu'l-Adhkar.

Subject: House of Worship [Mashriqu'l-Adhkar]
Quotation: Particularly commendable is the zeal thou hast shown in connection with the Mashriqu'l-Adhkar of Chicago. This donation of thine will have a profound effect in America, and thus did Abdul-Baha become immensely delighted.

Subject: House of Worship [Mashriqu'l-Adhkar]
Quotation: As to what you wrote concerning the Mashriqu'l-Adhkar and the blessed spot and the place of consultation and the united, assured souls - praise be to God that the friends of Truth have attained to the service of the Cause.

Subject: House of Worship [Mashriqu'l-Adhkar]
Quotation: As for the friends in Iraq, regarding the assistance for the children of the martyrs and the Mashriqu'l-Adhkar, they have exerted every sufficient and adequate effort, and I have become pleased with it and satisfied with them.

Subject: House of Worship [Mashriqu'l-Adhkar]
Quotation: Thou hadst written that the friends intend to contribute towards the cost of the Mashriqu'l-Adhkar. This is the first incident of its kind; therefore, it will undoubtedly yield laudable results and bring forth admirable effects.

Subject: House of Worship [Mashriqu'l-Adhkar]
Quotation: You have shown great effort and extended a helping hand in supporting the Mashriqu'l-Adhkar. You have again contributed to its construction. Through Sheikh and Khan, dedicate the pledged fifty tumans to the Mashriqu'l-Adhkar as well.

Subject: House of Worship [Mashriqu'l-Adhkar]
Quotation: completion of the minarets of the Mashriqu'l-Adhkar... The Mashriqu'l-Adhkar committee and service committee are worthy of praise and are sacrificing their lives... truly showed great resolve in offering his house to the Mashriqu'l-Adhkar

Subject: House of Worship [Mashriqu'l-Adhkar]
Quotation: in these days the new resolve which ye have shown in completing the Mashriqu'l-Adhkar has brought joy to 'Abdu'l-Baha and gladness to this servant at the threshold of greatness... who were the first to establish the Mashriqu'l-Adhkar in all regions

Subject: House of Worship [Mashriqu'l-Adhkar]
Quotation: His honor Asad and the son of My Name Al-Asdaq, upon them be My Baha, have arisen to serve the Cause, and whatsoever they have executed regarding the Mashriqu'l-Adhkar and the Spot of Blessing in the lands of Kha hath been approved by the Supreme Pen.

Subject: House of Worship [Mashriqu'l-Adhkar]
Quotation: Thou hast given the greatest importance to the question of the Masherko'l Azkar. The Mashreko'l Azkar is a magnet for the confirmations rendered by the Supreme Concourse. The sooner ye begin its construction the greater the confirmations attained to.

Subject: House of Worship [Mashriqu'l-Adhkar]
Quotation: And if it be possible to begin the construction of the Mashriqu'l-Adhkar, do not delay. As regards the land, carry out the agreement that you have made with the owner of the property, that it may be purchased, but let the payment be made in installments.

Subject: House of Worship [Mashriqu'l-Adhkar]
Quotation: In reality, the radiant, pure hearts are the Mashriqu'l-Adhkar and from them the voice of supplication and invocation continually reaches the Supreme Concourse...they will certainly exert the utmost endeavor and energy in the building of the Mashriqu'l-Adhkar.

Subject: House of Worship [Mashriqu'l-Adhkar]
Quotation: News hath arrived that a Mashriqu'l-Adhkar hath been established--that in that land, the praise and glorification of God hath reached unto the Kingdom of Glory, and the melodies of praise and devotion to the spiritual Beloved have reached the Concourse on High.

Subject: House of Worship [Mashriqu'l-Adhkar]
Quotation: From this news great fragrance and joy were produced. Thanks be to God that thou wast helped to establish a meeting for this purpose. I hope that the members of this meeting will become the receivers of the divine benevolence and aided by the heavenly assistances.

Subject: House of Worship [Mashriqu'l-Adhkar]
Quotation: Make thy house a nest and shelter for the celestial birds, so that they may sing for thee divine melodies and reveal the mysteries of the knowledge of God. May that gathering in Seattle become a Paradise Supreme and may its fame endure throughout the cycles and ages.

Subject: House of Worship [Mashriqu'l-Adhkar]
Quotation: The friends there laid the foundations of a Mashriqu'l-Adhkar in the great house, but left it unfinished... This plan containeth nine doors, nine pathways, nine gardens, nine pools, nine sides, nine columns, nine pillars, nine verandas and nine porticos on the inside.

Subject: House of Worship [Mashriqu'l-Adhkar]
Quotation: Mrs. True is one of the first maid servants of the Kingdom of God. She is well-known to and praised by the believers and the maid servants of the Merciful both in the East and in the West. She has displayed and is displaying the utmost effort in the construction of the Mashrek El Azkar.

Subject: House of Worship [Mashriqu'l-Adhkar]
Quotation: Praise be to God that the New York believers became confirmed in the accomplishment of a great service and held in that City the Consultation Convention for the erection of the Mashriqu'l-Adhkar. They displayed the utmost of effort till that convention was inaugurated with infinite perfection.

Subject: House of Worship [Mashriqu'l-Adhkar]
Quotation: Whatever belongs to the doorway, give to Aqa Ahmad so that it may be sent with utmost speed to Chicago for assistance to the Mashriqu'l-Adhkar, as an amount was sent to pay the installment due on the land but it was not sufficient and more must be sent. If it is not paid, great loss will result.

Subject: House of Worship [Mashriqu'l-Adhkar]
Quotation: The Convention of the delegates for the Mashriqu'l-Adhkar was held in perfect order... Although hereafter thousands of Mashriqu'l-Adhkars will be founded, yet as this Mashriqu'l-Adhkar is the first divine Institute in America, therefore, it is very important and its results and fruits are endless.

Subject: House of Worship [Mashriqu'l-Adhkar]
Quotation: As to the problems of Mashriqu'l-Adhkar all are to be referred to the general Convention. Whatever is decided upon thereat, is acceptable and should be executed. With regard to the Mashriqu'l-Adhkar, which Mr. Rockfleur intends to build as a part of the exhibition of all temples, there is no harm therein.

Subject: House of Worship [Mashriqu'l-Adhkar]
Quotation: When the Mashrak-el-Adkar is built, then the matter of prayer will become adjusted... It seems a pity to build the Mashrek-el-Adhkar only half the size of the original plan. The original would cost several million (dollars). If it is according to the original plan it would take about fifty years to build it.

Subject: House of Worship [Mashriqu'l-Adhkar]
Quotation: Thy letter, concerning the celebration of the anniversary of the declaration of His Holiness the Supreme --may my spirit be sacrificed for Him!--which was held on the land of the Mashrak-el-Azcar, was read... I am hopeful that, during the coming of Rizwan, a great feast shall be held in the land of the Mashrak-el-Azcar

Subject: House of Worship [Mashriqu'l-Adhkar]
Quotation: Move thou the soil, carry the clay, and haul the stones on behalf of 'Abdu'l-Baha for the building of this Mashriqu'l-Adhkar so that the thrill generated by thy service may bring joy and gladness to the Centre of Servitude. That Mashriqu'l-Adhkar is the first manifest and evident establishment of the Lord in this age.

Subject: House of Worship [Mashriqu'l-Adhkar]
Quotation: Jinab-i-Aqa Musa, upon him be mercy and contentment, was not successful during his lifetime in establishing and building the Mashriqu'l-Adhkar in Baku. And you know that I accepted nothing from him. But if he had erected this mighty edifice, what an effect it would have had now in both the earthly and heavenly kingdoms!

Subject: House of Worship [Mashriqu'l-Adhkar]
Quotation: Thine utmost wish and desire was the rearing and establishment of the Mashriqu'l-Adhkar. There is a right time for everything--and praise be to God that its time hath now come! The greatest endeavour must be exerted for this sublime edifice, that it may be erected with the utmost strength, firmness, elegance, and grace.

Subject: House of Worship [Mashriqu'l-Adhkar]
Quotation: All the divine friends were delighted in the construction of the Mashriqu'l-Adhkar...that the Mashriqu'l-Adhkar could be established with such freedom in that land. God willing, its melody will reach the Concourse on High at dawn. As for Abbas-of's receipt for the funds, use them in the construction of the Mashriqu'l-Adhkar.

Subject: House of Worship [Mashriqu'l-Adhkar]
Quotation: Regarding the Mashriqu'l-Adhkar, you wrote that praise be to God it has been established, and that his honor Adib and some of the divine friends were present and engaged in praising the Truth. Give thanks to God that you have been enabled to render this other service. This service is like unto the first, nay rather it is greater.

Subject: House of Worship [Mashriqu'l-Adhkar]
Quotation: His honor, my dear brother, has truly made an extraordinary effort by offering his residence in Bushruyih as a Mashriqu'l-Adhkar, and the friends of God with utmost effort undertook its repair, and that spiritual beloved, namely His Honor Aqa Mir-Vali, dedicated one share of the Mirabad farm for the lights of the Mashriqu'l-Adhkar

Subject: House of Worship [Mashriqu'l-Adhkar]
Quotation: Indeed, thou hast shown great effort in the construction of the Mashriqu'l-Adhkar. This assistance thou hast rendered is recorded in all the heavenly scrolls, divine books, and the Most Exalted Register, and through this assistance thou shalt forever be the recipient of the favors and the object of the bounties of the All-Merciful Lord.

Subject: House of Worship [Mashriqu'l-Adhkar]
Quotation: I hope that in this year [1917] the solid and firm foundation of Mashrekol-azkar be laid. In reality, thou are displaying great effort. Praise be to God that through thy endeavor and magnanimity useful results were produced. I hope the believers of God will become able to pay the $200,000.00 which they have pledged themselves to contribute.

Subject: House of Worship [Mashriqu'l-Adhkar]
Quotation: The question of the Mashrekol-Azkar is of great importance. The friends accordingly must exert a great deal of effort and must be self-sacrificing so that its construction may begin. As to appeal and encouragement for the Mashrekol-Azkar, in view of the glory and eminence of the Cause, it must be made orally or through private personal letters.

Subject: House of Worship [Mashriqu'l-Adhkar]
Quotation: O Mahdi! Hearken unto the call of thy Lord with the ear of thine inmost nature, then turn thy face toward the precincts of the House, this Sanctuary which God hath built with the hands of His power and made it an ornament of His Self between the heavens and the earths. Say: O people! Destroy not the sanctuary of God with hands of rancor and hatred.

Subject: House of Worship [Mashriqu'l-Adhkar]
Quotation: The two plans for the Mashriqu'l-Adhkar arrived, and both were reviewed. They cheered the hearts, and the friends and the handmaids of the Merciful engaged in speaking forth thy praise. Thou shouldst, however, discuss the design and form of the Mashriqu'l-Adhkar with the members of the Spiritual Assembly, in order that that ye may decide upon it in unity.

Subject: House of Worship [Mashriqu'l-Adhkar]
Quotation: Now the day has arrived in which the edifice of God, the divine sanctuary, the spiritual Temple, shall be erected in America. For the Cause is great--because this is the first Mashrak-el-Azkar in that country, and from it the praise of God shall ascend to the Kingdom of Mystery and the tumult of His exaltation and greeting from the whole world shall be heard.

Subject: House of Worship [Mashriqu'l-Adhkar]
Quotation: Praised be God! The Mashriqu'l-Adhkar is the dayspring of lights--its garden shone like unto a lamp, its pathways were ornamented with the designs of wondrous flowers, its pools flowed with living waters, and its fountains gushed forth like unto the hearts of the lovers. This is the first Mashriqu'l-Adhkar that hath been reared, and it hath great importance.

Subject: House of Worship [Mashriqu'l-Adhkar]
Quotation: The scroll containing your plan for the establishment of the Mashriqu'l-Adhkar and its dependencies consisting of a hospital, schools, a travellers' hospice, and quarters for the elderly and the poor... These edifices are places of supplication and invocation to the Threshold of His grandeur and the greatest means of diffusing the sweet savours of the Lord.

Subject: House of Worship [Mashriqu'l-Adhkar]
Quotation: thou hast made thy home a nest and shelter for the birds of the meadow, transformed it into a rose-garden of divine unity, and established it as a gathering place for the people of detachment, so that at dawn and daybreak it may become a Mashriqu'l-Adhkar where lights will shine forth and the melody of devotion and supplication will be raised to the Abha Kingdom

Subject: House of Worship [Mashriqu'l-Adhkar]
Quotation: As for the matter of the Mashriqu'l-Adhkar, it is very important. Exercise the utmost effort in this regard as it is of great significance. Praise be to God, Mashriqu'l-Adhkars have been established in all lands, even in villages - in some places they have been built and in others a location has been designated, and at dawn they are engaged in the remembrance of the Lord.

Subject: House of Worship [Mashriqu'l-Adhkar]
Quotation: In any city where word of the Mashriqu'l-Adhkar would arouse alarm and protests, and precipitate the mischief-making of the perverse and wayward, it is not permissible that it be openly established. Nevertheless, should the friends meet somewhere in the utmost privacy and secrecy to recite the daily prayers and communes, this would be highly pleasing at the Threshold of God.

Subject: House of Worship [Mashriqu'l-Adhkar]
Quotation: My hope is that in the coming year the foundation of the Mashriqu'l-Adhkar will be laid, and in the clime of America this heavenly edifice will rise so high that it will be visible from a great distance and the melody of glorification and praise will reach the Abha Kingdom. I beseech God that the Mashriqu'l-Adhkar of Chicago will become the second Mashriqu'l-Adhkar of 'Ishqabad.

Subject: House of Worship [Mashriqu'l-Adhkar]
Quotation: Indeed the day hath come whereon the divine edifice, the merciful sanctuary and the spiritual Temple must be raised in America. For this is the first House of Worship that shall be established in those regions for the commemoration of His praise -- a praise which shall reach the Kingdom of divine mysteries. And from that Temple shall be heard the anthems of glorification throughout all regions.

Subject: House of Worship [Mashriqu'l-Adhkar]
Quotation: A very large Mashriqu'l-Adhkar will be built on the summit of Mount Carmel where the recitation of verses and the chanting of prayers will bring the spirits of the listeners to delight and the souls of the yearning ones to excitement. The singing of the singers there in that light-filled Mashriqu'l-Adhkar will cause tumult, joy, gladness, and delight in the hearts of the righteous and the good.

Subject: House of Worship [Mashriqu'l-Adhkar]
Quotation: This news, in truth, brought forth such joy to the hearts as is impossible to describe or recount, for it hath conjured the image of that noble group carrying the stones in the utmost humility and meekness, yet with honour greater than that of the kings of the world. They are engaged in physical labour in the Mash_riqu'l-Adh_kar, carrying the earth and offering it as a gift to the Threshold of Oneness

Subject: House of Worship [Mashriqu'l-Adhkar]
Quotation: Among the most important affairs is the founding of the Mashriqu'l-Adhkar. When the Mashriqu'l-Adhkar was founded in 'Ishqabad its clamour affected all the cities of the Orient and caused souls to awaken (to the call). This organization of the Mashriqu'l-Adhkar will be a pattern for the coming centuries and will hold the station of the mother and thus later in other cities many Mashriqu'l-Adhkars will be its offspring.

Subject: House of Worship [Mashriqu'l-Adhkar]
Quotation: Several years ago, mention was made of the Mashriqu'l-Adhkar in the letter of Mirza Asadu'llah which he wrote to this servant, and thou thyself wert also in agreement with him in this matter. The House of Worship was previously built in Mosul, and the Land of Kha also intended [to build one], and the Sun of Permission hath risen from the Most Holy Court for [its construction] in certain lands if they proceed with wisdom

Subject: House of Worship [Mashriqu'l-Adhkar]
Quotation: The Mashriqu'l-Adhkar is circular in shape. It has nine paths, nine gardens, nine pools with fountains and nine gates. Each path will lead to a center such as an orphanage, a hospital, a school, a university and other buildings that are dependencies of the Mashriqu'l-Adhkar. In the building there will be an organ, balconies and a rostrum especially for prayers and devotional programs but addresses may be given there as well.

Subject: House of Worship [Mashriqu'l-Adhkar]
Quotation: The Mashrak-el-Azkar will be erected and hundreds of such structures in due season. It is not a favor to contribute but a blessing to be allowed to give to such purpose... The Mashrak-el-Azkar in Ishqabad has proved to be a great aid to the Cause and so it shall be in America. Wherever the heart of a Believer sincerely worships there is a Mashrak-el-Azkar, but with the growth of the Cause the outward Temple is also necessary.

Subject: House of Worship [Mashriqu'l-Adhkar]
Quotation: The purpose is this: that according to the divine law, the place for common worship and recitation of verses is none other than the Mashriqu'l-Adhkar. It abrogateth all the previous gatherings and assemblages of worship. The loved ones of God must, to the extent possible, assist with the expenses of this gathering, until such time when, God willing, the Mashriqu'l-Adhkar shall be established with the utmost majesty and dominion.

Subject: House of Worship [Mashriqu'l-Adhkar]
Quotation: Indeed you spare no effort in this respect and I entertain the hope that this endeavour may grow day by day. Deeds are like unto trees; for to plant a shrub is no difficult matter while the care necessary for its growth and yielding fruit is hard and difficult. So far effort was expended to lay the foundation of the Temple but now its erection and completion is a difficult matter and may hope is that the friends of God may be therein assisted.

Subject: House of Worship [Mashriqu'l-Adhkar]
Quotation: That house was considered among the sacred spots and reverence for it is an obligatory matter... Strive with complete determination, desire and importance to deliver that frequented house from the hands of strangers and make it the Mashriqu'l-Adhkar of the righteous... even as in other lands the Mashriqu'l-Adhkar caused the fire of God's love to blaze, created great enthusiasm and delight in hearts, and bestowed divine glad-tidings upon souls.

Subject: House of Worship [Mashriqu'l-Adhkar]
Quotation: Dr. Esslemont spoke of a Tablet in which it said only the Words of Baha'u'llah were to be read in the Mashriqu'l-Adhkar. "Does this mean that the Words of the Bab and 'Abdu'l-Baha are not to be read?" ... "There is no harm in it. But the essential thing is the reading of the Words of Baha'u'llah. The Prayers of His Holiness the Bab are also good. If it becomes necessary to have an explanation of some topic that comes up, they may refer to the Words of 'Abdu'l-Baha."

Subject: House of Worship [Mashriqu'l-Adhkar]
Quotation: Four great, mighty, and exalted tablets shall be placed on the four sides of the Temple, the seat of the Throne, at the height of one person's stature, containing the Visitation of God that was revealed from the tongue of His grandeur. Golden lines upon crystal in whatever manner is suitable and beautiful upon crystal, such that the words may be removed through chemical components or written with pure liquid gold, or in whatever other manner the craftsmanship may require.

Subject: House of Worship [Mashriqu'l-Adhkar]
Quotation: Now the work on the Mashriqu'l-Adhkar has become somewhat difficult - a sum is needed to construct the dome but nothing is available...for this is the first Mashriqu'l-Adhkar established in the world. It is of great importance and significance in the sight of God. Each of its bricks and stones equals the construction of a mighty palace in the path of God, for this Mashriqu'l-Adhkar is now the cause of the exaltation of the Word of God and the greatness of the Cause of God.

Subject: House of Worship [Mashriqu'l-Adhkar]
Quotation: The meaning is this that in every place first a Mashrak-el-azkar must be founded; then a School for the education of orphan children and the poor; then the Hospital and Medical Dispensary must be founded; then the Home of the Cripple; then the College of Higher Scientific Education. In every city a great Mashrak-el-azkar must be founded after this order. Now we hope the Mashrak-el-azkar may be founded in Chicago. After its foundation the important accessories may gradually be founded.

Subject: House of Worship [Mashriqu'l-Adhkar]
Quotation: In the deduction of our necessary expenses, are contributions to the Mashriq'u'l Adhkar, Teaching and other activities of the Cause considered as part of Huquq or should they be taken separately? A.B. replied that Huquq was separate and independent of these and came first. After that had been determined then the other affairs could be looked after. He smiled and said when Huquq is given Abdu'l Baha will ascertain how much of it is for the Mashriq'u'l Adhkar, how much for teaching and how much for the needy, etc.

Subject: House of Worship [Mashriqu'l-Adhkar]
Quotation: The model of the Mashrekol-Azkar made by Mr. Bourgeois was approved by his honor, Mr. Remey, and selected by the Convention. The model of the Mashrekol-Azkar is, however, too big. It needs several millions of dollars for the cost (of construction). If possible, Mr. Bourgeois may reproduce the same model on a smaller scale, so that one million dollars may suffice for its construction. This should be reconsidered only if possible. Thy services to the Mashrekol-Azkar are accepted at the Threshold of the Most Great One.

Subject: House of Worship [Mashriqu'l-Adhkar]
Quotation: This delightful spot is worthy of this edifice and building. However, it must be enlarged yet a little more, so that spacious ground around the Mashrak-el-Azkar may afford ample room for a rose garden. The Mashrak-el-Azkar, though outwardly a material foundation, is possessed of spiritual effect and causes the union of hearts and the gathering of souls. In the days of the Manifestation, any city, wherein a Temple was founded, afforded the means of promulgation and the confirmation of hearts and the confidence of souls.

Subject: House of Worship [Mashriqu'l-Adhkar]
Quotation: The Mashriqu'l-Adhkar is the dawning place of lights and the gathering place of the righteous and noble.  When heavenly gatherings are held therein, devotions are offered, divine verses are intoned in wondrous voices and prayers are chanted, the inhabitants of the Concourse on High hearken unto them and cry out with the call of "blessed, blessed are ye!" that, praise be unto God, in the lower realm, angels from Kingdom of Glory have arisen to pray and supplicate and to intone the verses of Divine Unity in a holy gathering.

Subject: House of Worship [Mashriqu'l-Adhkar]
Quotation: At present it is clearly evident that if it were to be established, it would become a cause of provocation to the oppressors. Therefore, it would be better if an undisclosed location were designated where the loved ones of God might gather by chance and engage in worship, prayer and the chanting of verses. And if contributions are collected for the Mashriqu'l-Adhkar, send those contributions now to the House of Blessing in Ishqabad, so that when an opportune time arrives with no impediments, those funds may be used to establish the Mashriqu'l-Adhkar.

Subject: House of Worship [Mashriqu'l-Adhkar]
Quotation: The glad tidings of the near completion of the Mashriqu'l-Adhkar, the arrangement of its gardens, and the imminent flow of its fountains have brought infinite joy. In truth, the Mashriqu'l-Adhkar will be most spiritual, fragrant, and pure. The solidity and grace of the edifice, the fine arrangement of its avenues, the design of its flowers, the gushing of its fountains, the blossoming of its trees, the purity of its air, and the sweetness of its vistas shall all be combined to form a paradise of utmost purity. Indeed, it shall become peerless and unrivaled.

Subject: House of Worship [Mashriqu'l-Adhkar]
Quotation: Today in the forefront of all urgent affairs is the building of a Mashriqu'l-Adhkar, that at dawn-tide and in the early morn, souls may devote themselves to the praise and glorification of the loving Lord, thus gaining endless joy and peace. If in some area the public raising up of a Mashriqu'l-Adhkar should prove unwise, that is, should it provoke the alarms, the protests and attacks of evil-doers, then by all means let it be established in some hidden place, and even underground. This matter is most weighty; it is an obligation laid without exception upon all the believers.

Subject: House of Worship [Mashriqu'l-Adhkar]
Quotation: The church, the synagogue, the mosque will continue to exist as a house of public worship - Mashriqu'l-Adhkar. Even every private person may in his house make an appropriate room into a private place of worship for the joint edification of friends and acquaintances among the Baha'is. The Blessed Perfection (Baha'u'llah) has ordained in the Kitab-i-Aqdas that there should not be any pictures, portraits, statues put up in the places of worship, but only inscriptions, verses, mystic monograms and numerical symbols, arabesques, ornaments, wall-hangings, carpets, beautiful vases, incense burners etc.

Subject: House of Worship [Mashriqu'l-Adhkar]
Quotation: You had praised and extolled the luminosity of that gathering. In truth, the convention of delegates in Chicago was a heavenly assembly, confirmed by divine confirmations. A ray from the Abha Kingdom was manifested and a life-giving breeze wafted from the direction of grace. It was a glimpse of the effulgence of the Sun of Truth that the divine friends gathered in that luminous assembly in utmost love, unity and oneness. Through the power of divine confirmation, the purpose of all was to serve the Cause of God, to manifest servitude at the Divine Threshold, and to establish the Mashriqu'l-Adhkar.

Subject: House of Worship [Mashriqu'l-Adhkar]
Quotation: Explain to the people the details of the Mashrak-el-Azkar in Chicago and tell them how contributions are received from the East and the West.
