For example, at this moment four contributions were received in one day from Rangoon, Bombay (India), Jahram of Shiraz and Kheirol-Gora of Khorassan for the Mashrak-el-Azkar of America and were forwarded to their destination. Truly, I say, the friends of God displayed wonderful generosity in regard to the contributions for the Mashrak-el-Azkar. They displayed magnanimity at any cost to such an extent that some of them sold portions of their clothing on the streets.

Subject: House of Worship [Mashriqu'l-Adhkar]
Quotation: How self-sacrificing he was in the rearing of the Mashriqu'l-Adhkar! He completely dedicated his life until he succeeded in establishing the first Mashriqu'l-Adhkar in that land. This service was extremely great, for this is the first Mashriqu'l-Adhkar that hath, in the name of God, been reared in the world, and it therefore hath great importance. In the future, however, a hundred thousand Mashriqu'l-Adhkars shall be reared with the utmost glory, dignity, and majesty. This Mashriqu'l-Adhkar of 'Ishqabad hath the station of the mother, and the other Mashriqu'l-Adhkars are like unto children that shall be born from it.

Subject: House of Worship [Mashriqu'l-Adhkar]
Quotation: The consultative spiritual assembly, as well as the Mashriqu'l-Adhkar, are of great import and have beneficial consequences. Insofar as possible, the Mashriqu'l-Adhkar should remain fixed in a single location, for to move it from place to place, without wisdom and in the absence of dire necessity, would lead to despondency. The loved ones of God must, of a certainty, attach the utmost significance to both of these institutions, for in these days they have become extremely important and are absolutely obligatory. In any village in which even two of the friends reside, a Mashriqu'l-Adhkar must be designated, even if it be established beneath the ground, in order that its goodly effects may be witnessed in the future.

Subject: House of Worship [Mashriqu'l-Adhkar]
Quotation: Verily the founding of the Mashriqu'l-Adhkar will mark the inception of the Kingdom of God on earth. It is the evident standard waving in the center of that great continent of America. Should the believers undertake (the erection of the Temple) in many places, it will not become completed anywhere; and as in Chicago they have preceded every other place to plan the erection of the Temple, undoubtedly to cooperate and help them is nobler and a necessity. Then when it is built in one place it will become erected in many other places. God willing, in all the states of America in the future there will be erected Temples, with infinite architectural beauty, with pleasing proportions and handsome and attractive appearances.

Subject: House of Worship [Mashriqu'l-Adhkar]
Quotation: 'Abdu'l-Baha hath long cherished the desire that a Mashriqu'l-Adhkar be upraised in that region. Praised be God, thanks to the strenuous efforts of the friends, in recent days the joyful news of this hath been announced. This service is highly acceptable at the Threshold of God, for the Mashriqu'l-Adhkar inspiriteth the lovers of God and delighteth their hearts, and causeth them to become steadfast and firm. This is a matter of the utmost significance. If the erection of the House of Worship in a public place would arouse the hostility of evil-doers, then the meeting must, in every locality, be held in some hidden place. Even in every hamlet, a place must be set aside as the Mashriqu'l-Adhkar, and even though it be underground.

Subject: House of Worship [Mashriqu'l-Adhkar]
Quotation: "Verily, the greatest affair and the most important matter today is to establish a Mashriqu'l-Adhkar and to found a Temple, from which the voices of praise may rise to the Kingdom of the majestic Lord." "When the Mashriqu'l-Adhkar is completed, when the lights are emanating therefrom, and the righteous assemble therein, when prayers are offered to the Kingdom of divine mysteries and the voice of glorification is raised to the Supreme Lord, then shall the believers rejoice, and their hearts be dilated, overflowing with the love of the ever-living and self-subsisting God. The people shall hasten to worship in that heavenly Temple, the fragrance of God will be diffused, the Divine Teachings will take root in the hearts like unto the establishment of the spirit in the souls of men and the people will stand firm in the Cause of your Lord, the All-Merciful."

Subject: House of Worship [Mashriqu'l-Adhkar]
Quotation: The other nations have hundreds of thousands of temples, the Christians having as any as a million temples of the greatest structural importance. What result have they yielded, that now this one Mashrak-el-Azkar is said to cause the manifestation of signs and prove a source of light! Among the differences are these: In the other temples superstitions hold and the Reality is missing. Furthermore, today, the establishment of the Mashrak-el-Azkar is of paramount importance, but hereafter it shall not be so. This is the beginning of organization. It is like unto the first church founded in Christianity. It is an expression of the elevation of the Word of God. When the Mashrak-el-Azkar was erected in Ishkabad, its influence was felt in all the Oriental countries. Whosoever heard of it commenced an investigation of the Cause. Now the Mashrak-el-Azkar of Ishkabad like an evident banner waves in the world. And if in Chicago the Mashrak-el-Azkar is established, even in Ishkabad, then you will see what the recognition of the Cause will do.

Subject: House of Worship [Mashriqu'l-Adhkar]
Quotation: Among the most important affairs is the founding of the Mashriqu'l-Adhkar, although weak minds may not grasp its importance: nay, perchance, they imagine this Mashriqu'l-Adhkar to be a temple like other temples. They may say to themselves: Every nation has a hundred thousand gigantic temples; what result have they yielded, that now this one Mashriqu'l-Adhkar (is said) to cause the manifestation of signs and prove a source of light? But they are ignorant of the fact that the founding of this Mashriqu'l-Adhkar is to be in the inception of the organization of the Kingdom. Moreover, the accessories of the Mashriqu'l-Adhkar are numerous. Among them are the school for orphans, the great college for the higher arts, hospital, home for the cripples, and hospice. The doors of these places are to be opened to all sects-no differentiations. When these accessories are completed, and, by God's help and aid, the departments fully systematized, it will be proved that the Mashriqu'l-Adhkar is to human society a great bounty and a great blessing.

Subject: House of Worship [Mashriqu'l-Adhkar]
Quotation: Thousands of Mashriqu'l-Adhkars, dawning points of praise and mention of God for all religionists will be built in the East and in the West, but this, being the first one erected in the Occident, has great importance. In the future there will be many here and elsewhere -- in Asia, Europe, even in Africa, New Zealand and Australia -- but this edifice in Chicago is of especial significance. It has the same importance as the Mashriqu'l-Adhkar in Ishqabad, Caucasus, Russia, the first one built there. In Persia there are many; some are houses which have been utilized for the purpose, others are homes entirely devoted to the divine Cause, and in some places temporary structures have been erected. In all the cities of Persia there are Mashriqu'l-Adhkars, but the great dawning point was founded in Ishqabad.... It is centrally located, nine avenues leading into it, nine gardens, nine fountains; all the arrangement and construction is according to the principle and proportion of the number nine.

Subject: Imam 'Ali
Quotation: Heard ye not that Ali, peace be upon him, was on the brink of a lofty mountain, when one of the doubters said to him, "Do you rely, O Ali, on God and His protection...?" He said: "And how could I not do so when He is the All-Protector, the All-Kind." He said: "Then throw yourself from the peak of this lofty mountain, if you are certain." He said, peace be upon him: "It is not for the servant to test his lord, neigh it is for God to test the servant."

Subject: Imam 'Ali
Quotation: Yet another of the valuable possessions of the Blessed Beauty was the prayer of Kumayl in the handwriting of the Imam 'Ali, son of Abu-Talib, in the Kufic style of calligraphy. The scholars of that day, including Mir 'Imad, had testified in writing that the handwriting was that of the Imam 'Ali. It was truly of such value that no price could be put on it.

Subject: Imam 'Ali
Quotation: Say: Have ye not heard that on the Day of Resurrection Ali shall take by the hand those who have believed in him and deliver them from the fire? Do ye not see how Ali hath aforetime declared: They have followed me in the Cause of my Lord? And whosoever followeth him in the Cause of his Lord, verily he shall be delivered therefrom and shall enter Paradise as a mercy from his Lord.

Subject: Imam Husayn
Quotation: Blessed is he who visits My Name Husayn...and what befell you from the enemies of the Self of God, your Lord.

Subject: Imam Husayn
Quotation: They slay Husayn and then weep for him...Muhammad, the Apostle of God, bewails their deeds in the highest paradise

Subject: Imam Husayn
Quotation: The text specifically mentions prostration on "the soil of Husayn - upon him be thousands of praises and greetings"

Subject: Imam Husayn
Quotation: By God! The tradition of God concerning the soul of Husayn hath returned, nay the traditions of the Messengers, until I arrived in this most remote Prison.

Subject: Imam Husayn
Quotation: we would sacrifice our lives in their path and recite in detail the Visitation Tablet for the Prince of Martyrs, our eyes becoming like spring clouds with tears upon hearing it.

Subject: Imam Husayn
Quotation: Then remember those days when the heedless made captives of the family of the Apostle - those by whose faces Yathrib and Ba??a were illumined - until they entered spacious Damascus.

Subject: Imam Husayn
Quotation: For one thousand three hundred years the Prince of Martyrs was killed, and still lamentations and cries are raised for him. The Prince of Martyrs uttered one "I thirst" and how many thirsty ones were satisfied.

Subject: Imam Husayn
Quotation: The polytheists of the Plain of Taff were asked: "For what crime did you martyr the son of the Messenger of God?" They replied saying that he had risen against the Imam of the Age. Now they say that Hasan and Husayn had risen against the Friday prayer leader.

Subject: Imam Husayn
Quotation: The All-Merciful intended by the mention of Joseph the very soul of the Prophet and fruit of the Virgin, Husayn son of Ali son of Abu Talib, as witnessed. And verily God ordained his martyrdom through the testimony of Unity by Himself from Himself in truth, accepted.

Subject: Imam Husayn
Quotation: Multiple references throughout describing Husayn's martyrdom at Karbala, his seeking water, and God's witnessing of his sacrifice: The people disbelieved in God after Husayn arose in the land of Taff, proclaiming from the station of love, detached from all save God, the Ancient One.

Subject: Imam Husayn
Quotation: His liver - may my spirit be his sacrifice - had become from thirst like a piece of iron in fire. If they deny, then witness with thine own eyes how he bore the holy struggle with such tremendous thirst. He mounted his steed for the sake of God and donned his father's cloak to manifest the grandeur of God's friend. Then he stood firm in God's majesty before the army of polytheism, bearing witness to God's unity and to Muhammad's - peace be upon him and his family - prophethood.

Subject: Imam Husayn
Quotation: Oppression hath reached such a pitch that the pen and the tongue alike are powerless and inadequate to recount or express it. Souls who at no time harmed another soul; who comported themselves with perfect love and kindliness; and who lived on terms of friendliness with all the peoples and kindreds of the earth - behold what was inflicted upon them! Were it to be inquired of those two embodiments of ignorance who regard themselves as learned, "Wherefore slew ye these wronged ones, notwithstanding that no crime or sin had been committed on their part?," they would, in reply, undoubtedly repeat the same words uttered by the mouths of the infidels in respect of the Prince of Martyrs - may all else but him be His sacrifice. After the business of the Land of Kaf, the company of the oppressors were wont to repeat this utterance:  "Husayn beyond his limit stray'd,  so slain was, by his grandsire's blade."

Subject: Imam Husayn
Quotation: There hath befallen you in the path of God that which befell the sons of the Apostle, their daughters and their womenfolk, in the Land of Taff (Karbila) and other lands.

Subject: Imam Husayn
Quotation: The people disbelieved in God after Husayn arose in the land of Taff, proclaiming from the station of love, detached from all save God, the Ancient One. And God is knowing of all things. The people turned away from God and from the rewards of the twin Paradises, accursed with Satan's unbelief. They followed in their polytheism Satan's dominion, turning away from God, the Truth - and He is God, the Mighty, the Praised One - God, there is no God but He, the Truthful in utterance through the tongue of the Gate, in truth and by the truth, worthy of all gratitude. Soon shall We punish those who warred against Husayn on the banks of the Euphrates with the severest chastisement and mighty retribution, in truth and by the truth. What aileth you, O hosts of Satan? Did not the Truth come to you upon his steed on the Day of Ashura, after he had proclaimed unto you, in truth and by the truth, God's most great Cause from his own self, with utmost intensity? Did he not humbly seek water for himself and for his infant child, prostrate upon the earth in sublime truth, weak in that mighty Cause?

Subject: Islamic laws and jurisprudence
Quotation: Therefore, if someone does not follow Islamic laws and beliefs has a relationship with me, my pure forefathers and I will be displeased with him in this world and the next.

Subject: Islamic laws and jurisprudence
Quotation: The Shaykhis, contrary to the Shi'ites, believe that reliance on conjecture in matters of faith is forbidden; one must rely on deeds, as mentioned in most parts of the Quran.

Subject: Islamic laws and jurisprudence
Quotation: I give the example of Islamic law and the law that preceded it, of which thou art aware and cannot deny. If a Christian, according to his law and custom, demands payment for wine or a portion of swine meat from one of his co-religionists, and afterward both become honored by accepting Islam, and the deputies of the Most Holy Law wish to secure the right of the wronged one - how do they proceed and exact the right, given that in Islamic law wine and swine meat are of no use and have no value and yield no fruit for the rightful owner?

Subject: Islamic laws and jurisprudence
Quotation: Likewise in the Islamic world, they say religious matters are all matters of blind obedience, whether or not science and reason confirm them. However, one Islamic sect interpreted religious matters saying What is ruled by religious law is ruled by reason - but this too was merely interpretation.

Subject: Islamic rituals; holy days; practices; etc.
Quotation: The story takes place in the context of Islamic preaching in a mosque

Subject: Islamic rituals; holy days; practices; etc.
Quotation: The text lists seven specific Islamic religious observances including prostration, prayer recitation, and wearing inscribed rings

Subject: Islamic rituals; holy days; practices; etc.
Quotation: People chatting, smoking, talking and drinking coffee and tea while Koran was chanted; at such feasts El Koran is chanted by very great singers

Subject: Islamic rituals; holy days; practices; etc.
Quotation: And now there is no doubt that religion has not changed nor will it change, and my belief in the laws of religion is what I now write in this book.

Subject: Islamic rituals; holy days; practices; etc.
Quotation: During the call to prayer in the Dispensation of the Furqan (Qur'an), placing the hand beside the ear was an ancient custom and longstanding practice of the muezzins.

Subject: Islamic rituals; holy days; practices; etc.
Quotation: I performed the circumambulation of the House on behalf of the owners... After departing from the city of Mecca, I traveled by land and was honored to reach the pure city of Medina

Subject: Islamic rituals; holy days; practices; etc.
Quotation: Is it necessary to arise to say the midnight prayer, or the prayer of the Dawn, or to wash the hands and face before using these? No, the ablution is only for the obligatory daily prayer which should be said three times a day.

Subject: Islamic rituals; holy days; practices; etc.
Quotation: That all things may bear witness to that for which Thou didst created them - the testimony that there is no God but God and that Muhammad is the Messenger of God and that the Imams are the Proofs of God and that the Gates of the House are the Manifestations of God's Mystery.

Subject: Islamic rituals; holy days; practices; etc.
Quotation: The serious question arises: 'Has the Lord God foreseen that this human being will not let himself be saved, or has He, for reasons inscrutable to us, let him be ensnared from the beginning in folly and delusion?' Forget not, O my guest, that the Christian religion expresses itself more in belief than in actions, but Islam concerns itself more with deeds than with belief.

Subject: Islamic rituals; holy days; practices; etc.
Quotation: Thereupon he speaketh the Takbirs: In the first: "We all, verily, worship God." In the second: "We all, verily, bow down before God." In the third: "We all, verily, are devoted unto God." In the fourth: "We all, verily, are rememberers of God." In the fifth: "We all, verily, give praise unto God." In the sixth: "We all, verily, are patient in God." (Each of these is to be repeated nineteen times.)

Subject: Islamic rituals; holy days; practices; etc.
Quotation: O pilgrim to the Ka'bah of the Friend! Praise be to God that thou hast been honored to visit the House of God, hast been blessed with the greater pilgrimage, and after the veil was lifted, didst enter the Most Pure Sanctuary. Thou didst circumambulate and taste from the spiritual Zamzam of holiness, and with utmost longing and desire didst run with the feet of detachment between the spiritual Safa and divine Marwah.

Subject: Islamic rituals; holy days; practices; etc.
Quotation: This is a Day whereon there gather at Thy House, by the word of Thy Beloved, such numbers as none can reckon save Thee, and likewise at His tomb, and likewise at the places...Thus was their remembrance ordained among the servants in Islam, as Thy Beloved made that day a festival wherein they might honor one another, draw close to one another, and approach each other in obedience to Thy Messenger's command and to exalt the Word of Thy Prophet.

Subject: Islamic rituals; holy days; practices; etc.
Quotation: The first obligatory prayer is the noon prayer of four rak'ahs, then the afternoon prayer likewise, then the sunset prayer of three rak'ahs, then the night prayer like the first, then the dawn prayer of half that, then the Friday prayer during the days of occultation which is two rak'ahs... Then there is the prayer for solar eclipse, lunar eclipse, earthquakes, and for every wondrous sign that descends from heaven or occurs on earth by God's leave. Then the circumambulation prayer for obligatory pilgrimage and lesser pilgrimage and women's circumambulation.

Subject: Islamic rituals; holy days; practices; etc.
Quotation: O Ali! A group is gathered in that place, and by the True One Himself, it hath been witnessed that one of those souls continuously struck himself against stone and mud and wall for more than four hours until there was fear of his perishing. Then he would fall unconscious to the ground and for about two hours would have no awareness at all. And they count these things among spiritual gifts. God is quit of them and We are quit of them. Likewise there is a group known as the Rifa'i. These souls, by their own account, walk through fire and in moments of ecstasy strike each other with swords in such manner that the observer would think they had severed their own limbs. All this is but tricks and deceit and guile from their own selves.

Subject: John the Baptist
Quotation: So, having regard to this state and station, Christ announced that John the Baptist was Elias, who was to come before Christ. And the likeness of this station is as that of lamps kindled (from one another): for these in respect to their glasses and oil-holders, are different, but in respect to their light, One, and in respect to their illumination, One; nay, each one is identical with the other, without imputation of plurality, or diversity or multiplicity or separateness.

Subject: Judaism; the Torah; the Jewish people
Quotation: Remember when the Interlocutor (Moses) came with clear signs, every remote scholar turned away from Him.

Subject: Judaism; the Torah; the Jewish people
Quotation: Two Jewish children have written a beautiful commentary proving the Cause of Christ, Muhammad, and the Blessed Perfection.

Subject: Judaism; the Torah; the Jewish people
Quotation: This is the day in which Zion dances with joy. That day has come for you to return to Palestine and see how it is flourishing.

Subject: Judaism; the Torah; the Jewish people
Quotation: Of course it is forbidden in the laws of Moses to intermarry with strangers...Unto them a son will be born who will be your promised Messiah.

Subject: Judaism; the Torah; the Jewish people
Quotation: His Holiness Moses offers praise in the Kingdom of sanctification for your enkindlement and attraction...His Holiness Abraham, the Friend, in the exalted Kingdom

Subject: Judaism; the Torah; the Jewish people
Quotation: Some of the prophets were commissioned at night in the world of vision. In the world of vision they would see a luminous person or divine form address them saying: "Go to the land of Israel and convey such and such, say such and such."

Subject: Judaism; the Torah; the Jewish people
Quotation: The Blessed Beauty explicitly stated in the Holy Tablets that Israel's days of abasement have passed, the shadow of divine grace encompasses them, and this people will progress day by day and be freed from the inertia and humiliation of thousands of years.

Subject: Judaism; the Torah; the Jewish people
Quotation: Because the Children of Israel were wavering, doubts would continually arise for them. These doubts cast them into such afflictions. If the Children of Israel had possessed steadfastness, neither the events of Nebuchadnezzar nor the events of Titus would have occurred.

Subject: Judaism; the Torah; the Jewish people
Quotation: O divine loved ones, descendants of His Holiness the Illustrious Abraham...This is the gift of God, this is the grace of the All-Merciful, this is the divine promise to His Holiness Abraham, peace be upon him. Truly you are descendants of that illustrious personage and progeny of that beautiful master.

Subject: Judaism; the Torah; the Jewish people
Quotation: Moreover, in the time of Christ, the general morals and condition of the Children of Israel had become entirely corrupt and degraded, and Israel had fallen into the depths of abasement, bondage and humiliation. One day they were captive to Persia and Chaldea, another day subject to the Assyrian state; one day they were the subjects of Greece, another day submissive and abject before Rome.

Subject: Judaism; the Torah; the Jewish people
Quotation: The Israelites raised up such a tumult and displayed such attraction and enkindlement that the glorious spirit of His Holiness Abraham found gladness and joy in the Most Glorious Kingdom, for praise be to God, this lineage of the Israelites in the Day of His Manifestation beheld the dawning of the Light, hastened to the sanctified shelter of the All-Forgiving Lord, and gathered beneath the banner of the Creator.

Subject: Judaism; the Torah; the Jewish people
Quotation: O beloved friends of Abdu'l-Baha! Praise be to God, the horizon of Israel has become illumined and the bestowals of the Glorious Lord unto His Friend Abraham have become and shall continue to become manifest. The Israelites of Iran have, in truth, completely rent asunder the veil of vain imaginings, have transcended the realm of metaphor, and have worshipped the Beauty of Reality. They have become the cause of pride and glory to all Israelites.

Subject: Judaism; the Torah; the Jewish people
Quotation: Now, for nearly three thousand years, Israel had fallen to the depths and become abased and humiliated. Yet again the rays of grace have shone forth and the manifestation of divine bounty has been perfected. The descendant of Abraham has been illumined and the light of ancient glory has dawned. The morn of divine favors has risen and the star of beneficence has gleamed bright. Soon you shall observe that God's promise concerning Abraham's lineage shall be particularly fulfilled and joy shall unveil its countenance.

Subject: Judaism; the Torah; the Jewish people
Quotation: As for the word Israel, this was the title of Jacob himself, not his children. After the term Bani-Israel (Children of Israel), the word son was dropped and Israel alone was used. This is common in languages; for example, the children of Ham are called Ham, the children of Japheth are called Japheth, the Turkish lineage is called Turk, and the children of Ya'rub are called Arab. There are many such examples. Later, the term Israel was applied to the people of God, as mentioned in the Torah, meaning the community of God, and in this sense it was applied to all souls who turned to God.

Subject: Judaism; the Torah; the Jewish people
Quotation: Today is a day when particular thoughts, whether from individuals or nations, cause great misfortune and ultimately lead to evident loss. What is universal today is divine and causes the progress of all humanity, while what is particular is pure detriment and sheer loss. Now Israel must abandon sick thoughts and with sound determination engage in universal matters. Israel's thoughts must settle on what benefits all and brings happiness to all humanity. Today success accompanies those who, like the sun, shed divine radiance upon all horizons and are completely detached from personal and national restrictions that spring from satanic whisperings. This is the foundation of triumph and prosperity.

Subject: Judaism; the Torah; the Jewish people
Quotation: Question: The American turns to the Master: "Honoured Teacher, what does the Prophet of the Baha'i Religion teach regarding the future of Israel, will Israel remain the Chosen People - until the end of time?"   Answer:  The Master explains: "...If we study the Bible, the Holy Book of the Jews and Christians, the light of understanding will dawn for us. By whom have the Jews been chosen? We are agreed on this -by God, the Almighty! For what, to what purpose have they been chosen: for service, for sacrificial service, and because service and sacrifice are synonymous with suffering, the answer is: God, the All-Highest, has chosen the people of Israel for service and for suffering.... There have been and are those divines in God who consider the people of Israel as a chosen people, because it has been chosen by the Lord God in the highest degree as the bearer of His Revelation. If one thinks about it, one is tempted to ask: Why has the Almighty made particularly this small, insignificant Semitic people into the place and instrument of His Revelation? Have not three of the greatest divine Manifestations: Moses, Christ and Muhammad sprung from the Semitic womb? The answer must be: The Almighty is the sovereign Potter Who forms in absolute freedom the vessels of honour and of dishonour, Who gives suitable form and the right content and adds the greatness or smallness of responsibility to each vessel according to eternal standards. He is the Creator, Preserver, Director and Judge at the same time. His judgment spans three or four human generations, His mercy, however, illumines a thousand generations! Let us bow to His boundless wisdom, His unimaginable mercy; to Him do we commend the chosen people of Israel, to Him do we commend ourselves and all mankind."

Subject: Judas
Quotation: A question was asked regarding the elder brother and the Master replied: In any cycle or time someone has shown pride. In the time of Christ it was Judas. In the days of the Blessed Perfection, Subhi Ezel. Now it is the head of the Nakazeen [Mirza Muhammad 'Ali].

Subject: Letters of the Living
Quotation: And if ye obey God and then the Letters of the Living, then ye shall be guided within your own selves.

Subject: Letters of the Living
Quotation: The Letters of Truth are the Letters of the Living. These are they who believe in God, deliver the messages of their Lord, and are assured in Him.

Subject: Letters of the Living
Quotation: The first to believe in the Primal Point, may my spirit be sacrificed for Him, was the revered Mulla Husayn-i-Bushrui, the Babu'l-Bab, not the Quddus.

Subject: Letters of the Living
Quotation: The Exalted Herald (the Bab) says to one of the Letters of the Living that you comprehend Him, but verily the Cause is mighty, mighty. God willing, may you be occupied in the nights and days with the remembrance of the Lord of all beings, and be steadfast on His path, arise in His service, and speak His praise.

Subject: Letters of the Living
Quotation: And upon the Letters of the Living and upon those who seek shelter beneath the shade of that Tree until the Day when Thou shalt renew it through the renewal of Thy light and raise it up through the manifestation of Thy creation

Subject: Letters of the Living
Quotation: For they consist of 14 sacred Souls, and the Hidden, Well-Guarded Name, Whose 4 letters are called by various names including the Four Gates, the Lights of the Throne, and the Bearers of creation, provision, death, and life. Together They comprise the number of the word the Living (hayy=18), Who are the most near Names unto God. All others besides Them are guided through Their guidance, inasmuch as God hath proceeded the creation of the Bayan from Them, and hath ordained that unto Them they shall return.

Subject: Letters of the Living
Quotation: The names of the Letters of the Living are as follows: [list of 18 names]. The greatness and glory of most of these Letters of the Living resides solely in the fact that they professed their faith at the very beginning. Among them and in terms of importance, a few souls occupy a primary position-Mulla Husayn, Quddus, and Tahirih; a few other blessed souls occupy a secondary position; and the rest are honoured solely for having believed in the very beginning-two of them even, like Judas Iscariot, recanted their faith later.

Subject: Letters of the Living
Quotation: By the testimony of the Point, the Letters of the Bayan are infinitely greater and more excellent than the Imams of the Qur'an.

Subject: Letters of the Living
Quotation: It is most clear that the Primal Point, exalted be His grandeur, made no mention except of the Letters of the Unity and the Mirrors. He designated the Letters of Unity as the fourteen returned proofs of the Qur'an and the other four from the four gates, and named these souls the Letters of the Living, giving them precedence over all who are in the Bayan. After this rank, He mentioned the Mirrors. Observe that in none of the Tablets did He set a limit to the Mirrors, as He states that if infinite mirrors were to face each other, the light of the sun would be reflected and manifest in all of them, and after their turning away, He states, that bounty is withdrawn. He gave the example of the visible mirror and the visible sun, stating that whosoever wishes to understand should observe the visible sun and the visible mirrors. He removed all Qur'anic limitations, such that it became clear to all who had vision that these people had nothing of truth in their hands, and whatever they had was contrary to it. Now I shall present some matters to you so that, God willing, you may act with insight. For instance, first, if anyone claimed that the Qa'im must be born, they considered such a person an infidel and deemed his execution necessary and obligatory. Second, His existence in Jabulqa and Jabulsa, and likewise they rejected anyone who denied this belief. Third, similarly regarding the seal of prophethood, they firmly held that absolutely no one would ever come after, and if anyone believed that a Manifestation would come, they considered him an infidel, rejected, and among the people of the fire. Fourth, what they mentioned regarding the resurrection, considering its deniers as infidels. Fifth, the mention of the vision of God, considering those who affirmed it as infidels. Sixth, the mention of the bridge, about which they held such vain beliefs. Seventh, the mention of resurrection, wherein they all believed that decayed bones must rise from literal graves, and they considered [its deniers] as infidels, and similar matters that they held. You observe that in none of these sayings were these people truthful. There is no doubt that you yourself confirm that they all spoke of these things unknowingly, as it became clear in the Manifestation of the Point of the Bayan, may the spirit of all else be sacrificed for Him, that all they held was contrary to God's Cause, as if these people had not a single truth in their possession, for they mentioned all these matters unknowingly while considering them true and [their denier] as rejected. Now you yourself confirm that they had not understood any of these matters, and what they were saying was pure falsehood and sheer calumny. Similarly, compare the rest of the statements of this group to the aforementioned matters and keep the heart pure and sanctified from all things. Although today the leaders of the Bayan have cast people into such delusions that, I swear by the Truth, no nations among the nations of the past have ever been tainted by such delusions. And they are now occupied with proofs that even the lowliest among the people of the Furqan (Qur'an) had used as evidence, and they pride themselves on this, hoping that through these imaginary utterances they might deprive the people of the Chosen Beauty.

Subject: Manifestation of God as divine physician
Quotation: He is...the Physician of the hearts and the souls

Subject: Manifestation of God as divine physician
Quotation: In this Day the world of being is like a sick person in need of a trustworthy physician; only a true physician can diagnose the ailment and prescribe a speedy remedy. This sickness cannot be healed by either politics or the promotion of liberal ideas because the disease is a moral one and pertains to the conscience; these ills afflict the souls and minds of human beings. We are in need of a remedy that will revive the spirit, educate the conscience, resuscitate the heart, uplift humankind by endowing each and everyone with the perfections of the All-Merciful.

Subject: Manifestation of God as divine physician
Quotation: For the Spiritual Physician has now entered the visible realm and has diagnosed the cause of all the ailments afflicting the world of humanity, His teachings, counsels and admonitions have shown us the way at last to a speedy recovery and this new and wondrous medication He has prescribed will finally resolve the conflicts and contentions in the world and restore our peace and tranquillity.

Subject: Manifestation of God as divine physician
Quotation: O ye wounded hearts, the divine Physician has come - a thousand remedies flow from His ruby lips

Subject: Manifestation of God as divine physician
Quotation: The divine Manifestations of God had come for this purpose, that man may be informed of the Kingdom of the Lord of Hosts, that he may know divine realities and may attain to the second birth.

Subject: Manifestation of God as divine physician
Quotation: BAHA'O'LLAH is the divine physician who diagnoses the world's malady; for the whole planet is ill and needs the power of a great specialist. BAHA'O'LLAH'S teachings are the health of the world.

Subject: Manifestation of God as divine physician
Quotation: This ailing world with its weakened body and feeble physique has fallen desperately sick and all its chronic maladies have become inveterate. There is no alternative now but to administer the one supreme panacea to relieve its ills and no other medicine left but the Most Great Elixir.

Subject: Manifestation of God as divine physician
Quotation: The knowing Physician unveiled His face and the skilled, truthful Doctor drew back the curtain...However, ignorant physicians and lazy doctors have intervened and forbidden the instant divine remedies, while freely dispensing that which causes the disease to worsen and the ailment to intensify.

Subject: Manifestation of God as divine physician
Quotation: The Prophets are even as physicians engaged in healing the world and its peoples, that through the remedy of unity they may cure the disease of discord. In the doings and prescriptions of the physician there is no room for objection, for he is aware of the constitution of the body and its ailments, and never can the bird of human understanding soar to the height of his knowledge.

Subject: Manifestation of God as divine physician
Quotation: If a physician describes someone's illness, this is out of kindness so they may be cured... I cannot tell someone with tuberculosis that they are healthy - I want to treat them and this is the utmost kindness, not enmity. Therefore if the loved ones of God are kind to someone, they should want what is best for them and endeavor to counsel them so that the kind physician may treat them and they may be healed.

Subject: Manifestation of God as educator
Quotation: But the supreme education is Divine Teaching. Through it the most ignorant become wise and the lowest are elevated to the loftiest heights. One day's education under the inspiration of the Holy Spirit is better than ten years material training in the universities of the world. Baha'o'llah has said two steps are necessary for human development;--Material and Divine Education.

Subject: Manifestation of God as educator
Quotation: May He be their leader to the path of prosperity and success, refine them through divine education and Muhammadan virtues, and cause them to inherit eternal glory.

Subject: Manifestation of God as educator
Quotation: to open spiritual universities, to be instructed in the mysteries of the love of God by the Heavenly Instructor

Subject: Manifestation of God as educator
Quotation: Through His name "the Educator of the World," the Divine Educator has educated all

Subject: Manifestation of God as educator
Quotation: the Dawning-Places of Light and Manifestations of the Revelation of the Forgiving Lord are wondrous, glorious Teachers and peerless, matchless Educators who, in the school of realities, educate these children with divine teachings and nurture them in the cradle of grace

Subject: Manifestation of God as educator
Quotation: These holy Manifestations are the ideal Gardeners of human souls, the divine Cultivators of human hearts. The world of existence is but a jungle of disorder and confusion, a state of nature producing nothing but fruitless, useless trees. The ideal Gardeners train these wild, uncultivated human trees, cause them to become fruitful, water and cultivate them day by day so that they adorn the world of existence and continue to flourish in the utmost beauty.

Subject: Manifestation of God as educator
Quotation: The prophets of God are the real Instructors and Educators, so that they may train the morality of the people; so that the ignorant ones become wise, the blind ones receive sight, the deaf ones become hearing, the mute ones unstop their tongues, the pusillanimous become magnanimous, the earthly bird be transformed into the heavenly nightingales, the animalistic souls become divine, the imperfect attain to perfection and those who are captives of nature be released from its fetters.

Subject: Manifestation of God as educator
Quotation: The founders of material civilization are the philosophers of the world and the educators of the spiritual civilization are the holy Persons of divine Manifestations. Therefore if human beings allowed themselves to stray far from material and spiritual educators, they would assuredly succumb to the lowest abyss of the animal world. Material civilization is like a globe and divine civilization as the light thereof. Material civilization may be likened to a body and divine civilization as the spirit. The globe needeth light and the body the spirit.

Subject: Manifestation of God as gardener; cultivator
Quotation: A gardener would be a bad gardener if he allowed rank and noxious [weeds to grow among] his choice plants and beautiful flowers. He must weed them out and destroy them in order to protect and foster the lives of said plants. It is not that he hates the weeds and wishes them evil but that he cherishes and protects his flowers by removing them.

Subject: Manifestation of God as gardener; cultivator
Quotation: As there is and outward, material reality, so there is also an inward, spiritual reality. Take for example, the sun. Unless we dig and plant a piece of ground, and have a gardener to care for the plants, we can have no garden; we shall have no beautiful flowers or plants, but there will be wild forest instead.

Subject: Manifestation of God as gardener; cultivator
Quotation: This Gardener hath come in order to make this unfruitful forest a Divine Garden and increase its trees in fruit yield, through Divine training. Before long thou shalt see how this Gardener will engage in adorning the avenues of hearts withe the flowers of Significances, and make the trees full of blossoms and fruits.

Subject: Manifestation of God as gardener; cultivator
Quotation: I hope that you may become baptized with the Fire of the Love of God and the Water of the Holy Spirit, and that each of you may become a Divine Farmer and sow in the farm of humanity the seeds of reality, irrigating them with the Waters of the Teachings of Baha'u'llah, so that the Light of Truth may illumine that country.

Subject: Manifestation of God as gardener; cultivator
Quotation: Therefore we are expectant and hopeful, watchful and in intense anticipation that this delicate branch, like its noble root, will become fruitful with the utmost freshness and grace, and will gain verdancy and vitality from the life-giving breezes, and will become the ornament and adornament of the divine garden and yield perpetual fruit.

Subject: Manifestation of God as gardener; cultivator
Quotation: When a child is trained in early youth, like a sapling by the stream of knowledge and wisdom, through the care of the Gardener of the garden of unity, drinking from the pure waters of inner meanings, he will surely receive the light of the Sun of Truth, and through its rays and warmth will attain infinite freshness and grace in the garden of existence.

Subject: Manifestation of God as gardener; cultivator
Quotation: When the divine farmer ploughs the ground and scatters the seeds, his heart is attached to it. Day and night he is watching his field to see when the seeds push out of the earth. Then he trains them, waters them till they grow, reach to the stage of fruition and his labors of many months is crowned at last with rich a harvest but if he sees the field is barren, the seeds are not germinating, the hard work is wasted he feels sad and despondent.

Subject: Manifestation of God as gardener; cultivator
Quotation: The example of Persia is like unto a garden which has been taken out of the cultivating hand of the gardener. The wild animals have run through its pastures, its meadows are turned upside down, its trees are leafless, its plants are dried and its tender, fragrant flowers trod under foot; to such an extent that whereas formerly it was a rose-garden it has now become a thorny patch. But when the real gardener appears he takes the garden again under his care and arrange it better than its former condition.

Subject: Manifestation of God as gardener; cultivator
Quotation: Like a gardener I scattered the seed. I hope that those plantations may become rich and green and may give a great harvest, that from day to day it may attain to greater progress.

Subject: Manifestation of God as mediator
Quotation: For example, Jesus claimed, 'I am the way... no man cometh unto the Father, but by me.'

Subject: Manifestation of God as mediator
Quotation: It was in reference to these bestowals that Christ said "The Father is in me and I am in you," like the reflection of the sun in pure mirrors

Subject: Manifestation of God as mediator
Quotation: Every crystalline praise in its essence and every pure radiance in its abstraction points to the sublimity of thy praise and indicates the glory of thy exaltation

Subject: Manifestation of God as mediator
Quotation: Through Thee is God known, for He cannot be known without Thee, and through Thee is God unified, for He cannot be unified except through Thee, and through Thee is God, thy Lord, praised, for He cannot be praised except through Thee.

Subject: Manifestation of God as mediator
Quotation: To cling unto them is to cling unto God, the All-Glorious, and to hold fast unto them is to hold fast unto Him. Whoso hath known them hath known God, and whoso hath obeyed them hath obeyed God, and whoso hath turned away from them hath turned away from them hath turned away from God, the Help in Peril, the Self-Subsisting.

Subject: Manifestation of God as mediator
Quotation: Then strive, O you who are certain of God, not to sever the cord that forms the connection between you and your Lord. This is mighty counsel, for none can draw nigh unto God except through this cord that moves between the heavens and earth. It is God's command among His servants, His means among His creatures, and His way among His creation, if you be of those who know.

Subject: Manifestation of God as mediator
Quotation: In every Revelation, all things shall know Our Self through him who maketh himself known, for these are they who know God their Lord, and these are they who draw proof of God their Lord from His names. And I shall cause My creation to know Me through the Manifestation of My Self, and whoso knoweth Him is indeed the first of My creation, and these are they who ascend in the ocean of Ridvan.

Subject: Manifestation of God as mediator
Quotation: O ye shadows! Before the rising of the sun ye exist not; likewise, before God manifests the Sun of Truth in your religion, ye exist not. Consider how, from the Beginning that hath no beginning, God hath created His creation: how they were powerless to accomplish any matter save through the Messengers whom God raised up. Then, by His command, did they act, and He revealed unto them the Books, through their own tongues, and manifested therein His power, that ye might believe and be assured.

Subject: Manifestation of God as mediator
Quotation: Through us is God known and through us is God worshipped. Were it not for us, God would not be worshipped. The truth of this matter is that the contingent hath ever been contingent, unable to know its Lord, and the Eternal shall never descend to be known in Its Essence. He hath brought forth, through the outpouring of His power and the sovereignty of His creative Will, a sign in the realities of souls and horizons that they might be guided thereby to His knowledge and know Him through it.

Subject: Manifestation of God as mediator
Quotation: The Sacred Reality can never be imagined. People envision an illusion, consider it god, and worship it. However, the Sacred Reality is above all imaginings and sanctified beyond all thoughts, and the only path [to Him] is by way of the Manifestations. Beyond Them is naught but mere invention. "Whosoever believes in Them, believes in God; and whosoever separates himself from Them, has separated himself from God. Whosoever obeys Them, has obeyed God and whosoever denies Them, has denied God."

Subject: Manifestation of God as mirror
Quotation: For Thou, O my God, hast made him the mirror of Thy Self and the one who standeth in the station of Thy oneness.

Subject: Manifestation of God as mirror
Quotation: If a man wishes to know God he must find him in the perfect mirror, Christ or Baha'o'llah. In either of these mirrors he will see reflected the Sun of Divinity.

Subject: Manifestation of God as mirror
Quotation: His likeness is as the sun - if a number of mirrors face it, His manifestation is seen therein, and if a thousand thousand ones face it, likewise, and above that likewise, and below that likewise, then unto what cannot be numbered, likewise. Thus doth God set forth similitudes that ye may show mercy unto your own selves.

Subject: Manifestation of God as mirror
Quotation: The likeness of Him Whom God shall make manifest is as the likeness of the sun, and the likeness of that creation is as the likeness of mirrors. Is the sun multiplied at its rising or its setting? Say: Glory be to God, exalted above such a thing! Likewise, the Manifestation of God is not multiplied, and what has appeared before will appear hereafter.

Subject: Manifestation of God as mirror
Quotation: What is the meaning of the father and the son? We say that this fatherhood and sonship are allegorical and symbolical. The Messianic reality is like unto a mirror through which the sun of divinity has become resplendent. If this mirror expresses, The light is in me - it is sincere in its claim, therefore Jesus was truthful when he said The Father is in me. The sun which is in the sky, and the sun in the mirror are one, are they not?

Subject: Manifestation of God as recipient of divine revelation; Holy Spirit
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/Manifestation of God as recipient of divine revelation; Holy Spirit.txt
Quotation: Christ's nobility and greatness lie not in His fatherlessness but in His divine perfections, bounties and effulgences. Thus it becomes evident that the sacred reality - the true existence of every great one - has been realized through God and brought into being by the breath of the Holy Spirit.

Subject: Manifestation of God as sun
Quotation: Consider the physical world of existence: The solar system would be dark and obscure, but within it the sun is the center of light, and all the planets revolve around it, becoming illumined through its bounties. The sun is the source of life and light, and the cause of the growth and development of all things within the solar system. Without the sun's emanations, no living thing would exist in this system--all would be dark and dispersed. Thus it is clear and evident that the sun is the center of light and the cause of life for all beings in the solar system.... Similarly, the holy Manifestations of God are the centers of the light of Reality, the wellsprings of mysteries and the bounties of love. They shed illumination upon the world of hearts and minds, bestow everlasting grace upon the world of spirits, grant spiritual life, and shine with the light of realities and meanings.

Subject: Manifestation of God as sun
Quotation: The Sun declares: gaze at my splendor and effulgences.

Subject: Manifestation of God as sun
Quotation: through the heat of the Sun of Reality reach perfection and fruition

Subject: Manifestation of God as sun
Quotation: That Dawn of the unseen Glory, that Countenance beyond doubt has come

Subject: Manifestation of God as sun
Quotation: The Manifestation (Baha'o'llah) had all the qualities of the Sun of Truth manifested in him.

Subject: Manifestation of God as sun
Quotation: Reference to souls being "illumined by the rays shining forth from the star of the Most High"

Subject: Manifestation of God as sun
Quotation: Today the Sun of Truth, from the horizon of the prison of 'Akka, speaketh this most sublime Word

Subject: Manifestation of God as sun
Quotation: thou hast recognized the Sun of Truth which hath dawned from the horizon of the heaven of bounty

Subject: Manifestation of God as sun
Quotation: for verily it is one Sun and all else are mirrors wherein is reflected the image of its revelation

Subject: Manifestation of God as sun
Quotation: Lift up those raven locks from Thy moon-like Face, That the sun may get loose from the veil of darkness.

Subject: Manifestation of God as sun
Quotation: O Divine providence, shed a ray from the Sun of Truth upon this gathering that it may become illumined.

Subject: Manifestation of God as sun
Quotation: "It is the Sun of Truth, O Artist." "The Sun of Truth is everywhere. It is shining on the whole world."

Subject: Manifestation of God as sun
Quotation: Detachment is as the sun; in whatsoever heart it doth shine it quencheth the fire of covetousness and self.

Subject: Manifestation of God as sun
Quotation: The Sun of Truth is the Word of God...Its radiance in every mirror appears according to that mirror's color.

Subject: Manifestation of God as sun
Quotation: The world-illuminating Sun is turning toward the West...If this Most Great Luminary had risen from our horizon

Subject: Manifestation of God as sun
Quotation: The divine revelation is described as "the Sun shining from the horizon of the heaven of the knowledge of your Lord"

Subject: Manifestation of God as sun
Quotation: He returneth its body to clay, its essential body to the gates, and its essential self to the Manifestation of praise, which is the Daystar of Truth.

Subject: Manifestation of God as sun
Quotation: As all things are nourished and sustained by the light and warmth of the sun, so are all created things filled with the overflowing bounty of Christ.

Subject: Manifestation of God as sun
Quotation: that light shone forth from the horizon of the Manifestation, appeared upon the horizon of existence...the Sun of Guidance dawned in the horizon of heaven

Subject: Manifestation of God as sun
Quotation: "he shone so brilliantly in the horizon of existence with the lights of prostration that the moon and sun became amazed and became moths to that brilliant lamp"

Subject: Manifestation of God as sun
Quotation: When the Most Great Luminary shed its splendor from the horizons of the nations...The Sun of Truth with one ray rent asunder and destroyed all those veils and shrouds

Subject: Manifestation of God as sun
Quotation: Bay?a' is one of the names of the sun, therefore your radiance and effulgence...This is the gleaming and brilliance of the sun. This light is eternal and this heat is everlasting.

Subject: Manifestation of God as sun
Quotation: The sun and the moon together, His face and eyebrow. He unveiled His Beauty and appeared in the garb of the All-Glorious; The whole world was stunned by the light of His Countenance.

Subject: Manifestation of God as sun
Quotation: "See how His radiant face is transformed, See how His cheeks blush so crimson and fair, How bright is this jewel of beautiful hue" and "His brightness doth lighten the nethermost world"

Subject: Manifestation of God as sun
Quotation: Is it possible to accept the sun and to reject its rays? He who rejects the rays is a rejector of the sun, too... They do not know that the divine Manifestations are the bright rays of the Sun of Truth

Subject: Manifestation of God as sun
Quotation: But now the Divine Joseph of Canaan and the Merciful Beloved of Egypt's throne, with a countenance like the sun and a beauty beyond description or praise by those of understanding, has unveiled Himself

Subject: Manifestation of God as sun
Quotation: Reality is like unto the sun...Even as this sun has become manifest and shining upon all phenomena, all earthly phenomena owe their existence and their development to the sun. The bounty of the sun reaches all.

Subject: Manifestation of God as sun
Quotation: The remembrance of God, in the form of the Sun behind the ocean of grandeur, hath been witnessed above the horizon of utterance...upon it hath moved the Sun of Beauty with a light that hath encompassed all worlds.

Subject: Manifestation of God as sun
Quotation: Therefore, if any soul denies the divine verses and heavenly evidences and lordly favors in this Manifestation, he is deprived of the Most Great Sea and forbidden from the effulgences of the lights of the Sun of Truth.

Subject: Manifestation of God as sun
Quotation: The Sun [of Glory] hath dawned from the horizon of eternity with the ornament of God, the Almighty, the Most High, the Most Exalted... for the Sun of Beauty hath risen at the meridian with the sovereignty of grandeur and majesty.

Subject: Manifestation of God as sun
Quotation: Know that all descriptions, praises, attributes and perfections are among the characteristics of the Sun of Truth, and just as light emanates from it and returns to it, these perfections in other realities are borrowed from that Sun of Truth

Subject: Manifestation of God as sun
Quotation: One kind are the universal Manifestations, which are even as the sun. But the universal Manifestations are all-encompassing: They are like the root, and all others are as the branches; they are like the sun, and all others are as the moon and the stars.

Subject: Manifestation of God as sun
Quotation: The text uses extended solar metaphors to describe the Manifestation: The intensity of its heat would melt bodies, and the radiance of its lights would dazzle eyes. The force of its rays would burn faces, and the fierceness of its flame would roast hearts.

Subject: Manifestation of God as sun
Quotation: That Sun hath no setting and that Luminary of the Supreme Concourse hath no going down. Setting and rising are relative to the people of the earth, but for the sun what rising and what setting? It is ever at the point of burning brightness and at the highest summit of bounty, shining and gleaming.

Subject: Manifestation of God as sun
Quotation: If you want to see the light, you must look at the essence, and not be misled by the lamp through which it manifests itself. For instance, Abraham was a lantern, and Moses was a lantern, Jesus Christ was a lantern, also Mohammed, and the seal of the prophets (Bab) a lantern, in all of which the Lights of GOD were manifest.

Subject: Manifestation of God as sun
Quotation: It is only through the rays of the Sun that the various kingdoms of life on this earth are being warmed and lighted... There was a time when this sun appeared from the Eastern horizon... As soon as the sun rose from its dawning place, flooding the regions with light... This have always been the results whenever the Sun of Reality dawned.

Subject: Manifestation of God as sun
Quotation: When He rose from Iraq, He caused a tumult throughout all regions and cast an illumined radiance upon all existence. Being was set in motion, contingent existence found joy, the realities of all things sought divine meanings, the atoms of creation found the divine Beloved, the East became the dawning-place of lights, and the West became the horizon of effulgence.

Subject: Manifestation of God as sun
Quotation: Consider the sun metaphor where different prophets are described as horizons where the same sun (divine truth) appears: "It is as if one looked at the horizon instead of the sun, and because the sun was last seen at this horizon, should expect it to appear again at the same place. So, one horizon is that of Jesus, another that of Moses, another of Mohammed, etc."

Subject: Manifestation of God as sun
Quotation: Yet, O my God, through Thy great mercy and Thy boundless gift, Thou hast brought into being a luminous Point, a Word of Oneness, a singular Reality, a divine Being, and made it the Sun of Truth. It shone with utmost brilliance upon the mirrors of the horizons and appeared as lights from the Dawning-Place of mysteries, shedding upon existence the light of witness.

Subject: Manifestation of God as sun
Quotation: Behold thou the Ancient Beauty in the mirror of thy heart, then take comfort in Him and be of the thankful. Conceal the beauty of the Cause from the eyes of the polytheists, and His mysteries from the hearts of the misguided. By God, the Truth! These are days wherein God hath tested all the Prophets and Messengers, then those who were behind the pavilions of infallibility and the canopy of grandeur and the tent of glory - how much more these polytheists who have taken their own selves for gods, and when the sovereignty of God and His power, then His grandeur and His majesty are made manifest unto them, they place the hand of rejection over their eyes, then hasten to practice deception that they might cause doubt among the servants.

Subject: Manifestation of God as tree of life; sadratu'l-muntaha
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/Manifestation of God as tree of life; sadratu'l-muntaha.txt

Subject: Manifestation of God as tree of life; sadratu'l-muntaha
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/Manifestation of God as tree of life; sadratu'l-muntaha.txt

Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/Manifestation of God as tree of life; sadratu'l-muntaha.txt

Subject: Manifestation of God as tree of life; sadratu'l-muntaha
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/Manifestation of God as tree of life; sadratu'l-muntaha.txt
Quotation: The Tree of Life mentioned in the Holy Book is Baha'u'llah, and the daughters of the Kingdom are the leaves of that blessed Tree

Subject: Manifestation of God as tree of life; sadratu'l-muntaha
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/Manifestation of God as tree of life; sadratu'l-muntaha.txt
Quotation: and the Divine Lote Tree hath called out from the Most Exalted Horizon: 'Verily, there is none other God but Him, the One, the Single, the All-Knowing.'

Subject: Manifestation of God as tree of life; sadratu'l-muntaha
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/Manifestation of God as tree of life; sadratu'l-muntaha.txt
Quotation: His holiness Moses beheld the flame of fire from the green tree and heard a Voice... Thou hast beheld the kindled fire of the Lord in the Tree that is neither of the East nor of the West

Subject: Manifestation of God as tree of life; sadratu'l-muntaha
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/Manifestation of God as tree of life; sadratu'l-muntaha.txt
Quotation: Verily the Divine Lote-Tree desireth to raise thee up through its sovereignty, and draw thee nigh through its bounty and its hosts, and cause thee to hear its sweetest call and the scratching of its Most Exalted Pen.

Subject: Manifestation of God as tree of life; sadratu'l-muntaha
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/Manifestation of God as tree of life; sadratu'l-muntaha.txt
Quotation: This is a fresh, verdant, graceful and flourishing branch growing from the Tree of Thy divine unity and the Lote-Tree of Thy oneness...Send Thy blessings upon the Tree of Unity and its branches, twigs, leaves, roots, offshoots, conditions and fruits

Subject: Manifestation of God as tree of life; sadratu'l-muntaha
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/Manifestation of God as tree of life; sadratu'l-muntaha.txt
Quotation: The Divine Lote-Tree hath been planted by the hand of this Most Great Remembrance in a Paradise that was hidden from the eyes of the polytheists. It hath been raised up through this Name, as We watered it from the Water of Life which flowed from a luminous and holy Finger. And verily it encompasseth all who are in the heavens and the earth

Subject: Manifestation of God as tree of life; sadratu'l-muntaha
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/Manifestation of God as tree of life; sadratu'l-muntaha.txt
Quotation: Glory and praise be upon the white pearl, the Lote-Tree of the uttermost boundary, the Tree of Blessedness, the benevolent Reality, the celestial Gem, the divine Unique One, the all-embracing Word, the brilliant Flame, the blessed Tree, and upon those who seek shelter beneath its shade, pluck from its flowers, and gather its fruits forever and ever.

Subject: Manifestation of God as tree of life; sadratu'l-muntaha
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/Manifestation of God as tree of life; sadratu'l-muntaha.txt
Quotation: In the Gospel it is said "I am the Vine, the Father, the Husbandman." Mohammed said that god is as a tree. Baha'o'llah said that He was a Divine Lote Tree. In the time of Moses God appeared to Moses as a Bush of Fire, but was not consumed. The meaning of this, is that all Prophets have likened the Cause of god unto a tree. Baha'o'llah said that He was the Lote Tree and the teachers and prophets the Branches and the believers, the leaves.

Subject: Manifestation of God as tree of life; sadratu'l-muntaha
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/Manifestation of God as tree of life; sadratu'l-muntaha.txt
Quotation: Hasten ye to the Tree of God and seek shade beneath it. By the Truth of God! Should ye search throughout all regions of the heavens and earth, ye would find no place of security save beneath the shade of this Tree which hath been raised up over all mankind. Through its boughs wafteth the breath of God whereby every mouldering bone is quickened. Turn ye unto it and eat of its fruits that your hearts may be purified from the promptings of every wicked sinner.

Subject: Manifestation of God does not act of own volition
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/Manifestation of God does not act of own volition.txt
Quotation: The winds of the Divine Will move Me as they please. The Command is in His grasp; He doeth what He willeth through His sovereignty that encompasseth all lands.

Subject: Manifestation of God does not act of own volition
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/Manifestation of God does not act of own volition.txt
Quotation: Not of Mine own volition have I revealed Myself, but God, of His own choosing, hath manifested Me. I was indeed as one dead when His behest was uttered. The hand of the will of thy Lord, the Compassionate, the Merciful, transformed Me.

Subject: Manifestation of God does not act of own volition
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/Manifestation of God does not act of own volition.txt
Quotation: Do ye imagine that the Cause is in my hands? Nay, by the Self of God, the Omnipotent, the Transcendent, the All-Knowing, the All-Wise! By God, were the Cause in my hands, I would not have manifested myself unto you for less than an instant, nor would I have uttered a word - and God is witness unto this and is all-knowing.

Subject: Manifestation of God speaking in the voice of Divinity

Subject: Manifestation of God speaking in the voice of Divinity
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/Manifestation of God speaking in the voice of Divinity.txt
Quotation: My outward calls unto My inward and My inward unto My outward. There is none in the kingdom save Me, and I am the Truth, the Knower of the unseen.

Subject: Manifestation of God speaking in the voice of Divinity
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/Manifestation of God speaking in the voice of Divinity.txt

Subject: Manifestation of God speaking in the voice of Divinity
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/Manifestation of God speaking in the voice of Divinity.txt

Subject: Manifestation of God speaking in the voice of Divinity
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/Manifestation of God speaking in the voice of Divinity.txt

Subject: Manifestation of God speaking in the voice of Divinity
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/Manifestation of God speaking in the voice of Divinity.txt
