Subject: Manifestation of God speaking in the voice of Divinity
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/Manifestation of God speaking in the voice of Divinity.txt
Quotation: O people! By God, the Most Great Spirit of God speaketh in this Ancient Temple as He willeth and desireth. This is not from Me but from Him, would ye but perceive it.

Subject: Manifestation of God speaking in the voice of Divinity
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/Manifestation of God speaking in the voice of Divinity.txt
Quotation: Glory be to Thee, O my God! This is a day among the days of Thy Ridvan wherein one of Thy servants invited the Manifestation of Thy Self and the Dayspring of Thy sovereignty

Subject: Manifestation of God speaking in the voice of Divinity
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/Manifestation of God speaking in the voice of Divinity.txt
Quotation: The Balance hath been set up when the All-Merciful appeared with a Cause that caused all who are in the heavens and earth to swoon away, save whom God willed, the Lord of all worlds.

Subject: Manifestation of God speaking in the voice of Divinity
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/Manifestation of God speaking in the voice of Divinity.txt
Quotation: We heard thy call and drew nigh unto Thee from the frequented House. The heedless ones cast Us into prison, but God hath made it the Most Great Prison, despite every hateful polytheist.

Subject: Manifestation of God speaking in the voice of Divinity
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/Manifestation of God speaking in the voice of Divinity.txt
Quotation: This tablet is in itself a hidden book, which hath from time immemorial been concealed in God's inviolable treasuries, and its verses traced by the Finger of Might, if ye but comprehend.

Subject: Manifestation of God speaking in the voice of Divinity
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/Manifestation of God speaking in the voice of Divinity.txt
Quotation: Verily there is no God but I, the All-Hearing, the All-Seeing." I testify that Thou didst arise with the Cause and didst manifest that which was hidden from time immemorial and treasured within Thy knowledge.

Subject: Manifestation of God speaking in the voice of Divinity
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/Manifestation of God speaking in the voice of Divinity.txt
Quotation: From Our delight/Drops of a light/Cloud Are drifting down,/And from Our song/Love's mystery Is drifting down...From the face of God, the jeweled sun hath dawned...The day of "I am He" hath shone from out Our face

Subject: Manifestation of God speaking in the voice of Divinity
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/Manifestation of God speaking in the voice of Divinity.txt
Quotation: By Him Who speaketh within my breast! Were all who are in the heavens and earth to turn today unto God, He would teach them from the wonders of His knowledge that which would make them independent of all the worlds.

Subject: Manifestation of God speaking in the voice of Divinity
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/Manifestation of God speaking in the voice of Divinity.txt
Quotation: At this time, the Branch of the Divine Lote-Tree was present and made mention of you. Therefore We make mention of you with a mention whose fragrance has diffused the sweet-scents of love and affection among the servants.

Subject: Manifestation of God speaking in the voice of Divinity
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/Manifestation of God speaking in the voice of Divinity.txt
Quotation: Verily there is no God but Him, the All-Powerful, the Almighty, the Most Exalted, the Mighty, the All-Wise...We chose the Interlocutor aforetime and sent him to Pharaoh and his chiefs with nine clear signs, and I am verily the Sender

Subject: Manifestation of God speaking in the voice of Divinity
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/Manifestation of God speaking in the voice of Divinity.txt
Quotation: In My Name, the One dawning from the horizon of the Kingdom of Utterance! The breezes of utterance have wafted, the fragrance of divine knowledge has been diffused, the sun of unity has shone forth, and the moon of oneness has appeared.

Subject: Manifestation of God speaking in the voice of Divinity
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/Manifestation of God speaking in the voice of Divinity.txt
Quotation: The Divine Lote-Tree calleth out to its leaf, and the Lord to His handmaiden: Behold the bounty and generosity of God! Verily, He hath remembered thee from within the Most Great Prison with that which hath attracted the hearts of them that are sincere.

Subject: Manifestation of God speaking in the voice of Divinity
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/Manifestation of God speaking in the voice of Divinity.txt
Quotation: After Me you shall hear no verses. This statement makes clear the station of mirrors and their verses, assuming submission. Likewise He says - exalted be His mention: If a mirror claims to be the sun, it is known to the sun that it is but its reflection.

Subject: Manifestation of God speaking in the voice of Divinity
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/Manifestation of God speaking in the voice of Divinity.txt
Quotation: In the Name of Him Who is the Most Holy, the Most Glorious! Exalted is He Who sendeth down verses from the Kingdom which was illumined with the lights of the Throne, and Who speaketh in the Lote Tree of Revelation that perchance men may find a way unto Him.

Subject: Manifestation of God speaking in the voice of Divinity
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/Manifestation of God speaking in the voice of Divinity.txt
Quotation: The Prisoner, pacing in His dwelling, hath revealed for thee that from which the fragrance of God's tender mercy, the All-Knowing, the All-Informed, is diffused. Thou hast attained unto My remembrance from the Pen of My Will in My wondrous and glorious Book.

Subject: Manifestation of God speaking in the voice of Divinity
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/Manifestation of God speaking in the voice of Divinity.txt
Quotation: O 'Ali-Akbar, upon him be the Glory of God! He is the Manifest, the Speaker, the All-Knowing, the All-Wise! Glorified be He Who hath appeared with the truth and hath come from the heaven of utterance with a mighty proof, and hath spoken before the faces of the world.

Subject: Manifestation of God speaking in the voice of Divinity
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/Manifestation of God speaking in the voice of Divinity.txt
Quotation: My remembrance is of My handmaiden who was attracted by My verses, who turned to My horizon, who soared in My atmosphere, who drank the choice wine of My love and the Salsabil of My tender mercy and the Kawthar of My grace that prevails over all who see and are seen.

Subject: Manifestation of God speaking in the voice of Divinity
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/Manifestation of God speaking in the voice of Divinity.txt
Quotation: Verily We have made thee of the best of women and have granted thee a station before the Face to which no woman has ever attained. Thus have We showered Our Grace upon thee and granted thee this precedence as a Favor on the part of the Possessor of the Throne and the earth.

Subject: Manifestation of God speaking in the voice of Divinity
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/Manifestation of God speaking in the voice of Divinity.txt
Quotation: By My life! Thou wert present before the Face... By God's life! There is nothing like unto them in all creation. To this beareth witness My Pen, and beyond it My Tongue which speaketh in the kingdom of Mine utterance that there is no God but I, the All-Knowing, the All-Informed.

Subject: Manifestation of God speaking in the voice of Divinity
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/Manifestation of God speaking in the voice of Divinity.txt
Quotation: O Warbler! That which thou didst send to the servant who standeth before the Throne hath been presented and hath won the attention of the Wronged One in this glorious and noble station. We answer thee with this Tablet - verily thy Lord is the All-Merciful, the Mighty, the All-Knowing.

Subject: Manifestation of God speaking in the voice of Divinity
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/Manifestation of God speaking in the voice of Divinity.txt
Quotation: The Beauty of the Unseen hath appeared through grace, and the Tongue of the Unseen speaketh the truth. O people! Behold ye My Beauty in His Beauty, then His signs in My signs, then His Manifestation in My Manifestation, then His dawning in My dawning, then His effulgence from this manifest horizon.

Subject: Manifestation of God speaking in the voice of Divinity
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/Manifestation of God speaking in the voice of Divinity.txt
Quotation: Through Him the mysteries have been revealed, the rivers have flowed, the lights have shone forth, and the trees have spoken. By God! He Who was mentioned in the hearts of the Prophets and inscribed by the Most Exalted Pen hath come. He is the Dawning-Place of verses and the Manifestation of clear proofs.

Subject: Manifestation of God speaking in the voice of Divinity
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/Manifestation of God speaking in the voice of Divinity.txt
Quotation: The Ancient Countenance hath turned toward thee from this glorious horizon. The servant present before the Throne desired to write unto thee. We said: Take up thy pen, for verily We have ever been One Who revealeth, sendeth down, and transmitteth, and I am the Sender, the Revealer, the Transmitter, the Almighty, the Powerful.

Subject: Manifestation of God speaking in the voice of Divinity
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/Manifestation of God speaking in the voice of Divinity.txt
Quotation: Write: Hast thou not heard that My proof is My Being, My evidence My Self, My testimony My Revelation, and that which floweth from My Pen is the path to My knowledge, wherewith none shall attain except those who have detached themselves from all things and have passed by this world and whatsoever hath been created therein as a fleeting cloud?

Subject: Manifestation of God speaking in the voice of Divinity
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/Manifestation of God speaking in the voice of Divinity.txt
Quotation: He is the One Who standeth manifest, speaking before all faces. My Most Exalted Pen desireth to reveal unto thee the pearls of wisdom that lay hidden in its treasuries, to cause thee to hear the call of God, and to show thee the waves of the ocean of utterance in these days wherein He Who was hidden hath appeared with His Name, the Self-Subsisting

Subject: Manifestation of God speaking in the voice of Divinity
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/Manifestation of God speaking in the voice of Divinity.txt
Quotation: Were I to recount unto thee, beneath countless veils of concealment, certain hidden mysteries, We now return to Our elucidation of the Books of old, that perchance thy feet may not slip and thou mayest receive with complete certitude the portion which We shall bestow upon thee of the billowing oceans of life in the realm of the names and attributes of God.

Subject: Manifestation of God speaking in the voice of Divinity
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/Manifestation of God speaking in the voice of Divinity.txt
Quotation: Through God's grace and favor, the path exists and the way is evident, and the banner of unity has been raised in the most exalted station. Today the world is adorned, for the city of inner meanings is embellished with the anemones of divine truths, and the standard proclaiming Verily He is God has been planted upon the crimson spot situated in the white land.

Subject: Manifestation of God speaking in the voice of Divinity
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/Manifestation of God speaking in the voice of Divinity.txt
Quotation: My glory is My Name, and My manifestation is My Beauty, and My fortress is My love, and My proof is My Self, and My power is My signs, and My creation is My verses, and My sovereignty is My might, and My abode is My prison, and My Tablet is My messenger, and My Pen is My Command, and My party is My trust, and My fingers are My companions, and the Promised One is My meeting, the Mighty, the Wondrous.

Subject: Manifestation of God speaking in the voice of Divinity
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/Manifestation of God speaking in the voice of Divinity.txt
Quotation: God! There is no God but I, and verily I have been standing at the right of the Path of Truth, and I witness those who pass over it - among them are those who pass like lightning from the clouds, and among them are those who pass upon their breasts, and among them are those who pass upon their feet, and among them are those who pause before it, and thus do We witness them and We are witness unto this.

Subject: Manifestation of God speaking in the voice of Divinity
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/Manifestation of God speaking in the voice of Divinity.txt
Quotation: In this station, They say: "Verily, I am God!" And indeed They speak the truth, for in this station Their words are the words of God, Their command is the command of God, Their decree is the decree of God. For They say: "Those words are spoken by the tongue of My might, and these other words are spoken by the tongue of My power!" And They say: "These words are spoken by the tongue of My grandeur, and those words are spoken by the tongue of My sovereignty!"

Subject: Manifestation of God the only route to knowledge of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/Manifestation of God the only route to knowledge of God.txt
Quotation: Hear the word of Him Who speaketh the truth, and dispute not the verses of God after their revelation, even should all beings command thee to do so, and withhold not thyself from His grace, even should both races of men prevent thee. Behold thy Lord's Cause with thine own eyes, then know it through thine own self. Even if all humanity and jinn should prevent thee therefrom, behold thou the Cause of thy Lord with thine own eyes, then know it through thyself and thy spirit, for the recognition of others cannot serve as proof for thee, nor can the rejection of all else stand as evidence against thee.

Subject: Manifestation of God the only route to knowledge of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/Manifestation of God the only route to knowledge of God.txt
Quotation: The truth in that most exalted station and greatest prospect is the manifestation of Him Who has no name, no description, no exposition and no attribute. Essential realities are cut off from His presence and material things are prevented from addressing Him, for it is the station of the letter of the manifestation of the Essence in the countenance of pure abstraction and absolute presence

Subject: Manifestation of God the only route to knowledge of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/Manifestation of God the only route to knowledge of God.txt
Quotation: Knowledge of the Pre-existent One is knowledge of him, and knowledge of him is knowledge of the Pre-existent One, for in the contingent world there is nothing but knowledge of Him. To this refer the words of the Family of God: "Whoever knows you has known God," and the words of the Imam, peace be upon him: "We are the Most Beautiful Names of God, through which alone God can be known. Through us God is known and through us God is worshipped. Were it not for us, God would not be known, and were it not for us, God would not be worshipped."

Subject: Mary Magdalene
Quotation: Mary the Magdalene, even an adultress, will be promoted to such a lofty station... He officiated Mary the Magdalen the holiest of the holy souls, an angel.

Subject: Mary Magdalene
Quotation: whose blessed name was Mary Magdalene...Until now her worth and station had remained hidden - now it has become clear and evident. This paragon of beauty manifested such power that she became the pride of heroic men.

Subject: Mary Magdalene
Quotation: Ye have undoubtedly read the history of Mary Magdalene. She was but one country woman. Consider what firmness and steadfastness she displayed and made manifest, both in the days of His Holiness Christ, and after Him!

Subject: Mary Magdalene
Quotation: "When Mary Magdelaine embraced the Cause of Christ no one gave any importance to her, no one even mentioned her name. Outwardly not the least importance was attached to them; but it became known afterwards and the great privilege of entrance into the Kingdom of Christ was appreciated."

Subject: Mary Magdalene
Quotation: Consider Mary Magdalene: she was but a village woman, yet when she believed in her Lord and remained firm and steadfast in the love of God, she made firm the feet of the apostles in the love of the radiant and beloved Christ. This was naught but a confirmation from her Lord and a blessing from Him Who reared her.

Subject: Mary Magdalene
Quotation: Ponder over the condition of the apostles, and that of Mary the Magdalene, Mary the mother of James, and Mary the Virgin the mother of Jesus. What a severe calamity befell them, and how they were patient and endured all difficulties until they succeeded, prospered and attained to the Bounty of thy Lord, the Generous.

Subject: Mosaic imagery
Quotation: O Commander! Hear the call of thy Lord upon Mount Sinai

Subject: Mosaic imagery
Quotation: "That thou mayyst see Mount Sinai circling here in worship"

Subject: Mosaic imagery
Quotation: your Job-like affliction, the separation of your Joseph and the anguish of your Jacob

Subject: Mosaic imagery
Quotation: He Who conversed with God [reference to Moses] took His seat upon the throne of Revelation

Subject: Mosaic imagery
Quotation: O Commander! Hear the call of thy Lord upon Mount Sinai: Verily there is no God but Him, and I am the Most High, as hath been hidden in what God hath ordained in the Mother Book.

Subject: Mosaic imagery
Quotation: You have caught the scent of Joseph's garment and found your way to the divine Egypt, and like Jacob you have regained your sight. I hope that you may behold the divine Beauty of Joseph and attain to the station of unveiled vision.

Subject: Mosaic imagery
Quotation: Stand thou firm in the Cause of God like unto a tree firmly rooted, with massive trunk, widespread branches and abundant fruits, that thou mayest become a manifestation of that which the glorious Lord hath said in the Gospel: "By their fruits ye shall know them."

Subject: Moses
Quotation: We chose the Interlocutor [Moses] aforetime and sent him to Pharaoh and his chiefs with nine clear signs...Among these was the staff of Command whereby We parted the sea and delivered those who believed, and drowned the idolaters

Subject: Moses
Quotation: Out of love for His Visage, Moses hastened to the Mystic Mount

Subject: Moses
Quotation: Thus when Moses went to Mount Sinai and was occupied there with establishing God's law, he fasted for forty days to remind and awaken the Israelite people.

Subject: Moses
Quotation: O Musa! The Interlocutor attained His presence and the Friend mentioned "My heart is at rest." Say: The Command of ten words lieth concealed in a single word, the oceans of utterance are hidden in a single letter, and the pearls of wisdom are treasured in a single shell. The Interlocutor of the Mount is seated upon the throne of Revelation.

Subject: Moses
Quotation: all the realities of the Prophets and Messengers, one of whom was Moses son of Imran, expired on the Mount of the glorious Cause at the appearance of the sublime Mystery

Subject: Moses
Quotation: Moses, peace be upon him, rescued the children of Israel from degradation, imprisonment and abandonment, and educated them with support from the All-Powerful until he brought them to the heights of glory and elevation...

Subject: Moses
Quotation: His holiness Moses beheld the flame of fire from the green tree and heard a Voice, whereupon he became unconscious and senseless, and became the confidant of the Divine Call and Message. He brought forth the manifest serpent and drew forth the white hand from the mighty bosom.

Subject: Moses
Quotation: Moses lived in the wilderness of Sinai where crime necessitated direct punishment. There were no penitentiaries or penalties of imprisonment. Therefore, according to the exigency of the time and place it was a law of God that an eye should be given for an eye and a tooth for a tooth.

Subject: Moses
Quotation: And when His day was ended, there came the turn of Moses. Armed with the rod of celestial dominion, adorned with the white hand of divine knowledge, and proceeding from the Paraan of the love of God, and wielding the serpent of power and everlasting majesty, He shone forth from the Sinai of light upon the world. He summoned all the peoples and kindreds of the earth to the kingdom of eternity, and invited them to partake of the fruit of the tree of faithfulness.

Subject: Mount Carmel
Quotation: Carmel raised its calls / With harp and flute and lute and oud

Subject: Mount Carmel
Quotation: The Prophets and Holy Men always went into the wilderness to pray. Many of them walked upon Mount Carmel and communed with God.

Subject: Mount Carmel
Quotation: How inspiring is the matchless panorama spread before one's view! How quiet and spiritual is its very atmosphere! This is the best season of Mount Carmel. The mountain covered with fragrant flowers, the bright sun shining upon it with its vital, life-giving rays

Subject: Mount Carmel
Quotation: Today We have risen through the grace of God, the Lord of the worlds, and directed Ourselves to another place which We have made the Most Great Scene of Vision for mankind. When We arrived, We revealed that whereby the stones soared, the trees cried out, and the hearts of the righteous were drawn in rapture.

Subject: Mount Carmel
Quotation: The weather of Mount Carmel is fragrant and its earth is sweet. Its panorama of sea and land is very unique; its sun is all-glorious; its moon is all-beautiful and its stars are all-sparkling. Syria is a most wonderful country. It is a world in miniature. All the trees of the hot climate such as date-palms, oranges, mandarins etc as well as the trees of the cold climate such as walnuts, pines etc are found in Syria. Tiberias is famous for its hot weather, while Mount Lebanon is a cool summer resort.

Subject: Mount Carmel
Quotation: For some time the Seat of the Throne was in the land of Haifa, and in most times the voice of nature was raised. We said: What aileth thee, O Nature, that We hear thy cries in the nights, thy lamentations in the days, and thy moaning at dawn? Thereupon she raised her voice, crying out and saying: O Sovereign of existence! The idolaters have sunk Thy crimson ark and have hamstrung Thy white She-camel, and they desire to extinguish Thy light. Therefore have my cries and the cries of all things been raised, and my lamentations and the lamentations of those in earth and heaven. O Supreme Being! I beseech Thee by Thyself and by Thy most sweet call and the scratching of Thy Most Exalted Pen to protect Thyself from the cannons of the enemies and the swords of the wicked ones. Verily, Thou art powerful over whatsoever Thou willest, and in Thy grasp are the reins of all affairs of the first and the last. Repeatedly was this cry heard when We were engaged in revealing a new tablet, and mention of it hath been recorded in that blessed tablet. To this testifieth this Book that moveth and speaketh: There is no God but Me, the Single, the Powerful, the Commander, the All-Wise.

Subject: Muhammad; Islam
Quotation: And peace and blessings be upon Him and His family and companions who, in the Cause of God, the Lord of earth and heaven, consumed date pits - those servants whom poverty could not prevent from proclaiming the Cause, and whom the veils of the world could not withhold from the Ancient Lord. They arose and spoke with such steadfastness as did shake the very foundations of might and power, and caused the pillars of the pharaohs among men to tremble.

Subject: Muhammad; Islam
Quotation: Through the appearance of Mohammad and his disciples, the Arabian desert became the mother of all the countries, the Kaaba for millions of souls and the object of veneration by all mankind.

Subject: Muhammad; Islam
Quotation: In the Quran it is mentioned that seven tribes came before the Secret of Being and Essence of Purpose, His Holiness Muhammad, peace be upon Him. Each made his faith contingent upon a miracle. One said: "Bring down a book from heaven." Another said: "Cast down a fragment of heaven to earth." Another said: "Make a spring to flow." Another said: "Ascend to heaven." Another said: "Show us the Lord with His hosts." Another said: "Produce a treasure." Another said: "Bring forth the lofty paradise." In reply to all of these He declares: "Say: Glory be to my Lord! Am I aught but a mortal messenger?" Nevertheless, I beseech the Divine favors that your desires may be fulfilled and your needs be granted.

Subject: Muhammad; Islam
Quotation: The blessed Cause is proclaimed and proofs are established demonstrating the power of the Greatest Name, and even the power of the Holy Spirit of the Seal of the Prophets, the mighty Messenger [Muhammad], is clearly and conclusively proven. From the day of the appearance of the Prophet until now, no mention of good was made of Him here [America] - people would only speak of Him with contempt. It was impossible to mention His name in churches and temples. Now, praise be to God, through the power of the Blessed Beauty, the truth of the Seal of the Prophets and Guide of all paths is proven in great churches, and the listeners remain silent, with not a soul raising any objection.

Subject: Muhammad; Islam
Quotation: Our Lord said the Muhammadans were accustomed to think Mahomet the greater because of his title "Seal of the Prophets," but in the time of Jesus spirituality and spiritual life was far greater.

Subject: Muhammad; Islam
Quotation: He is the Lamp of Guidance among mankind, the Sign of the Ancient of Days amidst the nations...God made Him the source of His revelation, the repository of His knowledge, and the manifestation of His laws.

Subject: Muhammad; Islam
Quotation: until He sealed the Messengers with Muhammad, His Apostle, revealed unto Him His Book of Truth which was the true Furqan, and in it called His creation unto Himself, making him the Manifestation of His Divinity

Subject: Muhammad; Islam
Quotation: Muhammad - may the spirit of all else but Him be His sacrifice - came and summoned all who dwell on earth to the highest horizon. He brought the Book and established the Path, made manifest the Balance, and announced unto all the Day of God and gave them the glad-tidings.

Subject: Muhammad; Islam
Quotation: The first to pledge allegiance to me, as ye shall see in your Books, was Muhammad the Messenger of God, then Ali, then those who were witnesses after him, then the Gates of Guidance - will ye not be thankful? Say: O people! This is the matter wherewith ye were promised.

Subject: Muhammad; Islam
Quotation: until the chain of Prophethood culminated in the Lord of the world and Master of nations - upon Him be God's blessings and peace, and upon Him be God's grace, glory and favors. Through Him was inscribed the seal, and He was made the Herald of that which was hidden in divine knowledge

Subject: Muhammad; Islam
Quotation: I bear witness that Muhammad is Thy servant and Thy Messenger, whom Thou didst send from Thy presence unto all things, and made him a Messenger from Thee to all things. Thou didst ordain for him successors from the letters of his own self, and witnesses who were created from his light.

Subject: Muhammad; Islam
Quotation: I testify for Muhammad the Messenger of God that God has selected him from the innermost realm of eternity at a station He adorned, and made him stand in His own station in delivering and executing, since "No vision can grasp Him, but His grasp is over all vision" and He is the Subtle, the All-Aware.

Subject: Muhammad; Islam
Quotation: And as for the noble Messenger, Muhammad the Chosen One, upon him be prayer and peace - God sent him in a valley without cultivation or plants, among scattered tribes and warring peoples and nations fallen into the depths of ignorance and blindness, not knowing who called them, not knowing a letter of the Book...

Subject: Muhammad; Islam
Quotation: Even as the Apostle of God -- upon Him be blessing and salutation -- was able to reconcile the warring, the antagonistic and barbarous tribes of the desert and to gather them together beneath the tabernacle of unity. As a result of this unity the nomadic tribes of Arabia achieved great advancement, raised the banner of excellence in both material and spiritual spheres and thus attained imperishable glory.

Subject: Muhammad; Islam
Quotation: From another horizon we see Muhammad, the Prophet of Arabia, appearing. You may not know that the first address of Muhammad to His tribe was the statement, "Verily, Moses was a Prophet of God, and the Torah is a Book of God. Verily, O ye people, ye must believe in the Torah, in Moses and the prophets. Ye must accept all the prophets of Israel as valid." In the Qur'an, the Muslim Bible, there are seven statements or repetitions of the Mosaic narrative, and in all the historic accounts Moses is praised. Muhammad announces that Moses was the greatest Prophet of God, that God guided Him in the wilderness of Sinai, that through the light of guidance Moses hearkened to the summons of God, that He was the Interlocutor of God and the bearer of the tablet of the Ten Commandments, that all the contemporary nations of the world arose against Him and that eventually Moses conquered them, for falsehood and error are ever overcome by truth. There are many other instances of Muhammad's confirmation of Moses. I am mentioning but a few. Consider that Muhammad was born among the savage and barbarous tribes of Arabia, lived among them and was outwardly illiterate and uninformed of the Holy Books of God. The Arabian people were in the utmost ignorance and barbarism. They buried their infant daughters alive, considering this to be an evidence of a valorous and lofty nature. They lived in bondage and serfdom under the Persian and Roman governments and were scattered throughout the desert, engaged in continual strife and bloodshed. When the light of Muhammad dawned, the darkness of ignorance was dispelled from the deserts of Arabia. In a short period of time those barbarous peoples attained a superlative degree of civilization which, with Baghdad as its center, extended as far westward as Spain and afterward influenced the greater part of Europe. What proof of Prophethood could be greater than this, unless we close our eyes to justice and remain obstinately opposed to reason?

Subject: Muhammad; Islam
Quotation: I bear witness that Muhammad is Thy servant and Thy Messenger whom Thou didst choose for Thyself and select for Thy Cause and single out for Thy Message and elect for Thy Revelation and prefer for Thy sovereignty. Thou didst entrust unto Him the affairs of Thy kingdom. He hath no equal in Thy knowledge, no likeness in Thy Book, no counterpart in the kingdom of earth and heaven, no peer among the manifestations of Thy creation, and no match among the daysprings of Thy invention.

Subject: Muhammad; Islam
Quotation: Then God in His Mercy sent to us a prophet from amongst our own people. He admonished us to worship the one True God, to leave behind polytheism, to keep our words, to practice piety and chastity, to believe in the divine mission of Moses, Jesus Christ, and other prophets and fear the Lord of Hosts.

Subject: Muhammad; Islam
Quotation: This is what Muhammad taught His people concerning Jesus and Moses, and He reproached them for their lack of faith in these great Teachers, and taught them the lessons of truth and tolerance. Muhammad was sent from God to work among a people as savage and uncivilized as the wild beasts...Among these half animal people Muhammad was sent with His divine Message. He taught the people that idol worship was wrong, but that they should reverence Christ, Moses and the Prophets. Under His influence they became a more enlightened and civilized people and arose from the degraded state in which He found them.

Subject: Muhammad; Islam
Quotation: We are the people of the Quran, we are believers in the Messenger of God, peace be upon Him. We are firm in the Covenant and Testament, and in this path we sacrifice our lives. We believe in all the Prophets, making no distinction between any of His Messengers. For our faith is real, not metaphorical; it is based on investigation, not blind imitation. If oppressors should attack us with drawn swords and say Either deny Muhammad, the Messenger of God, peace be upon Him, or we will behead you with this sword, we would cry out under the sword: We bear witness that Muhammad is the Messenger of God, that He is the Greatest Sign and the Word that comprehends all divine meanings, that He is the supreme gift mentioned in all the scriptures, psalms and tablets. May my soul be sacrificed for Him!

Subject: Noah
Quotation: And when days had passed and nights had gone by, We sent Noah with truth and clothed him in the garment of the Spirit, making him a sign for those who desired to be guided. But when he came to them with Paran of fire and lights of the Spirit, they turned away from him, ascribed partners to God, the Supreme, the Beloved, and said: "Thou art not sent, nor hast thou been guided by God's lights. Rather, thou art of those who lie upon the earth, and thou art naught but a deceiving impostor." They sought to slay him, but We preserved him from those who would ascribe partners to God. When matters grew severe for him, he performed ablutions with holy waters and sat before God in beloved humility, desiring to call down affliction upon them. Then We sent down to him the angels of heaven that he might be among those who show mercy, and they descended upon him and said: "O Noah, deal not with them as they have dealt with thee. Have mercy upon them and take them not to task for their rebellion, for they are weak upon the earth and poor in the kingdom, possessing neither death nor life nor resurrection for themselves. Be patient in God's Cause, for He shall fully reward those who are patient and who trust in their Lord. This is the first affliction to descend upon the earth, so be patient with their tyranny and persecution. God shall reward thee with the recompense of those who are patient in His good-pleasure." And Noah arose from his place and desisted from what he had intended. Thereafter he called them unto God, the Supreme, the Beloved. Thus did Our mercy precede all things and Our grace encompass all who are in the heavens and earth, would ye but ponder the mysteries of the Cause. Years passed in succession, yet his people were not guided by God's guidance and were of those who in all eternity were not to be guided. The melodies of God moved them not, but only increased them in rebellion and unbelief, until Noah despaired of them and desired to call down affliction upon them and render them as scattered dust. Then We sent angels from another heaven who said: "O Noah, be not the first cause of earth's affliction. Have mercy upon God's servants and overlook them and their misdeeds, that they may be guided by God's lights and then by His signs." So be patient in the Cause, then be steadfast, and be as an iron mountain in the Cause of God, the Supreme, the Beloved. And he was patient thereafter until a time and season had passed that none knoweth save God, as honored servants do testify. Yet they believed him not in aught, nor did they arise from the graves of their desires, nor were they gathered after the trumpet was blown, and thus were they veiled within their own shrouds. Then did God call unto him from behind the veils: "None of thy people will believe except those who have already believed." And likewise were they veiled in the shadows of their own selves. Then did God call unto him from behind the veils: "None among thy people will believe except those who have already believed, and grieve not for what they do." When he heard the call of God, his soul was stirred with longing and he raised his hands, saying: "O my Lord! Leave not these people upon the earth." We answered his prayer and commanded him to build the Ark. When the Ark of the Spirit was completed through the Most Great Word, We said: "O Noah! Embark therein those of thy kindred for whom the decree hath already gone forth, those who excel in the religion of God." Then did We cause the clouds of wrath to rain down showers of heedlessness, and We drowned all who were on earth save those who were embarked upon the Ark of the Spirit.

Quotation: Thou hast asked about the blessed Quranic verse We have given thee the twice-repeated seven. The Muslim divines have interpreted the term twice-repeated seven to refer either to the seven chapters of the Qur'an that begin with the disconnected letters Ha' and Mim or to the opening chapter of the Qur'an. They say it is twice repeated because the opening chapter, consisting of seven verses, was revealed twice--once in Mecca and again in Medina--and, as such, it is twice repeated. Furthermore, they say that as this opening chapter is recited twice in the daily prayer, it is thus described as the twice-repeated seven. But the true meaning is the mystery of Divine Unity and the outpourings of heavenly grace, and that is the glad-tidings of the advent of the subsequent Revelation, in which the Bearer of the seven letters hath appeared twice. The first seven letters correspond to 'Ali-Muhammad, and the second seven to Husayn-'Ali. This is the meaning of the twice-repeated seven. Yet another meaning is that Muhammad, the universal Manifestation of the Quranic Dispensation, together with thirteen distinguished souls, make fourteen, which is seven twice repeated.

Subject: Saint Peter and Saint Paul
Quotation: Question: In the Gospel of Matthew Christ says to Peter: "thou art Peter, and upon this rock I will build My church". What is the meaning of this verse?  Answer: This utterance of Christ is an affirmation of Peter's reply, when Christ asked: "Whom do ye believe Me to be?" and Peter answered: "I believe that Thou art the Son of the living God." Then Christ said to him: "thou art Peter" -- since "Cephas" in Aramaic means "rock" -- "and upon this rock I will build my church". For others, in answer to Christ, had said that He was Elias, or John the Baptist, or Jeremiah, or one of the Prophets. Christ meant, through metaphor and allusion, to affirm the words of Peter. And so, since the latter's name meant "rock", He said: "thou art Peter, and upon this rock I will build my church". That is, your belief that Christ is the Son of the living God will become the foundation of the religion of God, and upon this belief the foundation of the church of God -- which is the Law of God -- shall be established.  As to the existence of Peter's tomb in Rome, it is doubtful and disputed; some say that it is in Antioch.

Quotation: Ali Kuli Khan asked our Lord which was greater - Jesus Christ or Mahomet. Our Lord said the Muhammadans were accustomed to think Mahomet the greater because of his title "Seal of the Prophets," but in the time of Jesus spirituality and spiritual life was far greater.

Subject: Seal of the Prophets
Quotation: Know thou with certain knowledge that the Most Great Word which the All-Merciful revealed in the Qur'an through His saying "but He is the Apostle of God and the Seal of the Prophets" hath been fulfilled in the Day when mankind shall stand before the Lord of the worlds.

Subject: Seal of the Prophets
Quotation: Say: O people! Prophethood and Messengership have been sealed through His exalted Word but He is the Apostle of God and the Seal of the Prophets. Now must ye grasp, with the hands of power and detachment, the hem of God's bounty and hold fast to the cord of the blessed verse the Day when mankind shall stand before the Lord of the worlds.

Subject: Shaykhis
Quotation: The people claim this Cause is like the cause of Ahmad before Kazim. Nay, by your Lord! If Ahmad were alive he would convey my Cause, and Kazim would not separate from me and would circle around me by God's leave

Subject: Shaykhis
Quotation: His Holiness the Heavenly Light, Haji Siyyid Kazim Rashti, upon him be greetings and praise, asked of the Candle of the Divine Assembly, the late revered Shaykh Ahsa'i: "What is the outcome of this Cause in which we are engaged and to what will it lead?" The revered Shaykh wrote in reply, and it is recorded in the books and treatises in the possession of the Shaykhis: "This Cause must needs have a focal point, and every announcement has its fixed time, but it is not permissible to specify by name. You shall surely know its tidings after a time." Observe how clearly he states that a focal point is established for this Cause, but specifying the person by name and title is not permitted. Then he cites the blessed verse from the Furqan which states "This is but a Reminder for all the worlds, and you shall surely know its tidings after a time," meaning that focal point is the Remembrance of God, and what He announces will become manifest and evident in the year after sixty-eight, which corresponds to the numerical value of "time," and after "time" is sixty-nine, meaning it will bear fruit, just as the Exalted One [the Bab] has stated: "Then in the year nine you shall attain all good."

Subject: Shaykhis
Quotation: Know that in the latter days the Shi'ihs of Persia had forgotten the truth of the religion of God and had become entirely devoid and deprived of the morals of the spiritually minded. They were cleaving to empty husks and remained entirely heedless of the pith and substance. The Shi'ihs then became divided into two camps: Some followed the august Shaykh and became known as Shaykhis, while others kept to their prior condition and were called "Qishri".

Subject: Shaykhis
Quotation: The Shaykhis inquired about the Sheikh's words, the beginning of which is adorned with these sublime words: "Verily, after the passing of the ALMS by the AMR, the Mahdi - peace be upon Him - shall arise..." The Shaykhis themselves have mentioned that when the departed and honored Haji Siyyid Kazim - upon him be the Glory of God - was asked about the elevated one, no answer was forthcoming, and likewise from other Shaykhis. And all acknowledged that were the meaning of these passages to become manifest, they would turn towards the Supreme Horizon.

Subject: Shaykhis
Quotation: As to the matter of statements attributed to Shaykh Ahmad-i-Ahsa'i, upon him be all the Most Glorious Glory of God: the original statements were written by one of the Shaykhi school who inquired about them in Iraq. Several errors were observed therein, but no attention was paid to correcting them. The statements were copied exactly as written by the scribe, as is also referenced in the Tablet to Mir Karim Khan. One passage from these statements will be mentioned, that thou mayest be assured that thy Lord is indeed the All-Knowing, the All-Wise: "The letter Vav comprises three letters making six, and one Alif, and six, and six days have passed." This refers to the creation of the heavens and earth in six days. They say that creation was completed, and the Alif between the two Vavs indicates the completion of the first six, and that Alif represents the station of the arising of the Qa'im, as was made manifest. And the other Vav refers to the creation of new heavens through the manifestation of the Qayyum in the latter six days. After the appearance of this station, the mystery of inversion is witnessed, according to the symbol of "the chief," as thou hast heard: "He maketh their highest to become their lowest." The Shaykh's intent was that what was created in six days has passed and ended with the Alif standing between the two letters, and in another six days that which was raised before will be raised again. Then all matters will be transformed as thou hast seen and known. Thus was the matter completed through the Proof, and the Most Great Name appeared among creation. His is the praise for this.  In these days the Supreme Pen is not inclined to interpretation. He loveth to speak at all times: "There is no God but I, the Powerful, the Mighty, the Bestower." These two words were also revealed for that person without his asking. In truth, through these two words alone all the statements of the Shaykh have been interpreted. The purpose of mentioning him in the tablet to the ignoble one was that perchance he might recognize his own impotence and inquire of the Truth. But due to pride and vainglory, despite his soul's helplessness, he did not inquire nor turn unto God. Lo! He is among the losers. All the Shaykhis, by their own admission in Iraq, were unable to understand its meaning. They even mentioned that they presented it to the late Siyyid, but he concealed the matter and did not reveal an answer.

Subject: Shoghi Effendi and the Guardianship
Quotation: At first I had not noticed that, behind the tall, stately man, his eldest son, Shoghi Effendi, had entered the room and greeted his venerable Grandfather with the oriental kiss on the hand. I had already seen the child briefly several times. I had been informed recently by Bahiyyih Khanum that this young boy of perhaps 12 years, the oldest direct male descendant of this family of prophets, was destined to be the eventual successor and authorized representative (vazir) of the Master. While 'Abbas Effendi conferred in the Persian language with Abu-Shoghi who was standing in front of Him, the grandson remained in a respectful attitude near the door, after also having greeted us politely and having given his great-aunt the oriental hand-kiss. In the meantime several other Persian Effendis (a group of pilgrims who were about to cross to 'Akka) had entered the room, there was greeting and leave-taking for about a quarter of an hour, coming and going. Bahiyyih Khanum and I had retired to the seat in the window on the right, and we continued our conversation in Turkish in low voices. While doing so I did not take my glance off the very youthful grandson of 'Abbas Effendi. He was in European summer clothes, with short trousers but very long stockings reaching above the knees, and with a short jacket. From his size and build one would have thought him thirteen, even fourteen years old rather than eleven or twelve. In the still childish face I immediately noticed the dark, prematurely adult, even melancholy eyes. The boy remained in his respectful and waiting attitude and position without moving. When his father and his companion had taken leave of the Master, his father whispered something to him on going out, whereupon the boy, slowly and sedately like an adult, approached his Grandfather, waited for Him to address him, then replied modestly in Persian and was dismissed smilingly, not without having been permitted to kiss the hand respectfully. I noticed how the boy walked backwards when leaving and did not remove his dark, true-hearted eyes from the blue, magical glances of his Grandfather for a moment.  'Abbas Effendi got up and came across to us; we immediately got up, but the Master asked us to sit down again and Himself sat down in an informal manner on a Persian stool next to us, or rather to the side of us. As usual we silently waited for Him to address us, which He soon did: "Well, my daughter", the Master commenced, "how do you like Shoghi Effendi, my future Elisha?" (Old Testament, 2 Kings, 2nd chapter, verse 13). "Master, if I may speak frankly, then I have to say that in his boyish face are the dark eyes of a sufferer, of one who will suffer a lot!" Thoughtfully the Master looked beyond us into a far distance, only after a considerable time did His glance come back to us, and He said: "My grandson does not have the eyes of a pioneer, of a fighter, of a victor, but in his eyes, in his glances there is an abyss (=depth) of fidelity, endurance and conscientiousness. And do you know, my daughter, why he particularly has been appointed to the difficult inheritance of my Vazir (Minister, Bearer of official business)?" Without waiting for my answer, looking more at His dear sister than at me, as if He had forgotten my presence, He continued: "Baha'u'llah, the Great Perfection - blessed be His Words - in the past, present and forever - had appointed this lowly servant as His Successor, not because I was the first-born, but because His inner eye had earlier discerned the Seal of God on my brow.  Before His ascension into eternal light the blessed Manifestation exhorted me that I also - without regard for the right of primogeniture or age - should look among my sons and grandsons for him whom God would mark for His office. My sons sank into eternity [died] at a tender age; among my kindred and lineage only little Shoghi carries the shadow of a great calling in the depths of his eyes." Again a long pause followed, then the Master turned to me again and said: "At the moment the British Commonwealth is the greatest empire and is still in the ascendant, its language is a world language. My future 'Vazir' will receive the education for his hard office in England itself, after he has been given a grounding in the oriental languages and in the wisdom of the Orient - here in Palestine." After this I dared raise the objection: "Will not a western education, the English training, change his nature, fetter his lively spirit with rigid, intellectual bonds, stifle his oriental irrationality and intuition with dogma, conventionality, so that he will no longer be a servant of the All-Highest, but a slave of expediency, of western opportunism and of shallow triteness?" Long pause! - Then 'Abbas Effendi - 'Abdu'l-Baha rose and said in a firm voice in a solemn tone: "I am not giving my Elisha to the British to educate, I dedicate and give him to the All-Highest. God's eyes will keep watch over my child in Oxford also. - Insha'allah."

Subject: Shoghi Effendi and the Guardianship
Quotation: After My return to God, the Lord, for "all springs from God and all returns to God", the blessed Master of the Mystery of God (Aqa, Sirrullah, 'Abbas Effendi, 'Abdu'l-Baha) will take on and continue the guardianship of the souls, and when the day dawns when also this Most Great Branch on the Tree of Sinai ('Abdu'l-Baha - Tree of Sinai=Baha'u'llah) will have entered into the depths of the Primal Will (God), He, the one blessed many times ('Abdu'l-Baha), will have decided beforehand - in a last Tablet (alva? = testamentary Tablet) - who, from among the members of the Baytu'l-'Adl should take on the guardianship of the souls.

Quotation: Dr. Zia and the handmaid of God Zeenat have resided in the Holy Land for a long period... Since they have attained the bounty of pilgrimage to the two Holy Thresholds - the Shrine of Baha'u'llah and the Most Exalted Shrine

Quotation: His honor Aqa Muhammad Isma'il arrived at the blessed shrine of "Glorified is He Who caused to journey" and illumined and perfumed his face and hair with the dust of the Threshold, the circumambulation point of the Concourse on High.

Subject: Shrines and Holy places
Quotation: Now that at the foot of Mount Carmel I am engaged with utmost joy in service at the Holy Threshold and absorbed and occupied in raising the edifice of the circumambulation place of holy ones... As we are engaged in building the holy, purified shrine

Subject: Shrines and Holy places
Quotation: The Blessed Beauty repeatedly commanded the friends to acquire a most delightful and pure location on Mount Carmel in Haifa...which is extolled in all the books of the Prophets with clear glad tidings, we are engaged in constructing the Sacred Shrine

Subject: Shrines and Holy places
Quotation: In the future there will be seven beautiful, terraced gardens from the base of the mountain up to the Holy Tomb. Those who have seen the sweeping, heavenly scene spread before their eyes from the Tomb of the Bab cannot forget it throughout all their lives.

Subject: Shrines and Holy places
Quotation: O thou who hast been honored to visit the Sacred Threshold whose precincts are the envy of the highest Paradise! Praise be to God that through the aid and grace of the Most Holy One, thou hast attained the honor of pilgrimage to the circling-place of the people of the most glorious Kingdom

Subject: Shrines and Holy places
Quotation: The holy house and focal point of circumambulation of the Concourse on High must be protected and preserved with the utmost wisdom in every respect, and served with reverence...that spiritual focal point of circumambulation in the Abha Kingdom...that station, the focal point of holy spirits

Subject: Shrines and Holy places
Quotation: These days I began work on the Holy House in the City of God in Baghdad...It is the exaltation of the Word of God and the manifestation of the greatness of the Cause that after fifty years, the revered House has once again been raised up despite the enemies, and it must be built in utmost glory.

Subject: Shrines and Holy places
Quotation: Concerning Jinab-i-Aqa Muhammad-Rida-yi-Yazdi, the builder, of whom thou didst write that he should come for construction - the heedless ones have created such corruption regarding the elevation of the Holy Shrine, both here and abroad, that it was observed the holy sepulcher would be endangered.

Subject: Shrines and Holy places
Quotation: The rocky crags of this mountain shall be transformed into gardens of flowers and roses, and shall become a place of pilgrimage for all the peoples of the world. The edifice of the Most Exalted Shrine shall be expanded. In time to come, the walls of the Most Exalted Shrine shall be built of such stone.

Subject: Shrines and Holy places
Quotation: Two miles west of Jordan and an hour's walk from Tiberias is Tell-hum, now a mass of ruins. The principal ruins are those of the 'White Synagogue', as it has been called on account of its having been built of white limestone. Tell-hum is the famous Copernaum of the Gospel, and it is said this Synagogue is the one built by the Roman Centurion.

Subject: Shrines and Holy places
Quotation: "We visited the two Blessed and Holy Thresholds and received infinite bounty. Now we have come to the summit of Mount Carmel which is Thy sacred garden, where on this blessed mountain many of the prophets prayed to Thee and where in the middle of the nights with the utmost humility they were occupied in (discovering) Thy secrets and mysteries."

Subject: Shrines and Holy places
Quotation: When you were in Haifa, He repeatedly described a location on Mount Carmel, saying that place had great beauty, charm, freshness and views. He commanded that this location should be acquired by any means possible - there was very great desire on His blessed part to obtain that place... Now we are engaged in constructing the holy edifice on Mount Carmel

Subject: Shrines and Holy places
Quotation: After the recitation of special tablets, prayers, odes and praises...all the friends, with complete humility and submissiveness, faced the Holy Shrine and with utter meekness and lowliness we all attained the honor of kissing the Sacred Threshold. The visitation continued until about an hour after sunset, and I lit all the lamps of the Pure Shrine with my own hand

Subject: Shrines and Holy places
Quotation: You have entered a place that is the point of circumambulation for the Concourse on High and the Kaaba of the people of the Most Glorious Kingdom. Its dust is sweet-scented ambergris, and its soil is more fragrant than musk to the spiritual ones. Its territory is renowned in all divine books and tablets as the Holy Land, and its realm is mentioned as the Blessed Spot.

Subject: Shrines and Holy places
Quotation: Therefore, strive within thyself to visit the Most Great House of God which hath appeared in the temple of the Youth. Blessed be God, the best of creators, through Whom every direction was intended, every house confirmed, and every wise matter made manifest. Say: By God! This is verily the sanctuary of God and His House, round which circle the denizens of the All-Highest Paradise and the angels drawn nigh.

Subject: Shrines and Holy places
Quotation: Praise be to God that for the present you are all well and happy! I have met you and associated with you this hour. You are living on the slope of Mount Carmel, are near to the Holy Tomb of the Bab, inhaling the fragrances of its rose garden, looking at the unique panorama and are enjoying the gifts of heaven. This is the ultimate hope of the lovers of truth, to be in the neighborhood of the Most Eminent Mercy!

Subject: Shrines and Holy places
Quotation: I have seen many places, but none has the vivifying air and the beauty of the Shrine of the Bab. The Shrine of the Bab will be constructed in the best possible way and most majestically. It will be surrounded with many gardens, displaying multitudes of flowers. Nine terraces will be constructed from the bottom of the mountain to the Shrine of the Bab, and nine more will be above it to the summit of the mountain.

Subject: Shrines and Holy places
Quotation: For three-hundred years after Christ's death no one searched for his grave. Rubbish was deposited there. The mother of the Emperor Constantine came to Jerusalem and made careful enquiries to ascertain the place and they have come to the conclusion that the grave was there. This is the truth that for three-hundred years they used to put rubbish on it. Opinions differ, but the general opinion is that it is there (i.e. at the Church of the Sepulchre).

Subject: Shrines and Holy places
Quotation: However, regarding the water cistern, since this servant was imprisoned before its construction, the European and Ottoman engineers were unable to properly execute its solidity and arrangement as they should have. They left the work incomplete, and consequently the wall of the cistern on the sea side collapsed and some efforts were wasted. However, this was not a problem - it has been rebuilt under this servant's own engineering with perfect solidity and will soon be completed.

Subject: Shrines and Holy places
Quotation: O thou pilgrim with musk-scented breath! Through the aid and bounty of the King of Oneness, thou hast traversed mountains, hills, deserts and seas to reach the Blessed Spot. At the Holy Shrine, which is the circumambulation point of holy beings, thou hast illumined thy face with the dust of its threshold, strengthened thy vision, and perfumed thy nostrils. The dust and soil of this exalted Threshold is a mighty effective collyrium for the eyes of the holy ones who circle round it.

Subject: Shrines and Holy places
Quotation: There is a method for the visit of the Holy Tomb of the Blessed Perfection. First we resorted to the Garden of Rizwan, and after feasting and drinking tea we were all filed into along line, and while each person carried a pot of flowers on his head, we started on foot toward the Holy Tomb. The deceased Mirza Mahmoud chanted prayers and communes all along the road. I cannot describe the spiritual atmosphere that surrounded us all along the Path. We were all in a state of the utmost supplication, attraction and humility.

Subject: Shrines and Holy places
Quotation: There was a large plot of land above the Holy Shrine which, had it remained in the hands of strangers, they might have constructed a building there in the future, causing a great problem. That land had repeatedly been blessed by His footsteps, and there were several cypress trees there under which the Ancient Beauty, may my spirit be sacrificed for His loved ones, had repeatedly sat while the loved ones of God attained His presence. That plot of land was also necessarily purchased in these days for two thousand tumans and joined to the Holy Shrine.

Subject: Shrines and Holy places
Quotation: Praise be to God Who caused His servant to journey for twelve days from the Sacred Mosque on the seventeenth day of the third sacred month to the Sacred Territory, the Holy Land whereon was established the Throne of Glory and wherein were exalted the resting places of the kindred of the transcendent God - the holy surface whose very soil was created from the face of the Throne. The blessings of God be upon it so long as the sun riseth from the depths of creation and setteth, for at no moment doth the All-Merciful cease to shower His blessings upon it.

Subject: Shrines and Holy places
Quotation: Be assured about these matters. God willing, through the aid and favor of the Ancient Beauty, we will not allow anyone to act according to their own desires in the Cause of God, for the mighty fortress of God's Cause is firm and impregnable...Regarding what you wrote about the honored House, the Sacred Threshold (may my spirit be sacrificed for its dust), detailed pleas and supplications constantly arrive from visitors and passersby of that Holy City...The point is that this Threshold's importance exceeds that of 'Abdu'l-Baha's very spirit - consider then how honored and revered it is.

Subject: Shrines and Holy places
Quotation: After a thousand years during which the ancient Persian capital lay in ruins with nothing remaining but mounds of earth and the Arch of Ctesiphon - itself half-cracked - truly a remarkable arch fifty-two paces wide and very tall and solid - divine confirmations encompassed the ancient Persians that this ruined capital might again be populated and prosperous. That shrine is among the sacred spots where an elaborate Mashriqu'l-Adhkar must be built, and if possible the Arch of Ctesiphon itself should be restored and made into a Mashriqu'l-Adhkar, along with its dependencies - a hospital, a house of healing, schools both higher and elementary, a refuge for the poor and weak, a shelter for orphans and elderly, and a traveler's hospice.

Subject: Shrines and Holy places
Quotation: Let the eleven Temples which are the seat of establishment of the Temple of the Branch be raised of diamond, and let the verses, letters and words of glorification, sanctification and praise that were revealed in the Temple by command of the Primal Point, exalted and glorified be He, be of emerald, ruby and pearl in their colors. After this, by God's leave, all these great and honored stones shall come into being through a hidden and treasured stone from crystal stone, which can be arranged in whatever length, width and thickness desired. And now, in the absence of its appearance, let the Temples be arranged from pure, refined, luminous, white crystal stone, and let the lines of verses be arranged in gold with the most beautiful and perfect craftsmanship that is ordained in the wonders of creation.

The restoration of the honored House is among the most urgent obligations, and not a moment's delay is permissible. Not a minute's delay is permissible. This is of utmost importance, and its spiritual and physical effects are profound.  AB03533
Praise be to God that thou hast reached the luminous Shrine, inhaled the holy fragrances from the blessed earth, prostrated thyself upon the sacred dust of that Threshold

Subject: Tahirih [Qurratu'l-'Ayn]
Quotation: "Kurat-el-Ayn had attained to this supreme state...Although she never cared for dress, that day she wore her best white silk dress and jewelry and perfumed herself with the most fragrant attar of roses. She hailed the chamber of death as a happy bride entering the nuptial bower of the bridegroom."

Subject: Tahirih [Qurratu'l-'Ayn]
Quotation: Did Kurratu'l Ayn habitually discard the veil after that meeting? No. In the presence of some of the more intimate friends who used to visit her, she would unveil but not in public.

Subject: Tahirih [Qurratu'l-'Ayn]
Quotation: Consider how Victoria, with all her imperial glory, became as though she had never been mentioned, while Qurratu'l-'Ayn, who was but the daughter of a mulla, groweth brighter in her radiance day by day, and will forever shine like unto a brilliant star from the horizon of everlasting glory

Subject: Tahirih [Qurratu'l-'Ayn]
Quotation: As for what you have asked about the pure leaf [Tahirih], concerning the fact that she has claimed for herself the station of being a proof for others -- there is nothing dreadful or serious about this, since laudable meanings can be attributed to being a proof.... She has recognized the aspects of my decree and has pondered on the lights shining from my verses. Let none of my followers repudiate her, for she only speaks with evidences that have shone forth from the people of sinlessness [i.e., the Imams] and tokens that have radiated from the people of truth. This is enough for her as an honour among this sect.

Subject: Tahirih [Qurratu'l-'Ayn]
Quotation: And among others, that Point of Attraction, His Holiness Ta - upon her be the glory of God, the Most Glorious - remained for a time with this servant, and she would not have exchanged the meeting with this Youth for the sovereignty of this world and the next, nor did she desire to be separated from Me for even less than that. But what was decreed came to pass. And how numerous are the verses and poems that she composed concerning this wondrous Cause! Among them, she composed a ghazal in description of the Divine Countenance, of which one couplet is the following: Should Baha cast aside the veil from His face / A hundred thousand like the Primal Point would come into being.  In like manner hath she amply described others besides this servant, and above all these utterances is the Hidden Book of the Primal Point -- may the souls of all else be His sacrifice -- all of which hath been revealed concerning this wondrous Cause but remaineth veiled from sight.
