Quotation: But the divine Spirit discovereth divine realities and cosmic mysteries in the realm of the divine world

Subject: The Holy Spirit
Quotation: unless hearts are quickened by the breaths of the Holy Spirit, souls are liberated, and a new cycle appears

Subject: The Holy Spirit
Quotation: you are intoxicated from the cup of guidance and in the utmost joy and delight from the wine of "Am I not your Lord?"

Subject: The Holy Spirit
Quotation: The Faithful Spirit, Gabriel, the Holy Spirit, and the Most Strong Power are expressions referring to one and the same thing.

Subject: The Holy Spirit
Quotation: I pray to God that He may cause to descend upon thee a heavenly blessing, quicken thy heart with the Holy Spirit into an everlasting life

Subject: The Holy Spirit
Quotation: I begged of God to breathe the Holy Spirit into the soul of thy soul and to cause the lights of communion to shine upon the heart of thy heart.

Subject: The Holy Spirit
Quotation: References to "the dawning of the lights of guidance" and divine outpourings that illuminate and purify reality point to the action of the Holy Spirit

Subject: The Holy Spirit
Quotation: The text explicitly mentions "Even as the Holy Spirit, the grace of the Ancient Beauty and the effulgence of the Most Great Name quicken the heart of men"

Subject: The Holy Spirit
Quotation: You must definitely continue conducting this gathering and give it importance so that day by day it may expand and be quickened by the breaths of the Holy Spirit.

Subject: The Holy Spirit
Quotation: Verily, I address thee with a heart overflowing with the love of God... Indeed thou wilt see the teachings of God spread in those regions by the breath of the Holy Spirit

Subject: The Holy Spirit
Quotation: At that time the inspiration of the Spirit will aid thee in understanding the realities, the mysteries, and the meanings of the Books of God, the All-Subduing, the Self-Subsisting.

Subject: The Holy Spirit
Quotation: Breathe with the Power of the Holy Spirit over this man and he will be freed from his foolishness. With the same breath of the Holy Spirit that I blew over the ignorant and he became wise

Subject: The Holy Spirit
Quotation: However, the spirit of faith, which is the light of guidance, and the Holy Spirit, which is the reality of divine revelation, both return in every dispensation and cycle to this realm of the first creation.

Subject: The Holy Spirit
Quotation: They are the body and Thou art the Life. The body is dependent for its life and freshness upon the Spirit--therefore they are in need of confirmation and long for the Breaths of the Holy Spirit in this new Cause!

Subject: The Holy Spirit
Quotation: The teachings of BAHA'O'LLAH will give to the hearts the necessary impulse for bestowing eternal life and will cause the breeze of the Holy Spirit to waft upon you, so that with a single heart you will turn toward God.

Subject: The Holy Spirit
Quotation: You have heard the divine call and have been quickened by the breathings of the Holy Spirit. Through the breaths of the Holy Spirit ye have received life, ye have entered the eternal world and attained everlasting grace.

Subject: The Holy Spirit
Quotation: The ever-present efficacy of the Holy Spirit... So the Holy Spirit touches the heart of man and wakens him to eternal life. Like the sun to earth it brings to man warmth, energy and perfection. It gives him all possibilities.

Subject: The Holy Spirit
Quotation: Christ was born and realized through the Holy Spirit. Thus it becomes evident that the sacred reality - the true existence of every great one - has been realized through God and brought into being by the breath of the Holy Spirit.

Subject: The Holy Spirit
Quotation: thou wilt find thyself assisted by the angels of heaven and the hosts of the Supreme Concourse; thou wilt hoist the banner of peace and the sounds of the trumpet will be heard in the tunes of love and union throughout those countries

Subject: The Holy Spirit
Quotation: Man cannot attain to the highest summit of human progress without the assistance of the Breaths of the Holy-Spirit. Therefore whosoever is confirmed with the Breaths of the Holy Spirit he will be assisted to confer a general education.

Subject: The Holy Spirit
Quotation: When the Lord Christ came He spread the light of the Holy Spirit on all around Him, and His disciples and all who received His illumination became enlightened, spiritual beings. The virtues of the human world come through the breaths of the Holy Spirit.

Subject: The Holy Spirit
Quotation: I hope that Mr. Dreyfus and Dr. Chevalier will be so confirmed by the favors of the Blessed Beauty to speak with eloquent and fluent tongue that they themselves will be amazed at their own utterance, for the breathings of the Holy Spirit will confirm them.

Subject: The Holy Spirit
Quotation: The Holy Spirit was always with Christ. It was hidden from others, but manifest to him. The story about the dove is simply a metaphor. No dove came down. Amongst the people, John the Baptist felt that the Holy Spirit was in Christ. The Holy Spirit was always with Christ.

Subject: The Holy Spirit
Quotation: O God, give me a new life at every instant and bestow upon me the breaths of the Holy Spirit at every moment, in order that I may remain steadfast in Thy love, attain unto great felicity, perceive the manifest light and be in the state of utmost tranquillity and submissiveness.

Subject: The Holy Spirit
Quotation: If they endeavor to fulfill these conditions, the Grace of the Holy Spirit shall be vouchsafed unto them, and that assembly shall become the center of the Divine bestowals, the hosts of divine confirmation shall come to their aid, and day by day they shall receive a new effusion of Spirit.

Subject: The Holy Spirit
Quotation: The Holy Spirit hath come to our aid and the Spirit of Faithfulness hath unsealed the significances of the Glorious Book. The garden and meadow are quickened by the Holy Spirit, which is the power of divine confirmation, and the Faithful Spirit is the interpreter of the meaning of the Glorious Book.

Subject: The Holy Spirit
Quotation: The power of the Holy Spirit, enlightening man's intelligence, has enabled him to discover means of bending many natural laws to his will. The Holy Spirit will give to man greater powers than these, if only he will strive after the things of the spirit and endeavour to attune his heart to the Divine infinite love.

Subject: The Holy Spirit
Quotation: The ancients strived greatly to establish means of education through the power of reason, but although philosophers [...] They educated themselves and a few souls, but they could not provide universal education. Every power is incapable of providing extraordinary universal education except the power of the Holy Spirit.

Subject: The Holy Spirit
Quotation: This power alone can remove differences, warfare and strife from among the people inasmuch as the Congresses of Universal Peace and the unity of the races are radiant but are like the candle. A limited circle only do they illuminate, but the whole world is made radiant through the rise of the Sun of Truth and darkness is entirely dispelled.

Subject: The Holy Spirit
Quotation: It is by the Confirmation of the Spirit. Think of an Oriental permitted to speak with utmost power in the churches, and his speech against the established doctrines, and allowed to demonstrate the validity of Baha'o'llah, the validity of Mohammed, in the center of the churches, and no opposition! THIS IS A MIRACLE. AN EXTRAORDINARY MIRACLE!

Subject: The Holy Spirit
Quotation: And they have angels who serve those therein by their Lord's leave, glorifying their Lord with praise, and they weary not night or day. God hath sent down no name but He hath sent down with it angels from heaven who glorify their Lord with praise for what He hath revealed unto them, testifying that there is no God but Him, the One, the Single.

Subject: The Holy Spirit
Quotation: But the only power that is capable of delivering man from this captivity, is the power of the breaths of the Holy Spirit. The attraction of the power of the Holy Spirit is so effective that it keeps men ever on the path of upward ascension. The malevolent forces of no enemy will touch those sanctified souls who have made this universal power their guide.

Subject: The Holy Spirit
Quotation: O thou who art illumined by the light of divine guidance! I have chanted the verses of thy gratitude to God for having guided thee unto His Kingdom, enlightened thy vision with the light of guidance, baptized thee with the water sent down from heaven and with the fire kindled in the Tree of Sinai, and with the Holy Spirit that quickeneth hearts and souls.

Subject: The Holy Spirit
Quotation: The grace which is between the Creator and the created is Love. The intermediary of that grace of God is the Holy Spirit. If there were no love, there would be no communication between God and created beings. Were there no light, there would be no communication between the sun and the earth. The intermediary of these graces and benefits is the Holy Spirit.

Subject: The Holy Spirit
Quotation: Thy name hath been inscribed in the book of the daughters of the Kingdom, and supplication was offered to the Self-Subsisting Lord that thou mayest be gathered in the assemblage of humanity with seeing eyes, hearing ears, an eloquent tongue and a heart attracted to the Holy Spirit, and that thou mayest become the cause of the life of souls and the salvation of the heedless.

Subject: The Holy Spirit
Quotation: The human spirit hath a wonderful power and strength, but it must be reinforced by the Holy Spirit. Whatever else thou hearest is mere imagination. But if it is confirmed by the grace of the Holy Spirit, it will show forth a marvelous power, discover realities, and become aware of mysteries. Direct all attention to the Holy Spirit, and invite everyone to this orientation. Then you shall witness wonderful effects.

Subject: The Holy Spirit
Quotation: Be not dormant or torpid but let your hearts be ignited and kindled with a great fire. Be not saddened and disconsolate but let your souls surge with excitement and enthusiasm. Be the signs of the one true God and verses of divine unity; be trees in the garden of His bounty and fruits in the tree of His gifts, for He is the Lord of perfection! Be manifestations of the loving providence of the Blessed Beauty that the power of His Holy Spirit may confirm you at all times.

Subject: The Holy Spirit
Quotation: In the teaching of Baha'u'llah, it is written: 'By the Power of the Holy Spirit alone is man able to progress, for the power of man is limited and the Divine Power is boundless.' ... The influence of the wisest philosophers, without this Spirit Divine, has been comparatively unimportant, however extensive their learning and deep their scholarship... We understand that the Holy Spirit is the energizing factor in the life of man. Whosoever receives this power is able to influence all with whom he comes into contact.

Subject: The Holy Spirit
Quotation: The Holy Spirit is the only power which will ultimately unite and harmonize the races and nations of the world. The power of the Holy Spirit is necessary to carry into execution these noble thoughts of the age. But the divine power unites nations and peoples and cements together in the bond of brotherhood and peace for ages and cycles. Through the effect of the Holy Spirit he was enabled to unite many nations and religions under the standard of Christianity. Such spiritual victories are dependent upon the breaths and bestowals of the Holy Spirit.

Subject: The Holy Spirit
Quotation: Christians have always believed that this refers to the Holy Spirit. How can this be? The Holy Spirit was already in the world. He came in Jesus when He was born. The Holy Spirit is a spirit; not a man with ears. The Holy Spirit was always upon Jesus. At thirty years of age He was baptized and John saw the dove descend upon Him. The Holy Spirit upon the disciples was like the rays of the sun. Jesus was the Sun and His rays shone upon His disciples through His teachings. It permeates a soul or mind spiritually. The Holy Spirit in the disciples was the spirit or essence of the truth which they taught.

Subject: The Holy Spirit
Quotation: When the Sun of Reality shed its endless bounties from the Dawning-Point of all desires, and this world of being was lit with that sacred light from pole to pole, with such intensity did it cast down its rays that it blotted out the Stygian dark forever, whereupon this earth of dust became the envy of the spheres of heaven, and this lowly place took on the state and panoply of the supernal realm. The gentle breeze of holiness blew over it, scattering abroad sweet savours; the spring winds of heaven passed by it, and over it, from the Source of all bestowals, were wafted fruitful airs that carried boundless grace.

Subject: The self-generation of the Primal Will
Quotation: In it the Primal Will came into existence before the mention of contingent things. In it Lordship appeared and all servitude was established... through the essence of the aforementioned Will, in its own station

Subject: The self-generation of the Primal Will
Quotation: All that the mirrors reflect are but reflections of itself, and all that the crystals display are but expressions of its essence. Such is the creation of the Will, created from nothing by itself for itself, after God cast within it the likeness of its own revelation. Then there appeared from it that which filled the heavens and the earth and all that lies between them.

Subject: The self-generation of the Primal Will
Quotation: Indeed, He created it by itself for itself, without any soul preceding it, nor any mention equaling it, nor any attribute resembling it, nor any description opposing it. He made its essence identical with its own reality, and its being identical with its own identity. It is the Cause of causes in the origins of the Command and the ultimate endings, which God hath placed in the station of Will as His own station.

Subject: The self-generation of the Primal Will
Quotation: God hath created all things through His Will, and hath created the Will through itself, and it is the Primal Remembrance, and this is the Eternal Remembrance. All things were created through it, whether of heaven or earth, mountain or sea, great creation or small. It verily encompasseth all the heavens and all the earth and whatsoever is between them - an encompassment of knowledge and dominion, not of physical embodiment within physical form.

Subject: The self-generation of the Primal Will
Quotation: The Primal Will existed, through itself, of itself, by itself, and He made it the embellishment of the garments of the Divine Essence, the Camphorated, the Pre-existent, through which all adorned things were adorned in the manifestations of the heaven of the realm of martyrdom. From the beginning when sight was adorned, it was a sign thereof, and verily the Will which God made the station of His Essence and His Grandeur was adorned with Purpose, and He made it the station of itself. Then through it He adorned His Essence through its manifestation through Destiny.

Subject: The Primal Will
Quotation: Say: All return unto God and all begin through His command. Say: Nothing returns unto the Essence of God, but all return unto His Command and all begin through His Command.

Subject: The Primal Will
Quotation: The Will of God is more penetrating in the kingdom of the heavens and the earth and whatsoever is between them than the will of all peoples.

Subject: The Primal Will
Quotation: "without His wish and bidding no leaf hath stirred, nor shall ever stir. In whatsoever cometh to pass there is a wisdom, and all must radiantly and optimistically acquiesce therein."

Subject: The Primal Will
Quotation: In it the Primal Will came into existence before the mention of contingent things. In it Lordship appeared and all servitude was established... through the essence of the aforementioned Will, in its own station

Subject: The Primal Will
Quotation: If a soul attaineth unto the recognition of God and truly knoweth Him as "He who doeth what He willeth and ordaineth what He pleaseth," he will never be prevented by any trial nor disturbed by any occurrence. Such a one is the drinker from the cup of assurance and the attainer unto the station of certitude.

Subject: The Primal Will
Quotation: And hallowed and blessed greetings be upon the all-embracing Word, the radiant Flame, the conclusive Proof, the Most Great Sign, the Primal Will, the luminous Reality, and the Essence that has overflowed upon all things, and upon those who love it, follow its guidance and direction, and fulfill its covenant and testament.

Subject: The Primal Will
Quotation: All that the mirrors reflect are but reflections of itself, and all that the crystals display are but expressions of its essence. Such is the creation of the Will, created from nothing by itself for itself, after God cast within it the likeness of its own revelation. Then there appeared from it that which filled the heavens and the earth and all that lies between them.

Subject: The Primal Will
Quotation: And as for what thou didst desire that God should guide whom thou lovest unto Him - God, thy Lord, is the Best of guides. He desired through His Primary Will to guide all things, but some love God and therefore love, while others love not. And when some remained veiled, God caused His Secondary Will to flow after His proof had been completed and perfected against those who were veiled from the Primary Will.

Subject: The Primal Will
Quotation: Indeed, He created it by itself for itself, without any soul preceding it, nor any mention equaling it, nor any attribute resembling it, nor any description opposing it. He made its essence identical with its own reality, and its being identical with its own identity. It is the Cause of causes in the origins of the Command and the ultimate endings, which God hath placed in the station of Will as His own station.

It verily encompasseth all the heavens and all the earth and whatsoever is between them - an encompassment of knowledge and dominion, not of physical embodiment within physical form.

From the beginning when sight was adorned, it was a sign thereof, and verily the Will which God made the station of His Essence and His Grandeur was adorned with Purpose, and He made it the station of itself. Then through it He adorned His Essence through its manifestation through Destiny.

Subject: The Primal Will
Quotation: And if thou sailest upon the sea of creation, know that the example of the Primal Will is like unto the sun, which God, exalted be His glory, hath created through His all-pervading power. From a beginning that hath no beginning, He hath made it manifest in every Dispensation through His Will, and unto an end that hath no end, He shall continue to make it manifest through His decree. Know thou that its example is like unto the sun - if it should rise unto infinity, there would still be but one sun, and if it should set unto infinity, there would still be but one sun.

Subject: The Primal Will
Quotation: Through the Most Holy Effulgence, the attributes of the Divine Essence have manifested from the plane of Divine Unity into the plane of Primordial Unity. In this station, the archetypal realities are determined through a concrete intellectual existence, not through external existence, for these realities have never inhaled the fragrance of external existence. Rather, they exist through Divine intellectual existence. This station represents the first manifestation of Truth from the Hidden Treasury, and is expressed as Primordial Unity, Divinity, and the station of archetypal realities.

Subject: The Primal Will
Quotation: The ethereal substance is, therefore, the active force since light, heat and electricity appear from it. It is also the recipient, for as vibrations take place in it, they become visible. For instance, light is a vibration occurring in that ethereal substance. From these vibrations the power of sight is affected, and the result is visibility. Likewise, vibrations occur in air and from them the eardrum is affected. That effect is sound and the result is hearing. He says that the Nature which they consider as the source of all beings is the manifestation of His Creative Name. That is to say, the Holy Essence is sanctified from all names and attributes, even from being known as the First Cause. It is the First Cause that is the source of all being and which has been interpreted as Nature. The point is this: All the conditions and perfections that the philosophers attribute to Nature are the same as have been attributed to the Primal Will in the Holy Scriptures. It is clear that the Primal Will is the manifestation of the Creative Name.

Subject: The Primal Will
Quotation: Praise, sanctified from the limitations of created things and exalted above the doubts of all beings, befitteth the most holy, most exalted, most inaccessible court of the Lord of existence and the Sovereign of the seen and unseen, Who, through His irrevocable decree, ordained the Pen of Command to be the source of ancient mysteries and the fountain of life for all the peoples of the world, that all nations might attain unto eternal, everlasting life. That life-giving water appeared in the form of the Word among creation and shone forth through a single effulgence, and that effulgence was manifested according to the diversity of mirrors in the forms of mirrors. That Word is the Primal Form into which the Divine Spirit breathed the Merciful Spirit, whereby He took hold of all spirits and bestowed upon them a new spirit. In some mirrors it appeared in the form and effect of light, and He guided it to the Dayspring of revelation; and in others it appeared in the form of fire, and He caused it to return to the evil dwelling place which is the abode of the wicked. This blessed Primal Word hath been called by all names - in one place as the Trumpet, in another as the Bugle, and likewise as the Path, the Balance, and the like. It is the cause of the gathering and resurrection of all things whatsoever that have been created in earth and heaven. Through it was manifested all that hath been sent down in the Book concerning the Hour and its signs, and the Resurrection and what shall appear therein. In one station it cannot be described by any description nor mentioned by any mention, while in another station it is described by the most exalted attributes and mentioned by the most beautiful names. Verily it is the Primal Will which created itself by itself and created through itself all else besides it.

Subject: Theosophy
Quotation: The point was then presented as to whether all men would eventually progress to the same stages of perfection. 'Abdu'l-Baha said that this is a matter of Divine Will. That although the Theosophists dwelt upon Karma and ultimate perfection, this was not to be expected, as degrees of existence must always be presented. For instance, if all men were kings there would really be no kings, as a kingdom requires ministers, soldiers, subjects, etc., etc. The goal to be reached is perfection according to kind or station, and this perfection is happiness.

Subject: Theosophy
Quotation: Theosophy emerged from them [the Buddhists] but differs from them. They strongly believe in reincarnation. There are many in Europe, but they are all people who are eighty or ninety years old because they are very attached to this world. Their leader came to meet in Boston. He had written a detailed book with illustrations, then he became a believer. Now he has written works. I said to him, "Were you not satisfied with this journey that you wish to come again?" He said, "I suffered much hardship this time, the second time will be better." He had drawn three images of man: one physical image mixed with light and darkness, one behind it showing the heavenly form and the world of similitude, and another luminous image. For man's true form he had drawn a black image representing the animal nature. Every soul has an animal form which is black and pure darkness. It has a heavenly form and image which is spiritual and physical combined, having both angelic and animal nature. The luminous one is the merciful body, the divine form which is hidden in the human temple. I asked him to explain what these images meant. He would not say. I said, "Let me tell you," then he did not conceal it and said that the Theosophists have two things that people really like: one is the matter of reincarnation, saying you do not perish but simply remove one garment and put on another, and the other is being immersed in the ethereal realm with no return. In the Quran it states: "Is it that whenever there came to you a Messenger..." This does not refer to reincarnation - the Quran itself interprets it saying: "Their hearts are alike." This refers to spiritual perfections and existence.

Subject: Theosophy
Quotation: As for the matter of the Theosophists' philosophy, they have borrowed certain phrases from the heavenly Books but have not grasped their reality. Nevertheless, they have made these outward expressions the foundation of their doctrine and religion. But the essence of the question of unity is this: The Sun of Truth has shone forth from the horizon of oneness upon all regions. All created things are made manifest through the light of that Sun. Were it not for the Sun's light, no created thing would become manifest - all would remain hidden. Indeed, the very life of earthly creation depends upon the light and heat of the Sun, and all things, even to the smallest particles on earth, benefit from its rays and heat. Yet each created thing receives according to its own capacity and worthiness.

Subject: Theosophy
Quotation: As for the Theosophical Society, if you attend their gatherings and speak about the oneness of humanity, the contents of the divine Tablets, divine spirituality, equality, unity, love and harmony among humans, and associate with utmost attraction, it will surely be beneficial.

Subject: Theosophy
Quotation: You must be exceedingly kind to the Theosophists. When you meet them, tell them that they are freed from blind dogmas, they are investigating the Reality, that they are very near to the Baha'i Cause. Last night I observed spiritual motion and ecstasy in the Theosophical Society. They were very alive.

Subject: Theosophy
Quotation: Thou hadst written that thou arranged a joyous gathering and celebration of happiness in the home of one of the Theosophists. This Theosophical society hath the capacity to hear the Word of God. Deal with them with the utmost love, kindness, unity and oneness, that the attractive power of the Word of God may draw them to the Sun of Truth.

Subject: Word of God and human limitations
Quotation: Some beheld a gleam, others a flame, while yet others became bewildered and wandered astray

Subject: Word of God and human limitations
Quotation: Thus have We made the Word to be the Sword of God, distinguishing thereby between the monotheists and the polytheists.

Subject: Word of God and human limitations
Quotation: The Word of God is likened unto a divine Lote-Tree and a Pavilion, with humans finding shelter and security beneath/within it

Subject: Word of God and human limitations
Quotation: This is the Book of the Bayan which the All-Merciful has sent down from the Kingdom of mystic knowledge to those who have believed in Him in His days

Subject: Word of God and human limitations
Quotation: For some, their countenance became adorned like a clear light from the rays of this effulgence, while for others this dawn-light appeared as continuous sorcery

Subject: Word of God and human limitations
Quotation: This is the Day whereon thou must give glad tidings of the appearance of the Lord of all possibility to all the friends and guide them to the straight path of God.

Subject: Word of God and human limitations
Quotation: To recite one verse in a spirit of joy and fragrance is better for you than to recite a thousand verses while witnessing aught else but that spirit and that fragrance.

Subject: Word of God and human limitations
Quotation: By God, O people, I am afflicted with a sorrow unparalleled in creation, for I am aware of the tribulations that have befallen and continue to befall the Ancient Beauty at every moment.

Subject: Word of God and human limitations
Quotation: When thou hast attained unto My verses and drunk the choice wine of My utterance, turn thy face toward My direction and say: Praise be unto Thee, O Thou Who art wronged, lonely and unique!

Subject: Word of God and human limitations
Quotation: The Word of God is conveyed through oral teaching and its influence takes effect. Not much benefit will result from publishing in newspapers. Therefore, teach through speech and utterance as much as you can.

Subject: Word of God and human limitations
Quotation: At all times the divine verses are being revealed and His evidences made manifest. This is the day of pure unity, for God the Truth, exalted be His glory, since this is His Day and none is mentioned therein except Him

Subject: Word of God and human limitations
Quotation: These weak-natured ones of the world have never been and are not now capable of hearkening. Until now they have spoken of the idols of names while remaining heedless of and turning away from the Truth, exalted be His glory.

Subject: Word of God and human limitations
Quotation: Should all who dwell in the kingdom of the heavens and of the earth and whatsoever is between them assemble together, they would fail to produce the like of these verses from God. Bring ye forth therefore a verse like unto it, if ye are able.

Subject: Word of God and human limitations
Quotation: God is the Light of the heavens and earth. His Light is like a niche wherein is a lamp, the lamp, the lamp, the lamp within a crystal above a crystal, the crystal, the crystal, well-nigh shining forth of itself even as doth shine the Morning Star.

Subject: Word of God and human limitations
Quotation: The barrier was His Word which separated the monotheists from the idolaters. Reflect upon God's power and dominion: He hath built through the Word that which no eye hath outwardly seen, and hath prevented every remote polytheist from transgressing it.

Subject: Word of God and human limitations
Quotation: Every universal matter is from God; and limitations are from man. Therefore, if people's services and efforts are undertaken for the benefit of all, they are acceptable to God and leave lasting traces. Otherwise, every other effort is limited and transitory.

Subject: Word of God and human limitations
Quotation: The ocean of utterance has surged and the fragrance of the All-Merciful has wafted, yet the people do not understand. The scratching of My Pen has been raised up, along with the flowing of the water of My mercy and the rustling of My Divine Lote-Tree, yet most people do not perceive.

Subject: Word of God and human limitations
Quotation: Whatsoever hath been revealed in the Bayan is a bounty from God bestowed upon thee until the Day when all shall return unto Him. Behold those who pride themselves on vain credentials from such as have no right to judge, while this is a Book from God wherein there is no doubt, a revelation from the Lord of the worlds.

Subject: Word of God and human limitations
Quotation: Yet the mirrors have not recognized their own reflection and imagine Divine Unity in the previous sun's effulgence which was in the Temple of Muhammad, peace be upon Him, even though it has been lifted just as at the time of the Manifestation of the Apostle of God it was lifted from Moses to the Spirit of God (Jesus).

Subject: Word of God and human limitations
Quotation: We commanded you not to apply your men's knowledge to Our words, for this shall profit you not. Take ye the Book of God in truth and hear ye from the Tongue of God in truth, and preserve in truth all that hath been revealed from Our presence, for this is your provision until the Day of Resurrection whereon all shall stand.

Subject: Word of God and human limitations
Quotation: He has demanded of me a meaning which has no evidence save wisdom, and cannot be established otherwise, according to the text of the Sheikh - may God's mercy be upon him - in the Benefits, twenty-four proofs from among those that were the province of children, after having read in the Book of God the three proofs sufficient for all.

Subject: Word of God and human limitations
Quotation: Every soul that rises up for the sake of God in that very moment enters the presence of the Intended One and finds the Beloved through the fragrance of hearts...God willing, through the grace of the All-Merciful, may you be free at all times from idle fancies and imaginings, and be attentive and turned toward the direction of certitude.

Subject: Word of God and human limitations
Quotation: The example of the Books of God is as the example of the sun - if it rises innumerable times it is one sun, and if it sets innumerable times it is one sun. Likewise the Books, if they are revealed innumerable times from God, verily it is one Book, and if they are raised up innumerable times, verily they are raised up unto God and it is one Book.

Subject: Word of God and human limitations
Quotation: Let them play with what they have. By Him Who holds my soul in His hands, all the verses of the Bayan and its revealed ordinances lament the cruelty of those polytheists. Though mention of the Bayan flows from their tongues out of their desire to preserve their leadership, they have perpetrated against its Revealer that which no people have ever inflicted upon the Divine Manifestations.

Subject: Word of God and human limitations
Quotation: Wouldst thou question Him by Whose command all that was and shall be hath appeared? Him Who created all things by His word "Be," and it was, if thou be of them that understand? Wouldst thou associate the mention of thy Lord with the mention of any other? By God! Subject: Zoroastrianism; Mahabad and Zoroaster
Quotation: Question: What is the relation of the Bahá'í teaching to the ancient Zoroastrian religion?  Answer: The religions of God have the same foundation, but the dogmas appearing later have differed. Each of the divine religions has two aspects. The first is essential. It concerns morality and development of the virtues of the human world. This aspect is common to all. It is fundamental; it is one; there is no difference, no variation in it. As regards the inculcation of morality and the development of human virtues, there is no difference whatsoever between the teachings of Zoroaster, Jesus and Bahá'u'lláh. In this they agree; they are one. The second aspect of the divine religions is nonessential. It concerns human needs and undergoes change in every cycle according to the exigency of the time. For example, in the time of Moses divorce was conformable to the needs and conditions; Moses, therefore, established it. But in the time of Christ,  169  divorces were numerous and the cause of corruption; as they were not suitable for the time, he made divorce unlawful and likewise changed other laws. These are needs and conditions which have to do with the conduct of society; therefore, they undergo change according to the exigency of the time. Moses dwelt in the desert. As there were no penitentiaries, no means of restitution in the desert and wilderness, the laws of God were an eye for an eye, a tooth for a tooth. Could this be carried out now? If a man destroys another man's eye, are you willing to destroy the eye of the offender? If a man's teeth are broken or his ear cut off, will you demand a corresponding mutilation of his assailant? This would not be conformable to conditions of humanity at the present time. If a man steals, shall his hand be cut off? This punishment was just and right in the law of Moses, but it was applicable to the desert, where there were no prisons and reformatory institutions of later and higher forms of government. Today you have government and organization, a police system, a judge and trial by jury. The punishment and penalty is now different. Therefore, the nonessentials which deal with details of community are changed according to the exigency of the time and conditions. But the essential foundation of the teachings of Moses, Zoroaster, Jesus and Bahá'u'lláh is identical, is one; there is no difference whatsoever.
