Quotation: We endured endless trouble in purchasing the land and construction...I was very happy to hear the news you wrote about the reduction of your debts. You must absolutely, absolutely bring matters to the point where you have no debt at all.

Subject: business; financial; property matters
Quotation: The entire text deals with the proper handling of orphans' funds and debt repayment: "Henceforth do not entrust orphans' funds to a single individual... As for Haji Muhammad-Javad's debt, Haji Muhammad-Isma'il must make an effort to pay it"

Subject: business; financial; property matters
Quotation: And as for the matter of Haji Abdullah from Shushtar, if he can support your livelihood and sustenance to a sufficient degree, that would be most suitable. But if he cannot support your livelihood in any way, then the situation is difficult.

Subject: business; financial; property matters
Quotation: Please deliver the sum of fifty tumans to the wife of His Holiness 'Ali-before-Akbar and fifty tumans to the wife of His Holiness Mirza Haydar-'Ali...Also please present ten tumans each to Shaykh Haydar and Mulla Aqa through Haji 'Abdu'l-'Azim

Subject: business; financial; property matters
Quotation: We have sent unto thee what was presented before the Face concerning that which thou didst entrust to Our servant, the Wanderer. Although thou didst spend it, yet We loved not that any but thee should dispose of it, as a favor from Us unto thee.

Subject: business; financial; property matters
Quotation: Regarding the carpets of Ibn-i-Nabil, the Hamadani traveler, according to what his honor Haji Aqa Muhammad wrote, there are four more bales in Alexandria, and a sum is needed. I have left this matter to you; carry out whatever you deem advisable.

Subject: business; financial; property matters
Quotation: Be not sorrowful and grieved over the vicissitudes of this treacherous world and the burden of debts... While I am in debt and encumbered, how can the true spiritual friends be free, safe and at rest? God willing, the means of relief shall be provided.

Subject: business; financial; property matters
Quotation: Whatever remains with you from the servants - if those souls suffered losses in the sedition of 'Ubaydu'llah [the Second], meaning their property was plundered, you must not trouble those souls. If they themselves give something, accept it, otherwise no.

Subject: business; financial; property matters
Quotation: If you truly have no need of the sum you mentioned, give it to this servant present so that he may pay some debts. But if it is needed - that is, if there is some need, meaning it might prove useful and could be invested in trade - then certainly keep it.

Subject: business; financial; property matters
Quotation: Mirza Habib mentioned that the honored Haji had not yet put his affairs in order and his work was in disarray. He wanted to appoint someone from outside as his representative to organize his affairs... First put your affairs somewhat in order and then come.

Subject: business; financial; property matters
Quotation: As for the pilgrim house, it has been built in the best location near the Most Exalted Shrine, but it needs furnishings and equipment. Therefore it would be better that when you yourself are present, you attend to the completion and perfection of the pilgrim house.

Subject: business; financial; property matters
Quotation: the sum of ten tomans and one toman which has been placed in the blessed name of His Holiness the Greatest Branch, Aqa Mirza Diya'u'llah, and His Holiness the Greatest Branch, Aqa Mirza Badi'u'llah...deliver to his honor the Shaykh that he may spend it as instructed.

Subject: business; financial; property matters
Quotation: Indeed, by what religious law do heedless souls sell property to its owner, while authoritative deeds bearing the seals of that land's clergy are in hand? They sell our property back to us. By the life of God, they have been and are usurpers though they perceive it not!

Subject: business; financial; property matters
Quotation: Your letter was received. You had mentioned your claim that you hold a promissory note for one thousand five hundred tumans. If this is so, it is certain that that person will show you the utmost deference and good conduct and will pay your debt with perfect contentment.

Subject: business; financial; property matters
Quotation: The sum of three hundred pounds which you sent from Tehran arrived. As the journey to America lies ahead with a group accompanying and endless expenses...From America they sent three thousand and some pounds for travel expenses, but it was not entirely accepted and was returned.

Subject: business; financial; property matters
Quotation: Sent by the Leaf, upon her be the Glory of God, wife of Muhammad-i-Rahim. He who hath attained should deliver five hundred tumans as commanded to Ali-Haydar, upon him be the Glory of God, and act according to what is mentioned in this leaf: [detailed financial allocations follow]

Subject: business; financial; property matters
Quotation: The entire letter concerns the purchase of properties and associated financial matters, including "the aforementioned house was purchased on the 22nd of Ramadan for two thousand six hundred tumans in cash plus one hundred seventy-five tumans as settlement for right of rescission"

Subject: business; financial; property matters
Quotation: The honored Afnan, Jinab-i-Aqa Siyyid 'Ali, is truly experiencing hardship these days, and his means of livelihood is limited to the rent from the 'Ishqabad house. Therefore, make an effort to increase the rent of the house and, as much as possible, ensure it reaches him in full.

Subject: business; financial; property matters
Quotation: Concerning what thou hadst written about the divine friends' devoted endeavors in settling the debts of Aqa Ghulam-Husayn... Regarding what thou hadst written about the economic depression, we beseech God to protect His loved ones in the shelter of His preservation and protection.

Subject: business; financial; property matters
Quotation: Regarding what you wrote about the lands and M., news has arrived but they have written that it passed peacefully. However, as long as wealth remains within one's self, that person will never be considered pure from polytheistic doubts and infidel allusions in the eyes of the people of Iran.

Subject: business; financial; property matters
Quotation: Aqa 'Abdu'l-Ghaffar has repeatedly made the utmost complaints about his father Haji Muhammad Ibrahim, and has raised such lamentations and cries that his anguish and distress are beyond description. In these days he has again written a letter of complaint through you and raised his cry and lamentation.

Subject: business; financial; property matters
Quotation: Mashhadi 'Abbad, upon him be the Glory of God, the Most Glorious, has given eighty-some tumans for the travel expenses of Mirza Asadu'llah...Therefore, whatever sum Mashhadi 'Abbad specifies, please remit it and count it toward the account here...please also remit the travel expenses for Aqa Mirza Mahmud

Subject: business; financial; property matters
Quotation: Your going with him, given your impoverishment, would cause difficulties, for this person can host you for but a few days at most. First, you would be kept from your work here - this is the first harm. Second, you would face other expenses, such as travel costs and obligations to poor Iranians in Damascus

Subject: business; financial; property matters
Quotation: According to the command, the sum of thirty tumans for the price of a horse sent from Faran should reach His honor Aqa Muhammad-'Ali 966 [Baha'u'llah], who owns a carriage in this land, so that he may purchase a horse and engage in service, and the person who sent the horse may attain the reward of his deed.

Subject: business; financial; property matters
Quotation: these two shares out of four shares of the income to you during your lifetime to be spent on completing those properties, and whatever remains beyond that is at your disposal...the five hundred manats of rental income that you sent has arrived, and God willing that Russian woman's land will also be obtained

Subject: business; financial; property matters
Quotation: As to the mortgage of the house, it is quite true. I would like to assign a certain monthly sum and send it through thee for Mirza Ahmad that he may content with that sum and engage day and night in service. Deliver, therefore, to him every month a hundred dollars, which is equivalent to the sum of twenty pounds.

Subject: business; financial; property matters
Quotation: Regarding what you mentioned about Jenab-i-Amin, he has taken refuge in the fortress of the blessed word "The poor is under God's protection." Who can breach the city that is built upon smooth rock? In truth, the outward means of the world have fled from him, and the reason and cause for this is clear and evident.

Subject: business; financial; property matters
Quotation: You and Jinab-i-Aqa Siyyid 'Ali - upon you both be My greetings - together with the friends who are present, should gather in a designated place, and in that assembly should set aside their own wishes and firmly grasp whatever will be the means of deliverance from external debts, and act upon it without hesitation.

Subject: business; financial; property matters
Quotation: From the circumstances, it appears that no prosperity has been achieved there, but you had not written whether there is hope for prosperity in the future or not...according to what has been heard, he has become employed in minor work with one of the divine friends who gives him one hundred and twenty ghurush per month.

Subject: business; financial; property matters
Quotation: Regarding the matter of the three hundred tumans, justice must be observed, and His Holiness should receive his right. Concerning the accounts with Afnan Ahmad, whatever His Holiness Afnan has accepted is acceptable. Regarding the accounts of Aqa Siyyid Yahya from the Land of Ya, it is referred to the commercial council.

Subject: business; financial; property matters
Quotation: For the sake of the Blessed Beauty, I had it repaired. But after leaving the barracks, the simple matter of bathing became increasingly difficult for the Blessed Beauty until I borrowed a sum of money and repaired the bath in the House of 'Abbud. By some means, I was able to repay the money I had borrowed within four months.

Subject: business; financial; property matters
Quotation: A letter has arrived from Mulla Bahram expressing gratitude to a respected person and Mirza Hasan-'Ali Khan who have arranged to give him some land along with two hundred and fifty tumans. You should strive to ensure that Mulla Bahram returns gratefully to Yazd and that these gentlemen quickly fulfill what they have promised.

Subject: business; financial; property matters
Quotation: As for the properties of the honorable Nawwab, upon him be 966 [Baha'u'llah], he and a group of acquaintances are exerting their utmost efforts, as they have done before, and God willing they shall triumph and prevail according to the meaning "the party of God shall be victorious." That is, they shall obtain and deliver your rights.

Subject: business; financial; property matters
Quotation: Just as this letter was concluding, a missive arrived from you stating that you had received a most disrespectful letter from Haji Ali Rashti demanding the deed to Mirza Ibrahim Khan's orange grove, claiming this was by my order. God forbid! Never did I issue any order for anyone to question you about this matter, let alone make demands.

Subject: business; financial; property matters
Quotation: Regarding the purchase of the burial place and tomb of the honored Manshadi, complete and thorough instructions were given to Jinab-i-Aqa Ahmad. However, he said that he would undertake to purchase the land after his journey, as he is now planning to travel to Europe. If he were to take action now, it would not be done in a fitting manner.

Subject: business; financial; property matters
Quotation: Regarding the water rights given to Aqa Siyyid Mahdi - their return is not permitted unless his brothers indicate that this inheritance belongs to all and should be divided...Regarding the two hundred tumans belonging to the daughter of Haji 'Ammih Khanum - we have accepted that and gifted it to her herself...Send fifty tumans for Aqa Siyyid Zaynu'l-'Abidin

Subject: business; financial; property matters
Quotation: Among the matters that have occurred in this land is that his honor [Baha'u'llah] has incurred debts exceeding two thousand tumans - two thousand tumans belonging to the merchant partner, and a considerable sum from the poor merchant himself. It is evident that this amount was given with trust in God. The aforementioned personage has thoughtlessly taken on this burden.

Subject: business; financial; property matters
Quotation: You made no mention of the affairs of Beirut and Constantinople, and from the beginning no permission was sought nor consultation undertaken, despite all being commanded to this. Nevertheless, the sum of six hundred and seven Ottoman liras which was the House's funds and was present was delivered to his honor Afnan, upon him be my Baha and loving-kindness, for him to send.

Subject: business; financial; property matters
Quotation: And concerning what was written about His Honor the Afandi - may God, blessed and exalted be He, strengthen him - having willed to send quince from that direction to this direction: yes, quince is good and is also available in this city. And if distinguished trees from there can be sent without trouble, and likewise the Mastaki apricots that were mentioned, it would be beloved.

Subject: business; financial; property matters
Quotation: Regarding another matter, about the maidservant - if she has not been returned to her owner and her price is still outstanding, purchase one set of copper vessels suitable for a feast, including pot, strainer, container and its vessels, and other necessities thereof made of copper, equivalent to the price of the maidservant, or even if it exceeds her price, it will be paid here.

Subject: business; financial; property matters
Quotation: "This money I took to a merchant who was in former time a grain-dealer but now out of work. I told him We will enter into a partnership, the Capital from me, the labor from you. With this fund you will deal four months in grain. After paying off all the expenses of rent etc; and receiving your monthly salary, we will divide the net profit; one third for you and two third for me."

Subject: business; financial; property matters
Quotation: Dwell thou in a house that doth not compromise your station. If today the dwelling of the Most Pure Consort - upon Her be all glory and exaltation - in the true house would cause clamor among the servants and become the cause of rancor and hatred, residence therein is not permitted, according to the wisdom which God hath revealed in the Book, until God bringeth about His appointed time.

Subject: business; financial; property matters
Quotation: Regarding what was written that it is not permissible for the Afnan to own even a hand's breadth of land in Ishqabad - this statement of your honor is indeed correct and right. This matter is quite clear and evident to those of insight, for such matters become cause for dispute, and dispute leads to the distress of some of the friends. Therefore non-existence is preferable to existence.

Subject: business; financial; property matters
Quotation: Concerning what thou didst write about the spiritual partnership, it hath been adorned with the honor of acceptance and the ornament of good-pleasure. From the first day We commanded thee to that direction, We beseeched God to grant thee blessing, bounty and steadfastness, and it was answered. Relying upon God, hold fast unto that which Jinab-i-Haji and other friends have deemed advisable.

Subject: business; financial; property matters
Quotation: However, concerning the matter that arose between Aqa Siyyid Muhsin and Aqa Siyyid Ali, immediately upon receipt of the letter from the revered father of that illustrious branch - upon him be the Glory of God - and the request for forbearance with Siyyid Ali, Aqa Siyyid Muhsin was given a definitive ruling to go and comply with whatever Aqa Siyyid Ali wanted, even if it meant all the land.

Subject: business; financial; property matters
Quotation: At the end of thy letter mention was made of the Face. It was intended to be acquired in the way of religion, but it proved impossible as commerce hath ceased in this land. According to what thou didst submit to my master, His Holiness Gh. S., may my spirit be a sacrifice for the dust of his footsteps, the funds were sent to Egypt for the purchase of the stone, and likewise for other purposes.

Subject: business; financial; property matters
Quotation: In reference to the large house which thou hadst explained, thou shouldst take into consideration Mr. Jeffery Parsons' consent, pleasure and joy. With his consent if thou rentest the big house and live in the smaller one, it would be more economical... As to the large and small farms, if you leave them in charge of suitable person, it will certainly be better, so that they may not remain idle.

Subject: business; financial; property matters
Quotation: Among the greatest means for the progress of this age and the prosperity of nations and the civilization of peoples is the establishment of companies for commerce, industry and other sources of wealth...However, the establishment of any company must be based on divine principles; its foundation must be trustworthiness, religiosity and truthfulness, so that it may safeguard the rights of all people.

Subject: business; financial; property matters
Quotation: Furthermore, regarding the aforementioned matter, no word hath reached Us from you. In any case, if Aqa Murtada-Quli and the heirs of the deceased are acting according to the will and sending any funds, let them send them to Aqa Siyyid Mahdi-i-Yazdi in Baghdad. As debts have also accumulated in this land, we have therefore left the Siyyid and appointed him trustee over affairs and payment of debts.

Subject: business; financial; property matters
Quotation: Regarding the American correspondence you mentioned, I did not send such an order to America. Some have written on their own accord. God willing, it will be set right. As for letters that come from every direction, place them all in envelopes as before and send them in the name of Aqa Mirza Jalal. Without this system there will be no order, for he is always in Haifa and immediately forwards them to Akka.

Subject: business; financial; property matters
Quotation: His honor Mirza Habibu'llah...had an appointment in Egypt with Muqtadir'ul-Mulk at a salary of five hundred tumans. When Muqtadir'ul-Mulk traveled to Europe, he told him to return from Egypt. Now Mirza Habibu'llah is left destitute and wandering, without work or occupation. You must strive and exert your utmost efforts so that by whatever means possible he may be appointed either again in Egypt or in Europe

Subject: business; financial; property matters
Quotation: The honored Trustee, upon him be the Glory of God, during his presence, having resided in this land for some time, became aware of the confined space. Therefore, he strove earnestly to acquire some land and build a house. No land came into their possession until a plot was found near the house. After investigation, it became known that its owner desired to exact the price of all of Acre for that plot of land.

Subject: business; financial; property matters
Quotation: As to their turning towards this direction, it is not permitted, for conditions are unsettled, as was explained before. Regarding the properties, permission for their use hath been granted to them, but their sale is not permitted, as their existence is outwardly necessary for that honored lady. Let her use them with the utmost joy and fragrance and be occupied with the mention of the Beloved of all possibility.

Subject: business; financial; property matters
Quotation: God hath ordained the Zakat on gold, after it reaches twenty dinars, shall be half a dinar when it is minted and a year consisting of eleven months according to the Book of God hath passed over it... God hath ordained the Zakat on silver similar to gold in terms of the passing of a year and its being minted, after it reaches two hundred dirhams. At that point, five dirhams are obligatory upon its owner by God's decree.

Subject: business; financial; property matters
Quotation: Then it was reported that each one had designated or would designate a sum, and that merchandise would be sent to him from wherever he requested. [...] Repeatedly some complained that Aqa Muhammad-'Ali was not sending merchandise according to requests - that he was sending items contrary to what was ordered. [...] your letter arrived mentioning a theft, saying "They broke my safe and took three hundred and fifty liras"

Subject: business; financial; property matters
Quotation: I hear thou art living in great constraint. Learn somewhat from thy brother, who hath a life of comfort and a table of bounty, and who feedeth a group of riffraff day and night. At the very least, thou shouldst consume a handful of rice each night. Glory be to God! They incur these enormous expenses, yet before friend and stranger alike they complain of privation, saying that this servant hath restricted their livelihood.

Subject: business; financial; property matters
Quotation: For the repair of the honored House in Baghdad we collected one thousand two hundred and fifty tumans and deposited it with Haji 'Abdu'r-Rasul in 'Ishqabad until gradually a sufficient amount could be collected...The late Aqa Mirza 'Ali-Naqi had made a bequest, and since its execution was not possible at that time, a share of his timchih was designated, and Jinab-i-Aqa Siyyid Nasru'llah has sent all the rent from that share.

Subject: business; financial; property matters
Quotation: Since not all of that amount was related to the House door, it would have been better if you had sent what was related to the House door. To whom did you send the draft? For Mr. Ahmad must send it to a specific designated person. As for the list of debt for the Mashriqu'l-Adhkar land, the purpose was for you to know that payment of the installment for the price of the land has been delayed, therefore we are sending this amount.

Subject: business; financial; property matters
Quotation: Regarding the two hundred tumans which We mentioned in the presence of Afnan M., upon him be the Glory of God, they must take it. According to the physician's account, that sum was spent on the House, that is, it was purchased. At first he himself had this thought and later submitted it. Therefore, his honor must deliver the sum of two hundred tumans, which Siyyid M., upon him be the Glory of God, had given, to him in lieu of the claim.

Subject: business; financial; property matters
Quotation: From the day of their arrival in this Holy Land until the time of their departure, his honor Aqa Siyyid Sadiq and the assured and triumphant leaf, upon them both be the Glory of God, the Most Glorious, continuously pleaded that this servant accept whatever belongs to them of their wealth, properties and real estate. Until now, this servant has not wished to accept from anyone, but from them it was accepted due to their repeated entreaties.

Subject: business; financial; property matters
Quotation: Now, according to what Ahmad has written, Madame wishes to sell it. She herself mentioned this to Ahmad, and her sister's husband told Ahmad that Madame is in debt and needs money. He told Ahmad to find someone who would buy it for 1,200 Napoleon liras. Since this house was built with great difficulty, therefore please make an effort, if possible, to buy it from Madame for 1,000 liras by whatever means, for this house belongs to all the friends.

Subject: business; financial; property matters
Quotation: O Jinshid Khudadad hath fallen into the snare of injustice and is utterly distressed. He is now setting out for Tehran in the hope that through the friends he may be able to recover something of his property from that ill-intentioned one, so that he may at least pay his debts. Although the debtor hath fled, it seems he hath some savings from properties and goods in Iran. You and the other friends must exert your utmost effort to secure his rights.

Subject: business; financial; property matters
Quotation: Your letter was received and from its contents it became known that the thread of business in this worldly abode has been severed and difficulties have arisen in commercial affairs. Assuredly if your brother would join hands with you, the work would improve and some means of comfort would be attained. If travel is not possible for you, request your brother to come temporarily to Tabriz for a few days so that arrangements can be made in this matter

Subject: business; financial; property matters
Quotation: O thou who art firm in the Covenant! Jinab-i-Jamshid Khudadad has fallen into the trap of injustice and is extremely distressed. He is now heading to Tehran in hopes that through the friends he may recover some property from that ill-minded one, so that he may at least pay his debt. Although the debtor has fled, it seems he has accumulated some properties and goods in Iran. You and the other friends must exert your utmost effort in securing his rights.

Subject: business; financial; property matters
Quotation: You also wrote that Mrs. Getsinger gave six hundred dollars from the five thousand dollars donated by the maidservant of God, Mrs. Cole, for Mr. Harris's travel expenses, and gives to whoever makes a request from that amount. This generous giving is most acceptable and beloved, but that devoted maidservant of God should keep in mind the journey to Iran - whatever is necessary for the Iranian journey should be set aside, and the remainder given in charity.

Subject: business; financial; property matters
Quotation: Henceforth, do not entrust orphans' funds to a single individual, for such dangers may result. Rather, let them be placed in a bank or special fund for orphans under the administration of the Spiritual Assembly, and they must be managed with the Assembly's knowledge. As for the debt of Haji Muhammad-Javad, Jinab-i-Haji Muhammad-Isma'il must make an effort to repay it, for it belongs to orphans, and lack of effort would cause the removal of divine blessing.

Subject: business; financial; property matters
Quotation: Concerning what you wrote about this servant's intention to gather the means for the garden remaining firm and steadfast - this is among the aspects of love, for when a hundred cometh, ninety is also with us. When love is established, its conditions and effects are present. Since they had inquired about the previously sent grape vines, the grape vines that were sent as gifts - as their cuttings arrived here dried up - therefore remained barren and unfruitful.

Subject: business; financial; property matters
Quotation: Now the loved ones must, in all conditions, hold fast to the means that lead to the payment of external debts. The Tongue has ever spoken this verse as a favor from Us to Our loved ones: Hold fast to deeds and be confident in His grace. Surely after these hardships come ease, mercy and the manifestation of grace. Sorrows prevent man from attending to affairs, and this is not acceptable before God. They must, detached from all else, hold fast to what is befitting.

Subject: business; financial; property matters
Quotation: The Holy Land is much disturbed these days, as His Holiness the Name has incurred a debt of one thousand liras and has nothing to show for it, and this sum belongs to the poor Khawaja and his partner. In such circumstances, it is evident what has happened and what will happen. Indeed, this matter has been and continues to be a source of great humiliation, although it remains concealed for now. But after people become aware of it, it is unknown what will transpire.

Subject: business; financial; property matters
Quotation: After the consent of the couple and their parents has been given, a number of the faithful should assemble and read the Marriage Prayer with the utmost joy and fragrance. After the reading of the Marriage Prayer, the couple should in a separate place, recite the Marriage Verse revealed in the Bayan. This verse should be committed to writing, then the husband should hand the dowry to the wife and they, together with the witnesses, should put their seals on this document.

Subject: business; financial; property matters
Quotation: They had written a packet in that honored one's name to be sent. These are Tablets that some had specifically requested to be sent together with the Austrian steamer. They had written that when the Tablets arrived, the packet had already been given to the post, and there was no opportunity to write another letter. Therefore it was sent there to be forwarded by the Russian steamer. And the other items that were sent all arrived and were handled according to what was written.

Subject: business; financial; property matters
Quotation: The settlement of affairs and payment of the debts of the honored Afnan brought the utmost gladness and delight...Temporary losses are not important, for blessings will show their face again...The friends had pledged not to be excessive in purchases again and to conduct business with moderation, but they fell somewhat short in their promise and made abundant purchases. Therefore these difficulties arose. Again they will gradually be resolved and another day of commerce will come.

Subject: business; financial; property matters
Quotation: During the lifetime of Baha'u'llah the inhabitants of the village Mokeiss were most anxious that I may buy half of their real state for Â£1.700 but I did not do it. I bought half of the village of Adassayah for only $1000 and half of the village of Nogaib for $300. In those days land was very cheap in these parts but since the construction of railroad all the prices are raised considerably, especially those lands which are situated in the vicinities of the stations all along the way.

Subject: business; financial; property matters
Quotation: O my Afnan! As to what was written concerning the property of Jinab-i-Aqa Muhammad-'Ali (Bahram), upon him be the Glory of God, after being submitted before His presence, these words shone forth from the Dawning-Place of the All-Merciful's utterance - exalted and blessed be His Word: O my Afnan! Jinab-i-Muhammad-'Ali, upon him be my Glory, praise be to God, has attained to acceptance and devotion, despite being in lands where the fire of hatred blazes and from which foul odors spread.

Subject: business; financial; property matters
Quotation: As for the account of the land of Shin, it appeareth that the Siyyid of that land's inattention hath caused an uproar to arise. The affairs of His Holiness Afnan of the land of Shin (upon him be the Glory of God, the Most Glorious) have apparently suffered somewhat due to the disorder in the affairs of certain other Afnans (upon them be the Glory of God and His loving-kindness), as their sudden movement during the rainy season and their physical illness prove what hath been submitted.

Subject: business; financial; property matters
Quotation: Prayer beads made of pearls â€" one of the most precious of the household possessions of the Blessed Beauty, and valued at 10,000 tumans in the currency of those days â€" had been spared for us. After our possessions had been looted, we were obliged to leave this string of beads in a trust for 1,000 tumans. Since interest charges were accumulating, we could not afford to reclaim it. Today, if those same prayer beads were still in our possession, they could be sold for 100,000 tumans in Paris.

Subject: business; financial; property matters
Quotation: The merchants of Bushihr practiced dabbih. That is, the merchants, after having negotiated a transaction and agreed upon its terms, would ask for a reduction in the price at the time of payment. In this way, they would get some money back from the seller. One day certain merchants went to the Bab and made an agreement for the purchase of a large amount of indigo. After this agreement, they carried the goods to their own store. When the time for payment arrived, they asked for a reduction in the price.

Subject: business; financial; property matters
Quotation: Regarding your inquiry about sending funds, a telegram was sent to Mr. Bagheroff through Mirza Jalal, and now again it is being written to you that the Imperial Bank of Tehran should, through the Anglo-Egyptian Bank in London, issue a draft to the Anglo-Egyptian Bank in Haifa. Once submitted to the Imperial Bank, inform here by telegram. For now, there is no better way than this. Regarding the property that his honor Bagheroff sold to you, whatever you and Mr. Bagheroff deem advisable is acceptable and agreeable.

Subject: business; financial; property matters
Quotation: They wrote that they were indebted thirty tumans from the funds of Hadba. Let Jinab-i-Zayn settle that debt. Regarding the matter of taking fifty majidis and giving them to Jinab-i-Haji Ali -- upon him be the Glory of God -- for his claim, what was done was both beloved and desired. And concerning what was written about not yet having given to Jinab-i-Aqa Muhammad Ali Kabir -- upon him be the Glory of God -- and intending to give later, this matter is not necessary at present, as it would delay the work of that honored one.

Subject: business; financial; property matters
Quotation: O servant of Baha! After all moisture has been removed from silkworm eggs, place them in small bottles but do not fill them completely. Leave an opening in the bottle so that air may enter. Keep them in places free from moisture where excessive heat will not affect them, where there is air circulation. During the silk season, the eggs should be placed in a room where sunlight enters and air circulates, with sufficient warmth for the silkworms to emerge from their eggs. When this is done, the Gilan eggs will also prove beneficial.

Subject: business; financial; property matters
Quotation: According to what has been heard, Ilyas Bey has handed over or leased 'Adasiyyih to you and another person. In any case, we gave 'Adasiyyih to the aforementioned Bey to develop it, not to ruin it. However, the promise of development he made - namely the stone buildings and factories to separate cotton seeds from cotton - for which, according to the ledger he provided, he intended to spend twenty thousand liras, shows no sign of materialization. Rather, 'Adasiyyih has fallen into ruin and not one of his commitments has been fulfilled.

Subject: business; financial; property matters
Quotation: Three items have arrived from Tehran in Europe from Aqa Siyyid Nasru'llah and Haji Ghulam-Rida, but regarding the significant amount, namely four hundred pounds - they had sent the first copy to Port Said in the name of Aqa Siyyid Muhsin, and the second copy has arrived here but its receipt is not yet known...The draft of one thousand pounds that was sent to Tehran to Haji Ghulam-Rida was received, but during the time of upheaval two thousand pounds had been borrowed from Amatu'l-Baha Barney, and now one thousand pounds of that is being paid.

Subject: business; financial; property matters
Quotation: It is related that the Bab - may the spirit of all in the kingdom be sacrificed for Him - in the days when He was engaged in commerce in Bushihr, one day some people came to His blessed presence on behalf of the King of Merchants and purchased some goods. As it was an old custom of that city to claim loss three times in the indigo trade, after three days someone came into His presence and stated that the King of Merchants was claiming a loss in this transaction. Upon hearing these words, His Holiness withdrew from the original transaction completely.

Subject: business; financial; property matters
Quotation: Regarding the ruler for the pot lid, it was supposed that his honor Haji Siyyid Javad, upon him be Baha'u'llah's glory, would examine that ruler - it is very pleasing. Regarding the ruler for the basin, this one is not bad either, though the previous basin seemed better, therefore it was sent according to your honor's request. Regarding the tray, it was given to his honor Khwajih and what you had written was mentioned. He said that a tray is not needed now - he wanted several coffee pots, and when the brass arrives, instructions will be given afterwards.

Subject: business; financial; property matters
Quotation: Our first loan to Hajji was six thousand tumans, and this second loan which we have newly taken is also four to five thousand tumans. Thus we now owe eleven thousand tumans. This borrowing from last year until now was unavoidable. Now since the journey to America lies ahead, therefore this second loan was taken. In any case, from now on whatever arrives must go toward paying off this loan. We will manage and make do with whatever is available in America. You should think about having the loan repaid. The burden of debt is very heavy. I do not want you to be in debt.

Subject: business; financial; property matters
Quotation: At one time His Holiness the King of Martyrs (may the spirit of those near unto God be sacrificed for him) wrote to His Holiness Ismu'llah (upon him be the Most Glorious Glory): There exists a property belonging to this servant in which no one has any share. I request permission to sell it and send its proceeds to the Most Holy Court. For some time there was delay in accepting this until they repeatedly made the request. Then acceptance was granted with the instruction that they themselves should undertake its cultivation, and an arrangement was made concerning its yield.

Subject: business; financial; property matters
Quotation: Their intention is that the funds which are in your honor's keeping should be delivered to his honor Nazir. Indeed, they strongly emphasized this, hoping that through your honor's efforts, they might be relieved of this embarrassment. There has never been any doubt that if funds were available in your honor's keeping, they would be given. Therefore, as commanded, it should be written to his honor Afnan, Haji Seyyed Ali, upon him be the Most Glorious Glory of God, that from the proceeds of the property sale, they should deliver the amount of his claim to his honor Nazir, upon him be the Glory of God.

Subject: business; financial; property matters
Quotation: Affairs here are as described, therefore nothing can be drafted to the Afnan, nor can they be charged with matters requiring immediate payment. Thus is this Wronged One perplexed. Aqa 'Ali-Haydar and the Trustee have also been afflicted. The honored Afnan Haji Siyyid 'Ali has gone to 'Ishqabad where, as bidden, all properties have been put up for sale. Indeed, all have adhered to this and there has been no laxity in carrying out the decree. They have announced that they will sell whatever they possess in 'Ishqabad, and seekers from every direction have come forward for the purchase of the properties.

Subject: business; financial; property matters
Quotation: And regarding what you wrote that there are many options available - indeed it is just as you wrote. It is very good that you have made inquiries from others besides Habib. This servant had also intended to mention to you that there are some good craftsmen there - do make inquiries from them as well as from Habib. Praise be to God that beloved one has, of his own accord, done what was in this evanescent one's mind. Now what is needed is to meet with you. Please determine from Nicholas the mason what daily wages would be required if we were to request a master craftsman to come to Akka. Please specify this matter.

Subject: business; financial; property matters
Quotation: The matter of the Afnan requireth attention. His own view is not known. They are aware of the available persons; whomsoever they request will be sent. Jenab-i-Amin, upon him be Baha'u'llah, was dispatched according to instructions solely so that the Afnan would not be alone; there was no other intention whatsoever. In any case, there are many rabble and ruffians in that city. They must conduct themselves in such a manner as to ensure the confidence of the merchants from all regions, and they must spend within measure. The means have not been and will not be withheld; they must hold fast to this and act accordingly.

Subject: business; financial; property matters
Quotation: As His Honor Haji, like a creditor - a Turkish colonel and Azerbaijani soldier - is present, and this servant, like a devoted debtor, is penniless, perplexed and thoughtful about how to pay this debt of one thousand tumans profit each month, since Haji adds a profit to the requested letters each month. For some time, due to great occupations, they had given this respite and were being very reasonable. But now today, like a creditor who, fearing the debtor's bankruptcy, becomes restless and agitated, they have suddenly appeared and at once want to collect five promissory notes, and will not leave until they get them.

Subject: business; financial; property matters
Quotation: Furthermore, Haji Abbas-Ali, the merchant of Shiraz, has raised his hands in supplication and has written to this servant from Egypt mentioning a partnership and including a complaint. Although it is known from your good conduct, manner and character that it is impossible that you would delay in fulfilling anyone's rights or leave them unattended, nevertheless it would be most acceptable in the Holy Presence if some way could be found to satisfy this person or at least quiet him. Now his letter is being sent exactly as received, and he has also sent a copy of the partnership agreement which is with me. I await your reply so that I may send a detailed response to that person's letter.

Subject: business; financial; property matters
Quotation: In these days a matter hath come to pass which the assured ones and the sincere ones must needs take note of, namely that the honored Afnan, his eminence Aqa Mirza Aqa, upon him be the Glory of God, the Most Glorious, after turning to the Desired One and attaining His presence, and in view of the fact that in the Book of God everyone is commanded to engage in some occupation, craft or trade, he, after obtaining permission, set out for Port Said where he hath engaged in commerce and in truth hath held fast to serving the Cause and is a source of joy and comfort to the emigrants. His wife resideth in that land and there is no one to arrange her departure and look after the affairs of this Afnan of the Sacred Tree.

Subject: business; financial; property matters
Quotation: The telegraph expense is accepted and recorded in the account, but the reckoning is with the noble scribes. Regarding return, it was previously written that the Iraq route is more suitable and the judgment of His Excellency accords with wisdom. Communicate and request instructions. If you return with the permission of the Na'ibu's-Saltanih and the assembly it would certainly be better. It was also written before to communicate from Iraq, and the purpose of communication was to obtain permission, for the government's purse is empty like the heart of Moses' mother, and due to need they will try to obtain money from anyone by any means. If you proceed without permission, they will use this as a pretext to demand funds.

Subject: business; financial; property matters
Quotation: What is remarkable is that Jinab-i-Ismu'llah Mim Ha, upon whom be all the most glorious Glory, despite being very particular and precise, wrote that the great upheaval that occurred in the land of Sad was all calmed through the wise management of Jinab-i-Ismu'llah Ha, and the captured souls were freed. His Holiness the Kalim, may my spirit and being be sacrificed for him, did not have much cultivation. They acquired a piece of land and some cultivation has been done for the recreation of the Most Great Branch, may my spirit be sacrificed for the dust of his most pure footsteps, and others who occasionally honor it with their presence. Consider its affairs like the affairs of this prison - there has been no order and arrangement, and these days it remains suspended.

Subject: business; financial; property matters
Quotation: At last I went to an Arab friend of mine and borrowed from him £20 at 2 per cent. This money I took to a merchant who was in former time a grain-dealer but now out of work. I told him We will enter into a partnership[,] the Capital from me, the labor from you. With this fund you will deal four months in grain. After paying off all the expenses of rent etc; and receiving your monthly salary, we will divide the net profit; one third for you and two third for me. We entered into this agreement and he engaged in business. After four months we cleared our accounts. I payed the debt with its two per cent; the merchant received his one third of the net profit, all the other expenses defrayed and 80 pounds left in the balance for me. With that sum, then I built a bath in the house which is kept intact up to the present day.

Subject: business; financial; property matters
Quotation: When Aqa Mirza 'Abdu'l-Husayn was departing, I wished to present him with travel expenses, but due to scarcity of funds it was not possible. It was arranged that he would borrow from his fellow traveler and you would repay it there. Please deliver one hundred tumans, and henceforth if you send ____, stipulate that the German consul here should deliver gold, not bank notes, as they depreciate greatly and people accept them only reluctantly with a discount. Thus far through the United Company, one sum of two hundred pounds has arrived, another of two hundred and fifty, and a third of two hundred and ten, and another telegram has come from the United Company saying they have sent two hundred and fifty, but it has not yet arrived. All these amounts have gone to accumulated debts, as we were indebted to the sons of ?adiq Pasha, and the debt bore interest, and they still have an outstanding claim.

Subject: business; financial; property matters
Quotation: Another matter concerns the return of the beloved of the heart, His Honour Amin, upon him be God's peace and favors. Until now, which is nearly a year, nothing substantial has arrived. That beloved one is aware that in these days they wrote to this servant that if you wish to receive two hundred Ottoman liras from the beloved His Honour Shaykh, upon him be Baha'u'llah's glory, the funds are available here. They wished to send it to His Honour, the beloved of the heart, upon him be the Most Glorious Beauty of Baha'u'llah, and they also sent some to purchase and send silk from Rasht. Then they suspended it, writing that they feared it might result in loss like the shawl of the previous year. In any case, if possible, they should send it. That beloved one is aware of the affairs here and the expenses of this land. Likewise, thirty Ottoman liras have been sent as a personal trust by His Honour Afnan, upon him be the Most Glorious Beauty of Baha'u'llah. They have written for that beloved one to send this as well.

Subject: business; financial; property matters
Quotation: Aqa Muhammad 'Ali's occupation was separate, his affairs distinct, having no connection whatsoever with the Shaykh. Nevertheless, he tore away the veil of contentment and arose with complete greed to harm and show enmity toward the Shaykh. Day and night, before those within and without, he was aflame with the fire of greed and strove diligently to destroy the Shaykh's work. And according to what is known, the Shaykh's trade was also confused for two reasons: for whatever one would build up, another would tear down, and in some transactions losses occurred. The honored master, his eminence the Afnan of the Land of Ya wrote a detailed letter to this servant. Among other things, he complained about the trade in the Great City and mentioned that his honored eminence the Afnan of the Land of Ha and he himself deemed it advisable to close the door of trade in that city, as did the other honored Afnans. They wrote that if it is necessary for an establishment to remain open in that city, that is another matter and depends upon the will - whatever is commanded shall be done.

Subject: business; financial; property matters
Quotation: There are certain urgent expenses at hand, including the living expenses of your companion and others, and various other endless expenditures, and I am perplexed as to what should be done. Since Jinab-i-Aqa Mirza Ja'far has written that from the sum they have sent for purchasing land, whatever remains should be given to the household, and in these days the affairs of the household are as disheveled as your beard and as scattered as your hair, with absolutely no recourse left - the destitute are in God's protection - therefore, if you deem it advisable, use the remaining sum thus: fifteen liras for the price of candles from Aqa Ahmad's draft, pay your companion's living expenses, pay the postal fees, deliver two liras to Husayn Effendi's house, give one lira to Hibatullah, take four liras yourself, and write to Jinab-i-Aqa Mirza Ja'far that since in these days extreme hardship in household expenses had arisen, and since you had written likewise, out of kindness they said to use that sum for the aforementioned items. However, this amount is a debt upon me. God willing, it will be repaid in summer when it is building season, so that construction may be done on the land, for winter is not the season for building.

Subject: business; financial; property matters
Quotation: Two years ago, one of the friends besought Tablets from the heaven of divine favor and wrote several names, but four names were written incorrectly -- for example, writing Muhammad instead of Hassan, and Hussein instead of Ahmad. This causes delay and confusion. Although these servants write the names at the head of the Tablets according to how the friends mention them, in any case this matter requires attention and consideration so that names are written correctly. Regarding the two sums of money about which you wrote in these days -- one from the Land of Ha and another from 'Aliyyih -- news of their arrival has come; God willing, they will arrive. As commanded, the sum of one hundred tumans must reach Jinab-i-Samandar -- upon him be the Most Glorious Glory of God -- as it was assigned to him to give to two persons, which he has done and sent the receipt. That honored one must pay the debt of God, exalted be His glory. Likewise, deliver fifty tumans to the honored wife of him who ascended unto God (the late Mirza Ahmad Khan) and send the receipt. And He said: We must impose a fine upon Jinab-i-Amin! We have one treasurer and he is bankrupt! Gracious God, there is one treasury belonging to God, and that is empty of funds. Indeed, by virtue of its exalted station, such a treasury ought to be freed and sanctified from earthly things and not be confused with the treasuries of the world.

Subject: call to acquire knowledge; sciences
Quotation: You must ever concentrate your thoughts on the acquisition of knowledge, so that unlimited confirmations may continually descend upon you from the Kingdom of God

Subject: call to acquire knowledge; sciences

Subject: call to acquire knowledge; sciences

Quotation: Then reflect how thou shouldst be. Arise and be of those who act. This behooveth all His loved ones together.

Quotation: Arise to remember God amongst His servants... Hearken, O people, to the call of your Lord, then turn unto Him

Quotation: Arise amidst the servants, then speak forth in His praise. Thus doth command thee the Pen of the All-Choosing.

Quotation: O peoples of the earth! Fear the All-Merciful and follow not every froward devil. Cast aside vain imaginings.

Quotation: Give spirit to the Slavs, bestow light to the Hungarians / Be a balm for every wound, bestow the remedy of theriac

Quotation: call to action: "O people! Awaken, awaken! Become conscious, become conscious! Open seeing eyes, gain hearing ears."

Quotation: There is strong hope that the friends and handmaidens of the All-Merciful will seek no rest or repose day and night

Subject: call to action
Quotation: Read ye the Bayan, that ye may be of them that understand...would they but ponder upon this Cause for less than a moment.

Subject: call to action
Quotation: Seize, O friends, the chance which this Day offereth you, and deprive not yourselves of the liberal effusions of His grace.

Subject: call to action
Quotation: Know ye the value of this and arise to fulfill whatsoever is required and incumbent upon you by virtue of this relationship.

Subject: call to action
Quotation: Strive! Make ye an effort! and work by day and night so that a time may soon come when the Continent of Europe is illumined.

Subject: call to action
Quotation: Stand ye firm in the Cause... Unite ye in the Cause of God and His religion, and stand ye firm in love...aid ye then the Youth

Subject: call to action
Quotation: Convey loving greetings to Jenab-i-Qabil...convey most glorious greetings to the maidservants of God Muluk, Liqa and Ruh-angiz

Subject: call to action
Quotation: Today the people of God must manifest such steadfastness that no opportunity for speech remains for the polytheists of the Bayan.

Subject: call to action
Quotation: May he arise with all his might to exalt the Word of God. May he become the chief among the lovers and the joy of the yearning ones.

Subject: call to action
Quotation: "Arise in passionate fervor and awaken the world from the slumber of heedlessness, and rouse them from the stupor of self and desire."

Subject: call to action
Quotation: O people of Milan! Verily your Lord, the All-Merciful, calleth you unto the Kawthar of life, and it is My love, the mighty, the wondrous

Subject: call to action
Quotation: O people! Dispute not in God's Cause...Say: We are engaged in a momentous Cause. It behooveth you to aid your Lord, the All-Merciful.

Subject: call to action
Quotation: O people! Answer him who calleth you unto God and follow not every obstinate polytheist. Prepare yourselves to hearken unto the Word of God

Subject: call to action
Quotation: This is the Day of mention and utterance, and this is the Day of service and recognition. Strive ye that ye may drink from the living waters

Subject: call to action
Quotation: O friends! Strive that ye may not deprive yourselves of the ocean of bounty, and adorn yourselves with that which beseemeth this divine Day.

Subject: call to action
Quotation: Now is the time for all the friends to arise to guide humanity and through their conduct, deeds and words become the cause of guiding souls.

Subject: call to action
Quotation: Turn ye, O people, unto the mercy of God and His grace, and tarry not in this Most Great Cause. Fear ye God and be not of them that slumber.

Subject: call to action
Quotation: Arise to help the Wronged One... Arise to the Cause in such wise that neither the barking of dogs nor the might of the oppressors disturbs you.

Subject: call to action
Quotation: Therefore, make an effort that harmony may be established, for this will be the cause of joy and gladness to the heart and soul of 'Abdu'l-Baha.

Subject: call to action
Quotation: you must follow in his footsteps and move according to his way and conduct, so that you may become a sign of mercy and witness the ultimate bounty

Subject: call to action
Quotation: In this mighty cycle and manifest dispensation, strive thou to attain the most exalted cup and become foremost in the assemblage of divine knowledge.

Subject: call to action
Quotation: Cast aside what you possess and take what you are commanded by God, the Lord of all men. Turn with radiant faces, trusting in God, the Lord of Lords.

Subject: call to action
Quotation: Arise, O concourse of the earth, to reform the world! This is what ye have been commanded in the Tablets of God, the Lord of what was and what shall be.

Subject: call to action
Quotation: Abandon idle fancies through the Name of thy Lord, the Self-Subsisting, and arise amidst mankind with such steadfastness as cannot be followed by sitting

Subject: call to action
Quotation: Make ye an effort that this universe may become another universe and this darkened world find a ray of the Sun of Truth and become luminous and refulgent.

Subject: call to action
Quotation: Encouragement for the believers to "show new enthusiasm and strike a fresh flame" and "raise a clamor and hoist the banner of precedence and eternal glory"

Subject: call to action
Quotation: O Lord! Ordain in my remembrance a fire from Thy presence and a light from Thy court, that the world may be ignited thereby and the nations illumined therewith.

Subject: call to action
Quotation: I eagerly await and anticipate that each of you may become an exalted banner and a manifest light in service to the Cause of God and the diffusion of His verses.

Subject: call to action
Quotation: As much as thou art able, day and night, convey the song and melody of the angel to the ears of the heedless, that perchance they may awaken and become conscious.

Subject: call to action
Quotation: Now hath the Sun of Truth shed its rays upon Japan. It is our hope that that land will become illumined, that the heavenly civilization will be established there.

Subject: call to action
Quotation: Therefore, O ye spiritual friends, gird up the loins of service and like those of understanding who follow the path of truth, arise to diffuse the divine fragrances.

Subject: call to action
Quotation: Stand thou firm in the Cause of God and cast behind thee all else besides Him... Arise to serve the Cause, then protect the people from the whisperings of the satans

Subject: call to action
Quotation: Let not time slip away from you, and arise to recover what hath passed you by. This is a Day wherein from all directions the call of the Revealer of verses is raised.

Subject: call to action
Quotation: When thou art illumined by the lights of the Face and art revived by the fragrances of the Robe, arise amidst the servants and say: O people! The Promised Day is come.

Subject: call to action
Quotation: Therefore arise in this servitude, wear thy crown at a rakish angle, stand tall, and place upon thy head the most glorious and bejeweled crown of the Supreme Concourse.

Subject: call to action
Quotation: we must...with utmost joy and delight associate in the gathering of the world and become the cause of awakening and awareness and guidance and nobility of all humanity

Subject: call to action
Quotation: Arise to serve the Cause and speak forth its beautiful praise...Remember My loved ones on My behalf and give them the glad tidings of My grace and remind them of My days

Subject: call to action
Quotation: Hasten, hasten to the forgiveness of thy Lord and His mercy! Quick, quick to the fountain of grace and compassion! Come ye, come ye to the source of bounty and bestowal!

Subject: call to action
Quotation: You must occupy yourselves with His mention and praise in the nights and days, and let your highest endeavor be the reformation of the world and the education of nations.

Subject: call to action
Quotation: Stand firm in the Cause of thy Lord, then convey unto the people this Revelation... Be not silent in thy Lord's remembrance... Gird up thy loins to assist the Cause of God

Subject: call to action
Quotation: Hasten ye in the Cause of God with a mighty hastening. [repeated multiple times] Hasten ye, with surpassing greatness, in the Cause of God, Who standeth between all things.

Subject: call to action
Quotation: This is not the time to sit in silence; Bring the lovers to a state of fervent ardor Speak a portion of love and loving, That thou may distinguish the godly from the ungodly

Subject: call to action
Quotation: Dispatch the likeness of that Book to some of the Doctors of religion, and announce unto them the glad tidings of the days of God, as the advent of the Lord is surely coming.

Subject: call to action
Quotation: Therefore, O ye loved ones of the Ancient Beauty, arise in thanksgiving for this most great favor to promote the Cause, that ye may enter the Abha Kingdom with radiant faces.

Subject: call to action
Quotation: Arise with wisdom and utterance... Be in all conditions one who speaks My Name, soars in My atmosphere, turns to My horizon, and gives glad tidings of this Great Announcement.

Subject: call to action
Quotation: O Commander! Hear the call of thy Lord upon Mount Sinai: Verily there is no God but Him, and I am the Most High, as hath been hidden in what God hath ordained in the Mother Book.

Subject: call to action
Quotation: Apply your utmost effort in learning the English language and complete it... make an effort and take action, and with heavenly determination and divine resolve and godly purpose

Subject: call to action
Quotation: This is not a day to sit still. Arise in the name of thy Lord, then remind the people of this Day wherein the Caller calleth out that there is no God but Him, the Mighty, the Loving.

Subject: call to action
Quotation: So strive with heart and soul to become illumined candles in the assembly of the world, brilliant stars in the horizon of Truth, and the means for spreading the lights of the Kingdom

Quotation: Cast aside what thou hast of idle fancies and take fast hold of the hem of thy Lord, the Lord of all mankind. Be thou steadfast in the Cause and speak forth in remembrance of thy Lord

Subject: call to action
Quotation: Arise to praise thy Lord amongst His servants... Leave creation behind thee and summon the servants unto the Cause which hath dawned and shone forth from the horizon of thy Lord's will

Subject: call to action
Quotation: God willing, may you be speaking words of remembrance at all times, whose effects shall become manifest and evident in the world. Awaken those who slumber and make the heedless mindful.

Quotation: Now is the time when, like the apostles of Christ, you should forget all else save Him and surge and roar like the great sea, that the fragrances of truth may perfume the East and the West

Subject: call to action
Quotation: We must deal with all with loving kindness and be the real well-wishers of mankind. We must free them from old prejudices which are decayed and rotten. We must confer upon them a new life.

Quotation: Although it is summer season and surely you will leave Paris, I will ask God that wherever you are, you may become the cause of exalting God's Cause and spreading the Covenant and Testament

Quotation: Cast aside what ye possess and take what ye are commanded by God, the Ancient Commander. Say: Beware lest ye deprive yourselves of the outpourings of the days of God, the Lord of the worlds.

Quotation: O servant! Hearken unto the call from the direction of 'Akka... Be thou occupied with His remembrance amidst His heedless servants that they may hear the call of God and find a way unto Him.

Quotation: O friends of God! ... O lovers of the Ancient Beauty! The time for surging and tumult is like an endless ocean, and the moment for being set ablaze by the fire of the Divine Lote Tree has come.

Quotation: I hope that you will be confirmed in this service and become the cause of eternal glory for that noble tribe. May you sow pure seeds that will yield abundant harvests, and may this effect endure.

Quotation: Now is the time to leap into the game and win the ball from the most renowned players of the world! Now is the hour to speak with the greatest eloquence and present the most impressive arguments.

Quotation: O people! Ponder upon that which hath appeared in truth, and follow not every denier and doubter. It behooveth every soul to turn unto it and to abandon whatsoever tales of old he possesseth.

Quotation: He invited all to righteousness and prohibited strife and contention...Ask God that through the assistance of the Abha Kingdom you may become the manifestation of love and affection to all humanity

Quotation: Be thou steadfast in the love of thy Lord and remind the people in this Day wherein intoxication hath seized those in all regions. Turn ye unto Him and make not yourselves deserving of chastisement.

Quotation: O friends! Drink ye of the everlasting Kawthar in the days of the manifestation of the Divine Beauty...Take ye and drink, O people of holiness, in this glorious paradise, and be not of them that delay!
