Quotation: I beseech You to assist Your servants in that which You have commanded them in Your Book, then enable them to perform what You have ordained for them through Your binding command and Your firm decree.

Subject: call to action
Quotation: Therefore, O people of the earth, awaken yourselves and return wholly unto God, that He may forgive your transgressions and remit what ye have done in His days when ye turned away from His beauty.

Subject: call to action
Quotation: Cast aside vain imaginings in the name of the Lord of all beings and turn to God, the All-Knowing, the All-Wise. Fear God and be not of the heedless ones. Turn with your hearts to the Dawning-Place of grace

Subject: call to action
Quotation: O Rashid! Show forth courage and manifest valor, so that thou mayest fulfill the rights of manliness in the arena of the Covenant and strike such a polo-mallet that thou mayest steal away the ball of hopes.

Subject: call to action
Quotation: O Faraj'u'llah! Hear the call of the Wronged One and pray that perchance the heedless souls may become aware and turn from falsehood to truth, from rejection to acceptance, and from denial to acknowledgment.

Subject: call to action
Quotation: Strive that you may attain to that which shall endure as long as the kingdom of earth and heaven endure. Set the world ablaze with the fire of the blessed Lote-Tree. Hold fast to the cord of unity and concord.

Subject: call to action
Quotation: The time has come to arise with all your powers to serve the Cause of God and to diffuse the fragrances of God. Raise such a melody that will set the Caucasus, nay rather Russia itself, in motion and vibration.

Subject: call to action
Quotation: O people! Fear God and follow not the manifestations of idle fancies who dispute the signs of God, the All-Knowing, the All-Informed. Cast away what the people possess and take My Book, the Mighty, the Wondrous.

Subject: call to action
Quotation: Today is the day of purity and freedom, and the time to act according to the counsels of the Divine Prophets. As far as you are able, bring the sheep of Israel beneath the shadow of the heavenly Shepherd's grace

Subject: call to action
Quotation: I fain would hope that in this centre of materialists, the people of God will flourish and be victorious, that the divine foundation may be laid down, and that the standard of "Ya Baha'u'l-Abha" may be unfurled.

Subject: call to action
Quotation: The morn of guidance has appeared and the candle of great bounty is shining. The light is shed abroad and exceeding grace is made manifest. It is the time for sanctity, for self-sacrifice, for purity and freedom.

Subject: call to action
Quotation: Now must thou and all the unitarians, with utmost humility and lowliness, beseech the Self-Sufficient One for that which would conduce to the betterment of the world and the progress and tranquility of its peoples.

Subject: call to action
Quotation: "Arise to promote the Cause between the heavens and the earths, then let the herald call out that he may summon the servants in these grievous days to the Manifestation of God, thy Lord and the Lord of all worlds."

Subject: call to action
Quotation: O my Lord! Aid this servant of Thine to exalt Thy Word, to vanquish falsehood, to vindicate truth, to spread the divine verses, to manifest the lights, and to cause the dawn to break in the hearts of the righteous.

Subject: call to action
Quotation: This is a day wherein all the loved ones should turn their gaze toward the All-Bestowing Lord and arise to serve the Cause of God...In like manner must accepted souls arise with their whole being to serve the Cause

Subject: call to action
Quotation: Therefore keep those friends vigilant and those nightingales aware of the claws of the ill-fated, full-feathered raven, lest they become veiled from the garden's nightingale by the croaking of crows and cawing of ravens.

Subject: call to action
Quotation: Therefore, arise with all thy power that thou mayest make the heedless mindful, the strangers intimate, guide the rebellious to obedience, and lead the oppressors to the fountain of pardon and bounty of the Blessed Beauty

Subject: call to action
Quotation: O friends! By the life of the All-Merciful! If in this Day any soul should miss performing a deed, its compensation shall be impossible thereafter. Strive that ye may not be deprived of the outpourings of the divine days.

Subject: call to action
Quotation: Awaken and arise from the beds of negligence, and be ignited by the fire kindled in the Tree of the Covenant on the Sinai of the Testament. Arise to serve the Cause of God and make firm your feet upon this mighty Covenant.

Subject: call to action
Quotation: We counsel them and those who have believed to arise to serve My Cause, through which the hearts of the servants were troubled and the feet of the mystics did slip, save whom God willeth, thy Lord, the Mighty, the Powerful.

Subject: call to action
Quotation: This is a day of arising to render service and to show servitude at the Threshold of Oneness. While life remains, make haste, and before autumn overtakes spring and while health has not yet been conquered by illness, arise.

Subject: call to action
Quotation: Turn with illumined hearts toward the Most Exalted Horizon that ye may behold His most great signs. Arise to serve God and to aid His Cause, that perchance the people may awaken and turn unto the Peerless, the All-Informed.

Subject: call to action
Quotation: O Ahmad! Hearken unto the call of Ali from the Supreme Kingdom... Cast behind thee all that thou findest among men, then soar with the wings of holiness in this atmosphere which God hath sanctified from mention of aught else

Subject: call to action
Quotation: assembly may become an army of universal peace and shatter the forces of strife, contention and warfare through the power of the teachings of Baha'u'llah, and raise up the standard of unity, harmony and love in the human world

Subject: call to action
Quotation: Arise from the slumber of passion, in the name of your Lord, the Most Glorious - this would be better for you, did ye but know. Arise at My call, then walk in My Kingdom which We have adorned with My Name, the Mighty, the Beloved.

Subject: call to action
Quotation: Raise up, I implore Thee, O my God, as helpers to this Revelation such as shall be counted worthy of Thy name and of Thy sovereignty, that they may remember me among Thy creatures, and hoist the ensigns of Thy victory in Thy land.

Subject: call to action
Quotation: "Strive thou that in the days of God thou mayest not be deprived of the outpourings from the heaven of grace and bounty" and "Endeavor to succeed in such deeds as may cause the perpetuation of thy remembrance in the Kingdom of God"

Subject: call to action
Quotation: O people, hasten, hasten to harmony! You must abandon hatred! You must abandon rancor! You must abandon dispute! You must dispel misguidance! You must disperse darkness! You must investigate reality in what has passed of the days!

Subject: call to action
Quotation: Therefore, all the friends must demonstrate a manifest and evident determination so that they may create a new invention, or discover a novel art, or undertake a great enterprise, or demonstrate a power and gift in the human world.

Subject: call to action
Quotation: The duty is that in all conditions you should sacrifice yourself for the Cause of God and be occupied with spreading the divine fragrances and strengthening hearts in the Covenant of God. This is the fruit of existence and station.

Subject: call to action
Quotation: Now therefore it behoveth thee to fill a glass with this wine of God's love and offer it to those worshippers of the cup. Say: how long will you roam in the valleys and the fields? This is the time of attainment, the time of reunion!

Subject: call to action
Quotation: Arise and exert all your strength in the service of the Cause of God... All must appreciate and arise with utmost constancy and sincerity so that these divisions are reconciled, these wounds are healed, and these ailments are cured.

Subject: call to action
Quotation: endeavor ye with heart and soul and impart with the utmost happiness and rejoicing the glad tidings of the Kingdom of God so that the inhabitants of Tropico may find rejoicing and beatitude and your kind father may also obtain Faith.

Subject: call to action
Quotation: O people! Fear ye God and follow not him who hath followed his passions and disbelieved in God, the Mighty, the Best-Beloved. O people! Turn ye unto God and the Dawning-Place of His Cause. This is better for you, did ye but know.

Subject: call to action
Quotation: Rather, the friends must be in utmost joy and delight, familiar with divine breezes, strive to exalt the Word of God, and make effort to spread the fragrance of the love of God...Rather they must ever arise to fulfill their own duties

Subject: call to action
Quotation: O people of the earth! Come ye and observe justice concerning that which hath appeared from Him, and follow not the imaginings of such as have uttered that which was the greatest cause for the martyrdom of the Beloved of the world

Subject: call to action
Quotation: Exert thine utmost endeavour, therefore, in pursing such goals as would lead to the progress of the entire world, and in fulfilling such intentions as are conducive to the perpetual exaltation and eternal life of the whole human race.

Subject: call to action
Quotation: Therefore, we must see ourselves in every breath as bound for the realm of nothingness, and arise to perform that which will be the cause of eternal life and the means of ascension and attainment to the Kingdom and the place of meeting.

Subject: call to action
Quotation: O ye handmaidens of God! Make waves like a mighty ocean! Sing songs like the birds of the Abha paradise! In the rose garden of God, with utmost joy and exaltation chant each and all in praise of Him who is the desire of all the nations.

Subject: call to action
Quotation: O people of Baha! Gird up the loins of endeavor, that perchance religious strife and conflict may be blotted out from among the peoples of the world. For the love of God and His servants, arise to serve this momentous and exalted Cause.

Subject: call to action
Quotation: Therefore your honor must contemplate this mighty station and resort to all means and measures so that perhaps you may become the manifestation of God's decisive will and render a new service and unprecedented effort in the Cause of God.

Subject: call to action
Quotation: Multiple exhortations to arise and support the Cause: "Arise, O people, in support of God's Cause and His victory, and be not of the heedless ones." "Help your Lord, the All-Merciful, with all that ye are able in the realm of possibility"

Subject: call to action
Quotation: O ye believers! Call upon God your Creator for Our deliverance, in truth and by truth, through this Gate round about the Water abundantly. O ye believers! What aileth you? How is it that ye remove your journeys far from the dwellings of God?

Subject: call to action
Quotation: O people, rend ye asunder the veils of glory that ye may behold the Dawning-Place of Beauty Who hath shone forth from this manifest horizon. Beware lest allusions hold you back from the Source of verses, or symbols from this Mighty News.

Subject: call to action
Quotation: Arise, O servant, with all thy power to serve the Cause of God, and make me thy partner in servitude at the threshold of His Most Glorious Beauty, and give the seekers to drink from the cup of remembrance in the gathering of divine knowledge.

Subject: call to action
Quotation: Be thou steadfast in the service of the Cause and speaking the praise of thy Lord. Say: O people of the earth! Turn ye unto the Dawning-Place of Revelation, then read what hath been sent down unto you from God, the Peerless, the All-Informed.

Subject: call to action
Quotation: Thy mission in America for the present is this: Thou must travel as far as possible to every part and pass through cities and towns, summoning everyone to the Beauty of ABHÃƒ, raising the Call of the Kingdom and proclaiming at the top of thy voice

Subject: call to action
Quotation: The Afnan and the loved ones must, to the extent possible, hold fast to whatsoever will guide and draw near the servants of God, as well as that which will cause the lands to flourish. The time is your time, and the revealed Tablets are your support.

Subject: call to action
Quotation: O heedless ones! Arise from the slumber of passion and turn unto the Most Exalted Horizon. Beware lest these numbered days withhold you from the Dayspring of Oneness. Cast away what ye possess and turn with your hearts unto the Mighty, the Beloved.

Subject: call to action
Quotation: Today the call is raised from all directions...Now must all gird up the loins of endeavor and arise to serve the Cause, and guide and lead the people of the earth to the straight path of God through kindly counsels, wise exhortations, wisdom and utterance.

Subject: call to action
Quotation: Arise through divine power and heavenly wisdom, that perchance from the trees of existence may appear and become manifest the fruit of the Tree of Sinai. Arise in the name of God, the Lord of Hosts, and strive for the betterment and elevation of the world

Subject: call to action
Quotation: Make thou a melody for the Supreme Concourse and turn to the Abha Kingdom. Let thy ambition soar high and thy purpose be noble. Therefore, while the bow is in hand and arrow nocked, strive thou to hunt the meanings and gallop in the field of eternal life.

Subject: call to action
Quotation: We have desired to cause thee to soar in the atmosphere of remembrance and knowledge with wings the like of which have not been seen in the realm of creation... that thou mayest arise to make mention in such wise as to move the world and awaken the nations.

Subject: call to action
Quotation: Before all faces, with the most exalted call, We summoned all, but the people accepted not the Word of truth and remained occupied with vain imaginings. The Day is Thy Day; bestow from the treasuries of meanings and utterance that which befitteth these days.

Subject: call to action
Quotation: Answer the Call of God in your midst, then go forth from your homes, turning unto the Kingdom. Thus doth your Lord, the True, the Faithful, counsel you. Say: Present yourselves before your Lord and withhold not yourselves from that for which ye were created.

Subject: call to action
Quotation: Leave the bells, and come forth, then, from your churches. It behoveth you, in this day, to proclaim aloud the Most Great Name among the nations. Prefer ye to be silent, whilst every stone and every tree shouteth aloud: 'The Lord is come in His great glory!'?

Subject: call to action
Quotation: Now is the time for us to follow in the footsteps of those noble ones and arise like them to sacrifice our lives. Then each of the friends according to their means must arise to assist this mighty edifice and in this cause sacrifice and offer up their lives.

Subject: call to action
Quotation: Emerge from behind the veil in the name of thy Lord, the Mighty, the Bestower, and fear not the idolaters. Hesitate not in the Cause of thy Lord. Be thou one who remembers Him with His remembrance, assists His Cause, and speaks His praise amongst His creatures.

Subject: call to action
Quotation: Arise from the horizon of utterance with the remembrance of thy Lord, the All-Merciful, then summon all creation unto God, the Mighty, the Bestower...Be thou among the people a herald of thy Lord's Cause and a bearer of that which thou art commanded in the Book.

Subject: call to action
Quotation: Therefore, since you are a lion of this reed-bed and a servant at this Threshold, strive to be the cause of life, not death; to bring salvation, not destruction; to be a radiant lamp, not a world-consuming fire; to become a brilliant star, not a prevailing demon.

Subject: call to action
Quotation: Since you are a lion, you must make an attack and show your might and drive away these weak animals so that the sheep and birds in the gardens of the Sovereign of Manifestation may burst into such melody as will astound the consciousness of the people of the world.

Subject: call to action
Quotation: Now must each one of you hasten unto this field and seize your chance before all others. What better time is there than this? Lose not this opportunity and seize your chance. Strive that that region may become a heavenly paradise and that country may be illumined.

Subject: call to action
Quotation: O servants! The days are passing and things are perishing. Strive that ye may attain unto the lamp of the favor of God, exalted be His glory. The place of return, outwardly, is observed to be narrow and dark. A lamp is needed and solitude requireth a companion.

Subject: call to action
Quotation: O people! Spread not corruption in the earth, nor wage war with anyone. Be patient in all things, place your trust in God, and be of them that trust in Him. Aid your Lord, the All-Merciful, with the swords of wisdom and utterance, for this befits human dignity.

Subject: call to action
Quotation: Make manifest the entirety of the true Faith through a mighty and sublime authority. Aid, O my God, those who have believed in God and His signs throughout all the worlds, until there remaineth not a single soul upon the earth but worshippeth Thee through these verses

Subject: call to action
Quotation: O ancient friend! Strive with all thy soul to guide other friends and give shelter at the Divine Threshold to the helpless and wandering Persians, that all may engage in praise and worship of the Lord of creation and attain to that which was the desire of their forebears.

Subject: call to action
Quotation: Through the grace and favors of the Blessed Beauty, I hope that ye may become the leaders of the free and the chiefs of the company of the righteous, that ye may become centers reflecting the signs of the Self-Subsisting Lord and dawning-places of the lights of the known Lord

Subject: call to action
Quotation: Why are ye silent, then? Why are ye quiet and without joy? Where are your celebrations, your jubilations? Let us raise and unfurl the banner of victory! Let us drink from the cup that hath been tempered at the camphor fountain and chant our thankful psalms with melodies of praise.

Subject: call to action
Quotation: However, you must not be content with these stages, but rather day by day increase your acquisition of heavenly gifts until you become so attracted to the Eternal Beauty that you become renowned throughout all regions and famous throughout all the world for your passionate devotion.

Subject: call to action
Quotation: "You have written regarding BÃ¶hmen, Austria, that Herr Grunz [KrÃ¼ttner] has become confirmed, has arisen to serve and to give the glad tidings of the coming of the Kingdom God. Know certainly that soon he will find a wonderful help and that this Cause will spread in those regions."

Subject: call to action
Quotation: Make your hearts firmer than the mountains of the earth, and consume what is thereon with a single act, as though it were but a small morsel. Thus doth God desire people to be in the religion of their Lord -- nay, even more exalted than this, would they but reflect and render thanks.

Subject: call to action
Quotation: Now, O ye believers of God! Endeavor ye; so that in these states the lights of the Kingdom of God may find the utmost splendor, human hearts may be illumined, the knowledge of God may be disseminated, and the teachings of God like unto refreshing breezes may spread among all humanity.

Subject: call to action
Quotation: O people! O people! The sun of Reality has dawned from the horizon of the world, casting Effulgence upon the East and the West....O thou world of humanity! Awake! Awake! O thou negligent of the Kingdom of God! Revive! Revive! O thou prisoner of nature! Liberate thyself! Liberate thyself!

Subject: call to action
Quotation: Today is the mighty century of the Manifest Beauty and the day of confirmation and success of the Lord of the Worlds...Therefore they must shine forth like the radiant moon from the dawning-place of divine knowledge and become the cause of education of souls and the nobility of humankind.

Subject: call to action
Quotation: Therefore He writes that if it be possible and not too arduous a task, it would be most appropriate and fitting for you to undertake a journey to Hamadan and Iraq and other places in those regions. Assuredly this journey will prove better than other journeys and its results will be greater.

Subject: call to action
Quotation: Through the grace and bounty of the Ancient Beauty, I hope that thou wilt shine forth like unto a candle and burn away the veils of them that are shut out, that thou wilt close thine eyes to the world and all who dwell therein, and become filled with eagerness and rapture, fervor and delight.

Subject: call to action
Quotation: By God's life! This is that word of counsel which deserveth to adorn the frontispiece of the Mother Book. Say: Beware lest the conditions of creation withhold you from the Truth. Set aside what is with the people in hope of that which is with God, your Lord and the Lord of your fathers of old.

Subject: call to action
Quotation: I tell thee what duty requires: make haste, make haste, for time is short and the musician's melody nears its end. If in this feast thou dost not dance in thy shroud, beat the drum, raise thy voice in song, and lift up the high notes, then when else wilt thou become intoxicated and enraptured?

Subject: call to action
Quotation: Night and day confine thy time to the education of the world of humanity. Arise to guide the creatures and spend time in promulgating the teachings of His Holiness BAHA'O'LLAH, so that lives may find glad-tidings, hearts gladness, the souls eternal life and the minds extraordinary advancement.

Subject: call to action
Quotation: Strive ye according to your capacity to aid the Cause of God, for the Ancient Beauty Himself, after His arrival in the Most Great Prison, undertook matters of great moment and significance, even as He taught the kings of the earth one after another, as thou art aware of some of these instances.

Subject: call to action
Quotation: Therefore, O ye friends, arise with great resolve and render a service. Sow a seed, plant a sapling, lay a foundation, kindle a light, burn away the veils, manifest strength and display might. Under the shadow of the Standard of the Covenant, which waveth over all regions, sacrifice your lives.

Subject: call to action
Quotation: Arise from the couches of heedlessness by this Name through which all things have arisen, and follow not every rejected ignorant one. Hold fast to the cord of justice and deprive not yourselves of this manifest bounty. Draw nigh with your hearts unto the Beloved and follow not every hateful outcast.

Subject: call to action
Quotation: O Abdu'r-Rahim! Arise to serve and guide the servants, as far as possible, to the shore of the Most Great Ocean. The people of God and all other peoples must turn to the horizon of Revelation and beseech from the Truth that which will cause the exaltation of His Word and the advancement of existence.

Subject: call to action
Quotation: Since that region and land is the native place of the Exalted One - may my spirit be a sacrifice unto Him - the hope is that the Divine Standard may wave there at its loftiest heights and that the fire of the love of God may blaze forth in such wise that its light and warmth may spread to other lands.

Subject: call to action
Quotation: Follow thou the footsteps of thy Lord, and remember His servants even as He doth remember thee, undeterred by either the clamor of the heedless ones or the sword of the enemy....Spread abroad the sweet savors of thy Lord, and hesitate not, though it be for less than a moment, in the service of His Cause.

Subject: call to action
Quotation: "Arise, O wayfarer in the path of the Love of God, and aid thou His Cause... Would that such a man might arise and, wholly for the sake of God, admonish, privately and openly, the people, that haply they may bestir themselves and aid this wronged One Whom the workers of iniquity have so sorely afflicted."

Subject: call to action
Quotation: O loved ones of God! Rest not upon the couch of ease, and when ye have recognized your Creator and heard what hath befallen Him, arise to His aid, then speak and be not silent for less than a moment. This is better for you than all the treasures that have been and shall be, were ye of them that understand.

Subject: call to action
Quotation: Now you too must follow his example and arise to that which befits one related to him, that you may become the cause of brightening his lamp and enter into the circle of the gathering. 'Abdu'l-Baha's desire is that all the kindred and relations of that sagacious one may become distinguished in both worlds.

Subject: call to action
Quotation: Friends, weep for as long as you have eyes, and cry out for as long as your souls exist, for the carpet of union, joining, nearness and encounter has been rolled up. Instead, the sovereign of destiny has, by virtue of a preordained decree, spread out the quilt of parting, leave-taking, absence and departure.

Subject: call to action
Quotation: O handmaiden of God! You must be the cause of joy and gladness, attraction of conscience, and delight of heart and soul among the handmaidens of the Merciful, so that day by day the fire of the love of God may blaze more intensely among God's handmaidens and its warmth may spread to the hearts of other women.

Subject: call to action
Quotation: In thanksgiving for this grace, thou must strive to make the deprived ones intimates of the mystery, to make those who are silent become melodious and harmonious, and arise to serve the Cause that thou mayest attain eternal glory, kindle the lamp of guidance, and consume the veil of the people's vain imaginings.

Subject: call to action
Quotation: May they then open their tongues and speak the mysteries of the Lord of Hosts, awaken the heedless and make the deprived ones aware, inform the unaware and give glad tidings to the downcast, bring the dead to life and bring them beneath the shade of the tree of hope, and make them attain the gift of this new age.

Subject: call to action
Quotation: Be steadfast in God's Cause, walk the straight path, be patient in adversity, grateful in prosperity, and act according to what thou art commanded. Thus does the Mother Book command thee. Should a croaker come to you with the book of the wicked ones, cast it behind you, turning toward the Mighty, the All-Bestowing.

Subject: call to action
Quotation: O My Afnan! Upon thee be My glory and My loving-kindness. The Afnans of the Divine Lote-Tree were created for the service of the Cause. In all conditions and circumstances they must hold fast unto that which will cause its exaltation and elevation, and the manifestation of that which is now hidden from minds and eyes.

Subject: call to action
Quotation: The objective point of Bahais is to promote the Principles of BAHA'O'LLAH, to unfurl the Flag of Divine Brotherhood, to serve the cause of Universal Peace, to spiritualize mankind through the Breathes of the Holy Spirit, and to establish the kingdom of justice, love and mercy in the hearts of the people of the world.

Subject: call to action
Quotation: Your honor must, with divine power, guide all the friends of God in diffusing the divine fragrances, so that in a brief time the life-giving breeze of God's guidance may bestow eternal life upon that vast region, and souls may arise who shall each become, through divine bounty, a manifest sign and an unfurled standard.

Subject: call to action
Quotation: O thou who art advancing toward the Supreme Concourse, turning unto the Kingdom of El-Abha, art attracted by the Fragrances of God, enkindled with the Fire of the Love of God, spreading the Religion of God, calling people to salvation, guiding them to thy Supreme Lord and art speaking the praise of the Beauty of El-Abha!

Subject: call to action
Quotation: It is incumbent upon steadfast, firm, well-grounded and content souls who are detached from all save God and are gazing toward and turned to the Most Exalted Horizon to supplicate God, glorified be His majesty, in the nights and days for the protection of the manifest religion and to beseech the elevation of its station.

Subject: call to action
Quotation: Seize your chance and avail yourselves of this opportunity. The day will come when ye will long for a single moment of these days. Now, praise be to God, ye are persevering in this path. Consider how thankful ye should be, what a flame ye should enkindle, what a candle ye should light, and what a clamor ye should upraise.

Subject: call to action
Quotation: O how I long to see the believers shouldering the responsibilities of the Cause! Now my desire is that the friends arise to serve the Cause of God. Will they not make my heart happy? Will they not fulfill my hope? Will they not realize the desire of my heart? Will they not accept my request? Will they not gladden my soul?

Subject: call to action
Quotation: O my God! Arise to serve the Cause in such wise that all on earth shall witness thy arising. We have testified to this, and We are the All-Knowing Witness. Then speak forth with remembrance and praise amongst the concourse of creation, that they may be drawn to the supreme horizon and brought near to the One, the All-Informed.

Subject: call to action
Quotation: Be joyous, therefore, and exceeding glad, be alive with enthusiasm and seek to be ever more attracted to the presence of God at all times. Any wavering now will result in your becoming lukewarm and only half-alive; any silence on your part will lead to utter oblivion. So show forth your deeds and speak out eloquently at all times.

Subject: call to action
Quotation: "Now as it is so, it is better that you should say farewell with the Friends in the utmost of spirituality and happiness; (saying) 'that I intend to make a journey to teach (the Cause). Perhaps I may be confirmed in servitude & in this Path I may be sacrificed. And perhaps the cup of this great martyrdom may overflow (upon me).'"

Subject: call to action
Quotation: O My loved ones! Hear the call of the Wronged One with such hearing that neither oblivion shall overtake it nor change alter it. This is the Day of assistance. Ye must arise with complete devotion to serve the Cause and guide the people of the world to the horizon of the loving-kindness of the Lord of all beings with spirit and joy.

Subject: call to action
Quotation: Therefore the beloved friends of God must strive to bring about reconciliation between government and people, and if they remain powerless, they should withdraw... Now they must, day and night, with firm resolve, spiritual power, heavenly confirmation, divine breath and celestial determination, engage in educating and guiding the people

Subject: call to action
Quotation: O My loved ones there! Hear ye My call. Verily, We make mention of you and counsel you to manifest the Greater Steadfastness in this Cause whereby the pillars have been shaken and the eyes of them that have recognized God have been intoxicated. Take ye the Book as bidden by Us - this is what ye were commanded aforetime and at this moment.

Subject: call to action
Quotation: "O ye firm, steadfast, and faithful Believers!" and "Ye are the angels, if your feet be firm, your spirits rejoiced, your secret thoughts pure, your eyes consoled, your ears opened, your breasts dilated with joy, and your souls gladdened, and if you arise to assist the Covenant, to resist dissension and to be attracted to the Effulgence!"

Subject: call to action
Quotation: O divine friends and spiritual companions! This is a divine call that reaches from the Most Glorious Kingdom of Mystery to those silent in the valley of unconsciousness: O sleepers, awake! O intoxicated ones, become conscious! O dead ones, come to life! O withered ones, become fresh and verdant! O silent ones, speak! O mute ones, cry out!

Subject: call to action
Quotation: Therefore this is the time for steadfastness and the moment for glad-tidings, the day of sacrifice and the time of joy - and sacrifice is the essence of success. Weep like the clouds and smile like the meadow, and ask God that you may become a sacrifice at the Threshold of the Blessed Beauty and offered up in the path of that Peerless Beloved.

Subject: call to action
Quotation: Lead them that have gone astray unto the tabernacle of the recognition of Him Who is the Desire of all mankind. Ye have been called into being for the purpose of serving this Day of Victory. Through the power of trust and detachment, strive ye to attain this exalted station, and deprive neither yourselves nor mankind from its life-giving water.

Subject: call to action
Quotation: Whomever they deem suitable - that is, possessed of eloquence and a detached heart - should be sent to the divine cities and regions to purify souls with the Kawthar flowing from the Supreme Pen. This is beloved and acceptable in the presence of God. All souls have been created for this Day. The beloved ones must strive their utmost in this matter.

Subject: call to action
Quotation: In truth, mankind hath been created for the knowledge of God and the development of the earth, but lack of success and unseemly deeds have prevented people from building and they have engaged in destruction, being unaware. Say: O servants! Strive that perchance ye may build an abode beneath the canopies of divine mercy wherein ye may dwell forever.

Subject: call to action
Quotation: "I trust in Him to make your faces shine forth with a glorious light in that clime, radiant as the face of heaven at early dawn, casting its light upon all regions. Verily, I announce the glad-tidings of the confirmations which will sustain you, by the mercy of your Lord. For ye have arisen with all your powers to serve God's Cause in that vast land."

Subject: call to action
Quotation: O sincere seeker, call to the heavenly Kingdom as much as you can, so that you may make human souls into heavenly angels through divine guidance. And in this great age, may you become a cause of spreading universal peace and serve the unity of the kingdom of humanity, attain eternal life, follow Christ, and become a companion on the path of 'Abdu'l-Baha.

Subject: call to action
Quotation: Raise up your call in gratitude for His infinite bestowals, sing with joy and tell of the plenteous bounties of Him who is the Revealer on Sinai. Raise aloft His banners in the very corners of the world creation and make your steps ever firmer, ever more steadfast. Establish meetings to teach His cause and lead the ignorant to the morn of divine guidance.

Subject: call to action
Quotation: O people! Fear God and follow not those in whose breasts ye find rancor against God and His chosen ones, who cast the Book of God behind their backs and prevent people from the mercy that hath descended from the clouds of grace. Say: O people! Believe in God and His messengers, and slay not the she-camel of God that giveth you to drink of the milk of wisdom.

Subject: call to action
Quotation: This return will make thee to be a sign of the Supreme Concourse and the banner of the Kingdom in all regions, and through thy face will be illumined between earth and heaven, and thy tree will bring forth the most wondrous and unique fruits in the world of existence unto all eternity, and thou shalt be confirmed in eternal life throughout centuries and ages.

Subject: call to action
Quotation: Today must the chosen ones arise and, with wisdom and utterance, rend asunder the veils of the people, that all may witness, without concealment or hindrance, the signs of power, might and utterance from the Hands of the Cause, and may speak in gatherings as befits them, becoming the cause of sanctification, detachment and the manifestation of the fear of God.

Subject: call to action
Quotation: Move in perfect unity with the loved ones, in such wise that discord may be utterly removed. Move with utmost tranquility and remember with utmost love. Let no sorrow overtake thee. In every breath be other than thy former self, and with every step advance beyond thy previous step, that thou mayest be occupied at all times in purifying and sanctifying thyself.

Subject: call to action
Quotation: Today, the friends of God are the illumined candles of the world of humanity; unless the candle burns it will not bestow light. Man must endure if he would obtain treasure. Unless the friends are self-sacrificing, wonderful signs will not become manifest; unless the seed is planted it will not become a fruitful tree; unless the water flows gardens will not become verdant.

Subject: call to action
Quotation: O friends! Associate not with the people of hypocrisy, and be not content with the deceit and craftiness of the polytheists. This is the Day of God; mention of aught else is not permitted. Some have desired to renew the vain imaginings of the past and are now preparing the foundation thereof. Beseech ye God to keep all steadfast and not to deprive them from the ocean of His knowledge.

Subject: call to action
Quotation: Therefore must all arise to serve the Cause, and the service of the Cause is the manifestation of virtues and characteristics worthy of man's station. They must arise to serve in such wise that neither the might of the world nor the clamor of nations shall prevent them from service. They must hold fast unto wisdom and occupy themselves with mention, praise, and that which beseemeth them.

Subject: call to action
Quotation: Therefore it is necessary, indeed obligatory, that treatises be written in the most beautiful calligraphy and sent to Paris for us to give to the public library... Therefore I am compelled to assign this task to you, that every three months you prepare one treatise in the finest calligraphy, illuminate and bind it, and send it to Mr. Dreyfus so that he may deliver it to the public library.

Subject: call to action
Quotation: Therefore, strive with your souls and free your hearts from the bonds of water and clay. In the shadow of the Word of Unity, with sincerity and tranquility and dignity and stability and firmness and steadfastness and persistence, arise to serve the Lord - that is, become manifest signs of the Ancient Beauty and the Most Great Name through your conduct and deeds and words and character and behavior

Subject: call to action
Quotation: Have mercy upon yourselves by entering into God's religion in every Dispensation, lest your existence bear no fruit. If it does bear fruit through acceptance, this is the height of your glory; otherwise, only to that degree will it bear fruit. Have mercy upon yourselves, O people of the Bayan, on the Day of the Manifestation of Him Whom God shall make manifest, that you may enter into His religion.

Subject: call to action
Quotation: Wherever We may be, and whatever may befall Us, the people of God must fix their gaze with perfect steadfastness and confidence upon the Most Sublime Horizon and occupy themselves with the reformation of the world and the education of peoples. Whatsoever hath befallen and will befall hath been and is the cause of the exaltation of His Cause. Take ye hold of the command of God and cling ye thereunto.

Subject: call to action
Quotation: Be steadfast in My Cause and articulate in My praise, that perchance every heedless doubter may be awakened thereby...Return to thy land with the Book of thy Lord, the Possessor of all creation, that perchance the heedless souls may become aware and partake of the wine of knowledge...Hearken unto the counsel of the Friend and be vocal in His remembrance amongst the people, and arise to serve His Cause.

Subject: call to action
Quotation: Thus shalt thou attain the secrets of eternity in this thy transient life and become aware of divine existence whilst still in this dust-heap of a world. Bestir thou the company of lovers and create thou a tumult and commotion amongst these spiritual souls so that thou shalt enhance the understanding of those in the school of love and educate the novices of the Kingdom in the rudiments of true learning.

Subject: call to action
Quotation: Now that that Ravisher of hearts has spurred on His charger into the arena of Truth, and all that hath been hidden is revealed, why be still and silent, heedless and forgetful? Now is the hour to be stirred even as the surging billows of the sea, and seek to attain the heights of the stars...for time is fleeting, and the Divine Messenger will tarry no longer. Let us make haste and let our lamps be burning.

Subject: call to action
Quotation: O diffuser of the divine fragrances! The aid and loving-kindness of the All-Merciful is thy helper and supporter, and the protection and preservation of the Lord is thy refuge and shelter. As much as thou art able, strengthen thy arm and desire the most great striving. Shatter the army of error and scatter the hosts of darkness to all horizons. Rest not for a moment and remain not tranquil for an instant.

Subject: call to action
Quotation: O Lion! Upon thee be the Glory of God, the One, the Single! Arise to serve and, through wisdom and utterance, illumine the world of creation with the light of divine knowledge. Tarrying is not permitted -- this is the Day of speech, not silence. It behooveth thee to arise to serve the world and, through the waters of wisdom and understanding, to wash away the rancor and hatred hidden within the hearts of men.

Subject: call to action
Quotation: Arise in the name of your Lord, the All-Merciful, amidst all creation in such wise that the sincere shall find in your faces the radiance of the All-Glorious. Thus doth this imprisoned Stranger command you. Arise to aid the Cause of your Lord as your Master hath arisen, in such wise that neither the greatness of the turbans nor the might of them that have wronged and are among the most lost shall prevent you.

Subject: call to action
Quotation: If thou art slumbering upon thy couch, lift up thy head; and if thou art seated, by the power of My name, arise; and if thou art standing, in thy yearning for My beauty, take flight; and if thou art in flight, through My sovereign might, ascend; and if thou art in ascent, by the majesty of My Cause, halt in the firmament of the Spirit. Open then thy lips in My name, the Opener. Move then thy tongue in My name, the Mover.

Subject: call to action
Quotation: Why then are ye quenched, why silent, why leaden and dull? Ye must shine forth like the lightning, and raise up a clamouring like unto the great sea. Like a candle must ye shed your light, and even as the soft breezes of God must ye blow across the world. Now is the time to serve, now is the time to be on fire. Know ye the value of this chance, this favourable juncture that is limitless grace, ere it slip from your hands.

Subject: call to action
Quotation: God has ever had and still has one city whose gate is hope, whose walls are hope, whose atmosphere is hope, whose trees are hope, and whose keeper is hope. It allows not entrance to its enemy, despair, nor has despair any access thereto. Therefore should no soul ever despair. God is powerful and able; through the means of education He prepares and makes ready souls for the service of the world and the refinement of nations.

Subject: call to action
Quotation: Hearken unto the call of the Wronged One and convey unto the people that which hath been sent down from the heaven of His bounty and bestowal, that perchance they may cast away what they possess of idle fancies and vain imaginings, and may take fast hold of the cord of God's loving providence... With the hand of power, rend ye asunder the veils, that perchance ye may attain unto the splendors of the light of the Day of God.

Subject: call to action
Quotation: Now is the time therefore, to chant melodies on the Tree of oneness; now is the hour to be renewed in the garment of sanctity. The love of the Ancient Beauty can thrill the nations. The praise of the Most Great Name can attract the tribes and peoples of the world. Silence and immobility at such a time as this shall result in dullness of sense and apathy of heart; the summons to the Kingdom shall be the source of limitless joy.

Subject: call to action
Quotation: O friends and handmaidens of the All-Merciful! The region of Tabriz was ever stirring in all times, and from that land renowned figures spread to other regions...The days of listlessness have passed, the times of obscurity have ended, and the period of inertia has come to a close. The time has come for the fire of the Burning Self to blaze forth, for the promised rose to spring forth, and for the pledged bounty to be manifested.

Subject: call to action
Quotation: O Jamal! That which is needed today is unity and concord. Should this matter be realized, the horizons shall be illumined; otherwise we see it in manifest darkness, profound gloom and great sorrow. This matter is incumbent upon all. With a hundred thousand tongues they must implore and beseech God, exalted be His glory, that He may aid steadfast souls to carry out this command, which is accounted among the most mighty of matters.

Subject: call to action
Quotation: Be thou assured of thy Lord's favor in all conditions and arise to aid His Cause amidst the heavens and the earths. Beware lest the cawing of them who have disbelieved in God should deter thee, or the veils of them who have turned away from the Face after it hath shone forth from the horizon of thy Lord's will with manifest sovereignty should hinder thee. He, verily, aideth him who ariseth to serve His Cause and calleth the people unto Him.

Subject: call to action
Quotation: O Ahmad! Upon thee be the glory of God and His light wherewith the horizons have been illumined. The Cock of Oneness hath crowed upon the branches of the blessed and supreme Lote-Tree. Greatness belongeth unto God, the Lord of the days. Take the Book with power from Me and cast behind thee that which every doubting polytheist uttereth. Say: O people! This is God's Day. Blessed is he who hath cast away and taken what he was commanded in the Book.

Subject: call to action
Quotation: Today souls must hold fast to unity and accord, and conduct themselves with love, fellowship and harmony. Although the True One beareth witness, and the worlds of the seen and unseen testify, that this Wronged One hath, from the earliest days until now, endured tribulations for the elevation of being and the advancement of souls - and this matter is established and proven before all - yet every day the arrows of hatred descend and the swords of the wicked appear.

Subject: call to action
Quotation: Erelong shall God draw forth, out of the bosom of power, the hands of ascendancy and might-hands who will arise to win victory for this Youth and who will purge mankind from the defilement of the outcast and the ungodly. These hands will gird up their loins to champion the Faith of God, and will, in My name the Self-Subsistent, the Mighty, subdue the peoples and kindreds of the earth. They will enter the cities and will inspire with fear the hearts of all their inhabitants.

Subject: call to action
Quotation: You must become such a volcano in that region that the fire of the love of God will send its flames to the Supreme Horizon... Therefore, an effort must be made so that from the plain and desert and mountain and wilderness of that land the cry of "O Glory of the Most Glorious" is raised high... In any case, strive greatly that the friends of Khurasan may surge and roar like the sea and seize the ball of precedence in the field of the love of God with the polo stick of effort.

Subject: call to action
Quotation: O Friends! The time has come to rise from your slumbers, to act with determination, to be alert and wise and not be foolish. This is the century of the blessed Beauty; it is the age of the Most Great Name! A new melody is being chanted, a new song sung, a new tune of joy and radiance warbled by the birds of the rose garden. Appreciate the times in which you live, lose not these opportunities and strive as much as you are able to seize your chance, to hasten and to sacrifice your lives.

Subject: call to action
Quotation: O people of God in Baku! Ye should be engaged in the remembrance and praise of the Beloved of the worlds with utmost joy and fragrance, with delight and assurance. God, exalted be His glory, hath aided you and granted you success in such wise that ye have shattered the idols of vain imaginings with the arm of certitude, and through His grace have rent asunder the veils and clouds, attaining that which the people of the world remain deprived of, even after all their hopes and expectations.

Subject: call to action
Quotation: With a beseeching and suppliant heart, overflowing with attraction to the Most Glorious Kingdom, I humble myself before the Divine Threshold and the Lordly Court, that He may cause you to progress continuously to the highest degrees of success and prosperity, enkindled with the fire of the love of God, engaged in the remembrance of the Lord of the first and the last, striving to acquire human perfection, until you are prepared for service to the Cause of your Lord, the Merciful, the Compassionate.

Subject: call to action
Quotation: Days and nights have passed, yet mention of your names has not appeared before the Throne. Say: Fear God, O companions of Baha, and be not among the silent ones. This is a Day wherein the Tongue of Grandeur has spoken amongst creation and all things have called out. This is a Day the mention of which the Lord of the world and sovereign of nations has sent down in His clear Book. Take it with the hands of power and might, then read it in the nights and days, a command from God, the Ordainer, the Wise.

Subject: call to action
Quotation: Arise thou, by God's leave, to promote My Cause, then gather together My loved ones and remind them of My remembrance, and shelter them beneath the wing of My mercy and the pavilion of My glory and the canopy of My gracious favor. Then give them to drink from the chalices of My bounty, and stir them with the passing of the breezes of My grace and favor, and gather them together in My Cause lest they be disturbed by the clamor of the oppressors and the croaking of the polytheists and the caviling of the deniers.

Subject: call to action
Quotation: I beseech Thee, O Lord of humanity and Master of the mysteries of destiny, by the Luminary of Thy Cause shining forth from the Most Great Horizon, to assist Thy loved ones in that whereby the standards of Thy guidance may be raised amidst Thy creatures and the banners of Thy knowledge among Thy creation. And guard them, O my Hope, beneath the shadow of Thy Most Great Name from the evil of the wicked ones among the nations, and grant them what Thou hast promised them in Thy Book and given them glad tidings of in Thy binding utterance.

Subject: call to action
Quotation: Therefore, in thanksgiving for this bounty and grace, strive to spread abroad His fragrances and drink deep from His refreshing cup. Burn brightly even as a candle and be ablaze like the kindled Fire in the sacred vale. Illumine the horizons so that the Caucasus may become the nest of the immortal Phoenix and the people of Tiflis (Tbilisi) may become the intimate companions of that precious Bird, so that the birds of holiness may sing and chant in its gardens of truth, and the gazelles of unity may stroll in its fields and mountains.

Subject: call to action
Quotation: Make those souls signs of guidance and make that group the dawning-place of inspiration from the Most Glorious Kingdom. Cause them to raise a tumult and ecstasy, to scatter musk and ambergris. Grant them joy and delight, bestow upon them movement and motion, that each one may become a royal falcon soaring to the heights of the greatest bounty and the phoenix of the Qaf of the Abha Kingdom.

Subject: call to action
Quotation: Thus it befits the handmaidens of the All-Merciful in the Eastern realm that each become a shining lamp and a brilliant star... In any case, O handmaiden of God, strive as much as thou canst that the divine maidservants may day by day increase in culture and refinement, and at every moment may scatter musk and ambergris, and from the sweetness of the love of God may pour forth refined sugar, and struggle against self and passion, and raise up such rapture and attraction that those regions may become the dawning-places of the lights of clear signs

Subject: call to action
Quotation: Come forth from the corner of inaction and make for the heights of acceptance. Soar in this Most Glorious atmosphere and enter the garden of God's Cause through your arising to diffuse His holy fragrances and exalt His Word - an arising that will shake the pillars of polytheism and cause the limbs of those veiled from the Lord of Lords to tremble, that will raise high the banners of divine knowledge, unfurl the standards of certitude, cause the flags of explanation to wave, and hoist the sail of life upon the ark of salvation on the sea of contingent being.

Subject: call to action
Quotation: Rest is not possible, sleep is not permissible! Patience in this regard and at such a time will not lead to victory and lethargy will only lead to sloth. The candle must needs be ignited and the moth shall surely burn its wings as it circles round the flame. The nightingale must needs warble its sweet melodies both night and day and the birds of the meadow are filled with wondrous songs. Strive with all your might to kindle the fire of God's love and burn away the veils of vain imaginings; strive to create this new and wondrous song and fan the bright flames of your prayers and divine supplications.

Subject: call to action
Quotation: O my friend! The undying Fire which the Lord of the Kingdom hath kindled in the midst of the holy Tree is burning fiercely in the midmost heart of the world. The conflagration it will provoke will envelop the whole earth. Its blazing flames will illuminate its peoples and kindreds. All the signs have been revealed; every prophetic allusion hath been manifested. Whatever hath been enshrined in all the Scriptures of the past hath been made evident. To doubt or hesitate is no more possible... Time is pressing. The Divine Charger is impatient, and can tarry no longer. We must take the lead and light the luminous lamp.

Subject: call to action
Quotation: Rather, you must travel through the lands and raise a cry and clamor among the servants of God. Draw forth from the scabbard of quietude and be as a brandished sword, gleaming with the confirmation of the Ever-Living, the Self-Subsisting. Speak with an eloquent tongue and powerful utterance in praise of the Lord of the Most Glorious Kingdom and the Primal Point. Call the people to God and give them glad tidings of the appearance of the Most Great Sign. Quicken hearts with the spirit of guidance, perfume souls with the lights of piety, and refresh spirits with a musk-laden breeze wafting from the Most Glorious Paradise.

Subject: call to action
Quotation: O Party of God! Ye are the oppressed ones of the world. The enemies of this blessed party lie in ambush, and the oppressors watch from their outposts. From every direction fly the arrows of rancor, and the swords of hatred are unsheathed. They have had and have no helper save God. They have attained unto the light of His countenance and have scattered the pearls of life at His feet. Some gave up their lives, others their possessions, and some expended all they had. How many days and nights they found no rest from their sorrows. Yet all that hath befallen the party of God, exalted be His glory, is recorded and inscribed by His Most Exalted Pen.

Subject: call to action
Quotation: O beloved of the All-Merciful in the lands! How many nights did the Ancient Beauty turn His face toward you and reveal unto you that which surpasseth in worth all the pearls of the oceans, all the fruits of the trees, all that is treasured in the earth, and all that is stored in mines and mountains! And how many were the days wherein ye attained the traces of My Most Exalted Pen, and its rushing sound was raised in your remembrance in such wise that the dwellers of Paradise and the Most Exalted Heaven gave utterance! Hold ye fast unto the Book of God and His ordinances, and cleave unto that which shall exalt the Cause of your Lord, the Almighty, the All-Bountiful.

Subject: call to action
Quotation: O people! Do ye not behold the Beauty of God, how His light hath encompassed all who are in the kingdom? Do ye not hear the anthems of the birds of eternity upon the branches of the luminous Tree? Do ye not see how He hath lit the lamp of the Spirit in the niche of oneness, whereby the hearts of the sanctified are illumined? How is it that ye have turned away from all this and have inclined unto the company of satans, and have grown heedless of the remembrance of God, and have turned unto those who have disbelieved and turned away and were among the idolaters? Return ye, therefore, unto God with your hearts, then aid His Cause at all times, and be not of the patient ones.

Subject: call to unity; prohibition of disunity
Quotation: The True One hath ever summoned the people to unity and concord.

Subject: call to unity; prohibition of disunity
Quotation: You have no contending thoughts and seek no divergent opinions. You are united and in agreement

Subject: call to unity; prohibition of disunity
Quotation: These causes [of disunity] are racial, patriotic and religious bias or prejudice. This bias will be removed and when it is removed, people will live in friendliness, kindness and love which will bring forth unity.

Subject: call to unity; prohibition of disunity
Quotation: We have commanded and continue to command all the friends to unity and harmony, yet still the fragrance of this most exalted station hath not been detected.

Subject: call to unity; prohibition of disunity
Quotation: God grant that the light of unity may envelope the whole earth, and that the seal, "the Kingdom is God's", may be stamped upon the brow of all its peoples.

Subject: call to unity; prohibition of disunity
Quotation: We beseech God to preserve you and His loved ones from the evil of those who love discord. We ask of the True One that He may assist them to unity and harmony.

Subject: call to unity; prohibition of disunity
Quotation: exert thine utmost in uniting the servants and strive diligently to foster love in their hearts.

Subject: call to unity; prohibition of disunity
Quotation: without cease I have reminded all to unity and forbidden strife and contention.

Subject: call to unity; prohibition of disunity
Quotation: Abandon dissimulation and hold fast unto unity. Thus doth He command you Who possesseth the knowledge of the heavens and the earth. Set right your mutual differences through this Name that ruleth over the worlds.

Subject: call to unity; prohibition of disunity
Quotation: The purpose of bearing these successive tribulations and consecutive trials is that souls firm in their faith in God should walk together in perfect unity, in such wise that all difference, duality and estrangement might be effaced from their midst

Subject: call to unity; prohibition of disunity
Quotation: The people of Baha must be the cause of uniting all the nations. They must dispel inharmony and dispute. If you would all act entirely in accordance with the Teachings of Baha'u'llah no discord would ever appear. Then all disagreements will vanish, and be certain that the pavilion of Unity will be hoisted in the world of man.

Subject: call to unity; prohibition of disunity
Quotation: He gathered the scattered peoples of the world under the shade of the Divine Word and united the conflicting and contending peoples under the pavilion of divine love.

Subject: categories of Prophets (major; minor; village)
Quotation: Prophets are in general of two kinds. Some are independent Prophets Who are followed, while others are not independent and are themselves followers. The independent Prophets are each the Author of a divine religion and the Founder of a new Dispensation. At their advent the world is clothed in a new attire, a new religion is established and a new Book revealed. These Prophets acquire the outpouring grace of the divine Reality without an intermediary. The other kind of Prophets are followers and promulgators, for their station is contingent rather than independent. They acquire divine grace from the independent Prophets and seek the light of guidance from the reality of universal prophethood.

Subject: celestial spheres [aflak]; planets; astronomy
Quotation: But regarding the innumerable stars and the distance between each other, that in this day the astronomers of Europe explain as worlds containing the living spirits, this is pure imagination and not fact.

Subject: celestial spheres [aflak]; planets; astronomy
Quotation: The Persian month is measured against the lunar month. In each month, the second day is the appearance of the moon, since usually on the first day it is hidden...when fourteen is added to two and twelve, it becomes twenty-eight, and these are the lunar mansions that the moon traverses in the course of one month.

Subject: celestial spheres [aflak]; planets; astronomy
Quotation: These brilliant stars are numberless and their existence is not void of wisdom both useful and important... Rather, they are worlds, as this world of ours. But they differ in their bodies, by the difference of elements, from this earthly body. They differ in their formation. The beings existent upon these bodies are according to their formation.

Subject: celestial spheres [aflak]; planets; astronomy
Quotation: You had asked about astronomy. That which relates to mathematics is acceptable, but what the ancient astrologers established and the great influences they attributed to squares and triangles, and what they wrote about planetary conjunctions in positions and motion through the zodiac and the steadfastness of stars and the influence of hours and designation of times, which is found in existing books, consists of the concepts and thoughts of ancestors and lacks a solid foundation. However, some among the ancients through the power of detachment gained knowledge of certain cosmic mysteries and obtained awareness of relationships and connections that exist between created things - they became aware of certain hidden secrets in the realities of things and deduced some future events from the relationships between existing things. This cannot be denied, as mentioned in the epistle of the maternal uncle regarding the brilliant star that indicated the birth of Christ. But the superstitions contained in astrological books are absolutely not to be trusted.

Subject: celestial spheres [aflak]; planets; astronomy
Quotation: You have asked concerning the stars, whether they are void-uninhabited. Know thou that God hath not created all these existent things without a purpose. Every one of these stars is like unto the sphere of earth and with the utmost grandeur are inhabited by living beings. Notwithstanding that this sphere of earth is so small it contains very many different species, then know how much more those great celestial bodies! Existing beings live in each one according to its composition and it is sure that none are void.

Subject: celestial spheres [aflak]; planets; astronomy
Quotation: All the glittering stars are suns, each having its own realm and planets, and the planets of planets which are termed satellites. Mercury and Venus are among the lower planets, while the rest are among the upper planets. That which is of the upper sphere has, in relation to the moon, both direct and retrograde motion, and its orbit is vast; therefore when it passes through the point of the dragon's head it is either northern or southern, unlike the lower planets, whose orbits being visible and smaller, move around the sun more swiftly than the earth. Hence when passing through the dragon's head they remain in their own center.

Subject: celestial spheres [aflak]; planets; astronomy
Quotation: With regard to what you had previously written, that someone among the mathematical scholars had inquired of His Holiness concerning the celestial spheres, planets, their movements and influences - this was presented at the Most Holy Court... during the days in Iraq, a Tablet was revealed from the heaven of God's Will concerning these matters. This servant will present what is remembered from it. Among other things, in that Tablet nineteen planets were mentioned, and He stated that the full account had not yet been given. What was mentioned therein about the heavens and celestial spheres was different from what people commonly describe.

Subject: celestial spheres [aflak]; planets; astronomy
Quotation: You had inquired about astronomy. 'Abdu'l-Baha is so overwhelmed that He has no time to write letters, let alone treatises and books. In brief, the new astronomy is more correct than the old astronomy, for these discoveries are among the fruits of this new age. Some of its principles conform to the verses of the glorious Quran: All swim in their orbits, and We have created above you seven paths, and The sun moves unto a resting-place for it, and similar verses. In the divine Tablets there are references to the correctness of the new astronomy. However, in this new cycle great discoveries will be made, and even the new mathematicians have not yet understood and discovered all mathematical problems, but the unknown matters will soon be discovered.

Subject: celestial spheres [aflak]; planets; astronomy
Quotation: The first query was about the spots on the moon. Know that the first to ask this question was the Prophet Khidr, peace be upon him, when he came to the door of the house of the Messenger of God, peace be upon him and his family, in Medina after His ascension to heaven. He saw that Ali, peace be upon him, was standing by the door with great sorrow visible upon his countenance due to the cessation of revelation and the ascension of the Prophet, peace be upon him and his family. He asked him about these spots on the moon, meaning the change in the appearance of its face. He answered him, may my soul be his sacrifice, with the well-known verse from the Quran. And the spots on this moon of heaven corresponded to the moon of authority. Those possessed of understanding know that what is there cannot be known except by what is here, and these described spots are indeed a station of the answer. It is what God has written by His hands of power on the face of the two moons: "There is no God but God, Muhammad is God's Messenger, Ali is God's Friend." This is the inner path. As for the outer aspects, I ask thee: the face of the moon is a clear mirror, and the spots are reflections of great things above the earth such as seas, mountains, and land masses. Even as the Christians, when they mounted their aerial vessels, had with them a wondrous glass through which they looked at the moon and then observed what was on earth reflected in the moon, even to the trees. Subject: celestial spheres [aflak]; planets; astronomy
Quotation: The end of this infinite expansion they call the supreme heaven, but truly it is beyond description and measure in its loftiness, for this expansion cannot be contained in thought, and this height has no end, since every infinite has a boundless realm of dominion, and every measureless has a sovereign in the measureless cosmos. In this revolution of light, such vision and intelligence have become manifest that the motion, manner, order, elevation, quality and quantity of the celestial spheres, sun, moon and stars have become evident and apparent.

Subject: celestial spheres [aflak]; planets; astronomy
Quotation: When I was very young I was present in a meeting in which people discussed astronomy according to the theories of the old School of Ptolemy. The lecturer told us that the earth is stationary and all the planets revolved around it; that the earth and the planets are like unto seven layers of an onion one over the other. I was made very angry; because I thought I am made a prisoner in one of these spheres. These worlds crowding over each other and their heavy weights pressing over one another! It was as though I was held a prisoner within the circumscribed limit of the earth. I got out of the meeting with a sad heart and for several days no one could change my mood. One day I was reading one of the Tablets of Baha'u'llah in which it was stated that this is "infinite space." Then I was made very happy. I realized that I am no longer a prisoner of the limits of the world.
