Quotation: Woe unto the heedless ones! Beware lest the affairs of the world hold thee back from the Lord of all mankind, or the claws of the polytheists frighten thee - they who have torn apart the sheep and hamstrung the she-camel of God, the Lord of the worlds.

Subject: chastisement and requital
Quotation: Know thou the value of the mention of the Wronged One and preserve this Tablet as thou wouldst thine eye, that it may be protected from the eyes of the treacherous and the ears of the thieves. Countless are the treacherous ones and many are the thieves.

Subject: chastisement and requital
Quotation: O people of hypocrisy! Whither do ye flee? Fear God, O people, and follow not every doubting idolater. Hath vain desire withheld thee from thy Most Glorious Lord, or have names prevented thee from turning toward God, the Creator of earth and heaven?

Subject: chastisement and requital
Quotation: O people! Follow not those who follow their idle fancies and spread corruption in the earth - they are indeed among the heedless. Say: Beware lest ye follow those who claim that which God hath not permitted them. By My life! They are among the most lost.

Subject: chastisement and requital
Quotation: O servants! That garment of sanctity still hangs suspended between earth and heaven, and its holy breezes continue to waft over all regions. Beware lest you be heedless and deprive yourselves of its sweet-scented breeze of divine unity through imaginary veils.

Subject: chastisement and requital
Quotation: The Day hath come, yet the people have turned away from it. He Who was promised in His Books and Scriptures hath appeared, yet most of the people remain asleep. We bear witness that they are recorded among the most lost in the Book of God, the Lord of all worlds.

Subject: chastisement and requital
Quotation: They have cast aside what hath come to them with truth and have taken that which debarreth them from God, the Lord of all worlds. Yet the people remain in manifest darkness, following their desires and turning away from guidance. They are indeed among the most lost!

Subject: chastisement and requital
Quotation: Yet the heedless servants have turned away, denying the Proof of God and rejecting His Divine Testament, perpetrating that which no oppressor of old hath ever perpetrated. The barking ones and the treacherous lie in wait, striving zealously to lead the servants astray.

Subject: chastisement and requital
Quotation: And should you follow anyone besides God, God loveth not that He should make mention of you. Fear ye God, for verily ye are at this moment among the heedless. Say: He is ashamed to make mention of what ye have earned, so how is it that ye are not ashamed of what ye earn?

Subject: chastisement and requital
Quotation: As mentioned, some corruption hath appeared from you, and this is contrary to your station. Most assuredly make amends for this corruption, for today the Truth will not be pleased with you except through recompense for the past. God is witness that great harm hath befallen you.

Subject: chastisement and requital
Quotation: Such was their heedlessness that not a single one of the divines discovered the presence of the Intended One in the loins. They were worshippers of fancy yet counted themselves among the monotheists. Their station on the Day of Reckoning became evident to all in earth and heaven.

Subject: chastisement and requital
Quotation: If you knew what you were earning, you would destroy yourselves with your own hands before learning how you have judged your Lord in a way that no servant would be pleased to judge another servant. Therefore fear God, for this grieves Me, and all else beside Me are created for Me.

Subject: chastisement and requital
Quotation: You should announce this to all the friends and let them see it and become acquainted with it, because people who seek material gains might be tempted to give currency to some unknown picture as that of the Blessed Beauty, and this would of course perturb the minds of the friends.

Subject: chastisement and requital
Quotation: The opposers and deniers are like unto clods of earth - ere long shall the moisture of heedlessness and ignorance scatter and disperse them all. The barking ones and the deniers shall soon return to nothingness, having exchanged the eternal, everlasting dominion for fleeting days.

Subject: chastisement and requital
Quotation: The polytheists have surrounded the believers in the Divine Unity from all directions, and the clouds of tyranny have prevented the Sun of Justice from shedding its radiant beams. The cities and lands of the people of Divine Unity lie in ruins through the tyranny of the polytheists.

Subject: chastisement and requital
Quotation: O concourse of idolaters! Do ye take refuge in the mountain of hatred and hypocrisy that it might protect you from associating partners with God? Say: By God! None can protect anyone today from God's decree and judgment save him who cometh unto Him with a pure and tested heart.

Subject: chastisement and requital
Quotation: The polytheists among you say: The Fire shall not touch us save for numbered days. But when We gather them on the Day of Resurrection around the Fire, they shall witness against themselves that their Lord's punishment was indeed foreordained in the Mother Book from the Gate's presence.

Subject: chastisement and requital
Quotation: Thou hast worshipped God thy Lord throughout thy life and wert among them that prostrate themselves before God. But thy heart's utterance of yea on the Day of Resurrection profiteth thee not. We have rendered thee and thy works as though thou hadst never been among the doers of good works.

Subject: chastisement and requital
Quotation: O Ghadanfar! O Lion! This is the time of the lion and the moment of the fierce beast. A few foxes have begun prowling in the fields and plains, and some hyenas have pursued the sheep of God. Since you are a lion, you must make an attack and show your might and drive away these weak animals

Subject: chastisement and requital
Quotation: Have mercy upon yourselves and fear God, your Lord, the Lord of the heavens and Lord of the earth, the Lord of the worlds. What preventeth you from following Him? Be not veiled by aught, for He is the Truth in which there is no doubt, and all worship Him, and all are helped through His Day.

Subject: chastisement and requital
Quotation: They have cast away My Sealed Wine and turned away from My Self-Subsisting Name, following every doubting learned one who hath denied the meeting with God and His Manifestation and turned away from Him Who hath spoken and speaketh "Verily there is no God but I, the All-Powerful, the Almighty."

Subject: chastisement and requital
Quotation: From their dwellings they visit what they imagine to be things associated with Jesus, yet God hath manifested Muhammad as the Manifestation of His Self, and they neither visit Him nor believe in Him. What they have distorted hath made Muhammad independent of their belief, yet they are not ashamed.

Subject: chastisement and requital
Quotation: We must, in the nights and days, beseech the True One - exalted be His dominion and mighty His proof - to make the people of earth receptive, that they may not be deprived of the special effusions of His days, that they may detach themselves from what they possess and turn to that which is with God.

Subject: chastisement and requital
Quotation: Have they not heard the divine Call? Have they not seen the Balance? Man is bewildered as to what they accept and what they reject, what they believe and what they deny. Woe unto them and unto those who worship idols while perceiving not, and who bow down before vain imaginings while comprehending not.

Subject: chastisement and requital
Quotation: This person observed how the leaders of the people fell through their deviation and were afflicted with the greatest abasement, yet he took no lesson and makes feeble movements. After Christ, persons like Arius appeared who were followed by a million souls, yet later were obliterated and left no trace.

Subject: chastisement and requital
Quotation: Glory be to God! This servant is astonished that some of the friends in the Land of Ta have been observed to be fearful and anxious about new arrests, even though none of them has committed any opposing act, nor has any deed been seen from them that would harm the government or nation, nor will there be.

Subject: chastisement and requital
Quotation: He was caught sleeping by our enemies and they deceived him. He thought after writing and publishing this book all the Persian will honor and respect him and it will elevate his station in the estimation of the public. But none of his expectations became true. Today he is fallen in great disgrace and shame.

Subject: chastisement and requital
Quotation: Beware, thou canst be beaten, abused, chased off and maybe hanged. I wonder if this is appropriate? Is this full of good omen? Is it a brimful cup? I am dumbfounded and bewildered at this, that thou hast afflicted thyself with calamity, subjected thyself to hardship and that thou performest a difficult feat.

Subject: chastisement and requital
Quotation: As for those who turned away from God, then waxed proud against Him and made His verses the object of their mockery - these are they whom their own wretchedness hath overcome. God will not speak to them on the Day of Resurrection, nor will He guide them to the path which God hath extended upon the exalted throne.

Subject: chastisement and requital
Quotation: However, a scheming mouse moves about that settlement, occasionally sending messages seeking to make it desolate and ruined, for it is an ill-omened owl that seeks decrepit ruins rather than prosperous dwellings. And if it enters a flourishing place, it reduces it to demolished, buried and destroyed nonexistence.

Subject: chastisement and requital
Quotation: God hath seized those who rose up in hypocrisy and made them a warning unto them that have eyes to see... Through what was uttered by the tongue of power, servants possessed of mighty strength were raised up who entered upon them with power and sovereignty. Thus was the matter decreed and judgement came from thy Lord

Subject: chastisement and requital
Quotation: God will assuredly blot out all that hath come unto you if ye believe not in Him Whom God shall make manifest, or if ye believe but remain uncertain, or if ye see but fail to uphold the Cause of God, or if ye uphold God's Cause yet fail to manifest before His presence all that behooveth Him from whatsoever is on earth.

Subject: chastisement and requital
Quotation: Inform the people of the regions who are forbearing and the bearers of the Divine Trust not to feel secure from traitors, thieves and liars. As previously this supreme utterance was revealed from the Most Exalted Pen: "Do not feel secure from every arrival, do not believe every speaker, and do not listen to every liar."

Subject: chastisement and requital
Quotation: Know thou that there is no escape for anyone. Whosoever among the eminent men hasteneth to the extended shadow and turneth to the praiseworthy station and cometh under the unfurled standard will become successful and confirmed in all things. Otherwise, he will fall into manifest loss and be overtaken by great abasement.

Subject: chastisement and requital
Quotation: O people, fear ye God! By God, the Truth! Were ye to be truly conscious, ye would sever your own necks with your own hands, or cast yourselves into the waters, or fling your bodies from the mountains, for ye have committed that which hath caused tears to flow from the All-Seeing Eye of God that beholdeth all things.

Subject: chastisement and requital
Quotation: Therefore thou shouldst wish that God had never created thee. Thou didst make thyself a divine in Islam to save one of the believers, yet thou didst cause those who followed thee to enter the fire, since thou wert veiled from the verses of God at the time of their appearance while deeming thyself among the God-fearing ones.

Subject: chastisement and requital
Quotation: Beware lest thou turn unto those who have disbelieved after having believed, and when the verses of the Spirit are recited unto them in My most sweet accent their faces darken and they return to the abode of wrath, the depths of the fire. They read the verses yet deny their Revealer. Thus have We recorded their deed in a clear Book.

Subject: chastisement and requital
Quotation: By God the Truth, it is boiling water and putrid, stagnant water which springs from the depths of hell. Whoever drinks from it, their entrails will be torn apart from the severity of the torment. But they are in deep slumber and great intoxication. Soon they shall awaken and see that their shade is black smoke and their water is boiling.

Subject: chastisement and requital
Quotation: The Book of God hath been sent down in truth - therefore die, O concourse of polytheists! The Tablet of God hath appeared with justice - therefore be ye distinguished, O people of envy! This verily is a mighty conquest. This is the Immortal Scroll which hath come with grace, and this is God's vengeance upon you, O assemblage of the malevolent!

Subject: chastisement and requital
Quotation: Without the favors of God and His chosen ones, though one be a king, his pages are but blackened. O Salman! Impress upon the loved ones of God that they should not view anyone's words with the eye of objection, but rather observe with an eye of mercy and compassion - except for those souls who in this day write inflammatory tablets in rejection of God.

Subject: chastisement and requital
Quotation: O all things! From the beginning that hath no beginning until this moment have We nurtured you in every Dispensation that ye might be saved in the subsequent Revelation. Yet ye showed no shame and perceived not what We intended for you, but followed your own desires in that which profiteth you not, and on the Day of Resurrection ye shall enter the Fire.

Subject: chastisement and requital
Quotation: Never could truth be confused with aught else, if ye would but reflect on His proof. Falsehood cannot be confused with truth, if ye would but reflect on the proof of truth. How many servants in Islam have claimed false causes which ye followed, even after witnessing proof! What then shall be your excuse before your Lord, if ye would but briefly reflect?

Subject: chastisement and requital
Quotation: Until the Day of Resurrection, man will repeatedly ask: What profit did Nimrod gain, and what benefit did Pharaoh reap? Have they not heard the tale of Abu Sufyan, or learned of the oppression of Caiaphas who was the Jewish judge, and likewise of Pilate who was the governor of that place? Which oppressor ever benefited from his deeds or gained any profit?

Subject: chastisement and requital
Quotation: And if God should manifest a sign like unto the rod of Moses, then all would believe. Say: God hath revealed greater than that, yet they remember not, nor do they know. Were not the verses of the Qur'an greater than the nine signs of Moses and all the signs of Jesus, how then did God abrogate their religions and establish the true religion in the Qur'an?

Subject: chastisement and requital
Quotation: Verily God will abase those who believe not in Him Whom God shall make manifest through what hath been revealed in the Book, for they believe not in God. This is more severe than any fire, if ye be of them who are affected thereby. Therefore watch ye lest any soul be abased by God before Him Whom God shall make manifest while ye hear but are not affected.

Subject: chastisement and requital
Quotation: Soon shall the fire and its rocks encompass them in the valley of Hell by leave of God, the Exalted, and nigh. This is your recompense from God for having been hypocrites in God's true religion, and God is witness over what ye do. O people! Hath not the news come to you of those before you? And I warned you of the severe chastisement of the Merciful in very truth.

Subject: chastisement and requital
Quotation: Where are they who turned away from God, who warred against His sovereignty, who disputed His signs and denied His proof? We seized them unawares. We shall soon seize those who have oppressed today and who have risen in opposition - a promise from Us, for We have power over what We say. Neither their souls, nor their wealth, nor their traces shall remain on earth.

Subject: chastisement and requital
Quotation: Wake up from your slumber, O friends of God! Verily, We informed you beforehand that the leaflets of doubts would be circulated in all directions, and the convulsions of uncertainty would seize those who shun the truth. The limbs of the feeble ones shall be seized with fear and trembling, except for those who cling to the unbreakable Cord and tread the straight path.

Subject: chastisement and requital
Quotation: The smoke of pride and vainglory has deprived the world of this greatest bounty, and the recompense for the deeds of the people of unity has become the cause of the exaltation of the word of polytheism, nay rather, the cause of its dominance and victory, as can be witnessed today: the people of unity are subjugated and oppressed under the hands of the people of polytheism.

Subject: chastisement and requital
Quotation: These are they whom their own selves curse, then their beings, then their realities, yet they perceive it not. Their inner selves speak with their secret tongue, addressing them thus: O concourse of hatred! Did ye not believe in Ali when God's verses were sent down unto him? Why then, when they were sent down again, did ye turn away and become a most wretched and lost people?

Subject: chastisement and requital
Quotation: From every direction the idolaters have risen to extinguish the Muhammadan light and Ahmadic character. The tempests of polytheism and the storms of infidelity have nearly extinguished the light of divine unity. O people of the world! Arise and with perfect humility, submission and lowliness beseech the Self-Sufficient Lord for assistance, that perchance something may remain.

Subject: chastisement and requital
Quotation: When thou hast recognized God as thy Lord, thou hast judged Him by that which no soul would be content to judge another, wherefore will thy Lord cause thee to enter the fire with those who enter therein. Thou hast imagined thyself to be among the diligent ones. Nay, nay! The measure of thy faith is less than that of him who confronted Moses when he brought forth something of sorcery.

Subject: chastisement and requital
Quotation: How many are the signs which they pass by, yet turn away from them in aversion! How base have these times become that clay is taken for pearl, and darkness is set in the place of light. We observe souls who have not attained to a single letter of the Book's knowledge, nor fathomed a single mystery of divine wisdom, yet today they are the leaders of the people and guides of the servants.

Subject: chastisement and requital
Quotation: Lament with the lamentation of one who has lost all, for this Bird dwelt among you for successive years, yet you failed to attain His presence, though His presence would have profited you more than all your deeds throughout your days. God is sufficient witness to what I say. You remained heedless of Him and occupied yourself with words whereof no Messenger had ever uttered a single letter.

Subject: chastisement and requital
Quotation: If thou rejoicest in what thou concealest, woe betide thee from the torment of a near day. God hath not made it lawful for anyone to judge without justice, and if thou desirest, thou shalt soon know. From the first day when I warned thee not to exalt thyself against God until this day, four years have elapsed, and I have seen naught from thee and thy soldiers save injustice and grievous pride.

Subject: chastisement and requital
Quotation: O people! Fear God and believe in Him and differ not concerning His Cause, and be not of the mischief-makers. Follow the command of God and migrate unto Him with your hearts, and when ye hear the verses of the Spirit, fall down in prostration before them, and follow not those who have cast the Book of God behind their backs as though they had never heard it, and who walk in the valley of polytheism.

Subject: chastisement and requital
Quotation: When thou didst hear of the Manifestation of God, hadst thou said yea, it would have been better for thee than all that thou hadst worshipped God throughout thy life, and thou wouldst have been among the sincere ones. But when thou didst hear and turn away, the proof of thy Lord was completed against thee, for thou didst not follow the Truth nor wert thou among them that were certain of the signs of God.

Subject: chastisement and requital
Quotation: O heedless doubter! We desired your presence in Iraq and left the choice to you to appear in whatever place you wished, that We might show you the proof. You accepted, but when the appointed time came, the winds blew and you fled, O fly! Soon shall death come upon you and you shall see the punishment of your Lord, O you who have turned away from Him by Whom the promise was fulfilled and the Herald has called aloud.

Subject: chastisement and requital
Quotation: O people of vain desire! Did you imagine you could rest at ease in your seats, occupied with carnal delights and bodily pleasures, and by your own fancy comprehend the subtleties of this Revelation without being tested? Have you not read this noble verse which God, the Most Exalted, revealed through His Beloved: Do men think that they will be left alone on saying, 'We believe,' and that they will not be tested?

Subject: chastisement and requital
Quotation: Although in all Tablets We commanded all to wisdom and counseled trustworthiness, religiosity, truthfulness and sincerity, from the friends appeared deeds which We do not wish to mention. In any case, the actions and behavior of some cut off the breezes of love and trust of the people of that land, and finally they wrote that which caused most of the people to turn away. Fame for virtue was transformed to notoriety.

Subject: chastisement and requital
Quotation: O people! Commit not acts of mischief and indecency, and follow not every doubting polytheist. Beware lest ye backbite one another. This hath been forbidden in the Tablets. Fear ye the All-Merciful, and be not of those who spread corruption. Enter not a house except with permission, betray not the trust of others in their possessions, and lean not towards them that have acted unjustly, for this indeed is a grievous error.

Subject: chastisement and requital
Quotation: Take heed of souls who plunge into seas of vain imaginings and wish to deceive and beguile the common folk with confused dreams. They abandon the attained rose and dispense with proffered support, desiring the fruit of Zaqqum and avoiding the blessed tree with low-hanging clusters and extended spathes. Destruction and remoteness be upon them for this manifest loss, great deprivation, severe abasement, and abject poverty without end.

Subject: chastisement and requital
Quotation: When someone from among the friends wishes to discuss political matters in his home or in other gatherings, it would be better for him to first sever his connection with this Cause, so that all may know he has no association with it and acts independently. Otherwise, in the end it will result in general harm--that is, it will disrupt our spiritual path and engage the friends in utterances that lead to their abasement and deprivation.

Subject: chastisement and requital
Quotation: After your letter arrived - may God reward you with the most wondrous reward for mentioning Him Who was in the hands of the enemies in all days until He was imprisoned in this prison - and if you inquire about conditions, I swear by the Pre-existent King that they are beyond description. However, this much was known to you, that all which this servant strove for over successive years to exalt the Cause of God was scattered to the winds.

Subject: chastisement and requital
Quotation: And when God sealed Prophethood with His Beloved, He promised His servants that they would meet Him on the Day of Resurrection, as ye read in the Book, insomuch that We have not recorded in the Book any matter greater than this. Therefore hath God seized them for their sin and veiled them from His beauty on the day of meeting Him and debarred them from mercy and concealed from them the mysteries deposited within their souls while they perceive not.

Subject: chastisement and requital
Quotation: O Zayn, reflect on the grace, loving-kindness, compassion and forbearance of the Truth, and on the wretchedness and cruelty of the heedless souls. All are certain that all souls are forbidden from corruption, conflict and contention by command, yet every day the oppression of the transgressors becomes manifest. O Zayn, the sun of justice is hidden behind clouds of oppression, and the birds of the divine throne are afflicted among the beasts of earth.

Subject: chastisement and requital
Quotation: During thy return journey, in whatever land thou didst arrive, if thou didst find anyone celebrating the remembrance of God, convey to them greetings from this wronged prisoner. Tell them of the tribulations that have befallen Us, that perchance they may not commit that which is forbidden in the Tablets. Say: O friends! Corruption hath ever been forbidden and rejected by God, yet most people soar in the atmosphere of self and walk in the land of wickedness.

Subject: chastisement and requital
Quotation: They claim justice while doing that which causes the dwellers of Paradise to lament in their most exalted station. They rejoice in the ornaments that have accumulated in their possession. Say: Soon will the fire come between you and these things, as testified by Him through Whom the tongue of dawn spoke and by Whom the horizons were illumined. They rejoice in the world and its prosperity, but soon they shall lament with a grief that pens are powerless to describe.

Subject: chastisement and requital
Quotation: And whoso denieth Our verses and departeth not from his house as an emigrant unto the Land of Remembrance - We shall reveal his decree in the Book even as was revealed concerning Abu Lahab in the Qur'an. Those have indeed disbelieved who followed after [several words missing in the original manuscript] the decree of the false one and the companions of the Fire, and these are they who in God's Book are the unbelievers, and these are they who are the leaders of the Fire.

Subject: chastisement and requital
Quotation: O brother! For twelve hundred years and more, such souls were engaged in opposition, disputation and strife. During their debates, they would beat their heads against each other like elephants with their trunks, denying one another, nay, cursing and reviling each other from every faction to another. Yet on the Day of Testing, they all found themselves among the people of hell-fire, and neither their beliefs nor their deeds were of any avail, nor did they yield any fruit.

Subject: chastisement and requital
Quotation: Do not deal so harshly with our people and do not let our Persian pilgrims who serve the Holy Shrine and the Most Exalted Shrine become disheartened. These rooms you possess are dependent on 'Adasiyyih and were part of it from the beginning. Show consideration regarding these and give them to them. There are many rooms in Sarsaq, all in your possession. If you wish to write lengthy excuses, it will only cause me more grief. Do not be satisfied with my sorrow and do not grieve me.

Subject: chastisement and requital
Quotation: O beloved of my heart! Observe thou the heedlessness and unconsciousness of the people. They have turned away from the Sun of the Divine Word and have turned unto unworthy vanities. Every person of fairness beareth witness to the loftiness and excellence of these decisive words and firm verses which, like brilliant suns, have dawned and shine forth from the horizon of the heaven of divine knowledge. Yet the deniers of the Revelation are seen to be heedless and turned away therefrom.

Subject: chastisement and requital
Quotation: Especially as the present governor in Damascus is a harmful person of evil nature who may cause trouble and secretly write something to Istanbul. Despite all this, it depends on your wish - whatever you deem advisable is acceptable and beloved to this servant. What has been written are matters that come to mind. However, if you have great desire and wish to go, you must absolutely maintain complete silence and not speak a word except about calligraphy, even if someone should question you.

Subject: chastisement and requital
Quotation: The religion of God has become weak among the people due to the dominion of the polytheists, and these transgressors have been and are of two kinds: one group consists of those who have been nurtured in pride for years, and the other group consists of those who have become occupied with themselves and heedless of the Truth, showing no respect for divine ordinances and the counsels of the True Counselor. They have acted according to their own desires and become deprived of the Command of God.

Subject: chastisement and requital
Quotation: Woe unto them and unto those who follow them! For the sake of this base and transient world they have forsaken the eternal realms of God. And strange it is that, despite such deeds and actions, they count themselves among the faithful. By the life of God! The Apostle lamenteth their actions and the Holy Maiden weepeth at that which their hands have wrought. They slay the sons of the Apostle while praying unto Him and weep for those martyred in former times. We testify that they are among the losers.

Subject: chastisement and requital
Quotation: By My glory! I shall surely punish thee with the punishment of all the worlds. For had thou followed the Truth on the first day, none upon that earth would have perished. And verily He is the All-Knowing, the Inaccessible, the August. By My glory, I shall assuredly chastise thee with the chastisement of all the worlds. For hadst thou followed the Truth on the first day, none would have perished in that land, and all the veils that have screened the veiled ones - their chastisement returneth unto thee.

Subject: chastisement and requital
Quotation: They have cast the ocean of knowledge behind their backs, turning instead to every remote ignorant one. They hear the verses of God, then deny them; they behold the proof of God, yet turn away from it. The evidence hath appeared and the bounty hath been perfected, yet most of the people know not. They deny that which God hath acknowledged, and acknowledge that which the Self-Subsisting, the Guardian hath denied. The punishment of wrath hath seized them such that they perceive not the breaths of revelation.

Subject: chastisement and requital
Quotation: Glory be unto Thee, O God! Chastise him with a severe chastisement and seize him with a swift seizure. Question him concerning all from which he was veiled in Islam, for verily Thou art knowing of all things. Show him the recompense of what he hath wrought as befits Thy justice, for Thou art powerful over all things. Cause him to be forgotten and cast him into the fire with those who enter therein. This is in measure with what he earned in the Qur'an by transgressing God's bounds, being among those who are far removed.

Subject: chastisement and requital
Quotation: O My loved ones! Beware lest the clamor and opposition of those who have denied God's Manifestation and His sovereignty and who have uttered that which caused the angels and the Spirit to lament, and those who appeared before the Face and heard the Call and attained unto what was inscribed by the Supreme Pen in the books of the Prophets and Messengers, make you sorrowful. Say: Beware lest you waste your stations or deprive yourselves of what has been ordained for you in the Most Exalted Paradise by God, the Lord of the worlds.

Subject: chastisement and requital
Quotation: O concourse of princes! Be fair in the cause of God, then consider how God sent His Messengers aforetime and what befell them from those who denied the Book and followed every heedless and remote one. Say: Be fair! By God, the Mother Book speaketh with truth, if ye be of those who know, and the Tongue of God proclaimeth with grace between the heavens and the earth, if ye be of those who hear. Say: The power of the mighty shall not withhold Him, and through Him He speaketh before all faces as commanded by the Ordainer, the All-Wise.

Subject: chastisement and requital
Quotation: In days when the edifice of existence was shaken and the foundation of the world was made to tremble through the onslaught of the oppressors, this Wronged One arose alone to promote the Cause - an arising that no sitting could overtake and which was not prevented by the clamor of the polytheists and hypocrites. He guided the people of creation to the supreme horizon with the most great call. Now that the rays of the sun of revelation have somewhat appeared, from every corner a croaking is heard, a viper becomes manifest, and barking is raised.

Subject: chastisement and requital
Quotation: Now then, know, O thou who disbelievest in God and associateth partners with His signs and turneth away from His presence and showeth pride against His gate, that God - exalted be His mention - nothing escapeth His knowledge and nothing is beyond His power. He hath not granted thee respite in thy stations nor has He been heedless of judging thine actions. By Him Who holdeth my soul in His hand, thy heedlessness of My remembrance and thy disobedience to My judgment and thy turning away from My countenance is more severe for thee than the fire of hell.

Subject: chastisement and requital
Quotation: If our purpose - that is, the purpose of humanity - be merely these outward means of the world and its ornaments and embellishments, then by the life of our Purpose and your Purpose, we are all in manifest loss, for ere long extinction shall seize it and make it as naught. None denieth this save every heedless and remote one. Wonder of wonders that despite all being aware of what hath been mentioned, they nevertheless remain deprived of His love through attachment to these things, and through preoccupation therewith are forbidden from His infinite bounties.

Subject: chastisement and requital
Quotation: By the life of God, the deeds of those who have cast godliness behind their backs, clinging to tyranny and wickedness while attributing themselves to the Dayspring of sanctity and holiness, have grieved Me. By this the Pen of God hath lamented in the most exalted station. We have revealed in the Tablets that which draweth the servants nigh unto the Mighty, the All-Bestowing. Among them are those who claimed My love and entry into the stronghold of My grace, yet committed that which caused My heart and My Pen to lament, and the eye of My inner being to weep in the nights and days.

Subject: chastisement and requital
Quotation: O thou who art heedless of God and who turneth to self and passion: When thou didst enter the House of God, out of pure kindness and mercy, whatever was in the house was graciously presented to thee that thou mightest be gladdened and rejoice in the divine favors. This pure kindness and generosity thou hast repaid with rancor and hatred. By God, besides Whom there is none other God! Most days until nearly sunset there was nothing in the sanctuary to be consumed, and what few sweetmeats some of the friends would send were specially preserved for visitors, that each soul who arrived might partake of divine bounties.

Subject: chastisement and requital
Quotation: O concourse of the earth! Do ye not behold those who preceded you, who transgressed in the Cause of God and were among the transgressors? And now no trace of them remaineth on earth, for their edifice hath been ruined and their pillars have been demolished, and they are among the perished ones. They turned not unto God in their first life and were heedless of the remembrance of their Creator, and were among the corrupt ones. Now nothing shall profit them, and God hath seized them for their words and deeds, and in the fire they cry out. None shall answer them, and God shall punish them at every moment with a grievous punishment.

Subject: chastisement and requital
Quotation: Fear ye God and dispute not concerning the Cause of God, worship none but Him, and spread not corruption in the land of divine knowledge. Know ye that whosoever spreadeth corruption in this good and blessed land, upon him be the curse of God; whosoever raiseth his hands without God's good pleasure or without permission from His presence, upon him be the curse of God; whosoever moveth his feet without obedience to God, he is deprived of God's mercy; whosoever taketh his hands from his pockets and followeth his desires, casting the Cause of God behind his back, he is excluded from God's shadow even should he dwell in the precincts of God's sanctuary.

Subject: chastisement and requital
Quotation: Some souls are observed whose grief hath been and continueth to be the cause of God's grief, exalted be His glory, and likewise their joy the cause of His joy... Were it not for a decree that hath gone forth from Us, We would have shown the heedless and the oppressors which of us is more exalted and powerful. In this Most Great Revelation, ye have observed how many enemies He seized with mighty power; yet none became aware, all being intoxicated with the wine of heedlessness and far removed from the court of divine mercy. However, the world is pregnant with oppression. Soon shall the oppressors behold what they have wrought in the days of God, the Self-Subsisting, the All-Compelling.

Subject: chastisement and requital
Quotation: I swear by Him Who hath fashioned Me from the light of His own Beauty! None have I ever seen that surpasseth you in heedlessness or exceedeth you in blindness. Ye seek to prove your faith in God through such holy Tablets as ye possess, yet when the verses of God were revealed and His Lamp was lighted, ye disbelieved in Him Whose very Pen hath fixed the destinies of all things in the Preserved Tablet. Ye recite the sacred verses and yet repudiate Him Who is their Source and Revealer. Thus hath God blinded your eyes in requital for your deeds, would ye but understand. Day and night ye transcribe the verses of God, and yet ye remain shut out, as by a veil, from Him Who hath revealed them.

Subject: chastisement and requital
Quotation: The days shall come when ye will lament within yourselves and your souls will be filled with remorse. By God! Evil regrets have encompassed you because of what your hands have wrought, and because ye remained veiled from the presence of God in His Day, after the Sun of Spirit had dawned from the daybreak of eternity while ye remained occupied with the ornaments of this world at all times. Woe unto you for what ye have neglected on the day when the Dove warbled upon the twigs of the beloved glory, when the Fire of God was kindled and proclaimed at every moment that He is God, the Supreme, the Mighty, the Praised One - yet ye remained heedless of all this and were veiled by God's Messengers after they came to you with clear proofs and scriptures which all in the heavens are powerless to comprehend.

Subject: chastisement and requital
Quotation: For on that Day, from none will any ransom be accepted, as the judgment of your Lord then, shall not admit the plea from neither a guardian nor from a helper.

Subject: chastisement and requital
Quotation: God shall seize with a mighty seizing, and hath already seized with a severe seizing, whosoever - whether male or female - desireth not to enter into this Faith.

Subject: chastisement and requital
Quotation: Praised be to He Who hath punished the veiled ones in the blazing fire! Praised be to He Who hath made the doubters to taste of the putrefaction of error and sin and blindness!

Subject: chastisement and requital
Quotation: My love is the sword of the Almighty that separateth the righteous from the wicked, and by it are the hearts of the free made cool while the souls of the infidels are set ablaze

Subject: chastisement and requital
Quotation: See how in the Land of Sad that malignant monster who was the cause and instigator of the martyrdom of the Twin Shining Lights was overtaken by the direst torment, to the degree that all the members of his household shunned him.

Subject: chastisement and requital
Quotation: And when I witness Thy vengeance upon the idolaters, the pillars of my heart tremble, my heart's flesh is troubled within me, my skin doth creep, tears flow from mine eyes, and my inner being crieth out: How can I enter the fire and how can I endure therein?

Subject: chastisement and requital
Quotation: Thus doth God torment the idolaters in the fire of remoteness and raise up the monotheists to the holy and exalted court. And thou, despair not of God's grace and grieve not over what the oppressors do in numbered days. Soon shall their souls and deeds perish and they shall enter a fire kindled by God's wrath.

Subject: chastisement and requital
Quotation: The murderer, therefore, is submerged in the abyss of vices, and surely he will be subjected to the proper retribution in the transferences mentioned in the lecture, which transferences are numerous, appearing in endless forms and images. Another spirit may be dark, satanic, animalistic. These qualities in themselves are its retribution and punishment.

Subject: chastisement and requital
Quotation: As for those who have waxed proud against me and denied what God hath graciously bestowed upon me of clear signs and a manifest Book - these are they against whom the word of torment hath been fulfilled, and they shall find no protector or helper on the Day of Separation. By Him Who createth all things and unto Whom all shall return: no soul that dieth in enmity toward me or that denieth what I have brought of clear signs but shall enter into grievous torment.

Subject: chastisement and requital
Quotation: By the life of God! Not an atom's weight of the deeds of the idolaters shall escape thy Lord, the Mighty, the Ancient.

Subject: chastisement and requital
Quotation: No indeed, by God's Justice! None will be punished for another's deeds, nor will any be chastised for another's transgressions.

Subject: chastisement and requital
Quotation: He desires to raise you from your resting places, and bestow His favor upon you, and recompense you for what you have done in His religion before this.

Subject: chastisement and requital
Quotation: Await the mighty results of these glorious services. Ere long thou shalt observe how that lamp hath become a brilliant light and that ember a divine fire.

Subject: chastisement and requital
Quotation: The day is approaching when the wrathful anger of the Almighty will have taken hold of them... and shall give it for an heritage unto such of His servants as are nigh unto Him.

Subject: chastisement and requital
Quotation: God hath promised them a goodly reward and will surely cause them to enter an abode of truth from His presence. These are they who shall receive their sustenance in Paradise from their Lord

Subject: chastisement and requital
Quotation: The near ones have attained, and the sinners have been enraged. As for the companions of the right hand, their faces beamed with joy...But as for the companions of the left hand, their skin shuddered...

Subject: chastisement and requital
Quotation: Those who have disbelieved in God and His signs - these are they who are the losers... These people drink naught but the boiling water of hell... He is most severe in punishing the oppressors and most stern in retribution.

Subject: chastisement and requital
Quotation: Yet observe now how these two glorious beings shine resplendent from the horizon of power, while the obstinate Jews and Yazid are abased, defeated, despised, rejected, scorned, and suffer the most severe torment and veiling.

Subject: chastisement and requital
Quotation: We give to drink unto the sincere ones, at all times, the water of life, and unto the polytheists from water that is like molten brass...Soon shall the breaths of chastisement pass over them from the presence of One mighty and powerful.

Subject: chastisement and requital
Quotation: God shall recompense those who present themselves before God and those who present themselves before the Letters of Truth with better than what their hands have wrought, when they shall, on the Day of Resurrection, be certain of His signs.

Subject: chastisement and requital
Quotation: We shall gather them on the Day of Resurrection with heads bowed before their Lord, and these shall be brought to the Fire. Whoever believes, it is for his own soul, and whoever turns away, it is against it, and God thy Lord is independent of the worlds.

Subject: chastisement and requital
Quotation: Reward is of two kinds: specific - that is the recompense of specific deeds like tyranny and transgression, "No soul shall bear another's burden" and "No bearer of burden shall bear the burden of another" - and universal, like someone who afflicts themselves with a contagious disease.

Subject: chastisement and requital
Quotation: Verily thy God assigneth the measure of all created things as He willeth, by virtue of His behest; and those who conform to the good-pleasure of your Lord, they are indeed among the blissful... Indeed, those who have disbelieved shall suffer the punishment of divine justice from thy Lord

Subject: chastisement and requital
Quotation: But the oppressor, as it says in the Qur'an, will receive eternal punishment and the torture of fire [2:201] "Save us, O God from the torment of the Fire." In time it shall be seen how the oppressed one shall be raised to honor and the oppressor will be reduced to eternal loss and affliction.

Subject: chastisement and requital
Quotation: By God! Whoso attaineth unto this testimony, God shall raise him up on the Day of Resurrection with a mighty sovereignty and shall make him to sit with the Prophets and Messengers, and shall send down upon him at every moment a mercy that no created thing between the heavens and the earths can equal

Subject: chastisement and requital
Quotation: All faces have turned black except those to whom the God of Mercy hath vouchsafed a radiant heart. Drunken are the eyes of those men that have openly refused to behold the face of God, the All-Glorious, the All-Praised. Paradise is on your right hand, and hath been brought nigh unto you, while Hell hath been made to blaze. Witness its devouring flame.

Subject: chastisement and requital
Quotation: The believers are they who circle round about Me - these have degrees from God and these are the successful ones. God will reward them with gardens of eternity for what they have earned, and they shall attain the mercy of their Lord... And God will cause them [the polytheists] to enter the fire in their life and their death, and they shall not be helped.

Subject: chastisement and requital
Quotation: As these qualities are instinctive and not voluntary, animals will not be rewarded. Their benefits are confined to this word only. A rich man gives a bounty to a poor man. Should the rich man also give him a reward because he has received bounty? It is the same with the animals. Their qualities are bestowed by God. Shall He give them reward for this Bounty?

Subject: chastisement and requital
Quotation: Those souls who have been kind and merciful, who have promoted peace and good-fellowship...shall attain to the good-pleasure of the Lord...Those souls who have not acted according to the Commands of the Lord, who have been instrumental in sowing the seeds of discord and mistrust amongst their fellowmen...will remain in a state of ignorance, heedlessness, inadvertence and deprivation

Subject: chastisement and requital
Quotation: And those who perform righteous deeds before Our Remembrance, God shall soon give them from His bounty manifold and thousandfold increase, for God is powerful over all things... Verily those who earn sin through falsehood after the truth hath come to them from God, the Exalted, the Powerful - We shall soon cause them to enter a great Fire in the Day of Resurrection, upon the heat of fire with fire.

Subject: chastisement and requital
Quotation: Know that there are two kinds of torment: subtle and palpable. For example, ignorance is itself a torment, but it is a subtle torment; indifference to God is itself a torment; falsehood is itself a torment; iniquity and treachery are torments. Indeed all the human imperfections are torments, but they are subtle torments...The other kind of torment is palpable and consists in physical punishments such as imprisonment, beating, expulsion and banishment.

Subject: chastisement and requital
Quotation: On that Day, the faces of the believers shall be humble before the Most Great Remembrance, and abasement shall cover them in their standing, but God is ever merciful to the believers. And on that Day, the faces of the polytheists shall be in veils of fire, hidden around the fire. God has ordained no food for them save from a boiling spring that neither nourishes nor avails them aught, and God has prepared for them a painful chastisement in justice upon the truth.

Subject: chastisement and requital
Quotation: The people of the left hand sigh and bemoan. The people of the right abide in noble habitations: they quaff the Wine that is life indeed, from the hands of the All-Merciful, and are, verily, the blissful. They drink of the tainted water, and know it not. Some have made haste to attain the court of the God of Mercy, others have fallen down on their faces in the fire of Hell, while still others are lost in bewilderment. They hasten forward to Hell Fire, and mistake it for light.

Subject: chastisement and requital
Quotation: God hath prohibited in the Bayan that anyone should judge another when he knoweth not the beginning and end of the matter, lest his judgment fall upon God his Lord while he deemeth himself among the righteous. O people of the Bayan! Should any servants inform you of one who hath claimed a Cause or revealed verses whose outward appearance befitteth none but God, the Guardian, the Self-Subsisting, pass no judgment upon him ever, lest ye pass judgment upon Him Whom God shall make manifest while ye know not.

Subject: chastisement and requital
Quotation: As for Thy loved ones, Thou shalt assuredly admit them into Thy paradise and grant them in their lives whatsoever befitteth the sublimity of Thy holiness and glory, for that which Thou hast promised unto those who glorify Thee after their death is better than what Thou hast ordained for the living during their lives, and what Thou hast ordained for the living in their lives is better than what Thou hast ordained for those who know Thee not and seek not Thy good-pleasure. For should such a one rejoice for a day, Thou wilt torment him in the eternal realm after his death in Thy fire, and should this one be sorrowful for a day, Thou wilt gladden him eternally in Thy paradise.

Subject: chastity and purity
Quotation: Once when I was passing over Mount Carmel, I saw one of them [the nuns] ascending with such a state of supplication and humility, and had such a murmur that was very touching. I was very pleased and stood listening. Truly purity and cleanliness has a strange effect.

Subject: chastity and purity
Quotation: Any soul from whom signs of wickedness and lust become manifest, such a one is not and has never been of the Truth

Subject: chastity and purity
Quotation: Marriage is the greatest fortress for the preservation of man's purity. It shall protect him from immoral deeds. It will be the means of his chastity and sanctity. In the estimation of God there are no greater attributes than chastity and sanctity. The Most wonderful Bestowal of God is sanctity. These two qualities are specialized in man. Their absence means animalism and the ascendency of brute passions.

Subject: chastity and purity
Quotation: The people of Baha must be manifestations of the greatest chastity and supreme virtue. In the divine texts it is written, and the meaning of the verse in Persian is that even if the most beautiful women were to pass before them, their gaze would never turn in that direction. The meaning is that purity and sanctity are among the greatest characteristics of the people of Baha. The assured and tranquil believing women must become renowned throughout all regions for their complete purity, sanctity, chastity, virtue, modesty, veiling, and bashfulness, so that all may testify to their purity, cleanliness, and virtuous qualities.  For one speck of chastity is greater than a hundred thousand years of worship and a sea of knowledge.

Subject: chastity and purity
Quotation: The greatest adornment for handmaidens hath ever been and shall ever be chastity and virtue. By God! The light of chastity illumineth the horizons of the worlds of meaning, and its fragrance reacheth unto the Most Exalted Paradise.

Subject: civil courts
Quotation: You had written that the government has ordered a court hearing to establish the truth, so that through trial the oppressor may be distinguished from the oppressed... In any case, the hearing will be fruitless - do not trouble yourselves.

Subject: cleanliness and refinement
Quotation: To bathe oneself is a great bounty. Near the army barracks in 'Akka there existed a public bath which was in a state of ruin. For the sake of the Blessed Beauty, I had it repaired. But after leaving the barracks, the simple matter of bathing became increasingly difficult for the Blessed Beauty until I borrowed a sum of money and repaired the bath in the House of 'Abbud. The water could be warmed up in half an hour, and the convenience of the bath brought great joy to the Blessed Beauty.

Subject: cleanliness and refinement
Quotation: Even though some things are earth-bound, they have great effect on the soul, such as cleanliness or a good voice. Voice is no more than airwaves that reach one's ear and cause the vibration of the eardrums. Yet, consider its profound effect on the spirit. Similarly, cleanliness effects the soul.

Subject: cleanliness and refinement
Quotation: Therefore purify what ye wear with water as soon as ye are able, that ye may find the mercy of your Lord within yourselves and then be thankful.

Subject: cleanliness and refinement
Quotation: The seminal fluid which is the substance of human existence was considered by the Shi'ih divines as unclean filth, but this was not so in the law of the Prophet [Muhammad].

Subject: cleanliness and refinement
Quotation: you should keep your bodies, your clothing, your possessions, your effects, your food and your drink as clean as you are able.

Subject: cleanliness and refinement
Quotation: Even though cleanliness is related to worldly affairs, yet its effect is manifested in the soul. Now the Cause of God is not established, but when it is, you will see that cleanliness and refinement is one of the foundations of God's religion.

Subject: cleanliness and refinement
Quotation: Fear ye God and cleanse your bodies, and shun all things unclean, and purify your garments and your souls in water, that ye may be God-fearing. Use ye perfume, then rose water, then whatsoever beareth a pleasant fragrance

Subject: cleanliness and refinement
Quotation: As for the renewal of household furnishings, clothing, bedding, vessels and furniture, this has the wisdom of cleanliness and refinement, for the renewal of all that is old is the foundation of all cleanliness. This is a mighty wisdom with which every person of culture and discernment will agree.

Subject: cleanliness and refinement
Quotation: He remarked how far removed the Shi'ih people were from proper conduct, for despite their belief in the tradition The believer is alive in both worlds, they would enter holy places with breath fouled by garlic and onions and in unclean attire. He said that He was affected by such unpleasant odors beyond description.

Subject: cleanliness and refinement
Quotation: Let some of you show mercy unto others and be kind unto yourselves insofar as ye are able. Adorn yourselves for God, your Lord, through your glorification of God and your remembrance of His praise, through your magnification of God and your declaration of His oneness, and through wearing the finest garments ye possess. This is of God's grace and mercy upon you, that ye might be thankful.

Subject: collection; ordering of the Sacred Writings
Quotation: Thou hast, also, assigned unto every soul a portion of this virtue in accordance with the Tablet of Thy decree and the Scriptures of Thine irrevocable judgment. Every leaf of these Books and Scriptures Thou hast, moreover, allotted to each one of the peoples and kindreds of the earth.

Subject: collection; ordering of the Sacred Writings
Quotation: The teachings of Baha'o'llah are not yet evident, not yet made known, not all accumulated. For instance, there are teachings in the Book of Akdas, but they are not all there. There are the Tablet of Bishara, etc., but all these do not contain all the teachings of Baha'o'llah. They are scattered, but they will be gathered together. Then it will become evident how important are the teachings of Baha'o'llah.

Subject: collection; ordering of the Sacred Writings
Quotation: The writings of the Point, exalted be His glory, the Bayan, were revealed in the manner of verses and in portions from the Book of God, exalted be His glory. Therefore, let these portions be bound into another volume, and if God willeth, all that hath been revealed in the Book shall be gathered for us.

Subject: collection; ordering of the Sacred Writings
Quotation: As to the matter of recording and collecting the wondrous writings and extraordinary events witnessed from the Ancient Beauty - to forbid this would cause hearts to become chilled, therefore no one should interfere.

Subject: collection; ordering of the Sacred Writings
Quotation: Pure souls should gather divine verses pertaining to every subject and, with wisdom and appropriateness, convey them in a spirit of joy and fragrance.  For instance, verses concerning character, as well as those revealed regarding deeds and words and the prohibition of dissension, contention and conflict, and likewise keep in mind verses for other occasions, reciting them when necessary, that perchance the heedless may become aware and comprehend their purpose. The loved ones of God must reflect upon those matters that conduce to the exaltation and glory of the Cause and that accord with the wisdom revealed in the Tablets, and act accordingly. Were someone to compile the verses sent down from the Kingdom of the divine Command concerning the absence of dissension, conflict and contention, it would surely constitute a mighty book.

Subject: collection; ordering of the Sacred Writings
Quotation: The teachers must be taught such utterances as will cause the nearness, attraction and enkindlement of souls. In the revealed Tablets, whatsoever they may desire hath been sent down. Regarding detachment, mighty verses have been revealed, and likewise concerning righteousness, seeking and wayfaring. Concerning each virtue and attribute, that which hath been revealed would, if imparted, attract beings to the highest summit and ultimate goal. You should strive to compile these so all may attain that which will bring about the elevation of the world of being and the exaltation of the souls. We beseech God, blessed and exalted is He, to assist you under all conditions to attract the hearts.

Subject: collection; ordering of the Sacred Writings
Quotation: With respect to every mode and subject there hath streamed forth that which no mind can reckon…..  We beseech the True One to aid one of His loved ones to compile all that hath flowed from the Supreme Pen on various occasions concerning the elimination of conflict, contention and strife, as well as heavenly counsels, consummate wisdoms, and union and concord amongst the children of men. Verily He is the Helper, the Mighty, the Powerful, the Great. Likewise the mention of those souls who in this Most Great Revelation, with rapture and ecstasy, with longing and yearning, have sought the station of sacrifice and have offered up their lives in the path of the love of the Beloved of the worlds - these matters are acceptable and praiseworthy before God.

Subject: coming-of-age; maturity of mankind
Quotation: The teachings of BAHA'O'LLAH have the same basic principles, but are according to the stage of the maturity of the world and the requirements of this illumined age.

Subject: coming-of-age; maturity of mankind
Quotation: It may be said that the development of the human being from the beginning of life to the age of maturity is but a preparation for the appearance of the power of reason. This is the age of maturity and the time of the manifestation of the Most Great Intellect and the Most Ancient Bounty so that divine and material civilizations may be joined and the perfection of the human world may dawn.

Subject: coming-of-age; maturity of mankind
Quotation: All created things have their degree, or stage, of maturity. The period of maturity in the life of a tree is the time of its fruit bearing. The maturity of a plant is the time of its blossoming and flower. The animal attains a stage of full growth and completeness, and in the human kingdom man reaches his maturity when the lights of intelligence have their greatest power and development.... Similarly, there are periods and stages in the life of the aggregate world of humanity, which at one time was passing through its degree of childhood, at another its time of youth but now has entered its long presaged period of maturity, the evidences of which are everywhere visible and apparent.

Subject: compassion; kindness
Quotation: That which manifested kindness...Look not at this or that - be thou kind

Subject: compassion; kindness
Quotation: Man must be a mine of piety and sympathy. He must raise the fallen and cheer the hopeless.

Subject: compassion; kindness
Quotation: Show kindness to the helpless and be gentle with the distressed. Be a healing balm to every wound and the greatest remedy for every ailment.

Subject: compassion; kindness
Quotation: The rendering of service to humanity. Each member must try to be kind to everyone and to show forth great affection towards every living soul.

Subject: compassion; kindness
Quotation: Physical kindness consists of affection, nurturing, watchfulness and attention. But spiritual kindness is heavenly guidance and divine knowledge.

Subject: compassion; kindness
Quotation: Be always kind to everyone and a refuge for those who are without shelter. Be nurses to the sick, treasurers for the poor, and supply heavenly food to the hungry.

Subject: compassion; kindness
Quotation: that they may shine like unto brilliant stars in this darksome world, teach all the peoples of the world the mores of love, and show everyone kindliness and friendship, sympathy and courtesy

Subject: compassion; kindness
Quotation: Ye must tread in the path of God, show kindness to all that dwell on earth and become acquainted with all nations. Ye must become sweet and honey to the human world and grant affection and tender compassion to humankind. Become a healer of the ailing and a balm to any pitiful wounded (being.) Become (companions) comforters of hearts and quickeners of souls that ye may become the revealers of the great mercy.

Subject: competition vs. cooperation; the struggle for existence
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/competition vs. cooperation; the struggle for existence.txt
Quotation: For partnership is a sign of the unity of words and union and agreement in the divine Cause. It is very difficult for human beings individually to succeed in any undertaking, but when an association is formed and a company is established, they succeed through unity in carrying out great enterprises.

Subject: competition vs. cooperation; the struggle for existence
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/competition vs. cooperation; the struggle for existence.txt
Quotation: The higher forms of life are fed upon the lower status of genesis. The grass takes its nourishment out of the soil and every day grows taller and taller like unto this. The animal in turn eats this grass and is sustained by it. After awhile man comes around, kills the cow and feeds himself upon it.

Subject: competition vs. cooperation; the struggle for existence
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/competition vs. cooperation; the struggle for existence.txt
Quotation: like a fierce wolf that would tear apart all the sheep in the world if it could, and every animal wants all the grass in the field for itself...Can one say to the lion and wolf, why do you tear apart the sheep? No, this is the requirement of nature - might makes right - and this is the struggle for existence, that everything seeks benefit for its own life and harm and destruction for other beings

Subject: composition and decomposition
Quotation: Nature is a condition or reality which outwardly appears to be the source of life and death, or in other words, the composition and decomposition of all things. This nature operates under precise systems, firm laws, perfect arrangements and consummate geometry, from which it never deviates.

Subject: composition and decomposition
Quotation: [the soul of man] is not a composition of diverse elements...and is not subject to decomposition... all material existents...will also be found to be composed [and therefore capable of being decomposed]

Subject: composition and decomposition
Quotation: For collection, unification and composition are the means of life. And that which causes separation and decomposition is the means of death. Hence it is evident that composition and gathering cause life, and decomposition and disunion cause death.

Subject: composition and decomposition
Quotation: Therefore it is logically proven that the existence of phenomena depends upon composition, and their destruction upon disintegration... Composition is of three kinds. 1. Accidental composition. 2. Involuntary composition. 3. Voluntary composition. There is no fourth kind of composition.

Subject: composition and decomposition
Quotation: Because these illuminating bodies which exist in yon immeasurable immensity are all composed of matter, and every composition is followed by decomposition, and this shows that (these stars) are deprived from the gift of perpetuity; but as the universe of the Kingdom is abstract and sanctified above the laws of composition and decomposition, therefore it is imperishable and indestructible.

Subject: composition and decomposition
Quotation: The law of composition and decomposition, amalgamation and dissolution, construction and destruction, protection and danger are two basal principles of creation. Creation therefore is based upon the activity of these two fundamental laws.

Subject: composition and decomposition
Quotation: The people of truth hold that all material existents, even those which the scientists of today consider simple, if investigated carefully and examined closely, will also be found to be composed [and therefore capable of being decomposed]

Subject: composition and decomposition
Quotation: God hath not created any being except that its existence is conditioned upon the composition, mixing and combining of simple primary elements, nor hath He ordained any death, passing or non-existence except through the analysis, decomposition, separation and dispersion of its original constituent parts.

Subject: composure; tranquillity; serenity
Quotation: O loved ones of God! Upon you be calmness and dignity.

Subject: composure; tranquillity; serenity
Quotation: shelter us under the shade of the tree of thy mercifulness and grant us spiritual composure and rest

Subject: composure; tranquillity; serenity
Quotation: with the utmost joy and fragrance remain firm and steadfast beneath the shade of the Beloved of all possibility

Subject: composure; tranquillity; serenity
Quotation: O God, give me a new life at every instant and bestow upon me the breaths of the Holy Spirit at every moment, in order that I may remain steadfast in Thy love, attain unto great felicity, perceive the manifest light and be in the state of utmost tranquillity and submissiveness.

When the time for payment arrived, they asked for a reduction in the price. The Bab did not accept their request. He told them that they had already agreed upon the price and all other terms of the transaction, that the deal had been completed and so He refused to reduce the price. They insisted but the Bab remained firm. 'Dabbih is the custom of this land.' The Bab answered, 'Soon many of these bad customs will be changed.' No matter how much they insisted, the Bab did not change His position. He told them that if they thought that the price was too high, they could return the goods.

When this merchant in Beirut was assured of this fact, he helped Gasem in buying tobacco and did not even ask him of his notes. Then Gasem carried the tobacco to Jerusalem where he sold it for a good profit and sent the capital to the merchant in Beirut.

Therefore I hope that henceforth the friends of God will conduct business with the utmost moderation and not deviate from the laws of commerce, so that such difficulties may not arise again.

Subject: conduct in finance and business
Quotation: Not a long time ago I knew a merchant who exported a great deal of wheat. Once he had a cargo on the sea with 6000 pounds Sterling wheat in it. One morning while he was sitting in his office, busy with his mercantile affairs he received a cable to the effect that a storm had arisen, sinking his valuable cargo of wheat. He did not manifest the least trace of worry or perturbation in his face. In his calm, most matter of fact tone he turned to his clerk and handing him the cable he said: 'Note this on the debit of loss and contingencies' and resumed his work. But when this very merchant went to the market to buy daily provision for his home he would haggle with the vegetable vendor for a quarter of Mataleek and tried to save one or two cents in the whole bargain. He was not really a parsimonious fellow but a careful, household economist. He would say the loss of a cargo of wheat is not a thing that will happen often but if one does not watch over his daily expenses sooner or later he will be drained to the bottom and will then have to weep over his own carelessness.

They had made things very hard for her, - her husband, her father, sons, and all her relatives. The Blessed Beauty sent and arranged her escape by night. She was brought to Tehran and for a few days was in Baha'o'llah's house. Then He sent her to Badasht for the friends were gathered there. Also, later the Blessed Beauty went.

Subject: conference of Badasht
Quotation: Regarding the episode of Badasht, although it is accurate, it is not detailed. The details are that Qurratu'l-Ayn was in one garden and Quddus was in another garden, but the Blessed Beauty was in a tent. The blessed tent and pavilion were between the two gardens beside a stream. The Blessed Beauty had told Quddus and Qurratu'l-Ayn that this Cause must be fully proclaimed. The next day the Blessed Beauty became ill. Quddus came and was sitting in the presence of the Blessed Beauty while all the friends were gathered in a circle around the tent. At this moment Qurratu'l-Ayn came out of the garden crying out and wailing, entered the tent and sat down. The Blessed Beauty said to recite the Surih of the Event. They recited the Surih of the Event in the blessed presence. Afterwards a great tumult arose - some fled, some wept and lamented, and some became agitated. Mulla Ismail cut his own throat and the gathering at Badasht dispersed.

Quotation: To his honor Aqa Abdul-Husayn, convey this servant's utmost satisfaction with his efforts...These services were for the Truth, not for him, and are accounted with God.

Subject: consolation and comfort
Quotation: Yet there is hope in the aid and favor of the Glorious Lord, and the end shall be praiseworthy. The cottage of sorrows shall one day become a rose garden - grieve not.

Subject: consolation and comfort
Quotation: I beseech for you the forgiveness of the Almighty God, and seek tranquility of heart and soul, and deliverance from tests, that you may become an adornment of creation.

Subject: consolation and comfort
Quotation: Therefore We seek his contentment, that he be not troubled, for from the beginning of days he had shown love towards Us. We have loved and continue to love faithfulness.

Subject: consolation and comfort
Quotation: This entire tablet is a letter of consolation to parents who have lost two children, assuring them their children are safe with God and encouraging them to have patience

Subject: consolation and comfort
Quotation: Grieve not in thy exile. By God, wert thou to see with Mine eye, thou wouldst sacrifice thyself in My path... Grieve not for thy son; verily, he circleth round his Lord.

Subject: consolation and comfort
Quotation: Rest ye assured in the grace of God, and in His mercy: He, verily, is with you in every world of His worlds. He, verily, is the Beholder, the Ever-Present, the All-Seeing.

Subject: consolation and comfort
Quotation: "Grieve not for that which hath befallen thee...whereas he who hath ascended is in a glorious station." "Grieve not for thy father. He is in the most sublime Companion..."

Subject: consolation and comfort
Quotation: Indeed they have become involved in a great calamity, but God bestowed His grace and protection, and its outcome was good. God willing, it will become even better than this.

Subject: consolation and comfort
Quotation: "O Siyyid 'Ali, upon whom be the Glory of God! The dust of hypocrisy hath encompassed the Luminary of the horizons, and the sorrows of the world have transformed joy itself."

Subject: consolation and comfort
Quotation: I swear by My life! Nothing save that which profiteth them can befall My loved ones. To this testifieth the Pen of God, the Most Powerful, the All-Glorious, the Best Beloved.

Subject: consolation and comfort
Quotation: I love you tenderly and I knew that you are drinking deep of the cup of afflictions... I love you tenderly, very tenderly, and you are always to find comfort in this thought.

Subject: consolation and comfort
Quotation: No more lament your estrangement, but soar through the special favors of God. Be not withered, be not grieved, be at peace. Rejoice and seek happiness through heavenly bounty

Subject: consolation and comfort
Quotation: Praise be to God that the ship's ordeal resulted in heavenly citrus fruit. Thou didst not become prey to the sea-fish; may God protect thee from the wolves of the wilderness.

Subject: consolation and comfort
Quotation: "Follow God's decree at this time and fear not. Dwell in the myrtle house, for verily We are your protectors. Be patient and grieve not, for verily We are witnesses over you."

Subject: consolation and comfort
Quotation: Do not wail and lament, and do not seek sorrow and grief... Thus it is not permitted to become a companion to mourning, nor is it fitting to become captive to pain and grief.

Subject: consolation and comfort
Quotation: Be not grieved by anything. Trust in God. He is with you in all conditions. Beware, beware lest anything sadden you. Drink the Kawthar of joy from the hand of thy Lord's favor

Subject: consolation and comfort
Quotation: Be not grieved at what hath befallen you. The Wronged One giveth you glad tidings of that which hath been ordained for you from the presence of a Mighty, All-Powerful Lord.

Subject: consolation and comfort
Quotation: Thou, O servant soaring in Mine atmosphere, when thou hearest the scratching of My Pen, grieve not at its mention, but place thy trust in God, the Mighty, the One, the All-Wise.

Subject: consolation and comfort
Quotation: Let not the affairs of the world sadden thee, nor the gloating of those who have disbelieved in God, the Lord of the Day of Judgment...Be not grieved by what hath befallen thee.

Subject: consolation and comfort
Quotation: yet it behooveth all to hold fast to gracious patience. Verily thy Lord is the All-Patient. He commandeth thee and His handmaidens and loved ones to show forth gracious patience.

Subject: consolation and comfort
Quotation: I beseech God that He may impart unto thee the word of patience, console thee in the calamity of the Afnan Abdul-Husayn, make thee content with His decree, patient under tribulation

Subject: consolation and comfort
Quotation: O My handmaiden! Be not grieved by what hath befallen thee in this transient abode. Find solace in the remembrance of thy Lord, the Possessor of all names and Creator of the heavens.

Subject: consolation and comfort
Quotation: I hope that through the grace and favor of the Blessed Beauty this difficulty too shall be resolved, affairs will again be set in order, and comfort and ease will be attained by all.

Subject: consolation and comfort
Quotation: "However, this separation is surely difficult and hard for you. I hope that this separation will lead to eternal reunion, and this distance become the cause of everlasting nearness."

Subject: consolation and comfort
Quotation: O Beloved, O My Beloved One, from your tongue before your Lord, do not grieve, O My Lord, for verily this is a noble station and an ancient glory, and your Lord is Kind, Merciful.

Subject: consolation and comfort
Quotation: "Grief lieth not in what befalleth bodies, but in what befalleth spirits" "Grieve not because of imprisonment. Know thou its station. God hath made it the Most Exalted Paradise for thee"

Subject: consolation and comfort
Quotation: O Mariam! Give up sorrow to happiness, and dispel all grief from the cup of joy... Cleanse thine eyes from tears, sweep sorrow from the chamber of thy heart, set thy mind free from worry

Subject: consolation and comfort
Quotation: Think not that the cessation of letters stems from weariness, or that in the heart is something that would kindle it. Rather, my hand wrote to you letters which my tears raced to wash away.

Subject: consolation and comfort
Quotation: Give thanks to God that the end was praiseworthy and the conclusion of the journey became the beginning of divine favors... Now you should thank God that He has granted you three such sons

Subject: consolation and comfort
Quotation: Always comfort these souls that they may not be sorrowful. God willing, all matters will be set right, and all these tribulations shall be compensated. It only requires that one be patient.

Subject: consolation and comfort
Quotation: However difficult things may seem, do not become sorrowful. The joy of your heart takes precedence over everything. It is not possible for worldly affairs to always accord with one's wishes.

Subject: consolation and comfort
Quotation: Be not disturbed about affairs. In the past and present, things heavier than mountains have befallen people, but after despair and loss of hope, God's grace encompassed them. Be not grieved.

Subject: consolation and comfort
