Quotation: O My handmaiden! Grieve not over separation, but be content with what God hath ordained for thee, for it is better for thee than all that hath been created between the heavens and the earths.

Subject: consolation and comfort
Quotation: O ye beloved ones of mine, set then your hearts on His favours, and open up your eyes in order to behold His bounties. Sorrow not and nor be ye ever grieved. Be not dejected, be not sorrowful.

Subject: consolation and comfort
Quotation: O branch sprung from the Blessed Tree! May God illumine thine eyes with the sanctified outpourings sent down from the clouds of grace. Thy letter was read and brought the utmost joy and delight.

Subject: consolation and comfort
Quotation: They will not be disturbed by the death of their dear ones nor be grieved at the passing of their relatives...do not be sad and be not grieved. You must be thankful that her life was ended well.

Subject: consolation and comfort
Quotation: Your services and sacrifices, especially those of your noble father, are accepted, beloved and remembered at the threshold of the Lord - they have not been and will not be forgotten, be assured.

Subject: consolation and comfort
Quotation: Though afflictions from all directions have encompassed the spirit, yet the splendors of the lights of the Countenance of the Manifestation have prevented all events from having their full effect.

Subject: consolation and comfort
Quotation: Do not in any way allow yourself to grieve and do not think too much. In all conditions be patient and rely upon God's grace, for God's favors are many, and God's relief will arrive, God willing.

Subject: consolation and comfort
Quotation: This entire Tablet is addressed to console a grieving believer, with passages like "that joy might possess her after sorrow" and "Grieve thou not save in My grief, and rejoice not save in My joy."

Subject: consolation and comfort
Quotation: I beg of God that he may vouchsafe to thee such a tranquility that it is not followed by confusion and dispersal. It is also my hope that your external affairs will achieve order and organisation.

Subject: consolation and comfort
Quotation: And We make mention at the end of the Book of the loved ones of God whose names were not mentioned before the Face, that they may be assured through the grace of their Lord, the Kind, the Forgiving.

Subject: consolation and comfort
Quotation: The Wronged One maketh mention of thee from the precincts of the Prison, and answereth that which thou didst beseech of Him. We have heard thy call - rejoice thou and be of them that render thanks.

Subject: consolation and comfort
Quotation: Be not grieved by any worldly events. Soon will God change hardship into ease and there shall appear on earth that which will cause the very atoms to proclaim: This is what God promised in the Book.

Subject: consolation and comfort
Quotation: O ye kindred of His Holiness Nabil-i-Akbar...ye are considered worthy of the favors of the Ancient Beauty in the sight of His grace and are encompassed by the loving-kindness of the Lord of Lordship

Subject: consolation and comfort
Quotation: "Despite this bounty, you should not be saddened or grieved by any sorrow, nor be sorrowful from any calamity" ... "In any case, we hope that you will find solace and show patience in this calamity"

Subject: consolation and comfort
Quotation: He Who remembereth thee from His Most Glorious Horizon declareth and beareth witness to thy turning, thy devotion, thy attachment and thy clinging to the hem of the mercy of the Beloved of the worlds

Subject: consolation and comfort
Quotation: O Afnan! This Wronged One counsels that the honored Afnan not be saddened by what has occurred. In truth, you have been and are partner with the Wronged One in the tribulations that have befallen Him.

Subject: consolation and comfort
Quotation: Make joyful the broken hearts and grant flight to birds with broken wings. Give the thirsty to drink from the Salsabil of grace...Make the hopeless hopeful and make those deprived worthy of every gift.

Subject: consolation and comfort
Quotation: Good news to thee, O noble one slain in the path of God!' By God the Truth! The denizens of the holy precincts celebrated his arrival and the people of the gardens of fellowship rejoiced at his coming

Subject: consolation and comfort
Quotation: "be not grieved, neither do ye weep and sorrow, for that celestial bird hath flown to the illimitable realm, and hastening away from this mortal domain hath attained unto the everlasting rose-garden."

Subject: consolation and comfort
Quotation: The text discusses how faith provides comfort to those who have lost loved ones: "He is the Comforter of the broken-hearted ones. The miraculous power of Faith will cheer them up and heal their wounds."

Subject: consolation and comfort
Quotation: when the dark gloom of cares and sorrows hangs low, the mention of the loved ones, and recalling to mind those who are close to the Threshold of the Lord, impart consolation to the hearts of His friends

Subject: consolation and comfort
Quotation: O Pen! Be patient, for sorrows have overtaken both the seen and unseen. If Thou shouldst desire, Thou wouldst turn grief into joy in Thy kingdom, and the essence of care into delight among Thy servants.

Subject: consolation and comfort
Quotation: If it can be accomplished with joy and delight, very good, but if not, do not be sad and troubled. Inevitably there is wisdom in why it did not work out, and this matter is not a source of shame for you.

Subject: consolation and comfort
Quotation: Firstly, because no relationship is worthy of mention in relation to the Truth, and secondly, they can still return from Yazd. We beseech the Truth to manifest that which is the cause of the greatest joy.

Subject: consolation and comfort
Quotation: Ask about the helpless sister who left that house with several ailments and has settled in the utmost joy, tranquility and dignity in the home of His Honor Kalim, and by God's grace is in perfect comfort.

Subject: consolation and comfort
Quotation: Can tribulation prevent the people of Baha? Nay, by the Lord of all names! Can the hatred and oppression of the enemies cause the companions of the Crimson Ark to waver? Nay, by the Creator of the heavens!

Subject: consolation and comfort
Quotation: Be not sorrowful or grief-stricken, for in the world of heaven, in the gathering-place of the Beloved, we shall become intimate companions and confidants. There, reunion is eternal and meeting everlasting.

Subject: consolation and comfort
Quotation: O thou who art firm in the Covenant! Thou hadst complained of loneliness. Thou art not alone - God is with thee and 'Abdu'l-Baha is thy companion and intimate friend in heart and soul. Why art thou lonely?

Subject: consolation and comfort
Quotation: Grieve thou not over anything. Verily thy Lord is with them that have turned unto His Countenance. Soon shall they find themselves in the most exalted station... Despair not of the Spirit of God and His mercy

Subject: consolation and comfort
Quotation: Be not grieved. God has been and continues to be mindful of His servants. Sufficient unto us is He as Guardian and Trustee, sufficient is He as Knower and Reckoner, sufficient is thy Lord as Guide and Helper.

Subject: consolation and comfort
Quotation: Your future is very great, for it is protected and preserved under divine protection, confirmed by heavenly confirmations, encompassed by the glance of grace, and bright and radiant with the light of guidance.

Subject: consolation and comfort
Quotation: It is inevitable that you too must have your share and portion, for this is what faithfulness requires - to be partners and participants in both joy and sorrow, in comfort and hardship, in glory and abasement.

Subject: consolation and comfort
Quotation: What greater consolation could there be than that this bird of faithfulness has made its nest in the branches of the Divine Lote-Tree, and this spiritual breeze has returned to the gardens of the All-Merciful.

Subject: consolation and comfort
Quotation: Know thou for a certainty that thou hast not lost him, and that ultimately thou shalt find him. Therefore be thou strong and patient, tranquil and composed, and supplicate God's grace and mercy on his behalf.

Subject: consolation and comfort
Quotation: Although you two sisters from the beginning endured utmost persecution from the enemies of the Beauty of Abha...Therefore be not sorrowful, be not grieved. Be gladdened through the grace of the Ancient Beauty.

Subject: consolation and comfort
Quotation: "O my God! Though the chicory be bitter, it is from the garden. O time! God willing, through the bounty of the All-Merciful thou shalt become sweet and be accounted as among the flowers of the divine paradise."

Subject: consolation and comfort
Quotation: Grieve not at separation. Grieve not at remoteness, but be content with whatsoever God hath ordained. Beware lest thou complainest of aught in My path. God will soon make manifest what He hath ordained for thee.

Subject: consolation and comfort
Quotation: You have always been the object of the blessed Beauty's loving kindness and continue to be so until now. Be assured. If Haji Ramadan has made some mention, this was of his own accord and he spoke idly. Be assured.

Subject: consolation and comfort
Quotation: These calamities are but the reflection of bountiful gifts for they have been encountered in God's pathway. Be at rest, O loved ones of God, for the Concourse on High remember you with most wonderful descriptions.

Subject: consolation and comfort
Quotation: Be not sorrowful and grieved over the vicissitudes of this treacherous world and the burden of debts, for conditions change moment by moment, and the ultimate victory belongs to the spiritual ones and the sincere.

Subject: consolation and comfort
Quotation: Therefore there must be intense hope and firm expectation, for He is the shelter of sinners and the refuge of the erring ones... Therefore we must be confident in the grace and bounty of the Sovereign of existence

Subject: consolation and comfort
Quotation: O servant! Grieve not over what hath befallen thee in this world...Forget thy sorrows...Be thou patient in all things except in My tribulations, then put thy trust in God Who created thee by a command from His presence.

Subject: consolation and comfort
Quotation: Prayer seeks divine mercy and forgiveness as consolation for the suffering caused by this loss: "O Lord, have mercy on the blazing fire of hearts and the cries of spirits and souls from this overwhelming, blind calamity"

Subject: consolation and comfort
Quotation: Thou shalt not be saddened or prevented by the clamor of the oppressors and the heedless. God shall soon seize them with justice from His presence and shall show thee what He hath ordained for thee in His perspicuous Book.

Subject: consolation and comfort
Quotation: In short, be not sorrowful, be not grief-stricken, be not agitated, sit not in sadness, become not despondent. You have many partners and countless associates. Soon this tempest will end and security and safety will appear.

Subject: consolation and comfort
Quotation: Be not grieved. When thou considerest the tribulations and afflictions of 'Abdu'l-Baha, thou wilt realize that all sorrows are as a drop while this is as an ocean. One must be patient and forbearing and place one's trust in God.

Subject: consolation and comfort
Quotation: Yet there is hope in the abundant grace of the All-Forgiving Lord that in the future what was missed will be made up for and abundant joy will be attained. In these days hardship upon the friends is endless. This too shall pass.

Subject: consolation and comfort
Quotation: Grieve not for what hath befallen thee. Consider what hath befallen Us at the hands of the oppressors... Thus doth the Most Exalted Pen give thee glad tidings, that thou mayest rejoice within thyself and be of the thankful ones.

Subject: consolation and comfort
Quotation: Be not sorrowful, be not distressed, shed no tears, weep not, scratch not thy face, make no lamentation, and leave not thy heart in sadness... In truth this is cause for joy, not grief, and occasion for gladness, not bitterness.

Subject: consolation and comfort
Quotation: Be not sorrowful, be not dejected, sit not in silence, be not bewildered...Soon a time will come when the free shall freely arise to serve the Cause, and the oppressed shall openly play the melody of the Abha Kingdom. Be assured.

Subject: consolation and comfort
Quotation: In this moment when I am companion to thy remembrance, I have taken up the pen and begun to write, that it may be established that the remembrance of friends is the comfort of the soul and the companion of the heart and conscience.

Subject: consolation and comfort
Quotation: O Leaf, mother of the martyr who ascended unto God - He who hath dawned from His most exalted horizon! Upon thee be My glory and My loving-kindness. Blessed art thou, and blessed are thy son and daughter and those who are with thee.

Subject: consolation and comfort
Quotation: Be not grieved, for whatsoever hath befallen you hath been and shall be the cause of the exaltation, glory, loftiness and elevation of those souls who were mentioned. God will soon reveal that which hath been hidden from sight.

Subject: consolation and comfort
Quotation: Your cries and complaints and sighs and lamentations and wailing are all justified and you are right - truly you have been left alone...My condition, God be praised and through the grace of the Ancient Beauty, is good. Be assured...

Subject: consolation and comfort
Quotation: You have a spiritual army like lions from the hosts of heaven behind you, and an invincible fortress and iron tower from the Kingdom of might and power behind, and that Abha realm beyond...But you, take refuge in God and be secure.

Subject: consolation and comfort
Quotation: The Wronged One at this hour makes mention of him with such remembrance that, should God will it, all created things would be reminded thereby and all beings would turn toward the horizon which was illumined by the lights of the Face

Subject: consolation and comfort
Quotation: Soon you will forget these difficulties and troubles and will make a great commotion and uproar. Do not be sorrowful, do not be grieved. These bitter days, more bitter than poison, shall pass. Once again days sweet as sugar shall come

Subject: consolation and comfort
Quotation: About the resting place of that one drawn near to the Divine Threshold, do not be sorrowful - it will be built and restored in the finest manner. Be certain that whatever has flowed from the Pen of the Covenant will surely come to pass

Subject: consolation and comfort
Quotation: "Do not be despondent over the supreme calamity and the most great catastrophe, for although the Ancient Beauty is hidden from the horizon of the world, yet in the most great Kingdom and the heaven of eternity He is risen and manifest."

Subject: consolation and comfort
Quotation: The letter concludes with words of comfort: "Therefore be not sorrowful at this calamity that has occurred and be not grieved at this tragedy that has taken place. Set your hearts on the grace and loving-kindness of the Ancient Beauty."

Subject: consolation and comfort
Quotation: Beware lest thou grieve on account of thy mother, for she, in truth, hath been uplifted to a seat of transcendent holiness in the realms above and gained admittance into the chambers of Paradise, from whose horizon the lights are shining.

Subject: consolation and comfort
Quotation: "Enable the mother of Abdullah, the companion of Ishaq, and Habibullah and Nurullah and Abdullah and all their descendants to follow in the footsteps of their illustrious brother and walk his path, following the example of that noble one."

Subject: consolation and comfort
Quotation: One must look at matters with the eye of wisdom and consider with thought and reflection...Now whatever befalls you, remembrance of what has passed brings consolation to the heart, and engagement in teaching causes expansion of the breast.

Subject: consolation and comfort
Quotation: Therefore I am most pleased with thee, and I hope that through God's favors thy burdens may henceforth be lightened and thou mayest find some rest. God willing, the day shall come when I will give thee solace and speak of divine bestowals.

Subject: consolation and comfort
Quotation: I am always thinking of you and I beseech assistance and bounty for you. O esteemed teacher, I desire your comfort and happiness. If you are to come, then certainly come soon. I would sacrifice the world for a single one of the loved ones.

Subject: consolation and comfort
Quotation: Therefore comfort your heart and submit to the decree of the Generous Lord...show her the utmost consideration and respect, protect her rights, and treat her beyond what she deserves so that poor woman may find solace in this great calamity

Subject: consolation and comfort
Quotation: Grieve not for him who hath ascended unto God. By the Sun of the horizon of grace! Those souls who are steadfast and who ascend through divine love have, in the presence of God, a station which all pens and tongues are powerless to describe.

Subject: consolation and comfort
Quotation: Be assured that on this momentous Day, the outpourings of forgiveness from the Abha Kingdom are descending like torrential rain. Thy father is forgiven, and thou art accepted at the threshold of the loving Lord. What more couldst thou desire?

Subject: consolation and comfort
Quotation: O Lord! Pour forth patience and solace upon its parents in this overwhelming calamity and mighty tribulation. Verily, Thou art the consolation of hearts that throb with Thy love, and the tranquility of souls that are drawn to Thy countenance.

Subject: consolation and comfort
Quotation: O handmaid of God, sister of one who hath migrated and attained! He is the Witness, the Witnessed One! The dawn hath broken and the cock hath crowed, and the nightingale warbleth upon the branches. The kingdom is God's, the Mighty, the Bestower!

Subject: consolation and comfort
Quotation: Therefore, O ye friends, be ye gladdened in spirit and joyous and hopeful in heart, for the grace of the Abha Kingdom is great, indeed great, and the bonds between the loved ones of God flow from the outpourings of the Ancient Lord and are mighty

Subject: consolation and comfort
Quotation: "Without a doubt the trials and tribulations of those friends were extremely severe. Nonetheless, in truth, they were an abundant grace, and for the hearts of those well-favored at the threshold of oneness, they were the morning's cheerful rays."

Subject: consolation and comfort
Quotation: But be thou not sorrowful nor distressed. Thy affairs move in tandem with the affairs of 'Abdu'l-Baha. Whenever there occurs a change or transformation in this servant's tribulations and sorrows, a great relief will also come about in thy affairs.

Subject: consolation and comfort
Quotation: O Ali! The Wronged One hath heard thy mention and thy praise in the letter thou didst send to the servant present before the Countenance, and We have revealed for thee that which hath attracted the hearts of them that are possessed of understanding.

Subject: consolation and comfort
Quotation: If ye have written letters to Abdul-Baha and answers to them are delayed, know ye of a certainty that untold hindrances have been the cause. Be ye not unhappy... Should ye send a hundred letters and no answers be received, do ye not feel at all sad

Subject: consolation and comfort
Quotation: O Light of God! His honor the Observer, upon him be My glory and loving-kindness, made mention of thee, and likewise of the mother and sister. We beseech God not to deprive any from the Euphrates of mercy and the waves of the ocean of loving-kindness.

Subject: consolation and comfort
Quotation: But inasmuch as he sacrificed himself in the path of the glorious Lord, this affliction is really a feast and this calamity the joy and delight of souls. Wherefore, grieve and sorrow not at the martyrdom of that great soul; rather, be glad and rejoice.

Subject: consolation and comfort
Quotation: O handmaid who has been afflicted with the separation of her most ancient, most ancient son! O handmaid of God! Do you weep at the separation from your son when the Son of God remembers you in truth? Be fair - does grief befit after that? No, by My life!

Subject: consolation and comfort
Quotation: There is no harm in this, for God willing it will soon be eliminated, and God shall recompense thee. Have no regrets, therefore. This plunder will lead to eventual happiness and this pillage will result in ultimate wealth for nothing is impossible for God.

Subject: consolation and comfort
Quotation: O Leaf, wife of the Afnan who has ascended to God, He Who is the Protector of all who are in earth and heaven! O my leaf and my handmaiden! The lamentation of your heart has influenced the regions and your wailing has saddened the dwellers of the pavilions.

Subject: consolation and comfort
Quotation: Be not grieved at what hath befallen you in the path of God and His love. Ye have been beneath the canopy of God's protection, the Lord of all worlds. He will protect you as He protected you before. Beware lest the might of the oppressors frighten you.

Subject: consolation and comfort
Quotation: That leaf who ascended unto God - that is, the honored aunt, upon her be the glory of God and His mercy and His grace - it was presented before His face. This is what was revealed for her from the Kingdom of her Lord's grace, and my Purpose and her Purpose.

Subject: consolation and comfort
Quotation: This servant of Thine... hastened to Thy luminous spot... but was prevented from arrival... So he returned with a broken heart... O Lord! Ordain for him every good in Thy Kingdom and the reward of every guest who arrives at the door of Thy grace and bounty.

Subject: consolation and comfort
Quotation: Surely night will turn to morning and the hangover-breaking wine will arrive. A fresh intoxication will be attained and boundless joy and delight will appear... Do not be sad, do not be sorrowful, be content and joyful, for the end belongs to the God-fearing.

Subject: consolation and comfort
Quotation: Be patient in the path of God and be not grieved by reason of that which befalleth you in the days of Him Who is the Spirit of God, for erelong ye shall, within His celestial Garden of holiness and sublimity, behold the recompense of them that endure patiently.

Subject: consolation and comfort
Quotation: Grieve not for him who hath ascended unto God, and be content with God thy Lord. Verily He is with His remembering handmaidens. Find solace in the remembrance of God, for through His remembrance sorrows are lifted and mercy and joy descend from all directions.

Subject: consolation and comfort
Quotation: His honor Mushkin-Qalam, whenever he becomes downhearted, remembers you and involuntarily, like an overflowing cup, becomes the cause of happiness and joy of the righteous ones, and never forgets you, and always at the Sacred Threshold begs confirmation for you

Subject: consolation and comfort
Quotation: Indeed, the events in Rasht were severe and widespread. Others were utterly scattered and demoralized, and consolation was nowhere to be found. Yet praise be to God, the loved ones of God find solace in every tribulation and are gladdened by divine glad-tidings.

Subject: consolation and comfort
Quotation: Look toward the Supreme Kingdom so that sorrows may be transformed into spirit and fragrance, and depression and withering may become joy and expansion and freedom and tranquility. Therefore, be not broken-hearted and do not seclude yourself. Be hopeful and joyful

Subject: consolation and comfort
Quotation: "Therefore, caress the children, train and nurture them, and deliver to them the glad-tidings of the manifold bounties of the Abha Beloved, for in this realm they are most precious, and in this world their cup is overflowing" "Let them grieve and sorrow no longer"

Subject: consolation and comfort
Quotation: Do not imagine that you have been forgotten or that we have ceased to mention you. The blessed leaves constantly remember all, and 'Abdu'l-Baha mentions everyone... Indeed separation from the Holy Land was difficult for you, but one must be patient and forbearing.

Subject: consolation and comfort
Quotation: I supplicated with utmost humility, lowliness and need for pardon and forgiveness from the Self-Sufficient Lord...From the Kingdom of Forgiveness, pardon and blessing were sought for the departed one who ascended to the horizon of sanctity, the late Aqa Husayn Aqa.

Subject: consolation and comfort
Quotation: The days of oppression are short, and whatsoever hath come to pass hath been a cause of exaltation, despite those who have violated God's Covenant and Testament. With the utmost joy and fragrance, occupy yourselves with the mention of the Best-Beloved of the worlds.

Subject: consolation and comfort
Quotation: Be thou not sorrowful, be thou not grief-stricken. We have accepted every affliction in the path of Baha, and have purchased with heart and soul every tribulation. Therefore we must show patience and forbearance. Through the grace of Baha, affairs will also prosper.

Subject: consolation and comfort
Quotation: Do not be sorrowful or broken-hearted at the ascension of that attracted leaf who has ascended to the Abha Kingdom, for that assured one has found her dwelling in the precincts of the Most Great Mercy and taken up her residence in the shade of the Divine Lote-Tree.

Subject: consolation and comfort
Quotation: And give the glad tidings of the favors of the All-Glorious, Most Holy Lord to the handmaiden of God, Tavus, daughter of Ishaq. Give glad tidings to the handmaiden of God, Tavus, that your kind brother Aqa Jan is, through God's grace and bounty, at peace in Paradise.

Subject: consolation and comfort
Quotation: O confident leaf! Do not be distressed at the death of your son, and shed no tears. Do not grieve, do not be sorrowful...If you love him, be patient and forbearing - nay rather, render praise and thanks that he was blessed with such a great victory and manifest grace.

Subject: consolation and comfort
Quotation: According to what was heard, you have been relieved from the occupation you had. Since it was beneficial for the friends, its continuation would have been better, but only on condition of comfort of heart and soul. In any case, divine assistance and bounty are assured.

Subject: consolation and comfort
Quotation: Why art thou sad? Thou dwellest in God's realm of happiness. And why art thou dejected since thou hast been addressed with the call of the supreme glad-tidings? The world of happiness circleth round thee and the sun of felicity and gladness is shining from the horizon.

Subject: consolation and comfort
Quotation: This is Thy handmaiden who is related to her. Look upon her with the glance of Thy providential eye...She shall soon see that which will gladden her heart and bring joy to her soul in those worlds which God has sanctified beyond people's comprehension in this first life

Subject: consolation and comfort
Quotation: Surely after this dark night will come a luminous morning, and after these dense clouds a delicate horizon. After this deadly poison will come superior honey, and after this sword wound will come an effective balm in the end, through the aid and favor of the Lord of Mercy.

Subject: consolation and comfort
Quotation: Remember what befell those in former ages, so that your wound from the oppression of later ones may be healed... God willing, you will be permitted to come at the appointed time, so that our meeting may be a comfort to your anxious heart and solace to your grieving spirit.

Subject: consolation and comfort
Quotation: The letter indicates joy at the steadfastness of the Naddaf family through trials and assures them of divine assistance: "I am certainly pleased, content and happy with them, and I will beseech infinite assistance and bounties from the Center of Favors for the Naddaf family."

Subject: consolation and comfort
Quotation: Upon thee be the Glory of God and His grace! The Most Great Branch arrived at this moment and made mention of you, whereupon these words were sent down from the Kingdom of utterance of the All-Merciful: Mention of thee hath been and shall ever be made in the Most Great Prison.

Subject: consolation and comfort
Quotation: O ye refugees of the one true God! Be not grieved or disconsolate; neither allow yourselves to sit despondent and dejected. Therefore, his mind is consoled and his spirit rejoiceth. Rest assured! The gates of bounty have been flung open and heart and soul will become tranquil.

Subject: consolation and comfort
Quotation: Although there is hardship and straitness, yet there is a melody and song that can transform every difficulty into ease and every constraint into boundless relief. Despite this, there is hope that the means of ancient comfort will be provided through His aid, grace and bounty.

Subject: consolation and comfort
Quotation: yet since the descent of this greatest calamity is assuredly based on the Most Great Wisdom...If you were aware of this mystery, you would surely not have begun to cry out and lament in grief. But though my eyes weep, it is from the tenderness of heart and delicacy of feeling.

Subject: consolation and comfort
Quotation: Mention thou the other Leaf, that is, the mother, on behalf of the Wronged One, with a mention that will transform her sorrow into joy and her grief into supreme gladness. Say: Grieve not, for thy Lord is with thee and with her, and He is the All-Bountiful, the Mighty, the Wise.

Subject: consolation and comfort
Quotation: This servant, Mr. Zair Mihrban, praises the friends with heart and soul, for those souls have attained recognition of the pure God and are enkindled and aflame with love for the celestial Beloved. Therefore they are worthy of consideration and deserve the expression of my love.

Subject: consolation and comfort
Quotation: O ye who remain of the family of the beloved one on earth! Grieve not for him, for he hath ascended unto the Supreme Companion... Grieve not for him; rather, if ye must needs grieve, grieve for this lonely one who remaineth in the hands of the idolaters without helper or champion.

Subject: consolation and comfort
Quotation: But when I am in the paradise of contentment, I follow the [decree of] the Book of God and say: "Praise be to God Who hath lifted sorrow from me!" And thou, like me, shouldst say: "Praise be to God Who hath lifted sorrow from me. Verily our Lord is All-Forgiving, All-Appreciative."

Subject: consolation and comfort
Quotation: O saplings in the garden of that noble one's hopes! Were ye to know how the clay and water of this heart hath been leavened with the crystal-clear waters of love for those friends, ye would surely, out of the intensity of joy, spread forth wings and soar to the most exalted heights.

Subject: consolation and comfort
Quotation: O cherished handmaiden of God! The Khan has departed for Iran. Undoubtedly your heart is constricted and you remain alone. Be not sorrowful, neither become captive to regret and grief. I hope that the Khan will return soon and become the cause of your joy, happiness, gladness and delight.

Subject: consolation and comfort
Quotation: After these two momentous events, we should not be disturbed by any occurrences. Whatever may happen, even if all of us who are in the Holy Precincts should be torn to pieces, you must, together with all the loved ones of God, engage in work and service and be filled with joy and gladness

Subject: consolation and comfort
Quotation: "Do you grieve over anything after having endured tribulations in My love and calamities in My path? By My life! If you but knew and saw with Mine eye, you would soar in your longing to the heaven of My gladness, to the kingdom of My delight, and to the dominion of My joy and loving-kindness."

Subject: consolation and comfort
Quotation: But the springtime will come again and the life-giving spring will pitch its tent and pavilion upon plain and wilderness, making up for what was lost. "Hast thou not seen that after the night has spread its darkness over all, there must come the light of dawn?" The dawn itself is proof of this.

Subject: consolation and comfort
Quotation: "As much as possible, close the door to such statements and expressions, that such types of conversations may not occur in gatherings and meetings, for they cause souls to become weary, hearts to grow cold, and minds to become frozen, and they have not had and do not have any fruit whatsoever."

Subject: consolation and comfort
Quotation: O thou who bearest My name! Blessed is the eye that hath wept for thy tribulations, whereby he who beareth the name of ?a crieth out in the land of ?aff, saying: O bearer of the name of ?a! By thy life! Through thy calamity have my calamities, my sorrows, my grief and my affliction been renewed.

Subject: consolation and comfort
Quotation: Do thou not lament on account of the death of thy father. Trust thou in God. Rely upon the Kingdom of ABHA. That father of thine hastened to the world of immortality and took a share from the realm of the Merciful and with the utmost joy hath attained to eternal life in the everlasting universe.

Subject: consolation and comfort
Quotation: Cast off the garment of sorrow and adorn thy inner and outer being with the robe of joy. Therefore do all eyes weep for my loneliness and all hearts burn for my oppression. O Mahdi! Today, forget thyself and arise to make mention of the Truth. For this reason be thou neither grieved nor sorrowful.

Subject: consolation and comfort
Quotation: The greatest consolation for the heart is the Love of God. This is the balm for every wound and the remedy for every ailment. Therefore the foundation upon which the eternal consolation of the human heart is based is the Love of God. This is the Cause of happiness! This is the means of consolation!

Subject: consolation and comfort
Quotation: Rejoice within thyself that the face of the Wronged One hath turned toward thee from this luminous horizon. Let not the utterances of those who have disbelieved in God, the All-Knowing, the All-Informed, grieve thee. Put thy trust in Him, then make mention of Him with a truthful and faithful tongue.

Subject: consolation and comfort
Quotation: Sorrow not; griever not; be not unhappy because you are not wealthy. You are brothers of Jesus Christ. Christ was poor. Baha'u'llah was poor. Be ever happy; be not sad. Trust in God and if in this world you undergo dire vicissitudes, I hope that in the Kingdom of God you will have the utmost happiness.

Subject: consolation and comfort
Quotation: "Do not think that you have lost him. You should not suppose that this is an eternal separation. This separation is temporary. You will find him in the Presence of God. You will receive him in the Kingdom of God...Be not sad neither be disappointed. Be not unhappy. It is as though he had taken a trip."

Subject: consolation and comfort
Quotation: Be not grieved at what hath befallen thee. Verily, Our Most Truthful Name hath attained unto that which none hath attained except whom thy Lord hath willed. Thy Lord, of a truth, doth console thee as a token of His grace. Grief was and is not permissible. Console and comfort all on behalf of the Truth.

Subject: consolation and comfort
Quotation: Praise be to God, thy letter contained wondrous meanings and from it was inhaled the perfumed fragrance of the Abha Paradise. There is strong hope that confirmations and success will surely come, and that the favors of the Most Great Name from the ancient realm will become all-encompassing and complete.

Subject: consolation and comfort
Quotation: How blessed are you, for you spent your lifetime amidst trials in the path of the All-Merciful. These will surely be compensated in the Kingdom of the Lord of the worlds. There, joy upon joy shall be yours, and light upon light shall shine forth. All therein is gladness and rejoicing, delight and bliss.

Subject: consolation and comfort
Quotation: Thanks be to God! After mention was made of the ascension of his honor the departed one, upon him be the Most Glorious Glory of God, this servant beheld before him the waves of the ocean of grace and forgiveness. From all directions, great mercy and supreme bounties were directed towards the departed one.

Subject: consolation and comfort
Quotation: Therefore, do not be grieved. These days more bitter than poison shall pass. Until there are storms and snow and blizzards in winter, the musk-scented spring will not come, and mountain and plain will not become verdant and fresh, and flowers and fragrant herbs will not make the face of earth like paradise.

Subject: consolation and comfort
Quotation: Regarding thy extreme sorrow, thy sadness and thy great regret for My imprisonment, there is no harm therein. At that time My Bosom will be dilated, My Spirit rejoiced, My Body gladdened and My Eyes brightened, forasmuch as this is My utmost desire, greatest object, comfort of My heart and Spirit of my life.

Subject: consolation and comfort
Quotation: Be not grieved from any direction. Praise be to God, through the merciful favors and infinite outpourings of God thou art turned to the Most Great Horizon and art clinging to the cord of love of the Lord of Destiny. He will deliver thee and ordain for thee what He willeth. His grace hath encompassed all worlds.

Subject: consolation and comfort
Quotation: Grieve not at the divine trials. Be not troubled because of hardships and ordeals... Be not sorrowful on account of the departure of thy good son. He hath indeed departed from this narrow and gloomy world which is darkened by unlimited sorrow, unto the Kingdom which is spacious, illumined, joyous and beautiful.

Subject: consolation and comfort
Quotation: Do not grieve for father, mother, brother, sister and loving companion. The lights of favor shine so brightly that the darkness of sins and shortcomings is erased and destroyed. The gloom of night vanishes with the manifestation of light, and the darkness of sorrow disappears with the rising of the star of joy.

Subject: consolation and comfort
Quotation: God be praised, through His grace and favour, my health and well-being are now restored, but it is very hard for me to bear thine absence. We think of thee at all times, here on the slopes of this sacred, holy and blessed Mount Carmel, and we are being happy on thy behalf. Affairs, praise be to God, have passed.

Subject: consolation and comfort
Quotation: Be not grieved by what hath befallen thee, for verily today whoever is adorned with the ornament of the love of God hath in truth attained unto all good. The entire world cannot equal a single word that issueth from the mouth of Divine Will concerning His loved ones, and these stations are today hidden from eyes.

Subject: consolation and comfort
Quotation: 'Abdu'l-Baha assures thee that He will not forget thee for a moment. Thou art ever in His thoughts, before His sight, and under the glance of the providence of the Almighty Lord. Thou art ever present with Me, attendant in the gathering, trusted and confided in. Thou art near to My soul and intimate with My heart.

Subject: consolation and comfort
Quotation: It behooveth thee to be like fire in thy love for thy Lord, the Chosen One, and to be in such wise that thou wouldst rejoice in whatsoever God hath ordained. Today one like you should educate the people of the earth that all may drink from the ocean of contentment and fix their gaze upon the Will and Purpose of God.

Subject: consolation and comfort
Quotation: O handmaid of God, pure leaf, wife of Khan, upon her be the Most Glorious Glory of God! He is the Most Glorious! O thou who art assured by the signs of God! Do not wail and lament over separation from those who were the light of thine eyes, and do not sigh and moan over parting from those who were pieces of thy heart.

Subject: consolation and comfort
Quotation: I know that you are infinitely pained and affected by these grievous events. Even if tears of blood were to flow like the River Oxus from our eyes, still the heart would find no peace and the soul no rest. For the consolation of the hearts of the beloved friends, I write briefly that you should not at all be sorrowful

Subject: consolation and comfort
Quotation: Therefore you must show the utmost patience and forbearance, and seek solace and tranquility from the consolation of 'Abdu'l-Baha, knowing that this separation will ultimately end in eternal reunion and this remoteness will finally lead to everlasting closeness. You must look to the end and think of the Kingdom of God.

Subject: consolation and comfort
Quotation: Let not the dust of sorrow settle upon your heart, and do not lament and wail. For though that assured leaf was separated from the tree of contingent being, she became connected to the blessed Tree. And though that bird took flight from its earthly nest, it found its dwelling and shelter in the nest of the All-Merciful.

Subject: consolation and comfort
Quotation: Be thou assured through His grace that He is with those who have been faithful to His Covenant and who have laid hold of the Book with might and evident sovereignty...Those who expelled you - God will soon abase them and exalt your names and record your deeds in a Tablet wherein no deed of those who act is left unmentioned.

Subject: consolation and comfort
Quotation: This prison is not a dungeon - it is a palace. This well is not a pit - it is the zenith of the moon. In the path of God, every constraint is expansion, every tribulation is rest and comfort, every bitterness is sweetness, and every poison is sugar and honey. Blessed art thou that thou hast been singled out for this bounty.

Subject: consolation and comfort
Quotation: This is God's way. No change and variation wilt thou find in God's way. It is exactly the same. Although this Servant is outwardly alone, the breezes of the Kingdom of Abha are wafting and the bounties of the Blessed Beauty descending. The remembrance of His Countenance is My companion and from all else I have severed My hope.

Subject: consolation and comfort
Quotation: All joy and blissfulness be thine, O Sali?, for the Lord did bless thee in thy life and in thy death; and thou wast mentioned by the Pen of Glory in the Most Exalted Paradise on the day thou didst repair to God, the Lord of men --a day whereon the dwellers of the realms above inhaled from thee the heavenly fragrance of thy garden.

Subject: consolation and comfort
Quotation: O Kind God! These servants have suffered persecution from the unfaithful and endured severe trials each day, and bore endless hardships with patience and opened their tongues in thanksgiving, and wept and smiled through intense tribulation, and in utmost joy and delight found the fire of oppression and tyranny to be as a rose garden

Subject: consolation and comfort
Quotation: We have remembered thee in Tablets that shall testify on thy behalf in all the worlds of thy Lord, the All-Knowing, the All-Informed...Know thou with certain knowledge and manifest truth that even should all who are on earth flee and turn away from thee, the Prisoner will not flee from thee and will be with thee under all conditions.

Subject: consolation and comfort
Quotation: Be of no cheerless heart; have no wing nor feather broken; sigh not, neither do thou wail, and sit not chilled in a corner. Be calm, be strong, be grateful, and become a lamp full of light, that the darkness of sorrows be annihilated, and that the sun of everlasting joy arise from the dawning-place of heart and soul, shining brightly.

Subject: consolation and comfort
Quotation: Be thou not sorrowful concerning Our Name "The Bountiful." We verily preserved him by the truth from the hosts of the polytheists when he was in prison with a few souls. We caused him to go forth by Our command and sent down upon him tranquility from Our presence until he sought refuge in the shadow of God, the Mighty, the Praiseworthy.

Subject: consolation and comfort
Quotation: Therefore, be not saddened by this hardship. Verily with difficulty cometh ease. That which is the cause of eternal life is, praise be to God, made possible, and the primary purpose is achieved. This hardship is temporary. I hope that through divine aid and bounty it may be transformed into relief. Therefore, be not grieved by this matter.

Subject: consolation and comfort
Quotation: Blessed art thou for having attained unto the days of God and for being numbered among those who have turned unto Him, as recorded in the mighty Tablet...We have heard thy call and have made mention of thee in this most sublime and most holy Tablet, that thou mayest be assured of the grace of thy Lord and not be saddened by the affairs of men.

Subject: consolation and comfort
Quotation: Do not grieve over what hath befallen thee. There hath befallen Us that which hath caused all things to lament, as attesteth He with Whom is the perspicuous Book. We desire to console thee and comfort thee in what hath befallen thee, that thou mayest be content with what hath appeared from God's decree and destiny, and be of the patient ones.

Subject: consolation and comfort
Quotation: O Abu'l-Hasan! Gladden and adorn the friends in that land with the ornament of a wondrous and sublime remembrance from before the True One. With utmost joy and delight, turn towards and traverse the dominions of the All-Merciful. Say unto them: Grieve not, but trust in God in all matters. Verily He is with you and will manifest what He willeth.

Subject: consolation and comfort
Quotation: In truth these two calamities were destroyers of the foundation of patience and severers of the root of endurance...However, since those two saplings were uprooted from the furnace of this world, they were planted and took root in the eternal divine garden, attaining endless freshness and grace, becoming adorned with leaves, blossoms and fruit.

Subject: consolation and comfort
Quotation: Therefore he should not be affected, for the fame of his truthfulness, trustworthiness and capability has reached even to the Holy Shrine... they should not be sad and sorrowful. In this transient world no matter continues permanently. Sometimes there is dismissal and sometimes appointment, sometimes there is success and sometimes lack of joy.

Subject: consolation and comfort
Quotation: Today there is bestowed from the horizon of the Ancient Beauty's favor such a gift to the handmaids who are firm in the Covenant that cannot be described. We hope that the radiance of that light may become clearly and evidently manifest in your countenance and that you may become a dawning-place for the rays of the gift of the All-Merciful Lord.

Subject: consolation and comfort
Quotation: Do not be surprised at this oppression by these unjust people. In every dispensation, occurrences more severe than this have befallen the Holy Manifestations of God, but destruction led to construction, humiliation became the cause of glory and honor, and abasement resulted in supreme exaltation...Hence you should not be sorrowful or distressed.

Subject: consolation and comfort
Quotation: In it, the loved ones of God complain about not receiving replies, but they do not know what a tumultuous situation exists here. If they were to come and observe, they would, with perfect justice and fairness, excuse themselves. But they view the fire from afar. Nevertheless, to the extent possible, there has been no negligence nor will there be any.

Subject: consolation and comfort
Quotation: O thou who art turned toward the Abha Kingdom! That which thou didst write was noted. All of it was supplication and entreaty, prayer and prayer and ardor. This condition is proof of the sincerity of thy heart and thy turning toward the Kingdom of Glory. Be not dejected, be not grieved. Be like a blossoming flower and like an overflowing wine-vessel.

Subject: consolation and comfort
Quotation: Be not sorrowful, be not grief-stricken, sit not with a bleeding heart. This ephemeral world is not worthy of distress and regret and remorse. Despite this, I hope that circumstances will change and some measure of comfort of heart and soul will be attained. Hardship will be transformed into ease, and difficulty will be changed into comfort and joy.

Subject: consolation and comfort
Quotation: Therefore, be thou not sorrowful, be thou not disheartened, sit not in grief, utter not sighs and lamentations. Be thou an intimate companion to all of them with utmost love and kindness. Show no harshness, display no severity, seek not contention, be not wounded in heart. For they know not and are ignorant; the matter has been made doubtful to them.

Subject: consolation and comfort
Quotation: O handmaid of God! Blessed art thou, for thy son hath attained the presence of the Throne and been honored to meet his Lord...Well is it with thee, O handmaid of God, that God hath brought forth from thee one who hath attained His presence...We send them to thee that thine eyes may be consoled thereby, thy heart may rejoice, thy heart may be gladdened

Subject: consolation and comfort
Quotation: Do not grieve over this...Fear not if this Branch be severed from the earth of the mortal realm that its leaves will fall - nay, the leaves will persist, for this Branch will grow after being cut from the earth and will rise until it overshadows the horizons, and its leaves will reach the highest heights and will yield perfumed fruits to all regions.

Subject: consolation and comfort
Quotation: "Please God, thou wilt attain unto His special favour, and find solace in the remembrance of Him... Be thou in no wise sorrowed, and hold fast, as bidden, unto the cord of patience. He, verily, will make manifest that which shall rejoice the hearts of those who have been afflicted with sorrows by reason of that which the hands of rebellion have wrought."

Subject: consolation and comfort
Quotation: Concerning the ascension of the respected young lady to the Most Glorious Horizon, console her mother that she may find the greatest glad-tidings in this passing, for that bird of faithfulness is continuously engaged in the verdant garden of the Abha Kingdom, with melodies of praise and glorification in sanctification and glorification of the Beauty of Abha.

Subject: consolation and comfort
Quotation: Therefore put your trust in God in all matters, for in Him do His sincere servants place their trust. Soon will God bring about His Cause and make manifest His command and establish His proof. Beware, beware lest you forget God's favor upon you, and grieve not over the world and its constraints. Rather, rejoice in the joy of God, the Most High, the Most Great.

Subject: consolation and comfort
Quotation: but, through the love of His Holiness BAHA'O'LLAH, we, in this intense darkness, are like unto a shining torch, and while in this tempest of calamities, we are turning toward the Kingdom of the Almighty... We do not consider this calamity as billows of the sea of afflictions and sufferings; nay, it is the ark of deliverance and the shore of peace and security.

Subject: consolation and comfort
Quotation: O thou who hast sought refuge from strangers with thy Chosen Lord! Know thou that every shade is darkness save His sheltering shade, and every fruit is bitter save the fruit of His great Kingdom's paradise garden, and beyond every door lies disappointment save the door of His mercy which standeth open before the faces of all who dwell in the heavens and on earth.

Subject: consolation and comfort
Quotation: In any case, your letter was received through Mr. 'Andalib and was read. You had complained about your difficult circumstances and the domination of the people of affliction. This difficulty and hardship is universal in all directions and has befallen most people. There is wisdom in this. God willing, it will pass away. Some patience and forbearance is necessary.

Subject: consolation and comfort
Quotation: However, regarding the friends, I have turned to the Court of Unity and sought the gift of ease and comfort of heart and soul. Likewise, the friends in Paris have written a detailed telegram in this regard, and also the friends in America have written a complete telegram to His Imperial Majesty. Give glad tidings of divine grace and bounty to all the friends of God

Subject: consolation and comfort
Quotation: Know with certainty that you are remembered and witnessed in this gathering and will not be forgotten. Give glad tidings to Inayatu'llah of the divine, hidden favors from the Abha Kingdom, and likewise to other relatives and friends, upon them be the glory of God and the glory of all things. They are under the shadow of His favors and beneath His glances and sight.

Subject: consolation and comfort
Quotation: O thou dear maidservant of Baha! Thy kind mother, like unto a bird whose nest is on some lofty height, hath winged her flight towards her heavenly home in the Abha Kingdom. Be not then afflicted; neither weep nor grieve, neither sigh nor lament...Is it then permissible, O gentle maidservant, to mourn and sorrow, to be consumed with grief by reason of this separation?

Subject: consolation and comfort
Quotation: Cast aside thy sorrows in My name and take the cup of joy through My remembrance. Then drink thereof at eventide and at dawn. By My life! Thy grief hath grieved Me, and that which hath befallen thee in the nights and days. We have been with thee in all conditions, have heard thy call, and have sent down in thy name that which hath illumined the earth and the heavens.

Subject: consolation and comfort
Quotation: O servant of God! You have your hand on the fire from afar - you do not know what is happening. You carry your own grief and sorrow from the specific calamities that have befallen. All the calamities that have befallen you are like a drop, while this year's tempest of tribulation is like an ocean...In any case, do not be sorrowful and grief-stricken from such matters.

Subject: consolation and comfort
Quotation: "Though that sanctified soul has winged his flight to the horizon of glory, praise be to God, he has left you as his worthy successor. Therefore you must arise to serve at the Most Great Threshold with complete submission and contentment, and utmost joy and fragrance...Do not be depressed or distressed by this calamity, and do not be hurt, saddened or grief-stricken."

Subject: consolation and comfort
Quotation: Thus do We teach you the ways of wisdom that ye may be among the triumphant...O Ahmad! Give thanks unto God for having guided thee unto His Self and nourished thee from the freshly-plucked fruits of holiness and brought thee near unto the shore of nearness and caused thee to hear the sweet and holy melodies and accepted thee and thy brother and assisted you both in His service

Subject: consolation and comfort
Quotation: But when we recall the ascension of the Ancient Beauty and the Greatest Name, all of our other troubles will vanish, for deprivation from His sunlike face maketh separation from a shining lamp easier to bear, nay, it dispelleth it from the mind. Although thou art afflicted on account of the calamity that befell thy family and thy son, be patient, forbearing, and long-suffering.

Subject: consolation and comfort
Quotation: Do not be sorrowful and grieved at staying in that land. That is the decree of the Mighty, the All-Knowing. And we are hopeful through the grace of the Blessed Beauty that He will make this toil the cause of greatest rest and this hardship the means of greatest repose. Be confident in His favor, for His grace upon the branches of His Tree is truly great and His kindness truly glorious.

Subject: consolation and comfort
Quotation: Though you are far from home and separated from your family and without shelter or refuge, yet you are safe in the shelter of God and have a dwelling and refuge in the Most Glorious Kingdom. These earthly houses are flimsier than a spider's web - every edifice shall be laid low, but the shelter of God is the most exalted of palaces. Praise be to God that this is attainable and not difficult.

Subject: consolation and comfort
Quotation: He is the Comforter, the Consoler, the Mighty, the Generous... The Divine Lote-Tree remembereth you from the Most Exalted Horizon, and desireth to console its leaves, its branches, its boughs and its fruits in all that hath come upon them through God's irrevocable decree and His destined ordinance... We beseech God - exalted be His glory - to transform the fire of sorrow into the light of joy

Subject: consolation and comfort
Quotation: "O supplicating, assured leaf! Give thanks to the Ancient Being that thou hast entered beneath the shade of the Manifest Beauty, hast drunk from the cup of pure water, and hast tasted the honey of favors and become related to His Holiness the Martyr, son of the Martyr, upon him be the Most Glorious Glory of God. Today thou art mentioned in the Abha Kingdom and renowned in the Supreme Concourse."

Subject: consolation and comfort
Quotation: In the face of the Blessed Beauty's favors, one should not be saddened by any affliction nor frightened by any sound. Whenever the armies of sorrow mount their attack, call to mind those bestowals, that the darkness of grief may be transformed into a radiant moon. Since we have in Him such a loving Friend, and since His Kingdom's bounties are boundless, why then weep and wail, why mourn and grieve?

Subject: consolation and comfort
Quotation: Your esteemed father was present in this gathering and requested this letter. Consider how dear is a father who in this gathering is intimate with your remembrance and familiar with your mention, and who beseeches God for your success. At every moment you should offer a hundred thousand thanks that you have such a loving father and that you are confirmed in the bounty and favor of the Ancient Beauty.

Subject: consolation and comfort
Quotation: Grieve thou not over anything; be thou of such disposition that neither the circumstances of the world nor the words of those who have denied God, the Lord of all religions, should sadden thee... Be not grieved over what hath befallen. That which thou didst perform aforetime for God's sake and didst send forth was accepted before the Throne, though outwardly it came not to pass according to thy wish.

Subject: consolation and comfort
Quotation: Sorrow not, grieve not. Be not unhappy because you are not wealthy. You are the brothers of Jesus Christ. Christ was poor; Baha'o'llah was poor. For forty years he was imprisoned in poverty. The great ones of the world have come from a lowly station. Be ever happy; be not sad! Trust in God and if in this world you undergo dire vicissitudes I hope that in the Kingdom of God you will have the utmost happiness!

Subject: consolation and comfort
Quotation: I beseech God, exalted be His glory, that if He hath, in His wisdom, folded up for a few days the world of meeting, He may at every moment strengthen the world of remembrance and message, that His loved ones may remain informed of one another and be aware of each other's condition. In truth, news of the friends manifests the effects of springtime, for it refresheth the soul and bestoweth freshness upon the body.

Subject: consolation and comfort
Quotation: O ye two believers in God! Although your precious child has passed from this mortal world, yet praise be to God, he lives in the eternal realm. You will find him in the Kingdom of God. Therefore, be not sorrowful or grief-stricken at his passing. This is not death but life, this is not destruction but salvation, for that precious child has hastened to the Kingdom [of Paradise] in the utmost spirituality and radiance.

Subject: consolation and comfort
Quotation: The point is that this grief and sorrow and anguish relates to the friends and loved ones, but that star of guidance, although it has set from the nearest horizon, has risen in the highest horizon... Therefore, do not weep and lament, do not heave burning sighs, and do not pass your time with tearful eyes. Engage in praise of the All-Merciful Lord Who has caused that luminous star to rise and shine in such a clear horizon.

Subject: consolation and comfort
Quotation: In truth, when I imagine the difficulties and tribulations and trials and pains and exile and distress of that blessed leaf, the utmost grief and sorrow results. But O pure leaf, do not be sorrowful...Soon thou shalt behold with grateful eyes the rewards of these hardships and the benefits of these difficulties. Thou art under the eye of His grace and included in the confirmations of His mercy. Be confident and take thy rest.

Subject: consolation and comfort
Quotation: Separation is a calamity greater than passing and death. But Hadrat-i-Fadil, with sincere intention and surpassing love, in complete detachment hastened from Iran to the Holy Land...Now you should feel the utmost joy and gladness from his journey. God willing, he will return victorious and triumphant, and reunion after separation is a hundred thousand times sweeter and more pleasant. Be confident - I think of you more than you do

Subject: consolation and comfort
Quotation: Be not grieved at the calamity that hath befallen thee...Know thou with certain knowledge that this blessed verse was revealed after the ascension of the sons of the Apostle to the Supreme Horizon. That child is and hath been preserved with the true Trustee. God hath made him a treasure for thee, a store for thee, and an honor for thee. He is verily the Most Merciful of the merciful ones and the Most Generous of the generous ones.

Subject: consolation and comfort
Quotation: Those holy souls of the loved ones departed for the kingdom of existence, and those sanctified lights of the world of creation ascended to the limitless expanse of the placeless... Be not heartbroken and disconsolate, for if ye could perceive the true state of the deceased, I swear by the Ancient Beauty, ye would shine with the utmost joy and happiness, for he is in the blessed garden of intercession and imploring for forgiveness.

Subject: consolation and comfort
Quotation: "Your letter was received. Its perusal conveyed the utmost supplication and communion. Your lamentation and cries, in reality effect the hearts, especially the heart of 'Abdu'l-Baha. If you could realize what an effect your letter produced, undoubtedly you would feel assured that the heart of 'Abdu'l-Baha has the utmost attachment to you, and day and night he is supplicating toward the Kingdom of Abha and begs for you confirmation"

Subject: consolation and comfort
Quotation: Bestow patience, moreover, O my God, upon the remaining righteous members of his family and his noble descendents and make Thy loving-kindness a solace to them in this great loss and a source of mercy and peace from this futile mourning and cause them to become the inheritors of his virtues, the keepers of his station, the lights of his remembrance, the waves of his sea, the stars of his horizon and the trees of his verdant garden.

Subject: consolation and comfort
Quotation: You must trust in God and respond with perfect meekness, patience, love, kindness and good conduct. If they draw daggers, you must offer life-giving elixir. If they give deadly poison, you must bestow pure honey. If they permit arrows and spears, you must lavish spirit and fragrance. If they draw daggers, you must offer life-giving elixir. If they inflict wounds to the heart, you must apply salve and become the remedy of heart and soul.

Subject: consolation and comfort
Quotation: O Jamal, upon thee be My glory! Erase the book of sorrows and with fresh clarity reflect on what hath been mentioned. He will open before thy face the gates of joy and gladness, of glory and delight. Verily thy Lord is powerful over whatsoever He willeth through His word "Be" and it is. Take the cup of joy from the hand of the bounty of My Most Glorious Name, then drink therefrom in spite of every caviling liar and every heedless doubter.

Subject: consolation and comfort
Quotation: Therefore, O my Beloved, clothe them with the garments of patience and forbearance, and the vestures of mercy and tolerance, that their eyes may be illumined by Thy fresh mercies, and their hearts be tranquillized by Thine infinite favors. Cause them to enter the rivers of nearness and the cities of reunion, and give shelter to these homeless ones in the precincts of Thy mercy and beneath the pleasant shadows of Thy forgiveness and pardon.

Subject: consolation and comfort
Quotation: Be not sad nor grieved. Do not sorrow, for no man in this world is permanent. You have not lost him. At most, there is now a temporary separation between you. In the Kingdom there will be a meeting. It is precisely like taking a journey. You will meet him. Do not sorrow. You should be comforted. Thus may the spirit of Mr. Chase be pleased with your patience and forbearance. If you were sad, he would be sad, and you would not want to make him sad, too.

Subject: consolation and comfort
Quotation: Grieve not therefore and be not despondent. Enkindle his lamp and strive that the orchard of his highest wish may abound with fruitful trees. Rest thou assured in the bounties of the Lord of Hosts and endeavor to be confirmed by the favors of the glorious Lord. If he has disappeared from this plane, grieve not, for thou shalt find him in the divine realm. Be not sad at this temporary separation, thou shalt enjoy eternal companionship in the realm above.

Subject: consolation and comfort
Quotation: Although the tempest and upheaval were severe, praise be to God the ark of salvation reached the shore of safety, protected and preserved. In this most great tempest and severe upheaval, when all nations of the world were afflicted and fell into grave peril, cities were laid waste, souls perished, possessions were plundered and pillaged, and the sighs of the helpless were raised on every height and the tears of orphans flowed like floods in every valley.

Subject: consolation and comfort
Quotation: Do not be sorrowful, do not be grieved, for that illustrious person, the martyr in God's path, is shining and radiant like the morning star in the horizon of eternal glory. Whenever sorrow and pain arise, reflect upon the exalted stations of that noble soul so that divine joy may appear and spiritual delight may be attained. O daughter of the martyr and piece of his heart! Do not grieve and be not saddened by the calamity of your father who was martyred in the path of Baha.

Subject: consolation and comfort
Quotation: Otherwise those souls who are well-assured rejoice at their departure from this vain-glorious world and are pleased at their deliverance from this dark and narrow world. That luminous ray hath returned to the Sun of Truth, that tiny drop hath reached the Most Great Ocean, and that flower of the divine rose-garden hath been restored to the paradise of the All-Merciful and the garden of the Kingdom of Abha. Therefore, be not grieved and let not thy spirit become extinguished.

Subject: consolation and comfort
Quotation: Grieve not for what hath befallen thee and what hath befallen the loved ones of God. By the life of God! Whosoever hath ascended is recorded among the martyrs in God's Book. Blessed are they and joy be unto them for having turned unto Him and attained martyrdom in the days of the appearance of the Dayspring of their Lord's verses, the All-Knowing, the All-Informed. Be not sorrowful in any matter, but with utmost joy and fragrance speak in remembrance of the Beloved of all possibility.

Subject: consolation and comfort
Quotation: But thou must not grieve over the ascension of that dove of the garden of love to the solitude of the Beloved. That mystic bird hath winged its flight to the eternal garden, and that yearning moth hath soared toward the light of the Supreme Concourse. From the wilderness of deprivation it hastened to the feast of reunion, and from the abyss of separation it attained the center of beauty. As for thee, thou art not left alone. Consider Abdul-Baha as thy representative and guardian in his stead.

Subject: consolation and comfort
Quotation: He was and is with you - grieve not. After sorrow comes joy; be not downcast, for boundless relief follows. In this very world countless doors exist - God willing, they shall be opened by the finger of will, and new worlds shall be witnessed in this world. If thou sittest upon dust, grieve not - the Lord of the Throne is with thee. If thou art hungry, be not sorrowful - the place of heavenly food beholds thee. If thy night is without light, be not downcast - the Dawning-Place of light is present.

Subject: consolation and comfort
Quotation: O servant of the Abha Beauty! It appears that infinite sorrows have encompassed you and you are in the utmost state of dejection and withering, the cause of this grief being the departure of your offspring from this world to another realm. O ancient friend of Abdu'l-Baha! Before the Most Great Calamity, the only son of Abdu'l-Baha ascended to the Abha Kingdom. This servant did not become affected, saddened, or disturbed in any way, even though all the relatives were delighted by his sweetness and charm.

Subject: consolation and comfort
Quotation: O partner of him who has ascended unto God! Be not grieved, for this is an ascension to the highest horizon, not a descent into the layers of dust. It is a rising in the Most Exalted Heaven, not a setting in the dark pit... O Faraju'llah! Although this passing of your father brought you grief and sorrow, for him it was the greatest relief and firmest victory. He became joyful while you became sorrowful; he became grateful while you became grief-stricken. Therefore you too should be glad that he ascended firm and steadfast.

Subject: consolation and comfort
Quotation: Yet I swear by God, besides Whom there is no other God, that the Beauty of the Beloved's favors toward thee have surpassed all love and faithfulness, and His fidelity to those who are related to Him exceeds the faithfulness of all the world. Today thou must manifest complete contentment, submission, joy and delight, being pleased with God's decree and grateful for what He hath ordained, appearing thus among the people, so that through divine favors thou mayest be distinguished from other creatures by lofty and sublime attributes.

Subject: consolation and comfort
Quotation: Whether thou comest or not, God willing, there shall be no shortcoming in what must needs be done. Never imagine that there would be the slightest negligence. If there be any shortcoming, it is due to impossibility... We hope that ultimately, God willing, the means of thy comfort and ease shall be provided. The end belongeth to the God-fearing. Many such difficulties arise, but in the end they become simple and easy, and assuredly it shall be so for thee. Rest assured that the end will be good. The Blessed Beauty is kind and merciful.

Subject: consolation and comfort
Quotation: Multiple letters have been written to his grandfather and father to comfort their hearts. In any case, He said if they wish, staying in Yazd is far better than Shiraz - the choice is theirs. May they have no anxiety whatsoever. Praise be to God, all goes well, and in every case they should beseech God to bring about whatever is best. Though they are obviously in utmost grief, they should console themselves with the mention of Joseph and Imam Musa. The contents of this page should be read in their presence to bring comfort to their hearts.

Subject: consolation and comfort
Quotation: Be well assured of the favours of thy Lord, be resigned unto Him, and cross the ocean in full tranquillity and security. And as for thee, O precious handmaiden of God, be thou assured of healing from every ailment through the power of the Spirit from God. At that time, the clouds of tests shall be dispersed, revealing a light shining brilliantly throughout all existence. These tempests shall pass away and the radiant light shall appear, and thy heart shall find tranquillity through the outpouring of thy Lord's tender mercies, the All-Merciful, the Compassionate.

Subject: consorting with all; being kind; loving to all
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/consorting with all; being kind; loving to all.txt
Quotation: Yes, any outward differences and hostilities are as nothing when compared with harmony and love and unity among men.

Subject: consorting with all; being kind; loving to all
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/consorting with all; being kind; loving to all.txt
Quotation: Mingle with all people

Subject: consorting with all; being kind; loving to all
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/consorting with all; being kind; loving to all.txt
Quotation: when Abdul-Baha inquired the condition and the association of the friends, it was intimated that unlike the days gone by the friends are intimately associating with all the people of every shade and opinion, of every sect, and social standing. "Such is the way that must be adopted, for only through intimate association will the friends be able to teach and sow a seed in the heart of a seeker. The flower must be brought close and near in order to inhale its scent and fragrance."

Subject: consorting with all; being kind; loving to all
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/consorting with all; being kind; loving to all.txt
