Quotation: the joy of these wanderers is not in musicians and singers and players, but rather in enduring hardships, patience in calamities, detachment from all created things, exalting the Word of God and diffusing the divine fragrances

Subject: detachment; severance; renunciation; patience
Quotation: I beseech my Beloved and thy Beloved to clothe thee in the garment of poverty and evanescence, and to crown thee and me with the diadem of lowliness and brokenness at the Threshold before which all necks have bowed in submission.

Subject: detachment; severance; renunciation; patience
Quotation: Despite having an establishment, having first been a chief of ruffians, he abandoned it all and came on foot to Akka... I was bound by everything, I was attached to creation like a bird in a cage. I broke the cage and became free.

Subject: detachment; severance; renunciation; patience
Quotation: Convey eloquent greetings to Jinab-i-Dhabi?, saying: How long will you remain in bonds? Break free so that you may lift up your head and become wise. What you see is bondage, not freedom - a trap, not grain - ruin, not prosperity.

Subject: detachment; severance; renunciation; patience
Quotation: They cast behind them the world, its riches, glory, bounties and pleasures - to this every fair-minded and discerning one bears witness... and upon those whom neither commerce, nor trade, nor wealth, nor glory hath withheld from God

Subject: detachment; severance; renunciation; patience
Quotation: O thou who hast attained to the sanctuary of sanctification and detachment, who hast hearkened unto the pure utterance and counsels of the Lord, and who hast been a companion and intimate of this sorrowful one in these numbered days!

Subject: detachment; severance; renunciation; patience
Quotation: Just as a child will give up a jewel of great price for a sugarplum, so men will exchange the Truth for a treasure of earth. The Bab said, 'One glance from the Eye of Him Whom God shall Manifest is worth all the wealth of the world.'

Subject: detachment; severance; renunciation; patience
Quotation: Cast behind thee all idle fancies, then walk in the way of truth and fear not the insinuations of the sinful ones. Leave that land before the Youth departeth. By God! This is better for thee than the kingdom of the heavens and the earth.

Subject: detachment; severance; renunciation; patience
Quotation: Detachment is as the sun; in whatsoever heart it doth shine it quencheth the fire of covetousness and self. He whose sight is illumined with the light of understanding will assuredly detach himself from the world and the vanities thereof.

Subject: detachment; severance; renunciation; patience
Quotation: the intention is that he must abandon his carnal desires, human sensations, and personal interests, and seek spiritual fragrances and heartfelt attractions, becoming immersed in the sea of sacrifice, attracted to the Most Glorious Beauty

Subject: detachment; severance; renunciation; patience
Quotation: Blessed are the friends of God and His chosen ones who have cast behind them idle fancies and vain imaginings, turning unto the horizon of certitude...By the life of God! Whoso drinketh thereof, nothing whatsoever shall prevent him from God

Subject: detachment; severance; renunciation; patience
Quotation: Cast away what the people possess and take hold of the Book of God with such strength as shall not be prevented by the doubts of those who have disbelieved in the Beginning and the Return. Soar on the wings of detachment in this atmosphere

Subject: detachment; severance; renunciation; patience
Quotation: This is not the day of desires - burn them with the fire of the love of your Lord, the Self-Sufficient, the Most High. And this is not the day of idle fancies - rend their veils asunder by the name of your Lord, the Almighty, the Powerful.

Subject: detachment; severance; renunciation; patience
Quotation: Is there any who will cast aside what what was ordained in creation and hasten with Me in the wilderness of detachment? Is there any possessed of might who will eschew all that is in creation, turning unto God, the Mighty, the Most Praised?

Subject: detachment; severance; renunciation; patience
Quotation: Become trees of oneness and roses and fragrances from the rose bush of detachment...Let each one become a sign of unity and seek detachment and raise high the banner of transcendence - that is, become completely distinguished from all else.

Subject: detachment; severance; renunciation; patience
Quotation: You must renounce this world and all within it, for it is the source of all sin. Do not pause in your journey, for the dog of the Jews is better than the people of the marketplace, and the people of the marketplace are those who stand still.

Subject: detachment; severance; renunciation; patience
Quotation: The companions of the cave were souls who had detached themselves from worldly concerns - those who, through the intensity of their attraction to the divine fragrances and their occupation with the Truth, became wholly unaware of this world.

Subject: detachment; severance; renunciation; patience
Quotation: Blessed is that company who have detached themselves from the world and who gaze toward the horizon of the Will of the Ancient Lord. We beseech God to aid him, that through the light of detachment he may become the cause of unity and concord.

Subject: detachment; severance; renunciation; patience
Quotation: O people of God! Cast aside all else, for He hath come with the truth and hath summoned all to the horizon from which hath shone the Sun of this Revelation... Take the cup of detachment and drink it in the name of the Creator of new creation.

Subject: detachment; severance; renunciation; patience
Quotation: Blessed is the soul who, detached from all else, ariseth to do that which God loveth. We convey Our greetings to the friends in that land--that is, to those souls who are detached from all save God and who are gazing toward the Most Exalted Horizon.

Subject: detachment; severance; renunciation; patience
Quotation: Give thanks unto God for having caused thee to cast off every garment of worldly adornment in favor of a pure garment that is an ornament for the maidservants of the All-Merciful who are believers, who are detached from God and freed from the world.

Subject: detachment; severance; renunciation; patience
Quotation: Quaff the water of life in My name, the All-Merciful, and proffer unto the near ones amongst the inmates of this heavenly garden that which shall cause them to become detached from all names and enter beneath this blessed and all-encompassing shadow.

Subject: detachment; severance; renunciation; patience
Quotation: Blessed is the soul that hath rent asunder the veils and torn away the coverings and turned toward the horizon of God alone. Cast aside suppositions and idle fancies, and take hold of that which ye are commanded by God, the Mighty, the Praiseworthy.

Subject: detachment; severance; renunciation; patience
Quotation: This wine is befitting only to enduring souls and detached hearts, and ever shall be... Strive thou to remain steadfast on the path of divine knowledge and love, and be not deprived of eternal spiritual stations through attachment to ephemeral things.

Subject: detachment; severance; renunciation; patience
Quotation: My God, my God! Grant me to drink from the cup of detachment and intoxicate me with the wine of Thy love in the assembly of manifestation and bestowal. Deliver me from the conditions of self and desire, and free me from the bonds of this earthly world

Subject: detachment; severance; renunciation; patience
Quotation: Pure is thy soul and pure is thy heart, for thou hast become detached from the world of water and clay, hast set thy heart upon another realm...Thou hast cut thy heart loose from attachment to this dust-heap and soared to the heights of the love of God.

Subject: detachment; severance; renunciation; patience
Quotation: I have great hope in the Bounty and Favor of God that you and Mr. Brittingham may be assisted with great power in the service of the Kingdom of God, be freed from different thoughts and attachments, and be wholly enamored with the Beauty of Baha'o'llah.

Subject: detachment; severance; renunciation; patience
Quotation: Today those who have turned to the Qiblih of existence must be sanctified and detached from both the seen and unseen. By My life, whoso attaineth unto His knowledge soareth in the atmosphere of His love and detacheth himself from all who dwell on earth.

Subject: detachment; severance; renunciation; patience
Quotation: O my Lord! Grant me complete detachment from all else save Thee, that I may wholly cling to the cord of Thy bounty and hold fast to the hem of the robe of Thy generosity...O Lord! I long to be detached from all else save Thee and attracted by Thy verses

Subject: detachment; severance; renunciation; patience
Quotation: have forgotten themselves, and have become detached from comfort and rest...Blessed are these souls who have become disappointed with the comfort of this world and familiar with the holy fragrances. They seek another world and pursue the infinite realm.

Subject: detachment; severance; renunciation; patience
Quotation: Baha'o'llah was passing his time in poverty and even his robes and clothes were those of the poor; his food was that of the indigent. The signs of severance were manifest upon him as the sun at mid-day, and he was absolutely careless regarding his life.

Subject: detachment; severance; renunciation; patience
Quotation: "Such souls shall not seek comfort for a moment nor shall they let themselves become entangled with ephemeral adornments. Their only comfort shall be to tread the path of the Well-Beloved, their only embellishments are the bounties of the Blessed Beauty."

Subject: detachment; severance; renunciation; patience
Quotation: in no realm of existence have I seen a self to engage in discourse about...I exist in a realm where I flee from all such thoughts. I know no infallibility except service at the Sacred Threshold and seek no unity except immersion in the ocean of His love.

Subject: detachment; severance; renunciation; patience
Quotation: O my Lord and my Hope! Deliver me from my self and my desires, inspire me to remain firm in my servitude, lowliness and self-effacement, preserve me from pride and arrogance, and through Thy grace and bounty protect me from heedlessness and forgetfulness.

Subject: detachment; severance; renunciation; patience
Quotation: O Muhammad-Mahdi! The Wronged One calleth thee from the precincts of the Prison, and counseleth thee with that which will exalt the Cause of God. Set aside what is with the people, and hold fast unto that which is with God, the Mighty, the Self-Subsisting.

Subject: detachment; severance; renunciation; patience
Quotation: Place not thy reliance upon created things and be not anxious. Behold naught but the face of the Friend, seek no shelter save in the street of the Friend, and inhale no fragrance except the sweet-scented breeze of the Friend. All else is but shell and husk.

Subject: detachment; severance; renunciation; patience
Quotation: O Darvish! Divest thyself from the colour of the world, that thou mayest be adorned with the wondrous colour of the Best-Beloved. O 'Ali! Free thyself from the outward form of creation, that thou mayest ascend unto the placeless Throne of the Ancient of Days.

Subject: detachment; severance; renunciation; patience
Quotation: Thus should it be with those who have believed in God, who have detached themselves from whatsoever is repugnant to His good-pleasure, who have shattered the idols of polytheism through God's power, and who have turned with their hearts toward the holy court.

Subject: detachment; severance; renunciation; patience
Quotation: They have become detached from idols and idolatry and have become intimate companions of the nightingale of inner meanings in the divine garden...they have detached themselves from the world and all who are in it, and have set their hearts upon the divine realm.

Subject: detachment; severance; renunciation; patience
Quotation: Thou hast caused them to be detached from all else besides Thee, that they may recognize Thy sovereignty and acknowledge Thy glory... Send down, therefore, O my God, upon all that seek Thee that which will entirely strip them of all that pertaineth not unto Thee

Subject: detachment; severance; renunciation; patience
Quotation: If thou traversest the vast expanse of the realm of the spirit, surely thou wilt rend asunder the garment of patience and forbearance, become swift in sacrificing thy life, pass beyond the defilement of nothingness and find repose upon the throne of ancient days.

Subject: detachment; severance; renunciation; patience
Quotation: By Thy might, O my Beloved! Though others might flee from tribulations in Thy path, I am the one who longeth for them all in Thy love... I am the one, O my God, who purchaseth with my spirit and my soul all that appeareth from Thee and proceedeth from Thy presence

Subject: detachment; severance; renunciation; patience
Quotation: Reflect upon the Ancient Beauty [Baha'u'llah], Who, with but a single garment, bore the Tablet to His Majesty the Sultan and manifested such power and might that the pen is powerless to describe; yet He held fast with complete detachment, patience and tranquility.

Subject: detachment; severance; renunciation; patience
Quotation: "Were people to know what rank is ordained in this Day for the loved ones of God, they would all detach themselves from all who are in the heavens and on earth" ... "I am he who hath fled from his self and his desires and turned toward the direction of Thy good-pleasure"

Subject: detachment; severance; renunciation; patience
Quotation: But the delivery of the Cause of God depends upon the diffusion of the Fragrances of God, severance from the world, engagement in the commemoration of God in independence of the rich. And the more this is done in the state of severance (from the world) the better it is.

Subject: detachment; severance; renunciation; patience
Quotation: In this day he who seeks the light of the Sun of Truth must free his mind from the tales of the past, must adorn his head with the crown of severance, and his temple with the robe of virtue. Then shall he arrive at the ocean of Oneness and enter the presence of Singleness.

Subject: detachment; severance; renunciation; patience
Quotation: There were loved ones in Baghdad who were in the utmost joy and delight, despite spending their nights with only plain bread. They had a room whose floor was covered with a mat. If plain bread was available at night, they were delighted, as some nights it was not to be had.

Subject: detachment; severance; renunciation; patience
Quotation: Whatever brings thee joy in this world, Think thou upon its separation at that time. Many were gladdened by that which gladdens thee, But in the end fled from it like the wind. Therefore flee thou from it ere it flees from thee, Set not thy heart upon it ere it parts from thee.

Subject: detachment; severance; renunciation; patience
Quotation: When I was a young man I wished to be entirely free, devoting my time to the service of the Cause. My first intention was not to marry...How glorious it would be if man could live for ever in an abstract atmosphere, free, sanctified, pure, unattached, like a disembodied spirit!

Subject: detachment; severance; renunciation; patience
Quotation: "He traversed the valleys and the plains and crossed the rugged grounds and the mountains enduring every toil and affliction... They served Thy sublime Threshold with hearts throbbing with Thy love, tongues uttering Thy praise, tears flowing by reason of being withheld from Thee"

Subject: detachment; severance; renunciation; patience
Quotation: It is as you have written - today my joy and gladness lie in the steadfastness and persistence of the loved ones of God, the attraction of hearts to the divine fragrances, the detachment of souls from the desires of self and passion, and complete connection to the Kingdom of God.

Subject: detachment; severance; renunciation; patience
Quotation: They are not greedy after comfort nor are they seeking flitting pleasures. They are not longing for honor, neither are they chasing the phantasmal pictures of glory and wealth. They are the devotees of the Blessed Perfection and in the utmost state of renunciation and evanescence.

Subject: detachment; severance; renunciation; patience
Quotation: O Ali, leave the kingdom to its seeker, then free thyself from the prison of hopes. Be content with My love, for verily it is better than the treasures of the heavens and earth, than all that was and will be. This indeed is My command unto thee and My counsel to the sanctified ones.

Subject: detachment; severance; renunciation; patience
Quotation: sanctified and holy above the human temperaments, illumined and adorned with the outpourings of severance to the Lord of mankind...sanctified above self and desire, seeking nothing for themselves save severance to God, delivered from the selfish suggestions in the Cause of their Lord

Subject: detachment; severance; renunciation; patience
Quotation: These few days have no significance in the sight of God and His friends. The man of insight will assuredly not defile himself beneath it nor soil his most pure hem. Blessed are they who came with joy and passed with fragrance, and with complete gratitude returned unto the Desired One.

Subject: detachment; severance; renunciation; patience
Quotation: Blessed the man who hath detached himself from all else but Me, hath soared in the atmosphere of My love, hath gained admittance into My Kingdom, gazed upon My realms of glory, quaffed the living waters of My bounty, hath drunk his fill from the heavenly river of My loving providence.

Subject: detachment; severance; renunciation; patience
Quotation: Be thou detached from all things and devote thy powers and time to the spreading of the Faith of God. For this alone shall profit thee, while all else - even were it dominion over the entire earth - shall pass away as a mirage in the desert which the thirsty one imagineth to be water.

Subject: detachment; severance; renunciation; patience
Quotation: "But that which is essential to the acknowledgment of this word is attraction to the love of God, service to the Cause of God, diffusing the Word of God, severance from all else save God, affinity, union and oneness, humility, meekness, nothingness and servitude to the beloved of God."

Subject: detachment; severance; renunciation; patience
Quotation: They seek neither comfort nor pleasure, desire neither glory nor wealth. They are the devoted lovers of the Blessed Beauty who, in utter selflessness and evanescence, wander through mountain and desert, raising the call to the divine Kingdom and becoming the cause of guidance for souls.

Subject: detachment; severance; renunciation; patience
Quotation: "Blessed art thou for having utterly abolished the idol of self and of vain imagination, and for having rent asunder the veil of idle fancy" ... "And the glory be upon you and upon those who have detached themselves from all else and turned with their hearts to this holy and beloved Scene."

Subject: detachment; severance; renunciation; patience
Quotation: The time has come for me to become naked, To leave the body and become entirely soul... This is the teaching for the people of truth and a clear and evident sign that the free must be stripped bare of every garment, meaning they must be freed from every bond and detached from every attachment.

Subject: detachment; severance; renunciation; patience
Quotation: Even so, consider the hearts of them that have detached themselves from all else but God and have turned unto the Mighty, the Well-Beloved. The glory shining from the horizon of grace be upon thee and upon them that have detached themselves from the world and have turned unto the Lord of Names

Subject: detachment; severance; renunciation; patience
Quotation: I beseech Thee by the pearls of the ocean of Thy utterance and the mysteries of Thy Book to assist me in Thy remembrance and praise, and to ordain for me through Thy Most Exalted Pen that which will exalt me amongst Thy servants through Thy Name, and cause me to enter the precincts of Thy great mercy.

Subject: detachment; severance; renunciation; patience
Quotation: If you wish to deliver yourself from evil ones and from all harm, leave the world to its people and never draw near to it. And if you wish to enter the pavilion of grandeur at the dawning of the lights of My beauty, detach yourself from all else save Me and from all who are in the heavens and on earth.

Subject: detachment; severance; renunciation; patience
Quotation: O thou who journeyest! Be not content with transient wealth, nor be gladdened by a borrowed soul. Strive to enter the immortal Kingdom and attain unto the Holy Eternal Beloved. By God! Today naught is accepted save My good-pleasure, and all else besides the subtleties of My Cause is limited and non-existent.

Subject: detachment; severance; renunciation; patience
Quotation: I beseech Thee to make me detached from all else save Thee, holding fast unto the cord of Thy loving providence, steadfast in Thy remembrance and in the service of Thy Cause in such wise that the hosts of denial shall not prevent me from turning unto Thee and clinging to the hem of the robe of Thy generosity.

Subject: detachment; severance; renunciation; patience
Quotation: Turn not thy gaze to the world and whatsoever is therein; soon shalt thou find thyself in a strange place... Say: O my God! I beseech Thee by Thy Most Great Name to make me one of those who have attained unto Thy presence and have hearkened unto Thy call and have detached themselves from all else besides Thee.

Subject: detachment; severance; renunciation; patience
Quotation: "Whoso is for God, God is for him." Blessed art thou and blessed are they who have cast away what they possessed, holding fast unto that which is with God, the Lord of all worlds...Blessed are those souls who have attained unto this most great station and have regarded all else save God as non-existent and null.

Subject: detachment; severance; renunciation; patience
Quotation: We have servants who, were all the treasures of the heavens and earth to be offered unto them, would pay no heed nor turn their gaze from the Most Great Vision. These have passed by the world and its adornments as clouds pass by. Take thou the cup of detachment in the name of thy Lord, the Creator of invention.

Subject: detachment; severance; renunciation; patience
Quotation: Despite his dignity and position, nothing prevented him, and when the oppressors and transgressors demanded that he recant the Word, he refused and sacrificed the precious pearl of his life for the Goal of all the worlds. Indeed, were you to count the martyrs of God in this Cause, you could not reckon their number.

Subject: detachment; severance; renunciation; patience
Quotation: I beseech God to make thee detached from every bond and attachment in this earthly life, that thou mayest don the garment of sanctity in the Most Glorious Kingdom and be purified from the darkness of the natural world and its conditions, aflame with the fire of the love of God and attracted to the divine fragrances.

Subject: detachment; severance; renunciation; patience
Quotation: O Mahdi! Empty thyself of all else save Him, lest sorrow take hold of thee in the contingent world. Be thou in joy and gladness, for soon shall pass away the world and all that is therein, and the Cause shall return to what it was, and naught shall remain save the Face of God, the All-Compelling, the Self-Subsisting.

Subject: detachment; severance; renunciation; patience
Quotation: Let not your hearts be fettered by the material things of this world; I charge you not to lie contentedly on the beds of negligence, prisoners of matter, but to arise and free yourselves from its chains! Look higher than all earthly thoughts; detach ourselves from every material idea, crave for the things of the spirit.

Subject: detachment; severance; renunciation; patience
Quotation: They are free from all attachment to this mortal world; They seek only the Abha Kingdom and they see this mortal world as a dark prison. this earthly home seems to them as a dreadful, dark, narrow place. therefore they long to ascend to the Abha-Kingdom every moment and they hurry to leave this world for the eternal one.

Subject: detachment; severance; renunciation; patience
Quotation: Who draws away from all selfish desire, And raises high the standard of faithfulness That whoever beholds his countenance Is transformed by a single gesture from him That whoever receives his influence Is illumined like a candle from his fire That his very being, without speech or tongue, May guide creation to the Creator

Subject: detachment; severance; renunciation; patience
Quotation: But those souls who have drunk from the brimming cup of "God will render each of them rich through His abundance," though outwardly poor and possessing not a penny, yet they have a flowing treasure in their sleeve, and the kingdom of the placeless beneath their signet ring, and the treasures of the Kingdom concealed within.

Subject: detachment; severance; renunciation; patience
Quotation: When the sun of detachment dawns from the horizon of the heaven of any soul, the fire of desire and craving is quenched therein. Thus doth He Who is the Lord of all men inform you, did ye but know it. He whose sight is illumined by the light of understanding will assuredly detach himself from the world and all that is therein.

Subject: detachment; severance; renunciation; patience
Quotation: Turn thy face toward God, then detach thyself from all else... Then cause me, O my God, to be severed from all that Thy good-pleasure abhorreth... that I may be wholly devoted to Thy love, speaking forth the praise of Thy Self, gazing upon Thy countenance, turning toward the Kaaba of Thy nearness, and detached from all the worlds.

Subject: detachment; severance; renunciation; patience
Quotation: O Nightingale! The purpose is that it be made known to all that from the earliest days the Supreme Pen hath commanded all to sanctification, detachment, and that whereby the Cause is exalted. These sublime words were revealed in the Tablet of Majesty: "Today the helper of the Truth hath been goodly deeds and praiseworthy character."

Subject: detachment; severance; renunciation; patience
Quotation: Be ye detached from the world and whatsoever is therein, and dispose not of the property of others except with their permission. Thus have We sent down aforetime and now from the presence of One mighty and beauteous. Be ye the trustees of God in His lands, such that were ye to pass by cities of gold, your eyes would not turn toward them.

Subject: detachment; severance; renunciation; patience
Quotation: In this mountain I have remained alone, and have come to such a pass that none of those gone before Me have suffered what I have suffered, nor any transgressor endured what I have endured! I render praise unto God and yet again praise Him. I find Myself free from sorrow, inasmuch as I abide within the good-pleasure of My Lord and Master.

Subject: detachment; severance; renunciation; patience
Quotation: But detachment is not about lacking means - rather it is about lacking attachment of the heart... So detachment is about lacking attachment of the heart, not lacking means. When the heart is free and enkindled with the fire of the love of God, all material affairs and physical conditions become a means for developing human spiritual perfections.

Subject: detachment; severance; renunciation; patience
Quotation: Therefore, thou must detach thyself wholly from all else save God and turn thy face toward Him Who hath created the heavens and the earth, submissively, yielding, humbly and meekly at the threshold of Divine Glory, turning unto God, attracted by His lights, enkindled with the fire of His love, and radiant with the light of guidance among all peoples.

Subject: detachment; severance; renunciation; patience
Quotation: "They shall labour ceaselessly, by day and by night, shall heed neither trials nor woe, shall suffer no respite in their efforts, shall seek no repose, shall disregard all ease and comfort, and, detached and unsullied, shall consecrate every fleeting moment of their lives to the diffusion of the divine fragrance and the exaltation of God's holy Word."

Subject: detachment; severance; renunciation; patience
Quotation: He doth fly while they crawl, abject and worm-like, in the bowels of the earth. These are they that have considered the world to be limited to this realm of dust. Ye should be intimates of the mysteries of sacrifice and arise in service to the Abha Beauty. True gladness and joy lieth in detachment and in attraction and yearning for the Kingdom of Glory.

Subject: detachment; severance; renunciation; patience
Quotation: It is incumbent upon you to abandon the world and all that is in it. Indeed, it is the chief of all evils. And in your quest do not linger at any station. Thus a dog of the Jews is better than the people of the marketplace because the people of the marketplace are the people of lingering and this is the source of that negligence which bars access to God.

Subject: detachment; severance; renunciation; patience
Quotation: By My Life! The Most Great Divine Heaven requireth ascending steps that one may tread thereon and attain unto the habitations of imperishable glory and the most exalted holy seats, and may gallop, detached from all else, in this arena. In such wise, rarely are found such temples who mount the wings of detachment and seek ascent unto the heaven of exaltation.

Subject: detachment; severance; renunciation; patience
Quotation: If the whole earth were to be converted into silver and gold, no man who can be said to have truly ascended into the heaven of faith and certitude would deign to regard it, much less to seize and keep it. Such a man will, with his inner eye, readily recognize how altogether vain and fleeting are the things of this world, and will set his affections on things above.

Subject: detachment; severance; renunciation; patience
Quotation: The essence of detachment is for man to turn his face towards the courts of the Lord, to enter His Presence, behold His Countenance, and stand as witness before Him. True reliance is for the servant to pursue his profession and calling in this world, to hold fast unto the Lord, to seek naught but His grace, inasmuch as in His Hands is the destiny of all His servants.

Subject: detachment; severance; renunciation; patience
Quotation: Therefore, if a bird doth at the outset take flight unto the rose-garden of the All-Glorious, it hath indeed traversed the path of salvation and hath drunk from the chalice and cup of a goodly end the wine of bounty. It is hoped that we shall all hasten, at the earliest moment, to the divine realm and be delivered from the constraints and defilements of this heap of dust.

Subject: detachment; severance; renunciation; patience
Quotation: it behooveth thee to detach thyself from all who are in the heavens and earth, from all that hath been and shall be... Strip thyself of all things that the hand of grace may take thee and raise thee to a seat of glorious and beloved might... O Dhabi?! Purify thy sight from all contingent things and whatsoever lieth therein, and from all possibility and whatsoever is thereupon

Subject: detachment; severance; renunciation; patience
Quotation: A perfect man will seek an all-embracing grace, he will rather walk in the path of the just Lord. He will attach his heart to the true morn of God. He will gather round a real light. He will shun all else other than the everlasting beauty. He will seek separation from all entanglement so that he can rise to serve the cause, so that he can sacrifice heart and soul in the path of God.

Subject: detachment; severance; renunciation; patience
Quotation: Counsel him and guide him that he may find some detachment from the entanglements of this mortal world and attachment to this dusty earth, so that his heart and soul may find some rest and relief, and he may turn to God and discover the divine realm of freedom. May he seek the throne of eternal sovereignty in the divine world and become wholly detached from the sovereignty of this world

Subject: detachment; severance; renunciation; patience
Quotation: The meaning of the world of causes is the heedlessness of the servant from the One Who is served, and this hath not been and is not specific to any one thing. Therefore a mighty effort is needed, lest today the veils of glory prevent thee from the Throne of manifestation and independence. Rend thou the veil, then emerge from behind the clouds, and be thou of them that are firmly established.

Subject: detachment; severance; renunciation; patience
Quotation: When man attains to the station of Divine Spirituality, if he pass by a mountain of gold he will not look at it; if he come by a treasure of jewels, it will be like a heap of stones; he will become a luminous candle, he will seek neither fame nor honor, he will become an embodied light. When a person becomes so detached and spiritual he will surely obtain the infinite Graces of the Almighty.

Subject: detachment; severance; renunciation; patience
Quotation: This servant sees himself as evanescent and non-existent before any of His sincere servants, considers himself lowly, and regards any thought of existence as pure polytheism. Given such evanescence and non-existence, how can one imagine stations and ranks? What status does a drop have to speak of its relation to the ocean? What audacity does an atom have to explain its connection to the sun?

Subject: detachment; severance; renunciation; patience
Quotation: My affairs are very strange and very few can understand my motives. For example for the last 2 years and half I have not sent one dollar to my own family to buy clothes with, neither have I bought for them one yard of cloth but I bought just this past winter more than one hundred overcoats for the poor of Acca. One who may hear these things may not believe them but nevertheless they are true.

Subject: detachment; severance; renunciation; patience
Quotation: Glory be unto Thee, O my God! Make Thy servants poor at the manifestation of Thy Revelation, lest riches prevent them from turning toward the seat of Thy throne and the dawning-place of Thine Essence. For in this Revelation I have seen none among the wealthy who would soar in the atmosphere of detachment, enter before the throne of Thy grandeur, acknowledge Thy oneness, walk in the paths of Thy Cause

Subject: detachment; severance; renunciation; patience
Quotation: Keep the mansion of thy heart sanctified from the allusions of all else besides Him, and recite that sublime Tablet during the days and nights, for each time it is read anew, a wondrous effulgence from the lights of the glorious Sun will illumine thy heart. Be thou engaged in the remembrance of the Beloved Beauty in complete detachment, and regard thyself as rich and independent of all else besides Him.

Subject: detachment; severance; renunciation; patience
Quotation: ...the Bird of Oneness hath soared into the atmosphere of holy and luminous sanctity, then detached itself from all who are in the heavens and on earth... And thereby were the hands of the polytheists and the monotheists cut off from this holy and mighty hem... In the flight of this Bird there are signs for them that know, and it guideth all, through this detachment, unto the precincts of a mighty nearness.

Subject: detachment; severance; renunciation; patience
Quotation: O friend! Hear My counsel, then detach thyself from dominion and be as a fire burning in love of thy Lord, such that the words of those who followed the Samiri in their own selves - who were but a limited shadow - might not turn thee back. All that thou beholdest today shall perish, and sovereignty shall remain with God, and those who believe in divine unity shall return to the vicinity of a treasured might.

Subject: detachment; severance; renunciation; patience
Quotation: Let us then exert ourselves with heart and soul, and lift up our voices in a gladsome chorus, that we may become acceptable at the Threshold of Oneness; be made alive by the fragrant breaths of holiness; detach ourselves from whatsoever is of the world; become devoted servants at the threshold of Him Who is the Ever-Living, the Self-Subsisting; be made recipients of His infinite bounty, and attain to everlasting life.

Subject: detachment; severance; renunciation; patience
Quotation: that through it they may purify their souls and rid themselves of all attachment to any one but Thee... I have turned, wholly detached from all things, and cleaving steadfastly unto the cord of Thy gifts and favors... that I may so fix my gaze upon Thee and be so detached from all else but Thee, that the world and all that hath been created therein may appear before me as a fleeting day which Thou hast not deigned to create.

Subject: detachment; severance; renunciation; patience
Quotation: Today the loved ones must aid the Cause through the fear of God. O Zayn! Blessed is the head that is crowned with the crown of detachment and the temple that is adorned with the ornament of godliness. His Holiness the Spirit said to His friends: Strive to be unencumbered and detached in your journeys for the sake of God, cut from all else but Him, and when ye leave any city, endeavor not to carry with you the dust of that land.

Subject: detachment; severance; renunciation; patience
Quotation: Set not your hearts upon this narrow, transient space; soar in the unlimited atmosphere of the spirit, until ye arrive at a station wherein ye shall behold the entire world and its people as non-existent and extinct. God willing, ye must all be adorned with the ornament of detachment, and in this springtime of the All-Merciful be honored with the robe of acceptance, and remain not deprived of the Salsabil of His grace and favor.

Subject: detachment; severance; renunciation; patience
Quotation: Whosoever loves money does not love God and whosoever loves God does not love money. The souls must be detached from the world. Those souls who are attached to this world and its wealth are deprived of spiritual advancement. The believers must live such an independent life that if one comes and begs them to accept money, they should refuse him. As long as the souls are not severed, how do they expect to journey along the ideal path?

Subject: detachment; severance; renunciation; patience
Quotation: Today, whatever we may contemplate while sitting idly shall all prove fruitless and ultimately cause regret and remorse, unless we sacrifice our lives in the path of that Loving Beloved, engage in spreading the verses of sanctification, guide souls to the Most Great Guidance, raise high the banner of the supreme gift, become detached from all else save God, and with hearts attracted, set ablaze and awaken all the people of the earth.

Subject: detachment; severance; renunciation; patience
Quotation: They have, O my God, detached themselves from their own concerns and have appeared among the hosts of creation arrayed in the garments of Thy knowledge. They have given free rein in the arena of wisdom and utterance, have voiced Thy praise at the center of all worlds, have severed themselves from all else but Thee, supplicating before Thee, pleading at Thy threshold, seeking the station of self-effacement, yearning for the field of sacrifice

Subject: detachment; severance; renunciation; patience
Quotation: Beware lest the world and its ornaments occupy you from the remembrance of God, and lest the affairs of sovereignty turn you away from the direction of Him Who was remembered by the name of God. Neither grieve for what hath escaped you, nor rejoice in what ye are given, for the world and all that is therein shall perish, and sovereignty shall remain with God, in Whose grasp is the kingdom of all things, and He, verily, encompasseth all things.

Subject: detachment; severance; renunciation; patience
Quotation: Strange, passing strange! that there was not a breath of self-desire in this person. Wholly divested from all other thoughts and mentions he had consecrated all his time to the service of the Holy Threshold. From the day that he ushered under the shade of the Blessed Tree he forewent every pleasure and cut his heart from every worldly station. He asked for no comfort, he sought no rest, he longed for no fame and he wished no notoriety or name.

Subject: detachment; severance; renunciation; patience
Quotation: He was a dervish; a man who lived free and detached from friend and stranger alike. He belonged to the mystic element and was a man of letters. He spent some time wearing the dress of poverty, drinking the wine of the Rule and traveling the Path, but unlike the other ?ufis he did not devote his life to dusty hashish; on the contrary, he cleansed himself of their vain imaginings and only searched for God, spoke of God, and followed the path of God.

Subject: detachment; severance; renunciation; patience
Quotation: Can one who standeth between earth and heaven be compared with one who remaineth concealed behind veils? Nay, by the Self of God, the Almighty, the Mighty, the Bountiful, if ye but knew. Say: Can one through whom the realities of all things were set ablaze, and in all things was kindled the fire of God, the Almighty, the Mighty, the All-Choosing, be compared with one who is consumed by the fire of self and passion, and is far removed from the shores of nearness?

Subject: detachment; severance; renunciation; patience
Quotation: Otherwise, how many there are who have acted as ye have acted and have sought the glory of God as ye have sought, yet unto this moment they find no way unto that which ye have gained possession of, nor can they find any proof leading to that which God hath opened unto you of His grace. This is your glory with God your Lord, where the exalted angels, and they that glorify, and the cherubim, and the sanctified ones, and they that cry "Holy!" descend into your courtyard.

Subject: detachment; severance; renunciation; patience
Quotation: Today it behoveth each one of the people of God to pass beyond the gulf of names, through divine strength and power, that they may find their way to the Most Great Ocean. Blessed is he who hath turned unto Him and acted according to that which was enjoined in the Book of God, the Lord of the worlds. The glory shining forth from the horizon of the heaven of My mercy be upon thee and upon them that have clung fast unto God, detached from the world and all that is therein.

Subject: detachment; severance; renunciation; patience
Quotation: All the peoples of the world were afflicted with the fire of separation and the flames of expectation, and when the spring of reunion gushed forth through the name of the Self-Sufficient, the Exalted, and the Sun of Meeting dawned from the horizon of the Will of the Lord of Names, all were found to be veiled and deprived save those souls who were truly detached from the diverse colors of the world and its transient manifestations through the name of the Lord of Oneness.

Subject: detachment; severance; renunciation; patience
Quotation: If thou lovest Me, turn away from thyself; and if thou seekest My pleasure, regard not thine own; that thou mayest die in Me and I may eternally live in thee. There is no peace for thee save by renouncing thyself and turning unto Me. If thine heart be set upon this eternal, imperishable dominion, and this ancient, everlasting life, forsake this mortal and fleeting sovereignty. Busy not thyself with this world, for with fire We test the gold, and with gold We test Our servants.

Subject: detachment; severance; renunciation; patience
Quotation: In truth, were anyone possessed of insight to be found, or were anyone of understanding to appear in the world, all that was manifested by them in prison would be a cause for the purification of souls, detachment, and drawing nigh unto God, the Lord of the first and the last. Well is it with him! No matter hindered him and nothing prevented him. He entered prison for the sake of God, remained therein through love of Him, and departed through His Name, the Strong, the Mighty, the Powerful.

Subject: detachment; severance; renunciation; patience
Quotation: O Friend! Strip thyself of the allusions of the people, then adorn thy temple with the raiment of glory resplendent, for We have made thee the herald of Our Cause in that land, that thou mayest convey unto the people that which the Spirit hath inspired in thee from Our presence, and that thou mayest be engaged in a wondrous remembrance. By My Beauty! He in whose heart there remaineth love for aught created between heaven and earth shall never be able to bear this firm, mighty, and exalted Cause.

Subject: detachment; severance; renunciation; patience
Quotation: Separation from the things of the world is a sun. If it shines forth from the horizon of the heaven of any soul, then the fire of selfishness and evil desire will be extinguished; thus informeth you the Possessor of the whole universe, if ye were of the knowing. Verily the one whose self-dedication opens his sight to the light of understanding will be cut wholly from the contingent world and all that is therein: to this beareth witness thy Lord, the Merciful, in this beloved and exalted station.

Subject: detachment; severance; renunciation; patience
Quotation: It is clear and evident that thou hast no attachment to the affairs of this world. A noble person like thee would not set his heart upon this base world nor don tattered garments. He would not relinquish the lofty heights to be content with the lowly depths. He would place upon his head the radiant crown of ancient glory and don the majestic diadem of eternal sovereignty. The wine of this ruined abode is but a mirage, and the pleasures of this ailing realm are hell itself, for they are bound to perish.

Subject: detachment; severance; renunciation; patience
Quotation: Sheikh Murtaza, indeed, was strictly religious... He was trusted and strongly religious. Indeed, he used to work with honesty. No matter how much the people questioned about this Revelation, he answered according to his belief, 'I have not yet investigated this Cause. Go and investigate for yourselves.' The Sheikh never said any unsuitable word... He was such a religious man, he never gathered luxuries, enormous funds were sent him from India, but it was all spent on the poor; nothing was left after his death.

Subject: detachment; severance; renunciation; patience
Quotation: But observe with keen sight and delicate vision that if a fresh date be planted, it will yield no fruit, for it hath not been divested of its outer garment and hath not been detached from whatsoever pertaineth to this world. Yet when the bare and detached stone returneth to the soil of the Lord of Lords, it is therefore blessed with these supreme honors and countless fruits. Therefore, O Mahdi, enter barefoot into the sanctified court of Divine Unity, and purified from all else, arrive at the station of eternal glory.

Subject: detachment; severance; renunciation; patience
Quotation: O my beloved! Be thou detached, be thou attracted, be thou sincere, and expend thy spirit in the path of God. Be thou celestial, spiritual, divine, ethereal, luminous, holy, sanctified, merciful, and steadfast in the Covenant. Be thou articulate, knowing, and gazing toward the Abha Kingdom with a heart throbbing with the love of God, with tears flowing in remembrance of God, with a face radiant with the light of God, with a heart sincere toward the loved ones of God, and with a sword that separateth truth from falsehood.

Subject: detachment; severance; renunciation; patience
Quotation: They must seek His divine good-pleasure and should be wholly detached from this ephemeral world, for attachment to it will plunge man into an intense darkness. The love of this world is the fountain head of every vice and sin. It is the first sin that a soul can commit. No sin is greater than this. Whoever is detached from this world is assuredly near unto God, is a real and sincere Bahai, and whoever is attached to it knows well that he is not a real Bahai, for a real Bahai cannot love this world and cannot be possibly attached to it.

Subject: detachment; severance; renunciation; patience
Quotation: It is said that Kayqubad, in the end of his life, laid the foundation of detachment and sanctification, withdrew from the world, and chose contentment of heart and tranquility of soul in the corner of seclusion and retirement. But you, in the prime of youth, show such manliness - that is to say, be detached in your soul from the world and its peoples while remaining loving and kind in heart and tongue. The essence of retirement and seclusion is that one should have no attachment of heart to this world, but rather seek freedom, tranquility and wisdom.

Subject: detachment; severance; renunciation; patience
Quotation: The exalted steps of those near to God run through barren deserts, enduring a thousand thousand thorns in search of the Friend, while we repose in the shade of passion. By the Spirit of All Spirits and Soul of All Souls, see how that exalted Being and beloved Temple utterly sacrificed and effaced Himself, and how that pure and captivating Spirit gave His life, and how those divine spirits - each of whose bodies was equal to all the spirits of the kingdom of earth and heaven - were sacrificed and effaced in the path of the Friend in countless ways of detachment.

Subject: detachment; severance; renunciation; patience
Quotation: His honor and the other loved ones should repeatedly call the people to patience and forbearance, and not be distressed by the deeds of some. They should fix their gaze upon the horizon of the Cause, not upon the words and deeds of the servants. If, out of wisdom, some matter should appear from the Sovereign Commander, one must hold fast to the cord of patience. This Wronged One beseecheth God to preserve and protect this party, lest some matter should appear that would lay waste the deeds and patience of forty years. No blessing and no food hath a sweetness that prevaileth over the sweetness of patience.

Subject: detachment; severance; renunciation; patience
Quotation: O Musa, upon thee be the Glory of God! In the name of the One Friend - thy letter which expressed the degrees of utter powerlessness, nothingness, complete effacement and absolute non-existence was received in the Most Holy Presence and was accepted. He who acknowledges his powerlessness and confesses his nothingness before the manifestations of the greatness of his Creator is indeed among those who have recognized their Lord and are counted among the successful ones. The soul that has ever been convinced of and confessed to utter powerlessness and complete effacement has been and will continue to be reckoned before the All-Merciful as one of the people of true knowledge.

Subject: development of capacity and readiness
Quotation: "Capacity attracts. The greater your capacity, the more you will be filled."

Subject: development of capacity and readiness
Quotation: Acceptance is not due to capacity or ability. It is therefore evident that acceptance depends upon the favor of GOD and is not according to capacity.

Subject: development of capacity and readiness
Quotation: The Revelation of which I am the bearer is adapted to humanity's spiritual receptiveness and capacity

Subject: development of capacity and readiness
Quotation: if one is not thirsty, no matter how much pure water is available, they will derive no benefit from it

Subject: development of capacity and readiness
Quotation: In truth, that which bears fruit and is the purpose of the creation of beings, they have, praise be to God, attained unto.

Subject: development of capacity and readiness
Quotation: In what condition is the soul before entering the body? In a state of potentiality, possessing no consciousness as we understand it.

Subject: development of capacity and readiness
Quotation: Know that when the seed of guidance is scattered in hardened hearts, it may sprout from a little rain, but since it has no roots, it soon withers and dries up.

Subject: development of capacity and readiness
Quotation: It is clear this girl has great capacity and capability. If she becomes intoxicated from the cup of the love of God she will make much progress, for she has capacity.

Subject: development of capacity and readiness
Quotation: Every human being has a spiritual capacity. Now just as there are various degrees of capacities, likewise there must needs be different modes of expression, various ways of teaching.

Subject: development of capacity and readiness
Quotation: They possess a clear right and true capacity. If you were to write them a letter, it would be an act of grace and fidelity, and if you were to deprive them, it would be cruelty and faithlessness.

Subject: development of capacity and readiness
Quotation: If you pray for soil to become green and verdant, it will be answered, but if you pray for a rock to become a flower garden and meadow, it lacks capacity - the acceptance of prayer is conditional upon capacity.

Subject: development of capacity and readiness
Quotation: Through the grace and favor of the Beloved of all possibility, may your honor be successful at all times in attaining the supreme gift and greatest bounty, which is the recognition of the Manifestation of God's commandments

Subject: development of capacity and readiness
Quotation: It is known that none but the ear of truth can hear the divine melody, and none but the eye of the spirit can behold the countenance of the Beloved. "They have eyes with which they see not, and ears with which they hear not."

Subject: development of capacity and readiness
Quotation: But since its conditions and its prerequisites are mighty indeed, not all things can bear it nor do all creatures have the capacity of reflecting it. They are unable to do so. This trust pertains only to the world of humanity.

Subject: development of capacity and readiness
Quotation: The rain of mercy requires pure soil to bring forth flowers and sweet herbs, and a pure jewel is required to receive the bounty of the sun of the heavens. Otherwise, black earth cannot become the dawning-place of the gleaming pearl.

Subject: development of capacity and readiness
Quotation: The nightingale of the garden of divine mystery is loathed by such as these but the croaking and the cawing of every crow is found acceptable. For as it is stated in the Qur'an [24:26]: "Pure things are for the pure and men of impurity seek impure things."

Subject: development of capacity and readiness
Quotation: They who have been given insight from God - these do recognize the truth and are not prevented by the veils of the polytheists. They behold the lights of the Kingdom even as they behold the sun in the midst of heaven - these are indeed among those drawn nigh.

Subject: development of capacity and readiness
Quotation: "From the radiance of the sun full of light, the blind eye receives nothing but heat." They feel the warmth of the sun but not the effulgence of its rays. Yet there were souls who were gladdened by the glad-tidings of God and attracted by His divine fragrances.

Subject: development of capacity and readiness
Quotation: Discussion of spiritual prerequisites: "For not every fattened cow can prance in the field of the Covenant, and not every broken-winged crow can soar in the heights of recognition. Birds of the holy gardens are needed to warble of the truths of the ancient covenant"

Subject: development of capacity and readiness
Quotation: The entire world has capacity - it just needs teachers. If the world did not have capacity, there would not have been a Revelation. The very fact of Revelation is proof of capacity...Until the body has capacity, the spirit will not be manifested. The very appearance of the spirit is proof of the body's capacity.

Subject: development of capacity and readiness
Quotation: Thank ye God that you have heard the call of the Almighty, beheld the effulgences of the Sun of Truth, inhaled the sweet fragrances of the Paradise of Abha, attained to that which was the utmost hope of the sanctified souls, shone forth from the horizon of the love of God, and tasted the sweetness of the knowledge of God.

Subject: development of capacity and readiness
Quotation: You have entered the world in the day of Baha'o'llah. You have harkened to the summons of Baha'o'llah. You have turned to the kingdom of Baha'o'llah and are manifesting the favors of Baha'o'llah. Verily the light of the Most Great Guidance has become iridescent in your hearts, and in the wilderness of the world you are proving to be fruitful trees.

Subject: development of capacity and readiness
Quotation: In truth, the American people have capacity, greater capacity than the Europeans. The people of America are noble, energetic, spiritually susceptible and keen. That is why the Bahai cause has spread here. Europe is nearer the Holy Land, but America was first to accept the message. No matter how distant a mirror may be from the sun it will reflect as though it were near, but a stone, no matter how near it may be, can never reflect the sun.

Subject: development of capacity and readiness
Quotation: Consider how the sun shines upon all creation, yet its radiance is most powerful upon a pure and sanctified surface. The rays of the sun shine forth, but the black stone receives no portion thereof, the barren soil takes no reflection therefrom, the withered tree finds no nurture from its heat, and the blind eye beholds not its light. Rather, only those with pure eyes can behold the sun, and only verdant trees can benefit from its bounty. Therefore must man acquire capacity and capability, for without these, divine bestowals will find no expression in him.

Subject: devotion; sacrifice; consecration in teaching the Cause
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/devotion; sacrifice; consecration in teaching the Cause.txt
Quotation: They gathered on top of a mountain, and made a pact whereby they would consent to bear tribulations, renounce their comfort, and spread guidance.

Subject: devotion; sacrifice; consecration in teaching the Cause
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/devotion; sacrifice; consecration in teaching the Cause.txt
Quotation: Truly I say this beloved of Abdu'l Baha left his native land, turned his back upon the comforts and pleasures of home, accepted the difficulties of travel, and crossed the Pacific and the Atlantic Oceans.

Subject: devotion; sacrifice; consecration in teaching the Cause
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/devotion; sacrifice; consecration in teaching the Cause.txt
Quotation: Striving meaneth this, that ye should live and move according to the divine counsels and admonitions and be filled with zeal and fervour, that ye should seek no rest and be engaged at all times in service.

Subject: devotion; sacrifice; consecration in teaching the Cause
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/devotion; sacrifice; consecration in teaching the Cause.txt
Quotation: These souls know no rest - they strive night and day to complete the tasks assigned to them... At every breath they have sacrificed a hundred thousand lives and have not rested for a moment upon the pillow of comfort.

Subject: differences between the Manifestations; station of distinction
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/differences between the Manifestations; station of distinction.txt
Quotation: Our Lord said the Muhammadans were accustomed to think Mahomet the greater because of his title "Seal of the Prophets," but in the time of Jesus spirituality and spiritual life was far greater.

Subject: differences between the Manifestations; station of distinction
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/differences between the Manifestations; station of distinction.txt
Quotation: Christ and Baha'o'llah are mentioned as being One in degree of power.

Subject: differences in human capacity
Quotation: [When I first met the wonderful man whom his followers call "Master," I was deeply impressed with the breadth and liberality of his views, and ventured to call his attention to statements of another tenor, which I had seen. He deprecated them unreservedly, and continued:] "They see from their own standpoint. But these people are pure in heart and simple in spirit; therefore, though not intellectually advanced, they are capable of grasping their portion of truth, for truth is for all. They give it out according to their understanding. "

Subject: differences in human capacity
Quotation: The essence today is to partake of the ocean of divine bounties - one should not look at the size of the vessels. One has taken a handful, another a cup, another a pitcher, and yet another a large vessel.

Subject: differences in human capacity
Quotation: Souls differ in their capacity to receive and manifest the Light of the Spirit. The Blessed Perfection said, 'There are as many ways to God as the breaths of His Human creatures.' Each soul must develop according to its individual capacity.

Subject: differences in human capacity
Quotation: Each individual perceives with the faculties peculiar to his own evolution. The Manifestation appeared not for all, but for a few. To the simple, as to the great, he is the same: but some see him in one light, some in another, according to their capacities to perceive.

Subject: differences in human capacity
Quotation: Now the people that one meets, those who are ready become quickened instantly, as it was stated before, that as soon as the wick of the lamp is touched by the fire it is ignited -- those who have a little capacity are developed by degree, but those who have not any capacity are deprived.

Subject: differences in human capacity
Quotation: Some of the attributes of those people possessing this capacity are, for example, devotion, attraction towards God, separation from the world. All food is good, and a gift from God, but we must have the appetite to eat it. Suppose the rain is falling in abundance, no good is done by it in a salt desert which only grows thorns and useless plants.

Subject: differences in human capacity
Quotation: When we consider god has made a stone to be a stone, man to be man, etc., can we say god has shown oppression to a stone, because it is not a man? God has given according to capacity. He has created men with nails and eyes. Can nails say, "I am oppressed because I am not the eye? Can the foot say, "O, God, Thou hast not shown Mercy because I am not the brain?" God has given according to station.

Subject: differences in human capacity
Quotation: The Prophets also confirm this view that education has the utmost effect on human beings, but They state that minds and perceptions also differ in their essence and innate nature, and this is self-evident and undeniable. As we observe, children of the same age, homeland, and gender, even from the same family, raised under the training of one person, nevertheless have different minds and perceptions - one progresses rapidly, another learns slowly, and another remains at the lowest level.

Subject: differences in human capacity
Quotation: there are certain souls whose capabilities are very great, having in themselves the latent power of igniting - As soon as they come in touch with a flame they take fire like a torch - others have but little capability like unto a piece of wet wood - they have the power of enkindling, but it may take some time before the wood is dry enough to light. Other souls are like unto the stones, if a stone is put into the fire for a thousand years it will not burn - it has no capability of lighting.

Subject: differences in human capacity
Quotation: The meaning is that the existence of a heedless person in comparison to the existence of a perfect individual is like being nonexistent. In brief, all souls exist, but the existence of the heedless and the ignorant in comparison to the existence of the perfect and the wise is like nonexistence. The intention of this discourse is that both the ignorant and the wise possess existence, but the existence of the ignorant is like that of a stone, while the existence of the perfect individual resembleth the existence of man.

Subject: differences in human capacity
Quotation: With regard to differences in character that are inherited, they arise from the strength and weakness of man's constitution, that is, if the parents are of weak constitution then the children will be likewise, and if they are strong then the children will also be robust. Moreover, the excellence of the bloodline exerts a major influence, for the goodly seed is like the superior stock that exists likewise among plants and animals. For example, you see that children born of a weak and sickly mother and father will naturally have a weak constitution and nerves, will lack patience, endurance, resolution, and perseverance, and will be impulsive, for they have inherited the weakness and frailty of their parents.

Subject: disregarding individual capacity; weakness
Quotation: Do not look to your own capacity and worthiness, but rather trust in the favors and confirmations of the Blessed Beauty, for that eternal bounty makes a plant into a blessed tree, and makes a mirage into cool water. It makes a lost particle into the essence of existence, and makes a non-existent ant into a scholar in the school of knowledge. From thorns He causes roses to grow, and from black soil He brings forth precious, fragrant flowers. He turns stone into rubies of Badakhshan, and fills the sea shell with brilliant pearls.

Subject: disregarding individual capacity; weakness
Quotation: From the bounty of this mighty century and the favors of the Manifest Beauty this is not far-fetched. Look not to thine own capacity; rather, consider the divine bounty that can transform a drop into an ocean and make of a gnat a Solomon. He can cause an Ethiopian Bilal to excel over a Qurayshi chief, and make a Qurayshi Abu Lahab assume Ethiopian features. This is not difficult for God.

Subject: disregarding individual capacity; weakness
Quotation: Do not look upon thyself and thine own capacity...Do not look upon thine own incapability.

Subject: disregarding individual capacity; weakness
Quotation: One must not look at one's self, for the more he does this, the more he sees his faults and feels guilty and useless.

Subject: disregarding individual capacity; weakness
Quotation: Do ye not look upon your own capability and merit...Therefore in this glorious Cause we must not consider our own capabilities but rather expect the Graces of God.

Subject: disregarding individual capacity; weakness
Quotation: if a weak ant should arise with firm resolve, profound effort and mighty endeavor to promote the Faith of God, the ranks of the hosts of the Kingdom will, like an impregnable edifice, support him

Subject: disregarding individual capacity; weakness
Quotation:
True friends are even as skilled physicians, and the Teachings of God are as healing balm, a medicine for the conscience of man. They clear the head, so that a man can breathe them in and delight in their sweet fragrance. They waken those who sleep. They bring awareness to the unheeding, and a portion to the outcast, and to the hopeless, hope. Wherefore, look not on the degree of your capacity, ask not if you are worthy of the task: rest ye your hopes on the help and loving-kindness, the favours and bestowals of Baha'u'llah -- may my soul be offered up for His friends!   AB00128
In truth, in all matters and conditions, keep in view that blessed verse which states: Look not upon the creatures and their actions, but upon God and His sovereignty.

Subject: disregarding own capacity in teaching the Cause
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/disregarding own capacity in teaching the Cause.txt
Quotation: Do not say you have not capacity; look to the great bounties of Baha'o'llah. One seed becomes a big harvest, a small seed a big tree, one wave an ocean. He makes the dark dust a beautiful garden. This is His power.

Subject: divine grace, bounty, confirmations; spiritual capacity
Quotation: Divine confirmations and rewards in teaching the Cause - "from all directions unlimited divine confirmations are evident and heavenly favors have encompassed the Persians"

Subject: divine grace, bounty, confirmations; spiritual capacity
Quotation: O thou who lovest God, rest assured of the grace and bounty of the Blessed Beauty, and be gladdened by the glad-tidings of God. Verily, great is thy Lord's favor unto thee.

Subject: divine grace, bounty, confirmations; spiritual capacity
Quotation: The glance of favor has encompassed and will continue to encompass you. Your ultimate spiritual and inner aspirations will be fulfilled through divine assistance and grace.

Subject: divine grace, bounty, confirmations; spiritual capacity
Quotation: Praise be to God, with your own eyes ye have witnessed the brilliant lights of divine confirmation, and the fragrant breeze from the Concourse on High perfumes your senses.

Subject: divine grace, bounty, confirmations; spiritual capacity
Quotation: I beseech God that He may bestow upon thee gladness of heart and soul and tranquility of conscience, that thou mayest become the cause of joy and comfort to others as well.

Subject: divine grace, bounty, confirmations; spiritual capacity
Quotation: He hath verily protected thee and protected him whom thou didst desire... Soon will His Cause be exalted in truth and His mention elevated between the heavens and the earth

Subject: divine grace, bounty, confirmations; spiritual capacity
Quotation: Rest assured that the escort of divine favor will reach thee, the lights of confirmation will shine forth, and the angels of the Abha Kingdom will grant victory and triumph.

Subject: divine grace, bounty, confirmations; spiritual capacity
Quotation: If the hosts of divine might and power lend their aid, it will become clear and evident that all the sects, governments and peoples of the world are as an army put to flight.

Subject: divine grace, bounty, confirmations; spiritual capacity
Quotation: Do not be amazed at this - if you remain firm and steadfast and do not falter in tests, know with certainty that you will be confirmed and successful in attaining this bounty.

Subject: divine grace, bounty, confirmations; spiritual capacity
Quotation: I will pray for you, that confirmation may be your companion and mighty reinforcement may descend, but only on condition that you become the cause of joy to the honored uncle.

Subject: divine grace, bounty, confirmations; spiritual capacity
Quotation: 'Abdu'l-Baha will supplicate and beseech at the Threshold of Grandeur with utmost satisfaction at your endeavors and efforts, and will seek new confirmations for you every day.

Subject: divine grace, bounty, confirmations; spiritual capacity
Quotation: When thou wouldst treat patients, turn thy heart to the Abha Kingdom and seek reinforcement. Divine confirmations will reach thee and unfailing assistance will become manifest.

Subject: divine grace, bounty, confirmations; spiritual capacity
Quotation: I beseech God to assist the unitarians with the hosts of His grace, to bring forth the vanished standards, and to raise high the lowered banners. He is the Mighty, the Powerful.

Subject: divine grace, bounty, confirmations; spiritual capacity
Quotation: I will supplicate and implore in the divine Kingdom and seek heavenly confirmations for you. Rest assured that you will be confirmed...and be certain that you will be confirmed

Subject: divine grace, bounty, confirmations; spiritual capacity
Quotation: When divine confirmation arrives, this becomes simple and easy... When one engages in teaching with perfect wisdom, confirmations will arrive and all stations will be attained.

Subject: divine grace, bounty, confirmations; spiritual capacity
Quotation: The lights of confirmation are shining from the Kingdom [of Abha], and the hosts of divine success are continually arriving from the Supreme Horizon. Be thou assured and certain.

Subject: divine grace, bounty, confirmations; spiritual capacity
Quotation: Hear once again the Call from the Lote Tree beyond which there is no passing, raised up upon the white earth: "Verily there is no God but I, the Truth, the Knower of the unseen."

Subject: divine grace, bounty, confirmations; spiritual capacity
Quotation: Whenever I send some one to serve the Cause I pray in his behalf and God will help you. Rest thou assured that I will be with you and you will be enabled to render great services.

Subject: divine grace, bounty, confirmations; spiritual capacity
Quotation: Ere long thou shalt witness how the confirmations of the Kingdom and divine assistance shall course through the arteries of the body of the world even as the spirit flows therein.

Subject: divine grace, bounty, confirmations; spiritual capacity
Quotation: If this be so, know thou of a certainty that such a brilliant light will illumine thy brow that, like unto the manifest morn, thou shalt become bright and radiant and resplendent.

Subject: divine grace, bounty, confirmations; spiritual capacity
Quotation: Through the bounty and generosity of the Sovereign of existence, we hope that thou wilt be fresh and verdant at all times through the breezes of the favors of the All-Merciful Lord

Subject: divine grace, bounty, confirmations; spiritual capacity
Quotation: confirmations of the Holy Spirit and Lord of the dawning mentioned as source of spiritual qualities; "its meanings were from the confirmations of the breathings of the Holy Spirit"

Subject: divine grace, bounty, confirmations; spiritual capacity
Quotation: make them intimate companions with the fragrances of the gardens of Your Abha Kingdom... Bestow abundantly the Holy Spirit's grace and freely grant the power of the Faithful Spirit

Subject: divine grace, bounty, confirmations; spiritual capacity
Quotation: Whatever you desire will be made possible and the means of joy will be prepared. The great bounty of the Glorious Lord is continuous and the favors of the Generous God are perpetual.

Subject: divine grace, bounty, confirmations; spiritual capacity
Quotation: "The hosts of divine assistance stand ready in the Celestial Concourse, and the battalions of assistance and brigades of might are mobilized to fight and contest in the Abha Kingdom"

Subject: divine grace, bounty, confirmations; spiritual capacity
Quotation: These effects that you see are not only the result of addresses but are due to the assistance of the Blessed Beauty. It is indeed the confirmations of the Blessed Beauty that aid us.

Subject: divine grace, bounty, confirmations; spiritual capacity
Quotation: The text promises divine support to those who hold fast to the Covenant: "the hosts of the Most Glorious Kingdom will support you, and the legions of the highest horizon will aid you"

Subject: divine grace, bounty, confirmations; spiritual capacity
Quotation: It is incumbent upon us to pray, and God confirmeth whomsoever He willeth in whatsoever He willeth. Assuredly this steadfastness attracts divine confirmations and draws forth success.

Subject: divine grace, bounty, confirmations; spiritual capacity
Quotation: Thus commandeth thee the Pen of the Ancient of Days in this dawntide... that He may aid thee with a power and might from Himself, and render thee victorious over all people of iniquity

Subject: divine grace, bounty, confirmations; spiritual capacity
Quotation: We seek divine confirmation for her in all conditions...Verily He is with His loved ones in all conditions and He is the Guardian of the sincere ones, the steadfast, the trusting ones.

Subject: divine grace, bounty, confirmations; spiritual capacity
Quotation: And if you are in fear, then do what is necessary in the path of the Cause, for God aids whom He wishes by His decree... And I see by God's power not an atom's weight of fear in myself

Subject: divine grace, bounty, confirmations; spiritual capacity
Quotation: Thy letter was like the mirror in which were reflected the pictures of Divine Confirmations. Pure intention is the magnet of heavenly assistance and the means of attracting Great Power.

Subject: divine grace, bounty, confirmations; spiritual capacity
Quotation: At all times I am expecting to hear that you have become more attracted to the Kingdom of God, more enkindled with the fire of God's love, and have been the cause of guidance to others.

Subject: divine grace, bounty, confirmations; spiritual capacity
Quotation: The springtime of the All-Merciful hath appeared and by it the trees have been verdant. That which no one can reckon save God, the All-Knowing, the All-Wise, hath been ordained for you.

Subject: divine grace, bounty, confirmations; spiritual capacity
Quotation: "Soon, in every world of the divine worlds, its fruits and ears of corn shall appear" "The spring rain of the All-Merciful's mercy is ever-descending and flowing from the clouds of grace"

Subject: divine grace, bounty, confirmations; spiritual capacity
Quotation: I swear by the Most Great Name - may my spirit be sacrificed for His loved ones - that the hosts of the Abha Kingdom will confirm you and the angels of the Supreme Concourse will assist you

Subject: divine grace, bounty, confirmations; spiritual capacity
Quotation: Today the Holy Spirit confirms the steadfast ones and the Spirit of Truth grants success to the firm ones. Through divine power you will gain such utterance that all will remain powerless.

Subject: divine grace, bounty, confirmations; spiritual capacity
Quotation: I, too, with perfect spiritual love, beseech heavenly confirmations for thee, that thou mayest receive a portion of God's infinite bounty and obtain a share from the treasures of the Kingdom.

Subject: divine grace, bounty, confirmations; spiritual capacity
Quotation: O kind One! Grant them shelter and security under Thy protection, preserve them from tests and trials, send them invisible help and confer upon them the doubtless bounty, O Thou kind Beloved!

Subject: divine grace, bounty, confirmations; spiritual capacity
Quotation: be assured that you will be assisted by the confirmations of the Holy Spirit and supported in this service...Whoever arises for this service will receive the confirmations of the Holy Spirit.

Subject: divine grace, bounty, confirmations; spiritual capacity
Quotation: It is certain, and beyond doubt, that the Hosts of the Kingdom of ABHA will help you, the Angels of the Supreme Concourse will confirm you and the Breaths of the Holy Spirit will empower you.

Subject: divine grace, bounty, confirmations; spiritual capacity
Quotation: Behold the divine bounty which has not been and will never be confined within limits. God guides whomsoever He willeth and bestows from His all-encompassing bounty upon whomsoever He desireth.

Subject: divine grace, bounty, confirmations; spiritual capacity
