Quotation: My hope is that in this stream of the garden of guidance, through the outpourings of the clouds of grace and nestled in the embrace of the favors of the One True God, thou wilt grow and develop

Subject: divine grace, bounty, confirmations; spiritual capacity
Quotation: These armies are attacking and these stars are pelting the people of negligence... The cloud of divine bounty is pouring down and the sun of heavenly gifts is shining and bestowing abundantly.

Subject: divine grace, bounty, confirmations; spiritual capacity
Quotation: But a steadfast soul shall obtain the confirmation of the Kingdom of Abha, and partake of eternal life, and like unto the morning star shall scintillate on the horizon of the world forevermore.

Subject: divine grace, bounty, confirmations; spiritual capacity
Quotation: Verily, God will confirm thee by a spirit on His part... Verily, by God, the Truth, the Holy Spirit confirmeth every maidservant who becomes attracted by the Fragrances of God in this Covenant.

Subject: divine grace, bounty, confirmations; spiritual capacity
Quotation: They that have forsaken their country for the purpose of teaching Our Cause - these shall the Faithful Spirit strengthen through its power. A company of Our chosen angels shall go forth with them

Subject: divine grace, bounty, confirmations; spiritual capacity
Quotation: By God! The Holy Spirit will confirm thee, the Faithful Spirit will assist thee, the hosts of the Supreme Concourse will render thee victorious, and the cohorts of the near angels will help thee.

Subject: divine grace, bounty, confirmations; spiritual capacity
Quotation: Do you realize that God's mercy has encompassed your condition without any request on your part? Eternal fortune has knocked at your door - open it and welcome it with the utmost joy and gladness.

Subject: divine grace, bounty, confirmations; spiritual capacity
Quotation: Then shall you witness that the gates of the Kingdom are opened wide, the lights of the Sun of Truth are shining bright, and the confirmations of the Most Glorious Kingdom follow one after another.

Subject: divine grace, bounty, confirmations; spiritual capacity
Quotation: If thou become firm and steadfast in the love of God, thou shalt be confirmed with a confirmation whereby thy face will be gladdened, thy heart rejoiced and all thy family will be happy and pleased.

Subject: divine grace, bounty, confirmations; spiritual capacity
Quotation: Therefore, since thou hast received the rays from the Sun of Truth, thou wert deserving of this bounty, and since thou hast found illumination from the Candle of Providence, thou wert a moth of love.

Subject: divine grace, bounty, confirmations; spiritual capacity
Quotation: That which thou hast asked from Him in His path has already been granted to you. In this way we have made descend for thee a great spiritual banquet from the clouds of heaven of the Mercy of the Lord.

Subject: divine grace, bounty, confirmations; spiritual capacity
Quotation: Although the body was remote, the spirit was near. I hope from the Bestowals of the Lord of Hosts, His Highness the Promised One to crown thy voyage with success like unto the voyages of Peter and Paul

Subject: divine grace, bounty, confirmations; spiritual capacity
Quotation: The text emphasizes the essential unity of seemingly different aspects: "We make mention of the Tablet at times as the Written and at other times as the Preserved, and they are one and the same station"

Subject: divine grace, bounty, confirmations; spiritual capacity
Quotation: Such is my hope, that in this stream of the rose-garden of guidance, through the outpourings of the cloud of favors, thou wilt grow and develop in the embrace of the loving-kindness of the One True God.

Subject: divine grace, bounty, confirmations; spiritual capacity
Quotation: to give Thy loved ones to drink, from the hand of Thy bounty, the Kawthar of Thy favors, that the attraction of this pure wine may so transport them that the onslaught of Thy enemies may not frighten them

Subject: divine grace, bounty, confirmations; spiritual capacity
Quotation: When you call on the Mercy of God waiting to reinforce you, your strength will be tenfold. Remember not your own limitations; the help of God will come to you. Forget yourself. God's help will surely come!

Subject: divine grace, bounty, confirmations; spiritual capacity
Quotation: Be confident in the favors and bounties of the Abha Beauty. By God the Truth, verily they surge like the surging of seas and flow like the flowing of torrents and rivers, O ye who are firm in the Covenant.

Subject: divine grace, bounty, confirmations; spiritual capacity
Quotation: He offers supplications and entreaties on your behalf and seeks infinite divine confirmation so that you may remain firm and steadfast in the Cause of God and receive an boundless portion of divine bounty.

Subject: divine grace, bounty, confirmations; spiritual capacity
Quotation: His divine help and assistance have enveloped us and the confirmations of the Abha Kingdom have surrounded us. All confirmations encircle those who are engaged in rendering services to the court of oneness.

Subject: divine grace, bounty, confirmations; spiritual capacity
Quotation: Be thou assured with the utmost certainty that thy Lord will assist thee to attain the greatest bounty in existence for the people of prostration. Verily, this is the great bestowal and the manifest triumph.

Subject: divine grace, bounty, confirmations; spiritual capacity
Quotation: Now I beseech for you the outpourings from the divine realm and seek the illumination of heavenly bestowal, so that you may draw near to the divine threshold and increase in progress day by day in all things.

Subject: divine grace, bounty, confirmations; spiritual capacity
Quotation: O Lord! Aid them through Thy holy angels and enable them to serve Thy Cause...Ordain for them every good thing that Thou didst ordain for the holy women of former ages and the celestial women of past centuries.

Subject: divine grace, bounty, confirmations; spiritual capacity
Quotation: We are in Paris, and having risen with God's bounty and the confirmation of the Lord of the first and the last, we are enabled to respond briefly, for the press of important matters does not permit elaboration.

Subject: divine grace, bounty, confirmations; spiritual capacity
Quotation: At all times I am gladdened by remembering you and I beseech divine favors and assistance that you may become the recipients of His aid and be embraced by the bounties of Him Who is the Hidden Bestower of favors.

Subject: divine grace, bounty, confirmations; spiritual capacity
Quotation: and that unto thee and thy kindred a blessing of God shall come, and that thou mayest remain protected and sheltered under all conditions. Thus, may thy weakness be changed to strength and thy inability to power.

Subject: divine grace, bounty, confirmations; spiritual capacity
Quotation: Indeed in those regions the banners of the verses are raised high and the loved ones of God, attracted and wise, are engaged in mighty services and are intimate companions with the confirmations of the Abha Kingdom.

Subject: divine grace, bounty, confirmations; spiritual capacity
Quotation: I beseech Thee... that Thou write down for me from Thy Most Exalted Pen that which shall cause me to speak Thy remembrance and to gaze toward Thy direction and to act according to what Thou hast revealed in Thy Book

Subject: divine grace, bounty, confirmations; spiritual capacity
Quotation: Through the Graces of God I implore confirmation for Mrs. Boyle, Mrs. Haney, Miss Little, Leone Barnitz, Mr. Gregory and Miss Martha Root... These revered souls draw confirmation from the breaths of the Holy Spirit.

Subject: divine grace, bounty, confirmations; spiritual capacity
Quotation: Now, praise be to God, that ocean of bounty has surged again and the whale of divine favors has roared. The glance of God's grace has encompassed that lineage and the light of divine gifts has shone upon their faces.

Subject: divine grace, bounty, confirmations; spiritual capacity
Quotation: Today the Euphrates of mercy is flowing, the gate of grace is opened, and the heaven of inner meanings is adorned with the stars of utterance...We beseech God to aid thee and draw thee nigh unto Him in all conditions.

Subject: divine grace, bounty, confirmations; spiritual capacity
Quotation: guidance is a divine bestowal and a heavenly bounty, and "God guideth whom He willeth unto the straight path." Therefore, at every moment offer thanksgiving that thou hast been assisted by the favors of the one true God

Subject: divine grace, bounty, confirmations; spiritual capacity
Quotation: We make mention of you and draw you nigh and give you to drink from the hand of My bounty that encompasseth the worlds. We have accepted what ye desired in the path of God and have sent down concerning that clear verses

Subject: divine grace, bounty, confirmations; spiritual capacity
Quotation: "Glory be to the One who strengthened them with the banners of the greatest signs! Glory be to the One who supported them with mighty power! Glory be to the One who reinforced them with hosts from the Supreme Concourse!"

Subject: divine grace, bounty, confirmations; spiritual capacity
Quotation: Whosoever ariseth to aid our Cause God will render him victorious over ten times ten thousand souls, and, should he wax in his love for Me, him will We cause to triumph over all that is in heaven and all that is on earth.

Subject: divine grace, bounty, confirmations; spiritual capacity
Quotation: divine confirmations are attracted through steadfastness in the Cause, diffusion of divine fragrances, service to the believers, humility before the chosen ones, self-effacement, supplication, universal love, and obedience

Subject: divine grace, bounty, confirmations; spiritual capacity
Quotation: Praise be to God that thou art assisted in the service of the world of humanity and art the manifestor of divine Confirmations; for the service in which thou art engaged is the magnet which attracts the heavenly assistance.

Subject: divine grace, bounty, confirmations; spiritual capacity
Quotation: Even with freedom and having the means, without divine confirmation no work succeeds. But with His confirmations, success is achieved without means - enemies become friends, and proud souls with bowed necks become prostrate.

Subject: divine grace, bounty, confirmations; spiritual capacity
Quotation: Dost thou know what bountiful favours have assisted thee? The lamp of thy heart was kindled by the torch of guidance and thou inhaled the fragrance of the garment of the divine Joseph. What graciousness, what bounty is this?

Subject: divine grace, bounty, confirmations; spiritual capacity
Quotation: the glances of the eye of the All-Merciful encompassed thee from thy tenderest years, and divine gifts surrounded thee while thou wert still a nursing babe in the cradle of childhood, drinking from the milk of [divine favors]

Subject: divine grace, bounty, confirmations; spiritual capacity
Quotation: I hope that through the boundless favors of the Blessed Beauty, vitality and vigor may once again be attained in this feeble frame. Rest ye assured of the favors of the Desired One, for confirmations shall arrive successively.

Subject: divine grace, bounty, confirmations; spiritual capacity
Quotation: O Lord! ... open before him the doors of success, overshadow him with clouds of prosperity, make him a source of comfort to souls and a spirit to those hearts which have been revived by the joyous breezes in the world of forms.

Subject: divine grace, bounty, confirmations; spiritual capacity
Quotation: Abdul-Baha loves you with heart and soul and will seek confirmation and success for you from the Abha Kingdom, that you may become a brightly burning candle throughout and shine as a brilliant star from the horizon of guidance.

Subject: divine grace, bounty, confirmations; spiritual capacity
Quotation: Thus have We given you to drink of the choice wine of immortality from the hands of the loving-kindness of your Lord, the All-Merciful, that ye may arise to remember Him amongst His servants and to serve Him amidst His creation.

Subject: divine grace, bounty, confirmations; spiritual capacity
Quotation: Today the penetrative power in the world of existence is the confirmation of the Kingdom of Abha. Every plan and system which is assisted by this power will be established in the world of humanity and will be realized among men.

Subject: divine grace, bounty, confirmations; spiritual capacity
Quotation: By God, the Truth, you will be assisted by a numerous army, and re-inforced by a cohort of the angels of God... for verily the Holy Spirit will confirm you by the breaths of the True One in all cases and under all circumstances!

Subject: divine grace, bounty, confirmations; spiritual capacity
Quotation: I implore God, glorified and exalted be He, to confirm thee in thy tender age and the softness of thy youth with that wherewith He hath confirmed the mightiest of men and the most distinguished souls at the pinnacle of perfection.

Subject: divine grace, bounty, confirmations; spiritual capacity
Quotation: Thank thou God that He hath provided such a means for thee that by divine aid, heavenly confirmation, merciful intention and heavenly power thou mayest arise to serve, so that thou mayest see wonderful signs and marvelous results.

Subject: divine grace, bounty, confirmations; spiritual capacity
Quotation: Praise to be God! By the bounty and favor of the Blessed Perfection, amid such great confusion and severe whirlwind of calamities and severe oppression, these distressed ones were in safety and rest. No distress came upon any one.

Subject: divine grace, bounty, confirmations; spiritual capacity
Quotation: I swear by Him round Whom circle the Concourse on High that all the atoms of created things, with the tongue of the Kingdom, offer praise and glorification unto thee, and from the Abha Kingdom they seek confirmations on thy behalf.

Subject: divine grace, bounty, confirmations; spiritual capacity
Quotation: Confirmations would pour forth and then My voice would be raised. [BahÃ¡'u'llÃ¡h] wrote, 'Arise to further My Cause, and to exalt My Word amongst men. We are with you at all times, and shall strengthen you through the power of truth.'

Subject: divine grace, bounty, confirmations; spiritual capacity
Quotation: I swear by the Ancient Beauty, may my spirit be sacrificed for His sincere loved ones, that today the loved ones of God are confirmed with a bounty that is the ultimate hope of those drawn nigh and the final desire of the monotheists

Subject: divine grace, bounty, confirmations; spiritual capacity
Quotation: I swear by the bounty of God's wisdom that if they win this great prize, the members of the Tarbiyat School will be admitted to the assemblage of God, and that unto them, beyond a peradventure, the portals of His grace will open wide.

Subject: divine grace, bounty, confirmations; spiritual capacity
Quotation: "Consider what the bounties and loving providence of the Ancient Beauty have accomplished and what the gifts of the Most Great Name have achieved...Great is your blessedness because of this bounty O ye maidservants of the All-Merciful"

Subject: divine grace, bounty, confirmations; spiritual capacity
Quotation: And as for the director of the school, his honor Aqa Mirza Ruhu'llah - I hope that the divine spirit will give him such strength that he may sacrifice his life in managing the school and be accepted and beloved in the divine presence.

Subject: divine grace, bounty, confirmations; spiritual capacity
Quotation: O Lord! Through them open the doors of hearts, subdue the regions of souls, spread abroad the signs of unity, manifest the tokens of divine confirmation, and make them brilliant lamps, conclusive proofs, shining stars, and abundant rain.

Subject: divine grace, bounty, confirmations; spiritual capacity
Quotation: we were deprived of portion and share, Thou didst bestow upon us a portion from the Great Bounty; we were astray, Thou didst guide us; we were thirsty, Thou didst give us to drink; we were debarred, Thou didst made us privy to the mystery

Subject: divine grace, bounty, confirmations; spiritual capacity
Quotation: Abdul-Baha is at all times remembering you with infinite love and kindness and supplicates assistance and favor, at the Threshold of Oneness, so that the invisible confirmation may pour down, the divine bounties unveil their countenances

Subject: divine grace, bounty, confirmations; spiritual capacity
Quotation: praised be God, the sweet savors of the love of the Lord were inhaled from the rose-garden of inner meanings...Thank God that through the gracious favor and mercy of the Blessed Beauty, the hearts and souls are in close union and constancy

Subject: divine grace, bounty, confirmations; spiritual capacity
Quotation: Those souls who are free from every bond and have received the baptism of the Holy Spirit are inspired by divine inspirations at the time of utterance. This is why He says, Take no thought when speaking; express whatever enters your heart.

Subject: divine grace, bounty, confirmations; spiritual capacity
Quotation: God willing, may you be blessed through divine grace with the outpourings of the True Bestower... Give thanks to God for having remembered you before His presence and revealed for you that whereby your mention shall endure throughout creation

Subject: divine grace, bounty, confirmations; spiritual capacity
Quotation: God will verily assist thee with the Spirit of truth and the power of the kingdom...Rest assured that the grace of thy Lord is with thee, and that the spirit of power will enable thee to spread abroad the sacred and sweet savours of thy Lord.

Subject: divine grace, bounty, confirmations; spiritual capacity
Quotation: But in these travels, such was the shoreless ocean of Baha'u'llah's loving providence that by following one thread of discourse I found the whole weave and design falling into my hands. Every where I turned the doors were flung wide before me

Subject: divine grace, bounty, confirmations; spiritual capacity
Quotation: Regarding the assistance you wrote about, you have sent funds to Paris, Chicago, New York and Washington for the publication of literature. This is most acceptable. Such good works and charitable deeds become the cause of divine confirmations.

Subject: divine grace, bounty, confirmations; spiritual capacity
Quotation: "Assuredly the Blessed Perfection is with such souls. They shall see with their own eyes the Confirmations of BAHA'O'LLAH, just as I saw them when addressing large gatherings in churches and temples. I saw them hovering like the birds of Paradise!"

Subject: divine grace, bounty, confirmations; spiritual capacity
Quotation: The favors of the Kingdom of God are great, the attention and bounties of the Blessed Beauty are fixed upon you and His hidden hosts are assisting you. Therefore, we must arise in servitude so that His confirmations may surround us from all sides.

Subject: divine grace, bounty, confirmations; spiritual capacity
Quotation: Rest assured, however, that a bounty unspeakably glorious shall be conferred upon you. Until you have consummated your work, if all the darts of an unbelieving world be directed against you, they will be powerless to hurt a single hair of your head.

Subject: divine grace, bounty, confirmations; spiritual capacity
Quotation: Verily, by the Lord of Hosts, thou wilt find thyself in the Kingdom surrounded by favors on the part of thy Lord, the Praiseworthy, and the angels of mercy will herald to thee glad-tidings which are the greatest gift from the King of the All-Loving.

Subject: divine grace, bounty, confirmations; spiritual capacity
Quotation: Whensoever thou desirest to explain and expound a passage from the Holy Bible, turn thy face toward the Divine Kingdom, supplicate for assistance, and then immediately open thy lips. Undoubtedly the confirmations of the Spirit will descend upon thee.

Subject: divine grace, bounty, confirmations; spiritual capacity
Quotation: It is clear and evident that the power of the Kingdom is aiding thee, that the glances of the eye of His loving-kindness are turned toward thee, the hosts of the Supreme Concourse are helping thee, and the power of the Holy Spirit is supporting thee.

Subject: divine grace, bounty, confirmations; spiritual capacity
Quotation: God's favor hath encompassed and continues to encompass that spiritual friend. Repeatedly have They stated that whatever intensity and tribulations befell the faithful companions, their opposite shall soon appear from the dawning-place of God's favor.

Subject: divine grace, bounty, confirmations; spiritual capacity
Quotation: God willing, ye shall be always under the protection of the Truth. In your behalf, I seek favor and bounty from the Blessed Beauty. They may rest assured that the safety, protection, confirmation and assistance of the Blessed Beauty shall reach them.

Subject: divine grace, bounty, confirmations; spiritual capacity
Quotation: We make mention of thy son Mahdi who desired to drink from the ocean of the utterance of his Lord, the All-Knowing, the All-Informed. Remember him on My behalf and give him the glad-tidings of My loving-kindness which hath preceded all created things.

Subject: divine grace, bounty, confirmations; spiritual capacity
Quotation: O servant! Open thy tongue in utterance, for the Holy Spirit will assist those who in these days convey unto the people the Cause of their Lord, the Powerful, the Mighty, the All-Knowing. This hath been decreed in truth within sealed tablets of glory.

Subject: divine grace, bounty, confirmations; spiritual capacity
Quotation: The light shining from the horizon of the heaven of My Kingdom be upon him and upon those who are with him, who love him, and who hearken unto his words for the sake of God, the Lord of the Throne and of the dust, the Lord of the Last and of the First.

Subject: divine grace, bounty, confirmations; spiritual capacity
Quotation: Rest assured that when you arise to serve the Cause, you will find the doors of confirmation opened wide, and all the peoples of the earth cannot prevent your success, for when one arises to serve the Kingdom, one abides under divine protection and care.

Subject: divine grace, bounty, confirmations; spiritual capacity
Quotation: And I see clearly the Confirmation of the Kingdom of Baha'u'llah soaring above the heads of the friends like unto an imperial Bird of Paradise and His invisible Army are constantly assisting us and coming over us like unto the tumultuous waves of the sea.

Subject: divine grace, bounty, confirmations; spiritual capacity
Quotation: Praise be to God that the heavenly Confirmations and the Breaths of the Holy Spirit are thy supporters and helpers and the Bestowals of His Holiness Baha-o-llah the vanguards of thy army. Therefore in whichever city thou didst enter thou didst become victorious.

Subject: divine grace, bounty, confirmations; spiritual capacity
Quotation: The pearl-scattering clouds of the Supreme Kingdom are pouring down their bounties, and the limitless ocean of the Lord is bestowing its gifts. The life-giving breeze of divine favors is wafting, and the heat of the Sun of Truth is shining with utmost brilliance.

Subject: divine grace, bounty, confirmations; spiritual capacity
Quotation: Through the grace of the Ancient Beauty, deem nothing strange nor remote. Through His favors, the shell becometh a pearl, stone and rock turn into precious gems, dust taketh on the glory of the pure spirit, and the sand of the desert becometh the ruby of Badakhshan.

Subject: divine grace, bounty, confirmations; spiritual capacity
Quotation: O my kind and glorious Lord! Bestow upon us Thine assistance and vouchsafe Thy confirmations. We are chilled; Thou art an ocean of fire. We are withered; Thou art a life-giving breeze. Send down, then, upon us a breath of Thy bounties and a fragrance of Thy favours.

Subject: divine grace, bounty, confirmations; spiritual capacity
Quotation: And do Thou ordain for me that which Thou didst ordain for Thy trusted ones, them that have quaffed the celestial Wine of Divine Inspiration from the chalice of Thy Bounty, them that have hastened to follow Thy Desire, and have guarded Thy Covenant and Thy Testament.

Subject: divine grace, bounty, confirmations; spiritual capacity
Quotation: O Lord! Strengthen me with a power from Thee and a might from Thy presence that I may be enabled to serve and worship Thee... Be a support to them in resisting the people of tyranny and a refuge for them when the hands of oppression and hostility are stretched forth

Subject: divine grace, bounty, confirmations; spiritual capacity
Quotation: their brilliant traces will remain eternal and everlasting in all worlds, even in the lowest realm which is this earthly plane of dust, and the star of their noble deeds will shine forth from the horizon of contingent being like the lights of the realm beyond place.

Subject: divine grace, bounty, confirmations; spiritual capacity
Quotation: We beseech God that He may keep those illumined hearts alive and fresh at all times through the breaths of the spirit and fragrant breezes...At all times you are stirred by the breezes of grace, and in all conditions you are made fresh and verdant by the rain of mercy.

Subject: divine grace, bounty, confirmations; spiritual capacity
Quotation: How often a detailed book has the significance of one word, and how often one word has the significance of infinite books and volumes...Every family that becomes the recipient of divine providence receives wondrous blessings, spreads throughout all regions of the earth

Subject: divine grace, bounty, confirmations; spiritual capacity
Quotation: Glory be to Him Who hath distinguished His servants and handmaidens in the days of God with the most great gifts and favors, and made them dawning-places of light and daysprings of mysteries and recipients of inspiration on the day when He came in the shadows of verses.

Subject: divine grace, bounty, confirmations; spiritual capacity
Quotation: His bounties emanating from His presence are around us ever more and the waters of His grace are constantly poured forth. The gates of His mercy are wide open and the cup of His bounty brimmeth over. His blessed tree is laden, and His sacred orchard replete with fruits.

Subject: divine grace, bounty, confirmations; spiritual capacity
Quotation: This was purely through divine confirmations, otherwise there was no document in hand...Despite this, through the confirmations of the Beloved of the horizons and the success granted by the Luminary of Dawn, the morning of victory arose and the Sun of bounty shone forth.

Subject: divine grace, bounty, confirmations; spiritual capacity
Quotation: Verily the sun of permission hath dawned from the horizon of thy Lord's will, the Perspicuous, the All-Knowing, the All-Informed...Then the Sun of Divine Permission shone forth from the Dayspring of Will, as may be understood from that which the All-Merciful hath revealed.

Subject: divine grace, bounty, confirmations; spiritual capacity
Quotation: The sweet fragrance from the rose-garden of truth has perfumed your nostrils, and the rays of the Sun of the All-Merciful have enlightened your eyes. This heavenly bestowal is precious indeed, for it leads the soul to the Beloved and guides the thirsty to the boundless ocean.

Subject: divine grace, bounty, confirmations; spiritual capacity
Quotation: I swear by that Luminary of the horizon of sanctity that if anyone today, whether male or female, arises to kindle the fire of the love of God in hearts, divine assistance and victory will surround them from all directions to such a degree that they themselves will be astonished

Subject: divine grace, bounty, confirmations; spiritual capacity
Quotation: The servant present read thy letter. Praise be to God, the fragrance of steadfastness and the sweet-scented breeze of love were inhaled therefrom. We beseech God to ordain for thee the good of this world and the next, and to exalt thee through His Name in the kingdom of creation.

Subject: divine grace, bounty, confirmations; spiritual capacity
Quotation: At every moment I seek assistance and grace for you, and bounty and blessing, that the confirmations of Baha'u'llah may surge over you like an ocean, that the lights of the Sun of Reality may shine upon you, that you may be successful in service and become manifestations of bounty.

Subject: divine grace, bounty, confirmations; spiritual capacity
Quotation: Rest assured that the confirmations of the Blessed Beauty (BAHA'O'LLAH) will ever come to your assistance and will ever encompass you. On your behalf I pray at these Sacred Spots and beg for ye assistance and confirmation. Rest ye assured that ye are under His sheltering protection!

Subject: divine grace, bounty, confirmations; spiritual capacity
Quotation: And verily I know, O my God, that when Thou hast sent down upon anyone Thy greatest bounties, Thou hast not withheld from him anything less except for what Thou knowest - which none other than Thee knoweth - that naught would be suitable for him save what Thou hast ordained for him.

Subject: divine grace, bounty, confirmations; spiritual capacity
Quotation: Praise be to God, you observed how divine assistance appears at the crucial moment, and like a piercing meteor strikes the band of mischief-makers. Abasement and wretchedness were struck upon them, and they drew upon themselves the wrath of God, and the future belongs to the righteous.

Subject: divine grace, bounty, confirmations; spiritual capacity
Quotation: The candle of guidance is lit and the light from the realm on high adorns every assemblage. The showers of grace are pouring down and the bestowals of the kingdom of the unseen are abundant. The angelic call is raised and the birds of the heavenly gardens are singing the Psalms of David.

Subject: divine grace, bounty, confirmations; spiritual capacity
Quotation: Today is the day of divine confirmations and heavenly aid. Whosoever turns to the Abha Kingdom and, detached from all else, travels the spiritual path, reads the Hidden Words and acts according to them, let him be assured that he will be victorious and triumphant, confirmed and assisted.

Subject: divine grace, bounty, confirmations; spiritual capacity
Quotation: Those souls who have become subservient to the will of God as manifested in the life and teachings of BAHA'O'LLAH must know of a certainty that they attract unto themselves heavenly confirmation and assistance. Now, existence upon the Sacred Threshold is a magnet whereby aid is attracted.

Subject: divine grace, bounty, confirmations; spiritual capacity
Quotation: "O ye who seek! The portal of the Most Great Gift is opened wide, and the outpourings of the cloud of Supreme Mercy are manifest. Turn ye unto your hearts that ye may become the manifestations of the confirmations of the Beloved Lord and the dawning-places of the favors of the Desired Beauty"

Subject: divine grace, bounty, confirmations; spiritual capacity
Quotation: Say: No soul believeth save by God's leave -- of them some are settled and some are deposited, and God will confirm in the hearts of them that believe in God and His signs their faith, and will make them steadfast, and will make His believing servants to be of them that are firm in that religion.

Subject: divine grace, bounty, confirmations; spiritual capacity
Quotation: Among them is he who intended to spread Thy sweet fragrances in those parts... Assist them all in what Thou lovest and art pleased with, and make him not despairing of Thy mercy. Illumine his brow with the light of guidance and gladden his heart with joy and glad-tidings at every moment and instant.

Subject: divine grace, bounty, confirmations; spiritual capacity
Quotation: He beholds the services of the friends and thanks them with gratitude for their hardships and troubles... The Holy Spirit shall confirm thee. O thou beloved maidservant of God! With heart and soul I am with thee. Rest thou assured. Thou shalt be assisted in such wise that you will stand astonished.

Subject: divine grace, bounty, confirmations; spiritual capacity
Quotation: This indeed is a token of God's infinite bestowal, and it is the abounding grace and blessing of the Lord of Hosts that ye have eventually attained unto the Reality. This Reality is the Ark of salvation, it is heavenly enlightenment, it is life eternal, and it is the confirmations of the Holy Spirit.

Subject: divine grace, bounty, confirmations; spiritual capacity
Quotation: May divine power confirm you. Therefore, I beseech from the favors of Baha'u'llah that He may bestow upon you a heavenly power so that you may guide souls and bring those who are deficient to the station of perfection, make the blind seeing, and bestow eternal life upon those who are spiritually dead.

Subject: divine grace, bounty, confirmations; spiritual capacity
Quotation: And these bestowals cannot be manifested in human reality except through the divine celestial power and heavenly teachings, for it requires a force beyond nature, and in the world of nature an example of these perfections is possible but unstable and ephemeral, like the reflection of the sun upon a wall.

Subject: divine grace, bounty, confirmations; spiritual capacity
Quotation: I give thee the glad tidings that when thou returnest to thy homeland, the hosts of the Concourse on high will assist thee with power and dominion. God will cast into thy heart that which shall cause thee joy throughout all eternity, and will make thee speak in such wise that thou thyself shalt be amazed

Subject: divine grace, bounty, confirmations; spiritual capacity
Quotation: From ancient bounty and new bestowals which continuously arrive from the invisible Kingdom of the Most Glorious, mayest thou, God willing, receive an abundant portion, gain an unlimited share, and obtain an unbounded blessing. The glance of favor is all-encompassing and the outpouring of bounty is perfect.

Subject: divine grace, bounty, confirmations; spiritual capacity
Quotation: Strengthen them through Thine ancient glory and exalt them in Thy glorious Kingdom, and aid them with the hosts of Thy bounty in this great Day... Raise up their banner, increase their protection, spread abroad their traces, and increase their lights until they become as a lamp for the light of Thy bounties

Subject: divine grace, bounty, confirmations; spiritual capacity
Quotation: This is purely divine bounty - be thankful that you have attained to it. It is hoped that day by day you will draw closer to the Kingdom of Baha'u'llah, become more enkindled with the fire of the love of God, receive a greater portion of the Holy Spirit's breaths, and I beseech divine confirmations for you.

Subject: divine grace, bounty, confirmations; spiritual capacity
Quotation: Be you assured by the grace of your Lord, let your breast be gladdened by what He has bestowed upon you, let your spirit be refreshed by His unveiling of the veil, let your eyes be consoled by witnessing the light of His bounty, speak forth the Most Great Word, and commune with your Lord morning and evening.

Subject: divine grace, bounty, confirmations; spiritual capacity
Quotation: The hosts of God's Kingdom are at work. Armies are of two kinds: one stationed in garrison and one engaged in the battlefield. But the army of God's Kingdom is engaged in battle, arraying its forces. Word has arrived from America with details - the celestial army is in battle, victorious and breaking ranks.

Subject: divine grace, bounty, confirmations; spiritual capacity
Quotation: Just as He says, the heavenly hosts and the confirmations of the Blessed Beauty arrived consecutively. Whichever direction we turned, the doors were open. We were amazed. In cities we had never seen, among people with whom we had no familiarity - even if kings were to go there, they would receive no attention.

Subject: divine grace, bounty, confirmations; spiritual capacity
Quotation: Praise be to God that the lights of providence have dawned and shone forth from the Most Glorious Horizon, and the outpourings of divine mercy from the clouds of grace and bounty are continuous and abundant. The eye of divine providence encompasses the friends, and the flood of favors flows from right and left.

Subject: divine grace, bounty, confirmations; spiritual capacity
Quotation: I will pray in their behalf and supplicate for them the Confirmations of BAHA'O'LLAH; thus just as the rays of the sun pour upon all the contingent beings, likewise the Effulgences of the Sun of Reality may so interpenetrate every fibre of their beings that each one of them may become like unto a fruitful tree.

Subject: divine grace, bounty, confirmations; spiritual capacity
Quotation: Praise be to God, through the grace and favor of the Blessed Beauty, since the divine friends conducted themselves in accordance with the divine teachings, they remained protected and preserved. Not a speck of dust settled upon anyone, and this is a mighty miracle that none but every aggressive sinner would deny.

Subject: divine grace, bounty, confirmations; spiritual capacity
Quotation: The blessing hath been perfected, the mercy hath preceded, and might and power have encompassed all. As observed, from every soul wafted even a trace of love, it attained the supreme grace; it brought a drop and received an ocean in return. Whether a star appeared or not, the grace of the Sun was manifest and evident.

Subject: divine grace, bounty, confirmations; spiritual capacity
Quotation: The Ancient Beauty and the Most Great Name - may my spirit be a sacrifice for His loved ones - hath opened before thy face the gate of the Kingdom and showered upon thee heavenly grace, that thou mayest be nurtured beneath the shadow of His bounty and favor, become a sign of divine bestowal and a manifestation of infinite favors.

Subject: divine grace, bounty, confirmations; spiritual capacity
Quotation: Baha'o'llah was with us. We are always confident that he is with us, no matter where we are. Although the trip was fraught with a great many troubles, yet God guided us to take the direct line. God protected us. God assisted us. The providence and protection of Baha'o'llah were with us. God has protected us under all circumstances.

Subject: divine grace, bounty, confirmations; spiritual capacity
Quotation: The steadfast soul becomes like unto a flourishing plant, and the firm individual becomes the manifestation of the outpourings of the highest heaven. These are the angels of divine confirmation, the angels of heavenly success, the angels of mercy, the angels of bestowal, the angels of inspiration, the angels of certitude and assurance.

Subject: divine grace, bounty, confirmations; spiritual capacity
Quotation: It is this penetrating force and conquering power that gives victory to a humiliated people over the most mighty nations and makes the most civilized nations defeated by the most ignorant tribes of the world. Therefore, except through divine power and heavenly confirmations, every thought is impossible and every attempt mere imagination.

Subject: divine grace, bounty, confirmations; spiritual capacity
Quotation: If they desire tremendous progress in as a short time as possible they must get gold of this spiritual potency, thus reforming and changing all the various branches of their institutional life. This is of course a slow progress and as I told you, they must get hold of this Celestial Power. Then you will observe their magical advancement.

Subject: divine grace, bounty, confirmations; spiritual capacity
Quotation: O Lord! Unite the ranks of those who have held fast unto Him and recognized Him, gather their scattered forces, organize their assembly, make their affairs easy, and untie the knot that hath befallen their affairs. Make all things possible unto him and facilitate every difficulty, through Thy mercy, O Thou Ever-Living, Ever-Forgiving One!

Subject: divine grace, bounty, confirmations; spiritual capacity
Quotation: He is the One Who gazeth from His Most Glorious Horizon. We aided thee with the hosts of love and affection until thou didst attain the presence of the Wronged One in His mighty prison, and beheld the Dawning-Place of thy Lord's verses, and heard His sweetest call, and stood before a door which was opened unto all who are in earth and heaven.

Subject: divine grace, bounty, confirmations; spiritual capacity
Quotation: I beseech Thee by the lights of Thy countenance and the revelations of Thy power that Thou aid whosoever hath turned unto Thee and sought Thy grace...O my Lord! I beseech Thee by Thy most exalted attributes and the manifestations of Thy glory in the Kingdom of eternity that Thou aid whosoever hath turned unto Thee and arisen to serve Thy Cause

Subject: divine grace, bounty, confirmations; spiritual capacity
Quotation: Those who have wronged thee - God will surely seize them with His authority from His presence and will aid thee with the truth. He, verily, is the Powerful, the All-Choosing. Despair not of God's mercy, then act according to what thou wast commanded before. He will grant thee that which will gladden thy heart and the hearts of the loved ones.

Subject: divine grace, bounty, confirmations; spiritual capacity
Quotation: Praise be to God that thou hast been and art remembered in the presence of the Wronged One. Today the brocade of the Book of Divine Favor is adorned with this blessed word that was revealed aforetime: "Whoso is for God, God is for him." The Wronged One beareth witness that thou hast attained unto this most exalted station and this supreme summit.

Subject: divine grace, bounty, confirmations; spiritual capacity
Quotation: If there is fairness, this matter alone suffices - that in the great church of London, before five thousand people, it was proven that all their thoughts were wrong and the prophethood of all the Prophets was established. When I would attend these churches, although I was unwell, I would see the confirmations of the Blessed Beauty surging forth.

Subject: divine grace, bounty, confirmations; spiritual capacity
Quotation: In Baha'i philosophy, luck is the same as divine confirmation, which is ceaseless and continuous, never subject to interruption or suspension. It is not limited to some to the exclusion of others. Showers of divine bounty and confirmation are always falling; if any spot experiences a suspension or delay, other areas shall receive these effusions.

Subject: divine grace, bounty, confirmations; spiritual capacity
Quotation: This beam is a gift from the Blessed Beauty which will forever shine forth from the Dawning-Place of the Morn of Oneness, manifest and visible. A hundred thousand women were submerged in the sea of regret, yearning to witness a single ray, but the beam of favor fell upon thy brow and enabled thee to achieve this mighty victory and manifest bounty.

Subject: divine grace, bounty, confirmations; spiritual capacity
Quotation: Praise be to God that through the Favors and Bounties of the Blessed Perfection the means of Happiness are prepared for you. Render ye thanksgiving unto Him for at a time that the whole world is submerged in the sea of war, lamentation and tribulation you are being protected and preserved and are joyous and happy through the emanations of the Kingdom.

Subject: divine grace, bounty, confirmations; spiritual capacity
Quotation: I beseech from the unbounded grace that the fragrances of the love of God may ever waft over the illumined heart of that true friend and become the cause of spiritual joy and gladness...and this servant will supplicate with utmost humility, submission, powerlessness and contrition at the Court of the Self-Sufficient, seeking confirmation and assistance

Subject: divine grace, bounty, confirmations; spiritual capacity
Quotation: Look not through human power, but rather place thy reliance upon divine confirmations, which can transform the hardest rock into a precious gem and black soil into a delightful garden. Today divine confirmation is confined to those souls who arise to serve and engage in teaching the Cause of God and in protecting the impregnable fortress of the Lord of Mercy.

Subject: divine grace, bounty, confirmations; spiritual capacity
Quotation: The hand of mercy took hold of thy hand and delivered thee from the abyss of eternal loss, and the light of grace shone upon thy countenance and made thee bright and illumined. The melody of the divine herald reached thine ears and the voice of the Evil One was cut off. The cup of bounty made its rounds and the gathering of the All-Merciful became intoxicated.

Subject: divine grace, bounty, confirmations; spiritual capacity
Quotation: Turn thy heart in all days toward the court of God, thy Lord, with sublime humility, that the breezes of grace may waft over thee and the breathings of holiness may take hold of thee from the direction of a mighty throne. By God, besides Whom there is none other God! A single breath thereof excelleth whatsoever hath been created between the heavens and earths.

Subject: divine grace, bounty, confirmations; spiritual capacity
Quotation: Through God's infinite bounty and His pre-existent mercy, that spiritual friend has attained unto it. Praise be unto Him, again praise be unto Him, for having sent down to His loved ones from the heaven of His generosity the feast of His knowledge. Verily, He is the Beloved in His actions and the One to be obeyed in His command, and He is the Mighty, the Powerful.

Subject: divine grace, bounty, confirmations; spiritual capacity
Quotation: I have prayed on thy behalf that thou mayest become the minister of the Temple of the Kingdom and the herald of the Lord of Hosts...that in all thy affairs that thou mayest become inspired by the Breaths of the Holy Spirit, and that thou mayest become so illumined that the eyes of all the ministers be dazzled by thy brilliancy, and may long to attain to thy station.

Subject: divine grace, bounty, confirmations; spiritual capacity
Quotation: now drink of the pure wine which floweth from the Fountainhead of the Supreme Pen. Blessed are ye for having attained this supreme bounty...For God Himself maketh mention of you in words that cannot be equaled by all that is in the heavens and on earth...The eternal bounty and manifest blessing rained down upon them from the heaven of divine Will like a copious rain.

Subject: divine grace, bounty, confirmations; spiritual capacity
Quotation: Confirmation is not dependent on talent, knowledge or wisdom. Many unimportant persons have made significant discoveries. Many people labored for years to explore the North Pole but Admiral Peary reached it. Because Columbus found confirmation, he discovered America with a minimum of difficulty. So it is evident that everything comes about through the assistance of God.

Subject: divine grace, bounty, confirmations; spiritual capacity
Quotation: O friends of Abdu'l-Baha! I swear by the Ancient Beauty that such a confirmation has been ordained in the Kingdom of existence as cannot be imagined. The hosts of divine confirmation and inspiration are marshalled in the Abha Kingdom, waiting for someone to arise in the arena of true understanding, so that these armies and hosts may instantly render victory and support.

Subject: divine grace, bounty, confirmations; spiritual capacity
Quotation: When the confirmation of the Holy Spirit descendeth, ye are not a drop, but a roaring sea! The hosts of the Kingdom of ABHA are drawn and filed up in battle-array on the plain of the Supreme Apex and are expecting that a band of volunteers step upon the field of action with the intention of service; so that they may assist that band and make it victorious and triumphant.

Subject: divine grace, bounty, confirmations; spiritual capacity
Quotation: We should not look at our present powers and capacities. We should fix our eyes instead on the bounties of the Kingdom and be determined to contribute our share. Even if a mote of dust is infinitely small and insignificant yet shall it shine even as a star when the rays of the sun light on it. Even if a drop is brief and limited yet may it be connected to the sea of seas.

Subject: divine grace, bounty, confirmations; spiritual capacity
Quotation: O thou who standeth in My service, who maketh mention of My praise, and uttereth My command! Throughout the nights and days thou hast dwelt secure and at rest beneath the canopy of loving-kindness. Time and again hath mention been made of thee, and that which hath streamed from the Pen of submission, contentment and steadfastness hath been dispatched unto the Most Holy Court.

Subject: divine grace, bounty, confirmations; spiritual capacity
Quotation: We have chosen thee through Our knowledge and related thee unto Ourselves as a mercy from Our presence and a bounty recorded in the Book. We are indeed cognizant of all things. And thy Lord shall soon give thee in the next creation that which shall satisfy thy heart, then thy spirit, then thy soul, then thy body, then whatsoever pertaineth unto thee through thy Lord's bounty.

Subject: divine grace, bounty, confirmations; spiritual capacity
Quotation: As for the fruits of your efforts: the greatest fruit is the good-pleasure of the Lord, which is the foundation of eternal glory. The second fruit is the illumination of heart and soul, which is the greatest divine gift. The third fruit is renown in East and West, which will be manifested in the future. The fourth fruit is that your book will find many seekers in the future.

Subject: divine grace, bounty, confirmations; spiritual capacity
Quotation: For this reason divine confirmations have encompassed thee from all directions. Each day thou hast become victorious, nay rather, at every moment the assistance and bounty of the Most Great Name hath become thy companion. Be confident in the grace and favor of the Lord. Verily thy Lord will assist thee with the hosts of the unseen and will enable thee to serve His Sacred Threshold

Subject: divine grace, bounty, confirmations; spiritual capacity
Quotation: From the bounty of this mighty century and the favors of the Manifest Beauty this is not far-fetched. Look not to thine own capacity; rather, consider the divine bounty that can transform a drop into an ocean and make of a gnat a Solomon. He can cause an Ethiopian Bilal to excel over a Qurayshi chief, and make a Qurayshi Abu Lahab assume Ethiopian features. This is not difficult for God.

Subject: divine grace, bounty, confirmations; spiritual capacity
Quotation: Praise be to God, very soon the fire of his rancor was extinguished and the spark of his envy perished and disappeared. He said that glory had been taken from those souls; even if they should cling to all means, they shall never attain unto it. The example of those souls is like embers of fire, and all of them have been and shall be extinguished by a single wave from the ocean of God's will.

Subject: divine grace, bounty, confirmations; spiritual capacity
Quotation: Man above all needs divine assistance for his spiritual progress. You must consider how great are the favours of God. Consider how the dark earth through the favours of the rays of the sun yields fragrant and beautiful flowers. Therefore I say that through the assistance of God any one of us can perform wonders. This is of the essence of faith and this is that upon which depends all success.

Subject: divine grace, bounty, confirmations; spiritual capacity
Quotation: In all these assemblages and churches, whether in the course of My speech or thereafter, not a soul dared raise an objection, notwithstanding that what was being said ran counter to their beliefs... My meaning is that all this was due to the confirmations of the Blessed Beauty and His heavenly assistance, for otherwise they would not have permitted the first word to be followed by the second!

Subject: divine grace, bounty, confirmations; spiritual capacity
Quotation: But when divine confirmation comes, a state of trust and reliance appears, one can break through the armies of vain imaginings and tear asunder the preventing veils. I had never spoken in gatherings before. At first when I wanted to speak, sweat would pour from my brow. But the confirmations of the Blessed Beauty so encompassed me that in all gatherings the call was raised to the Abha Kingdom.

Subject: divine grace, bounty, confirmations; spiritual capacity
Quotation: The Divine Breath will pass, the Spirit of God will bestow life, the Divine Fragrance will perfume the horizons, and the Gift of God will bring all beneath the canopy of glory. The spring breezes of God will blow, the clouds of Baha'i bounty will rain, the heat of the Sun of Truth will shine, and the Divine Gardener will proceed to plant flowers of realities and meanings in the avenue of hearts.

Subject: divine grace, bounty, confirmations; spiritual capacity
Quotation: For the hosts of divine confirmation there is a vast arena, and for the light of the Sun of Truth there is a wondrous dawning-place. Therefore eyes are ever expectant that from that star of felicity the lights of bounty will shine forth, and the steed of success will gallop in the divine arena, becoming manifestations of the signs of divine unity and the dawning-place of the star of confirmation.

Subject: divine grace, bounty, confirmations; spiritual capacity
Quotation: O Lord! Revive him by His command and make him happy in what is pleasing to him and what he desires, and loose his tongue to speak out Thy praise and inspire his heart by Thy mysteries promised in the truths of creation and make him a banner among Thy banners and an emblem of Thy signs, and a meaning of meanings of Thy hidden book and mystery of Thy mysteries in the manifest scroll and the guarded Tablet

Subject: divine grace, bounty, confirmations; spiritual capacity
Quotation: By God the Truth! The hosts of the Unseen, and the legions of might and power, shall reinforce thee, and the armies of the Most Glorious Kingdom shall grant thee victory. Thou shalt witness how the eastern and western parts of the earth shall be stirred by the breezes of God, and how the lights of unity shall shine forth from radiant faces, and how the voices of the Unseen shall address thee from the Supreme Concourse.

Subject: divine grace, bounty, confirmations; spiritual capacity
Quotation: Praise be to God, you have been assisted and victorious through the confirmations of the Abha Kingdom in all places. Until now, no one has remained so clearly protected. Despite all the unveilings, you remained protected and preserved under the sheltering care and protection of the Abha Beauty - may my spirit be sacrificed for His steadfast and firm servants. You were confirmed and successful in ways that no one could have imagined.

Subject: divine grace, bounty, confirmations; spiritual capacity
Quotation: Know ye for a certainty that ye will be confirmed by the aids of the Holy Spirit and that ye will render the Kingdom of God a distinguished service, whereby ye will become dear in both realms and will shine forth as morning stars from the horizon of the Love of God. These souls have arisen to serve Thee well and have begun servitude. Confirm them and aid them. Encourage each by promises of Thy divine favors and make them of the elect.

Subject: divine grace, bounty, confirmations; spiritual capacity
Quotation: O my God, assist me and Thy loved ones with confirmations from Thy Most Glorious Kingdom, strengthen my back and theirs with mighty power, and reinforce my strength and theirs in Thy service through power from on high, that we may endure every tribulation, stand firm in the severest calamities, remain patient against the onslaught of enemies, and resist hostile armies through the protection of Thy love amidst intense hatred and enmity.

Subject: divine grace, bounty, confirmations; spiritual capacity
Quotation: The eye of God's grace gazes upon Thee all the time, and His utmost Bounty surrounds thee in the Sacred Threshold of the Ancient Beauty, may my soul be a sacrifice for His loved ones. These are prudent handmaidens and in the Sacred Threshold of the Lord, they are but submissive and dedicated maidens. The clouds of Mercy have been dispersed, the showers of grace are flowing, the morn of bounty has risen, and shining blessings are manifesting.

Subject: divine grace, bounty, confirmations; spiritual capacity
Quotation: Lord! They are the signs of Thy mercy in the realm of possibility, and the standards of Thy triumph in the world of being. Lord! Thou beholdest them as scattered pearls upon the dusty earth and as glittering gems strung like brilliant ornaments. This is naught but through Thy great bounty, whereby Thou dost single out for Thy mercy whomsoever Thou pleasest and dost confirm whomsoever Thou willest upon whatsoever Thou desirest in the realm of creation.

Subject: divine grace, bounty, confirmations; spiritual capacity
Quotation: While travelling around he has carried in his hand the torch of guidance, illumining many dark hearts and consoling many downcast spirits... Wherever we went the Doors of Confirmation were opened before our faces. Anything undertaken was carried to completion.... Every undertaking must be backed by Divine Confirmation; even breathing is in need of Confirmation. No affair whether important or trivial will reach the stage of fruition without Confirmation

Subject: divine grace, bounty, confirmations; spiritual capacity
Quotation: In any case, praise be to God that in the East and West the fragrance of the musk of the soul is wafting, and in the South and North the cry of "O Thou the Glory of the Most Glorious" is raised. It is a spiritual springtime and a divine spring. The wilderness and plain are a flowering paradise, and the valley and mountain are garden and rose bower. The cloud of mercy weeps, the meadow and field laugh. The trees are adorned with leaves and blossoms, joyful and verdant.

Subject: divine grace, bounty, confirmations; spiritual capacity
Quotation: Praise be to the Intended Lord that in all circumstances you have been the recipient of the confirmations of the All-Loving Lord and in establishing proof and evidence have prevailed over the people of doubt and fancy. Pay no heed to your lack of education, but rather place your trust in the assistance of the All-Loving Lord, for divine aid bestows heavenly power upon the weak human being, and the favors of the Lord of Hosts elevate the lowly servant to a praiseworthy station.

Subject: divine grace, bounty, confirmations; spiritual capacity
Quotation: If ye follow these steps, then divine confirmations shall continuously be vouchsafed. The friends in 'Ishqabad made the building of the Mashriqu'l-Adhkar the means of creating complete fellowship. With the utmost love and sincerity, they elected a committee, and that committee attended to the establishment, planning, ordering, and form of the Mashriqu'l-Adhkar. Divine confirmations were received day by day, and--praised be God!--it was reared up in perfect strength and majesty.

Subject: divine grace, bounty, confirmations; spiritual capacity
Quotation: How many monarchs expressed their longing and desire to be engaged in some service or to be confirmed in some endeavor in this day, even as the late sovereign, His Majesty the Sultan, set aside a treasure in the name of His Holiness the Qa'im -- may the spirit of all else but Him be sacrificed for His sake -- and not a single coin thereof was spent for the intended purpose. Most monarchs have cherished and continue to cherish such a desire, but divine confirmation did not attend them.

Subject: divine grace, bounty, confirmations; spiritual capacity
Quotation: I pray on thy behalf to make thee a lamp of guidance in that spot, a land heedless of the call of God. The Kingdom hath been adorned with the raiment of beauty, perfection, might, greatness, and glory; and from God's universal Revelation the veil hath been lifted, and lo, divine gifts, heavenly favours, wonders of the merciful Lord, celestial signs, wondrous symbols and holy tokens have appeared. These dazzle the eyes, astound the minds, rejoice the breasts, and attract the hearts of the onlookers.

Subject: divine grace, bounty, confirmations; spiritual capacity
Quotation: He who knows nothing of the wind, when he see trees shaken does not know it is the wind which causes them to shake. Since the beginning of the Cause there were at least ten thousand men who went with gladness to suffer martyrdom, and people who found them suffering this martyrdom thought it was through their own power and did not know that a breeze had shaken them. Now, if one is not shaken by a breeze from the Garden of God, it is not possible for him to be in joy and gladness under these circumstances.

Subject: divine grace, bounty, confirmations; spiritual capacity
Quotation: Thus have We reckoned all thy deeds in the Book of My Self and ordained for thee a station sanctified above all else. This is a glad tiding that no glad tiding hath preceded, no expression can surpass, no indication can equal, no allusion can veil, no story can comprehend, and no narrative or metaphor can describe. Therefore, rejoice within thyself at what I have given thee of the wondrous tokens of My favor, as a grace from My presence, a manifestation of My loving-kindness, and an expression of My generosity.

Subject: divine grace, bounty, confirmations; spiritual capacity
Quotation: The infidels had purposed to turn My abode into one of disgrace and humiliation. But Thou hast glorified Me through My remembrance of Thee, hast exalted Me through My praise of Thee, hast graciously aided Me through the revelations of Thy oneness, and hast conferred upon Me a great honour through the effulgent splendours of Thine ancient eternity. To the fire Thou dost command, 'Be thou a soothing balm unto My Servant', and to the prison, 'Be thou a seat of tender compassion to My Servant, as a token from My presence'.

Subject: divine grace, bounty, confirmations; spiritual capacity
Quotation: Do not look to your own capacity and worthiness, but rather trust in the favors and confirmations of the Blessed Beauty, for that eternal bounty makes a plant into a blessed tree, and makes a mirage into cool water. It makes a lost particle into the essence of existence, and makes a non-existent ant into a scholar in the school of knowledge. From thorns He causes roses to grow, and from black soil He brings forth precious, fragrant flowers. He turns stone into rubies of Badakhshan, and fills the sea shell with brilliant pearls.

Subject: divine grace, bounty, confirmations; spiritual capacity
Quotation: But I now assure thee, O servant of God, that, if thy mind become empty and pure from every mention and thought and thy heart attracted wholly to the Kingdom of God, forget all else besides God and come in communion with the Spirit of God, then the Holy Spirit will assist thee with a power which will enable thee to penetrate all things, and a Dazzling Spark which enlightens all sides, a Brilliant Flame in the zenith of the heavens, will teach thee that which thou dost not know of the facts of the universe and of the divine doctrine.

Subject: divine grace, bounty, confirmations; spiritual capacity
Quotation: His delectable gifts undoubtedly shall be vouchsafed to us, were we to seek the manna that falleth from heaven. Should we desire safe refuge in this life, see how lofty is the stronghold of His sanctuary and how exalted, and were we to wish for eloquence, let us utter His verses for are they not truly wondrous? If we yearn for the boundless ocean, the waters of His bounty are surely fathomless and if we desire to live our days in blowers of roses and in flower-filled meadows, this divine, this ideal garden is verily the most vast, the most spacious.

Subject: divine grace, bounty, confirmations; spiritual capacity
Quotation: You are indeed striving and endeavoring in the physical hospital and rendering worthy service. This service is acceptable in the divine Kingdom, but my hope for you is greater than this. That is, I wish that you would sacrifice yourself in the divine hospital and strive to heal those souls who are afflicted with the disease of ignorance, deprived of reason and understanding, unaware of the world of Truth, bereft of heavenly teachings, and submerged in the darkness of the world of nature, so that they may obtain divine healing and attain heavenly bounties.

Subject: divine grace, bounty, confirmations; spiritual capacity
Quotation: Know thou this of a certainty, that through the Bounty of the Blessed Perfection, thou shalt find victory over the world of creation. Shouldst thou walk and move in this Road thou wilt attain to such a station that thou wouldst observe East and West under thy control. This is glad-tidings that I impart to thee! Verily this is palpable and invulnerable Truth! Rest thou assured that the Beauty of Abha confirms from the Supreme Horizon and bestows victory through the Hosts of Heaven and the Cohorts of the Proximate Angels upon each soul who arises in the Service of His Cause.

Subject: divine grace, bounty, confirmations; spiritual capacity
Quotation: Though the reality of Divinity is sanctified and limitless, yet the purposes and needs of the servants are limited. Divine bounty is like the rain from heaven: water hath no form or limit, yet in every place it assumeth a form according to the capacity of that place. That limitless water taketh on a square shape in a square pool, and likewise in pools of six or eight sides. Water hath no geometry, limit or form, but it acquireth a shape according to its container. Similarly, the Sacred Essence of Truth is limitless, but Its manifestations and bounties in creation become bounded by limits.

Subject: divine grace, bounty, confirmations; spiritual capacity
Quotation: Then they were embraced by a glance from the All-Merciful One and were singled out for a divine gift from among heavenly bestowals...Their Guide was the Merciful Lord

Subject: divine grace, bounty, confirmations; spiritual capacity
Quotation: The divine favors are increasing and the heavenly gifts are manifesting with intensity. Be confident in His magnificent bounty and great victory, and rely upon His grace and generosity.

Subject: divine grace, bounty, confirmations; spiritual capacity
Quotation: Through His grace, thou hast attained and gazeth toward the Most Exalted Horizon...Grace lieth within His mighty grasp, and mercy dependeth upon His will. He bestoweth upon whomsoever He willeth.

Subject: divine grace, bounty, confirmations; spiritual capacity
Quotation: We only attain to these spiritual stations through the Bounty and Favor of the Blessed Perfection...Praise be to God that the Confirmations of God are descending from the Kingdom of the Merciful like unto the torrential rain.

Subject: divine grace, bounty, confirmations; spiritual capacity
Quotation: What can this servant say and what can he mention? That Beloved One, through His infinite bounty and supreme grace, hath with His own eyes beheld the Most Exalted Horizon and with His own ears hearkened unto the scratching of the Most Exalted Pen.

Subject: divine grace, bounty, confirmations; spiritual capacity
Quotation: If there is any hope, it is through the favors of the Glorious Lord that assistance and grace may arrive and war and strife and the bitterness of the bloodied sword may be transformed into the honey of friendship and reconciliation and truth and righteousness.

Subject: divine grace, bounty, confirmations; spiritual capacity
Quotation: For certitude is a bounty and a grace that cometh from God. "This is a bounty of God that He vouchsafeth to whomsoever He willeth". If such assurance is achieved, however and such blessed certitude attained by the grace of divine assistance, then one should thank God at all times both night and day.

Subject: divine grace, bounty, confirmations; spiritual capacity
Quotation: new confirmations may reach you, that success may accompany you, and that you may attain to your utmost desire. Your degree of longing is evident and your love is well-known. Therefore I hope that day by day you will progress in spiritual stations and become the cause of spreading the light of guidance.

Subject: divine grace, bounty, confirmations; spiritual capacity
Quotation: That bird cannot be purchased, for it is the guidance of God. Divine guidance pertains to grace, not justice. He guideth whom He willeth and leadeth astray whom He willeth. Verily, thou canst not guide whom thou lovest, but God guideth whom He willeth. Guidance relates to the Divine Will, not to effort and endeavor.

Subject: divine grace, bounty, confirmations; spiritual capacity
Quotation: Whoever has the love of Baha'u'llah in their heart finds capacity, for divine love is like the spirit - as long as the spirit is in the body, the capacity to achieve anything is attainable. Therefore do not say "we have no capacity" - as long as you have the love of Baha'u'llah in your heart, you have every capacity and worthiness.

Subject: divine philosophy and natural philosophy
Quotation: The philosophers of the East consider the perfect criterion to be reason or intellect, and according to that standard the realities of all objects can be proved; for, they say, the standard of reason and intellect is perfect, and everything provable through reason is veritable.

Subject: divine philosophy and natural philosophy
Quotation: How can we compare philosophical thoughts with religious thoughts? Know that this nether world is the mirror of the kingdom, and the former is exactly the counterpart of the latter. The sound opinions of the world, which are the results of philosophical right thinking, correspond to the Traces of the Kingdom, and there does not exist any difference whatever between them.

Subject: divine philosophy and natural philosophy
Quotation: The metaphysical concepts of Mulla Sadra and Muhyi'd-Din are mostly vain imaginings. For example, the concept of the universal archetype is imagination, conception, not reality. For instance, Mulla Sadra's ten intellects were taken from the idolatrous Greek philosophers. When Aristotle would go forth with Alexander, they would carry nine idols before him. These ten intellects are Aristotle's theory. For example, [he says] motion is of two kinds: forced motion and circular motion. Circular motion is evidence of will. Since we see circular motion in these spheres, they possess will, therefore in these spheres there is an intellectual force which is the controlling power of that sphere. In each of the spheres there is an intellectual force which is the source and controller of the nine spheres. There are eight spheres, in each of which there is one intellect, and all are expressed as the eight intellects, in the ninth sphere there is one intellect under whose shadow are all the others. There is one Universal Intellect ruling over all in the tenth sphere. This is imagination.

Subject: divine unity [tawhid] and degrees of unity
Quotation: Thou didst open the gate of Divine Unity to all servants

Subject: divine unity [tawhid] and degrees of unity
Quotation: thou hast been illumined with the lights of the Word of Divine Unity

Subject: divine unity [tawhid] and degrees of unity
Quotation: This is the Surah of Unity. In the Name of God, the Most Merciful, the Most Compassionate.

Subject: divine unity [tawhid] and degrees of unity
Quotation: True unity is not established except through the sanctification of His holy Being from all else.

Subject: divine unity [tawhid] and degrees of unity
Quotation: the money-changers of divine unity distinguish and differentiate between the pure and that which is otherwise

Subject: divine unity [tawhid] and degrees of unity
Quotation: through Whom the light of unity shone forth amongst the servants...whose hearts God hath illumined with the light of His unity

Subject: divine unity [tawhid] and degrees of unity
Quotation: The effulgence is one effulgence, the rising is one rising, and the Manifestor is one Manifestor, yet the effect is of two kinds

Subject: divine unity [tawhid] and degrees of unity
Quotation: Enter beneath the shade of the Word of Unity...The sign of unity hath become resplendent and the mysteries of divine uniqueness have become manifest.

Subject: divine unity [tawhid] and degrees of unity
Quotation: Verily He is the Truth, there is no God but Him, and God hath power over all things. He is the One like unto Whom there is nothing, and He is God, the Mighty, the Wise.

Subject: divine unity [tawhid] and degrees of unity
Quotation: Enter beneath the shade of the Word of Unity and drink of the wine of detachment. The sign of unity hath shone forth and the mysteries of divine uniqueness have become manifest.

Subject: divine unity [tawhid] and degrees of unity
Quotation: God is truth and all else beside God is creation, and verily the letters of truth are eighteen Vavs, each Vav being one of those who have hastened to the Cause of their Lord.

Subject: divine unity [tawhid] and degrees of unity
Quotation: Thus it is neither of the eternity of firstness nor of the everlastingness of lastness, but rather it shines forth from the Sun of Oneness, gleaming from the might of the Eternal

Subject: divine unity [tawhid] and degrees of unity
Quotation: God testifieth that there is none other God but Him... there is none other God but Him, the All-Knowing, the All-Wise... there is none other God but Him, the Mighty, the Praiseworthy

Subject: divine unity [tawhid] and degrees of unity
Quotation: Through the word "no," caused all the manifestations of negation to perish, and through the blessed word "except," guided the manifestations of affirmation to the station of immortality.

Subject: divine unity [tawhid] and degrees of unity
Quotation: He called thee aforetime with a call whereby the unitarians took flight, the polytheists were thunderstruck, and the sincere hastened to the dawning-place of thy Lord's Most Exalted Beauty

Subject: divine unity [tawhid] and degrees of unity
Quotation: the fragrance of confession to the word of unity was wafted therefrom...to guard those who believe in His unity, through the hosts of the seen and the unseen, from the evil of the polytheists

Subject: divine unity [tawhid] and degrees of unity
Quotation: who broke the covenant and pledge of the idols and cast away their ordinances and pulled up the tent-pegs of the pavilions of polytheism and raised the pavilion of divine unity among the world

Subject: divine unity [tawhid] and degrees of unity
Quotation: God cannot be known by anything, for He is what He hath ever been, and there was naught else besides Him. And now God is as He hath ever been, and there is no mention of aught else besides Him.

Subject: divine unity [tawhid] and degrees of unity
Quotation: He is the Single One, the Eternal, the Everlasting, the Unique, the Ever-Living, the Self-Subsisting, Who has taken neither consort nor son, nor partner in might, nor protector out of weakness.

Subject: divine unity [tawhid] and degrees of unity
Quotation: I bear witness to that which God has testified in His knowledge that there is no God but Him, the Ever-Living, the Self-Subsisting, the Most High, the Most Great, the Lord of Majesty and Bounty.

Subject: divine unity [tawhid] and degrees of unity
Quotation: This is the Greatest Sign that proclaimeth the unity of its Lord at all times, before time and after time. That is the Furthermost Temple wherein the name of God is remembered morning and evening.

Subject: divine unity [tawhid] and degrees of unity
Quotation: Bear thou witness that there is no God but Him, the Sovereign, the Holy. He is God, there is no God but Him, the Knower of the unseen and the seen, the Living, the Protector, the Self-Subsisting.

Subject: divine unity [tawhid] and degrees of unity
Quotation: Verily the first principle of religion is what ye proclaim: There is no God but God, and then whatsoever God ordaineth in every Dispensation whereby that Word is established, if ye be of them who know.

Subject: divine unity [tawhid] and degrees of unity
Quotation: Call not upon any god besides God, for whatsoever is besides God is His creation, and all are devoted unto Him. This is the path of God upon which all do travel. He is the Truth, there is no God but Him.

Subject: divine unity [tawhid] and degrees of unity
Quotation: I bear witness at this moment, from this station, even as Thou hast testified to Thine own Self by Thine own Self, that Thou art God, there is no God but Thee. Thou hast ever existed and wilt ever exist.

Subject: divine unity [tawhid] and degrees of unity
Quotation: God testifieth that there is no God but He. His is the kingdom and the dominion, then the might and the omnipotence, then the power and the divinity, then the strength and sovereignty, then the dominion of earth.

Subject: divine unity [tawhid] and degrees of unity
Quotation: Glorified be He in Whose grasp is the Kingdom of the divine essence of the heavens and the earth and whatsoever lieth between them. Therefore glorify ye God on that Day in the true religion with a sublime glorification.

Subject: divine unity [tawhid] and degrees of unity
Quotation: At this time when the effulgence of that Self-Subsisting Sun hath from the unseen aspect of existence cast its rays across the earth and heaven and irradiated the farthest horizons with its dawning lights of primal unity

Subject: divine unity [tawhid] and degrees of unity
Quotation: That which ye imagine to be the unity of God is but fancy - profess not His unity except with certainty. This is the Tree of Affirmation - take shelter in its shade that your profession of unity may be raised unto God.

Subject: divine unity [tawhid] and degrees of unity
Quotation: Indeed, the Religion is supported by four pillars:  1) Tawhid  2) Nubuwwa 3) Walaya, and 4) Shi'a. These are four gates of which no one is of any use without the others. And all of this is the Face of God which will never perish.

Subject: divine unity [tawhid] and degrees of unity
Quotation: For those possessed of truth and wisdom, there is in every station an explanation. Know thou furthermore that each letter of these sacred words hath two aspects - one turning toward the inner meaning and one toward the outer.

Subject: divine unity [tawhid] and degrees of unity
Quotation: Who hath distinguished between the polytheists and the monotheists through the blessed word "There is none other God but God." This blessed word is the decisive utterance. Through their belief in unity the limbs of polytheism trembled.

Subject: divine unity [tawhid] and degrees of unity
Quotation: Thus do We cast down the verses of the Spirit and spread the carpet of grace over all who dwell in the kingdom... O Ocean of Oneness! Be thou gladdened within thyself, for upon thee hath settled the Ocean of Joy - and this is indeed a great bounty.

Subject: divine unity [tawhid] and degrees of unity
Quotation: Yea, whosoever relies upon God, his Lord, and is among those who have recognized the unity of God and call upon none besides Him - these are they who shall not grieve, neither in the life to come nor in this life, and these are they who shall triumph.

Subject: divine unity [tawhid] and degrees of unity
