Subject: equality of men and women
Quotation: Another teaching of Baha'o'llah is relative to the equality of men and women. In the human family of God there is no distinction. God is no respecter of gender. The religion of God is one. The human family share in common all the faculties; they share in common all the divine bounties. God has not accredited any difference between the male and the female.

Subject: equality of men and women
Quotation: The sixth principle of Baha'o'llah regards the equality of men and women. The male and female of the human kingdom are equal before God. God is no respecter of gender. Whosoever practices more faith, whosoever practices more humanitarianism is nearer to God: but between the male and female there is no innate difference because they share in common all the faculties.

Subject: equality of men and women
Quotation: "If women were given the same advantages as men, their capacity being the same, the result would be the same. In fact, women have a superior disposition to men; they are more receptive, more sensitive, and their intuition is more intense. The only reason of their present backwardness in some directions is because they have not had the same educational advantages as men."

Subject: equality of men and women
Quotation: In former times no one would have believed that women shall arise and demand equal rights and suffrage. Now in America the women have received suffrage in nine states and their cause is marching on. One of the meanings of the prophecy in the Old Testament that the lion and the deer shall graze together in one meadow is that men and women shall be equal and have the same rights.

Subject: equality of men and women
Quotation: in the sight of Baha, women are accounted the same as men - all are created by God in His image and likeness, that is, as manifestations of His names and attributes. There is no distinction between them from a spiritual perspective. The nearer one is, the nearer they are, whether men or women. How many enkindled women in the shelter of Baha have surpassed men and excelled the renowned of the world!

Subject: equality of men and women
Quotation: Men say that because women are weak and feeble in powers, and men are active in the field, therefore in existence women cannot be counted the same as men. But women claim: "We are equal with men in all the powers and in intelligence and understanding. There is no difference. We are all human beings and of humankind. What is the reason for this distinction? Nay this thought is tyranny and transgression."

Subject: equality of men and women
Quotation: Women used to be oppressed in the Orient. They were in every respect humiliated. They were deprived of the opportunity to gain knowledge. They could not study science or art, and in politics they had no voice at all. Men did not consider them their equal. Baha'o'llah announced that women have the same right as men. He uplifted their conditions. He said, "The world of humanity has two wings, the one is man, the other woman."

Subject: equality of men and women
Quotation: His Holiness BAHA'O'LLAH has set a brilliant crown upon the head of women, whose brilliant jewels will shine and gleam throughout all ages and cycles. In all the former dispensations, men were considered superior to women. Women were lower than men; nay, rather during some of the past ages women were made captives of men. For example during the Mosaic dispensation women were captives of men, but in the dispensation of BAHA'O'LLAH, His Bestowals have made men and women equal. He caused the people to put into active practice this social equality and declared that the women in this age shall make extraordinary advancement and they shall reach to such a degree, that no difference will be left between men and women.

Subject: essential distinction of Manifestation of God from others
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/essential distinction of Manifestation of God from others.txt
Quotation: Man has two planes: the physical and the intellectual. The divine revelators have three: their physical condition, which is shared by all mankind - they eat, they sleep, they are sometimes ill, they become well again, they become fatigued, they undergo all that man can undergo; their intellectual degree and their holy reality which surrounds all beings and comprehends secrets. Their horizons enfold the universe, for they are the suns of real truth illuminating all the regions of thought, dispersing the darkness, uplifting the world of mankind and making the material world heavenly. Were it not for these divine messengers there would be no consciousness of continuity....  Other men, although able to evolve to a high degree, are still in the second condition; this third state is alone partaken of by the divine messengers although great saints have attained extraordinary pre-eminence and reflect the splendor of the sun.

Subject: essential distinction of Manifestation of God from others
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/essential distinction of Manifestation of God from others.txt
Quotation: Look not upon all people with the same eye, for the likeness of all forms compared to the form of Him Whom God shall make manifest is as the likeness of suns in mirrors compared to the sun in heaven - all derive their existence from it and draw their sustenance from it, and have no reality except through it.

Subject: essential distinction of Manifestation of God from others
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/essential distinction of Manifestation of God from others.txt
Quotation: A dull person, no matter how much severe discipline he may undergo, no matter how much he may strive and be transformed, can never attain to the station of the Manifestations of Revelation and the Dawning-places of inspiration. The zaqqum tree cannot become a lofty palm, nor can the bitter colocynth yield sweet fruit. What fantasies are these, what strange conjectures, that people give ear to such delusions!

Subject: essential distinction of Manifestation of God from others
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/essential distinction of Manifestation of God from others.txt
Quotation: As for the possibility of all creation attaining the station of the Prophets, this is not possible since creation has ranks - the lower cannot comprehend the higher - "He created you in stages." A hard stone cannot become a red ruby, and pottery and shells cannot become brilliant pearls. Quddus was under the shadow of the Exalted One [the Bab], not independent, but Jesus and Muhammad were independent beings. The believers of this Manifestation can reach the station of the Prophets of Israel, but not the Manifestations of Universal Divine Authority, for they were Universal Manifestations. In brief, the Universal Manifestations of God who shone forth independently have another station and another condition - no one can attain their station and rank.

Subject: essential vs. actional attributes of God
Quotation: That which is described as God's knowledge is other than what you describe. That which is described as God's hearing is other than what you describe. That which is described as God's sight is other than what you describe. And likewise you witness in all that is attributed to God.

Subject: essential vs. actional attributes of God
Quotation: existence as conceived by man or comprehended through human reason or intellect is a characteristic of matter...But it is not so with the Essential Self-Existent One. His existence is true existence which is self-subsistent, not an intellectually perceived and comprehended existence

Subject: essential vs. actional attributes of God
Quotation: God, exalted be His glory, hath ever been our Lord, knowing, and knowledge was His essence when there was nothing to be known; and hearing was His essence when there was nothing to be heard; and sight was His essence when there was nothing to be seen; and power was His essence when there was nothing over which to exercise power. When He brought things into being, knowledge occurred between Him and the known, hearing between Him and the heard, sight between Him and the seen, and power between Him and that over which power was exercised.

Subject: essential vs. actional attributes of God
Quotation: Verily He, exalted be His glory, hath no need in His life for the existence of aught beside Him, and likewise in knowledge He hath no need for the existence of anything known, for He is His own Self. Similarly befitting unto God, glorified and exalted be He, are all the attributes of perfection and names of glory, and whatsoever name is attributed to Him pertaineth to the modes of His action, and these are the modes of His command. The names of the Divine Essence have ever described God, and the names of Divine Action shall forever glorify God. Yet the former is eternally ancient, while the latter is mentioned in connection with creation and origination.

Subject: eternal archetypes [a'yan-i-thabitah]
Quotation: Essential Pre-existence, which has ever been, existed when nothing else existed alongside it, nothing accompanied it, and nothing else was mentioned at its level - this is the pre-existence of the Eternal Essence which exists without anything being mentioned with it or any multiplicity existing in the simplicity of its essence. Exalted is God above what the philosophers say when they claim that the cause of origination is the pre-existence of the Essence, thereby seeking to establish a connection between Truth and contingent being and to prove the existence of archetypes through the pure subtlety of simplicity in the Essence.

Subject: eternality vs. origination; creation from nothingness
Quotation: And when thou hast understood this, thou wilt be certain that creation hath no beginning whereby thou mightest reckon from its inception, and preserve this as one of the bounds of thy religion. In every Revelation all things are renewed and created anew.

Quotation: Days may pass away and times may come to an end, but the favors of the Blessed Beauty remain eternal and everlasting, and the bounties of the Most Great Name continue forever and ever, embracing eternity. Therefore seek thou that which is eternal, and desire thou that which is everlasting.

Subject: eternality vs. origination; creation from nothingness
Quotation: There are two kinds of eternities. There is an eternity of essence, that which is without first cause, and an eternity of time, that which has no beginning. The universe has never had a beginning. From the point of view of essence it transforms itself. God is eternal in essence and in time. He is his own existence and cause.

Subject: eternality vs. origination; creation from nothingness
Quotation: Notwithstanding this, we read in Genesis in the Old Testament that the lifetime of creation is but six thousand years. This has an inner meaning and significance; it is not to be taken literally...Our purpose is to show that the divine sovereignty, the Kingdom of God, is an ancient sovereignty, that it is not an accidental sovereignty.

Subject: eternality vs. origination; creation from nothingness
Quotation: Pre-existence and Origination. Question: How many kinds of pre-existence and origination are there? Answer: Certain sages and philosophers hold that there are two kinds of pre-existence, essential and temporal, and that there are likewise two kinds of origination, essential and temporal. Essential pre-existence is an existence which is not preceded by a cause; essential origination is preceded by a cause. Temporal pre-existence has no beginning; temporal origination has both a beginning and an end.

Subject: eternality vs. origination; creation from nothingness
Quotation: Know that it is one of the most abstruse questions of divinity that the world of existence--that is, this endless universe--has no beginning. Apart from this, absolute non-existence lacks the capacity to attain existence. If the universe were pure nothingness, existence could not have been realized. Thus, as that Essence of Oneness, or divine Being, is eternal and everlasting--that is, as it has neither beginning nor end--it follows that the world of existence, this endless universe, likewise has no beginning.

Subject: eternality vs. origination; creation from nothingness
Quotation: In the world of existence and the realm of being, the ultimate desire of humanity is permanence and immortality. Despite physical afflictions and trials, and endless pain and calamities, still man yearns for everlasting life. If then this ephemeral existence, which appeareth as reality, is so greatly cherished as the ultimate goal and desire of man, how much more precious and exalted must be that eternal life and everlasting felicity in the realm of immortality and the world of sacrifice, which are among the fruits of divine guidance!

Subject: eternality vs. origination; creation from nothingness
Quotation: Since the existence of the Eternal Essence is established by His own existence and not by anything else - as indicated by "O Thou Who hast proven Thy Essence by Thy Essence" - the existence of originated things is established through creation itself, not from anything else. And it has four ranks, among them the rank of manifest eternity in the First Remembrance and the manifest eternity in the station of action, which is the station God made in creation for the station of knowing through reasoning about the eternity of His Essence and His eternality

Subject: eternality vs. origination; creation from nothingness
Quotation: When a discerning man considers the evolution of humanity and studies pages of the book of creation, it is evident that the world is not limited to six thousand years. The divine truth is an everlasting cause. The life of divinity if infinite. Is it possible for His eternity to come to an end? Sovereignty requires subjects, attendants, armies, courts, soldiers and people. Is it meaningful to claim that one is a king without having an army? Light and warmth are the essential attributes of the sun. Therefore, is it possible to say that at one time sun did not have light or energy, or perhaps it does not have these qualities now? Nay, it is impossible.

Subject: eternality vs. origination; creation from nothingness
Quotation: Quintessential gems of divine unity and delicate pearls of holy praise ascend unto the court of the peerless Sovereign and glorious King, Who hath caused the realities of all created things and the subtleties and refinements of the essences of beings to emerge from utter nothingness into the realms of existence and immortality, and Who hath rescued them from the abasement of remoteness and extinction, exalting them to the kingdom of glory and eternity. This was naught but His Own prior grace and all-embracing mercy, for it is evident that absolute nothingness hath no capacity or receptivity for existence, and utter extinction hath no worthiness for being and creation.

Subject: ether; the phenomenon of light

Subject: ether; the phenomenon of light
Quotation: The philosophers of old believed in the four elements, and contended that the element of fire was above ether, but these materialist philosophers now maintain that all these elements are compounded rather than uncompounded, and that, while ether cannot be detected by the senses, it nonetheless encompasses all creation. Although these philosophers believe ether to be intangible, yet they deny the existence of other intangible forces - this notwithstanding that the inability to perceive something with the senses does not necessarily prove the non-existence of that thing....

Subject: ether; the phenomenon of light
Quotation: Although they themselves believe in the imperceptibility of ethereal force, they still deny imperceptible forces, while denial and lack of perception is no proof for the non-existence and absence of a force or perfection.

Subject: eulogies; reminiscences

Subject: eulogies; reminiscences

Subject: eulogies; reminiscences

Subject: eulogies; reminiscences

Subject: eulogies; reminiscences

Subject: eulogies; reminiscences

This noble person placed a crown upon your heads whose brilliant and radiant jewels will shine throughout centuries and ages.

It was watered from the spring of Tasnim and stirred by breezes from the gardens of the Abha Kingdom.

Now, praise God, Mr. Chase did yield fruit. Mr. Chase was heavenly. Mr. Chase was spiritual. Mr. Chase was radiant.

Subject: eulogies; reminiscences

Subject: eulogies; reminiscences

Upon you be His Glory. Upon you be His Praise. Upon you be the assistance and the bounty of your Supreme Lord.

Subject: eulogies; reminiscences

He illumined the horizons with the light of guidance

Having embraced all the friends, he hastened to the plain of sacrifice, dancing and snapping his fingers in ecstasy.

Subject: eulogies; reminiscences

He was honored at the luminous Holy Threshold and covered his face and hair with the dust of this earth which Thou hast ever made the center of Thy greatest signs and the dawning-place of Thy lights

Blessed are you and your brother, and upon your mother and your sister, and upon those who believed in God on the Day of Return.

Subject: eulogies; reminiscences

From the beginning of his childhood, he lived a life of utmost piety and spent all his days in acquiring perfections.

Subject: eulogies; reminiscences
Quotation: "She hastened from this mortal world to the divine world and soared from this temporal realm to the expanse of the Kingdom...I hope her noble son may seek the Path wherein his mother walked, and may become better and more illustrious; nay, rather, the lights of his love may also take effect in his grand parents."

Subject: eulogies; reminiscences
Quotation: He created thee from a father who believed in God and His signs, who was attracted by His fragrances, who remained firm in His Covenant, who hastened to His holy spot, who circumambulated the sanctuary of the concourse of the near ones, who pressed his forehead and covered his face with the dust of His divine threshold.

Subject: eulogies; reminiscences
Quotation: May the shining light and brilliant radiance from the Supreme Horizon envelop the soil that contains your pure and purified grave... The eyes of the people of the Most Glorious Kingdom have wept, and tears have flowed from the eyelids of the people of the exalted scenes of grandeur upon the fragrant soil of your shrine

Subject: eulogies; reminiscences
Quotation: O Husayn! After Ghulam, the Mighty, the All-Knowing remembers thee, when He was wronged at the hands of the heedless. Blessed art thou for having turned towards Him and believed when the people were in manifest rejection. Thou didst attain unto the traces of My Pen before thy ascension and after it through this luminous Tablet.

Subject: eulogies; reminiscences
Quotation: Thy noble grandfather Mirza Jalal was illumined by the lights of the Beauty. Praise be to God, until his final breath he was intimate with the mention of the Beloved of the horizons and was firm and steadfast in the Cause. In truth, he was the brilliant lamp of that family, and now he shineth bright in the niche of the higher realm.

Subject: eulogies; reminiscences
Quotation: The text eulogizes a deceased believer who recognized the truth: "The first light that dawned from the horizon of the Most Merciful's utterance and the first fragrance that wafted in the days of God, the Lord of all beings - upon thee, O thou who didst attain unto faith when the people were wrapped in the darkness of vain imaginings."

Subject: eulogies; reminiscences
Quotation: And concerning what thou didst write about the elevated and blessed Aqa Mirza Aqa Baba, upon him be the glory of God, His loving-kindness and His grace, praise be to God that he ascended to the Supreme Companion with complete faith and perfect devotion, and the fragrance of certitude was diffused from him at the time of his ascension.

Subject: eulogies; reminiscences
Quotation: What a shining candle was aflame in that black-colored lamp. Praise be to God that that lighted candle ascended from the earthly lamp to the Kingdom of Eternity and gleamed and became aflame in the Heavenly Assemblage. Although that sinless one was black in color, like unto the black pupil of the eye, he was a source of shining light.

Subject: eulogies; reminiscences
Quotation: Reflect upon Abu-Basir and Ashraf and that which was manifested from them...Blessed are they both, and blessed is he who visiteth them, who seeketh them out, who turneth toward them, who maketh mention of them, and who draweth nigh through them unto God, the Forgiving, the Generous. With illumined hearts and radiant faces did they ascend.

Subject: eulogies; reminiscences
Quotation: O ye two remnants of the two noble souls, `Abdu'l-Majid and Siyyid Mu?sin. The truth is that I find myself incapable of befittingly extolling those two blessed souls. Both were taught by the Blessed Beauty, were revived by the Fragrances of the Holy Spirit, and they both, like unto immovable mountains remained firm, steadfast and strong in Iraq.

Subject: eulogies; reminiscences
Quotation: We have desired in this Station to make mention of him who ascended unto Us and attained the Supreme Companion, the Station whereby the eyes of those brought near were solaced. He was named Lu?f-'Ali in the Kingdom of Names, and there was revealed for him from the Most Exalted Pen that which hath perfumed with its fragrance the heavens and the earth.

Subject: eulogies; reminiscences
Quotation: The near ones make mention of him in the heaven of eternity, for the Most Exalted Pen hath been moved to his remembrance by the fingers of Glory. Thus did the bounty of his Lord encompass him...How wonderful art thou, O servant who hast ascended unto God and detached thyself from all else, for thy beard was reddened with thy blood in the path of thy Lord.

Subject: eulogies; reminiscences
Quotation: Mary Magdalene - and Magdala was a humble village on the shore of Lake Tiberias. Glory be to God! Though this leaf was from among the veiled ones and from a village, she was confirmed with such a spirit of reinforcement that renowned men were rendered helpless, and she became the cause of steadfastness, firmness, constancy and tranquility for all the monotheists.

Subject: eulogies; reminiscences
Quotation: Those souls who participated in the funeral procession of the pure body of Aqa Fadlu'llah are truly deserving of the favors of the Ancient Beauty, and assuredly the influence of this procession will become evident and manifest in all the worlds. For attending the funeral of the friends of God is among the requirements of love and steadfastness in the Cause of God.

Subject: eulogies; reminiscences
Quotation: O thou who art mentioned before the Wronged One! Call to mind when 'Ali-Qabli-Akbar proceeded to the Prison accompanied by My Name Jamal and a few other souls... The essence of remembrance and praise be upon thee, O thou who didst bear hardships in the path of God, the Creator of heaven, and didst drink from the cup of tribulation in His love, the Mighty, the Wondrous.

Subject: eulogies; reminiscences
Quotation: Blessed art thou, O brother! Verily he ascended to the Supreme Companion and God made him purified from the defilement of the world... O Hashim! Blessed art thou for having heard the Call and responded to thy Lord. We bear witness that thou didst turn and believe when the servants turned away, until thou didst fulfill thy pledge by the command of God, the Lord of the worlds.

Subject: eulogies; reminiscences
Quotation: That illustrious Uncle is seated upon the throne of truth in the presence of the Mighty Sovereign and gazes upon those left behind, his pure soul being present. That embodied spirit was very kind to 'Abdu'l-Baha, and in childhood in Nur would shower affection day and night and embrace him. His kindness will not be forgotten and 'Abdu'l-Baha will not be silent in mentioning him.

Subject: eulogies; reminiscences
Quotation: We testify that his tongue was created for the remembrance of God, his sight for beholding the signs of his Lord, the Possessor of Names, and his ear for hearkening to His sweetest call. From the beginning until now he has been speaking words of praise and glory. Great is the reward of this station and this deed, and from the Tongue of Grandeur he was named the Most Great Nabil.

Subject: eulogies; reminiscences
Quotation: We make mention of him at this time and beseech God to spread out for him the carpet of pardon and forgiveness, and to send down upon him at all times mercy from His presence and grace from His own Self. We bear witness that he believed in God and His verses, acknowledged His Books and His Messengers and His chosen ones, and recognized what He hath revealed in His Perspicuous Book.

Subject: eulogies; reminiscences
Quotation: His honor Ali Haydar was in the days of God a manifestation of favor and a dawning-place of the light of guidance. He was a believer and one assured in faith, and he stood firm in service. The Blessed Beauty showed him great consideration. After the Ascension also he remained firm and steadfast in the Covenant and exerted his utmost effort in service to the Cause of the Desired One.

Subject: eulogies; reminiscences
Quotation: We have previously made mention of him who attained to faith and recognition, who was named Habibullah in My perspicuous Book. Concerning him who ascended unto God there hath been revealed that which hath caused its fragrance to encompass the world. This Wronged One beareth witness to the turning, the devotion, the humility and the submissiveness of that deceased one in the days of God.

Subject: eulogies; reminiscences
Quotation: O Breakwell, O my dear one! Where now is thy fair face? Where is thy fluent tongue? Where thy clear brow? Where thy bright comeliness? Where is thy fire, blazing with God's love? Where is thy rapture at His holy breaths? Where are thy praises, lifted unto Him? Where is thy rising up to serve His Cause? Where are thy beauteous eyes? Thy smiling lips? The princely cheek? The graceful form?

Subject: eulogies; reminiscences
Quotation: O Greatest of the Great Ones and Leader of the Noble Ones and Light of the Eyes of the Distinguished Ones! O man of wisdom and glorious martyr, unique among the loved ones and peerless among the chosen ones! How blessed is the mother who bore you, the earth that carried you, the father who raised you, the city that contained you, the tribe that claimed you, and the souls that found comfort in you.

Subject: eulogies; reminiscences
Quotation: He is the All-Glorious! Blow O ye sweet fragrances of God! Breath O ye breezes of God! Proceed ye to the city towards the south, a land within which layeth to rest a soul breathed into its heart and soul the spirit of God, a land which embraced a body gathered under the banner of God, and a heart attracted by the sweet fragrances of God, and limbs and members enkindled by the fire of the Love of God.

Subject: eulogies; reminiscences
Quotation: Your noble uncle is established upon the throne of eternal glory in the Kingdom of Light, for in his days he was engaged in service, devoted to servitude at the Threshold of the One, and familiar with the holy fragrances. Now you too must follow his example and arise to that which befits one related to him, that you may become the cause of brightening his lamp and enter into the circle of the gathering.

Subject: eulogies; reminiscences
Quotation: Blessed be he that entereth the Ridvan Garden, extolling the name of God, his Lord, the Most Compassionate. May the perfumed breezes wafting from thy flowers and blossoms blow over thee, O 'Abdu's-Sali?, O thou effulgent light! I bear witness that the evidences of thy handiwork in this garden are a testimony to thy living presence and to the services that thou hast rendered to thy Lord, the God of mercy.

Subject: eulogies; reminiscences
Quotation: Since that dove of love hath winged its flight to the garden of faithfulness, and that yearning one for the Beauty of the All-Merciful hath hastened to the eternal gathering of divine manifestation, and that parched and burning soul hath rushed to the living waters, and that consumed moth hath ascended around the lamp of the Concourse on High, this servant writeth in reply that the details of the event in Nayriz are known.

Subject: eulogies; reminiscences
Quotation: The news of His Holiness Minshadi's ascension caused the utmost grief and sorrow, but that embodied light became a pure spirit and attained the joy of the righteous in the divine realm. From the beginning of his faith and certitude, he spent his time in complete steadfastness and constancy in service to the Divine Unity, and was confirmed and assisted in winning His good-pleasure. Blessed is he and excellent is his final abode.

Subject: eulogies; reminiscences
Quotation: "O Letter ?a! By God, through thee the horizon of faithfulness dawned and that was manifested whereby the Cause of God, Creator of the heavens, was spread abroad. Blessed is the eye that hath wept for thy calamities, and the ear that hath heard thy praise, and the face that hath turned toward thee, and the soul that hath hastened until it reached thy resting-place - the spot honored by thy noble body and thy sacred and glorious temple."

Subject: eulogies; reminiscences
Quotation: This chapter refers to the Most Exalted Leaf, the mother of Abdu'l-Baha. And truly the humiliation and reproach which she suffered in the path of God is a fact which no one can refute. For the calamities and afflictions mentioned in the whole chapter are such afflictions which she suffered in the path of God, all of which she endured with patience and thanked God therefor and praised Him, because He had enabled her to endure afflictions for the sake of Baha.

Subject: eulogies; reminiscences
Quotation: We miss Hadji Mirza Hyder Ali very much - we hear that he has passed away. Yes; he ascended. Hadji Mirza Hyder Ali was one of the souls who was immersed in the Kingdom of God; he was unaware of the material world; he lost himself in Baha'o'llah; he had no thought by day or night save that of the Kingdom of God. At the age of thirty he became a believer and remained firm until his death. For over sixty years he had no thought save that of service in the Kingdom.

Subject: eulogies; reminiscences
Quotation: Prayer seeking forgiveness for: Aqa Mashhadi Husayn Naddaf of Qom, Aqa Mashhadi Rida Naddaf of Qom, Aqa Mirza Ibrahim Naddaf of Qom, Ustad Muhammad Hasan Najjar, Aqa Muhammad Ibrahim Saffar, Ustad Quli Najjar, Aqa Muhammad Ibrahim Naddaf of Yazd, Aqa Mashhadi Abdul-Razzaq of Tabriz, Ruqiyyih Sultan, Narjis Khatun, Khadijih Sultan, Bilqis Sultan, Kawkab Sultan, Sultan, Qamar Sultan, Khanum Sultan, Khavar Khanum of Kashan, Ustad Hasan Naddaf of Yazd, Bilqis Khanum

Subject: eulogies; reminiscences
Quotation: O servant of the Blessed Beauty! Convey loving greetings to Aqa Muhammad-Hasan and tell him that his honored father walked for a time in the path of God and has now returned to the horizon of forgiveness. He has left you as a remembrance for us, and in the Kingdom of pardon he watches over your condition and conduct. Walk in such a way as to bring joy to the spirit of that forgiven soul and become a worthy and distinguished successor to that one who has ascended unto God.

Subject: eulogies; reminiscences
Quotation: Your letter of condolence regarding the supreme calamity of the passing of Abu'l-Fadl brought solace to our hearts. As for Abu'l-Fadl, praise be to God, in his own time, as soon as news of his death spread to distant cities, people mourned and shed tears, joined in sighs and laments, and sought the elevation of his station in their prayers. Yet his dear countrymen in Egypt would not approach his bier, lest they be humbled, even though that noble being was the glory of Iranians.

Subject: eulogies; reminiscences
Quotation: Verily Your maidservant who was attracted by the fragrances of Your holiness, who was set ablaze with the fire of Your love, who proclaimed Your name and spread Your verses among Your creatures...She gave drink to every thirsty one from the cup of Your guidance and healed every sick one with the antidote of Your knowledge. She traveled in Your path to distant regions and proclaimed Your Kingdom in various lands until her flesh and fat melted away from the hardships she endured in Your path.

Subject: eulogies; reminiscences
Quotation: Ismu'llahu'l-A?daq was truly a servant of the Lord from the beginning of life till his last breath. When young, he joined the circle of the late Siyyid Kazim and became one of his disciples. He was known in Persia for his purity of life, winning fame as Mulla ?adiq the saintly. He was a blessed individual, a man accomplished, learned, and much honored. The people of Khurasan were strongly attached to him, for he was a great scholar and among the most renowned of matchless and unique divines.

Subject: eulogies; reminiscences
Quotation: He served Your Sacred Threshold from tender youth... He turned to You night and day, and supplicated before You evening and morning. He served the righteous and strove for the comfort of the free, knowing no weariness and never tiring in serving them continuously... He reached maturity in servitude to You and grew and developed in Your service with a heart overflowing with Your love, a tongue speaking Your praise, a spirit gladdened by Your favors, and a heart aflame with longing to meet You

Subject: eulogies; reminiscences
Quotation: Thou art he whom neither the clamor of the divines nor the objections of the wise deterred, nor did what the people possessed distract thee from God, the Lord of the beginning and the end. Thou didst continue to make mention of God and to praise Him until thy days were ended and thou didst soar on the wings of certitude unto the Supreme Companion and the Most Glorious Horizon, attaining unto that which was ordained for thee in the Crimson Scroll by the Pen of thy Lord, the Creator of all things.

Subject: eulogies; reminiscences
Quotation: who plumbed the depths of knowledge and discovered the mysteries of learning, who contemplated the divine verses and through them found proof of the radiance of lights from the Dayspring of mysteries...he strove to lift the veil and sought reality behind the mask, and left no obstacle unscaled in his quest to reach Thee...He guided pure souls to the decisive Cause and gave them to drink of the choice wine in an elegant cup, guided them to the even path, and strove to exalt Thy Word in Thy kingdom

Subject: eulogies; reminiscences
Quotation: As for the account of the departed and elevated mother, upon her be the Glory of God, at the very moment when news arrived of the ascension of that distinguished emigrant lady, this servant was engaged in writing in His presence. At that very moment, mention of her appeared from the horizon of the Pen. God knows that she attained. She was among the handmaidens who attained to His good-pleasure. In the nights and days she had no occupation except the mention of God. Blessed and welcome tidings to her.

Subject: eulogies; reminiscences
Quotation: From your early youth, nay from your tender age, you turned to your Lord and answered the call of your Master when it was raised between earth and heaven. You were attracted by the holy fragrances wafting from the garden of eternity, and were set ablaze with the fire of the love of God among His chosen ones... You sacrificed yourself completely for His martyred loved ones, and you sacrificed your affairs and the worthless things of this world and all you possessed in the lower realm in the path of God.

Subject: eulogies; reminiscences
Quotation: O My Pen! Make mention of him who loved Me with words that will set ablaze the hearts of all created things and illumine all contingent beings. Say: The Glory shining forth from the mouth of God's loving-kindness, the Lord of all worlds, be upon thee, O thou who wast named Muhammad before Husayn, before the throne of thy Lord, the Most High, the Most Great. I testify that thou didst cast away idle fancies and didst hold fast unto certitude when the Lord of the Day of Judgment came with manifest sovereignty.

Subject: eulogies; reminiscences
Quotation: This is Thy servant who hath believed in Thee and in Thy signs and been illumined by Thy glory. He hath discovered Thy mysteries and believed in Thy most exalted beauty and sought shelter beneath the shadow of Thy Sadratu'l-Muntaha and drunk to the full at the hands of the Cup-bearer of bounty. Eventually, he was attracted to the fragrances of Thine all-glorious Kingdom and hastened unto Thy Divine Presence and stood before Thy face, lowly, submissive, shaken, enkindled, enraptured and hearkening to Thy Call.

Subject: eulogies; reminiscences
Quotation: I testify at this moment that she turned unto Me when the horizon of the Manifestation appeared and responded when the call was raised between earth and heaven. She stood ready to serve the loved ones at eve and at dawn, at night and in the morning. Whenever a man or woman emigrant arrived, they found her to be an ocean of joy and a star of bounty. There was no traveler but remembered her before the presence, and no visitor but gave thanks for her and spoke well of her before the throne of God, the Mighty, the Praiseworthy.

Subject: eulogies; reminiscences
Quotation: The Lord of Manifestation in the Mount of knowledge, which is the prison-abode of the Desire of all worlds, maketh mention of thee... Mention was made in thy letter of several names, each of whom hath been honored with the verses of the Most Exalted Pen... We make mention of him who is named Muhammad-'Ali... We make mention of Muhammad-Husayn... The Countenance of the Ancient One hath turned toward thee from the direction of His Most Great Prison, remembering thee with a remembrance wherewith the books of the world have been adorned.

Subject: eulogies; reminiscences
Quotation: O Crimson Leaf and Most Glorious Sign! I bear witness that through thee the fire of love and affection was kindled in the hearts of the servants. Thou art she who chanted in the nights and days the praise of God, the Lord of all beings. Thou art she who heard the Call in the beginning of days, and the attraction of the utterance of the All-Merciful seized thee in such wise that thy heart was melted and thy very being was set ablaze. Through thee appeared the rustling of the Divine Lote-Tree and the cry of the Kingdom was raised amongst creation.

Subject: eulogies; reminiscences
Quotation: Among them was Thy servant Husayn, who believed in Thee and Thy verses, was attracted by the signs of Thy oneness, was enchanted by Thy beauty, and was bewildered by the manifestations of Thy might and majesty, until he migrated unto Thee, arrived at Thy holy court, and took shelter under the shadow of the King of Thy Lordship... He sought refuge in Thy protection, lived beneath Thy shadow, found tranquility in Thy remembrance, and his heart was gladdened by Thy favors. He remained firm in Thy Covenant and Testament, served Thy Most Holy and Exalted Threshold

Subject: eulogies; reminiscences
Quotation: We have desired at this time to make mention of the Friend who hath ascended unto God, the Almighty, the All-Praised. Before his ascension We revealed for him that which brought solace to the eyes of them that are nigh unto God, and after his ascension We mentioned him from My Most Exalted Pen in such wise that the Concourse on High and the dwellers of the Most Sublime Paradise welcomed it, as bidden by the Ancient Commander. O Friend! We have desired to make mention of thee at this time once again, as a mercy from Us--verily thy Lord is the Most Merciful of the merciful ones.

Subject: eulogies; reminiscences
Quotation: Mr. Mirza Mahdi Ikhvan-i-Safa devoted his life to the exaltation of the Word of God. He never rested for a moment, constantly traveling from city to city and village to village. He was a detached soul possessing an attracted spirit, with a pure and goodly heart and an eloquent tongue. Patient in tribulations, he occupied himself with the guidance of souls. Therefore, that pure spirit was cherished and respected in the presence of 'Abdu'l-Baha, nay rather, in the Concourse on High. Though his worth and station are unknown at present, they shall soon become manifest and apparent.

Subject: eulogies; reminiscences
Quotation: And as for what you wrote concerning the honored and forgiven departed father - upon him be the ocean of God's care and mercy - in truth this servant is powerless to describe his station and offer fitting praise, for whatever might be said would not be worthy, as he was among those souls who were illumined and adorned by the lights of the sun of steadfastness. Such expressions of favor have been shown regarding him that every pen is incapable and falls short of their mention. A house has been built for him by the hands of grace that the passing of ages and centuries cannot alter.

Subject: eulogies; reminiscences
Quotation: And further, Khajih Rabi`, with his wondrous character, delivered most eloquent speeches, he had a powerful utterance, and thus invited the souls and guided them to the new Faith. As such, he occupied a sublime station. Pages have been written in their remembrance. And now concerning the faithful friend, Aqa Mirza Mihdi Akhavan ?afa, whose passing brought [me] infinite sadness, grief, anguish and sorrow. He was a mighty pillar, and had attained the station of utter nothingness before the Blessed Beauty. He breathed no breath but one blessed with Divine good pleasure, and he cherished no hope except that of service to His Cause.

Subject: eulogies; reminiscences
Quotation: He was from the branches of the Divine Lote-Tree and a kinsman of the Exalted One, the Bab, may my soul be a sacrifice unto Him. From earliest childhood, signs of intelligence and wisdom, and evidences of understanding and discernment, were manifest in his blessed countenance. Even as an infant in the cradle, signs of nobility were apparent upon his brow. When he reached adolescence, both friends and strangers alike observed distinguished qualities in his bearing and were amazed by his conduct. Having received an excellent upbringing, he strove with the utmost zeal and determination to acquire both material and spiritual perfections.

Subject: eulogies; reminiscences
Quotation: Concerning the ascension of His honor ?adru'?-?udur which thou didst write about - that lamp of light and one who acquired the flame of Sinai truly dedicated his days to serving the Forgiving Lord and persisted in servitude to His Divine Unity. He brought souls to life and set many free. He established classes for teaching and instructed with an eloquent and wondrous tongue. This foundation is eternal and will continue in succession, and his noble spirit will remain forever joyous and steadfast in the world of mysteries. His blessed name will raise such a melody in the world's assemblies that it will set the divine birds in motion and flight.

Subject: eulogies; reminiscences
Quotation: The Wronged One wisheth to make mention of him who loved Him and spoke His praise and turned unto His countenance when they that wear white turbans and they of the green domes turned away... Blessed art thou, O 'Abdu'r-Rahim! Thou didst hear My call and turn to My horizon, and didst soar in My atmosphere and speak My praise in My days, and didst prostrate thyself before My countenance and humble thyself before My sovereignty, and wert assured of My Manifestation and My verses, and didst hearken unto My words and attain the effulgences of the lights of the Sun of My bounty, and didst arise to serve Me amongst My servants and to assist My loved ones.

Subject: eulogies; reminiscences
Quotation: O Pen of the Most Ancient Being! Make mention of him who turned towards the Most Great Prison, who circled round the Throne, and who sacrificed himself for God, the Lord of all worlds. He is now in the All-Glorious Horizon and the Supreme Companion, and was named Mahdi in the kingdom of creation - he who heard the Call when it was raised betwixt earth and heaven, who turned unto the Countenance, and who took hold of the Book with the power of God, the Sovereign Lord, the Mighty, the All-Praised. He ascended unto God as a stranger and was buried in His vicinity, whereupon the Ocean of Pre-existence shed upon him that which the creatures are powerless to describe.

Subject: eulogies; reminiscences
Quotation: Among them was the Fire-Dragon of the Cause and the Lion of the thickets of bounty, the Dove of the gardens of knowledge, who believed in Thee and Thy verses from his tender youth, who was nourished at the breast of Thy favor from the beginning of his life, who was reared in the cradle of Thy love and grew and developed in the bosom of Thy knowledge. He became intoxicated with the wine of understanding and was inebriated with the choice wine of certitude while yet a suckling child among his peers. When he reached maturity and attained his full strength, the fire of Thy love blazed forth within him and the waves of the ocean surged through the winds of Thy knowledge.

Subject: eulogies; reminiscences
Quotation: We testify that she departed from her home, turning toward the Supreme Horizon, and traversed deserts, mountains, land and sea until she arrived at the fortified City mentioned in the Books and Tablets, and attained the presence of the Face, and was blessed with what God had revealed in His Books. We testify that she believed in God and His signs, and responded when the Call was raised between earth and heaven, and drank the cup of reunion from the hands of the bounty of her Lord, the Self-Sufficing, the Most Exalted, and heard what the near ones heard on the Mount of Knowledge, and saw what eyes and visions were prevented from seeing, save whom God, the Lord of lords, willeth.

Subject: eulogies; reminiscences
Quotation: In the days when the Ancient Beauty was residing in the palace, the aforementioned departed one took flight to the Supreme Companion at the first light of dawn on the twentieth day of Rabi'u'l-Avval. That very night, the Most Great Branch - may my spirit, my being and my essence be sacrificed for the dust of His footsteps - visited his home and remained with him for some time. This was one of the special bounties that was bestowed upon him. The next day when news reached the palace, at that very moment the Most Great Branch and the other Branches - may my spirit and being be sacrificed for the dust of their footsteps - by command proceeded on foot to accompany the funeral procession.

Subject: eulogies; reminiscences
Quotation: Your servant Andalib, the beloved one, has acknowledged Your oneness and confessed Your singleness, and has answered Your call with passionate attraction to the threshold of Your mercy... He did not falter in exalting Your Word and establishing proof and evidence for the seekers, and manifested with clear signs and authority for those who yearned. He endured every hardship in his familiar homeland and was compelled to migrate to the Center of Manifestation... In the corner of obscurity he endured every hardship and withering while his heart was aflame with the fire of Your love, his tongue speaking Your remembrance, and his talent flowing with Your praise and attributes among Your loved ones.

Subject: eulogies; reminiscences
Quotation: He is God! I plead for forgiveness for the holy, assured leaf, the handmaiden of God, the consort of the Best-Beloved of Martyrs, upon her be the Most Glorious Beauty of God. Allah-u-Abha! My God, my God! This is a leaf who was stirred by the fragrances wafting from the gardens of Thy Lordship, and this is a handmaiden who was illumined by the lights that shone and gleamed from the horizon of Thy Divinity. She believed in Thy Beauty, acknowledged Thy words, sought clarity in Thy proofs, witnessed Thy signs, and was related to a tree that grew in the garden of Thy knowledge, became verdant through the outpourings of the clouds of Thy mercy, blossomed with the flowers of Thy bestowal, and bore the fruits of Thy love.

Subject: eulogies; reminiscences
Quotation: O pure soul, Emily Knobloch! Though thou didst take flight from this dusty world, thou didst enter the luminous realm. Thou didst hear the divine call and beheld the light of truth. Through the breathing of the Holy Spirit thou wast given life, and thou didst taste the honey of the love of God. Thou didst become a handmaiden of the Lord of Hosts, became the cause of guiding souls, and wert the recipient of the favors of the Desired One. Thou didst guide the wayward and granted a portion of the heavenly feast to the deprived. Thou didst dedicate thy days of life to service to the All-Glorious Lord and engaged in diffusing the fragrances of the Most Glorious Paradise. How many souls were perfumed and how many hearts were illumined!

Subject: eulogies; reminiscences
Quotation: Upon thee be the glory of God and upon thee be the peace of God, O thou who hast believed in God and His signs, who hast acknowledged His words, who hast clung to the hem of His robe and held fast to the fringes of the garment of His grandeur. I testify that thou hast been faithful to the Covenant, that thy face hath been illumined by the light of the Lamp of the horizons, that through thee the eyes of the people of constancy have been gladdened, that thy heart hath found peace through the dawning of the light that hath spread through the seven layers, and that the resurrection of tears hath been established for thee in that thou wert made to suffer in the path of God, wert tried in thy love for God, and didst achieve martyrdom in thy steadfastness in the Covenant.

Subject: eulogies; reminiscences
Quotation: O Most Exalted Leaf, mentioned in the Crimson Book! Thou art she whom God created to arise for the service of His Own Self, the Manifestation of His Cause, the Dawning-Place of His Revelation, the Dayspring of His signs, and the Source of His laws. He strengthened thee in such wise that thou didst turn wholly unto Him when the servants and handmaidens turned away. Thou didst hear His most sweet call and didst respond to it, and thou wert with Him in all conditions, until thou didst migrate from the Land of ?a to Zawra, and from Zawra to the Land of Mystery, and thence to this Prison. Thou wert, during the nights and days, blessed with His presence, gazing upon His countenance, circling round His throne, hearing His call, dwelling in His house, clinging to His cord, and holding fast to the hem of the robe of His bounty and grace.

Subject: eulogies; reminiscences
Quotation: "His name was Mollah Salek Mogaddass. He was one of the learned men of Persia and when he became a believer he devoted his knowledge and erudition to the propagation of the Movement. With an unprecedented zeal and holy enthusiasm he upheld the teachings of the Bab and he was destined to play a most important part in the development of the Movement he became the object of the attack of the enemies. In Shiraz they did ran a cord through his nose and paraded him through the streets and Bazaars. He followed the spiritual destiny of the Cause and at last he was besieged by the royal army with the rest of the Babis in the famous fortress of Tabarassi in Mazanderan. Those who are slightly familiar with that dramatic or tragic episode know the privations and sufferings they had to go through. Finally when they were released and put to death he was one of the very few who was given freedom. Later on he came to Acca and visited the Blessed Perfection."

Quotation: As to thy seeking and mentioning the recognition of reality, and saying "Will not my will unite with Thy will?" - the tongue should seek forgiveness of God for this utterance, for this station is one whereunto the recognition of the mystics, the knowledge of the learned, and the realities of those in earth and heaven cannot attain. He hath ever been, in the heights of inaccessibility, sanctified above all else but Himself, and will forever remain, in the summit of His exaltation, hallowed above all that is besides Him. No one hath known Him as He should be known, and no soul hath comprehended Him as He should be comprehended, for this station hath been and shall ever be sanctified and exalted. The Books and Scriptures have testified to His sanctification and transcendence. Whosoever today beholdeth and recognizeth the hidden treasure through the concealed Name, hath attained unto his own Paradise and Kingdom, and this is the utmost station of the servant's recognition within the realm of possibility. Beyond this the path is barred and seeking is rejected. His proof is His Revelation, and His evidence is His being established upon His mighty Throne.... Furthermore, no one's will hath ever been or shall ever be united with God's will, for the will of all hath been and shall ever be as nothingness before His will. The glory of existence is for one to make his own will fade away in God's will - that is, to have no will, thought or imagination of his own, but to move by God's will and act accordingly. Deem not this matter imaginary. Whosoever today hath drunk of the sealed wine and acted according to that which hath proceeded from the Source of Command, hath attained unto God's will, and he is of the people of truth. And whosoever remaineth veiled from this station is accounted among the dead, even should he manifest the knowledge and recognition of the ancients.

Quotation: When He reached Kinar-Gird a fresh order came from the Prime Minister appointing the village of Kulayn as an abode and dwelling-place. There He remained for a period of twenty days. After that, the Bab forwarded a letter to the Royal Presence craving audience to set forth the truth of His condition, expecting this to be a means for the attainment of great advantages. The Prime Minister did not admit this, and made representation to the Royal Presence: The royal cavalcade is on the point of starting, and to engage in such matters as the present will conduce to the disruption of the kingdom. Neither is there any doubt that the most notable doctors of the capital also will behave after the fashion of the doctors of Isfahan, which thing will be the cause of a popular outbreak, or that, according to the religion of the immaculate Imam, they will regard the blood of this siyyid as of no account, yea, as more lawful than mother's milk....  So Mirza 'Ali-Asghar the Shaykhu'l-Islam, who was one of the noble Siyyids, brought Him to his own house and applied the rods with his own hand. After this they sent the Bab back to Chihriq and subjected Him to a strict confinement.

Subject: evolution; human evolution
Quotation: Among these animals is the snake, which has vestigial organs indicating that it once had legs, but over time this organ disappeared while traces of it remained. Likewise, in the human spine there is a trace that indicates that humans, like other animals, once had a tail. They maintain that its traces remain--that this organ was once useful, but when humans evolved it no longer served a purpose and thus gradually disappeared. The snake, too, found its dwelling underground and became a crawling creature, no longer needing legs, so they disappeared though their traces remained.

Subject: evolution; human evolution
Quotation: Between man and the ape, however, there is one link missing, and to the present time scientists have not been able to discover it. Therefore, the greatest proof of this western theory of human evolution is anatomical, reasoning that there are certain vestiges of organs found in man which are peculiar to the ape and lower animals...For example, a serpent has a certain appendage which indicates that at one time it was possessed of long limbs, but as this creature began to find its habitation in the holes of the earth, these limbs, no longer needed, became atrophied and shrunk.

Subject: evolution; human evolution
Quotation: The genesis of man upon this earthly sphere may be likened unto the formation of the human embryo in the maternal womb. The embryo gradually groweth and developeth until its birth, whereafter it continueth to grow and develop until it reacheth the state of maturity. Similarly doth the growth and development of all beings proceed by gradual degrees. This is the universal divine law and the natural order. The seed doth not suddenly become the tree; the embryo doth not at once become the man; the mineral substance doth not in a moment become the stone: Nay, all these grow and develop gradually until they attain the limit of perfection.

Subject: evolution; human evolution
Quotation: First station, that of the body, the solid or mineral condition which is referred to as Eden. The term "Eden" in the Arabic language means place of living or residing. Second station, that of the growing condition of man, which is the development from the mineral to the vegetable, referred to as the Garden of Eden. The garden, as you know, is the plane for plants to grow. Third station, that of the power of sensation, which condition is arrived at after leaving or developing from the vegetable to the animal, in which condition man begins to eat, drink, feel, etc., which sensations are referred to as the different kinds of fruits. Fourth station, that of mentality; in this condition or stage of development man is enabled to use his reasoning faculties, which is referred to as the station or tree of good and evil. Fifth station, that of the Kingdom of Faith in God, which condition depends upon one's attitude toward the Word of God.

Quotation: We counsel you, O My loved ones, to fear God and to follow what hath been sent down in His preserved Book. Act ye in accordance with what hath been revealed therein with joy and radiance. It will surely lead you to a praiseworthy station.

Subject: exhortations and counsels
Quotation: "You should conduct yourself with people in the same way as he conducted himself with them...In any case, you must, God willing, act in such a way that all the inhabitants of the Supreme Concourse and the angels brought nigh will rejoice."

Subject: exhortations and counsels
Quotation: Stand firm in the Cause through the power of thy Lord and remind the people with wisdom and utterance. Beware lest the affairs of men hold thee back from the truth. Leave the world behind and take what God hath sent down in His mighty Book.

Subject: exhortations and counsels
Quotation: O ?abibu'llah! We counsel thee and them that have believed to be trustworthy and chaste, and to that wherefrom the detached ones perceive the fragrance of detachment, and the sincere ones the sweet savour of My glorious and beloved garment.

Subject: exhortations and counsels
Quotation: Thou must, God willing, be ever turned toward the Most Exalted Horizon and act in accordance with that which befitteth the Day of God. Know thou the value of these days and occupy thyself with the remembrance of the Best-Beloved of all possibility.

Subject: exhortations and counsels
Quotation: Show patience with Mahdi Beheshti as well; perhaps he will remember or fear God. Be infinitely kind to the Iranians. Engage only in praising the righteous, and strive that, God willing, Abu'l-Hassan Khan may become attracted to the Beauty of the Beloved.

Subject: exhortations and counsels
Quotation: This entire tablet is an exhortation to spiritual virtues and proper conduct, particularly: "Strive thou to attain to such a station that mention of it shall endure as long as God's most beautiful names endure. Reflect a little and act as befitteth thee."

Subject: exhortations and counsels
Quotation: Remember my counsels, heed my advice. Act in such wise that you may shine forth in the Kingdom of God and adorn your countenance with the light of Baha and the radiance of the Covenant. Show forth a lofty aspiration and be not content with a moment or a dewdrop.

Subject: exhortations and counsels
Quotation: "Gird up the loins of service and enter the company of the angels of the kingdom of oneness so that on the shore of the Most Great Sea you may catch the thirsty fish of the ocean of understanding and in the land of unity hunt the gazelles in the meadow of truth"

Subject: exhortations and counsels
Quotation: O loved ones of the All-Merciful in all lands! Remember your Lord with spirit and fragrance, and hold fast unto that which ye have been commanded in His perspicuous Book. He hath commanded you that which profiteth you - to this testifieth every discerning scholar.

Subject: exhortations and counsels
Quotation: Counsel the servants to trustworthiness and godliness, and to that whereby the Word of God may be exalted amongst His servants. Hold thou fast in all conditions unto the wisdom that hath been sent down in the Book, a command from God, the Sovereign of the Kingdom.

Subject: exhortations and counsels
Quotation: Counsel the servants regarding trustworthiness and truthfulness, and to act according to what hath been revealed in the Tablets. Say: O people! Adorn yourselves with the attributes of the All-Merciful in the realm of possibility. Beware lest ye follow your passions.

Subject: exhortations and counsels
Quotation: O My friends! Act ye in accordance with what ye have been commanded in the Book. Well is it with the one who fulfilleth My decrees for the love of My Beauty, and woe to the one who neglecteth the Dayspring of Command in the days of his Lord, the Almighty, the Omnipotent.

Subject: exhortations and counsels
Quotation: Today, the confirmations of the Blessed Beauty are with the soul who utterly forgets himself, constantly investigates his own faults and defects, loosens his tongue in mentioning the good qualities and sublime susceptibilities of others, does not see or hear or speak evil.

Subject: exhortations and counsels
Quotation: Let not that which hath appeared from the dayspring of tyranny frighten thee, and let not the clamor of every remote ignorant one sadden thee. Hold fast unto the cord of wisdom in all circumstances, lest there appear that which would sadden the hearts of those who have turned towards God.

Subject: exhortations and counsels
Quotation: You must certainly exercise the utmost vigilance and explicitly forbid everyone from this, for no characteristic is more harmful than this trait of fault-finding, especially in relation to the Cause of God. Never should anyone express a word or hint that is unworthy about any of the friends of God.

Subject: exhortations and counsels
Quotation: Therefore, follow the path of Christ and traverse His vast arena, and follow the people of God in every time and place. As for political affairs, they are temporary and partial matters with no substance beneath them, and no one who has tasted the sweetness of the love of God occupies himself with them.

Subject: exhortations and counsels
Quotation: O Branch! Upon thee be My glory and My loving-kindness. We counsel thee and those who have believed to observe trustworthiness, godliness, forgiveness and generosity, that the lights of virtuous character may shine forth and illumine the earth amidst this darkness that hath encompassed the kingdom of God.

Subject: exhortations and counsels
Quotation: Be content with what God hath been pleased with, and be not one who doubteth His Cause...Purify thyself from the allusions of the people, then thy breast from that which hindereth thee from this bounty...Let not thy soul be troubled, and fear no one. Look unto God and what is with Him, not what is with thee.

Subject: exhortations and counsels
Quotation: Remember thy Lord by night and by day, and voice His praise amongst His servants, that perchance through His praise the fire of His love may be kindled in the hearts of the well-favored, and all may arise to praise God, their Lord and the Lord of all that is seen and unseen, and the Lord of your fathers of old.

Subject: exhortations and counsels
Quotation: The bounty of God hath been and shall, if it be His will, continue to be with thee. He is the Commander, the All-Knowing and the Omnipotent. He commandeth His lovers to do that which is the cause of their salvation and prosperity. Cling thou to the Cause of thy Lord. It verily benefitteth thee in every world of His worlds.

Subject: exhortations and counsels
Quotation: Do not imagine that you have been forgotten or that we have ceased to mention you... The exigencies of the time and wisdom required that all should not be fettered... Indeed separation from the Holy Land was difficult for you, but one must be patient and forbearing. Besides submission and contentment what choice is there?

Subject: exhortations and counsels
Quotation: Take ye the chalice of eternity from the fingers of holiness, then drink therefrom by the leave of your Lord, the Most High, the Most Exalted, and tarry not even for a moment... Cast away what ye possess and take what God hath graciously given you, then journey in the wilderness of His knowledge and tarry not even for a moment.

Subject: exhortations and counsels
Quotation: Put forth a hand from thy sleeve and scatter the treasure of the spirit throughout the regions of the world. Put thy tongue and utterance to use in promoting the religion of God and exalting the Word of God, that thou mayyst, like a polished sword, conquer the realms and, like the morning breeze, bestow new life upon yearning hearts.

Subject: exhortations and counsels
Quotation: All the friends must, in the nights and days, beseech the Exalted Truth, glorified be His majesty, for the exaltation of the Cause, that perchance all may attain to the Cause of God and His religion. God willing, the waters of the world shall not prevent you from the Kawthar of God, and gold shall not make you heedless of the divine path.

Subject: exhortations and counsels
Quotation: We have counseled all with that which profiteth them, without regard to that which profiteth Us. The hem of divine bounty is far more expansive and elevated than to be circumscribed by the doubts and imaginings of His servants. The purpose of His binding commandments and firm ordinances hath been and is the glory of His Cause and the exaltation of His loved ones.

Subject: exhortations and counsels
Quotation: Rather, their thoughts must be centered on one purpose and their aim focused on a single goal: the diffusion of the divine fragrances, the exaltation of the Word of God, the chanting of the verses of God, and the wafting of the breeze of God. If this bounty is attained, all hopes will be fulfilled and realized; otherwise no endeavor will yield fruit or provide benefit.

Subject: exhortations and counsels
Quotation: Look not unto your own own personal interests, but rather unto that which shall profit all mankind. Thus doth command you the Lord of Pre-existence. He, verily, is the Commander, the All-Hearing, the All-Seeing. We love to behold each one of you as the source of all good and the dawning-place of righteousness amidst all the worlds. Prefer your brethren before yourselves.

Subject: exhortations and counsels
Quotation: This question of the union of the white and the black is very important, for if it is not realized, ere long great difficulties will arise and harmful results will follow. Therefore, the believers and the maidservants of the Merciful must exercise the utmost endeavor to bring affiliation of hearts between the white and the black and seek the confirmation of the Holy Spirit.

Subject: exhortations and counsels
Quotation: O Ja'far! Make thy purpose the purpose of all mankind. Set aside all else, for this shall suffice thee, by the Lord of all worlds. If the purpose of thy heart be other than what hath been revealed in the Tablet, it shall be but scattered dust, by the Lord of the Exalted Throne. Fix thy heart upon the Most Great Purpose, for verily it is the Lote Tree beyond which there is no passing

Subject: exhortations and counsels
Quotation: O handmaiden of God! Thy letter was received. The doors of the Kingdom are open and the bounty of God is like unto the spring rain. Although the signs of material bounty are abundant, yet the true bounty is that of heaven, which bestoweth life eternal. Follow this and thy heart shall become as beautiful as a garden, thine eyes illumined, thy spirit joyous and thy thoughts a solace to souls.

Subject: exhortations and counsels
Quotation: From the beginning of your acceptance of the Faith in the days of God ye have arisen to serve the Cause of God and have trodden the path of faithfulness in the way of the Most Glorious Beauty. Ye have ever been occupied with teaching the Cause of God and have devoted yourselves to the promotion of the religion of God. In truth, ye deserve His grace and are the recipients of the favors of His Divine Unity.

Subject: exhortations and counsels
Quotation: O friends of God! If you desire the joy and gladness, the repose of spirit and peace of conscience of 'Abdu'l-Baha, add to your unity and concord. Be as the waves of one sea, the drops of one river, the flowers of one rose garden, and the links of one coat of mail. Soar in one atmosphere and sing in one melody and voice. This is the cause of eternal joy and the comfort of the heart in the everlasting world.

Subject: exhortations and counsels
Quotation: Praise be to God that in the great Temple of the Jews in San Francisco, proofs were produced to demonstrate the truth of Christ's divine Revelation, and all listened with great joy. No one objected. At the end of the speech, they expressed utmost gratitude. One said, "I am ashamed to be a Jew, and I shall not be one hereafter". Another Jew, when he met us on the street, said, "Truly this speech was a speech of Isaiah the prophet".

Subject: exhortations and counsels
Quotation: O Rida! Strive that thou mayest attain unto that which beseemeth this divine Day, and act in accordance with that which its fragrance shall endure throughout the kingdom of earth and heaven. Strive that the temple of faith and certitude may remain protected from the darts of doubts cast by the heedless and the opposition of the suspicious ones. This is the station of the supreme steadfastness. Blessed are they who attain thereunto.

Subject: exhortations and counsels
Quotation: Now, with divine strength, heavenly power, celestial attraction, spiritual resolve, heartfelt glad-tidings, radiant vigor, an eloquent tongue, surpassing utterance, perfect remembrance, and comprehensive confirmations, return to the land of Ta and from there to the land of Kha. Gather all the loved ones of the land of Kha around the all-embracing Word, the brilliant gift, the manifest sign and the resplendent banner of the Book of God and the Religion of God

Subject: exhortations and counsels
Quotation: Today the world is in turmoil and most of the peoples of the earth are veiled by the dust of doubt and suspicion. Beseech God to dispel with the Kawthar of utterance this dust that has darkened the world, and to illumine all through the light of justice. Verily He is the Mighty, the Powerful. We send greetings to the friends and counsel them with what is befitting. Say: Hold fast to wisdom, for it will benefit you in all conditions. Blessed is he who acts, and woe unto every heedless doubter.

Subject: exhortations and counsels
Quotation: O friends of the Friend, come to yourselves! O lovers of the Beloved, become conscious! O seekers of Truth, detach yourselves! O hearers of the Word of truth, open the ear of reality and the eye of insight! Let not this transient wealth prevent you from standing in the holy presence of the Beloved, nor this outward glory become a veil in the path of Truth. Open the eye of righteousness and the vision of uprightness, and bring the ear of fairness into the presence of Truth. Neglect not even for a moment.

Subject: exhortations and counsels
Quotation: Choose ye nothing for yourselves except what ye desire for God, the Lord of the worlds. Do no deed except with sincerity for God, the Lord of the worlds. Listen to no word except that ye listen through God for God, the Lord of the worlds. Look at nothing except that ye look through God for God, the Lord of the worlds. Bear witness to nothing except that ye bear witness through God for God, the Lord of the worlds. Speak not except through God for God, the Lord of the worlds. Preserve nothing except through God for God, the Lord of the worlds.

Subject: exhortations and counsels
Quotation: In the gathering of hearts you occupy the seat of highest respect, and in reality of souls you deserve complete honor. You are the descendant of that illustrious one and the fruit of that supreme paradise garden. Therefore we are expectant and hopeful, watchful and in intense anticipation that this delicate branch, like its noble root, will become fruitful with the utmost freshness and grace, and will gain verdancy and vitality from the life-giving breezes, and will become the ornament and adornament of the divine garden and yield perpetual fruit.

Subject: exhortations and counsels
Quotation: One must exercise care in all matters and, after their manifestation, hold fast to consultation in deeds. Verily our Lord is the Ever-Present, the All-Seeing, the All-Knowing, the All-Informed. The friends must hold fast to consultation, and cleave to such means as will draw the hearts of God's servants nearer. By wisdom is meant such deeds and character as attract souls and draw them to the Most Great Ocean - not actions that cause estrangement, hatred and enmity. The friends must surely not be content to appear lowly and insignificant in the eyes of others.

Subject: exhortations and counsels
Quotation: Be ye, O people, God's trustees in His earth, and be not of them that betray their trust. Beware lest ye act treacherously toward anyone, for treachery is not befitting the True One. Deal not with anything save by God's leave. Consume not the substance of others wrongfully, but observe God's balance and His justice, and be not of the oppressors. Be ye so faithful that should anyone entrust to your keeping all the treasures of the earth and whatsoever is therein, ye would not turn toward them nor incline your gaze in their direction, nor stretch forth your hands toward them. Hold ye fast unto the cord of God and His grace, then unto His might and His grandeur.

Subject: exhortations and counsels
Quotation: Hearken thou unto My counsel, and unto that which the Tongue of God doth utter in this wondrous Age. Beware lest anything deter thee or any matter hinder thee. Strive within thyself, then endeavor in thine essence, that thou mayest be numbered among the righteous in this Cause, whereby the people of the realms of mystical insight are terrified, and the dwellers of the pavilions of certitude are dismayed, and the spirits of them that are nigh unto God are thunderstruck, and the mountain of the arrogant is crushed. Purify thine eyes from all else save Him, then abandon all that is in thy hands, then sanctify thyself from all who are in the earth and the heavens, that thou mayest be enabled to stand firm in the Cause whereat the feet of the sincere ones slip. Then detach thyself from thine own self and from all else besides, and from the souls of the polytheists.

Subject: existence and nonexistence; preexistence
Quotation: The contingent nature of the world lieth in its being preceded by a cause, while absolute pre-existence hath ever been and will continue to be the exclusive attribute of God, glorified be His mention.

Subject: existence and nonexistence; preexistence
Quotation: In what condition is the soul before entering the body? In a state of potentiality, possessing no consciousness as we understand it.

Subject: existence and nonexistence; preexistence
Quotation: In this mortal dust-heap, every nostril that becomes perfumed with the breaths of the All-Merciful hath received a portion from the realm of pre-existence and gained a share from the divine Kingdom of everlasting being. Otherwise, alas for us! Woe betide us! All moments would be fruitless, foundations scattered to the winds, and manifest loss would appear.

Subject: existence and nonexistence; preexistence
Quotation: If the reality and essence are other than existence and not identical with existence, then existence can be separated from it because it is derived from other or because it is other than the essence... Every existent whose existence is derived from another, or whose existence is other than its essence and whose essence is other than its existence, can be separated from existence. But existence itself cannot be conceived as separate from itself

Subject: existence; immortality of the human soul
Quotation: Therefore, consider from the highest point of existence to the lowest point of existence which is dust itself and look at all beings, all tribes, all nations, all peoples - all are facing finality except those loved ones who have hastened to the city of divine providence, those poor ones who have sought refuge in the precincts of absolute wealth, those ailing ones who have come to the divine infirmary. These souls are like brilliant stars in all the grades of existence; they will shine from the everlasting horizon as luminous as a full moon, even in the material world.

Subject: existence; immortality of the human soul
Quotation: You will retain your individuality and will not be swallowed up in one vast spirit. The essence of the human soul is clarified from material substances and purified from the embodiment of physical things. It is exclusively luminous; it has no body; it is a dazzling pencil of light; it is a celestial orb of brightness.

Subject: existence; immortality of the human soul
Quotation: They are not at all annihilated. They are immortal. But the spirits of heavenly souls will find eternal life, that is, they will attain to the highest and most great stations of perfection. But the spirits of the heedless souls although they are immortal yet they are in a world of imperfection, concealment and ignorance.

Subject: existence; immortality of the human soul
Quotation: This very independence from the body indicates that the spirit need not perish with the decomposition of the body. The effects of the spirit remain and are manifest in the world. How can there be an effect without an effecter? Existence is necessary for effects to be manifest from it. If we consider carefully, nothing becomes absolutely non-existent; at most its form changes. The vicissitudes and accidents that befall the body have no effect upon the spirit, whether from illness, fatigue, stoutness and obesity, or thinness and privation. No accident that befalls the body has any effect upon the spirit, therefore the decomposition of this body has no effect upon it either.
