Subject: expressions of grief; lamentation; sadness
Quotation: Your cries and complaints and sighs and laments are all justified and you are right - truly you have been left alone.

Subject: expressions of grief; lamentation; sadness
Quotation: "O grieving Leaf! Thou, alas, art left a captive at the perigee of existence and art suffering the supreme affliction"

Subject: expressions of grief; lamentation; sadness
Quotation: Glory be to God! His existence is heavier than Mount Abu Qubays and weightier than the solid rock in the Valley of Qays

Subject: expressions of grief; lamentation; sadness
Quotation: The ascension of Aqa Musa caused grief and sorrow, and difficulties arising from the former wife added to the distress.

Subject: expressions of grief; lamentation; sadness
Quotation: I am extremely concerned about the disordered state of affairs of that kind friend, and am thinking of you every moment.

Quotation: That which hath caused all things to lament and the tears of them that know to flow hath befallen you in the path of God.

Quotation: "The heart of Baha hath been so distressed that all things have been seized with perturbation" and "Verily thy Lord mourneth"

Quotation: Fie upon a people who wronged you, slew you, and pillaged your possessions. By My life! The people are indeed in grievous loss.

Subject: expressions of grief; lamentation; sadness
Quotation: A detailed letter was sent in the previous post. Now too the ocean of divine love has surged and cast forth a wave, and purely out of remembrance of you and to express the truth of that love which radiates and shines forth from the spirit and heart, I have undertaken to pen these brief lines.

Subject: expressions of grief; lamentation; sadness
Quotation: God the One is witness that boundless joy was attained from its arrival, though grief had encompassed this servant due to the sorrows that had befallen those beloved ones. What befell his eminence, the embodied spirit, Nabil-ibn-Nabil, upon him be the Most Glorious Baha of God, hath grieved all.

Subject: expressions of grief; lamentation; sadness
Quotation: Lord! Hearts have reached the throat, and troubles and afflictions have intensified, with none to remove them save Your all-encompassing mercy, Your brilliant bounty, Your conquering might, and Your prevailing power. Lord! Lord! How long shall these trials continue, and how long these calamities?

Subject: expressions of grief; lamentation; sadness
Quotation: O my God, O my God! Not a day hath passed over 'Abdu'l-Baha that hath not brought with it for him some dire calamity, nor any night hath ended wherein he hath not heard tidings of some grievous affliction such as to cause hearts to break, souls to melt, tears to flow, and sighs to ascend to heaven.

Subject: expressions of grief; lamentation; sadness
Quotation: Your affliction hath grieved Me and that which hath befallen you, and likewise those who have circled round Me and have clung to the cord of My bounty and My mercy... How many nights and days have you been sorrowful due to the oppression of the servants, and the greatest of afflictions is separation

Subject: expressions of grief; lamentation; sadness
Quotation: When the Bird of Captivity calls out from the direction of Iraq and sings the verses of separation, thereby are the hearts of those who are nigh unto God disturbed. And when you hear that the Bird of Holiness has flown from one branch to another, grieve not within yourself nor be of the disturbed ones.

Subject: expressions of grief; lamentation; sadness
Quotation: O thou my affectionate sister! In the daytime and in the night-season my thoughts ever turn to thee. Not for one moment do I cease to remember thee. My sorrow and regret concern not myself; they centre around thee. Whenever I recall thine afflictions, tears that I cannot repress rain down from mine eyes.

Subject: expressions of grief; lamentation; sadness
Quotation: O Kind Lord! Thou knowest and bearest witness that in this chess game of separation I am so confined, forsaken, sorrowful and grief-stricken that my breath is cut off and not a moment's rest remaineth to me. Mine eyes are weeping, my heart is burning, my soul is aflame, and the fire of longing is manifest.

Subject: expressions of grief; lamentation; sadness
Quotation: His heart grew lowly; his love surged; his eyes ran down with tears in this extremity; and he sighed as one distraught with love during those days, such was his yearning towards Thee. He begged forgiveness for his transgression, trusting in Thee; and pronounced his confession before the remnant of God's mercy

Subject: expressions of grief; lamentation; sadness
Quotation: My food is the fragments of My broken heart, and My drink the droplets of My blood. My companion is My fingernails, Mine associate My pen, and My mainstay reliance upon God. Thereby the hearts of men have cried out, the pillars of the Throne have buckled, and the clouds of holiness have wept tears of crimson.

Subject: expressions of grief; lamentation; sadness
Quotation: Concerning what was mentioned about the ascension of the sister, upon her be the Glory of God, mention of this was previously recorded by the Pen of God and sent. I beseech God to cause all to attain unto that which will enable them to drink from the ocean of the utterance of the Desired One of all the worlds.

Subject: expressions of grief; lamentation; sadness
Quotation: The entire prayer is a profound lamentation expressing intense grief, pain and suffering, with vivid metaphors like "Sorrows surge like seas and griefs swoop down like birds upon scattered seeds" and "The liver is wounded, O my God, and the innards are injured, O my Beloved, and blood is spilled, O my Master!"

Subject: expressions of grief; lamentation; sadness
Quotation: It seems all remain buried in the graves of heedlessness and desire. They were not moved by the rustling of the Divine Lote Tree nor stirred by the sweet waters of mercy. How many divine verses and heavenly proofs pass before them night and day, yet none perceives except him whom the hand of divine will has saved.

Subject: expressions of grief; lamentation; sadness
Quotation: Glory be unto Thee, O Thou Who art the King of names, for that Thou hast converted joy into vexation, and pitched the tent of sorrows during Thy festival of Ridvan. O My Lord! The sea of troubles hath surged during the days of Thy happiness, and the fragrance of sorrows hath wafted even in the day of Thy blissful joy.

Subject: expressions of grief; lamentation; sadness
Quotation: His glorious heart was broken, as He found not the fragrance of faithfulness from these who claimed to love Him. Thereupon He stirred once again the thread of His Cause in the innermost hearts of the captives through the ascension of the Spirit of Glory from the atmosphere of nearness unto a lofty and remote atmosphere.

Subject: expressions of grief; lamentation; sadness
Quotation: At this time, when the severity of cold makes speech impossible and the abundance of ice and snow prevents movement, some of the children, in separation from their loved ones, recite verses of parting, while others, in despair of home and country, moan like the sick and wander bewildered in the wilderness of perplexity.

Subject: expressions of grief; lamentation; sadness
Quotation: O loved ones of the All-Merciful! Be not grieved at what hath befallen you. None should grieve in the days of God - He Who possesseth the knowledge of the Book beareth witness to this. Verily the Dayspring of generosity remembereth you, the Source of grace calleth you, and the Manifestation of faithfulness consoleth you.

Subject: expressions of grief; lamentation; sadness
Quotation: Rapture and ecstasy have appeared in the City of Lovers, for a precious gem among gems has sought its mine, and a lover among lovers has outstripped all others and sacrificed himself in the path of the Desire of all worlds. The wolf has devoured, the oppressor has slain, and the serpent has opened its mouth and swallowed.

Subject: expressions of grief; lamentation; sadness
Quotation: O Nawwab! The All-Giving remembers thee from the prison quarter, at a time when He hears the buzzing of flies on His right, and the howling of wolves on His left, and beholds the banners of sorrow before His face. Were We to recount unto thee what hath befallen Us in these days, thou wouldst weep as those who are bereaved.

Subject: expressions of grief; lamentation; sadness
Quotation: For some time now the mind of this exiled one hath suffered from the thought of all the afflictions and adversity that have befallen the friends. With every breath I have lifted up my lamentations to the Kingdom of everlasting might. I am deeply affected at all times and grievously saddened by the flood of your adversities.

Subject: expressions of grief; lamentation; sadness
Quotation: From the time of sunset when I attained the honor of Thy presence until now, which is the afternoon of Thursday, the twenty-eighth of the revered month of Sha'ban, praise and gratitude be to God for what He has ordained for me - all has passed well, and whatever sadness there has been was the sadness of yearning for Thy presence.

Subject: expressions of grief; lamentation; sadness
Quotation: The point is this: be assured that this servant has no hardship, difficulty or fatigue. I am occupied with myself and free from all mental preoccupations save one thought that causes disturbance of mind, and that is lest you be sorrowful. Through the grace and favor of the Ancient Beauty, I hope that He may grant solace to hearts.

Subject: expressions of grief; lamentation; sadness
Quotation: Sorrows have encompassed Us from every side through that which the hands of the aggressors have wrought, yet My Most Exalted Pen moveth at all times and traverseth the field of utterance in such wise that neither the power of the mighty nor the hosts of those who have disbelieved in God, the Omnipotent, the Almighty, can hinder it.

Subject: expressions of grief; lamentation; sadness
Quotation: O Lord! This is a stranger who hath hastened to his most exalted home beneath the shadow of Thy mercy, and a sick one who hath turned toward the ocean of Thy healing. Therefore, O my God and Enkindler of fire within my liver, behold the tears of mine eyes, the sighs of my heart, the burning of my liver, and the blazing of my limbs.

Subject: expressions of grief; lamentation; sadness
Quotation: That which thou hadst written with the pen of sorrows upon the page of griefs was read and perused with utmost care. From its meanings, full of moaning and lamentation, was inhaled the fragrance of grief and great sorrow. We were saddened from one perspective and astonished from another - saddened by the intensity of thy lamentation

Subject: expressions of grief; lamentation; sadness
Quotation: By the life of God, that which hath saddened thee hath grieved me also, for from the first day I attained the presence of thy person, I have shared in thy sorrows and rejoiced in thy joy, been gladdened by thy gladness and troubled by thy troubles. Were it not for the Lord of Days, I would have been among those who lament and cry out

Subject: expressions of grief; lamentation; sadness
Quotation: Verily, the heaven weepeth and the clouds lament, the mountains cry out and hearts are in turmoil. Would that I had been with them and had attained to what they attained! A hundred thousand regrets that this evanescent one did not attain to this most great bounty! I swear by the Ancient Beauty that this regret remaineth in the heart.

Subject: expressions of grief; lamentation; sadness
Quotation: From this most great calamity, were we to wail and lament for a hundred thousand years, were we to begin tearing our clothes and rending our collars, were we to shed tears and cast dust upon our heads, were we to burn and melt away - this pain shall find no cure, this wound shall accept no healing, and this flame shall not be quenched.

Subject: expressions of grief; lamentation; sadness
Quotation: Recall to mind My sorrows, My cares and anxieties, My woes and trials, the state of My captivity, the tears that I have shed, the bitterness of Mine anguish, and now Mine imprisonment in this far-off land... Couldst thou be told what hath befallen the Ancient Beauty, thou wouldst flee into the wilderness, and weep with a great weeping...

Subject: expressions of grief; lamentation; sadness
Quotation: By Thy glory! Hope hath been cut off from me, the gates of joy have been closed before me, and affliction hath encompassed me from every direction. Thou seest me sitting in the depths, with sleeplessness as my companion... alone and friendless in this furthest shore, weeping with the weeping of the bereaved, and lamenting like the dove.

Subject: expressions of grief; lamentation; sadness
Quotation: "I bear witness that, due to thy remoteness from the court of nearness, thy liver was consumed, thy joy was turned to sorrow and great was thy calamity." "We testify, and the near ones and the sincere ones bear witness, that separation hath consumed thee, such that thy sighs have ascended and thy tears have fallen in the nights and days."

Subject: expressions of grief; lamentation; sadness
Quotation: This evanescent servant reflects how the idolaters have surrounded the lands of the unitarians, and such grief seizes him that he is truly unable to describe it. What hath caused these humiliations? The resplendent Law, with its supreme glory and its mighty sovereignty, is now witnessed in such a state. The eye weeps and the heart laments.

Subject: expressions of grief; lamentation; sadness
Quotation: Your letter of condolence regarding the supreme calamity of the passing of Abu'l-Fadl brought solace to our hearts. As for Abu'l-Fadl, praise be to God, in his own time, as soon as news of his death spread to distant cities, people mourned and shed tears, joined in sighs and laments, and sought the elevation of his station in their prayers.

Subject: expressions of grief; lamentation; sadness
Quotation: In these days the divine tests are like unto a surging ocean - ships of being are shattered and submerged by this tempest. You have observed this servant, in what affliction he is caught: night and day blood streams from mine eyes and pieces of my burning liver fall away. Weep thou a while for my condition and raise thy voice in lamentation.

Subject: expressions of grief; lamentation; sadness
Quotation: This is Thy servant who fashioned with his own hands what he fashioned for Thee, then was afflicted after that with separation and remoteness from Thee, whereby patience departed from all who have eyes to see, and whereby arose the lamentations of those near unto Thee, then their crying, and the weeping of the monotheists, then their weeping.

Subject: expressions of grief; lamentation; sadness
Quotation: Trials have intensified upon me from all directions, and I have been burned by every blazing fire and flames of anguish kindled between my ribs and bowels...The fire of grief is ablaze and the flame of separation has burned the soul. Sighs and lamentations rise from the heart to heaven. Moaning and groaning are companions to the sorrowful soul.

Subject: expressions of grief; lamentation; sadness
Quotation: The shocking news of the passing of that cherished maidservant of God reached the spiritual gathering. All the friends of God, both women and men, became extremely sorrowful and heartbroken, and were grieved and distressed that such a calamity had befallen you and such mourning had resulted, to such an extent that all shared in this sorrow and grief.

Subject: expressions of grief; lamentation; sadness
Quotation: The grief of this Wronged One hath not been from enemies, for whatsoever hath come to pass in God's path hath been, by My life, beloved. But the grief and affliction and tribulation of this Wronged One have been from certain souls who claim attachment to the Truth yet have committed that which caused the Pen of God to lament and the Eye of God to weep.

Subject: expressions of grief; lamentation; sadness
Quotation: Thou didst cleave to the door and wept as the clouds weep, causing the hearts of companions to soften and the tears of the loved ones to flow, inflaming hearts in the Most Great Prison in the Frequented House. From thee arose weeping and lamentation at sunset and in the dark of night unto the Concourse on High: "Glory be to my Lord, the Most Glorious!"

Subject: expressions of grief; lamentation; sadness
Quotation: O City of God! How canst thou endure this separation that sets Iraq ablaze and melts the horizons?...O land of the City! How canst thou bear anything in creation after the departure of God's burden, the Mighty, the Powerful? How can roses appear from thee and plants of glory spring forth after the disappearance of God's rose, the Transcendent, the Luminous?

Subject: expressions of grief; lamentation; sadness
Quotation: But hearts are rent asunder and souls are choked and breasts heave and tears flow and sighs rise and sorrows intensify when I remember the ascension of Thy good and pure maidservant...her tears continued to flow and her heart to melt and her inner being to burn and her sighs to rise and her tears to pour forth in the desert of longing, consumed by separation

Subject: expressions of grief; lamentation; sadness
Quotation: My bones are worn and my body is wasted, And my heart is scorched from the heat of its burning. Thy passion hath bewildered me and Thy love hath tested me, And Thy separation hath dissolved me while union with Thee is my desire. And from the secret of my sorrow the heavens were nearly rent asunder, And from the anguish of my heart the earth of the soul was cleft.

Subject: expressions of grief; lamentation; sadness
Quotation: Though in these days a fresh calamity hath occurred and a grievous affliction hath come to pass--the bird of holiness hath grown weary of its earthly nest and winged its flight to its heavenly abode in the Most Glorious Kingdom. In brief, for the departed soul this is a great bounty and supreme mercy, but for those left behind it is grief, separation, and anguish.

Subject: expressions of grief; lamentation; sadness
Quotation: O Salman! Sorrows have so encompassed Me that the tongue of the All-Merciful has been prevented from making mention of exalted matters. I swear by the Lord of all possibility that the gates of the paradise of inner meanings have been shut due to the oppression of the idolaters, and the breezes of divine knowledge have been cut off from the right hand of divine unity.

Subject: expressions of grief; lamentation; sadness
Quotation: Every time I turn to my right, I hear the voice of the lamentation of them that are dear to Thee, whom the infidels have made captives for having believed in Thee and in Thy signs. The hearts of Thy chosen ones, O my Lord, have melted because of their separation from Thee, and the souls of Thy loved ones are burnt up by the fire of their yearning after Thee in Thy days.

Subject: expressions of grief; lamentation; sadness
Quotation: He lamented in separation until the fruits lamented with him. Through his yearning all things yearned, and through his burning the fire of longing was kindled in all regions...My liver hath melted in separation from Thee and my pillars have been shaken in Thy days. By Thy glory, the burning of separation from Thee and my remoteness from the court of Thy nearness have destroyed me.

Subject: expressions of grief; lamentation; sadness
Quotation: Now that we are in the time after the Most Great Calamity and the Supreme Affliction, if in the past one became sorrowful over the death of someone, it could be said they were excused. However, after the ascension of the Abha Beauty to the Invisible Kingdom and the setting of the Sun of Truth, if anyone becomes sorrowful over anyone's passing and death, in truth they should be fined.

Subject: expressions of grief; lamentation; sadness
Quotation: Great indeed is your calamity, momentous your affliction, and grievous what hath befallen in your presence. From the beginning when God's knowledge encompassed what befell you, eyes have wept for you and hearts have been wounded for you, until the first moment when God shall raise you up on the Day of Resurrection from the resting places of your souls, as He shall raise up His Friend.

Subject: expressions of grief; lamentation; sadness
Quotation: By God the Truth, verily the heart is in sorrow, and the spirit is in distress, and the inmost heart is in severe pain from what hath befallen the Cause of God through calamities and the spread of calumnies from souls who are turned upside down... And I, by the life of God, weep blood for what hath transpired, and I steel myself against the fire of hatred, and I wail like one bereaved

Subject: expressions of grief; lamentation; sadness
Quotation: The nightingale of separation, perched upon the branch of the horizon, calls out in grief, you who are filled with yearning; The bird of loyalty sings upon the tree of eternity with the strains of this parting, you who are filled with yearning; As does the dove of the two seas upon the twigs of the lote-tree of separation-- that the departure is imminent, you who are filled with yearning.

Subject: expressions of grief; lamentation; sadness
Quotation: By My life! My condition and circumstances have transcended mention and utterance. While I was sitting upon the ashes, crying and weeping for Myself and for what had befallen Me from the loved ones, at that moment a letter arrived and was presented by the servant who was present before Me. We heard a plaintive cry whereat the Maid of Heaven lamented and a shriek whereat the fruits cried out

Subject: expressions of grief; lamentation; sadness
Quotation: The hearts are burning and the eyes are weeping at the news of the martyrdom of that flashing light, ?adiq. The breasts are wounded and the spirits crushed by sorrow and anguish... O would that our eyes were an encompassing sea so that the waves of our tears, like a flood, could flow forth. But what is the use, when the world itself is not vast enough to contain the mourning of the friends.

Subject: expressions of grief; lamentation; sadness
Quotation: "By reason of the oppression and atrocities that have befallen those two souls whom the people of the world have wronged, ye have raised the cry of lamentation and grieving and have wept and sighed bitterly... There is no doubt that as a result of those dire woes and sufferings the hearts of the friends of God have been set aflame like unto a candle and they bemoan their grief with tearful eyes."

Subject: expressions of grief; lamentation; sadness
Quotation: In any case, man is astonished, the world is astonished. For one thousand two hundred years and more they turned away from truth and clung to falsehood. If anyone spoke about the birth of the Manifestation, they would immediately deem it necessary to kill and dishonor him. How utterly strange that among all those divines, not one attained true knowledge or tasted a drop from the ocean of awareness.

Subject: expressions of grief; lamentation; sadness
Quotation: This evanescent servant is bewildered every moment - have the people of the Bayan not recognized the words and deeds of the past? The Shi'ites possessed not one word of truth; they uttered various calumnies in the name of truth, and those calumnies became the cause of the shedding of the blood of the Beloved of the world, and the Lord and Sovereign of existence was imprisoned in the prison of Akka.

Subject: expressions of grief; lamentation; sadness
Quotation: The floods of afflictions are let loose, and the winds of Thy judgment have blown, and from the clouds rain down the darts of tests, and the heavens of Thy decree pour forth the arrows of trial...They were seized with such trials that the clouds weep over them and the thunder groaneth by reason of the manifold tribulations that have afflicted them in their love for Thee and for the sake of Thy pleasure.

Subject: expressions of grief; lamentation; sadness
Quotation: How can I send greetings unto Thee, O Beloved of my heart, after having heard what befell Thee, whereby the heavens are well-nigh rent asunder, the earth cleft, and the mountains crumble to dust? Unto God do I complain, and unto Thee is the return. Would that I had been with Thee that I might have ransomed myself for Thee, and that I might attain that which Thou didst attain through the mercy of my Lord!

Subject: expressions of grief; lamentation; sadness
Quotation: Your wailing and lamentation has cast such grief and sorrow upon 'Abdu'l-Baha that even the denizens of the Supreme Concourse, despite their sanctification and detachment from sorrows, were affected and saddened. In truth, if in this mourning a flood of tears were to flow like the Oxus River, it would be fitting and appropriate... All the loved ones of Tehran became sorrowful and despondent, as did other friends.

Subject: expressions of grief; lamentation; sadness
Quotation: Were ye to become aware of what befalleth Me of sorrows, ye would abandon the world entirely and would act in accordance with that which ye have been bidden by your Lord, the All-Bountiful. By God's life! The conditions of the world have not troubled Me, nor the ranks of the enemies, but sorrows have seized Me on account of that which the hands of those who have committed what was unseemly for the days of God have wrought.

Subject: expressions of grief; lamentation; sadness
Quotation: In Persian it is revealed: O Munir! Through the oppression of the oppressors against the Beauty of the Most Merciful, the divine fragrances from the direction of the realm of possibility have been cut off, and the perfumes of the garment of the Beloved have been forbidden to the peoples of the worlds. Such sorrows have been inflicted that none save God can reckon them, and were they to be detailed, they would cause endless grief.

Subject: expressions of grief; lamentation; sadness
Quotation: Through this every fair-minded one hath lamented, the sighs of every assured one have ascended, and the tears of every seeing one have fallen. O 'Ibadu'llah! By the life of God, the Wronged One is in manifest grief. My grief is not for My imprisonment and what hath befallen Me from Mine enemies, but from those who claim to love Me yet have wrought that which hath caused My sighs to ascend, My tears to fall, and the Tablet and the Pen to lament.

Subject: expressions of grief; lamentation; sadness
Quotation: This Wronged One beholds Himself immersed in an ocean of sorrow. The deeds and actions of some are like arrows and spears directed and descending from every direction. At this moment the Mother Book lamenteth, inasmuch as We have spread forth a carpet of trustworthiness and religiosity for the deceased. Today the eyes of the Tablets weep, for the actions of some have become the cause of the derision of others and the turning away of the servants.

Subject: expressions of grief; lamentation; sadness
Quotation: Thou knowest, O my God, how Thine enemies have dealt with Thy loved ones, seizing from them all that Thou hadst bestowed upon them through Thy bounty, and inflicting upon them what no ear hath ever heard before. No land remaineth but their blood hath been shed therein, no wood but their bodies have been burned thereby. How many little ones, O my God, are left without elders, how many mothers cry out for their sons, how many sons weep for their fathers.

Subject: expressions of grief; lamentation; sadness
Quotation: Calamities and afflictions have encompassed from all directions, and tribulations and hardships have descended from every quarter like pouring rain upon a house from which ascended continually glorification and magnification in praise of Thee... whose hearts are grieved at his separation, whose breasts are constricted by the intensity of his calamity, whose souls are terrified by this catastrophe, and whose pillars are shaken by this convulsing disaster.

Subject: expressions of grief; lamentation; sadness
Quotation: Time and again have sorrows come to pass that have caused the people of Baha to grieve. O My Most Exalted Pen! Calamities have befallen thee that have caused the dwellers of the most exalted Paradise and the highest Heaven to lament, and those who circle round the Throne at morn and eventide to weep. Thy grief hath today turned day into night, joy into sorrow, and tranquility into agitation, until sorrows encompassed all who dwell in the realm of possibility.

Subject: expressions of grief; lamentation; sadness
Quotation: Though thy heart doth melt in separation from thy Lord ignite the soul of the world with thy cries and kindle a fire in the midmost heart of humanity. Raise the palms of thy longing prayers each dawn, immerse thyself in the ocean of wonderment and every evening kneel beside the embers of supplication. Lift up thy lamentations, let thy grief flow, and weep with words of love. Pour down thy tears in torrents and let the fragments of thy heart become thy nourishment.

Subject: expressions of grief; lamentation; sadness
Quotation: this evanescent servant has joined pen with ink, that perhaps from the meeting of these two might emerge from the realm of heart and soul into the world of manifestation and utterance a heartrending cry of separation, and that a drop from the ocean of longing might sprinkle upon the horizons, so that from these sprinklings of love the hearts of the lovers might surge forth, and from this heart-consuming fire of separation the hearts of friends might be set ablaze.

Subject: expressions of grief; lamentation; sadness
Quotation: And thou, O quarter of Iraq! Weep with thy heart and thine eyes, for the Beauty of God hath departed from thee and established Himself in the prison, behind the peaks of towering mountains. Strip from thy frame the garment of joy, for the breezes of glory have been cut off from this hidden Pearl. By God! The eyes of eternity weep for thee, and the hearts of the people of Paradise bleed for what hath befallen Us at the hands of the embodiments of detested oppression.

Subject: expressions of grief; lamentation; sadness
Quotation: I had no comfort in this great convulsion and this overwhelming, devastating calamity which shook my pillars and limbs, melted my liver and heart, and obliterated my being and essence... Thou knowest well, O fiery phoenix, the intensity of my separation, the severity of my burning, my excessive yearning, my sighing and moaning, the flame of my fire, the clamor of my heart and the blazing of my fires from this grief which has crushed my bones and melted my flesh and innards.

Subject: expressions of grief; lamentation; sadness
Quotation: The Wronged One uttereth speech at a time when His heart, His Pen, and His limbs lament, and at His weeping do weep the company of them that are nigh, the sincere ones, and the dwellers of the Most Exalted Paradise and the Supreme Heaven. These are words I uttered aforetime: The affliction is not My imprisonment and what hath befallen Me at the hands of Mine enemies, but rather from those who claim relationship with Me yet perpetrate what causeth Satan himself to flee, let alone man.

Subject: expressions of grief; lamentation; sadness
Quotation: In truth, hardship hath befallen your honor and those with you, and the utmost favor hath also been made manifest, for in days when the light of justice was veiled and the horizon of equity was concealed behind clouds of oppression, and when outward polytheism was manifestly at its height of rebellion and the domains of the unitarians were besieged - in such times did your honor and the other companions attain unto the visitation of the House and that which was revealed in the Books of God.

Subject: expressions of grief; lamentation; sadness
Quotation: O my God! O my God! Thou seest me a captive to the forces of fate and predestination, submerged in an ocean of calamities and tribulations, fallen upon a bed of sorrows and grief and a companion to afflictions, mourning and anguish. Not a single day passes by that I hear not a caller announcing the demise of a precious loved one and declaring the ascension of a chosen one. Thus the souls plunge into desolation and the eyes shed tears of sorrow and the hearts melt away in these agonizing hardships.

Subject: expressions of grief; lamentation; sadness
Quotation: O concourse of the divine cloud! None shall comprehend even a shadow of what Husayn, peace be upon him, witnessed from the people of unbelief. All have imagined somewhat of those calamities, then were struck senseless at his countenance. The first to don the garment of grief for Husayn, peace be upon him, was verily the Primal Reed in the thicket of the Divine Nature. She spoke and fell senseless upon the dust, saying: "Would that I had died before this and been a thing forgotten, utterly forgotten!"

Subject: expressions of grief; lamentation; sadness
Quotation: Though at the beginning of every letter it is necessary, nay obligatory, for every soul to make mention of the One Friend, the One Beloved, and the One Goal, and to express to the extent possible His all-encompassing favors, His precedent mercies, and His all-pervasive grace which hath surrounded every atom of existence, yet due to strange occurrences and the unseemly rejected deeds of some, one finds oneself bewildered and astounded to such degree that silence is preferred over speech and utterance.

Subject: expressions of grief; lamentation; sadness
Quotation: At the hour when the Bride of Sorrow lifted her veil from behind the curtain of concealment, and the Countenance of Grief raised the banner of anguish... the maidens of paradise emerged from their chambers of divorce, and the secluded ones of discord adorned the countenance of dissension, the confined ones of paradise struck their heads, and the virtuous beauties ran distraught, and the holy faces donned garments of mourning, and the countenances of intimacy shed crimson tears from the eye of fidelity

Subject: expressions of grief; lamentation; sadness
Quotation: These are verses of the Spirit that have verily descended from clouds of supreme sorrow, and wert thou to behold with the eye of the spirit, thou wouldst witness that its drops fall with the hue of blood, and thus doth it distill from clouds of grief, if thou be of them that perceive. By God! The realities of all things weep at what hath befallen My Beauty, and then the realities of the Concourse on High at the adversities that have touched Me from those who were created by My word, if ye be of them that know.

Subject: expressions of grief; lamentation; sadness
Quotation: Alas, alas, O Sovereign of Fidelity! Alas, alas, O King of Justice in all creation! Do we see Thee imprisoned in the hands of the most wicked of men, or do we see Thee martyred in the path of God, Lord of all beings? Grievous is it to the people of Baha to hear what hath befallen Thee in Thy love for God, Lord of the throne on high and of the earth below. Grievous is it to the Most Great Name to behold the world yet not behold Thee, to hear the clamor of the nations yet not hear Thy cry nor Thy whispered prayer.

Subject: expressions of grief; lamentation; sadness
Quotation: A hundred thousand regrets that people are asleep! They know not what has happened and what has appeared. If a soul were to reflect with the eye of insight upon this very prison and what has been manifested therein, they would proclaim Thine is the greatness, O Lord of the worlds! And if for the duration of the kingdom and the heavenly realm this evanescent servant were to express wonder and regret, it would be insufficient, for to the extent of an atom or a drop he is aware of what has appeared and from what people are deprived.

Subject: expressions of grief; lamentation; sadness
Quotation: However, recent events have dispelled all gladness and joy. In prison, nothing is observed save sighs and tears. Every monotheist must lament and every believer cry out, for most lands of the monotheists have been taken by polytheists, and they continue in their pursuit. Each day a herald proclaims that this country has fallen, that land has been conquered. Truly, for the monotheists and sincere ones, these matters are a grievous torment. Until now, none knows what has been and is the cause of this great abasement after supreme glory.

Subject: expressions of grief; lamentation; sadness
Quotation: The hearts of the mystics were seized with trembling, the foundations of every soul were shaken, and the flesh of those who dwelt round about Us and were among the unitarians quivered. I testify that at Thy calamity all things between earth and heaven wept, then the eyes of those brought nigh behind pavilions of mighty glory. The celestial maidens in their chambers uncovered their heads and struck them with fingers of wondrous holiness, fell upon their faces in the dust, sat in ashes and lamented at that time in chambers of radiant crimson.

Subject: expressions of grief; lamentation; sadness
Quotation: O Most Exalted Pen! Another calamity hath come to pass through that which was inscribed by the Pen of Destiny from God, Creator of earth and heaven, whereupon grief hath overtaken the loved ones of the All-Merciful. The tale of sorrow hath returned, for a star hath vanished from the heaven of My love and a letter from the book of My affection. Thereby have the people of the realms of My knowledge lamented - they who have cast aside all else but Me, clung to the hem of My grace, and attained unto the ocean of My mercy and the sun of My bounty.

Subject: expressions of grief; lamentation; sadness
Quotation: By God! There hath befallen Me that which cannot be mentioned in words, and tears have flowed from the eyes of them that are nigh unto God. And by this the Hoopoe of the Cause hath ceased to mention Sheba, and the faces of the holy ones have been reddened with blood. By God! The Nightingale of Paradise hath shut its eyes to the beauty of the rose by reason of the sorrows that have befallen this Beauty, the Mighty, the Inaccessible. The rivers have been cut off from union with the sea, as joy hath been cut off from this radiant and luminous Sun.

Subject: expressions of grief; lamentation; sadness
Quotation: I call upon Thee now, O my God, at this time when the lamp of oneness is kindled in the niche of white light, and this eternal candle melts in the crimson lamp, and the heart is consumed by the fire of grief in the liver of Baha, and the cock of the Cause cries out in the most exalted Kingdom, and crimson tears flow upon sallow cheeks. For though he writes before Thee with the pen of ink upon the green tablet, yet in the secret of his heart he writes with the pen of blood upon pieces of his liver that which none can hear in the nearest dominion.

Subject: expressions of grief; lamentation; sadness
Quotation: O Lord! Thou seest the onslaught of the peoples of the world and their aggression, the arrogance of the nations of the earth and their brazenness, against Thy lonely and desolate servant who doth abide in exile in Thy Most Great Prison. Thou beholdest the shafts that incessantly fly, the spears that unceasingly rain, the swords that ever multiply, and the battalions that surge and swell on every side. The spears compassing his weak and wasted frame surround him even as a halo, and the trenchant swords arrayed against him have cast over him a shadow of darkness.

Subject: expressions of grief; lamentation; sadness
Quotation: When observing the oppression of the Beloved who has become afflicted among the Gog of rancor and Magog of hatred, I consider the departure of the spirit from the body to be preferable, nay, I deem it the greatest divine gift. I swear by the Educator of all possibility and the Revealer of clear exposition that grief has so overwhelmed me that tears have involuntarily forgotten the paths of the eyes, and the lamentation of the grieving heart has found its way of exit blocked. This poor and lowly one knows not with what words and utterances to explain these sorrows.

Subject: expressions of grief; lamentation; sadness
Quotation: Strange and wondrous manifestations have appeared in the world. Souls who could not distinguish right from left and were in no wise aware of the foundation of the Cause, and were forever veiled behind curtains and clouds, after the departure of the figure of the Name of God and the loved ones (upon them be the Most Glorious Glory of God) from imprisonment, came forth and instead of gratitude showed hatred toward the mighty Sovereign who through His conquering power raised this Cause to this station, and in place of submission and contentment appeared with sword and spear.

Subject: expressions of grief; lamentation; sadness
Quotation: Though this sudden calamity, like a thunderbolt from heaven, hath bewildered the consciousness and senses of the loved ones of the All-Merciful, and burned their hearts with the fire of deprivation, and though all the dwellers of the pavilion of chastity pass their days and nights with weeping eyes, burning hearts, grieving breasts and souls filled with sorrow - and there is no doubt that this will have a profound effect on that holy leaf, for this is the natural response of pure and sensitive hearts to manifest intense grief and abundant anguish at the onset of separation

Subject: expressions of grief; lamentation; sadness
Quotation: Alas, alas for what has been ordained and decreed, and this is from Thy primary loving-kindness! And after that Thou didst clothe them with the garment of Thy generosity and compassion and didst manifest them from the kingdom of Thy attributes in the temple of Thy names. Then, when their creation was complete and their nature refined, the winds of extinction blew upon them and the breezes of eternity were cut off from them until their life was taken and their niche was broken and their lights were extinguished. Alas, alas for what has been ordained and decreed, and this is from Thine other decrees.

Subject: expressions of grief; lamentation; sadness
Quotation: O what has prompted this wretched transgressor - who, for the sake of a creature he has neither seen nor known, has turned away from the Creator and made his abode in the abyss of infidelity and rejection - to write mockingly against God that truth consists in eating fragrant rice, Indian rice and various sweetmeats! Now, O ye who are endowed with insight and who gaze upon the Most Great Scene, observe to what depths of malice and ignorance they have sunk, that they should seek to destroy the pure Cause of God and the holy and eternal Mystery through such frivolous words from these embodiments of hatred and polytheism.

Subject: expressions of grief; lamentation; sadness
Quotation: Some of the faithful are observed to be sorrowful, nay, fearful, due to the occurrence in the Land of ?ad, whereas the hand of God's power especially raised them up and showered upon them from the heaven of mercy and the clouds of grace the rains of blessing and bounty, and His complete power adorned them with the ornament of glory amidst mankind, such that the tongues of the sincere ones and those drawn nigh spoke in their praise, and they attained to such a station that even enemies bore witness to the loftiness of their rank, and in [their final] days they attained to the most exalted and supreme station, which is the greatest martyrdom - a station which the chosen ones and friends of God have forever yearned for and sought after. Nevertheless, some are seen to be troubled and grieved.

Subject: expressions of grief; lamentation; sadness
Quotation: News hath spread throughout all regions of the setting of the Sun of Truth after its dawning, and the faithful have raised their lamentations, their hearts rent asunder by this separation. The flames of discord from the people of dissension have intensified, and they imagined that the fire of God's love had been extinguished, the lamps of guidance snuffed out, the waves of the Most Great Ocean stilled, the breezes of the Spirit of God cut off, the divine fragrances disappeared, the Lote Tree uprooted, the Blessed Tree torn out by its roots, its fruits fallen, the stars of guidance scattered from the supreme horizon, the lights of the manifestation of the Most Glorious Beauty of God vanished, the banners of the signs of unity furled, darkness encompassing all, vision blinded, the appearance of the people of God broken, the cord of God severed, the standards of polytheism raised, the signs of truth disappeared, the traces of God obliterated, the triple darkness advanced, the birds of night taken flight, croaking and braying and bellowing raised high, and the melodies of the birds of holiness cut off.

Subject: fairmindedness; personal justice [insaf]
Quotation: The best beloved of all things in My sight is Justice [insaf]; turn not away therefrom if thou desirest Me, and neglect it not that I may confide in thee. By its aid thou shalt see with thine own eyes and not through the eyes of others, and shalt know of thine own knowledge and not through the knowledge of thy neighbor.

Subject: fairmindedness; personal justice [insaf]
Quotation: Rather, they should follow the path of justice and fairness. Let them investigate with their own eyes.

Subject: fairmindedness; personal justice [insaf]
Quotation: The heaven of divine wisdom is illumined with the two luminaries of consultation and compassion, and the canopy of world order is upheld by the two pillars of reward and punishment.

Subject: fairmindedness; personal justice [insaf]
Quotation: The essence of all that We have revealed for thee is justice [insaf], is for man to free himself from idle fancy and imitation, discern with the eye of oneness His glorious handiwork, and look into all things with a searching eye.

Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/false claims to divine revelation or spiritual stations.txt

Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/false claims to divine revelation or spiritual stations.txt

Some of them even beat the drum of divinity, but the Muhammadan sea produced one wave and cast them out. Now no trace of them remains. Bayazid Bastami would say "There is no god but I, so worship me" and would utter "There is nothing in my cloak except God" and had royal pomp. Whenever he would ride in Bastam, seventeen horses would be led before him. In the end he was completely forgotten, and likewise the other mystics.

Subject: family of Muhammad; early figures in Islam
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/family of Muhammad; early figures in Islam.txt
Quotation: And I bear witness that their names in God's Book are Ali, Hasan, Husayn, Ali, Muhammad, Ja'far, Musa, Ali, Muhammad, Ali, Hasan and Muhammad. And I bear witness that Fatima, daughter of God's Messenger, is a leaf of the White Tree

Subject: family of Muhammad; early figures in Islam
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/family of Muhammad; early figures in Islam.txt
Quotation: The Eternal Morn is Ali, the Eternal Sun is Muhammad, and from His indication to the two Husayns, and shone refers to the Imams, and the Light to Fatima, the temples of Unity are the Prophets and Successors, and its traces are his station and the station of the Shia.

Subject: family of Muhammad; early figures in Islam
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/family of Muhammad; early figures in Islam.txt
Quotation: I beseech Thee by their right upon Thee and Thy right upon them to bless them according to Thy station of Glory, Unity, Majesty and Greatness, and according to what they deserve before the court of Thy grandeur - the rightly-guided Imams: Ali, Muhammad, then Ali, and Hassan.

Subject: family of Muhammad; early figures in Islam
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/family of Muhammad; early figures in Islam.txt
Quotation: I testify that Ali, Fatima, Hasan, Husayn, Ali son of Husayn, Muhammad son of Ali, Jafar son of Muhammad, Musa son of Jafar, Ali son of Musa, Muhammad son of Ali, Ali son of Muhammad, Hasan son of Ali, and Muhammad son of Hasan - these are Thy proofs unto all who dwell in the kingdom of Thy earth and heaven.

Subject: family of Muhammad; early figures in Islam
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/family of Muhammad; early figures in Islam.txt
Quotation: I beseech Thee, O my God, at this moment to bless Muhammad and the family of Muhammad, through all that pertaineth unto Thee, O my God, of Thy glory and holiness, Thy perpetuity and sovereignty, Thy belovedness and praiseworthiness... For Thou, O my God, hast created no being closer to Thee than Muhammad and the family of Muhammad.

Subject: family of Muhammad; early figures in Islam
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/family of Muhammad; early figures in Islam.txt
Quotation: And I bear witness to Muhammad, Thy Beloved, may Thy blessings be upon him and his family, as becometh Thee... And bestow Thy peace, O God, upon his chosen successors: Ali, Hassan, Hussein, Ali, Muhammad, Ja'far, Musa, Ali, Muhammad, Ali, Hassan, and the Proof, the Qaim - Thy blessings be upon them with all Thy signs and bestowals

Subject: family of Muhammad; early figures in Islam
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/family of Muhammad; early figures in Islam.txt
Quotation: The members of this small band of voluntary exiles consisted of eleven men and four women, including his daughter Rokaia and his son-in-law Othman Ibn Affan who acted as the leader of the party....  With them came also Jafar, the son of Abou Taleb and brother of Ali. Jafar was a man of true faith and possessed a native eloquence and a confident heart.

Subject: family of Muhammad; early figures in Islam

Quotation: by the sanctity of KHY'S and HM'SQ, and by the Ascension of the Chosen One, and by the martyrdom of the Accepted One, and by the nearness to Thee of the Companions of the Cave...by the choosing of Moses and his firmness in religion, and I beseech Thee by Thy Christ Jesus son of Mary and his modesty, and by the purity of Fatima the Radiant, and by the martyrdom of Husayn at Karbila

Subject: family of Muhammad; early figures in Islam
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/family of Muhammad; early figures in Islam.txt
Quotation: And blessings and peace be upon the first sign that shone forth from the horizon of Will and Purpose, and the first Word whereby was adorned the brocade of the Book of Unity and Love - He Who was named Muhammad in the Book of Names and by the Most Beautiful Names in a Tablet which none has seen save God, the Lord of Names and Creator of heaven, and upon His family and companions through whom flowed the rivers of generosity in the world and through whom was made manifest the decree of the Lord of Eternity amongst the peoples - blessings which no understanding or mind can encompass and which none can enumerate.

Subject: family of Muhammad; early figures in Islam
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/family of Muhammad; early figures in Islam.txt
Quotation: The second is the Book of Ali, peace be upon him, wherein God hath ordained the laws of absolute sovereignty pertaining to him, and it is the Paradise of Unity. God hath made its shade for those who acknowledge his sovereignty. The third is the Book of Fatima, may God's blessings be upon her, wherein God hath ordained all that is for her and upon her, and it is the Paradise of Delight. The fourth is the Book of Hassan, peace be upon him, wherein are written his laws and the laws of his followers who have entered the depths of Oneness in the shelter of his love, and it is the Paradise of Eden and the Pole of Paradise, having no boundaries. The fifth is the Book of Hussein, peace be upon him - may my soul be sacrificed for him - wherein are the laws concerning himself, even unto the name of his murderer - may he be cursed and punished. The sixth is the Book of Ja'far ibn Muhammad, peace be upon them both, wherein is written whatsoever God hath willed concerning him, and it is the Paradise of Immortality. The seventh is the Book of Musa ibn Ja'far, peace be upon them both, wherein is written all that God hath willed concerning him, and it is the Paradise of Refuge.

Subject: fellowship with the wayward and ungodly
Quotation: Consider the companionship of the righteous a bounty, and withdraw both hand and heart from association with the wicked. And in this connection the Tongue of Grandeur declares that if after associating with a person in three gatherings you observe no effect from you upon him, surely withdraw, for an effect from him upon you will become manifest.

Subject: fellowship with the wayward and ungodly
Quotation: "Is it possible to seek association and to familiarize oneself with a scorpion? Read over the Bible for this question is clearly explained in many different places." "O Friend! In the garden of the heart plant only flowers of Love, and withdraw not from clinging to the Nightingale of Love and yearning. Esteem the friendship of the just but withdraw both mind and hand from the company of the wicked."

Subject: fellowship with the wayward and ungodly
Quotation: There are other people who are ill-tempered, who are accustomed to tell lies or fibs. We must not shun these people. Gently we must teach them - and pray every night that we may not become inoculated with these poisonous social microbes - and show them by example, by word and by deed the benefits of veracity and truthfulness.

Subject: fellowship with the wayward and ungodly
Quotation: You may meet these people in public but no need of close association; because if one's character is not strong enough to be proof against temptation one may be slowly led to those risky paths.

Subject: fellowship with the wayward and ungodly
Quotation: avoiding heedless and hostile persons

Subject: fellowship with the wayward and ungodly
Quotation: We came to meet the poor, not to see kings and princes. We have no desire or inclination to meet with leaders

Subject: fellowship with the wayward and ungodly
Quotation: On the other hand there are some persons whose very respiration extinguishes the light of faith; whose conversation weakens firmness and steadfastness in the Cause of God; whose company divert one's attention from the kingdom of Abha.

Subject: fellowship with the wayward and ungodly
Quotation: One who associates with evil companions loses his reputation and his good name; from being good he becomes bad, from being virtuous he becomes impure, from being holy he becomes depraved. Do not take example from the vicious, do not permit yourselves to be corrupted by the evil-minded.

Subject: fellowship with the wayward and ungodly
Quotation: since you interfere in political matters, we have no association with you. Your path is different from our path. We are Baha'is and you are Buddhist, and you engage in political matters and discussions. Our path is very different from yours, therefore excuse us from association and correspondence.

Subject: fellowship with the wayward and ungodly
Quotation: There is a story of a Shaykh meeting a Bektash and saying to him, "Why do you continue causing mischief and spending your time gratifying your carnal desires? Come with me and pray, meditate, fast for forty days, fear God and become righteous. Once you have become accustomed to praying and fasting, then you will no longer commit unseemly acts." Bektash responded, "There is no need for forty days of prayer. You stay with me for just one night and all religion will be forgotten to you!"

Subject: fellowship with the wayward and ungodly
Quotation: And if thou findest in a heart My love, associate with him; otherwise shun him and be of those who turn away.

Subject: fellowship with the wayward and ungodly
Quotation: We have ever enjoined upon all to act with and associate with those on earth in a spirit of fragrance and delight, save those souls from whom the odor of malice is diffused - in such case, avoidance is necessary.

Subject: fellowship with the wayward and ungodly
Quotation: There are those whose impurity is to such a degree that association with them is not only unprofitable but harmful. One should not completely avoid them, but association with them should be solely for the purpose of awakening and enlightening them.
