Quotation: passage describes how even the lowliest creature that remains firm in the Covenant will be elevated to a mighty station: "if today even a fly remains firm in the Covenant and Testament, it will become an eagle soaring in the heights of understanding"

Subject: firmness in the Covenant
Quotation: In this time when the winds of tests have encompassed the horizons of contingent being, plant firm thy feet in steadfastness and constancy in the arena of faith and certitude, and in all things hold fast to the Covenant and Testament of the All-Merciful

Subject: firmness in the Covenant
Quotation: The Glory from Us be upon you and upon those who have not broken God's Covenant and His Pact, whom the power of the world hath not weakened and the armies of the nations have not frightened. They have turned with radiant faces to the Most Exalted Horizon

Subject: firmness in the Covenant
Quotation: It was like the melody of the divine nightingale, whose song delighteth the hearts. This is because its contents indicated faith, assurance and firmness in the Covenant and the Testament. Praise be to God, thou art firm in the Covenant and the Testament.

Subject: firmness in the Covenant
Quotation: In faith and certitude they are as firm mountains, and in their steadfastness and constancy in the Covenant they are as lofty, towering peaks. They are intoxicated with the wine of the Covenant and are attracted to the countenance of that loving Beloved.

Subject: firmness in the Covenant
Quotation: I swear by God, verily the inmates of heaven praise those who are firm and steadfast in the Covenant of God. They are the Lord's saints and chosen ones. They are the guardians of His Book and Tablets, the holy ones among His people and the delivered ones.

Subject: firmness in the Covenant
Quotation: Be confident in the favors of the True One, for through the blessing of firmness in the Covenant thou shalt attain success and divine bestowals shall encompass thee. The firm ones are successful and those who are steadfast are like an impregnable fortress.

Subject: firmness in the Covenant
Quotation: Until the power of attraction comes into play, firmness and steadfastness do not appear... Therefore, firmness in the Covenant requires the attractive force of heart and soul. Praise be to God that the friends in Faran are firm in the Covenant and Testament

Subject: firmness in the Covenant
Quotation: The text emphasizes the critical importance of firmness, stating: "holding fast means to grasp and cling with such firmness that no loosening or dissolution follows, and separation between the one holding fast and that which is held fast becomes impossible"

Subject: firmness in the Covenant
Quotation: Hold fast to this extended cord and take shelter beneath this raised standard which the hands of thy Lord, the All-Merciful, have raised... And thou, O thou who art certain of the signs of God, leave every doubter and hold fast to the hem of the Lord of Lords

Subject: firmness in the Covenant
Quotation: O thou who art attracted by the fragrances of the gardens of the Covenant! By God the Truth, verily the glad tidings of the Supreme Concourse encompass thee from all directions, and the joyous news of the Most Glorious Kingdom reaches thee from every quarter.

Subject: firmness in the Covenant
Quotation: O thou servant of the Most Great Name and the Ancient Beauty! Be thou glad, for thou art gathered beneath the shade of the providence of the Ever-Living, the Self-Subsisting, and through special favor art firm in thy love for the explicitly designated Servant.

Subject: firmness in the Covenant
Quotation: O Guardian! Your duty is but to pray. Consider the past: after Christ, the apostles never faltered. Day and night they blew the trumpet until they transformed most nations to the direction of the All-Merciful. You too must be thus firm, steadfast and resolute.

Subject: firmness in the Covenant
Quotation: Thou hast chanted verses of gratitude with wondrous melody to the Glorious Lord, for He hath enabled His sincere loved ones to hold fast to the mighty Covenant and the binding Testament, the like of which the sacred Dispensations of the past have never witnessed.

Subject: firmness in the Covenant
Quotation: Thy detailed letter which thou hadst written to his honor Haydar-Qabli-'Ali was perused. From beginning to end, it was wholly indicative of firmness and steadfastness in the Covenant of the Glorious Lord. Blessed art thou for this firmness in this mighty Covenant!

Subject: firmness in the Covenant
Quotation: "O you who are steadfast in the Covenant and firm in the Testament!" "And now too you remain firm and steadfast in the Covenant and Testament like an iron foundation, dwelling beneath the shade of the Tree of Life and protected in the impregnable fortress of the Covenant."

Subject: firmness in the Covenant
Quotation: Well done! Again, well done! For thou hast stood firm and grown, and hast demonstrated and made clear with decisive proofs, surpassing evidence, and overwhelming force... And upon thee be glory, and upon all who are firm in God's Covenant, the Protector, the Self-Subsisting.

Subject: firmness in the Covenant
Quotation: Firmness in the Covenant is not mere words. If a soul shall utter a word without the sanction of the Covenant, he is not firm. Baha'o'llah appointed a Covenant in order to ward off dissensions, so that no one should give his own opinion, but that the Center should be referred to.

Subject: firmness in the Covenant
Quotation: O thou who art firm in the Covenant! The friends in Hamadan are indeed true companions who harbor no thought save the good-pleasure of the Beloved, and chant no praise but that of the True One. Day and night they are in harmony with the holy fragrances, detached from all save God.

Subject: firmness in the Covenant
Quotation: Must grow in the garden of the Covenant with utmost freshness and grace, develop and flourish in the stream of the Covenant...Grasp firmly the pure hem of His Holiness the Exalted One and hold fast to the sanctified robe of the Blessed Beauty...stand firm in the Covenant of your Lord

Subject: firmness in the Covenant
Quotation: These are souls who have perceived the breath of the All-Merciful, tasted the sweetness of divine knowledge, have not forgotten Thy remembrance on the Day of the Covenant, and have gathered beneath the standard of the Covenant waving upon the edifices of glory throughout the horizons.

Subject: firmness in the Covenant
Quotation: We beseech God to cause you to grow with goodly growth and make you a sign of guidance among the people in steadfastness and firmness in God's Covenant and adherence to God's pact. And glory be upon you and upon all who are firm and steadfast in God's Covenant and His mighty Testament.

Subject: firmness in the Covenant
Quotation: This day is unlike any other day, and this time unlike any other time. The eye was created to behold the Most Exalted Horizon, and the ear came into being to hearken unto the Call. Any deed performed in this Day for the sake of God shall be recorded by the Supreme Pen in the Crimson Book.

Subject: firmness in the Covenant
Quotation: Be not shaken by the winds of trial nor stirred by the tempests of temptation. Send forth roots into the soil of the Covenant and grow through the stream of the Testament of the Day-Star of the horizons. Hold fast to the firm cord and grasp the hem of the Covenant of the Lord of all worlds

Subject: firmness in the Covenant
Quotation: How many were the servants who considered themselves among God's chosen ones and the noblest of creation, yet when the winds of tests moved even as much as the eye of a needle, they broke God's Covenant and joined the hosts of polytheism. After divine recognition, steadfastness is necessary.

Subject: firmness in the Covenant
Quotation: They must be souls well known as Baha'is, firm and steadfast in the Covenant. The greatest requirement is to be firm and steadfast in the Covenant. Some one suggested getting up a circular letter in which the beliefs are stated especially regarding the firmness in the Center of the Covenant.

Subject: firmness in the Covenant
Quotation: Stand so firmly in the Cause that even should all who are in the heavens and earth contend with thee, and should there remain on earth no believer but thee, thou wouldst yet arise by thyself in the Cause. This is God's command upon thee, and verily His command hath ever encompassed all worlds.

Subject: firmness in the Covenant
Quotation: Now too, hold fast to the firm covenant and cling with might, that you may demonstrate steadfastness and constancy and, to the dismay of the negligent ones, may cause your countenance to shine bright in the gathering of the Covenant. This is the sure handle of God and the firm cord of the Lord.

Subject: firmness in the Covenant
Quotation: The friends of Najafabad, from the first dawning and the rising of the luminous morn of the horizons, entered into the circle of lovers, and each yearning soul longed to sacrifice their life in the path of the Lord of the Covenant, and in all circumstances demonstrated firmness and steadfastness.

Subject: firmness in the Covenant
Quotation: Be so firm and steadfast in the divine Covenant and Testament and the will of the All-Merciful Beauty that the hosts of doubts cannot imagine otherwise and cannot cause division in the Cause of God. Assuredly make firm your steps and steady your feet, make your hearts assured and your spirits glad.

Subject: firmness in the Covenant
Quotation: We beseech God, through His favours and loving-kindness that thou mayest be strengthened to enable a myriad wavering souls to become steadfast in the Covenant through the sweet savours of constancy, and that in the banquet of the Covenant thou mayest shine forth and shed thy radiance like unto a candle.

Subject: firmness in the Covenant
Quotation: O illumined and pure leaf! Show such steadfastness in firmness in the Covenant and constancy in the Testament that you become the wonder of men and the envy of heroes. And the Glory be upon you and upon every handmaiden who is firm in the Covenant and has disassociated herself from the people of hypocrisy.

Subject: firmness in the Covenant
Quotation: Now consider to what extent the believers in God must become firm and soul-sacrificing. Every one of the friends must become the essence of essences; each one must become a brilliant lamp. Wisdom and Divine insight are necessary. Firmness and steadfastness are needed at such a crucial period of the Cause.

Subject: firmness in the Covenant
Quotation: Well is it with thee, for like a foundation made of steel plates thou hast remained firm and steadfast in the New Covenant, and in the Cause of the Peerless Beauty thou hast stood straight and strong. Today there is no greater praise than firmness in the Covenant, and no higher commendation than steadfastness.

Subject: firmness in the Covenant
Quotation: All must thank God that in this blessed Dispensation He has given rest to all and left no room for hesitation. Therefore, we must show obedience and submission and pay complete attention. But discourse must be confined to this; never transgress beyond this so that it may be the cause of unity and remove discord.

Subject: firmness in the Covenant
Quotation: Therefore, occupy thyself with the praise of the incomparable Lord, for thou hast found repose in the shade of the Tree of the Covenant and hast attained the ultimate hope of the people of God, and hast been accepted in His most holy court. And upon thee, and upon all who stand firm in God's Covenant, be the Glory.

Subject: firmness in the Covenant
Quotation: it shows your steadfastness and firmness in the Covenant of God and His Testament, which was confirmed by the trace of His Supreme Pen, the greatness of which hath been divulged in all the regions, entered the palaces of kings, of which both rulers and subjects have been informed, and no human being could ever deny it

Subject: firmness in the Covenant
Quotation: Blessed art thou for having remained firm in God's Covenant and Testament...plant firm the foot of steadfastness and make the heart a paradise of Ridvan through the breaths of God's Covenant. Through the power of the Testament, arise in such wise that you will cause the destroyer of the Covenant to flee in an instant.

Subject: firmness in the Covenant
Quotation: Whoso willeth, let him remain firm, and whoso willeth, let him return to the corner of oblivion forever and ever. In truth, the sweet fragrance of firmness and steadfastness is inhaled with utmost potency from the loved ones of that land. Assuredly this steadfastness attracts divine confirmations and draws forth success.

Subject: firmness in the Covenant
Quotation: Therefore, make firm thy steps on God's Covenant and Testament... By God the Truth! Thou shalt see the banner of the Covenant waving over the horizons and the standard of the Testament raised upon the edifices of glory... I beseech God to make thee firm, steadfast and upright in this Covenant which has stirred the horizons

Subject: firmness in the Covenant
Quotation: Indeed it must be so, for when assured hearts enter beneath the shade of the Divine Sinai of God's Covenant and Testament, their hearts and souls become a supreme paradise, and their speech and utterance become as honey and nectar. Know thou the value of this station, and implore God that thou mayest remain firm and steadfast.

Subject: firmness in the Covenant
Quotation: To have a 'good end' is the most difficult thing, especially in these days when the winds of tests are blowing from the four corners of the earth. Whosoever has obtained a 'good end' he must know of a certainty that this is the most great gift of God. In the world of humanity there is no greater bestowal than a 'good ending'.

Subject: firmness in the Covenant
Quotation: This is a servant who has cast off from his tattered garment and donned the new robe, who has detached himself from his spirit, his self, his sleep, his rest, his family, his people, his pleasures, his provisions and his clan, and has made all his prayers and remembrances a single prayer, and his condition in Thy service eternal.

Subject: firmness in the Covenant
Quotation: Praise God that thou hast drunk from the cup of firmness and steadfastness and held fast to the sure handle of constancy...they are like an iron barrier against the Gog of wavering and like a mighty rampart against the Magog of confusion. They are a veil against the whirlwind of trials and an obstacle against the tempest of tests.

Subject: firmness in the Covenant
Quotation: The friends of God must withdraw from all parties, never interfere in political matters, obey the government, wish well for all, engage in teaching the Cause of God, accept as true and proper whatever issues from the Pen of the Covenant and remain firm and steadfast, conducting themselves with complete dignity, sobriety and composure.

Subject: firmness in the Covenant
Quotation: By God the Truth, verily the dwellers of the Most Glorious Kingdom pray for every servant who is firm and steadfast in God's Covenant and His Great Testament. For through their steadfastness the pillars of discord are shaken, the edifice of hypocrisy trembles, the Sun of the Covenant shines forth, and its fame spreads throughout all regions.

Subject: firmness in the Covenant
Quotation: The call is the call of the Covenant, and the Testament is the mark of the Pen of the Luminary of the horizons... Praise be to God that in this holy age the text of the Covenant is an unfurled scroll and the preserved tablet, and the appointed Center is a mighty edifice. The steadfast ones are promised and singled out for the greatest bounty.

Subject: firmness in the Covenant
Quotation: May he show forth the power of his arm in spreading Thy Covenant...Strive that thou mayest become a manifest light in this mighty cycle and a brilliant star in the horizon of the highest heaven. Become a divine Rustam and charge forth in the arena of the Covenant's victory, that no foolish one may breach it and no capricious one cause weakness.

Subject: firmness in the Covenant
Quotation: O Ali! Exaltation and ascendancy today lie in servitude at the Sacred Threshold and in firmness and steadfastness in the Covenant and Testament of the Lord, the Merciful. Therefore, join with this servant in firmly girding up the loins of servitude to the Ancient Beauty, and guide all to firmness and steadfastness in the divine Covenant and Faith.

Subject: firmness in the Covenant
Quotation: That which has come forth from the Center of the Covenant you must take fast hold of. Whosoever utters a word you must ask: 'Where is the authority of the Center of the Covenant? Show it.' Without this you must not listen to him. If an angel comes down from heaven and has no authority from the Center of the Covenant, you must require his authority.

Subject: firmness in the Covenant
Quotation: Today the banner of the unity of the Covenant is raised high and the connection between hearts is firm. As much as you are able, expound the mysteries of the Covenant and Testament, that the lights of the Lord of the Covenant may shine forth. Success in attaining this most exalted station is conditional upon and dependent on firmness in the Covenant.

Subject: firmness in the Covenant
Quotation: After Me there shall come a period of quietude, then a mighty flame shall burst forth, especially if the friends of God remain firm and steadfast in the Covenant. No terror or fear shall come upon them. If any soul is wavering, let him become more firm. If any is troubled, let him become assured, so that when they return they may be transformed souls.

Subject: firmness in the Covenant
Quotation: I swear by those soul-stirring smiles you witnessed, that should a soul in this day stand firm as it ought to be, it would make all creation its servant and behold all existence beneath its shadow. Test it and you will be delighted. Whosoever wishes may believe in God's Covenant, and whosoever wishes may turn away. Verily thy Lord is on a straight path.

Subject: firmness in the Covenant
Quotation: O God, do Thou make known to all who have believed in the Bayan that if they stand firm in their allegiance to Him, they shall become the treasurers of all good, whereupon they shall expend in the fortification of His Word and the exaltation of His majesty that which Thou hast bestowed upon them through His bounty and conferred upon them through His grace

Subject: firmness in the Covenant
Quotation: If thou seekest a sheltering shade, enter beneath the shadow of the Tree of Companionship. If thou desirest an eternal paradise, establish thyself in the gardens of the Covenant. If thou searchest for the fountain of life, drink from the Salsabil of the Testament. I swear by the light of God that great good, abundant portion, and ancient glory lie in this.

Subject: firmness in the Covenant
Quotation: O thou who hast been sore afflicted on the pathway of the Covenant! [...] If I, like Abraham, through flames must go, Or yet like John a bloodstained road must run; If, Joseph-like, Thou'd cast me in a well, Or shut me up within a prison cell-- Or make me e'en as poor as Mary's Son-- I will not go from Thee, But ever stand My soul and body bowed to Thy command.

Subject: firmness in the Covenant
Quotation: I humble myself before the Divine Lote Tree, the Throne of Thy Lordly Sovereignty, and the Seat of Thy All-Merciful dominion, beseeching Thee to make firm the feet of Thy servant who has humbled himself at the gate of Thy Oneness, who is broken before the Kingdom of Thy Unity, who has clung to the hem of Thy Singleness, to stand fast in Thy Covenant and Testament.

Subject: firmness in the Covenant
Quotation: Furthermore, your honor must strive with the utmost effort for the firmness and steadfastness of the loved ones in God's Covenant and Testament, so that the mighty fortress of God's Cause may remain protected and preserved from the arrows of doubt of the wavering ones, and no one can use ambiguous verses as an excuse or cast whispers into the hearts of the believers.

Subject: firmness in the Covenant
Quotation: Today every firm and steadfast soul is a confirmed soul and a manifestation of the favors of the All-Merciful. The hosts of divine confirmation are his helper and supporter, his protector and aid. He is victorious and triumphant, near and favored. This matter has been proven throughout all regions - while every wavering soul is abandoned, subdued, cast down and defeated.

Subject: firmness in the Covenant
Quotation: Although thou art outwardly far and remote, yet in reality thou art present in the gathering and intoxicated with the cup of fellowship. Since thou art assured in God, attracted to the Kingdom of Abha and firm in the Covenant, thou art present at the Threshold of the Blessed Beauty - may my spirit be a sacrifice for His loved ones - and thou art immersed in the ocean of favors.

Subject: firmness in the Covenant
Quotation: Whereupon have they hearkened unto the call of the Covenant, witnessed the signs of unity, and beheld the light of illumination. They have hastened to the service of the Day-Star of the world, and their faces have been set aglow with the light of divine gifts. They have stood fast and firm in the ancient Covenant, have traversed the Straight Path, and have clung to the Firm Cord.

Subject: firmness in the Covenant
Quotation: Yet what is needed is attention, detachment, supplication, purification, firmness and steadfastness in the Divine Covenant and Testament, uprightness and establishment in the Covenant and Pact of the All-Merciful, the conforming of your character to divine virtues and your conduct to holy spiritual behavior, and that your utterance be in praise and glorification of the Ancient Beauty.

Subject: firmness in the Covenant
Quotation: O loved ones of God! Beware lest ye be shaken, disturbed, fearful, distressed, lethargic or inactive on this momentous day. This is the day of supreme steadfastness. This is the day of firmness and constancy among the concourse of creation. Blessed are the souls that are firm and steadfast like an impregnable fortress against this shattering, crushing tempest that breaks backs and spines.

Subject: firmness in the Covenant
Quotation: Today your duty is to burn away, like a blazing fire, the thorns and thistles of doubt, and with the light of the Covenant so illumine your countenance that you may enlighten the horizons. Extend the hand of firmness from the sleeve of steadfastness and scatter the pearls of the Covenant over the world and its peoples. Be a herald of the Covenant and a servant of the Cause of the All-Merciful.

Subject: firmness in the Covenant
Quotation: Regarding the aforementioned chief, a letter was sent some time ago, and now you must assist him that day by day the flame may burn brighter and he may take steps forward, otherwise persons from his own group and others will arise and with the utmost determination, even to the point of threats and pressure, will prevent him. Therefore, each day reinforcement is necessary and reminders are essential.

Subject: firmness in the Covenant
Quotation: Therefore raise thy hands in supplication to the Court of the All-Glorious and begin thy entreaty: O Lord! Through Thy mighty grace and profound favor, Thou hast granted shelter to the destitute and ruined, admitted them to Thy divine court, bestowed awareness, guided them with the light of dawn and infinite bounty, and enabled them to serve. Keep this servant steadfast in Thy service until his last breath.

Subject: firmness in the Covenant
Quotation: Ibn-i-Abhar, upon him be the most luminous glory of God, has the utmost joy in you and constantly opens his tongue in praise day and night that during the days of imprisonment you showed the utmost assistance, consideration and support. It is fitting and proper for those firm in the Covenant and Testament that during times of captivity and imprisonment they strive to serve those imprisoned in the path of God.

Subject: firmness in the Covenant
Quotation: These are servants whom neither the might of tyrants nor the hosts of pharaohs could deter. They arose and spoke that which the Tongue of Grandeur had uttered before the creation of the heavens and the earth. Some souls, despite their claims of steadfastness, certitude and assurance, were veiled by a single cawing from the flow of the Most Exalted Pen. Verily, they are among the wrongdoers in the perspicuous Book.

Subject: firmness in the Covenant
Quotation: Thy letter hath arrived, imparting joy and gladness by the evidence it provided of thy firmness and steadfastness. For this reason, I have named thee Thabit [steadfast], and my earnest entreaty of the one true God is that thou wilt remain as steadfast as an immovable mountain in the Cause of God, entirely unaffected by the tempestuous wind of trials; nay more, that thou wilt become a source of firmness unto others.

Subject: firmness in the Covenant
Quotation: These days are the time for firmness and the period for steadfastness and constancy in the Cause of God. The beloved of God must be confirmed with such a firmness that if every moment a hundred like Abdul-Baha become the target of arrows, no change should occur in their decision or intention, no transformation in their zeal or attraction to God, and no abatement in their occupation in the service of the Cause of God.

Subject: firmness in the Covenant
Quotation: O Rustam! Today thou who art reposing beneath the shade of the celestial Tree, who hast discovered the divine garden and heavenly rose-garden, who hast entered beneath the protection of the true King and art counted among the heavenly hosts - strive thou and make an effort that thou mayest show forth might in the arena of divine knowledge, rout the wavering ranks, and manifest the power of steadfastness in the Covenant.

Subject: firmness in the Covenant
Quotation: By the life of God! The maidens of Paradise, repositories of spiritual meanings, and the chaste companions in the heavenly chambers of the divine Kingdom, yearn to enter beneath the shade of those who hold fast to the divine Covenant, while the angels of victory circle round every soul who cleaveth to the hem of the Self-Subsisting Lord. Ere long ye shall hear the melodies of the birds of holiness in the gardens of the Covenant

Subject: firmness in the Covenant
Quotation: By the life of God, all the confirmations of the Kingdom of God will surround those whose hearts are firm, whose feet are steadfast and whose souls are tranquilized in the Most Great Cause. Be ye assured with the greatest assurance that, verily, God will help those who are firm in His Covenant in every matter, through His confirmation and favor, the lights of which will shine forth unto the east of the earth, as well as the west thereof.

Subject: firmness in the Covenant
Quotation: Today, the measure of the Cause of God, the protection and preservation of the Faith of God, the well-being of the loved ones of God, the salvation of the servants of God, the safeguarding of the Word of God, and the diffusion of the fragrances of God are all dependent and conditional upon firmness and steadfastness in God's Covenant and Testament. Should the slightest weakness and laxity occur, all matters would be disrupted and disordered.

Subject: firmness in the Covenant
Quotation: I swear by the Ancient Beauty! Steadfastness in the Covenant and Testament of God in this day means that one must sacrifice one's life for the friends of the All Merciful. Until such a degree of sacrifice is attained one cannot be accounted among those who are faithful to the Covenant. Not a single drop from the ocean of sincerity can be tasted, nor a breath of fragrant air inhaled from the rosegarden of the All Glorious without this level of sacrifice.

Subject: firmness in the Covenant
Quotation: We hope that under the shadow of the Ancient Beauty's grace, he may attain the most great success and remain firm and steadfast as a mighty edifice in the Covenant and Testament of the Merciful Lord. I hope that thou mayest remain protected and preserved in the impregnable fortress of divine protection from the evil of the rebellious ones, and with all thy strength remain firm on the straight path and the ancient covenant and the mighty testament of God.

Subject: firmness in the Covenant
Quotation: If you are firm in the Covenant, you may rest assured that the aid and confirmation of Baha'u'llah will reach you. Consider how it is in Persia. The friends of God, notwithstanding their many enemies, in their hearts are firm in God's Covenant. Day by day they are growing brighter; day by day they are becoming uplifted; day by day becoming dearer; day by day their hearts are more attentive. This is the fundamental; because firmness in the Covenant insures Baha'i oneness.

Subject: firmness in the Covenant
Quotation: That gathering will assuredly have momentous results in the future and its manifest effects are certain. As it was the first general gathering in America, it therefore possessed great significance. Without the power of God's Covenant and Testament, such a gathering in that luminous assembly would have been impossible in so short a time. But the Covenant possesses a power that confounds minds, and in every spot the signs of the Covenant's confirmation are clear and evident.

Subject: firmness in the Covenant
Quotation: Like unto a heart-surrendered lover, they became bewildered and enamored of the beauty of the covenant and in the garden of God's manifold blessings, they were joyous and elated to observe the mystic flowers. But those with poor sight like unto the bats were dejected and despondent from the rays of the covenant...Erelong, ye will see that those who slackened will all grow helpless and disappointed, and the steadfast will be gathered together in every meeting with resplendent faces.

Subject: firmness in the Covenant
Quotation: This servant, with the utmost humility and need, beseecheth at the Threshold of Oneness: O Lord! Make this vigilant one noble through Thy heavenly bounty and cause him to partake of Thy divine favors. Grant him eternal life and bestow upon him everlasting glory. Place upon his head a crown of Thy greatest bounty and clothe him with a robe of silk and brocade from the Most Glorious Paradise, that he may be blessed with Thy infinite bounties and be distinguished by Thy special favors.

Subject: firmness in the Covenant
Quotation: Therefore, the Center of the Covenant explains this matter in clear and correct terms so that no difference may remain at all, all may become united and in agreement, and through this unity the light of truth may illumine the human world...This is the sincere heart-felt belief of 'Abdu'l-Baha and all are obligated to hold fast to and believe in whatever issues from the Pen of the Covenant. This is the foundation of God's Cause, this is the light of truth, this is the belief of 'Abdu'l-Baha.

Subject: firmness in the Covenant
Quotation: Every word that issues from the fountain of sincerity in the Cause of God is like pure water that descends from spring clouds, bestowing freshness upon the heart, delicacy upon the spirit, and glad-tidings upon souls... there is no solace except the sweet fragrances from the hearts of the loved ones of God, and no respite except beholding the signs of steadfastness and firmness in the Cause of God. For this firm foundation is the pillar of the Cause and the source of the effects of destiny.

Subject: firmness in the Covenant
Quotation: Through the bounty of the Ancient Beauty, it is hoped that these divine friends will show such steadfastness and firmness that the foundations of opposition will be utterly destroyed, and will manifest such radiance that the darkness of night will be completely dispelled. O loved ones of God! This is the time for firmness and constancy. O ye who are attracted to the Beauty of Baha! This is the time for steadfastness and resistance, for detachment and orientation, for supplication and devotion, and for joy.

Subject: firmness in the Covenant
Quotation: The honored Afnan attained His presence and visited Him. [The Blessed Beauty] stated that he should now attend to his commercial affairs. He submitted that it was Jinab-i-Aqa Siyyid Mirza's thought that Jinab-i-Aqa Siyyid Ahmad should proceed to India, but that he had no intention whatsoever of going in that direction. [The Blessed Beauty] stated that in this case he should proceed to the Great City and occupy himself with refuting the calumnies of the calumniators and the treacheries of the treacherous ones.

Subject: firmness in the Covenant
Quotation: No power can eliminate misunderstandings except that of the Covenant. The power of the Covenant is all-embracing and resolveth all difficulties, for the Pen of Glory hath explicitly declared that whatever misunderstanding may arise should be referred to the Centre of the Covenant. He will resolve every difficulty. Thus no power can dispel misunderstandings among the friends except the Covenant and Testament of God. Therefore it behoveth thee to urge and encourage all the friends to remain firm in the Covenant and Testament.

Subject: firmness in the Covenant
Quotation: In the Qur'an, He clearly stated: Then We gave the Book for an inheritance to such of Our servants as We chose. But there are among them some who wrong their own souls; some who follow a middle course; and some who are, by God's leave, foremost in good deeds. He says that We made inheritors of the Book those souls among Our servants who are the manifestations of We chose, but these manifestations of We chose are of three kinds: some wrong their own souls, some are moderate, meaning they follow a middle course, and some are foremost in good deeds.

Subject: firmness in the Covenant
Quotation: O servant of the Blessed Beauty! Praise be to God that in the Days of God thou became intoxicated with the wine of the love of God, took in hand the cup of recognition, attained the presence, arose to serve the Cause of God, and in the gathering of the Covenant of Alast became a cup-bearer. God willing, thou shalt be among those souls who, like the true dawn, illuminate the horizons with the light of the Covenant, be an accepted servant at the Threshold of Truth, and be counted among those of whom He says: The blame of the blamer shall not deter them in the path of God.

Subject: firmness in the Covenant
Quotation: Your letter was received and its contents brought infinite joy and delight, for it demonstrated that, praise be to God, the sons and daughters of the Kingdom are calling to the Kingdom and are engaged in promoting the divine teachings with eloquent speech and articulate discourse. Although letters from the Holy Land were cut off for a time due to obstacles, praise be to God that you showed no lassitude or weariness. The friends of God, as before and even more so, arose to serve, and this is evidence of steadfastness and firmness in God's Kingdom and the cause of utmost joy.

Subject: firmness in the Covenant
Quotation: O vigilant one! You have opened your eyes and witnessed the most great signs, and you have opened your ears and heard the call of the Concourse on High. You have spurred your steed in the field of endeavor and seized the ball of divine guidance. You have grasped the hem of grandeur and delivered yourself from grievous perils. Now too, hold fast to the firm covenant and cling with might, that you may demonstrate steadfastness and constancy and, to the dismay of the negligent ones, may cause your countenance to shine bright in the gathering of the Covenant. This is the sure handle of God and the firm cord of the Lord.

Subject: firmness in the Covenant
Quotation: In any case, the glad tidings of the return of the spiritual friends and heavenly souls to the shelter of the Tree of the Covenant brought joy to the friends. Indeed, the heart cannot be content that souls who for many years dwelt beneath the Lote Tree of the utmost boundary, who were in the circle of the Bahais, who endured hardships, suffered tribulations, became the target of reproach and censure from friend and stranger, and were humbled before friend and foe in the path of God, should in the end be deprived of the bounties of the Most Glorious Kingdom, held back from exalting the Word of God, and become heedless of diffusing the divine fragrances.

Subject: firmness in the Covenant
Quotation: Especially since thou hast attained to circumambulating the gathering-place of the Concourse on High and been honored to visit the Blessed Spot around which God hath sanctified and blessed... I swear by the Ancient Beauty (may my spirit be sacrificed for His loved ones) that if today a soul should firmly grasp and mightily hold fast to God's Covenant and Testament, which is the firm handle of the All-Merciful Beauty, the confirmations of the Abha Kingdom will surround from all directions, the lights of victory will shine forth from the Kingdom of Mystery, and will so sanctify the reality of his heart and conscience that the verses of his holiness will be recited in the gathering of the righteous.

Subject: firmness in the Covenant
Quotation: If today this mighty foundation is not made firm and solid, thereafter a hundred thousand breaches will appear in the divine edifice, and the foundation of God's Law will be utterly demolished. The Sun of Truth will be hidden, the shining moon will be concealed, the manifest standard will be overthrown, and the hearts of the unitarians will be drowned in blood. The Divine Lote-Tree will be uprooted, and the axe will fall upon the garden of the Most Glorious Paradise. A hundred thousand trees will be felled in an instant, and a hundred measures of fruit will be scattered and strewn in a moment. The lights of guidance will vanish, and pitch darkness will prevail. The sign of mercy will be abrogated, and the people of wrath will be transformed.

Subject: firmness in the Covenant
Quotation:
words which revealed what lay between the ribs and innermost being - the burning flames of the love of God, its intense heat, and the crying out of hearts in their passion and ardor...and remained firm in His Covenant and Testament, which is the sure handle that cannot be broken, the raised standard, the praiseworthy station, and the extended shade revealing both witness and witnessed...Glory and praise, spirit and radiance be upon those who have held fast and clung to that mighty cord, who have walked that straight path, who have stood firm, grown and become deeply rooted in the Ancient Covenant and the firm, true Testament. AB02494
I beseech God that each of you may become firm and steadfast in the love of God

Subject: forces of light and darkness; integration and disintegration
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/forces of light and darkness; integration and disintegration.txt
Quotation: These nations are thinking, Hate. You think with all your powers, Love. They are calling War. Send out a call for Peace.

Subject: forces of light and darkness; integration and disintegration
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/forces of light and darkness; integration and disintegration.txt
Quotation: Though clouds may conceal the rays of the sun for a time, yet ultimately the dense clouds shall dissipate and the radiant beams shall shine forth.

Subject: forces of light and darkness; integration and disintegration
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/forces of light and darkness; integration and disintegration.txt
Quotation: But be not grieved, for the effulgences of the Sun of Truth shall absorb the excess moisture of nature and shall gather together the scattered letters.

Subject: forces of light and darkness; integration and disintegration
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/forces of light and darkness; integration and disintegration.txt
Quotation: Wait and see what the sun will bring, For what you saw were but effects of dawn. Soon the world from East to West will be illumined, but this depends on the power of the friends' efforts.

Subject: forces of light and darkness; integration and disintegration
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/forces of light and darkness; integration and disintegration.txt
Quotation: The people of tyranny desired to destroy the Law of God. The divine champion, the Word of God, came forth to the field, defeated the army of ignorance, and through the rays of the Sun of Truth destroyed the hosts of darkness.

Subject: forces of light and darkness; integration and disintegration
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/forces of light and darkness; integration and disintegration.txt
Quotation: Under all conditions, keep thy gaze fixed on the Truth and hold fast unto Him. The satans are lying in wait and expectant. Each one of you must, like a piercing flame, prevent the satans from ascending to the heavens of hearts.

Subject: forces of light and darkness; integration and disintegration
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/forces of light and darkness; integration and disintegration.txt
Quotation: Today the penetrative power in the world of existence is the confirmation of the Kingdom of Abha. Every plan and system which is assisted by this power will be established in the world of humanity and will be realized among men.

Subject: forces of light and darkness; integration and disintegration
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/forces of light and darkness; integration and disintegration.txt
Quotation: Darkness hath enveloped most of the peoples: Where is the brightness of Thy splendor, O Radiance of the worlds? The whisperings of Satan have been breathed to every creature: Where is the meteor of Thy fire, O Light of the worlds?

Subject: forces of light and darkness; integration and disintegration
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/forces of light and darkness; integration and disintegration.txt
Quotation: Under what tumultuous times the foundation of this divine structure was laid! In reality to bring the remains of the BAB from Persia and inter it in the unique building was the most difficult and at the same time the most triumphal work of the Cause.

Subject: forces of light and darkness; integration and disintegration
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/forces of light and darkness; integration and disintegration.txt
Quotation: See how the power of the Cause of God has created a tumult in the hearts and what a revolution it has produced. See how the aid and assistance of the Abha Beauty have reached us constantly and invariably the lights of victory have shone from the supreme horizon.

Subject: forces of light and darkness; integration and disintegration
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/forces of light and darkness; integration and disintegration.txt
Quotation: The divine champion, the Word of God, entered the arena, routed the army of ignorance, and with the rays of the Sun of Truth scattered the hosts of darkness. This radiant effulgence shone forth like the dawn, and the celestial Sun cast its rays. Day by day this light grows brighter and the darkness of ignorance is dispersed.

Subject: forces of light and darkness; integration and disintegration
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/forces of light and darkness; integration and disintegration.txt
Quotation: Consider now how humanity is drowned like animals in the sea of nature. No trace of the human world remains. The people of the world must be fair - can anything except the teachings of Baha'u'llah, which are rays of the Sun of Truth, overcome this darkest night and cause the bright morn to dawn, making the world a rose garden?

Subject: forces of light and darkness; integration and disintegration
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/forces of light and darkness; integration and disintegration.txt
Quotation: Tremors have seized the tribes, and turmoil hath encompassed the dwellers of earth, save whom God hath willed. That which hath appeared hath transcended the power of comprehension. The King of Names hath astounded the manifestations of might and wealth, and realms which their men had imagined to be free from decline now show evident cracks.

Subject: forces of light and darkness; integration and disintegration
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/forces of light and darkness; integration and disintegration.txt
Quotation: O joy! The darkness of separation hath passed away and the day of reunion hath come! O gladness and delight for the people of faithfulness, and sorrow and extinction for the perfidious! Calamity upon calamity hath overtaken them, and they have no refuge or protection from the chastisement of thy Lord - evil indeed is the abode of those who break the Covenant!

Subject: forces of light and darkness; integration and disintegration
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/forces of light and darkness; integration and disintegration.txt
Quotation: "And from that which they smelt in the fire for the sake of ornaments ariseth a foam like unto it. Thus doth God set forth truth and falsehood. As for the foam, it passeth away as doth all that is worthless, while that which profiteth mankind remaineth on the earth." "Then He states that those doubts and intrigues have no permanence and vanish away, but the divine bounty endures."

Subject: forces of light and darkness; integration and disintegration
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/forces of light and darkness; integration and disintegration.txt
Quotation: All who dwell on earth, throughout the days and nights, beseeched God for the meeting with the Manifestation of His Self and the Dawning-Place of His verses. Yet when those days appeared and the countenance of the Promised One shone forth from the Horizon of Revelation, all denied Him save a few. Such is the state of the people - they have forsaken the Truth and become worshippers of idols.

Subject: forces of light and darkness; integration and disintegration
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/forces of light and darkness; integration and disintegration.txt
Quotation: It is impossible for the different nations and parties which exist now - such as socialists, Bolshevists, the extremists or radicals, strikers and those who wish for absolute authority, to leave these dissensions and be united - save through BAHA'O'LLAH'S teachings. The teachings of BAHA'O'LLAH are like the sun and these dissensions are like the darkness. This darkness cannot be dispelled except through the teachings of BAHA'O'LLAH.

Subject: forces of light and darkness; integration and disintegration
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/forces of light and darkness; integration and disintegration.txt
Quotation: Consider the Russia-Japanese war. A country as powerful as Russia must at least be able to win a small victory, [yet they were completely denied.] They had mined the sea expecting to sink Japanese warships, but instead the same mines sank the largest Russian ship, carrying her highest-ranking Captains and military officers. Notice that their plans were not in congruence with the predestined decree and, no matter how well plans are drawn, preordained destination is supreme.

Subject: forces of light and darkness; integration and disintegration
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/forces of light and darkness; integration and disintegration.txt
Quotation: Soon will the words of the deniers and epistles of the polytheists be spread abroad. By the one true God! In the sight of those who gaze upon the Most Glorious Horizon, all that they have written has been and will be devoid of the garment of true meaning, deprived of the robe of acceptance, and bereft of the fragrances of truth. When the veils of fancy were rent asunder by the fingers of divine power, the words of the manifestations of Satan appeared more insignificant than the words of children.

Subject: forces of light and darkness; integration and disintegration
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/forces of light and darkness; integration and disintegration.txt
Quotation: The bats of darkness were greatly saddened and deprived, and the ravens have lamented and languished. Some said: The day is reversed. Others stated: The nightingale is a crazed lover. Yet others said: The fate of the candle is to be extinguished. And some said: The longing desire of the meadow of truth is to love the beginning, and its end is to be beaten with a stick. Consequently, darkness is good and light is bad; the rose-garden and meadow are worthless, and the dunghill is eternal and endureth forever.

Subject: forces of light and darkness; integration and disintegration
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/forces of light and darkness; integration and disintegration.txt
Quotation: The signs of divine power are appearing moment by moment from the Abha Kingdom in such a way that minds and souls are left bewildered... Were it not for the onslaughts of the Covenant-breakers and the schemes, corruption and deception of the violators - that is, if this great blow had not occurred - today the Cause of God would be manifest and evident in the world and universe like the sun. Yet despite this, through divine assistance and grace, the Sun of Truth will shine forth from the Kingdom of Mystery with such radiance that soon these dense clouds and dark vapors will completely dissolve and its brilliant rays will illumine East and West.

Subject: forces of light and darkness; integration and disintegration
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/forces of light and darkness; integration and disintegration.txt
Quotation: O Sun! Emerge from the eclipse of fancy and desire and behold the Most Luminous, Most Manifest, Most Glorious Orb in the pole of the heaven of eternity with such radiant lights that were all the atoms of existence, both seen and unseen, to reflect but the least ray from the rays of its light, verily would they all attain unto the cry "Verily I am God!" O Sun! Behold on one hand the radiance of His grace's lights which, with a single effulgence, hath adorned all the heavens of the unseen majesty with suns of glory and honored the mountains of holy oneness with the appearance of hidden mines. And on the other hand, the piercing meteor of His [presence] hath demolished all the thrones of loftiness and elevation, and cast down the exalted suns of the heaven of grandeur to the dust of abasement.

Subject: forces of light and darkness; integration and disintegration
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/forces of light and darkness; integration and disintegration.txt
Quotation: The League assembly's thoughts are scattered among numerous matters and they do not have the opportunity for proper effort and endeavor as they should, nor is any result expected in the future...the League assembly clearly has no proper foundation. In this case, remaining in those parts will yield no results.

Subject: forces of light and darkness; integration and disintegration
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/forces of light and darkness; integration and disintegration.txt
Quotation: There is no such thing as self-development. Growth only comes by working for others. The time as prophesied from all time is short - very short. How is the Holy Spirit to be recognised by the world? A great mass of people all over the world who have united as brothers in sorrow, suffering and affliction, will be persecuted until their cries reach the very gates of heaven. Then Angels of Light will arise and these people will receive the Message I came to bring and have held so long, waiting for more sorrow and suffering. When these souls are awakened - watch the results. Turkey was freed in one night; the world will also change in the same way, not from a Baha'i movement, but from a world movement. Many of the Bahais in name will steal away disappointed, but be ye firm and never let go.

Subject: forces of light and darkness; integration and disintegration
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/forces of light and darkness; integration and disintegration.txt
Quotation: Every Universal Dispensation has two great events occur: collection and separation. That is, it will divide the father from the mother and the brother from the sister.

Subject: forces of light and darkness; integration and disintegration
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/forces of light and darkness; integration and disintegration.txt
Quotation: The teachings of His Holiness Baha'u'llah are today the spirit of life, the means of Peace and Reconciliation, the cause of Amity and Union and the promoter of the Oneness of Mankind.

Subject: forces of light and darkness; integration and disintegration
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/forces of light and darkness; integration and disintegration.txt
Quotation: When the light of His Essence shone forth from the lamp of oneness, both the horizons and the souls were illumined, and this dark world of dust became the dawning-place of the signs of the All-Merciful.

Subject: forces of light and darkness; integration and disintegration
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/forces of light and darkness; integration and disintegration.txt
Quotation: Destroy the root of conflict and strife; abandon imitations and prejudices which lead to cruelty, so that you may acknowledge the Truth and the light of the oneness of humanity may shine brilliant and manifest as the sun; the standard of universal peace be hoisted

Subject: forces of light and darkness; integration and disintegration
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/forces of light and darkness; integration and disintegration.txt
Quotation: After this War, the minds and understandings [of people] will have expanded. Peace-lovers and peace-makers will grow throughout all corners of the globe. This War is the harbinger of universal peace. It is the greatest instrument of universal peace, its greatest catalyst.

Subject: forces of light and darkness; integration and disintegration
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/forces of light and darkness; integration and disintegration.txt
Quotation: "All Europe is an armed camp. These warlike preparations will necessarily culminate in a great war. The very armaments themselves are productive of war. This great arsenal must go ablaze. There is nothing of the nature of prophecy about such a view; it is based on reasoning solely."

Subject: forces of light and darkness; integration and disintegration
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/forces of light and darkness; integration and disintegration.txt
Quotation: Torrential rain will disturb and scatter those creatures accustomed to live beneath the ground but the flower gardens will become ever more graceful with blooms filled with anemones and roses and with nightingales that chant and sing a myriad songs at every moment. All that hath come to pass is a bounty unto the righteous and a calamity unto the feeble ones.

Subject: forces of light and darkness; integration and disintegration
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/forces of light and darkness; integration and disintegration.txt
Quotation: You observe that although material civilization has reached its height in this age, there is still war and conflict, bloodshed, destruction of human foundations...In former times which we called savage, if there was a war perhaps a thousand people would be killed in a year. Now in the war between Russia and Japan, five hundred thousand were killed in six months.

Subject: forces of light and darkness; integration and disintegration
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/forces of light and darkness; integration and disintegration.txt
Quotation: Every Universal Dispensation has two great events occur: collection and separation. That is, it will divide the father from the mother and the brother from the sister. For instance, when the father believes and the mother disbelieves, separation is produced; when the brother accepts the Message and the sister rejects it, division will occur; when the son is converted and the daughter is perverted, partition will take place.

Subject: forces of light and darkness; integration and disintegration
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/forces of light and darkness; integration and disintegration.txt
Quotation: The Breeze of Providence wafts from the direction of the rose-garden of Reality bestowing joy and happiness upon the adepts. The Sun of the divine world hath dawned from the horizon of the temperate, spring equinox, resurrecting into new life the countries of the orient and the occident. A most tremendous stir or motion is witnessed in the world of creation. All the phenomena are in the process of reformation and regeneration.

Subject: forces of light and darkness; integration and disintegration
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/forces of light and darkness; integration and disintegration.txt
Quotation: The brilliant sun at the equator has risen in all regions from the point of equilibrium in springtime, bestowing through its light and intense heat a new outpouring and powerful spirit upon all climes. From that light and heat, movement and motion have stirred in the veins and sinews of the horizons. A new creation has appeared and a fresh spirit has been breathed. The frozen body of contingent being and the lifeless form of existence have found new life and attained boundless favor.

Subject: forgiveness; a sin-covering eye; patience and forbearance
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/forgiveness; a sin-covering eye; patience and forbearance.txt
Quotation: We must look upon every human being we saw as a letter from the Beloved to us. No matter how blotted, blurred, torn or soiled that letter appears to be, nevertheless, you must look upon it with the eye of reality and say to yourself, this is a letter from my Beloved, therefore, because it is from Him, I must love it with that divine love and overlook all its defects--inasmuch as the Beloved wrote it.

Subject: forgiveness; a sin-covering eye; patience and forbearance
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/forgiveness; a sin-covering eye; patience and forbearance.txt
Quotation: Let us have a sin-covering eye

Subject: forgiveness; a sin-covering eye; patience and forbearance
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/forgiveness; a sin-covering eye; patience and forbearance.txt
Quotation: Be patient in what befalls you.

Subject: forgiveness; a sin-covering eye; patience and forbearance
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/forgiveness; a sin-covering eye; patience and forbearance.txt
Quotation: those who pardon men; for God loveth those who do good

Subject: forgiveness; a sin-covering eye; patience and forbearance
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/forgiveness; a sin-covering eye; patience and forbearance.txt
Quotation: Do not express hatred or resentment toward anyone. Be at peace and make peace with all.

Subject: forgiveness; a sin-covering eye; patience and forbearance
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/forgiveness; a sin-covering eye; patience and forbearance.txt
Quotation: be a veiler of people's faults... be kindly to thy debtors; be a forgiver to the transgressors

Subject: forgiveness; a sin-covering eye; patience and forbearance
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/forgiveness; a sin-covering eye; patience and forbearance.txt
Quotation: Overlook the shortcomings of others. Don't mind the criticism of any one. Overlook the sins of others.

Subject: forgiveness; a sin-covering eye; patience and forbearance
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/forgiveness; a sin-covering eye; patience and forbearance.txt
Quotation: "Treat them with grace and kindness and overlook their slips of pen and tongue...leave them to their affairs."

Subject: forgiveness; a sin-covering eye; patience and forbearance
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/forgiveness; a sin-covering eye; patience and forbearance.txt
Quotation: Although the Jews had caused Christ's death, Christ would never be pleased that revenge be taken against them.

Subject: forgiveness; a sin-covering eye; patience and forbearance
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/forgiveness; a sin-covering eye; patience and forbearance.txt
Quotation: prayer for forgiveness of his killers: "Lord! Hold them not accountable for this grievous wrong...for they are ignorant ones"

Subject: forgiveness; a sin-covering eye; patience and forbearance
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/forgiveness; a sin-covering eye; patience and forbearance.txt
Quotation: Be compassionate towards the wayward and forgiving nigh the sinful! Be humble before God and conceal the shortcomings of the people.

Subject: forgiveness; a sin-covering eye; patience and forbearance
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/forgiveness; a sin-covering eye; patience and forbearance.txt
Quotation: Show the utmost love and kindness to those who caused trouble in Ishqabad and fled, and never bring to their attention that they committed any wrong.

Subject: forgiveness; a sin-covering eye; patience and forbearance
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/forgiveness; a sin-covering eye; patience and forbearance.txt
Quotation: one of the great teachings of Baha'u'llah not found in previous dispensations, which is the prohibition of cursing enemies and to pray for their forgiveness

Subject: forgiveness; a sin-covering eye; patience and forbearance
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/forgiveness; a sin-covering eye; patience and forbearance.txt
Quotation: I raised him up and pardoned him, and wrote a letter to the Vali of the time, Nasr Hayi Bey, recommending him and saying he had caused us no harm or injury.

Subject: forgiveness; a sin-covering eye; patience and forbearance
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/forgiveness; a sin-covering eye; patience and forbearance.txt
Quotation: Be patient, O My loved ones, in adversity and tribulation, and if one should oppress you, refer his judgment to God, in Whose hand is the kingdom of all things.

Subject: forgiveness; a sin-covering eye; patience and forbearance
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/forgiveness; a sin-covering eye; patience and forbearance.txt
Quotation: How my heart leaps with joy when I hear the friends love each other, always overlooking one another's small mistakes; and that they are forgiving their enemies!

Subject: forgiveness; a sin-covering eye; patience and forbearance
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/forgiveness; a sin-covering eye; patience and forbearance.txt
Quotation: By God! In all instances of oppression and tyranny, We have shown patience and left matters to God. Verily, He heareth and seeth, and He is the All-Hearing, the All-Seeing.

Subject: forgiveness; a sin-covering eye; patience and forbearance
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/forgiveness; a sin-covering eye; patience and forbearance.txt
Quotation: By God, O My brother, there is no hatred in My heart for thee nor for any created thing. Hear My words, then return from thy course and turn to thy Lord in mighty humility.

Subject: forgiveness; a sin-covering eye; patience and forbearance
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/forgiveness; a sin-covering eye; patience and forbearance.txt
Quotation: Despite such insolence, we have no complaint against him while he protests. Still, pray for him and seek his healing. I harbor no ill-feeling toward him and will not be vexed, but will pray for him.

Subject: forgiveness; a sin-covering eye; patience and forbearance
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/forgiveness; a sin-covering eye; patience and forbearance.txt
Quotation: I treat him with such love that he becomes confused about his own situation - even if he has committed the greatest betrayal against me, I treat him as though he were the most trustworthy of souls.

Subject: forgiveness; a sin-covering eye; patience and forbearance
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/forgiveness; a sin-covering eye; patience and forbearance.txt
Quotation: Although he has spread tales and stories about me and authored a book to demean me, I have never written a single word about him. If he were fair-minded, this patience and forbearance alone would suffice.

Subject: forgiveness; a sin-covering eye; patience and forbearance
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/forgiveness; a sin-covering eye; patience and forbearance.txt
Quotation: At present forbearance is necessary lest a break occur, for if a break occurs, fellowship and association will cease and no one will draw nigh. We exercise patience and forbearance, and you too must do likewise.

Subject: forgiveness; a sin-covering eye; patience and forbearance
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/forgiveness; a sin-covering eye; patience and forbearance.txt
Quotation: Should anyone commit an error, he should be reminded with the utmost joy and fragrance, and if he be not receptive to reminders, leave him to himself. Deal with the friends of God with utmost love and forbearance.
