Quotation: O Forgiver of sins, Remover of afflictions, and Concealer of faults!...Verily Thou art the Forgiver, verily Thou art the Pardoner, verily Thou art the Sufficient, the Healing, the Faithful to every grateful servant.

Subject: forgiveness; grace; bounty; mercy; compassion of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/forgiveness; grace; bounty; mercy; compassion of God.txt
Quotation: O You Who are great in beneficence, O Forbearing One, O Merciful One! ... Verily You are the All-Merciful, the Most Merciful ... Verily You are the Generous One, possessed of bounty, Who forgives whomsoever You will

Subject: forgiveness; grace; bounty; mercy; compassion of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/forgiveness; grace; bounty; mercy; compassion of God.txt
Quotation: "Accept, then, his supplication and forgive his father who has ascended to the realm of Your great mercy. Verily You are He Who pardons and forgives fathers through the entreaties and supplications of their children."

Subject: forgiveness; grace; bounty; mercy; compassion of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/forgiveness; grace; bounty; mercy; compassion of God.txt
Quotation: This is naught but the endless bounty and favor that hath in this time been manifested to the world of being. Through His bestowals we all found refuge and shelter... This is pure bounty, not capacity and worthiness.

Subject: forgiveness; grace; bounty; mercy; compassion of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/forgiveness; grace; bounty; mercy; compassion of God.txt
Quotation: His grace hath encompassed the world, and the lights of the Sun of His providence have illumined all hearts and minds. No obstacle hath prevented His grace, and no denier hath hindered the manifestations of His bounty.

Subject: forgiveness; grace; bounty; mercy; compassion of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/forgiveness; grace; bounty; mercy; compassion of God.txt
Quotation: seeking forgiveness for his sins, asking cover for his faults, seeking aid from Thee, hoping for Thy bounty, and crying for help at Thy gate... Verily, Thou art the Forgiving, the Generous, the Merciful, the Bestower.

Subject: forgiveness; grace; bounty; mercy; compassion of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/forgiveness; grace; bounty; mercy; compassion of God.txt
Quotation: By the life of God! The Most Great Mercy and Supreme Bounty have intervened and prevented it, for mercy hath precedence and continueth to have precedence, and compassion hath encompassed and continueth to encompass all.

Subject: forgiveness; grace; bounty; mercy; compassion of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/forgiveness; grace; bounty; mercy; compassion of God.txt
Quotation: Thus doth God bring forth the latter creation through His mercy. This is a mercy that hath encompassed all who are in the kingdom of the heavens and the earth and all that lieth between them, then throughout all worlds.

Subject: forgiveness; grace; bounty; mercy; compassion of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/forgiveness; grace; bounty; mercy; compassion of God.txt
Quotation: Our mercy has preceded the world and Our generosity has encompassed those in the heavens and earths. Thus has the scratching of My Pen been raised and the ocean of My mercy surged, as a bounty from My presence upon thee.

Subject: forgiveness; grace; bounty; mercy; compassion of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/forgiveness; grace; bounty; mercy; compassion of God.txt
Quotation: O Thou Bestower! Make that blessed friend radiant like a star in the east of bounty and forgiveness, and cause him to shine forth bright as the luminous moon. Thou art the Bestower, the Kind, Thou art the Forgiving Lord.

Subject: forgiveness; grace; bounty; mercy; compassion of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/forgiveness; grace; bounty; mercy; compassion of God.txt
Quotation: Thou hast praised Thyself in the clear verses of the Qur'an as "Accepter of repentance, Forgiver of sins," and "Verily God forgives all sins."...Verily, Thou art kind to Thy servants and generous to every penitent soul.

Subject: forgiveness; grace; bounty; mercy; compassion of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/forgiveness; grace; bounty; mercy; compassion of God.txt
Quotation: I beseech Thee to send down from the heaven of Thy grace upon Thy loved ones a blessing from Thee, a table from Thy heaven, and a benediction from Thy presence. Verily Thou art the All-Bountiful, possessed of great favor.

Subject: forgiveness; grace; bounty; mercy; compassion of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/forgiveness; grace; bounty; mercy; compassion of God.txt
Quotation: Yet We concealed it, for thy Lord is the Concealer, the All-Knowing, the All-Wise... Though We found him in hypocrisy, We concealed his affair as a grace from Us. Verily thy Lord is the All-Bountiful, the Ancient of Days.

Subject: forgiveness; grace; bounty; mercy; compassion of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/forgiveness; grace; bounty; mercy; compassion of God.txt
Quotation: Grant pardon and forgiveness, and bestow abundant mercy and free grace. O Forgiving, Kind One... so that in the world above she may shine with a face like the luminous moon and radiate the light of pardon and forgiveness.

Subject: forgiveness; grace; bounty; mercy; compassion of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/forgiveness; grace; bounty; mercy; compassion of God.txt
Quotation: who gives everything a portion of Your vast mercy encompassing contingent being...Verily You are the Generous, the Merciful, the Bestower. There is no God but You, the Powerful, the Forgiving, the Accepting of Repentance.

Subject: forgiveness; grace; bounty; mercy; compassion of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/forgiveness; grace; bounty; mercy; compassion of God.txt
Quotation: O Thou the Forgiving! Afflicted are we, yet inexhaustible are Thy blessings. Helpless are we, yet Thy mercy lendeth us a helping hand. Captives of self and passion are we, yet Thy favors are the succor of every feeble one.

Subject: forgiveness; grace; bounty; mercy; compassion of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/forgiveness; grace; bounty; mercy; compassion of God.txt
Quotation: He it is Who willeth naught for anyone save mercy from His presence, for He is the All-Encompassing, the Most Subtle. He it is Who willeth naught for anyone save bounty from His presence, for He is possessed of great bounty

Subject: forgiveness; grace; bounty; mercy; compassion of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/forgiveness; grace; bounty; mercy; compassion of God.txt
Quotation: the fragrances of the Raiment of Thy grace which at Thy bidding and in conformity with Thy desire were diffused throughout the entire creation...the cord of Thy tender mercy...clouds of Thy bounty and the heaven of Thy favor

Subject: forgiveness; grace; bounty; mercy; compassion of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/forgiveness; grace; bounty; mercy; compassion of God.txt
Quotation: "The command is in the hand of God, the Lord of the worlds, and the Most Great Name through Whom the limbs of the nations have quaked. God, verily, is the Merciful, the Bountiful, and He is the Forgiving, the Compassionate."

Subject: forgiveness; grace; bounty; mercy; compassion of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/forgiveness; grace; bounty; mercy; compassion of God.txt
Quotation: We pray God that He may forgive us, and forgive them that have turned unto thee, and grant their desires, and bestow upon them, through His wondrous grace, whatever be their wish. He, verily, is the Bountiful, the Generous.

Subject: forgiveness; grace; bounty; mercy; compassion of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/forgiveness; grace; bounty; mercy; compassion of God.txt
Quotation: Shelter me in the proximity of Your mercy, forgive my sins, remove my difficulties, and make the end of my life begin with kindnesses... Verily You are the Forgiving, You are the Kind, You are the Mighty, the Compassionate.

Subject: forgiveness; grace; bounty; mercy; compassion of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/forgiveness; grace; bounty; mercy; compassion of God.txt
Quotation: O Lord! Give Ardishir to drink from the breast of forgiveness and immerse him in the ocean of pardon... Thou art the Bestower, the Kind, and Thou art the Giver, the Illuminating and Radiant One of the world of heart and soul.

Subject: forgiveness; grace; bounty; mercy; compassion of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/forgiveness; grace; bounty; mercy; compassion of God.txt
Quotation: Plunge him into the depths of Thy great mercy...Encompass him with the glances of the eye of Thy grace and cause him to enter the depths of the ocean of Thy favors and forgiveness...Verily, Thou art the Pardoner, the Forgiving.

Subject: forgiveness; grace; bounty; mercy; compassion of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/forgiveness; grace; bounty; mercy; compassion of God.txt
Quotation: He sent down the Book as a grace from His presence and ordained therein what befits man...He will assist you and teach you what He desires and will deliver you as a grace from His presence. He is the Powerful, the All-Bountiful.

Subject: forgiveness; grace; bounty; mercy; compassion of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/forgiveness; grace; bounty; mercy; compassion of God.txt
Quotation: Blessed is He Who hath sent down the verses as a grace from His presence, for He is the All-Bountiful, the All-Generous...Verily Thou art the All-Bountiful, the All-Generous. There is no God but Thee, the Forgiving, the Merciful.

Subject: forgiveness; grace; bounty; mercy; compassion of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/forgiveness; grace; bounty; mercy; compassion of God.txt
Quotation: The favors of the Most Holy One are endless and the forgiveness and pardon of the Reality of the All-Merciful are boundless... He sees fault yet bestows gifts, finds sin yet grants shelter, witnesses disobedience yet shows favor.

Subject: forgiveness; grace; bounty; mercy; compassion of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/forgiveness; grace; bounty; mercy; compassion of God.txt
Quotation: In the morning hours I call upon Thee, hoping for Thy boundless grace, and in the evening I turn to the horizon of Thy mercy, yearning for Thy ancient bounty. I call upon Thee by Thy name, the All-Merciful, the Most Compassionate.

Subject: forgiveness; grace; bounty; mercy; compassion of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/forgiveness; grace; bounty; mercy; compassion of God.txt
Quotation: Thou hast ever been forgiving through bounty and grace, and compelling through might and justice. Thy giving is grace from Thy bounty, and Thy withholding is justice. Thou art He Whose mercy hath encompassed all contingent things.

Subject: forgiveness; grace; bounty; mercy; compassion of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/forgiveness; grace; bounty; mercy; compassion of God.txt
Quotation: Thou hast settled them beneath the shelter of Thy pavilion of grace and gathered them at Thy bountiful table and illumined them with the radiance of Thy loving providence...Thou art the Concealer of faults and the Forgiver of sins.

Subject: forgiveness; grace; bounty; mercy; compassion of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/forgiveness; grace; bounty; mercy; compassion of God.txt
Quotation: and by Thy mercy through which Thou didst call all created things to the banquet of Thy favor and beneficence; and by Thy loving-kindness through which Thou didst answer within Thyself, before all who are in the heavens and the earth

Subject: forgiveness; grace; bounty; mercy; compassion of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/forgiveness; grace; bounty; mercy; compassion of God.txt
Quotation: The merciful Lord, out of His perfect grace and pure bounty, has opened wide the gates of guidance and thrown open the doors of His gifts...Would that my people knew how my Lord has forgiven me and made me to be of the honored ones!"

Subject: forgiveness; grace; bounty; mercy; compassion of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/forgiveness; grace; bounty; mercy; compassion of God.txt
Quotation: He is the One dawning from the horizon of the heaven of bounty. This is a day wherein the fragrance of bounties and favors hath been wafted from God, the Lord of creation. Blessed is he who hath inhaled the fragrance of the All-Merciful

Subject: forgiveness; grace; bounty; mercy; compassion of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/forgiveness; grace; bounty; mercy; compassion of God.txt
Quotation: O Lord! Withhold not the glances of Thy loving-kindness from this servant whose gaze is fixed upon Thy most exalted horizon. Preserve him, then, beneath the shade of the Tree of Thy grace. Verily, Thou art the Almighty, the All-Choosing.

Subject: forgiveness; grace; bounty; mercy; compassion of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/forgiveness; grace; bounty; mercy; compassion of God.txt
Quotation: Lord! Have mercy upon me through Thy grace and transport me from this world unto the court of Thy forgiveness in the realm hereafter. Thou art the Forgiving. Thou art the Clement, the Kind, the Benevolent, the Merciful, the Compassionate.

Subject: forgiveness; grace; bounty; mercy; compassion of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/forgiveness; grace; bounty; mercy; compassion of God.txt
Quotation: O Rahim! Know thou that God, blessed and exalted be He, hath forgiven your father and sent down upon him mercy from His presence. He is the Mighty, the Forgiving. His mercy hath preceded all things and His grace hath encompassed existence.

Subject: forgiveness; grace; bounty; mercy; compassion of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/forgiveness; grace; bounty; mercy; compassion of God.txt
Quotation: His mercy hath ever preceded, and His bounty hath ever taken precedence. He is the Lord of the kingdom of bounty and generosity, and He is the All-Bountiful One Whom the world and all that is therein cannot prevent from His grace and favor.

Subject: forgiveness; grace; bounty; mercy; compassion of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/forgiveness; grace; bounty; mercy; compassion of God.txt
Quotation: O Lord! Thou Who art the Concealer of faults, show Thy magnanimity. Forgive, grant pardon, bestow mercy, overlook the sins, guide aright. For they are ignorant and exposed to shame, heedless and indolent, slaves to their desires and unaware.

Subject: forgiveness; grace; bounty; mercy; compassion of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/forgiveness; grace; bounty; mercy; compassion of God.txt
Quotation: O my Lord, the Most Merciful, Who hast dawned from the horizon of forgiveness! [...] Verily, Thou art the Pardoning, the Forgiving, the Most Merciful, the One Who manifesteth grace and beneficence, and verily, Thou art the Kind, the Bestower.

Subject: forgiveness; grace; bounty; mercy; compassion of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/forgiveness; grace; bounty; mercy; compassion of God.txt
Quotation: This bounty suffices them, by the Lord of the seen and unseen! The Command is in His hand and bounty is in the grasp of His power. He doeth what He willeth and ordaineth what He pleaseth, and He is the Almighty, the All-Knowing, the All-Willing.

Subject: forgiveness; grace; bounty; mercy; compassion of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/forgiveness; grace; bounty; mercy; compassion of God.txt
Quotation: Glorified be He in Whose grasp is the dominion of the bounties of the heavens and the earth and whatsoever is between them! Glorified be He in Whose grasp is the dominion of the favors of the heavens and the earth and whatsoever is between them!

Subject: forgiveness; grace; bounty; mercy; compassion of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/forgiveness; grace; bounty; mercy; compassion of God.txt
Quotation: His favor hath encompassed the world of existence, both seen and unseen... The forbearance of God, exalted be His glory, seeketh salvation for all. Verily He is the Most Merciful of them that show mercy and the Most Generous of the generous ones.

Subject: forgiveness; grace; bounty; mercy; compassion of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/forgiveness; grace; bounty; mercy; compassion of God.txt
Quotation: Thou art the Merciful, Thou art the Refuge of the poor and Thou art the Succourer of them that seek Thy shelter. Thy forgiveness beseemeth me, for Thou art the All-Merciful, Whose help is implored by all men, and Thou art the Refuge of the sinners.

Subject: forgiveness; grace; bounty; mercy; compassion of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/forgiveness; grace; bounty; mercy; compassion of God.txt
Quotation: His mercy hath preceded all things and His grace hath encompassed all things, and He hath established His Cause with justice throughout all the worlds. He sendeth down mercy upon whomsoever He willeth and withholdeth mercy from whomsoever He willeth

Subject: forgiveness; grace; bounty; mercy; compassion of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/forgiveness; grace; bounty; mercy; compassion of God.txt
Quotation: We beseech Him, exalted be He, to change sins into good deeds and to purify you from whatsoever is displeasing to His good-pleasure... this Wronged One likewise acknowledges that God, exalted be His glory, possesses oceans of forgiveness and pardon.

Subject: forgiveness; grace; bounty; mercy; compassion of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/forgiveness; grace; bounty; mercy; compassion of God.txt
Quotation: "He is the Forgiver, the Kind, the Compassionate...My grace and My loving-kindness and My mercy that have preceded all who are in the heavens and on earth...Verily Thou art the All-Bountiful, the Munificent, and Thou art the Forgiving, the Merciful."

Subject: forgiveness; grace; bounty; mercy; compassion of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/forgiveness; grace; bounty; mercy; compassion of God.txt
Quotation: I intercede for another and beseech Thee to forgive Thy servant who turned to the Dawning-Place of Thy mercy and the Dayspring of Thy oneness...O Lord! Forgive him and accept his repentance and pardon him and cause him to enter the gardens of Thy mercy

Subject: forgiveness; grace; bounty; mercy; compassion of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/forgiveness; grace; bounty; mercy; compassion of God.txt
Quotation: Thy mercy hath encompassed all created things, and Thy bounty hath surrounded all atoms. Therefore, O my God, send down upon Thy servants that which will satisfy them from the treasuries of Thy grace, reassure them through the wonders of Thy generosity

Subject: forgiveness; grace; bounty; mercy; compassion of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/forgiveness; grace; bounty; mercy; compassion of God.txt
Quotation: It befitteth Thy Lordship to forgive the sinner, and it beseemeth Thy greatness to pardon every captive. I seek forgiveness and beg pardon for transgressions, and implore abundant grace. Thou art the Kind, Thou art the Merciful, Thou art the Munificent.

Subject: forgiveness; grace; bounty; mercy; compassion of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/forgiveness; grace; bounty; mercy; compassion of God.txt
Quotation: We praise God, the Blessed and Exalted, in the nights and days, and remember Him at eventide and dawn, and beseech Him to protect you and to open before your face the gates of grace, bounty, glory, exaltation and loftiness. Verily, He does what He wills.

Subject: forgiveness; grace; bounty; mercy; compassion of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/forgiveness; grace; bounty; mercy; compassion of God.txt
Quotation: This is a maidservant intoxicated by the wine of Thy love, whose heart was revived by the breeze from the gardens of Thy oneness...Draw her near to the seat of truth, admit her into the gardens of Thy forgiveness, shade her beneath the tree of Thy mercy

Subject: forgiveness; grace; bounty; mercy; compassion of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/forgiveness; grace; bounty; mercy; compassion of God.txt
Quotation: Verily Thou art the Benevolent, the Compassionate, the Merciful...Make him to graze in the meadows of Thy forgiveness, [to wade] in the waters of Thy pardon...Verily, Thou art the Forgiver, the Pardoner, the All-Sufficient, the Compassionate, the Merciful.

Subject: forgiveness; grace; bounty; mercy; compassion of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/forgiveness; grace; bounty; mercy; compassion of God.txt
Quotation: Thy letter hath come before the Throne, and the fingers of mercy and power have taken hold of it, and the gaze of thy Lord, the Most Merciful, the Compassionate, hath turned toward it. This is from God's bounty unto thee, but most of the people are heedless.

Subject: forgiveness; grace; bounty; mercy; compassion of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/forgiveness; grace; bounty; mercy; compassion of God.txt
Quotation: Be thou happy, for the clouds of mercy have bestowed eternal bounties upon the gardens of heart and soul...It is hoped from the bounty of the King of existence that at every moment a dewdrop from the cloud of divine bestowal may descend upon the tree of being

Subject: forgiveness; grace; bounty; mercy; compassion of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/forgiveness; grace; bounty; mercy; compassion of God.txt
Quotation: Strengthen with the abundance of Thy mercy every government which acts with equity towards its subjects, and every dominion under whose flag the poor and weak find protection. We ask Thee by Thy holiness and bounty to pour out thy blessing upon this government

Subject: forgiveness; grace; bounty; mercy; compassion of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/forgiveness; grace; bounty; mercy; compassion of God.txt
Quotation: Suffer me not, I implore Thee, to be kept back from the ocean of Thy tender mercies, nor to be far removed from the shores of nearness to Thee. Forgive, then, O my Lord, Thy servants and Thy handmaidens. Thou, truly, art the Ever-Forgiving, the Most Compassionate.

Subject: forgiveness; grace; bounty; mercy; compassion of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/forgiveness; grace; bounty; mercy; compassion of God.txt
Quotation: We beseech God to open before thy face the gates of His bounty, His mercy and His generosity, and to ordain for thee that which will exalt thee amongst His servants, and make thee mighty through His might, and a champion of His Cause, and steadfast in His service.

Subject: forgiveness; grace; bounty; mercy; compassion of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/forgiveness; grace; bounty; mercy; compassion of God.txt
Quotation: O my God! Verily, Thy wretched and poor servant, the captive of Thy favors, the hireling of Thy bounties, who seeketh refuge at Thy door, hath no intimate save Thy forgiveness and pardon...O Lord! Make him a sign of forgiveness and a standard of pardon and bounty.

Subject: forgiveness; grace; bounty; mercy; compassion of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/forgiveness; grace; bounty; mercy; compassion of God.txt
Quotation: His bounty belongeth unto God, the grace is His, and the bestowal is His. For every soul who hath been present in the Most Holy Court or whose name hath been mentioned, there hath been revealed that within each word of which are concealed oceans of grace and favor.

Subject: forgiveness; grace; bounty; mercy; compassion of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/forgiveness; grace; bounty; mercy; compassion of God.txt
Quotation: Now that she has turned to Thy threshold of oneness and hastened to Thy holy court of the All-Merciful, grant her a portion from the table of Thy grace and favor and from the feast of Thy pardon and forgiveness, and give her shelter beneath the tree of Thy providence.

Subject: forgiveness; grace; bounty; mercy; compassion of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/forgiveness; grace; bounty; mercy; compassion of God.txt
Quotation: I beseech Thee by Thy mercy that hath preceded all created things, and by Thy grace that hath encompassed all contingent beings, to forgive me and to remit my sins. Thou art, verily, the Almighty over what Thou willest, and Thou art the Ever-Forgiving, the All-Merciful.

Subject: forgiveness; grace; bounty; mercy; compassion of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/forgiveness; grace; bounty; mercy; compassion of God.txt
Quotation: O Lord! Forgive her and bestow Thy favors upon her, make her the companion of intimate prayer and supplication in that other world, and at the feast of meeting make her partake from the cup of Thy bounty. Thou art the Kind Lord and Thou art the Peerless God in both worlds.

Subject: forgiveness; grace; bounty; mercy; compassion of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/forgiveness; grace; bounty; mercy; compassion of God.txt
Quotation: After every hardship ease is ordained, and likewise after severity cometh relief. These conditions encompass the world... We beseech Him to open before their faces the gates of mercy and bounty. Verily He doeth what He willeth, and He is the All-Bountiful, the Most Generous.

Subject: forgiveness; grace; bounty; mercy; compassion of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/forgiveness; grace; bounty; mercy; compassion of God.txt
Quotation: Unto God belongeth all mercy, which He bestoweth upon whomsoever He willeth of His servants; verily He is possessed of great mercy. Unto God belongeth the benevolence of the heavens and the earth and whatsoever lieth between them, and God is possessed of ancient benevolence.

Subject: forgiveness; grace; bounty; mercy; compassion of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/forgiveness; grace; bounty; mercy; compassion of God.txt
Quotation: O Forgiver of errors and Pardoner of sins and wrongdoings! You forgive whomsoever You wish through Your all-embracing mercy and Your resplendent compassion... Verily You are the Kind, the Merciful, the Compassionate, and verily You are the Forgiving, the Loving, the Helper.

Subject: forgiveness; grace; bounty; mercy; compassion of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/forgiveness; grace; bounty; mercy; compassion of God.txt
Quotation: If thou returnest unto Us, We shall surely transform thy negation into affirmation, for We are the Forgiving Ones. But if thou remainest veiled, thou harmest none save thyself and those who follow thee, and thou shalt surely die and find none beside God as protector or helper.

Subject: forgiveness; grace; bounty; mercy; compassion of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/forgiveness; grace; bounty; mercy; compassion of God.txt
Quotation: The forgiveness of the Lord is an infinite ocean and His pardon and loving-kindness is a limitless sea...the grace and bounty of the Lord of Glory is a fresh outpouring, and the heat of the sun of His forgiveness is intense, and the flood of the cloud of His pardon is abundant.

Subject: forgiveness; grace; bounty; mercy; compassion of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/forgiveness; grace; bounty; mercy; compassion of God.txt
Quotation: Forgive my sins and remove my sorrows, O Knower of the unseen! Lord, I am abject - strengthen me by admitting me to the Kingdom; poor - enrich me from the inexhaustible treasury in the realm of divinity; sick - heal me from grievous illness and admit me to Your highest paradise

Subject: forgiveness; grace; bounty; mercy; compassion of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/forgiveness; grace; bounty; mercy; compassion of God.txt
Quotation: I testify to the potency of Thy Cause, the pervasive influence of Thy decree, the immutability of Thy will, the endlessness of Thy purpose... Thou art, in truth, He Whose mercy hath encompassed all the worlds, and whose grace hath embraced all that dwell on earth and in heaven.

Subject: forgiveness; grace; bounty; mercy; compassion of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/forgiveness; grace; bounty; mercy; compassion of God.txt
Quotation: Unto God belongeth all mercy, which He bestoweth upon whomsoever He willeth among His servants, and God is possessed of tremendous mercy. Unto God belongeth all mercy, which He sendeth down at all times upon whomsoever remembereth Him; verily He is possessed of tremendous mercy.

Subject: forgiveness; grace; bounty; mercy; compassion of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/forgiveness; grace; bounty; mercy; compassion of God.txt
Quotation: Grace hath encompassed all things, and bounty and munificence have embraced all created things. The waves of the ocean of favor have transcended the heavens. Glory be to God! His favor hath reached such heights that every drop hath become an ocean, and every atom possesseth a sun.

Subject: forgiveness; grace; bounty; mercy; compassion of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/forgiveness; grace; bounty; mercy; compassion of God.txt
Quotation: Yet since Thy custom is grace and beneficence, and Thy way is pardon and favor, Thou judgest each according to what their hands have earned, that they might be delivered from the darkness of turning away and might willingly be content with Thy countenance and standing before Thee.

Subject: forgiveness; grace; bounty; mercy; compassion of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/forgiveness; grace; bounty; mercy; compassion of God.txt
Quotation: Anguish and torment, when suffered on the pathway of the Lord, Him of manifest signs, is only favor and grace; affliction is but mercy, and grief a gift from God. [...] Then praise thou Him, the loving Provider, for having ordained this dire affliction, which is but bounty unalloyed.

Subject: forgiveness; grace; bounty; mercy; compassion of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/forgiveness; grace; bounty; mercy; compassion of God.txt
Quotation: O my Lord! Thou knowest and seest that the Wronged One desired for them naught save that which would draw them nigh unto Thee and move them through Thy will and purpose... I beseech Thee to assist them to return to the court of Thy mercy and the precincts of Thy might and forgiveness

Subject: forgiveness; grace; bounty; mercy; compassion of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/forgiveness; grace; bounty; mercy; compassion of God.txt
Quotation: Through God's grace and bounty, it is hoped that He will grant endless bounties to the friends and freely bestow a royal treasure... This is a bounty without equal, for while bounty and generosity in the contingent world has limits, the gifts of the world of the Kingdom are infinite.

Subject: forgiveness; grace; bounty; mercy; compassion of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/forgiveness; grace; bounty; mercy; compassion of God.txt
Quotation: This is not of the Justice, but of the Bounty of GOD. For illustration, children are to be bed with milk; but guidance is a Perfect Bounty, therefore His Favor is Bounty. But the strength and the power come through obedience and piety. GOD bestows His Mercy upon whomsoever He wishes.

Subject: forgiveness; grace; bounty; mercy; compassion of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/forgiveness; grace; bounty; mercy; compassion of God.txt
Quotation: The Grace of God is more excellent in the kingdom of the heavens and the earth and whatsoever is between them than the grace of all peoples. Say: The Bounty of God is more vast in the kingdom of the heavens and the earth and whatsoever is between them than the bounty of all peoples.

Subject: forgiveness; grace; bounty; mercy; compassion of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/forgiveness; grace; bounty; mercy; compassion of God.txt
Quotation: Thou art He, O my God, Who hath not closed the door of Thy grace nor withheld the rain of Thy bounty and loving-kindness...who hath not gained the lights of the Sun of Thy favors, and who hath faced Thy horizon and hath not beheld the waves of the ocean of Thy bounty and loving-kindness?

Subject: forgiveness; grace; bounty; mercy; compassion of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/forgiveness; grace; bounty; mercy; compassion of God.txt
Quotation: I beseech Thee, O Thou the Possessor of Names and the Fashioner of Heaven, to ordain for her that which will gladden her heart, illumine her eye and delight her bosom...Give her to drink at all times from the wine of Thy bounty, from the river of Thy favour and the wellspring of Thy mercy.

Subject: forgiveness; grace; bounty; mercy; compassion of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/forgiveness; grace; bounty; mercy; compassion of God.txt
Quotation: The ocean of Thy bounty hath encompassed the world, and the effulgences of the Sun of Thy generosity have shed their radiance upon all. Praise be to God! The waves of the ocean of divine bounty are visible, and His mercy hath encompassed those near unto Him, and His grace hath preceded all.

Subject: forgiveness; grace; bounty; mercy; compassion of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/forgiveness; grace; bounty; mercy; compassion of God.txt
Quotation: O Thou Forgiver! Pardon their sins, cover their faults, and bestow Thy gifts, that they may attain endless bounties in the hidden Kingdom and may be blessed to behold Thy beauty and perfection in the assemblage of splendor. Thou art the Forgiver, Thou art the Bestower, Thou art the Kind One.

Subject: forgiveness; grace; bounty; mercy; compassion of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/forgiveness; grace; bounty; mercy; compassion of God.txt
Quotation: Send blessings upon Muhammad and the family of Muhammad with all Thy generosity, for verily his generosity surpasseth any generosity in Thy knowledge; and send blessings upon Muhammad and the family of Muhammad with all Thy bounty, for verily his bounty surpasseth any bounty in Thy knowledge.

Subject: forgiveness; grace; bounty; mercy; compassion of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/forgiveness; grace; bounty; mercy; compassion of God.txt
Quotation: Thy mercy hath preceded all things, Thy bounty hath been perfected, and Thy gift hath been completed for those who have acknowledged Thy oneness, who have drawn from the ocean of Thy grace... Verily, Thou art kind to Thy poor servants, and verily, Thou art the Most Merciful, the Compassionate.

Subject: forgiveness; grace; bounty; mercy; compassion of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/forgiveness; grace; bounty; mercy; compassion of God.txt
Quotation: Let, then, Thine almighty arms enfold me, O my God, and ordain for me what beseemeth Thy bounty in every world of Thy worlds. Deny me not, I pray Thee, the drops which are sprinkled from the ocean of Thy gifts; neither do Thou withhold from me the outpourings of the clouds of Thy tender mercies.

Subject: forgiveness; grace; bounty; mercy; compassion of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/forgiveness; grace; bounty; mercy; compassion of God.txt
Quotation: Lord! Visit her with Thy forgiveness and Thy pardon, clothe her with the raiment of Thy grace and Thy loving-kindness... Thou art the Almighty, the Most Merciful. Thou art the Compassionate, the Benevolent. No God is there except Thee, the Pardoner, the Forgiving, Whose help is implored by all.

Subject: forgiveness; grace; bounty; mercy; compassion of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/forgiveness; grace; bounty; mercy; compassion of God.txt
Quotation: O Lord! Illumine his brow with the manifest light of Thy forgiveness, make his face radiant in Thy glorious Kingdom, clothe him in the robe of pardon through Thy mighty grace... Verily Thou art the Pardoning, the Forgiving, the Merciful, and verily Thou art the Kind, the Compassionate, the Generous

Subject: forgiveness; grace; bounty; mercy; compassion of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/forgiveness; grace; bounty; mercy; compassion of God.txt
Quotation: How kind art Thou to me, beyond what befits my station! How merciful art Thou to me, beyond what I deserve according to my worth! How near art Thou to me and how compassionate art Thou toward me! How loving Thou art towards me, how vigilant over me, how generous to me, and how bountiful in my regard!

Subject: forgiveness; grace; bounty; mercy; compassion of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/forgiveness; grace; bounty; mercy; compassion of God.txt
Quotation: Grace is when someone has done no work and made no effort, yet receives kindness - for instance, when you give charity to a poor person who has done nothing to deserve it and performed no service for you. This is grace. For example, Christ asked forgiveness for His executioners - this is called grace.

Subject: forgiveness; grace; bounty; mercy; compassion of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/forgiveness; grace; bounty; mercy; compassion of God.txt
Quotation: He is the Compassionate, the All-Loving, the Forgiving, the Merciful! We have forgiven thy brother who hath ascended unto God, and We testify that he is among those who turned unto the Supreme Horizon and reached the ultimate goal. All this is of My grace unto thee, that thou mayest be of the thankful.

Subject: forgiveness; grace; bounty; mercy; compassion of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/forgiveness; grace; bounty; mercy; compassion of God.txt
Quotation: Glory and praise rest upon Thee, O Thou the Beauty of the All-Merciful, O Thou the Countenance of the All-Praised, O Thou the Most Bountiful, the Lord of Might, the Bestowing, the Lord of knowledge and understanding, He Who granteth tranquility to the believers and them who set their faces towards Him.

Subject: forgiveness; grace; bounty; mercy; compassion of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/forgiveness; grace; bounty; mercy; compassion of God.txt
Quotation: And unto God belongeth mercy in the kingdoms of the heavens and of the earth and of whatsoever lieth between them, and God was merciful, compassionate. And unto God belongeth gift-giving in the kingdoms of the heavens and of the earth and of whatsoever lieth between them, and God was a generous bestower.

Subject: forgiveness; grace; bounty; mercy; compassion of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/forgiveness; grace; bounty; mercy; compassion of God.txt
Quotation: O God! O All-Bountiful! O All-Merciful! These are my eyes before Thy face, beseeching from Thee that which befitteth Thy bounty...All created things testify to Thy munificence...and a company of sinners stand before the waves of the ocean of Thy forgiveness, yearning and supplicating for Thy boundless grace.

Subject: forgiveness; grace; bounty; mercy; compassion of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/forgiveness; grace; bounty; mercy; compassion of God.txt
Quotation: O Lord! Forgive their trespasses, conceal their faults, and cancel their transgressions. Enable them to return unto Thee and assemble them under the banner of Thy Covenant. Divest them of their tattered garments and attire them with the robe of holiness. Verily, thou art the All-Bounteous, the Most Merciful.

Subject: forgiveness; grace; bounty; mercy; compassion of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/forgiveness; grace; bounty; mercy; compassion of God.txt
Quotation: "the bestowals of the Blessed Beauty flow forth without any worthiness, and the favors of the Desired One encompass all without any capacity...O God! Deal with us through Thy grace, not through Thy justice. Verily Thou art the All-Bountiful, the Generous, the Bestower, the Giver, the Gracious, the Merciful."

Subject: forgiveness; grace; bounty; mercy; compassion of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/forgiveness; grace; bounty; mercy; compassion of God.txt
Quotation: We have forgiven them and ordained for them that which brings joy to the eyes of those near unto God. The grace of thy Lord hath encompassed them at this hour by His command, and He is the All-Bountiful, the Most Generous. We have pardoned those who are there as a token of Our bounty and mercy from Our presence.

Subject: forgiveness; grace; bounty; mercy; compassion of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/forgiveness; grace; bounty; mercy; compassion of God.txt
Quotation: Immerse her in the ocean of Your bounty and cleanse and sanctify her from the filth of sin. And likewise accept at the threshold of Your oneness Your distinguished maidservant Dolat, daughter of Khosrow, and grant her pardon and forgiveness. Similarly, gladden Firuz Khodadad and set him free through Your mercy.

Subject: forgiveness; grace; bounty; mercy; compassion of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/forgiveness; grace; bounty; mercy; compassion of God.txt
Quotation: We beseech God to give him to drink, at all times, from the Kawthar of life from His hand of bounty...We beseech God to send down upon him at all times a blessing from His presence and a bounty from His own Self...Mercy, loving-kindness, grace and bounty be upon you and upon every servant who hath believed in God

Subject: forgiveness; grace; bounty; mercy; compassion of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/forgiveness; grace; bounty; mercy; compassion of God.txt
Quotation: Unto God belongeth all mercy in the kingdom of the heavens and of the earth and of whatsoever lieth between them, and God was ever the Most Merciful. Unto God belongeth all command; He sendeth down the measures of His mercy upon whomsoever He willeth of His servants, and verily He is the Guardian over all things.

Subject: forgiveness; grace; bounty; mercy; compassion of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/forgiveness; grace; bounty; mercy; compassion of God.txt
Quotation: The pens of earth are powerless to describe divine forgiveness, and the tongues of the peoples of the world have been and will forever be unable to recount His all-encompassing grace. The breezes of forgiveness have wafted upon you from the paradise of the mercy of your Lord, the Most Merciful, the Compassionate.

Subject: forgiveness; grace; bounty; mercy; compassion of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/forgiveness; grace; bounty; mercy; compassion of God.txt
Quotation: He hath guided those who are nigh unto Him to His most exalted horizon and ordained for them that which the pens of creation are powerless to recount. The servant beareth witness that all grace lieth within His grasp - He bestoweth it upon whomsoever He willeth. He, verily, is the All-Bountiful, the Most Generous.

Subject: forgiveness; grace; bounty; mercy; compassion of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/forgiveness; grace; bounty; mercy; compassion of God.txt
Quotation: Do you realize that God's mercy has encompassed your condition without any request on your part? Eternal fortune has knocked at your door - open it and welcome it with the utmost joy and gladness. You know not what a bounty has been bestowed upon that household, which has caused the family to attain endless glory.

Subject: forgiveness; grace; bounty; mercy; compassion of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/forgiveness; grace; bounty; mercy; compassion of God.txt
Quotation: O Lord, O Forgiver, these are broken-winged birds - bestow upon them wings and feathers and enable them to soar in the heights of pardon and forgiveness. Lead these thirsty ones to the spring of favors and seat these needy ones at Thy bountiful table. Thou art the Bestower, the Giver, the Forgiver, and the Kind One

Subject: forgiveness; grace; bounty; mercy; compassion of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/forgiveness; grace; bounty; mercy; compassion of God.txt
Quotation: My God, my God! I have witnessed the waves of the ocean of Thy forgiveness and have hastened toward them with my grievous sins and mighty transgressions...O Lord! Look not upon my failings, but upon Thy bounty, and not upon the hosts of my disobedience, but upon the waves of the ocean of Thy pardon and forgiveness.

Subject: forgiveness; grace; bounty; mercy; compassion of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/forgiveness; grace; bounty; mercy; compassion of God.txt
Quotation: This cycle is the cycle of grace, not justice, and this century is the era of forgiveness, not measure and trial. The Blessed Beauty - may my spirit be a sacrifice for His loved ones - declares that the preceding mercy has encompassed all, and this encompassing means that it is agreeable and compatible in all degrees.

Subject: forgiveness; grace; bounty; mercy; compassion of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/forgiveness; grace; bounty; mercy; compassion of God.txt
Quotation: If ye fear your Lord, the All-Merciful, concerning what your hands have wrought through Satan's doing, then hasten to forgiveness from your Lord before the Day when ye shall find your deeds presented before you... that God may forgive you your sins. Verily God hath ever been All-Forgiving, All-Merciful to the believers.

Subject: forgiveness; grace; bounty; mercy; compassion of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/forgiveness; grace; bounty; mercy; compassion of God.txt
Quotation: Verily We make mention of Husayn who hath ascended unto God, and We beseech Him, exalted be He, to forgive him as a bounty from His presence - and He is the Forgiving, the Merciful... We beseech God to send down upon thee at all times a sign of forgiveness... And may God forgive those for whom thou didst seek forgiveness

Subject: forgiveness; grace; bounty; mercy; compassion of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/forgiveness; grace; bounty; mercy; compassion of God.txt
Quotation: O Lord! Thou knowest and seest that this servant desireth naught save the waves of the ocean of Thy mercy and the effulgences of the Day-Star of Thy Revelation. The cup of Thy bounty hath seized me, the Kawthar of Thy utterance hath attracted me, and Thy prevailing Will and all-encompassing Purpose move me as They please.

Subject: forgiveness; grace; bounty; mercy; compassion of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/forgiveness; grace; bounty; mercy; compassion of God.txt
Quotation: "He is verily the Compassionate, the Generous, the Munificent, the Merciful." "We beseech Him, exalted be He, to open before thy face, through the key of His Name, the All-Giving, the gates of His grace, mercy and bounty, and to rain down upon thee from the clouds of His generosity the showers of His blessings and riches."

Subject: forgiveness; grace; bounty; mercy; compassion of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/forgiveness; grace; bounty; mercy; compassion of God.txt
Quotation: Through the presence of thy letter before the Throne, God hath absolved thee of thy misdeeds and immersed thee in the ocean of forgiveness. Verily thy Lord is the Mighty, the Forgiving. He hath ordained for thee through His grace whatsoever He hath willed. Despair not of God's spirit and mercy, for He is the Mighty, the Loving.

Subject: forgiveness; grace; bounty; mercy; compassion of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/forgiveness; grace; bounty; mercy; compassion of God.txt
Quotation: God hath forgiven thee through His grace from His presence, and hath sent from the right hand of the divine good-pleasure the fragrances of forgiveness...Were all who are in the heavens and on earth to stand firm today in the love of thy Lord, God would assuredly forgive them in truth and clothe them in the garments of forgiveness

Subject: forgiveness; grace; bounty; mercy; compassion of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/forgiveness; grace; bounty; mercy; compassion of God.txt
Quotation: We have mentioned thee time and again, and have sent down for thee diverse tablets and dispatched them unto thee, that thou mayest inhale from them the fragrance of My loving-kindness and the sweet-scented breeze of My tender mercy and the musk-laden perfumes of My mercy which have preceded all who are in the heavens and the earth.

Subject: forgiveness; grace; bounty; mercy; compassion of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/forgiveness; grace; bounty; mercy; compassion of God.txt
Quotation: Unto God belongeth all mercy; He bestoweth it upon whomsoever He willeth of His servants. He, verily, is the Mighty, the All-Bountiful. Unto God belongeth the sublimity of the heavens and of the earth and of whatsoever is between them, and God was supremely exalted. Unto God belongeth all mercy, whereby ye show mercy one to another.

Subject: forgiveness; grace; bounty; mercy; compassion of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/forgiveness; grace; bounty; mercy; compassion of God.txt
Quotation: O Forgiver! O Glorious God! [...] O Merciful Lord! Grant every pure soul entry to Your divine threshold, make every destitute one precious in Your heavenly realm, immerse them in the sea of Your bounty and generosity, and permit them to behold Your radiant countenance. You are the Giver, the Bestower, the Forgiver, and the Kind One.

Subject: forgiveness; grace; bounty; mercy; compassion of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/forgiveness; grace; bounty; mercy; compassion of God.txt
Quotation: My hope is that divine grace may take hold of thee and His loving-kindness encompass thee... Today the waves of the ocean of mercy are manifest and visible before all faces. Verily He preserveth whoso turneth unto Him, and aideth him with His hosts, and assisteth him through His grace. He, verily, is the All-Bountiful, the Generous.

Subject: forgiveness; grace; bounty; mercy; compassion of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/forgiveness; grace; bounty; mercy; compassion of God.txt
Quotation: I beseech Thee, O my God, to shower Thy blessings upon Muhammad and the family of Muhammad in the Kingdom of Command and the Realm of Creation, through Thy grace and mercy... Verily, I am one who clingeth to the hem of Thy pardon and bounty, who standeth between Thy Will and Purpose, and who waiteth at the gate of Thy leave and favor.

Subject: forgiveness; grace; bounty; mercy; compassion of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/forgiveness; grace; bounty; mercy; compassion of God.txt
Quotation: O Lord! Forgive them through Thy grace, generosity and pardon, and have mercy upon them through Thy kindness and bounty, in honor of his faith in Thy Beauty, his certitude in Thy verses, his enkindlement with the fire of Thy love, and his utterance of Thy praise. Verily, Thou art the Generous, the Merciful, the Pardoning, the Forgiving.

Subject: forgiveness; grace; bounty; mercy; compassion of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/forgiveness; grace; bounty; mercy; compassion of God.txt
Quotation: O God! ... Ordain for Thy servants that which will draw them nigh unto the shore of the ocean of Thy bounty... Have mercy, O Most Merciful One of the heavens and earth, and forgive, O All-Forgiving One... Thou seest the sinner seeking after the waves of the ocean of Thy forgiveness and the effulgences of the lights of the Sun of Thy pardon.

Subject: forgiveness; grace; bounty; mercy; compassion of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/forgiveness; grace; bounty; mercy; compassion of God.txt
Quotation: To God belongeth the bounty of the heavens and the earth and whatsoever is between them. God bestoweth His bounty upon whomsoever He willeth through His command. Verily He is possessed of great favor. To God belong all the circles of mercy which God sendeth down upon whomsoever He willeth of His servants. Verily He is the Near, the Bountiful.

Subject: forgiveness; grace; bounty; mercy; compassion of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/forgiveness; grace; bounty; mercy; compassion of God.txt
Quotation: The Sun of generosity has risen from the horizon of the world. His mercy has preceded the world and His grace has encompassed all beings. Reflect on the mercy and compassion of this Revelation. By thy life! Mercy itself is ashamed to be attributed to Him, and all discerning souls prostrate before His mercy which they are powerless to comprehend.

Subject: forgiveness; grace; bounty; mercy; compassion of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/forgiveness; grace; bounty; mercy; compassion of God.txt
Quotation: Each day, like unto the leaves and fruits of trees, fresh injuries were inflicted by the wicked ones, yet His supreme benevolence and infinite mercy were not arrested by the unseemly deeds, words and actions of the ungodly. His forbearance and patience have ever taken precedence, even as His all-encompassing mercy hath precedence over all His names.

Subject: forgiveness; grace; bounty; mercy; compassion of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/forgiveness; grace; bounty; mercy; compassion of God.txt
Quotation: By My life! Were all created things to raise their hands today in pure supplication toward the court of hope of the King of Names, and were they to beseech Him for the treasures of the heavens and earth, He would bestow upon them through His all-encompassing grace ere their hands returned unto them. Thus hath His mercy ever encompassed all the worlds.

Subject: forgiveness; grace; bounty; mercy; compassion of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/forgiveness; grace; bounty; mercy; compassion of God.txt
Quotation: Among the special favors of the Greatest Name - may my spirit be sacrificed for His loved ones - in this mighty Dispensation is that the son may seek forgiveness for the father, and descendants may intercede for their ancestors. Therefore, this servant beseeches at the threshold of the Lord that your father and mother may be immersed in the ocean of forgiveness.

Subject: forgiveness; grace; bounty; mercy; compassion of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/forgiveness; grace; bounty; mercy; compassion of God.txt
Quotation: Verily, Thou art the Great Giver, the Bounteous, the Generous, the Compassionate. I beseech Thee, moreover, by Thy mercy that hath embraced the entire creation, through which Thou didst vivify the realities of all created things...Verily, Thou bestowest goodly descendants unto whomsoever Thou willest through Thy grace and Bounty. Verily, Thou art the Most Generous.

Subject: forgiveness; grace; bounty; mercy; compassion of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/forgiveness; grace; bounty; mercy; compassion of God.txt
Quotation: You have sent down from the heaven of Your mercy the water of Your pardon, forgiveness and clemency, and through this pure, purifying, outpoured water You have cleansed the filth of rebellion, the stain of transgression, the contamination of sins and the dirt of faults...Verily You are the Ever-Relenting, the Merciful, the Generous, the Pardoning, the All-Forgiving

Subject: forgiveness; grace; bounty; mercy; compassion of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/forgiveness; grace; bounty; mercy; compassion of God.txt
Quotation: My Lord, my Lord! Thy mercy hath preceded all things, Thy bounty hath been perfected, and Thy gift hath been completed for those who have acknowledged Thy oneness, who have drawn from the ocean of Thy grace, and who have been illumined by the fire of Thy love... Verily, Thou art kind to Thy poor servants, and verily, Thou art the All-Merciful, the All-Compassionate.

Subject: forgiveness; grace; bounty; mercy; compassion of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/forgiveness; grace; bounty; mercy; compassion of God.txt
Quotation: By God, the Most Bountiful, the Most Bountiful! Through the bounty of God, the Most Bountiful, the Most Bountiful! Say: God is more bountiful than any possessor of bounty. None can withhold the flowing bounty of His bountiful grace, whether in the heavens or on the earth or in what lieth between them. Verily, He is the Ever-Bountiful, the All-Bounteous, the Most Generous.

Subject: forgiveness; grace; bounty; mercy; compassion of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/forgiveness; grace; bounty; mercy; compassion of God.txt
Quotation: After being presented before the Most Holy and Exalted Presence, the ocean of forgiveness surged, and each received that which hath no peer or likeness. The honored Darvish 'Ali-Akbar hath ever been mentioned in the Most Holy Court, and God's favor hath encompassed and continueth to encompass him. In brief, each one hath received a full portion from the ocean of divine mercy.

Subject: forgiveness; grace; bounty; mercy; compassion of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/forgiveness; grace; bounty; mercy; compassion of God.txt
Quotation: Make these blossoms fresh through the outpourings of the clouds of Thy grace, and these flowers resplendent through the warmth of the Sun of Thy mercy... Immerse them in the ocean of forgiveness and pardon, and grant them a blessed dwelling in the mansion of benevolence. Verily, Thou art the Mighty, the Ever-Forgiving, and verily, Thou art the All-Merciful, the Compassionate.

Subject: forgiveness; grace; bounty; mercy; compassion of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/forgiveness; grace; bounty; mercy; compassion of God.txt
Quotation: And whosoever places his trust in God, verily He shall suffice him, for God is the Protector of the faithful. And whosoever places his trust in God, his Lord, He will surely aid him and guard him from before him and behind him, from his right and his left, from above his head and beneath his feet, and from every direction that leads to him, howsoever He pleaseth through His command.

Subject: forgiveness; grace; bounty; mercy; compassion of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/forgiveness; grace; bounty; mercy; compassion of God.txt
Quotation: God testifieth that there is none other God but Him. Within His grasp is the dominion of grace in the heavens and the earth and whatsoever is between them, and God is possessed of mighty grace. God testifieth that there is none other God but Him. Within His grasp is the dominion of bounty in the heavens and the earth and whatsoever is between them, and God is possessed of mighty bounty.

Subject: forgiveness; grace; bounty; mercy; compassion of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/forgiveness; grace; bounty; mercy; compassion of God.txt
Quotation: And if thou shouldst write a letter to Him Whom God shall make manifest, and cause the sincere servants of God to deliver it unto Him, and seek forgiveness of God, thy Lord, therein, and then be of the steadfast ones - perchance God will transform thy fire into light and forgive thee what thou didst commit in the Furqan. He is verily the All-Forgiving, the Most Generous, the Most Merciful.

Subject: forgiveness; grace; bounty; mercy; compassion of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/forgiveness; grace; bounty; mercy; compassion of God.txt
Quotation: They who seek forgiveness of God and then repent - upon these doth God bestow His mercy and He will spread over them the blessings of Paradise through His grace; verily He is the Lord of exceeding bounty. They who, when affliction befalleth them, grieve in God's path and say We are all God's and unto Him do we return - upon these are forgiveness and mercy from God, and these are the triumphant.

Subject: forgiveness; grace; bounty; mercy; compassion of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/forgiveness; grace; bounty; mercy; compassion of God.txt
Quotation: That which is incumbent upon the people of God today are those virtues and deeds which have been recorded and inscribed in most of the Tablets, and that which is incumbent upon God is grace, loving-kindness, compassion and generosity. I swear by the Sun of the horizon of utterance that We have ordained for each soul that which shall bring joy unto them, and I am the All-Informed, the All-Knowing.

Subject: forgiveness; grace; bounty; mercy; compassion of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/forgiveness; grace; bounty; mercy; compassion of God.txt

He does not deprive His servants, no matter how disobedient and rebellious.

Verily thy Lord is the Mighty, the All-Forgiving, and He is the Ever-Turning, the All-Compelling, the All-Choosing. By God, God hath forgiven thee and purified thee by His binding command among the nations. Today thou art before God among those who have no sin.

I am the one, O my God, who lay fast asleep on his couch, when lo, the messengers of Thy manifold mercies were sent down upon me by Thee, and the gentle winds of Thy loving-kindness blew over me, and roused me up, and caused me to set my face towards the sanctuary of Thy knowledge, and to fix mine eyes upon the splendors of the light of Thy face.

I beseech Thee by Thy loving-kindness, through which the ocean of forgiveness surged in the contingent world and the fragrance of Thy generosity was wafted amidst all religions, to forgive those who have turned unto Thee and have quaffed the wine of faith from the cups of Thy bounty and the Salsabil of utterance from the spring of Thy grace and favors.

Subject: forgiveness; grace; bounty; mercy; compassion of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/forgiveness; grace; bounty; mercy; compassion of God.txt

He, verily, is the All-Bountiful One Who loveth His servants and creation, and remindeth them at all times of His signs, and sendeth down mercy upon them from the heaven of His bounty.

Subject: forgiveness; grace; bounty; mercy; compassion of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/forgiveness; grace; bounty; mercy; compassion of God.txt
Quotation: O my God, I know naught save what I have read in his letter and discovered of the secrets contained therein, and recognized from the hidden things of his heart...For Thou, O my God, knowest better than I whether in his heart there was love for Thy beauty and passion for Thy Being and yearning for Thine Essence. Therefore forgive him, then have mercy upon him, then conceal his sins and errors from first to last, then pardon him and turn unto him in forgiveness

Subject: forgiveness; grace; bounty; mercy; compassion of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/forgiveness; grace; bounty; mercy; compassion of God.txt
Quotation: O Forgiving Lord! Thou art kind, Thou art the Lord of supreme forgiveness. We are all full of shortcomings, but Thou art the Forgiving Lord. We are sinners, Thou art the Forgiver. Grant forgiveness to every sinning servant, and give these helpless ones a refuge and shelter. Free the captive in the chains of wrongdoing, and give the poor wanderer a shelter at Thy sacred threshold. Thy sea of forgiveness is boundless and Thy sun of bounty is radiant and shining.

Send down upon them the tokens of Thy grace and grant them, wherever they reside, a liberal share of that which Thou hast ordained for the pious among Thy servants. Faith, certitude, recognition and assurance are related to grace, and the mysteries of "This is the grace of God; He bestoweth it upon whomsoever He willeth, and God is the Lord of great bounty." What capacity or deservedness did these servants possess? The Ancient Beauty accepted us at His divine threshold purely through grace and enabled us to attain to servitude at His court.

Subject: forgiveness; grace; bounty; mercy; compassion of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/forgiveness; grace; bounty; mercy; compassion of God.txt

Subject: four elements
Quotation: "Then multiply the ten letters from the first to the fourth and from the third to the second.  Then deduct seven and evaluate by seven. Afterward you will observe from the twenty-nine [lunar] mansions (manazil), commensurate with the science ('ilm) of their astrological houses (al-nujum), according to the letter of Fire, the valuation of Fire; and Air, the valuation of Air; and Water, the valuation of Water; and Earth, the valuation of Earth."

Subject: four elements
Quotation: As regards what was asked concerning the mixture of the four elements, it is known to thee that the combination of separated, external, and opposing elements is not possible. Indeed, the masters of the craft consider four elements necessary in their work, for they regard all things as subsisting through the four elements. In truth, all four are necessary to earth, for it is the seat of manifestation... The four elements - namely fire, air, water and earth - after combination and coalescence manifest two qualities each: in fire there is heat and dryness, in air moisture and heat, in water cold and moisture, and in earth dryness and cold.

Subject: four elements
Quotation: The earlier philosophers believed in four elements and said the element of fire was above the ethereal sphere. But now they say none of these elements exist in pure form but are compounds, and the ethereal sphere is imperceptible and surrounds creation.

Subject: four methods of acquiring knowledge
Quotation: Man has four standards to which he refers in the ascertainment of truth-the report of the senses, the verdict of reason, tradition or testimony, and inspiration.... Our conclusion must, therefore, be that none of these standards for the determination of truth is worthy of implicit confidence; and man has no other means for reaching a true understanding. Yet if the conclusion declared by all four of these standards be the same, it is worthy of confidence. Then we may be assured that the common report is correct. Otherwise we cannot be sure. The rule, then, which we should adopt in our investigations, is this: In determining every question we should refer it to these four standards, and a conclusion which is supported by the verdict of all we should accept; any other we should regard as uncertain. Yet there is another standard which is the peculiar possession of the Chosen of God. This standard is the breathings of the Holy Spirit. By that power assurance is produced, man becomes certain, and the consciousness is satisfied.

Subject: four methods of acquiring knowledge
Quotation: Therefore, know that all the peoples and kindreds possess four balances with which they weigh the truths, the significances, and the divine questions. All of them are imperfect, unable to quench the burning thirst or heal the sick. We shall therefore make mention of each one and demonstrate its limitation and inaccuracy.... As for the true, divine balance which never strayeth, and which ever comprehendeth the universal realities and the sublime inner meanings, it is the balance of the inmost heart [mizanu'l-fu'ad], of which God hath made mention in the blessed verse.

Subject: four pillars
Quotation: Verily religion is established upon four pillars: unity, prophethood, divine authority, and the followers--four gates, the first of which cannot be sound without the last.

Subject: four pillars
Quotation: Praise be to God Who created the Point and appointed for it four pillars, and brought forth from the first pillar an Alif which spoke of its own self and circled round it, being the mirror reflecting it in the station of Oneness, wherein the unitarians profess His unity, the sincere ones glorify Him, and those nigh unto God proclaim that He is God, there is none other God but Him, the All-Knowing, the One. And from its second pillar He manifested that same Form in another station, and shed upon it the lights shining forth from His Most Great Horizon, whereupon it called out, turned towards Him, arose in the station of multiplicity, and proclaimed that verily there is none other God but Him, the Mighty, the Bestower. Thus did all things appear and all names become distinct. And from its third pillar He brought forth another Alif and made it the Dawning-Place of His most exalted attributes, and it proclaimed that verily there is none other God but Him, the Mighty, the All-Knowing. And from its fourth pillar He manifested that which reflected the first, third and second pillars, and it proclaimed in this station that He is the First and the Last, the Manifest and the Hidden, there is none other God but Him, the Mighty, the Peerless.

Subject: four; five pathways of love
Quotation: Q: "What is Love in the commandment of the Christ "that ye love one another?"  A: "There are different kinds of degrees of love: First, from God to God; the Spiritual flow from God to the Manifestations. This is the bounty of the Holy spirit, perfect in its effulgence and Expression as the light of the sun in a mirror. Second, from God to the creatures. This is called Eternal life: that which the disciples received in their heavenly blessings, divine guidance and abundant power. Third, from the creatures to God. The outcome of this is Faith, Assurance, and turning to God in spiritual recognition and relationship. Fourth, from the people of God to the people of God. For instance, we witness such devotion among believers that they will sacrifice life for each other. Through this love is the accomplishment of Unity among them. By this love all believers become as one. This is the Divine Spirit of Love which gives Life to the world, illumines the temples of existence, restores sight to the blind, causes the deaf to hear, makes the dump speak, and transforms enemies into friends. Fifth, from man to himself. If this is simply selfishness it is as disastrous to the soul, but if it be spiritual and conscious devotion to self it becomes a spur upward and onward. Mere selfish love is like a man whirling round and round until he becomes dizzy and falls. The true love of self is that which leads forward and upward in a direct course toward higher life and being."

Quotation: For every matter there is an appointed time with thy Lord - none can hasten it, nor can any soul delay it. Thus hath the matter been ordained according to measure and proportion.

Subject: free will and predestination; fate
Quotation: If ye will what God loves, then ye will through His will, and if ye will what God loves not, then ye stand through His will.

Subject: free will and predestination; fate
Quotation: Real faithfulness is that kind which is volitional... This free-will in man which God has created in man's being is the cause of adornment.

Subject: free will and predestination; fate
Quotation: It seems you have gained knowledge of the comprehensive words and the perfect word as they truly are. Well done to you, again well done to you! Yea, the manifestations of action in the world of existence appear through divine destiny and arrangement, but destiny and arrangement do not become the cause of deficiency such that an argument would arise or a flaw would find its way. If you become aware of this subtle point, you will gain knowledge of all the stations of the worlds of destiny, of which the world of compulsion and free will is but a letter. Rules and customs are of the characteristics of the world of creation, while the world of command is sanctified and exalted above all such limitations. Therefore one must lift one's foot from the realm of nothingness and step into the realm of eternity, so that we may raise the banner of being in the heaven of non-being and comprehend the meaning of "All things perish save His face," and pass beyond the earthly homeland to return to the original divine homeland, of which "Verily we are God's and to Him we return" is indicative of this theme.

Subject: free will and predestination; fate
Quotation: God has not charged any soul beyond its capacity and strength. God has guaranteed the sustenance of His servants, and each shall receive what is destined.

Subject: free will and predestination; fate
Quotation: Neither compulsion nor complete free will, neither constraint nor dominion. "The truth lies between the two extremes" means that existence is bestowed by God but the performance of deeds comes from creation... This is the meaning of "between the two extremes."

Subject: free will and predestination; fate
Quotation: Accident means or signifies meaninglessness. If you, my son, do not seek for any meaning in the order of the world, in personal life, then you will not wonder about meaningless happenings! You will not rub yourself sore on difficult questions. The meaninglessness which appears to you in natural law, the inner and outer difficulties of the creature, will not trouble you, the word accident (the concept of meaninglessness) will help you to overcome the most difficult questions by burying them. - But if there is meaning behind all that happens, beyond cause and effect, then, so teaches us logic, there must be a meaningful Cause behind it all! There you have, O my son, caught the Godhead in the net of your logic! 'I shall not let go of You, unless You enlighten me!'...  My son, here on the mountain of all Religions (the Carmel is equally holy to the Jews, Christians, Muslims, Persians, Baha'is), engrave it on your hands, tattoo it on your heart: 1. Accident is meaninglessness - 2. I, the creature with sense and spirit, originate from the Source of all meaning, all spirit. -3. I can, I will, I must therefore reject accident, meaninglessness in all that happens. 4. I therefore surrender unconditionally, in life and death, to my Maker, the All-Meaningful, the Almighty and All-Wise. - 5. He does with me what He wills. He is the hidden God, on Whom I cast myself in all sorrow, in all fear. His Will will let me bear only what His benevolence has decreed and can justify.   The Blessed Perfection Baha'u'llah tells you about this in the Hidden Words (Arabic): 'Earthly calamity is My providence, My will, thy fate decreed by Me, in outward appearance it is purification, fire and punishment, in truth it is light and mercy, guidance and rescue.' Why wilt thou flee from divine purification and guidance decreed for thee, as if it were meaninglessness (accident), aimlessness and purposelessness? Draw near to sorrow, accept suffering, embrace misery, so that thou mayest triumph as an eternal lamp and an immortal spirit. This is My command. Understand it, observe it!'

Subject: free will and predestination; fate
Quotation: The love shown by animals is instinctive and not dependent upon their own will--that is, they are endowed with their qualities and use them in a natural way, but not by their own will. Man is the only creature who can receive reward, because he has the power of choice--whether he will show forth love or withhold it.

Subject: free will and predestination; fate
Quotation: As to what thou hast asked concerning human nature, know thou that all men have been created according to the nature of God, the Supreme, the Self-Subsisting. He hath ordained for every soul the measures of His decree as inscribed in the preserved tablets of glory. Yet all this manifesteth through your own volition, even as ye witness in your own deeds.
