Subject: greatness and influence of the Cause; of this Day
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/greatness and influence of the Cause; of this Day.txt
Quotation: Had it not been for His aid and assistance, would these people sitting on your right and left have any concern about you and me? Compare the position of Persia with that of America.

Subject: greatness and influence of the Cause; of this Day
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/greatness and influence of the Cause; of this Day.txt
Quotation: Behold the world all in slumber / Behold the Cycle of Baha'u'llah / Behold the symbol of the Book of God / Behold the secret of God's utterance / Behold the explanation of God's Word

Subject: greatness and influence of the Cause; of this Day
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/greatness and influence of the Cause; of this Day.txt
Quotation: O Hakim! By the life of God, verily this Day is great and this Cause is great. Today all things are adorned with a new ornament, and the Promised City hath descended from the new heaven

Subject: greatness and influence of the Cause; of this Day
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/greatness and influence of the Cause; of this Day.txt
Quotation: Thank ye God that ye are living in the age of Baha'u'llah and you have recognized him in his own day. Your station is very high, otherwise later on many people shall embrace this truth.

Subject: greatness and influence of the Cause; of this Day
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/greatness and influence of the Cause; of this Day.txt
Quotation: This station is so great that, by the truth, none upon earth can be compared with it...This day belongeth unto God, for in previous Books it was mentioned and recorded as the Day of God.

Subject: greatness and influence of the Cause; of this Day
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/greatness and influence of the Cause; of this Day.txt
Quotation: I conveyed the Word of God to East and West, until now when all necks are bowed in submission, even important people in different centers - though they are not Baha'is, they are submissive.

Subject: greatness and influence of the Cause; of this Day
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/greatness and influence of the Cause; of this Day.txt
Quotation: Great is the Cause and great is the Day! By the life of God! All divine Books and Scriptures bear witness to the greatness of this Cause and to the excellence and nobility of these companions.

Subject: greatness and influence of the Cause; of this Day
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/greatness and influence of the Cause; of this Day.txt
Quotation: This is a Day wherein eyes are transfixed and hearts are constricted. This is a Day wherein the earth hath related its tidings and the Tongue of Grandeur hath spoken from the most exalted station

Subject: greatness and influence of the Cause; of this Day
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/greatness and influence of the Cause; of this Day.txt
Quotation: In these days the region of the Caucasus hath shown complete readiness. An effort must be made to establish that it is [?] and the Glorious Qur'an. It is the nest of the Divine Phoenix of the East.

Subject: greatness and influence of the Cause; of this Day
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/greatness and influence of the Cause; of this Day.txt
Quotation: The fragrances of the garment of revelation of the Ancient King are diffusing throughout the realm of being, and the lights of His countenance are shining and manifest from the horizon of creation.

Subject: greatness and influence of the Cause; of this Day
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/greatness and influence of the Cause; of this Day.txt
Quotation: Today the hosts of the Supreme Concourse are rendering victorious the princes of the Kingdom, and verily Our hosts shall be the conquerors - this is certain and will soon become evident and manifest.

Subject: greatness and influence of the Cause; of this Day
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/greatness and influence of the Cause; of this Day.txt
Quotation: Were someone to appear every day, the Cause of God would not be established in the cities and lands. This is a Manifestation that revealeth Himself but once in every five hundred thousand years.

Subject: greatness and influence of the Cause; of this Day
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/greatness and influence of the Cause; of this Day.txt
Quotation: The whole world was gladdened by the mention of this wondrous Day and longed for its appearance, beseeching in the nights and days that they might not be deprived of attaining the presence of this Day.

Subject: greatness and influence of the Cause; of this Day
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/greatness and influence of the Cause; of this Day.txt
Quotation: We have created all servants and handmaidens specifically for this Day, for the Purpose of all worlds is now manifest, established upon the throne of grandeur...The Cause is mighty and the Purpose mighty

Subject: greatness and influence of the Cause; of this Day
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/greatness and influence of the Cause; of this Day.txt
Quotation: But now Baha'o'llah has come with incomparable glory like the glow of the sun at midday, the moment of its greatest heat and light. The glory of God has proclaimed a cause that until now none had heard.

Subject: greatness and influence of the Cause; of this Day
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/greatness and influence of the Cause; of this Day.txt
Quotation: Those regions and environs shall so prosper as to become the envy of every other land. The whole world shall circle round them, and they shall become the first and foremost among the regions of the world.

Subject: greatness and influence of the Cause; of this Day
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/greatness and influence of the Cause; of this Day.txt
Quotation: Praise be to this Faith that revealed every hidden gem in the mine of Iran. The treasure that that Leader stored up was revealed on this auspicious day and its precious pearls were scattered over the world.

Subject: greatness and influence of the Cause; of this Day
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/greatness and influence of the Cause; of this Day.txt
Quotation: Each hour of it equals a thousand hours, each day of it equals a thousand days...matters that would take fifty thousand years to occur or be achieved will be manifested in one day in the Day of Manifestation.

Subject: greatness and influence of the Cause; of this Day
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/greatness and influence of the Cause; of this Day.txt
Quotation: All the peoples and religions were promised this Most Great Day, which in the divine Books is known as the Day of God. Blessed is the soul that hath recognized the station of this Day and acted as beseemeth it.

Subject: greatness and influence of the Cause; of this Day
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/greatness and influence of the Cause; of this Day.txt
Quotation: This is a Day the like of which all times, hours, days, nights and centuries bow down in humility, nay prostrate themselves before a single moment thereof. Strive that you may attain to that which is befitting.

Subject: greatness and influence of the Cause; of this Day
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/greatness and influence of the Cause; of this Day.txt
Quotation: In this merciful cycle, this most great dispensation, thou must strive to receive a plenteous share of the divine bestowals...This is the day of the most great bounty and the dawning of the most effulgent light.

Subject: greatness and influence of the Cause; of this Day
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/greatness and influence of the Cause; of this Day.txt
Quotation: The Divine Day which was mentioned in the books, scriptures, psalms and tablets, and which was promised by the Supreme Pen, hath appeared with utmost brilliance, yet none hath recognized it save whom God hath willed.

Subject: greatness and influence of the Cause; of this Day
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/greatness and influence of the Cause; of this Day.txt
Quotation: This is the Day which in all the divine Books, Scriptures and Psalms hath truly been attributed to God and is known as the Day of God... Great and wondrous is this Day... O 'Ata! Say: This Day hath no peer or likeness.

Subject: greatness and influence of the Cause; of this Day
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/greatness and influence of the Cause; of this Day.txt
Quotation: Today the world is illumined by the lights of Him Who conversed with God on Sinai, and the Divine Call is raised. Blessed is the eye that hath beheld it and blessed is the ear that hath heard it. These days are God's days.

Subject: greatness and influence of the Cause; of this Day
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/greatness and influence of the Cause; of this Day.txt
Quotation: These signs become more evident and manifest day by day, and these lights shine forth more and more with each passing day, and this musk-laden fragrance spreads its ambergris perfume moment by moment throughout all regions.

Subject: greatness and influence of the Cause; of this Day
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/greatness and influence of the Cause; of this Day.txt
Quotation: Ere long thou shalt witness how the heavenly grace and bounty hath become manifest and evident, and how the fame of the greatness of the Ancient Beauty hath conquered the world and caused a trembling throughout all regions.

Subject: greatness and influence of the Cause; of this Day
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/greatness and influence of the Cause; of this Day.txt
Quotation: Today the Sun of Manifestation is shining and the light of His countenance is radiant. You heard the Call of the Friend and were enabled to respond, in days when the limbs of the mighty trembled from the power of those times.

Subject: greatness and influence of the Cause; of this Day
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/greatness and influence of the Cause; of this Day.txt
Quotation: To this station kings are subjects, and monarchs are helpless vassals. The grace of the Most Great Name hath placed upon the heads of the faithful friends a precious crown whose brilliant gems will illumine centuries and ages.

Subject: greatness and influence of the Cause; of this Day
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/greatness and influence of the Cause; of this Day.txt
Quotation: Consider what hath been manifested and search with their own intellect and understanding, lest they be deprived of the effulgent rays of the Sun of Truth. The Truth hath ever been and shall forever remain distinct from aught else.

Subject: greatness and influence of the Cause; of this Day
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/greatness and influence of the Cause; of this Day.txt
Quotation: Indeed, this is among the special characteristics of this Most Great Cycle and this promised Day, which hath lifted its veil and revealed its countenance, whereby the Kingdom of existence, both seen and unseen, hath been illumined.

Subject: greatness and influence of the Cause; of this Day
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/greatness and influence of the Cause; of this Day.txt
Quotation: Perchance through this means the ignorant people may come to know how firm and strong are the foundations of this Great News, which is the spirit of life to the body of the world and the brilliant lamp in the niche of contingent being.

Subject: greatness and influence of the Cause; of this Day
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/greatness and influence of the Cause; of this Day.txt
Quotation: The Baha'is in both East and West have raised high their standard. Today in the five continents of the world, the cry of Ya Baha'ul-Abha and the call of Ya Ali'ul-A'la are raised. They are triumphant, victorious, confirmed, and renowned.

Subject: greatness and influence of the Cause; of this Day
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/greatness and influence of the Cause; of this Day.txt
Quotation: Today every good deed is more exalted and more excellent and more beauteous than all the deeds of the world. By My life! The traces of every soul that ariseth today shall remain on earth as long as the divine names and attributes endure.

Subject: greatness and influence of the Cause; of this Day
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/greatness and influence of the Cause; of this Day.txt
Quotation: The pillars of polytheism have been shaken by the effulgence of the lights of divine unity, and the hosts of error have been scattered by the onslaught of the armies of guidance, which have raised high the standards of divine confirmation.

Subject: greatness and influence of the Cause; of this Day
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/greatness and influence of the Cause; of this Day.txt
Quotation: Now that in this mighty Cycle the Sun of Reality has risen at the most noble point of the vernal equinox and illumined the horizons, it will bring about such a resurrection and commotion...that the earth will become the Most Glorious Paradise

Subject: greatness and influence of the Cause; of this Day
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/greatness and influence of the Cause; of this Day.txt
Quotation: Great is this day and the manifestation of favor from the horizon of the heaven of supreme grace is most glorious...By My life and by God's Cause! The treasures of the world and whatsoever is with the kings and rulers cannot equal this Tablet.

Subject: greatness and influence of the Cause; of this Day
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/greatness and influence of the Cause; of this Day.txt
Quotation: Today the veil has been lifted, and the exalted Truth, without any concealment or barrier, is calling out and summoning all to the highest horizon...The Lord of Days hath appeared and the Master of mankind speaketh with the most exalted utterance.

Subject: greatness and influence of the Cause; of this Day
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/greatness and influence of the Cause; of this Day.txt
Quotation: O divine friends! The cycle is great and the radiance intense. The age of the Glorious Lord is in motion and all existence is in ecstasy and joy. The realities of beings are in passionate longing, and the atoms of existence in delight and gladness.

Subject: greatness and influence of the Cause; of this Day
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/greatness and influence of the Cause; of this Day.txt
Quotation: A single moment thereof cannot be compared with centuries and ages. A particle in this Day is beheld as the sun, and a drop thereof as an ocean. Were the excellences of this Day to be mentioned, all would fall unconscious save whom thy Lord willeth.

Subject: greatness and influence of the Cause; of this Day
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/greatness and influence of the Cause; of this Day.txt
Quotation: O people! The Doors of the Kingdom are opened--the Sun of Truth is shining upon the world--the Fountains of Life are flowing--the Day-springs of Mercy have appeared--the Greatest and most Glorious Light is now manifest to illuminate the hearts of men

Subject: greatness and influence of the Cause; of this Day
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/greatness and influence of the Cause; of this Day.txt
Quotation: The greatness of the Cause and importance of the teachings of Baha'u'llah is accepted by all people of understanding. Today the outpourings of the Abha Kingdom are like an endless ocean - only attention is necessary and some capacity and arising is required.

Subject: greatness and influence of the Cause; of this Day
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/greatness and influence of the Cause; of this Day.txt
Quotation: This day is the Lord of days and the King of all days. One breath drawn today for the sake of God is equal to the goodly deeds of numbered years. This supreme blessing is specially ordained for this Day. Know ye its value and count it as a precious treasure.

Subject: greatness and influence of the Cause; of this Day
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/greatness and influence of the Cause; of this Day.txt
Quotation: From the beginning of this Revelation, when the ocean of bounty surged, We removed the word "never" and appeared without veil or covering. This is the Day wherein man can attain unto everlasting stations, eternal bounties, heavenly sustenance, and endless favors.

Subject: greatness and influence of the Cause; of this Day
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/greatness and influence of the Cause; of this Day.txt
Quotation: As for thy reaching a house that was larger and more magnificent than the palace, and each of its chambers appeared as grand as the palace - these details testify to the greatness of the Cause, the expansion of the Revelation, and the extensiveness of its holy hem.

Subject: greatness and influence of the Cause; of this Day
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/greatness and influence of the Cause; of this Day.txt
Quotation: The Cycle of the Blessed Perfection will last for a long time. The next manifestation will not be so great as this One. When He appears, He will not be an independent One. Baha'u'llah is the consummation of all degrees. He is the Revelation of all Truth and Light.

Subject: greatness and influence of the Cause; of this Day
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/greatness and influence of the Cause; of this Day.txt
Quotation: But now I see this banner is bringing down our banner, cutting our roots, obliterating and destroying us. Therefore, before this banner overthrows our banner, it is better that we gather under it. We killed them and imprisoned them severely, yet day by day they increase.

Subject: greatness and influence of the Cause; of this Day
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/greatness and influence of the Cause; of this Day.txt
Quotation: O Land of Ta! By God, thou hast attained to that which most of the world's lands have not attained. God hath made thee the dawning-place of His signs and the manifestation of His names. This is a blessed and mighty day, to whose greatness the divine Books have testified.

Subject: greatness and influence of the Cause; of this Day
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/greatness and influence of the Cause; of this Day.txt
Quotation: It is as though every atom of earthly dust danceth from its fragrances, moveth in its atmosphere, and seeketh to attain the presence of its countenance. In the midst of abasement, it manifesteth such glory that the might of all in the heavens and earth is as naught before it.

Subject: greatness and influence of the Cause; of this Day
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/greatness and influence of the Cause; of this Day.txt
Quotation: In no age or century hath there appeared the like of this Revelation. For this reason hath this blessed Day been specifically distinguished and become known as the Day of God, although the days of the appearance of each Manifestation are, in their own station, the Day of God.

Subject: greatness and influence of the Cause; of this Day
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/greatness and influence of the Cause; of this Day.txt
Quotation: This century has superiority and distinction over all other centuries in all respects... the achievements of this century exceed the glories of fifty centuries. This century is like the sun while other centuries are like stars; this age is like an ocean while other ages are like rivers.

Subject: greatness and influence of the Cause; of this Day
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/greatness and influence of the Cause; of this Day.txt
Quotation: This is the mighty Cause whereby hearts have been perturbed, feet have slipped, eyes have been startled, limbs have trembled, pillars have been shaken, and faces have been transformed, and every mighty structure hath been stirred save such as God, the Lord of this manifest Day, hath willed.

Subject: greatness and influence of the Cause; of this Day
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/greatness and influence of the Cause; of this Day.txt
Quotation: Baha'o'llah in appearing has brought the force to rend the veils. He has spread the teachings which are the soul of our time, opened the doors to the seekers of the great law, breathed into the hearts a great love, united those who were at enmity and given victory to saints and pure spirits.

Subject: greatness and influence of the Cause; of this Day
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/greatness and influence of the Cause; of this Day.txt
Quotation: They who are on earth have gathered around the putrid carcasses of passion and desire, and are deprived of the descended feast from the heaven of the bounty of God, exalted be His glory. Soon shall they behold the recompense of their deeds and actions in this Most Great, this ordained Cause.

Subject: greatness and influence of the Cause; of this Day
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/greatness and influence of the Cause; of this Day.txt
Quotation: Great is this Day! Blessed is he who hath recognized it, and woe unto him who hath been heedless. The rays of the Sun of grace from the horizon of the bounty of God, exalted be His glory, have shone forth in such wise that the minds and understanding of the peoples of earth cannot comprehend it.

Subject: greatness and influence of the Cause; of this Day
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/greatness and influence of the Cause; of this Day.txt
Quotation: Today the Sun of Truth hath shone forth from the horizon of the heaven of will, proclaiming: O peoples of the earth! Ye have been created for this Day - recognize ye its station and that which hath appeared therein from God, the All-Knowing, the All-Wise. Great is this Day and great is its bounty.

Subject: greatness and influence of the Cause; of this Day
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/greatness and influence of the Cause; of this Day.txt
Quotation: O people, fear the Self-Subsisting! He hath come with a sovereignty that the hosts of the world cannot frustrate, nor can the clamor of those who have denied the Promised Day prevent it. Say: This is the Day of Victory, did ye but know it, and this is the Day of Grace, did ye but perceive it.

Subject: greatness and influence of the Cause; of this Day
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/greatness and influence of the Cause; of this Day.txt
Quotation: The whole world awaited this blessed Day and in the nights and days beseeched God for the attainment of His presence. However, when the horizon of the world was illumined with the Sun of Revelation and the rustling of the Divine Lote-Tree was raised, all were found deprived and prevented save a few.

Subject: greatness and influence of the Cause; of this Day
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/greatness and influence of the Cause; of this Day.txt
Quotation: Today a most glorious Sun hath dawned from the horizon of Persia. This Movement hath deeply affected the American and European world and hath made us the real friends of Persia. Now Persia is a position to complete the spiritual victory of mankind through the Potency of the Universal Religion of God.

Subject: greatness and influence of the Cause; of this Day
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/greatness and influence of the Cause; of this Day.txt
Quotation: A hundred thousand glad-tidings be upon ye that the Sun of the Reality of the Beauty of ABHÃ hath shone forth from the Horizon of the Contingent Being and hath illumined the regions with the lights of the Most Great Guidance. This is the Century of the Merciful One and the Period of Joy and Gladness.

Subject: greatness and influence of the Cause; of this Day
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/greatness and influence of the Cause; of this Day.txt
Quotation: Yet they are heedless that opposing winds cannot extinguish the divine lamp, and the Sun in the heaven of existence cannot be hidden by the dust of vain imaginings. The ocean of the All-Merciful's bounty will not cease its waves, and the divine springtime cloud will not be prevented from its outpouring.

Subject: greatness and influence of the Cause; of this Day
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/greatness and influence of the Cause; of this Day.txt
Quotation: What proof greater than this, what power greater than this? Despite this, the people of light are still asleep and know not what bounty hath been bestowed upon that land and region, and what crown of glory hath been placed upon the head of the people of light, whose brilliant jewels illuminate the horizons.

Subject: greatness and influence of the Cause; of this Day
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/greatness and influence of the Cause; of this Day.txt
Quotation: The morn of guidance cast a ray upon the East and illumined the Orient, and shed a beam upon the West and made the Occident luminous. Praise be to God that the mighty call of the Abha Beauty hath encompassed the world, and the proclamation of the Most Great Name hath created a tumult throughout all regions.

Subject: greatness and influence of the Cause; of this Day
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/greatness and influence of the Cause; of this Day.txt
Quotation: The Ancient Beauty dawned from the horizon of hopes with all names and attributes, and illumined this mighty century with a new effulgence as the manifestation of glorious bounty...The dawn of hope broke and the light of the Sun of Truth shone forth. The horizons were illumined and the morning breezes wafted.

Subject: greatness and influence of the Cause; of this Day
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/greatness and influence of the Cause; of this Day.txt
Quotation: It is a most great Festival, without peer or likeness... The greatness of the Cause was manifested to such a degree that all enemies lost hope, for each day groups upon groups of the most eminent scholars and learned ones, even Namiq Pasha the Governor of Baghdad, would come and attain the Most Holy Presence.

Subject: greatness and influence of the Cause; of this Day
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/greatness and influence of the Cause; of this Day.txt
Quotation: Peter, who in the Arabic tongue is called Simon Peter, was but a fisherman casting his nets by the seashore when the Spirit of God passed by him and said: Leave thy fishing, and come, that I may make thee a fisher of men. With but one garment he followed, and now kings remove their crowns at the mention of his name.

Subject: greatness and influence of the Cause; of this Day
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/greatness and influence of the Cause; of this Day.txt
Quotation: We have created all creation for this Day and have manifested the Cause unto every hearing and seeing one. This is the Day wherein the earth hath disclosed her tidings and hath shone with the light of her Lord, the All-Knowing, the All-Wise. The rapture of the Day of Resurrection hath seized the essence of all beings

Subject: greatness and influence of the Cause; of this Day
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/greatness and influence of the Cause; of this Day.txt
Quotation: "The Cause of God has in itself an animate force propelling it forward and onward... Who could ever dream that after the hard incarceration of Acca, the spies, and the closing of the doors of all correspondence - to the extent that we could not send out one letter - the voice of the Cause would be heard from Honolulu."

Subject: greatness and influence of the Cause; of this Day
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/greatness and influence of the Cause; of this Day.txt
Quotation: A fleeting moment, in this Day, excelleth centuries of a bygone age... Blessed is our time, blessed is our day, and blessed is our state! The grace of the Beloved of the worlds has encompassed all, the lights of the Sun of loving-kindness have shone forth, the ocean of mercy is surging, and the light of bounty is radiant.

Subject: greatness and influence of the Cause; of this Day
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/greatness and influence of the Cause; of this Day.txt
Quotation: The Hijaz was a waterless and plantless desert valley, "an uncultivatable valley," but through the rising of the Sun of Truth it became the Qiblih of the horizons and the circling-point of all the world. Now that the Most Great Light has shone forth from the dawning-place of Iran, consider what will happen in the future.

Subject: greatness and influence of the Cause; of this Day
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/greatness and influence of the Cause; of this Day.txt
Quotation: God willing, they have become somewhat mindful that no power can resist this overwhelming force, for if you extinguish the flame of this lamp in the East, its light will blaze forth in the West. There is no help for it. They desire to extinguish the light of God with their mouths, but God refuses save to perfect His light.

Subject: greatness and influence of the Cause; of this Day
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/greatness and influence of the Cause; of this Day.txt
Quotation: By the life of God! Were ye to hearken with true hearing--that is, were ye to hear the Call of Truth with the ear of inner truth--ye would be set ablaze in such wise that the peoples of the world would be powerless to quench it. Today the Sun calleth out, and the waves of the ocean summon mankind unto the most exalted horizon.

Subject: greatness and influence of the Cause; of this Day
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/greatness and influence of the Cause; of this Day.txt
Quotation: Were the peoples of the world to ponder the tribulations that have befallen this Wronged One, and likewise the evidences of power and might that have been manifested before the faces of the divines and princes, they would at that moment bear witness to the greatness of this Revelation and the power of Him Who conversed on Sinai.

Subject: greatness and influence of the Cause; of this Day
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/greatness and influence of the Cause; of this Day.txt
Quotation: This is a Day wherein all the seas appear but as a drop before this Most Great Sea, and the sun but as a mote before the revelation of the Sun of the Cause of thy Lord in this mighty Prison. Heaven hath bowed down to the earth of the prison, and eyes are transfixed at the dawning of this Light, shining from the horizon of the Brow.

Subject: greatness and influence of the Cause; of this Day
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/greatness and influence of the Cause; of this Day.txt
Quotation: All the Books and Prophets have given mankind the glad tidings of this most exalted, most holy, most great Day. In truth, the purpose of creation hath been the recognition of these days, yet most remain heedless and veiled. The lights of Revelation have encompassed the world, and the Speaker of the Mount proclaimeth with His most exalted call

Subject: greatness and influence of the Cause; of this Day
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/greatness and influence of the Cause; of this Day.txt
Quotation: In this cycle of the Great Lord, the Sun of the highest heaven, the Light of Truth, is at the height of its radiance, and the sun is at its point of burning brightness, its rays spreading across the horizons. For this is the first stirring of the manifestation of the Ancient Beauty and the revelation of the power of the arm of the Most Great Name

Subject: greatness and influence of the Cause; of this Day
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/greatness and influence of the Cause; of this Day.txt
Quotation: The Sun of Revelation hath risen from the horizon of the Will of the Lord of the Day of Resurrection, shining and manifest, and the Ocean of mercy hath appeared before the faces of all beings, evident and resplendent. All divine Books have testified to the Day of God, and all Prophets and Messengers have given the glad-tidings thereof to their people.

Subject: greatness and influence of the Cause; of this Day
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/greatness and influence of the Cause; of this Day.txt
Quotation: This is the Day of Victory, did ye but know it, and this is the Day of remembrance and praise. This is the Day whereon the Temple of Revelation was established upon the throne of Sinai, yet most of the people do not understand. Say: This is the Day of Utterance, did ye but comprehend it, and this is the Day of distinction, would ye but judge with fairness.

Subject: greatness and influence of the Cause; of this Day
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/greatness and influence of the Cause; of this Day.txt
Quotation: Another proof is that Baha'u'llah revealed and established such a mighty Cause--whose fame has spread throughout all regions and has gained utmost stability in the East, and whose brilliant dawn is spreading like the rays of the sun--in this severe prison, despite opposition and resistance from Eastern governments and peoples who opposed with all their might.

Subject: greatness and influence of the Cause; of this Day
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/greatness and influence of the Cause; of this Day.txt
Quotation: Wherefore, when He appeared, the foundations of nations trembled, the learned were bewildered and the wise men were confounded, save those who came near unto Thee, took from the Hand of Favor the pure wine of Thy Inspiration, and drank in Thy Name, saying: Praise be unto Thee, O Desire of the Nations! Praise be to Thee, O Beloved of the hearts of the yearning!

Subject: greatness and influence of the Cause; of this Day
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/greatness and influence of the Cause; of this Day.txt
Quotation: "His Holiness Christ states that people shall come from all parts of the world, from remote countries and enter into the Kingdom but the sons of the Kingdom shall go out. Now how many inhabitants of Persia are deprived of the Graces of His Holiness Baha'u'llah and you who are from the remote places of the earth have entered in the Kingdom of the Blessed Perfection."

Subject: greatness and influence of the Cause; of this Day
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/greatness and influence of the Cause; of this Day.txt
Quotation: The fame of the divine teachings has spread in all regions. The contents of the Most Holy Book and the Surih of the Temple have after fifty years all been fulfilled and realized...it has become established among the public of all horizons that today the spirit of this age and the wellbeing of this century depend on the teachings that have issued from the Supreme Pen.

Subject: greatness and influence of the Cause; of this Day
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/greatness and influence of the Cause; of this Day.txt
Quotation: I am pleased, very pleased to meet one from far away America. He told me of his millions of followers in Persia (the English officials fifteen years ago estimated the number as between three and four millions in Persia alone) and he told me of the thousands who are flocking to his banner in India, but he seemed to me even more interested in his message to Europe and America.

Subject: greatness and influence of the Cause; of this Day
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/greatness and influence of the Cause; of this Day.txt
Quotation: Today the Cause of God shines like a lamp at its zenith, and all eyes are bewildered and amazed that a Cause of such greatness, like the brilliant moon, has never before appeared in the realm of possibility. Even strangers testify to the greatness of the Cause of God. In all Western newspapers and journals, from all religions and nations, testimony to the greatness of the Cause exists

Subject: greatness and influence of the Cause; of this Day
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/greatness and influence of the Cause; of this Day.txt
Quotation: Such is the greatness of this Day that the Hour itself is seized with perturbation, and all heavenly Scriptures bear evidence to its overpowering majesty. In this Day the Book solemnly testifieth to His glory and the Balance is moved to lift up its voice. This is the Day wherein the ?ira? calleth aloud: 'I am the straight Path', and Mount Sinai exclaimeth: 'Verily the Lord of Revelation is come.'

Subject: greatness and influence of the Cause; of this Day
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/greatness and influence of the Cause; of this Day.txt
Quotation: The signs of power and greatness from the appearance of all the holy Manifestations of God - May my soul be a sacrifice to them! - were evident only to the believers... But in this Blessed Manifestation everybody wrote incomparable poems during the (days after Baha'o'llah's) departure. A certain Christian said: 'Though I am not a believer in Baha'o'llah, yet I find his miracles like unto the sun.'

Subject: greatness and influence of the Cause; of this Day
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/greatness and influence of the Cause; of this Day.txt
Quotation: This is a Day through whose mention the Books have been adorned, and in whose praise the birds have warbled upon the branches. By the life of God! The ocean of knowledge hath surged and the heaven of understanding hath been upraised on a Day wherein the All-Merciful hath established Himself upon the throne of His Name, the All-Bountiful. Ye were created for this Day, to this all atoms bear witness.

Subject: greatness and influence of the Cause; of this Day
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/greatness and influence of the Cause; of this Day.txt
Quotation: but in the days of the Blessed Perfection no one dared to show any disrespect to the Temple of the Cause. The greatest missionaries have composed poetry in His honor, yet they were against Him. This goes to show the greatness of the Cause of the Blessed Perfection, for in the time of the past Prophets, only their followers testified of them and their greatness, but now even the enemies of Beha testify of Him.

Subject: greatness and influence of the Cause; of this Day
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/greatness and influence of the Cause; of this Day.txt
Quotation: I swear by God that a moment's tranquility in these days beneath the shade of the Tree of this supreme Manifestation is greater than the creation of the heavens and the earth. Just as this Revelation and its affirmative manifestations are the greatest of all manifestations, likewise the letters of negation in these days are greater than all ages past and future, and are more firm and steadfast in their opposition.

Subject: greatness and influence of the Cause; of this Day
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/greatness and influence of the Cause; of this Day.txt
Quotation: This is the lord of all days, and the King of Manifestations is seated upon the throne of utterance. Blessed are they who attain! The days of the Divine Manifestations are in one sense referred to as the Day of God, but these days are specially distinguished in all the Books as the appearance of the Hidden Mystery and the Treasured Secret, Who calleth out with the most exalted voice before the faces of all the world.

Subject: greatness and influence of the Cause; of this Day
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/greatness and influence of the Cause; of this Day.txt
Quotation: The spiritual power of the Blessed Perfection in his days was such that thousands of people entered the Kingdom, and through the power of the Word of God, more than twenty thousand, upheld by the strength, steadfastness and firmness of their belief, under great oppression, went to the place of death and with perfect happiness and joy drank from the cup of martyrdom. They were cut to pieces while uttering "O thou, Baha'o'llah!"

Subject: greatness and influence of the Cause; of this Day
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/greatness and influence of the Cause; of this Day.txt
Quotation: O friends! O ye who drink the choice wine of the mercy of the All-Merciful! This is a great day. Great is its worth, great is its station, and great indeed is that which transpireth therein. The tongue was created for this day, and the eye came into being from the realm of nothingness for this blessed day. By the life of God! This is the day of ears and hearts, that they might see and speak and hear and preserve in the treasury.

Subject: greatness and influence of the Cause; of this Day
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/greatness and influence of the Cause; of this Day.txt
Quotation: The Ancient Beauty and the Most Great Name--may my soul be sacrificed for His dust--alone, solitary, manifestly and evidently, without helper or assistant, confronted in His blessed Person all governments and peoples, and stood against all who dwell on earth. Like the brilliant sun and like a radiant lamp in every gathering, He ever cast aside the veil and raised high the banner, making His breast the target for the arrows of all parties.

Subject: greatness and influence of the Cause; of this Day
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/greatness and influence of the Cause; of this Day.txt
Quotation: Never forget these days - remember them. The more you remember them, the more spiritual you will become. Appreciate the value of these days. The cool breeze does not always blow; the rain does not always come; the trees do not always bear fruit. Now you are in such days that the breeze in continually blowing; the rain is continually falling; the divine tree [is bearing] fruit continually. These are the days of spring, the days of Baha'o'llah.

Subject: greatness and influence of the Cause; of this Day
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/greatness and influence of the Cause; of this Day.txt
Quotation: The favor of the Truth is abundant and His ancient bestowal is uninterrupted. His cycle is all light. His century fulfils all the signs. Be not hopeless neither disappointed. It is the day of hope and the century of the Glorious God. His great fame has filled the east and the west. The song of His divinity has encompassed the south and the north, and caused a tumult among the pillars of the world, making the hearts of the sons of Adam to quake.

Subject: greatness and influence of the Cause; of this Day
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/greatness and influence of the Cause; of this Day.txt
Quotation: The greater the Cause, the more stupendous its upheavals. The vaster the ocean, the more tumultuous its tempests. A lake is not as turbulent as the sea. The waves of the most great Sea are impetuous, ungovernable. Now in this age the most weighty Cause is the Cause of the Blessed Perfection. It is the greatest Dispensation of all the bygone ages and cycles. Its revolutions are world-shaking; its obstacles are tremendous, its impediments are infinite.

Subject: greatness and influence of the Cause; of this Day
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/greatness and influence of the Cause; of this Day.txt
Quotation: This is a great Day. Strive that ye may be enabled to make good what hath escaped you. By Him at Whose command the Supreme Pen moves, a single moment of these days is more precious than all the mines of the earth and their jewels, and than all that the kings and others in the world possess. One must know the station of such times, epochs, days, hours and minutes, for there has never been and never will be anything comparable to what has been mentioned.

Subject: greatness and influence of the Cause; of this Day
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/greatness and influence of the Cause; of this Day.txt
Quotation: Furthermore, do not compare the Cause of Baha'u'llah to any other cause, for this Cause encompasses all causes. The followers of every religion and assembly find their foundation in this Cause. Moreover this Cause creates souls anew, gives them a second birth, transforms falsehood to truth and ignorance to knowledge, makes the impure pure and troubled tranquil, makes the fearful and anxious brave and assured, makes the mute speaking and the deaf hearing.

Subject: greatness and influence of the Cause; of this Day
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/greatness and influence of the Cause; of this Day.txt
Quotation: The candle is lit and the century of the Ancient Beauty is a rose garden. The dawn of the Abha Kingdom is radiant and the stars of the Concourse on High are shining. The breeze from divine meadows is blowing and the fragrance of heavenly gardens is wafting. The melody of the Abha Kingdom is raised and the call of the Supreme Concourse reaches every needy ear. The Sun of bounty shines with utmost brilliance and the Moon of generosity illumines all horizons.

Subject: greatness and influence of the Cause; of this Day
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/greatness and influence of the Cause; of this Day.txt
Quotation: This age is indeed as a hundred other ages: should ye gather the yield of a hundred ages, and set that against the accumulated product of our times, the yield of this one era will prove greater than that of the total of all the books that were ever written in ages past, and compare that with the books and treatises that our era hath produced: these books, written in our day alone, far and away exceed the total number of volumes that have been written down the ages.

Subject: greatness and influence of the Cause; of this Day
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/greatness and influence of the Cause; of this Day.txt
Quotation: By God! My Cause is great, great! But most of the people are heedless. Today is very great and wondrous, for the He is manifest in the garment of I and the Hidden One speaketh with "I am the Witnessed One." Despite the greatness of this Cause which by the testimony of all the Books is more manifest than the sun in midheaven, no person of insight has been nor will be confused about it, for its lights, manifestations, verses and evidences have encompassed all regions.

Subject: greatness and influence of the Cause; of this Day
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/greatness and influence of the Cause; of this Day.txt
Quotation: It satisfies every assemblage! Each group testifies to its greatness. In the churches it shakes the souls; it excites the Theosophists; it imparts spirituality to the spiritualists; it makes the Unitarians aware of the reality of unity; it makes the socialists contented and grateful and inspires joy and happiness in the peace meetings. There is no refuge for any denomination except in submission to it. It is a miracle! It is the greatest force in the world of existence.

Subject: greatness and influence of the Cause; of this Day
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/greatness and influence of the Cause; of this Day.txt
Quotation: Verily, by God the Truth, the doors of the Kingdom are opened, the lights of God have shown forth and illumined the horizon of the earth! The Lord of Hosts hath descended with the army of lights and angels of heaven and depressed the armies of darkness! He sent His angels to all directions, with a call of the trumpet of realities and meanings, instructions and teachings! Therefore, O people of the earth, appreciate the opportunity, in this new century, wherein the lights have been revealed by the Glorious Lord!

Subject: greatness and influence of the Cause; of this Day
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/greatness and influence of the Cause; of this Day.txt
Quotation: That is, this wondrous cycle is distinguished and different from previous cycles to this extent. As you observe, it is still the first century, yet in this brief period how many secrets of existence have emerged from the realm of the unseen into the visible world, how many hidden mysteries and protected secrets that were in the unseen realm of contingent being have become manifest, how many discoveries about the secrets and realities of things have been verified, and how many crafts and innovations have appeared!

Subject: greatness and influence of the Cause; of this Day
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/greatness and influence of the Cause; of this Day.txt
Quotation: The Cause will soon throw a great reverberation throughout the pillars of the world. It will embrace in its fall the East and the west. Its power will penetrate through every stone of creation. Its imperial Tent will be pitched upon the apex of Existence. Its invisible Army will conquer the cities of the hearts! Its royal diadem will be set upon the brow of humanity. Its throne will be established amongst the children of men. Its heavenly scepter will sway nations and empires! and its spiritual influence will be felt by the people of every clime.

Subject: greatness and influence of the Cause; of this Day
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/greatness and influence of the Cause; of this Day.txt
Quotation: Know ye the value of these days and hold fast unto that which is befitting.

Subject: greatness and influence of the Cause; of this Day
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/greatness and influence of the Cause; of this Day.txt
Quotation: This day hath no likeness or parallel. You must regard the time as precious. I swear by the Sun of Truth that every moment of these days has been and is more precious than mountains of gold. O friends! Consider the time precious and act as befits it.

Subject: greatness and influence of the Cause; of this Day
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/greatness and influence of the Cause; of this Day.txt
Quotation: God willing, may ye succeed in preserving this most exalted station and supreme rank. While the waves of the ocean of utterance are manifest and the effulgences of the sun of inner meanings are dawning and evident, arise to serve and undertake that which exalteth the Cause of God.

Subject: greed; envy; covetousness; attachment to the world
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/greed; envy; covetousness; attachment to the world.txt
Quotation: Detachment is as the sun; in whatsoever heart it doth shine it quencheth the fire of covetousness and self.

Subject: greed; envy; covetousness; attachment to the world
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/greed; envy; covetousness; attachment to the world.txt
Quotation: Do not rejoice in the world and whatsoever is therein. By God's life! Every treasure hath been and is the cause of infinite grief and sorrow and regret.

Subject: greed; envy; covetousness; attachment to the world
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/greed; envy; covetousness; attachment to the world.txt
Quotation: In these days the fire of greed and passion is ablaze in the great city, and the flames of tyranny and wickedness are evident, and poor trustworthiness is suffering in the well of treachery. They have engaged in plunder and have taken away the wealth of many.

Subject: greed; envy; covetousness; attachment to the world
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/greed; envy; covetousness; attachment to the world.txt
Quotation: How strange is this world wherein man, for the sake of unworthy gold, would abandon his station, rank, truth and fellow men. It is the recompense of treachery and falsehood that hath seized the understanding of such souls, that they comprehend not what harmeth or profiteth them.

Subject: greed; envy; covetousness; attachment to the world
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/greed; envy; covetousness; attachment to the world.txt
Quotation: Do not attach your hearts to the worldly possessions. Attachments alloys happiness. There are some people who dream that if they had 10 thousand dollars they would be happy; but they do not know that those who have already 10.000 dollars are unhappy and are sad because they do not have $ 100.000 and so on. If you want to be happy, attach your hearts to nothing.

Subject: greed; envy; covetousness; attachment to the world
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/greed; envy; covetousness; attachment to the world.txt
Quotation: Among the people is he who believed, then denied, and wrongfully consumed the property of others, uttering that which none before him had ever uttered... He cast aside righteousness and piety when he was consumed by the fire of greed and passion... In these days, heedless souls have, in their greed for wealth, turned away from the Truth. To such a degree are they aflame with the fire of avarice and desire that the pen is powerless to describe it.

Subject: greed; envy; covetousness; attachment to the world
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/greed; envy; covetousness; attachment to the world.txt
Quotation: The fire of greed and corruption hath been kindled in the lands through that which the hands of the oppressors who followed vain imaginings and idle fancies have wrought. They have wrongfully consumed the substance of the people and have uttered that which hath caused hearts to melt and tears to flow. They have denied the favor of God and the favor of His loved ones, and have rejected the heavenly table that was sent down from the heaven of His bounty upon all existence.

Subject: growth and progress is gradual and according to capacity
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/growth and progress is gradual and according to capacity.txt
Quotation: The question was asked whether after the further declaration of this Truth would the millennium begin at once?  Abdu'l-Baha:  No, gradually, for a plant that grows too quickly lasts only a short time.

Subject: growth and progress is gradual and according to capacity
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/growth and progress is gradual and according to capacity.txt
Quotation: The nations of the world strive to increase their armaments to such an extent that they become like serpents, rushing at one another, and much blood is shed. The wise ones among the nations gather to investigate the cause, and become aware that the cause of bloodshed is prejudices, the most severe of which is religious prejudice. They strive to eliminate religion so that prejudice, which is a branch of religion, might also disappear. Then they realize that humanity cannot live without religion. Therefore, they gather and study the teachings of existing religions to see which religion conforms to the requirements of the time. Then the Cause of God becomes universal.

Subject: growth and progress is gradual and according to capacity
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/growth and progress is gradual and according to capacity.txt
Quotation: Whatsoever is latent in the innermost of this holy cycle, shall gradually appear and be made manifest, for now is but the beginning of its growth and the dayspring of the revelation of its signs.

Subject: growth of the Cause
Quotation: Assuredly the Cause of God will advance day by day, for the power of the Holy Spirit confirms it and the Word of God grants success.

Subject: growth of the Cause
Quotation: Day by day this light grows brighter and the darkness of ignorance is scattered. At last the light of truth will fully illumine both East and West.

Subject: growth of the Cause
Quotation: However, the foundation laid by Baha'u'llah is spreading day by day... You have now sown a seed - it will certainly sprout. Its sprouting is with God.

Subject: growth of the Cause
Quotation: The nations of the world strive to increase their armaments to such an extent that they become like serpents, rushing at one another, and much blood is shed. The wise ones among the nations gather to investigate the cause, and become aware that the cause of bloodshed is prejudices, the most severe of which is religious prejudice. They strive to eliminate religion so that prejudice, which is a branch of religion, might also disappear. Then they realize that humanity cannot live without religion. Therefore, they gather and study the teachings of existing religions to see which religion conforms to the requirements of the time. Then the Cause of God becomes universal.

Subject: growth of the Cause
Quotation: The Baha'i Faith is penetrating and surging forth across America

Subject: growth of the Cause
Quotation: Praise be to God, the divine fragrances are spreading to the utmost degree.

Subject: growth of the Cause
Quotation: that the Cause of his Holiness BAHA'O'LLAH must ultimately encircle the globe

Subject: growth of the Cause
Quotation: From every land a cry is raised, and from every clime a life-giving breeze wafteth.

Subject: growth of the Cause
Quotation: Iran and its surroundings are, praise be to God, in the utmost state of enthusiasm.

Subject: growth of the Cause
Quotation: I hope from His grace that He will soon raise up these souls so that His Cause may be exalted.

Subject: growth of the Cause
Quotation: The news you wrote about the spread of the Cause since the beginning of winter was joy-bringing.

Subject: growth of the Cause
Quotation: growth of the Cause "the coastal regions of the Sea of Oman are the beginning point of victories"

Subject: growth of the Cause
Quotation: Account of how "most of the late one's followers entered into the Divine Law" after learning the truth

Subject: growth of the Cause
Quotation: From all parts of the world host after host enter under its Radiance. Erelong it will become world-wide.

Subject: growth of the Cause
Quotation: Jinab-i-Yusuf Khan has arrived and today set out for America. God willing, may he be confirmed and assisted.

Subject: growth of the Cause
Quotation: Before long the results of this mighty undertaking will be uncovered and laid bare before the eyes of all men.

Subject: growth of the Cause
Quotation: This Cause first appeared in Iran, then spread to other Islamic countries and propagated among Jews and Christians

Subject: growth of the Cause
Quotation: So why are the friends in the region of ?abaristan few in number, and the register of their blessed names limited?

Subject: growth of the Cause
Quotation: "When the movement of the Supreme Pen (BAHA'O'LLAH) becomes audible, undoubtedly the buzzing of flies ceases. This is evident."

Subject: growth of the Cause
Quotation: Now the fame of God's Cause and the renown of the Manifestation of Baha'u'llah has set the seven climes in motion and vibration

Subject: growth of the Cause
Quotation: "This Blessed Tree grows through blood... Rather the Word of God will be raised higher and the Sun of Truth will shine more brightly"

Subject: growth of the Cause
Quotation: In the city of 'Ishqabad, the Cause of God is well renowned, resplendent and manifest, and is subject to no veil or concealment whatever.

Subject: growth of the Cause
Quotation: But rest assured that ere long thousands, each of the same stature as Count Tolstoy, will arise and gather under the banner of the Cause of God.

Subject: growth of the Cause
Quotation: The people of God are the recipients of His aid and assistance, and will, in the end, shed the radiance of the Divine splendors upon the whole world.

Subject: growth of the Cause
Quotation: The call of Ya Baha'u'l-Abha can be heard far and wide. It is my hope that this soul-stirring melody of the Abha Kingdom may also be raised high in Paris

Subject: growth of the Cause
Quotation: The letter which thou didst write to his honor Asad brought great joy, for it conveyed glad tidings of the establishment of the Cause of God in those regions.

Subject: growth of the Cause
Quotation: Rest ye assured that ere long the Banner of Guidance shall over all the regions and the Harmony of the Baha'is shall fill the Kingdoms of the East and the West.

Subject: growth of the Cause
Quotation: Now in all regions the fragrances of the Cause are diffusing, and assuredly the Helper and Supporter will become manifest. This is irrevocable and will not change.

Subject: growth of the Cause
Quotation: We are watching with great interest the progress of this Movement. For it seems to us it is advancing with great rapidity without the usual propaganda organization

Subject: growth of the Cause
Quotation: China, China, China, China-ward the Cause of Baha'o'llah must march! Where is that holy, sanctified Bahai to become the teacher of China! China has most great capability.

Subject: growth of the Cause
Quotation: divine confirmations are arriving continuously and the Cause of God has achieved tremendous spread in Iran. In Tehran, all will soon be attracted to the divine fragrances.

Subject: growth of the Cause
Quotation: Numerous souls entered beneath the shade of the Divine Word and some, intoxicated from the cup of grace, hastened to the altar of sacrifice and gave their hearts and souls.

Subject: growth of the Cause
Quotation: The purpose is that the time has come for Kerman to stir and move, so that that region may become a paradise of delight and that country may be perfumed with holy fragrances

Subject: growth of the Cause
Quotation: Eloquent and knowledgeable souls must be found who will strive to seek out these souls and, wherever they are found, lead them to the Divine Law. many souls are secretly ready

Subject: growth of the Cause
Quotation: The Cause of God is nigh unto yielding results, and on that day shall the believers rejoice shall be fulfilled. Rest thou assured that in both East and West it is in intense growth.

Subject: growth of the Cause
Quotation: In Washington we always had audiences of one to two thousand in large meetings. Day and night I had no rest. Many came to the Faith. Even those who are not believers drew much closer.

Subject: growth of the Cause
Quotation: We hope through the favors of Baha'u'llah that the pure seed will sprout and through the bounty of the cloud of guidance these plains and mountains will become verdant and flourishing.

Subject: growth of the Cause
Quotation: Soon thou shalt witness that: There is no commotion in the city save from the curl of the Friend's tresses, There is no tumult in all horizons save from the arch of the Beloved's brow.

Subject: growth of the Cause
Quotation: So intensely hath the light of Baha'u'llah shone upon the American continent that in each city a company of believers is to be found, and the call of 'Ya Baha'u'l-Abha' is being raised.

Subject: growth of the Cause
Quotation: When the Most Great Luminary shed its splendor from the horizons of the nations...The call of the Cause of God was raised higher and the fame of the party of God encompassed East and West.

Subject: growth of the Cause
Quotation: The time will come when her whole family will be proud of Mrs Krug and her faith...Ere long the whole of her family will consider the faith of that lady as the crown of honor on their heads.

Subject: growth of the Cause
Quotation: May the voice of the Celestial Bird of God's Cause be raised from those [?] and regions, and may the reflection of this luminous mountain cast its radiance and light upon this boundless expanse.

Subject: growth of the Cause
Quotation: We killed them and imprisoned them severely, yet day by day they increase. Observe how much the Roman monarchs and Eastern kings opposed them, yet there is no doubt they will ultimately triumph.

Subject: growth of the Cause
Quotation: You wrote about the errors and neglectfulness of the people of Switzerland: before long you will see that the Light of guidance will also take effect in that region, and finally it will be illumined.

Subject: growth of the Cause
Quotation: "The headquarters of the Baha'is is Persia. There are many Baha'is there. They are all over the world. There is not a country in which there is no Baha'is...We have no statistics, but there are many."

Subject: growth of the Cause
Quotation: From the beginning of the dawning of the Morn of Guidance, Adhirbayjan raised high the banner of faith and certitude in servitude to the Self-Sufficient Lord, and the Cause of God achieved great diffusion.
