Quotation: The Cause has now reached such a state that the banner of Ya Baha'ul-Abha is raised on the right while others' banners are raised on the left. Compare the condition of today with that of thirty years ago. Now that it has spread to Japan and Australia - in Japan a Baha'i journal is being published - observe what tidings these are! The blessed fame of Muhammad, peace be upon Him, has not reached the clime of Japan in thirteen hundred years, and the holy voice of Christ has not influenced that distant realm in two thousand years, yet the world-embracing call of the Baha'is has reached that far country in a brief period, and the Cause is spreading.

Subject: growth of the Cause
Quotation: Communication with him had to be in secret, but still the Cause spread, and they said: "Day by day his lamp becomes brighter, his potency becomes greater." But the banishment of Baha'o'llah, the Blessed Perfection, instead of resulting in the extermination of the Cause in the country proved just the contrary; the fame became more widely circulated; the teachings of the Blessed Perfection became more widely promulgated in Persia. Through the power of God he was able to hoist his banner. If at first it was a lamp, it became a flame. If it was a star, it became a mighty sun. The fame of the Cause of the Blessed Perfection went as far as the East and the West.

Subject: growth of the Cause
Quotation: Praise be to God that ye arose to serve in Qum and succeeded in organizing meetings and spiritual gatherings. The friends found solace and the seekers heard familiar melodies. It is hoped this will yield praiseworthy results. Kashan became flower-strewn and the fragrance of mysteries perfumed the nostrils of seekers. Signs of divine confirmation became manifest and the lights of success shone forth. In Nushabad, the feast of spiritual joy was adorned and the wine of the love of God was passed round. In Fathabad, victories appeared and traveling meetings were established. The friends were filled with ecstasy and those unaware of the traceless Beloved found traces. Naraq received the rays of dawning light and the breeze of the Covenant wafted. The overflowing cup was passed round and several souls became intimate with the divine mysteries.

Subject: growth of the Cause
Quotation: Praise be to God that the power of the divine Cause became manifest as the sun in its meridian course. The European and American tour had brought forth most extraordinary and unforeseen results and has advanced and promoted the position of the Cause in the eyes of the public in the most astonishing manner. Consider how great has become the Cause that the Governor-General of Salonika, the Governor-General of Syria, the Governor-General of Damascus, the English Consul General in Beirut and a host of other great men were so excited with an interest as to come to Haifa and call on me to find out the truth without any intermediary. Reflect what a great tumult the Cause of God has thrown in the pillars of the earth - that hardly we have arrived here yesterday than all these men were attracted and listened to all that I have said with much attention.

Subject: growth of the Cause
Quotation: His influence continued to spread, and His followers multiplied throughout Persia and neighboring lands, despite fierce opposition and persecution. Soon the followers of the Bab, who had been dwindling away, came and others joined the movement.

Subject: happiness; joyfulness; joy and sorrow
Quotation: Under all conditions thou shouldst be joyous, cheerful, and exhilarated. First, thou must at all times be joyous, cheerful and expansive

Subject: happiness; joyfulness; joy and sorrow
Quotation: All gladness and joy, delight and exultation, and expansion belong to the friends of Truth. Should sorrows sometimes overtake them, joy and relief shall swiftly follow, for the matter resteth with God. Grief is unseemly and sorrow unwarranted.

Subject: happiness; joyfulness; joy and sorrow
Quotation: And in the utmost joy and delight, attraction and rapture, may you be occupied with stringing the pearls of praise and diffusing the holy fragrances of glorification of the Most Glorious Beauty among the peoples of the world, so that the sound of the song and delight and the melody of attraction and rapture of the friends may reach the precincts of the Most Glorious Kingdom

Subject: happiness; joyfulness; joy and sorrow
Quotation: Normal spiritual joy has a healing effect upon the body. his joy will then be unceasing and his happiness a flowing stream of crystal water. The joy of a soul is indescribable, if the fragrance of spirituality waft from the garden of his being. This diving happiness is not followed by any sorrow nor is this heavenly spring ended by the sultry days of summer.

Subject: happiness; joyfulness; joy and sorrow
Quotation: Are you all well? Are you all happy? If you be not happy, who could be happy? If you be not happy, who could be happy? If you be not attracted, who could be attracted? If you be not radiant, who could be radiant? If you fly not away with joy, who could fly away?

Subject: happiness; joyfulness; joy and sorrow
Quotation: The greatest means of joy and gladness is the mention of the divine friends... This will cause enthusiasm and rapture in the friends and attraction and delight in the loved ones.

Subject: happiness; joyfulness; joy and sorrow
Quotation: This is the Day of supreme joy though tribulation may shine forth from its horizon, and the Day of gladness though pitch darkness may enshroud all directions. Yet the lights of the Sun overcome the darkness.

Subject: happiness; joyfulness; joy and sorrow
Quotation: This is the day of happiness. A happy state brings special blessings.

Subject: happiness; joyfulness; joy and sorrow
Quotation: "I wish you to become heralds of happiness, because happiness is the cause of progress and development. The Appearance of the Manifestations is to bring happiness; that all may reach this great aim of life. Seek the real happiness; nothing is greater than it. Except this happiness of God there is none; all other happiness is but imagination. Therefore My greatest happiness is to see you spiritually happy."

Subject: happiness; joyfulness; joy and sorrow
Quotation: True joy comes from the tranquility of heart, and this state comes from faith! This is why we are always happy.

Subject: happiness; joyfulness; joy and sorrow
Quotation: Be ye always the bearers of good tidings and spread such news quickly.... and be the cause of joy and awakening of hearts

Subject: happiness; joyfulness; joy and sorrow
Quotation: Contentment is the creator of happiness. Notwithstanding this we were all very happy and thought that ours was the most delicious dinner.

Subject: happiness; joyfulness; joy and sorrow
Quotation: Therefore rejoice, be happy, and drink the cups of gladness through the mystery of thy Gracious Lord in this mighty cycle and glorious age

Subject: happiness; joyfulness; joy and sorrow
Quotation: For now you have your gathering, and we have also sent your source of laughter and joy. In any case, you are surely happy, joyous and radiant.

Subject: happiness; joyfulness; joy and sorrow
Quotation: Consequently, we must be very happy, very glad, very much pleased, very contented, very joyful, because we are submerged in the ocean of the bestowals of Baha'o'llah. A thoughtful man enjoys the gifts and the blessings of God.

Subject: happiness; joyfulness; joy and sorrow
Quotation: Should this happen, it will be filled with bliss in both worlds and remain forever radiant and shining. It will experience boundless joy and felicity and a lasting happiness. Then will he become joyous in both worlds and eternally radiant.

Subject: happiness; joyfulness; joy and sorrow
Quotation: I lived there two years in the utmost happiness. The soul of man must be happy no matter where he is. One must attain to that condition of inward beatitude and peace--then outward circumstances will not alter his spiritual calmness and joyousness.

Subject: happiness; joyfulness; joy and sorrow
Quotation: Happiness is the King of our hearts. Let us not part from it. If the candle of happiness is ignited in the chamber of the heart all the foreboding gloom of evil suggestions will be dispelled. My home is the home of happiness. My home is the home of joy and delight. My home is the home of laughter and exultation. Whosoever enters through the portals of this home must go out with a gladsome heart.

Subject: happiness; joyfulness; joy and sorrow
Quotation: In this manner men attains to eternal happiness and will enjoy perpetual spiritual health. For the happiness of man is through the spiritual susceptibilities; the happiness of man is through evanescence and complete self-abnegation; the happiness of man is to renounce everything in the path of the Blessed Perfection; the happiness of man is through divine Bestowals; the happiness of man the conceptions of the Kingdom. The misery of man consists in the absence of these.

Subject: harmony of science and religion
Quotation: conform religion with science and reason

Subject: harmony of science and religion
Quotation: He speaks with rational proofs and arguments about the harmony of religion with reason and science

Subject: harmony of science and religion
Quotation: Even material sciences and arts have reached such a degree that a child today knows more than the philosophers of old.

Subject: harmony of science and religion
Quotation: They counted these conjectures as sciences and this madness as wisdom from the peerless world...Thus vain was the work of these conjecturers!

Subject: harmony of science and religion
Quotation: material mind finds various nourishments and progresses through wonderful scientific discoveries...you must set the heart in motion to unite with knowledge - that is, to join spiritual virtues with physical perfections

Subject: harmony of science and religion
Quotation: Praise be to God, that stupendous material developments are obtained in this country; but material civilization alone does not safeguard the progress of a nation...When material civilization joins hands with spiritual civilization, then it will be perfect.

Subject: harmony of science and religion
Quotation: In this divine Cause, there are divine texts stating that religion, reason and science must agree. For example, if something is proven religiously but not rationally, or proven rationally but not religiously, one must investigate reality until the two align.

Subject: harmony of science and religion
Quotation: If the churches are anxious to win the souls back to Christ they must interpret these 'seven great mysteries' of Christianity according to science and reason - otherwise no liberal-minded person will ever accept the old, hide-bound interpretations.

Subject: harmony of science and religion
Quotation: Baha'o'llah further declares that through the equipment of science and art the misunderstandings which have prevailed between religion and science will become reconciled. The non-conformity of science and religion has been the greatest factor in keeping the religions apart.

Subject: harmony of science and religion
Quotation: Thanks be to God, that in this new cycle the admonition of Baha'u'llah is that in the search for truth man must weigh religious questions in the balance of science and reason. When religion is upheld by science and reason we can believe with assurance and act with conviction

Subject: harmony of science and religion
Quotation: For example, their first weapon was that whatever contradicts science is ignorance. We proclaimed that religion must be in accordance with science and reason - they are one. Any religious matter that does not accord with science is superstition. We broke their weapon, for they wanted to say religion contradicts science and reason, therefore is ignorance.

Subject: harmony of science and religion
Quotation: There is no contradiction between true religion and science. When a religion is opposed to science it becomes mere superstition: that which is contrary to knowledge is ignorance. Religion and science are the two wings upon which man's intelligence can soar into the heights, with which the human soul can progress. It is not possible to fly with one wing alone!

Subject: harmony of science and religion
Quotation: Know that this material world is the mirror of the Kingdom, and each of these worlds is in complete correspondence with the other. The correct theories of this world which are the result of sound philosophical thinking are in agreement with the divine verses without the slightest divergence between them, for the truth of all things is laid away in the treasuries of the Kingdom.

Subject: harmony of science and religion
Quotation: Morality is the basis of the happiness of the world of humanity. Merciful attributes are the best adornments of man. Science holds the next position to morality. Science is conducive to the happiness of the world of humanity next in degree to morality. If a nation be well qualified with education and yet dispossessed of good morals, it will not attain happiness. If that same nation be dispossessed of education, but possessed of moral training, it will be capable of accomplishing philanthropic deeds. When Morality and science go hand in hand, then will it be light upon light.

Subject: health and healing; material and spiritual healing
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/health and healing; material and spiritual healing.txt
Quotation: Praise be to God that thou has two powers: one to undertake physical healing and the other spiritual healing. Matters related to man's spirit have a great effect on his bodily condition.

Subject: health and healing; material and spiritual healing
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/health and healing; material and spiritual healing.txt
Quotation:
He who is filled with the love of the Glory (of God) and forgets all things, the Holy Spirit will be heard from his lips and the spirit of life will fill his heart, the light of the sign will shine forth from his face, the words will issue from his mouth in strands of pearls, and all sickness and disease will be healed by the laying on of his hands.
all sickness and disease will be healed by the laying on of his hands

Subject: health and healing; material and spiritual healing
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/health and healing; material and spiritual healing.txt
Quotation: Man must not imagine disease but must ever trust God. If a man thinks too much of his health, he will become afflicted.

Subject: health and healing; material and spiritual healing
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/health and healing; material and spiritual healing.txt
Quotation: this is He Who quenches thirst from the spring of life, and this is He Who healeth the sick with the antidote of salvation

Subject: health and healing; material and spiritual healing
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/health and healing; material and spiritual healing.txt
Quotation: The Baha'i Cause is the fountain of Job. Whosoever enters in it will become freed from all the moral and spiritual diseases.

Subject: health and healing; material and spiritual healing
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/health and healing; material and spiritual healing.txt
Quotation: Abdul-Baha spoke of the Druzes who never drank wine or smoked, and in consequence of this, many diseases were quite unknown to them.

Subject: health and healing; material and spiritual healing
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/health and healing; material and spiritual healing.txt
Quotation: When will the physicians learn to treat by proper diet? ... I treat myself always by diet. Yesterday I treated myself with this butter. Today it was not necessary, so I did not eat it.

Subject: health and healing; material and spiritual healing
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/health and healing; material and spiritual healing.txt
Quotation: But you should nurse the sick ones, for it is one of the greatest services to the human world; especially while nursing them recite the Most Great Name and read the all-sufficient prayer for healing.

Subject: health and healing; material and spiritual healing
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/health and healing; material and spiritual healing.txt
Quotation: God is their physician, and their illnesses are far fewer than those of humans. But medicine is among the legitimate sciences, it is among the noble sciences. God created medicine for the preservation of mankind...

Subject: health and healing; material and spiritual healing
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/health and healing; material and spiritual healing.txt
Quotation: Although ill health is one of the unavoidable conditions of man, truly it is hard to bear. The bounty of good health is the greatest of all gifts. I beseech God that complete healing and perfect health may be attained.

Subject: health and healing; material and spiritual healing
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/health and healing; material and spiritual healing.txt
Quotation: No treatment is better for the sick than spiritual joy and delight, and joy and gladness are confined to divine glad-tidings. This is a remedy for every ailment, a cure for every sick one, and a quenching for every thirst.

Subject: health and healing; material and spiritual healing
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/health and healing; material and spiritual healing.txt
Quotation: One must obey the command of God and submit to medical opinion. Thus your journey was undertaken in obedience to God's command and not for the sake of healing, since healing is in the hand of God, not in the hand of doctors.

Subject: health and healing; material and spiritual healing
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/health and healing; material and spiritual healing.txt
Quotation: From this three-year journey and endless hardships and difficulties, Abdul-Baha's physical powers have been completely depleted - it is as if the limbs have fallen apart from each other. Praise be to God, these days the body is also better.

Subject: health and healing; material and spiritual healing
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/health and healing; material and spiritual healing.txt
Quotation: O physician of souls! Direct your blessed thoughts somewhat toward the healing of hearts, and become a spiritual physician...At that time, both spiritual and physical healing will be attained, and health of body and soul will both be realized.

Subject: health and healing; material and spiritual healing
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/health and healing; material and spiritual healing.txt
Quotation: Concerning the Tablet beginning "O 'Ali, O Faithful One!" about which thou hadst written - this Tablet is for healing from illness. When seeking healing for a sick person, it should be chanted with the utmost attention, mindfulness and concentration in a sweet melody.

Subject: health and healing; material and spiritual healing
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/health and healing; material and spiritual healing.txt
Quotation: Therefore, treat thou the sick with both powers. Spiritual feelings have a surprising effect on healing nervous ailments. Try thou this: Grant thou healing through the Holy Breaths, and cure thou the sick ones, and become a means of treatment for the afflicted ones.

Subject: health and healing; material and spiritual healing
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/health and healing; material and spiritual healing.txt
Quotation: O Physician of all heart's ailments! Heal spiritual maladies with divine glances, and cure wounds of the self with holy mysteries and rapturous glances. Remedy the sicknesses of separation with cups of sweet beverage. Apply the salve of inner meanings to hidden pains.

Subject: health and healing; material and spiritual healing
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/health and healing; material and spiritual healing.txt
Quotation: GOD has so created man that from within he possesses all the power to recuperate and his work properly without the aid of stimulants. GOD has made the stomach like an animal, to go by itself, to do its work properly. Wine makes you overwork it, and then it will not digest properly.

Subject: health and healing; material and spiritual healing
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/health and healing; material and spiritual healing.txt
Quotation: O physician of souls! Direct your blessed thoughts somewhat toward the healing of hearts, and become a spiritual physician. Completely forget the body and physical matters...At that time, both spiritual and physical healing will be attained, and health of body and soul will both be realized.

Subject: health and healing; material and spiritual healing
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/health and healing; material and spiritual healing.txt
Quotation: Thou shouldst endeavour to study the science of medicine. It is extremely useful and serveth as the greatest instrument for the dissemination of the Cause. It is absolutely imperative that thou acquire this bounty. Strive day and night that thou mayest become highly qualified in this science.

Subject: health and healing; material and spiritual healing
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/health and healing; material and spiritual healing.txt
Quotation: Hence, "This is a refreshing water to wash and a drink" it is the divinely effulgence, compassionate blessings and inward revivals emanate from the reality of man from which whosoever seeketh profusion will be remedied from every severe sickness and will find relief of all serious contingents.

Subject: health and healing; material and spiritual healing
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/health and healing; material and spiritual healing.txt
Quotation: Thou art He, O my God, through Whose names the sick are healed and the ailing are restored, and the thirsty are given drink, and the sore-vexed are tranquillized...Clothe him, then, O my God, by Thy grace, with the robe of well-being and health, and guard him, O my Beloved, from every affliction and disorder

Subject: health and healing; material and spiritual healing
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/health and healing; material and spiritual healing.txt
Quotation: Treat the sick with divine glad-tidings and cure the ailing with the supreme elixir of the All-Merciful's joy. Nurse the ill with hope and promise, and strengthen the weak with divine gladness. No treatment is better for the sick than spiritual joy and delight, and joy and gladness are confined to divine glad-tidings.

Subject: health and healing; material and spiritual healing
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/health and healing; material and spiritual healing.txt
Quotation: Just as when a physician gives bitter medicine to a patient, the patient protests and shouts that he does not want this bitter medicine and considers the physician an enemy, while the physician protects him - the patient complains and is not content. But this protection comes from love and the patient's complaints come from ignorance.

Subject: health and healing; material and spiritual healing
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/health and healing; material and spiritual healing.txt
Quotation: There are a number of diseases which are psychological. They have to be treated according to suggestive therapeutics. Those diseases that are due to psychological neurosis, treat them according to psychological neurosis and suggestive therapeutics, and those that are due to material causes then you have to give them the material treatment.

Subject: health and healing; material and spiritual healing
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/health and healing; material and spiritual healing.txt
Quotation: God be praised, according to what we hear the climate in that land hath proved not unfavourable. It is to be hoped that out of the grace of the Blessed Beauty thy illness will be completely cured and thou wilt return in the best of health. We here, God be thanked, are all enjoying the best of health. I have been better lately, and sleeping well at night.

Subject: health and healing; material and spiritual healing
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/health and healing; material and spiritual healing.txt
Quotation: When man becomes ill he should refer to a doctor, for he knows how to diagnose the illness. A good number of people in the Orient become afflicted with diseases, and the reason is that they do not refer to a doctor. For instance, these Arabs may have twenty children but only two or three will live; the others die, for when they become ill they do not refer to a doctor.

Subject: health and healing; material and spiritual healing
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/health and healing; material and spiritual healing.txt
Quotation: Due to lack of time to attend to the requirements of the patient regarding physician, medicine and nourishment, We have decided that he should return to 'Akka and rest there. We beseech God to adorn it with the ornament of healing and to change his illness into health. We beseech the Healer to deliver him from every ailment, sickness and disease. Verily, God is the Healer, the Sufficient, the All-Bountiful.

Subject: health and healing; material and spiritual healing
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/health and healing; material and spiritual healing.txt
Quotation: But you send to your children every eatable things - the result is the over-filling of their stomachs with different kinds of food - thus causing them dyspepsia, constipation and other ills but my children are always in good health and seldom complain of any sickness. Therefore you see that my parsimony is backed up by hygienic and physiological considerations while your extravagant family expenses lead to troubles.

Subject: health and healing; material and spiritual healing
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/health and healing; material and spiritual healing.txt
Quotation: Illnesses which occur by reason of physical causes should be treated by doctors with medical remedies; those which are due to spiritual causes disappear through spiritual means. Thus an illness caused by affliction, fear, nervous impressions, will be healed more effectively by spiritual rather than by physical treatment. Thou shouldst give equal attention to spiritual treatments, for they produce marvellous effects.

Subject: health and healing; material and spiritual healing
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/health and healing; material and spiritual healing.txt
Quotation: "Are these people who claim to surpass the other Christian sects in charity and good deeds to be considered possessors of a special excellence...As to healing the ills of the body and caring for the sick and the poor. This is very good, but its effect or result is not a permanent one. For when a man is healed of one physical pain, another will sooner or later affect him; and finally as a result, bodily death will overtake him."

Subject: health and healing; material and spiritual healing
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/health and healing; material and spiritual healing.txt
Quotation: The Prophet Job endured diseases, ailments and great tribulation until he plunged into the fountain of healing and was cured of an incurable malady. Without having to endure such affliction, tribulation and suffering, thou hast plunged into the true fountain of healing and hast attained eternal health. Thou hast found deliverance from every ailment and healing from every malady. This is everlasting health and eternal well-being.

Subject: health and healing; material and spiritual healing
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/health and healing; material and spiritual healing.txt
Quotation: If thou wishest to heal nervous pains, turn with thy whole self unto the Supreme Horizon with thy heart free from all else save Him and with thy soul attracted by the Love of God. Then seek the confirmations of the spirit from the Kingdom of Abha, while touching the place of pains, with all love, affection and attraction. And after all these matters have been conformed with, be thou assured that, verily, healing will be attained.

Subject: health and healing; material and spiritual healing
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/health and healing; material and spiritual healing.txt
Quotation: For instance if the brain is diseased and one becomes insane, but his hands and feet are all right... his head is diseased but his body is all right. One is suffering from cancer, every day the pain increases and it is worse than death, but his brain is all right. If they experiment on this suffering animal, and he should die, it will shorten his suffering. There are many diseases that can be discovered thru postmortem examination.

Subject: health and healing; material and spiritual healing
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/health and healing; material and spiritual healing.txt
Quotation: I will guarantee it. Be content. Let your heart be confident and assured that thru the bounty of Baha'o'llah everything will become pleasant for you. You must be assured. Know thou of a certainty. But you must turn your face wholly toward the kingdom of Abha, giving perfect attention; the same attention that Mary Magdalene had for His Holiness Christ. Be like her and I will assure you that you will get physical health and spiritual health.

Subject: health and healing; material and spiritual healing
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/health and healing; material and spiritual healing.txt
Quotation: This ailing world with its weakened body and feeble physique has fallen desperately sick and all its chronic maladies have become inveterate. There is no alternative now but to administer the one supreme panacea to relieve its ills and no other medicine left but the Most Great Elixir. This sovereign remedy is none other than the love of the Blessed Beauty and His Sacred Dispensation ordained by the One True God for it will speedily restore true health.

Subject: health and healing; material and spiritual healing
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/health and healing; material and spiritual healing.txt
Quotation: The body of contingent being has become afflicted with severe diseases, chronic ailments, contagious illnesses and continuous fever...He compounded elements of hidden jewels and stored medicines, bestowed the most great healing theriac, and granted the most perfect antidote. He prepared spiritual compounds and arranged remedies from divine pearls and rubies. He prescribed perspiration-inducing medicines, sedatives and solvents from the jewels of unity and the essences of detachment...

Subject: health and healing; material and spiritual healing
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/health and healing; material and spiritual healing.txt
Quotation: Set aside medicine when in good health, but take it when needed. When two contrary foods are served, mix them not but be content with one. Begin with the light food before the heavy, and with liquid before solid. The introduction of food upon food is dangerous - be thou cautious of this. Eating little in the morning is as a light unto the body. Abandon harmful habits, for they are a calamity unto mankind. Meet illnesses with their remedies - this utterance is the decisive word in this regard.

Subject: health and healing; material and spiritual healing
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/health and healing; material and spiritual healing.txt
Quotation: During treatment, turn thy thoughts to the Blessed Beauty and carry out whatever is inspired in thy heart. Treat the patients with divine joy and spiritual delight. Give the suffering ones the remedy of the Greatest Glad-Tidings, and bestow upon the wounded the salve of supreme bounty. When thou attendest any patient's bedside, grant joy and delight and gladness, and through spiritual power bestow divine attractions. This merciful breath is the bestower of life to decayed bones and the reviver of the spirit of every sick and ailing one.

Subject: health and healing; material and spiritual healing
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/health and healing; material and spiritual healing.txt
Quotation: Once during my early childhood I became very sick. At the time, my family lived in Teheran. I was lying in bed in a semi-conscious state. After much consultation the Doctors agreed upon a course of "musical treatment." Before sunset they brought into my room an old man with a very long beard. He carried under his 'Aba' a guitar. He sat near my bed and immediately began to play and sing. All through the night he played and sang, now in high, resonant voice and again in sweet, soft strains. My soul was charmed with his music. In the morning I felt better.

Subject: health and healing; material and spiritual healing
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/health and healing; material and spiritual healing.txt
Quotation: Thou hast inquired about the cure for the plague. The generality of the physicians are of the opinion that this disease hath no remedy and that there existeth no panacea for this malady. During the breakout of the plague, however, the extensive letting of blood, the consumption/intake of drinks of a cold nature as well as the drinking of large doses of barberry juice are of great benefit. Especially prior to being afflicted with this disease, and during the outbreak of the plague in the city or villages, if a person continues with such measures, he will be protected.

Subject: health and healing; material and spiritual healing
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/health and healing; material and spiritual healing.txt
Quotation: In the divine pharmacy there are a hundred thousand immediate remedies and true medicines, yet the patients are heedless and the sick are negligent. Everyone runs after harmful remedies and each soul seeks deadly drugs. Meanwhile, the supreme antidote and the instantaneous cure for the ills of the people of the world are the sacred teachings of the Ancient Beauty and true love for that heart-ravishing countenance. Therefore, as much as you can, apply this true antidote and spiritual remedy so that all chronic diseases of the horizons may be cured and all deadly ailments of the peoples may be healed.

Subject: health and healing; material and spiritual healing
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/health and healing; material and spiritual healing.txt
Quotation: The Blessed Beauty has explicitly commanded consultation with physicians. A person must even ask every minute detail from his physician. Furthermore, do not allow too many people to frequent his bedside, and let only a single person remain in the room to nurse the ill. Let the ill rest. The very air of tranquility will affect a cure. That is, once calm, serenity and peace have surrounded the ailing, they will greatly benefit his condition. Conversely, if many come, each visitor speaking his opinion, tarrying for a while, engaging the ill in conversation, then, obviously, he will be fatigued. There is nothing better than calm and quite.

Quotation: For healing, prayer and medicine, both are necessary. God has created the herbs and the plants with their useful properties. God has deposited in all the objects a definite effect. Disease is nothing else but a disturbance of equilibrium between the various organisms and functions of the body; healing is to gain again that equilibrium. When the measures of the various elements which go into the make-up of a healthy constitution are disturbed, sickness is produced. For instance let us suppose that there must needs be 2000 grams of saccharine element and 2000 grams of gelatine element in the body of man in order to live normally. Now when the quantities of these measures are disturbed, then, the body is attacked with disease. A course of treatment which will give back the normal standard to these elements will be conducive to health.

Quotation: You have asked concerning the verse: Abstain from eating two incompatible foods at the table. By incompatibility is meant foods and dishes whose ingredients do not agree with each other. However, Baha'u'llah hath not stipulated whether these foods should be specified according to the ancient school of medicine or the modern one. By it is meant that if two incompatible foods be served at the table, it is not advisable to partake of both. And this dependeth also on the state of one's health and on whether the digestive system is functioning properly or poorly. For instance to consume two courses of food which are not easily digestible or to eat two successive meals whose ingredients are both either cold or hot by nature, would hardly agree with a delicate constitution. Or perhaps one's natural disposition may be such that one cannot tolerate two different courses of a certain food or two dishes each of which would adversely affect the digesting of the other. Hence it would not be advisable to partake of these foods in quick succession. This is a matter that must be determined by physicians. Whatever foods a physician may forbid a person to eat successively should be regarded as incompatible.

Quotation: O people of medicine! God teacheth you all measures of wisdom that ye may be thankful. He hath created the bodies of all men together with what He hath created of their souls, their spirits and their hearts, and God knoweth what He hath created by His command, and if ye fear God, ye shall know. God hath created me possessed of equal powers, neither increasing in the first balance the higher force above the lower, nor the outer above the inner in aught. Thus hath God created me, and He hath not created anyone like unto me save those who are witnesses from their Lord. These were created from their Lord's light, and these are they that shall triumph. When ye touch the bodies of the believing men and believing women, glorify ye God and remember Him with praise, and profess the unity of God and magnify Him with His remembrance. This should be within yourselves without raising your voices, lest anyone among you should say what would grieve your souls. God is your Protector and the Protector of the believers. When ye remember God as He hath commanded you, every force that prevaileth in the body - God will surely inspire you then, and ye shall judge accordingly. Verily, dryness after moisture, and cold before heat, are calmed by the one water if ye but ponder its mystery. Verily, water that is not stagnant calmeth all heat in your bodies if ye glorify God and say: "God beareth witness that there is no God but Him. Say: All are His worshippers." And cold is calmed by milk whose taste hath not changed if ye praise God and say: "God beareth witness that there is no God but Him and that Muhammad is His Messenger, and all are devoted to Him." And all moisture is calmed if ye boil in hot water the leaf that cometh from China while ye profess the unity of God and say: "God beareth witness that there is no God but Him, and that those who are witnesses after Muhammad - these are the Imams of Truth, and all bow down to God." Say: Verily all forms of dryness are remedied by the preparation which the servants who remember not make among you nowadays, for they purify it and make it an essence. God hath permitted this unto you as a mercy from Him. And ye should make what ye prepare superior to that, and waste not yourselves in what ye prepare, and make delicate all that ye do lest anyone should surpass you in making a preparation. This is what God hath taught the physicians among you regarding the whole of medical knowledge, would they but ponder it. Say: His name is One, and His meaning in the Mother Book is One, wherein lies healing for all, as a mercy from God. He, verily, is the Truth, the One God. Even so does God gather all healing into one thing, that ye may witness the creation of all things in one thing, and order all your affairs by one command, and construct the chambers of your houses upon one door, whereby every door is opened by one word - one door. This, that ye may witness in the creation of all things the mystery of oneness in oneness. Glorified be He Who desires to expand your religion that ye might find delight therein.

A group of Christians from various regions have shown sincerity and affection, and have come to this land purely to investigate and examine... Nevertheless they are still hesitant... In any case, the Fire is ablaze, the Sun is shining, and the Light is manifest, yet the people are in great delusion.

Subject: heedlessness and ignorance of the people
Quotation: Thou beholdest how all the peoples of the earth remain heedless and veiled from the most exalted wine and the Kingdom of eternity, and like immature children are occupied with idle play, unaware that these fleeting days and all that is witnessed therein shall soon pass away. Though they witness with their outward eyes the conflicts and upheavals and changes of the world, their heedlessness increaseth with each passing moment.

Subject: heedlessness and ignorance of the people
Quotation: The wonder is that lifeless souls have not yet attained unto life and have not become aware of this Cause of such magnitude. One is astonished at what the divines of the earth are seeking and from what they turn away. Is it that due to the abundance of bounties they have become worthless in the sight of the ignorant masses, or have their deeds become embodied and deprived those polytheistic souls of awareness? Have the hearing and sight of all been seized?

Subject: heedlessness and ignorance of the people
Quotation: Glory be to God! They have forsaken the Kingdom of utterance and the heaven of knowledge, and have taken demons for their guides. We testify that they have taken for themselves lords besides God. The call of the King of the Kingdom of names hath been raised from the most exalted horizon in the nights and days, and the ocean of utterance hath appeared before the faces of all religions, yet the people remain heedless save whom God willeth, the Lord of the worlds.

Subject: heedlessness and ignorance of the people
Quotation: It is not known what has prevented the servants and deprived them from turning to the horizon of Revelation. Praise be to God, He has bestowed sight and granted hearing, yet as can be observed, though every soul is distinguished by these two great gifts, they are not employed in their proper place. The preoccupation of the servants with the desires of self and passion and the ornaments of this world has caused heedlessness, and when heedlessness gains strength it is transformed into error.

Subject: heedlessness and ignorance of the people
Quotation: Yet We found them in the realm of heedlessness of these messages - one breath of which transformed all existing things to the court of a praiseworthy nearness. Thereafter We appeared in truth among them with a beloved holy beauty, that perchance the lightning flashes of the Face might remind them and guide them to Him Whom they had been unitizing in their days, and immerse them in the depths of attainment to that station from separation from which the eyes of those near to God were filled with tears.

Subject: heedlessness and ignorance of the people
Quotation: Furthermore, prevent the people from turning towards the direction of God, for the situation in this land hath become entirely difficult. However, should souls sanctified from self and desire turn toward the Ultimate Goal, it would be beloved that they might perchance become aware of hidden matters and be informed of concealed affairs. Although the heedlessness of the people hath been witnessed to such a degree that nothing could exceed it, yet none hath been or shall be aware of the concealed soul and the cause and reason of her matter.

Subject: heedlessness and ignorance of the people
Quotation: The peoples of the world are fast asleep. Were they to wake from their slumber, they would hasten with eagerness unto God, the All-Knowing, the All-Wise. They would cast away everything they possess, be it all the treasures of the earth, that their Lord may remember them to the extent of addressing to them but one word. So bewildered are they in the drunkenness of their evil desires, that they are powerless to recognize the Lord of all being, Whose voice calleth aloud from every direction: There is none other God but Me, the Mighty, the All-Wise.

Subject: heedlessness and ignorance of the people
Quotation: The call is raised from every direction, yet the heedless servants have transformed light into fire, knowledge into ignorance, blessing into punishment, justice into tyranny, and fairness into oppression. They have risen in disputation and denied the divine bounty and heavenly feast. They have followed their own desires and perceive not; they have forsaken their God and know not; they have taken their vain imaginings as lords for themselves and understand not. Glory be to God! The people of the cities of wisdom and utterance are lamenting and bewailing the deeds and actions of the servants.

Subject: heedlessness and ignorance of the people
Quotation: By your life, O beloved, one is astonished at the heedlessness of these people - how they have veiled themselves from that which is best for them in this world and the next, and have clung to that which profits them not, oblivious to what the Creator of all things has intended for them. The people are asleep, knowing not what benefits them nor distinguishing it from what harms them. Had they known, they would not have denied this Cause which has appeared only to safeguard their rights, elevate their souls, protect their stations, and enable them to attain what is best for them in their beginning and their end.

Subject: heedlessness and ignorance of the people
Quotation: By night and by day the Divine Pen is in motion, its call is raised, and its horizon is luminous, yet the people of the earth are heedless and remote, save whom God willeth. All have been waiting by their own admission, and in the nights and days they have been uttering "Hasten, O God," yet when the veil was rent asunder and the gate of heaven was opened and the Promised One appeared, all arose in opposition save the quantity of the letters of the Face. They reflected not for a moment what was the cause and reason that all sought deliverance for that Being, may the spirit of all else be sacrificed for His sake. By the life of God! The people are in manifest drunkenness and in strange slumber.

Subject: heedlessness and ignorance of the people
Quotation: All the world has awaited this Day, and the divine Books have given glad tidings of this Most Great Manifestation to all, and the Prophets and Messengers have promised all peoples this Day. Yet when the Day of God dawned from the horizon of His Will and became manifest, all turned away save whom God wished. Reflect upon the heedlessness of men, who themselves say that when the Qa'im (may the spirit of all else be sacrificed for Him) appears, He will speak such a word that even the chosen ones will flee. This is what they all proclaim, yet they remain unaware to such a degree that they themselves have fled and distanced themselves from the exalted Truth, rising up with utmost opposition to extinguish the divine light and quench the fire of the divine Tree. The slumber of heedlessness has so overtaken them that they were not awakened by the Word of God nor roused by the Call.

Subject: heedlessness and ignorance of the people
Quotation: Despite this, these heedless people--that is, the masses of the negligent--are still submerged in endless slumber. They are utterly unaware of whence comes this boundless growth and development, from what sun's dawning comes this divine springtime, and from what cloud's effusions flow this infinite bounty. They behold the motion but think not of the Mover; they acknowledge the freshness and beauty of the spring season but are entirely heedless of the boundless bestowals of the divine springtime; they see the dust but perceive not the Horseman; they observe the motion of buildings but comprehend not the blowing of the winds; they hear the spiritual melody but are unaware of the mystic nightingale; they see the endless waves but know not of the limitless ocean; they eat delectable fruits but are heedless of the mystic tree; they observe the glitter of the glass but are unaware of the light of the lamp.

Subject: high station of learning
Quotation: Knowledge is love.

Subject: high station of learning
Quotation: The days of man and the life of the wise ones consist of an inscribed book, an unfolded parchment, and a preserved tablet wherein in all its pages and tablets events are written, and in all its leaves and wonders realities of occurrences and mysteries are inscribed.

Subject: high station of learning
Quotation: Speaking of the philosophers, they said: What hath illuminative philosophy accomplished in all this time? It could not produce even a match or a needle. It is all talk. But observe how natural philosophy hath yielded the telegraph, the steamship, electricity and so forth. For instance, had Morteza applied in mathematical sciences the same exactitude he devoted to jurisprudence, what discoveries he would have made.

Subject: high station of learning
Quotation: the promotion of useful sciences, the spread of universal knowledge, the expansion of innovations and crafts

Subject: high station of learning
Quotation: O king of the country of knowledge...Through the mercy of God ye became the king of the country of knowledge and the sovereign of the world of understanding.

Subject: high station of learning
Quotation: Those men are truly wise who are decorated with the ornaments of science and character; these are the head of the body of mankind. The ruling of man has always been in their hands.

Subject: high station of learning
Quotation: Make them proficient in every beneficial science and grant them a portion of every wonderful craft. Be ambitious and endure hardship. Learn to undertake important matters and encourage the pursuit of beneficial affairs.

Subject: high station of learning
Quotation: All sciences are acceptable and beloved at the Threshold of the Ever-Living, the Self-Subsisting. Whatever science is the desire of thy heart and the yearning of thy consciousness - acquire that, for it is acceptable and beloved.

Subject: high station of learning
Quotation: The attainment of the most great guidance is dependent upon knowledge and wisdom, and on being informed as to the mysteries of the Holy Words. Wherefore must the loved ones of God, be they young or old, be they men or women, each one according to his capabilities, strive to acquire the various branches of knowledge, and to increase his understanding of the mysteries of the Holy Books, and his skill in marshalling the divine proofs and evidences.

Subject: high station of learning
Quotation: Knowledge is the mightiest pillar of religion. Previously, all peoples believed that knowledge was contrary to religion, especially the Christians. Whoever pursued knowledge was said to have forsaken religion. Divine addresses praising those of knowledge are many.

Subject: high station of learning
Quotation: Although to acquire the sciences and arts is the greatest glory of mankind, this is so only on condition that man's river flow into the mighty sea, and draw from God's ancient source His inspiration. When this cometh to pass, then every teacher is as a shoreless ocean, every pupil a prodigal fountain of knowledge.

Subject: high station of learning
Quotation: How erudite and learned he was! He had marvelous knowledge of the contents of books. He was well informed of the tenets of every religion and had mastered the intricate laws and complicated customs of every nation - ancient and modern. He knew in detail the doctrines of every sect or party, and was a standard-bearer of the oneness of the world of humanity.

Subject: high station of learning
Quotation: This school is of utmost importance. In all existence there is nothing greater than wisdom. It is knowledge and learning that cause the advancement of nations. It is knowledge and learning that guide humanity and bring illumination. It is knowledge and learning that bring prosperity and development. It is knowledge and learning that transform a wasteland into a rose garden. It is knowledge and learning that make a wilderness into paradise. It is knowledge and learning that exalt abased nations. Therefore, in all existence, the most important of matters is knowledge and learning.

Subject: high station of learning
Quotation: For example, when one solves a scientific problem, a strange delight appears, or when one advances a good deed or great cause, joy and expansion of heart occur. It is written that Khwajih Nasiru'd-Din-i-Tusi, who was skilled in mathematics, would go to the roof some nights to observe the movements of the stars and make astronomical discoveries. Whenever he solved difficult astronomical problems, he would rise up and dance with intense joy, saying: 'Where are the kings to come and see wherein true joy lies? Let the monarchs of earth come and see wherein real delight exists!' This is why in the divine tablets the Blessed Beauty has so praised sciences and arts, encouraging and urging all to acquire them, for eternal happiness lies therein.

Subject: high station of learning
Quotation: You must ever concentrate your thoughts on the acquisition of knowledge, so that unlimited confirmations may continually descend upon you from the Kingdom of God

Subject: high station of teachers of the Cause
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/high station of teachers of the Cause.txt
Quotation: this most exalted and most glorious station - which is the station of teaching the Cause of the Lord of all beings

Subject: high station of teachers of the Cause

Quotation: strive with heart and soul to exalt the Cause of God, propagate the Law of God, and expand the circle of the Religion of God, forgetting every thought and becoming immersed in this thought which is the essence of eternal glory. For no matter save this divine gift has any importance, and no station except this most glorious, most exalted position has any elevation before the True One.

Subject: high station of teachers of the Cause
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/high station of teachers of the Cause.txt
Quotation: O thou Lion hearted Bashir. The Egyptian Basher brought back with him the garment of the Canaanite Joseph but thou art the bearer of the garment of the King of the City of Love. Behold the difference of thy station!

Subject: high station of teachers of the Cause
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/high station of teachers of the Cause.txt
Quotation: Whenever during his lifetime, the Blessed Perfection desired to signalize anyone with His special Favor, He encouraged him to go forth and teach the Cause of God. When He spoke to one of the pilgrims or wrote to a far-off Baha'i concerning the promotion of the Cause and inciting the former and the latter to arise and deliver the Message of the Kingdom, everyone felt instinctively that these souls were elected, the chosen ones, and that the Glances of Mercifulness had encircled them.... He used to say that the Teachers are the Israfels of God, who with the sound of their trumpets blow the Spirit of Life into the dead bodies of mankind.

Subject: high station of the arts and sciences
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/high station of the arts and sciences.txt
Quotation: By his arts, sciences, inventions and all of his work, man must reveal his highest capacity.

Subject: high station of the arts and sciences
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/high station of the arts and sciences.txt
Quotation: What bounty could be greater than this - that knowledge is considered worship and craft is considered service to the Kingdom of God?

Subject: high station of the true believer
Quotation: Verily, such a one is, in the sight of God, the Lord of all worlds, numbered among the companions of the Crimson Ark.

Subject: high station of the true believer
Quotation: O handmaiden of God who is near to Him! Your services and labors in this most glorious Cause are well-known and renowned

Subject: high station of the true believer
Quotation: But the faces of the loved ones, illumined by the light of the favors of the One True God, will shine resplendent forever and ever.

Subject: high station of the true believer
Quotation: Blessed is he who, endowed with vision, hath beheld the Most Great Panorama and followed that which was ordained by the Ancient Commander.

Subject: high station of the true believer
Quotation: But every heavenly daughter is like a brilliant star, shining from the horizon of existence forever. This is the station I desire for you.

Subject: high station of the true believer
Quotation: Were the station of faith to be made manifest today, all the sincere ones, the near ones, and the unitarians would perish from joy and gladness

Subject: high station of the true believer
Quotation: This is the station of the spiritual ones; this is the honor of the Bahais; this is the glory of the sincere ones and this is the sovereignty of the unitarians.

Subject: high station of the true believer
Quotation: Such blessed souls shine like brilliant stars from the horizon of eternal glory. You are successful in both worlds and renowned among the assemblage of humanity.

Subject: high station of the true believer
Quotation: Blessed are the people of Baha! By God, they are the solace of creation. Through them have the realms of creation been adorned and the Preserved Tablet embellished.

Subject: high station of the true believer
Quotation: Rejoice thou in what God hath ordained for thee and in His having made thee one of those whose faces He hath honored above all else. This is none other than an exalted station.

Subject: high station of the true believer
Quotation: O pure-hearted servant of the Lord God! You trod the way of the Ancient Beauty and took shelter in the shadow of the Most Great Name. Like an unerring arrow, you reached the goal.

Subject: high station of the true believer
Quotation: The entire visitation prayer section extols the high spiritual station of the deceased, particularly: "I bear witness that you believed in the Supreme Lord and the Primal Point..."

Subject: high station of the true believer
Quotation: We have ordained for thee in the Tablet a station which none can attain save those who have attained the presence of their Lord and have been illumined by the lights of manifest glory

Subject: high station of the true believer
Quotation: For the people of knowledge and understanding do not set their hearts upon water and clay, but rather they establish a mighty palace, seek a noble man, and take refuge in a strong pillar.

Subject: high station of the true believer
Quotation: These souls who have drunk from the chalice of steadfastness and independence in the Cause of the King of grandeur and majesty and who in all conditions look to the Lord of beginning and end

Subject: high station of the true believer
Quotation: I swear by the Sun of the heaven of inner meanings that if thou become aware of this most great, most exalted station, thou wilt in the nights and days utter "Thine be the praise, O God of the worlds."

Subject: high station of the true believer
Quotation: "Your friends and relatives, nay your father and descendants shall soon glory over this action of yours, that you have overcome such barriers and have come and lived among the disciples of Baha'o'llah."

Subject: high station of the true believer
Quotation: O handmaiden of God! If thou desirest eternal glory, arise to fulfill the conditions of servitude, for the handmaidens of the Blessed Beauty must each be a sign of guidance and a manifestation of the Most Great Bounty.

Subject: high station of the true believer
Quotation: How fortunate and blessed you were to become the recipient of such a favor that the ladies of kings and queens of the horizons have wished and still wish for, though they know it not now, but they shall soon become aware.

Subject: high station of the true believer
Quotation: Every soul that is firm in the Faith of God surpasses thousands of people in human perfections. One shining jewel prevails over a thousand pieces of rock, and one illumined heart is better than a thousand darkened hearts.

Subject: high station of the true believer
Quotation: It behooveth you to glory and pride yourselves over the queens of all regions, for yours is an everlasting, eternal sovereignty, in that ye have attained to servitude to the Ancient Beauty and service to the chosen ones of God

Subject: high station of the true believer
Quotation: Thou hast created loved ones whom Thou hast guided to the fountain of the Salsabil of faithfulness, whose eyes Thou hast illumined with the light of guidance, and whom Thou hast made to be mines of piety and dawning-places of the lights of fidelity.

Subject: high station of the true believer
Quotation: Every one of the friends of God in the world of the Kingdom hath the crown of eternal sovereignty upon his head and is seated upon a heavenly throne. They regard the hosts of this world as non-existent and behold the legions of wickedness crushed in defeat.

Subject: high station of the true believer
Quotation: It befitteth thee to pride thyself above all the queens of the world. For thousands of worldly queens shall come and go, leaving behind neither name nor trace, neither sign nor fruit; but through the light of God's love thou wilt shine forth above the horizon of eternity

Subject: high station of the true believer
Quotation: He is not a servant but a lord, not a subject but a sovereign on the throne of dominion. He is not lowly but exalted, not without standing but a leader. He would not exchange this sovereignty for the crown of East and West, nor would he trade this nobility for rulership over the whole earth.

Subject: high station of the true believer
Quotation: Though thou art His servant, yet art thou the master of the world, for thou art the devoted bondsman of the Abha Beauty, the King of Kings. That is, thou dost rule over the hidden realm and art sovereign in the kingdom of inner meanings. Thou art seated upon the throne of grandeur and majesty, and dwellest in the lofty palaces of sovereignty.

Subject: high station of the true believer
Quotation: By Him Who has caused Me to speak what He desires, your names are more renowned in the Supreme Kingdom than your names are among yourselves. Think not this utterance is vain imagination. Would that you could see what your Lord, the All-Merciful, sees of the loftiness of your station, the greatness of your worth, and the excellence of your rank!

Subject: high station of the true believer
Quotation: verily, your Lord, the Supreme, is calling upon you from His Ancient Kingdom and announces unto you such glad-tidings, whereat the hearts of the angels of heaven rejoice...Then ye will become the angels of heaven, will enter among the Supreme Concourse and will permanently abide in the paradise of union (with God), and will be associated with the Beauty of El-ABHA.

Subject: high station of the true believer
Quotation: At that time, the worth, station and rank of the divine friends becomes known, and the glory and loftiness of the sacred beings who are the beloved of the All-Merciful becomes understood... The purpose is that through the grace and gift of the Beauty of Oneness, the friends of God have such a station that the essences of existence would sacrifice their lives and become oblated for it.

Subject: high station of the true believer
Quotation: O people, look not upon the loved ones of God with contempt, for they are the most exalted of creatures in God's sight, even if in your eyes they appear as the lowliest of servants, were you but to perceive. A single hair of theirs is, in God's sight, better than those who appear ascetic before men to preserve their leadership, while in secret they commit what even Nimrod did not commit.

Subject: high station of the true believer
Quotation: This human being is one who has believed in Thee and Thy signs, turned toward Thy Kingdom, shown humility before Thy Might, been illumined by Thy radiance, sought victory through Thy holy angels, drawn from the ocean of Thy knowledge, been enlightened by the dawning-place of Thy subsistence, arisen to serve Thee, sought Thy servitude, persisted in Thy worship, spoke Thy praise, showed humility to Thy loved ones, and submission to Thy chosen ones

Subject: high station of the true believer
Quotation: O ye illumined beloved ones! Should ye comprehend how much ye are loved in the Kingdom of Abha, ye would surely open the wings and soar upward to the Most Great Height of Exultation and Happiness, Felicity and Bliss. The Hand of Power and Strength hath prepared Thrones Heavenly, provided diadem wrought with gems celestial, hath invited the souls of humanity and hath chosen the essences of mankind. Now arise ye, make ye an effort to establish yourselves upon those Thrones and crown your heads with those diadems refulgent.

Subject: high station of the true believer
Quotation:
O friends of God! Praise be to God that the ocean of bounty is surging, the cloud of grace is raining pearls, and the holy fragrances are diffusing musk. The Sun of the horizons has cast such a light upon the friends that its radiance will illuminate centuries and cycles. Give thanks to God that you are the manifestations of guidance and the dawning-places of bounty. If the veil and covering were lifted and the covering removed, you would see what a crown you wear upon your head and what a robe you wear upon your body. But due to divine wisdom, this bounty is now a hidden secret and a protected mystery, and in the future it will become manifest and evident.   AB00608
I swear by the Promised Beauty, the Praiseworthy King, and the Essence of existence that if the station and rank of the pilgrims were to become outwardly manifest and clear, all the tribes of the earth would make their eyes the dust of the footsteps of those who turn to Him, and their hearts the dust of those who seek Him.

Subject: higher encompasses the lower
Quotation: For instance, the fetus cannot imagine hearing and sight, and whatever you might convey would be mere fancy to it. For in the world of the womb these virtues and vices, these bounties and punishments do not exist for it to conceive of them. Now if someone were to explain to a fetus the virtues and vices of this world, and describe its bounties and punishments, could the fetus conceive of it? No, by God! Similarly is man's condition in the womb of this world. When he hastens to the other world, he observes that he has been delivered from a narrow and dark world and has entered into the divine world. Consider the ranks of physical existence - the mineral kingdom is entirely unaware of the vegetable kingdom, and [...] while the vegetable world exists, it is wholly unaware of the animal kingdom, for the vegetable capacity cannot encompass the perception of the animal realm, nor can it conceive of the faculty of the senses.

This edifice is situated on a mountainside and has several levels. In front of it they built a wall ten cubits high. It has two staircases, one on the right and one on the left. These staircases are sixty feet long, but they are remarkable stairs, with each step one-fourth and one knot in height. When you reach the top of the stairs, you turn right for sixty feet and left for fifty feet, totaling one hundred and ten feet. The staircases on the left similarly extend sixty feet to the left and fifty feet to the right, and these stairs are constructed such that a person's feet do not bend and horses can ascend and descend with perfect ease. When you reach the top, you see a platform that is four hundred and seventy cubits (470) in length and [two hundred and ninety] (290) cubits in width. It is a very large platform. Gushtasb built a gateway atop this platform, setting up four pillars. Atop these four pillars are four creatures. The body of the creature is like a bull, with a human head and wings. Behind these figures, they raised the pillars to nine cubits. This is a corridor through which one enters the terrace that had forty columns. This building was overseen by Gushtasb and completed by Isfandiyar. Here too the stairs are short. Up above is the forty-columned hall. The columns are very large and tall, though not monolithic. They are in three pieces but joined so perfectly that no seams are visible. Beyond the forty-columned hall, one reaches the buildings constructed by Darius. It has elaborate rooms. For example, its gateway consists of three stones - two large vertical pieces and one piece across. Its walls are of cut stone that still shine like mirrors to this day. It has such delicacy that one's reflection can be seen in it, but alas it has fallen into ruin. Most of the columns have fallen. Of the forty columns, thirteen remain standing. Quotation: The law of Jihad has ever been a veritable firebrand with which the Ulemas of Islam have threatened the world from time to time. In former ages its moral influence upon the army and the public at large was tremendous, because it placed in the soul of the soldiers an unconquerable spiritual motive. They were no more fighting for their country, they were fighting for the religion of God. If any one of them came out of the struggle alive he was satisfied because he had served his God and if he fell with the sword of the bullet of the enemy he believed he would go to Paradise and enjoy the fruits of a martyred life. Once this law was promulgated by the Sheik-ol-Islam, the power of restraining the religious fury of the Moslems was entirely out of his hand. Even if he desired he could not bring down the floodgate of fanaticism, till it had spent its fury and force. In these days, the law of Jihad is shorn of much of its spiritual power, because the Mohamadans have become more intelligent and are not easily swept away by a seeming torrent of prejudices. Some, however, think that the Mohamadan world is divested of much of its former Faith and Zeal on account of clerical innovations. Be it as it may, there is no need of much feverish anxiety on account of Jihad.... Moreover there are two kinds of Jihad: minor and major. Minor Jihad means fighting with the enemies of the religion of Islam; major Jihad signifies fighting with the enemy of the Self.  For this reason the following tradition is recorded from the lips of a god-fearing adept: 'From minor Jihad we have turned our attention to the major Jihad;- that is, we have quitted fighting with the outside enemy and are concentrating our forces on the defeat of the inside foe - the foe of the spirit.
