Quotation: I fain would hope that in this centre of materialists, the people of God will flourish and be victorious, that the divine foundation may be laid down

Subject: importance of community building
Quotation: Whatever place proves a focal point for the concentrated effort of the friends of GOD shall become a Center, provided, they live according to the Teachings of Baha'o'llah, consorting with one another in the utmost of love. Such a place will be at the Center be it Green Acre or elsewhere.

Subject: importance of community building
Quotation: O Solomon's hoopoe of divine majesty, make a journey to the verdant Saba and the blooming wilderness. You will find it prosperous, yet there are several ruined vaults. Build magnificent palaces and make a delightful paradise flourish. You will find a firm foundation and see the basis for the highest heaven established.

Subject: importance of community building
Quotation: What a wonderful meeting ye have arranged and longed for the beauty of service and have arisen to spread the fragrances of God! If this committee become firm, it will grow and develop; if it remain steadfast, it will become a gift of the Almighty to the human world; if it last, it will display marvelous signs for the well-being of the children of man!

Subject: importance of community building
Quotation: I hope all the friends of God and the maidservants of the Merciful will be assisted to attain to this gift... Announce to the believers in Baltimore the Glad Tidings of the infinite bounties of the Forgiving Lord and all of you - hand in hand - exert yourselves with heart and soul that day by day that region may become more illumined and your vast continent be perfumed with the fragrances of God.

Subject: importance of community building
Quotation: All we are servants of one Threshold, attendants at one Court, waves of one sea, drops of one stream, the dust before one door and plants of one garden. We must have general unity, not particular meetings. To organize assemblies is praiseworthy and acceptable, but these must be established for certain matters. For example: Assemblages for teaching, gatherings for the spread of the fragrances of God, gatherings for the relief of orphans, gatherings for the protection of the poor, assemblages for the spread of learning, societies of commerce, societies for the expansion of agriculture.

Subject: importance of prayer
Quotation: Give thanks to your Lord, then remember Him in the nights and days.

Subject: importance of prayer
Quotation: that thou mayest at every moment engage in praise, supplication and worship of the one true God

Subject: importance of prayer
Quotation: Know the value of this station and be occupied with His remembrance in the nights and days, detached from all else.

Subject: importance of prayer
Quotation: Worship and the prescribed mentionings of God should not be abandoned, for such worship is a requirement set forth in the Book of God.

Subject: importance of prayer
Quotation: Bear ye witness even as God hath witnessed, then remember Him at eventide and at dawn... Remember God at all times and glorify Him with His praise.

Subject: importance of prayer
Quotation: Glorify thy Lord with praise in the nights and days and say: Praise be unto Thee, O Beloved of the worlds and Goal of all who are in the heavens and on earth

Subject: importance of prayer
Quotation: you must occupy yourself day and night in the remembrance of God, engaging in supplication and prayer. You must recite the verses of divine unity and be raised up through the essence of sanctification

Subject: importance of prayer
Quotation: Know thou, O daughter of the Kingdom, that prayer and supplication are the water of life, they give life to existence and bring happiness and joy to souls. As much as thou can, be steadfast in them and call others to prayer and supplication.

Subject: importance of prayer
Quotation: Whensoever the worshipper communeth with his Lord, turneth wholly unto Him, and supplicateth some portion of His boundless grace, then this very act of supplication is a light unto his heart, a collyrium unto his eye, a source of life unto his soul, and a cause of exaltation unto his being.

Subject: importance of prayer
Quotation: the highest aspiration of any who is attracted to the divine Kingdom is that he should obtain some free time daily that he might supplicate and implore His Beloved and seek the divine bounties and blessings of God, and beseech Him to become immersed in the ocean of His divine summons.

Subject: importance of prayer
Quotation: Man becomes like a stone unless he continually supplicates to God. The heart of man is like a mirror that is covered with dust, and to cleanse it one must continually pray to God that it may become clean, and the act of supplication is the polish which erases all worldly desires. The delight of supplicating and entreating before GOD cuts one's heart from the world. Therefore, prayer is a key by which the doors of the kingdom are opened. There are many subjects which are difficult for man to solve. But, during prayer and supplication, they are unveiled, and there is nothing that man can not find out.

Subject: importance of prayer
Quotation: I beseech Thee at this hour, before the dawn breaketh in this month which Thou hast associated with Thyself and clothed in the garment of Thy glory and arrayed in the robe of Thy grace, wherein Thou didst formerly send down Thy verses and ordain therein the measures of Thy creation, that Thou mayest cause to descend upon the hearts of those who have ascended unto Thee that which befitteth the loftiness of Thy praise, and upon the spirits which have risen towards Thee that which befitteth the sublimity of Thy glorification, and upon the souls which have been consumed in the path of Thy love that which befitteth the exaltation of Thy unity, and upon the bodies which have been severed from all else save Thee, with all that they possess, that which befitteth the elevation of Thy magnification.

Subject: importance of reading the Sacred Writings
Quotation: Read ye the verses of God each day. Blessed is he who readeth them and pondereth thereon. He, verily, is of them that have attained.

Subject: importance of reading the Sacred Writings
Quotation: Blessed is he who readeth it and pondereth that which hath been revealed therein of the verses of God, the Almighty, the Mighty, the Chosen One.

Subject: importance of reading the Sacred Writings
Quotation: Read thou this Tablet in the nights and days. It will draw thee to a station wherein thou shalt hear from all things: "Verily, there is no God but Him, the Mighty, the All-Choosing."

Subject: importance of reading the Sacred Writings
Quotation: Rejoice in what hath been sent down unto thee in this Tablet, then recite it in the nights and days. By My life, through it thou shalt find the fragrance of the Garment wafting from this exalted Station.

Subject: importance of reading the Sacred Writings
Quotation: Preserve thou this Tablet, then read it and take comfort in it, and be of those who remember. Blessed is he who readeth the verses of God and pondereth them and draweth forth from their depths the pearls of a preserving knowledge.

Subject: importance of reading the Sacred Writings
Quotation: Preserve the verses of thy Lord, then recite them in the nights and days. By God! They shall draw thee to a station wherein thou shalt witness naught save the effulgences of the light of thy Lord's countenance, the Mighty, the Praiseworthy.

Subject: importance of reading the Sacred Writings
Quotation: And concerning what thou didst ask about the return - read thou the Book of Certitude which the All-Merciful revealed when the Light was shining from the horizon of Iraq. Thus doth the Lord of all horizons command thee from His exalted station.

Subject: importance of reading the Sacred Writings
Quotation: It behooveth thee to read the blessed Surih of Ra'is, as well as the Tablets to the Kings...It is most strange that your honor hath not seen the divine Tablets, for had you observed them, you would have become aware of the power and might of God

Subject: importance of reading the Sacred Writings
Quotation: Encourage other children also to drink from this Salsabil spring and partake of this pure water... O Lord! Assist his peers and equals to learn knowledge and wisdom and to study the Torah and Gospel and Qur'an and examine the Bayan and manifest wisdom and understanding.

Subject: importance of reading the Sacred Writings
Quotation: The Bible and Holy Books of other religions must always be studied and to be read in the Baha'i meetings. Their study will widen the circle of one's information and acquaint him with the wonderful prophecies fulfilled today. The reading and study of the Holy Books are essential so that man may become informed with the glad-tidings.

Subject: importance of reading the Sacred Writings
Quotation: We have counseled the servants to trustworthiness and religious devotion. In truth, the hosts that assist this Most Great Cause have been and are goodly deeds and praiseworthy character. Blessed are they who, through these hosts, open the cities of hearts in the name of the True One, exalted be His glory. Ask thou the True One to aid the servants to recite that which hath been revealed and to meditate upon that which hath become manifest.

Subject: importance of reading the Sacred Writings
Quotation: Concerning the question about this blessed verse--His words, exalted be His grandeur: Recite ye the verses of God morning and evening--the intention hath been and shall be all that hath been revealed from the Kingdom of Utterance. This is what the Desired One hath decreed. O Zein! The greatest condition is the inclination and love of holy souls for the recitation of verses. If one verse, or even one word, be recited with spirit and joy, it is better than reading numerous books.

Subject: impossibility of true worship of God
Quotation: I told him: "We are no soothsayer: none but God hath knowledge of the unseen."

Subject: impossibility of true worship of God
Quotation: Thou canst never be worshipped as Thou deservest to be worshipped, and none knoweth how Thou art except Thee alone

Subject: impossibility of true worship of God
Quotation: How can the servant praise Thee despite his poverty and non-existence? And how can paths to Thy knowledge be established in one who is in want, given his limitations and remoteness?

Subject: impossibility of true worship of God
Quotation: Glorified art Thou above accepting unto Thyself one who worshippeth Thee not, or prostrateth not before Thee, or acknowledgeth not Thy oneness, or submitteth not to the sovereignty of Thy singleness, or boweth not before the King of Thy unity.

Subject: impossibility of true worship of God
Quotation: Some worship Thee for what Thou givest them, some ask of Thee for what they desire of their needs, some abandon the world and its pleasures yet forsake Thy good pleasure in the Hereafter, some obey Thee out of fear, some worship Thee out of love...

Subject: impossibility of true worship of God
Quotation: O Lord! No allusions can approach Thy presence, and even detachment, though a form of praise, falls short. Yet by Thy glory, I seek naught but utter negation in the face of Thy revelation. Alas, alas, that I should make mention of Thy Self or attempt to proclaim Thy unity!

Subject: impossibility of true worship of God
Quotation: Should I say Thou art Thou, Thy Self and all Thy creation would give me the lie, for the servant can never know the Essence of his Lord nor unify the Reality of his Creator. Rather, in all conditions he knoweth the bounds of his own self and describeth openly his own reality.

Subject: impossibility of true worship of God
Quotation: How can I make mention of Thee after realizing that any remembrance of aught else but Thee befitteth not Thy presence? Reason saith: Make no mention of Him, for He hath ever been sanctified above the remembrance of all beings and exalted beyond the recognition of all creatures.

Subject: impossibility of true worship of God
Quotation: I have not known Thee as Thou didst bring me into being and deposit within my soul the sign of Thy revelation, and I have not worshipped Thee as Thou didst create me and inspire me with Thy remembrance of Thyself. Thou hast ever been manifest through Thy light while I remain veiled by my mention of Thee.

Subject: impossibility of true worship of God
Quotation: Thou wilt never be praised, nor glorified, nor thanked, nor unified, nor worshipped according to what Thou dost merit, for whatsoever proceedeth from the realities of contingent beings and is diffused throughout the kingdoms of earth and heaven are but signs created by Thy handiwork and manifestations realized by Thy invention.

Subject: impossibility of true worship of God
Quotation: O my God! The path to knowing the true essence of Thy signs as they are is impossible, and thus the impotence to truly know Thy signs is the most conclusive proof of the impotence to know Thee. O my God! The nearest of Thy signs to my soul is my own soul, and my soul's inability to know its own true essence is among the most self-evident facts to my soul.

Subject: impossibility of true worship of God
Quotation: How can one who has no way to comprehend the essence of knowing Thine eternity possibly worship Thee? Glorified art Thou above this, and exalted art Thou beyond that! All worship Thee according to what Thou hast created in them of the likeness of Thy creation, and all unite in Thy oneness through what Thou hast deposited within them of the signs of Thy handiwork.

Subject: impossibility of true worship of God
Quotation: O my God! How can I call upon Thee when the ultimate end of my supplication returns to my own self, complaining of the wickedness of what my soul hath wrought? And how can I not call upon Thee when my heart is ever enthralled by Thy love and cannot endure separation from Thee, nor remain silent from communing with Thee, nor stay distant from the seats of Thy nearness?

Subject: impossibility of true worship of God
Quotation: Glorified and exalted art Thou! None can point to Thy Being, for nothing hath existence at Thy level nor mention with Thee in Thy grandeur. When Thou didst manifest Thyself to all contingent things through the appearance of Thy creation, essences took on their essential nature by Thy command, and thus they described Thee in ways incapable of knowing Thine Essence. Had they known Thee, they would not have described Thee, and thus they have not unified Thee.

Subject: independent investigation of truth; reality
Quotation: Let them investigate with their own eyes.

Subject: independent investigation of truth; reality
Quotation: We counseled all in the Bayan to see with their own eyes and hear with their own ears in this Most Great Revelation

Subject: independent investigation of truth; reality
Quotation: We should strive to promote the truth regardless of what our opinions may be. In this way the divine confirmations will surround us. Our aim should be to promulgate reality, not our own opinions.

Subject: independent investigation of truth; reality
Quotation: "The first principle of Baha'u'llah is the Search after Truth" "If a man would succeed in his search after truth, he must, in the first place, shut his eyes to all the traditional superstitions of the past."

Subject: independent investigation of truth; reality
Quotation: Therefore, it is our duty to ever investigate reality, no matter what words or which lips utter that reality. We must investigate reality in whatsoever Book we may find it unrolled. We must investigate reality in the persons of whomsoever it may be revealed.

Subject: independent investigation of truth; reality
Quotation: By God, I speak not from idle fancy, but rather the Spirit speaks within my breast - this is my proof, if you be of the fair-minded... Say: O people! Do not as did the people of the Furqan, and place not the reins of your recognition in anyone's hands.

Subject: independent investigation of truth; reality
Quotation: The station of fairness requireth that no matter be accepted save through direct vision - that is to say, that man should witness with his own eyes and gain knowledge thereof. The intention is that one should not be content with mere hearsay regarding the Manifestation and its degrees.

Subject: independent investigation of truth; reality
Quotation: Two things are necessary today: one is the shattering of the idols of fancy and imagination that have existed before, and the other is attainment to the horizon of certitude. This is the station of the Most Great Steadfastness that hath flowed from the Most Exalted Pen in former Books.

Subject: independent investigation of truth; reality
Quotation: One should read and also gain insight into the depths of things. When these two are combined in one being, it becomes excellent. But if a person limits their thoughts to what scholars have said and written, it is of no benefit. These must be set aside and matters investigated experimentally from their foundation; one must search for truth, then new matters will become evident and clear.

Subject: independent investigation of truth; reality
Quotation: Everyone is giving an account of his religion and statements of his religion, the history of his religion. But there is no investigation of the realities. There must needs be an investigation of the Realities, for only through the reality will results be obtained; because thoughts are various, and imitations are so various. Therefore, we must investigate reality, discovering what Reality is.

Subject: independent investigation of truth; reality
Quotation: The first principle Baha'o'llah urged was the independent investigation of truth. "Each individual," he said, "is following the faith of his ancestors who themselves are lost in the maze of tradition. Reality is steeped in dogmas and doctrines. If each investigate for himself, he will find that Reality is one; does not admit of multiplicity; is not divisible. All will find the same foundation and all will be at peace."

Subject: infallibility; sinlessness ['ismat]
Quotation: He hath come with an authority before which neither the hosts of Pharaohs nor the ranks of tyrants can stand. Thus hath the Pen spoken when the Wronged One was established upon this exalted station.

Subject: infallibility; sinlessness ['ismat]
Quotation: I say, and upon God do I rely, that the disobedience of Adam, peace be upon him, is mentioned in the Wise Book, and God, glorified and exalted be He, said: "And Adam disobeyed his Lord, and went astray" and "We found no firmness of purpose in him." And He said concerning Dhun-Nun (Jonah), peace be upon him: "And remember Dhun-Nun, when he departed in wrath: he imagined that We had no power over him." And He addressed the Noble Messenger: "Verily We have granted thee a manifest victory: that God may forgive thee thy preceding and following sins." These verses speak explicitly concerning the Prophets and contradict the Most Great Infallibility, whereas the Holy Divine Manifestations are light upon light, untouched by the darkness of sins, and their divine reality is unsullied by traces of disobedience, for they are the suns of guidance, the full moons in darkness, and the stars of heaven. How then could darkness befall the sun, or veils and obstacles conceal the moon?... In brief, the noble Messengers, the great Prophets, the luminous Manifestations, the merciful Realities, the perfect Words, the conclusive Proofs, the brilliant Suns, the shining Moons, and the gleaming Stars - all their luminous inner beings are sanctified from the touch of darkness, and their divine consciences are purified from the stains of vain imaginings. God addresses them thus only for a wisdom, that those possessed of understanding might humble themselves and submit, and abase themselves before the Mighty, the Bestower, and not become proud even if they ascend to the highest chambers, but rather awaken to how the Ever-Living, the Self-Subsisting addressed the Great Beloved, the Honored Light, the Guide of nations, and the Speaker of the Most Great Name with such decisive address and reproof.

Subject: infallibility; sinlessness ['ismat]
Quotation: These holy Souls are sanctified above every sin and freed from every fault. These blessed Souls are light, and light cannot be united with darkness. They are life everlasting, and life cannot be gathered in with death. They are guidance, and guidance cannot be brought together with waywardness. They are the very essence of obedience, and obedience cannot join hands with rebellion.

Subject: infallibility; sinlessness ['ismat]
Quotation: How excellent is the state of the soul that has entered the divine sanctuary, which is the abode of infallibility and the place of God's manifestation, becoming stirred by the vibrations of beauty and delighting in the sweetness of reunion.

Subject: infallibility; sinlessness ['ismat]
Quotation: As to the question asked about the blessed word - although the exact verse is not in view - O beloved of my heart and the one remembered in my heart, most utterances are revealed in the language of the people, and in the heavenly Books there are many such instances. No one has been or is aware of the consummate divine wisdom and inner mysteries of the Lord, except for that which He Himself reveals and commands His servants to follow. The Primal Point - may the spirit of all else be sacrificed for Him - in one place states that "if anyone claims for Me special prophethood, guardianship or particular gateship, he has uttered falsehood and I am innocent of him". Yet in another place He speaks that which the reality of understanding is powerless to comprehend. The Truth, exalted be His station, is the possessor of the Most Great Infallibility, and the meaning of the Most Great Infallibility is that error, mistake and forgetfulness have no access whatsoever to that realm. This is the station of "He doeth what He willeth and ordaineth what He pleaseth." If He declares the qiblih to be toward the east, it is the indubitable truth, and if He declares it to be toward the west, likewise. Even as in the Qur'an, the Beloved of all possibility, in accordance with the command of the All-Merciful, turned toward the qiblih of Islam to which they turn today. "Were He to pronounce the earth to be heaven, no one hath the right to question why and wherefore." I swear by the Sun of Truth that were a breeze from the direction of this station to pass over the withered trees of possibility, all would be seen fresh and verdant. Blessed are they who understand.

Subject: infallibility; sinlessness ['ismat]
Quotation: Today is the day of true monotheism. All have been created by God's Word. The Most Great Infallibility belongeth exclusively to God, exalted be His glory - none shareth with Him in this station. The Letters, whether of the past or future, are all created beings, and the source of all is the Divine Word, and the educator of all is His grace.

Subject: infallibility; sinlessness ['ismat]
Quotation: For twelve hundred years and more they made mention of the Qa'im and related countless traditions and reports, yet failed to comprehend even a single letter of the signs of His appearance as they truly were. Every learned one who shut himself out from the ocean of knowledge hath lost, while every heedless one who hastened and drank hath said: "Praise be unto Thee, O Quickener of the worlds!" For years these souls were occupied with manifest and subtle polytheism, yet never perceived it. Those who were created by a single word from God's Messenger they regarded as his peer or even his superior. Though outwardly some would not admit this, yet from their statements and expressions this matter is clear and evident. Through ignorance they attributed the Most Great Infallibility, which belongeth solely to the True One, to His subordinates. They thus set up partners with God unknowingly, for they were among the ignorant. The station of the Most Great Infallibility is the station wherein God doeth what He willeth. In that realm there neither is nor hath been any possibility of error. Whatsoever proceedeth from the Source of the Unseen and the Dawning-Place of Revelation is and shall be the truth, and naught else is mentioned at this station.

Subject: infallibility; sinlessness ['ismat]
Quotation: This Wronged One hath ever been and still is occupied with the mention of the servants and handmaidens of God. We beseech God to adorn His handmaidens with the ornament of the Most Great Infallibility and to ordain for them that which shall be the cause of eternal mention and everlasting praise.

Subject: infallibility; sinlessness ['ismat]
Quotation: Know that infallibility is of two kinds: infallibility in essence and infallibility as an attribute. The same holds true of all other names and attributes: for example, there is the knowledge of the essence of a thing and the knowledge of its attributes. Infallibility in essence is confined to the universal Manifestations of God, for infallibility is an essential requirement of their reality, and the essential requirement of a thing is inseparable from the thing itself. The rays are an essential requirement of the sun and are inseparable from it; knowledge is an essential requirement of God and is inseparable from Him; power is an essential requirement of God and is likewise inseparable from Him. If it were possible to separate these from Him, He would not be God. If the rays could be separated from the sun, it would not be the sun. Therefore, were one to imagine the Most Great Infallibility being separated from the universal Manifestation of God, He would not be a universal Manifestation and would lack essential perfection. But infallibility as an attribute is not an essential requirement; rather, it is a ray of the gift of infallibility which shines from the Sun of Truth upon certain hearts and grants them a share and portion thereof. Although these souls are not essentially infallible, yet they are under the care, protection and unerring guidance of God--which is to say, God guards them from error. Thus there have been many sanctified souls who were not themselves the Daysprings of the Most Great Infallibility, but who have nevertheless been guarded and preserved from error under the shadow of divine care and protection. For they were the channels of divine grace between God and man, and if God did not preserve them from error they would have led all the faithful to fall likewise into error, which would have wholly undermined the foundations of the religion of God and which would be unbefitting and unworthy of His exalted Reality. To summarize, infallibility in essence is confined to the universal Manifestations of God and infallibility as an attribute is conferred upon sanctified souls. For instance, the Universal House of Justice, if it be established under the necessary conditions--that is, if it be elected by the entire community--that House of Justice will be under the protection and unerring guidance of God. Should that House of Justice decide, either unanimously or by a majority, upon a matter that is not explicitly recorded in the Book, that decision and command will be guarded from error. Now, the members of the House of Justice are not essentially infallible as individuals, but the body of the House of Justice is under the protection and unerring guidance of God: this is called conferred infallibility.... In sum, the meaning of "He doeth whatsoever He willeth" is that if the Manifestation of God issues a command, enforces a law, or performs an action whose wisdom His followers cannot grasp, they should not think for a moment of questioning His words or actions. All souls are under the shadow of the universal Manifestation, must submit to the authority of the religion of God, and are not to deviate so much as a hairsbreadth. Rather, they must conform their every act and deed to the religion of God; and should they deviate from it they will be reproved and held accountable before God. It is certain that they have no share of the station "He doeth whatsoever He willeth," for it is confined to the universal Manifestation of God.

Subject: infinity and eternity
Quotation: How large is the Creation of God! How stupendous is His machinery! How infinite is His dominion! How majestic is His divine system! How imperial is His Holy Court! They could then realize the grandeur and infinity of the universe. They would see with their own eyes how stupendous and magnificent are these shining stars. They would behold the wonders of the Almighty treasured in His Universal Creation.

Subject: infinity and eternity
Quotation: "The creation of God is infinite. The worlds of God are numberless...The light travels about one hundred eighty thousand miles in a second and there are certain stars, the light of which takes 8 yrs to reach the earth. Such is the infinitude of the universe of God."

Subject: infinity and eternity
Quotation: O Name of the Merciful, bear thou witness that God hath ever been and shall ever be a Living, Eternal Being, even as He hath been.

Subject: infinity and eternity
Quotation: when physical bounty is unlimited, how could spiritual bounty be limited? When a drop is unlimited, how could the ocean be limited? When an atom is unlimited, how could the sun be limited? When the physical world is infinite, how could the spiritual world be limited and finite?

Subject: infinity and eternity
Quotation: "Our guest is right, the human intellect cannot form a distinct idea, a clear conception of where and how time may cease and flow into eternity. It is not with logical understanding that we can capture the concept of eternity in the nets of our reason, but it is the mystic, the intuitive power of perception which approaches and touches this concept. Let me point, O my listeners, to the following fact: To the eternity of time belongs the infinity of space and the omnipotence and the imperishability of power (= might, creative power, original force). One without the other is wholly unthinkable and illogical."

Subject: infinity and eternity
Quotation: In its outward appearance it is a station of questioning, yet inwardly it is the station that bars the way for all created things. Then know the wisdom of its appearance from the words of the Almighty: The Night of Power is better than a thousand months. And know in that station that things are never devoid of three ranks: the eternal, which has neither beginning nor end; perpetuity, which has a beginning but no end; and time, which is realized through the motion of the supreme sphere by the rising of the sun and moon and the appearance of day and night.

Subject: innateness; early self-awareness of the Manifestations of God

Quotation: The Holy Spirit was always with Christ. He knew about his mission from early childhood. Yes [the Bab, Baha'u'llah and 'Abdu'l-Baha also knew of their mission from early childhood]. From childhood it was apparent to him, like the sun.

Subject: innateness; early self-awareness of the Manifestations of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/innateness; early self-awareness of the Manifestations of God.txt
Quotation: At age seven, one day as the Blessed Beauty was walking, His mother, observing His blessed figure, said He was somewhat short in stature. The father of the Blessed Beauty said, You do not know what capacity and capability He possesses, how intelligent and brilliant He is. He is like a flame of fire. At this young age He surpasses mature youth. In childhood He gained remarkable fame among friend and stranger alike, and the signs of divine gifts were clear and evident. He was beloved by all.

Subject: intelligible vs. perceptible realities
Quotation: Sensible realities are perceived by every moving creature, but intelligible realities are unveiled and observed by the seeing knower.

Subject: intelligible vs. perceptible realities
Quotation: There are three kinds of light... The third light is the light of the intellect. This has three functions. It is the manifestor, the seer and the comprehendor of phenomena.

Subject: intelligible vs. perceptible realities
Quotation: At most, it is possible to give hints, since in this world if thou desirest to describe an intelligible reality, thou art obliged to express it by means of sensible images. For instance, knowledge is an intelligible reality, and if thou desirest to explain it, thou might describe it as a sea. The state of that intelligible reality which compriseth knowledge hath become described through a sensible image which is the sea. This description is a hint, a symbol, a metaphor, an allusion. By this means, the listener is able to obtain a sense of that intelligible reality; otherwise, it is never manifested and revealed in the sensible world.

Subject: interconnectedness of the teachings
Quotation: The world of humanity will not be transformed into the heavenly paradise through the promotion of one, single principle. Every progressive principle which is the cause of the advancement of the world of humanity is like a simple element. A simple element does not produce a composite life. But when the elements are associated together then a being is brought into existence.

Subject: interconnectedness; all things involved in all things; chain of being
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/interconnectedness; all things involved in all things; chain of being.txt
Quotation: all beings, whether universal or particular, are mutually connected in accordance with God's consummate wisdom and mutually influence one another. Were it not so, the all-embracing organization and universal arrangement of existence would become disordered and disrupted.

Subject: interconnectedness; all things involved in all things; chain of being
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/interconnectedness; all things involved in all things; chain of being.txt
Quotation: We compare the body of the universe with the body of man. The members of the body of man are closely connected; so, also, are the parts of the great universe. In the body of man, all the members and parts are interdependent; for example, the heart feels the things seen by the eye; the ear hears, and the soul is thereby moved; the nostrils inhale a sweet odor, and the whole body is delighted. This is a proof that all the parts of the body of man are interrelated.

Subject: justice and mercy
Quotation: In truth, undertaking that matter personally was not permissible. However, the government has the right to carry out retribution through other means apart from the heir.

Subject: justice and mercy
Quotation: O Lord! If Thou shouldst pronounce the just to be unjust, who would dare protest? And if Thou shouldst deem the essence of oppression to be justice, who would dare claim otherwise?

Subject: justice and mercy
Quotation: The people of truth must beseech Him in the nights and days that the restraining veils may be rent asunder through divine power and the sun of justice and righteousness may illumine the world.

Subject: justice and mercy
Quotation: The human reality is adorned by divine mercy and just heavenly inspirations. Until this reality appears in its fullest splendor at the feast of Iran, the beauty of the desired goal will not be embraced.

Subject: justice and mercy
Quotation: We beseech the Most High at this moment to illumine him with the light of justice which shall endure as long as the Kingdom of God, the Mighty, the Wondrous, shall endure. O people! Hold fast to justice and fairness, and cling to the hem of God's religion.

Subject: justice and mercy
Quotation: Praise be to God that these matters, through divine will and thy endeavor and the justice and wisdom of his honor the Helper - may God assist him - were made clear and their reality became evident to all. Praise be to God Who aided him to vindicate truth and vanquish falsehood.

Subject: justice and mercy
Quotation: What is needed is mercy and justice and forgiveness and determination and wisdom, and with utmost supplication and humility we turn to the court of the Self-Sufficient Lord, that whatsoever benefits the radiant government and brings comfort to the obedient nation may be realized.

Subject: justice and mercy
Quotation: The justice and mercy of God is very difficult a subject and requires much reflection upon our Lord's words. First to know the meaning of justice. It is not equality, but the giving to everyone according to his right. The meaning of Justice is reward and punishment, when either one is due to the person to whom it is awarded.

Subject: justice and mercy
Quotation: "The object of punishment is not vengeance, but the prevention of crime." "If a person commit a crime against you, you have not the right to forgive him; but the law must punish him in order to prevent a repetition of that same crime by others, as the pain of the individual is unimportant beside the general welfare of the people."

Subject: justice and mercy
Quotation: For the kings of the world there has not been and is not any helper mightier than justice and wisdom... O concourse of rulers! There is no force in the world mightier than justice and wisdom. Blessed is the king before whose face marcheth the standard of wisdom and behind whom standeth the host of justice... The pavilion of the world's tranquility is upheld by these two pillars: justice and wisdom.

Subject: justice and mercy
Quotation: Justice is what Thou decreest, the ruling is what Thou pronouncest. There is no doubt that when the reality of matters becomes evident and manifest, whatsoever issueth from the source of supreme justice is the pure good of the subjects and the welfare of all the people...And when they had carefully examined the Ishraqat, the Most Holy Book, and other writings which constitute the greatest foundation of this community, they observed that all these petitions and appeals, all this clamoring and tumult and roaring, all these accusations, were pure calumny and absolute falsehood.

Subject: justice and wrath of God
Quotation: This indeed is unshakeable justice. For grievous indeed is thy Lord's chastisement.

Subject: justice and wrath of God
Quotation: after a universal revolution the Sun of Justice shall dawn from the horizon of the unseen

Subject: justice and wrath of God
Quotation: Justice is to give to each one his due, while grace is bestowal without deservedness or capacity.

Subject: justice and wrath of God
Quotation: Soon shall they find themselves in the clutches of death and receive the recompense of their deeds.

Subject: justice and wrath of God
Quotation: He hath spoken forth that whereby the balance of justice hath been established between earth and heaven

Subject: justice and wrath of God
Quotation: Verily We have sent down the Book of Justice wherein are ordinances from Our presence for people who act

Subject: justice and wrath of God
Quotation: Woe unto her and unto those who have taken her as their leader without any proof from God, the Lord of lords!

Subject: justice and wrath of God
Quotation: The blasts of chastisement shall assail them from all sides: He, verily, is the All-Knowing, the All-Informed.

Subject: justice and wrath of God
Quotation: Were I not beholding Thee, I would have destroyed the wicked ones and delivered My chosen ones from the fiery letters.

Subject: justice and wrath of God
Quotation: Erelong will ye witness the result of your deeds; for the Lord, My God, lieth in wait and is watchful of your behavior.

Subject: justice and wrath of God
Quotation: Prayer for divine justice against oppressors: "O Lord! Set upon him a dog from among dogs to crush his bones with its fangs."

Subject: justice and wrath of God
Quotation: No indeed, by God's Justice! None will be punished for another's deeds, nor will any be chastised for another's transgressions.

Subject: justice and wrath of God
Quotation: He exalts whomsoever He willeth and abases whomsoever He willeth...He hath established His Cause with justice throughout all the worlds

Subject: justice and wrath of God
Quotation: Soon shall they receive the recompense of their deeds... Not an atom's weight of deeds shall remain concealed on God's Day, nor ever shall.

Subject: justice and wrath of God
Quotation: The full account of the Albanian murderer being brought to justice through the persistence of his victim's dog, culminating in his execution

Subject: justice and wrath of God
Quotation: Surely those two just leaders are not content with such oppression and persecution and will cut short the hand of that bloodthirsty oppressor.

Subject: justice and wrath of God
Quotation: Soon you will see the corrupt ones in manifest loss...so that the corrupt may be distinguished from the righteous, and the ill-wisher from the well-wisher.

Subject: justice and wrath of God
Quotation: The day is approaching when the wrathful anger of the Almighty will have taken hold of them. He, verily, is the Omnipotent, the All-Subduing, the Most Powerful.

Subject: justice and wrath of God
Quotation: Thus hath it been decreed in the recorded Tablet... Fear ye God, O people, and walk not in the footsteps of them who disbelieve the presence of the All-Merciful.

Subject: justice and wrath of God
Quotation: Look, how the wrath of their Lord has overtaken them. I am the Wrathful, the Severe. We first seized them because through them the root of tyranny gained strength.

Subject: justice and wrath of God
Quotation: Consider with justice, O my God - that justice which Thou hast enjoined upon Thy servants... Thou art He Who hath established supreme justice between earth and heaven.

Subject: justice and wrath of God
Quotation: And We requite not those who denied Our signs except according to what their hands have wrought. God thy Lord will judge between people with truth, and He is the best of judges.

Subject: justice and wrath of God
Quotation: As for those souls who have become the source of oppression against the Cause of God, their station is in the lowest depths of existence, and this is the recompense of their deeds.

Subject: justice and wrath of God
Quotation: Verily thy Lord is ever watchful...He never overlooks injustice and transgression - He grants respite but does not neglect. Every soul will soon witness the recompense of their deeds

Subject: justice and wrath of God
Quotation: "We shall forget them as they forget Our presence, for We are all-powerful and all-encompassing... By God! He shall seize them and banish them as though they had never been mentioned."

Subject: justice and wrath of God
Quotation: Soon shall the fire and its rocks encompass them in the valley of Hell by leave of God, the Exalted, and nigh. This is your recompense from God for having been hypocrites in God's true religion

Subject: justice and wrath of God
Quotation: However, the All-Informed gave no respite to oppression and hypocrisy, and seized them, and He shall soon seize those who have committed tyranny on earth without clear proof or enlightening Book.

Subject: justice and wrath of God
Quotation: "God treats these people with His mercy, not with His justice, since God is against war." "Is it just to be so afflicted and killed and suffer and have no reward? This is contrary to the Kingdom of God."

Subject: justice and wrath of God
Quotation: Verily thy Lord will judge between men with justice on the Day of Resurrection, and not an atom's weight of injustice shall be done that Day. Glorified be God above what the wrongdoers ascribe to His judgment.

Subject: justice and wrath of God
Quotation: However if harm comes to the Cause of God, I cannot remain patient. Someone demolishes the house of the Cause while I stand watching, and he becomes upset asking "Why don't you join me in the demolition, fellow?"

Subject: justice and wrath of God
Quotation: Soon shall they discover what they have wrought when the angels of wrath seize them with a grievous punishment. Thus doth God distinguish between truth and falsehood, and between the monotheists and the idolaters.

Subject: justice and wrath of God
Quotation: Soon shall the blasts of His chastisement beat upon you, and the dust of hell enshroud you... Ere long, will God, with the Hand of Power, strip them of their possessions, and divest them of the robe of His bounty.

Subject: justice and wrath of God
Quotation: He, verily, is the Omnipotent, the All-Subduing, the Most Powerful. He shall cleanse the earth from the defilement of their corruption, and shall give it for an heritage unto such of His servants as are nigh unto Him.

Subject: justice and wrath of God
Quotation: Those who have disbelieved, God will seize them with a mighty vengeance from His presence. Soon shall come a day wherein none shall find for himself any protector. Then shall the unitarians rejoice in God's mercy and bounty.

Subject: justice and wrath of God
Quotation: I swear by the Sun of the horizon of the heaven of utterance that the All-Glorious Lord hath not and will not overlook the tyranny of the aggressors. Soon will He requite all according to that which their hands have wrought.

Subject: justice and wrath of God
Quotation: It would bestow bounty upon both the righteous and the wicked, and would illuminate the dwelling of both the sinner and the pious. It would shower its rays upon both the perfect and imperfect, the learned and the ignorant alike

Subject: justice and wrath of God
Quotation: Thou art God, my Lord, Thou knowest my needs, Thou seest my state and art well aware of what hath befallen me by reason of Thy decree, and of the earthly sufferings I have endured by Thy leave and as a token of Thy bounty and favour.

Subject: justice and wrath of God
Quotation: Those who plundered your possessions and seized what was yours are in manifest loss. God will soon seize them with His wrath, even as He seized aforetime those servants who wronged His loved ones without clear proof or illuminating Book.

Subject: justice and wrath of God
Quotation: We have seized him who arose in tyranny with a vengeance from Us. Verily, thy Lord is the Avenger, the Almighty. And We shall seize those who conspired with him in his designs. God hath cut down the tree of tyranny with the sword of justice.

Subject: justice and wrath of God
Quotation: This servant in all conditions beseeches and hopes that the All-Glorious Truth may make the rulers aware of the sweetness, delight, loftiness and greatness of justice, and not deprive His servants of this supreme bounty and most evident light.

Subject: justice and wrath of God
Quotation: How wilt thou answer the moaning and the lamentations of women before the throne of the Almighty on the Judgment Day? Yea, yea, what wilt thou say? Dost thou dare to plead not guilty before the Supreme Judge who seest the secrets of the heart?

Subject: justice and wrath of God
Quotation: Soon shall We punish those who warred against Husayn on the banks of the Euphrates with the severest chastisement and mighty retribution, in truth and by the truth... So await ye God's mighty seizure, in truth and by the truth, in the land of Hell.

Subject: justice and wrath of God
Quotation: "Know thou with clear certainty that God, exalted be His glory, is just, and assuredly according to the requirements of justice shall He requite those who led astray, the polytheists, the slanderers and the murderers. Not an atom escapeth His knowledge."

Subject: justice and wrath of God
Quotation: If the Truth were to arise to execute justice and turn towards the punishment of deeds, what would the people of Iran do? In some of the former Books He saith: The sword of vengeance is intoxicated; it distinguisheth not between the wise and the heedless.

Subject: justice and wrath of God
Quotation: God shall soon seize him who hath wronged, even as He seized the wrongdoers of the past. Verily thy Lord is the Almighty, the All-Compelling. Nothing can frustrate Him, no thing can prevent Him. He doeth what He willeth, and with Him is the Mother of the Book.

Subject: justice and wrath of God
Quotation: Not an atom's weight of injustice exists in your judgment...With you are the keys of Paradise and Hell - you cause to enter therein whom you will: people who were certain of your signs, and you cause to enter therein whom you will: people who denied God's signs

Subject: justice and wrath of God
Quotation: By the Truth, We shall make the polytheists taste the heat of the Fire with severe punishment, and We shall fully reward the patient ones with the finest reward in the Land of Saffron, according to the decree of the Book, from the judgment of the Gate, in comfort.

Subject: justice and wrath of God
Quotation: Know ye, verily, that an unforeseen calamity followeth you, and grievous retribution awaiteth you. Think not that which ye have committed hath been effaced in My sight. By My beauty! All your doings hath My pen graven with open characters upon tablets of chrysolite.

Subject: justice and wrath of God
Quotation: Soon shall perish that which hath occupied you and prevented you from attaining unto and drawing nigh unto the Self-Sufficient, the Most High. In this Most Great Revelation, God, exalted be His glory, hath not given, nor will He ever give, respite to the oppressors.

Subject: justice and wrath of God
Quotation: And do Thou send down, O God, upon those who have not believed in Him, all Thy chastisement and retribution, for Thou art the most severe in punishment and the most terrible in vengeance. Verily, Thou art severe in chastisement and Thou art, over all things, powerful.

Subject: justice and wrath of God
Quotation: Thus doth God love to take vengeance, for He is Severe, possessed of mighty strength. Thus doth God love to take vengeance, for He is the Subduer, possessed of mighty strength. When I addressed them both with verses of the Qur'an, how was it when ye saw God's verses in the Bayan?

Subject: justice and wrath of God
Quotation: And verily those who showed pride against Thee, even in their moment of pride were tormented by the fire of their unbelief and were chastised by the punishment of their associating partners with God. No flame is fiercer for them than this, nor any retribution and wrath greater than this.

Subject: justice and wrath of God
Quotation: Where are the swords of Thy vengeance, O Destroyer of the worlds? ... Therefore We took hold of the reins of wrath with a sovereignty from Our presence ... The angels of divine wrath suddenly seized them and made them a lesson to the worlds. May the All-Merciful not have mercy on their graves!

Subject: justice and wrath of God
Quotation: But suddenly the all-encompassing hand of divine power emerged from the sleeve of truth - the bonds were broken and the foundation of barriers collapsed. The chain, fetters and shackles of the prison of Joseph were removed from the necks of the wanderers and placed on the necks of the oppressors.

Subject: justice and wrath of God
Quotation: For Thy justice hath ever encompassed me, and Thy creative power hath ever been in my heart, and the punishment of Thy justice hath ever been before mine eyes. Alas! Alas! If Thou shouldst desire to punish me, or if Thou shouldst wish to call me to account, or if Thou shouldst want to take me to task!

Subject: justice and wrath of God
Quotation: He that cast justice behind his back has been seized, clinging to that injustice which caused the Manifestations of loving-kindness and bounty to lament. Glory be to God! To please an oppressor - that is, the Son of the Wolf - he committed that which caused God's wrath to encompass him from all directions and seize him.

Subject: justice and wrath of God
Quotation: Therefore, O my Beloved, seize them with Thy severe chastisement for what their hands have wrought. Verily, Thou art powerful over whatsoever Thou willest. Thou doest what Thou pleasest and ordainest what Thou desirest. Verily, Thou art the Originator and the Restorer, and Thou art the All-Hearing, the Answerer of prayers.

Subject: justice and wrath of God
Quotation: O concourse of rulers! Turn unto the poor; verily God hath created them and you from the selfsame substance. Let a portion of your wealth be shared by them. This is that which will profit you throughout all times and ages. Bestow a part of that which God in His grace hath given you; for thereby will your wealth be increased.

Subject: justice and wrath of God
Quotation: Ere long shall they who possess insight behold the oppressors of the earth in manifest loss and grievous torment. He is the Just One Who hath pledged that He will not overlook the tyranny of the oppressors. We testify that He will fulfill His promise and make manifest that which the Pen hath uttered in the arena of the Tablet.

Subject: justice and wrath of God
Quotation: When Hasan and Husayn were martyred and their days were ended, We seized the source of tyranny and oppression with a sovereignty from Our presence. Verily thy Lord is the Almighty, the Powerful. Soon shall We seize those who have oppressed even as We seized them aforetime. Thy Lord is verily the Ruler over whatsoever He willeth.

Subject: justice and wrath of God
Quotation: If but a particle of the mountain of His justice were to move, it would annihilate all hidden essences from the beginning that has no beginning until this time. And if a single flash of the lightning of His might were to surge forth, it would render non-existent all primary and ultimate manifestations, as if they had never been mentioned.

Subject: justice and wrath of God
Quotation: Make them taste, O my God, of Thine awful majesty and vengeance, for they have repudiated the truth of the One in Whom they had believed, Who came unto them with Thy signs and Thy clear tokens and the evidences of Thy power and the manifold revelations of Thy might. Thou art, verily, the One Whose power is immense, Whose vengeance is terrible.

Subject: justice and wrath of God
Quotation: Thus hath flowed from My Most Exalted Pen that which hath caused the eyes of them that are nigh to shed tears. We have seized him by whom all things have lamented, with an authority from Us and a power from Our presence. He, verily, is the Mighty, the Powerful. And We shall seize those who have acted unjustly without clear proof or illuminating Book.

Subject: justice and wrath of God
Quotation: By God, the Truth! Unto Us is your return in truth, then upon Us resteth your reckoning in truth, concerning that Gate which hath been inscribed round about the Letter B. What aileth you that ye ponder not the Qur'an in truth, seeking its true interpretation? Verily We shall reckon with you, by God's leave, on the Day of Resurrection, layer upon layer.

Subject: justice and wrath of God
Quotation: Forty days after the martyrdom of those two noble ones - on their fortieth day - the manifest Ruler seized the Imam of the polytheists through His power with an abasement beyond which none can be conceived. The Causer of causes thereafter brought about circumstances that led to complete discord between him and the governor, who is the son of the sovereign.

Subject: justice and wrath of God
Quotation: If Thou shouldst punish me with all Thy might, verily I am deserving thereof, for Thou art praised in Thy deeds and obeyed in Thy command. And if Thou shouldst admit me to the precincts of Thy nearness, to the paradise of Thy holiness and the throne of Thy manifestation, this would be naught but a token of Thy generosity toward me and Thy benevolence unto me, for I am not worthy thereof.

Subject: justice and wrath of God
Quotation: O people of the City! Fear God on the day when ye shall have no power over anything, and Our decree hath been inscribed in truth, by the truth. If ye persist in your ways and return not unto the remembrance of God, the Most High, in truth, upon truth, and soon - God will show you in the Day of Resurrection a fire that shall encompass your souls; on that day ye shall find no helper besides God, the Most High.

Subject: justice and wrath of God
Quotation: And among them is a sword against the polytheists of Arabia, as God the Exalted has said: Slay the polytheists wherever you find them, and take them, and confine them, and lie in wait for them at every place of ambush. But if they repent and establish prayer and give alms, then let them go their way. Indeed, God is Forgiving and Merciful. From these servants nothing is accepted except death or entering Islam.

Subject: justice and wrath of God
Quotation: And upon those who have not recognized the rights of these beloved Manifestations from the highest depths to the lowest atom, and these intended Dawning-Places in the last and the first, send down what befitteth the desert of Thy oneness. Verily, Thou art possessed of great vengeance against those who know not Thy right, and of mighty retribution against those who love not them who believe in Thee and Thy signs.

Subject: justice and wrath of God
Quotation: Had the blessed word In retaliation there is life not been sent down from the Kingdom of utterance, verily the pavilion of preservation would have been witnessed prostrate upon the earth, without pillar or support. In truth, this blessed word which was revealed in the Quran from the Kingdom of the All-Merciful's will hath been and shall ever be the cause and means of security, prosperity, tranquility and preservation.

Subject: justice and wrath of God
Quotation: The Lord God is not only the Almighty, but also the All-Merciful - for true might and power are always paired with kindness and goodness - and is at the same time the Just and the Avenger, we lowly creatures have to bow to His inscrutable decree and believe that the Potter in His absolute wisdom and goodness, in His justice and truth, creates, changes and completes everything to the best for the individual and for the whole.

Subject: justice and wrath of God
Quotation: Willingly I submit to a judge who, amazingly in his decree, Pronounced my blood lawful to shed both within and without the sanctuary. O Lord, make that judge content who gave the verdict for the shedding of this wanderer's blood both within and without the sanctuary of the Kaaba, while even hunting is forbidden in the sacred precinct. Yet that wretched one was so hard of heart that he made this servant's blood lawless both within and without the sanctuary.

Subject: justice and wrath of God
Quotation: Therefore, O my God, at this time do Thou chastise all Thine enemies, and the enemies of Thy Beloved, and the enemies of the Manifestations of Thyself, and the enemies of those who claim relationship to Thee... Seize them, O my God, through Thy might with a mighty seizure, for verily Thou art the All-Powerful, the Almighty. Chastise them, O my God, through Thy power with a great chastisement, for verily Thou art most severe in punishment and in retribution.

Subject: justice and wrath of God
Quotation: Verily We shall reckon with you by God's leave on the Day of Resurrection, examining thoroughly layer upon layer, and with truth upon truth, hair by hair... And your Lord, the All-Merciful, is never in the least unjust to His servants. If you do good, you do good for your own souls - this is the truth that exists from God your Lord upon the paths of the Gate around the water. And if you do evil, you do it against yourselves - this decree from you is inscribed in the Mother Book around the fire.

Subject: justice and wrath of God
Quotation: By God's all-compelling Will, these encompassing tribulations and calamities shall not be lifted save by the command of the Omnipotent. That which was revealed and recorded by the Supreme Pen in God's Book has befallen the oppressors, and its effects are evident and manifest at all times, yet most of the people understand not and are unaware. The fire of tyranny and its smoke have encompassed and veiled the light of justice. Assuredly the retribution for this heinous deed has and will return upon them.

Subject: justice and wrath of God
Quotation: He is the Just One Who, through the balance of reward and punishment, bestowed freshness and radiance upon the world of justice. In truth, the affairs that occurred in the Great City have become a cause of astonishment. People's wealth has been scattered to the wind, a great injustice has been inflicted upon justice, and the severest blow has been dealt to religion. His injustice reached such a point that the hand of power revealed his deeds and uncovered them. Verily He is the Avenger, the Just, the Wise.

Subject: justice and wrath of God
Quotation: And I, within the bounds of my earthly existence, when I behold one who walketh in the path of my good-pleasure, how can I not manifest the tokens of judgment concerning him since he hath not committed that which would necessitate judgment from Me and pardon from My presence? And should I witness in anyone attributes devoid of Thy love and good-pleasure, I must needs don the garment of judgment and forgiveness, and this is naught but from the abhorrence of my heart and what Thou lovest not to witness in my being.

Subject: justice and wrath of God
Quotation: The day is approaching when God will have exalted His Cause and magnified His testimony in the eyes of all who are in the heavens and all who are on the earth. Nothing whatsoever escapeth Him. He knoweth the secrets both of the heavens and of the earth. His knowledge embraceth all things. Rejoice not in what ye have done, or will do in the future, nor delight in the tribulation with which ye have afflicted Us, for ye are unable by such means as these to exalt your stations, were ye to examine your works with acute discernment.

Subject: justice and wrath of God
Quotation: The kings, among all the peoples of the world, both high and low, have been and are foremost in the sight of God, for they are the dawning-places of might and power and the daysprings of justice and equity. If they are illumined with the light of justice, this oppressed people have, in both night and day, besought from God - exalted be His glory - for them that which is lasting and enduring. Blessed is the king who hath seized the reins of his passion, conquered his anger, and preferred justice to tyranny and fairness to oppression.

Subject: kindness to and rights of animals
Quotation: When you boil water, and the sheep and the cow raise their cries of anguish, both sets of organisms feel the agony of torment and murder.

Subject: kindness to and rights of animals
Quotation: The animal, like unto man, is very dear to the people of truth. Therefore, man should be kind to both man and animal, and should strive as much as possible towards the comfort and protection of animals.

Subject: kindness to and rights of animals
Quotation: It is not permissible even to strike an animal. When an animal is trained properly, it becomes domesticated. The Arabs do not strike their horses as they train them, for they say that striking the horse will make it ill-tempered and unruly.

Subject: kindness to and rights of animals
Quotation: This animal has always been my companion; whether at home or on the road he has faithfully guarded me against danger... This is a trained dog who has been my constant companion, accompanying me on all my travels. It has performed good and faithful service and has rescued me many a time from life-threatening danger.

Subject: kindness to and rights of animals
Quotation: Man can live without meat. To kill an animal and eat his flesh seems to be cruelty, but today it is almost impossible for the people not to eat the flesh of animals. Every act can be done with tyranny or with justice. In vivisection justice and not tyranny should be practiced. If they do not give chloroform to a healthy animal it is tyranny.

Subject: kindness to and rights of animals
Quotation: The love shown by animals is instinctive and not dependent upon their own will--that is, they are endowed with their qualities and use them in a natural way, but not by their own will. As these qualities are instinctive and not voluntary, animals will not be rewarded. Their benefits are confined to this word only. A dog shows affection by instinct and not by will.

Subject: knowledge of self
Quotation: Cast off yourself and come. Abandon this commanding self.

Subject: knowledge of self
Quotation: I soar in the kingdom of the heavens and the earth and whatsoever is between them only that I may recognize Thy handiwork within myself.

Subject: knowledge of self
Quotation: As for the way to reach this pivot, know thou that attaining unto the station of thine own reality is attaining unto thy Lord, and it is the station of pure God-fearing

Subject: knowledge of self
Quotation: Whosoever hath cleansed the mirror of his heart from the rust of desire hath become worthy of this divine raiment and hath delivered himself from the nakedness of ignorance.

Subject: knowledge of self
Quotation: Know then that the purpose of creation hath ever been and shall ever be the knowledge of God, and this knowledge dependeth upon the recognition of His servants who perceive the Truth through their own vision and heart and nature, for imitation sufficeth not, whether in acceptance or rejection.

Subject: knowledge of self
Quotation: Thou must look to thyself and within thyself and find thine own errors and weaknesses. If thou hast any imperfection thyself, try to improve it. Busy thyself with thine own improvement. Man is a blind far-seeing creature. He is blind to his own faults but he sees the faults of others, thousands of miles away.

Subject: knowledge of self
Quotation: Therefore break thou the idol of self, that thou mayest take up abode in the hiding place of the Friend. Pass beyond passion, that thou mayest wing thy flight to the Egypt of immortality. Purify the city of the heart, that thou mayest behold the Beauty of the Divine Essence and become quickened by the Holy Spirit from spirit itself.

Subject: knowledge of self
Quotation: Consider, for instance, the rational soul which is a divine trust deposited within human beings. Observe within thyself how movement and rest, will and purpose, and all else above and below these, as well as hearing, sight, smell, speech, and other outward and inward senses, all exist through its existence. Indeed, were its connection with the body to be severed even slightly, all these senses would be deprived and prevented from their effects and actions. This is most evident and known, that the effect of all these aforementioned causes is dependent and conditional upon the existence of the rational soul, which is a sign of the manifestation of sovereign Unity. Through its manifestation all these names and attributes appear, and through its concealment all become non-existent and perish.

Subject: knowledge; recognition of God
Quotation: Every soul who today desires to drink from the chalice of divine knowledge and attain the light of certitude must first purify their heart with the water of the utterance of Him Who is the Aim of all worlds.

Subject: knowledge; recognition of God
Quotation: Mankind has been created to know God

Subject: knowledge; recognition of God
Quotation: The purpose of creation hath been the knowledge of God

Subject: knowledge; recognition of God
Quotation: Sulfur is the fire of the love of God, and mercury is the sea of the knowledge of God

Subject: knowledge; recognition of God
Quotation: "May Haji 'Abdu'llah be like the surging and billowing ocean of divine recognition at all times."

Subject: knowledge; recognition of God
Quotation: God willing, may you drink in all days from the Kawthar of the knowledge of the Lord of all beings

Subject: knowledge; recognition of God
Quotation: Text discusses "divine knowledge" and "flowers of wisdom and mysteries" sprouting from divine water

Subject: knowledge; recognition of God
Quotation: But when he looks at God, he feels God is near to him, and feels God's power, Greatness, Bounty and Love.

Subject: knowledge; recognition of God
Quotation: Why, from among all the people of the world have we attained the blessing of knowing the Truth and coming here?

Quotation: After ascending to the heavens of inner meanings, the wayfarers attain to three stations, meaning that the manifest Sun shines and becomes revealed in the mirrors of existing things according to these three ranks, although some consider the ranks of determinations to be five and have named them the five presences. Were I to explain in detail, a book would not suffice and I would not be able to fulfill it, just as that divine mystic and knower of divine mysteries, the lordly Imam, mentioned a drop from these stations in defining the world of the heart, which has surely come to your noble attention - that the final rank of these three stations is the journey from God unto God. In this station and rank, existence is effaced from self and subsists through the Truth. All are from God and unto God shall they return, and "Say: All things are from God" is sufficient witness and adequate proof of this point, as the mystic of Rum has said:  "The seeker's attributes are annihilated in His attributes, While his essence remains through the survival of His Essence."  This station certainly has no laws and seeks no customs, meaning all His deeds are pure justice even if outwardly they appear as injustice, and pure knowledge even if in form they appear as ignorance.

Quotation: The letters (alphabet) and the numbers (arithmetic) have a mystic correspondence with transcendent reality. The letters and numbers are the elements of the spiritual and material worlds.
