Subject: language and the structure of reality
Quotation: Angelic and human, celestial and aerial, fiery are her fragrant breezes - southerly, easterly, westerly, northerly - all directions are her directions. And when thou hast understood this, know that Writing is likewise. For when letters are elevated and enter their gardens, all letters become one letter, all words one word, all languages one language, and all grammatical forms one form. Then a single word becomes noun and verb and particle, declinable and indeclinable, variable and invariable, subject and object, possessed and possessor, subject and predicate, circumstantial phrase and specification - unto infinity. A single governing word effects nominative, accusative, genitive and jussive cases, while a single governed word becomes nominative, accusative, genitive and jussive by condition. Thou seest not the nominative as other than the accusative, nor the accusative as other than the genitive, nor the genitive as other than the jussive. Each word indicates every meaning, and a single word becomes singular and dual and plural, masculine and feminine. When thou hast understood this, O precious youth, solace of the discerning ones, mirror of the wise, lamp of the learned, light of the mystics, radiance of the monotheists, brother of prophethood and mine of divine authority - may God preserve him from the eyes of the oppressors - when he desired that people should know that station and that drops might splash upon them from that vast ocean, they recoiled from him and turned back on their heels, saying "We have never heard the like of this; this is naught but error." God slay them for their lack of understanding! This eloquent nightingale warbled upon the tree of origin and return. And since he - peace be upon him - was of the people of that Faith, his words must needs be thus, for the effect resembles the qualities of its cause. This is no proof of imperfection, rather it is proof of perfection in the eyes of those possessed of perfection who have attained the pinnacle of moderation. Woe, utter woe unto those who say that he - peace be upon him - knows not grammar and morphology! How could he not know, when the essence of all knowledge is in his hand and the reality of all things is with him? The essence of grammar is with him, and the essence of morphology. These people have naught but the husks and outer forms that neither nourish nor satisfy hunger.

Subject: language and the structure of reality
Quotation: Then know, O my strong confidant, that the name is the mark of the thing as it is in its essence. It has ranks, among them that mirrors its grace, words its limit, forms its attribute, and inscribed images its trace. For every book according to the decree of all is from God, inexhaustible. God has made words as bodies for spirits which are meanings, and God has written with His hands between them a true relationship, and there was naught between them save as between the Kaf and the Nun.

Subject: law of Huququ'llah
Quotation: The Blessed Beauty hath emphasized through His decisive Word that the utmost honesty hath to be observed in matters related to the Huquq. The institution of Huquq is sacred.

Subject: law of Huququ'llah
Quotation: The law of Huququ'llah has been made obligatory and binding in the Book of God, as it is the cause of progress, steadfastness, firmness and the attainment of blessings for the giver

Subject: law of Huququ'llah
Quotation: The Huquq is received and spent by permission of the Center of the Covenant. If there are small amounts of Huquq in those regions, you are authorized to distribute them among the poor.

Subject: law of Huququ'llah
Quotation: As for the Right of God, wherever it is found, it is best that it be given to the poor of that land. Well is it with them that act in accordance with what they have been bidden by the Mighty, the Paramount, the All-Wise.

Subject: law of Huququ'llah
Quotation: Last year there flowed from the Most Exalted Pen concerning the payment of the Rights of God that which is recorded in the Tablets. These are the Rights which have been prescribed for everyone by God and were formerly ordained.

Subject: law of Huququ'llah
Quotation: And concerning those servants of God and handmaidens who were enabled to pay the Rights of God and sent them - these were received. Praise be to God, they were confirmed in that which was revealed in the Book from the Supreme Pen.

Subject: law of Huququ'llah
Quotation: As to the matter of Huquq, place no one under pressure, nor make any remark to anyone! If any sincere and sacrificial soul should, with complete willingness and pleasure, offer something as Huquq or as assistance to the poor, then thou mayest accept it.

Subject: law of Huququ'llah
Quotation: Regarding what was written about the Huquq, according to the command, that which must reach the Right should be delivered to the beloved Aqa Mirza Muhammad-Taqi, upon him be the Glory of God and His grace, and the receipt thereof should be forwarded to the Most Holy Court.

Subject: law of Huququ'llah
Quotation: The payment of the Rights of God is obligatory upon all and its ordinance hath been revealed and established by the Most Exalted Pen in the Book. However, demanding and insisting upon it is never permitted. If anyone is enabled to pay it and delivers it with joy and radiance, it is accepted; otherwise, no.

Subject: law of Huququ'llah
Quotation: The demanding of the Rights of God hath never been and is not permissible. This decree hath been revealed in God's Book for certain necessary matters which have been ordained through divine causes. If someone, with utmost contentment and joy, nay rather with insistence, wisheth to attain this bounty, it may be accepted; otherwise, no.

Subject: law of Huququ'llah
Quotation: It was written to some that since the friends in Persia demonstrate the utmost sacrifice, there is therefore no need to accept it from elsewhere. In America and other places, they are authorized by the permission of Abdu'l-Baha to spend the Huquq in their own necessary areas, and this authorization is considered payment of the Huquq, for it is like a draft.

Subject: law of Huququ'llah
Quotation: My brother Ustad Kazim, from whom no good effects have been witnessed, has multiple veils. Among them is that this humble one had sent two payments for the Huquq - once through His Honor the Trustee, upon him be the Glory of God, and once through His Honor Afnan, upon him be all the Most Glorious Glory. One payment arrived and they wrote it in my brother Ustad Kazim's name.

Subject: law of Huququ'llah
Quotation: First must they arise to pay the Rights of God if they are able, for this deed is the greatest means for the rectification of outward affairs and inward conditions, and for attaining the good pleasure of God, exalted be His glory. Otherwise, verily thy Lord is the All-Bestowing, the Compassionate, the Bountiful. Moreover, it is the cause of the purification of one's wealth.

Subject: law of Huququ'llah
Quotation: After one has paid all his necessary expenses 19% of what is left is taken by him and given as Huquq. For example if a person has 100 piastres left after all his expenses have been paid, then 19 piastres are taken as Huquq for the Cause of God. This is done at the end of the year after he has ascertained what his expenses are. For every hundred piastres, 19 are taken for Huquq.

Subject: law of Huququ'llah
Quotation: Regarding the Huquq, all was forgiven and bestowed through His grace, including the Huquq of the departed one, upon her be the Glory of God. In this regard, they said: We beseech God, blessed and exalted be He, to shelter her beneath the shadow of His mercy and to send down upon her from the heaven of His bounty that which will gladden her heart and the hearts of the devoted ones in the chambers.

Subject: law of Huququ'llah
Quotation: Since 'Abdu'l-Baha absolutely does not wish to impose on anyone, you and Jenab-i-Amin must send with utmost speed ten thousand tumans from what is available to Haji Mahmud Qa??abchi in Baghdad, for the construction of the House requires at least thirty or forty thousand tumans, and this is among the most pressing expenses that cannot be delayed. According to the people, it is more obligatory than prayer.

Subject: law of Huququ'llah
Quotation: There was a paper with the names of friends who had given the Huquq in previous years, and those rights were transferred to the assembly of Hamadan for the maintenance of schools and other terrestrial expenses. Last year they wrote from Hamadan that some Huquq had been collected, and it was written that it should be spent in Hamadan itself for organizing schools, educating children, and training orphans.

Subject: law of Huququ'llah
Quotation: "As to what was written regarding the Huququ'llah, thus far in that land no one has been appointed to receive the Rights of God. For several years the matter of Huquq was suspended, as permission for its collection had not been issued from the Source of the Cause. In recent years this blessed word shone forth from the tongue of the Divine Unity - exalted be His utterance: 'Whosoever desires to pay the Rights of God, let the Trustees receive it.'"

Subject: law of Huququ'llah
Quotation: Until this year, this servant always heard these words from the tongue of Grandeur regarding the Huququ'llah, saying that no one should demand Huququ'llah from anyone, as this depends on the success and pleasure of the servants themselves to pay with complete contentment and submission. However, this year, in view of current affairs and apparent conditions, they said that each of the loved ones of God upon whom Huququ'llah has become binding must pay it.

Subject: law of Huququ'llah
Quotation: As for the Huquq, half of what is prescribed hath been adorned with the ornament of God's forgiveness, and the remainder may be paid gradually whenever divine confirmations arrive. O Letter Ha! God is witness and testifier that although the Huquq belongs to God Himself and is mentioned in all heavenly Books, were it not for this concession, not a penny would have been accepted. However, as a token of grace and worthiness, some has been accepted for the sake of God.

Subject: law of Huququ'llah
Quotation: Concerning what was written about the Rights of God (Huququ'llah), truly much trouble hath been caused to your honor. After it was presented before the Most Holy and Exalted Presence, He said that the benefits of charitable deeds return to the souls themselves, and in these matters the utterance of a single word sufficeth. Whosoever payeth it with the utmost joy and radiance, with submission and contentment, it is acceptable before God; otherwise, He verily is independent of all worlds.

Subject: law of Huququ'llah
Quotation: As to what thou hast mentioned regarding the Rights of God, this pertaineth exclusively to God, exalted be His glory. It must be sent to the Holy Court. The matter is in His hands. He doeth what He willeth and ordaineth what He pleaseth. Since thou hast inquired, this answer hath been sent down from the heaven of bounty. This matter is obligatory upon all, and the honor of all lieth in its payment, for it is the cause of the purification of one's possessions and the source of blessing and increase in bounty.

Subject: law of Huququ'llah
Quotation: Thou hadst asked about Huquq. I do not wish to write anything regarding this matter, but ask Mr. Wilhelm as he is aware and will explain it. In brief, after having deducted the yearly expenses, if there remains anything from trade, Huquq will be applicable to it at the rate of nineteen percent, and no further payment of Huquq will fall due on this amount. In the following year however, after the annual expenses, if there is profit in excess of expenditure, then Huquq will again be applicable to this excess amount after deducting that year's expenses.

Subject: law of Huququ'llah
Quotation: As for the matter of the Huquq funds you sent through Ahmad, since all communication is completely cut off, it remains with him and will arrive later. And since you asked how you should send any Huquq or poor-relief funds if you wish to send them, it is now written that you should send them through a very trustworthy and experienced person who can go from America to Germany, from Germany to Vienna, from Vienna to Constantinople, and from Constantinople to the Holy Land. In this way it is possible, and the amount should be either in British or French currency.

Subject: law of Huququ'llah
Quotation: As for the Huququ'llah, that which was revealed in the Most Holy Book is nineteen mithqals for every hundred mithqals, whether of gold or silver or existing possessions. Likewise rights have been designated for the House of Justice, and prior to its establishment and its members, the disposal thereof has been and will be dependent upon God's leave. Beseech God, glorified and exalted be He, to aid the people to pay the rights, for if all were to comprehend the fruit of this deed and not withhold the divine rights, the friends in that land would not experience hardship.

Subject: law of Huququ'llah
Quotation: As to the question of Huquq: Reference to this matter is in no wise permissible. We have formerly enjoined upon you and Jinab-i-Amin that which will redound to the glory and dignity of the Word of God and of His Cause. Touching on this particular subject We have bidden thus: Ye may relinquish the whole world but must not allow the detraction of even one jot or tittle from the dignity of the Cause of God. Jinab-i-Amin -- upon him be My glory -- must also refrain from mentioning this matter, for it is entirely dependent upon the willingness of the individuals themselves.

Subject: law of Huququ'llah
Quotation: That which you wrote concerning the mention and service of the friends of God, especially regarding the honored friend J.L.H., may the glory and favors of God rest upon him, and his intention, as well as the payment of the Rights of God by all, was presented at the Most Holy Court. His blessed and exalted Word: "Praise be to God, they are blessed with His favors, steadfast in service, speaking His praise and turned toward His face. However, since they are engaged in service and their station is that of the friends and wayfarers, the payment of the Rights depends on their own will."

Subject: law of Huququ'llah
Quotation: With regard to the beloved and honored Amin, upon him be the Glory of God and His grace, you wrote concerning his traveling to collect the Huquq and that without this he would not come. Therefore it was written to him to come to this land that perchance some may, God willing, become enabled to pay the Huquq. Whosoever today succeeds in paying the Rights of God is among those who have acted according to the commandments of God, exalted be His majesty, and have attained to that which hath flowed from the Most Exalted Pen. However, We have ever written and commanded that none should make demands.

Subject: law of Huququ'llah
Quotation: The draft of 200 pounds you had sent through Ahmed Yazdi has been received. And similarly the draft of 1000 (a thousand) dollars which you had sent payable to Mirza Jalal. Likewise a sum of twenty pounds has been received from Miss Root. This is all that has been received from you and through you from those regions. In your letter dated February 15, you had written that next week I expect to forward some Huquq through the Anglo Egyptian Bank at Haifa. So far it has not been received. All that has been sent through you so far (i.e., 420 pounds) has been distributed among the poor immediately. But the poor people are numerous and in the utmost need.

Subject: law of Huququ'llah
Quotation: Concerning the Huquq, it has not been restricted to his honor the Trustee, upon him be the Glory of God. It was said that whatever reaches him is executed and approved. They have said that it is absolutely not permissible for anyone to direct his attention specifically to the Huquq for any purpose. The intention must be the remembrance of God and the promotion of the Cause. Had outward exigencies not required it, the command to collect would not have been given. Even as in the early years its collection was forbidden, but later, in view of the victory of the Cause and the exaltation of the Word, it became necessary and the command to collect the Huquq was given.

Subject: law of Huququ'llah
Quotation: whatever has reached your honor regarding the Huququ'llah from any soul and any place has reached this evanescent servant through the King of Martyrs, His Holiness the Name of God "?", upon him be all the most glorious Baha. We beseech God to assist those who have acted according to what they were commanded in the Book and to send down upon them from the heaven of His grace a blessing and mercy and benediction from His presence. Verily He is the Mighty, the Bestower. In truth the matter of divine rights is a great matter, incumbent upon all to fulfill, for it is the cause of bounty and blessing and goodness and whatsoever accompanies every soul in every world of the worlds of their Lord, the Self-Sufficient, the Generous.

Subject: law of Huququ'llah
Quotation: From these fifty tumans, as commanded, five tumans were spent on hospitality on his behalf, and certain arrangements were made regarding the aforementioned souls, upon them be the Glory of God. The handmaiden of God who had the honor of serving the House of her Lord, namely the noble lady Sayyidih, upon her be the Glory of God, gave five tumans for her daughter. That sum was received here and the aforementioned hospitality was provided from it. And the aforementioned fifty tumans were assigned to be delivered to the beloved of the heart, His Holiness Samandar, upon him be the Glory of God, that he might distribute that sum along with the twenty-four tumans to the friends of God, exalted be His Glory, according to the distribution document.

Subject: law of Huququ'llah
Quotation: It is certain and evident that the Incomparable One is always praised for His absolute wealth, distinguished for His all-embracing mercy, characterized by His eternal grace, and known for His gifts to the world of existence. Nonetheless, in accordance with His inscrutable wisdom and in order to apply a unique test to distinguish the friend from the stranger, He hath enjoined the Huquq upon His servants and made it obligatory. Those who have observed this weighty ordinance have received heavenly blessings and in both worlds their faces have shone radiantly and their nostrils have been perfumed by the sweet savours of God's tender mercy. One of the tokens of His consummate wisdom is that the payment of the Huquq will enable the donors to become firm and steadfast and will exert a great influence on their hearts and souls. Furthermore, the Huquq will be used for charitable purposes.

Subject: law of Huququ'llah
Quotation: For a number of years Huquq was not accepted. How numerous the offerings that on reaching Our presence were returned to the donors, because they were not needed then. However, in recent years We have, in view of the exigencies of the times, accepted the payment of the Huquq, but have forbidden solicitation thereof. Everyone must have the utmost regard for the dignity of the Word of God and for the exaltation of His Cause. Were a person to offer all the treasures of the earth at the cost of debasing the honour of the Cause of God, were it even less than a grain of mustard, such an offering would not be permissible. All the world hath belonged and will always belong to God. If one spontaneously offereth Huquq with the utmost joy and radiance it will be acceptable, and not otherwise. The benefit of such deeds reverteth unto the individuals themselves. This measure hath been ordained in view of the necessity for material means, for averse is God from putting aught into effect except through its means. Thus instructions were given to receive the Huquq.

Subject: law of Huququ'llah
Quotation: Questions were submitted concerning the divine ordinances, and from the Dayspring of grace this answer shone forth and appeared, these are His words, exalted be His glory: O Zaynu'l-Muqarrabin! God willing, may you be successful through God's grace in all worlds. Your questions are accepted before the Throne, for in them lies benefit for all creation. We have specifically commanded you to inquire about the divine laws and verses. When a person acquires ownership of one thousand mithqals of gold and pays its Huququ'llah, no further Huququ'llah is payable on that property unless it increases through trade and business dealings and reaches the amount subject to Huququ'llah - that is, on any profits derived therefrom. In such cases, one must act according to what God has decreed. However, if the property passes into other hands, Huququ'llah becomes payable on it again as it was the first time. The Primal Point has stated that Huququ'llah must be paid on the value of all things that one possesses, but in view of His supreme bounty, We have exempted household furnishings and one's residence - that is, such furnishings as are needed.

Subject: law of burial and cremation
Quotation: Moses passed away and no one knows the place of his death nor his cave. Elijah passed away in a cave on Mount Carmel and no one knows his tomb. Christ's tomb was in a garbage dump until Helena found it

Subject: law of burial and cremation
Quotation: Regarding the efforts of the living for the dead in preparing, embalming, shrouding and burying them - this too is clear evidence for protecting the living from germs that spread from the dead, but in a way that shows respect and consideration, not degradation, destruction and ruin. The handmaiden of God Barney asked about the wisdom of burial in the earth, given that cremation has a swifter effect in dispersing bodies and preventing decay of the dead.

Subject: law of burial and cremation
Quotation: As for the burial of the dead, it would be better if for now it remained as before, for we must not act in such a way as to cause complete separation between friends and strangers, as separation is an obstacle to teaching. When the time comes that the execution of the laws will in no way cause hearts to be troubled and the Cause of God is openly proclaimed, then in Turkistan they should face from east toward west inclined to the north, and bury the dead with head toward the Qiblih and feet toward the north.

Subject: law of burial and cremation
Quotation: The arrangement of all cemeteries should be in this manner: four wide paths like the shape of a cross in the center, the width of each path being at minimum two yards, and in the center of the four paths a water fountain should be built. In this way the width of the land is divided into four sections. Each section should be divided in the same way in the shape of a cross, and each grave should have flower beds one yard wide on all sides - right, left, above and below - meaning the graves should not be connected to each other.

Subject: law of burial and cremation
Quotation: In short, the composition and decomposition, the gathering and scattering and journeying of all creatures must proceed according to the natural order, divine rule, and the most great law of God, so that no marring nor impairment may affect the essential relationships which arise out of the inner realities of created things. This is why, according to the law of God, we are bidden to bury the dead....  Thus the ancient Egyptians mummified the body that it might remain intact to the end of time, their belief being that the longer the dead endured, the nearer they would draw to the mercy of their gods. Yet the Hindus of India cremate the body without any concern, and indeed the burning is a solace to their hearts. This lack of concern, however, is fortuitous: it deriveth from religious beliefs and is not a natural thing. For they suppose that the more rapidly the body is destroyed, the nearer it will come to divine compassion. This is the opposite of what the ancient Egyptians believed. The Hindus are even persuaded that, as soon as the body is with great rapidity disintegrated, forgiveness will be assured, and the dead will be blessed forevermore. It is this belief which reconcileth them to the cremation.

Subject: law of burial and cremation
Quotation: the graves of the divine friends should outwardly appear like palaces...Each grave should be in a flower garden. And if beautiful trees were planted around the cemetery and around the fountain, that would also be desirable.

Subject: law of cause and effect
Quotation: O questioner! Act not before knowledge, and seek not from other than the source. For everything a cause hath been ordained, and for every matter an outlet. If thou desirest it, be not heedless thereof. Enter every house through its door. Thus was it revealed aforetime and now in this perspicuous Tablet.

Subject: law of cause and effect
Quotation: Thus combination, arrangement, pairing, blending, composition and synthesis became the cause of life in all things, while analysis, separation, dispersion, dissolution and decomposition became the cause of death and non-existence.

Subject: law of cause and effect
Quotation: Irrevocable fate is likened to how a lamp's oil will inevitably burn out, while conditional fate is like a strong wind that may or may not extinguish the lamp before its oil is consumed. This demonstrates the operation of natural cause and effect.

Subject: law of cause and effect
Quotation: It is the inherent nature of fire is to burn, the inherent nature of electricity is to give light, the inherent nature of the sun is to shine, and the inherent nature of the organic earth is the power of growth. There is no separation between a thing and its inherent qualities.

Subject: law of cause and effect
Quotation: God established the term for the sake of causes, and God raised the book through the rulings of effects, so that nothing of existence would be missed from the Book except that they would find it explained as to causes in this Book and clarified as to reasons in the mystery of this Gate.

Subject: law of cause and effect
Quotation: Yet when you look at nature itself, you see that it possesses neither consciousness nor will. For example, fire's nature is to burn - it burns without will or awareness. Water's nature is to flow - it flows without will or awareness. The sun's nature is to shine - it shines without will or awareness. Vapor's nature is to rise - it rises without will or awareness.

Subject: law of cause and effect
Quotation: Laughter is caused by the slackening or the relaxation of nerves. Laughter is the visible effect of an invisible cause. Happiness is caused either by looking at a beautiful picture of witnessing a delectable panorama or associating with the person whom you love or listening to a good voice or solving an intellectual problem. All these are the motives of happiness but the real cause is spiritual.

Subject: law of cause and effect
Quotation: The great events which happen are due to this connection. There is day, there is night; sometimes there are eclipses, etc.--all according to the requirements of this Divine system. Even unpleasant things, such as chill in the feet which is felt in the head, a disagreeable odor which affects the whole system, or trifles (which are endless, and seem to be accidental) such as a small hair appearing in an unusual place on a man's face, should also be considered as having a place or part in this general system. Therefore, what we call an accident is the effect of the connection of all the parts, and no events transpire in vain.

Subject: law of divorce
Quotation: Divorce is forbidden according to the explicit text of the Testament, but there is no conclusive text in it prohibiting the plurality of wives. Monogomy came into practice after his holiness Christ.

Subject: law of divorce
Quotation: As to the matter of thy wife, if it is as thou hast written, separation and divorce are permissible under the Law of God, and this is after one year of separation. When the impossibility of maintaining the marriage is established and one year of separation has elapsed without reconciliation being achieved, the divorce becomes final.

Subject: law of divorce
Quotation: Question: If, during the year of patience, if the fragrance of love emerges and then aversion occurs, and throughout the year there is alternation between aversion and inclination, and the year ends in a state of aversion, does separation occur or not? Answer: In any case, whenever aversion occurs, the year of patience begins from that day and must complete its course.

Subject: law of divorce
Quotation: "As regards divorce, Baha'o'llah says that if a husband and wife cannot agree, there should be a preliminary separation of one year. If at the end of a year there is no reconciliation, then divorce is permissible. Because both sides would be in torment, separation is better. In the Bahai marriage the husband and wife must be in the utmost of happiness together."

Subject: law of divorce
Quotation: Marriage and divorce must be carried out with the knowledge of the government or through those in authority, otherwise difficulties will arise. In any case, marriage and divorce must be administered under an effective center, so that should either party seek to undermine them, they would be powerless to do so, but rather be compelled to obey, and upon thee be the Most Glorious Glory.

Subject: law of divorce
Quotation: "Although divorce is allowable, yet it is hated and blamable by God. Divorce is allowable, and can take place under such circumstances as these which are here mentioned: That is, if there is nothing else to be done in the matter, if both sides hate one another, and if they are in perpetual troubles. Now if such is the case with you both, perform the divorce. But after being divorced, you ought to wait for one year until it becomes firm"

Subject: law of divorce
Quotation: Formerly in Persia divorce was very easily obtained. Among the people of the past Dispensation a trifling matter would cause divorce. However, as the light of the Kingdom shone forth, souls were quickened by the spirit of Baha'u'llah, then they totally eschewed divorce. In Persia now divorce doth not take place among the friends, unless a compelling reason existeth which makes harmony impossible. Under such rare circumstances some cases of divorce take place. Now the friends in America must live and conduct themselves in this way. They must strictly refrain from divorce unless something ariseth which compelleth them to separate because of their aversion for each other, in that case with the knowledge of the Spiritual Assembly they may decide to separate. They must then be patient and wait one complete year. If during this year, harmony is not re-established between them, then their divorce may be realized.

Subject: law of divorce
Quotation: As for the question of equal rights between men and women in the matter of divorce that you had written about: Marriage and wedlock are contingent upon the consent of both parties, but separation and divorce are dependent upon the will of the husband alone. The wife alone does not have such authority to seek separation and obtain divorce after one year. This is the decree of God. However, after the wife's aversion, the husband's obstinacy is quite inappropriate and contrary to human nobility. Surely a divine person would not be content to remain bound in attachment to an unconscious wife in a state of aversion. As soon as he senses aversion, he would surely let her go and grant separation and divorce.

Subject: law of fasting
Quotation: "Then he spoke about fasting and how it is necessary for the rich to think of the poor during the month of Ramadan."

Subject: law of fasting
Quotation: There is many a divine wisdom in fasting. Among them is this: that, in the days when He Who is the Dayspring of the Sun of Truth engages, through divine inspiration, in revealing the verses of God, in establishing His religion, and in setting forth His teachings, He is so enraptured and enkindled as to find no time for food or drink. For example, when Moses went up to Mount Sinai to establish the religion of God, He fasted for forty days; and fasting was therefore enjoined upon the Israelites to awaken and admonish them. Likewise Christ, at the beginning of the foundation of His divine religion, the establishment of His teachings, and the formulation of His admonitions, disregarded for forty days all physical necessities and refrained from food and drink. The Apostles and early Christian believers also fasted, but this fast was changed by the Church Councils to abstinence from certain foods. Similarly, the Qur'an was revealed during the month of Ramadan and therefore the fast was enjoined during that period. In the same way, in the beginning of His manifestation, the Bab would be so overcome with emotion at the revelation of the divine verses that for days He would confine himself to drinking tea. Likewise, in the days when He was instituting the divine teachings, and when the divine verses would be sent down continuously, Baha'u'llah would be so overwhelmed with the intensity of their influence and the emotions surging within His heart that He would take but little food.... The second wisdom is that fasting is conducive to spiritual awareness. One's heart grows more tender, one's spirituality is increased, and as a result one's thoughts become purely focused on the remembrance of God. Such awareness and awakening leads inexorably to spiritual progress.  The third wisdom is this. There are two kinds of fast: material and spiritual. The material fast consists in abstaining from food and drink, that is, refraining from satisfying the physical appetites. But the true and spiritual fast is for man to forsake covetous desires, heedlessness, and evil and animalistic attributes. The material fast is therefore a symbol of that spiritual fast. It is like saying: "O Divine Providence! As I am abstaining from bodily desires and from all occupation with food and drink, even so purify and sanctify my heart from the love of anyone save Thyself, and shield and protect my soul from corrupt inclinations and satanic qualities, that my spirit may commune with the breaths of holiness and fast from the mention of all else besides Thee."

Subject: law of fasting
Quotation: The law of the Fast is ordained for those who are sound and healthy; as to those who are ill or debilitated, this law hath never been nor is now applicable.

Subject: law of fasting
Quotation: These are the days of the Fast. Blessed is the one who through the heat generated by the Fast increaseth his love, and who, with joy and radiance, ariseth to perform worthy deeds.

Subject: law of fasting
Quotation: Fast ye for the sake of your Lord, the Mighty, the Most High. Restrain yourselves from sunrise to sunset. It is not for anyone to exceed the limits laid down by God and His law, nor should anyone follow his own idle imaginings.

Subject: law of fasting
Quotation: Difficulty is not a preventative. But if fasting gives rise to inharmony it is injurious. If there be a preventative, it should not be kept. As far as one possibly can, yes; but if there be any preventative at any time, no. But after sunrise one cannot eat.

Subject: law of fasting
Quotation: If one arrives during the fasting month at a place where one will stay for one Bayanic month, one should break the fast for three days, then fast the remaining days. If one returns to one's permanent residence, one should begin fasting from the first day of arrival.

Subject: law of fasting
Quotation: The days which Thou hast named the Ayyam-i-Ha (the Days of Ha, Intercalary Days) in Thy Book have begun, O Thou Who art the King of names, and the fast which Thy most exalted Pen hath enjoined unto all who are in the kingdom of Thy creation to observe is approaching.

Subject: law of fasting
Quotation: And among Thy sincere and acknowledging servants I have explained the ruling about what emerges from the chest to the mouth during fasting - that he should expel it from his mouth, and it is not valid if he was deliberate in his action. Thou forgiveth those who cannot control themselves

Subject: law of fasting
Quotation: QUESTION: Some of the friends think the life is so strenuous in America that it is not possible to work there and keep the Fast.  'ABDUL-BAHA: In the Torah the command for fasting is from sunset to sunset for three days. For three days and three nights they, the Jews, take nothing. This is not obligatory.... But now, in this Revelation, it is for only twelve hours-very little.

Subject: law of fasting
Quotation: Concerning fasting, as you wrote, this is a matter of great importance, so observe it with the utmost diligence. It is among the very foundations of God's Law and a pillar of God's religion. Assuredly must fasting be given the utmost importance. By the Ancient Beauty, were trees and stones and clay to hear this address and follow what they are commanded out of love for Thy Self, they would surely observe an eternal fast.

Subject: law of fasting
Quotation: As to what you wrote concerning fasting, in this blessed city new utterances have issued forth from the Master's tongue. In three Tablets He has made mention of fasting and those who fast, and offered congratulations. In truth, fasting is the supreme remedy for the illness of self and passion, and the greatest healing. It draws out excessive moisture and brings about equilibrium. And when equilibrium is achieved, the self is freed from idle talk and becomes bound to the Will of God.

Subject: law of fasting
Quotation: O thou who art present! In the days when fasting was revealed, the polytheists of Hijaz and Yathrib rejected the decree of God and with utmost oppression rose up to refuse the divine commandments. But the power and sovereignty of God prevailed, and He established what He purposed through His Will. God doth blot out or confirm whatever He pleaseth, and with Him is the Mother Book. We beseech God to enable His people to observe the most great Fast and the most exalted Fast, which is to protect one's eye from beholding whatever is forbidden and to withhold one's self from food, drink and whatever is not of Him.

Subject: law of fasting
Quotation: O people of the world! We have enjoined upon you fasting during a brief period, and at its close have designated for you Naw-Ruz as a feast. Let the days in excess of the months be placed before the month of fasting. We have ordained that these, amid all nights and days, shall be the manifestations of the letter Ha, and thus they have not been bounded by the limits of the year and its months. It behoveth the people of Baha, throughout these days, to provide good cheer for themselves, their kindred and, beyond them, the poor and needy, and with joy and exultation to hail and glorify their Lord, to sing His praise and magnify His Name; and when they end--these days of giving that precede the season of restraint--let them enter upon the Fast. Thus hath it been ordained by Him Who is the Lord of all mankind. The traveller, the ailing, those who are with child or giving suck, are not bound by the Fast; they have been exempted by God as a token of His grace.

Subject: law of fasting
Quotation: The law of fasting hath been revealed by God in His Most Holy Book. There is no doubt that it hath been sent down from One Who is All-Knowing, All-Wise. The laws of fasting and prayer as revealed have not been changed, but wisdom is necessary. Hitherto, most have acted in accordance with the laws of the Qur'an. Were something entirely different to suddenly appear before the people, great discord would arise and none would draw nigh to hear the Word of God. In any case, divine forgiveness hath ever encompassed and continueth to encompass your honour, but others must hold fast to wisdom and cling to its hem. This utterance is a mercy unto the friends and a bounty unto the party of God, lest the clamour of every ignorant one and every dissembling hypocrite be raised....  O Ahmad! Upon thee be My glory! The mention of fasting and prayer is renewed, that it may become clear and evident that the fast of the Bayan is acceptable before the All-Merciful and its ordinance hath been revealed in the Most Holy Book. The ordinance of fasting was formerly specific to the servants in this land, for its abandonment caused commotion. Today they must hold fast unto that which accordeth with wisdom.

Subject: law of inheritance
Quotation: The inheritance in the Divine Book is divided into 2520 shares, which number encompasses all possible fractions of nine. These shares are then allocated to seven categories of heirs as mentioned in the Book. For example, the children are designated sixty-nine units, which is the number of the word Muqt. The meaning of We doubled their share is that an equal amount was added, making two times sixty-nine.

Subject: law of inheritance
Quotation: If the brother is from the father's side, his share is as mentioned in the Book. If from the mother's side, one-third of his share reverts to the House of Justice and two-thirds to him. The same applies for the sister.

Subject: law of inheritance
Quotation: Concerning minors, it hath been revealed in the Book that their inheritance should be entrusted to a trustee in the presence of witnesses, and that the trustee should be given a portion of the profits until they reach maturity. This is what the Best-Beloved of the worlds hath ordained.

Subject: law of inheritance
Quotation: Those who turn away from the Truth after it hath come unto them are they who know not. Say: The Lord of Command has more authority over you than your own selves - God will judge between you with truth; woe unto you, how you fail to reflect! God has created all that is in the heavens and the earth and whatsoever lies between them for the Manifestation of His Self - how little do you understand!

Subject: law of inheritance
Quotation: the truth is that a person has absolute freedom and can distribute their property among their heirs during their lifetime however they wish through a will, to be executed after their passing. Making a will is obligatory for all - that is, every person must write a firm, sound and clear will during their lifetime, seal and protect it, and keep it in a very secure place. In the will one has absolute freedom, and the will takes precedence over and is enacted before any other decree.

Subject: law of inheritance
Quotation: Two thirds of the inheritance shall pass to nephews and nieces; or, lacking these, to uncles and aunts on both father's and mother's side, and after them to their sons and daughters. The remaining third of the inheritance shall, in any case, revert to the Seat of Justice. Should the deceased be survived by none of those whose names have been recorded by the Pen of the Most High, his estate shall, in its entirety, revert to the aforementioned Seat that it may be expended on that which is prescribed by God.

Subject: law of inheritance
Quotation: What is meant are the immediate fathers and mothers, not the fathers of fathers and mothers of mothers. As for the circumstance where the father and mother of the deceased are non-existent, their share of inheritance must later be arranged by the House of Justice, since that Body must determine how to allot the shares of such non-existent heirs as have not been specified in the Book of God. Until the House of Justice is established, the share of the deceased heir must be redistributed among the remaining heirs according to the Law of God.

Subject: law of inheritance
Quotation: As to the matter of the house, whatever hath transpired until now is past and appeal is not permissible, as it would cause renewal of contention. I know that thou preferrest my good pleasure above a thousand houses and seekest my contentment. Therefore, with utmost embarrassment, I make this request that thou remain silent regarding the house, for what is past is past, and whatever hath been executed thus far in the distribution of inheritances must be pardoned. However, henceforth it must be carried out according to what hath been prescribed.

Subject: law of inheritance
Quotation: Furthermore, regarding the question about inheritance that was asked, this is it: In the divine laws concerning inheritance, the residence and specific garments have been designated for the male offspring. They asked whether this law applies to the father's property only or if the mother's property falls under the same ruling. The answer is that the mother's used clothing should be divided equally among the daughters, and other possessions including property, jewelry and unused clothing should all be divided as revealed in the Kitab-i-Aqdas. In the absence of daughters, all property should be divided as prescribed for men.

Subject: law of inheritance
Quotation: It appears that more than a year has passed since you posed this question, and the answer was revealed from the Most Holy Heaven and sent. It is strange that it has not reached you. Now that which was revealed in the Kitab-i-Aqdas regarding inheritance has been written and sent. However, They have said: We have forgiven the Rights of God and the rights pertaining to the House of Justice to that child. Let that child remain with his mother, and let the utmost care be shown to him, and let the expenses be given according to the rules.

Subject: law of inheritance
Quotation: that it has been ordained regarding inheritance that if there be no offspring, their shares revert to the House of Justice, and when any of the other categories are not present, such as father, mother, brother, sister, or teacher, whether their shares also revert to the House of Justice or are otherwise disposed - this matter hath been revealed in the Book of God. He saith, exalted be He: "Should one die and leave no offspring, their share shall revert to the House of Justice" and so forth. And: "Should one leave offspring but none of the other categories specified in the Book, two-thirds of what they leave shall revert to the offspring and the remaining third to the House of Justice." Thus hath the All-Mighty, the Most Exalted, decreed with grandeur and majesty. If there be offspring but some or all of the other souls - father, mother, brother, sister and others - are absent, the shares of those souls shall be divided into three parts: two parts shall revert to the offspring and one part to the House of Justice.

Subject: law of inheritance
Quotation: Regarding your question about inheritance, His exalted words state: When We heard the cries of the children in the loins, We doubled their portion and decreased from the others. The inheritances in the Divine Book are made into two thousand five hundred and twenty shares, which encompass the nine divisions. This number is divided into seven portions, each portion going to a class of heirs as mentioned in the Book. Among these, nine sixties, which equals the number of Muqt, is designated for the children. The meaning of His exalted words We doubled their portion is that one equivalent was added to it, making it two Ta, and what was increased was decreased from the others. For example, it was revealed And for the spouses from the Book of Ha according to the number of Ta and Fa, meaning eight sixties equaling the number of Ta and Fa was designated for the spouses. Now sixty and half of sixty, which equals ninety, was decreased from the spouses and added to the children, and so forth until the end, where the amount decreased becomes nine sixties, which was added to the first nine sixties.

Subject: law of inheritance
Quotation: As for the blessed verse regarding the mention of males excluding females, the intention is the firstborn, for in all divine religions the firstborn has had special privileges. Refer to the books of the Torah and Gospel, as well as previous traditions. Read in the Torah the story of Esau and Jacob, the two sons of Isaac, that it may become clear that in all divine religions the firstborn had extraordinary privileges, even inheriting prophethood, let alone worldly treasures. Even the just laws among civilized nations and states have given privileges to the firstborn. Today the British government, which claims to be the most rational government in the world, has this characteristic that all property is restricted to the firstborn. Their purpose is that when wealth is divided, it becomes scattered and lost. For example, if someone amasses wealth through great effort, when it is divided after death, this distribution causes dispersion and it is lost to the wind. But if it is restricted to the firstborn, it remains intact and preserved, and he can maintain the others. In any case, all these matters are in reality secondary issues. What is fundamental and essential, and what is divinely ordained by explicit text, is the Will. Every person must make a Will during his lifetime and distribute and apportion his property according to his own wish and desire, though he should observe justice and equity. In this way, no one will die without a Will, and inheritance will be handled according to the deceased's testament. These laws apply when someone dies without making a Will. The deceased has the option to bequeath the residence to whomever he wishes, and can likewise make it shared among the heirs. Thus no cause for dispute remains.

Subject: law of obligatory prayer
Quotation: living and walking according to the laws of the Book of Akdas

Subject: law of obligatory prayer
Quotation: As for the second question, it is permissible to perform two prayers with one ablution unless the ablution becomes void.

Subject: law of obligatory prayer
Quotation: The designation of the Qiblih and its promulgation is not at present conducive to divine wisdom. It will be announced in due time.

Subject: law of obligatory prayer
Quotation: Whoso wisheth to pray, let him wash his hands, and while he washeth, let him say:  Strengthen my hand, O my God, that it may take hold of Thy Book with such steadfastness that the hosts of the world shall have no power over it. Guard it, then, from meddling with whatsoever doth not belong unto it. Thou art, verily, the Almighty, the Most Powerful... Medium obligatory prayer, to be recited daily, in the morning, at noon, and in the evening.

Subject: law of obligatory prayer
Quotation: Furthermore, He counsels thee to observe fasting and prayer. Know thou that religion is as the heaven, and fasting and prayer are as its sun and moon.

Subject: law of obligatory prayer
Quotation: If ablutions are performed for another purpose and prayer time coincides, are those ablutions sufficient or must they be renewed? Answer: Those ablutions suffice; renewal is not required.

Subject: law of obligatory prayer
Quotation: Regarding the nine-rak'at prayer about which you inquired...As for the other three prayers, they too are abrogated. Whichever one is performed will be acceptable. And prayer before sunrise is permitted

Subject: law of obligatory prayer
Quotation: Prayer is very easy because there is the Long, Short and Medium Obligatory Prayer. When one feels spiritually uplifted and attracted, one can say the Long Obligatory Prayer, and even that is not so lengthy.

Subject: law of obligatory prayer
Quotation: The souls in this land, praise be to God, are not lazy like some Babis - they observe the seventeen-hour fast and likewise maintain the law of prayer. In truth, a person without worship is seen to be without effect and fruit.

Subject: law of obligatory prayer
Quotation: Recite this prayer every day after noon, that ye may inherit Paradise purely from God's decree forever... And when thou hast completed the prayer, glorify thy Lord a prescribed number of times that thou mayest be numbered among those who act.

Subject: law of obligatory prayer
Quotation: Whoso wisheth to recite this prayer, let him stand up and turn unto God, and, as he standeth in his place, let him gaze to the right and to the left, as if awaiting the mercy of his Lord, the Most Merciful, the Compassionate. Then let him say: O Thou Who art the Lord of all names and the Maker of the heavens! I beseech Thee by them Who are the Day-Springs of Thine invisible Essence, the Most Exalted, the All-Glorious, to make of my prayer a fire that will burn away the veils which have shut me out from Thy beauty, and a light that will lead me unto the ocean of Thy Presence.... Long obligatory prayer, to be recited once in twenty-four hours.

Subject: law of obligatory prayer
Quotation: Ablutions performed before or at the time of prayer are both acceptable and need not be renewed unless invalidated, for there is no requirement that ablutions be immediately followed by prayer. If there is an interval between ablutions and prayer, the prayer remains valid.

Subject: law of obligatory prayer
Quotation: "O thou beloved and spiritual friend! Thou hast asked regarding of the wisdom of the obligatory prayers: Know thou that this prayer hath been prescribed as an obligation and an ordinance. Man is not exempt therefrom for any reason unless he is disabled or a catastrophe should have occurred."

Subject: law of obligatory prayer
Quotation: The obligatory prayer, or daily prayer ... There are three prayers. One is necessary ... There are three daily prayers. One of them has no prostrations, one only sits and repeats it. This is the easiest of all, but the second one has the prostrations. The third one, the longest, has many prostrations.

Subject: law of obligatory prayer
Quotation: Let not the tradition "Be mindful in prayer" pass from sight. Make "Prayer is the pillar of religion" thy guiding principle, and soar to the heights of meaning and utterance on the wings of remembrance and praise. He hath said: "Prayer is the ladder of the believer. Hold fast unto it. Religion is heaven; prayer is its sun, and fasting is its moon".

Subject: law of obligatory prayer
Quotation: Likewise, the Obligatory Prayers have been set down by the Pen of the Most High and have been mentioned in the Persian Questions and Answers, which supplementeth the Kitab-i-Aqdas. They are clearly binding, and without a doubt everyone must perform one of these three prayers. At present, since the Command hath not been openly proclaimed, if someone should fall short, let there be no reproach or rebuke.

Subject: law of obligatory prayer
Quotation: Know that, according to God's decree, prayer is not valid except with pure earth... The water of heaven, the sea, and flowing springs never becomes impure. As for other waters, if impurity overcomes the water such that its essential nature is changed - whether in color, taste or smell - it is not valid for anyone to use it for anything... Human impurity is purified when the substance is removed and a kurr of water or flowing water contacts it.

Subject: law of obligatory prayer
Quotation: We have enjoined obligatory prayer upon you, with nine rak'ahs, to be offered at noon and in the morning and the evening unto God, the Revealer of Verses. We have relieved you of a greater number, as a command in the Book of God. When ye desire to perform this prayer, turn ye towards the Court of My Most Holy Presence, this Hallowed Spot that God hath made the Centre round which circle the Concourse on High, and which He hath decreed to be the Point of Adoration for the denizens of the Cities of Eternity, and the Source of Command unto all that are in heaven and on earth; and when the Sun of Truth and Utterance shall set, turn your faces towards the Spot that We have ordained for you.

Subject: law of pilgrimage
Quotation: Pilgrimage to the House of God is incumbent upon those who are able to undertake the journey.

Subject: law of pilgrimage
Quotation: law of pilgrimage; thanks for completion of pilgrimage: "Give thanks unto God for having enabled thee to circumambulate the Most Great House and to attain unto the Most Great Pilgrimage."

Subject: law of pilgrimage
Quotation: "Thy journey hath been accepted and thy turning unto Him hath been approved, and the Divine Tongue beareth witness that thy pilgrimage hath been adorned with the most excellent of ornaments."

Subject: law of pilgrimage
Quotation: The best route is through the Caucasus, where one can travel with some comfort. Whenever the Caucasus route becomes completely safe and fully comfortable, permission for presence will be granted.

Subject: law of pilgrimage
Quotation: didst attain, time and again, the honor of visiting the Most Exalted Threshold, which is the point round which circle the Concourse on High and the Ka'bih of the denizens of the All-Glorious Kingdom

Subject: law of pilgrimage
Quotation: Then command one with fine handwriting to write the Surah of Good-Pleasure in gold ink on twelve gilded pages, for I desire to change what is customary in the return of pilgrimage with verses of truth.

Subject: law of pilgrimage
Quotation: Say: O My servants, you shall ascend to My House - that is the House of Him Whom God shall make manifest. That is My House, so do not purchase what surrounds it except according to what you are able to raise up.

Subject: law of pilgrimage
Quotation: Mr. Musa and Mr. Qanbar-'Ali traversed long distances, mountains, deserts and seas to reach the blessed and luminous Shrine. After attaining the presence at the Sacred Threshold, they hastened to the realm of Egypt

Subject: law of pilgrimage
Quotation: Both your father and mother crossed seas and countries until they were honored to attain the presence at the Most Exalted and Supreme Threshold, and circumambulated the point around which circle the Concourse on High.

Subject: law of pilgrimage
Quotation: With the utmost joy and fragrance didst thou arrive at the blessed, luminous Shrine, where thou didst inhale the sweet fragrances of the rose-garden of the All-Merciful and attain the ultimate hopes and spiritual desires.

Subject: law of pilgrimage
Quotation: Ye have been honored to visit the Holy Threshold and have perfumed your nostrils with the fragrance of the blessed earth. Ye have visited Yathrib and Batha, and have beheld the holy sites where the revelations of the Lord of Glory descended.

Subject: law of pilgrimage
Quotation: It is hoped that all the monotheists, through the attraction of the blessed verse "Pilgrimage to the House is a duty unto God for mankind," may set forth toward the ultimate goal, namely the House of God, the Lord of all beings, and attain the honor of circumambulation.

Subject: law of pilgrimage
Quotation: To You do I complain about those who prevented me from visiting you and arriving at the carpet of your glory. For by Him in Whose hand is my soul, if God were to give me all that is on earth, I would give it to enter your sanctuary, for it is a piece of the gardens of Paradise

Subject: law of pilgrimage
Quotation: Jinab-i-Aqa Siyyid Mahmud, accompanied by the luminous leaf Amatu'l-Baha, crossed sea and desert until he reached the Sacred Threshold, where at that exalted portal he rubbed his face and hair in the dust, turned toward the Abha Kingdom, and in his inmost heart made supplication

Subject: law of pilgrimage
Quotation: When he reached the holy threshold and made the sacred dust the collyrium of his insight's eye, he remembered you and opened his lips in mentioning you, and from the circumambulation point of the Supreme Concourse he especially beseeched assistance and grace for each one of you.

Subject: law of pilgrimage
Quotation: Furthermore, the time of pilgrimage is approaching and those intending to come are enkindled. God willing, may this fire of love remain ever-blazing, may He enable all to attain the blessing of visiting the House, and may He adorn the deeds of all with the ornament of acceptance.

Subject: law of pilgrimage
Quotation: When thou arrivest at the gate of the first sanctuary, pause and magnify thy Lord God as thou turnest thy face toward His face... Then enter with effaced verses and manifest signs, for if in that station thou callest to mind any remembrance save the remembrance of thy Lord, the angel will cry out Return!

Subject: law of pilgrimage
Quotation: Praise be to God that thou hast crossed mountains and hills, traversed seas, circumambulated the Point round which circle the Cherubim of the Supreme Concourse, made the dust of the Sacred Threshold a healing collyrium for thine eyes, and perfumed thy face, hair, locks and entire being with the Holy Shrine

Subject: law of pilgrimage
Quotation: O pilgrim Jinab-i-Nadim, upon whom be the Glory of God, the Most Glorious! O thou who hast circled round the gathering-place of the Supreme Concourse! Praise be to God that thou hast entered the Holy Land, cast off thy sandals, traversed the Valley of Tuva, and been present in the assemblage of the All-Merciful.

Subject: law of pilgrimage
Quotation: In regard to what was written that one of the friends has expressed having been subjected to harm due to delaying his pilgrimage to the House of God after gaining the means, when this was presented before His countenance, He said: For some time he has been occupied with this hope. Permission is granted from the Wronged One.

Subject: law of pilgrimage
Quotation: Mr. Muhammad Ibrahim and Haji Ghulam-'Ali, along with two others - upon them be the peace and favors of God - arrived intending to visit the House, and praise be to God, they attained the Most Great Pilgrimage. This year was very pleasant for the pilgrims. In truth it was a blessed journey. Blessed are they who have attained.

Subject: law of pilgrimage
Quotation: God hath accepted thy performance of the rites at the House and what thou hast done in His path... Blessed art thou for having inhaled the fragrance of God from His House... Joy be unto thee for having kissed the dust of the City, beheld its walls and traces, and walked upon ground that was honored by the footsteps of thy Lord

Subject: law of pilgrimage
Quotation: The Holy Book of Bayan of the Bab is provisional, and was to be partly added to, partly replaced by the Blessed Perfection Baha'u'llah, according to the Prophet Bab's own instruction, Who ordained in writing that the "Man Yu?hiruhu'llah" should and would reveal the eight missing chapters of the nineteen chapters of the Bayan.

Subject: law of pilgrimage
Quotation: "Thy Lord hath prescribed mercy for thyself, and God beareth witness concerning thee in the sacred month of pilgrimage to the House as one performing 'Umrah." "God, thy Lord, witnesseth concerning the months of pilgrimage to the House only for thyself and for those who follow the decree as thou dost, and for the soul that came with Me to the pilgrimage."

Subject: law of pilgrimage
Quotation: Regarding your question about the state of one who claims that these pilgrims to the Ka'bah of the Divine Purpose go as Muslims and return as infidels, or who interprets this, or claims "I am a certain person" - I call God, His angels, His Messengers, His Prophets, His chosen ones, the denizens of His realms of glory, and the bearers of His throne to witness that such words proceed only from those who wander in the wilderness of heedlessness and pride. This station belongs to those pilgrims who have entered the pavilion of certitude and truly attained to the love of God.

Subject: law of repetition; recitation of the Greatest Name
