Quotation: Now that your throat has fallen into the chains of the curls of the Abha Beloved, enter the sacrificial altar of love with smiling lips, torn garment, and singing love songs. Cry out from heart and soul "O my blessedness! O my delight! O my joy!"

Subject: love of God
Quotation: The peace and tranquility of the heart come through love for the Lord, and the joy and delight of the soul through love for the All-Merciful. I beseech God that thou mayest daily increase in divine love and adorn thy heart and soul with this bounty.

Subject: love of God
Quotation: I have answered thee now with the most excellent composition possible, that the birds of love may stir in thy breast and the cock of divine identity may move in thy heart, and thou wilt not be able to remain still in thy love or patient in thy station

Subject: love of God
Quotation: Merely because you were enkindled with the fire of the love of God have they treated you thus... Love was fierce and bloody from the start / So that the outsider might flee / Sacrificing life and wealth and self / Is but the first stage on love's path

Subject: love of God
Quotation: Today, a fire of love must be kindled in the soul of Azerbaijan so that the surroundings and outskirts of Tabriz may become brimming cups of the wine of the love of God and become perfumed with the fragrance of the rose-garden of the knowledge of God.

Subject: love of God
Quotation: This is from a fire kindled by the heat of God's love, which consumeth the hearts of the lovers who, when they hear the verses of God, are transformed in their hearts and fall prostrate before God, the King, the Help in Peril, the Mighty, the Powerful.

Subject: love of God
Quotation: Yet that enthralling Beloved hath ever been wont to slay the lover and to set aflame the yearning heart. Such are the ways and doings of that precious Beloved. The wound He inflicteth is a soothing balm and the poison He dispenseth but a healing remedy.

Subject: love of God
Quotation: The soul hath found its way to the Beloved on the wake of His scent The breasts of the lovers of the world are void of patience in this Day This Dervish gallops in the wilderness of His love, As the running herd of His gazelles in the desert of Oneness.

Subject: love of God
Quotation: O servant of the Sacred Threshold! Your eloquently written letter with pleasing contents reached this wanderer in the wilderness of the love of God... Azerbaijan needs souls who have fire in their spirit and heart - that is, the fire of the love of God.

Subject: love of God
Quotation: First, the knowledge; and, second, His unfathomable love...This is a great gift from God and hath no equal; although in this physical world its greatness is not perceivable, nor its nature clearly known, yet in the spiritual world it shineth like the sun.

Subject: love of God
Quotation: This, Thy servant, hath advanced towards Thee, is passionately wandering in the desert of Thy love, walking in the path of Thy service...Increase the fervor of his affection for Thee, the constancy of his praise of Thee, and the ardor of his love for Thee.

Subject: love of God
Quotation: They were filled with joy and ecstasy, and were seized with longing and rapture. They took in hand the overflowing cup of the love of God and, dancing in the arena of mystic knowledge, with stamping feet and clapping hands, hastened to sacrifice their lives.

Subject: love of God
Quotation: My very limbs testify to the intensity of its heat, and evince the consuming power of its flame...The power of Thy might beareth me witness, O my Well-Beloved! Every limb of my body, methinks, is endowed with a tongue that glorifieth Thee and magnifieth Thy name.

Subject: love of God
Quotation: the fire of longing blazed within his heart and innermost being, and he hastened to the scene of annihilation with utmost eagerness, joy and delight from the light of dawn... was consumed by the fire of longing for Thee, was illumined by the light of Thy effulgence

Subject: love of God
Quotation: Indeed, the fragrance of intense longing was inhaled from the rose garden of its meanings, and the heat of the fire of the love of God was felt. Praise be to God that you are enthralled by the countenance of the Kind Beloved and are enchanted by that musk-laden tress.

Subject: love of God
Quotation: make me captive to Thy love, that I may become wholly enamored of Thee and mad with love for Thee. I seek none but Thee, search for none but Thee, pursue no path but Thine, and speak of no mystery but Thine. Like the bird of dawn, may I be caught in the snare of Thy love

Subject: love of God
Quotation: I have ignited in the chamber of your hearts the light of the Love of God. Strive day and night that its lustre and brightness may increase, so that the Light of God may environ all the regions. Enkindle the extinct men and women with the consuming Fire of the Love of God.

Subject: love of God
Quotation: I have come long distances that you may attain these attributes and divine favors. The honor of man is through the attainment of the knowledge of God; his happiness is from the love of God; his joy is in the glad tidings of God; his greatness is dependent upon his servitude to God.

Subject: love of God
Quotation: The luminosity of every jewel comes from the light of the love of God, and every precious pearl is nurtured within the shell of the knowledge of God. When one attains to these two distinctions, one becomes a royal pearl to the world and illumines both worlds with light and radiance.

Subject: love of God
Quotation: O my God! Thou seest how my heart melteth in Thy love to such degree that were all the seas of the world to be poured upon it they would never quench it, for my being, my soul, my spirit, my body and my form were all created through Thy love - and Thy love endureth and shall never perish.

Subject: love of God
Quotation: But we are all happy because we have the love of God in our hearts. When the heart is full of the love of God it loses consciousness of the body. So the martyrs who have suffered for their faith, their hearts are so full of the love of God, their ears so penetrated by His songs of gladness

Subject: love of God
Quotation: And it is the love of the Family of God which is the same as the love of God. And this is the Hidden Treasure to which the Prophet, upon him and his family be peace, openly alluded when he said: Above each good is another good until one loves us, and when one loves us there is no good above it.

Subject: love of God
Quotation: O my Lord! This loop of Baha fell into that collar of tribulation which was Thy hair. Every fragrance of musk that reaches the nostrils comes from Thy sweet nature. If the Euphrates bestowed life, its fountainhead was Thy stream. The soul is parched, hearts are feverish, all seek after Thy face.

Subject: love of God
Quotation: Though thy purse be empty of silver and gold, praise be to God that the jewels of the love of God lie hidden and treasured in the shell of thy heart. At the divine threshold this is accepted, and in the market of the jewelers of the Abha Kingdom these pearls are beloved, sought after and desired.

Subject: love of God
Quotation: Today must diffuse the fragrance of faith to such a degree that all the world may perceive it, nay rather that the inhabitants of the graves may attain through that musk-laden breeze to life everlasting... manifest such warmth in the love of God that the cold-hearted of the world may be set ablaze.

Subject: love of God
Quotation: O ye peoples of the world! Know assuredly that My commandments are the lamps of My loving providence among My servants, and the keys of My mercy for My creatures. Observe My commandments, for the love of My beauty. Happy is the lover that hath inhaled the divine fragrance which emanateth from them.

Subject: love of God
Quotation: They indicate thy great love to God, thy attraction to His fragrance, thy attachment to His Kingdom...The love of God kept them busy from ought else...For, verily, to God is the praise. They are lamps aflame with the fire of the love of God, majestic trees in the rose-gardens of the knowledge of God.

Subject: love of God
Quotation: "Yet, by Thy glory, O my God, were I to be tormented more severely than this, such that the limbs of my body be torn asunder by the hands of the polytheists among Thy creation and the rebellious ones among Thy creatures, it would but increase my love for Thee, my ardor in Thee, and my longing for Thee."

Subject: love of God
Quotation: O You who attracts hearts through the magnet of love overflowing upon existence, who revives decayed bones through a spirit that refreshes hearts and souls, who shines with the Ancient Light upon the horizons of creation, and who gives everything a portion of Your vast mercy encompassing contingent being

Subject: love of God
Quotation: The essence of love is for man to turn his heart to the Beloved One, and sever himself from all else but Him, and desire naught save that which is the desire of his Lord. The essence of wealth is love for Me; whoso loveth Me is the possessor of all things, and he that loveth Me not is indeed of the poor and needy.

Subject: love of God
Quotation: "If a person is illumined with the light of the love of God, he is (like unto) the morning star, even though his name be dark" "be thou intent thou that thou makest thy face illumined with the light of the love of God, through the divine assistance and favor. This attribute will make thee independent of every name!"

Subject: love of God
Quotation: This is Thy servant, Oh my Lord, who hath set his face towards Thee and hath been set ablaze with the fire of his longing for Thee, fleeing for shelter from the tribulations of separation from Thee, athirst for the wellspring of Thy Presence, yearning to behold Thy Resplendent Beauty from the horizon of reunion with Thee.

Subject: love of God
Quotation: And verily from the day when the Sun of Reality dawned, the winds of love stirred in the hearts of the people of divine authority, and those who were to be attracted were attracted, and those who were to be quickened were quickened by that Life-Giving Spirit and by the wind that bloweth from the third pillar of the Sacred House.

Subject: love of God
Quotation: That beloved friend must ignite such a flame that its heat will make those regions like the mountains of Paran, and the fire of love will reach to the zenith of heaven...kindle within our hearts the fire of longing and yearning in the path of the Luminary of the horizons, yearning for Thee and longing for the gate of Thy oneness.

Subject: love of God
Quotation: When the Quintessence of Beauty turned His face towards the mirror of His glory and that ravishing countenance was reflected in the world of humanity, He taught the friends the ways of true love. And He underwent all these sufferings so that the friends might learn the lessons of love and be trained in the ways of ardour and attraction.

Subject: love of God
Quotation: In a similar manner all of us must banish from the spheres of our minds all the names, mentions and thoughts save Baha. To know and recognize Baha and his commands. This is our heavenly power! This is the Confirmation of the Kingdom. This is the cause of our spiritual attraction! Let the watchword of the believers be Love; love of God and love of man.

Subject: love of God
Quotation: This meeting is through the Love of the Blessed Perfection. In the sensibility of the heart is the true realization. God is Love. In the last day all the sheep shall be gathered together. There are two kinds of Love: one Universal and one Individual. You must love humanity in order to uplift and beautify humanity. Even if they kill you, you must love them.

Subject: love of God
Quotation: The intoxication of the wine of attraction so seized her that she wandered in the desert of passionate devotion and love, cried out with the cry of one possessed, rushed like the thirsty toward the water of life, and was ignited with the fire of Thy love as fuel is ignited by flames [...] She was kindled with the fire of Thy love even as fuel is kindled by flames

Subject: love of God
Quotation: The greatest consolation for the heart is the Love of God. Every day brings in its train new difficulties and ordeals. The world is very dark and the only light which is capable to penetrate through this darkness is the Light of the Love of God. The Glory of man is through the Love of God, entrance into his Kingdom and being imbued with his divine characteristics.

Subject: love of God
Quotation: O joy to one like me that One like Thee shouldst remember me! Again joy, and again joy to me that One like Thee shouldst be my companion! Again joy, and again joy to me that One like Thee shouldst speak to me! Through Thee do I love Thee, and were it not for Thee I would be as nothing. Through Thee do I know Thee, and were it not for Thee I would not know how Thou art as Lord.

Subject: love of God
Quotation: O sons of love! You shall be tried in My love and forsaken for My Name's sake. And when harm befalls you in this, be patient, for this is a light above light for your souls, and God shall make it glory and honor and exaltation and light for you, if you but knew. Know, O sons of insight, that My love is God's greatest treasure and His most manifest mystery and His most luminous pearls.

Subject: love of God
Quotation: O spiritual friend! Though there are many in the world who bear the name Habibu'llah (Beloved of God), yet all these names are without reality and these titles without meaning, save for those souls who are the manifestations of the love of the Ancient Beauty and who possess ardent longing in their hearts. Such souls are the true beloved ones of God and acceptable at the divine threshold.

Subject: love of God
Quotation: Like these homeless ones you became rootless, and like these love-smitten ones you became lost in the wilderness and desert... Were it not so, every prisoner of passion would raise the banner of divine love and every one afflicted with pleasure and wealth would pitch high the tent of divine attraction. From the first, love was fierce and bloodthirsty So that whoever was an outsider might flee

Subject: love of God
Quotation: Let his honor Agha Mirza Muhammad-'Ali-i-Qa'ini, upon him be the Glory of God, take note. O thou who art enkindled with the fire of the love of God and hast migrated from God unto God! May God assist me and thee to quaff from the cup of sacrifice in the path of God. Thy letter, adorned with wondrous mention of God, arrived and we were moved and gladdened by the sweet fragrances of the love of God.

Subject: love of God
Quotation: Love, the beloved, the lover, and the beloved one are four signs of the manifestation of the Family of God within thee, and they are thy very self. When these four signs are remembered within thee, and thy heart is illumined, and thy mind is enraptured, and thy spirit is quickened, and thy body trembleth with longing, then art thou truly of the people of Paradise and of the companions of the Commander of the Faithful.

Subject: love of God
Quotation: When the love of God is established, everything else will be realized. This is the true foundation of all economics. Reflect upon it. Endeavor to become the cause of the attraction of souls rather than to enforce minds. Economic questions will not attract hearts. The love of God alone will attract them. Economic questions are most interesting; but the power which moves, controls and attracts the hearts of men is the love of God.

Subject: love of God
Quotation: This is the Paradise on whose foliage the wine of utterance hath imprinted the testimony: "He that was hidden from the eyes of men is revealed, girded with sovereignty and power!" This is the Paradise, the rustling of whose leaves proclaims: "O ye that inhabit the heavens and the earth! There hath appeared what hath never previously appeared. He Who, from everlasting, had concealed His Face from the sight of creation is now come."

Subject: love of God
Quotation: They should take in hand the cup of the love of God and, dancing and leaping, give to drink the wine of the Most Great Glad-Tidings... The divine friends, praise be to God, are intoxicated from the divine wine-house and, with perfect enthusiasm and rapture, cup in hand and wine-worshipping from the wine of alast... in a brief time the fire of the love of God will blaze forth in that country such that all regions will be illumined.

Subject: love of God
Quotation: This life-giving water of which He speaks is like unto fire, for it is none other than the Love of God, and this love means life to our souls. By the fire of the Love of God the veil is burnt which separates us from the Heavenly Realities...There is nothing greater or more blessed than the Love of God! It gives healing to the sick, balm to the wounded, joy and consolation to the whole world, and through it alone can man attain Life Everlasting

Subject: love of God
Quotation: O my God! Thou art the Beloved, there is none besides Thee, and Thou art the Intended One, there is none other than Thee. I have known Thee through Thee and called upon Thee through Thy love for me. Were it not for Thee, I would be nothing, neither could I remember Thee, nor drink from the pure wine of Thy love, nor dwell in the precincts of Thy bounty, nor be established upon the throne of Thy sovereignty, nor mention Thy favors before Thy near servants.

Subject: love of God
Quotation: Perfect joy was obtained for the divine friends, that that remnant of the luminous Temple and Manifestation of the All-Merciful, the spacious gate to the exalted city of the Most Glorious Paradise - may my spirit be a sacrifice for him - praise be to God, is in the utmost attraction and burning from the fire of love for the Unique Beloved, and night and day like a night-illumining candle is in burning and melting, and is exalted in service to the Cause of the Lord God.

Subject: love of God
Quotation: They pray only for love of GOD, and not because they fear Him or hell, or hope for Bounty or Heaven. Thus, the souls in whose heart the fire of love is enkindled are attracted by supplications to Thee. The true supplication to God must therefore be actuated by love to God only. When a man falls in love with a human being, it is impossible for him to keep from mentioning the name of his beloved. How much more difficult is it to keep from mentioning the name of GOD, when he has come to love Him.

Subject: love of God
Quotation: "I hope a great love may be established among you and that day by day this love will increase. I have gathered you all together here that you may be gathered in the same way in the Kingdom of God, and that you may love one another very, very much. If you love one another as you should, it is just as though you had loved me as you should. The more you love one another, the nearer you get to Me." "Baha'u'llah endured all these hardships and difficulties only for the sake of establishing Love in this world."

Subject: love of God
Quotation: Let them hold fast unto His verses - that is, let them contemplate and reflect, and quicken the dead of the earth through the breaths of wisdom and utterance. Know ye with certitude that those souls who are this day adorned with the ornament of love and are mentioned by the name of God, exalted be His glory, if they arise to serve the Cause - that is, if they engage in teaching the divine Cause with the utmost wisdom, speaking for God's sake and making mention of Him for His sake - they will assuredly transform the world of brass into a world of gold.

Subject: love of God
Quotation: Its conveyance depends on that loved one's favors - whether to deliver it personally or to send and convey it through correspondence. May my spirit be a sacrifice for Thy love! But what can I say? After separation from that Beloved One, how the burning fire of separation hath been kindled in the heart and soul of this evanescent one in such wise that no pen can reckon it nor tablet bear it. It is a fire that, no matter how much the waters of remembrance are poured upon it, they but increase its heat, blaze and intensity, and it shall not be quenched save by the water of reunion.

Subject: love of God
Quotation: Cast away the world of existence that thou mayest embrace the neck of thy Friend, and draw thy heart from heart that thou mayest grasp the tresses of thy Beloved. I swear by the Spirit of eternity that if thou shouldst hear with the ear of understanding the melodies of the Dove from the ant of love, thou wouldst at once arise above the world of creation, and from the attraction of love thou wouldst sacrifice a hundred thousand thousand spiritual worlds of pure radiant light for the sake of thy Friend, and shed tears of blood from a hundred thousand eyes in thy longing for the beauty of thy Friend.

Subject: love of God
Quotation: When Majnun was consumed with love for Layla, though it was not based on truth and was merely at the level of physical existence, they reached a state that you all remember. When he saw a dog that belonged to the tribe wherein Layla's name was mentioned, he kissed it out of love for her - this was love of body for body. How is it then that you do not ascend in the love of God? If true love is found in God, it will erase from one who attains it all mention save His. And verily, in the love of God no description can be made, so how is it that when you love God and hear His verses, you are not drawn unto them?

Subject: love of God
Quotation: Possess a pure, kindly and radiant heart, that thine may be a sovereignty ancient, imperishable and everlasting. Veiled in My immemorial being and in the ancient eternity of My essence, I knew My love for thee; therefore I created thee. I loved thy creation, hence I created thee. Wherefore, do thou love Me, that I may name thy name and fill thy soul with the spirit of life. Love Me, that I may love thee. If thou lovest Me not, My love can in no wise reach thee. Thy Paradise is My love; thy heavenly home, reunion with Me. If thou lovest Me, turn away from thyself; and if thou seekest My pleasure, regard not thine own. My love is My stronghold; he that entereth therein is safe and secure.

Subject: love of God
Quotation: The highest love is independent of any personal advantages which we may draw from the love of the friend. A man who really loves God, will love Him whether he be ill, or sad, or unfortunate. He does not love God because He has created him - his life may be full of dissociations and miseries. He does not love God because he has given him health or wealth, because these may disappear at any moment. He does not love Him because He has given him the strength of youth, because old age will surely come upon him. The reason for his love is not because he is grateful for certain mercies and benefits. No! The lover of God desires and adores Him because He is a perfection and because of His perfections.

Subject: love, unity, and fellowship among the friends; in the Cause
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/love, unity, and fellowship among the friends; in the Cause.txt
Quotation: The Supreme Pen has commanded all to love, affection, fellowship and unity, for unity has been the cause of the exaltation of the Cause while discord leads to its dissipation. In these days which are in truth the source of all days, and in this age which is the king of ages, the friends of the All-Merciful should strive with the utmost joy and fragrance to attain lofty stations and enduring ranks. Blessed are they of insight who today have not been deprived by any veil from the Most Great Vision and who day and night are occupied with uniting hearts and bringing souls together.

Subject: love, unity, and fellowship among the friends; in the Cause
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/love, unity, and fellowship among the friends; in the Cause.txt
Quotation: differences between the friends in any matter whatsoever causes weakness in the Cause of God and leads to the wavering of souls... Consider that when differences arise, inevitably one party is supported while the other party becomes broken-hearted and sorrowful, and ulterior motives emerge and become a cause of veiling... You must have utmost fellowship with each other and strive that if any difference arises, even between two people, to quickly remove it so that its scope does not expand.

Subject: love, unity, and fellowship among the friends; in the Cause
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/love, unity, and fellowship among the friends; in the Cause.txt
Quotation: O loved ones! Be ye united in the Cause of God, in such wise that no winds of discord may pass between you. This is that whereunto ye were bidden in the Tablets. This is better for you, did ye but know.

Subject: love, unity, and fellowship among the friends; in the Cause
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/love, unity, and fellowship among the friends; in the Cause.txt
Quotation: gather ye together around the Cause, for this is what God desired for you in the atomic realm before the creation of the heavens and the earths

Subject: love, unity, and fellowship among the friends; in the Cause
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/love, unity, and fellowship among the friends; in the Cause.txt
Quotation: We desire fellowship amongst you. Make your desire that which your Lord, the Mighty, the All-Choosing, hath desired.

Subject: love, unity, and fellowship among the friends; in the Cause
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/love, unity, and fellowship among the friends; in the Cause.txt
Quotation: Through unity the gate of power is opened. Reflect, O ye who are endued with insight!

Subject: love, unity, and fellowship among the friends; in the Cause
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/love, unity, and fellowship among the friends; in the Cause.txt
Quotation: All nations must embrace one religion and all people must become as brothers.

Subject: love, unity, and fellowship among the friends; in the Cause
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/love, unity, and fellowship among the friends; in the Cause.txt
Quotation: O My loved ones! Be ye united in My Cause and detached from all else.

Subject: love, unity, and fellowship among the friends; in the Cause
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/love, unity, and fellowship among the friends; in the Cause.txt
Quotation: Today discord hath been and will be the cause of harm to the Cause of God. Set aside your selves and take hold of God alone. Thus doth your Best-Beloved, the Most Glorious, command you. The purpose of service and assistance is the mention of Truth through wisdom and utterance, that perchance the scattered letters of the world may be gathered together in the temple of a single word, and that word may become the cause of the completion and adornment of the Book of Creation.

Subject: love, unity, and fellowship among the friends; in the Cause
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/love, unity, and fellowship among the friends; in the Cause.txt
Quotation: The letter thou hadst written was received. It brought exceeding joy and gladness, for it contained matters that were evidence of the steadfastness and constancy of the friends of God. It told of the unity and accord of the beloved of the Lord, and the aid and assistance they rendered unto one another. Such glad-tidings caused infinite happiness, for firmness and steadfastness in this wondrous Cause is as a magnet that draweth down the confirmations and aid from the Kingdom of God

Subject: love, unity, and fellowship among the friends; in the Cause
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/love, unity, and fellowship among the friends; in the Cause.txt
Quotation: The first watering of this real plantation is unity among the friends of God. To-day there is nothing so essential and so indispensable for the glory and honor of the Bahai cause as the unity of the beloved of God. The more the friends of God are united the greater will be the success attending their efforts...Therefore I beg and counsel you to continue in good fellowship and unity, to co-operate with and be kind toward one another, to exalt one another, and to be the means of comfort and ease to one another, in order that other nations may learn from you how great are the fruits of unity.

Subject: love, unity, and fellowship among the friends; in the Cause
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/love, unity, and fellowship among the friends; in the Cause.txt
Quotation: We beseech God to make them the banners of His unity, the standards of His love, and the signs of fellowship and unity among His servants.

Subject: love, unity, and fellowship among the friends; in the Cause
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/love, unity, and fellowship among the friends; in the Cause.txt
Quotation: Beware lest dissensions divide you. You must be agreed and united. You must always turn to the kingdom of God, be attracted to Baha'o'llah, be filled with Baha'o'llah, and ever be the recipients of the favors of Baha'o'llah.

Subject: love, unity, and fellowship among the friends; in the Cause
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/love, unity, and fellowship among the friends; in the Cause.txt
Quotation: In the human world there is no greater connection than the attachment of hearts - even a chain of iron is not as strong. Praise be to God that this connection among the friends is firm and steadfast, binding and connecting, and tied with the manifest light, and day by day it becomes firmer and stronger.

Subject: love, unity, and fellowship among the friends; in the Cause
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/love, unity, and fellowship among the friends; in the Cause.txt
Quotation: Blessed art thou for having found solace in the company of the loved ones of God and for having associated with them, and this is the way of the sincere ones. Hold fast unto the loved ones of God and separate not thyself from them.

Subject: love, unity, and fellowship among the friends; in the Cause
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/love, unity, and fellowship among the friends; in the Cause.txt
Quotation: Whenever you who are believers meet with one another, your conversation should not be about worldly matters; you should advise each other how to live noble lives, and seek good examples in one another.

Subject: love, unity, and fellowship among the friends; in the Cause
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/love, unity, and fellowship among the friends; in the Cause.txt
Quotation: conduct yourselves with utmost love toward one another, purely for the sake of the Beloved. Consume the veils of self with the fire of oneness, and associate with each other with radiant and joyous faces

Subject: love, unity, and fellowship among the friends; in the Cause
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/love, unity, and fellowship among the friends; in the Cause.txt
Quotation: What doth the world possess if there be no love, and if there be no mention of friends? Indeed it would be worthy of naught, nay, less than naught would be better.

Subject: love, unity, and fellowship among the friends; in the Cause
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/love, unity, and fellowship among the friends; in the Cause.txt
Quotation: In brief, though outwardly far away and remote, and burning with the fire of separation, yet, because we are inebriated with the same wine and rejoicing in the bounties of our Forgiving Lord, because we are immersed in one ocean, wanderers in one desert, birds of one rose-garden, and fishes of one sea, therefore are we close companions and intimates, attuned and in harmony.

Subject: love, unity, and fellowship among the friends; in the Cause
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/love, unity, and fellowship among the friends; in the Cause.txt
Quotation: Every man who believes in God is My brother, and every woman who turns to the Face is My sister, My handmaiden, and a leaf of My paradise among the unitarians.

Subject: love, unity, and fellowship among the friends; in the Cause
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/love, unity, and fellowship among the friends; in the Cause.txt
Quotation: Pass your days with the utmost joy and fragrance, and be intimate companions with the righteous and the monotheists.

Subject: love, unity, and fellowship among the friends; in the Cause
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/love, unity, and fellowship among the friends; in the Cause.txt
Quotation: The duty of the believers of God is to be the servants to each other and attend to each other's wants.

Subject: love, unity, and fellowship among the friends; in the Cause
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/love, unity, and fellowship among the friends; in the Cause.txt
Quotation: Remember the friends and become the companion of the loved ones.

Subject: love, unity, and fellowship among the friends; in the Cause
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/love, unity, and fellowship among the friends; in the Cause.txt
Quotation: During such blessed days institutions should be founded that may be of permanent benefit and value to the people... they must be in the utmost harmony, love and oneness, clasping hands, engaged in the commemoration of the Blessed Beauty and thinking of the great results that may be obtained on such a blessed day.

Subject: love, unity, and fellowship among the friends; in the Cause
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/love, unity, and fellowship among the friends; in the Cause.txt
Quotation: The believers of God must invite the people to the Feast of the love of God. In the Baha'i feasts the expression of moral sentiments must become very strong and overpouring and the table of divine life be spread. When the material and spiritual feasts are wedded together in love and affection, the child of harmony and peace will be born in the assemblage of the elect.

Subject: love, unity, and fellowship among the friends; in the Cause
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/love, unity, and fellowship among the friends; in the Cause.txt
Quotation: are associated with one another in utmost love and fellowship

Subject: love, unity, and fellowship among the friends; in the Cause
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/love, unity, and fellowship among the friends; in the Cause.txt
Quotation: He commanded us to show love and kindness to all in the world.

Subject: love, unity, and fellowship among the friends; in the Cause
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/love, unity, and fellowship among the friends; in the Cause.txt
Quotation: Bahais journey long distances to see one another. I have traveled far to see you.

Subject: love, unity, and fellowship among the friends; in the Cause
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/love, unity, and fellowship among the friends; in the Cause.txt
Quotation: "your spiritual love and union ought to be increased and you must become brother and sister"

Subject: love, unity, and fellowship among the friends; in the Cause
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/love, unity, and fellowship among the friends; in the Cause.txt
Quotation: However, the members of consultation must have perfect love, harmony and sincerity with one another.

Subject: love, unity, and fellowship among the friends; in the Cause
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/love, unity, and fellowship among the friends; in the Cause.txt
Quotation: You have until now endured much trouble and hardship until you brought them into harmony with each other.

Subject: love, unity, and fellowship among the friends; in the Cause
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/love, unity, and fellowship among the friends; in the Cause.txt
Quotation: Blessed is the soul who reclines upon his couch while his heart is illumined with love for all the peoples of the world.

Subject: love, unity, and fellowship among the friends; in the Cause
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/love, unity, and fellowship among the friends; in the Cause.txt
Quotation: Final paragraph emphasizing importance of unity and oneness among the friends as a prerequisite for 'Abdu'l-Baha's visit.

Subject: love, unity, and fellowship among the friends; in the Cause
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/love, unity, and fellowship among the friends; in the Cause.txt
Quotation: let the youth show respect and consideration for the elderly, and let the elderly be loving fathers to the youth...Let them care for one another

Subject: love, unity, and fellowship among the friends; in the Cause
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/love, unity, and fellowship among the friends; in the Cause.txt
Quotation: Every assembly held for the purpose of bringing about unity and concord will be conducive to turning strangers into friends and aliens into companions.

Subject: love, unity, and fellowship among the friends; in the Cause
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/love, unity, and fellowship among the friends; in the Cause.txt
Quotation: The friends of God must be like a solid structure supporting one another, "The believers are like a solid structure, each part strengthening the other."

Subject: love, unity, and fellowship among the friends; in the Cause
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/love, unity, and fellowship among the friends; in the Cause.txt
Quotation: Set aside every thought and remove every difference from your midst...With perfect love and harmony, occupy yourselves with praising and glorifying the Mighty Lord

Subject: love, unity, and fellowship among the friends; in the Cause
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/love, unity, and fellowship among the friends; in the Cause.txt
Quotation: If the friends of God in New York truly unite, in a short time they will shine like the sun and attain such joy that its rays will influence the horizons of America.

Subject: love, unity, and fellowship among the friends; in the Cause
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/love, unity, and fellowship among the friends; in the Cause.txt
Quotation: The greatest means of attracting the hearts and the raising of souls beneath the banner of the Most Ancient Beauty is none other than good fellowship and unity amongst the friends.

Subject: love, unity, and fellowship among the friends; in the Cause
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/love, unity, and fellowship among the friends; in the Cause.txt
Quotation: The friends of God must be willing to sacrifice their lives for each other; their love must attain such heights of idealism and self-abnegation. You must love each other very much.

Subject: love, unity, and fellowship among the friends; in the Cause
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/love, unity, and fellowship among the friends; in the Cause.txt
Quotation: We had hoped that you would be the cause of unity and agreement between Mr. Jamshid Khodadad and Mr. Mirza Mahmud. Now it appears this did not happen. I still hope for this from you

Subject: love, unity, and fellowship among the friends; in the Cause
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/love, unity, and fellowship among the friends; in the Cause.txt
Quotation: O ye true friends! Be kind to each other, therefore in heart and soul! Be sacrificing in the path of love towards each other so that ye may be accepted in the threshold of the One True God.

Subject: love, unity, and fellowship among the friends; in the Cause
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/love, unity, and fellowship among the friends; in the Cause.txt
Quotation: When such complete connection and harmony is achieved among the handmaidens of God as exists between you and Lua, surely progress will be made day by day and joy and gladness will increase.

Subject: love, unity, and fellowship among the friends; in the Cause
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/love, unity, and fellowship among the friends; in the Cause.txt
Quotation: We must show love and kindness, and through faithfulness and purity prove that we are all servants of that Threshold - truthful, steadfast, vigilant and real Baha'is, not just in word and tongue.

Subject: love, unity, and fellowship among the friends; in the Cause
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/love, unity, and fellowship among the friends; in the Cause.txt
Quotation: "O divine friends! Be, with heart and soul, well-wishers of all peoples and religions... Be well-wishers to all, whether friend or foe. Serve all with faithfulness, whether stranger or acquaintance."

Subject: love, unity, and fellowship among the friends; in the Cause
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/love, unity, and fellowship among the friends; in the Cause.txt
Quotation: Let none wrong another, nor let any companion speak ill of his companion, nor let any brother deny his believing brother. Fear God in all that We have revealed unto you, and be among the God-fearing.

Subject: love, unity, and fellowship among the friends; in the Cause
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/love, unity, and fellowship among the friends; in the Cause.txt
Quotation: Therefore, make an effort that harmony may be established, for this will be the cause of joy and gladness to the heart and soul of 'Abdu'l-Baha. Otherwise He shall remain sorrowful and grief-stricken.

Subject: love, unity, and fellowship among the friends; in the Cause
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/love, unity, and fellowship among the friends; in the Cause.txt
Quotation: Praise be to God! A hundred thousand praises be to the Goal of the world's peoples, that in such days as these He hath made firm the fellowship of His loved ones and hath regarded the connection between them.

Subject: love, unity, and fellowship among the friends; in the Cause
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/love, unity, and fellowship among the friends; in the Cause.txt
Quotation: Observe Qazvin, how the friends are in the utmost unity and harmony...May all arise in unity and harmony to diffuse the divine fragrances...We are all servants of one threshold and bondsmen at the court of one Lord.

Subject: love, unity, and fellowship among the friends; in the Cause
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/love, unity, and fellowship among the friends; in the Cause.txt
Quotation: It was proof of the unity and harmony of the friends, who are all, aflame and attracted, united and in harmony, occupied with exalting the Word of God and diffusing the divine fragrances and teaching the Cause of God.

Subject: love, unity, and fellowship among the friends; in the Cause
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/love, unity, and fellowship among the friends; in the Cause.txt
Quotation: the believers of Detroit, Grand Rapids, Muskegon, Chicago and Fruitport have gathered together and have spent their time with perfect love, unity and joy... associate with each other with the utmost amity, affection and harmony

Subject: love, unity, and fellowship among the friends; in the Cause
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/love, unity, and fellowship among the friends; in the Cause.txt
Quotation: From news of the unity, love, oneness and fellowship among the divine friends brought the utmost joy and gladness. I hope that at all times there will be spirituality and fellowship among the friends and complete unity and harmony.

Subject: love, unity, and fellowship among the friends; in the Cause
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/love, unity, and fellowship among the friends; in the Cause.txt
Quotation: Therefore I hope that in Shiraz thou wilt be engaged with melody and song, and wilt make the friends intimate companions and confidants of one another, so that this existing discord may disappear and this estrangement may end in unity

Subject: love, unity, and fellowship among the friends; in the Cause
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/love, unity, and fellowship among the friends; in the Cause.txt
Quotation: The first thing the Baha'is must do is to feel love and unity in their hearts before they can spread it among others. I am waiting and expecting to hear that love and harmony have blossomed in the hearts of all the Baha'is in America.

Subject: love, unity, and fellowship among the friends; in the Cause
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/love, unity, and fellowship among the friends; in the Cause.txt
Quotation: Let no one utter a word that might cause him sadness of heart. Despite all our efforts to remove ill-feeling between the friends, it has not been achieved...strive your utmost that complete harmony and love may be established among all

Subject: love, unity, and fellowship among the friends; in the Cause
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/love, unity, and fellowship among the friends; in the Cause.txt
Quotation: I swear by the holy dust of the Blessed Threshold that it brought such joy as is beyond description...for it brought glad tidings of unity and harmony among the friends, and heralded fellowship, oneness and love between the beloved ones

Subject: love, unity, and fellowship among the friends; in the Cause
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/love, unity, and fellowship among the friends; in the Cause.txt
Quotation: The friends of God were associating with great harmony and friendship. I entreat from God that the believers may at all times strive to bring about union and harmony, in order that this power of unity may display an effect in this world.

Subject: love, unity, and fellowship among the friends; in the Cause
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/love, unity, and fellowship among the friends; in the Cause.txt
Quotation: the friends of God are humble and submissive, and show utmost love and affection toward one another... so that the radiant flame of true fellowship may be kindled in the assemblage of the world and utterly consume the veil of estrangement

Subject: love, unity, and fellowship among the friends; in the Cause
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/love, unity, and fellowship among the friends; in the Cause.txt
Quotation: I hope that this love and unity may increase day by day, and its effects may reach other regions. Therefore, the friends of God and the daughters of the Kingdom must serve this purpose and become the cause of joy to the heart of Abdul-Baha.

Subject: love, unity, and fellowship among the friends; in the Cause
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/love, unity, and fellowship among the friends; in the Cause.txt
Quotation: All your letters are the product of a sincere pen, for they indicate the unity of the divine friends... I hope that, through the favors of the Blessed Beauty, he may show extraordinary valor in fostering love and fellowship among the loved ones.

Subject: love, unity, and fellowship among the friends; in the Cause
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/love, unity, and fellowship among the friends; in the Cause.txt
Quotation: Light ye the candle of the love of God and drink ye the wine of the knowledge of God, and make your palate sweet with the honey of love and unity, so that the countenance of divine bestowal may appear in that gathering with the utmost grace, beauty and sweetness.

Subject: love, unity, and fellowship among the friends; in the Cause
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/love, unity, and fellowship among the friends; in the Cause.txt
Quotation: In New York, due to the discord that exists among the friends, the Cause is declining day by day. If it remains thus, it will be completely extinguished. If you wish to render a great service, strive to completely remove this discord. The Cause will immediately progress.

Subject: love, unity, and fellowship among the friends; in the Cause
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/love, unity, and fellowship among the friends; in the Cause.txt
Quotation: O loved ones of God! Be not at variance among yourselves. Rather, remove all differences between you and be not hard of heart if ye be among those who know. Show mercy unto yourselves and your brethren, transgress not the straight path, and be not among the transgressors.

Subject: love, unity, and fellowship among the friends; in the Cause
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/love, unity, and fellowship among the friends; in the Cause.txt
Quotation: That is why there must be much love amongst the believers of God. The friends of God must sacrifice their lives for the sake of each other. Their love for each other must be so great. You must love each other very much. They must become like unto one spirit and one heart.

Subject: love, unity, and fellowship among the friends; in the Cause
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/love, unity, and fellowship among the friends; in the Cause.txt
Quotation: Today the greatest of obligations is the unity of the friends of God. You must certainly exert great effort to bring about, by whatever means, complete harmony among the friends. You must give this matter your utmost attention. And today there is no service greater than this.

Subject: love, unity, and fellowship among the friends; in the Cause
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/love, unity, and fellowship among the friends; in the Cause.txt
Quotation: Now you must strive diligently night and day to become dawning-places of the lights of unity and rising-points of the lights of detachment, and to blend with one another with utmost love such that the cloud of favors will pour forth and the lights of bestowal will shine forth.

Subject: love, unity, and fellowship among the friends; in the Cause
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/love, unity, and fellowship among the friends; in the Cause.txt
Quotation: I hope for such results from this amity that it will lead to spirituality in the world, to impart guidance to all who dwell on this earth. I hope for such results from this gathering that it will not be like other gatherings of people who forget each other as soon as they disperse.

Subject: love, unity, and fellowship among the friends; in the Cause
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/love, unity, and fellowship among the friends; in the Cause.txt
Quotation: The divine friends must make the unity of the human world their highest aim and aspiration. This unity must first be established among the friends of God so that it may afterwards spread to other peoples. Such unity is impossible save under the shadow of the banner of God's Covenant.

Subject: love, unity, and fellowship among the friends; in the Cause
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/love, unity, and fellowship among the friends; in the Cause.txt
Quotation: tell them that 'Abdu'l-Baha is constantly waiting to receive good news in regard to the plenteousness of the Fire of the Love of God in New York: that the believers unanimously and harmoniously do their utmost to revive the hearts, guide the souls and their arising to attract the spirits (of men).

Subject: love, unity, and fellowship among the friends; in the Cause
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/love, unity, and fellowship among the friends; in the Cause.txt
Quotation: It was an absolute impossibility for a Zoroastrian to unite with a Jew, a Seyed, and a Mullah and for these to unite with a Christian was an impossibility; but the power of the Covenant has even so gathered them that they are accounted as one spirit. Although the bodies are numerous, the spirit is one.

Subject: love, unity, and fellowship among the friends; in the Cause
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/love, unity, and fellowship among the friends; in the Cause.txt
Quotation: I beseech God to unlock before ye the doors of unity in all matters, purified from all limitations and bondage, clinging to the robe of oneness and detachment. By the grace of God, nothing brings joy to the heart of ?bdu'l-Baha save the unity of the loved ones of God, and the loved ones of the pure ones of God.

Subject: love, unity, and fellowship among the friends; in the Cause
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/love, unity, and fellowship among the friends; in the Cause.txt
Quotation: If you are sincere in your love for me, the love and serve the believers of God. My remedy is to hear that the believers love each other. Let everyone speak to me about love and I will love him more. How my heart leaps with joy when I hear the friends love each other, always overlooking one another's small mistakes.

Subject: love, unity, and fellowship among the friends; in the Cause
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/love, unity, and fellowship among the friends; in the Cause.txt
Quotation: This is the foundation of the religion of God, and if this is not firmly established, ultimately the entire structure will completely collapse and all souls will fall into manifest loss...the lack of unity among the Hands and the absence of fellowship among the friends with one another has become an obstacle and barrier.

Subject: love, unity, and fellowship among the friends; in the Cause
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/love, unity, and fellowship among the friends; in the Cause.txt
Quotation: Thy letter was received. It was a clear proof of the unity and oneness of the divine friends. This news brought joy and delight. I beseech the divine favors that this unity and oneness may increase day by day, and that not a single soul may remain unless they enter this circle of oneness with the utmost love and kindness.

Subject: love, unity, and fellowship among the friends; in the Cause
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/love, unity, and fellowship among the friends; in the Cause.txt
Quotation: The divine friends must nurture one another and demonstrate the utmost love and kindness. If the loved ones of God do not bear with one another, who can bear? Therefore, all thoughts must be concentrated on this: first, that the divine friends achieve the utmost love and harmony with each other, and then proceed to guide others.

Subject: love, unity, and fellowship among the friends; in the Cause
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/love, unity, and fellowship among the friends; in the Cause.txt
Quotation: Union and concord between the Friends and the Maidservants of the Merciful, are the causes of extension of God's Kingdom, and receiving the help of the Holy Spirit. [...] If there should be no unity, then the bases of God's religion will fall to pieces. However, it is my hope that you may be of one Spirit, one heart and one opinion.

Subject: love, unity, and fellowship among the friends; in the Cause
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/love, unity, and fellowship among the friends; in the Cause.txt
Quotation: You must establish a bond of unity and agreement among yourselves to such extent that you may love each other. In Persia such a state of love exists among the Baha'is that they are ready to sacrifice their lives for each other, and they have such an ideal communication like unto communication of flowers gathered together in a bouquet.

Subject: love, unity, and fellowship among the friends; in the Cause
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/love, unity, and fellowship among the friends; in the Cause.txt
Quotation: O friends! Today ye must all arise to that which will cause unity and harmony. Every decayed bone is moved by the motion of the Supreme Pen and is enabled to speak through the choice wine of the utterance of the Beloved of all possibility. God willing, may each one be as a spirit for the bodies of the servants and as a light for the lands.

Subject: love, unity, and fellowship among the friends; in the Cause
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/love, unity, and fellowship among the friends; in the Cause.txt
Quotation: O ye two kindly brothers! Praise be to God that ye are brothers both in body and soul, kindred spirits born of one father and one mother, and both servants of the All-Glorious Lord. Through the bounty of the Glorious Lord, it is my hope that these two brothers may be equal partners in both this earthly world and the heavenly realm, ever harmonious with one another.

Subject: love, unity, and fellowship among the friends; in the Cause
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/love, unity, and fellowship among the friends; in the Cause.txt
Quotation: This is the time of love and unity. This is the moment for the affection of the loved ones of God. The ears of 'Abdu'l-Baha are ever attentively waiting to hear from what clime will come the life-giving fragrances of friendship, reconciliation, unity and harmony among the friends. With utmost longing I await the glad tidings of oneness, unity, sincerity, faithfulness, love and purity from my dear friends.

Subject: love, unity, and fellowship among the friends; in the Cause
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/love, unity, and fellowship among the friends; in the Cause.txt
Quotation: Therefore, I pray, asking for your confirmation and assistance, that the aid and uplift of BAHA'O'LLAH may reach you, the hosts of the Kingdom of Abha may reinforce you, that the powerful angels of God may assist you. Be assured of the victory; rest assured that you will be confirmed. That which is of essential importance is your unity and agreement. You must be in the utmost state of unity and agreement.

Subject: love, unity, and fellowship among the friends; in the Cause
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/love, unity, and fellowship among the friends; in the Cause.txt
Quotation: The more they strive for harmony the more they will make progress; the more they exert efforts for unity the more they will witness the signs of His divine assistance and providence... O friends of 'Abdu'l-Baha! I adjure you by the sweetness of the Countenance of the Abha Beauty to become as united as the stars of the Pleiades. Uproot all source of dissension among you and raise up the foundations of true harmony.

Subject: love, unity, and fellowship among the friends; in the Cause
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/love, unity, and fellowship among the friends; in the Cause.txt
Quotation: Consider what wonderful love is this that has been established between us through the Power of His Holiness Baha'u'llah! [...] But [we] who were Prisoners for 40 yrs have come here and have found so many heartfelt, cordial friends whose love and affection are lasting and not temporary. Therefore it is made clear to you that this love and amity have been brought into being through an extraordinary power; otherwise it would have been impossible for our hearts to be so cemented together.

Subject: love, unity, and fellowship among the friends; in the Cause
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/love, unity, and fellowship among the friends; in the Cause.txt
Quotation: This is the time for unity and harmony, and the season for oneness and unity of word. From all directions, discord brings death and destruction, while concord brings life and salvation. The glory of the Cause of God and the glory of the friends of God lie in unity and wisdom, while the abasement of God's Cause and the degradation of God's loved ones lie in discord and wrongdoing and estrangement. Therefore, as much as you can, increase love and unity so that you may become manifestations of divine mercy.

Subject: love, unity, and fellowship among the friends; in the Cause
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/love, unity, and fellowship among the friends; in the Cause.txt
Quotation: In truth, in that land you and Jinab-i-Samandar must be engaged in the promotion of the Cause of God with perfect fellowship and unity, with such steadfastness that none among the peoples of the world shall be able to prevent it. God willing, I hope that the light of unity may shine forth in that land and all may occupy themselves with the remembrance of God upon the carpet of love, fellowship, affection and unity. The very unity of the friends of God hath been and shall ever be the cause of guiding mankind.

Subject: love, unity, and fellowship among the friends; in the Cause
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/love, unity, and fellowship among the friends; in the Cause.txt
Quotation: The question of co-ordinating and unifying the two Spiritual Assemblies, that of Chicago and of New York, is of the utmost importance, and once a Spiritual Assembly is duly formed in Washington, these two Assemblies should also establish ties of unity with that Assembly. To sum it up, it is the desire of the Lord God that the loved ones of God and the handmaids of the Merciful in the West should come closer together in harmony and unity as day followeth day, and until this is accomplished, the work will never go forward.

Subject: love, unity, and fellowship among the friends; in the Cause
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/love, unity, and fellowship among the friends; in the Cause.txt
Quotation: O ye believers of God! If you wish the joy, happiness and the composure of the spirit and the peace of the conscience of Abdul-Baha, strengthen the bonds of union and harmony amongst yourselves so that all of you may become the waves of one sea, the drops of one river, the flowers of one garden, the links of one cuirass, soaring in the atmosphere and breaking forth into one glad song. Today there is no greater service than union and accord amongst the believers. This is the imperative need! This is the happy consummation.

Subject: love, unity, and fellowship among the friends; in the Cause
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/love, unity, and fellowship among the friends; in the Cause.txt
Quotation: Concerning the slight estrangement between Jinab-i-Aqa Siyyid Mehdi and certain friends which you had written about, these matters were incidental and assuredly, through the lofty endeavors of that loving friend, those clouds have been dispelled and the light of unity and love now shines forth. Today the greatest of all matters is the fellowship and amity of the friends. Assuredly strive with the utmost effort that the chalice of sincere fellowship and love may be passed around in the gathering of the friends, so that all may become intoxicated with this wine.

Subject: love, unity, and fellowship among the friends; in the Cause
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/love, unity, and fellowship among the friends; in the Cause.txt
Quotation: O chosen ones of God, be steadfast in the Cause of your Lord, the All-Merciful, in such wise that the winds of trials shall not move you, and be ye of those who are firmly rooted in God's Cause. Gather ye in the assemblies of fellowship and remember this Prisoner Who hath been afflicted amidst the hypocrites. Gather ye around that Name. Beware lest ye be scattered, for the wolves lurk behind you with great cunning. Be ye united amongst yourselves, for through unity shall the Cause of your Lord, the Mighty, the All-Bestowing, be made manifest, if ye be of those who are endowed with insight.

Subject: love, unity, and fellowship among the friends; in the Cause
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/love, unity, and fellowship among the friends; in the Cause.txt
Quotation: Discord is an axe at the root of the foundation of God's manifest religion and destroys the foundation of the divine edifice. This Most Great Cause is founded upon the unity and concord of the people of all regions, and is purely for the harmony and unity of the manifestations of radiance. Today, which is the glorious century and the mighty age of the Sovereign of existence, should in all aspects show pride and glory over all ages and centuries. The foundation must be laid today, therefore the loved ones of God must appear in such a garment that even a sharp sword cannot separate or prevent them.

Subject: love, unity, and fellowship among the friends; in the Cause
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/love, unity, and fellowship among the friends; in the Cause.txt
Quotation: When news of discord among the friends reaches me, I become infinitely saddened, for we are sacrificing our lives for the realization of unity and oneness in the world of humanity. Subject: many are called but few are chosen
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/many are called but few are chosen.txt
Quotation: Question: Christ says in the Gospel: "many are called, but few are chosen", and in the Qur'an it is written: "He singleth out for His mercy whomsoever He pleaseth." What is the wisdom of this?  Answer: Know that the order and perfection of the universe require that existence should appear in countless forms. Created things cannot therefore be realized in a single degree, station, manner, kind, or species: Differences of degree, distinctions in form, and a multiplicity of kinds and species are inevitable. So there must necessarily be mineral, vegetable, animal, and human kingdoms; for through man alone the world of existence could not be adequately arranged, adorned, organized, and perfected. By the same token, with the animals, plants, or minerals alone, this world would not possess such a wondrous appearance, sound arrangement, and subtle adornment: There must be differences of degrees and stations, of kinds and species, for existence to shine forth with the utmost perfection.... Now, so long as the degrees of created things are different, some will naturally rank above the others. Thus, since the election of certain creatures, such as man, for the highest degree; the maintenance of others, such as plants, in the middle degree; and the relegation of yet others, such as minerals, to the lowest degree are each and all due to the divine will and purpose, it follows that the singling out of man for the highest degree is through the grace of God, and that the differences among men with regard to spiritual attainments and heavenly perfections are likewise due to the choice of the All-Merciful. For faith, which is life eternal, is a token of grace and not the result of justice. The flame of the fire of love, in this world of earth and water, burns by the power of attraction and not through human effort and striving, although through the latter one may indeed acquire knowledge, learning, and other perfections. It is the light of the divine Beauty, then, that must stir up and move the spirit through its attractive power. Wherefore is it said: "many are called, but few are chosen".
