Quotation: The text centers on Imam Husayn's martyrdom at Karbala, particularly describing his thirst and seeking water before being killed: Did he not humbly seek water for himself and for his infant child, prostrate upon the earth in sublime truth, weak in that mighty Cause?

Subject: martyrs and martyrdom
Quotation: Blessed is the blood that hath been shed in the path of God and blessed is the body that hath borne hardships in His love. Thus hath the Tongue of Revelation made mention of those servants who hastened to the field of martyrdom in such wise as to astonish all hearts.

Subject: martyrs and martyrdom
Quotation: After several days his turn for martyrdom came. When the executioner entered the prison and called out his name loudly, that youth arose and performed a complete dance in the prison before surrendering himself to the executioner. Then he attained the supreme martyrdom.

Subject: martyrs and martyrdom
Quotation: His honor Ashraf, upon him be the Glory of God, purposed to attain the place of sacrifice. The martyrdom of that luminary of the heaven of love is a truthful testimony and an eloquent witness to the faith, recognition, certitude, steadfastness and confession of that soul.

Subject: martyrs and martyrdom
Quotation: "It has always been thus - the ancient friends lived in seclusion, yet despite this their sanctified fragrances reached the highest heaven. Though isolated by the oppression of the tyrannical, they perfumed the nostrils of the spiritual ones with their musk-like fragrance"

Subject: martyrs and martyrdom
Quotation: Prayer commemorating the martyrdom of Ghulamrida, describing his violent death at the hands of enemies who "attacked him as fierce wolves attack a gentle lamb" and "struck with clubs and palm branches until his bones were crushed, his flesh scattered, and his blood spilled."

Subject: martyrs and martyrdom
Quotation: The bird of faithfulness has flown from the branch of this world to the Divine Lote-Tree by what the hands of the oppressors have wrought. We testify that he is in a joy unequaled by any joy in creation, while his loved ones are in such grief that all things lament for them.

Subject: martyrs and martyrdom
Quotation: "And from the news of the martyrdom of Aqa Murtada of Sarvistan... that oppressed one had been under chains and fetters for several years and endured every kind of tribulation and affliction in God's way, ultimately giving his life in utter oppression for love of the Beloved"

Subject: martyrs and martyrdom
Quotation: He became a believer, taught the Truth and suffered martyrdom in the Fortress of Tarbarazi. After teaching many, he was arrested in Bar Faroosh and torn in pieces by people of all classes, and his body was scattered in small fragments. Finally he suffered martyrdom in x x x x.

Subject: martyrs and martyrdom
Quotation: His Holiness Manshadi has found freedom from this mortal world and hastened to the divine realm. Due to the intensity of his burning and the abundance of his longing, the lamp could not be contained within the glass of contingent existence, and thus ascended to the infinite world.

Subject: martyrs and martyrdom
Quotation: the martyrdom of the noble branch of Thy lofty Tree and the tragedy of the gentle offshoot of Thy glorious divine Lote-Tree, namesake of Thy honored Messenger, Ahmad the Praiseworthy, the Strong, the Firm...that he should be martyred in Thy path in the homeland of the Primal Point

Subject: martyrs and martyrdom
Quotation: the glorious martyr Master 'Ali-Akbar, may my spirit be sacrificed for him...until savage bloodthirsty ones like wolves attacked that chief of the free, giving not a moment's respite. They drew sword and blade against that faithful leader and adorned the earth with that pure blood.

Subject: martyrs and martyrdom
Quotation: Behold, then call to mind Our servant Kazim who was martyred in the land of ?ad - a martyrdom at whose tragedy the atoms of creation wept, and beyond them the Concourse on High and the dwellers in the cities of Names. Thy Lord, the All-Seeing, the All-Informed, beareth witness to this.

Subject: martyrs and martyrdom
Quotation: Those who have drunk from the cup of supreme martyrdom in the path of God - this is from the grace of thy Lord, the All-Merciful, the Most Compassionate. These are they whose hearts God has specially endowed with His love, and whose faces beam with the light of God in the Garden of Ridvan.

Subject: martyrs and martyrdom
Quotation: The martyrdom of assured souls hath been and continueth to be the cause of the exaltation of the Word, yet some have added that which is not worthy of mention. Tribulation, hardship, martyrdom, adversity and torment in the path of God are sweeter than honey and constitute a supreme bounty.

Subject: martyrs and martyrdom
Quotation: For thou, in remembrance of the martyrs of Yazd and Isfahan, don crimson robes and play a melody like an organ, for those friends became intoxicated with the wine of love and hastened to the altar of sacrifice, and took flight to the private chamber of communion with the Self-Sufficing Lord.

Subject: martyrs and martyrdom
Quotation: Thou art he who preferred the Self of God above thine own self in thy longing to attain His presence and seek His good-pleasure, and who was so transported by the rapture of His Call and the scratching of His Most Exalted Pen that thou didst scatter the pearls of thy life at thy Lord's feet.

Subject: martyrs and martyrdom
Quotation: "O my friend, O Sulayman Khan! If you wish to demonstrate your long friendship to me, then I beseech you not to intercede on my behalf. Through your intercession, I will be deprived of the bounty of martyrdom, will fall behind my companions, and remain in the clutches of this ephemeral world."

Subject: martyrs and martyrdom
Quotation: Verily the unbelievers who speak of God without the word of the Gate, speaking vainly without truth, and who say falsely concerning Our friends that after their martyrdom they are dead - these are they who have purchased God's verses of truth for a paltry price, unrighteously and for little gain.

Subject: martyrs and martyrdom
Quotation: They are, in the sight of God, among those who glorify Him. Say: For him who lays down his life in the path of God there remains no unfulfilled desire, for God will grant him at that time from His bounty that which was bestowed upon those who were martyred in His path, as they shall join them thereafter.

Subject: martyrs and martyrdom
Quotation: You had expressed the desire for martyrdom in the path of God. This is the ultimate hope of the daughters of the Kingdom, and every attracted soul desires this brimming cup of the greatest bounty. But attraction to the divine fragrances and service to the Kingdom of God is itself the greatest martyrdom.

Subject: martyrs and martyrdom
Quotation: See what a conqueror David was. He conquered countries, he killed all his enemies, he overcame all, but when he is mentioned it has no effect. But the humility of Christ, see what an effect it! Or John the Baptist, when they cut off his head, see what an effect it had! Consider what an effect these have.

Subject: martyrs and martyrdom
Quotation: Would that I had been with him, that I might have attained a mighty triumph! For that luminous countenance, with divine attraction and heavenly glad-tidings, with spiritual sensibilities and celestial joy, with divine delight and godly detachment and heavenly ascension, hastened to the field of sacrifice.

Subject: martyrs and martyrdom
Quotation: During the upheaval in the Land of Ta, countless times were heard from the Blessed Tongue mentions of those honorable women who arose to serve His loved ones. O servant present in the prison of the Land of Ta! It is adorned with the name of God's loved ones and its dust is honored by the blood of Ali-A'la.

Subject: martyrs and martyrdom
Quotation: I testify that though He was slain before Thee, yet was He living in Thy presence. Nothing can frustrate His power, nothing can be hidden from His knowledge, and no changes of ages and times can alter Him, for Thou didst create Him from the light of Thine Essence, and He shall never cease to exist forever.

Subject: martyrs and martyrdom
Quotation: make my blood spilled upon the earth, my body crucified in the sky, my flesh scattered upon the dust, and my bones shattered by the arrows of fate...The loved ones of Nayriz became intoxicated with this overflowing cup and, with the polo stick of endeavor, carried away the ball of precedence from this field

Subject: martyrs and martyrdom
Quotation: Consider His Holiness, the Bird of the Garden of the Kingdom, his honor Murta?a (may my spirit be sacrificed for him), what a burning fire he kindled at the pole of the horizons that its flame reached to the borders of the Abha Kingdom, and such a radiance did he shed that it illumined the horizons of creation.

Subject: martyrs and martyrdom
Quotation: through the power of the Word of God, more than twenty thousand, upheld by the strength, steadfastness and firmness of their belief, under great oppression, went to the place of death and with perfect happiness and joy drank from the cup of martyrdom. They were cut to pieces while uttering "O thou, Baha'o'llah!"

Subject: martyrs and martyrdom
Quotation: This mighty flood reached every foundation and destroyed it, but cast the holy souls into the Most Great Sea of martyrdom...When I recall the glory of the martyrs' martyrdom, I wish that this deprived one could also partake of that sealed nectar, and this poor one could also receive a portion of that greatest gift.

Subject: martyrs and martyrdom
Quotation: This is a mention of those who were martyred in the path of God, the Lord of Destiny... Blessed is the soul that attained the wine of certitude in the days of the All-Merciful and was martyred in the path of God in such wise that the kindreds of the Supreme Paradise and the dwellers of the Cities of Names lamented.

Subject: martyrs and martyrdom
Quotation: O Lord! Thou seest my two sons named Muhammad who have ascended to the Supreme Companion in the precincts of Thy great mercy. They turned to Thee and spoke Thy praise and glory, and neither the oppression of the oppressors prevented them from turning to Thee, nor the schemes of the plotters from beholding Thy horizon.

Subject: martyrs and martyrdom
Quotation: Finally, in utmost joy they hastened to the altar of love, lifted up their heads, and galloped on the steed of endeavor from the earthly realm to the Supreme Concourse...Deprived is the head that is not sacrificed in His path, and disappointed the soul that does not become a sacrifice for the Beauty of the All-Merciful.

Subject: martyrs and martyrdom
Quotation: expressions of grief over martyrdom of Ali and yearning to attain martyrdom: "Whenever I reflect that the body of Ali was suspended in the air while I remain between earth and heaven, my heart is troubled, my limbs tremble, my skin crawls, and my body is shaken. Therefore, woe unto myself and lamentation upon my being!"

Subject: martyrs and martyrdom
Quotation: such a fire of grief has been kindled in the heart of this wronged prisoner due to sorrow over the oppression of the martyrs... what bounty could be greater than this and what favor more complete than that one's life be sacrificed in the path of the Beloved and one's body roll in dust and blood for love of that Rose-clad One?

Subject: martyrs and martyrdom
Quotation: He it is Who recompenseth those who were slain in the path of their Lord aforetime, and those who spent their wealth in their Lord's path, and those who have ascended to that station, and those who have grieved or shall grieve in their Lord's path as servants by their Lord's leave, with better than what their hands have wrought.

Subject: martyrs and martyrdom
Quotation: "I testify that, verily, thou art a martyr of faithfulness" ... "Blessed is thy body which was burned by the hand of every transgressor! Blessed is thy throat which was cut by the poniard of every traitor! Blessed is thy breast which was stricken by the oppressors' darts! Blessed is thy heart which was wounded by a sharp sword!"

Subject: martyrs and martyrdom
Quotation: She had seven sons; six of them had been martyred...He was condemned to be crucified...He steadfastly refused, saying: 'Nay, rather do I wish to be sacrificed for my God.'...They fell upon her. Still she cried aloud, rejoicing that she had given her dearest treasure for the Cause of God -- and they beat her till she, too, died.

Subject: martyrs and martyrdom
Quotation: For these few souls who happened to drink the cup of martyrdom, and likewise for those who suffered material losses, supplications and entreaties were made at the Divine Threshold that His all-encompassing grace might envelope all, and that those who were accidentally killed might be counted among the martyrs at the Divine Court.

Subject: martyrs and martyrdom
Quotation: O My Pen! Make mention of him who was martyred in the path of God in the early days, who was named Sul?an-'Ali and who attained the choice wine of revelation from the hand of the bounty of his Lord, the All-Bountiful. I testify that he believed in God and acknowledged His Manifestation on a day wherein every remote scholar denied Him.

Subject: martyrs and martyrdom
Quotation: I bear witness that though Thou wert slain in the path of God, yet Thou wert not dead, and though Thou didst endure harm in the Cause of God, yet Thou wert not overcome. Thou art He Who hath desired martyrdom for Thyself, and thereby have hearts borne witness at the station of utterance with the testimony of unity unto the All-Merciful.

Subject: martyrs and martyrdom
Quotation: And We mention at this time the one who ascended unto God in prison. My Supreme Pen has acknowledged his martyrdom in My path. Blessed is he and joy be unto him. The Concourse on High welcomed him by God's leave, the Lord of all names and Creator of heaven, and the maidens of Paradise in their celestial chambers sought blessings through him.

Subject: martyrs and martyrdom
Quotation: "The Prince of Martyrs (may my soul be offered up to him), as regards the ocean of calamity, reached the bottom of the sea, while the vile Yazid and the loathsome Walid achieved outward victory in the material world and rejoiced and made merry over their success. But later it became clear and evident that the suffering of Husayn was the real favor"

Subject: martyrs and martyrdom
Quotation: Among the special bounties that were revealed concerning the ascension of the destined sign was that on the day when, outwardly, news of the ascension was presented, at that very moment He commanded that the Branches of the Blessed Tree and all those around Him should hold a gathering and occupy themselves with mention of this new and blessed event.

Subject: martyrs and martyrdom
Quotation: Husayn of old beheld his slayer on that day until he was martyred in My mighty, impregnable path...By God! He was martyred only to establish My remembrance, out of love for My Self, and longing to attain My presence...Verily, Husayn of old was slain in the path of God and offered up his spirit in his longing to attain His mighty, impregnable presence.

Subject: martyrs and martyrdom
Quotation: The horsemen of the field of martyrdom galloped to the Abha Kingdom...This pure blood which made the dusty earth the envy of crimson tulips shall surge in such wise as to transform the land of Iran into the Paradise of Ridvan...Therefore we must give thanks that the land of Ya [Yazd] became a divine altar and that region became the place of sacrifice.

Subject: martyrs and martyrdom
Quotation: And I testify that ye answered your Lord when His call was raised, and turned towards Him when He appeared with His sovereignty prevailing over all who are in the heavens and earths...We have sent down for those who were martyred in the path of God that whereby the tears of those near unto God have fallen and the sighs of the sincere ones have ascended

Subject: martyrs and martyrdom
Quotation: Account of a martyr who was imprisoned and then executed, rejoicing in his sacrifice: "He addressed them saying: 'O you who are present for my execution in the path of my Beloved Lord! I have nothing to offer you in return for this glad tidings you have given me except this covering for my head, which I present to you in recognition of your kindness.'"

Subject: martyrs and martyrdom
Quotation: Night and day, in remembrance of the martyrs, He is so affected, longing, grieved and regretful that it defies description... these sorrows and pains, this effect and longing, this withering and hurt are because of how the faithful friends drank the cup of purity in the arena of supreme martyrdom, attained the greatest gift, and soared to the Abha Kingdom

Subject: martyrs and martyrdom
Quotation: Like unto the gentle Ishmael they hastened to the field to martyrdom and with the eloquence of Christ they chanted soul-entrancing prayers on the cross... How many souls in that gathering drank the cup of bestowal from the cup-bearer of sacrifice with utmost joy and eagerness, and how many precious beings rolled like scattered pearls in that dust and blood.

Subject: martyrs and martyrdom
Quotation: When the executioner came to call a prisoner, he would rise up and dance - dance a regular dance - then would kiss his blessed Hands and embrace the other friends and would go - to be martyred. Every day they used to come and martyr a few. The executioner would come and take them away. When the music sounded, it was known that a martyrdom was taking place.

Subject: martyrs and martyrdom
Quotation: We make mention of Muhammad-Baqir who hath ascended unto the Most Glorious Horizon and attained the grace of his Lord, the All-Bountiful. He it is who drank the cup of tribulations in the path of God, the Lord of all names, and heard the taunts of the enemies because he turned unto the Supreme Horizon. Thus doth the Wronged One remember him in His mighty prison.

Subject: martyrs and martyrdom
Quotation: By God! Husayn weepeth at My sorrow, and all that hath been created between the Kaf and the Nun lamenteth for Me. O Hasan! Know thou that this Husayn at every moment beholdeth Shimr on His right, then Sinan on His left, then Khawli behind Him, and God is witness to what I say. His only crime was that He called all unto God, the King, the Mighty, the Praiseworthy.

Subject: martyrs and martyrdom
Quotation: The religious people no longer question the followers of BAHA'O'LLAH, being unable to reply to their arguments. The priests and rulers call them necromancers, persecuting and martyring them; and with great joy these disciples give all their worldly goods and gladly lay down their lives for the cause of BAHA'O'LLAH. They go to death crying aloud, "Ya Baha El-Abha!"

Subject: martyrs and martyrdom
Quotation: Likewise, consider the Babu'l-Bab (may the spirit of those drawn nigh be sacrificed for him), that illumined candle and most brilliant rising star, what afflictions, trials and tribulations he endured in the path of God, what blows he suffered, and how at last in the castle of adversity he drank the brimming cup of martyrdom, and what persecutions his relatives endured.

Subject: martyrs and martyrdom
Quotation: Regarding what was written about martyrdom and what was requested, after it was submitted to the Most Holy Court, He spoke these exalted words: Praise be to God, they have attained to that which was revealed from the Supreme Pen in the Divine Book concerning martyrs, for they have been in the presence for years and have attained to reunion, meeting, and service to the Cause.

Subject: martyrs and martyrdom
Quotation: O Haydar! Upon thee be My Baha! Some time ago a special Tablet was revealed for the son of the martyr, upon them both be the Most Glorious Beauty of God, and in that Tablet mention was made of the martyr who sacrificed his life in the path of God, and We revealed for him that whose fragrance shall not cease and whose traces shall not change, and that which was ordained therein.

Subject: martyrs and martyrdom
Quotation: The heat of love had seized him to such degree that he was set ablaze and soared in the atmosphere of the love of the All-Merciful. When he ascended, God purified him from all the odors of this world and the hand of grace admitted him to a station that cannot be described in words. On the Day of Ascension, the Concourse on High and a company of angels and the Spirit welcomed him.

Subject: martyrs and martyrdom
Quotation: The news of his ascension saddened the hearts. He was in reality in the utmost sincerity. Praise be to God that you adorned his blessed finger with the ring bearing the inscription: 'Verily I originated from God and returned unto Him'... This too is a proof of his sincerity and that in his last breath, he breathed the Allah-u-Abha, whereby the hearts of those present were impressed.

Subject: martyrs and martyrdom
Quotation: Consider the two martyrs - they are two lamps unto the world. Were We to mention now what shall appear hereafter, all would be struck with wonder. The Two Shining Lights, upon them be My glory and loving-kindness, asked martyrdom from the Self-Sufficient, the Exalted with utmost humility and supplication. Now observe what station could be greater than this station which they attained.

Subject: martyrs and martyrdom
Quotation: Likewise a special tablet of visitation hath been revealed for His Holiness the Martyr, Mulla 'Ali-Jan, who advanced toward martyrdom with such strength that neither the hosts could intimidate him nor the might of the aggressors weaken him, until he sacrificed his spirit in My path. And also for those exalted souls who sacrificed their all in the path of God, the Lord of earth and heaven.

Subject: martyrs and martyrdom
Quotation: Those people formerly martyred the Prince of Martyrs, and when asked why they had put to such a humiliating death this holy soul whom all acknowledged and confessed to be the son of the Apostle and the Prince of the Youth of Paradise, they replied that he had risen against the Imam of the Age. And now they have martyred this Husayn, who is the Imam of the land of ?ad and His very essence.

Subject: martyrs and martyrdom
Quotation: But regret is for us mortals, for that servant of God and chosen one of the All-Merciful has soared from the place of sacrifice to the zenith of the Abha Kingdom, while we remain deprived and forsaken in this lower realm. They have drunk a single draught from the ocean of the greatest bounty, while we remain caught in the yearning for a single drop, suffering a hundred thousand afflictions.

Subject: martyrs and martyrdom
Quotation: As for the martyrs, they have indeed achieved a mighty triumph. By God, the True One! The faces of the Concourse on High beamed with joy at meeting them in the Most Glorious Kingdom, and the Tongue of Truth spoke glad tidings to them, and the angels drawn nigh celebrated their ascension and arrival in the Garden of Paradise in the highest heaven. There is no gift or bounty greater than this.

Subject: martyrs and martyrdom
Quotation: At the beginning of Our imprisonment We sacrificed a Branch from the Branches for a matter none knoweth save God, thy Lord. That Branch, in the prime of youth, laid down his life and sought another station. I swear by the Sun of the horizon of inner meanings that were there to be revealed less than a needle's eye of thy son's station who ascended unto God, all would fall unconscious with joy.

Subject: martyrs and martyrdom
Quotation: Thou art he who accepted not a ransom in the love of God, the Lord of this world and of the next; and repeatedly craved of God that which actually befell him. Thou art the Most Great Ransom in the Crimson Book. By thy life, O My Name! By reason of thine agony the afflictions of the saints have been effaced, and the eyes of God's chosen ones and the Celestial Concourse have run down with tears.

Subject: martyrs and martyrdom
Quotation: The friends of the All-Merciful, whether in times of mourning or days of joy, should visit the martyrs' shrines in Yazd, Ardakan and Manshad on behalf of Abdu'l-Baha, but with wisdom so as not to cause commotion, sedition or corruption. As for the families of the martyrs, they must receive continuous assistance, sustained and established. From here, whenever possible, aid will certainly be sent.

Subject: martyrs and martyrdom
Quotation: the scion of that august and majestic champion who, with beaming countenance, enkindled heart, and a spirit joyful at its impending ascent unto the kingdom of Thy sanctity, was martyred in Thy path, and his pure blood spilt upon the dust in Thy love the noble scion of that glorious and distinguished man who was martyred in Thy path and whose pure blood was shed upon the earth in his love for Thee

Subject: martyrs and martyrdom
Quotation: Behold and then remember when My Name ?a (Haydar-'Ali) came to the place of sacrifice and gave all that he possessed in the path of God, the Lord of the worlds. Blessed is he and blessed is thine uncle through whom the sighs of the Concourse on High ascended and the tears of the Messengers descended. By the life of God! Through him joy was transformed into the greatest sorrow and My mighty Throne did lament.

Subject: martyrs and martyrdom
Quotation: However, this station was sealed with him, and whosoever shall commit after him what he committed, God will not make mention of him. Likewise, a limited number in the past sacrificed their lives by their own hands in the path of the Beloved of all possibility, and the station of each hath been revealed in the Tablets. Blessed be the King of Martyrs who sacrificed his life in Iraq and his likes in other lands.

Subject: martyrs and martyrdom
Quotation: The door of the place of martyrdom, where men die for love, were flung open and while the loved ones of God, dancing for joy, hastened to it, the great feast was ready. The cup of sacrifice was passed around and the soil dyed crimson with blood. The arena of martyrdom hath become the sanctuary of His paradise and every faithful lover hath attained the comfort of his heart and the happiness of his conscience.

Subject: martyrs and martyrdom
Quotation: Mention is made of a servant who was martyred in His path, and whom the breezes of longing bore away until they turned him toward the countenance of the All-Merciful in the heavenly Pole, an exalted and gracious station...Blessed art thou, O servant, for thou hast dyed thy radiance with fire. By God! By radiance We mean but thy hair which turned white in thy faith in God, and by fire We mean but thy crimson blood.

Subject: martyrs and martyrdom
Quotation: I testify that Your calamity is greater than any calamity in creation can be joined to, and Your tribulation is higher than any tribulation in invention can equal...He attained this supreme martyrdom before his outward martyrdom, for he had no will, desire or thought of his own. He sacrificed all these degrees for the Friend, and afterward attained outward martyrdom, offering his life in the path of the True Beloved

Subject: martyrs and martyrdom
Quotation: In none of the past dispensations have there been such heroic and sublime instances of devotion and martyrdom as in this Baha'i Cause! For example, a believer was given to the cavalry. These ferocious beasts took him to Sabze Meydan and about one thousand of them riding on their horses, with drawn words attacked him from all sides. The body was actually cut into thousand small pieces and yet they did not gave it up.

Subject: martyrs and martyrdom
Quotation: Through your calamity the rock cried out, the great cry was raised, and tears flowed from the people of the depths of oneness. I testify that by you and the light of your steadfastness was adorned the brocade of the Book of Faithfulness in the mortal realm of creation, and by your suffering the heart of Baha lamented, His Most Exalted Pen cried out, and the outpouring from the clouds of grace and bounty was cut off.

Subject: martyrs and martyrdom
Quotation: They martyred innocent souls and took all the subjects captive in chains, brought them to Tehran and threw them in prison. They cut off the beard and chin of the Spirit of spirits, Mulla 'Abdu'l-Fattah, and dragged him in chains with bare feet to Tehran...upon reaching Tehran gave up his soul to the Beloved in prison, sacrificed himself for the Kind Friend, and joyfully and smiling became a martyr for that Radiant Moon.

Subject: martyrs and martyrdom
Quotation: The Beauty of God sacrificed Himself amongst the people for the sake of the Peerless Beloved. He freely removed the crown of life and cast it at the feet of the Beloved of all possibility. He attained unto twin martyrdoms - before his outward martyrdom, he had already sacrificed himself over the course of years, for he had no desires, will or purpose of his own; he had caused them all to perish in the will of the Beloved.

Subject: martyrs and martyrdom
Quotation: Remember Mustafa who was martyred in the land of Ta for the Cause of God, the Manifestation of this wondrous Cause... He spoke My name and hastened to the place of sacrifice through My love, the Mighty, the Inaccessible. The glory shining from the horizon of eternity be upon him and upon those who attained his exalted station and took refuge in the stronghold of their Lord's loving-kindness, the All-Knowing, the All-Informed.

Subject: martyrs and martyrdom
Quotation: God willing, they will be sent later as appropriate. I convey greetings and salutations to the honored beloved, His Holiness Ha before Dal, and likewise to Haji who shares thy name, and to all other friends. Convey the greetings of the Wronged One to all the friends in that land and say: Martyrdom is like the supreme elixir - rare, nay unobtainable - and hath not been and is not destined for every soul save by His binding and wise command.

Subject: martyrs and martyrdom
Quotation: They heard Your call from the Center of Glory and responded to Your summons when it encompassed the world of creation... The people persecuted them and rose against them with harm and blame. They fell under the claws of oppression and were immersed in seas of trials. Eyes wept for them like springs, and tears of sorrow flowed from eyelids. They bore every affliction in Your path and drank in Your love a bitter cup from all who harbored hatred.

Subject: martyrs and martyrdom
Quotation: I testify that on the night wherein thou didst ascend to the Most Glorious Horizon and the Supreme Companion, and on its day, God forgave every male and female servant who had ascended, as a token of His grace and favor toward thee, save those who denied the right of God and that which was manifested from His presence openly. The exalted fruit has truly melted from the fire of separation, therefore she is mentioned among the martyrs in God's presence.

Subject: martyrs and martyrdom
Quotation: At the time of Our departure one of the believers offered up his life as a sacrifice in his love for God, the Lord of all worlds. Here the one who hath been designated by Our Name, Munir, fell down upon his face before this Youth, laid hold upon His foot, and begged that he might sacrifice his life in the way of God even as he lay there before Us with his arms around Our foot. Shortly after he had disembarked, his soul ascended unto the Supreme Horizon.

Subject: martyrs and martyrdom
Quotation: Through thee have We manifested the Cause in such wise that hearts were confounded and eyes were blinded... When We showed unto him the Kingdom of the Cause and shone upon him from the Dayspring of Revelation, he was illumined by the lights of that effulgence. Such rapture seized him that he soared on the wings of detachment to aid thy Lord, the Creator of all things. Through him were gladdened the eyes of victory and adorned was the temple of the Cause.

Subject: martyrs and martyrdom
Quotation: And concerning what you wrote about Aqa 'Ali, upon him be 966 [Baha'u'llah], son of His Holiness Haji Na?ir who, as God beareth witness, was martyred in His path - this was presented before His countenance, and one Most Holy, Most Exalted Tablet was specifically revealed and sent for him. Deliver it unto him. Verily, He is with whosoever is with Him. The station of His Holiness Na?ir, upon him be the Most Glorious Glory of God, is great in the sight of God.

Subject: martyrs and martyrdom
Quotation: Each of those martyrs was a raised call and a quickening spirit, for through their martyrdom a new call was raised in such wise that all the kingdoms of the world gave ear, and every realm sought to draw nigh and become informed of the mysteries of this Most Great Revelation. And if it be said that each was but a trumpet, there is no harm in this, for there was breathed into those souls a Word that is the cause of the regeneration of the world and its peoples.

Subject: martyrs and martyrdom
Quotation: And We have revealed from the heaven of Our utterance, for those who were martyred in Ya, that which hath enraptured the hearts of those near unto God. Glorified be God! The oppressors of that land have committed that which hath caused wailing and lamentation to be raised from the Most Exalted Paradise and the Supreme Heaven, imagining they would profit from this trade. However, the Most Exalted Pen beareth witness to the loss of these heedless and evil souls.

Subject: martyrs and martyrdom
Quotation: With perfect strength they stood with their souls before the hosts of tyranny and ignorance, smiling. They martyred each one in such wise that none but God hath reckoned it, for there was no helper, no supporter, no one to show mercy. When they found none to command or forbid, they fully manifested their own desires in the execution of tyranny. That which caused the eyes of grandeur to weep and the lamentation of those nigh unto God to be raised became manifest.

Subject: martyrs and martyrdom
Quotation: Glad tidings unto thee, O servant, for thou didst draw nigh unto God and didst detach thyself from those who disbelieved and associated partners with God, and didst turn thy face toward God, the Mighty, the Powerful, the All-Choosing...Thus doth God give unto whomsoever He willeth from the Kawthar of grace and bounty, and clotheth with the robe of forgiveness those who were martyred in His path and soared in the atmosphere of nearness on two wings of detachment.

Subject: martyrs and martyrdom
Quotation: This text contains extensive discussions of various martyrs, including Husayn, Siyyid Isma'il-i-Zavari'i, Mulla Kazim, Badi, Arif-i-Malakuti Najaf-'Ali, Mulla 'Ali-Jan, Ashraf and Abu-Basir, describing their sacrifices and martyrdoms in detail. For example: "Consider Siyyid Isma'il-i-Zavari'i and that which proceeded from him...He swept the entrance to the House at dawn while wearing his turban, and afterwards by his own hand sacrificed his life by the riverside."

Subject: martyrs and martyrdom
Quotation: With perfect steadfastness he offered up his life - the most precious and valuable of all things in the world - at the feet of the peerless Friend. Again no effect was visible. Once more the divine will fixed upon another sacrifice, but like before it proved fruitless. And likewise another sacrifice removed the crown of life from his head and offered it at the feet of the Beloved of all possibility. Many were the sacrifices, their ranks and stations beyond enumeration

Subject: martyrs and martyrdom
Quotation: And it is incumbent upon him to be in such a mood that, should the king decree his death, he shall not be troubled within himself, and shall hasten to the place of sacrifice saying, "Praise be unto Thee, O my God, that Thou hast made me a helper of Thy Cause, and hast decreed unto me martyrdom in Thy path! By Thy Glory, I would not exchange this cup for all the cups in the worlds, for Thou hast not ordained any equivalent to this, neither do Kawthar and Salsabil rival it!"

Subject: martyrs and martyrdom
Quotation: O Isma'il! Dost thou know what hath appeared in My age and in My days? How many sacrifices have We sent to the place of martyrdom who gave up their lives in this straight Path! We have a sacrifice in Iraq who slept turning toward the House, and his throat was cut in his longing to meet God, the Mighty, the Beautiful. And We have a sacrifice in Sad - by the life of God, the Concourse on high were amazed by him - and likewise another sacrifice, and before them another sacrifice.

Subject: martyrs and martyrdom
Quotation: Among the martyrs was Siyyid Abu'l-Qasim of Marnun. This illustrious Siyyid lived to be nearly eighty years old, and throughout his life in that region was renowned for his piety, devotion, knowledge and virtue. He was the embodiment of light and the personification of spirit. Even his enemies testified to his sanctity and purity, and bore witness to his generosity, selflessness and charity - for he was a helper to every poor soul and an aid and protector to all who sought refuge.

Subject: martyrs and martyrdom
Quotation: O Zayn! Verily My Most Exalted Pen desireth to make mention of Husayn, who attained martyrdom in the path of God, the Lord of all worlds. Blessed art thou, O Husayn! I testify that thou didst turn unto God and believe in Him on a Day when the learned ones of the earth and its divines turned away from Him. Blessed art thou, and blessed is he who loveth thee and maketh mention of thee with goodness, and blessed is he who hath recognized thy most exalted station and thy glory amongst the people.

Subject: martyrs and martyrdom
Quotation: Today man is able to adorn himself with the raiment of everlasting life and to be recorded by the Supreme Pen in the Crimson Book among the martyrs. Whosoever detacheth himself from that which he possesseth and turneth his gaze toward that which is with God - that is, who becometh not the plaything of his own idle fancies but holdeth fast to the will of Him Who doeth what He pleaseth and ordaineth what He willeth - he is accounted among the martyrs, even though he walketh the earth and eateth.

Subject: martyrs and martyrdom
Quotation: This faithful messenger (Badi) took the epistle of Baha' with all power and authority and repaired to the threshold of His Highness the Shah, while cheered and smiling in joy. He then presented himself before the Shah and said: "This is an epistle from BAHA'O'LLAH," and then presented it to him. They arrested him and after severe torture and punishment, delivered him to the executioners. He was sitting between the executioners at the time of his death with all dignity, while turning unto God.

Subject: martyrs and martyrdom
Quotation: I had chosen one person for companionship and fellowship who was among the righteous and spoke of the pure ones. He was lost in such manner as thou knowest. By thy life, my sorrow is not for the loss of wealth, but for his death and condition, that he was slain with utmost abasement, though he attained the most glorious martyrdom and ascended to the most exalted horizon. "Think not of those who are slain in God's way as dead. Nay, they live, finding their sustenance with their Lord, rejoicing."

Subject: martyrs and martyrdom
Quotation: When Mulla `Ali was led to the place of his martyrdom, he instructed the executioner to open one of his veins. When a bit of his throat was cut, with his own sacred blood, he dyed his white beard red, calling out to the crowd, 'O people! O people, is there anyone truly capable of seeing who will come to behold me?' But I say unto you, O people, is there anyone truly capable of seeing who will come to behold me?' People witnessed it but were not moved, and barbarously put to death that innocent soul.

Subject: martyrs and martyrdom
Quotation: Another will say: As a result of the illumination I received from the Day-Star of ethereal glory I was made captive and held fast in chains and stocks, for which exceptional rewards were lavished on me. Another will say: My heart was set ablaze with the fire of His love in such wise that I hastened to the field of sacrifice, and kissed the edge of the sword. Another will state: The blessed body of my illustrious father was hacked to pieces in the arena of sacrifice for the sake of my glorious Lord.

Subject: martyrs and martyrdom
Quotation: Divine nearness is not easily attained; divine nearness is attained through sacrifice of life, like twenty thousand Baha'is. For the Baha'is sacrificed their wealth, sacrificed their honor, sacrificed their comfort, sacrificed their lives, and with utmost joy hastened to the altar of supreme martyrdom. Their bodies were torn to pieces, their homes were destroyed, their possessions were plundered, their children were taken captive, and all these afflictions they accepted with the utmost joy and gladness.

Subject: martyrs and martyrdom
Quotation: And one person sacrificed themselves which caused an uproar in the city... Three souls also sacrificed themselves in this land of exile and prison: the two brothers Jinab-i-Aqa Muhammad-Baqir and Aqa Muhammad-Ismail, upon them be God's mercy and favor, who arm in arm sacrificed themselves in one night. From the beginning of creation until now, such an event has never occurred where two brothers thus united and in perfect agreement took flight from this dark earth to the Most Pure and Luminous Habitation.

Subject: martyrs and martyrdom
Quotation: "Those two gazelles of the meadow of oneness were held fast in the talons of ferocious beasts, and those two nightingales of the rose-garden of divine unity were gripped in the claws of depraved ravens... Their grave offence was to display a glimpse of the beauty of the heavenly Peacock. To do this they spread out the plumage of sanctity and intoned sweet melodies even as the warbling of a nightingale. This was the only guilt they had committed; their faithfulness was regarded as a crime, and their sincerity as deceit."

Subject: martyrs and martyrdom
Quotation: I testify that thou hast been faithful to the Covenant, that thy face hath been illumined by the light of the Lamp of the horizons, that through thee the eyes of the people of constancy have been gladdened, that thy heart hath found peace through the dawning of the light that hath spread through the seven layers, and that the resurrection of tears hath been established for thee in that thou wert made to suffer in the path of God, wert tried in thy love for God, and didst achieve martyrdom in thy steadfastness in the Covenant.

Subject: martyrs and martyrdom
Quotation: Where is he who loved God and His chosen ones? Where is he who stood firm in His service in every circumstance? Where is he who shone forth from the horizon of fidelity like the sun rising from the celestial horizon? Where is my trust in thee? Didst thou deliver him into the hands of enemies, or did he sacrifice his soul in the path of God, the Lord of Names? Tell me what the people have done to him through whom God's Cause was made manifest among the servants and the horizon of loving-kindness dawned in all lands.

Subject: martyrs and martyrdom
Quotation: O people of Baha! Know ye and act accordingly. Martyrdom in the path of the Beloved is higher, more precious, and more beloved than the treasures of earth and all that the kings possess. To this testifieth the Lord of the Kingdom in the prison of Akka. Blessed is he who hath attained, and joy be to them that are steadfast and that have turned unto Him. From every drop a creation is raised up, and from torment sweetness is ordained. God shall soon reveal the fruits of the Tree of His knowledge and the mysteries of martyrdom in His path.

Subject: martyrs and martyrdom
Quotation: God is My witness that whenever this servant remembereth the martyrs of the Land of Ya, he declareth with a myriad visible and invisible tongues: "Would that I had been with them! Would that I had heard their cry! Would that I had circled round them!" The fragrance of that shed blood hath perfumed the world of justice and equity. For days and nights the mention of those martyrs hath flowed from the Tongue of Grandeur in such wise that the Holy Spirit was filled with longing and the Spirit of Utterance cried out "Would that I had been!"

Subject: martyrs and martyrdom
Quotation: Then they martyred His Eminence Khalil with the most grievous torment. They have drunk of the blood of the monotheists in such measure as neither the Tigris nor the Euphrates, neither the Oxus nor the Sihon can equal. In the early dawn, the breezes of the All-Merciful's mercy passed over what remained of those bodies, and from their rustling was heard that which caused tablet and pen to weep. Some of these wronged ones had no mother to weep and lament for them; therefore did the Mother of the Bayan lament and the Mother of the Book weep.

Subject: martyrs and martyrdom
Quotation: From his intense fervor and enthusiasm it was clear and evident that he would drink this brimming cup of bounty from the hand of the Cup-bearer of favor. For that flame and that cry, that attraction and that burning passion, would ultimately lead to intoxication from this wine... he hastened to the field of sacrifice and laid down his life... That pure spirit, that embodied light, that personified knowledge, and that visualized certitude is among the company of martyrs, nay rather the commander of the host of those who sacrifice their lives.

Subject: martyrs and martyrdom
Quotation: A number of handmaidens became targets for the arrows of tribulation and the darts of cruelty, exposed to the oppression of enemies... They sacrificed fathers and sons, husbands and kindred... Thy father sacrificed his life in the path of the Beloved. Thy son was martyred at the hands of a tyrannical son-in-law. Thy silver-bodied brother became the radiant moon in the heaven of martyrdom. Thy brother's child, in the age of childhood and freedom, wandering and homeless, dancing and clapping his hands, laid down his head beneath sword and dagger.

Subject: martyrs and martyrdom
Quotation: However, seeing the luminous photograph of the resting place of his honor Haji Na?ir had a profound effect, as did the photograph of the wilderness where the mutilated and burned holy remains of his honor Ustad Muhammad Hashim were buried. Glory be to God! The oppressors in this illumined age committed crimes from which the tyrants of ancient dark ages would seek refuge in God. In the past, the ultimate was that they would kill someone. Now these cruel ones, after killing some bodies, out of extreme enmity cut them to pieces and set them on fire.

Subject: martyrs and martyrdom
Quotation: Were the idolaters to reflect even briefly, they would never molest these divine temples, for the purpose of those who turn away hath been and shall be to abase these tranquil souls. And if they knew that within the martyrdom of these souls lie eternal lives, and in their abasement in the path of the All-Merciful is concealed the kingdom of glory, they would never molest them. The ascension of spirits from bodies will occur in any case, whether through apparent illness or implements of war. Thus, blessed are those souls who lay down their lives in the path of the Friend and hasten to the Supreme Companion.

Subject: martyrs and martyrdom
Quotation: At times like John the Baptist they sacrifice their heads... At times they become companions of poverty, pain and sorrow like Jesus, son of Mary, and raise their heads upon the cross. At times, like the Beloved Habib, they endure a hundred thousand cruelties and ultimately ascend [poisoned] to the Supreme Companion. At times, like the dauntless Lion, the victorious Lion of God, they have their heads split open yet their faces remain radiant. And at times, like the oppressed martyr, the manifest shining luminary, they sacrifice their lives with parched lips in the path of God in the desert of tribulation and ordeal.

Subject: martyrs and martyrdom
Quotation: O heads severed in the Path of your Lord! O faces illuminated by the light of the Sun of Guidance! O eyes brightened by turning towards the Splendor of the Daystar of Thy Revelation! O ears made receptive by listening to the Call of the Lord! O nostrils invigorated by inhaling the pure breath of the Guidance of God! O palates refreshed by tasting every bitterness yet sweetened in the path of the Love of God! They were torn to pieces by the hands of the ruthless. Their bodies were scattered on the earth. Their heads were severed from their bodies, and hurled to the ground. Then their heads were speared and carried aloft.

Subject: martyrs and martyrdom
Quotation: Among them is the true account of Husayn, when he departed from his home with his family and companions, as ye hear tell each day and hour. The hosts of unbelief surrounded them from every side and prevented them from returning to God's sacred sanctuary. The armies of infidelity rose against them and cut off all means of entry and exit. When matters grew severe for God's companions, they strove with their wealth and their lives to such a degree that the eyes of the Concourse on High were directed toward them and the angels drawn nigh were bewildered, until they sacrificed their souls and spirits in the path of their Lord.

Subject: martyrs and martyrdom
Quotation: I testify that you spent your life in the path of God's good-pleasure and were content with God's decree, desiring nothing but martyrdom in God's path... until the enemies arose with all hatred and rancor to slay you in God's path. There was no weapon they did not use, no wound they did not inflict, no arrow they did not aim, no spear they did not thrust. Blessed be your body that was torn asunder in God's path, blessed be your heart that was pierced in the love of God, blessed be your entrails that were targeted by spearheads out of love for the Glory, blessed be your liver that was cut to pieces by the swords of enemies

Subject: martyrs and martyrdom
Quotation: Since the beginning of the Cause there were at least ten thousand men who went with gladness to suffer martyrdom, and people who found them suffering this martyrdom thought it was through their own power and did not know that a breeze had shaken them. In the days of other prophets there were people who suffered martyrdom in the Cause of God, but in this day there are more and they have been more sincere. How many mothers have been happy to see their children suffer martyrdom! How many wives have been glad when their husbands suffered martyrdom, and how many sisters went with joy when their brothers died in the Cause of God!

Subject: martyrs and martyrdom
Quotation: Say: Consider the martyrs in the land of ?ad who, despite their wealth, glory, bounty and exaltation, gave their lives in the path of the one true Friend. Reflect upon His Holiness Mulla 'Ali-Jan of Mazandaran - may the spirit of the world be sacrificed for him. The government wished to grant him a pension to turn away from the Truth. He said - may the spirit of the world be sacrificed for him: "Ten thousand tumans of my wealth have they plundered, and it hath gone in the path of Truth. I have no need of your wealth and riches. Attend to your own affairs." Thereafter that sanctified soul was martyred with the most grievous torment.

Subject: martyrs and martyrdom
Quotation: He hath caused every atom of existence to grieve for Husayn, peace be upon him, that the meaning of martyrdom might be known in the letters of unity through his testimony to His Face that there is none other God but Him. He hath donned the garment of sorrow from his martyrdom in all the realities of creation, that the tongues of all servants might proclaim the decree of his testimony on the Day of Witnessing. After the creation of all things, He hath deposited in the highest consciousness of his breast a spring of camphor water for the day of his martyrdom, that all might shed tears of manifestation from their eyes at the call of his martyrdom.

Subject: martyrs and martyrdom
Quotation: O Mahdi! Blessed is thy father who emigrated from his home in his longing to attain the presence of God and presented himself before the Throne when the Cause was still veiled behind a manifest veil. He drank from the Kawthar of reunion before its manifestation and attained unto the Hidden Mystery before its revelation. To this testifieth He with Whom is the mighty Book. He was with Me in prison for a number of days in the land of Mim. Thus doth his Ancient Lord make mention of him - He Who proclaimeth at the heart of the world: "There is none other God but Me, the Single, the All-Informed." He was among those who were martyred in the path of God

Subject: martyrs and martyrdom
Quotation: These helpless people are being killed and know not why they sacrifice their lives for dust... Like Jinab-i-Shaykh 'Ali-Akbar who in these days drank the cup of martyrdom while calling to the Abha Kingdom and summoning souls to the Law of God. He bestowed life, made the blind to see, the deaf to hear, the dumb to speak, and brought the dead to life. In such a state, in utter detachment, he drank the cup of martyrdom. But this is not without fruit and effect - when one blessed soul is martyred in God's path, thousands are brought to life. They water the Blessed Tree with their blood. Though they depart this elemental life, they attain divine life.

Subject: martyrs and martyrdom
Quotation: These holy souls had no crime save the love of God, and no sin but the character of angels and the nature of the sanctified ones. With perfect joy, delight and attraction they cried out Ya Baha'ul-Abha and were martyred beneath the sword and blade of the enemies. Children were taken captive...Now the American friends must consider with what steadfastness and firmness the friends of God in Iran hasten to the divine altar of sacrifice. In the city of Yazd alone, in the span of three or four days, nearly one hundred and seventy souls were martyred. These souls, in the utmost detachment and with perfect attraction and enthusiasm, drank the cup of martyrdom.

Subject: martyrs and martyrdom
Quotation: Such a state overtook me that I lost all control, involuntarily I prayed and was perfumed by the fragrance of his martyrdom. When it became known in that city that a renowned personage had arrived, intoxicated with the pure wine and proclaiming the Day of Manifestation, raising a mighty call and throwing the city into commotion, and that he would soon have a great influence, the government intervened. They arrested that wronged one, cast him into chains and fetters, and in the end, with the utmost joy and radiance, he drank the cup of glorious martyrdom, sacrificing his life at the divine altar and hastening to the Supreme Concourse and the Abha Kingdom.

Subject: martyrs and martyrdom
Quotation: Thy letter which thou didst send in the name of Jud was presented before the Wronged One, and whatsoever was mentioned therein was heard. Thou didst seek martyrdom and hast asked about its station from God, exalted be His glory, both before and after. The Most Exalted Pen beareth witness to thy martyrdom. Be grateful to thy Lord for this manifest grace. The Supreme Pen testified to the martyrdom of the King of Martyrs before his physical martyrdom, uttering these sublime words: "Verily the martyr walketh and speaketh and serveth the Cause of his Lord." Several years before his ascension, his name was recorded by the Supreme Pen in the register of martyrs.

Subject: martyrs and martyrdom
Quotation: "The King of Martyrs and the Beloved of Martyrs were two souls who were greatly honored among the people. They were very wealthy. They were extremely comfortable. The people pillaged all their property. They put them in chains. They put them in prison. The Shah of Persia decreed that they should be killed; that they should either deny their faith or be killed. The notaries came to them and advised them to renounce their faith. The friends came and advised them; even the government advised them to recant so that they might save their lives. But they would not deny. They continued to cry aloud, 'Ya Baha el Abha!' (O, Thou Glory of the Most Glorious!) And so they were martyred."

Subject: martyrs and martyrdom
Quotation: Seven souls were taken, among them the honored Mulla 'Ali-i-Sabzivari and likewise the honored Mulla Mahdi - upon them both be the glory of God and His favors. His Excellency said to one, "Recant and you will be freed." That true seeker replied, "For forty years I have awaited this day, and praise be to God, today I have attained it." And another, while being paraded through the markets with executioners, attendants and footmen, proclaimed: "O people! The Lord of the Martyrs said 'Is there any who will help me?' and I say, 'Is there any who will behold me?'" In brief, the fire of hatred was so intensely kindled that the pen is powerless to describe it. These two blessed souls and the others sacrificed their lives with complete steadfastness.

Subject: martyrs and martyrdom
Quotation: Among these were seven souls whom all people testified to their purity, nobility, virtue and perfection. They had no excuse against them except their being Babis, and throughout their lives they had never hurt even an ant. These persons were brought before the government, in the presence of a few ignorant ones like Annas and Caiaphas who counted themselves among the learned, in chains and shackles and with swords drawn. They were commanded to renounce this community. When they refused and instead proclaimed and confessed their faith, those innocent ones were each beheaded in different thoroughfares before the public and hung up. Then their bodies were dragged through the streets and bazaars with ropes, and finally were torn to pieces and burned with fire.

Subject: martyrs and martyrdom
Quotation: We created the Badi' with one word and sent him forth like a globe of fire for the propagation of God's Cause. They accepted him not and martyred him. We sent another sacrifice who accepted not preservation and offered up the crown of life at the feet of the Beloved of the worlds. And likewise We sent yet another sacrifice whose head was adorned with the crown of detachment and whose temple was embellished with the robe of resignation. With perfect assurance and complete detachment he proceeded to the place of sacrifice and freely offered up his life before the Desired One of all creation. We sent another sacrifice who, while speaking the Most Great Name and uttering this blessed word, declared: We have found that for which we longed! With this word he gave up his life and received eternal bounty and everlasting life.

Subject: martyrs and martyrdom
Quotation: How many souls, with utmost longing and eagerness, advanced toward the place of sacrifice. At one time these exalted words flowed from the tongue of the Lord of Names - glorified be His majesty: Were ye to count the martyrs of God, ye could not number them. Some were so attracted and enkindled by the Word of God that they sacrificed their lives by their own hands at the threshold of the Beloved of the worlds. Among them was the honored Dhabi? of Baghdad - upon him be all the most glorious Glory - and likewise the one who in the Land of Mystery cut his own throat, and further Jinab-i-Aba-Ba?ir and Jinab-i-Aqa Siyyid Ashraf - upon them both be the Most Glorious Glory of God. After beholding the Divine Tablet, they emerged from their homes and openly and clearly proclaimed the Cause of God until they attained the most great martyrdom.

Subject: martyrs and martyrdom
Quotation: He came from a very well-known and respected family. His mother was asked to speak with him, his persecutors thinking her influence might induce him to recant and save his life. She told them her words would have no effect upon him except to increase his faith. Then she was told he would be killed. The Governor sent him word that if he would renounce his faith his life would be spared. Still he remained fixed and steadfast. His friends pleaded with him, begging him for their sakes to change. Then his mother stood up beside him and kissed him, saying, 'Do not be shaken! Do not waver Be firm! Give your life to God! Say nothing that will deny His Cause! Glorify it by your death! If you deny or waver, you will no longer be my child!' She stood beside him as he was beheaded, pleading with him to the last that he might not deny the Truth.

Subject: martyrs and martyrdom
Quotation: Those who remained steadfast, those souls who were martyred - most of them were truly dancing as they were martyred. All were soaring in the Supreme Concourse. Anyone who became a believer had already sacrificed his life before believing, because if they had the slightest self-interest, they would not have believed. What blessed souls they were, how much they sacrificed, how detached they were, how attracted they were! Indeed, the Iranians showed nobility. These events that occurred in Iran, these sacrifices that were made in Iran, these sacred breaths that were drawn in Iran, these calls that were raised in Iran - had they occurred in any country, there would have been an uproar. Truly, souls were martyred in Iran who raised high the banner of the Supreme Concourse, who guided people through their words, their deeds, and their sacrifices. In the plains of Karbila seventy-two were martyred, while here thousands stepped into the field of martyrdom with utmost joy and contentment.

Subject: martyrs and martyrdom
Quotation: Would that they had heard the story of Aqa Siyyid Isma'il, the Beloved of Martyrs, who arose one dawn, detached from all save God, came to the gate of the house, swept the street with his turban, then went outside the city, cut his own throat, and sacrificed himself for the One Beloved. Likewise the martyrs of the Land of Sad, who despite their wealth, glory, exaltation and prestige, sacrificed all. Nothing could withhold them from the Lord of Names. They gave up their lives and hastened to the most exalted heights. Similarly Badi', who bore the letter to the Sultan and stood before him, raised the letter and proclaimed: O King, I have brought thee from the Most Great Announcement a Mighty Book. Surely they have heard the details of how, with what power and might, he declared his mission before His Majesty the Sultan, while wearing but a single shirt. The might and majesty of royalty could not deter him, and afterwards he gave up his life with complete submission and contentment, drinking the cup of martyrdom from the hand of grace.

Subject: martyrs and martyrdom
Quotation: The wolves have surrounded God's sheep, the Lord of the Mighty Throne. The son of the wolf hath devoured sheep from My flock in the land of ?ad on this Day whereon the Caller proclaimeth from the highest horizon of the world: The Kingdom belongeth unto God, the Lord of the Day of Judgment. Were ye to count the martyrs in My path, ye could not number them. The twin resplendent lights, that is, the two Husayns - upon them be the most glorious of all glory - of whom ye have heard, despite their wealth, glory and fortune, sacrificed their lives in the path of the Friend. And though the wicked ones strove mightily that they might utter but one word to save themselves, they would not consent. They forsook creation and all that pertaineth unto it, but forsook not the truth. Likewise before them, Mulla Kazim and other souls - upon them be the most glorious glory of God - all freely sacrificed their lives at the threshold of the Friend. And several months ago His Holiness Ashraf - upon him be the glory of God and His grace - attained the most great martyrdom.

Subject: martyrs and martyrdom
Quotation: He saith: O spiritual hoopoe of Saba, hasten with the divine and holy Book to the cities of thy Lord, and shouldst thou be asked by the birds of celestial might concerning the divine and holy Bird, say: I left that heavenly Bird of paradise in such wise that It had fallen under the talons of denial and the beaks of the evil among the people, with none to help that holy Bird of the divine Throne save the Lord Who created It and made It a lamp of His beauty betwixt the heavens and the earth - if ye be of them that are certain. And shouldst thou find one of the loved ones of Truth who asketh thee concerning this imprisoned Bird, say: By the Lord! I departed from the City of the Prison at such time as Husayn lay fallen upon the earth, with the knee of Shimr pressed upon that blessed breast - the Manifestation of the divine Self, the Treasury of the mysteries of the wisdom of the Eternal, the Recipient of the unseen divine revelation - and that essence of tyranny desired to sever that holy head, while Sinan stood before that blessed countenance, waiting to raise that radiant head upon his spear.

Subject: martyrs and martyrdom
Quotation: Then the clergy were summoned and incited. Praise be to God, these holy souls showed forth the utmost steadfastness - neither their power prevented them from the straight path, nor did their wrath deprive them of the light of certitude. To whatever they were asked, they gave complete and sufficient answers. Then the order for imprisonment was given, and in prison they extracted payment. On Monday morning, the honorable governor Jalal'ud-Dawlih summoned Aqa Shaykh Hasan and his sons Shaykh Baqir and Shaykh Ja'far, as well as Aqa Siyyid 'Ali the teacher with two other sons, and a group of other clergy. They threw a rope around the neck of the innocent Aqa 'Ali-A?ghar in their presence, and took him and six others with that most pure body, with trumpets, drums and music. Behind the telegraph office, they beheaded the divine philosopher, His Holiness Mulla Mahdi. While still alive, they cut open his stomach and stoned him. Then they took his pure body to another quarter and set it on fire. They also beheaded Aqa 'Ali at the door of one of the clergy's houses, raised his head on a spear, and made his pure body a target for stones of hatred.

Mulla Husayn opened a new gate to the field of martyrdom. Vahid distinguished himself as a peerless figure in the arena of sacrifice. Zanjani offered up his life as a martyr upon the plain of tribulation. The King of Martyrs hastened forth to the place of sacrifice. Ashraf attained the heights of honour as he unflinchingly set his face towards the arena of sacrifice. Badi', as he breathed his last, exclaimed: Magnified be my Lord, the Most Glorious! The martyrs of the land of Ya drank their fill with relish from the draught of glorious martyrdom, and the martyrs of Shiraz laid down their lives in the arena of ardent love to the tune of sweet and wondrous melodies. Those massacred in the land of Nayriz were inebriated with the brimful cup of sacrifice, and the martyrs of Tabriz were seized with ecstatic joy and unleashed new energies in the field of sacrifice. Those who renounced their lives in Mazindaran exclaimed: O Lord! Quotation: When this evanescent servant was in Iraq, the two radiant and martyred Luminaries set out toward Zawra with the intention of visiting the Divine Ka'bah. On their return from the Land of Taff, they attained the Most Holy Court and after hearkening to the Divine Call they truly underwent transformation. The manifestation of favor shown to them, though they were not known among the people, was witnessed to such a degree that some were struck with wonderment and amazement. Then by Divine command they returned to their land, and the Hand of Power exalted them and adorned them with the ornament of glory, and from the clouds of generosity rained bounty upon them until throughout the regions of the world they became known and mentioned by the name of the Lord of Eternity, and in truth they established their station in hearts, as you have witnessed and continue to witness. After arriving in the Land of Sad, two petitions from them reached the Most Holy Court, and likewise in other petitions they beseeched and implored with utmost humility and supplication. What bounty could be greater than this station they attained to - that praise be to God, in this earthly realm they were manifest in the name of Truth, and even the polytheists were seen to be humble in their presence, and in their final days they attained to a station that cannot be confined by this servant's pen nor encompassed by this evanescent one's utterance. From the Tablets that have been revealed from the heaven of the Will of the Lord of all beings regarding this supreme calamity, it becomes known and evident - O beloved of my heart - a hundred thousand blessings upon them and a hundred thousand regrets for this servant! It is as though at every moment the tongues of the world cry out "Would that I had been with them!" Consider this matter: the Lord of the world was martyred in the manner that has reached the blessed ears, and they were counted among His servants, yet their martyrdom is seen to have a greater effect, more complete influence, and more intense burning.

Quotation: There are two Books: One is the Book of Creation and the other is the written Book. The written Book consisteth of the heavenly Books which are revealed to the Prophets of God and have issued forth from the lips of His Manifestations. The Book of Creation is the preserved Tablet and the outspread roll of existence. The Book of Creation is in accord with the written Book. In the written Book thou canst find chapters and verses, words and letters; and inner meanings and mysteries are hidden therein. Likewise the Book of Creation is the command of God and the repository of divine mysteries. In it there are great signs, universal images, perfect words, exalted symbols, and secrets of all things, whether of the past or of the future. When thou readest the written Book thou wilt become aware of the mysteries of God, but when thou gazest at the Book of Creation thou wilt observe the signs, symbols, realities, and reflections of the hidden mysteries of the bounties of His Holiness the Incomparable One.… It is thus clear and evident that in the world of the Holy Writ there are letters, words, and verses, and likewise in the world of creation there are letters, words, and verses.... May we, honoured Master, ask your wise tongue to pronounce on this?"  The Master: "O my daughter, in your utterances, contradictory as they may appear, there is no contradiction! But one should walk the depths and heights of prophetic knowledge thoughtfully, in order to get a clear understanding of the relationship of man and of the human race to technology....  The more man can increase the speed of transportation, the more he becomes a slave of time, he no longer has time for anything - not for his body, much less for soul and spirit, not for himself, not for his fellow men, he is more and more subject to the whistling whip of the god of time.  America will conquer the Old World, not with the weapons of war or the sword of the spirit, but through its industrialism, its technical large-scale industry and through the expansion of the technical environment. The machine will devour time; prosaic numbers and formulae, cold charts and measuring devices will suck dry the soul. Mechanical power with its symbols and expressions will rule men, nay enslave and exploit them, and finally the machine will displace man entirely from life and from work, after which the end of time will approach for our planet because, though one may mechanize towns to a large extent, where man is concerned there is a limit.... But should nine tenths of mankind fall victim to the demon of exaggerated technology, the end of the history of our earth will come about. The last of the Days of Judgment will dawn, when the Prophetic Cycle will have come to an end and the world returns to God, when all becomes lost in Him through the crashing and bursting of the elements, which means annihilation for those turned away from God, but spiritualization for those resting in God, and for those souls still in need of purification and development it is a triumphant sinking into God's infinite grace and mercy.
