Subject: multiple meanings; interpretations in scripture
Quotation: Were the books of the world of reality to appear in the realm of gathering and resurrection, numerous volumes would be found containing your mention... A hundred thousand worlds of mention and utterance lie concealed in this station.

Subject: multiple meanings; interpretations in scripture
Quotation: Each letter of the verses that were revealed in the latter days in the Land of Mystery and likewise on the way, doth in itself proclaim and testify. Yet these veiled people were not worthy to hear even a whisper, much less to hearken unto the Call that was raised from the Kingdom of utterance.

Subject: multiple meanings; interpretations in scripture
Quotation: The verse hath a subtle inner meaning: the star is the first element of the Simple Name, the moon its second element, and the sun its third element... When the Moon of Prophethood, which represents the station of mind, set, there rose the Sun, which represents the station of divine authority and soul.

Subject: multiple meanings; interpretations in scripture
Quotation: However, the sacred scriptures employ a special terminology, and in the sight of God's Manifestations these wonders and miracles hold no importance - so much so that they do not even wish them to be mentioned. For even if these miracles were considered the greatest of proofs, they would serve as clear evidence only for those who present at their occurrence, not for those who were absent.

Subject: multiple meanings; interpretations in scripture
Quotation: The Most Truthful of Speakers mentions the dream of Joseph (peace be upon our age and upon him) and his interpretations of the dreams of the two persons mentioned in the Book. Now consider what kind of world it is where father and mother are seen in the form of sun and moon, and brother appears as a star, and what kind of world this is where the opposite is seen, where sun and moon appeared as father and mother, and star was perceived as brother.

Subject: multiple meanings; interpretations in scripture
Quotation: You had asked about the blessed verse "O Chief! We revealed Ourself to you once on Mount Tina and once on Mount Zita and in this blessed spot, but you were unaware because you followed your desires and were among the heedless."... Tina and Zita are outwardly two hills in Jerusalem on which divine revelation was sent to the prophets of God... By the mount of Tina the reality of Christ is intended, and by the mount of Zita, the reality of Muhammad

Subject: multiple meanings; interpretations in scripture
Quotation: And in all these degrees there is a meaning according to the outward language, whereby the servant understandeth when he reflecteth thereon. And whatsoever is beyond these seven degrees in the mention that followeth them is like unto a horizontal chain which is found from the reflections of the seventh degree. And it hath different stations in the transformation of meaning in every station according to the variation in rank, until the meaning of the verse reacheth the station of the atom.

Subject: multiple meanings; interpretations in scripture
Quotation: Verily, the Qur'an hath infinite stations in the knowledge of God, and none can comprehend these conditions save through knowledge of the matter between the two matters and the station between the two stations, which was revealed in the tradition from the suns of religion and the pillars of the people of certitude. When one is able to discover the secret of that wisdom, that path becomes easy for him - which is to behold multiplicity through the eye of the Divine Essence's revelation unto him. When one becomes steadfast upon that path, he sees no contradiction in the traditions, nor ambiguous decree in the Qur'an, and he sees questions as clear verses and allusions as evident proofs.

Subject: multiple meanings; interpretations in scripture
Quotation: The metaphorical is a bridge to the real. God willing, they shall be illumined by the light of reality and attain the station of "extinguish the lamp for the morn has dawned." When a person of insight enters the path of spiritual wayfaring, after purifying and sanctifying the soul from all that God loveth not, multiple paths appear and he traverses them. This is why they have said "The paths to God are as numerous as the breaths of created things." However, if through God's grace the eye is blessed with the light of truth, it will be observed that the Truth is one, the Path is one, and the Cause is one. This is the station of unity that makes the limbs of the polytheists tremble and the root of heedlessness quake.

Subject: music and singing
Quotation: This abound exhilarated and rejoiced by its own melody. How significant and eloquent were those new verses, for they were the notes of the clarion of the love of God!

Subject: music and singing
Quotation: The holy maidens are engaged with the spirit of fellowship in melodious songs and heavenly anthems, that perchance dead hearts may come to everlasting life and divine melodies

Subject: music and singing
Quotation: O spiritual nightingale! You are ever engaged in song and melody, and in the rose-garden of inner meanings you raise your voice in praise. The eloquence and elegance of your verses are clear and evident.

Subject: music and singing
Quotation: Make this servant melodious, attuned with the airs of the Supreme Concourse, and confer upon him a thrilling and resounding voice, like the nightingale of hidden meanings in the Divine Rose Garden.

Subject: music and singing
Quotation: Therefore, in thanksgiving for this bounty of the one true Lord, hold thou a festival day and night, that through the celestial melody of harp and lute thou mayest bestow joy and delight upon both friend and stranger.

Subject: music and singing
Quotation: Therefore be thou happy and remain in melody and delight. They say that [name not readable] is melodious and tuneful as David, renowned for his sweet voice - not for sighs and groans and constant wailing day and night.

Subject: music and singing
Quotation: May God assist you to sing the most wonderful melodies in the expansive gardens with diverse tunes. God willing, you will ever make the gatherings of the friends independent of evening wine and the strains of harp and lute through this song.

Subject: music and singing
Quotation: I swear by the Quintessence of existence Baha'u'llah if thou shouldst attain this station thy voice shall be the voice of the Psalms of David, thy chanting shall echo with the melodies of holiness and sanctity in the path of the All-loving Lord

Subject: music and singing
Quotation: Like a lark bursting with happiness turns thy face towards the mystic rose garden at all times and sings the sweetest of thy songs. Strike on the cymbal, blow the trumpet, play the harpsichord with thy melodies, and gather in a beautiful assembly dedicated to the Love of God.

Subject: music and singing
Quotation: These are days of melody and song, and the period of musical harmony and shahna'z... But delight and joy depend on music and song and the melodies of harp and instrument. Until the warbling of garden birds rises high, listeners will not be stirred nor become companions in joy and gladness.

Subject: music and singing
Quotation: In praise of the All-Knowing God you have given voice eloquently, and in describing and extolling the Ever-Living, the Almighty, you have arranged precious odes in poetic verse... Therefore now, with harp and tambourine and flute and lute and oud and strings, strive to raise up the Word of God

Subject: music and singing
Quotation: The music branch must operate with utmost perfection. This art is among the most glorious arts, and its study is among the requirements of this sovereign age of Divine Unity. However, it must be perfected, not left incomplete like others. The establishment of this branch is most fitting and appropriate.

Subject: music and singing
Quotation: Take up the lute and rebec and in these gardens of sanctity play songs of unity in praise of the Glorious Lord... Hear ye the vibrations of the divine strings and listen to the spiritual thirds and doubles... and from every branch rises the sound of lute and song, and from every palace the strains of harp and lyre.

Subject: music and singing
Quotation: Each word is a verse of jubilation, one word is a lute and tambour, one word is the psalms of the House of David, one word is harp and musical instrument, one word is singing and melody - a complete orchestra that brings listeners to ecstasy and joy. You play your tune there and bring lovers here to rapture and delight.

Subject: music and singing
Quotation: Musical melodies cause physical bodies to vibrate, but heavenly songs cause the human spirit to soar. Tell Mr. Harold McKey that if you can combine earthly tunes with celestial melodies, then you will observe that you have breathed the breath of life into the body of the world and bestowed upon the human world a joy and delight that will endure forever.

Subject: music and singing
Quotation: Music is an important means for the education and development of humanity. Musical melodies play an important role in the outward and inward qualities of man, for music is the inspirer and motive power of both the material and the spiritual susceptibilities. What a motive power it is in feelings of love! When man is attracted to the Love of God, music will have a great effect upon him.

Subject: music and singing
Quotation: Church bells don't have musical tone. An organ with its tones and half tones would be much more beautiful. The heavenly music is heart ravishing. That melody penetrates the heart of man. That clarion bestows on man spirituality and joy. That music awakens man out of the sleep of negligence. But the majority of mankind are not endowed with ears to listen to that joy and giving melody because their ears are accustomed to such cheap rag time.

Subject: music and singing
Quotation: Continue as long as thou canst this melody in the gatherings of the beloved, thus may the minds find rest and joy and become in tune with the love of God. When eloquence of expression, beauty of sense and sweetness of composition unite with new melodies the effect is ever great. Endeavor your utmost to compose beautiful poems to be chanted with heavenly music; thus may their beauty affect the minds and impress the hearts of those who listen.

Subject: music and singing
Quotation: An Hindu professor of music came here, bringing his musical instrument called The Vina with him and played for us certain oriental strains, accompanying them with singing... Let us find out the melody, the sweet strains of which will be taken up by angels and carried to the supreme concourse... Let us listen to a strain which gives life to man... But if we want to listen to all different kinds of music we will have nothing but discord, for they are being played by inferior artists.

Subject: music and singing
Quotation: The utmost joy was attained, for--praise be to God!--the friends of the Merciful passed some time on that day joyous and singing in the land of the Mashrak-el-Azcar and enjoyed commemorating the Lord of the verses with the greatest joy... I am hopeful that, during the coming of Rizwan, a great feast shall be held in the land of the Mashrak-el-Azcar, a spiritual celebration prepared and the melodies of the violin and the mandolin and hymns in praise and glorification of the Lord of Hosts make all the audience joyous and ecstatic.

Subject: music and singing
Quotation: His Holiness Baha'o'llah likened the religions of the world to musical instruments, each divine messenger having been sent to sound a different key, but the instruments have become out of tune and discord has resulted. Therefore Baha'o'llah brought a new musical instrument and put it into our hands, saying: "Play on this. It includes all notes, all harmony. This harmony will exhilarate even the angels and will set them to dancing. The Supreme Concourse will rejoice, for this harmony will be never-ending. The melody will be eternal."

Subject: music and singing
Quotation: Today illumined and spiritual children are gathered in this meeting. The art of music is divine and effective. It is the food of the soul and spirit. Through the power and charm of music the spirit of man is uplifted. It has wonderful sway and effect in the hearts of children, for their hearts are pure, and melodies have great influence in them. The latent talents with which the hearts of these children are endowed will find expression through the medium of music. Therefore, you must exert yourselves to make them proficient; teach them to sing with excellence and effect. It is incumbent upon each child to know something of music, for without knowledge of this art the melodies of instrument and voice cannot be rightly enjoyed.

Subject: mysteries and their discovery; the mystical vision

All who read it are filled with an anxious desire to leave this world and enter the next condition, so wonderful are the glories of the Spiritual Kingdom. In Persia, one man who read this Tablet killed himself. he could not wait for the happiness it promised him. Another, a youth of Isfahan, could not stand the spiritual food contained in this Tablet, and lost his reason.

Subject: mysteries and their discovery; the mystical vision
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/mysteries and their discovery; the mystical vision.txt
Quotation: The morn of Truth's beauty has dawned; the lights of the Absolute have appeared! That heart-ravisher--the one who sat veiled in seclusion the monarch of the highest paradise--now, into the streets and markets, like Joseph of Egypt, has ventured!

Subject: mysteries and their discovery; the mystical vision
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/mysteries and their discovery; the mystical vision.txt

Subject: mysteries and their discovery; the mystical vision
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/mysteries and their discovery; the mystical vision.txt
Quotation: Verily the lights have shone forth, and the glad-tidings have appeared, and the tokens have been fulfilled, and the Lord of verses - His traces have appeared and His lights have blazed forth, and His morn has dawned, and His breeze has wafted, and His spirit has become manifest

Subject: mysteries and their discovery; the mystical vision
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/mysteries and their discovery; the mystical vision.txt
Quotation: God hath created for us therein white chambers wherein we were among those who glorify Him, then yellow chambers wherein we were among the thankful ones, then green chambers wherein we were among those who declare His unity, then red chambers wherein we were among those who magnify Him. Say: The first chambers are of hidden white diamond. Say: The other chambers are of treasured yellow ruby. Say: The outer chambers are of emerald which, when ye behold them, will so attract your souls that ye will exclaim: God beareth witness that there is no God but Him, the Mighty, the Best-Beloved.

Subject: mysteries and their discovery; the mystical vision
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/mysteries and their discovery; the mystical vision.txt
Quotation: God will soon reveal unto thee that which We impart to thee, and will cause to descend upon thee from the lights which God created before the creation of the heavens and the earth. He will gather thee into the paradise of love and establish thee in the heaven of holiness and the garden of companionship.

Subject: mysteries and their discovery; the mystical vision
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/mysteries and their discovery; the mystical vision.txt
Quotation: If you open the eye of the soul and gaze upon the Kingdom of the Beloved, you will observe that this is a letter of freedom by which you will gain admittance to the divine Kingdom, and when you take flight from this dusty realm of darkness to the luminous world, you will hasten to the private chamber of the Truth.

Subject: mysteries and their discovery; the mystical vision
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/mysteries and their discovery; the mystical vision.txt
Quotation: At this moment I am seated by the shore of the Sea of Tiberias, now detached from all save the Friend and constantly anticipating the comprehensive effusions of the All-Merciful. If thou didst know in what state I write, thou wouldst surely be transported with rapture and ecstasy, and in the excess of joy and gladness thou wouldst dance while reciting this verse

Subject: mysteries and their discovery; the mystical vision
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/mysteries and their discovery; the mystical vision.txt
Quotation: Spiritual disclosures are of two kinds: One, which is commonly referred to among other peoples, is mere imagination, while the other is true spiritual visions such as the revelations of Isaiah, of Jeremiah, and of John. ... In like manner, spiritual disclosures are of two kinds. One is the visions of the Prophets and the spiritual disclosures of the chosen ones of God. The visions of the Prophets are not dreams but true spiritual disclosures.

Subject: mysteries and their discovery; the mystical vision
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/mysteries and their discovery; the mystical vision.txt
Quotation: As for what thou asked about the state of the spirit and its conditions, know with certainty that in sleep, the spirit is like the sun in its position--it does not leave the body, but rather by its light beholds the kingdom of the heavens and earth. If one is a believer, he beholds all things according to God's decree in his station, having an inseparable influence, and if one is an unbeliever, he beholds things in the inverted forms of unbelief.

The Books and Scriptures have testified to His sanctification and transcendence. Beyond this the path is barred and seeking is rejected. His proof is His Revelation, and His evidence is His being established upon His mighty Throne.... Furthermore, no one's will hath ever been or shall ever be united with God's will, for the will of all hath been and shall ever be as nothingness before His will. The glory of existence is for one to make his own will fade away in God's will - that is, to have no will, thought or imagination of his own, but to move by God's will and act accordingly. Deem not this matter imaginary. In this station and rank, existence is effaced from self and subsists through the Truth. All are from God and unto God shall they return, and "Say: All things are from God" is sufficient witness and adequate proof of this point, as the mystic of Rum has said:  "The seeker's attributes are annihilated in His attributes, While his essence remains through the survival of His Essence." Quotation: These are names wherewith God hath described His Self, that ye may describe. These are the nearest names in the Book of God, and the greatest. Say: The sea of names is two seas wherein ye traverse, seeing naught but God. Say: The names are like mirrors - do ye see aught but the Sun therein?

Subject: names and attributes of God
Quotation: God hath ninety-nine names. Were the name identical with the named, each name would be a god. But God [...] these names, and they are all other than He. O Hisham! 'Bread' is the name for that which is eaten, 'water' is the name for that which is drunk, 'garment' is the name for that which is worn, and 'fire' is the name for that which is burned."

Subject: names and attributes of God
Quotation: The bounties of God are continuous. The effulgences of God are never-ending. The lights of the virtues and attributes of God are ever shining. Man can comprehend these. Man can comprehend qualities such as the mercy and the power of God. But the reality of divinity is beyond human comprehension. In brief, the human mind can comprehend only the names, attributes and bounties of God.

Subject: names and attributes of God
Quotation: But in the world of contingence when the lights of Its perfections and qualities shine these lights reflect in the mirrors of names and attributes but all names and attributes are in relation to that Essence in the same station. Whatever Name ye may call Him He is possesses of All Beautiful Names, whether Manifest or the Manifester, whether the Seer or the Seen One, whether the name the Unseen whether the Present One.

Subject: names and attributes of God
Quotation: Each of His names is a gateway to blessing, mercy, grace, bounty, protection and generosity, and the effects of each have been and continue to be the cause of order in the world and the preservation of nations. Through His name the Educator, He hath educated and continueth to educate the world, and in the Perspicuous Book He hath called Himself the Lord of all worlds. Through His name the Quickener, the breath of life was breathed, and through His name the Powerful, other effects appeared and infinite wisdom became manifest to those possessed of insight.

Subject: names and attributes of God
Quotation: Rather, He created the names and attributes so that all existing things might worship Him through them while declaring His transcendence above them, for they are created attributes and temporal names which God has created for the benefit of hearts and minds.

Subject: names and attributes of God
Quotation: Glory be to Thee, O Lord my God! I implore Thee by Thy Name, through which Thou didst lift up the ensigns of Thy guidance, and didst shed the radiance of Thy loving-kindness, and didst reveal the sovereignty of Thy Lordship; through which the lamp of Thy names hath appeared within the niche of Thine attributes...Thou art, verily, the Healer, the Preserver, the Helper, the Almighty, the Powerful, the All-Glorious, the All-Knowing.

Subject: naming of children; of individuals

It was customary in the olden time to delay a christening until a fortunate time according to the astrological calendar...Now, as to your child, it is by chance that on the day that we are here, associating with you, a name will be given to him so that he will be very blest.

Subject: naming of children; of individuals
Quotation: O 'Abdu'l-Husayn, how blessed is this name, and how sacred this title! The realities of sanctification yearn for this cherished name and precious designation, and when it is uttered they are moved to ecstasy and joy, for this servant is associated with the Light of the two Easts, the Radiance of the two Horizons, and the Sun of the two worlds, being named after Husayn. This is the Most Great Name, this is the most noble talisman, this is the luminous full moon, and this is the brilliant sun. Blessed art thou to be designated by this name.

Subject: nationalism; love of country
Quotation: That is why Baha'o'llah says: "Let not a man glory in this, that he loves his country, let him rather glory in this, that he loves his kind."

Subject: nationalism; love of country
Quotation: He created one homeland, and that is the earth. All people are inhabitants of this homeland, yet different factions have introduced differences in all matters, even regarding homeland, as can be observed when they say This one is from Aleppo, this one from Damascus, this one from Iraq.

Subject: nationalism; love of country
Quotation: "There is no difference between Paris and London. All these limitations, all these divisions into various nationalities are due to the weakness of man. If man's mind were broad enough, if it were strong enough, these divisions would vanish. The earth is God's earth and all the peoples of the world are under His grace and favour."

Subject: nationalism; love of country
Quotation: These geographical boundaries are made by man, calling one piece of land Austria, another Germany, a third French, a Fourth English and so forth. The dogs in Oriental cities instinctively divide the various quarters amongst themselves and if by chance one of the dogs crosses the boundary he will be attacked. But these boundary lines are all imaginary. They have no real existence.

Subject: nationalism; love of country
Quotation: It is evident to the wise, people of thought, and those possessed of knowledge that dispersion in the human world - that is, disunity - is the cause of their abasement, the source of their degradation, the reason for their disorder, and the root of their ignorance. However, if they form a united society, it becomes the cause of their progress and their civilization. This being evident, they say that the human world requires a unifying force to bring individuals together and achieve this progress. Now, at times this unifying force is patriotism. Being fellow citizens is indeed a unifying force. However, this applies only to general benefits and harms and the attraction of common good; it has no authority in specific matters and no power over individuals. It is a unifying force in general matters, but only to a degree. For instance, the people of one country will defend against an external enemy to protect their nation, but only to a certain extent....  what truly serves as the unifying force of human society is religion. It unites different religions, unifies different nations, brings together different races, unites different languages, and unifies different homelands. It blends individuals together, melts them down and remolds them anew. For instance, observe how the Christian religion was a divine unifying force, what unity it created. The religion of Muhammad, Islam, how many different nations it united. The unity of religion eliminated all these differences.

Subject: nature and God's will
Quotation: Now, can it be said that such organization, such arrangement, and such laws that you observe in existence are the effects of nature itself, even though it has neither consciousness nor perception? Therefore it becomes evident that this nature, which has neither consciousness nor perception, is in the grasp of the Almighty God Who is the Ruler of the world of nature, manifesting through nature whatever He desires.

Subject: nearness and remoteness
Quotation: I love the children very much, because they are near to the Kingdom of God.

Quotation: God is nearer to you than your own eyes. Your Lord is near those who have turned toward Him.

Subject: nearness and remoteness
Quotation: "by reason of my deprivation from beholding Thy Face and attaining unto Thy Divine Presence and of my remoteness from Thy most sublime Threshold" ... "O Lord, if Thou didst destine for me remoteness from that most holy garden"

Subject: nearness and remoteness
Quotation: He seeks, through the wonders of Your grace, Your nearness and meeting, to stand at Your gate, attain Your presence...Has the Pen of destiny decreed for me to attain Your presence, or has Your binding decree prevented me from turning to You

Subject: nearness and remoteness
Quotation: The intention of kinship is not outward nearness, rather the intention is spiritual nearness unto Him - may my spirit and all within the kingdom of command and creation be a sacrifice for Him - in the realm of infinity, abstraction and beginning.

Subject: nearness and remoteness
Quotation: Then God made the point of proximity the focal point for drawing near in cycles, bringing it into existence and extending it as He had originated it when it was pure nothingness. And God made the point of remoteness the point of turning away in cycles

Subject: nearness and remoteness
Quotation: Make your way to the sanctified Concourse and become an intimate companion of the denizens of the Abha Kingdom... Therefore for all of us it is far better to spread our wings and fly from this perilous depth, entering a world that is sanctified from these dangers

Subject: nearness and remoteness
Quotation: He is the Point of nearness and remoteness - His remoteness is His nearness and His nearness His remoteness... And the Creator is manifest, and if He becomes distant, meaning if one does not attain unto that Reality, in His remoteness there is nearness which is the very essence of separation, for His manifestation is within it.

Subject: nearness and remoteness
Quotation: Then, through Thy grace, quench the fire of separation and remoteness by which the hearts of the ardent lovers have melted and the tears of them that are attracted have flowed, through the waters of Thy remembrance and utterance. O Lord! Transform their separation into the light of reunion with Thee, and their remoteness into the radiance of nearness to Thee.

Subject: nearness and remoteness
Quotation: However, it is clear and evident that true reunion is spiritual nearness attainable only by walking in the path of His good pleasure. Therefore, if a person is physically one hundred thousand miles away but blessed with God's good pleasure that one is in truth among those who enjoy nearness to Him. Otherwise, that which looks outwardly near is in fact distant. Therefore, it is proven that that blessed Leaf is at all times present in the Court of Holiness and nourished with the blessing of His proximity and reunion.

Subject: nearness and remoteness
Quotation: As to approaching the Most Holy Court in these days, this is outwardly not permitted. We have revealed in one of the Tablets: "How many are near whom We do not confirm in their nearness, and how many are remote and, by the Self of the Beloved, are yet nigh!" And in another Tablet: "How many who are near are yet strangers, and how many who are distant are yet near! Blessed is he who is near and drew near!" And in yet another Tablet: "How many a beloved one became but a bubble, and how many a companion We found to be a flatterer, and how many who were distant are near, and how many who were near We testify are in a station remote."

Subject: nearness to God
Quotation: You seek nearness to the divine threshold and yearn for the Beauty of Abha. I make mention of you, and you engage in prayer.

Subject: nearness to God
Quotation: The greatest gift in the human world is nearness to God. Every honor, every dignity, every excellence, every bounty that becomes possible for humanity is made possible through divine nearness. All the Prophets and Messengers sought divine nearness - how many nights they wept and lamented, how many days they beseeched and supplicated, seeking nearness to God. But divine nearness is not easily attained.

Subject: necessary and possible being
Quotation: Descent, division, qualification and transfer between stations are characteristics of contingent reality. The Ancient Reality is sanctified above these, for division and partition in any thing, when found, are proof of its contingent nature.

Subject: need for an educator
Quotation: Look at the civilized countries... That the world of nature is imperfect and needs education is to the wise beyond question.

Subject: need for an educator
Quotation: for without a teacher humanity cannot become learned. How did they know that truthfulness is good? Through education and training

Subject: need for an educator
Quotation: Know thou that the world of being standeth in need of an educator. There are two kinds of educators, material and spiritual. If we allow a piece of land to remain in its natural state it will become a jungle covered with wild vegetation, but if we place it under the care of a benevolent gardener it will become a wonderful orchard and the tangled underbrush will change into a pleasant garden. Thus it is evident that in the world of nature training is indispensable.

Subject: need for cooperation; solitary existence not possible
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/need for cooperation; solitary existence not possible.txt
Quotation: When you observe carefully you shall see that the economic prosperity of a community or a nation is maintained by reciprocity and co-operation. In the whole world you do not find one man, no matter how varied in his accomplishments who is sufficient unto himself. All that he can do is to contribute one thousandth share to the well-being of the nation. He studies for ten or 20 yrs and then he is able to co-operate with other thousands of his fellowmen to make them happier. He supplies them with part of their needs and as a reciprocal action, they supply him with all his needs.

Subject: non-participation in politics
Quotation: The Baha'is have no attachment to political affairs, neither are they connected to constitutional rule nor involved in aspirations of autocracy. They pray for and wish well to all peoples and those of different opinions. They have no quarrel with any party nor seek to blame any people.

Subject: non-participation in politics
Quotation: Speak thou no word of politics; rather, concern thyself with spiritual matters, for these lead to human happiness in the divine world. Subject: non-participation in politics
Quotation: In any case, the Baha'is should not interfere in political matters... A community that establishes the unity of the human world certainly cannot delve into political affairs, because a diplomat must always promote his hidden agendas, and this contradicts the intentions of peace, harmony, sincerity and faithfulness.

Subject: non-participation in politics
Quotation: But it is an established fact that the Bahais are the well-wishers of the nation and the government; are showing forth obedience and displaying good intentions; are not interfering in political matters; are engaged in the education and spiritualization of characters and are occupied with the training of the ignorant ones.

Subject: non-participation in politics
Quotation: The friends of God must withdraw from all parties, never interfere in political matters, obey the government, wish well for all, engage in teaching the Cause of God, accept as true and proper whatever issues from the Pen of the Covenant and remain firm and steadfast, conducting themselves with complete dignity, sobriety and composure.

Subject: non-participation in politics
Quotation: As soon as political plans are introduced in the Cause the spirit is killed. The apostles of Christ never devised any political schemes whereby to win the majority votes. These disciples were not politicians; they were the harbingers of the glad-tidings of the Kingdom. They did not know anything about election, votes, initiative and referendum.

In truth, it is not a political affair...You must not spend your time with political questions and political articles. We have nothing to do with the political world. Our thoughts and deeds are confined to spiritual things.

Subject: non-participation in politics
Quotation: The women of other nations are all immersed in political matters. Of what benefit is this, and what fruit doth it yield? Subject: non-participation in politics
Quotation: By the decisive divine text we absolutely do not interfere in political matters. Therefore, answering this question is beyond the duty and obligation of these wanderers. What role has this prisoner in political affairs, and what business has this wanderer?

Subject: non-participation in politics
Quotation: In brief, praise be to God that the divine friends, by the conclusive text of the Lord and the severe prohibition of Abdul-Baha and his explicit forbiddance, did not at all interfere in these matters and all remained protected and preserved. While all communities in Iran were in the utmost agitation, the friends of God remained confident and at ease, and in perfect peace and security they engaged in diffusing the divine fragrances and were occupied with chanting the evident verses.

Subject: non-participation in politics
Quotation: The Party of God has no involvement in political affairs and has no complaint or praise for the governments of the world. We stand apart from all parties and, with tear-filled eyes, seek the Lord's grace and bounty for all peoples and nations. We are neither intimate companions of the constitutionalists nor allies of the absolutists. Exercise complete sincerity and good-will toward the government authorities and His Majesty the Shah, and maintain obedience and good intentions, but absolutely do not interfere in political affairs.

Subject: non-participation in politics
Quotation: These matters relate to divine wisdom and cannot be explicitly explained. It is not that 'Abdu'l-Baha is unaware of the reality of things or that matters are unclear to Him, but it is due to the wisdom of the Cause. These events shall pass, and later the wisdom will become clear and manifest. Then all will acknowledge that what was said accorded with wisdom. The mysteries of 'Abdu'l-Baha's letters, the prohibition of involvement in political affairs, and the description and characterization contain consummate wisdom that will become evident hereafter.

Subject: non-participation in politics
Quotation: Explain to the Embassy that the criterion of being or not being a Baha'i is this: whoever interferes in political affairs and speaks or acts beyond their duties - this alone is sufficient proof that they are not a Baha'i; no other evidence is needed. In brief, all know that we are completely forbidden from interference in political affairs, and these recent events in Iran are sufficient proof that we were entirely free from corruption, strife and contention - we never interfered at all.

Subject: nonexistence of evil; relativity of good and evil
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/nonexistence of evil; relativity of good and evil.txt
Quotation: Evil is non-existence. All that is created is good. Evil is non-existence of good. Want of wealth is poverty; absence of justice is oppression; want of perfection is deficiency. All of these opposites imply non-existence and not existence.

Subject: nonexistence of evil; relativity of good and evil
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/nonexistence of evil; relativity of good and evil.txt
Quotation: Darkness is the absence of light - it has no existence. Poverty is the absence of wealth. Ignorance is the absence of knowledge - when there is no knowledge, there is ignorance. When there is no light, there is darkness. When there is no eye, there is blindness. Just as when there is no wealth, there is poverty - not that poverty has any existence.

Subject: nonexistence of evil; relativity of good and evil
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/nonexistence of evil; relativity of good and evil.txt
Quotation: In the innate nature of things there is no evil--all is good. This applies even to certain apparently blameworthy attributes and dispositions which seem inherent in some people but which are not in reality reprehensible. It follows therefore that in existence and creation there is no evil at all, but that when man's innate qualities are used in an unlawful way, they become blameworthy.

Subject: obedience to and respect for government authority

Subject: obedience to and respect for government authority
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/obedience to and respect for government authority.txt

Subject: obedience to and respect for government authority
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/obedience to and respect for government authority.txt

In truth, the present just government of His Majesty the King deserves praise and merits the heartfelt, sincere obedience of all subjects. Exercise utmost care in this regard, for it is obligatory and prescribed by the conclusive divine text.

Subject: obedience to and respect for government authority
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/obedience to and respect for government authority.txt

Always offer prayers for good and petition the divine Threshold for victory and triumph on behalf of His Imperial Majesty. In truth, in these recent years they have shown the utmost justice, nay rather favor.

Subject: obedience to and respect for government authority
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/obedience to and respect for government authority.txt
Quotation: And if any one of them be appointed to a position, whether minor or major, they must serve with the utmost virtue, steadfastness, truthfulness, purity and detachment, knowing that the least betrayal of the government and people is betrayal of the Truth, and lack of uprightness toward His Imperial Majesty is rebellion and sedition against the Lord God.

Subject: obedience to and respect for government authority
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/obedience to and respect for government authority.txt
Quotation: This obedience to the government is an obligatory and a mandatory command based on the definitive Text... Arise with heart and soul to serve with sincerity and benevolence this long lasting Government... for were a soul to act disloyally towards a just government, he acteth disloyally towards God Himself, and were he to serve such a government, he verily serveth God.

Subject: obedience to and respect for government authority

Subject: obedience to and respect for government authority

Quotation: Praise be to God! according to the commandments and exhortations of BAHA'O'LLAH, we are the well-wishers of all the governments and act toward all the nations of the world in peace and love. We have no intention but that which is good and no desire but the good pleasure of God. We mean well toward every people and seek to have sincerity and good-will toward every government.

Subject: obedience to and respect for government authority
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/obedience to and respect for government authority.txt
Quotation: Marriage and divorce must be carried out with the knowledge of the government or through those in authority, otherwise difficulties will arise. In any case, marriage and divorce must be administered under an effective center, so that should either party seek to undermine them, they would be powerless to do so, but rather be compelled to obey, and upon thee be the Most Glorious Glory.

Subject: obedience to and respect for government authority
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/obedience to and respect for government authority.txt

And each one who becomes employed in the court of the government must conduct himself with the utmost truthfulness, devotion to reality, chastity, purity, detachment, holiness, justice and fairness.

Subject: obedience to and respect for government authority
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/obedience to and respect for government authority.txt
Quotation: He hath proven and established before all the governments of the world that this community is commanded to obedience and harmony, and forbidden from conflict and discord. They are well-wishers of the government and lovers and friends of the sovereignty; they are obedient and submissive to the imperial throne, and are willing and devoted servants of the royal court, faithfully attending to their duties with pure hearts.

Subject: obedience to and respect for government authority
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/obedience to and respect for government authority.txt
Quotation: His Imperial Majesty the Shah of Iran is like a kind father, and His Excellency the Prime Minister is, as he should be, aware of the means of comfort and ease for the servants of God and exerts maximum effort. The good intentions of the authorities will surely cause gratitude from all, and all must strive for development and prosperity under the royal shade with perfect sincerity, trustworthiness, religiosity, goodwill and obedience to the government.

Subject: obedience to and respect for government authority
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/obedience to and respect for government authority.txt
Quotation: In all matters related to the just monarchical government, our duty is obedience, submission, compliance and acknowledgment. His Majesty is the just shepherd, the monarch who bestows benefit, knowing what is best for his subjects. And loyal subjects seek their comfort and happiness in the shadow of obedience to the crown. Whatever His Majesty and the authorities command, this servant must obey, and likewise all must obey and submit to whatever the government commands.

Subject: obedience to and respect for government authority
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/obedience to and respect for government authority.txt
Quotation: The people of Japan accepted to obey their King. Consider how significant the material progress that they made in so short a span of time. They struck the world with awe and caused the wonderment of all nations. If the people of Persia truly cherish the desire to progress, if they seek after well-being and tranquility, they must recognize their felicity in the comingling of the government and the people rather than in opposition to the laws of the government, for such opposition will have bitter consequences and will become the cause confusion and discomfort to all mankind.

Subject: obedience to and respect for government authority
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/obedience to and respect for government authority.txt
Quotation: For thirty-eight years until now, this community has traversed the valley of patience and quietude, bowed their heads in submission and acquiescence, and regarded obedience and subordination as religious obligations...We swear by all the noble ones of the divine court and the recipients of heavenly revelation, from beginning to end, that we are faithful subjects and steadfast servants, detached from flattery and hypocrisy, aloof from deception and contention. In obedience and submission to the sovereign throne and with sincere intentions we have pledged our divine faith and covenant.

Subject: obedience to and respect for government authority
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/obedience to and respect for government authority.txt
Quotation: O kings are the manifestations of power, and the daysprings of might and wealth of God. Pray ye on their behalf. Their sovereignty hath been given to them by God. The kings are the manifestations of God's power, wealth and grandeur. Pray ye for them. The sovereignty of earth was bestowed upon them and He ordained them to rule over the hearts of men. He hath forbidden conflict and strife - a weighty commandment in the Book. This is God's bidding in this most great Revelation, which He hath protected from annulment and adorned with the ornament of confirmation. He is verily the All-Knowing, the All-Wise. It is incumbent upon all to aid those manifestations of divine decree and daysprings of His command who are adorned with justice and equity.

Subject: obedience to and respect for government authority
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/obedience to and respect for government authority.txt
Quotation: And now, in gratitude for the assistance, confirmation, protection, and loving-kindness vouchsafed by the All-Glorious Lord, the beloved of God must with great wisdom strive to strengthen the pillars of the Cause of God, to establish and promote the religion of God, to diffuse the fragrances of God, and to exalt the Word of God. They must exert every effort for the advancement of the souls in all stages of existence. They must educate the children and teach them useful arts, reach ever higher degrees of civilization, multiply national crafts and industry, promote trade, improve agriculture, provide learning for all, educate women and honour them, and show consideration for the handmaidens of God. They must strive with heart and soul to create love and unity among the friends, to serve the government, and to be true to the royal throne, the well-wishers of everyone, and obedient to the valiant sovereign.

Subject: obedience to and respect for government authority
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/obedience to and respect for government authority.txt
Quotation: Among created things is the sacred human being, whom the Divine Realm has distinguished and honored with excellences, characteristics and qualities that make humanity the very essence of all created things and the spirit of all realities. Among the celestial characteristics of this sacred reality are reason and intelligence, and justice and fairness through heavenly inspiration. These divine powers have been bestowed to be put into action, not to be neglected and suspended. O loved ones of God! Observe how in all the divine Tablets ye are bidden to obedience and submission, and are commanded to serve with sincerity and faithfulness, and to manifest servitude to the divinely-ordained throne of sovereignty. Therefore, arise to render service with utmost truthfulness of purpose, with goodly intent and obedience to government, and sacrifice your lives in the discharge of your duties as subjects.

Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/obedience to; authority of the Manifestations of God.txt

Subject: obedience to; authority of the Manifestations of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/obedience to; authority of the Manifestations of God.txt

Subject: obedience to; authority of the Manifestations of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/obedience to; authority of the Manifestations of God.txt

Subject: obedience to; authority of the Manifestations of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/obedience to; authority of the Manifestations of God.txt

Subject: occult sciences; psychic phenomena

Read my prayers always and thus see a wonderful effect, causing all superstitious powers and influences to vanish away.

Subject: one universal law; attractive power of love
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/one universal law; attractive power of love.txt

Subject: one universal law; attractive power of love
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/one universal law; attractive power of love.txt

Subject: one universal law; attractive power of love
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/one universal law; attractive power of love.txt
Quotation: Love is the supreme magnetic force that directeth the movements of the spheres in the celestial realms. Love revealeth with unfailing and limitless power the mysteries latent in the universe.

Subject: oneness or innumerability of the Manifestations of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/oneness or innumerability of the Manifestations of God.txt
Quotation: Look not upon these Manifestations with the eye of difference, for this is not the path of those endowed with insight and understanding. Rather, He Who created you is He Who sustains you, and He Who created you is He Who causes you to die, and He Who causes you to die is He Who gives you life. No partner hath He in His work and no rival hath He in His dominion.

Subject: oneness or innumerability of the Manifestations of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/oneness or innumerability of the Manifestations of God.txt
Quotation: By God, the True One! The Eye of God wept for Me in His seat when I was cast into the fire, and once when I was afflicted at the hands of Pharaoh, and once when I was afflicted at the hands of the Jews, and once when I was cast upon the dust in the land of Taff, and once when I was suspended in the air, and in these days when I have fallen into the clutches of the polytheists among the people of the Bayan.

Subject: oneness or innumerability of the Manifestations of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/oneness or innumerability of the Manifestations of God.txt
Quotation: He is too exalted to be known through any other than Himself; rather, others are known through Him. He is too sublime for mention of truth in that station, for every truth becomes truth through Him. His similitude is that of the sun - if it were to rise and set from infinity to infinity, there would still be but one sun.

Subject: oneness or innumerability of the Manifestations of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/oneness or innumerability of the Manifestations of God.txt
Quotation: It is He Who hath been manifest in all the Messengers, and He Who hath spoken in all the Books. He hath had no beginning, for through Him doth the beginning begin; and He hath had no end, for through Him doth the end end. It is He Who in this wondrous Cycle, which is now the thirteenth year, is known as the Point of the Bayan, and as the First Creation in the days of Adam, and as Noah in his day, and as Abraham in his day, and as Moses in his day, and as Jesus in his day, and as Muhammad the Apostle of God in His day, and the Point of the Bayan in His day, and He Whom God shall make manifest in His day, and He Whom God shall make manifest after Him Whom God shall make manifest in His day, have been known.

Subject: oneness or innumerability of the Manifestations of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/oneness or innumerability of the Manifestations of God.txt
Quotation: And this is the meaning of the tradition concerning the Proof, wherein the Truthful One hath said: He saith: O assemblage of creatures! Whoso desireth to behold Adam and Seth, lo, I am Adam and Seth! Whoso desireth to behold Noah and his son Shem, lo, I am Noah and Shem! Whoso desireth to behold Abraham and Ishmael, lo, I am Abraham and Ishmael! Whoso desireth to behold Moses and Joshua, lo, I am Moses and Joshua! Whoso desireth to behold Jesus and Simon, lo, I am Jesus and Simon! Whoso desireth to behold Muhammad and the Prince of Believers, lo, I am Muhammad and the Prince of Believers! Whoso desireth to behold Hasan and Husayn, lo, I am Hasan and Husayn! Whoso desireth to behold the Imams from the progeny of Husayn, lo, I am the Imams one after another unto Hasan!

Subject: oneness or innumerability of the Manifestations of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/oneness or innumerability of the Manifestations of God.txt
Quotation: Glory be from God unto the First One and unto those who resemble that One wherein naught is seen save the First One.

Subject: oneness or innumerability of the Manifestations of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/oneness or innumerability of the Manifestations of God.txt
Quotation: Every Manifestation is the Adam of His time. (Adam means the type man, the perfect man.) There were one hundred thousand Adams before the Adam of biblical records each being the Manifestation of His own time or cycle.... 'Abdu'l-Baha says that within the last 500,000 years there have been seven universal Manifestations, the last three of whom were Melchizedek, Jesus Christ, and Baha'u'llah.

Subject: oneness or innumerability of the Manifestations of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/oneness or innumerability of the Manifestations of God.txt
Quotation: "We make no distinction between any of His Messengers." For their purpose is one and their mystery the same. To establish distinctions or precedence between Them is not permissible.

Subject: oneness or innumerability of the Manifestations of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/oneness or innumerability of the Manifestations of God.txt
Quotation: We behold in their Manifestation naught but the Manifestation of God, and in their concealment naught but His concealment, did ye but know. They all are the mirrors of God, wherein naught can be seen but God's Self, His Beauty, His might and His glory

Subject: oneness or innumerability of the Manifestations of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/oneness or innumerability of the Manifestations of God.txt
Quotation: Such as these are the great first teachers...One of the solar dawning points was Moses, another was Abraham. One of the great daysprings of the sun was His Holiness Christ. Another dawning point was Mohammed. One dawning point was the Bab, another Baha'o'llah.

Subject: oneness or innumerability of the Manifestations of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/oneness or innumerability of the Manifestations of God.txt
Quotation: For example, in the manifestation of the Bayan, when the Point of Truth found that you had become attached to names, therefore I informed you of their return, or their manifestation, or their resurrection, or other such terms that you might comprehend. Otherwise, the Cause in the sight of God is not as you imagine.

Subject: oneness or innumerability of the Manifestations of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/oneness or innumerability of the Manifestations of God.txt
Quotation: The essence of prophethood is one, just as the effect of one or more lights is that of one. If you look at the lamps we find them different, but the light is the same. It is sent by GOD (exalted is His name). There is no difference between the prophets, because all of them are lightened from the same light, and all have attained through the Giver of the Light.

Subject: oneness or innumerability of the Manifestations of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/oneness or innumerability of the Manifestations of God.txt
Quotation: Despite their differences in every age and era, there is no difference among them, for they all appeared through God's command... Whoso maketh any distinction between them, or between their words, or what hath been revealed unto them, or in their conditions and deeds, even to the smallest degree, hath indeed associated partners with God and His signs and His Messengers

Subject: oneness or innumerability of the Manifestations of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/oneness or innumerability of the Manifestations of God.txt
Quotation: This is the meaning of Muhammad's words aforetime mentioning the Prophets as being himself, for in all the Prophets there is one Command that reached unto Muhammad, the Messenger of God, and from Muhammad unto the Point of the Bayan, and from the Point of the Bayan unto Him Whom God shall make manifest, and from Him Whom God shall make manifest unto Him Who shall appear afterwards, unto an end that hath no end, even as ye may divine and be assured concerning a beginning that hath no beginning.

Subject: oneness; unity of religion
Quotation: The Cause of Baha'u'llah is the same as the Cause of Christ. For example this room is now lighted, but some one comes in and turns off the light through his ignorance, and we are steeped in darkness. Then another person coming in and hearing voices and lamentation turns on the lights and the room is again illumined. He may renew some of the furniture but the light and the room - are always the same.

Subject: oneness; unity of religion
Quotation: In every age and century, the horizon of the world becomes illumined with a special manifestation and is brightened by a supreme sign. In the age of Abraham, the horizon of existence shone with the lights of Divine friendship. In the Mosaic age, the dayspring of reality gleamed with the rays of Mount Sinai. In the time of the Spirit of God (Christ), all existence was perfumed with holy fragrances. In the day of the appearance of the Sun of Yathrib (Muhammad), the dawn of creation was illumined with the light of love and grandeur. At the time when the veil was lifted from the countenance of the Primal Point (the Bab), the morn of guidance was adorned with the brilliant rays of the greatest glad-tidings. And in the Most Great Manifestation and the appearance of the Ancient Beauty, the horizons of the world were encompassed by all divine outpourings, manifestations, names and attributes, and were enlightened, proven and perfected - for the Most Great Ocean contains and encompasses all seas, gulfs, lights, springs and conditions.

Subject: oneness; unity of religion
Quotation: Religion has to be a cause of harmony for mankind. When religion breeds enmity and hate, it is preferable that religion does not exist.

Subject: oneness; unity of religion
Quotation: The basic teachings of all divine religions is the same and the Prophets are the dawning places of truth. No one can take exception or say that the principles of the Prophets and the truth of their teachings are different.

Subject: oneness; unity of religion
Quotation: Religion with God is Islam, from Adam to the Seal, as God, glory be to Him and exalted is He, has said "Abraham was a Muslim community." Thus all the Prophets and Messengers were Muslims because they were all upon the manifest truth - "We make no distinction between any of His Messengers."...  But as for the fundamental foundation, there is absolutely no change or alteration, and you will never find any change in God's way.

Subject: oneness; unity of religion
Quotation: Christ gave this great foundation, as did Mohammed, the Bab and Baha'o'llah. They are all one. There is no difference in their teachings.

Subject: oneness; unity of religion

Subject: oneness; unity of religion

Subject: oneness; unity of religion
Quotation: Religion as reality is one reality; it does not admit multiplicity or division. If the nations of the world investigate reality, they will agree and become united.

Subject: oneness; unity of religion
Quotation: It was a proof of unity and oneness and an evidence of love and freedom. The purpose of the coming of the Manifestation of the Mount is the unification of the world of humanity.

Subject: oneness; unity of religion
Quotation: to prepare them to hearken unto that which conduces to the sanctifying and purifying of the people of the world from strife and discord resulting from differences in religions or sects

Subject: oneness; unity of religion
Quotation: The Cause of Baha'u'llah is the same as the Cause of Christ. It is the same Temple and the same Foundation. The origins and ends are the same. The sun of today is the sun of yesterday.

Subject: oneness; unity of religion
Quotation: They said all are fruits of one tree and leaves of one branch, except some are sick and must be healed; ignorant and must be educated through training; unlearned and must be made learned.

Subject: oneness; unity of religion
Quotation: Know ye that the paths to God are as numerous as the breaths of the creatures, and that there is no soul but one, and that there is no religion but the one religion, and it is the Cause of God.

Subject: oneness; unity of religion
Quotation: O servants of the All-Merciful! Set aside differences and hold fast to the cord of unity. This is what ye were commanded in the Tablets of God aforetime and in this glorious and wondrous station.

Subject: oneness; unity of religion
Quotation: Be unified in God's Cause and His religion in such wise that no differences may arise among you - this is a matter We have loved from all eternity and have inscribed in preserved tablets of glory.

Subject: oneness; unity of religion
Quotation: Therefore, the religions are essentially one and the same. Christ ratified and proclaimed the foundation of the law of Moses. Muhammad and all the Prophets have revoiced that same foundation of reality.

Subject: oneness; unity of religion
Quotation: Religion can be divided into two parts: the first is the spirit which never changes; and the second the laws which are regulated according to the time. True religion is always one in whatever form it may appear.

Subject: oneness; unity of religion
Quotation: Lay such a foundation that the influence of the confederation of religions and sects may permeate to all parts of the world from Green Acre; and Green Acre for the future ages and cycles may become the standard bearer of the oneness of the world of humanity.

Subject: oneness; unity of religion
Quotation: We cherish the hope that through the endeavors of God's loved ones and friends, the withered world may be revived, and the weakness of the monotheists may be transformed into strength, and their powerlessness into might.

Subject: oneness; unity of religion
Quotation: Religion is but one religion, and it is the Command of God, and Our Command is but one, so set thy face steadfastly toward the true Faith--the nature which God hath instilled into mankind. There is no altering God's creation.

Subject: oneness; unity of religion
Quotation: The various religions will be united, and different races will be known as one kind. Abraham proclaimed this reality; Jesus promulgated it; all the Prophets who have appeared in the world have founded Their teachings upon it.

Subject: oneness; unity of religion
Quotation: Whoso turneth to names because of their connection to God, he is indeed among the unitarians. And whoso fixeth upon them in themselves and for themselves, he is among the worshippers of names and is accounted among the idolaters.

Subject: oneness; unity of religion
Quotation: Religion must be the cause of Love and amity - if Religion ever becomes the means of hatred and rancor then irreligion is better than that kind of religion for Religion is a cause of treatment and remedy for the sickness of the body social.

Subject: oneness; unity of religion
Quotation: The basis of the teaching of Baha'u'llah is the Unity of Mankind, and his greatest desire was that love and goodwill should live in the heart of men. If these religious prejudices could be swept away, the nations would soon enjoy peace and concord.

Subject: oneness; unity of religion
Quotation: Baha'o'llah states that Mohammed was a prophet of God, that Christ was the word of God and Moses the Friend of God. He affirms the principles, the spirit, the reality of each religion, giving lordly and abiding arguments and never indulging in vague sentiments.

Subject: oneness; unity of religion
Quotation: All prophets are messengers from God and all ways lead to him and all have borne fruit. All reverence and gratitude should be given to the prophets of the past. That whenever we found good or heard of it, we were to rejoice and accept it; that all religions were of God.

Subject: oneness; unity of religion
Quotation: Those people who have harkened to the teachings of BAHA'O'LLAH-Hindus, Mohammedans, Christians, Zoroastrians, Buddhists, Jews-such people have discarded their past rancour and are associating with the utmost love and unity... All these different faiths are merging into one great faith.

Subject: oneness; unity of religion
Quotation: The divine religions They established have one foundation; Their teachings, proofs and evidences are one; in name and form They differ, but in reality They agree and are the same. Likewise, the divine religions of the holy Manifestations of God are in reality one, though in name and nomenclature they differ.

Subject: oneness; unity of religion
Quotation: When the devotees of religion cast aside their dogmas and ritualism, the unification of religion will be in sight, and the realities of the holy books will become unveiled. In these days misunderstandings are rife, but when these misunderstandings and blind imitations are relinquished, the sun of reality shall dawn.

Subject: oneness; unity of religion
Quotation: The fundamental basis of the divine religions, having been forgotten, is being reformed and reestablished by the Bahai movement. It is a reformation. The basis of the divine religions is one. It is not multiple, for reality is one and not multiple. The fundamental basis of all divine religions is one and the same. In that sense the Bahai movement is not a new religion.

Subject: oneness; unity of religion
Quotation: These Bahai Jews acknowledge Mohammed also, and are able to offer rational and traditional proofs regarding his prophethood. Religious tolerance of this kind would have been hitherto impossible and inconceivable but during this century of radiance such progressive thought is made possible by the dispensation of Baha'o'llah.

Subject: oneness; unity of religion
Quotation: Abraham was the servant of this Cause; Jesus Christ sacrificed himself for it; Muhammed, the prophet, promulgated this teaching; his highness, the Bab, lighted this candlestick; his holiness Baha'o'llah manifested this brilliant star. This is the original purpose, the essential part of the Cause, the reality of the teachings of God.

Subject: oneness; unity of religion
Quotation: There is no difference...the past is like the future. This is what Christ said: "Compare my days with those in the future." His Holiness Muhammad said that the past and future are like a pair of shoes....the same way the days of Moses are like my days. Muhammad said one shoe is like the other. These can be compared one to the other.

Subject: oneness; unity of religion
Quotation: We believe in what hath been sent down unto Us in this Tablet, and in what was sent down unto Moses and Jesus, and in what was sent down unto Muhammad the Messenger of God, and in what was sent down unto 'Ali before Nabil from holy and exalted verses. We make no distinction between any of them, and We, verily, are on a straight path.

Subject: oneness; unity of religion
Quotation: His Holiness Baha'o'llah likened the religions of the world to musical instruments, each divine messenger having been sent to sound a different key, but the instruments have become out of tune and discord has resulted. Therefore Baha'o'llah brought a new musical instrument and put it into our hands, saying: "Play on this. It includes all notes, all harmony."

Subject: oneness; unity of religion
Quotation: We explained these one by one, and that religious leaders must abandon these ignorant prejudices and modern imitations. They must grasp the foundation of divine religion, which is universal peace and the unity of humankind. All the Prophets were sent for the sake of affection between people, not affliction. They came for unity, not division. They were sent for love, not hatred.

Subject: oneness; unity of religion
Quotation: Today, the Religion of God and the Faith of God is this: that the diverse religions and manifold ways should not be made the cause of enmity. These principles and laws, these firmly-established paths, have proceeded from one Source and shone forth from one Dayspring. These differences have appeared in response to the requirements of the time, the age, and the centuries and epochs.

Subject: oneness; unity of religion
Quotation: Today in the Orient those souls from amongst the various sects, religions and nations who have accepted the teachings of BAHA'O'LLAH are cemented together with the power of affinity and love. Were you to enter any of their conferences in the Orient you would behold the Mussulmans, Buddhists, Jews, Christians and Zoroastrians associating together in a spirit of unity and brotherhood

Subject: oneness; unity of religion
Quotation: The essential ordinances of religion were the same during the time of Abraham, the day of Moses and the cycle of Jesus. Inasmuch as the essential reality of the religions is one and their seeming variance and plurality is adherence to forms and imitations which have arisen, it is evident that these causes of difference and divergence must be abandoned in order that the underlying reality may unite mankind.

Subject: oneness; unity of religion
Quotation: Then indeed these brilliant stars from the horizon of reality were in harmony and united and agreed, and each predecessor gave glad tidings of each successor, and each successor confirmed the prophethood of each predecessor. So why do you, O people, differ and dispute and quarrel when you have a good example in these divine manifestations and merciful dawning-places and recipients of revelation, the divine company?

Subject: oneness; unity of religion
Quotation: There may be a light in a room, but it merely sheds light in that room. There may be many lights, with coloured bulbs of various hues and shades. But the source of all those lights is the same--and there must be sources; it is the dynamo that is hidden from sight. So it is with all the religions. They sparkle here and there in various colours--but there is but one source for them all, just one Light, and that is God. Self-seeking preachers and teachers have wandered far from that Real Light. And it is the Light that we now seek in the real truth. Men have wandered far from the teachings of Christ, Buddha, the Jewish prophets and all of the others. Ours is not a new religion, it is the very old one; we desire to unite all forms in their original purity.

Subject: oneness; unity of religion
Quotation: Your very deeds are your paradise in God's good-pleasure, and your fire in that which is other than His good-pleasure, if ye would but briefly ponder your actions. Though thou rememberest after the matter hath been decreed what was revealed in the Book whose verses have been perfected by the All-Knowing, the Exalted, the Sublime, thou shalt find no way to that which God hath witnessed except if thou desirest to be among the guided ones.

Subject: oneness; unity of religion
Quotation: The fundamental question is the unification of religious belief. All religion has the same foundation. It is not necessary to lower Abraham to raise Jesus. It is not necessary to lower Jesus to proclaim Baha'o'llah. We must spread the Truth of God wherever we behold it. The essence of the question is that all these Great Messengers came to raise the Divine Standard of Perfections. All of them shine as stars in the same heaven of the Divine Will.

Subject: oneness; unity of religion
Quotation: One of the teachings of Baha'o'llah relates to the unification of religion. Religion should be a bond to connect the hearts of men. It should be a cause of the illumination of the human world. It should be a center of attraction to the hearts. It should be a channel for the mercy of God. If it prove to be a cause of discord, enmity and bloodshed, then irreligion would be preferable, because religion should be a door to the knowledge and love of God.

Subject: oneness; unity of religion
Quotation: "He promulgated the fundamental oneness of religion. He taught that reality is one and not multiple, that it underlies all divine precepts and that the foundations of the religions are, therefore, the same. Certain forms and imitations have gradually arisen. As these vary, they cause differences among religionists. If we set aside these imitations and seek the fundamental reality underlying our beliefs, we reach a basis of agreement because it is one and not multiple."

Subject: oneness; unity of religion
Quotation: Religions are many, but the reality of religion is one. The days are many, but the sun is one. The fountains are many, but the fountainhead is one. The branches are many, but the tree is one. The foundation of the divine religions is reality; were there no reality, there would be no religions. Reality is one; it does not admit multiplicity or division. Reality is as the sun, which shines forth from different dawning points; it is as the light, which has illumined many lanterns.

Subject: oneness; unity of religion
Quotation: The purpose of all the divine religions is the establishment of the bonds of love and fellowship among men, and the heavenly phenomena of the revealed Word of God are intended to be a source of knowledge and illumination to humanity. Each of the holy Manifestations announced the glad tidings of His successor, and each One confirmed the message of His predecessor. Therefore, inasmuch as They were agreed and united in purpose and teaching, it is incumbent upon Their followers to be likewise unified in love and spiritual fellowship.

Subject: oneness; unity of religion
Quotation: It is evident then that we must not look at the dawning places but at the real sun. The dawning places vary, but the sun does not vary. In whatever point it may appear it is always the sun. Now all the followers of the great religions of the world are veiled because they are looking at the old dawning places and are not watching for the coming of the Sun. Your lover must love you, not your house. If he really loves you he will recognize you in whatever house you may appear; but if he is attached to the house, he will not find you if you appear in a new house.

Subject: oneness; unity of religion
Quotation: For ye have drunk from the Living Waters while your companions remained deprived, and ye have attained the eternal bounty while your fellow believers were forbidden... For the Prophets - they who have been the Dawning-Places of divine revelation and the Daysprings of divine inspiration - there are stations which names cannot access. They are all seen as one soul, for they speak but one word and stand firm upon one cause. Blessed is he who immerseth himself in this vast ocean whose shores none hath reached, how much less its depths. This is the station of the Sun of unity and the Ocean of oneness.

Subject: oneness; unity of religion
Quotation: I hope, through divine grace and bounty, that such fellowship may be established among the Hands of the Cause of God as has never been witnessed from the beginning of creation, nor shall be witnessed hereafter. For this Cause is mighty, mighty indeed, and in the future the institution of the Hands will attain the utmost importance, such that all mighty affairs, both general and specific, pertaining to the Cause of God will be discussed in consultation among the Hands of the Cause of God. Consider, then, how essential are unity, accord, oneness, and unity of purpose - without these nothing is possible.

Subject: oneness; unity of religion
Quotation:
The Holy, Divine Manifestations are Unique and Peerless. They are the Archtypal of Celestial and spiritual virtues in their own age and Cycle. They stand on the summit of the Mount of vision and they foreshadow the perfections of the future humanity. For example during the Dispensation of His Holiness Moses - Peace be upon him - there was not a single human soul similar or like unto him. He overshadowed all the Holy Souls who came after him, even the hosts of the Israelitish prophets. In a similar manner all the people who lived during the cycle of His Holiness Christ - may my life be a sacrifice to Him!- were under his spiritual authority. They had no will of their own. He was the Sun and the others were the lamps.   ABU0128
He continued to reveal divine teachings and wrote numerous tablets and books, proclaiming the principles of the oneness of humanity, universal peace, and the unity of religion.

Quotation: Please write about any news or events that arrive from anywhere, or like the late Aqa Siyyid Taqi, write a brief summary of that news on the back of the same letter and send it...Letters arrive and remain with you for several days. Among them, Mirza Jalal had sent a letter, but after he himself arrived, his letter reached us. Please be attentive in this matter.

Subject: order; organization; tact; deliberation [tadbir]
Quotation: Say: God, verily, loveth order in all things. In all things ye manifest the order of God. Thus, if ye have a ring on your right hand, place one likewise on your left, for this is of God's order whereby ye may be strengthened. And if there be an amulet on your right arm, and none on your left, this is not of God's order. Therefore, order all your affairs according to what ye comprehend from God, and then according to what ye yourselves love.

Subject: order; organization; tact; deliberation [tadbir]
