That heavenly food consisted of the love of God, the knowledge of God, the mysteries of God and the bestowal of God.

Subject: outward and inward meanings
Quotation: Baha'u'llah was no exception in this respect to all other Divine Manifestations. He used symbols and metaphors, and if we would understand him, we must interpret these. But this is the day of enlightenment, and therefore his symbols will be read with the highest conception of truth, and his teachings will throw light upon those of all the former Manifestations.

Subject: outward and inward meanings
Quotation: For divine words are symbols, mysteries, hidden treasures. A treasure is always hidden. A mine of jewels is always concealed. For example, Christ says "I am the heavenly bread" and it is clear that Christ was not bread and did not literally come from heaven but rather came from Mary's womb. But what was meant by this bread was heavenly bounty, divine perfections.

Subject: outward and inward meanings
Quotation: The people are ignorant and become greatly alarmed at any change of dress, imagining that if someone changes their clothing it will destroy the foundations. They recognize people by their garments and thus become veiled. Yet recognition of an illustrious person requires no lengthy discourse - one who recognizes the Truth will see and know it in any garment, while the veiled one remains veiled.

Subject: outward and inward meanings
Quotation: Each sign has a special significance. Each is a symbol, requiring special interpretation. Concerning the falling of the stars: Many of the stars are larger than the sun. The sun is a million times larger than the earth, and many of the Stars are larger than the sun. How then can they fall upon the earth? It is as if a hundred thousand mountains should be placed upon a grain of mustard. These are symbols only.

Subject: outward and inward meanings
Quotation: Thus the people who seek truth and inner meanings can discover the divine mysteries and become aware of the secrets of the Books of God. They know God to be the Supreme, His bounties infinite and the doors of His mercy unbarred. They believe in all the Prophets and affirm 'No difference do we make between any of them'. But those who adhere to outer meanings only, who worship outer form, cling to imitations and follow their superstitions.

Subject: pain of love; love as veil
Quotation: Beloved, our breasts to shards are torn, Our hearts all shorn from kith and kin, Bondslaves are we of Thy holy will, Ensnared in Thy tangled locks are we

Subject: pain of love; love as veil
Quotation: We are killed by Thy love, extinguished in our separation from Thee, annihilated in Thy Name. Thy trials, I desire. Thy decree, I desire. May all souls be offered up for Thy sake.

Subject: pain of love; love as veil
Quotation: Thou didst come with a sword in Thy hand, O Love, Here is my head, here is my heart, strike, strike hard this lifeless lover. With Thy blood-shedding eyebrow, shed the blood of this heart-bereft soul.

Subject: pain of love; love as veil
Quotation: If but a breath from this garden were to reach thy nostrils, the pen would fall from thy hand and thy letter would be torn asunder, nay rather, it would be consumed by the flame of the fire of the love of God.

Subject: pain of love; love as veil
Quotation: In their love of His Face, sanity and insanity were distraught, Drunkenness and sobriety circled about His abode. Marvel not that the lover hath fallen into His snare, The necks of the Monarchs of the Spirit are caught in His wavy locks.

Subject: pain of love; love as veil
Quotation: "Do Thou supply me, O Lord, with the cup of death after Thou hast made me taste the bitterness of remoteness from Thee... Have mercy, O my Lord, upon my sicknesses and upon my wakefulness and upon my sorrows and upon my burning with the flame of my separation"

Subject: pain of love; love as veil
Quotation: Though the fire of separation from Him is a burning flame, and the yearning to behold Him sets the heart ablaze, and these two cause floods of tears to flow, yet this temporary deprivation ends in eternal reunion and intimate fellowship in the private chamber of that loving Friend.

Quotation: All praise be unto God, Who hath created realities that are paired through the mutual encounter of the divine names and attributes, that are comprised of both existence and essence, and that derive their grace from states that are opposite yet compatible and from facing mirrors that form complementary reflections. “Glory be to Him Who hath created all the pairs, of such things as the earth produceth, and of themselves, and of things beyond their ken”, and hath made the human reality to be a wellspring of blessings and a fountainhead of abundant increase in the world of being. The inner realities of all things proceeded from the encounter of the most excellent names, and the contest of the most exalted attributes. They married, assembled, gathered, harmonized, united, and attained unto completion and perfection—whereupon, within the essences of the realities derived therefrom, the effulgence of primal oneness shone resplendent.

Subject: parliaments; constitutional government
Quotation: Through the grace of God and His chosen ones, and the high endeavors of the devoted and the consecrated, every difficulty can be easily resolved, every problem however complex will prove simpler than blinking an eye. While the setting up of parliaments, the organizing of assemblies of consultation, constitutes the very foundation and bedrock of government, there are several essential requirements which these institutions must fulfill.

Subject: parliaments; constitutional government
Quotation: If they were well-wishers, they would have shown obedience and submission to His Imperial Majesty the Shah and, with utmost humility, submissiveness and dignity, would have presented whatever they considered beneficial for state and nation regarding the establishment of a national parliament. It is certain that His Imperial Majesty would accept the petitions of any unbiased person, especially if based on goodwill for state and nation.

Subject: parliaments; constitutional government
Quotation: The Hague Congress must have such power and influence that its word becomes effective among nations and peoples. In conversation with the respected members, indicate that before the war the head of The Hague Congress was the Emperor of Russia and its members were among the greatest figures, yet it could not prevent this terrible war. How will it be now? For in the future, an even more severe war will certainly occur - there is absolutely no doubt about this. What will The Hague Congress do?

Subject: parliaments; constitutional government
Quotation: You wrote a glorious letter saying that the time has arrived, of the most great glad-tidings that a national parliament has been established in Iran and that arrangements are being made for a constitutional government that is in accord with the divine Law, in conformity with the explicit command of the Most Holy Book. I read what you wrote about the joy and delight of the American intellectuals and scholars at this life-giving good news, as well as the rejoicing at the Ottoman embassy. This became a cause for great happiness. The constitutional government is, according to the unequivocal divine Text, sanctioned by the revealed Law, and it is a cause of the might and prosperity of the State, to which allegiance is owed, and of the progress and liberty of the respected citizenry.

Subject: parliaments; constitutional government
Quotation: The mighty government and the brilliant nation should unite and establish a constitutional government, for the contingent world requires it, and one cannot prevent the requirements of existence. Every age has its requirements, and today's requirement is that governments be constitutional, as this brings comfort to the world of creation. The government will be in utmost ease and the nation in complete gratitude. What could be better than having the national assembly and cabinet of ministers take responsibility for all affairs, accept accountability, serve the government, while the king, like the Emperor of England, lives in perfect comfort, security and happiness, with the entire nation devoted to him. Therefore, constitutionalism is preferable, but utmost caution must be exercised so it does not become like other cases.

Quotation: It is an established fact that Man travels through these various kingdoms. The indivisible atom in the mineral kingdom appears through infinite changes, and in each change it manifests a peculiar virtue. - Having perfected its journeys through the mineral kingdom it acsends to the vegetable kingdom - Again in the vegetable kingdom this indivisible atom manifests itself throughout all the different varieties of plant life, and having again finished its experiences in this kingdom it will appear in the animal kingdom.

Subject: passage of elementary matter through degrees of existence
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/passage of elementary matter through degrees of existence.txt
Quotation: and its true felicity lies in its progress into the animal and human realms, becoming transformed into their bodily substance. But its true felicity lies in being transferred from the animal to the human kingdom, like minute creatures which, through air and water, enter the human body and are absorbed, becoming part of human tissue. This is its ultimate glory and happiness; no greater honor can be conceived for it.

Subject: past, present and future of Iran
Quotation: In this upheaval of Iran, no breast remained that was not made a target for the arrows of tribulation, and no foundation remained that was not breached. Many a household was left without head or shelter, and many a gathering of hearts was scattered. What a devastating hunter was that which passed through this wilderness! The foundation of tyranny and oppression was overthrown, yet the edifice of freedom has not to this day been established. Iran is still in ruins, and parties are in strife and turmoil.

Subject: past, present and future of Iran
Quotation: The territory of Iran hath become an arena for cavalry and woe and aggression, and the fires of oppression and tyranny have been ignited therein through the occurrence of conflict between the parties. No breast remaineth except wounded by arrows, no liver except injured by spears, and no body except prostrate upon the dust of abasement and humiliation.

Subject: past, present and future of Iran
Quotation: The province of Fars, indeed the realm of Iran, is in ruins...That country is in truth subject to endless illnesses, troubled from every direction.

Subject: past, present and future of Iran
Quotation: railways have become widespread throughout all regions of the world. Now the merchants and wealthy ones among the Baha'is must think day and night about building railways in Iran...if this railway is built it will cause the development of the Ottomans and Iranians, indeed all the people of Asia, for it will facilitate the pilgrimage and expand general commerce

Subject: past, present and future of Iran
Quotation: Various parties in Iran have not grown repentant yet... Various parties in Iran have no intention of doing good. Their purpose is to gain personal profit.

Subject: past, present and future of Iran
Quotation: The standard of chaos and confusion hath, in these days, been hoisted in Iran. There is mischief in every place and misfortune in every quarter. The whole of creation is sorely distressed.

Subject: past, present and future of Iran
Quotation: Iran is desolate and much hardship must be endured so that, God willing, improvement may appear in Iran's condition... Though Iran's political affairs are in disarray, its spiritual affairs are unified and growing stronger.

Subject: past, present and future of Iran
Quotation: For the people of Kirman are in infinite need of education - nay, all of Iran is in need of education. Until now no significant enlightened souls have appeared in the assemblies of Iran, and if there be any, the rare is as the non-existent.

Subject: past, present and future of Iran
Quotation: For the prosperity and success of the government and people of Iran is a matter decreed and assured. If proper means be employed, this bounty will be speedily attained and the beloved object of royal desire will be made manifest; otherwise there will be delay.

Subject: past, present and future of Iran
Quotation: Therefore, the friends must strive with heart and soul to bring these bewildered Iranians to their senses. If they should so endeavor, it is certain that they will find deliverance from this abyss of humiliation and abasement and will progress in the degrees of eternal glory of humankind.

Subject: past, present and future of Iran
Quotation: Tihran. O Amin, upon thee be the Glory of God, the Most Glorious! He is God! O thou who art firm in the Covenant! Thy letter dated the 7th of Dhi'l-Hajjih 1339 was received. The world of humanity, particularly Iran, is in great turmoil, and changes and transformations in all conditions follow one after another.

Subject: past, present and future of Iran
Quotation: I have heartfelt attachment to Iranians and desire that justice, fairness and freedom from oppression be known of them throughout the world. As the Arab poet says: My country, though it treats me harshly, is dear to me; and my people, though they be stingy toward me, are noble. We have utmost attachment to Iran and Iranians.

Subject: past, present and future of Iran
Quotation: Strive ye and make an effort, for Iran is the homeland of the compassionate Beloved, and Persia is the source of the rising of the brilliant morn. Perchance through the endeavors of the friends, the people of that land may witness the radiance of the shining moon and receive their share and portion of the outpourings of the Lord of Signs.

Subject: past, present and future of Iran
Quotation: They sacrifice themselves for both government and people, and are the cause of true progress for the people of Iran. They are content with modest wages, and wash their hands of improper income and customary bribes. Through all means they strive for the happiness of the nation, and in every way they seek that which leads to Iran's advancement.

Subject: past, present and future of Iran
Quotation: They will organize new industries; found the traces of civilization, various factories, the spread of commerce, increase of agriculture, and the universalization of learning. As soon as security and tranquility are reached to the limit of perfection by the endeavors of the government, they will come, and will make the territory of Persia the envy of the world and of the other provinces.

Subject: past, present and future of Iran
Quotation: Soon shalt thou see that land perfumed with the breezes of holiness and brightened with the light of its ancient splendour. Therefore must the Persians appreciate this bounty and praise the Lord of all creation for having vouchsafed such a blessing, bestowed such peace, and conferred such grace. He hath made their ancient homeland the most exalted of regions and their dwelling-place the dawning-point of the manifest Light.

Subject: past, present and future of Iran
Quotation: The parable of Iran is like a verdant and flourishing field that has been seized by cold, with abundant snow fallen upon it. Soon the heat of the sun will melt and disperse the snows, then with utmost beauty that cultivation and garden will swiftly grow and progress. In any case, Iran will soon advance, though internal politics... This situation with their politics that you see continues for some time, until we see what God's politics will do with them.

Subject: past, present and future of Iran
Quotation: You tell them that we declare unto you that that the glories of Persia will become in the future thousandfold. If you don't believe in our declaration make a note of it in a book that a day is soon coming when Persia shall reach the highest zenith of glory, it will be built and become very prosperous. All the ancient cities of Persia will be built up and the fame of Persia and the Persians shall be spread over all the regions of the world and the greatness of the Persian civilization will cover the East and the West.

Subject: past, present and future of Iran
Quotation: During the reign of the late Monarch; Fath Ali Shah, even as the Russian troops were crossing the river Aras, the first traitor was Siyyid Fattah - that ignorant cleric who opened wide the gates of Tabriz and welcomed the Russian army thus creating such tumult and agitation in the city as to frighten and alarm the inhabitants, causing the notables to escape, forsaking all their cares and belongings. Once peace and harmony were established, Siyyid Fattah sought refuge in Russia and eventually all his hopes were shattered.

Subject: past, present and future of Iran
Quotation: Now I have found the opportunity to answer the petitions recently received and forward them to you in this mail. Regarding the subject of Persia: Praise be to God! she became the East of the Sun of Truth in this age. The Light of Eternity dawned, the Everlasting Glory unveiled her countenance and the Reality of Mercifulness became manifest. This is the prosperity of Persia. Undoubtedly she will progress day by day under the shade of the Blessed Tree until her illumination shall penetrate throughout the wide expanse of the earth.

Subject: past, present and future of Iran
Quotation: In these days, due to the counsels of Abdu'l-Baha, in all the cities of Iran the friends are reposing in the cradle of peace and security, while during this upheaval all other parties have been in the utmost distress. However, in the regions of Khurasan until now the friends remain caught in the grip of oppression and enmity... while Iran - which in ancient times was the center of humanity and civilization and was renowned throughout the horizons for its nobility - is now caught in such conditions: no modesty or shame, no justice or faithfulness, no fear of God.

Subject: past, present and future of Iran
Quotation: Speaking of Malkam Khan, when the German Emperor gave Bismarck the title of Prince, Nasir'd-Din Shah heard of this and said we should also bestow this title, and thus gave this title to Mirza Malkam Khan. Mirza Malkam Khan spent his life in vain. He was very intelligent and knew several languages, but lacked wisdom. For instance, in Tehran he told Nasir'd-Din Shah that Europe's order, organization and progress was due to their having Freemasonry lodges, and if you establish this too, the same will occur. The Shah accepted this and ordered its establishment, compelling all ministers to join that circle.

Subject: past, present and future of Iran
Quotation: The Blessed Beauty appeared at a time when the countries of Iran were immersed in such darkness and ignorance and consumed by the most extreme fanatical prejudices. You have undoubtedly read in detail about the character, conduct and thoughts of the Iranians in recent centuries as recorded in European histories, so there is no need to repeat it. Suffice it to say that the country had reached such a state of degradation that all foreign travelers lamented how this nation, which in earlier centuries had attained the highest degree of glory and civilization, had now fallen so low and lay in ruins, its very foundation destroyed, and its people reduced to a primitive state.

Subject: past, present and future of Iran
Quotation: Through the great bounty of the Merciful Lord, I hope that each of these newcomers will become the cause of Iran's progress and the nobility of Iranians. Indeed, may they shine like lamps in the assembly of the world and gleam like bright stars from the horizon of the world...Many centuries passed during which Iran's luminous morning had set in the west of obscurity. Now praise be to God, a brilliant dawn and gleaming morning light has shone forth from Iran's horizon upon all regions. That light, like the breaking dawn, is spreading and will soon encompass the world. It will illumine the dark world with divine lights and bestow celestial radiance. Iran will become the center of divine inspirations and the source of endless bounties for humanity. At that time the star of Persia's ancient glory will rise from the holy dawning-place.

Subject: perfection; imperfection of nature
Quotation: All beings, whether universal or particular, were created perfect and complete from the beginning. The most one can say is that their perfections only become apparent gradually. For example, all the vegetable perfections existed in this seed at the outset but were invisible and appeared only gradually. But from the beginning of its formation all of these existed potentially, albeit invisibly, in the seed.

Quotation: You, Haji Ali Sayyah and Ali Haydar Khan, if travel is possible for each with utmost joy and fragrance, have permission to attend in winter. Go directly to visit the Shrine and after several days, come wherever I am.

Quotation: In the coming spring, if circumstances permit and no obstacles arise, then those few who were bidden to be patient may don the pilgrim's garb of the Ka'bah of Purpose and present themselves in utmost joy and fragrance.

Quotation: You have permission to attain the presence, but Jinab-i-Aqa Muhammad ?adiq has permission to attain after your return. The intention is that both cannot be present at once - one must come first and the other afterwards.

Subject: permission for visit; pilgrimage
Quotation: Thine intention to pay a visit to the blessed House is acceptable and well-pleasing in the sight of this Wronged One, provided it is accomplished in a spirit of joy and radiance and would not prove contrary to the dictates of wisdom.

Subject: permission for visit; pilgrimage
Quotation: O visitor to the Sacred Shrine! Praise God that thou didst cross the seas and didst arrive at the shore of the ocean of thy Lord's bounty. Thou didst circumambulate the Sacred Shrine and didst prostrate thyself at the Threshold of His oneness.

Subject: permission for visit; pilgrimage
Quotation: However, if his honor Afnan, upon him be My Baha and loving-kindness, should send someone to that place for the conduct of affairs, so that the aforementioned gentleman might for a few days repair to these parts by way of recreation, this would be pleasing.

Subject: permission for visit; pilgrimage
Quotation: Concerning your request for renewed permission to visit the Holy Land: since you are now engaged in establishing the Mashriqu'l-Adhkar, this service is of great importance and perhaps your absence would cause a slackening, therefore persistence is necessary.

Subject: permission for visit; pilgrimage
Quotation: Regarding Mrs. Nash, you wrote that she has asked permission to consult with the Handmaid of Baha, Miss Barney. If she deems it appropriate, write to her to come, but on the condition that she not stay in Akka more than three nights, for the time is not favorable.

Subject: permission for visit; pilgrimage
Quotation: And at the end of the letter his honor Abdul-Baha, upon him be Baha, requested that after receiving permission you visit and circumambulate on his behalf. Permission hath appeared - turn thy face to Him Who mentioned thee and remembereth thee, then do as he desired.

Subject: permission for visit; pilgrimage
Quotation: You and a group had asked permission to attain the presence. In these days, coming into the presence in the Holy Land involves great difficulty and has many complications. You may possibly remain six months on the way. Postpone the time of presence to another occasion.

Subject: permission for visit; pilgrimage
Quotation: Thou hadst written requesting permission to be present. Thou art permitted to come, for it has been long since thou hast attained the honor of kissing the Sacred Threshold, and we too have not seen that luminous countenance nor been in the company of that spiritual friend.

Subject: permission for visit; pilgrimage
Quotation: And they desired that on behalf of the aforementioned souls they might repeatedly attain the presence and be honored with visitation...This has been adorned with the ornament of acceptance and it was commanded that they should engage in feasting and Jinab-i-Amin in service.

Subject: permission for visit; pilgrimage
Quotation: Praise God that you have crossed the seas and arrived at the shore of the ocean of your Lord's bounty. You circumambulated the Holy Shrine and prostrated yourself at the Threshold of the One. This is from the grace of the Lord of creation that you were enabled to achieve this.

Subject: permission for visit; pilgrimage
Quotation: And concerning what you wrote about Haji Ahmad, upon him be Baha, and Haji Ali-'Askar, that whenever the means are available they would proceed with wisdom in the way of trade - permission for this matter is not granted at present. Travel to this land is not permitted at present.

Subject: permission for visit; pilgrimage
Quotation: Thou hadst requested permission by telegraph to attain Our presence. However, as in these days certain souls have arisen in utmost opposition, shouldst thou come, it would only bring thee the greatest sorrow, and thy present grief and suffering would be multiplied a thousandfold.

Subject: permission for visit; pilgrimage
Quotation: Thou didst don the pilgrim's garb for the Ka'bah of thy heart's desire... A barrier arose and events prevented thee, and thou wert commanded to return. Be not disappointed, be not sorrowful, be joyous, for abundant reward is assured and the bounty bestowed upon pilgrims is ordained and destined.

Subject: permission for visit; pilgrimage
Quotation: Concerning what you wrote about Master Husayn Saffar, if he should proceed to the Land of Ta with joy and fragrance, with wisdom, for the purpose of meeting his relatives, there is no objection - indeed it is praiseworthy. God willing, may he be assisted in all matters and act in ways that exalt the Cause.

Subject: permission for visit; pilgrimage
Quotation: if it can be arranged with the utmost joy and fragrance, with means prepared and a companion found, you are permitted to come to the Holy Land and from here travel to Iran, and from Iran to India. However, it must be with complete attention, reliance and detachment, for travel certainly involves many hardships.

Subject: permission for visit; pilgrimage
Quotation: As for what you desired regarding the presence, the servant has presented it. Thus did the tongue of the Beloved speak: "O My servant! Thou knowest My loving-kindness, My love and My tenderness for him, but wisdom hath prevented Me from granting this request in these days, and We have postponed it to another day."

Subject: permission for visit; pilgrimage
Quotation: Know thou with certainty that the longing of 'Abdu'l-Baha exceeds thine own. I ever beseech at the threshold of the Ancient Lord with mighty supplication that He may ordain, in the near future, the contemplation of that beauteous countenance, and that wisdom may accord with permission for attainment unto His presence.

Subject: permission for visit; pilgrimage
Quotation: Thy letter was received and read. Thou hast invited me to America, saying: In that region and that country there are many fragrant and multi-colored flowers; likewise there are thorns and thistles; but Abdul-Baha should not look upon the thistles of the desert. He must hasten to that country for the sake of the flowers.

Subject: permission for visit; pilgrimage
Quotation: We have accepted thy deed in the path of God...Although those souls who turned toward the Most Holy Court without permission attained the presence, yet the Supreme Pen hath paused in their mention. We have pardoned them as a bounty from Us...And hereafter whosoever shall turn without permission, verily he is of the heedless.

Subject: permission for visit; pilgrimage
Quotation: As for visiting the Blessed Threshold, your presence is now needed in those parts. You must think about spreading the divine fragrances. Today this is the greatest of all matters and the most perfect of deeds. God willing, permission will be granted at its proper time. Therefore be patient, for God is with those who are patient.

Subject: permission for visit; pilgrimage
Quotation: For this reason We have not given and do not give permission save to a few souls, and this too for the sake of wisdom. God willing, thou shalt be assisted and with these hosts thou shalt conquer the cities of hearts. Whenever wisdom requireth, We shall summon thee; otherwise, We beseech God to bestow upon thee the reward of pilgrimage.

Subject: permission for visit; pilgrimage
Quotation: Buyuk Aqa Ahmadzadih has permission to circumambulate the gathering place of the Supreme Concourse...Regarding permission for general visitation that you had written about - each soul should, as before, come with permission and, having donned the pilgrim's garb of the Ka'bah of the intended goal, attain the blessing of visiting the Holy Threshold.

Subject: permission for visit; pilgrimage
Quotation: Although in thy journey thou didst intend to attain the presence of the Holy Land, if obstacles prevented thee, it mattereth not. Since thy intention was sincere, it hath been accepted, and in the Concourse on High thou art mentioned as a pilgrim and known by this distinguished attribute. The essential thing is acceptance, and the attainment of the purpose.

Subject: permission for visit; pilgrimage

Subject: personal instructions
Quotation: If the destination be European lands, he dwelt there for a time, yet each day yearned for Iran and complained of poverty and hardship in Europe. Now it is the same; therefore he must persist in some profession or occupation and become a source of comfort and tranquility for his kind father.

Subject: personal instructions
Quotation: Concerning thy mention of the daughter of Zayn and those related to her - each one hath attained unto the tokens of the Most Exalted Pen. Give them the glad-tidings of God's favors, the Lord of all worlds, and remind them of His verses, and illumine them with the lights of His wondrous utterance.

Subject: personal instructions
Quotation: Regarding divination, it was clearly stated that if the benefits and advantages or disadvantages of an important matter are not obvious and evident and you have doubts, in such cases divination is permissible for you alone, but not permissible in ordinary matters. Now you must proceed accordingly.

Subject: personal instructions
Quotation: Should he speak again, arise to respond through the power of thy Lord, that there may appear from thee that which will give assurance that thou art upon a straight path. After responding, it is necessary to avoid him. Do not attribute this to us - speak from yourself and do not mention anyone's name.

Subject: personal instructions
Quotation: If they decide to perform surgery on the eyes of His Holiness Afnan, proceed with it, but prepare a suitable place and we will send his mother and sister and Aqa Siyyid Ahmad. After that the operation can be performed. At minimum, his sister and Aqa Siyyid Ahmad or Aqa Siyyid Muhsin should be present.

Subject: personal instructions
Quotation: O Shamsiyyih, daughter of My brother! Hearken thou unto the Call from the direction of the mercy of thy Lord, the Most Exalted, the All-Glorious. Verily, there is none other God but Him, the Mighty, the Powerful. Remember thou thy Lord, then prostrate thyself before His Face, the Mighty, the Beautiful

Subject: personal instructions
Quotation: O Nabil!  Know, verily, that among the froword are those who claim that these verses were not revealed according to true faith. Say: woe betide you and that which flows from your tongues. By God! The true faith of God, the All-Powerful, the Almighty, the All-Subduing, hath appeared through these verses.

Subject: personal instructions
Quotation: O thou who bearest the same name as this servant! My firm hope is that thou wilt arise to fulfill the meaning of this name and show forth the courage, might and majesty of a lion - that is to say, that thou wilt gallop forth in the field of divine knowledge and, through the power of proof, capture souls.

Subject: personal instructions
Quotation: Regarding the travelers, they were not authorized to remain in that land, for if outsiders were to gather in that land it would give rise to certain matters. Two persons were granted permission to stay, and afterward Nabil-i-Qabli-'Ali as well. Let them keep the books preserved until the matter is settled.

Subject: personal instructions
Quotation: Your honor must go temporarily to Tehran regarding the purchased land where someone has claimed a conditional sale. Some of the notables and trustees are seeking information, so you should also meet with them, as this work can be accomplished by you. After completing these matters, you will return to Baku.

Subject: personal instructions
Quotation: O Munir! I swear by thy soul and by the Beloved that I do not have even a moment's leisure, nor time to write a single line. In brief, for three months I have wished to go to the bath, though it is obligatory, yet I have found no opportunity. Nevertheless, I have written in utmost haste the letters you requested.

Subject: personal instructions
Quotation: O son of Abhar! Make mention of Husayn on behalf of the Wronged One and give him the glad-tidings of the favor of the Truth, the Knower of things unseen. Say: O Husayn! Hold fast unto the cord of wisdom and speak forth with utterance, lest the clamor of them who have denied both the seen and the unseen be raised.

Subject: personal instructions
Quotation: O faithful servant of the Ancient Beauty! At this moment you are mentioned in the presence of 'Abdu'l-Baha and remembered with love in the gathering of friends. Your remembrance, like the morning breeze, brings refreshment to hearts, and mention of you is the cause of spirit and fragrance to the loved ones of God.

Subject: personal instructions
Quotation: Therefore, strive ye as much as ye can to seek this holy divine loftiness and search for this universal divine power and ask for this penetrating heavenly sword, so that ye may advance in all the degrees of existence and be confirmed in the characteristics of the All-Merciful and the emanations of the All-Glorious.

Subject: personal instructions
Quotation: And if thou enterest the City of God, inform My handmaidens of My tribulation and affliction, and walk in complete sanctification, and be not heedless of the wonders of My remembrance. O My handmaiden! Be not neglectful of service to the House of God and of visiting it, and be not veiled from the Beloved of the worlds.

Subject: personal instructions
Quotation: O My handmaiden! Give thanks for having heard the Call of God and turned unto Him when every heedless doubter turned away. He maketh mention of them that have turned unto Him and aideth them through the hosts of the heavens and of the earth. Make thou mention of thy Lord in the night season and in the days with this Name

Subject: personal instructions
Quotation: The Master said that he was sorry not to have seen us more, but that he had been very busy while we were there. But, he continued, it is not the length of time that one spends here that is important. Some people stay a short time, and then go and do great service. Other people are here a long time, and they learn nothing.

Subject: personal instructions
Quotation: Be thou vocal in His praise, steadfast in His Cause, holding fast unto His cord, and arising to serve His Cause, the Mighty, the Decreed... Convey My greetings unto thy mother and thy brother and thy sisters, and remind them of God's verses, and give them the glad-tidings of His grace, and illumine their hearts with His knowledge.

Subject: personal instructions
Quotation: If he were now to turn his attention to certain cities in Iran where this Cause is unknown, this would be closer to righteousness and shall remain so, for in these parts teaching has been entirely forbidden, and after the flames of sedition were kindled and conflict appeared, the people of these regions have become afflicted and scattered.

Subject: personal instructions
Quotation: O Muhammad! Ismi Mahdi in his letter sent to this Servant mentioned thee, and likewise made mention of the friends in that land. God willing, mayest thou ever be blessed with divine favors and remain turned toward the highest horizon, for should man show the slightest negligence, the smoke of the imaginings of the veiled ones will deprive him.

Subject: personal instructions
Quotation: O My handmaiden! Rejoice thou in that thou hast been mentioned before the Throne and that this wondrous Tablet hath been revealed for thee. By God! Nothing that hath been created on earth can compare with it. Blessed is the one who hast attained unto this mighty bounty. Remember thou thy Lord at all times. Thus doth thy Ancient Master command thee.

Subject: personal instructions
Quotation: Yesterday when the friends departed, I was in the bath and it was not possible to send a reply. Now that it is possible, I write. Several days ago we were going to come to Haifa but legal and religious impediments presented themselves. However, it is not known whether these excuses will be accepted or not. God willing, we will come but know not when.

Subject: personal instructions
Quotation: Regarding Aqa Muhammad-Rahim, upon him be the Glory of God, permission hath been granted, but his journey dependeth upon his own desire. As for thy temporary stay in that land, permission hath also been granted, but thou must observe wisdom. Aqa Muhammad-'Ali, upon him be the Glory of God, also hath permission to set out, that is, to make the journey.

Subject: personal instructions
Quotation: Please write about any news or events that arrive from anywhere, or like the late Aqa Siyyid Taqi, write a brief summary of that news on the back of the same letter and send it...Letters arrive and remain with you for several days. Among them, Mirza Jalal had sent a letter, but after he himself arrived, his letter reached us. Please be attentive in this matter.

Subject: personal instructions
Quotation: Through the grace of the true Confirmer and spiritual Helper, it is hoped that you will ever set the friends of God in a state of enthusiasm and eager longing, and not allow them to become quenched. Concerning what you wrote about the honored Khadim, no one hath the right to speak ought concerning him, and all must be enkindled with the fire of the love of God.

Subject: personal instructions
Quotation: O Shah Khalil! The Wronged One hath turned toward thee from His Most Great Prison and hath mentioned thee in such wise as nothing on earth can equal. Take hold of God's Book with the power bestowed by Him, detached from those who have mounted the steed of passion and committed that which hath caused the Pen of Baha to lament in this glorious and wondrous station.

Subject: personal instructions
Quotation: You must seek My good-pleasure rather than your own. Whatever you are commanded to do, you must know that your welfare lies therein and promptly obey. Time and again it was written that you must study the science of medicine with perfect steadfastness. Strive day and night to become a skilled physician. Again I say, you must absolutely show no laxity in this matter.

Subject: personal instructions
Quotation: Furthermore, his honor Diya and Badi', together with his honor Haji and Aqa Muhammad and others should proceed one hour before sunset, and after meeting either return or remain. The purpose is that one of the Branches should be with them. Otherwise, proceed as deemed advisable. Should his honor Nazir be present it would be most excellent. All should proceed mounted.

Subject: personal instructions
Quotation: O servant! Thou art favored by the grace of God and art mentioned in His presence. Mention by the Supreme Pen is among the great, pure, enduring, and special divine bounties for the servants. Whosoever attaineth unto it hath attained unto all good. However, the measure of success and prosperity hath ever been deeds performed in accordance with the commandments of God.

Subject: personal instructions
Quotation: At present what is advisable is that the sum you received from the House to give to the money-changer - if you have given it, take it back, and if you have not given it, do not give it, for perhaps again some people will intervene and create confusion as happened in Istanbul where everything was lost. In this case it is better that the money-changer remain a creditor.

Subject: personal instructions
Quotation: Be kind on my behalf to Badieh and Badi'u'llah, cherish Munirih and Inayatu'llah and Fadlu'llah, and convey my most glorious and most resplendent greetings to their mother, the handmaiden of God Zahra Sultan. I remember Mr. Muhammad Husayn and Shawkat and Nayyirih and Nuriyyih, all with most glorious remembrances. Upon you and upon them all, men and women, be the Glory.

Subject: personal instructions
Quotation: O Mahdi! Remember those whom We have mentioned by name in the Tablet and those whom We have not mentioned, that Our favor may be complete unto them that have recognized the unity of God. Then gladden him who is named Muhammad from Nayriz, and bestow upon him that which hath proceeded from the Spirit of the All-Merciful, which hath appeared from this perfumed and beauteous Mouth.

Subject: personal instructions
Quotation: Two envelopes from before and after, the first dated the first of Dhi'l-Hijjih and the second the 13th of Muharram, arrived but no response was sent due to the press of duties. By the truth of Truth, matters have reached such a state that there is absolutely no time, neither by night nor by day. Therefore, if there has been or will be delay in responding, we hope for forgiveness.

Subject: personal instructions
Quotation: O Jamal! Thou hast spoken a mighty word. The matter of Hadba occurred by choice, for in the Tablet there was and is no explicit command to proceed to that land. Read thou the Tablet that thou mayest know and be of them that bear witness. This matter was contingent upon your desire, and the purpose was that you might rest for a while and the clamor of the hypocrites might subside.

Subject: personal instructions
Quotation: Regarding your personal affairs about which you wrote: Until now 'Abdu'l-Baha has never imposed and will never impose anything upon any of the western friends. I hope that without any imposition from this servant, some blessed souls will arrange means for your assistance in that land next year, and indication will be given that some should voluntarily provide you temporary assistance.

Subject: personal instructions
Quotation: Concerning the trees about which thou didst write: this servant alone hath neither time nor opportunity for planting trees. Indeed, were I to borrow the angels nearest to God from the Lord of all worlds, I would still not have time for such tasks. Therefore I thank thee for having taken the trouble and shown kindness in sending the trees. In brief, this year what thou hast sent sufficeth.

Subject: personal instructions
Quotation: O Mahdi! We have guided thee to the Path and made known to thee the Proof and cast upon thee My Word through which all things have spoken: "The Kingdom is God's, the All-Knowing, the All-Informed." Let not the affairs of the world sadden thee, nor what the oppressors have wrought in the kingdom of creation. Arise to serve the Cause in the name of thy Lord, the All-Conquering, the Almighty.

Subject: personal instructions
Quotation: Though separation hath been prolonged, if the weather proveth favorable and thou wishest to tarry a few days more, there is no harm. However, that house is in no way suitable, for it is entirely exposed, and there are many undesirable persons in Haifa. Each day false rumors circulate among the people. The house of Husayn Effendi is more secure; it would be better if thou wert to dwell there.

Subject: personal instructions
Quotation: O Siyyid Mahdi, hearken to the call of the Wronged One from the direction of the Lesser Prison. He wishes to make mention of thee with a mention that shall endure as long as His most beautiful names and most exalted attributes endure. Blessed is he who has found the fragrance of utterance, detached from all else save God, and has held fast to the cord of God's command, the Lord of all worlds.

Subject: personal instructions
Quotation: O Mahdi! The Lord of inner meanings maketh mention of thee with a remembrance whereby the fragrance of utterance hath been diffused throughout all creation. Give thanks unto thy Lord for this great favor. Beware lest the affairs of the world withhold thee from the Lord of Eternity. Cast away what the people possess and take what thou hast been bidden by thy Lord, the Commander, the Ancient of Days.

Subject: personal instructions
Quotation: How long wilt Thou leave me in this state of abject lowliness and burning with the fire of separation from Thee, and yet Thou ordainest for those that are near to Thee to ascend to the Highest Summit. My body is melting away and my hair is white and I have grown old. I have no strength to arise and serve Thy loved ones--Thy loved ones whom Thou hast chosen to raise Thy word and spread Thy fragrances.

Subject: personal instructions
Quotation: O `Abdu'l-Husayn! How blessed is thy name and how auspicious is thy smile! Thou art my namesake - thou art `Abdu'l-Husayn and I am `Abdu'l-Baha. These two names are in truth one name and title. Thus we share a name in common, and God willing, we shall also share in attainment - that is to say, through the aid and favor of the Desired One, we shall both succeed in servitude and bondage at His sacred Threshold.

Subject: personal instructions
Quotation: Follow the course of your journey towards the north, and visit on your way Isfahan, Kashan, Qum, and Tihran. Beseech almighty Providence that He may graciously enable you to attain, in that capital, the seat of true sovereignty, and to enter the mansion of the Beloved. From Tihran proceed to Khurasan, and there proclaim anew the Call. From thence return to Najaf and Karbila, and there await the summons of your Lord.

Subject: personal instructions
Quotation: Your going with him, given your impoverishment, would cause difficulties, for this person can host you for but a few days at most. First, you would be kept from your work here - this is the first harm. Second, you would face other expenses, such as travel costs and obligations to poor Iranians in Damascus, as well as numerous requests for letters from the people of Damascus without any benefit or advantage therefrom.

Subject: personal instructions
Quotation: Work and craft are considered as worship. May all be aided to achieve that which is beloved. The Command is in the hands of God, the Powerful, the All-Knowing, the All-Informed. All friends must hold fast unto wisdom and deviate not from it by less than an atom's weight. This is the Day of tranquility and reformation. Whatsoever causeth agitation or tumult hath not been and is not of God - sufficient is God as a witness.

Subject: personal instructions
Quotation: O thou who art attracted by the fragrances of the Love of God! Free thyself, in whatever way thou canst, from Miss Rogers, for association with her will cast thee into trials. Come to Haifa. Go directly to the Household, or to Mirza 'Inayat'u'llah's house, and conceal thyself from Miss Rogers. She must not know at all, for if she learns of it she too will come. Depart suddenly from Beirut and say thou art going to Egypt.

Subject: personal instructions
Quotation: His honor Nabil, son of Nabil, upon him be My Baha and glory, has been and is in the Most Exalted Prison with the permission, leave and good-pleasure of this Wronged One. However, if his honor Afnan, upon him be My Baha and loving-kindness, should send someone to that place for the conduct of affairs, so that the aforementioned gentleman might for a few days repair to these parts by way of recreation, this would be pleasing.

Subject: personal instructions
Quotation: Nothing is needed here. Praise be to God, through the grace and favor of the Blessed Beauty all is well. Send a mosquito net and those yellow shoes. No attendant is needed at all, at all. Indeed, if someone were to come it would cause much trouble, for at present no one has any expectations of us. I have no difficulty at all, but if there were an attendant, then people would expect certain formalities and this would cause trouble.

Subject: personal instructions
Quotation: Then remember on Our behalf Abdullah Baqir and protect him in truth. God shall soon grant him that which shall gladden his heart, for verily He is the Powerful, the Mighty. Then remember thy wife with the most excellent remembrance and glorify her countenance, and likewise the wife of thy brother who is named Hassan. Give them both glad tidings of a mighty paradise. And she whom God hath made thy sister - let her be of the devout ones.

Subject: personal instructions
Quotation: O 'A.B., upon him be the Glory of God! God is Most Glorious! My Most Exalted Pen hath testified to thy turning unto God, the Most High, the Most Exalted. This is a testimony that cannot be equaled by the treasures of the world nor by whatsoever the peoples possess. That which hath been ordained for thee by God, the Lord of the worlds, shall erelong be sent down. Rejoice thou in this bounty, then render thanks unto thy Lord, the All-Bountiful.

Subject: personal instructions
Quotation: O Haydar-i-Qabli-'Ali! Upon thee be My glory and loving-kindness. Deliver unto him whatsoever hath specifically been revealed for the Mentioned Name from the Most Exalted Pen, and pray for him. Seek for him divine success and confirmation. Let him not be saddened, but rather act as behooveth him. To journey in this direction is forbidden at this time, for some upheaval hath occurred therein. Outwardly it is calm, but inwardly it is in turmoil.

Subject: personal instructions
Quotation: Consider from the first day when We wrote concerning thee "Fear God, thy Lord" until now - forty months have passed. If thou hadst shown true love and had truly feared God, by Him Who holdeth my soul in His hand, not even a mustard seed's weight would have been diminished from thy glory. So hold! Hold thy hand! Dost thou seize people's wealth unjustly and spend it as thy heedless soul desires, supposing God will not question thee concerning it?

Subject: personal instructions
Quotation: O friends of God! Say: Do not multiply your devotions by day and by night, nor that which ye recite. For if ye refine your deeds, it will draw you nearer unto God, your Lord. This is of God's grace and mercy, that ye may be thankful. And God sets forth parables unto you that ye may understand. If ye grow weary reciting a verse from the Book of God an hundred times when ye read it, then reduce it by ten and by ten until there remain but nineteen.

Subject: personal instructions
Quotation: From the letter which thou didst write, it becometh evident that thou art compelled to tarry for some days in Beirut, whereas swift movement toward Azerbaijan is necessary, as the winds of instability are surging. However, the matter of the teeth must be completed so that there will not be need for repair again afterwards. In any case, strive to complete the work in Beirut. If another skilled physician can be found, well and good; otherwise be patient.

Subject: personal instructions
Quotation: O My name, the A?daq! Render thanks unto God that We called thee to appear before the Seat of Glory, to hear Us and to witness the Light of the Countenance of thy Lord, the Exalted, the Mighty, the Single, the Supreme; and We sent thee back to inform the people of what thou hast seen and understood, and to call them to the utmost constancy, lest their steps falter at the clamour of any corrupt pretender. O My name! Recall every day Our counsel to thee in Our Presence.

Subject: personal instructions
Quotation: Your separation has deeply affected us and day by day our longing increases. However, one must obey the command of God and submit to medical opinion. Thus your journey was undertaken in obedience to God's command and not for the sake of healing, since healing is in the hand of God, not in the hand of doctors. In any case, I hope through the bounty of the Ancient Beauty that you will return in perfect tranquility and joy after receiving the doctors' approval and treatment.

Subject: personal instructions
Quotation: Put not on garments that cause grief to any soul, but rather wear such attire as bringeth joy to hearts when they behold it. Let your garments be refined, then grow more refined; let your garments be beautiful, then grow more beautiful. For whoso weareth garments that cause fear in any soul, or walketh upon earth in such manner as to cause apprehension in any soul, or moveth his face or hands in ways that cause fear in any soul - such are among those whom God loveth not to mention.

Subject: personal instructions
Quotation: O Naddaf! Blessed art thou for having turned toward thee from the direction of the Prison Him Who is the Dawning-place of grace and the Rising-point of loving-kindness and favors... O Husayn! The Supreme Pen hath been moved to make mention of thee... O Muhammad-Rida! The Lord of Names Who findeth Himself beneath the talons of hatred through what the hands of the wicked have wrought hath made mention of thee. Thou hast been remembered before the Wronged One and inscribed in the Scriptures and Tablets.

Subject: personal instructions
Quotation: Follow the instructions of the physicians and act accordingly. As to the question of your return to these parts, if you can manage to stay in those regions, surely day by day your future will improve, for in these parts there is absolutely no work available in which you could engage. Praise be to God, you were here and saw for yourself. But your intense longing indicates that you would be content with any condition. However, after being without work here, depression will set in. Therefore, carry out whatever you deem advisable.

Subject: personal instructions
Quotation: Servant in attendance, bring tea for Nabil but bring nothing for Aqa Tahir. After that (Baha'u'llah) asked, Do you drink tea in the morning or not? This servant did not give an answer. Jinab-i Nabil said, Yes. (Baha'u'llah) said, How many cups? He said, Three cups. (Baha'u'llah) said, Do you drink white tea (chay-yi safid) or not? He said, Javanese tea (chay-yi nimsih, a black tea). (Baha'u'llah) said, Do you drink it with bread or on an empty stomach? He said, I always drink it with bread, but Aqa Tahir always drinks it with an empty stomach.

Subject: personal instructions
Quotation: O sacred leaf! I have departed from Port Said to Marseilles, and this is in accordance with consummate wisdom - its secret shall be made manifest later. A box containing cups, saucers, teapots, milk jugs and sugar bowls has been sent for Dr. Fallscheer's office - please deliver it and tell her to write immediately to Miss Stevenson that the person who wishes to meet me in Marseilles should come quickly for the meeting to take place there, as I may travel from there elsewhere - to America or even to South America. Therefore, she should make haste as I am waiting in Marseilles.

Subject: personal instructions
Quotation: O Shafi', protect the party of God and His sheep from the wolves of self and passion belonging to the people of the Bayan, that perchance vain imaginings and idle fancies may not this time seize the servants, that all may be illumined with the light of certitude and assurance and fix their gaze upon the horizon of God alone. Through the power of the Most Great Name, take hold of the reins of souls and adorn all with the ornament of steadfastness in the name of Truth, that the satans and the wayward may witness the lights of steadfastness shining from the brow of each one of the party of God.

Subject: personal instructions
Quotation: Instructions were given to the handmaiden of God, Sakinih Sultan, the widow of the martyr, to convey to thee, and she will do so. Treat Jinab-i-Aqa Mirza Abu'l-Fadl with utmost kindness. Enquire daily about his health. Sometime visit him thyself and ask him how much of the book he hath written and how much of it is left to be done, and let Me know. His health is a very important matter. In this regard, try as much as possible and in whatever way to convince him that someone serve him at all times. Show great kindness to Aqa Muhammad-Taqi and Aqa Ali-Rida, and likewise constantly enquire after Jinab-i-Haji Niyaz. Show such kindness to Jinab-i-Haji that he becomes joyous and completely forgets the thought he had in mind. Give glad tidings to Jinab-i-Aqa Siyyid Taqi that I shall soon summon him. Convey longing greetings to Jinab-i-Haji Siyyid Javad and Jinab-i-Aqa Ahmad. Show much love to Aqa Nuru'llah and his wife. Should the Americans come, show them the utmost kindness. Show much kindness to Muhammad, the son of Aqa Abdu'l-Husayn, as he is an orphan, and likewise to Ahmad, the son of Aqa Muhammad Isma'il.

Subject: petitions to authorities
Quotation: Mirza Abu'l-Qasim, who was a Sufi, wrote to the king, bringing to his attention the fact that the people were innocent and did not deserve to be killed.

Subject: petitions to authorities
Quotation: As for the livelihood of those there, you yourself, either directly or through the government, may write to the Pasha however you deem advisable, explaining that Abdul-Karim has gone for pilgrimage and these ones are left stranded here - what should be done?

Subject: petitions to authorities
Quotation: Do thou have recourse to the government so that preventive measures may be taken; yet not in any adversarial fashion: rather, in a moderate manner state thou that such is contrary to justice and fellowship and love among all the subjects of the respected state.

Subject: petitions to authorities
Quotation: Regarding the assassin of His Majesty the late Shah, His Excellency the Grand Vizier informed all the consuls that after careful investigation and thorough inquiry it was determined that the condemned killer was a republican and materialist who had no connection to others.

Subject: petitions to authorities
Quotation: I immediately wrote a recommendation to the Sacred Person concerning Aqa Mirza Fat?-'Ali Khan. In truth, that wronged one hath been made captive. Though he is imprisoned, yet is he near to the court of the Incomparable Lord. I hope that relief will soon be granted and mercy shown.

Subject: petitions to authorities
Quotation: O Muhammad-Baqir, upon whom be the Glory of God! He is the Witness from His most exalted horizon. This is a Book sent down by the Lord of Names while He was in the hands of enemies who broke God's covenant and testament, denied His proof and evidence, and disbelieved when He came with manifest sovereignty.

Subject: petitions to authorities
Quotation: But Abdu'l-Baha is immersed in an ocean - letters pour like spring rain from East and West, all seeking replies. The mere reading of these letters would require miraculous power, let alone responding to them. Moreover, endless tasks and troubles keep me occupied day and night - I find no rest even upon my pillow.

Subject: petitions to authorities
Quotation: Write this firm and mighty decree, which hath in this moment issued forth from the treasury of the Most Exalted Pen, to the Trustee: O Trustee! Upon thee be My glory! Ponder this matter and give it thy attention. Employ all outward and inward means that perchance this handmaiden of God may be freed and return to her homeland.

Subject: petitions to authorities
Quotation: The government does not approve such gatherings, even though His Majesty Sultan Abdul-Hamid Khan, may the All-Merciful strengthen him, deals with all the people of these realms with joy and fragrance and compassion and care. Justice and fairness are honored and revered before him, and until now he has shown kindness toward this community.

Subject: petitions to authorities
Quotation: "Your Highness. This man who is from the province of _ has dropped dead here. He was a stranger amongst us and I am trying to collect money from these noble citizens for the expenses of his burial." The Minister puts five francs in the palm of the man and passes by. Tomorrow a law was issued that the province of _ is exempt from military conscription.

Subject: petitions to authorities
Quotation: O Lord, aid the throne of the supreme sovereignty with the hosts of the Supreme Concourse, and guard it beneath the shadow of Thy Most Exalted Word with the eye of Thy loving-kindness. Shield it from harmful hands in this earthly life, and assist it with armies from the uttermost horizon. Make the banner of justice wave and the sign of victory manifest therein.

Subject: petitions to authorities
Quotation: Your excellency's letter has been received. It showed great kindness and was productive of the utmost joy and happiness, gladness and delight. It is obvious that, whatever is done by your excellency, it will not be deficient. The purpose of this letter is to show gratitude to your excellency for having shown the greatest kindness and having delivered the petition.

Subject: petitions to authorities
Quotation: Convey expressions of gratitude and thanks on behalf of this supplicant to His Excellency the Great Ambassador, may his glory endure, and state that His Excellency has until now shown kindness to many, both great and small, and has endured many hardships. Yet none have rewarded your efforts and favors as they should have - rather, all have forgotten or concealed them.

Subject: petitions to authorities
Quotation: The petition of these helpless ones before the threshold of the royal court is this...We beseech from the royal favors this request: that Your Majesty would with your illustrious person investigate these recent events, and summon the accused persons before your truth-discerning royal presence, and subject the forged and slanderous documents to thorough investigation and scrutiny.

Subject: petitions to authorities
Quotation: I seek a fragrant breeze for thee and thy companion Mirza Abu'l-Qasim and thy father Aqa Husayn-'Ali and the handmaiden of God thy mother and the faithful brothers and pure-hearted sisters and the soul-stirring friends of Qamsar and the friends of Mazgan. And for the service gathering of Rasht I seek the favors of the Beloved of all horizons, and for Aqa Muhammad Isma'il I wish a spirit like Gabriel.

Subject: petitions to authorities
Quotation: To give a brief account, we resided for six years in Edirne on the orders of the Ottoman government; nothing contrary to the laws (of the state) was ever manifested by me or my followers, as all the people of Edirne bear witness and confess. Nevertheless, three months ago, officials of the Ottoman state suddenly surrounded our house, seized all the belongings of my followers in the bazaar, and took them to the government building. After this, a man came from the governor and informed us that, on the orders of the Sultan, I had to go with (my wives?) and children to Gallipoli. They gave us no further notice than that. All the belongings of my followers were sold for a paltry price at the decree of the military commanders, but they did not even give us an opportunity to collect the money. After this, they brought me to Gallipoli, along with seventy men, women, and small children. Following our arrival, a special official, 'Umar Effendi Binbashi (= bigbashi; major), arrived from Istanbul with five sergeants. They issued a decree to the effect that orders had been given for six individuals to go to Acre (with us?), and for five to go to Cyprus; I had no claim on the rest -- they were to be free to choose for themselves. It afterwards became apparent that he had arranged things, for he took the money for the steamer from everyone and brought all of us to Acre, which has the worst water and the worst air in the world -- except for four individuals, who were taken to a ruined fortress in Cyprus. No sooner had we arrived in Acre than they imprisoned us in a ruined barracks, even the women and six-month old children, and they forthwith shut the doors of entry and exit. We have now been imprisoned in the ruined barracks for fifty days, and, on account of the badness of the water and air, we have all been stricken by serious illnesses, such that, after two days, three people died without a physician or food or medicine. Up until now, we have not learnt the nature of our crime. There has been no enquiry. But neither wrongdoing nor acts contrary to the laws have ever been witnessed from us.... We beseech your excellency to turn your attention towards us, so that the breezes of the grace and bounty of his imperial highness the Sultan may blow upon us. Our fundamental aim is perchance to find shelter from these widespread tribulations in the shade of the protection of the most mighty, great, and noble Emperor, may his exalted shadow endure, and that we may occupy ourselves in prayer for his eternal rule.

Quotation: I wish to say that, although we have never met, I have heard much of your excellency's praiseworthy qualities, that you behaved with kindness towards all the people, especially my followers, when you were in Tehran. I, therefore, considered it necessary to give you a short account of what has taken place, that perhaps through your excellency's attentions some may find peace and dwell in the shade of the protection of the Prince of the Age, the Monarch of the Era, the King of the World, the Most Mighty, Most Noble, and Most Great Emperor.... Since your excellency is informed as to how things are in Iran, I beg of you to present my petition before the throne of the King of the Age, that perchance he may perform an act of grace whereby the hearts of some people may be put at rest, that all may find ease in the cradle of the protection and security of the Monarch of the World and in the shadow of his bounty. The one God is witness that I have not entertained and do not entertain any thought of myself. I am content with whatever has been written down by the supreme pen on the Tablet of Fate. From the first day that I recognized the Truth, I have set aside both life and property. Nay, at every moment I hope and pray that I may offer up my soul as a sacrifice in the path of the Beloved of the worlds. But since a large number of individuals have been oppressed, I have felt it necessary to explain how matters stand. I beg you to let no-one know of this until the purpose of this petition has been achieved.

Make firm their feet that they slip not through the doubts of the people of passion and desire. Verily, Thou dost protect whomsoever Thou willest through Thy power that prevaileth over all things. O my Lord! Draw them nigh through Thy will, then cause them to enter through that gate which Thou hast opened unto the world through Thy Most Great Name. I beseech Thee by the billows of the ocean of Thy knowledge, by the standards which Thou didst raise up by Thy command, and by the signs which were elevated throughout the earth by Thy power and sovereignty, that Thou forgive Thy servants even as Thou didst forgive him who gave up his spirit in Thy path.

O Lord! Separation from Thee hath caused my death, and my liver hath melted from remoteness from the court of Thy nearness. I beseech Thee by the power through which Thou didst transform remoteness into nearness and darkness into light, to ordain for me by Thy Most Exalted Pen that which Thou hast ordained for Thy chosen ones and trusted ones. Then cause me, O my God, to be so set ablaze with the fire of Thy love that Thy servants may be enkindled thereby.

Quotation: The earth has its inhabitants, the water and the air contain many living beings and all the elements have their nature spirits, then how is it possible to conceive that these stupendous stellar bodies are not inhabited? Verily, they are peopled, but let it be known that the dwellers accord with the elements of their respective spheres. These living beings do not have states of consciousness like unto those who live on the surface of this globe: the power of adaptation and environment moulds their bodies and states of consciousness, just as our bodies and minds are suited to our planet....  The components of the sun differ from those of this earth, for there are certain light and life-giving elements radiating from the sun. Exactly the same elements may exist in two bodies, but in varying quantities. For instance, there is fire and air in water, but the alloted measure is small in proportion. They have discovered that there is a great quantity of radium in the sun; the same element is found on the earth, but in a much smaller degree. Beings who inhabit those distant luminous bodies are attuned to the elements that have gone into the composition of their respective spheres.

Quotation: The sovereignty belongs to God, the Mighty, the Loving...Verily He doeth what He willeth and shall not be asked of what He hath willed, while all shall be asked of all things

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: All is in the hands of God, and without Him there can be no health in us! All creatures are dependent upon God, however great may seem their knowledge, power and independence.

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: Glorified be He in Whose grasp lies the Kingdom of the heavens and the earth and whatsoever is between them! Therefore, thou shalt aid God in the True Faith with a mighty aid.

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: Thou doest as Thou pleasest and ordainest what Thou desirest. Thou, verily, art the Almighty, the All-Praised. No God is there save Thee, the All-Glorious, the Most Bountiful.

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: He is the One, the Single, Who hath proclaimed that there is none other God but Him, the All-Knowing, the All-Wise... in Whose grasp lie the kingdoms of the heavens and earth.

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: Verily He is the Almighty, the Exalted, the All-Choosing... Verily, Thou knowest me better than I know myself. Thou knowest what is within me, and I know not what is with Thee.

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: Verily, there is none other God besides Me, the Protector, the Self-Subsisting... His is the creation and the command. He doeth what He willeth and ordaineth what He pleaseth.

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: No command can frustrate Him, nor can the hosts and ranks of kings and sovereigns frighten Him. He hath arisen with such authority that the limbs of the polytheists have quaked.

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: Thou didst ordain the creation of the heavens and earth and whatsoever lieth between them through Thy wisdom, and didst perfect the creation of all things through Thy Lordship.

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: Thus doth the Pen of God, the Originator of creation, command thee. We beseech God to ordain for you that which is best with Him. He, verily, is the Almighty, the All-Choosing.

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: "None knoweth how Thou art save Thyself alone...for none is able to do this besides Thee and none hath power over that save Thee, and verily Thou art the Lord of all the worlds."

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: Glorified art Thou! There is no God but Thee. Nothing can frustrate Thee, whether in the heavens or on earth or between them, and Thou art, of a truth, powerful over all things.

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: Glorified be His dominion and glorified be His proof. There is none other God but Him... Verily He is the Lord of all beings and the Lord of the throne on high and of earth below

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: He is God, exalted be His glory, the Greatness and the Power! ... Verily, He is the One with power over whatsoever He willeth. There is no God but Him, the Mighty, the Bestower.

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: He it is unto Whom boweth down in adoration whatsoever is in the heavens and whatsoever is in the earth, the All-Glorious, the Best-Beloved. Say: All are His submissive servants.

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: He it is Who created the heavens and the earth and whatsoever lieth between them by His command Be! and it is. He it is Who createth what He willeth by His command Be! and it is.

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: He it is Who createth all things by His command, and He is the Creator, the Impregnable. He it is Who originateth what He willeth by His command, and unto Him shall be the return

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: He is the One Who speaks before the faces of the parties. Light belongs to God, glory belongs to God, authority belongs to God, splendor belongs to God, and power belongs to God!

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: He is the One with power over whatsoever He willeth... Verily, He is the Master of creation and the One with power over whatsoever He willeth through His command "Be!" and it is.

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: Thus have We sent down the verses and manifested that which illumineth the hearts of the righteous...He calleth aloud and summoneth all to God, the Self-Sufficient, the Most High.

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: Verily thy Lord is the Almighty, the All-Powerful... Verily thy Lord doeth what He willeth and ordaineth as He desireth. There is no God but Him, the All-Hearing, the All-Seeing.

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: Verily Thou art the Almighty, from Whose knowledge nothing escapeth. Thou doest what Thou willest and ordainest what Thou pleasest. And verily Thou art the Mighty, the Praiseworthy

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: Your Lord is the Lord of the heavens and the Lord of the earth, the Lord of all worlds. God beareth witness that there is none other God but Him. Say: All are prostrate before Him.

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: And God was immensely great, and unto God belongeth sovereignty in the kingdoms of the heavens and of the earth and of whatsoever lieth between them, and God was a mighty sovereign.

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: Glory be unto Thee, O God, in Whose right hand are the reins of all created things, and in Whose grasp is the kingdom of earth and heaven. Within Thy grasp is the kingdom of names.

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: He Who giveth healing is God. All are commanded to seek treatment and follow the physicians' instructions. This is purely in obedience to God's command, otherwise the Healer is God.

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: Thus doth the Prisoner command thee from the direction of His Most Great Scene...by the Most Great Name, at Whose appearance all who are in the heavens and earth were thunderstruck

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: He is the Lord of all worlds. For there existeth not a soul but it knoweth God as its Lord and believeth in its Creator, its Originator, its Fashioner, its Producer and its Causator.

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: He is the Omnipotent One Who in an instant can transform the world's vengeance into blessing and cause oppression to end in justice. He is the Powerful One and He is the Transformer.

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
