Quotation: Blessed is He in Whose hand are the kingdoms of the heavens and the earth and all that lies between them. He createth what He willeth by His command. Verily He is powerful and mighty.

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: He is the One Who has dominion over all names... the Sovereign of the Kingdom of Names... Verily, there is none other God but Him, the Single, the One, the All-Knowing, the All-Wise.

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: In My Name, the One Who Rules over what was and what will be... that there is no God but Him, the Mighty, the All-Bountiful... He is the Powerful over what will be and what hath been.

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: Say: God maketh whatsoever He willeth a name for Himself in the Book. Verily, He hath power over all things. Say: God is the Creator of all things, and He is the Exalted, the Supreme.

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: The All-Merciful has come in the shadows of utterance, and sovereignty belongs to God, the Almighty, the All-Compelling... Sovereignty belongs to God, the Almighty, the All-Choosing.

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: The command is in the hand of God, the Lord of lords...He who is the Unconstrained hath come endowed with a sovereignty that the veils of the people of error can never hope to conceal

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: The Kingdom belongeth unto God, the Lord of all worlds... Not an atom escapeth His knowledge - He heareth and seeth, and He is the Protector of all who are in the heavens and earths.

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: Thou art the One Who exists, Who encompasses all, Who protects, Who is powerful and mighty... Verily He is the One Who has power over whatsoever He willeth. He giveth and withholdeth

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: Thy power hath preserved me from all else but Thee... Thou hast shown me that which was withheld from the world, and caused me to hear that which was heard by the Lord of all peoples

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: Verily Thou art He Whom nothing whatsoever can frustrate and no cause can hinder. Thou doest and commandest as Thou pleasest. Verily Thou art the Ever-Commanding, the Ancient of Days

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: Verily, all horizons have been illumined with the light of His Countenance, and the Peacock of the throne on High cried out "There is no God save Me, the Almighty, the All-Powerful."

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: Verily, He is powerful over all things and worthy to answer. Verily, He is the Powerful, the Generous, the Lord of Great Bounty. There is no God but He, the All-Knowing, the All-Wise.

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: God testifieth that there is none other God but Him. In His grasp is the dominion of the heavens and the earth and whatsoever is between them [repeated throughout text with variations]

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: The Day hath come and the Cause hath appeared, and that which was hidden from eyes hath been revealed...Thus hath the matter been decreed from before God, the Powerful, the Choice One.

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: This is a power from God before which all are powerless. This is a dominion from the Book of God before which all bow down. This is a sovereignty from God before which all are humbled.

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: He is the One Who createth what He willeth by His command... Say: Power belongeth unto God and might is in His hand. He doeth what He willeth and He is the Prevailer over His creation.

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: He is the One Who has power over all things, before and after... He is the Subduer over all things, and He is the King, the All-Possessing. His is the dominion of the heavens and earth

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: I testify to Thy oneness and Thy singleness, and to Thy grandeur and Thy sovereignty, Thy loftiness and Thy power...Thou art, verily, the One Who hath power over whatsoever He willeth.

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: By the one true God, verily, He Who is the Lord of Eternity hath appeared and shone forth above the horizon of creation through the power of His most lofty, His most exalted sovereignty.

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: He is the One with power over whatsoever He willeth, in His Name, the All-Encompassing over all names! Verily, Thou art the All-Powerful, the Most Exalted, the All-Knowing, the All-Wise.

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: I bear witness to His power, His might, His dominion, His glory, His grandeur, His majesty, and that He is, verily, the One Who doeth whatsoever He willeth through His word Be and it is.

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: Verily, Thou art powerful over whatsoever Thou willest, and Thou art the All-Compelling, the Self-Subsisting... O Thou in Whose hand is the Kingdom of names and the dominion of eternity

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: "There is none other God but Thee, the Almighty, the Most Exalted, the All-Knowing, the All-Wise... Thou art He in Whose grasp are the reins of the world and the controls of the nations."

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: He is the One Who creates what He wishes by His command, and unto God do all return. To God belongeth whatsoever dwelleth in the night and in the day, and unto God shall all be raised up.

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: He is the One with power Who hath made manifest from a single point the knowledge of what was and what shall be. We beseech God to confirm and assist all. He is the Powerful, the Mighty.

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: Nothing in the heavens or on earth can prevent Thee, nor can anything frustrate Thy power. Therefore cause her to attain, O God, unto the station of Thy good-pleasure and Thy generosity.

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: God is independent of you, and He is God, the All-Encompassing... He is the Ever-Existing Who hath never ceased to be, nor shall there be in His rank anything existing in truth upon truth.

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: Nothing escapeth His knowledge, and nothing among all names can prevent Him from what He willeth. Verily, He is powerful over what He pleaseth, and He is the All-Knowing, the All-Informed.

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: Say: O people! He is the One Who, were He to will to make all who are in the heavens and on earth enduring proofs from His presence, would be able to do so, and this would be easy for Him.

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: Verily Thou art the Almighty Whom the power of the aggressive ones cannot frustrate nor the ascendancy of the polytheists prevent. There is no God but Thee, the All-Knowing, the All-Wise.

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: Verily, We abase whom We will and We exalt whom We will unto the Dayspring of light. Say: The sovereignty on that Day shall be God's, the One, the Almighty, the Mighty, the All-Compelling.

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: Glorified art Thou, O Sovereign of the Kingdom of earth and heaven, and Ruler over kings and subjects!...through which Thy power was revealed, Thy sovereignty exalted, and Thy will enforced

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: Glorified be He in Whose grasp is the kingdom of splendor of the heavens and the earth and whatsoever is between them! Verily shall God on that Day be glorified with a mighty glorification.

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: Neither the power of the world nor the might of nations hath deterred Us. We have arisen, without veil or covering, and spoken that which hath caused the limbs of the polytheists to quake.

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: The Cause is in the hands of God, the Lord of the Day of Resurrection. Nothing whatsoever escapeth His knowledge. He heareth and seeth, and He is the Mighty, the Glorious, the Best-Beloved

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: Glorified be He in Whose grasp is the Kingdom of dominion of the heavens... Glorified be He in Whose grasp lies the Kingdom of the heavens and of the earth and of whatsoever is between them.

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: Glorified be He in Whose grasp lie the kingdoms of the lights of the heavens and the earth and whatsoever is between them. Therefore, glorify God in the True Faith with mighty glorification.

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: He, verily, is the Powerful, the Commander, the All-Informed... Verily, He sees whosoever turns to Him and hears the call of those who have directed themselves to the Dayspring of His Cause

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: Thou hast summoned kings and subjects, divines and princes to the Most Exalted Horizon with an authority that the hosts of the earth and the ranks of kings and sovereigns could not prevent.

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: All life is of Thee, and all power lieth within the grasp of Thine omnipotence. It is Thine to command, and all sovereignty belongeth to Thee, and the realm of might boweth before Thy behest.

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: He is, verily, the Ruler over what He willeth. The heavens may vanish at thy Lord's behest, but that which hath been revealed for thee by the Pen of the Ancient of Days shall never pass away.

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: We are powerless - Thou art the Powerful One. We are without head or refuge - Thou art the Kind One. Thou art the All-Seeing and the All-Powerful, and Thou art the Bestower and the All-Hearing

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: And God has full power over His affairs, but most men know not. God, besides Whom there is no other God, knows the unseen in the heavens and earth, and He is the One Who encompasses all things.

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: He is the Powerful, He is the Mighty. As to thy mention of H and S Kh, may God assist him - today every possessor of justice and fairness beareth witness that this Cause moveth above the world.

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: Such is the decree of our Lord, the Mighty, the All-Knowing. [...] As He, the Beloved One, hath said: He may cause it to grow or burn it. The command is in His hand and within His mighty grasp.

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: For none but Thee can do this, and Thy command is closer than saying to a thing "Be" and it is. For Thou knowest what is in the heavens and what is on earth, and Thou hast power over all things

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: O God of the unseen and the seen, and Educator of existence! Thou art He Who hath ever been powerful over whatsoever Thou willest. There is no God but Thee, the Single, the One, the All-Knowing.

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: Thy Lord, verily, is the Ruler over whatsoever He willeth... All affairs are in the grasp of thy Lord's power - He turneth them as He pleaseth. He, verily, is the Powerful, the Mighty, the Wise.

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: He doeth whatsoever He willeth and within His grasp lies the kingdom of creation. He giveth life and causeth death, He taketh and He giveth, and He is the Almighty, the Exalted, the All-Choosing.

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: He hath appeared with a sovereignty that neither the hosts of the world nor the clamor of nations can withhold. He speaketh at all times: "The Kingdom belongeth unto God, the Lord of all worlds."

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: He is the One Who gazeth from His most exalted horizon... there is none other God but I, the All-Compelling, the Self-Subsisting... Verily thy Lord is the Almighty over what was and what shall be

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: He is the One Who has dominion over all who are on earth and in heaven... The Kingdom belongs to God, the All-Knowing, the All-Informed... Victory and triumph belong to God, the Mighty, the Wise.

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: By Thy might! ... Verily Thou art the All-Powerful, the All-Choosing. There is no God but Thee, the Almighty, the Sovereign, the All-Compelling, the Omnipotent, the All-Powerful, the All-Subduing.

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: Glorified be He in Whose grasp are the kingdoms of sovereignty of the heavens and the earth and what lieth between them. Thou shalt indeed glorify God in the True Faith with a mighty glorification.

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: He is the One Who createth whatsoever He willeth through His command Be, and it is! He is the Fashioner of the heavens and the earth and whatsoever lieth between them, the Mighty, the Well-Beloved.

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: He to Whom belongeth the mystery of the heavens and earth, and He is the Truth that encompasseth all creation. And verily God, from behind all things, doth in truth encompass all things with truth.

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: He Who dominates all names! He makes mention of him who makes mention of Him, and desires him who desires Him, as a token of His grace. There is none other God but He, the Mighty, the All-Knowing.

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: Say: By God the Truth, that Tree is not in a station that ye are able to cover it even if there were to gather with you the hands of the people of the heavens with mighty power and great strength.

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: Verily thy Lord is the Powerful, the Mighty... Nothing whatsoever escapeth Thy knowledge. Thou doest what Thou willest and ordainest what Thou desirest. Verily Thou art the Almighty, the Powerful.

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: Glorified be He in Whose grasp is the Kingdom of power of the heavens and the earth and whatsoever is between them. Therefore, glorify ye God on that Day in the True Faith with mighty glorification.

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: Say: By God! Were all who dwell in the heavens and earth to unite against Me to inflict harm, I would still stand forth before their faces and proclaim that this is indeed the Beloved of all worlds.

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: Verily all bounty is in the grasp of thy Lord's power - to this testifies every insightful mystic. He sendeth down what He willeth to whom He willeth - there is no God but He, the Mighty, the Wise.

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: O Peerless Beloved! You are powerful and seeing. You can give a particle the power of the sun and bestow ocean's bounty upon a drop. You can make a fly an eagle and grant a gnat the might of Solomon.

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: Glorified be He in Whose grasp lies the kingdom of dominion of the heavens and the earth and whatsoever is between them. Therefore, on that Day, praise ye God with exalted praise in the true religion.

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: He createth whatsoever He willeth through His command, and unto Him shall all return. He it is Who ordaineth the measure of all things in the Book, and there is no God but Him, the Lord of all worlds.

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: I testify that Thou art the Omnipotent over whatsoever Thou willest, and in Thy grasp is the key of heaven. Thou withholdest and Thou givest, and verily Thou art the All-Bountiful, the Most Generous.

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: Thus hath the land of tyranny cast forth its burdens even as the land of power hath made manifest its sovereign...The City of Immortality hath been built by the sovereignty of thy Lord, the Most High.

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: Verily Thou art the Almighty Whom nothing whatsoever in the earth can frustrate, and Thou art the Ruler Who doeth as He pleaseth, through Thy Name, the All-Subduing, the Sovereign over all the worlds.

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: Dominion belongeth unto God, the Almighty, the All-Glorious, the All-Powerful, the Most Holy... He is the Subduer over all things... He it is in Whose hand is the kingdom of the divinity of all things

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: Verily He hath power over all things. And God shall purify the horizons of the earth by similar means, even as He hath purified the earth of souls by His command. Verily, He hath power over all things.

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: Who through His conquering power adorned the world from sheer nothingness with the ornament of existence... Verily He is powerful over whatsoever He willeth and in His grasp is the reins of all things

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: My sovereignty encompasses those in the heavens and on earth... Thus doth counsel thee He Who hath spoken in every matter, that there is none other God but I, the Commander, the Almighty, the Powerful.

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: The Day is His Day and the Kingdom of might is under His command...Verily Thou art the One with power over whatsoever Thou willest, through Thy Name, the All-Compelling over what was and what shall be.

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: He is the One Who createth what He willeth by His command, and unto God shall all return. He is the One before Whom prostrate all who are in the heavens and who are on earth, and unto Him shall all turn.

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: None can escape from the dominion of His sovereign renown, whether in the heavens or on the earth or between them. He createth whatsoever He willeth by His command. Verily, He hath power over all things.

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: "Verily Thou art powerful over whatsoever Thou willest, and within Thy grasp are the reins of all who are in the heavens and on earth" "I am the Powerful over what I will, and I am the Ancient Commander"

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: Glorified art Thou, O Thou in Whose hand is the dominion of all created things and in Whose grasp are the reins of all existence...Within Thy grasp is the kingdom of the dominion of the heavens and earth

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: Glorified be He Who createth whatsoever He willeth through His command Be, and it is! Glorified be He before Whom bow down in adoration all who are in the heavens and on earth, and unto Him do all return.

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: He is the One Who originateth whatsoever He willeth through His command Be, and it is. He is the Creator of the heavens and of the earth and of whatsoever lieth between them, the Mighty, the Well-Beloved.

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: He is the Truth, there is no God but Him. He giveth life and causeth death. His is the creation and the command, and unto Him shall all return. He it is Who createth by His word the Paradise and the Fire.

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: He ordaineth in His dominion whatsoever He willeth. He is, in truth, the All-Powerful, the All-Knowing. Verily, bounty is in His hand - He giveth and withholdeth. He, verily, is powerful over all things.

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: Glorified be He in Whose grasp lies the Kingdom of the ruby essences of the heavens and earth and whatsoever is between them... [repeating pattern through multiple verses listing different divine kingdoms]

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: I beseech Thee by the lights of Thy countenance to open before their faces the doors of Thy glory and bounty. Verily, Thou art the Almighty, before Whose power the power of all things hath proven powerless.

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: This is a Tablet which God hath made the bearer of His verses and the Dawning-Place of His grace, the Mighty, the Wondrous... Verily, Thou art the Almighty, the Protector of all in the heavens and on earth.

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: Thus has the Divine Lote-Tree spoken forth in His mighty prison. We have revealed for thee this Tablet, each letter of whose words testifieth that there is none other God but Me, the Speaker, the All-Wise.

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: He doeth what He willeth and ordaineth what He pleaseth. He is the Mighty, the All-Choosing. Can leaves remain still when winds blow? Can anyone have choice in the face of God's Will, the Lord of all men?

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: Say: What you possess cannot overcome Him, nor can the might of the transgressors weaken Him. Were He to wish, He would destroy whoever is on earth with a word from Him, for He has power over all the worlds.

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: Thine is sovereignty; in Thy hand are the Kingdoms of Creation and Revelation; in Thy right hand Thou holdest all created things... Thou art the Sovereign Ruler, the Mighty Doer, the Exalted, the All-Loving.

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: "There is no God but I, Who created all contingent things from nothing through My Will, and brought all beings into existence from naught through My Purpose. I am the One with power over whatsoever I desire"

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: God shall soon open it in truth. He is verily the Powerful, the Mighty. Verily Thou art the Ruler over whatsoever Thou willest. There is none other God but Thee, the Possessor of Names and Creator of heaven.

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: He is God, exalted be His station, the Grandeur and the Power! He was from eternity in the heights of might and majesty, and unto eternity shall continue to be in the heaven of glory, power and magnificence.

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: He is the One Who createth what He willeth by His command, and unto Him is the final return. This is God your Lord - His is the creation and the command. There is no God but He, the Most High, the Most Great.

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: He, verily, is the Almighty, the All-Powerful. The idolaters desired to extinguish the light of God through their vain imaginings. God drove them away through His command and made them to be among the losers.

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: Were I not beholding Thee, I would have destroyed the wicked ones and delivered My chosen ones from the fiery letters. Had not My mercy preceded all things, I would have returned existence unto non-existence

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: He is God, exalted be His station, the All-Wise, the Lord of Utterance... Verily, He is the Lord of all creation. He doeth what He willeth. There is none other God but Him, the All-Hearing, the All-Responding.

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: The Command is from the Mighty One, the remembrance of God, at a time when the breezes of separation blow upon all who are in the heavens and earths. Verily it is a revelation from God, the Lord of the worlds.

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: Glorified be He in Whose grasp is the Kingdom of the lights of the heavens and the earth and whatsoever lieth between them. Therefore glorify ye God on that Day in the true religion with a mighty glorification.

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: He is the One manifest from His most exalted horizon. Exalted be His majesty, all-pervading His bounty, and great His power! ... God doth as He willeth and ordaineth as He pleaseth. With Him is the Mother Book.

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: This is the Day whereon the Tongue of God, the King, the Most High, the Most Exalted, hath spoken from the Kingdom of eternity: "The Kingdom belongeth unto God, the Almighty, the Most High, the Most Glorious!"

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: Verily He is the Mighty, the Beloved. He is the One Who createth whatsoever He willeth by His command Be, and it is. Such is God, your Lord. His is the creation and the command. There is none other God but Him.

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: Verily Thou art the Almighty Whom the might of the world and the power of the nations cannot withhold. Thou doest what Thou willest and ordainest what Thou pleasest. Verily Thou art the Mighty, the All-Praised.

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: He is the One Who created you by His command, and unto Him shall all return. He is the One before Whom prostrate all who are in the heavens and the earth and whatsoever is between them, and unto God do all turn.

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: Say: All affairs are in the grasp of God, the Supreme, the Powerful. Say: God is the Powerful, the Triumphant, from Whose knowledge nothing escapes and Whom nothing can frustrate, and He encompasses all things.

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: For He is the One Who created you before and desires to create you again through His Word, just as He created you before through His Word. Indeed His Word is truth, through which He creates whatsoever He willeth.

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: He, verily, is the One Who hath power over whatsoever He willeth through His word "Be" and it is... Thou doest what Thou willest and ordainest what Thou pleasest. Thou art, verily, the All-Powerful, the Almighty

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: Soon wilt Thou raise up those who have fallen in Thy love, and exalt those who have been abased in Thy path, and illumine the faces of those who have been disfigured by the blows of the polytheists for Thy Cause

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: Within His grasp lie the dominion of Command and Creation, and the Kingdom of the heavens and earth... None can withhold His sovereignty. He doeth what He pleaseth through His word and ordaineth what He desireth.

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: Praise be to God Who hath caused us to know the unity of His Essence and the sanctification of His Being from creation and whatsoever pertaineth unto it... He is the All-Powerful, the Supreme, the Self-Subsisting

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: Say: Verily, the Kingdom on that Day shall belong to God, the One, the Helper, the Lord of the heavens and the Lord of the earth and the Lord of all that is between them, the Mighty, the Most Great, the Compeller.

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: Soon shall the hand of power roll up the carpet of the wicked... Verily, Thou art powerful over whatsoever Thou willest. There is no God but Thee, the Single, the One, the Powerful, the All-Knowing, the All-Wise.

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: Thou art in truth potent over all things... Thou art the All-Possessing, the Most High... Thou art in truth the Supreme Ruler, the Help in Peril, the Most High, the Incomparable, the Omnipotent, the All-Powerful.

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: Be not grieved by this prevention, for His Will is supreme and His Purpose prevailing...Verily Thou art the Almighty Whom the circumstances of creation cannot frustrate, nor can the hosts of the oppressors prevent.

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: God testifieth that there is none other God but Him. Within His grasp is the dominion of sovereignty in the heavens and the earth and whatsoever is between them, and God is possessed of mighty and true sovereignty.

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: Praise be to God, the Eternal that perisheth not, the Everlasting that knoweth no decline, Who hath witnessed unto His own Being by His own Self that He is indeed the One, the Single, the Unrestrained, the Exalted.

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: The Kingdom and the Dominion, the Majesty and the Power belong unto God, the Omnipotent, the Mighty, the All-Choosing! He doeth what He willeth and ordaineth what He pleaseth. He is the Almighty, the All-Powerful.

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: Thine is the creation and the command, from the past and unto the future. Thou givest life and death, then death and life. Thou createst what Thou willest by Thy command. Verily, Thou art powerful over all things.

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: Verily, Thou art the Lord of the world and the Sovereign of the nations. Thou doest what Thou willest and ordainest what Thou pleasest. Thou art, verily, the All-Powerful, the Almighty, and worthy to grant prayers.

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: "This amr is the amr of God, you cannot resist it, you cannot prevent it. No one has been able to resist the amr of God and you cannot either. Soon the divine amr will be raised up and will encompass East and West."

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: He doeth what He willeth through His word "Be" and it is...Thou art He Whose grace the veils of the world and the clamor of the nations cannot withhold. Thou doest what Thou willest and ordainest what Thou pleasest.

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: He is God, exalted be His glory, the Grandeur and Power! ...He, verily, is the Fulfiller of what He promised aforetime in His Tablets, and hath manifested that which lay concealed in God's Books throughout the ages

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: He is the One Who hath power over all things, and nothing in the heavens or on earth can frustrate Him. He is the One King, the Manifest, the Powerful, the Self-Exalted, the Almighty, the Compelling, the Impregnable.

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: I bear witness, and all things bear witness, that all things are Thy creation and within Thy grasp. I shall testify that all besides Thee is created and within Thy grasp, and none hath anything save through Thy Will.

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: The Heavenly Sovereignty is everlasting. The Heavenly Leader is selected by the Lord. The Heavenly Ruler is mighty through Divine Bounty, and the election of the Holy Spirit, and through the Power of the Love of God.

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: The questioner has asked about divine origination. Know what We have given thee from the glories of proofs. Say: Hath not the Ordainer of destiny informed thee, in a seat of truth established, near unto a mighty King?

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: Unto God shall all return. He is the One Who createth whatsoever He willeth through His command Be, and it is! He is the Creator of the heavens and the earth and whatsoever lieth between them, the Mighty, the Beloved.

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: He is the One in Whose grasp are all who dwell in the heavens and earth. Say: All are created by His command. He is the One Who standeth firm in His Cause, Who causeth to flow whomsoever He willeth through His bounty.

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: "Look not upon the creatures and their clamor, but rather to the Truth and His sovereignty." "Verily Thou art powerful to do what Thou willest and in Thy grasp are the reins of all who are in the heavens and on earth."

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: Glory and praise rest upon Thee, O Thou the Lord of Lords, the Deliverer of the loved ones on the Day of Revival, O Thou Who causes the clouds to pour down with rain and Who rends asunder the veils and burns them away.

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: Thou knowest that had He wished it for a moment, they would cease to exist in this world. Yet how greatly did I strive to protect them, and thou hast witnessed the patience and forbearance of God, how vast it hath been.

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: He is the One Who createth whatsoever He willeth by His command, and unto Him shall all return. Nothing in the heavens or on earth or whatsoever lieth between them can frustrate Him. Verily He hath power over all things.

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: Should they bring all the armies of the earth, verily thy Lord is powerful over whatsoever He willeth. He doeth what He desireth with a sovereignty that all who are in the realm of possibility are powerless to withstand.

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: Thou art the Sovereign Whom the power of all creation hath not weakened, and Whom the might of rulers hath not held back from His purpose. Through Thy name the banner of "He doeth what He willeth" hath been raised aloft.

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: Verily, there is none other God but Me, the Almighty, the Powerful... He, verily, is the One Who prevaileth over all who are in heaven and on earth. Soon will His banner be raised upon every lofty and towering mountain.

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: God will soon show you your true Lord upon His throne on the Day of Resurrection upon the straight path, and ye shall surely witness that His power extendeth equally over all worlds. Verily God hath power over all things.

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: He is God, exalted be His glory, the Grandeur and the Power...whereby He hath cast down the banners of the idolaters and taken hold of the reins of all in the heavens and the earths...Verily He hath power over all things.

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: O God! What wisdom is this, what power and what might - He makes your highest lowest and your lowest highest, makes the small great and the great insignificant. He guides whom He willeth and leads astray whom He willeth.

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: Our Lord is the Lord of the heavens and of the earth and of whatsoever is between them, the Lord of all worlds. His is the creation of the heavens and the earth and whatsoever is between them, and He is verily the Creator

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: Verily Thou art powerful over whatsoever Thou willest. Nothing in all things can prevent Thy will. Thou doest what Thou pleasest and ordainest what Thou desirest. Verily Thou art the Strong, the Triumphant, the Almighty.

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: We testify that there is none other God but Him, being assured of His grandeur and sovereignty, and acknowledging His might and power. There is none other God but Him, the Single, the All-Powerful, the Mighty, the Choose.

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: Nothing escapeth His knowledge. His gaze is fixed upon thee. He is verily the All-Seeing, the All-Hearing, the All-Perceiving... We have encompassed what thou hast not encompassed and numbered what thou hast not numbered.

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: The All-Knowing, the All-Powerful hath ordained the earth as a scroll wherein the deeds and words of the children of Adam are to be recorded... He is the Powerful, the All-Knowing, and He is the Subduer, the All-Powerful.

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: Greatness belongeth unto God! Power belongeth unto God! Might belongeth unto Him, exalted be His glory! This power is made manifest through His servants. From this power the light of steadfastness hath dawned and shone forth.

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: He is the One Who createth whatsoever He willeth through His command, and unto Him shall all return. This is God, your Lord. His is the creation and the command. There is none other God but Him, the Most High, the Most Great.

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: O Thou in Whose hand is the reins of all creation... Verily Thou art the One Who hath power over whatsoever Thou willest, and within Thy grasp is the kingdom of creation and command. Verily Thou art powerful over all things.

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: Thine is the kingdom and the dominion, Thine is might and omnipotence, Thine is power and divinity, Thine is strength and majesty...In Thy grasp lies the kingdom of all things and in Thy right hand the destinies of all things

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: God has not sent down any verse in the Book, nor in the horizons, nor in the souls, except that people might know in truth that the Remembrance is truth from God, and He is God, the All-Knowing of all things from ancient truth.

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: He, verily, doeth what He willeth. What He pleaseth will God abrogate or confirm, and with Him is the knowledge of all things in a Guarded Tablet. Beware lest thy sovereignty withhold thee from Him Who is the Supreme Sovereign.

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: There the authority is God's, the Truth. That is better and greater in command. Unto God belongeth all glory in the kingdom of the heavens and of the earth and of whatsoever lieth between them, and God was ever mighty in glory.

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: God created you and sustained you and causeth you to die and giveth you life that ye may worship God by day and by night. Say: The Command of God is not like the command of any among you. He, verily, is powerful over all things.

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: God will assist all those who arise to serve Him. No one is able to deprive Him of His majesty, His dominion, His sovereignty, for in the heaven and the earth and in all the realms of God He is the victorious and the conqueror!

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: God, exalted be His glory, hath been and ever shall be the All-Knowing and the All-Powerful. He readeth what is inscribed upon hearts and breasts. Verily He manifesteth whatsoever He willeth, and He is the Mighty, the Powerful.

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: He is God, exalted be His majesty, greatness and power... Verily, He is powerful over all things... Verily, He is the Almighty, the All-Conquering, the Powerful... The Command belongs to God, the Protector, the Self-Subsisting.

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: All are in His grasp. God will ease all things for him and will surely show him the countenance of His Own Self. Verily there is no God but Him, and all else beside Him are created beings before Him, all standing in His presence.

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: He, verily, is the Truth, there is no God but Him, the Single, the One, the Mighty, the Powerful... Verily, Thou art the One Who hath power over whatsoever He willeth, and in Thy grasp are the reins of all things past and future.

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: You are the Omnipotent over what You will, and in Your grasp is the reins of all things...You are the Omnipotent Whose power all created things have witnessed, and the Self-Subsisting Whom all contingent things have acknowledged.

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: He, verily, is the All-Powerful, the All-Knowing, the All-Wise. He, verily, is the Protector of whosoever turneth unto Him and the Helper of whosoever calleth upon Him. There is none other God but Him, the Mighty, the Praised One.

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: Some are chosen by God -- as the disciples of Jesus Christ -- God was able to make all the Jews like them but showed mercy to the disciples only. It is on account of this difference that we know everything is in the hands of God.

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: Verily, You are He Whom nothing can frustrate and no affair can defeat. You do and command as You please, and You are indeed the Truth, the Almighty, the Powerful. Within Your grasp lies the kingdom of the heavens and the earths.

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: He is the One with such might that neither the cawing of the crows, nor the denial of the infidels, nor the clamor of the polytheists, nor the turning away of the divines, nor the power of princes could deter Him from His purpose.

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: He doeth what He willeth and ordaineth what He pleaseth. None may undertake any matter save by His leave. He commandeth whom He willeth through His bidding, and forbiddeth whom He pleaseth. He is, verily, the Powerful, the All-Wise.

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: Thou art He Whom the conditions of the world cannot frustrate, nor the clamor of the nations deter, and the Powerful One Whom neither the might of the people nor the denial of those who disbelieved in the Day of Judgment can weaken.

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: He is God, exalted be His glory, the Most Great, the All-Powerful...Verily, Thou art the Lord of the throne on high and of the dust below. There is none other God but Thee, the Lord of all mankind and the Creator of earth and heaven.

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: O Lord of the kingdom of earth and heaven and Sovereign of the realm above!...Thou art, verily, the Almighty, Whose greatness and sovereignty all created things and all contingent beings have testified to through Thy power and might.

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: All things testify to His grandeur and His sovereignty. Exalted, immensely exalted, is His Cause that hath encompassed the kingdom of earth and heaven, and His sovereignty that hath dominated all who are in the realms of divine might.

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: God hath created between them the Glory of His remembrance, would ye but reflect. God hath gathered all Books therein, would ye but know. Say: God exalteth the servant, He doth not abase him. Glory be to God above what they attribute!

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: God, the Lord of all, hath manifested His light through guidance and truth, and made clear His Cause to all...The knowledge of all that is in the heavens and earth escapeth Him not, and with Him is the Kingdom of the seen and unseen.

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: He ordaineth for whomsoever He willeth whatsoever He pleaseth, and decreeth for whomsoever He chooseth whatsoever He desireth. Within His grasp is the reins of authority. He giveth and withholdeth, and He is the Mighty, the Bountiful.

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: In His Name, the Most Holy, the Most Exalted...He appeared with this Name whereby necks were brought low...He accepteth what He willeth from whom He willeth and writeth for whom He desireth. He is, in truth, the Mighty, the Bountiful.

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: Should He so desire, He is able with but a single word of His command to raise all who dwell in the realms of creation and invention from the graves of heedlessness and passion to the celestial heights of sanctity, glory and eternity.

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: But these souls have overlooked this point: if creation proceeded according to only one pattern, how would the all-encompassing Power manifest itself, and how would God be "He doeth whatsoever He willeth and ordaineth as He pleaseth"?

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: God is independent of you and of what ye earn. He it is Who created all things by His command, and unto Him shall all be turned. He is the Truth, there is no God but Him. He giveth life and causeth death, and unto Him shall all return.

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: I considered all such talk to be vain, for God wished to manifest His Cause, and it was impossible that any harm could befall Me before He manifested His Cause, and in the midst of trials it was impossible that He would not protect Me.

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: Verily, Thou art powerful over all things. Verily, Thou art knowing of all things, Thou art powerful over all things, Thou art the Sustainer of all things, Thou art the Watcher over all things, and Thou art the Preserver of all things

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: He is God, the Victorious, the All-Powerful, the Almighty! Say: By God! None shall ever outstrip His Cause, and none shall ever prevent His sovereignty, even should all the kings of the earth and all mankind behind them gather together.

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: He it is Whom nothing can frustrate, either in the heavens or on earth. He heareth all who call upon Him, and He hath power over all things. There is no God but Him - He giveth life and causeth death, and He is witness over all things.

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: All that is in the heavens and on earth praise God, and verily He has power over all things. His is the sovereignty of the heavens and the earth, and His is the dominion of Command and Truth, and He is the majestic and mighty Sovereign.

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: He is the One, the Single, the Powerful, the Supreme, the Self-Subsisting. Through His most exalted Word He summoned the peoples of the nether world to the Dayspring of grace and bounty. Exalted be His might and supreme His sovereignty!

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: I testify that Thou art the One Who hath power over whatsoever Thou willest and Who ruleth over whatsoever Thou desirest... Verily, Thou art the One Who hath power over whatsoever Thou pleasest. Within Thy grasp is the kingdom of names.

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: Sovereignty presupposes or necessitates its subjects. Sovereignty necessitates competency. Soveriegnty necessitates an army. Sovereignty necessitates supervisors. Sovereignty necessitates soldiers...the sovereignty of God is everlasting.

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: Therefore do I supplicate God and beseech the Lord that He may strengthen you with intense power and draw you nigh unto the Supreme Concourse, and that He may assist the weak through your might and power which prevailed in ancient times.

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: This is a Book from God, the All-Governing, the Self-Subsisting. Then be silent, for the call of the All-Glorious God hath been raised in the wilderness of guidance: There is none other God but Me, the All-Governing, the Self-Subsisting.

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: Say: God is the Subduer over His servants, and He is the Supreme, the Inaccessible, the Possessor of Power and Strength. Say: God is manifest above His servants, and He is the Sovereign, the Most Great, the Possessor of Power and Majesty.

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: Verily, Thou art the Omnipotent over what Thou willest, and Thou art the Self-Subsisting, the Almighty. There is none other God but Thee, the Mighty, the Beloved. Thou art the One with power to prefer a handful of dust above the heavens.

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: Glorified is He Who sendeth down the verses as He pleaseth, and verily He is the Mighty, the Self-Subsisting, the All-Compelling. Know thou that preservation lieth in His hand - He preserveth whom He willeth by a command from His presence

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: He split the atmospheres and rent the air and tore away the veils through the word "Be" (kun), and raised up the leaves with the trees, and the earths with the mountains, and the seas with the rains, and the springs with their likenesses.

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: Glory be unto Thee, O Thou in Whose hand is the dominion of all things and in Whose grasp is the kingdom of names! Verily, Thou art the Omnipotent over whatsoever Thou willest, and through Thy Name every wise decree hath been made manifest.

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: Verily thy Lord is He Who, through His word "Be!", hath power over whatsoever He willeth...Thou art He to Whose power and might all created things have testified, and to Whose grandeur and sovereignty all things possible have borne witness.

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: By God, besides Whom there is none other God! He dealt with all the people of the Bayan with the utmost kindness and mercy, bestowing upon each according to their capacity the wine of divine knowledge and the water of celestial understanding.

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: He is God, exalted be His station, the Grandeur and the Power! Thou art the Almighty Whom neither the clamor of the servants nor the turning away of those in the lands can hinder. Thou doest what Thou willest and ordainest what Thou desirest.

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: By His sovereignty He doeth what He willeth. He, verily, is the Self-Sufficient, the Bountiful, the Mighty, the Powerful. The hosts of earth did not prevent Him, nor the might of those who were heedless of God's Cause, the Lord of the worlds.

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: Glorified be He in Whose grasp is the Kingdom of the majesty of the heavens and the earth and whatsoever is between them! Glorified be He in Whose grasp is the Kingdom of sovereignty of the heavens and the earth and whatsoever is between them!

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: That is God, your Lord. His is the creation and the command. There is none other God but Him, the Mighty, the All-Wise. Say: Who hath created the heavens and the earth and whatsoever lieth between them quicker than to say unto it Be and it is?

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: through a divine power, a heavenly might, and a celestial sovereignty, He conquered the kingdom of existence and captured the citadels of hearts. He opened the horizons of contingent being and brought the realm of existence under His control.

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: Within His grasp lies the kingdom of all things, and within His hand the dominion of the entire creation. None hath preceded Him in His will, and none shall ever precede Him in His word. He doeth what He willeth and ordaineth what He pleaseth.

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: Thou art the Subduer Who cannot be subdued, the Manifest Who cannot be manifested, the Powerful Who cannot be rendered powerless, the All-Knowing from Whose knowledge nothing escapeth, and the All-Encompassing from Whose grasp nothing can flee.

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: Thou art the Subduer of the mighty, the Manifest among the manifest, the Most Glorious among the glorious, the Forgiver of sins, the Light of lights, the Consoler of hearts, the Creator of creation, the Seer of all things, the Helper of helpers.

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: Verily, there is none other God but Him, the All-Compelling, the Self-Subsisting. He verily ordaineth for whomsoever He willeth the reward of those who have attained unto every good thing in the days of God, the Lord of the seen and the unseen.

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: God beareth witness that there is none other God but Him, the rightful Sovereign...In His grasp lies the kingdom of all things...He preserveth whomsoever He willeth through His sovereignty, and within His grasp lies the kingdom of might and power

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: He is the Subduer over His servants, and He is the Supreme, the Self-Subsisting. He is the Manifest above His creation, and He is the Mighty, the Beloved. He is the One Who createth whatsoever He willeth by His command, and unto God do all return.

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: Say: O people of the earth! Do ye desire to prevent God from exercising His sovereignty? Can a drop rise up against the ocean, or a mote contend with the sun? What aileth you, O company of oppressors? Fear God, and follow not your selfish desires.

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: He it is Who createth what He pleaseth by His command, and unto Him shall be the return. He is the Fashioner of the heavens and of the earth and of whatsoever is between them, the Mighty, the Merciful. Say: God will assuredly judge you by His Name.

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: By His Command-Word He subdued the world, and by a single letter from His Book He guided those endowed with understanding to the fountain of life. He bestowed upon the atom the glory of the sun, and conferred upon the drop the effects of the ocean.

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: He is the Omnipotent One Who hath transformed the nay into yea and raised high the word Behold! from the wondrous Mount. Thou doest what Thou willest and ordainest what Thou pleasest. Thou art, verily, the Almighty, the Most Exalted, the All-Praised.

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
