Quotation: In His Name, the One Who rules over all who are in the earths and heavens!...All who dwell in the unseen and the visible bear witness to Thy sovereignty. There is none other God but Thee, the Almighty, the Most Exalted, the All-Knowing, the All-Wise.

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt

Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt

Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: O God, Almighty Protector! O Thou Who art the confirmer of every just power and equitable empire in eternal glory, everlasting power, continuance and greatness! Thou art the confirmer of whomsoever Thou willest. Verily Thou art the powerful and the mighty!

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: Thou art the Ancient Sovereign and the Lord of knowledge. There is none other God but Thee, the Mighty, the All-Conquering, the All-Powerful. Verily, Thou art the All-Powerful in whatsoever Thou willest, and Thou art the Self-Subsisting, the All-Compelling.

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt

Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: Glory be to Thee, Thou in Whose hand are the heaven of omnipotence and the kingdom of creation. Powerful art Thou to do what Thou pleasest. No God is there beside Thee, the All-Powerful, the Omniscient, the Supreme Ruler, the Help in Peril, the Self-Subsisting.

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: Thine is the dominion and the kingdom, Thine the might and the power, Thine the strength and the divinity, Thine the force and sovereignty, Thine the majesty and the glory. Thou createst what Thou willest by Thy command. Verily, Thou hast power over all things.

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God

Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: He is the All-Powerful, the Self-Subsisting! Say: He is manifest above His creation, and He is the Mighty, the Well-Beloved. He is the One before Whom boweth down in adoration whatsoever is in the heavens and whatsoever is on earth, and unto Him shall all return.

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt

Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt

Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt

Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: He is established upon the throne of "He doeth whatsoever He willeth" through His Most Holy, Mighty, and Beloved Name... Neither the might of the world shall frighten Me, nor shall the harm of those who have disbelieved in the Witness and the Witnessed hold Me back.

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: Sovereignty belongeth unto God, the Creator of the heavens and the Lord of the Kingdom of Names. We beseech Him, exalted be He, to protect them with His hosts, to guard them by His dominion, and to assist them with His power that hath encompassed all created things.

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: He is the One Who createth what He willeth through His command, and unto God shall all be transformed. Say: He is the Subduer over His servants, and He is the Guardian, the Self-Subsisting. Say: He is the Manifest above His creation, and He is the Mighty, the Beloved.

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: The Book of God speaketh the truth in this Most Great Prison and guideth the servants unto God, the Lord of all men. Not an atom escapeth His knowledge. He doeth what He willeth and ordaineth what He pleaseth. He is the Almighty, the Most Powerful, the All-Choosing.

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: Unto God belong the measures of the heavens and of the earth and whatsoever lieth between them, and God is the All-Powerful Guardian. Unto God belongeth power in the kingdoms of the heavens and of the earth and whatsoever lieth between them, and God is mighty, mighty.

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: I created all contingent beings to manifest My power and the atoms of existence to reveal My grace. I am He Who hath ever been powerful over all things... Verily, He doeth what He willeth through His sovereignty and createth what He desireth by His word "Be" and it is.

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: O Lord of Signs, Revealer of Intentions, and Sender down of perfect Words! I beseech Thee, through Thy Most Great Name, to watch over 'Ayn with the eye of Thy mercy, and to confirm him in all things through the power of Thy Self-Subsistence and the might of Thy Oneness.

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: We have extended unto the idolaters all the means of earth; therefore have the gates of bounties been opened before their faces. Soon shall We seize them with Our might. Verily thy Lord is the Powerful, the Almighty... Verily thy Lord is the Ruler over what He willeth.

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: God beareth witness that there is no God but Him. His is the dominion of the heavens and of the earth and of whatsoever is between them. None can comprehend Him, nor know Him, nor unify Him, nor bring Him into being. He hath no peer, nor likeness, nor equal, nor partner.

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: He is - In the Name of God, the Most Powerful, the Most Holy, the Most Wondrous, the Most Compelling! Thou givest to whom Thou pleasest and exaltest whom Thou willest. In Thy hand are the gates of all things. Thou decreest what Thou pleasest and doest what Thou willest.

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: He it is in Whose hands lies the dominion of all things, and naught escapeth His knowledge. He it is in whose hands is the dominion of all things, and in His power nothing can frustrate Him, and all creation, according to the decree of the Book, are submissive unto Him.

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: Praise be to God Who hath manifested and revealed His Cause with a power that the clamor of men could not deter, nor the might of the ungodly frighten, nor the strength of the powerful weaken. Verily, He doeth what He willeth through a power that encompasseth all things.

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: The Day Star of guidance which has illumined the world proclaims: The Best-Beloved of the worlds strideth forth and calleth all mankind to the Day Spring of Pre-existent Beauty. O ye people! The Sun of Truth shineth resplendently at the bidding of the Lord of all worlds.

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: The Kingdom and Dominion belong to God, the Possessor of all existence... There is no God but Thee, the Possessor of existence and the Guardian over all who are in the heavens and earths. There is no God but Thee, the Mighty, the Powerful, the All-Knowing, the All-Wise.

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: Thou doest what Thou willest and ordainest what Thou pleasest. Thou hast no partner in what Thou hast created, no guardian in what Thou hast provided, no helper in what Thou hast seized, no supporter in what Thou hast quickened, and no deputy in what Thou hast raised up.

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: Thus hath the matter been decreed by the Revealer of verses. Say: O people! The Day hath comeÃ¢â‚¬â€that which ye were promised in the Tablets. Through it the Great Cry hath been raised, and the Rock hath proclaimed: "The Kingdom is God's, the One, the All-Compelling!"

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: The Command is His--there is no God but Him, the Mighty, the Beloved. He is the One Who creates what He willeth through His command Be! and it is. He is the One before Whom prostrate all who are in the heavens and all who are on earth; verily, unto Him shall we all return.

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: Say: God is more protecting than any protector; none in the heavens or on the earth or between them can withstand the sovereignty of His protection. He creates whatsoever He willeth by His command, and verily He hath ever been the All-Protecting, the Preserver, the Guardian.

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: This is a mention from Us to one who has attained the lights of the Kingdom when the Sovereign of the Realm of Might came with a Word that caused all who are in the heavens and earth to swoon... He, verily, is the One Who doeth what He willeth through His word "Be" and it is.

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: Thou art the Subduer Who cannot be subdued, the Vanquisher Who cannot be vanquished, the Manifest Who cannot be manifested, the Invincible Who cannot be resisted, the Exalted Who cannot be surpassed, the Omnipotent Who cannot be challenged, the Sovereign Who cannot be equaled.

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: Thou hast ever ruled as Thou pleasest, how Thou pleasest, through what Thou pleasest, when Thou pleasest, and Thou wilt ever do what Thou willest, how Thou willest, through what Thou willest, when Thou willest, for whom Thou willest. Verily, Thou art powerful over all things.

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: Above all things Thou hast created all things by Thy power out of nothing, and things in Thy sight after their existence are even as they were before their existence, for Thou didst establish them by themselves out of nothing, and confined them within their bounds from nothing.

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: Glorified be He Who has manifested His Cause with a sovereignty that has encompassed all who are in the heavens and on earth. No thing can frustrate Him, no matter can prevent Him, the power of the world cannot weaken Him, and the hosts of kings and rulers cannot frighten Him.

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: Glorified be He Who sends down verses to whomsoever He wishes among His servants, and verily He is the All-Hearing, the All-Knowing. Glory be to God, Lord of the heavens and the throne, far above what they describe. Exalted is God, thy Lord, above what they associate with Him.

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: Glorified is He Who hath sent down the verses in truth and hath ordained therein the measures of all things. He is verily the Mighty, the All-Choosing... By God, the True One, the King, sovereignty on that Day belongeth unto God, the One, the Powerful, the Mighty, the Subduer.

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: God is Truth, and whatsoever is besides God is creation, and all are His worshippers. Say: God is Lord, and whatsoever is besides God is servant, and all bow down before Him. Say: God is the Creator of all things, and He is the Single One, the All-Powerful, the Self-Subsisting.

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: Thou art He to Whose bounty and munificence all created things have testified, and to Whose grace and bestowal all contingent beings have borne witness. There is none other God but Thee, the Almighty over what Thou willest. Verily, Thou art the All-Bountiful, the Most Generous.

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: God beareth witness that there is none other God but Him, the Sovereign of all worlds. God beareth witness that there is none other God but Him, the King of all who are in the kingdom of the heavens and the earth and whatsoever lieth between them, that is the Lord of all worlds.

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: Thou createst whatsoever Thou willest by Thy command. Verily, Thou art powerful over all things. Thou didst ordain the creation of all things and fashion them according to Thy Will, and Thou didst determine the measures of all things by Thy leave and decree them by Thy ordering.

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: Through His appearance every hidden secret hath been revealed, and from the treasury of His Supreme Pen have appeared the pearls of wisdom and utterance... Thou doest what Thou willest by Thy sovereignty. There is none other God but Thee, the Mighty, the Bountiful, the Generous.

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: God has ordained no extinction in the realm of mortality, nor any limit for the people of creation. Yet I, O my Lord, for my own self, through my prior knowledge of the end of my affair and what God has ordained for me - nay, God doeth what He willeth and decreeth what He desireth.

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: He is manifest above His creation, and He is the Mighty, the Well-Beloved. Before Him boweth down whatsoever is in the heavens and whatsoever is in the earth, and unto God shall all return. Say: He is the Subduer over His servants, and He is the All-Conquering, the Self-Subsisting.

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: He is the One Who standeth over His Cause, recompensing every soul according to what is decreed, and God is the guardian of all things... He it is Who giveth life and causeth death, and all shall return unto God. He it is Who causeth death and giveth life, there is no God but Him.

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: O Lord! They are poor and Thou art in truth the All-Possessing; they are weak and Thou art in justice the All-Powerful... Thou art He Who hath ever been exalted in grandeur and glory, and elevated in loftiness and majesty. Thou art, verily, the All-Compelling, the Self-Subsisting.

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: Praise be to God Who hath manifested His Cause, fulfilled His Promise, rendered victorious His hosts...He, verily, is the Almighty, the All-Choosing...Verily, Thou art the Almighty over whatsoever Thou willest, and within Thy grasp lie the reins of all in the heavens and on earth.

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: Today is the day of vision and utterance, that the eye may behold the signs of divine power and the tongue may arise to praise and speak forth Unto God belongeth all authority. He doeth what He willeth and ordaineth what He pleaseth. He, verily, is the Single One, the All-Informed.

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: He hath ever been powerful over all things and supreme over all who dwell in the heavens and on earth. He hath created the world through His most exalted Word and ordained for them laws and ordinances as a grace from His presence, and He is the Powerful, the Mighty, the All-Knowing.

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: He is the All-Powerful over all things... He createth what He willeth through His command... He is victorious over His Cause, both in the past and in the future... In His hand is the dominion of all things... Nothing in the heavens or earth can frustrate Us, and We are All-Knowing.

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: The Command is in God's hands - He doeth what He willeth and ordaineth what He pleaseth, and He is the Mighty, the Praiseworthy. Thou art He to Whose exaltation and sublimity all created things have testified, and to Whose greatness and power all things possible have borne witness.

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: He createth whatsoever He willeth by His command. Verily, He hath ever been penetrating, piercing and pervasive. Glorified be He before Whom bow down in adoration all who are in the heavens and who are on the earth and whatsoever lieth between them. Say: All are prostrate before Him.

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: He is God, exalted be His glory, the Grandeur and the Power! Through His assistance the tongue speaketh, the ink floweth, the pen moveth, hearts are attracted, faces are turned, and eyes are directed. Should He withdraw His aid for but a moment, existence would return to nothingness.

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: If the hosts of divine might and power lend their aid, it will become clear and evident that all the sects, governments and peoples of the world are as an army put to flight. Otherwise, "If He forsake you, who is there that can help you after Him?" will become manifest and apparent.

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: Say: He is the One Who standeth over every soul, knowing what it hath earned and bearing witness to what it shall earn, and verily He is the Truth, the Knower of the unseen. Such is the Fashioner of the heavens and the earth and whatsoever lieth between them, the Mighty, the Beloved.

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: Thou createst whatsoever Thou willest by Thy command. Within Thy grasp are the holy places and similitudes, and in Thy right hand are the wonders of glory and majesty. Thou hast ever created what Thou willest as Thou willest, and wilt ever fashion what Thou desirest as Thou desirest.

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: God hath ordained your provision in this heaven - in truth, upon the truth - a measured portion sent down. He it is Who hath ordained the sun for light and the moon for radiance that ye may seek of His bounty the goods of this life - in truth, upon the truth - in praiseworthy fashion.

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: Through Him the Cry was raised up, all things gave utterance, and the Herald proclaimed from the Most Exalted Paradise... By God! The Tree cried out and the Rock exclaimed, and the Command was decreed in truth by God... Thou art He Whose power and sovereignty the signs have testified

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: Thou art He Whom the might of the wicked hath not deterred, nor hath the tyranny of the evil-doers frightened. Thou doest what Thou willest through Thy sovereignty that hath encompassed the kingdom of earth and heaven, and through Thy power that hath prevailed over the realms of might.

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: Through Thy name, O my God, all created things were stirred up, and the heavens were spread, and the earth was established, and the clouds were raised and made to rain upon the earth...Thy might, verily, is equal to all things. Thou, in truth, art the Most Powerful, the Self-Subsisting

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: The Truth hath come for the reformation of the world and none hath the power to prevent Him. Should the entire world arise to prevent it, by the life of God, they shall find themselves impotent, and whatsoever He hath willed shall assuredly appear. Verily, He hath power over all things.

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: Verily Thou art the Almighty whom the affairs of Thy creation cannot frustrate, nor the events of the world and its ornaments in Thy earth. I testify that in Thy grasp are the reins of those in the heavens and the earth and the reins of hearts and minds by Thy power and Thy sovereignty

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: Unto God belongs the dominion of the heavens and the earth and whatsoever is between them, and God possesses vast dominion. Unto God belongs the standard of might in the kingdom of the heavens and the earth and whatsoever is between them, and God possesses a mighty and glorious standard.

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: Glorified art Thou, O my God! Thou art the Ancient Lord, the Supreme King, the Gracious Master, and the Compassionate Creator, Who hath made the balance for whoso standeth upon the straight path and desireth the true measure to be Thy revealed verses and the clear tokens of Thy utterance.

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: God, there is no God but Him, the Ever-Living, the Mighty, the Powerful, the Well-Beloved. He it is Whom God hath made the Self-Subsisting over all who are in the heavens and earths and whatsoever is between them. He is the Truth, there is no God but Him, the Supreme, the Self-Subsisting.

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: He is the One Who standeth supreme over His Cause, the All-Compelling, the Most Strong...He Who was promised in the Books of God, the Mighty, the All-Praised, hath come from the horizon of power and hath manifested what He desired by His command, and He is the Almighty, the All-Powerful.

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: He Who is sovereign over whatsoever He willeth...in Whose grasp is the reins of remembrance and utterance, and in Whose right hand are the reins of the kingdom of divine knowledge...Thou art the One Who hath power over whatsoever He pleaseth, and in Thy grasp are the reins of all things.

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: "On this Day all sovereignty is, in very deed, with God!" "The glory of all greatness belongeth to God, the Incomparable, the All-Compelling!" "Supreme ascendancy is to be attributed, this Day, to none except God, Him Who hath no peer nor equal, Who is the Most Powerful, the All-Subduing!"

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: They seek victory over Us through armies and cannons, while We seek victory over them through the Strong, the Mighty, the Powerful. The entire world and all that hath transpired therein beareth witness that not an atom's weight of deeds hath been nor ever shall be lost in the sight of God.

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: Upon Him be the blessings of God, the Mighty, the Praiseworthy, and upon His family and companions through whom the traces of polytheism were erased and the decree of divine unity was established, through whom the clouds rained down and the Word of the Cause was exalted amidst the parties.

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: He is the Truth, there is no God but Him. He giveth life and causeth death, and unto Him shall all return. He is the Subduer over His servants, and verily He is the Single One, the Protector, the Self-Subsisting. He is the Manifest over His creation, and verily He is the Mighty, the Beloved.

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: Blessed is He Who hath sent down the verses and made them a sign from His presence, an evidence from before Him, and a proof from His side. He, verily, is the One Who hath power over whatsoever He willeth. He giveth and withholdeth, and He is the Single, the One, the Mighty, the All-Choosing.

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: His are the Creation and the Command. He giveth life and causeth death, then causeth death and giveth life, and verily He is the Ever-Living Who dieth not. Within His grasp lieth the dominion of all things. He createth whatsoever He willeth by His behest. Verily He hath power over all things.

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: Say: God is more powerful than all who possess power. None can withstand the sovereignty of His dominion's might, neither in the heavens nor on earth nor whatsoever is between them. He createth what He willeth by His command. Verily, He hath ever been the All-Powerful, the Mighty, the Strong.

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: His is the Kingdom and the Dominion, then Glory and Might, then Power and Divinity, then Strength and Sovereignty, then Rulership and Humanity. He giveth life and causeth death, then causeth death and giveth life, and verily He is the Ever-living Who dieth not and the King Who passeth not away.

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: He it is Who hath created all things by His command, and unto Him shall all return. Unto God belongeth the origination of the heavens and the earth and all that lieth between them, and He, verily, is the Mighty, the Best-Beloved. He it is Who createth what He willeth by His command Be, and it is.

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: His creation beareth witness that there is none other God but Him, the One, the Book. His is the Kingdom and the Dominion, Thine the Glory and the Might, Thine the Power and the Divinity, Thine the Strength and the Ruby, Thine the Sovereignty and the Human Realm, Thine the Majesty and the Grandeur

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: Thou seest my resting place, and Thou, from Thy Most Exalted Horizon, dost ordain the creation of all things through Thy power and dost fashion whatsoever Thou willest through Thy Will. Nothing exists in Thy heaven and earth save through the sovereignty of Thy Purpose and the dominion of Thy Will.

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: He it is Who determineth the measure of all things in the Book, that ye may testify that there is none other God but Him, the Lord of all worlds. Say: He is the One Who standeth over every soul. He is the One Who originateth whatsoever He willeth by His command, and God keepeth count of all things.

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: Is that which your fathers left behind greater than that which hath shone forth from the Dayspring of the Cause, or have ye a proof more manifest than the Most Merciful Himself? This is His sovereignty which has appeared in truth. This is God's Manifestation among you and His sovereignty unto you.

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: The Kingdom is God's, the Protector, the Self-Subsisting," and those near unto Him have declared: "There is none other God but He, the Omnipotent over what was and what shall be." Soon shall all that is visible vanish, and sovereignty, might and power shall remain with God, the One, the Chosen One.

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: Thou art the Subduer in the kingdom of the heavens and the earth and whatsoever is between them. Exalted be the majesty of our Lord, the All-Merciful! He hath taken neither consort nor son, and He hath no partner in sovereignty, nor any protector out of weakness, and He is powerful over all things.

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: He hath spoken a Word whereby standards were raised upon standards, and the banner of "He doeth whatsoever He willeth" was hoisted upon the highest peaks... In My Name was raised the Standard of 'He doeth what He willeth,' and by My Command was hoisted the Banner of 'He ordaineth what He pleaseth.'

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: His is the grandeur and majesty in the kingdom of heaven and earth and whatsoever is between them, and He is the Mighty, the Beloved. Unto God belongeth all authority from before and after, and unto God are all turned. He createth what He willeth by His command. Verily He hath power over all things.

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: None in the heavens or on the earth or between them can withhold from the sovereign King His healing power. He createth what He willeth through His command... He is the Ever-Living Who dieth not, and the King Who passeth not away, and the Just One Who wrongeth not, and the Sovereign Who changeth not

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: Nothing can escape His grasp, whether in the heavens or on the earth or in what lieth between them. He createth what He willeth through His command, and verily He hath power over all things. Blessed is He unto Whom belongeth the dominion of the heavens and of the earth and of what lieth between them.

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: Whenever I attempt to approach Thee, I perceive nothing in myself but the tokens of Thy grace and behold naught in my being but the revelations of Thy loving-kindness. It is undisputed, however, that the influence of Thine attraction hath everlastingly been inherent in the realities of Thy handiwork

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: Praise be unto Him Who is sanctified above thought and utterance, the Beloved of the worlds, Who through one Word bestowed existence, through another Word caused return unto nothingness, and through yet another Word preserved His servants between existence and non-existence until their appointed time.

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: Thou art He Who disappointeth not those who hope in Thee, nor driveth away from Thy door those who seek Thee. There is none other God but Thee, the All-Forgiving, the All-Bountiful. Verily, Thou art powerful over whatsoever Thou willest. There is none other God but Thee, the All-Knowing, the All-Wise.

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: Thou art the Sovereign over all who dwell in the Kingdom of Names and Attributes, and Thy Book is supreme over all books and proofs... Nothing in the heavens or on earth or between them can frustrate Thee, and nothing in the kingdom of command or creation or whatsoever is beneath them can thwart Thee

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: Glorified be He Who createth whatsoever He willeth through His command Be and it is. He is the One before Whom boweth down in adoration whatsoever is in the heavens and whatsoever is on earth, and unto God do all return. The Fashioner of the heavens and of the earth and of whatsoever lieth between them

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: God took him unto Himself through His grace and generosity, for He is the best of those who take unto themselves... For God has aforetime brought low those who opposed truth unjustly, and He will seize them, obliterate them, take vengeance upon them and destroy them, for He is All-Knowing, All-Powerful.

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: He is the Omnipotent over His servants, and He is the All-Protecting, the Self-Subsisting. He is the One Who creates whatsoever He willeth through His command, and unto God shall all return. His is whatsoever dwelleth in the night and in the day, and verily He is the All-Protecting, the Self-Subsisting.

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: He is the One Who creates what He desires through His command Be! and it is. He is the One Who gives life and causes death, and unto Him shall all return. Say: All derive their might from God's might, for all might in the kingdom of the heavens and the earth and whatsoever is between them belongs to God.

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: He is the One Who createth what He willeth by His command, and unto Him is the journey's end. His is whatsoever dwelleth in the night and the day, and verily He is the Most High, the Most Great. That is the Fashioner of the heavens and the earth and whatsoever lieth between them, the Mighty, the Merciful.

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: He is the One Who createth whatsoever He willeth through His command, and unto God do all repair. Glorified be He Who createth what He pleaseth by His command, and there is no God but Him, the Lord of all worlds. He is the One Who createth what He willeth by His command, and unto Him is the journey's end.

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: How exalted are the signs of Thy power, how glorious the tokens of Thy grandeur, how exalted are the manifestations of Thy sovereign might, how all abstract realities are stilled at the dawning of the light of Thy oneness, and how all created things bow down before the splendor of the lights of Thy unity!

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: Within Thy grasp is the kingdom of all things. Thou createst whatsoever Thou willest, how Thou willest, by Thy command. Thou art, verily, powerful over all things. Nothing can frustrate Thee, neither in the heavens nor on earth, nor can anything escape Thy knowledge in the kingdom of Command or Creation.

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: He is the Subduer of His servants, the Self-Subsisting, the Inaccessible, the Most High. Before Him boweth down whatsoever is in the heavens and whatsoever is in the earth, and unto Him shall all return. His is whatsoever dwelleth in the night and in the day, and He, verily, is the Mighty, the Well-Beloved.

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: He it is Who createth whatsoever He willeth by His command Be! and it is. Such is the Creator of the heavens and the earth and whatsoever is between them, the Mighty, the Well-Beloved. He it is before Whom boweth down whosoever is in the heavens and whosoever is on earth; verily, we all bow down before Him.

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: God beareth witness that there is no God but Him. His is the creation and the command. He giveth life and causeth death, then causeth death and giveth life, and verily He is the Ever-Living Who dieth not. Within His grasp is the kingdom of all things. He createth what He willeth by His command Be! and it is.

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: I beseech Thee, O Thou in Whose grasp are the reins of all created things and the control of all existence, by Thy Name through which Thou hast subdued both the Kingdom and the Dominion. Thou art He Whom nothing can frustrate and no decree can hinder. All things have testified to Thy greatness and Thy power.

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: None can resist His bidding, none can stay His judgment, none can frustrate His decree, and none can oppose His will. His power has ever been triumphant, His might ever-subduing, His dominion ever-manifest, and His glory ever-resplendent. He ordains whatsoever He willeth and decreeth whatsoever He pleaseth.

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: He is the All-Compelling above His servants, and He is the All-Protecting, the Self-Subsisting. Say: He is the Manifest above His creation, and He is the Mighty, the Best-Beloved. He is the One before Whom prostrate themselves all who are in the heavens and all who are on earth, and unto Him shall all return.

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: The Kingdom belongeth unto God, the Mighty, the Inaccessible. This is a Day wherein all things have been stirred up by the Call of Him Who is the Lord of Names, and from every atom of existence can be heard glorification, praise, and movement out of longing for this manifestation of God in this clear station.

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: Glorified is He Who hath revealed the Word with authority from His presence. Soon shall We seize those who have wronged, even as We seized the transgressors in those regions who drove Us from the Land of Mystery when they opposed God, the Lord of all men. We seized them all with authority from Our presence.

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: Glorified be He in Whose grasp is the dominion of the rubies of the heavens and the earth and whatsoever is between them! He is the One Who creates all things by His command, and God is knowing of all things. He is the One Who originates whatsoever He willeth by His command, and God is powerful over all things.

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: One drop from the ocean of Thy generosity brought the world of being into existence, and one flame from the Fire of Thy Lote-Tree set the nations ablaze. Thou art the Self-Subsisting One through Whose strength the power of the world is made manifest, and through Whose might the power of the nations is revealed.

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: Glorified art Thou, O my God! Thy Kingdom, as it is in itself, severs all kingdoms in the heaven of dominion and sovereignty. Thy Omnipotence, as it is in itself, severs all powers in the cloud of holiness and might. Thy Divinity, as it is in itself, severs all divine things in the thrones of power and divinity.

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: God verily encompasseth all things. His is whatsoever lieth in the heavens and whatsoever lieth on earth. His is the dominion of the heavens and the earth and whatsoever lieth between them. Through His mercy God exalteth whomsoever He willeth in the Paradise of the All-Highest, for He hath power over all things.

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: Within Thy grasp is the kingdom of all things. Thou createst what Thou willest by Thy command. Verily, Thou art powerful over whatsoever Thou willest. To God belong the eternal ones of the heavens and of the earth and whatsoever lieth between them. God is over them the All-Powerful, the Almighty, the Omnipotent.

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: Hath not the All-Merciful taught you that the Gate of God hath never been vanquished in the Mother Book? Have We not made known to you that Our Gates in the Mother Book have ever been alive with God, the Ancient One? By God, the Truth! Unto Us is your return in truth, then upon Us resteth your reckoning in truth.

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: He is the One Who createth whatsoever He willeth through His command. His is whatsoever dwelleth in the night and in the day, and verily He is the Mighty, the Beloved. He is the Subduer over His servants. Within His grasp lieth the kingdom of all things. He createth what He pleaseth by His command: Be! and it is.

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: This is the Festival wherein the Beauty of the Divine Essence hath appeared without veil or concealment, with such sovereignty as hath humbled the necks of the proud. This is the Festival wherein the Pen hath been lifted from all things, for the Sovereign of Eternity hath appeared from behind the [veil of] names.

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: God beareth witness that there is no God but Him. Say: Within His grasp are the hosts of the heavens and earth and all that lieth between them, and all are brought into His presence. God beareth witness that there is no God but Him. He createth what He willeth by His command, and He is the Mighty, the Best-Beloved.

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: Say: This proof is God's dominion which He turneth as He pleaseth by His command. He is, verily, the Mighty, the Beloved. Say: Who created the heavens and the earth and whatsoever is between them and all worlds? They will surely say: God Who created all things by His command, and He is the Guardian over all things.

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: The Originator of the heavens and of the earth and whatsoever is between them - His command is nearer than the utterance Be, and it is! And unto God belongeth the kingdom of the heavens and of the earth and whatsoever is between them. He bestoweth as He willeth through His grace, and God is indeed a Bountiful King.

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: Blessed is He before Whom all in the heavens and on earth prostrate themselves, and we all do prostrate before Him. Blessed is He Whom all in the heavens and on earth do praise, and we all are supplicants of His grace. Our Lord is the Lord of the heavens and earth and all that is between them, the Lord of all worlds.

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: The seat whereon I am established is the Throne of God. Imagine not a throne for your Lord God in heaven, for He is in heaven a God established upon His throne, and on earth a God established upon His throne, and between them a God established upon His throne. He createth what He willeth by His command Be! and it is.

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: God testifieth that there is none other God but Him. His is the creation and the command. He causeth to live and die, and He causeth to die and live. He is the Ever-Living Who dieth not. Within His grasp is the dominion of all things. He createth what He willeth by His command. Verily, He is powerful over all things.

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: No power hath restrained His power, and no force in all the world hath held back His sovereignty from the influence and execution of His Will. Great is His dominion and mighty are the tabernacles of His bounty. Who is able to withhold Him from that which He desireth, and who can prevent Him from that which He wisheth?

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: Thou art God; Thou hast ever been, and naught was with Thee. Thou art God; Thou shalt ever be, and nothing shall be on Thy level. All confess their powerlessness, O my God, even as Thou knowest Thyself. Thy creative power is known among all created things, and Thy innovative acts are described through all indications.

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: Can aught be compared with My Word? Nay, by My true Self! Can anyone enumerate what hath been sent down from the heaven of bounty? Nay, by the Lord of the Day of Judgment! Today every fair-minded one hath acknowledged the greatness of the Cause, and every mighty just one hath confessed his powerlessness and shortcoming.

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: He creates all things by His command Be and it is. He it is who gave you form by His command Be and it is... He it is who created what He wills by His command... The command belongs to God entirely aforetime and hereafter... Praise be Him to Whom prostrate those in the heavens and earth and whatsoever lies between them.

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: He Who is the Eternal Truth hath appeared. He verily is the Promised One whose advent the scriptures of the past have heralded. Blessed are they that have believed in Him and woe betide such as have turned away. The Lord of all being hath come, and sovereignty belongeth unto God, the All-Compelling, the Self-Subsisting.

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: In every atom the signs of His craftsmanship are perfect - an eye is needed to behold them and a perceptive faculty to comprehend them. Thy power maketh dust to become as the sun and earth to become as heaven. Whatever cometh from Thee is the desire of hearts and the beloved of souls. Thou art the Mighty, the Powerful.

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: Glorified be He Who originateth what He willeth by His command Be! and it is! Such is God, your Lord. His is the creation and the command. There is no God but He, the Mighty, the Beloved. Say: Who created the heavens and the earth and whatsoever lieth between them by His command quicker than saying unto it Be! and it is?

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: He is the One Who createth whatsoever He willeth through His command Be, and it is. He is the One before Whom bow down in adoration all that are in the heavens and all that are on earth, and unto Him shall all return. Say: He is the Subduer over His servants, and He, verily, is the One, the Dominant, the Self-Subsisting.

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: Verily Thou art powerful over whatsoever Thou willest. The calumnies of Thy servants harm Thee not, nor do the descriptions of Thy creatures profit Thee. Thou doest what Thou willest through Thy power and ordainest what Thou desirest through Thy will. There is no God but Thee, the Powerful, the Mighty, the All-Choosing.

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: The Command is in His hand and wealth is in the grasp of His power. Fleeting riches became the cause of everlasting mention. By the Sun of Truth! The profit is with thee and the loss with the taker. Verily thy Lord is the Powerful, the All-Choosing. He changes the Command as He pleaseth, and He is the Mighty, the Bestower.

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: God beareth witness that there is no God but Him. His is the creation and the command. He giveth life and causeth death, then causeth death and giveth life, and He is the Ever-Living Who dieth not. Within His grasp is the kingdom of all things. He createth what He willeth by His command. Verily, He hath power over all things.

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: The verses descend from the heaven of the Will of God, glorified be His majesty, like unto torrential rain [...] From the sealed nectar they were debarred. The verses from the heaven of God's will, glorified be His majesty, have rained down like torrential rain upon the people of Iran from the first arrival in Iraq until now.

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: Thine is the might and the justice, Thine the similitude and parables, Thine the station and majesty, Thine the glory and invincibility, Thine the power and exaltation, Thine the joy and gladness, Thine the sovereignty and dominion, and Thine is whatsoever Thou hast loved or wilt love in the kingdom of Thy Cause and creation.

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: He is the One Who createth whatsoever He willeth by His command Be! and it is. He is the One before Whom prostrateth whosoever is in the heavens and whosoever is on earth, and unto God shall all be raised. He is the Truth, there is no God but Him. He giveth life and causeth death, and verily He is the guardian over all things.

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: He is the One Who createth whatsoever He willeth through His command Be, and it is. He it is Who createth what He pleaseth by His command, and unto Him shall all be raised. He is the Subduer over His servants, and He is the Self-Subsisting, the Supreme. He is manifest above His creation, and He is the Mighty, the Best-Beloved.

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: I testify that Thou art exalted above all mention and sanctified from what minds and thoughts can comprehend. Verily Thou art the One with power over whatsoever Thou willest. Thou givest to whomsoever Thou pleasest whatsoever Thou desirest. There is no God but Thee, the Single, the Self-Subsisting, the Mighty, the All-Praised.

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: This is the Day wherein if one desireth to gain ascendancy over all who are in the heavens and on earth, he would be empowered through My Name, the All-Subduing, the Powerful, the All-Knowing. And should any soul desire to encompass all created things, he would be enabled through My Command, the Almighty, the All-Encompassing.

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: Verily God hath sent it down through His power from His presence, and men are unable to produce its like, even as similitude unto similitude, let alone as a likeness. And verily thy Lord shall bestow upon thee on the Day of Resurrection the decree of truth upon all, from His presence, according to truth, by the truth, exalted.

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: Verily, Thou hast power to do what Thou willest through Thy command Be, and it is. Glorified be He before Whom bow down in worship all who are in the heavens and all who are on earth, and unto Him shall all return. This is God, your Lord. His is the creation and the command. There is no God but Him, the Mighty, the Best-Beloved.

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: By God! One verse from thy Lord, the All-Merciful, equaleth not the treasuries of all creation - thus hath the Tongue of Grandeur spoken as a grace from Him. He is verily the All-Forgiving, the All-Merciful... Verily He doeth what He willeth and ordaineth what He pleaseth. There is no God but Him, the Almighty, the All-Powerful.

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: Not a leaf doth fall, nor is there a mountain immovable, nor a drop in the ocean, nor a speck of dust upon the earth, nor a revolution in the heavens, nor a stroke of the pen, nor a sign in the spirits, nor a token in the hearts, save that they bear witness unto it, recognize it, and are, by God's leave, subject to its dominion.

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: The necks of all created beings have bowed before the manifestations of Thy power... Every king hath prostrated himself at the revelation of Thy might, and every prince hath been humbled before the evidences of Thy greatness. Verily Thou art the Almighty over whatsoever Thou willest, and in Thy grasp are the reins of all things.

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: Thou createst what Thou willest by Thy command. Verily, Thou art powerful over what Thou willest. Verily, Thou givest life and causest death, then causest death and givest life, and verily Thou art the Ever-Living Who dieth not, and the King Who passeth not away, and the Just Who wrongeth not, and the Sovereign Who changeth not.

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: Glory and dominion are His, power and divinity are His, grandeur and the ruby are His! He giveth life and causeth death; then He causeth death and giveth life. He is the Living One Who dieth not. Within His grasp is the dominion of all things. He createth what He willeth through His command; verily, He hath power over all things.

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: Thou art the One described through Thy primacy, and known through Thy finality, for Thou art described by Thy Self and known by Thy Self. Verily Thou art the Magnificent One of the heavens and the earth and whatsoever lieth between them. Thou givest magnificence to whom Thou willest and takest it away from whomsoever Thou willest.

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: Glorified be He by Whose leave all things operate in the kingdom of the heavens and the earth and whatsoever is between them, and unto Him shall all return. And unto God prostrate themselves all who are in the heavens and who are on earth; we are all prostrate before Him. Such is God, your Lord. His is the creation and the command.

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: Nothing escapeth Thy knowledge in the heavens or on earth or in what lieth between them. Thou art in truth the All-Knowing, possessed of might and majesty. Nothing can frustrate Thee in the kingdom of creation or command or in what lieth beneath them. Thou art indeed the Sovereign, the Almighty, possessed of sovereignty and power.

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: Fix your gaze upon the light of the Face of the One. Verily, He preserveth whom He willeth and ordaineth for whomsoever He desireth that which profiteth him in every world of His worlds. He, verily, is the Mighty, the Powerful. Soon shall the Hand of Divine Power seize the oppressors and polytheists and requite them for their deeds.

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: Glorified be He Who createth what He willeth through His command Be, and it is! He is the Creator of the heavens and the earth and whatsoever lieth between them, the Mighty, the Beloved. He is the One Who hath created all things by His command, and verily He is the Single One, the Inaccessible, the Most Exalted, the Self-Subsisting.

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: By Thy power Thou hast created all things according to a measure, and by Thy will Thou hast formed the creation of all things. Before Thee bow down in worship all who are in the heavens and the earth and whatsoever is between them, and all within the kingdom of command and creation and whatsoever is beneath them are devoted to Thee.

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: He is the One Who createth whatsoever He willeth through His command, and unto God shall all be turned. He is the One Who createth whatsoever He willeth through His command - Be! and it is. And He is the One Who ordereth the measures of all things in the Book by His command, and verily there is no God but He, the Mighty, the Beloved.

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: O Lord! Thou art the Generous One - all atoms testify to Thy generosity. Thou art the Merciful One - Thy mercy hath preceded all created things, and in the grasp of Thy Will is the control of all existence. Thou art He before Whose sovereignty and power all things bow down, and before Whose grandeur and majesty all necks are humbled.

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: Say: Verily thy Lord hath power over all things. He changeth whatsoever He willeth by His word, if thou be of those who understand. Say: O thou who associateth partners with God, dost thou imagine that He is powerless over anything, or that any matter among all that hath been created between the heavens and the earths can defeat Him?

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: To God belongeth the dominion of the heavens and the earth and whatsoever lieth between them; verily, we all shall return unto Him. He it is Who created all things by His command, and He is the Mighty Creator. To God belongeth the glory of the heavens and the earth and whatsoever lieth between them, and we all are guided by His glory.

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: Blessed is He in Whose grasp are the destinies of all things. He originateth what He willeth by His command, and God hath power over all things. God beareth witness that there is no God but Him. Within His grasp is the kingdom of might of the heavens and earth and whatsoever lieth between them, and God is possessed of tremendous might.

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: Hast thou not heard that He is not to be questioned concerning that which He doeth? Hast thou not read what hath been inscribed by the Most Exalted Pen upon the luminous leaf in the Most Exalted Paradise that He doeth whatsoever He willeth? Hast thou not heard His words, exalted be His remembrance: 'This is not the Day of questioning'?

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: God! There is no God but He, the Most Active, the Most Active! Say: God is the Most Active above every doer of deeds. None can withstand the sovereign might of His deeds, whether in the heavens or on earth or between them. He creates whatsoever He willeth by His command. Verily, He hath ever been the All-Doing, the Active, the Powerful.

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: In My Name, the All-Subduing over those on earth and in heaven... The Kingdom and the Dominion and the Grandeur and the Majesty belong unto God, the One, the Peerless, the All-Knowing, the All-Wise... Verily Thou art the All-Bountiful, the Generous, and within Thy grasp lieth the dominion of all who are in the heavens and on the earth.

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: O my Lord! Thou seest their humility in Thy Cause, their submissiveness at the appearance of Thy sovereignty, their turning toward Thy most exalted horizon, and their orientation toward Thy countenance after the passing away of all things. Verily, Thou art the Omnipotent over what Thou willest, and in Thy grasp is the Kingdom of Names.

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: Thou art the One beside Whom there was nothing, and Thou art the Creator with Whom nothing shares Thy station. Thou art the Most Exalted Who hath brought all things into being through Thy Will, and the Most High Who hast created all things through Thy Purpose, and the Most Inaccessible Who hast originated all things through Thy Decree.

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: He is the Subduer over His servants, and He is the Guardian, the Self-Subsisting. He is manifest above His creation, and He is the Mighty, the Beloved. Before Him prostrate all who are in the heavens and on earth, and verily He is the Mighty, the Beloved. He is the One Who createth whatsoever He willeth through His command Be, and it is.

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: Say: This is a proof that hath been made sovereign over all who are in the kingdom of the heavens and the earth and all that lieth between them, by God, the Lord of all worlds. Say: This is a proof that hath possessed all who are in the kingdom of the heavens and the earth and all that lieth between them, for God, the Lord of all worlds.

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: Glory and might and power and authority shall pass away, and the Cause shall remain with God alone, did ye but know. We have made the servants manifestations of Names that through them might appear that which befitteth this Day wherein the Desired One proclaimeth: The dominion belongeth unto God, the Powerful, the Forgiving, the Generous.

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: He is the Subduer over His servants, and He is the All-Compelling, the Self-Subsisting. He is the Manifest above His creation, and He is the Mighty, the Best-Beloved. Before Him prostrate all who are in the heavens and who are on earth, and unto Him do they bow down. He is the One Who createth what He willeth by His command Be! and it is.

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: Glorified be He Who knoweth what is in the heavens and what is on the earth. There is no God but Him, the Sovereign, the Almighty, the Great. He it is Who shall judge with truth on the Day of Separation, and there is no God but Him, the Peerless, the All-Compelling, the Inaccessible. He it is in Whose grasp lies the kingdom of all things.

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
