Quotation: He is God, exalted be His station, the Most Great, the All-Powerful... Who hath given strength unto His loved ones, bestowed power upon them, and made them the cause of unity, harmony and the reformation of the world. Through them He hath united the hearts of His servants and raised the banner of His victory and the standard of His might.

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: The Book of God hath been sent down in truth - verily it is a perspicuous Book. It proclaimeth: "There is none other God but Me, the Mighty, the Bountiful." The command is in God's hands - He ordaineth what He pleaseth. Verily He is the Almighty, the Powerful. Have ye not heard that He doeth what He willeth and ordaineth what He desireth?

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: He hath risen in His loftiness above all created things, Who hath elevated Himself in His exaltation above all atoms, Who hath made Himself inaccessible in His inaccessibility above all beings, Who hath shown His power in His omnipotence above all things, Who hath exercised His dominion over all who dwell in the kingdoms of earth and heaven

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: He it is Who createth what He willeth by His command, and unto Him is the ultimate return. He it is before Whom all who are in the heavens and earth do prostrate themselves, and verily He is the Truth, the Inaccessible, the Impregnable. Such is the Creator of the heavens and earth and whatsoever lieth between them, the Mighty, the All-Wise.

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: Verily Thou art powerful over what Thou willest and in Thy grasp are the reins of all things. Every tongue testifieth to Thy power, every eye to Thy might, and every heart to Thy greatness and choice. ... The power of the world and the might of the nations cannot frustrate Thee. Thou doest what Thou willest and ordainest what Thou pleasest.

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: By His sovereignty He doeth what He willeth, and by His command He ordaineth what He pleaseth. He is indeed the Single, the One, the Powerful, the Supreme, the Self-Subsisting. His penetrating Will and His all-encompassing Purpose have embraced all things. The armies of the world cannot frighten Him, nor can the clamor of nations dismay Him.

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: God testifieth that there is none other God but Him, the Almighty, the Self-Subsisting...Thou hast ever been the Sovereign of all names and their Ruler, and Thou wilt ever continue to be what Thou hast been from time immemorial. All things have testified to Thy power and might, and every possessor of a tongue to Thy greatness and sovereignty.

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: He it is Who createth what He pleaseth by His command, and God hath power over all things... Thou createst what Thou willest and originatest what Thou desirest. Nothing whatsoever escapeth Thy knowledge in the heavens or on earth, and nothing whatsoever in the kingdom of command or creation can frustrate Thee. Thou hast power over all things.

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: Thou hast ever been supreme over Thy creation and powerful over Thy servants...Thou art He Whom the might of the oppressors cannot frustrate and the ascendancy of the pharaohs cannot prevent. Thou doest what Thou willest and ordainest what Thou pleasest. Within the grasp of Thy power lieth the control of all who are in the heavens and on earth

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: He Who witnesseth concerning what He hath created, even as He did begin creation, and verily God hath knowledge of all things. He is the One Who createth what He willeth by His command, and unto God shall all return. He is the One before Whom prostrate themselves all who are in the heavens and who are on earth, and unto God shall all be turned.

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: Thou art He Who originated all things by Thy command and created all things for Thy wisdom and explained all things in Thy Book. Then Thou commanded all to recite Thy verses and follow Thy ordinances, that all atoms might quiver with the quivering of the signs of Thy might and all beings might shine with the radiance of the tokens of Thy power.

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: Thy glory, in itself, eclipseth all glory; Thy majesty, in its essence, eclipseth all majesty; Thy beauty, in its reality, eclipseth all beauty; Thy grandeur, as it is, eclipseth all things; Thy light, as it is, eclipseth all lights; Thy mercy, as it is, attracteth all things; and Thy words, as they are, eclipse all words in their very essence.

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: My pen and my tongue and my fingers and my inner self and my outer self and my hidden being and my heart and my liver and my spirit and my soul and my limbs and my faculties and my knowledge and my understanding and my hearing and my sight and my inmost heart testify to His grandeur and His sovereignty and His might and His power and His glory.

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: Say: God createth what He willeth through His command, and God taketh account of all things. Say: God is the Creator of all things, and God seeth all things. His is whatsoever dwelleth in the night and in the day, and verily He is the Single One, the Gracious. Say: He is the Subduer over His servants, and He is the Guardian, the Self-Subsisting.

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: Say: God is the Creator of all things, and He is the One, the All-Subduing. He is the One Who createth what He willeth by His command, and unto Him shall all return on the Day of Return. His are all that dwell in the night and in the day, and unto God shall all be raised. He it is Who giveth life and causeth death, and unto Him shall all return.

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: Thou art He Who art the Lord of grace and majesty, of bounty and action, of mercy and light, of grandeur and invincible might, of power and independence. Nothing escapeth Thy knowledge, nothing eludes Thy grasp, nothing is withheld from Thee, nothing is impossible before Thy power. Nothing is beyond Thy power, and naught can escape Thy dominion.

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: Thou hast ever created and wilt ever create as Thou willest whatsoever Thou willest, and Thou wilt ever exist to fashion as Thou desirest whatsoever Thou desirest for whatsoever Thou desirest. It is established with Thee, O my God, that shouldst Thou will a thing, none can frustrate Thy will, and verily Thou art the Almighty, the All-Compelling.

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: Say: Verily there is no God but I; all bow down before Him. He is the One before Whom prostrate all who are in the heavens and who are in the earth, and unto Him do all turn. He is the One Who sent all the Messengers together, and He is the One Who sent down the Books from heaven that you should worship none but Me; verily we are His worshippers.

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: The Kingdom belongeth unto God, the Lord of all return! When the call was raised, hearts were stirred with longing to hearken unto the verses of God, the Lord of lords. The Truth hath come, and on His right is the dominion of verses and on His left the kingdom of evidences, while before His face standeth the Manifestation of names and attributes.

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: Glorified be He and [...] He doeth whatsoever He willeth. Glorified and exalted is He! There is none other God but Him, the One, the Proud, the All-Compelling. I seek His forgiveness in the watches of the night and at the break of day, and I remember Him through that which hath been revealed in the Book. Verily, He is the King, the All-Forgiving.

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: By Him Who is the Great Announcement! The All-Merciful is come invested with undoubted sovereignty. Say: Whether ye rejoice or whether ye burst for fury, the heavens are cleft asunder, and God hath come down, invested with radiant sovereignty. All created things are heard exclaiming: The Kingdom is God's, the Almighty, the All-Knowing, the All-Wise.

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: He hath revealed that which was concealed and manifested that which was hidden. Through one exalted Word, He hath unveiled before the possessors of justice and fairness the veils of hearts and breasts and the treachery of souls and eyes. Verily, He is the One with power over whatsoever He willeth and desireth, and He is the Mighty, the Praiseworthy.

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: He it is Who ordaineth the measure of all things in the Book, and verily there is no God but Him, the Most Great, the Most Exalted. He createth whatsoever He willeth through His command, and unto Him shall all return on the Day of Reckoning. He is the Creator of the heavens and the earth and whatsoever lieth between them, the Mighty, the All-Bountiful.

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: Otherwise, by Him Who has caused Beauty to speak through the Spirit, all holy letters and intimate words are in danger of destruction, save those whom God protects through the power of His most-giving bounty and preserves through the might of His [divine] glory. And verily He is the Truth, there is no God but Him, most gracious and bountiful with truth.

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: Praise befits and is worthy of the Lord of Eternity Who, by His Pen alone, has conquered the world and its peoples, and Who, severed from all acknowledgement or denial, has raised high the banner of the Chosen Name before all faces through His complete power. The clamor of the oppressors and the tumult of the aggressors did not deter Him from His purpose.

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: Say: God is the God of the first and the last if ye but knew. Say: God is the God of the seen and the unseen. Say: God is the Lord of the first and the last. Say: God is the Beloved of the first and the last. Say: God is the Sovereign of the first and the last. Say: God is the King of the first and the last. Say: God is the Master of the first and the last.

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: Verily, He Who hath given will give again, for He is the All-Powerful, the All-Bountiful...Doth not the Kingdom belong to Him? Doth He not hold within His grasp the reins of all existence? Every created thing beareth witness to His sovereignty, His grandeur, His might and His power. He, verily, is the All-Conquering, the Almighty, the All-Knowing, the All-Wise.

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: He is God, there is no God but Him, the Mighty, the Beloved. Say: He is the First before all things, and the Last after all things, and the Manifest above all things, and the Powerful over all things, and the Dominant over all things. Nothing comprehendeth Him, yet He comprehendeth all things, and all are within His grasp, and all before Him bow down in worship.

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: Thou art He who from everlasting hath, through the potency of His will, been all-powerful, and will continue to remain the same for ever and ever. Thou art, verily, the All-Glorious, the Most High. No God is there but Thee, the Most Powerful, the Most Exalted, the Help in Peril, the Most Great, the One Being, the Incomparable, the All-Glorious, the Unrestrained.

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: Through Him were the idols of vain imaginings shatteredÃ¢â‚¬â€exalted be His might and His sovereignty! Though all the world rose up in opposition, He, through the Criterion, separated truth from falsehood, establishing truth in the most exalted station and consigning falsehood to the nethermost fire. Again, exalted be His might, His power and His sovereignty!

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: O Lord! The tongue of my tongue and the heart of my heart and the spirit of my spirit and my outward and inmost beings bear witness to Thy unity and Thy oneness, Thy power and Thine omnipotence, Thy grandeur and Thy sovereignty, and attest Thy glory, loftiness and authority. The powers of earth can never frustrate Thee, nor can the might of the nations alarm Thee.

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: Glorified be He in Whose grasp lies the Kingdom of the sublimity of the heavens and the earth and whatsoever is between them! Therefore sanctify ye God in the True Faith with a mighty sanctification. Glorified be He in Whose grasp lies the Kingdom of the dominion of the heavens and the earth! Therefore sanctify ye God in the True Faith with a mighty sanctification.

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: Glory and splendor be upon those who have stood firm in His Cause, spoken His praise, attained to hearkening to His call, turned to the horizon of His grace and drawn near to the ocean of His Most Great Name. Praise be to God Who has distinguished between creation through the Most Exalted Word, whereby the imaginary has ebbed and the seas of knowledge have surged.

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: He is God, exalted be His station, the Greatness and the Power! Praise be befitting and worthy of the Lord of existence and the Sovereign of the seen and unseen, Who through His glorious Name opened the gates of mercy and prosperity to all the peoples of the world, and taught and guided all to that which is the cause of the Most Great Guidance and the Supreme Gift.

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: He it is Who hath caused the clouds to be subdued and the rain to pour forth from the heavens, and Who hath split asunder the tongue of dawn through His firm and mighty command. Say: Verily He is the One Who calleth unto Himself between the heavens and the earth, and neither the harm of those who have disbelieved nor the might of the polytheists hath deterred Him.

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: None can prevent the influence of the Most Exalted Word and the Supreme Pen. By a power and might hath the Cause been made manifest, the like of which the essence of creation hath never witnessed. Verily, there is no power save His power and no sovereignty save His sovereignty. He is the Single, the One, the Mighty, the All-Conquering, the Commander, the All-Wise.

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: O Fath-'Ali, upon him be the mercy of God, He the Mighty, the Supreme, the Self-Subsisting! O beloved one, hear what God calleth thee to from this Tree which hath been raised up in truth, and sing that verily He is God, the Mighty, the Beauteous. Bear thou witness within thyself that He is God, there is none other God but Him, the Powerful, the Mighty, the Exalted.

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: We testify that He is truly powerful over whatsoever He willeth. There is no God but Him, the Able, the Ruler, the Mighty, the Wise. The heedless servants in power and [...] The people do not reflect upon the power of God. At all times manifest signs and clear evidences appear, yet they remain unaware and have not raised their heads from the slumber of heedlessness.

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: Unto God belongeth the kingdom of the heavens and the earth and whatsoever lieth between them, and God is possessed of supreme sovereignty. Unto God belongeth all might, which He bestoweth upon whomsoever He willeth of His servants; verily He is possessed of mighty glory. Unto God belongeth all command, both before and after, and God is possessed of wondrous command.

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: Say: God is supreme over His servants, and He is the Mighty, the Well-Beloved. Say: God is manifest in the kingdom of the heavens and of the earth and whatsoever is between them, and unto Him shall all return. Glorified be He in Whose grasp is the kingdom of might of the heavens and of the earth and of whatsoever is between them, and He is the Well-Beloved, the Mighty.

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: He is God, exalted be His glory, the Majesty and the Power! The servant beareth witness to the oneness and singleness of God, to His grandeur and His might, that He is the First and the Last, the Manifest and the Hidden, and He is established upon the throne of utterance, speaking that which profiteth the peoples of all religions. He, verily, is the Mighty, the Bountiful.

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: This is God, your Lord. His is the creation and the command. Say: All are submissive unto Him. Thus doth God create whatsoever He willeth through His command. Verily, He is the Mighty, the Beloved. Say: He is the All-Compelling above His servants, and He is the Supreme, the All-Glorious. He is the Most Manifest above His creation, and He is the All-Powerful, the Most Holy.

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: Unto God belong the dominions of the heavens and of the earth and of whatsoever is between them. All are within His grasp, and all shall return unto Him. Say: His is the creation and the command, both before and after, and unto God shall all be raised. Unto God belong the keys of the heavens and of the earth and of whatsoever is between them, and unto God shall all return.

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: He createth whatsoever He willeth, and He, verily, is powerful over all things. Say: All matters lie within the grasp of His Will, and all names stand in awe of His might. He raiseth up whatsoever He willeth through His command, and bringeth down whatsoever He desireth through His authority. He shall not be questioned of His doings, and He, verily, encompasseth all things.

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: He is the One Who originateth what He willeth through His command Be, and it is. He is the One Who giveth life and causeth death, and unto Him do all return. Such is God, your Lord. His is the creation and the command. There is no God but Him, the Mighty, the Beloved. His is whatsoever is in the heavens and on earth and what lieth between them. Say: All are His worshippers.

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: The ranks of those who would prevent it held Him not back, nor did thousands deter Him from exercising His power. The armies of the world cannot compare with the power of the Most Exalted Word, nor can the might of nations prevent the scratching of the Supreme Pen. He doeth what He willeth and ordaineth what He pleaseth. He is the Almighty, the All-Glorious, the All-Praised.

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: ...first we say that this inability exists in contingent beings, but God has power over all things. He transforms whatever He wills - if He wishes to turn all the gold of the world into copper, He is able and empowered. And if He wills, He creates the possibility of change in all things by His command, then changes it by His sovereignty, for He is the Omnipotent, the Powerful.

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: Before His manifestation in the realm of creation, His love adorned all, for the cause of His existence was the blessed word I loved to be known. He came for recognition and appeared specifically for love, and existed for service to Him. He had no will of His own, being wholly dependent upon and suspended by the Will of God, and likewise His desire was subject to God's desire.

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: Within His grasp is the kingdom of all things. He aideth whom He willeth as He willeth, and He, verily, is the Almighty, the All-Powerful. Every possessor of power is powerless before the sovereignty of His might, and every possessor of knowledge is ignorant before His knowledge, and every possessor of wealth is poor before His gate which openeth upon the face of all creation.

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: Unto God belongeth all authority; He createth whatsoever He willeth by His command. He is the One God, Single, Self-Subsisting, the Ever-Living, the Self-Subsisting, the Eternal, the Everlasting, the Trustworthy. Unto God belongeth the standard of sovereignty in the kingdoms of the heavens and the earth and whatsoever lieth between them, and God is the guardian over all things.

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: Unto God belongeth the dominion of the heavens and of the earth and of whatsoever is between them. Say: All shall be raised unto Him. He it is before Whom prostrate themselves all who are in the heavens and on earth. Say: All shall turn unto Him. Unto God belongeth the dominion of the heavens and of the earth and of whatsoever is between them. Say: All shall turn over unto Him.

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: He it is Who createth what He pleaseth by His command, and unto Him shall be the return. He is the Fashioner of the heavens and of the earth and of whatsoever is between them, the Mighty, the Merciful. His is whatsoever dwelleth in the night and in the day, and He is the Mighty, the Well-Beloved. He it is Who createth what He pleaseth by His command, and unto Him shall all return.

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: By reason of His Beauty, shining forth from the horizon of the world with grandeur and power, the more opposition increased and trials multiplied, the more His sovereignty and dominion were enhanced. Should all who are in the heavens and on earth unite to prevent that which God hath willed, they would have no power nor could they prevail, and would find themselves utterly impotent.

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: He is the One Who was not prevented by earthly afflictions, nor was He held back by that which beseemeth Him by the tyranny of the people. He, verily, is powerful over whatsoever He willeth and mighty to do as He pleaseth. Thou art He from Whose knowledge nothing whatsoever escapeth and Who is never frustrated by anything. Thou doest as Thou pleasest and ordainest as Thou willest.

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: He it is Who hath created all things by His command, and unto Him shall all return. Such is the Creator of the heavens and the earth and whatsoever lieth between them, the Mighty, the Beloved. Glorified be He Who granteth dominion unto whomsoever He willeth over the kingdoms of the heavens and the earth and whatsoever lieth between them. God is indeed All-Encompassing, All-Knowing.

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: Thy manifestation in the realities of all things and the essences of all contingent beings is more evident than the mention of manifestation itself by itself. Verily the gates of attainment unto the station of Thy power are open without hindrance, and the vessels to the shore of Thy nearness are prepared on the path for whosoever's essence is empty of allusion and mention thereof.

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: Unto God belongeth the divine realm of the heavens and the earth and whatsoever is between them, and all act by His command. And unto God belongeth the realm of might of the heavens and the earth and whatsoever is between them, and all judge by His leave. And unto God belongeth the kingdom of the heavens and the earth and whatsoever is between them, and all shall be raised unto Him.

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: By Thy might and dominion which pervadeth the kingdom of earth and heaven! Were any one of Thy chosen ones and Thy messengers to contemplate the workings of Thy Most Exalted Pen, which is moved by the finger of Thy Will, and were to ponder its mysteries, its influences and all that proceedeth therefrom, he would be so perplexed as to find himself powerless to speak or give utterance

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: Did We not make the earth spread out for you in truth? And We made the heaven above you preserved at the center of the Throne. We have indeed created you by permission of God, the Ancient, possessor of glory, in truth, in stages. Did We not make the sea to surge? Did We not make the earth submissive that you might bring forth from it what you sow for yourselves from the Gate's bounty

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: Thou art He before the manifestation of Whose might the very essence of power hath bowed down and every possessor of strength hath submitted to the operations of Thy strength... Thou art He Whom the happenings of the world cannot frustrate, nor can the might of nations frighten. Thou doest what Thou willest through Thy sovereignty and ordainest what Thou pleasest through Thy command.

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: God testifieth that there is no God but Him. His is the Kingdom and the Dominion, then the Might and the Omnipotence, then the Power and the Divine Essence, then the Strength and the Ruby Essence, then the Sovereignty and the Human Kingdom. He giveth life and causeth death, then causeth death and giveth life. Verily He is the Ever-Living Who dieth not, and the King Who passeth not away.

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: He is the One Who createth what He willeth through His command Be! and it is. He is the Subduer over His servants, and He is the All-Subduing, the Self-Subsisting. His are all things that dwell in night and day, and He is the Mighty, the Best-Beloved. He createth what He willeth through His command Be! and it is. He is the Creator of the heavens and earth and all that lieth between them.

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: O Thou our Providence! Thou art the Haven of the wretched and the Refuge of the exiled. Thy grace and bounty are the cure of every ailment, and the banquet table of Thy favors is extended in days of need and abundance. Thou hast adorned the realm of existence with the splendors of Thy limitless grace and hast promoted the welfare of this endless universe through Thine infinite bestowals.

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: Thine is the Kingdom and the Dominion, Thine the Glory and the Might, Thine the Power and the Divinity, Thine the Strength and the Ruby. Thou givest life and causeth death, then causest death and givest life. Nothing escapeth Thy grasp, whether in the heavens or on earth or between them. Thou createst what Thou willest [...] Thou hast ever been All-Knowing, All-Powerful, and Omnipotent.

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: Verily, there is no God but I, the Almighty, the All-Powerful. Say: O people! Do ye behold for your Lord, the All-Merciful, any partner in sovereignty? By God! The Lord of Power hath appeared with His most great sovereignty, and nothing in the heavens or earth can withhold Him from that which He hath created. He sendeth down what He willeth by His command, and decreeth what He pleaseth.

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: Blessed is He Who hath in His grasp the hosts of the heavens and the earth and all that lieth between them. Verily, He is the All-Protecting over all things. Blessed is He, unto Whom belongeth whatsoever is in the heavens and whatsoever is in the earth, and all are submissive to Him. Blessed is He in Whose grasp is the dominion of the heavens and the earth and all that lieth between them.

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: Whatsoever God willeth, there is no power except through God in all the former scriptures. Say: Whatsoever God willeth, there is no power except through God in all the latter scriptures. Say: Whatsoever God willeth, there is no power except through God in the highest heavens and what lieth above them in the most exalted heights... Thus doth God create whatsoever He willeth by His command.

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: He createth what He willeth through His command Be, and it is. He is the All-Conquering One Who cannot be conquered, would ye but know it. He is the All-Compelling One Who cannot be hindered, would ye but believe it. He is the Almighty One Whom nothing can frustrate, would ye but be assured of it. He is the One Who standeth over every soul; within His grasp lieth the kingdom of all things.

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: We beseech Him, exalted be He, in this Day which cannot be compared with other days - before whose dawn ancient centuries and countless ages bowed down - by His manifestations, His signs, His evidences, the fragrances of His raiment, the revelations of His might, and the manifestations of His sovereignty, that He may reveal to us that which will aid us in achieving the Most Great Steadfastness

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: To this every atom of the universe beareth witness, and beyond it the inmates of the realms on high, they that occupy the most exalted seats, and whose names are remembered before the Throne of Glory. All else besides Him stand poor and desolate at His door, all are powerless before the greatness of His might, all are but slaves in His Kingdom. He is rich enough to dispense with all creatures.

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: Would it befit any seeker to turn unto Him Whom no purpose of mortal men can encompass, and unto Whose presence no understanding among the peoples can attain? I beseech Thee by the lights of the Sun of Thy Revelation and by that which Thou hast sent down from the heaven of Thy bounty... Thou art He Who knoweth what is in the breasts of Thy creatures and beholdeth what the people of Thy realm do.

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: He giveth life and causeth death, then causeth death and giveth life. And verily He is the Ever-Living Who dieth not, and the King Who passeth not away, and the Just Who wrongeth not, and the Sovereign Who changeth not, and the Single One from Whose grasp escapeth nothing in the heavens or on earth or between them. He createth what He willeth by His command. Verily, He hath power over all things.

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: Say: God is the Lord and all else is creation. Will ye not fear? Say: God is truth and all else is creation. Will ye not fear? Say: God is the God of all gods and what He hath created by His command. Will ye not remember? Say: God is the King of all things and verily all else is within His grasp. Will ye not worship? Say: God is the Sovereign of all things and verily all else are poor before God.

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: How lofty are the wondrous expressions of His sovereign might, before the faintest glimmer of which all that is in the heavens and earth hath been reduced to utter nothingness! And how exalted are the attributes of His all-pervading power, the most insignificant sign of which all creation, from beginning that hath no beginning to end that hath no end, hath been and will ever be powerless to know!

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: Thou, O my God, hast never ceased nor wilt Thou ever cease to exalt whomsoever Thou dost abase, for Thy riches are established throughout all the manifestations of Thy creation, and the power of Thy might holds dominion over every atom of all contingent being, and the independence of Thy sovereignty extends through the extension of Thy power over all that exists in the kingdom of earth and heaven.

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: Graciously inspire me, O my God, through Thy grace and bounty, Thy glory and majesty, and Thy dominion and grandeur, for no one mighty and all-knowing can I find beside Thee. Protect me, O my God, through the potency of Thy transcendent and all-sufficing glory and by the hosts of the heavens and the earth, inasmuch as in no one can I wholly place my trust but in Thee and no refuge is there but Thee.

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: Through the tracing of the Most Exalted Pen He rendered His Cause victorious and raised high the pavilion of "Verily there is none other God but Him" in the most exalted station. The might of princes could not prevent them, nor could the clamor of divines deprive them. Glorified be His grandeur, glorified be His power, glorified be His sovereignty, glorified be His proof, and exalted be His praise!

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: Glorified be He in Whose grasp is the Kingdom of the rubies of the heavens and the earth and whatsoever is between them. Glorified be He in Whose grasp is the Kingdom of the lights of the heavens and the earth and whatsoever is between them. Glorified be He in Whose grasp is the Kingdom of the essences of the heavens and the earth and whatsoever is between them. [continues with additional attributes]

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: But Baha'u'llah, with perfect stability and independence, raised high the banner of human unity in that prison of criminals, and with utmost power withstood the attacking factions. He sent detailed letters to all the kings, even dispatching a letter to Nasiri'd-Din Shah, writing in its address that a holy soul must sacrifice his life and hasten to the altar of martyrdom to deliver this letter to the Shah.

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: He is the One Who createth what He willeth through His command, and unto Him shall all return. He is the One Who hath created the heavens and the earth and whatsoever lieth between them through His command, and verily He is the Most High, the Most Great. He is the One before Whom prostrate all who are in the heavens and who are on the earth and whatsoever lieth between them, and unto Him shall all return.

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: He is the One dawning from His most exalted horizon... Who hath stood before all faces with power whereby the feet of princes and divines have slipped, and with a sovereignty that hath encompassed all who are in the heavens and on earth... Verily Thou art the Lord of Names and Creator of heaven, and in Thy grasp is the reins of all things. There is none other God but Thee, the Compassionate, the Generous.

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: He it is Who createth what He willeth by His command, and unto God shall all return. His is whatsoever dwelleth in the night and in the day, and He is the Mighty, the Beloved. He it is Who createth what He willeth by His command Be and it is. Say: He is the Subduer over His servants, and He is the Protector, the Self-Subsisting. Say: He is the Manifest above His creation, and He is the Mighty, the Beloved.

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: O Lord! Thou art He Whom the hosts of the world cannot frustrate, nor can the might of nations weaken. Thou art He before Whose Name the kingdom of names hath bowed down and to Whose face the Concourse on High hath prostrated itself. Thou ordainest what Thou willest for whom Thou willest, and deniest what Thou willest to whom Thou willest. There is none other God but Thee, the Single One, the All-Knowing.

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: Thou dost rule as Thou pleasest, through what Thou pleasest, for what Thou pleasest, for whom Thou pleasest, over whom Thou pleasest. Thou hast ever been and wilt ever be - Thy proof is manifest and cannot be hidden, and Thy sovereignty is triumphant and cannot be resisted. All Thy servants are poor at the threshold of Thy mercy and grace, and all are servants before the revelations of Thy gift and bounty.

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: Glorified be He in Whose grasp is the dominion of the lights of the heavens and the earth and whatsoever is between them! Glorified be He in Whose grasp is the dominion of the subtleties of the heavens and the earth and whatsoever is between them! Glorified be He in Whose grasp is the dominion of the love of the heavens and the earth and whatsoever is between them! [continues through multiple similar verses]

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: Verily thy Lord's grace hath encompassed the world and His mercy hath preceded the peoples. He is the Almighty, the Protector of all who are in the heavens and earths...Thou art the All-Bountiful, Whose bounty is attested by all created things and Whose power is witnessed by all contingent beings. Thou givest and withholdest. In Thy grasp are the reins of all existence and the control of the seen and unseen.

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: Thou dost ever give life and cause death, then cause death and give life, and verily Thou art the Ever-Living Who dieth not, the Sovereign Who passeth not away, the Just One Who wrongeth not, the Ruler Who changeth not, the Single One from Whose grasp nothing escapeth, whether in the heavens or on earth or between them. Thou createst what Thou willest by Thy command. Verily, Thou art powerful over all things.

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: All faces are humbled before the Ever-Living, the Self-Subsisting; all are submissive unto Him. Say: All voices are hushed before the All-Merciful; all are prostrate before Him. Say: The hosts of the seen and the unseen are gathered before God, the King, the Mighty, the Best-Beloved. Say: The whole earth is made subject to the One, the Peerless, from Whose grasp nothing can escape - the Living One Who dieth not.

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: Glorified art Thou, O Thou in Whose grasp are the reins of all beings and in Whose right hand are the destinies of all created things! O my Lord! Assist him with the hosts of the unseen, then raise him to such a station that the tongues of all created things will speak his praise and glorification. Verily Thou art the Omnipotent Whom neither the conditions of the world nor the signs of the nations can frustrate.

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: He is the Sovereign Whom the sovereignties of earth did not prevent from His purpose. Through them appeared the power of God and His sovereignty and the might of God and His grandeur. Thou art He Whom the manifestations of might and the revelations of power do not prevent. Every seeing one and every informed one testifieth that Thy power hath conquered the power of the world and Thy might hath seized the nations.

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: Glorified be He in Whose grasp lies the Kingdom of glorification of the heavens and of the earth and of whatsoever is between them. He is the One Who creates all things by His command, and God is knowing of all things. He is the One Who originates whatsoever He willeth by His command, and God is powerful over all things. To Him belongeth whatsoever dwelleth in the night and the day, and God encompasseth all things.

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: Praise, sanctified above the utterance of all peoples, befitteth the Lord of the worlds, Who through His Most Great Name hath taken possession of the cities of the hearts of them that are nigh unto Him and sincere in their love for Him. No earthly dominion can weaken this power, nor can the might of tyrants prevent it. His weakness is the sovereign lord of all strength, and His command prevaileth over all commands.

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: Know ye that if We raise Our voice, the whole of creation would be disrupted, and if We cause the outpourings of Our utterance to be stilled, all things would perish, and ye would become as lost ones. Be not dismayed or perturbed if the inhabitants of the cities of unbelief repudiate your claim and deny your testimony. No man can comprehend that which hath streamed forth from the ocean of divine grace in these days.

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: Thou seest my position [...] None but Thee can comprehend the knowledge thereof. Thou beholdest my seat, and verily Thou art in the Most Sublime, Most Great, Most Inaccessible, Most Glorious, Most Exalted Prospect. For whomsoever Thou hast created, Thou dost nurture, and Thou dost not annihilate due to the loftiness of Thy power and Thy independence. Yea, Thou dost transform whatsoever Thou willest as Thou pleasest.

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: He causes to die and then causes to die and gives life. Verily He is the Ever-Living Who dieth not, and the Sovereign Whose dominion passeth not away, and the Just One Who wrongeth not, and the Ruler Whose authority changeth not, and the Single One from Whose grasp nothing escapeth, whether in the heavens or on the earth or between them. He createth what He willeth by His command. Verily He hath power over all things.

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: His is the command and the creation, His the grandeur and the majesty. Verily He is the Lord of all names and the Creator of the heavens. There is no God but Him, the Omnipotent over His will. Within His grasp lie the reins of all who dwell in the kingdoms of earth and heaven, and in His right hand are all who abide in the dominion of command and creation. He is the Mighty, the Supreme, the Powerful, the All-Knowing.

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: Glorified be He Who createth whatsoever He willeth through His command, and unto Him is the journey's end. Let us place our trust in the Living God Who dieth not, and let us believe in the One God from Whose grasp nothing escapeth, whether in the heavens or on the earth or between them, and unto Him are all transformed. His are all things that dwell in the night and in the day, and verily He is the Mighty, the Beloved.

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: Thou knowest all things and hast power over all things, and nothing in the heavens or on earth can frustrate Thee...Thou givest sovereignty to whom Thou willest and takest it from whom Thou willest. Thou exaltest whom Thou willest through Thy mention of him and abasest whom Thou willest through Thy decree...Thou createst what Thou willest as Thou willest, and Thou bringest into being what Thou desirest as Thou desirest.

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: Verily Thou art powerful over whatsoever Thou willest. There is none other God but Thee, the All-Possessing, the Self-Subsisting. Thou hast ever been supreme over all names and powerful over all things. The ranks of the world cannot frustrate Thy will, nor the opposition of nations. Thou doest what Thou willest and ordainest what Thou desirest. Verily Thou art the Almighty, the Powerful, the All-Conquering, the Omnipotent.

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: He it is unto Whom boweth down in adoration whatsoever is in the heavens and whatsoever is in the earth, the All-Glorious, the Best-Beloved. Say: All are His submissive servants. Whosoever prostrateth himself before God, verily what God hath ordained for him returneth unto him, and unto God is the end of all matters. His is whatsoever reposeth in the night and in the day, and He, verily, is the All-Glorious, the Best-Beloved.

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: Praise be to God Who hath by the exaltation of His Essence risen to such heights that all things have fallen beneath Him, and Who hath by the greatness of His Being ascended the throne of oneness before Whose countenance all things bow down - the One, the Single, the Eternal, the Unique, the Ever-Living, the Self-Subsisting, Who hath taken unto Himself neither consort nor son nor partner in might nor protector from abasement.

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: Thine is the sovereignty and Thine is the praise. Thou givest life and Thou causest death, then Thou causest death and givest life. Within Thy grasp is the kingdom of all things. Thou createst whatsoever Thou willest by Thy command. Thou art, verily, powerful over all things. O my God! Thy Will hath ever been dominant over all contingent things, and Thy Purpose manifest over all that dwell in the kingdoms of earth and heaven.

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: Thou art the Subduer Who cannot be subdued, and the Manifest Who cannot be manifested, and the Self-Subsisting Who cannot be approached, and the Beloved Who cannot be wronged, and the Sovereign Who cannot be resisted, and the Powerful Who cannot be rendered powerless, and the All-Knowing from Whose knowledge nothing escapeth. Thou createst what Thou pleasest by Thy command and bringest into being what Thou desirest by Thy will.

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: He is the Omnipotent over whatsoever He willeth. Neither the hosts of the world nor the might of nations can prevent Him. He is the One to Whose sovereignty every possessor of knowledge hath testified, and to Whose grandeur and majesty every possessor of power hath submitted, and before Whose loftiness and glory every possessor of greatness hath bowed down, and every possessor of exaltation before His manifestation and majesty.

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: Glorified be He in Whose grasp is the Kingdom of the sanctified realms of the heavens and the earth and whatsoever is between them! [repeated with variations] God beareth witness that there is no God but Him. Say: All are His servants and all stand humble before Him. Say: He is the Subduer over His servants, and He is the Guardian, the Self-Subsisting. Say: He is the Manifest above His creation, and He is the Mighty, the Beloved.

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: Glory be unto God, Who made the Perfect Power, the Source of the lights of knowledge, learning, books, scriptures and arts, to appear in the Hijaz - a place adorned with naught but rocks and thorny shrubs. Glorified be His grandeur, His power, His might and His sovereignty, that He made such a place the point of adoration for all who dwell on earth and in heaven, and likewise the Kaaba of the monotheists and those near unto God.

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: Thou createst what Thou willest by Thy command. Verily, Thou art powerful over all things. All stand by Thy command. Thou dost ever give life and cause death, then cause death and give life. Verily Thou art the Ever-living who dieth not, the Sovereign who passeth not away, the Just who wrongeth not, the King who changeth not, the Single One from whose grasp nothing escapeth, whether in the heavens or on the earth or between them.

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: The sovereignty of the Creator and Cherisher of all has always been everlasting and Divine kingship possesses an endless number of dominions and created things and for this sovereignty to be effective there must needs be mediators of His commands and prohibitions. Thus no one should limit the greatness and sovereignty of His august Self and we must never consider divine grace to be interrupted and ended or His bounty to be impeded.

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: Thou art the Creator of fire and light, Your power has ever dominated all atoms and Your will has ever been supreme over all contingent things. There is no power in any matter except through You, no glory in any matter except for You, no independence, no exaltation, no enjoyment, no majesty, no perfection, and no excellence except for Your Countenance, the sovereignty of Your Self-Subsistence, and the dominion of Your Unity's might.

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: God beareth witness that there is no God but Him, and that all else is but His creation, and all, in every condition, are His worshippers. God beareth witness that there is no God but Him. His is the creation and the command. He giveth life and causeth death, then causeth death and giveth life, and He, verily, is the Ever-Living Who dieth not. Within His grasp is the kingdom of all things. He createth what He pleaseth by His command.

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: Blessed is He to Whom belongeth the dominion of the heavens and the earth and whatsoever is between them, and unto God do all return. God giveth sovereignty to none save that they should prostrate themselves before Him Whom God shall manifest and be assured of His signs. Say: Your beginning is from God, if ye would see. Say: Your return is unto God, if ye would know. Say: In God's hands lie your ultimate return and your dwelling place.

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: God testifies that there is none other God but Him. He aids whomsoever He willeth through the hosts of wisdom and utterance. He is verily the Single, the One, Who created all things through a word from His presence and gave them glad tidings of this Revelation whereby the idols wailed and those in the heavens and earth were thunderstruck, save those whom the hand of divine power had seized. He is verily the Compassionate, the Generous.

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: The essence of praise and thanksgiving beseemeth the court of the Peerless One Who, through His consummate wisdom and perfect might, hath adorned diverse elements and varied forms with the garment of harmony and the ornament of unity and concord, Who hath spread the shade of the tree of His grace over those who have turned unto Him and who long for Him and seek Him, and hath opened the door of His bounty to all who come and who search.

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: God beareth witness that there is none other God but Him. Within His grasp is the Kingdom of the light of the heavens and the earth and whatsoever is between them. Within His grasp is the Kingdom of the right hand of the heavens and the earth and whatsoever is between them. Within His grasp is the Kingdom of dominion over the heavens and the earth and whatsoever is between them. This is God, your Lord. His is the creation and the command.

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: He is the Omnipotent One Whose Cause no denial of the world can hinder, and Whose accepted truth no rejecter among the nations can conceal. He rent asunder the veils of glory with the fingers of His will and removed the thick coverings through His pervading purpose, that every possessor of insight might be illumined by the effulgences of the light of the dawn of His revelation, and every possessor of hearing might hear and arise to serve.

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: Say: God hath power over all things. Not a thing escapeth His grasp, whether in the heavens or on the earth or between them, nor doth anything render Him powerless, whether in the kingdom of Command or Creation or whatsoever lieth beneath them. Nothing escapeth His knowledge in the kingdoms of the heavens or of the earth or of whatsoever lieth between them. He createth what He willeth by His command. Verily, He is the Powerful, the Mighty.

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: He it is at Whose call the Balance was established, and the Cock of the Throne crowed in the midmost heart of Paradise, and the Dove of the Cause warbled: The Kingdom is God's, the Lord of what was and what shall be. And at His call all things were attracted, and the fragrance of Revelation wafted between earth and heaven, and the ocean of bounty surged through the sovereignty of Names, whereby the Trumpet was blown and Mount Sinai trembled.

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: He it is unto Whom boweth down in adoration whatsoever is in the heavens and whatsoever is in the earth, and unto God shall all return. His is whatsoever reposeth in the night and the day, and verily He is the All-Glorious, the Best-Beloved. He it is Who createth what He willeth through His command, and unto God shall all return. Such is the Creator of the heavens and the earth and whatsoever is between them, the All-Glorious, the Best-Beloved.

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: Say: The Power of God is mightier in the kingdom of the heavens and the earth and whatsoever is between them than the power of all peoples. Say: The Sovereignty of God is more compelling in the kingdom of the heavens and the earth and whatsoever is between them than the sovereignty of all peoples. Say: The Dominion of God is more glorious in the kingdom of the heavens and the earth and whatsoever is between them than the dominion of all peoples.

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: Thine is the dominion and the kingdom, Thine the might and the power, Thine the strength and the divinity, Thine the grandeur and sovereignty, Thine the rule in the manifestations of creation and of the unseen. Thou art He Who hath possessed all kings through Thy power and hath taken possession of all sovereigns through Thy might, and hast ordered whatsoever is in the kingdoms of the heavens and earth and what lies between them through Thy wisdom.

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: He is the All-Compelling above His servants, and He is the All-Protecting, the Self-Subsisting. Say: He is the Manifest above His creation, and He is the Mighty, the Best-Beloved. He is the One before Whom prostrate themselves all who are in the heavens and all who are on earth, and unto Him shall all return. He it is Who hath sent down the Bayan wherein is detailed all things, a guidance and remembrance for those who ponder the signs of their Lord.

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: To God belong the hosts of the heavens and the earth and whatsoever lieth between them. He aideth whom He willeth through His command. Verily, He is the Mighty, the All-Wise. His is whatsoever dwelleth in the night and in the day, and verily He is the One, the Inaccessible, the Impregnable. Say: He is the Almighty over all things, and unto Him shall all be turned. Say: He is the Powerful over His servants, and He is the Supreme, the Self-Subsisting.

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: God hath testified by His Own Self unto His Own Self in the glory of His sovereignty that there is none other God but Him. He giveth dominion to whom He willeth and taketh it from whom He willeth, and He, verily, is the Mighty, the Generous. Say: God is the Creator of all things, and He, verily, hath power over all things. In His hand is the dominion of all things and the empire of creation and command, and He, verily, is wise concerning all things.

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: He is the Supreme Ordainer, the All-Compelling. From Him proceed all sovereignty, all grandeur, all knowledge, all power, all contentment, all love, all nobility, all dominion, all possession, all exaltation, all precedence, all wonderment, all generosity, all bounty, and all bestowal, and such other lofty attributes and compelling evidences. Through them He hath filled His heavens and His earth, for there is no God but Him, the One, the All-Subduing.

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: Consider the power of God - by chance, after a short while, an Iranian Jewish person called Kalim goes to an Ottoman engraver requesting a gold seal to be made, and gives him text that should be inscribed on the seal. That text was brief and suspicious. The engraver goes to the Chief of Police and says: An Iranian Jewish physician came to me requesting a seal to be engraved with this text. This text aroused my suspicion so I brought it to you to examine.

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: Verily, Thou art, O my God, powerful over whatsoever Thou willest and, O my Beloved, mighty over whatsoever Thou desirest... for nothing can frustrate Thee, O my God, whether in the heavens or on earth or whatsoever lieth between them, and nothing can frustrate Thee, O my Beloved, whether in the kingdom of command or creation or whatsoever lieth between them. Verily, Thou hast encompassed all things in Thy knowledge and Thou art powerful over all things.

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: His is the praise and the glory, His the gratitude and the splendor, for He has confirmed His loved ones in their recognition, turning and certitude. The Day is His Day, and the Cause His Cause. Today through His Name the banner of "He doeth whatsoever He willeth" hath been raised, and through His remembrance the standard of "The Sovereign hath come and the Kingdom is God's" hath been unfurled before the faces of all parties, without veil or concealment.

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: O Thou Whose dominion prevaileth over all created things, O Thou Whose will is manifest above all existing things, O Thou Whose power ruleth over all who dwell in the kingdoms of earth and heaven, O Thou Whose decree is exalted above all beings, O Thou Whose permission is withheld from those who dwell in the kingdom of names and attributes, O Thou Who knoweth all things and witnesseth the creation of all things and hast power over whatsoever Thou willest

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: We have been with thee in thy rising up and thy sitting down, and in thy migration unto God, and We have accepted thy deeds and have ordained for thee in the heaven of Our command a station which none can comprehend save them who are endued with insight. Thus doth God make mention of such of His handmaidens as He pleaseth. There is none other God but Him. His is the creation and the command. He doeth what He willeth, and He is the Mighty, the All-Choosing.

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: God is He, exalted be His station in greatness and power. Praise be to God Who hath spoken the truth and called the people to the Supreme Horizon, the station wherein the Divine Lote Tree speaketh: "There is none other God but Him, the Single, the One, the Alone, the Self-Subsisting, Who hath taken neither partner nor counsellor unto Himself. He hath ever been in the heights of might and majesty, and will forever remain as He hath been from time immemorial."

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: He is the Creator of the heavens and of the earth and of whatsoever lieth between them, the Almighty, the Well-Beloved. Before Him boweth down in worship all who are in the heavens and all who are on earth, and unto Him do all return. He is the One Who createth whatsoever He willeth through His command Be, and it is. He is the Subduer over His servants, the Self-Subsisting, the All-Compelling. He is manifest above His creation, the Almighty, the Well-Beloved.

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: Say: All command is in God's hands. He createth what He willeth by His command, and with Him is the knowledge of the Book. He effaceth what He willeth and confirmeth what He pleaseth, and unto Him shall all return. To God belongeth the dominion of the heavens and the earth and whatsoever is between them. There is no God but He, the Mighty, the All-Bountiful. Blessed is He in Whose grasp is the kingdom of the heavens and the earth and all that is between them.

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: Say: Who hath more might than God in the kingdom of the heavens and of the earth and all that lieth between them, if ye would strengthen one another? Say: Whose will is more penetrating than God's in the kingdom of the heavens and of the earth and all that lieth between them, if ye would will by His leave? Say: Who hath more power than God in the kingdom of the heavens and of the earth and all that lieth between them, if ye would strive in the presence of God?

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: He is the One Who createth whatsoever He willeth through His command, and unto Him shall all return. He is the One before Whom prostrate all who are in the heavens and all who are on earth, and unto Him shall all return. His is whatsoever dwelleth in the night and in the day, and He, verily, is the Mighty, the Well-Beloved. He is the One Who created the heavens and the earth and whatsoever lieth between them by His command, and unto God must all matters return.

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: He is the Manifest above all who manifest! Now doth the Most Exalted Pen move in his remembrance from the Most Glorious Horizon. When We desired that creatures should dwell beneath its shade, We heard its cry and its trembling within itself, such that the foundations of all things were shaken and the pillars of existence were well-nigh overturned, and it was about to be uprooted, whereupon the hand of thy Lord's power, the Most High, the Most Great, held it firm.

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: Say: Verily God is the Owner of all things through truth, and ye possess through His command. Say: Verily God is the King of all things through truth, and ye possess through His grace. Say: Verily God is the Sovereign of all things through truth, and ye possess through His mercy. Say: Verily God is the Deity of all things through truth, and ye possess through His bounty. Say: Verily God is the Lord of all things through truth, and ye possess through His generosity.

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: His power is visible in all things, and His grace pervadeth and existeth in all. Through a single word from His sublime utterances the kingdom of utterance appeared and was adorned, and through a single will infinite worlds were manifested. Exalted be His grandeur, elevated be His power, and all-encompassing be His dominion! We testify that He is the One with power over whatsoever He willeth, and in His grasp are the reins of all who are in the heavens and on earth.

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: Glorified be He Who createth what He pleaseth by His command Be, and it is! Say: He is the Almighty over His servants, and He is the Protector, the Self-Subsisting. Glorified be He Who createth what He pleaseth by His command, and unto God shall all return. He it is before Whom prostrate themselves all who are in the heavens and who are on earth, and unto God shall all be turned.
