Say: He is the Almighty over His servants, and He is the Protector, the Self-Subsisting.

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: This is the creation through which Thy sovereignty is established over all atoms, Thy dominion over all contingent beings, the ascendancy of Thy power over all created things, the exaltation of Thy grandeur over all existing things, the elevation of the might of Thy singular sovereignty over all who dwell in the kingdoms of earth and heaven, and the brilliance of the splendor of the light of Thy countenance over all that exists in the kingdom of names and attributes.

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: Say: God will assuredly protect those who have believed in God and His signs from before them and from behind them and from above their heads and beneath their feet and from every direction that reacheth unto them, through the angels of the heavens and of the earth and of all that lieth between them. He, verily, is the Guardian over all things. Say: The whole matter resteth with God. He aideth whom He willeth through His command. He, verily, hath power over all things.

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: Allah is the Most Great! This is a station wherein every tongue of utterance falls short of His mention, and the Kingdom of Knowledge of His praise. This servant testifies that there is none other God but Him, acknowledging His oneness and confessing His sovereignty, His transcendence, His exaltation and His power - a testimony that neither the might of them that are in the world can prevent, nor the chains of those who have turned away from God, the Lord of all nations.

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: Sanctified art Thou, O my God, above all mention and praise, and exalted art Thou above every description and utterance. The tongues of the righteous fall short of offering due praise and commendation, and the wings of the people of mystery are powerless to ascend and attain. How can the fly of vain imaginings buzz around the sanctuary of the All-Bountiful, and how can the gnat of suspicions and thoughts soar to heights before which minds and understanding fall prostrate?

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: Blessed is He in Whose grasp is the splendor of the divine realm of the heavens and the earth and all that lieth between them, and God hath power over all things. Blessed is He in Whose grasp is the radiance of the dominion of the heavens and the earth and all that lieth between them, and God is witness over all things. Blessed is He in Whose grasp is the glory of the kingdom of the heavens and the earth and all that lieth between them, and God is guardian over all things.

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: All glory, then, to this Spirit in Whose presence standeth the Faithful Spirit, together with a company of God's chosen angels! Yet another fruit thereof hath disclosed that which captivated the heart of Muhammad, the Apostle of God, Who, carried away by the sweet accents of the Voice from high, ascended unto the Divine Lote-Tree and heard, proceeding from within the Tabernacle of majesty, the Voice of God speaking forth the mystery of My hallowed, My exalted and mighty Name.

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: Then He turned to the Friends and said, 'Have you heard the news? The mujtahids and the Consul have gathered ten to twenty thousand people round them to wage jihad against Us.' Then He addressed the double-faced men, 'Go and tell them by the one God, the Lord of all, I will send two men to drive them away, all the way to Kazimayn. If they are capable of accepting a challenge, let them come.' The two hurried away and repeated what they had heard. And do you know, they dispersed!

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: Although Abdul-Baha had striven to the utmost of his power in this praiseworthy Cause prior to the declaration of the war, and so much have we said and spoken in connection with the lines of conduct, but without the favor of God we are nothing, absolutely nothing. This brilliant victory and this remarkable protection are exclusively ascribed to the blessings of the Eternal BeautyÃ¢â‚¬â€may my spirit be a sacrifice to His friends!Ã¢â‚¬â€otherwise human power is absolutely impotent.

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: O God! Through Thee do we seek sufficiency, therefore make us sufficient. Through Thee do we seek protection, therefore protect us. Through Thee do we seek refuge, therefore grant us refuge. Through Thee do we seek preservation, therefore preserve us. Through Thee do we seek shelter, therefore shelter us. Through Thee do we seek victory, therefore grant us victory. Through Thee do we seek excellence, therefore make us excellent, from all that Thou lovest not for any of Thy loved ones.

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: How great His Cause and His sovereignty! How mighty His penetrating influence and His power, through Whose most sweet call the names hastened to their named ones, words to their meanings, lights to their dawning-point, verses to their source, utterances to their Book, and knowledge to its ocean! He is the Almighty, before the waves of Whose ocean of power might itself hath confessed its weakness, and before Whose manifestation of grandeur and sovereignty all names have acknowledged their impotence.

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: Glorified be He in Whose grasp lies the Kingdom of the glorifications of the heavens and the earth and whatsoever is between them! Glorified be He in Whose grasp lies the Kingdom of the ruby essences of the heavens and the earth and whatsoever is between them! Glorified be He in Whose grasp lies the Kingdom of the light of the heavens and the earth and whatsoever is between them! Glorified be He in Whose grasp lies the Kingdom of the guidance of the heavens and the earth and whatsoever is between them!

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: Within Thy grasp is the dominion of the heavens and earth and all that lieth between them. Thou bestowest sovereignty upon whomsoever Thou willest and withdraweth it from whomsoever Thou willest. Thou exaltest whomsoever Thou willest and abaseth whomsoever Thou willest. Thou enrichest whomsoever Thou willest and impoverisheth whomsoever Thou willest. Within Thy grasp lies the kingdom of all created things. Thou createst whatsoever Thou willest by Thy command. Verily, Thou art the All-Powerful Sovereign.

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: He is the Subduer over His servants, and He is the Protecting, the Self-Subsisting. He is the Manifest above His creation, and He is the Mighty, the Beloved. His is whatsoever dwelleth in the night and in the day, and verily He is the Single One, the Protecting, the Inaccessible, the Beloved. Say: God is the Creator of all things and we are His servants, and we have ever been prostrate before Him. Say: God createth what He willeth by His command, and verily He is the Single One, the Inaccessible, the August.

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: Unto God belongeth dominion over the heavens and the earth and whatsoever lieth between them, and God is a mighty Sovereign. Unto God belongeth all authority; He createth what He willeth through His command, and God is a mighty Creator. Unto God belongeth all authority; He createth what He willeth by His command, and God is possessed of wondrous command. Unto God belongeth sovereignty in the kingdom of the heavens and the earth and whatsoever lieth between them, and God possesseth mighty and true sovereignty.

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: Although the policy of Sul?an 'Abdu'l-?amid was harsher than ever; although he constantly insisted on his Captive's strict confinementÃ¢â‚¬â€still, the Blessed Beauty now lived, as everyone knows, with all power and glory. Friends from everywhere presented themselves and gained an audience. The people and the government authorities witnessed it all, yet no one so much as breathed a word. And this is one of Baha'u'llah's greatest miracles: that He, a captive, surrounded Himself with panoply and He wielded power.

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: He is the One with such might that the opposition of the world could not weaken Him, nor could the bullets of nations deter Him from His Cause. Upon every mountain His banner of manifestation is planted, and upon every standard His ensign of power is raised. He is the Almighty One Who, through His perfect power, hath opened the way of He doeth whatsoever He willeth and demonstrated it to all peoples. Power and dominion appear and stand firm through His will, independent of all worldly means and those within them.

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: His command is nearer than Be, and it is! Blessed is He in Whose grasp is the dominion of glory of the heavens and the earth and all that lieth between them. Say: All derive their might from His might. Glorified is He in Whose grasp is the dominion of the creation of the heavens and the earth and all that lieth between them. Say: All shall return unto Him. Glorified is He in Whose grasp is the dominion of majesty of the heavens and the earth and all that lieth between them, and He, verily, is the Creator, the Loving.

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: But in this Divine Day, this heavenly age, this cycle of the All-Merciful, no one uttered such words. All peoples and nations - Turks, Europeans, Tajiks, Americans and Africans - testified to the greatness and majesty of the Divine Manifestation. At most, they only denied His truth and manifestation. Today in all the world's papers and journals, civilized nations testify to the greatness of the Blessed Beauty. See then how the power and might of the Word of God has influenced the veins and nerves of the world's body!

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: Thou art the Subduer Who cannot be subdued, and the Manifest Who cannot be manifested, and the Possessor Who cannot be possessed, and the Sovereign Who cannot be resisted, and the Creator Who cannot be created, and the Provider Who cannot be provided for, and the Living Who dieth not, and the King Who changeth not, and the Sovereign Who passeth not away, and the All-Knowing from Whose knowledge nothing escapeth, and the All-Powerful Whom nothing rendereth powerless, and the Self-Sufficient before Whose door all are poor.

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: Glorified art Thou, O my God! Verily Thou art the Creator of negation and affirmation, the Sovereign of fire and light, and the King of evanescence and eternity. Thou hast willed to cause this to pass away and that to endure, to restore from this or bring that into being, to abase this and exalt that, to humble this and glorify that, to lower this and elevate that, to rend this asunder from every fire and to bestow upon that every light. How sublime, O my God, is Thy power, and how penetrating, O my Beloved, is Thy Will!

Subject: power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/power and sovereignty of God; omnipotence of God.txt
Quotation: He hath risen with the sublimity of His Most Holy Sovereign Lordship above all essences, and is even as He hath ever been and shall forever be - the One God, Single, Self-Subsisting, Living, Self-Sustaining, the Ever-Enduring God. He hath taken unto Himself neither consort nor son. Verily He shall forever remain as He hath been - the Eternal Divine One, the Everlasting Lord, the Perpetual Sovereign, the Praiseworthy Master, the Manifest Subduer, the All-Knowing Judge, the One, the Single, the Self-Sustaining, the Supreme.

Quotation: Not all grandeur is His grandeur, nor all power His power, nor all remembrance His remembrance, nor all deeds His deeds, nor all bowing down His bowing down, nor all prostration His prostration, nor all devotion His devotion, nor all nobility His nobility, nor all lofty lineage His lineage, nor all exalted rank His rank, nor all utterance His utterance, nor all light His light, nor all names His name. For all these things and all that ye have known and comprehended were created by His word Be, and it is. And if He so desired, He could cause all created things to come into being through a single word from His presence, for verily He hath power over all things and is the All-Powerful, the Almighty, the Omnipotent.

Quotation: After losing hope at this stage, they petitioned the Roman government through other powers saying that Our presence in Iraq, which borders Persia, was causing disturbance to their hearts and upheaval in the Persian realm. Since you have disappointed us in what we requested, let them reside elsewhere - what need is there for them to grace the border region? Again the Roman government refused...In any case, when mention was first made of my departure, the enemies rejoiced greatly. However, in accordance with the blessed verse "They desire to extinguish God's light with their mouths; but God will perfect His light, though the unbelievers are averse," God arranged matters such that their joy was transformed into grief and sorrow...And they plotted and God plotted, and God is the best of plotters.

Quotation: Say: God, my Lord, is the First of the First. Say: God, my Lord, is the Last of the Last. Say: God, my Lord, is the Most Manifest of the Manifest. Say: God, my Lord, is the Most Hidden of the Hidden. Say: God, my Lord, is the Lord of all worlds. This is a Tree the like of which God hath not created in all the worlds. This is a Tree for which God hath created no equal in all the worlds. This is a Tree for which God hath created no counterpart in all the worlds. This is a Tree for which God hath created no likeness in all the worlds. This is a Tree for which God hath created no peer in all the worlds. Thus doth God create what He pleaseth - verily He is the Mighty, the Wise. Thus doth God bring into being what He willeth - verily He is powerful over all things. Thus doth God create whom He pleaseth of His servants for whom He pleaseth - verily He hath power over all things.

Quotation: Sufficient unto us is God Who created us in the first instance; we are all submissive unto Him. Sufficient unto us is God Who sustaineth us at every moment through His mercy; verily, He is the Mighty, the Best-Beloved. Sufficient unto us is God Who causeth us to die and then quickeneth us through His mercy; verily, He is the Lord of exceeding bounty. Sufficient unto us is God Who aideth us at all times through His hosts; verily, He is the Mighty, the All-Wise. Sufficient unto us is God Who showereth upon us the wonders of His mercy; verily, He is the All-Embracing, the All-Knowing. Sufficient unto us is God Who ordereth all things through His mercy; verily, He is the Gracious unto us. Sufficient unto us is God Who preserveth us from before us and behind us, from our right hand and our left, from above our heads and beneath our feet by His command; verily, He is the Guardian over all things.

Quotation: The greatest power in this world for unity and for the federation of man is religious power. Political powers or the powers of diplomatists are unable to bring about this ideal condition. They cannot cause the hearts of men to love each other. The influence of science and arts is impotent to bring about this union in character which is beautiful and sublime. It is impossible, except by the power of Religion.

Quotation: Religious belief is one of the mightiest means for the development of civilization and of human character. Even at present we can observe that the uneducated among the followers of Christian denominations are true philosophers because of firmness in their religious beliefs. For they are adorned with such character and conduct that it would take our great philosophers many years of hardship, training and self-denial to achieve, whereas the common people of this sect are highly endowed with noble virtues and perfections.

Subject: power of faith; power of the spirit

Quotation: This can only be achieved through spiritual power, for it was spiritual power that, through the Messianic breath, made the Israelites renowned throughout the world. It was spiritual power that, in a brief time, raised the wandering Arab tribes from the depths of degradation to the zenith of heaven and made manifest their eternal glory. Were it not for spiritual power, how could the region of Hijaz have become the focal point of all horizons, and how could the barefooted Arab tribes have become the rulers of the world?

Subject: power of faith; power of the spirit

Quotation: The spirit has two modes of operation: one through instruments and means, that is, seeing through the eye, hearing through the ear, speaking through the tongue. Though these instruments are at work, it is the spirit that moves them. Though these powers appear through the body, they are through the power of the spirit. The other operation is without instruments, as in the world of dreams where one sees without eyes, hears without ears, speaks without tongue, and travels without moving the feet. All spiritual powers manifest without bodily means in the world of dreams. Thus it becomes evident that the spirit has two modes of operation: one through bodily instruments like eyes and ears and such, and one without instruments. Similarly, while the body is in the West, the spirit discovers conditions in the East and manages affairs there.

Its sovereignty has not been and will not be erased from the book of the world, and its power has not changed and will not change. In one respect it is the greatest mercy for creation, and in another it is supreme authority over the world of being. Blessed is he who attains unto it, its effects and its fruits!
