Subject: power of prayer
Quotation: We were seated upon Our seat when the servant who was present entered with thy letter and read it before the Wronged One. We heard it and have answered thee with verses before which all other verses have bowed down, and with an utterance around which every new and wondrous utterance doth circle.

Subject: power of prayer
Quotation: And then, your letter reached Me, and when I had read and learned of its contents, I repaired to the station and laid it before the face of our Lord, the Mighty, the All-Knowing. Thereupon the Tongue of Grandeur spoke that which diffused the fragrance of the All-Merciful throughout all creation.

Subject: power of prayer
Quotation: It beseemeth us, therefore, to embrace each other even as angels and circle round the Throne of God and spend the hours in celebration of His praise and glory. By spiritual circumambulation is meant mutual attachment, inner attraction, comfort to the hearts and the consuming fire of the love of God.

Subject: power of prayer
Quotation: I raise my suppliant hands in prayer to the Kingdom of Glory, beseeching by day and by night that heavenly blessings may descend upon you and that your Lord may assist you through the hosts of the Supreme Concourse, until ye become signs of guidance and lamps of righteousness, kindled and shining upon all.

Subject: power of prayer
Quotation: Glory be to Thee, O God of Paradise and the Garden, and Educator of all possibility! I beseech Thee by the manifestations of Thy sovereignty and the modes of Thy Self-Subsistence to preserve those who have turned to Thee from the evil of self and passion, and aid them in that which diffuseth the fragrance of Thy good-pleasure.

Subject: power of prayer
Quotation: God willing, drink at all times from the pure water of the Kawthar of the utterance of the Beloved of all possibility. Its intoxication is the cause of awareness and its taste is the taste of everlasting life. The Most Exalted Cup is before the faces of the people of creation. Blessed is he who drinks, and woe to the heedless!

Subject: power of prayer
Quotation: Throughout your lives ye toil to possess a small thing, yet on the Day of Resurrection ye believe not in Him Whom God shall make manifest, that He might establish the Cause over all the earth through your faith, nor doth it weigh heavily upon them or upon you in your veiling, and ye imagine that ye are possessed of understanding.

Subject: power of prayer
Quotation: This servant supposed that in the realm of education souls would be found who would somewhat comprehend what is intended in this Most Great Manifestation. Now it has become evident that even if a hundred thousand worlds should reach their end, the people still remain at the beginning, as if they had seen nothing and heard nothing.

Subject: power of prayer
Quotation: O my God, my God! Thou seest me ablaze with the fire of Thy love and thankful for the manifestations of Thy bounty. I beseech Thee by the mysteries treasured within the repository of Thy knowledge and the pearls concealed within the shells of the ocean of Thy bounty to aid me and Thy servants to diffuse Thy verses among Thy creatures.

Subject: power of prayer
Quotation: O esteemed one! I beseech Divine Glory to prepare for you a right course in your affairs, to ordain for you that which is best for you in this world and the next, and to make you a sign of His bounty among all peoples. Verily my Lord aids whomsoever He willeth in whatsoever He willeth. Verily my Lord is gracious to His sincere servants.

Subject: power of prayer
Quotation: Through these sensations, moreover, thy receptive capacity is increased: and the more capacious the container, the more copious its contents; the more vehement one's thirst, the sweeter in one's palate the outpouring bounty of the cloud. This is the mystery of supplication; this is the wisdom of praying for the fulfilment of one's needs.

Subject: power of prayer
Quotation: When I read and understood it, I approached the Praiseworthy Station and the Frequented Temple, the Station wherein naught is seen save God alone. When I presented myself, I laid before the Throne what was contained therein, and after this was completed, the Tongue of the All-Merciful spoke that which caused the Kingdom of utterance to quake

Subject: power of prayer
Quotation: One of these deeds is prayer, which hath been designated by the Bearer of divine mysteries as the ascension. Prayer is the ascension of the believer, He hath said. A hundred thousand effects and benefits lie hidden and concealed within it - nay, they are beyond counting. How great the indolence and injustice for man to forsake this ascension and attach himself to Qarun!

Subject: power of prayer
Quotation: When one supplicates to his Lord, turns unto Him and seeks Bounty from His Ocean, this supplication is by itself a light to his heart, an illumination to his sight, a life to his soul and an exaltation for his being...By these attractions, one's ability and capacity increase. When the vessel is widened the water increaseth, and when the thirst grows the bounty of the cloud becomes agreeable to the taste of man.

Subject: power of prayer
Quotation: God Himself beareth witness that were all who dwell on earth to discover the fragrance of but one word of the Divine utterances, all would become intoxicated and turn their faces toward the light of His countenance. Praise be to God that they have been set ablaze by the attraction of the Divine utterance. Nothing that is witnessed or beheld can compare with the heat of the love of God - to this beareth witness the Lord of all beings and the Sovereign of earth and heaven.

Subject: power of prayer
Quotation: whenever at midnight, I am awakened I repeat the formula "Verily God is the Deliverer" many, many times; as many times as I feel the need of it; then right next day a great confirmation is seen and experienced...That night I prayed all night and repeated the formula of "Verily God is the Deliverer"...Toward the twilight I slept. Suddenly I was awakened out of my sleep by the loud knocking at the door...The servant of the Consul said that, my master has arranged all the papers in regard to the land and wants to affix his signature before yourself.

Subject: power of the Manifestation of God
Quotation: The vibration of the Manifestation has set Mount Sinai in motion.

Subject: power of the Manifestation of God
Quotation: His light, His glory and His sovereignty over the dwellers of the heavens and earth

Subject: power of the Manifestation of God
Quotation: Before Him necks bowed down, heads were humbled, faces were subdued, and voices were hushed.

Subject: power of the Manifestation of God
Quotation: power of the Manifestation of God: "The Sun of Reality has risen and illumined the horizons."

Subject: power of the Manifestation of God
Quotation: An innate proof, and a command-based demonstration, and an evidence based on My luminous Beauty

Subject: power of the Manifestation of God
Quotation: The horizons of the hearts of the friends are illumined by the lights of the Luminary of Manifestation

Subject: power of the Manifestation of God
Quotation: He is of them who witnessed and beheld the greatest signs of their Lord...at Whose appearance the verses bowed down in submission.

Subject: power of the Manifestation of God
Quotation: Through the tongue of His own Manifestations He has given the glad-tidings of the appearance of the Most Great Name to all who are in the world

Subject: power of the Manifestation of God
Quotation: Verily the Cause is in the grasp of My power. We mention whomsoever We wish, as We wish, and We bestow upon whomsoever We desire what We desire.

Subject: power of the Manifestation of God
Quotation: He hath appeared in the temple of the Youth... around Him circle the Kingdom of God, and before Him march the hosts of the unseen in mighty array.

Subject: power of the Manifestation of God
Quotation: I beseech Thee, O my God, before Whose fear the limbs of all names have trembled, and before Whose might all who are in earth and heaven have been shaken.

Subject: power of the Manifestation of God
Quotation: Today the manifestation of grace makes an atom into a sun, and the radiance of the revelation of the lights of the Most Great Name makes a drop into an ocean.

Subject: power of the Manifestation of God
Quotation: Yet in all conditions the scratching of the Pen was heard and the Call was raised. The heedlessness of the world did not prevent the Ancient Beauty from His purpose

Subject: power of the Manifestation of God
Quotation: I am a lamp of the love of God and a star of truth and reconciliation...souls will be educated and arise to fulfill the divine teachings and spread the Spirit of God

Subject: power of the Manifestation of God
Quotation: He is the One through Whom the greatest panic appeared amongst mankind and the Lord of Destiny spoke forth: "There is none other God but Me, the Mighty, the Bestower."

Subject: power of the Manifestation of God
Quotation: The Light that shines within me can neither wax nor wane. Whatever I manifest is nothing more or less than the measure of the Divine glory which God has bidden me reveal.

Subject: power of the Manifestation of God
Quotation: All kinds of people were received by Him and they were in turn impressed with his knowledge and wisdom. Day and night, Baha'u'llah labored till new conditions were created.

Subject: power of the Manifestation of God
Quotation: I have summoned the people unto naught save Thy Lord and the Lord of the worlds, and for His love I have encountered that, the like of which the eyes of creation have not seen.

Subject: power of the Manifestation of God
Quotation: The entire world was brought from nothingness into being for this blessed Day, yet heedlessness and pride have prevented all from hearkening to the call of the Speaker on Sinai.

Subject: power of the Manifestation of God
Quotation: He is the One before Whom boweth down in adoration whatsoever is in the heavens and whatsoever is on earth, and verily He is the Ever-Living, the All-Compelling, the Best-Beloved.

Subject: power of the Manifestation of God
Quotation: He hath come with the truth, and through Him the pillars of polytheism have quaked, the edifice of unbelief hath been shaken, and the faces of those near unto God have been illumined.

Subject: power of the Manifestation of God
Quotation: Verily there is no God but Him, the Single, the One, the Powerful, the All-Knowing, the All-Wise...Verily Thou art God, there is no God but Thee, the Powerful, the Mighty, the All-Praised

Subject: power of the Manifestation of God
Quotation: He hath stood before the faces of the world and summoned all unto the All-Informed One...with a sovereignty that the hosts could not repel, with a might that the power of kings could not weaken

Subject: power of the Manifestation of God
Quotation: Know this for a certainty. The darkness will not be dispelled except through the light of Baha'o'llah, and this tribulation cannot be calmed save through the tranquility bestowed by Baha'o'llah.

Subject: power of the Manifestation of God
Quotation: I was seated when the Command of God raised Me up, and I was silent when He Who hath caused all things to speak forth the praise of His Self, the All-Subduing Lord of all horizons, gave Me utterance.

Subject: power of the Manifestation of God
Quotation: that My power and sovereignty might be made manifest to all who are in the heavens and on earth. He does what He pleases and ordains what He wills. He is the Single One, the One, the Just, the All-Wise.

Subject: power of the Manifestation of God
Quotation: By God, besides Whom there is none other God! Not a single atom moveth upon the earth save through the will and command of the Ancient Beauty, and nothing ever hath been or ever shall be hidden from Him.

Subject: power of the Manifestation of God
Quotation: In brief, I hold within My grasp whatsoever any man might wish of the good of this world and of the next. Were I to remove the veil, all would recognize Me as their Best Beloved, and no one would deny Me.

Subject: power of the Manifestation of God
Quotation: The ignorant said, 'Who is this individual; He has only a few disciples!' But those who knew said: 'He is the Sun who will shine in the East and West, He is the Manifestation who shall give life to the world'.

Subject: power of the Manifestation of God
Quotation: He has appeared in truth with a sovereignty that none can deny save those who have denied God and His chosen ones among the Prophets and Messengers... The Creator of all things hath come with mighty sovereignty.

Subject: power of the Manifestation of God
Quotation: The Blessed Beauty commanded that they must be found...They commanded it must be found...They commanded that the mukhtar be imprisoned...They commanded "Bring the mules - be under whoever's protection you want."

Subject: power of the Manifestation of God
Quotation: It would enter through every door and climb over every transgressor's wall. It would expose forbidden spying and melt the acceptable snow-capped mountains. It would dry up useless plants and wither rootless trees.

Subject: power of the Manifestation of God
Quotation: By Him Who speaketh within my breast! Were all who are in the heavens and earth to turn today unto God, He would teach them from the wonders of His knowledge that which would make them independent of all the worlds.

Subject: power of the Manifestation of God
Quotation: He hath created all things for His mention and praise... Him Who created all things by His binding, wise command... Him through Whom the decree of the appointed time was established between the heavens and the earth.

Subject: power of the Manifestation of God
Quotation: The pillars of the divines were shaken by this Youth, and the limbs of the peoples trembled at this Great Name. He spoke, while seated upon the Throne: "There is no God but I, the Most High, the Mighty, the Inaccessible."

Subject: power of the Manifestation of God
Quotation: For were that Ancient Beauty to appear and manifest Himself as He truly is, none would have the power to deny or turn away. Rather, all created things would be thunderstruck by beholding His lights, nay utterly annihilated.

Subject: power of the Manifestation of God
Quotation: By thy life! My Cause is more wondrous than the Cause of Muhammad. God hath raised Me up among those who cannot speak a fluent word of Arabic, much less recite verses from God whereby He proveth His Cause unto all the worlds.

Subject: power of the Manifestation of God
Quotation: In existence there is a sign which We have, in most of Our Tablets, designated as the Most Great Elixir. When this sign is found in any soul, all his movements and stillness exert influence in the world and are effective therein.

Subject: power of the Manifestation of God
Quotation: Through Whom the limbs of the world did tremble and the Concourse on High rejoiced at His coming...through Whom the countenance of all possibility did smile, and the trees swayed, and the seas surged, and the mountains took flight

Subject: power of the Manifestation of God
Quotation: With the hand of power and might, and with the firm support of sovereignty and dominion, He hath stood before all the monarchs, both high and low, never turning His blessed countenance aside. What matter could be greater than this?

Subject: power of the Manifestation of God
Quotation: The Will of God hath never been, nor shall it ever be, subject to the will of men. Verily, He holdeth not to your cord, nor followeth what ye possess. His is the Most Firm Handle and the Most Great, Most Mighty, Most Glorious Path.

Subject: power of the Manifestation of God
Quotation: He Who was treasured in knowledge and concealed from eyes and sight hath come... He hath appeared and made manifest whatsoever He desired with a power before which the power of all who are in the heavens and on earth hath proved impotent.

Subject: power of the Manifestation of God
Quotation: Know thou that if all who are in the heavens and on earth were to unite to cast into the firmament of His Cause all the arrows of doubt they possess, it would not even disturb a thread in that web of certitude that hath been woven by Him.

Subject: power of the Manifestation of God
Quotation: Thus have We informed thee, apprised thee, and caused thee to hear the call of this lonely Stranger. Arise at My leave and My call, then drink of the choice wine which floweth from the direction of the Throne through His name, the Mighty, the Generous.

Subject: power of the Manifestation of God
Quotation: His Holiness Baha'u'llah - may my soul be offered up for His friends - hath shone forth with such splendor that His graces are boundless. His Manifestation is lordly and its fruit is life everlasting. Its power is that of the breathings of the Holy Spirit.

Subject: power of the Manifestation of God
Quotation: The power of Baha'u'llah hath set the Occident and the Orient in motion. His proof is manifest as the sun and His evidence is manifest and clear, yet the bat fleeth the light of the sun and the beetle doth abhor the sweet scents wafting from the rose garden.

Subject: power of the Manifestation of God
Quotation: By My life! Whosoever has today attained the lights of the Face, the denizens of the Supreme Concourse make mention of him, and towards him turn the faces of those through whom the clouds pour down rain, the winds blow, and the earth brings forth its vegetation.

Subject: power of the Manifestation of God
Quotation: And yet another of His signs are the extraordinary things He continually did, the miracles He performed, the wonders appearing from Him without interruption like the streaming down of His clouds--and the acknowledgement, even by unbelievers, of His powerful light.

Subject: power of the Manifestation of God
Quotation: He through Whom all things were transformed hath come, and the Call hath been raised from the horizon of the Prison of 'Akka. Today from the wilderness the voice of the divine Lote-Tree is raised, proclaiming "He Who is the Lord of the Kingdom of Names hath come!"

Subject: power of the Manifestation of God
Quotation: All names return unto God and all similitudes end in God and everything begins from God and everything returns to God. This is what God shall manifest thereafter, and God shall establish through Him the Resurrection; therefore await Him, then be ye assured of Him.

Subject: power of the Manifestation of God
Quotation: Praise be to God that thou art mentioned in the nights and days, and the favor of the Truth is directed toward thee. The Wronged One beareth witness that thou hast attained unto that which was revealed from time immemorial in the Books of God, the Lord of the mighty Throne.

Subject: power of the Manifestation of God
Quotation: Banished the ways of evil-doers and chained up the hands of evil-plotters, The design of the world was renewed by the strength of His arm. How could the Friend [Abraham] have shattered the idols of the world, Had He not drawn His power from a single cry of His enrapturing Call?

Subject: power of the Manifestation of God
Quotation: Thou hast ever been, O my God, in the heights of power, might and majesty, and wilt ever remain in the exaltation of grandeur, glory and magnificence. All the Prophets are in fear of the manifestations of Thy wrath, and all the Chosen Ones are disturbed by the revelations of Thy dread.

Subject: power of the Manifestation of God
Quotation: The Most Holy, Most Exalted Being remained seated with such composure, dignity and calm that it was as if these surrounding people were not enemies but had all had come with acceptance and devotion to the Truth. God is Most Great in His grandeur, His glory, His tranquility and His power!

Subject: power of the Manifestation of God
Quotation: By My life! They are My glory, a glory wherewith God hath adorned His own Self. The shame I was made to bear hath uncovered the glory with which the whole of creation had been invested, and through the cruelties I have endured, the Day Star of Justice hath manifested itself, and shed its splendor upon men.

Subject: power of the Manifestation of God
Quotation: Whatever They decree in this station is identical with reality itself and must be attributed to God. All that They proclaim in this station is Divine revelation, all that They declare is heavenly inspiration, all that They prescribe is justice, all that They enjoin is the truth, and all that They choose is what is best.

Subject: power of the Manifestation of God
Quotation: This young man, Christ, through an extraordinary power, abrogated the ancient Mosaic Law and undertook to reform the general morals. He re-established eternal glory for Israel; nay, rather, He undertook the reformation of the entire human world and spread teachings that were not limited to Israel but established universal felicity for human society.

Subject: power of the Manifestation of God
Quotation: It is the same with the holy messengers when they have left the earth. Christ acts to-day without an intermediary. His expressions in the world are numerous. The divine teachers act more powerfully after the detachment of their souls from the body. In his time the Christ was not able to influence many people. Afterward his influence became widespread.

Subject: power of the Manifestation of God
Quotation: By God! He hath stood firm in the Cause in such wise that were anyone to ponder thereon, he would cast away all created things and hasten unto the All-Merciful... He stood between earth and heaven, and nodded His head, and winked His eye, and raised His brow, and caused His garment to shine forth, and raised His sleeve, and moved His lips, and gestured with His hand

Subject: power of the Manifestation of God
Quotation: Through Him was revealed that which was concealed, and the Ancient Beauty shone forth amidst the peoples... Through Him the fragrance of the All-Merciful wafted throughout creation, and the atoms cried out: "Power belongeth unto God, the Almighty, the Most High, the Omnipotent!" Through Him were the veils rent asunder and that which was inscribed on a preserved tablet was made manifest.

Subject: power of the Manifestation of God
Quotation: In brief, throughout all days We stood before the faces of the people and raised up the Cause of God to such a degree that both East and West of the earth heard and understood according to their capacity. In days when all were hidden in fear, this Wronged One appeared with utmost power and spoke with most eloquent utterance. Neither the arrows of destiny nor the swords of tribulation prevented Him.

Subject: power of the Manifestation of God
Quotation: Though He was a merchant, He confounded all the divines of Persia. Alone and unaided, He undertook a task that one cannot even imagine, for the Persians are known throughout the world for their religious fanaticism. This illustrious Being arose with such power that He shook to their foundations the customs, habits, morals, conditions and institutions of Persia, and established a new Law, Faith and Religion.

Subject: power of the Manifestation of God
Quotation: When He rose from Iraq, He caused a tumult throughout all regions and cast an illumined radiance upon all existence. Being was set in motion, contingent existence found joy, the realities of all things sought divine meanings, the atoms of creation found the divine Beloved, the East became the dawning-place of lights, and the West became the horizon of effulgence. Earth became heaven, and the dark soil became luminous.

Subject: power of the Manifestation of God
Quotation: God's Cause through His Proof is more wondrous than what God revealed through Muhammad, the Messenger of God, aforetime, would ye but reflect a little. God hath manifested His Proof from among those who could not speak in the tongue of the Arabs, and after twenty-four years of his life did God make him manifest, whereas aforetime it was after forty years, when God had nurtured him among those who spoke in the Arabic tongue.

Subject: power of the Manifestation of God
Quotation: Yet in spite of all difficulties, he was ever in an exalted state; his face shone continually. He had the presence of a king. One cannot imagine such majesty. One never thought of him as a prisoner - on the contrary, one would have said that he was enjoying the greatest triumph, for he drew his strength from divine power. Minds were exalted on beholding him, and Baha'o'llah never hid himself. He spoke courageously before all.

Subject: power of the Manifestation of God
Quotation: He paid no attention to the ministers and viziers. The Governor-in-Chief of Acca craved to be honored by admission to the presence of Baha'o'llah. For five years this one man, called Zia Pasha, asked Abdul-Baha if he would supplicate the Manifestation to permit him to make this visit, but the Manifestation never granted it. The Blessed Perfection was imprisoned, yet he had that power to refuse anything or to do anything he wished.

Subject: power of the Manifestation of God
Quotation: I said the concise and sufficient proof is that Baha'o'llah in such a prison as Acca, and when under chains, raised His banner. In Teheran He was in prison and under chains. In Acca he was in prison. Under these circumstances he raised it. When I mentioned this proof he became very silent. I said, 'Just one word more. There is nothing recorded comparable to this. What power is this that from the beginning of the world until today such a thing has not happened.'

Subject: power of the Manifestation of God
Quotation: Thou art the One from Whose knowledge nothing escapeth, and Thou hast encompassed all things with knowledge. Thou art the One through Whom all creation hath turned to God in the beginning, and through Whom all creation hath returned to God in the end. Through thee have all things, past and future, been brought into being. Is there anything not created through thy love, having been created before through thy manifestation and to be created after through thy concealment?

Subject: power of the Manifestation of God
Quotation: Praise be to God Who hath manifested His signs, made clear His evidences, raised His banners, exalted His words, and diffused His fragrances. Through this all-embracing outpouring, this perfect generosity, this all-encompassing mystery, and this resplendent light, He hath renewed the garment of existence, distinguished between the arrogant and those who prostrate themselves, opened the gates of bounty, bestowed the promised gift and the sweet waters that flow abundantly.

Subject: power of the Manifestation of God
Quotation: Thus have We opened the gate of the Kingdom of utterance with My finger, and I am, verily, the Powerful, the Mighty. Magnified is the All-Merciful Who hath, through His Most Exalted Word, attracted all who are in earth and heaven, and guided all through it on a Day wherein the foundations of the cities of names were shaken. He it is Who hath subdued all things through His Most Exalted Pen, and through it hath opened the door of reunion unto all who dwell in the kingdom of creation.

Subject: power of the Manifestation of God
Quotation: From this prison, from within its walls, He wrote epistles to all the kings. He summoned them to arbitration and the Most Great Peace. Baha'u'llah hoisted His banner within the walls of that prison. Refer to all history. It has no parallel! No such event has ever taken place before. That a stranger, alone and a prisoner, has succeeded in advancing His Cause, and been enabled to spread broadcast His Teachings, so that, eventually, He was powerful enough to conquer the very king who banished Him.

Subject: power of the Manifestation of God
Quotation: The Ancient Beauty and the Most Great Name has shone forth and radiated upon all the realms of creation and regions of existence with all names and attributes. He guided the lost ones to the path of guidance, directed the thirsty to the pure spring, the poor to the treasure of wealth, and guided the abased to the summit of glory, the ignorant to the ocean of knowledge, the heedless to the pure fountain of conscience, called the destitute to the flowing treasury, and delivered the helpless from suffering.

Subject: power of the Manifestation of God
Quotation: Having never attended school nor studied books of learning, through divine power and celestial might and glory, openly and without any veil, He summoned and guided the divines and rulers of the earth to the Dayspring of Revelation and the Dawning-Place of inspiration. O Jacob! The opposition of the world did not prevent the Most Great Name from proclamation, and the bullets of the peoples' factions did not hold Him back from His purpose. Every fair-minded one hath testified to His power and every person of insight hath become aware.

Subject: power of the Manifestation of God
Quotation: Among the conditions indicating his absolute prophethood are the traces of his self, whereto Abu Ja'far, peace be upon him, pointed in his words, saying gloriously: In the Messenger of God, peace be upon him and his family, were three qualities found in no other: He had no shadow, and when he walked a path, if one were to pass by it two days later [...] No created thing would pass by where He had been without recognizing that He had passed there by His sweet fragrance, and whenever He passed by a stone or a tree, it would prostrate before Him.

Subject: power of the Manifestation of God
Quotation: The Bearer of this mighty Message, this ancient Light, and this straight Path possesses a lofty and exalted lineage and sublime and elevated nobility. Their forebears and ancestors illumined the darkness of night until the string of pearls was perfectly arranged. This lineage has ever transferred from pure loins to pure wombs. How many treasures lie hidden in corners, how many most glorious concealed gems and precious unique jewels stored away! Nevertheless, His Cause is too great to be established through connection to others and too noble to be known through any but Him.

Subject: power of the Manifestation of God
Quotation: Consider then the educative power of Baha'u'llah, Who has illumined the dark East and transformed savage beasts into heavenly angels. He has made the ignorant knowing and turned predators into gazelles in the field of oneness. Those who by belief and custom were the enemies of all mankind are now, with utmost unity, friends and kind to all. From extreme ignorance they used to burn the Holy Book; now they expound the truths and mysteries of the Torah and Gospel. In a brief period He so educated them that under fetters and chains, and under threat of sword and blade, they would cry out "Ya Baha'u'l-Abha!" and would place sweet candy in their executioners' mouths that they might strike with sweetened lips.

Subject: power of the Manifestation of God
Quotation: Look then with the eye of insight and the vision of reality at the mighty cycles and ancient ages, that you may see the reality of the meanings of this blessed verse ["Lord of the two Easts and Lord of the two Wests"] personified and embodied, lifting every veil, removing every covering, with clear proof and evident explanation. For when you look at this mighty universe, you see their traces spread abroad, their lights diffused, their tokens manifest, their law widespread, their way renowned, their manifest religion encompassing all beings, their mighty light illuminating from the horizons of the heavens and earths. Their way is the most excellent, and their banners are those waving above the loftiest edifices. This is their radiance, their manifestation and their appearance from the horizon of horizons. Then look at the world of souls and spirits and hearts, that you may see how souls are inspired by their remembrance, at peace with their thought, content with their decree, well-pleased with their devotion, sanctified by their radiance, gladdened by their bestowal, illumined by their lights, receiving grace from the brilliance of their rays. And spirits are stirred by the breezes of their gardens, delighting in the bounties of their realities, rejoicing in the freshness of their meadows, gladdened by the fragrance of their thickets, made happy by the outpouring from their fountains. Hearts throb with love for them, tongues speak their praise. Consciousness is filled with spirit and fragrance by their sweet scents, and stays wakeful through nights and days by their gentle breezes. Beings receive grace from their outpourings, realities are purified by their manifestations, essences derive lights from their kindled fire, identities acquire mysteries from their abundant effusions. Faces beam, tongues rejoice, ears take delight, eyes are illumined, breasts are expanded - all this from their perfect outpourings and all-encompassing perfections.

Subject: power of the Manifestation of God
Quotation: At stated periods souls are sent to earth by the Mighty God with what we call 'the Power of the Great Ether.' And they who possess this power can do anything; they have all Power...  Jesus Christ had this power. The people though him a poor young man whom they had crucified but he possessed the power of the Holy Spirit; therefore he could not remain underground. This ethereal power arose and quickened the world. And now look to the Master, for this power is his.

Subject: power of the mind over nature
Quotation: Through the law of nature, man can perceive and conceive visible things and intervene therein, managing and directing them - those visible things that are before his eyes. Yet man is here, and beholds matters of East and West; he makes arrangements in America as if he were present there, managing and directing. This transcends nature. From principles he discovers results. This transcends the law of nature. The results are unknown, the principles are known, and from these principles he draws conclusions. All past matters lie beneath nature's veil, beneath nature's covering. He discovers events and realities from five thousand years ago, saying that by this sign and principle it was thus. This transcends nature, for these events and matters lie beneath nature's veil. Likewise with matters that have not yet emerged from nature's depths, events of which no trace has yet appeared - man deduces what results will emerge in the future.

Subject: power of the mind over nature
Quotation: I perceive that man is ruler over nature. Consider how all other phenomenal existence and beings are captives of nature. The sun, that colossal center of our solar system, the giant stars and planets, the towering mountains, the earth itself and its kingdoms of life lower than the human - all are captives of nature except man. No other created thing can deviate in the slightest degree from obedience to natural law. The sun in its glory and greatness millions of miles away is held prisoner in its orbit of universal revolution, captive of universal natural control.

Subject: power of the mind over nature
Quotation: Not a hair's breadth can nature transgress its own law. The sun cannot deviate from its orbital center, nor can the earth exceed its orbit. All these are subject to nature. Man, however, is the opposite - he is nature's master. For example, according to nature's requirements and laws, man is an earthbound creature, not one of air or water. Yet despite this natural law, he breaks nature's rule - he soars through the air, traverses the surface of the sea as if it were an open field, runs upon the waters, and pilots vessels beneath them. This contravenes nature's universal law.

Subject: power of the mind over nature
Quotation: "Yes, when the complaint is mental in its cause and source. Many diseases springing from inside the body have a mental origin. These can be best healed by mind cure."

Subject: power of the mind over nature
Quotation: This is why great discoveries have been made, magnificent enterprises have been established, wonderful inventions have appeared, and the mysteries of creation have emerged from the realm of the unseen into the visible world.

Subject: power of the mind over nature
Quotation: Man is distinguished from all created things. Nature - all things are captive to it. The sun, with all its grandeur, is captive to it. But in man, whose body is so small, God hath created a sacred power that can break the laws of nature.

Subject: power of the mind over nature
Quotation: For instance, the power of steam, photography, phonography, telegraphy and mathematical problems were all once hidden mysteries and unknown secrets. But the human spirit discovered such invisible mysteries and brought them from the hidden into the visible world

Subject: power of the mind over nature
Quotation: Man can resist and oppose nature, for he has discovered the properties of things, and through this discovery of the properties of things he rules over nature itself. All these crafts that he has invented are due to his discovery of the properties of things. For instance, he has invented the telegraph which operates east and west. Thus it is clear that man rules over nature.

Subject: power of the mind over nature
Quotation: This penetrating power with which man is endowed has enabled him to discover these and bring them forth from the invisible realm into the visible realm, making them manifest to minds and understanding. This is man's sovereignty, and the proof of his most exalted nobility. For all crafts, inventions, sciences and arts were once in the realm of the invisible, the hidden mystery.

Subject: power of the mind over nature
Quotation: Man breaks the laws of nature and makes them subservient to his uses. For instance, man is an animate earthly being in common with the animals. The exigency of nature demands that he should be restricted to the earth; but he, by breaking the laws of nature, soars in the atmosphere high above it. By the application of his intellect he overcomes natural law and dives beneath the seas in submarines or sails across them in ships.

Subject: power of the mind over nature
Quotation: The reality of man encompasses all things and is the discoverer of things. All these things that thou seest were once not in existence, but this power which is in man has discovered them whilst they were hidden. Everything has been hidden. Man has discovered it. That which was hidden has become manifest, much as the telegraph, the phonograph, electricity. In former centuries it was hidden, no one had any knowledge of it. The power of man has brought it to light.

Subject: power of the mind over nature
Quotation:
This spirit is the discovering power that encompasses all things. All the wondrous signs, all the crafts and discoveries, all the mighty undertakings and momentous historical events of which you are aware have been discovered by this spirit and brought forth from the invisible realm into the visible plane through its spiritual power. Thus it abides upon the earth and yet makes discoveries in the heavens, and deduces that which is unknown from known and visible realities. For example, man is in this hemisphere, but through the power of reason he discovers, as Columbus did, another one--the Americas--which until then was unknown. His body is heavy, but he flies through the air by means of vehicles of his own devising. His movement is slow, but he journeys rapidly through East and West by the aid of the devices which he has fashioned.   AB00266
You observe that if someone suffers from a chronic physical illness, its effects remain in their children for three or four generations. Similarly, when one is afflicted with the spiritual disease of bad character, it has a profound effect on their descendants, for upbringing has a remarkable influence. That person's character traits are transmitted to their progeny.

Subject: power; greatness; centrality of the Covenant
Quotation: The Covenant of God is like the sun--the brilliance and light of the Covenant radiates and shines forth from the faces of those who are firm in it. The radiance of this Sun (the Covenant) has been felt from here to America. They wish to extinguish this light, but they do not know that the light of God's Covenant is kindled and comes from the presence of God.

Subject: power; greatness; centrality of the Covenant
Quotation: Bountiful in His bestowals and gracious with every blessing and favor, He hath gathered us beneath the shade of the Tree of the Covenant and under the banner of the Testament, all acknowledging His oneness, His singleness, His grandeur, His might and His power which hath spread and shone forth throughout all regions, until even His enemies bore witness to His majesty, the exaltation of His Word, the penetrating influence of His writings, the power of His teachings and the swiftness of their diffusion. Even in His own day, His mention spread far and wide throughout all regions and encompassed the entire earth. Never in the days of any previous Manifestation had there been such a penetrating influence and overwhelming power.

Subject: power; greatness; centrality of the Covenant
Quotation: in all times remind them of the greatness of the Covenant and Testament

Subject: power; greatness; centrality of the Covenant
Quotation: The standard of the Covenant hath been raised at the center of the world, and its banner, through the breezes of confirmation from the Kingdom, is full of waves and movement. The peoples of all regions are entering beneath its shade, and the hosts of the Concourse on High are following one another in succession to its aid.

Subject: power; greatness; centrality of the Covenant
Quotation: No covenant in previous cycles has preceded this Covenant, whereby even the exalted angels who were not commanded to bow before Adam on the day of the world's beginning have entered beneath its shade. Soon you will see the signs of this Covenant brilliant in souls and horizons, and the banners of this Covenant raised upon the highest peaks of the seven layers.

Subject: power; greatness; centrality of the Covenant
Quotation: The primary purpose and intimate desire of the Blessed Beauty--may my spirit, my being, and my essence be sacrificed for His holy threshold--in establishing this divine Covenant, which has had no parallel in any age or dispensation, was that no discord should occur in the Blessed Cause, but rather that all should unite under the shade of the Word of Unity and sever the root of differences among nations.

Subject: power; greatness; centrality of the Covenant
Quotation: From the very beginning of the Cause, the Ancient Beauty and the Most Great Name established the foundation of the Covenant and Testament firm, steadfast and immovable like sheets of iron, and made this lofty edifice of the Covenant the Pavilion of the All-Merciful. Any soul who shows the least fairness will observe that from the beginning of human existence until this divine Cycle, no such Covenant and Testament was ever established at the apex of the Supreme Concourse and the center of the Most Glorious Kingdom.

Subject: power; greatness; centrality of the Covenant
Quotation: Now in this Most Great Dispensation, by explicit text and clear and manifest explanation, without interpretation or allegorical meaning, it has been clearly stated in the Most Holy Book, which abrogates all books and whose laws abrogate the laws of all tablets that do not conform to it, and in the Book of the Divine Covenant and Testament, by the Supreme Pen, a covenant has been taken from all in existence, and it has been named the Book of the Covenant. And in all tablets and prayers, adherence to the divine Covenant and Testament has been counted as the greatest means of divine bounty, so that all might comprehend the greatness of the divine Covenant and Testament.

Subject: power; greatness; centrality of the Covenant
Quotation: As to the rainbow, this is the Bow of the Divine Covenant and the Testament of the All-Merciful. From this Bow stream forth the lights of the Kingdom and the celestial rays.

Subject: power; greatness; centrality of the Covenant
Quotation: Since in truth it was by indication and not explicitly stated, like "Whomsoever I am his Master..." etc. However in this Most Great Dispensation, God's Covenant and Testament has been taken

Subject: power; greatness; centrality of the Covenant
Quotation: It is the standard of the Covenant that is unfurled across the horizons. It is the ocean of the testament and pledge whose waves are endless and whose surge is at the utmost intensity and overflow, shaking foundations.

Subject: power; greatness; centrality of the Covenant
Quotation: The complete remedy lies in steadfastness in the Covenant and Testament.

Subject: power; greatness; centrality of the Covenant
Quotation: The call is the call of the Covenant, and the melody is the melody of harmony.

Subject: power; greatness; centrality of the Covenant
Quotation: thou hast trilled in the groves of the Covenant with the sweetest rhythms and measures

Subject: power; greatness; centrality of the Covenant
Quotation: Behold the power of the Covenant and witness the bounty of the Best-Beloved of the horizons.

Subject: power; greatness; centrality of the Covenant
Quotation: the flood of the grandeur of the Covenant hath descended from the mountains of the Testament

Subject: power; greatness; centrality of the Covenant
Quotation: This is the power of the Covenant, which is among the great bounties of the Lord of the Dawning-Place.

Subject: power; greatness; centrality of the Covenant
Quotation: The vivifying breezes wafting from the rose garden of the Covenant have perfumed the horizons of the world

Subject: power; greatness; centrality of the Covenant
Quotation: I hope to receive regular communications from you, for it is the means of strengthening the spiritual bond.

Subject: power; greatness; centrality of the Covenant
Quotation: God's Covenant and Testament has been taken, and by the pen of the Most High the Book of the Covenant was issued

Subject: power; greatness; centrality of the Covenant
Quotation: make your countenance radiant through the shining lights of the Covenant...roar in the atmosphere of the Covenant

Subject: power; greatness; centrality of the Covenant
Quotation: Glory be unto him who hath fulfilled God's Covenant and Testament and cast behind him every polytheist far removed.

Subject: power; greatness; centrality of the Covenant
Quotation: Tell them that today it is the power of the Covenant that moves souls to attraction and motion, not vain imaginings.

Subject: power; greatness; centrality of the Covenant
Quotation: Be not grieved by the weakness of souls, nor disheartened by the frailty of the covenant of the people of the cradle.

Subject: power; greatness; centrality of the Covenant
Quotation: By the power of the Covenant, shatter the ranks of discord. The hosts of divine confirmation arrive like mighty armies.

Subject: power; greatness; centrality of the Covenant
Quotation: This covenant is unique and unprecedented in all existence; no covenant like it has ever appeared in the seen or unseen realms

Subject: power; greatness; centrality of the Covenant
Quotation: Soon shall all who dwell on earth glory in your names. Thus hath the matter been decreed by the Pen that ruleth over all pens.

Subject: power; greatness; centrality of the Covenant
Quotation: Through the bounty of the clouds of the Covenant, become verdant and flourishing, and yield the fruits of steadfastness and firmness

Subject: power; greatness; centrality of the Covenant
Quotation: It is the flame of the Covenant that, through the heat of servitude to the Abha Beauty, hath influenced the very heart of the horizons.

Subject: power; greatness; centrality of the Covenant
Quotation: Unquestionably the divine melody will in the future be raised in that city, but I long that this may happen in these days of the Covenant

Subject: power; greatness; centrality of the Covenant
Quotation: Your services at the Sacred Threshold are evident, manifest and appreciated. I hope they increase in manifestation and appearance day by day.

Subject: power; greatness; centrality of the Covenant
Quotation: Be thou steadfast in the Cause and grieve not over anything, for soon that which shall gladden the hearts of the unitarians shall be made manifest.

Subject: power; greatness; centrality of the Covenant
Quotation: Thou didst establish the sign of Thy Ancient Covenant and raised high Thy Mighty Standard...made the Center of the Covenant renowned throughout all regions

Subject: power; greatness; centrality of the Covenant
Quotation: For the heat of the fire of the Covenant has blazed so intensely to all horizons that no ice or frost can resist it for even a minute, and this is the truth.

Subject: power; greatness; centrality of the Covenant
Quotation: For today most people are heedless and oblivious of the power of God's Covenant and Testament, although in no age or dispensation was such a covenant ever established.

Subject: power; greatness; centrality of the Covenant
Quotation: Thou hast made him inflamed with the heat of the Sun of Thy Covenant, that the warmth of his heart might penetrate the rocks of the hearts of those who are frozen and extinguished

Subject: power; greatness; centrality of the Covenant
Quotation: the power of the Covenant may assist thee to scatter the ranks of the people of discord... They shall protect the sanctuary of the Covenant, defend the stronghold of God's Covenant

Subject: power; greatness; centrality of the Covenant
Quotation: Glorified be the Lord of the Covenant Who attracted the monotheists through His verses, the sincere ones through His fragrances, and those near to Him through His mention and praise.

Subject: power; greatness; centrality of the Covenant
Quotation: A wave from the ocean of the Covenant hath surged and struck the shores of America... Under the shadow of the Standard of the Covenant, which waveth over all regions, sacrifice your lives.

Subject: power; greatness; centrality of the Covenant
Quotation: Today the spirit of the Covenant pulsates in the arteries of the horizons, and the clouds of the Testament pour forth their bounty upon both worlds. Blessed is he who holdeth fast unto it.

Subject: power; greatness; centrality of the Covenant
Quotation: Who took a covenant from all who dwell in earth and heaven...As for him who remained firm in His Covenant, he was safe from perdition, but as for him whose feet slipped, he fell and perished

Subject: power; greatness; centrality of the Covenant
Quotation: The call is the call of the Covenant, and the dawning of the effulgent grace of the Luminary of the horizons...His light is manifest in every sphere and His grace is apparent at every horizon.

Subject: power; greatness; centrality of the Covenant
Quotation: Blessed are they who are adorned with the adornment of love for the Twin Martyrs, for thee, and for thy kindred. Ye, verily, have an eminent position in the sight of God, the Lord of the worlds.

Subject: power; greatness; centrality of the Covenant
Quotation: According to this tablet, the Banner of Praise raised on the Day of Resurrection represents the Covenant and Testament, and those who enter beneath its shade will attain salvation and eternal life.

Subject: power; greatness; centrality of the Covenant
Quotation: Praise be to God that the banner of the Covenant is raised high...The luminous lamp of the Covenant will cast such radiance to the horizons that the world of mortality will become a realm of lights

Subject: power; greatness; centrality of the Covenant
Quotation: The True Tailor has sewn and clothed the shapely form of the horizons in a robe of divine silk and heavenly brocade and damask, whose warp and weft are the effulgences of the lights of the Covenant

Subject: power; greatness; centrality of the Covenant
Quotation: Through it the universe was illumined and the horizon of existence was lit up. The star of the visible realm grew dark, and the waves of the ocean surged in the hearts of the people of the Fountainhead.

Subject: power; greatness; centrality of the Covenant
Quotation: This ship is the ship of the Covenant, which is surrounded by the winds of discord for the people of hypocrisy...the sails of the Covenant shall be unfurled, and it shall reach the shore of the Kingdom of God.

Subject: power; greatness; centrality of the Covenant
Quotation: In this time when the Morn of the Covenant is dawning upon the horizons, the lights of confirmation from the Abha Kingdom have illumined both East and West... His Word is penetrating and His Covenant victorious.

Subject: power; greatness; centrality of the Covenant
Quotation: Even in the Most Holy Book, which abrogates all other books, He stated it in multiple places with such force and emphasized power - not through hints, metaphors and allusions, but in clear and explicit language.

Subject: power; greatness; centrality of the Covenant
Quotation: We enjoin Our brothers and their sons to love My Branches and to render them services. Fear God and dispute not about My verses and My Branches. This is what We counseled you before and in this perspicuous Tablet.

Subject: power; greatness; centrality of the Covenant
Quotation: Power of the Covenant: "Praise be unto the Ever-Living, the Self-Subsisting Lord, Who hath illumined and brightened the horizon of contingent being through the dawning of the Day-Star of the Covenant and Testament"

Subject: power; greatness; centrality of the Covenant
Quotation: O steadfast leaf! Strive to spread the Covenant and guide the handmaidens of the Most Merciful to the shade of the blessed Tree. Recite the verses of the Testament and clearly explain the evidences of the Covenant.

Subject: power; greatness; centrality of the Covenant
Quotation: I will ask God that wherever you are, you may become the cause of exalting God's Cause and spreading the Covenant and Testament - a Covenant that is the spirit of this world, a Covenant that is the light of this world.

Subject: power; greatness; centrality of the Covenant
Quotation: This victory is the promised victory mentioned in the Books, Psalms and Tablets. Despite this, bat-like souls with blind eyes cry out "Where is the light?" Say: This victory is the light, and this is the abundant grace

Subject: power; greatness; centrality of the Covenant
Quotation: The Covenant is most important - nothing is as important - because it is the magnet of confirmations. Baha'o'llah mentions it in many of His writings ... In one he says. "O GOD, confirm him who is firm in the Covenant."

Subject: power; greatness; centrality of the Covenant
Quotation: Erelong thou shalt reap the fruits of steadfastness, and thy countenance shall shine bright as the full moon among the friends, and beneath the Tree of the Covenant and Testament thou shalt attain unto the great bounty.

Subject: power; greatness; centrality of the Covenant
Quotation: I swear by the Ancient Beauty - may my spirit be a sacrifice for His loved ones - that the mighty means, the firm handle, the impregnable fortress, and the lofty and glorious shelter is the Covenant and Testament of God.

Subject: power; greatness; centrality of the Covenant
Quotation: His bounty is endless and His bestowal is like unto spirit and life. He maketh the black earth to bloom with flowers and sweet herbs, and bestoweth everlasting life upon the lifeless body. Verily, He is the Powerful, the Mighty.

Subject: power; greatness; centrality of the Covenant
Quotation: Indeed it must be so, for when assured hearts enter beneath the shade of the Divine Sinai of God's Covenant and Testament, their hearts and souls become a supreme paradise, and their speech and utterance become as honey and nectar.

Subject: power; greatness; centrality of the Covenant
Quotation: In all tablets, books, missives and scriptures He mentioned the Covenant and Testament, praising and glorifying the steadfast and firm while censuring and condemning the wavering, even warning of divine punishment and eternal retribution.

Subject: power; greatness; centrality of the Covenant
Quotation: Know thou that the Covenant which God took beneath the Tree of Anisa is the firm handle, the strongest means, the light of guidance and the sun of the forenoon. Through it the universe was illumined and the horizon of existence was lit up.

Subject: power; greatness; centrality of the Covenant
Quotation: Consider what wonderful love is this that has been established between us through the Power of His Holiness Baha'u'llah! [...] Therefore it is made clear to you that this love and amity have been brought into being through an extraordinary power.

Subject: power; greatness; centrality of the Covenant
Quotation: With their own hands they help the Cause of God, though they themselves are wholly unconscious of it. Verily God rendereth His Cause victorious at one time through the aid of His enemies and at another by virtue of the assistance of His chosen ones.

Subject: power; greatness; centrality of the Covenant
Quotation: The tablet emphasizes the power of the Covenant by linking it to salvation and eternal life, stating that "Whosoever entereth beneath that standard shall attain salvation, and upon whomsoever the shadow of that banner falleth shall find eternal life."

Subject: power; greatness; centrality of the Covenant
Quotation: Until wavering appears, the lofty station of the steadfast will not become clear and evident...the banner of the Covenant will not be raised at the pole of the horizons and the fragrances of the garden of the Testament will not perfume the hearts and souls

Subject: power; greatness; centrality of the Covenant
Quotation: In this day loftiness and sublimity is steadfastness in the Covenant and Testament. God hath ordained that the mystery of exaltation is to firmly cling unto the Sure Handle, for it is the Firm Cord; the Ancient Covenant; the Manifest Light; the Straight Path.

Subject: power; greatness; centrality of the Covenant
Quotation: The dawning place of the world is brightened through the effulgence of the Daystar of the Covenant which hath outshone the radiance of Sinai. All these favours emanate from the bountiful grace of the Abha Beauty, may my spirit be a sacrifice for His loved ones.

Subject: power; greatness; centrality of the Covenant
Quotation: Today, the world of humanity is in need of this Power more than at any other time... But the Power of the Blessed Perfection has come to stay, bringing healing under its wide, outstretched wings. This Power alone is the solvent for all these puzzling problems.

Subject: power; greatness; centrality of the Covenant
Quotation: The dawn of the Covenant glows with radiant light, and the Witness of the Covenant is the lamp of the gathering. The light of sanctification has brightened both East and West from the invisible Kingdom, and has become as armor and mail for the body of God's Cause.

Subject: power; greatness; centrality of the Covenant
Quotation: These are servants who have been set aflame with the fire of the Covenant and have drawn light from the lights of the Testament which shineth with most brilliant radiance upon all regions...and confirm them in service to Thy Covenant throughout all contingent beings

Subject: power; greatness; centrality of the Covenant
Quotation: For they are the supported ones, they are the successful ones, they are the victorious ones through the hosts of the Supreme Concourse. Their faces shall shine in the horizon of the world with lights by which the dwellers of the pavilion of grandeur shall be blessed.

Subject: power; greatness; centrality of the Covenant
Quotation: The effect of the pen of that kind friend was the cause of joy to the soul and conscience, for the meanings were spiritual occurrences and heartfelt emotions emanating from the reality of the inner heart, and sufficient and complete proof of firmness and steadfastness.

Subject: power; greatness; centrality of the Covenant
Quotation: They imagined that perhaps the fire of the divine Lote Tree would be extinguished and the lights of the Most Great Luminary would completely vanish from the horizons of the nations...Praise be to the Beloved of the world that in the end all were disappointed and defeated

Subject: power; greatness; centrality of the Covenant
Quotation: By My life! The kingdom of power and might doth verily support whoever is firm in this Covenant which was taken from all those near unto God, and the Sovereign of Truth is the helper of whosoever holdeth fast to this firm Handle stretched between the heavens and the earths.

Subject: power; greatness; centrality of the Covenant
Quotation: Consider the bounty and favor of the Ancient Beauty and the Most Great Name, that while a hundred thousand religious leaders and monks and countless scholars and learned ones of the world are deprived, you have been made privy to the secrets of the sanctuary of the Kingdom.

Subject: power; greatness; centrality of the Covenant
Quotation: We have had objectors from among the famous ones of the horizons, and objectors like Na?iri'd-Din and 'Abdu'l-?amid, two kings, but through the power of the Abha Kingdom all of these were obliterated and destroyed, while the standard of the Covenant waves throughout all horizons.

Subject: power; greatness; centrality of the Covenant
Quotation: This is through the Power of the Covenant of God, for until this day an event of this character has never transpired that from the East and Asia contributions were forwarded to the West for the building of a Temple. Verily this is a cause of astonishment for the people of perception.

Subject: power; greatness; centrality of the Covenant
Quotation: Now, praise be to God that the banner of the Covenant waveth over thousands of souls. It is therefore evident what influence it shall exert hereafter. When the ocean of the Covenant surgeth, with a single wave it casteth out thousands of worthless objects - how much more these souls!

Subject: power; greatness; centrality of the Covenant
Quotation: Praise be to God that for a time thou didst arise to serve the Covenant and Testament in Mazandaran, and wert confirmed in diffusing the divine fragrances throughout those regions. Now too, through the power of the Covenant, thou must create such attraction and ecstasy in that land...

Subject: power; greatness; centrality of the Covenant
Quotation: You too, O friends and helpers, become his partners and confidants, arise to serve at that Threshold, and bring the contingent world to ecstasy and joy, for the darkness of contingent limitations is at its most intense while the light of servitude shines forth with brightness and effulgence.

Subject: power; greatness; centrality of the Covenant
Quotation: Indeed, if a number of souls endowed with utmost detachment, ecstasy, firmness and steadfastness in the Covenant could travel to South America, they would be divinely confirmed like unto Peter and Paul, for the artery that pulsates in the body of the world today is the power of the Covenant.

Subject: power; greatness; centrality of the Covenant
Quotation: Setting aside every title and calling out "O 'Abdu'l-Baha! O bondservant of Baha!" until the pillars of earth and heaven are shaken by thy call. For with this iron pen have I built the pillars of the lofty palace, and in this do I glory among the Concourse on high in the Most Glorious Kingdom.

Subject: power; greatness; centrality of the Covenant
Quotation: "From the musk-laden breeze of the garden of the Covenant the horizons are perfumed, and from the lights of dawning the East and West are illumined... Soon will the light of the Covenant cast its brilliant rays upon all regions and the Sun of the Testament shed its radiance upon East and West."

Subject: power; greatness; centrality of the Covenant
Quotation: By God's life, thou hast been and art mentioned in the Most Holy Court. No thanks befitteth this most exalted station, and no praise attaineth unto this most glorious rank. However, purely through grace and loving-kindness, the Tongue of Grandeur hath, on behalf of His Afnan, offered praise and thanks.

Subject: power; greatness; centrality of the Covenant
Quotation: For this is the ark of salvation, this is the cause of life, this is the sure handle, this is the supreme means, this is the most great sign, this is the cord stretched between earth and heaven, this is the ladder of ascent to the Supreme Horizon, this is the praiseworthy station in the heaven of command.

Subject: power; greatness; centrality of the Covenant
Quotation: And know with certainty that if a person calls to the Kingdom with perfect steadfastness and promotes the Covenant with complete firmness, even if they are a weak ant they can put a mighty elephant to flight from the field, and if they are a frail mosquito they can break the wings and feathers of a fierce eagle.

Subject: power; greatness; centrality of the Covenant
Quotation: Follow the decree which We have revealed to you before, for it is indeed the truth which We have sent down in truth by your Lord's leave upon a mighty, straight path... And similar to what was written on that page, We had revealed before for you to convey to Solomon who was among the religious leaders of that island

Subject: power; greatness; centrality of the Covenant
Quotation: O Nushirvan! Take up the cup of sweetness from the ancient world, prepare the feast of the Covenant, and raise the call of "drink ye!" in the gathering of those intoxicated with the wine of God's love, that every mind may be awakened and every awakened one become intoxicated with the chalice of the Covenant of the Lord.

Subject: power; greatness; centrality of the Covenant
Quotation: Take up in thy hand a goblet of sweetness from the ancient world and adorn the feast of the Covenant. Raise the cry of "drink ye!" in the gathering of those intoxicated with the wine of the love of God, that every mind may be awakened and every awakened one may become inebriated with the chalice of the Covenant of the Lord.

Subject: power; greatness; centrality of the Covenant
Quotation: The fame of the Covenant has caused a great commotion throughout all regions...The power of Truth is triumphant over creation, the divine Will prevails over human realities. Though they arose to extinguish the kindled fire, its flame grew higher, and though they strove to put out the divine lamp, its radiance became more brilliant

Subject: power; greatness; centrality of the Covenant
Quotation: Through the blessing of the Blessed Perfection health was granted to me. Immediately I began to write Tablets so that the "Aiadi" of the Cause of God would give the Glad-tidings to the friends that Abdul-Baha is not weak. Through the help and assistance and the blessing and confirmation of the Blessed Beauty he is exceedingly healthy

Subject: power; greatness; centrality of the Covenant
Quotation: Observe how the piercing meteor of the Covenant struck the horizons and what radiance from the invisible Kingdom fell upon the pages of the Slavs and Vlachs. Illumine the East! Perfume the West! Give light to the Slavs! Bestow spirit upon the Vlachs! Despite this, these deniers like bats hide in their corner of obscurity denying the sun.

Subject: power; greatness; centrality of the Covenant
Quotation: The Tree of Man hath been set ablaze by the fire that was kindled on the holy Mount Sinai of the Covenant in the wilderness of Paran. Draw thou nigh unto this fire and seek the light of guidance from this fire that hath been kindled at the center of creation. By God the Truth! It is a light unto the steadfast and a fire unto those who waver

Subject: power; greatness; centrality of the Covenant
Quotation: Hold fast after Me unto the Branches that have branched from this Ancient Root. From them will the fragrance of My garment be shed throughout the world, and none shall inhale it, save those who turn their faces towards Him, and remain steadfast. After the Aghsan, a lofty station hath been ordained for the servant in attendance before the Throne.

Subject: power; greatness; centrality of the Covenant
Quotation: This is the Ancient Covenant! This is The One who has the cup in His Hand! This is the Testament of Accord! This is a Covenant to hold to, and utterly detach oneâ€™s self from aught else. This is the Cause of stopping the cries of Contradiction (made by deniers) through the Divine Mercy. This is the Pre-existent Covenant! This is the weighty Mystery!

Subject: power; greatness; centrality of the Covenant
Quotation: Baha'o'llah, desiring to prevent similar dissensions resulting from the misinterpretation of his words, wrote a book which he entitled Kitab el Ahd (Book of the Covenant). In this book, which is incontestable, being in his own handwriting, he appoints a center of his covenant, who is to be the expounder of the books and the judge between the false and the true.

Subject: power; greatness; centrality of the Covenant
Quotation: In previous dispensations, no explicit Covenant was taken from the Supreme Pen. There was no designated person who could be the standard of truth and error... But among the distinctions of this dispensation is that the Blessed Beauty did not leave souls in confusion. He took a Covenant from all and appointed the Center of the Covenant, writing with His own pen.

Subject: power; greatness; centrality of the Covenant
Quotation: "As for this strong and mighty cord, it is the clear Covenant and the ancient Testament and the great Testament of God" ... "Hold fast to My mighty cord and My clear Covenant and My firm handle and surest means and greatest intermediary and most great instrument"

Subject: power; greatness; centrality of the Covenant
Quotation: And since I am convinced that Thou hast honored me with Thy verses, I know that I was worthy of receiving both finite bounties and infinite gifts. And since its gates were not opened unto me, I bear witness before Thee and before those who testify from Thy presence that this was neither due to the heedlessness of Thy power concerning me, nor to its impotence, nor to my lack of capacity to behold it.

Subject: power; greatness; centrality of the Covenant
Quotation: Thy lamentation and supplication reached the threshold of the peerless Lord and was heard by the dwellers of the Supreme Concourse, and all raised their voices in prayer to the Court of Divine Unity, beseeching that the loved ones in that land might abide beneath the shade of the Tree of Companionship mentioned in the Hidden Words in Persian, and remain firm in their attachment and adherence to God's Covenant.

Subject: power; greatness; centrality of the Covenant
Quotation: O thou who art gladdened by the light of the Covenant! The seekers of enlightenment have drawn forth the lights of guidance from the realities of the Covenant, and the horizons have been illumined by that effulgence. Breasts have been dilated through the outpouring of the Covenant of the Sun of Manifestation, and the realities of existence have cried out: "Glory be unto Him Who hath taken this evident Covenant!"

Subject: power; greatness; centrality of the Covenant
Quotation: The pavilion of glory hath been raised upon the highest summits of the horizons, and the Sovereign of the Covenant hath been established upon the throne of the hearts of the people of effulgence. By God, verily the Covenant of the Lord of Effulgence, the Sovereign of the horizons, ruleth by the leave of the Lord of the Covenant over both East and West. Before it, necks bow down and voices are hushed, and eyes are transfixed.

Subject: power; greatness; centrality of the Covenant
Quotation: The Most Great Ocean of Grandeur - its waves have grown mightier, and the outpourings from the heaven of the All-Merciful have become stronger and more evident. For until now, the cloud of the human temple was preventing the witnessing of the Sun of Truth. But now that Brilliant Moon and that Sun of the Ethereal Sphere is, in truth, rising and shining from the Most Exalted Horizon and the All-Glorious Kingdom, sanctified from all limitations.

Subject: power; greatness; centrality of the Covenant
Quotation: When the divine edifice is made firm and the celestial foundation is established, every dispersion shall be gathered, every outcast shall become intimate with the private chamber of mysteries, and every homeless one shall find a nest and shelter in the Most Glorious Paradise. Otherwise, every bond of unity shall be severed, every door of hardship shall be opened, foundations shall crumble, palaces shall become tombs, and fortresses shall be utterly demolished from their foundations.

Subject: power; greatness; centrality of the Covenant
Quotation: O my God and the Helper of the sincere ones and those who are firm in Thy Covenant and are assured by Thy promise! Aid these, Thy servants, to serve at the threshold of Thy holiness, and make them signs of guidance and stars of piety, shining from the supreme horizon and gleaming from the highest zenith. Make firm their feet that they slip not through the doubts of the people of passion and desire. Verily, Thou preservest whomsoever Thou willest through Thy power that prevaileth over all things.

Subject: power; greatness; centrality of the Covenant
Quotation: Praise be unto God that presently the situation has come to a point where we gather with spirituality and love, under the shadow of the Blessed Beauty, on Mount Carmel and in the Shrine of the Bab, with utmost fellowship and affection, with no fear, no danger, no difficulty, no harassment, no opposition, no persecution. This is the power of God. All the monarchs and the nations of the world were our enemies, but now with utmost spirituality and radiance, we are assembled beneath the bounties of Baha'u'llah.

Subject: power; greatness; centrality of the Covenant
Quotation: O thou who art gladdened by the light of the Covenant! The seekers of enlightenment have drawn forth the lights of guidance from the realities of the Covenant, and the horizons have been illumined by that effulgence. Hearts have been dilated through the outpouring of the Covenant of the Sun of Manifestation, and the realities of existence have cried out: "Glory be unto Him Who hath taken this manifest Covenant! Glory be unto Him Who hath bound this firm banner! Glory be unto Him Who hath extended this outstretched shadow!"

Subject: power; greatness; centrality of the Covenant
Quotation: Let all seize upon the robe of 'Abdu'l-Baha and raise such a melody, showing such firmness and steadfastness, that whether 'Abdu'l-Baha be present or absent, no slackening shall occur in the diffusion of the divine fragrances. Rather, let all surge like the sea and soar like the birds of the Supreme Concourse, so that those who await the death and passing of this servant of the Divine Threshold shall be disappointed and know that the exaltation of the Blessed Cause and the glorification of the Word of God are not dependent upon 'Abdu'l-Baha's survival.

Subject: power; greatness; centrality of the Covenant
Quotation: O ye friends and maidservants of the Merciful! The Wine of His Testament is flowing; cause its drops to fall upon your tongues. The anthem of the Kingdom is abroad, let your ears be attuned to its strains. Draw near to the Truth, that ye may inhale the sweet fragrance from its garden, and harken to the Covenant, that ye may be illumined as by ever-burning lights. If your souls be detached, they shall be borne on high to the Kingdom; if ye search earnestly, ye shall find a path to the Holy Threshold; if ye hear His call, then bind yourselves to His Covenant and Testament.

Subject: power; greatness; centrality of the Covenant
Quotation: In any case, this spiritual letter is written and sent with the utmost love, kindness and faithfulness, that you may counsel certain souls somewhat, that they should not regard the Cause of God as child's play, nor imagine that the hosts of the Abha Kingdom can be overcome by foolish madness, or that the Eagle of the Covenant can be rendered helpless in the clutches of the sparrow of discord. The brilliant light of the dawn of divine confirmation will not be made to disappear by intense darkness, nor will the bright lamp of manifest verses be extinguished by the whisperings of doubts.

Subject: power; greatness; centrality of the Covenant
Quotation: But they are heedless and oblivious that this dust and dirt cannot conceal the Sun of the Covenant, and these schemes cannot hide the effulgence of divine destiny, and these barriers cannot hold back the waves of this ocean, and these whirlwinds cannot uproot this blessed tree. Soon souls will be raised up through the bounties of the Most Glorious Kingdom who will brandish the drawn sword of the Covenant upon the body of the horizons, cause the light of the Ancient Covenant to dawn from the horizon of the brow, and raise the standard of the Covenant at the pole of contingent existence.

Subject: power; greatness; centrality of the Covenant
Quotation: In short, these souls do think that those affairs will be the means of their progress and fame and will be useful to them and productive of results. But they do not consider that His Holiness Baha'u'llah is the protector of the Covenant. The Branches could not withstand the power of the Covenant and wholly they humiliated themselves. Now what can McNutt do? If the Kings of the world can efface this Covenant, it is better to be effaced. But it is not so! If the armies of the angels of heaven outwardly and visibly descend from the sky and aim to weaken the power of the Covenant they shall utterly fail.

Subject: power; greatness; centrality of the Covenant
Quotation: The ocean of joy hath surged and the countenance of God, the Help in Peril, the Self-Subsisting, hath smiled, inasmuch as the Call hath been raised from the Land of ?a unto the Most Exalted Horizon and hath gladdened the dwellers of the Most Glorious Paradise and the Supreme Heaven by the arising of the Hands of the Cause and the Manifestations of Utterance before the Kaaba of God with a clear covenant and firm pledge, that the world and all that dwell therein might be illumined by the light of unity and concord. Exalted, exalted is this most high station! Exalted, exalted is this Covenant through which the scrolls of names have been renewed and the stations of the people of Baha have been elevated among all humanity!

Subject: power; greatness; centrality of the Covenant
Quotation: Were it not for the protecting power of the Covenant to guard the impregnable fort of the Cause of God, there would arise among the Baha'is, in one day a thousand different sects as was the case in former ages. But in this Blessed Dispensation, for the sake of the permanency of the Cause of God and the avoidance of dissension amongst the people of God, the Blessed Beauty (may my soul be a sacrifice unto Him) has through the Supreme Pen written the Covenant and the Testament; He appointed a Center, the Exponent of the Book and the annuller of disputes. Whatever is written or said by Him is confirmable to the truth and under the protection of the Blessed Beauty He is infallible. The express purpose of this last Will and Testament is to set aside disputes from the world.
