Quotation: The Islands of java, Sumatra and another one which are situated in the Indian ocean in the equator contain about 20 millions of inhabitants. These people were converted from idolatry into Mohamadan religion by one single person. Just think of his attraction and of accomplishing such a mighty task! When he finished his work he left the islands for an unknown destination and after that no one heard anything about him. Even his name is not known. Now it is evident that that one single person was a greater man than a million of the present day Ulemas. For he worked for God and not for fame or name or wealth. It is said in the proverb that often happens "one man is equal to one thousand".

Quotation: How can the influence of this crucified one encompass East and West when only a few numbered souls among fishermen, carpenters and other lowly ones followed Him?' Far, far from it are these vain imaginings! Then observe what occurred - the banners of greatness were reversed while His exalted standard was raised up.

Quotation: When this sign is found in any soul, all his movements and stillness exert influence in the world and are effective therein. Consider Christ: when the Jews put Him to death, this martyrdom appeared so insignificant to them that they made no mention of it in their books. Yet because the aforementioned sign existed in Christ's being, it did not remain hidden beneath the earth, and thou canst observe what revolution it created in the world.

Quotation: Praise be to God, that you have organized and established a new assembly in the land of Esphahan and with the utmost devotion its members are arising to serve the Blessed Perfection (BAHA'O'LLAH).

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: The news of the Divine praise and glorification at dawn in the Mashriqu'l-Adhkar with spiritual melodies brought much joy and delight. This is the cause of happiness to the heart of 'Abdu'l-Baha.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: Your devotion to the Ancient Beauty...You have illumined your countenance with the light of unity and made your heart a treasury of the fragrances of detachment and love for the All-Bountiful One.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: O Haji ?abibu'llah-i-Chavush! O ?abib! The Beloved remembereth thee...Give thanks unto God for having aided thee in this Cause and caused thee to speak that which the Tongue of Grandeur hath spoken

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: O Mahdi! Hearken unto the call of the Lord of Names from the direction of Akka. Verily, He maketh mention of thee and commandeth thee to that which will draw thee nigh unto God, the Lord of lords.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: We thank Thee and we praise Thee for the establishment of this just and equitable Sovereignty, and this mighty Government which strives for the comfort of its people and the safety of its subjects.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: O Mashhadi 'Ali! He is the Most Holy, the Most Great, the Most Glorious! A mention from Us unto him who hath soared on the wings of faith unto God, the Single, the One, the Mighty, the Praiseworthy

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: O Red Leaf! Rejoice in that thy Well-Beloved, the Most Glorious, and the Wronged One Who hath borne tribulations for the love of God, the Lord of Names and Creator of heaven, maketh mention of thee.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: We give glad tidings to the members of the council, for their deeds are adorned with the ornament of acceptance and illumined with the light of His good pleasure. Blessed are ye and joy be unto you!

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: We have made mention of thee, and this suffices thee, wert thou of those who understand. We have remembered every servant who hath turned unto Us and every handmaiden who hath been among the devout.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: I hope that He may make thee the beloved of God's Egypt, so that all the friends and brethren may declare "By God, truly God hath preferred thee above us" and may rise up in praise and glorification.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: O sapling of the divine garden! What you had written to Mr. Bahhaj, the joyous one, upon him be the Most Glorious Glory of God, was noted. From its meanings, life-giving foundations were understood.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: O Lion of the Thickets of the Kingdom! The Ancient Beauty and the Most Great Name would at all times make mention of the region of Fars and the city of Shiraz, showing utmost bounty and perfect mercy

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: O brother, Muhammad-Qablih-Hasan! In the name of the Beloved of all horizons! God willing, may you be occupied at all times with the remembrance of God and drink from the Kawthar of divine knowledge.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: O Joseph, upon thee be My glory! Praise be to God that thou hast been made to attain, through the scratching of the Most Exalted Pen, unto the fruits of the Lote-Tree beyond which there is no passing

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: This is a mighty Day. We beseech God to make manifest its men who may, through wisdom and utterance, adorn the world with a wondrous and exalted ornament. Verily, He is the All-Powerful, the Almighty.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: Praise be to the pure Lord that He hath caused the ancient friends to enter this supreme paradise and hath chosen heavenly bounties, that each one may become a divine lamp and shed celestial radiance.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: The decoration and adornment of the tongue consists in praising and thanksgiving to the Lord Almighty... if thou give thanks a thousand centuries and cycles, thou wilt not be capable of doing justice

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: O Muhammad-Husayn! Upon thee be the Glory of God! Thy mention hath been made in the presence of Him Who is mentioned, and the Supreme Pen turneth toward thee from the prison and maketh mention of thee

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: Blessed is he, whom the fragrances of the Day of God hath quickened and caused to be detached from all else. Well is it with thee that thou hast forsaken thyself and turned towards the exalted realms.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: O Mulla Yahya, upon thee be the Glory of God, He Who is the Guardian over all names. Blessed art thou and blessed is he who hath hearkened unto thy words concerning the Cause of God, the Lord of Lords.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: Blessed art thou for having drunk the wine of immortality in the days of thy Lord, and for having been wafted by the breezes of the All-Merciful towards His blessed, mighty, and inaccessible direction.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: Blessed are ye and those with you, and blessed are the fair-minded ones who have shown justice concerning that which hath appeared there from the ocean of God's loving-kindness, the Lord of all worlds.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: Night and day be companions of the world-consuming fire of love, that ye may become like unto the illuminating candle of the night, and in the arena of divine knowledge become victorious and triumphant

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: I pen this letter in your name and I beseech God that your name may become renowned in the Abha Kingdom...Be happy and grow happier day by day, for the glance of favor is all-encompassing and complete

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: Therefore, I am well pleased with the beloved of the Lord for they have succeeded in rendering such a great service. It is my hope that this structure will be established in utmost beauty and strength

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: O thou who gazeth upon Mine horizon and drinketh the wine of Mine utterance from the hand of My bounty! ... Blessed be thy pen, thy tongue and thy heart. Give thanks unto God for this most great favor.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: Blessed is he who hath recognized and was among the firmly established. Blessed is she in having attained unto this mighty bounty. The favor of God hath transformed this small portion into a great one.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: I swear by the Beauty of Truth that the Concourse on High has opened their tongues in praise of you and offered such acclaim that the denizens of the most exalted Kingdom were moved to joy and delight.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: O Thou who art aflame by the Fire of the Love of God...The wordings were in the utmost eloquence and the thoughts were sweet and appealing. Praised be the Lord, it showed steadfastness and perseverance.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: Blessed art thou! Therefore, loose thy tongue in praise of the Most Glorious Beauty and occupy thyself with the mention of the Ancient Beauty - may my spirit and essence be sacrificed for His loved ones

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: Give thanks to God that you have reached the luminous shrine... When you don this glorious crown, you will become the cause of pride and glory to your father and bring joy and delight to all your family

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: The light of the sun of the celestial realm has fallen upon the heads and crowns of the friends, and the life-giving fragrance of the supreme paradise has made fragrant the minds of the ancient friends.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: Praise for Eglantyne Jebb and Mrs. Buxton: "Ye are serving both the world of humanity and the Sacred Threshold of God. Ye are praised by Baha'u'llah, for ye are acting in accordance with His teachings."

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: Blessed are ye for having entered the City and attained unto what your Lord, the Mighty, the All-Bestowing, desired...Ye are beneath the shadow of My loving-kindness and within the tabernacles of My mercy

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: O Afnan, upon whom be the peace of the All-Merciful! Thou hast repeatedly attained Our presence - praised be God! - and art mentioned before the Wronged One and hast been the recipient of special favors.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: Praise be to God Who guided His servants to His straight path, informed them of their momentous announcement, and gave them glad tidings of the Day when mankind shall stand before the Lord of the worlds.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: With the utmost joy and fragrance, speak forth the praise and glorification of the Beloved of all possibility...Be patient, O My handmaiden, and render thanks unto thy Lord, the Helper, the All-Bountiful.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: Encourage and urge them to arise with joy and movement, with eagerness and enthusiasm, that all may strive to diffuse the fragrances of the All-Merciful and expend mighty efforts to exalt the Word of God.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: Ancient lights course through the mighty Throne, and profound mysteries are inscribed upon fragrant tablets... Therefore praise be to God, the Beloved of the first and the last, the manifest and the hidden.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: "Blessed is the soul that is mentioned today in the Most Great Scene and is honored with divine favors" "Blessed art thou for the seeds of thy Lord's favors, the Revealer of verses, have been sown for thee"

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: that you may ever be assisted and victorious, confirmed and accepted...Praise be to God that you are accepted at the threshold of the Divine Unity and encompassed by the glances of the Blessed Beauty's favor

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: the friends in Nayriz from the dawning of the Day of Guidance were filled to overflowing and respected and cherished in the Abha Kingdom...Now too must the people of that city surpass and excel other cities

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: We have heard your call and have answered you with this Forbidden Tablet, that you may be assured of His mercy that has preceded all created things and His grace that has encompassed the unseen and the seen.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: O bondswoman of God! God willing, through the grace of the Absolute Creator, thou shalt abide beneath the shade of the divine Lote-Tree and drink at all times from the pure waters of the All-Merciful stream.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: O friends! Praise with the utmost humility, submissiveness and devotion the Beloved of all possibility, for He confirmed you in a Cause from which most of the world, despite their seeking, remained deprived.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: In truth, Barzu is pure in spirit and captivated by the love of that Kind Friend. You too should follow his example and seek his qualities so that you may find joy in the divine world and attain to happiness.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: The illumined Jinab-i-Yusuf has offered the utmost praise of the friends of God, that praise be to God, they are supplicating, imploring, wholly turned to God and attracted. This news brought the greatest joy

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: Truly you are radiant, and in every gathering you attend, the light of divine love shines forth...Therefore give thanks to God that you were confirmed in such a bounty and crowned with such a bejeweled diadem.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: Thanks be to the Ever-Living, the All-Powerful that thou art sheltered beneath the shade of the Great Lord, and thy nostrils are perfumed with the soul-ravishing musk and thy mind is filled with its fragrance.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: The letter which thou hadst written to Mr. Muhammad-Taqi was perused. It brought the utmost joy and gladness, for it was a mighty proof of the firmness of the friends in the Cause of the Lord, the All-Loving.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: Jinab-i-Ghulam-'Ali has opened his tongue in praise of you and offered thanks and gratitude, that praise be to God, the loved ones of those regions are companion to the fragrances of the Most Glorious Paradise

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: Blessed art thou for having answered thy Lord when the Tree raised its call that there is no God but Me, the Mighty, the All-Knowing... We have specially chosen thee for the service of this Great Announcement.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: O beloved spiritual one, his honor Mirza Ghulam-'Ali, may the Glory of God rest upon him. Blessed are they who have turned with pure hearts, sanctified breasts, and radiant faces toward the countenance of God.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: O handmaids of God! Hearken unto the call from the Lote-Tree raised up upon the luminous spot... Blessed are ye in that ye have been mentioned before the Throne and have turned unto the Dawning-Place of lights.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: Praise be to the All-Giving Lord Who summoned all peoples, unveiled, to the supreme horizon, created creation and showed the way. Great are His favors, exalted is His might, and all-encompassing is His dominion.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: "O thou whom God hath made a pillar of justice!" "Therefore become a divine pillar and follow the ways of thy forebears, that thou mayest become a pillar of light and remain firm and steadfast forever and ever."

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: Blessed are ye, O My Afnan! Ye have attained unto that which none have attained save whom God hath willed. My loving-kindness and My mercy preceded you. By My life! Nothing in all creation can equal this station.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: The pure soul of that heavenly spirit in the supreme realm is well-pleased and content with you, and at every moment offers profound praise. If ears were opened, that voice would be heard. May your soul be happy!

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: O Jamasp! Jamasp possessed a seeing eye and a hearing ear. He had an enlightened heart and an eloquent tongue... As you bear the name of that noble one, follow in his footsteps so that the pure God may assist you

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: O Yunis, upon thee be My glory! His honor the Trustee, upon him be My glory and loving-kindness, has mentioned thee, and We have remembered thee in this blessed Tablet with a remembrance whose end cannot be seen.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: Rejoice thou, then be thou joyful, in that thy name hath been mentioned at the Throne and these verses have been sent down to thee, which none can equal among all that the minds of the monotheists can comprehend.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: Well is it with thee for having remained faithful to the Covenant of God and His Testament... Let nothing sadden thee. By My life, He is with thee at all times. It behoveth everyone to venerate thee, glorify thee

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: Blessed art thou for having attained unto the presence of thy Lord and for having heard the call when it was raised from the Prison of Akka, and for having answered thy Lord when He came with manifest sovereignty.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: Your benevolent endeavors as one who speaks in remembrance of God are mentioned in this divine gathering, and the outstanding services of you who are assured of the Greater Signs are appreciated in this presence.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: O friends of God! With such love and kindness does 'Abdu'l-Baha desire to sacrifice his life for the loved ones of the Most Glorious Beauty. It is therefore obvious how these true friends must conduct themselves.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: O Rida! Bear thou witness to My love for thee, whereof all things bear witness, and beyond them My Self, the Mighty, the All-Forgiving. My remembrance of thee hath preceded, and likewise My description of thy soul.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: Observe thy faithful friend, what endeavor he hath shown on thy behalf - at the blessed Threshold, the Center of Lights, the Repository of Mysteries, the Circling-Point of the Concourse on High, the Luminous Shrine

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: The Blessed Beauty showed great favor toward the sincere loved ones, such that whenever mention was made of them in the Most Holy Court, signs of delight would appear upon His luminous countenance and radiant brow.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: Praise be to God that Faran is in effusion, and this is from the heat of the love of that kind friend. In these days the field is vast and the light of truth is radiant and the lamp of the love of God is brilliant.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: The honored Amin has praised the friends of that land to the utmost, that praise be to God, all are occupied in serving the Cause of God and exalting the Word of God. Blessed are they and excellent is their abode.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: The contents of thy letter betokened detachment, attraction and enkindlement with the fire of the love of God. When it was read, the taste of conscience was sweetened. Praise be to God, it indicated the utmost joy.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: O Haji Husayn who hath attained! O Husayn, He Who is remembered remembereth thee from this Spot which God hath made the circling-point of the denizens of the all-highest Paradise and the dawning-place of revelation

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: O Lord, praise belongeth to those who are worthy to praise Him - whose very existence was desired and is desired for the mention and glorification of the Lord of the seen and unseen, the One Who nurtures all things.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: The entire letter is praise for the spiritual awakening and progress of the Persian friends, especially noting how they have "become so enkindled that they have forgotten the thousand-year-old lethargy and wilting"

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: "Sultan Habibu'llah Khan is truly sincere, illumined, steadfast and spiritual...Praise be to God that from early youth he made his nostrils fragrant with the divine breaths and assistance and bounty encompassed him"

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: O thou Lion hearted Bashir. The Egyptian Basher brought back with him the garment of the Canaanite Joseph but thou art the bearer of the garment of the King of the City of Love. Behold the difference of thy station!

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: the entire letter contains praise and encouragement for the recipients, particularly "You are the manifestations of divine favors and the pride and glory of your forebears. You are the object of the glance of favor"

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: Joy be unto thee, for the divine breaths have awakened thee... Gladness be unto thee, for thy Lord's grace hath found thee... Thou hast attained what the near ones sought and enjoyed what the sincere ones longed for

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: O Mahmud! The All-Desired One calls you from His Praiseworthy Station to God, the Mighty, the Loving. Verily He remembers you from the horizon of the prison, having found from you the fragrance of His cherished love.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: O Mulla 'Abdu'l-Ahad! He is the One Who speaks in the Kingdom of Utterance. This is a mention sent down by God for him who has held fast to the cord of divine knowledge and turned to Him when the servants turned away.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: Thus have We sent down unto thee that which will gladden thy heart. Verily, thy Lord is the All-Bountiful, the Ancient of Days. Be thou assured through the grace of thy Lord, then remember Him in the nights and days.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: Blessed art thou and blessed are they who have fulfilled God's Covenant and His Testament...Blessed art thou and blessed are thy father and mother. Verily thy Lord is the All-Remembering, the Forgiving, the Generous.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: O faithful brothers! Praise ye the Lord of Grandeur that ye are all intoxicated from the cup of "Am I not your Lord?" offered by the Beloved, and that ye all hold goblets in your hands at the feast of the love of God.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: O writer of beautiful script! This contingent world is an inscribed book and an unfurled scroll. If thou art able, write with majestic pen upon this page of possibility the praises and attributes of the Blessed Beauty

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: Rejoice thou in this great bounty! Praise be to God, you have attained unto the infinite outpourings of God and have turned toward the Most Exalted Horizon. There has not been and is not any station greater than this.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: All praise, glorification, mention and utterance befitteth the Object of all possibility, Who hath graciously aided His handmaidens and guided them until they attained unto the Straight Path and the Great Announcement.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: Blessed be your tongue for having uttered that which has diffused the fragrance of God throughout all things, and blessed be your heart for having turned to Him on a day wherein appeared what had been hidden from eyes.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: Blessed is the ear that hath heard My call, and the foot that hath hastened in the path of My good-pleasure, and the eye that hath beheld My tokens, and the heart that hath turned unto My glorious and wondrous station.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: Blessed are ye, O people of Baha! We bear witness that ye have borne what none else hath borne, and have heard what no ear hath heard, and have seen what the eyes of none among those who are nigh and sincere have seen.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: The happiness and gladness of His Honor Afnan greatly rejoiced the heart of 'Abdu'l-Baha, for praise be to God, that blessed heart is happy and joyous...All those souls are accepted and beloved at the Sacred Threshold

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: O Siyyid Nasru'llah! The Most Holy, the Most Exalted! Your name hath been mentioned before the Throne, and there hath been sent down for thee that which rejoiceth the hearts of them that are endowed with understanding.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: Blessed is the handmaiden who has inhaled the fragrance of the verses and turned to this luminous horizon. Blessed are you for having attained the days of God and heard His call from the direction of His mighty prison.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: The True One hath bestowed His favors and guided the way and granted strength and conferred power, and through a hundred thousand mighty causes, nay more, He hath repeatedly blessed thee with the outpourings of His Day.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: O Baqir! In the name of the one true Friend, your call hath reached the hearing of Him Who is the Lord of all names. Both your poetry and prose were beheld. Blessed art thou and blessed is thy father who believed in God

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: O Abdul-Husayn, upon him be the Glory of God! Mention was made of thee before the Wronged One... Blessed is he who hath arisen to serve his Lord... Praise the Beloved of the world Who hath mentioned thee time and again.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: Blessed is he who has ears to hear and has turned towards Him... Blessed is he who has judged fairly and turned towards Him, and blessed is every hearer who has heard the Call when it was raised from this noble station.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: Blessed art thou for having forsaken thy home out of longing for the precincts of God...Praise be to the Exalted Truth that thou hast attained to a station mention of which shall forever be recorded in the divine Books.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: It is certain that thou art completely happy, for thou art successful in teaching the Cause of the forgiving Lord. How many philosophers and professors there are and yet God hath set the crown of guidance upon thine head

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: Mr. Fazel is truly in the utmost sincerity and has no purpose except service to the Cause of God. Miss Martha Root is a cherished maidservant of God. Mr. Agnew is a faithful servant of God and Mr. Wilhelm is sacrificial.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: O seekers of truth! Praise be to God that the escort of His grace has arrived and the light of guidance has shone forth. The veil of vain imaginings has been rent asunder and ye have been blessed with penetrating vision.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: Thy letter reached me. It was a beautiful proof of spiritual inclinations and of thy turning to the Kingdom of the Lord. O thou daughter of the Kingdom! Thy services in this supreme Cause are well known and are accepted.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: Praise be to God that you are guided by the light of guidance and attracted by the fragrances of the Abha Kingdom. You possess seeing eyes and hearing ears, enlightened hearts and souls like a rose garden and flower-bed.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: O Azizu'llah! He is the One Who has sovereignty over what has been and what will be. We have heard your call and recognized your turning towards Us. We beseech God to assist you in that which He loves and is pleased with.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: O sons of Samandar, upon them be the Glory of God! He is the All-Knowing Remembrancer. O Tiraz, praise be to God Who adorned thee with the ornament of divine knowledge and illumined thy heart with the lights of certitude.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: Praise and thanksgiving, glory and radiance beseem the One True God Who through the motion of His Almighty Finger rent asunder the veils and coverings of the world and obliterated the doubts and allusions of the peoples.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: O thou bird who art warbling in the Garden of the Guidance of God! Verily, I read thy excellent and brilliant letter. Blessed art thou; again, blessed art thou! Glad-tidings be unto thee; again, glad-tidings be unto thee!

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: O spiritual youth! May God uphold thee and edify thee in the flower of thy youth and in the spring-time of thy life and may He illumine thy face with the lights of advancement unto God and turning unto the Kingdom of God.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: Description of Ali Khan's devotion: "How many nights did he keep vigil while the stars watched and his eyes shed tears, communing with Thee with a heart overflowing with joy, calling upon Thee in the evening and at dawn"

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: Praise be to God, they bore faithful witness to thy devotion, thy turning to God and thy steadfastness...We bear witness that thou hast been faithful to God's Covenant and His Testament, and hast arisen to serve His Cause.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: O handmaid of God Sakinih, wife of Nabil! O handmaid of God! Praise thou the Best-Beloved of the world, Who, in the Most Great Prison, calleth unto His male and female servants. This is naught but from His infinite bounty.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: O Mirza 'Abdu'llah - upon him be the Glory of God - God willing, may you be blessed with the special favors of God and drink at all times from the wine of oneness which hath been unsealed by the finger of the Lord's will.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: This Wronged One has determined to make mention of the handmaidens of God, exalted be His glory...Give thanks unto the Goal of the world that He assisted you and guided you to the Straight Path and His Great Announcement.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: The Wronged One testifeth that he hath taken the Kawthar of meeting from the hands of bounty and hath drunk thereof in the name of God, Lord of all men, despite every ignorant remote one and every doubting mischief-maker.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: The servant hath been honored by what hath wafted from the drops of your ink, which flowed from your pen whose rustling was raised in the remembrance of God, our Beloved, your Beloved, and the Beloved of all in the worlds.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: We have accepted thy work done for God's sake - rejoice thou in this and say: "Praise be to Thee, O God of all the worlds!"... I rejoice in My remembrance of thee and in that wherewith My Most Exalted Pen doth acquaint thee

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: Among them are those... who have acknowledged what hath been revealed in Thy Book, who have turned to Thy most exalted horizon, who have attained unto Thy most sublime traces and who have hearkened unto Thy most sweet call.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: "O Sulayman, render thanks unto the Beloved of all possibility, that He hath aided thee to recognize this bounty, the like of which heaven hath not witnessed, nor earth borne. Rejoice thou and be of those who are thankful."

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: O Muhammad-'Ali! Rejoice in the remembrance of the Wronged One. Verily He remembereth him who hath held fast unto the cord of God and clung to His luminous hem. Glory be upon thee and upon everyone who is steadfast and firm.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: You composed a poem in the utmost sweetness, emerging from a spiritual throat and flowing forth from a wondrous talent. It was the melody of the dove of the All-Merciful and the song of a bird in the rose-garden of meanings.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: O Na?im, your eloquent poetry flows like running water with perfect fluency and eloquence. Praise be to God that your talent is flowing and your nature fluid. The verses were signs of love and arranged like scattered pearls.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: "Divine rays of Guidance are scattering wide, The Sinai of righteousness shineth once more" and "This is a cloud that raineth down gems, This is a bounty that poureth down pearls, This is the light which glistens and gleams"

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: This is a mention from God unto her who hath heard the call of her Lord and turned unto God, the Lord of all worlds...Blessed is the servant who hath believed, and the handmaiden who hath attained unto this wise Remembrance.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: Thou art among the first believers and of the company of those near to God - "Those who are foremost shall be foremost: these are they who shall be brought nigh." Thou art worthy of every praise and deserving of every bounty.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: O Helper! Thy mention hath flowed from the Most Exalted Pen and the Tongue of Grandeur hath spoken thy name. Be thankful and say: Praise be unto Thee, O Dawning-Place of bounty, and glorified art Thou, O Lord of the servants!

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: Blessed art thou, O Mahdi, for having outstripped the divines in turning unto God, the Goal of them that have recognized Him, and blessed art thou for having drunk the choice wine of revelation before the divines of the earth

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: O Muhammad-i-Tahir! He Who is round Whom circle the Concourse on High, the denizens of Paradise and the angels brought nigh, maketh mention of thee on this night. Give thanks unto God, then remember Him in the nights and days.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: Thy servant Adib, the beloved and noble one, who plumbed the depths of knowledge and discovered the mysteries of learning...He guided pure souls to the decisive Cause and gave them to drink of the choice wine in an elegant cup

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: Praise be to God that thou hast attained unto that which was recorded and inscribed in His Books and His Scriptures... Blessed art thou for having been aided to recognize Him and for having been enabled to make mention of Him.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: O Muhammad-Javad! He who hath traveled through the lands to spread My Word and diffuse My writings hath made mention of thee. We make mention of thee and reveal for thee that which shall gladden the eyes of them that are nigh.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: This is a remembrance from Us to him who has attained unto the Most Great Sea and has been honored with that which is the purpose in the Tablets of God... Well is it with thee, O thou who hast attained unto this noble station!

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: Praise be to God that the realm of darkness hath been illumined by the light of guidance, and the parched desert of thirst hath been refreshed by the waters of divine mercy. This is indeed a great bounty and its station exalted.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: O intimate companion of 'Abdu'l-Baha! With heart and soul you have made mighty efforts in service to the Cause and you strive mightily to spread the writings and disseminate the papers. Mr. Amin offers the highest praise of you

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: O thou whose face is radiant! Thy countenance, which is illumined by the light of the love of God, is a world-enlightening candle... And glory be upon thee and upon all who are firm and steadfast in God's Covenant and Testament.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: O Husayn! He is the One Who calleth from His most exalted horizon. The Cause hath appeared at the Greatest Scene through this Name whereby the horizon of utterance was illumined and the Dove of Knowledge warbled upon the branches

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: O Ahmad-'Ali Khan, upon him be the Glory of God! He is the One Who speaks in the Kingdom of Utterance. God willing, may the friends of God be illumined by the light of His Cause and be set ablaze with the fire of the blessed Tree

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: This is a mention from Us to him who turned towards God when the Manifestation of His Self appeared with the kingdom of verses, that he may rejoice in the remembrance of his Lord and speak forth His name amidst all created things.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: Consider what bounty thou hast received from the effulgence of divine favor, and what manifestation of grace and generosity thou hast become. Be thankful that thou hast placed such a crown upon thy head and obtained such a diadem.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: The gardens of its contents contained novel meanings, and the pools of its foundations held delicate waves...you are...a brilliant star in the horizon of the love of God and a radiant meteor in the heights of the knowledge of God

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: The entire letter is framed as praise and encouragement to Haji Niyaz and the believers, particularly: "O friends of God! All that the Blessed Beauty promised of divine assistance and victory has, praise be to God, been bestowed."

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: Pure praise and its essence befit the most holy and sacred threshold of the Self-Subsisting One, Who created earth and heaven through His Most Exalted Word, Who began with "We belong to God" and ended with "unto Him do we return."

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: O 'Ali-Akbar! He Who is the Lord of Destiny makes mention of thee from His Most Great Prison and gives thee glad tidings of His grace and bounty. Blessed art thou, for the fragrance of the love of God was wafting from every letter.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: O ancient friend! With utmost longing and eagerness I thought of you to write this letter. If you knew how beloved and praised you are among the divine friends in the merciful gathering, you would surely spread your wings and soar

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: How blessed are you, who are intoxicated with the cup of "Am I not your Lord?" and are filled with the ecstasy of the wine of recognition... Blessed art thou, then blessed art thou! Glad tidings to thee, then glad tidings to thee!

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: Well done on your steadfastness and constancy! How blessed you are to be so firm, steady and unwavering in the path of that Heart-engaging Beloved. I am very pleased with you for having such a firm step and power of steadfastness.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: O Muhammad-'Ali of Dihaj, who has attained Our presence and won the victory! We testify that thou hast attained unto the presence of thy Lord and hast drunk from the Kawthar of immortality from the hands of thy Lord, the Munificent.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: Praise be to God that, beneath the shade of the grace and loving-kindness of the Most Great Unity, thou art the recipient of the favors of the Beauty of the Desired One and acceptable at the sacred Threshold of the Lord, the Beloved

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: O handmaiden of God! As much as you can, compose odes of praise and glorification in extolling the Lord of all desire, that they may be chanted with wondrous melodies in great gatherings and bring gladness to hearts and joy to souls.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: The honorable Shah opened his tongue in praise and commendation...From these words joy was obtained and success was achieved, for praise be to God that souls have been raised up who are distinguished by the most wondrous attributes.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: O rose that hath blossomed in the garden of the love of God! With the utmost affection have I read thy letter, beauteous in meaning, wherein thou dost affirm the oneness of God and manifest thy fervent longing for the Kingdom of God.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: You had praised and commended Mr. Blument, that he is serving the Cause of the Incomparable Lord with utmost sincerity and sacrificing his life. Soon you shall observe that he is victorious and triumphant through the hosts of heaven.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: O My leaf! Upon thee be My Baha! Praise be to God that thou hast drunk from the hand of bounty the wine of everlasting life, and hast attained unto that which hath been the hope of them that are near unto God and of the sincere ones.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: O Mirza Nasru'llah, upon him be the Glory of God! He is the One Who gazeth from His Most Exalted Horizon. A Book from Us unto him who hath turned toward the horizon of the Cause when every ignorant and remote one turned away from it.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: O friends! Be not sorrowful, nor be ye shaken by the deeds of the oppressors. Praise be to God, ye have attained unto that which the divines of the earth, its rulers and learned ones are debarred from, though they were created for it.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: You became worthy of praise from the Concourse on High and the object of the Ancient Beauty's favors. His glance of favor encompasses you and His grace and bounty are complete. Be happy and joyful that such success was made possible.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: Thou, indeed, hath been most assiduous in thy labours and hath endured greatest troubles in the Path of God. This praiseworthy endeavour was spoken of in His Holy Presence, and is now also well-known and manifest in the Abha Kingdom.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: O servant of God, Ismail, who has attained unto the name of the Lord, the Counselor! Praise be to God that through the grace of the Lord of Names thou hast drunk from the ocean of faith and turned unto the horizon of divine knowledge.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: O Siyyid Muhammad, upon whom be the Glory of God! Thy name was mentioned in the presence of the Wronged One, Who hath remembered thee in such wise as nothing in all creation can equal, nor can any in the heavens or on earth prevent it.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: O Khammar! Blessed art thou, blessed art thou, who on the Promised Day didst run in the predestined garden in attendance upon His Holiness the All-Praised One, to aid the Cause of the All-Loving Lord. Blessed art thou, blessed art thou!

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: O illumined youth! With the utmost joy I read your spiritual letter and repeatedly chanted its phrases, which were imbued with heartfelt meaning. How delicate and refined were those words, springing from a heart filled with divine love!

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: "O ye who has turned to God! Render thanks to your Lord, the All-Gracious, inasmuch as the breeze of dawn has wafted over you from the mystical rose-gardens, and the fragrance of the flowers of the gardens of His signs has filled you."

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: O handmaid of Baha! This title is the pride of all titles and the essence of every bestowal. Praised be God, thy services match the requirement of this title and thou art striving in the path of the Ancient Beauty. Well done, well done!

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: Be steadfast in serving your Lord, speaking His praise, turning to Him, and soaring in His sublime atmosphere. Blessed art thou and blessed is he who has attained the most great steadfastness in the Cause of God, the Lord of all beings.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: O Mahdi! Upon thee be My glory! The Wronged One bears witness to thy turning, thy devotion, thy arising, thy presence, thy attentiveness, thy service and thy deeds in the Most Great Prison and the Most Mighty, Most Impregnable Fortress.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: O thou verdant myrtle planted in the Paradise of Sanctity! The smelling of the people of Baha is assuredly perfumed through the pure fragrance exhaled from the Garden of thine heart. Verily, I read those beautiful words traced by thy pen

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: Praise be to God that thou hast quaffed from the hand of divine bounty the wine of mystic knowledge and hast been illumined by the lights of the Sun of Revelation. The Supreme Pen hath ordained for thee that which will gladden thy heart.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: Praise befitteth Him Who, through His bounty and grace, opened wide the door of knowledge to the people of the world, and taught them the cause of preservation and the means of elevation, exaltation, progress and advancement of existence.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: This is the blessed morn of Naw-Ruz, and the lights of the Sun of Truth are radiant and manifest... that this family dwells beneath the sheltering shadow of the grace of the Divine Unity, and this household is encompassed by endless glory

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: The novel verses were secrets of a luminous heart. They are as sugar to the taste of the spiritually-minded and sweeter than honey to the palate of the divinely-attracted. They brought forth joy and delight...This verse is most excellent.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: Give thanks to God that you are assisted and confirmed...strive as much as you can in this service so that it may become the cause of your eternal glory and you may shine like a candle in the Abha Kingdom and become like a brilliant star.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: O Muhammad! Harken to the call from the luminous spot...Rejoice in that thou hast been mentioned before the Wronged One, and He hath revealed for thee that whereby thy name shall endure throughout the duration of His most excellent names.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: This sweet name and sugared appellation, when it flows from the pen and tongue of the sincere ones, bestows life...In any case, I became joyous from thy name. Thou too must become stirred and delighted by the mention of the Ancient Beauty.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: Well done, well done, for thou hast been attracted by the fragrances that have wafted from the gardens of God's Covenant. Bravo, bravo to thee, for thou hast been quickened by the spirit of thy Lord's tender care, the Mighty, the Bestower.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: O nightingale in the garden of Divine Unity! Blessed art thou, for thou hast warbled in the meadows of divine knowledge with the most wondrous melodies, and hast trilled in the groves of the Covenant with the sweetest rhythms and measures.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: O two faithful servants of the peerless Lord! Give thanks unto God that on this triumphant day you have become moths to the brightly-burning candle and have been consumed by the world-enkindling fire of love... May your souls be gladdened!

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: O nightingale of the gardens of divine knowledge! Though during this long period thou hast composed brilliant odes with perfect eloquence and fluency, this recent poem is a brilliant scattered pearl and matchless gems. It was well received

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: The letter you write was received and from its contents eternal joy was obtained... Praise be to God, now that region has come into motion again and a new vibration has been produced, and this has caused intense joy for the yearning ones.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: Blessed is the soul whom neither the might of the oppressors nor the clamor of the deniers hath kept back from turning toward the Most Exalted Horizon. Blessed art thou for having attained unto that which was sent down in the Books of God.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: Walk thou also in the footsteps of thy father and be characterized with his attributes and qualities. Enkindle thou his lamp and fructify his garden, so that thou mayest become his real son and worthy of the favors and gift of the Almighty.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: thou art renowned in the realm of the Concourse on High for thy love of the Beauty of Abha - may my spirit be a sacrifice for His loved ones - and art a distinguished and acceptable servant in the Kingdom of Oneness of the Lord of Grandeur

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: O God, my God! O Bewilderer of minds! O Encompasser of the thoughts of those endowed with understanding! O Thou Who art sanctified above every praise and commendation! O Thou Who art exalted above all glorification in the world of creation!

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: O Rida! God was well-pleased with thee and hath ordained for thee in the Tablet a station that was, in truth, exalted...Blessed art thou, for thou hast recognized thy Lord and purified thyself from turning unto every polytheist, accursed one

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: O thou who drinkest the choice wine of My love, who standest firm in service to My Cause, and who uttereth My beautiful praise!... Ever hath thy mention been and continues to be in the Most Holy Court. Blessed art thou and joy be unto thee!

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: The One Friend says: Praise be to God that you have attained to a bounty that is not equaled by anything in the heavens and earth. Know thou the value of this lofty, glorious station and be vocal in praise of the Beloved of all possibility.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: Blessed is she, and joy be unto thee, for having answered her Lord when the Call was raised betwixt earth and heaven, and for having turned unto Him and attained that which flowed from the Most Exalted Pen in the Sacred Scrolls and Tablets.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: The entire text is fundamentally one of praise and encouragement to Aqa Siyyid Aqa, particularly: "The robe of glory has been cut and prepared to the measure of your temples" and "Blessed art thou, and joy be unto thee and unto thy brothers"

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: O Muhammad-i-Tahir! Rejoice that the Most Great Ocean hath turned toward thee and desireth to cast upon thee, from the precincts of His mighty prison, the pearls of the All-Merciful's utterance. Rejoice thou and be of those who render thanks.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: O thou wondrous branch of the Divine Lote Tree! Through the favors of the Sovereign of existence, it is hoped that you will progress day by day in all things until it becomes evident and manifest that you have grown from the Sacred Lote Tree.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: Give thanks unto God for having aided thee to attain recognition and for causing thee to hear that which the Tree of Sinai doth utter. Praise be unto thee for having remembered the Prisoner, unto whom this Forbidden Tablet hath been revealed.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: The entire text is one of praise to God and encouragement to turn to Him, particularly: "Be thankful and say: Praise be unto Thee, O Thou Who hast appeared and manifested that which every reckoner and learned one was powerless to comprehend."

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: O Afnani! Upon you be the peace of God, His grace, His bounty and His gifts! Thou art ever mentioned in the presence of the Wronged One, nay rather thou art ever in His presence and art illumined by the splendors of the Sun of loving-kindness.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: O Muhammad! Upon you be the Glory of God and His praise in the kingdom of earth and heaven...and to exalt your mention among the Concourse on High, and to ordain for you that which will elevate you among those near ones of the people of heaven

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: This entire letter is essentially praise and encouragement to these young Japanese women, particularly: "Thank God that at this young age you have entered the divine Kingdom, become illumined, become heavenly, become divine, become merciful."

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: Whosoever taketh a step in such endeavor is indeed acceptable and favored by the Threshold of the Greatest Name, is respected by [?] and is the beloved of the hearts of the Concourse on High, and will be remembered and renowned by all peoples.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: Let these exalted words be thy love-song on the tree of Baha, O thou most holy and resplendent Leaf...Thus have We preferred thee and raised thee above the rest, as a sign of grace from Him Who is the Lord of the throne on high and earth below.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: O Mirza Sadiq, son of Jinab-i-Husayn, upon him be the Most Holy, Most Exalted, Most Great Glory of God! Thy name hath been mentioned before the Throne, and there hath been sent down for thee that which causeth minds and spirits to take flight.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: Praise be to God Who has illumined the world with the resplendent lamp of His Cause... O beloved of my heart, the servant wishes to expend an island of pens and an ocean of ink in your remembrance and praise and your arising to serve the Cause

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: O Baha'u'd-Din, light of the sincere ones... Rejoice, O my spirit, cause of my gladness and source of my joy, in that thou hast preserved my rights, hearkened unto my testament, stood firm in the Covenant, been illumined by the sign of radiance

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: Praise be to God that in this journey you are confirmed and successful, victorious and triumphant...Therefore, as much as you are able, scatter jewels and freely bestow brilliant pearls so that through their radiance the world may be illumined.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: Glory be to Thee, O Sender of the winds, Cleaver of the daybreak, Revealer of verses and Manifester of clear proofs! All things proclaim that Thou art God, there is none other God but Thee, the King, the Almighty, the Most High, the Most Great.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: Blessed art thou, O Nightingale, for having arisen to serve the Cause and for having spoken in praise of God, the Lord of the worlds. Verily, We caused thee to hear My greatest verses, aided thee in the Cause, and guided thee to the right path.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: The text opens with praise for the friends: "The faces were luminous and the countenances merciful. When I looked at them, I saw the friends present in the gathering of fellowship and found the utmost expansion of heart and dilation of breast."

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: Blessed is he who hath found its fragrance...Blessed is he who hath quaffed the choice wine of immortality from the hands of the bounty of his Lord, the Most Glorious, and joy be unto him who hath been named with the M and H in the Book of Names.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: Blessed art thou, O Mahdi, and joy be unto thee, O Mahdi! The Pen hath borne witness unto thee from the presence of the Ancient King and hath made mention of thee in such wise as caused the breezes of grace and generosity to waft over the world.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: "O thou who art attracted by the Fragrances of God! Blessed art thou, for thou hast lighted the lamp of the love of God in the glass of America... Fly away with joy, for God hath strengthened thee in this great gift, which is a glorious crown..."

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: O ye yearning one's who are quickened by the breeze of the love of God, flowing from the meadows of the Abha Kingdom. By the One True God, they who are the denizens of holiness, the gems of detachment, the temples of oneness, are longing for you.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: We have mentioned thee with that which shall endure as long as the names of thy Lord, the Possessor of what was and what shall be, shall endure. The glory be upon thee and upon every handmaiden who hath turned and attained unto this Decisive News

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: Praise the Sovereign of existence, Who from the ocean of bounty and grace accepted thy deed and revealed and sent down this Tablet especially for thee, that thou mayest with complete joy be occupied with the remembrance of the Lord of all beings.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: My God, my God! Praise be unto Thee for having given me to drink from the cup of Thy knowledge and caused me to hear the scratching of Thy Pen and made me to turn toward the Dayspring of Thy verses when most of Thy creation turned away from Thee.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: O handmaiden of God, be thou glad and smile through the favor of thy Lord...Is there any greater glory for thee than this? Nay, by God! Rather this is the crown of majesty shining upon thy brow, adorned with a brilliant pearl manifest to all eyes.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: You have ever been beneath the shade of the grace of the Self-Sufficient, the Transcendent, and His favoring glance has been turned toward you... Praise be to the Ancient Lord that you have attained to this station and turned toward His direction.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: Praise be unto the Lord of existence Who ordained humility and prostration as characteristics of the righteous and near ones... Glorified, glorified be He! How great is His power, how mighty His dominion, how glorious His remembrance and utterance!

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: Open your tongue in praise of the Ancient Beauty - may my spirit be sacrificed for His loved ones - so that the spirits of the Concourse on High may be stirred into motion and this gathering of the All-Merciful may increase in passion and rapture.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: His honor Mirza Habibullah from Tehran has offered the utmost praise and commendation of those illumined friends and divine companions, that praise be to God, Bijar has become the dawning-place of divine traces and has been illumined by the lights.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: Blessed art thou for having attained unto the recognition of God in His days and for having quaffed the choice wine in His wondrous Name...the Concourse on High, then the angels and the Spirit, have found from each one the fragrance of thy sincerity

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: O Beloved of my heart! The world appears ready at a time when complete despair prevails. Glory be to God, from this negation and this affirmation! God willing, a new creation shall appear and become manifest between the two, despite the polytheists.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: Blessed is he who has testified to that which God has testified...You are the one who has attained to recognition and heard the Call when it was raised between earth and heaven. This is from His great bounty, to which My Manifest Book bears witness.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: O Murad! Rejoice in that the Desire of the world hath remembered thee. Nothing that thou witnesseth and beholdest can equal this, as testified by His Clear Book. Blessed art thou for having rent asunder the veils and turned unto the All-Informed One.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: Upon thee be My glory and My loving-kindness... Grieve thou not over anything. In all matters place thy trust in God. Verily, He is with His Afnan and will manifest unto them whatsoever He willeth. He, verily, is the All-Bountiful, the Most Generous.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: Verily, those whose faces light up and whose hearts are illumined when the verses of God are recited unto them - these are they who are nourished by the enduring, single, eternal, absolute, divine bounty and who shall inherit the gardens of Paradise.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: Guidance is the love of the Beauty of Oneness. Praise be to God that its lamp is aflame within thy heart, and it is a gift of guidance to the path of the Kingdom. Praise be to God that thy heart, through this bounty, is like a rose garden and meadow.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: Well done in what thou hast done, for the matter of Huquq dependeth upon the acceptance of the souls themselves. Should any soul, with the utmost joy and fragrance, of his own free will, desire to pay the Right of God, it is acceptable; otherwise, no.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: Noble are the roots and excellent are the qualities, for the relationship is real...O joy to every servant who is firm and growing, whose heart's soil is stirred and nourished by this mighty outpouring from the Kingdom of thy Ancient Lord's Covenant!

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: The Tongue of Grandeur beareth witness to thy turning and devotion...Despite the divines, thou hast drunk from the cup of immortality. Neither the doubts of the people nor the might of men could prevent thee from drawing nigh unto the Lord of creation.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: O 'Abdu'r-Rahim! Hearken unto the call of the All-Merciful from this noble scene. Blessed art thou, for thy letter hath attained the presence of the Throne and won the glances of thy Lord's favors, the Bestower, the Munificent, the Mighty, the Generous.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: Blessed is the strong one whom the affairs of the world have not weakened, and the seeing one whom the veils of the oppressors have not hindered. And blessed is he who hath arisen to serve the Cause, and the tongue that hath spoken His beauteous praise.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: O my Rustam! In truth thou art a Tahmtan [mighty hero] and an enemy to the life of every Ahriman [evil spirit]. Thou art divine, thou art luminous, thou art merciful, and the proof of thy courage lies in thy services rendered in the time of difficulties

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: Blessed is the soul that hath heard and attained unto it. Blessed art thou and blessed are they who have heard and said: "Praise be to Thee, O Lord of the worlds, and glory be to Thee, O Thou Who art the Goal of all who are in the heavens and on earth."

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: O Sulayman! In the name of the one true God, the Speaker! O Sulayman, strive that in the days of the one true Friend thou mayest attain unto a station whose mention hath been inscribed by the Most Exalted Pen in the Book of Names. This Day hath no peer.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: Thy dear son is cultured and refined, therefore he hastened to this blessed clime and engaged in service, becoming a source of comfort. With the utmost sincerity and purity, love and faithfulness, he has devoted himself to service at the Divine Threshold

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: O ancient friend and long-time companion! Thou art among the foremost ones and of the company of those drawn nigh. "The foremost ones! The foremost ones! These are they who are brought nigh!" Thou art worthy of every praise and deserving of every bounty.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: O Karbila'i Ahmad (or Ahmad)! Your name hath been mentioned before the Wronged One, and there hath been sent down for thee that which caused the dwellers of the most exalted Paradise to perceive the fragrance of their Lord, the Speaking, the All-Knowing.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: O thou who gazest upon the Kingdom of Abha! Numerous letters have thus far been sent, and drops from the oceans of love surging in the essence of the heart have been expressed. And now once again we have thought of thee and set about penning this missive.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: O President and respected members of the Peace Society of New York! O divine society and heavenly hosts! Each time your lofty aims and the sublimity of your resolve come to mind, soul and conscience are moved to joy and delight, bringing gladness and hope

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: O spiritual friends of Balaakhan, upon them be greetings and praise! Everyone who has passed through Balaakhan, especially Jinab-i-Amin, has offered the utmost praise for the friends of Balaakhan, that those souls are in the utmost certitude and assurance

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: The entire letter is filled with joyous praise and encouragement to the believers, opening with "O you who thirst for the fountain of life! It is morning and 'Abdu'l-Baha is joyous and glad in remembrance of you. Joy upon joy and delight upon delight..."

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: O Son of Nabil! God willing, may you circle round the All-Merciful in all worlds, attain His favors, and find rest in His shadow. Blessed art thou for having turned, drawn nigh, attained the presence, heard, and witnessed with thine outward illumined eye.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: O thou who art young in years but mature in faith! Hearken unto the call of thy Lord, the All-Merciful. Verily He is the Speaker, the All-Knowing, the All-Wise. We have received thy glorification and have sent thee glorification from this luminous horizon.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: Praise be to God that on the Day of the dawning of the Sun of the horizons you became lovers, and turned to the Lord of the Covenant. You are confirmed, successful, victorious and triumphant. What the pure ones and the free ones longed for, you have found.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: Blessed is the soul that hath attained unto and recognized this Day. Thus doth the Wronged One make mention of thee that thou mayest know and be of them that are thankful for His having acquainted thee with and aided thee to recognize this resplendent Day.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: The text offers praise and encouragement to the recipient: "This servant bears witness that you have ever been remembered, observed, present, near, honored, content, well-pleased, immortalized in the paradise of our Lord the All-Merciful's good-pleasure..."

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: Glory be unto Thee, O Thou Guide of the seekers of the Sought One and the Magnet of the lovers to the Presence of the Beloved! Praise be unto Thee for Thou hast guided every thirsty one to the Fountain of Life and every ailing one to the Merciful Physician.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: Praise be to God! Through the grace and loving-kindness of the Blessed Beauty, may my spirit be a sacrifice for the threshold of His dust, we arrived from Alexandria to Marseilles in the utmost joy and fragrance and under the protection of the All-Merciful.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: Verily doth the Noble One make mention of His servant, the noble one, that he may rejoice in the remembrance of his Lord and be of the thankful. Blessed art thou and he in that ye have attained unto the Dayspring of the Cause. This is indeed a great bounty.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: O My Leaf! Upon thee be My glory! The grace of God, exalted be His glory, hath granted thee confirmation and bestowed success...but thou didst turn thyself and through the scratching of the Most Exalted Pen didst attain unto the fruits of the uttermost Tree.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: O people of Baha! Be as clouds that from you may fall that which will cause the earth to grow. This beseemeth him who hath turned unto God, the Lord of all men. Be ye of such character that the attributes of God may be manifested from you amidst all else.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: O Akbar! Your mention hath been made in the Most Great Presence, and the glance of favor hath been directed towards thee. God willing, thou shalt not remain deprived of the Sun of Divine Providence which hath dawned from the horizon of the heaven of bounty.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: Blessed is the soul that hath drunk from the chalice of steadfastness in the Name of God and hath arisen to His mention and praise. Blessed is the eye that hath beheld the lights of the All-Merciful's revelation and the ear that hath hearkened unto His call.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: Blessed art thou for having turned, directed thyself, and hastened to visit and circumambulate the House of God. This is a station before which tongues fail in its mention and praise, and every architect is powerless to define its attributes and excellences.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: Blessed art thou who hast turned to the Prison, purely for the sake of God, the Lord of all worlds, and hast turned to Him when all the divines of the earth turned away, save those rescued by the hand of thy Lord's will, the Strong, the Mighty, the Powerful.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: You have been guided by the light of guidance and illumined by the brilliance of the Supreme Concourse, kindled by the fire of the love of God and hath directed thyself to His Kingdom, partook of the heavenly table and enjoyed the fruits of the Tree of Life!

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: I have received your new letter and read it with boundless joy, for it demonstrated the intensity of your sincerity in the love of God and your pure intentions toward the loved ones of God. May God increase your nearness, attraction, spirit and enkindlement!

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: Blessed is he in that the Beauty of the Ancient of Days remembereth him in the Most Great Prison, that joy may possess him in the days of his Lord, the All-Forgiving, in such wise that no sadness shall overtake him in the Cause of his Lord, the All-Choosing.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: O Zayn! Thou didst mention Haji 'A.B. At this moment the gaze of favor is directed towards him. We make mention of him through God's verses, give him glad tidings of His loving-kindness, and counsel him with that which beseemeth His glorious and wondrous Day.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: Thou, however, hast become a manifestation of divine guidance and a recipient of heavenly favors. Thou art the lady of the world and a crown upon the children of Adam. In the Abha Kingdom may thy face be radiant and thine eyes be bright, O handmaiden of Baha.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: Praise God that thou hast heard the Call of Baha'u'llah and drunk from the chalice of the wine of Baha'u'llah's teachings. Thou hast been freed from ancient traditions and attained unto reality. Thou hast opened thine eyes and witnessed the light of guidance.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: O manifestation of the bounty of the Most Glorious Beauty! How blessed is that family wherein all are firm and steadfast in the Covenant and Testament...Give thanks that you have become the manifestation of such favors and the dawning-place of such attributes

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: O friends of Abdu l-Baha! The most great glad tidings have reached me! Abdu l-Baha has heard joyous news of the glad tidings of fellowship amongst the friends. The friends have made Abdu l-Baha very happy because of their recent efforts of unity and reunion.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: This is a Book that beareth witness to your condition and to what hath befallen you both in the path of God, the Mighty, the Most Praised. Blessed are ye for having attained unto the Most Great Bounty and followed the precepts of God, the Mighty, the Beloved.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: Blessed is the handmaid who has attained unto the Tablet of God and remained steadfast in this Cause... Blessed art thou for having fulfilled the Covenant and turned toward the Intended One... Thou art she to whose love for Him the All-Merciful hath testified

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: Praise be to God Who gladdened His servant with the rising of the sixth star from the horizon of the heaven of your bounty... O Zayn! Give them the glad-tidings of My mercy, My forgiveness, My grace and My bounty. We have forgiven them as a token of Our favor.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: O sapling of the garden of the love of God! Give thanks to His Holy Presence that thou hast grown up beside the stream of God's love, tasted of the honey of divine knowledge, drunk from the cup of heavenly favors, and attained acceptance at the Most Holy Court.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: O thou whose nostrils are perfumed with the sweet fragrance of the garment of the Joseph of eternity! Praise God that in these days thou hast taken shelter beneath the Lote-Tree of the utmost boundary, and hast arrived at the wellspring of faith and certitude.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: Grieve not over anything, for He is with thee and will aid thee through His grace, and He is the All-Bountiful, the All-Generous...By the life of God, that hath been ordained for them which no hearts have comprehended and no eyes have witnessed the like thereof.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: Blessed art thou, for the Sun of Grace hath dawned upon thee time and again, again and yet again. By God! A single word that proceedeth from the Tongue of Grandeur in praise of His loved ones cannot be equaled by all that existeth in the seen and unseen realms.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: Praise be to God Who hath called all unto His most exalted Paradise and His all-highest Heaven, and unto stations which the pens of all creation have failed to recount, and which the tablets witnessed in the world of creation are powerless to enumerate and bear.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: Praise be to God that the faces of those two brothers are illumined by the divine light like the brilliant moon...Therefore those two brothers, like the two figures of the constellation Gemini in the celestial heaven, shone forth from the horizon of fulfillment.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: O Lion! We have mentioned thee time and again, and this is yet another time. Give thanks to the Lord of all beings and the Master of the hereafter and of former times for this bounty which hath been manifested from His Most Exalted Pen in this perspicuous Tablet.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: O Yehuda! God willing, mayest thou be confirmed in that which causes the exaltation of the Word of God. The Most Exalted Pen beareth witness to his orientation, his turning to God, and the loftiness and excellence of his station before God, exalted be His glory.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: Blessed art thou for having turned unto the Intended One and believed in God after every froward polytheist turned away. Give thanks unto thy Lord for having sent down unto thee that which shall immortalize thy mention throughout the kingdom of earth and heaven.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: Your cordial and sincere greetings have reached me and have brought to me great spiritual happiness. Praise be to God that you have been guided by His light towards the Sun Truth. Praise be unto Him that He hath given you eternal life and celestial illumination.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: O servant of the Most Glorious Beauty! Your call has reached the Concourse on High and your prayer has been accepted at the Holy Threshold of the Most Glorious Beauty... And you, O one enkindled with the fire of God's love, be of good cheer and rejoice in spirit

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: How blessed are you! How blessed are you that you have become the cause and brought forth the hopes and aspirations of the Prophets into the realm of manifestation. The glances of divine favor encompass you and the gaze of the All-Merciful is directed toward you.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: O Mir Muhammad-Taqi! Hearken unto My call, for verily it will draw thee to My Kingdom and bring thee nigh unto a station which the pens are powerless to describe. Be thou grateful and say: "Praise be unto Thee, O Thou in Whose grasp are the reins of all mankind!"

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: All praise be to God Who hath spoken that wherewith He gladdened the servants in the Qur'an: The Kingdom on that day shall be God's, the Almighty, the All-Bountiful. And praise be to God Who hath moved the Supreme Pen and made it a herald between earth and heaven.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: Praise be to the Beloved that thou hast arisen with complete dedication to serve the Cause. God willing, thou shalt be assisted and confirmed in all conditions and act in accordance with that which He loveth and is pleased with, even as thou hast been and art now.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: But thou, O thou whose eyes have been gladdened by beholding the lights, whose breast hath been dilated through perceiving the signs, whose spirit hath been made joyous through the fragrances of the flowers, and whose heart hath been revived by the breezes of dawn

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: O maid-servant of God! Be rejoiced for God hath chosen thee for His love and sheltered thee under the shade of His Kingdom...Therefore, praise God for that He honored thee with presence in this great century and new cycle and caused thee to attain this new bounty.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: "From the beginning of the Cause, his honor Baqiroff has served with the utmost truthfulness, purity, firmness and steadfastness"; "That blessed soul who was the joy of the righteous and exemplar of the chosen ones deserves the utmost respect, honor and reverence"

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: Blessed art thou, O Tuba! Glad tidings unto thee, O Tuba! Joy be unto thee, O Tuba! Glory be unto thee, O Tuba!... Would that the handmaidens of the earth knew thy great station with God! I swear by the Ancient Beauty that the queens of the world would serve thee.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: "Praise be to God that through the grace and gift of the Ancient Beauty, may my spirit be a sacrifice for His loved ones, servants have gathered under the banner of the Covenant such that the horizons are perfumed by the fragrances from the gardens of their hearts"

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: Rejoice in My favor unto you, for nothing that can be mentioned or described in creation equals it. How can sadness overtake you when you find yourself upon the shore of the ocean of joy and gladness? Soon He will exalt your station and make you a sign of guidance.

Subject: praise and encouragement
