Quotation: O ye two saplings of the Divine Garden! Render thanks unto God that ye have sprung from the Blessed Tree and are being nurtured by the dewdrops of the cloud of providence in the embrace of kinship to the Tree of Truth. This is a supreme bounty and a most great gift.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: "We make mention of those among My loved ones who have believed, who have cast aside all else save Me and have turned to My luminous horizon... Give thanks unto God for this bounty which has encompassed the world and for this mercy which has preceded all existence."

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: O Muhammad-Qabli-Taqi! Blessed art thou for having turned thy face unto My presence and for having had thy name mentioned before My throne... Blessed art thou for having cast away and taken up that which thou didst when thou didst attain unto the Tablet of thy Lord.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: Blessed art thou for having turned unto the Countenance when it appeared... Blessed art thou, O Muhammad, for having turned unto and believed in Him Who is the Goal when all on earth turned away, save those whom God, the Lord of what was and what shall be, did will.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: Blessed art thou for having been faithful to God's Covenant and His Testament, and for having believed in Him when every doubting polytheist denied Him. Soar in the atmosphere of joy for the Lord of Revelation remembereth thee from the direction of His mighty Prison.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: I have utmost satisfaction with him. May Jinab-i-Fadil-i-Shirazi succeed in creating such melody and song as to become a discoverer of mysteries and a sign of the gift of the Self-Sufficient Lord. Jinab-i-Mirza Yusuf Khan is truly the Joseph of the Egypt of servitude

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: O K..., upon him be the Glory of God! He is the All-Knowing, the All-Informed. We promised thee a Tablet and have revealed for thee that which brings joy to the eyes of the people of the Most Exalted Paradise. Give thanks and praise to thy Lord for this great bounty.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: O you who are young in years but great in heavenly gifts! I chanted your supplication to God and was gladdened by its meanings which indicated your exceeding love for God, your great yearning for the Kingdom of God, and your utmost attraction to the fragrances of God.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: O Hassan, upon thee be the Glory of God, Lord of the hidden and manifest! Thou art present and mentioned before His face. Give thanks unto thy Lord for this manifest bounty. We made mention of thee before in such wise as did perfume the cities of wisdom and utterance.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: O Mahdi! Thy name was mentioned in the presence of the Wronged One. We make mention of thee with such remembrance as will gladden the hearts of the people of the cities of the Bayan...Praise be to God that thou hast attained to mention, praise and service of the Cause.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: Blessed art thou, O Nur! Thou art he who hath attained unto My days and dwelt beneath My shadow... Blessed is the ear that hath heard My call, and the eye that hath beheld the traces of My Pen, and the face that hath turned toward the lights of My luminous countenance.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: Blessed art thou for having inhaled the fragrance of God from His House, and for having diffused the sweet savors of His Cause amongst His creatures, and for being among the triumphant ones... This deed of thine shines forth among thy works like the sun among the stars

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: Praise be to God that thou hast been assisted and confirmed with such a bounty, and hast become the recipient of such a favor. This hidden pearl and treasured gem is the adornment of the crown of the people of the Kingdom. Know thou its worth and engage in thanksgiving

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: May God confirm and strengthen thee to serve His Cause and to enable thee to speak His praise among the maid-servants of the Merciful...Rejoice at the glad-tidings of God, in this day wherein the fragrances of holiness have perfumed the nostrils of all in the universe!

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: Verily, I am informed of thy letter which showeth how thou art praising God, hast acknowledged the unity of God, art attracted to His kingdom and art thanking Him for His favor... O glad-tidings be unto thee for this great gift! O blessed art thou for this worthy deed!

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: O ancient friend of 'Abdu'l-Baha! Although for some time I have not found the opportunity to write you a letter, yet at all times during prayer I have sought divine confirmations for you. And praise be to God, His all-encompassing grace and perfect bounty are with you.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: The services of that family from the beginning dawn of truth until this time are renowned throughout the world and witnessed by the spiritual ones. Indeed, that family is deserving and worthy of every kind of bounty, and this recent service is added to those services.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: "The glad-tidings of your attraction and enkindlement, ecstasy and exhilaration, hath reached us before... Mr. ... and Mr. ... arrived and praised you with the utmost enthusiasm, that 'the friends of Hoboken are firm, steadfast and eloquent (in delivering the Truth).'"

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: We have found the fragrance of thy love, O Beloved of the horizons, and We are aware of what is in thy heart. Blessed art thou for having attained the presence of the Beloved and for having entered, appeared, and heard the call of thy Lord, the Mighty, the Impregnable.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: In reality the German Baha'is are the embodiment of attraction and enthusiasm. They are Baha'is by deeds and actions. Each one of these friends is like a bright candle, and a luminous star. Mr and Mrs. Consul Schwarz are two wonderful Baha'is, full of love and kindness.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: O Professor 'Ali-Akbar! That which thou hast composed hath come before Us, and God hath accepted from thee that which thy tongue hath uttered and thy pen hath inscribed. Verily He was with thee and aided thee to uphold the truth, and He, verily, is the Ancient Bestower.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: We have, therefore, moved the Pen to make mention of thee, as a grace from Us unto thee and unto all peoples. Blessed art thou for having attained in the days of God and discovered that which was diffused from the garment of My remembrance, the Mighty, the Well-Beloved.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: Your mention was made in the presence of the Wronged One and your cry was heard. God's grace hath ever surrounded and will continue to surround the name of Jamal and those connected with him... His honor Jamal, upon him be my glory, hath expressed satisfaction with you.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: Praise be to God that thou hast been remembered in the Most Great Prison, and the Face of the Ancient of Days hath turned towards thee from the Most Exalted Station. We have revealed the verses and manifested the clear proofs, and We have called all to the Straight Path.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: O thou assured leaf! From the day thou didst return until now, thou hast ever been before Our gaze and constantly mentioned...praise be to God, thou didst attain certitude in the Bab, remained protected during the great convulsion, became a believer in the Beauty of Abha

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: O thou who art kindled by the fire of the Love of God! Rejoice through the fragrance of God and be attracted by the melodies of the holy birds in the garden of gifts of God! Blessed thou art for this great abundance! Glad-tidings unto thee because of this manifest light!

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: We send greetings to the travelers in the realms of the All-Merciful and the leaves of the Tree of Glory. God willing, may they be engaged in the remembrance of the Friend with utmost joy and expansion, with spirit and delight, and be happy and content in His remembrance.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: O Shamsiyyih, daughter of my brother! God willing, through the favors of the Countenance of Divine Unity, mayest thou shine forth even as the sun from the horizon of the heaven of certitude, that the darkened hearts of the heedless handmaidens may be illumined by its rays.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: Blessed are you in that you have cast away vain imaginings and taken the cup of certitude through this manifest Name...Blessed are you in that you have turned to the Most Exalted Horizon and faced toward the Qiblih of all horizons when every polytheist turned away from it.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: O ye dear handmaidens at the threshold of the One God! Though this letter is written briefly and collectively, yet its profound meaning lies in these very words "dear handmaidens" and suffices. I hope that day by day ye may become dearer in the court of the Blessed Beauty.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: These souls are mentioned in the Supreme Concourse; their names are recorded in the Kingdom of Abha; they are the favored ones at the Threshold of the Blessed Perfection. They are the quintessence of creation; for they have arisen to serve the believers of God unselfishly.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: Blessed art thou to receive this cup brimming with the choice wine of thy merciful and compassionate Lord's bounty. I have read thy words which bespeak thine intense yearning, thy radiant countenance, thy receptive heart, and thy abundant portion of God's outpouring mercy.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: O leaf! Thy mention hath been made before the Wronged One, and this Most Holy, Most Exalted Tablet hath been sent down for thee from the heaven of My Will. We beseech God that He may aid thee to drink from every letter of the divine Tablet a chalice - nay, rather, an ocean.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: Beloved of the heart, his honor Aqa Mirza 'Abdu'llah, upon him be the glory of God and His grace. The noble letter, like a spiritual messenger, illumined and adorned the heart and soul with the light of remembrance and utterance. In truth it brought joy and bestowed bounty.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: O servant of God! How great is thy blessedness for thou hast been revived by the fragrant breaths of the All-Merciful...The eyes of the One True God in His loving kindness are directed to thee. What more couldst thou wish for and what other hope couldst thou possibly desire?

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: Blessed is he who hath hearkened unto His most sweet call and acted according to that which was enjoined upon him in His perspicuous Book...Blessed art thou inasmuch as thou hast turned toward the Most Sublime Horizon at a time when most of mankind have turned away therefrom

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: We testify that We have mentioned you before with verses from which shone forth from the horizon of each letter the sun of God's loving-kindness, the Lord of all worlds...We have desired at this time to adorn your head once again with the crown of your Lord's loving-kindness

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: Whosoever today turns toward the true Kaaba is reckoned among the gems of existence before the Worshipped One... The loved ones of that land who have drunk from the Kawthar of recognition and who gaze toward the horizon of the Cause are all remembered in the Most Holy Court.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: Blessed is the heart that hath turned unto Him and the countenance that hath been directed towards Him. Blessed art thou, and blessed is he that dwelleth in thee, and joy be unto thee and unto him who hath attained thy presence and established for himself a seat within thee.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: Blessed art thou for having migrated unto God until thou didst reach the city whose name hath become renowned among all created things. O servant, rejoice within thyself at these missives which We have sent unto thee, that thou mayest be of them that are filled with gladness.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: O my beloved daughter! Thy letter was received. Its contents imparted the utmost joy, for it indicated that the star is shining, and that she speaketh forth and summoneth the people to the Kingdom of God. It is certain that her brilliance shall increase as day followeth day.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: Blessed art thou for guiding Fred Cobourn unto the Fountain of the Water of Life, caused him to enter the Ark of Safety, demonstrated unto him the manifest signs, and proved to him the elegant proofs. May God reward thee with the best of rewards, in the end and the beginning.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: "she hath glorified Thy name amongst Thy handmaidens whilst enraptured with the scene of Thy grandeur. She hath returned unto Thee with her heart overflowing with attraction to the Abha Horizon, her bosom gladdened with faith, and her face whitened with the light of guidance."

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: From the letter, which was a nose-gay from the Rose Garden of Significance, a sweet fragrance was inhaled. Thou has supplicated to become a word in the Book of Love, attain to Truth, love the enemies and be firm in the Cause of God. All these desires are accepted and beloved.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: Your sweet melodies and wondrous, sugary songs bring joy to the hearts of the friends and are the cause of spiritual delight. The odes that you compose and chant in praise of the Ancient Beauty bestow eternal life upon the spirit and grant happiness and gladness to the heart.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: O Siyyid Husayn, upon thee be the Most Holy, Most Ancient, Most Great Glory of God! We have heard thy call and what thou hast mentioned before the Remembrance of the worlds, and from thy letter We perceived the fragrance of thy love for thy Lord, the All-Knowing, the All-Wise.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: O Mahdi! Thou hast been mentioned in such wise that the fragrance thereof shall never cease to perfume creation throughout the duration of utterance. We beseech God - exalted be He - to forgive thee, thy parents and thy spouse. Verily, He is the All-Forgiving, the All-Merciful.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: Mr. Amin in this journey praised your dignity and composure, that the friends of Shirvan are like fierce lions and raging elephants - they have no fear of danger and seek no shelter or shield. They are willing to sacrifice their lives and are divine devotees and spiritual ones

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: O handmaiden of God! The Most Holy, Most Great, Most Ancient One makes mention from Our presence to her who has turned to the Countenance...Thy mention hath been made before the Throne and this Tablet hath been revealed for thee whereby thy name hath been recorded in the Tablets.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: O Ali, upon thee be my Glory! Blessed art thou, O Ali, for having turned towards Him, migrated, and directed thy steps until thou didst attain a place wherein was heard the rustling of the Blessed Tree, the flowing of the waters of oneness, and the whistling of the eternal winds.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: O sovereign of the realm of wisdom, don the crown of divine bestowals and ascend the throne of heavenly youth and prosperity. Seek a ray of divine grace and soar from the depths of the well to the height of the moon. Kindle thy face and burn away the veil of the world's ignorance.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: In my sojourn in London I witnessed thine utmost kindness and I am most pleased with thee. Praise be to God that thou wert confirmed, even as I had hoped, in thy service to the Kingdom of God during thy journey to Stuttgart, and didst become the means of spreading the word of God.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: Blessed is everyone who has sought today the station wherein the call was raised from the Ultimate Tree: "The Kingdom belongs to God, the Mighty, the Loving!" Blessed art thou for having attained unto this Most Great Cause whereby the limbs of every doubting scholar have trembled.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: Therefore, render thanks unto God for this bestowal, hold fast unto the Sure Handle, and be moved with joy by the favors of thy Lord, the All-Glorious, in that He chose thee for His love, selected thee for His knowledge, and elected thee to raise His remembrance amongst the worlds.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: O My Messenger, upon thee be all the glory of the Most Glorious! O my friend and messenger of My Cause, upon thee be My glory and My mercy! Blessed art thou, and joy be unto thee, in that thou hast arisen to serve the Cause and art speaking in praise of God, the Lord of the worlds.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: This is a Book from Us unto thee, that the breathings of revelation may draw thee unto God, the Help in Peril, the Self-Subsisting. Be thankful unto thy Lord, inasmuch as thou hast been mentioned before the Throne, and that which shall gladden the eyes hath been revealed unto thee.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: That which thou didst compose hath come before the Wronged One, and the servant present hath recited it. We heard it and responded to thee at that time with an utterance that illumined the horizon of the heaven of understanding, as a token of grace from God, the Lord of the worlds.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: Within the rose-garden of Thy mercy, and in the paradise of Thy favour, grant that this assemblage of Thy loved ones may become as fresh and ever-verdant cypresses that line the riverbanks of Singleness; and cause these brilliant stars to shine above the horizon of the All-Merciful.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: O illumined youth! Your letter dated February 10, 1921 was received. Its contents were eloquent and bore witness to the spirituality and illumination of your heart and soul, heralding that through divine confirmations and heavenly grace Shiraz has become filled with melody and song.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: Truly, they brought delight and gladness to all and became the cause of happiness and bliss. Such is the nature of thy musk-scented letter that when opened, the fragrances of the love of God are inhaled therefrom. It is evidence of thy firmness and steadfastness in the Cause of God.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: The springtime of utterance has come, and the signs of mercy and generosity have appeared from the April showers of God's loving-kindness, the Lord of all worlds. Blessed and great is this Day. Well is it with the soul that has acquired lofty stations and attained unto eternal life.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: Be at peace through God's grace and mercy... Blessed is he who has attained its lights and manifestations... Joy to those who have attained the recognition of God... God willing, may you be joyous through the bounties of the Self-Sufficient... Rejoice and be among the thankful ones.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: Blessed art thou for having attained unto the sweet fragrances of My love in My days, and for having held fast unto that which thou wast commanded in My Most Holy Book, which We sent down from the heaven of Our Will and made as the Lamp of Guidance to guide men unto My Straight Path.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: Praise, glory, exaltation and sanctification, sanctified above the understanding of all on earth and in heaven, befitteth the Most Desired One, Who hath opened the door of correspondence with the finger of power and hath granted victory to His Cause through the hands of the heedless.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: His honor the Trustee [Amin] offers utmost praise and commendation for the conduct and behavior of those friends who, with truly Baha'i character and disposition, associate with people, engage in guiding souls, and are intimate and familiar with servitude to the King of the Kingdom.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: Blessed art thou, inasmuch as thou hast chosen thy destination, and set out upon thy journey, in such wise that neither the vagaries of the rulers nor the veils of the learned could deter thee; and hast left thy home trusting wholly in God, thy Lord, the All-Glorious, the All-Loving.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: Praise be to God, ye are truly attributed unto Him and are mentioned in His presence, and in the eternal Book your names and your remembrance have been inscribed by the Most Exalted Pen. Every mention boweth in submission before this mention and every book is humbled before this Word.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: The letter of the Afnan is accounted in the presence of the Wronged One among exalted words, for from the Lote-Tree of his mention is kindled the fire of love and from his praise wafts the fragrance of the love of the All-Merciful. Blessed is he and blessed are they who have attained.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: O thou confident soul who art content and patient! Verily, I read thy welcome letter and was informed of its contents which gladdened the hearts of the unitarians (i.e., the believers at Acca) of thy desire for God's confirmation in the service of His Cause among the sincere servants.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: Dear brother, praise be to God that for some time now thou hast been occupied at the threshold of the Ancient Lord with the mention of that Friend and Companion, engaged and familiar therewith. They say that thou hast not forgotten Him for a moment, and I bear witness that this is true.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: These two sons are like two shining jewels that God hath given thee. Be thou grateful to God that others like these two exist in the world. After faith and certitude, there is no greater gift than perfect, wise and truthful children. Praise be to God that He hath bestowed this upon thee

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: My earnest hope is that thou wilt be a companion to this one beloved friend and thou wilt sit with that other most loved one. Praise be to God that thou hast attained the sacred threshold and that thy countenance has been suffused with light when thou didst prostrate thyself at His gate

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: O My Afnan! The Most Exalted Pen beareth witness that thou hast turned unto God, the Creator of the heavens, and hast testified to that which the Tongue of Grandeur hath testified. Rejoice thou in My mention and My testimony. By the life of God! Nothing in the world can equal these two.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: O Ataullah of Abadih, upon him be the Most Holy, Most Great, Most Glorious Glory of God! How sweet is My remembrance of him who has turned to the Kaaba of My Beauty and drunk the wine of reunion with Me from the hands of My bounty and attained the fragrances of My revelation in My days.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: O My Name! Upon thee be My glory and My loving-kindness. Thy letter has arrived and brought Us the glad tidings of thy release from prison, and this day was for Us a memorable day. O thou who hast dawned from the horizon of steadfastness! He is with thee wheresoever thou art and wilt be.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: Your letters have all been received. They were sources of joy and happiness, for they indicated firmness and steadfastness. I became exceedingly delighted that--praise be to God!--that sincere friend is like unto a lamp enkindled with the love of God and is serving the world of humanity.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: O Leaf! Rejoice in that the Tree which was raised up in truth and which spoke "Verily there is no God but I, the Forgiving, the Generous" makes mention of thee. Praise be to God that thou hast been assisted to attain unto that which most of the handmaidens of the earth have not attained.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: This news brought joy and gladness. Surely it is fitting that they increase this bounty day by day... The Parsi friends have truly arisen in faithfulness, truthfulness and reconciliation, have walked the path of His good-pleasure... Therefore, this servant is infinitely pleased with them

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: O handmaid of God, sister of His Honor Nazar, mother of Aqa Husayn, the most ancient, the most great! A mention from Our presence unto her who has turned to the Qiblih of the world and has drunk the choice wine of grace from the hands of the favors of her Lord, the Mighty, the Praiseworthy

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: Blessed is the eye that hath beheld My most exalted horizon, and the ear that hath heard My most sweet call, and the heart that hath turned to My glorious and impregnable station...Blessed art thou, O Muhammad, in that thou hast confined matters to the mention and praise of the Wronged One

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: In truth, thou art godly, merciful, divine and spiritual, and the proof of this is that whenever I think of thee, a spirit of joy and delight comes over me and heart and soul become glad. Jinab-i-Amin offered endless praise for the manner, behavior, words and deeds of that faithful friend

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: It was observed that, praise be to God, it is a record of what was and what will be...Know then with certainty that your blessed names are inscribed and recorded in the Abha Kingdom on the Preserved Tablet and the Unfurled Scroll, and each one is blessed with the eternal glory of servitude

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: This is a bounty that God hath specially conferred upon them when the lights dawned forth, the mysteries were revealed, and the signs were spread abroad. In the days of the Manifestation they were intoxicated with the wine of certitude and derived light from the Manifestation of the Mount.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: Blessed is he who, when he heard God's prohibition, desisted and returned to his place, enkindled with the fire of love and longing. By My life, he is among the triumphant ones and among the visitors. Blessed art thou, O son of Ahmad, in that thou hast turned to God, the Lord of the worlds.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: Blessed is the servant who hath turned away from the manifestations of tyranny and wickedness, setting his face toward the Dayspring of righteousness and piety. By My life! He is assuredly among the people of Baha in a Book of which none is aware save God, the All-Knowing, the All-Informed.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: Glorified be the majesty of God, our Lord and the Lord of the Mighty Throne. The handwriting of that beloved of the heart arrived like a luminous pearl, bestowing something upon every limb, but upon the heart it bestowed an ocean of joy. The writing was pleasing and the utterance was beloved.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: He is God - exalted be His glory, His greatness and His power! Praise be to God Who hath revealed unto His servants that which draweth them nigh unto Him and profiteth them in this world and the next, and Who hath provided them with the banquet of divine knowledge and the bounty of certitude.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: I hope that you will ever be assisted and confirmed in rendering services. This is the cause of illumination of the human countenance in the world of contingent being. Give thanks unto God that you are the recipient of His gracious regard and are encompassed by the favors of His Divine Unity.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: Truly, you are firm and steadfast in service at the Threshold of the Most Glorious Beauty, showing the utmost perseverance, and you are a partner and associate in serving the loved ones of God and those circumambulating the Center of Light and visitors to the Sacred Threshold of 'Abdu'l-Baha.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: O Afnan, upon thee be My glory! We make mention of thee at this hour with that whereby the hearts of them that are nigh unto God have taken flight. The glory be upon thee from Us and upon them that love thee and hearken unto thy word concerning the Cause of God, the Lord of this wondrous Day.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: Praise be to the sanctified Lord of all creation, Who is worthy and deserving, Who hath adorned every age, era and century with that which His consummate wisdom requireth, and Who hath commanded a matter that all might act upon it and be preserved from the vicissitudes of this transient world.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: Praise be to God! Mr. A.B., upon him be My Glory, hath attained unto God's favors and is occupied with His remembrance and praise. They drank from the chalice of acceptance in days when the opposers arose to harm, and they partook of the cup of love at times when the sea of enmity was surging.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: Thou who hast gained a speaking tongue, seeing eyes and hearing ears - occupy thyself with the praise of the Abha Beauty in the temples of earth and heaven, that thou mayest be awakened and quickened by the life-giving call that is raised from the Abha Kingdom and the invisible Realm of Might.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: Know thou the worth of this kind person. He is near to the threshold of God and the joy of the friends. He is honored in this court and is approved and esteemed by 'Abdu'l-Baha. Night and day his thoughts are occupied with service to the Cause of God and the diffusion of the divine fragrances.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: O Karbila'i Muhsin! He Who hath caused every possessor of grace to bow down before Him remembereth thee. Wondrous is he who performeth that which is commanded him by God. Verily He is the Beneficent One in My mighty Book. Blessed is he who hath hearkened unto the Call and responded to his Lord

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: O Muhammad-Rida, upon him be the Glory of God! How blessed is the state of the one who has attained unto hearing it and has turned towards the Most Exalted Horizon. Praise be to God that thou hast attained unto the days of God and hast drunk of the wine of merciful compassion in this dawn-time.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: Blessed art thou for having migrated unto God and entered the precinct of Paradise and attained the presence of the mighty throne. This Most Exalted Pen hath been moved to make mention of thee - the Pen whose scratching hath attracted the hearts of all who are endowed with knowledge and wisdom.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: Praise be to God Who has made clear to us His straight path, illumined us with the light of divine unity, and strengthened us to acknowledge the Most Great Word which He has made the criterion for the beliefs of all who dwell in the kingdom of creation -- namely the word There is no God but God.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: Some time ago mention of you was revealed from the Most Exalted Pen, and now once again, that you may give thanks to your Lord, the Generous. The servant present has read what has issued forth from the virgin spring of your sincerity and recognition in remembrance of God, the Lord of the worlds.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: O thou servant, rejoice in thyself inasmuch as God hath made mention of thee on this night... Rejoice then in your heart for God hath mentioned thee in His Tablet. By the righteousness of God, this is a blessing with which compareth none other that hath been created betwixt the earth and heaven.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: The beloved letter arrived and gladdened the sorrowful heart with news of the health, wellbeing and steadfastness of the honored Mr. Afnan, upon him be the peace of the All-Merciful, and that blessed being. The One God is witness that mention of the friends and loved ones brings joy and delight.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: A perfumed breeze and a musk-laden breath reaches the nostrils of the yearning ones from the region of Kerman. The people of Kerman have always been enchanted and enraptured, and in all ages have been renowned for their attraction and ecstasy. Surely in this great Cause they will outstrip others.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: Convey the Most Glorious and Most Wonderful greetings to that near handmaiden of God who is humble and submissive, your mother, and to the other brothers. Convey with utmost love the Most Glorious and Most Wonderful greetings to his honor 'Abdu'l-Mahdi, upon him be the Most Glorious Glory of God

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: O thou who hast turned thy face unto God! Thou hast entered beneath the shadow of the Divine Word and hast dawned forth with manifest lights from the Dayspring of the love of God. Therefore, know thou the worth of these bounties, and occupy thyself with the praise of the Beauty of the All-Merciful

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: O thou who hast turned to God, thy Lord, the All-Merciful, who circlest round the Kaaba of divine knowledge and uttereth His praise amidst the religions! Thou hast ever been mentioned on the carpet of captivity in this land, and thy works are witnessed, thy poetry remembered, and thy praise heard.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: 'Abdu'l-Baha, in mighty churches and great assemblies, is in ringing tones vindicating the truth of His Holiness the Apostle (Muhammad) and of His Holiness the Exalted One, and announcing the effulgent dawning of the Sun of Baha'u'llah, while most of the newspapers are complimentary in the extreme.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: O Abbas! Your mention hath been made before the Wronged One, and this Most Holy, Most Exalted Tablet hath been revealed in the Persian tongue that thou mayest drink from the Euphrates of the All-Merciful's mercy and occupy thyself with the praise and glorification of the Beloved of all possibility.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: The loved ones in that land are all remembered before the Wronged One and have attained His special favors. Happy are they and pleasant it is for them. We make mention of Our loved ones in Haji-Abad with words through which their names shall endure in the Book of God, the Lord of this wondrous Day.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: Blessed are you and your family and your children! You have attained, in the Days of God, to that which hath been sent down from the Supreme Pen. By the Sun of the horizon of Revelation! The entire world hath not equaled and will never equal a single word that hath issued from the mouth of His Will.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: Thy services are accepted in the Kingdom of ABHA, mentioned in this merciful Assemblage and the cause of joy and gladness to Abdul-Baha. Thank God, thou art a believer and an assured one, firm and steadfast; a truthful servant of the divine Kingdom and an agreeable lover of His Holiness BAHA'O'LLAH.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: Among them is Thy distinguished servant and noble bondsman, that luminous reality and merciful flame, that sign of oneness, who bore every affliction in Thy path, endured every calamity in his love for Thee, was tried by every hardship in Thy cause, and suffered every grievous torment in Thy Faith.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: O handmaiden of God! God willing, mayest thou be gladdened by the fragrances of the grace of the Revealer of Verses, and be occupied at all times with the mention and praise of the Beloved of all possibility. Praise be to the Ancient Beauty that ye are reckoned as His own and are attributed unto Him.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: O Mirza Abdul-Karim, upon thee be the Glory of God and His favors! Blessed art thou and blessed is he who hath held fast to the cord of patience and acted according to that which was ordained in the Book of God, the Lord of the worlds. Thy deeds and thy steadfastness in adversity have brought Me joy.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: O Qasim, who has attained unto the name of the Beloved of the world! Praise be to God that through divine bounty and the infinite mercy of the Lord thou hast attained unto the recognition of the Sovereign of Days and the Lord of all names, and hast drunk from the Kawthar of remembrance and utterance.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: O Muhammad-Baba, upon whom be the Glory of God! O thou who hast dawned from the horizon of immortality! This deed of thine is better in the sight of God than the deeds of those souls who spent years studying and teaching in schools, for the fruit of thy deed hath been the remembrance and praise of God

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: O ye who are attracted to the Heavenly Kingdom! O ye who are enlightened by the light of guidance! O ye lamps lighted by the light of love and faithfulness! Blessed ye are, oh ye who are firm and steadfast in the Covenant of God. Blessed ye are, oh ye shining stars from the Horizon of the Love of God.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: "This is My remembrance of My servant who was imprisoned in My path, taken captive for My remembrance, and banished for My love - that My verses may attract him, the winds of My grace stir him, the breezes of My Cause move him, My melodies draw him near, My call raise him to the heights of My bounties"

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: Blessed is the eye that hath beheld it, blessed is the tongue that hath uttered its praise, and blessed is the heart that hath attained its recognition. O handmaiden of God! Be thou thankful unto the one true God, inasmuch as thou hast attained unto His recognition and turned thyself unto His horizon.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: Praise be to God! The Hand of the Unseen rendered assistance and hidden guardians provided protection. The rose-bush, together with the two Muhammads -- upon them be the glory of God -- who moved with the speed of lightning, has arrived. It sprouted as though unsown and bore fruit before being watered.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: O Haydar-'Ali! Today, which is the third day of the Islamic Festival, the Most Great Branch made mention of you. Therefore, the Supreme Pen desired to make mention of you in such wise as will immortalize your remembrance among all mentions, your spirit among all spirits, and your body among all bodies.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: Well is it with thee! And the servant present acted in accordance with thy request. I beseech God, exalted be His glory, to cause thee to attain, at all times, unto new bounties, heavenly sustenance, everlasting mention and eternal gifts. He is verily the Bestower, the Compassionate, the All-Bountiful.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: Thou art accepted at the Divine Threshold, and favoured in the Court of the Ever-Abiding. Wherefore art thou king of the land of fidelity, and monarch of the realm of surpassing bounty. Thou art crowned with the diadem of Divine guidance, and seated upon the throne of steadfastness in the Cause of God.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: Blessed art thou and blessed are they who have uttered the praise of their Lord and have attained unto the Greater Steadfastness in such wise that the barking of the creatures who turned away, denied, and even disbelieved and pronounced judgment against God without any proof from Him, did not deter them.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: Glorified art Thou, O Lord of all beings and God of all existence! I testify with my outward and inward tongue to Thy manifestation and Thy revelation, to the sending down of Thy verses and the demonstration of Thy clear signs, and to Thy independence from all else and Thy sanctification above all others.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: I give praise unto Thee, O my God, that Thou hast ordained this day as a festival unto such of Thy servants as enjoy near access to Thee and unto Thy loved ones who are devoted to Thyself... I yield praise unto Thee, O Lord my God, inasmuch as Thou hast demonstrated Thy proofs and perfected Thy blessings.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: O Lord! Make firm his footsteps in Thy Cause, expand his breast through Thy light, gladden his spirit through Thy victories, spread through him Thy remembrance, make him speak forth Thy praise, clothe him in the robe of sincerity in Thy Cause, and through Thy grace admit him into the Garden of immortality.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: Through First Lieutenant Tahir Efendi, to His Excellency the honorable Ali Kazim Bey Efendi, the veterinary lieutenant colonel of the 28th Cavalry Regiment in Beirut: O Nazim of sweet breath, your fluid verses which flowed like running water were read. Indeed they were the height of eloquence and rhetoric.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: It is good that we are all assembled in the Shrine of the Bab under the canopy of the Blessed Beauty's bounties. Never did anyone think that such a gathering and meeting could be held in such a location, but praise unto God that, out of the beneficence of the Blessed Perfection, it has been made possible.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: O H.S., upon thee be My Glory and My loving-kindness! Praise be to God, thou hast repeatedly been blessed with the loving-kindness of God and the traces of the Most Exalted Pen. Thou didst aim for the ultimate goal and through the assistance of the Lord of all beings, thou didst arrive and witness and hear.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: O Nightingale! Upon thee be the Glory of God, the Lord of all worlds! We address thee in the Persian tongue. Verily, We love to make mention of thee and give thee glad tidings of My grace, My bounty, and My mercy which have preceded thee and aided thee in teaching My Most Great Cause and My Mighty Message.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: Praise be to God that on the Day of the Call you heard the melody of the Supreme Concourse, and responded "Yea" to the call of "Am I not?", and became attracted to the Abha Kingdom, and traversed the wilderness of separation, and were freed from the valley of deprivation, and attained the honor of meeting.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: "O thou who art enkindled with the fire of the love of God!" ... "Therefore, O flower of the rose-garden of the love of God, it is time to bloom and brighten the face, time to diffuse the fragrance of musk and perfume, to spread sweet scents and make the world fragrant with the breaths of the All-Merciful."

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: O people of the mortal world! Rejoice in the successive outpourings, the abundant rain, and the flowing waters from the clouds of mercy and the mists of compassion! Blessed are they who receive these outpourings! Joy to those who seek! Gladness to those who are steadfast! Rapture to those who are attracted!

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: Blessed is he who hath cast away all else save God, who hath hastened, who hath attained, and who hath drunk in His Name, the All-Subduing over all names. We testify that he is of the people of Baha who have cast away idle fancies, turning unto the Dawning-Place of the Sun of Certitude from the All-Merciful.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: "O Karim! We have mentioned thee time after time, and again and yet again. To this beareth witness My Most Exalted Pen, and beyond it he who circleth round My mighty throne." "In most times thy call hath been heard and the Most Exalted Pen hath moved at thy name. Know thou the measure of this mighty station."

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: We hope that you may ever dwell beneath the shade of the loving-kindness of the Best-Beloved and be at rest, attaining unto the manifestations of His grace and being honored by His bestowals. Blessed is he in having taken shelter beneath the shade of grace and having drunk from the cups of nearness and union.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: Say: Praise be to Thee, O my God, for having graciously bestowed upon me through Thy bounty and generosity, and guided me unto Thy Kingdom, and given me to drink from the cup of Thy guidance, and sheltered me beneath the tree of Thy oneness. Verily Thou art the All-Bountiful, verily Thou art the All-Merciful.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: All praise that is sanctified beyond the recognition and understanding of created things befitteth the most exalted and holy court of the Desired One, Who hath fulfilled His promises through a single exalted Word. Through Him the Path is made manifest, the Balance is established, and the Reckoning is complete.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: Praise be to God that the flower of the love of God has blossomed in your garden, and his honor the Trustee is a supreme paradise - cheerful, good-natured, heart-attracting and musk-scented. Give thanks to God that you have freely obtained such a flower-filled rose garden without cost. Well may it benefit you!

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: O thou erudite scholar! And O peerless plants in the garden of the love of God! It is the wish of 'Abdu'l-Baha that each one of you in the divine rose garden may grow tall and lofty as the cypress, may flourish in all honour and glory and may produce goodly fruits amid the leaves and boughs of your existence.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: Praise be unto Him Who speaketh, the Manifest, the All-Knowing, the All-Wise! Glory be to God! The divine Hand of bounty hath, in these luminous days, bestowed the choice wine of utterance and the fountain of true knowledge. No sincere seeker hath been denied a share of this most great bounty and supreme favor.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: Upon you be the glory of your Lord, the praise of your Creator, the greetings of your Master, and the peace of your generous and ancient Originator and Helper...The divine favors toward the beloved ones of Azerbaijan are without limit or end, and the sublime favors of the Eternal flow like the waves of the sea.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: Among the people are those who heard and hastened and answered and drank in His name, the Mighty, the All-Bestowing. We testify that thou hast drunk the wine of faithfulness from the hand of bounty and hast attained unto that which was recorded by the Most Exalted Pen and inscribed in the Scriptures and Tablets.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: O Husayn! Thy letter hath come before the Wronged One, and toward it hath turned the gaze of God, the Self-Subsisting. Wert thou to thank God throughout the duration of the kingdom and the heavenly realm for this bounty which hath appeared from the Source of generosity, it would be little, nay rather, as naught.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: Thou hast chosen servants sincere in their faith among all peoples, and distinguished them by their drawing light from Thy manifest Light, by their attraction to Thy luminous Beauty, and by their walking upon Thy straight path...They have the most abundant portion and the best character from Thy flowing bounties

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: Blessed is he who hath recognized the One to be recognized, and the seeker who hath held fast unto the Sought One... Blessed is the ear that hath heard, and the faces that have turned, and the tongues that have confessed and acknowledged that which God, the Powerful, the All-Knowing, the All-Wise, hath testified.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: That wherewith thou didst supplicate God, thy Lord and the Lord of the worlds, hath come before Us, and from it We perceived the fragrance of thy love for thy Lord, the Most High, the Most Great. Well is it with thee for having stood firm in the Cause of God, thy Lord, and for being among those who are steadfast.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: I was rejoiced through your endeavors in this glorious Cause, made with joy and good interest. Verily, ye are the first to arise for this glorious Cause in that vast region. Soon will ye see the spread of this enterprise in the world, and its resounding voice shall go through the ears of the people in all parts.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: O thou who art firm in the Covenant! Be thou happy! Be thou happy! that thou hast put aside rest and composure; that thou hast traveled through and visited different states and endured innumerable inconveniences so that thou might diffuse the fragrances of mysteries and perfume the nostrils of the spiritual ones.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: Among the Hands of the Cause of God who have departed this life and ascended to the Supreme Horizon was Jinab-i-Ismu'llahu'l-A?daq. Another was Jinab-i-Nabil-i-Akbar. Still others were Jinab-i-Mulla 'Ali-Akbar and Jinab-i-Shaykh Muhammad-Riday-i-Yazdi. Again, among others, was the revered martyr, Aqa Mirza Varqa.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: Praise be to God Who has made Himself known to us, taught us His Cause, made clear to us the paths of truth and certitude, and manifested what befits His generosity to the worlds. We thank Him in all conditions with thanksgiving wherewith He has spoken in His Book and taught us through His bounty and sovereignty.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: thy respected wife had written a letter and had praised extremely thy nature and character, that thou hadst become spiritual, and had been illumined, and hadst become heavenly and hadst received a share and portion from the breaths of the Holy Spirit, hadst attained eternal life and had come into joy and gladness.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: O ye who have been drawn towards the divine threshold! The light of guidance is brilliant and the beauty of the greatest of bestowals is revealed in every assembly. The brightness of the manifest light shines forth from the brow of the beloved friends and all the horizons radiate with the gleams of the true dawn.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: From the beginning of the Cause this Wronged One sacrificed His life, spirit, wealth, honor and comfort - all - in the path of the Goal of all the worlds, and arose alone to promote the Cause - an arising that no circumstance could alter and no might of the polytheists could prevent Him from proclaiming the Cause.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: O loved ones of God! Praise God that you have entered beneath the shade of the banner raised by the Lord of Hosts...This honor and station is cause for pride, and this success and prosperity shine bright and luminous like a lamp and light. Thanks be to God who has bestowed such bounty and freely given such favors.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: Truly you are a melodious nightingale in the rose garden of utterance and a diligent pupil in the school of knowledge and wisdom. Those brilliant proofs, decisive evidences and radiant arguments that you composed in the treatise are a sign of the Preserved Tablet and evidence of the contents of the unfurled scroll.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: The entire letter is fundamentally one of praise and encouragement to Nabil, especially "For God is your understanding, and for God is your deed, and for God is your sincerity, and for God is your humility, and for God is your submissiveness, and for God is your turning to Him, and for God is your verse and prose."

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: O My handmaiden! Hear My call from the direction of My prison, then weep for My tribulations and afflictions. Thus does the Beloved of the worlds command thee... Be thou thankful unto God, then make mention of Him and be devoted to Him, for verily He is with His handmaidens who do good and His servants who do good.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: O thou who art mentioned before the Wronged One! I say in truth that today the cause of the exaltation and elevation of existence is the fear of God. Blessed are those servants who have not deprived themselves of the fragrances of these days and have grasped and clung to the hem of holiness and the cord of sanctity.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: Rejoice thou in My remembrance of thee and My turning towards thee from this Prison which God hath made the circumambulation place of the righteous. O Muhammad! Rejoice thou in that the Wronged One remembereth thee in His Most Great Prison and announceth unto thee the bounty of thy Lord, the Forgiving, the Merciful.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: O ye Musa and Rahim! Upon you be the Glory of God! Praise becometh that Desired One Who hath illumined the realm of inner meaning with the light of true unity and opened the gates of knowledge before the faces of His servants with the key of utterance. Glorified, glorified be His grandeur and exalted be His dominion!

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: O ancient friend! From the rose-garden of thy soul wafteth a musk-scented breeze that bestoweth delight and gladness. They say that thy pure soul is enthralled by the Beloved and thy blessed heart is filled with the love of the Kind Friend. Well is it with thee, that thou hast manifested such conduct, deeds and words

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: That which thou hadst written to the late Jamal Effendi was perused. From the gardens of its meanings were inhaled the fragrances of attraction, and from the dawning-place of its contents were witnessed the lights of firmness and steadfastness. It brought joy and delight and was the cause of happiness to the friends.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: O Afnan, esteemed Buzurg, who has attained unto God! My Pen and My tongue bear witness that thou didst acknowledge the unity of God and His justice when the banner of tyranny was raised in the world and every idolatrous betrayer raised his cry, and thou didst arise to serve the Cause in days wherein feet did stumble.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: O My Nabil! Upon thee be My glory and loving-kindness. Thou hast ever been and art still beneath the glance of favor. Verily We were with thee in all conditions when thou wert traveling through the lands to spread the mention and verses. Blessed art thou, and blessed thy beginning and end, thy outward and inward being.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: O My handmaidens in My lands! Hearken unto the call of the Wronged One. In the nights and days, We have mentioned and continue to mention those men and women who have turned unto God and are unified. We beseech God to aid all to deeds whose light shall not set and whose fragrance the centuries and ages shall not alter.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: O Samandar, upon him be the Most Glorious Beauty of God! He is the All-Knowing Herald! The Divine bounty became embodied and His mercy encompassed all. He aided with the hosts of His providence and generosity, and caused the honored Shaykh, upon him be My glory and favor, to attain unto presence, hearing and witnessing.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: Praise be to Thee, O God of Names and Creator of Heaven! Praise be to Thee, for Thou hast made known unto Thy servants Thy Day, wherein the River of Life streamed forth from the finger of Thy Generosity, and the Fountain of Revelation and Unity became manifest by Thy Manifestation, to all who are in Thy earth and heaven.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: You are the remembrance of that noble one - how could you be forgotten? Rest assured that in this world and the divine world you have been and will continue to be mentioned. Through divine bounty, I hope you will prove and demonstrate that you are indeed the daughters of that illustrious person and worthy of great favor.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: Blessed is the work of those who have arisen to serve the Cause with the wisdom which God hath sent down in the Book. These are the people of Paradise inscribed in the Crimson Tablet, and the Concourse on High in the Most Glorious Horizon invoke blessings upon them, as do the angels and the Spirit, at morn and at eventide.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: Your mention hath been made before His countenance, and verses clear and manifest have been sent down for thee, that which nothing in the unseen and the seen can equal, that thou mayest be confirmed in that which thou possessest of the love of God and His chosen ones, and that thou mayest remember Him in this Promised Day.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: O handmaiden of God, Sultan Bigum, sister of Haji Ahmad! Give praise to the peerless Lord that thou hast drunk from the cup of bounty from the hands of divine favors and hast attained thereunto. Blessed art thou that thou art engaged in His remembrance among the handmaidens and art turned toward the direction of His grace.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: My spirit, my soul and my heart be a sacrifice unto thee! The mark of thy blessed pen hath deeply affected the heart, and its ambergris-laden fragrance hath perfumed the nostrils of the soul, while its musk-scented breezes have bestowed boundless joy and delight upon the soul. These decaying bones have been stirred thereby!

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: I have read your reports with great joy; they are of a nature to cheer and refresh the heart and gladden the soul. Wherefore, O ye loved ones of God, offer up thanks unto Him, since He hath made you the object of such bounties, and the recipients of such gifts. Blessed are ye, glad tidings to you, for this abounding grace.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: Praise be to the Ancient Lord Who hath shown favor and bestowed bounty and granted awareness on a Day when the people of the world are heedless and deprived. Know thou the measure of this grace and recognize the station of this gift. Thou hast attained unto a Tablet that cannot be equaled by whatsoever is in the whole earth.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: In truth I say that the Persians today have lit a lamp in the gathering of the friends and have burned away the veils, such that the radiant sun from the East of the Iranians has shone upon others. As has been seen and heard, the Persian youth became a guide to the Arab elder, and the Zoroastrian child made a group heavenly.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: Those two noble ones are like the Twin Stars, that is, the constellation of Gemini, bright and shining in the horizon of the heaven of guidance. You have become manifestations of heavenly bounty and dawning-places of divine lights. You have become imbued with angelic qualities and endowed with the gift of the Lord of Glory.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: Blessed are ye, inasmuch as your names have been mentioned before the Throne, and there hath been sent down for you that which shall cause your remembrance to endure amongst the righteous. Happy are ye, and happy are they who dwell in that place from among the loved ones of God, the Almighty, the All-Glorious, the All-Chosen.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: Abu'l Fazl, whose book you are in the midst of translating into German, is a man who is teaching the Holy Teachings with his deeds and through the word. His trip to America was accompanied by a great blessing. His station is higher than the apostles. He is the most sincere servant of the Holy Teachings. I love him very much.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: Glorified art Thou, O Lord my God! Magnified be Thou, inasmuch as Thou hast shone forth above the horizon of the Prison with so dazzling a splendour that all parts of the world have been illumined by virtue of the bounty Thou hast conferred upon those that have entered beneath Thy shadow and were admitted within Thy precincts.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: Blessed art thou for having appeared and having seen and heard that which the Tongue of Grandeur hath spoken forth when the Dayspring of Revelation appeared with mighty sovereignty...Blessed art thou for having aided the Cause of thy Lord and manifested that which beseemeth thee in the days of God, the Mighty, the All-Praised.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: The letter of His Honor Abu'l-Fadl - upon him be My Baha - which he wrote to thee was present before Me and I gave ear to it. Praised be God, every word of his words testified to his endeavor and service purely for the sake of God. In the land of H, the luminary of detachment rose and shone forth from the horizon of his deeds.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: The essence of praise and its pure reality befit the sacred realm of nearness to the Beloved, Who created all things visible and hidden through a single Word, Who gathered all created things through pure justice in a single plane through a single Word, and then through that same Word made manifest the greatest differentiation.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: O thou who ascendeth unto the heights of truth and casteth away from thy hands, both right and left, the veils of close scrutiny! Thou hast indeed discovered what hath been sent down in the allusions of thy words from a spring of pure water, which was the wine of love in the cup of signs and tokens, intoxicating to its drinker

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: O handmaiden of God! All the clamorous ladies of the world longed to be the maidservant of but one of the servants of the Lord. Now you are the distinguished maidservant of the Ancient Beauty and handmaiden of the Most Great Name. How much you must give thanks and turn in utmost gratitude and worship to the Court of Divine Unity.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: O My Name! Render thanks unto God for having made thee the showers of grace upon that which We have sown in blessed and goodly soil, and for having made thee the spring of loving-kindness for that which We have planted of wondrous and lofty trees. This is a bounty wherewith nothing created in the realm of possibility can compare.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: Blessed is the soul whom the smoke of rejection and heedlessness did not prevent - verily such a one is among the triumphant in My perspicuous Book. Praise be to God that that honoured lady hath attained unto infinite favors and blessings. By My life! There hath been recorded for thee in the Book that which shall never be effaced.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: O thou believer in the Day of Manifestation and flame of Sinai! Thy father's title was "Light" and his disposition was one of attraction to the Beauty of Manifestation. Through divine love he possessed a radiant countenance and a joyous heart. He spent his days occupied in the remembrance of God and enkindled with the divine fire.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: O star shining in the horizon of the love of God! The life-giving melody of the All-Merciful which emerged from the spiritual throat of that nightingale of the rose-garden of inner meanings reached the inner hearing of these yearners for the Beauty of the All-Glorious, bringing forth spirit and delight and causing endless rapture.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: It became evident that the breezes of radiant holiness were wafting from the Abha Kingdom, and thus the nostrils of my spirit and the spirit of the people of Adhirbayjan would be perfumed; for the grace and bestowal of the Blessed Beauty - may my spirit be sacrificed for His loved ones - is perfect toward the people of Adhirbayjan.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: Blessed is he and his pen and whoso loveth him for My sake. All that hath flowed from his pen, both before and after, in proof of the Word of God, is acceptable before the Wronged One. He hath spoken the truth...His mention and yearning in divine love hath deposited traces in the contingent world...Blessed is he and joy be unto him.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: O assured leaf! Your mention is recorded, known and renowned at the Sacred Threshold, and your praise is on the tongues and lips of the handmaidens of the All-Merciful. Be grateful and delighted for the infinite bounty that such a favor has been bestowed upon you, that you are mentioned at such a Threshold and known at such a Court.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: We rejoice in what comes from him. We beseech the Exalted One to strengthen him, enable him to remember and praise Him, and draw him nigh unto Him outwardly and inwardly...Praise be to God Who enabled him to turn to that from which most of creation turned away. I beseech the Exalted One to grant him a goodly reward from His presence.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: Praise be to God that you have been illumined by the effulgent rays of the Sun of Truth and have turned your faces toward the Sanctuary of true understanding after the turning away of the peoples of creation. Blessed are you for having attained unto the days of God, the Almighty, the All-Compelling, the All-Glorious, the All-Knowing.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: The treatise that you wrote in response to the ignorant, rejected, condemned doubter was read with utmost care in the gatherings of the loved ones and assemblies of the handmaidens of the All-Merciful. All opened their tongues in "Blessed is she! Again blessed is she!" And 'Abdu'l-Baha says "Good news to you! Again good news to you!"

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: O cherished handmaiden of God! The proof of this cherishment is that thou art occupied with service and accustomed to bearing hardships. Today, whichever one of the assured leaves engages in service as a handmaiden of the handmaidens of the All-Merciful becomes cherished at the Court of Oneness and draws nigh unto the Sacred Threshold.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: Your services in this divine gathering are clear and evident, and your radiant light in the horizon of the world is bright and most clearly visible like the morning star...this luminary of your services will shine bright and resplendent from the dawn of existence. A hundred thousand thanks are due that you have attained to this bounty.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: O thou who art mentioned before the Countenance! When thou hearest My call and art intoxicated with the wine of Mine utterance, turn with thy heart to the horizon of My loving-kindness, My grace and My bounty. Thus hath the Wronged One mentioned thee that thou mayest rejoice and give thanks unto thy Lord Who hath power over all things.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: Praise be unto Thee, O my God, for having made known unto me the Dawning-Place of Thy Revelation and the Dayspring of Thy Beauty... Praise be unto Thee, O my God, for having honored me with Thy presence... O Lord! Praise be unto Thee for these bounties which none of Thy servants can reckon, and thanksgiving be unto Thee for these favors

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: Praise be to God that thou hast traversed wilderness and desert until thou didst measure out the measure of the Covenant and didst attain to a supreme triumph, being blessed to kiss the Sacred Threshold. Open thy tongue in praise of the Ancient of Days, for thou hast been favored with such a gift and specially blessed with such a bounty.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: Praise be to God, thou didst inhale the fragrance of the Divine raiment, and it guided thee unto the dawning-place of the Hidden Secret, and the dayspring of the Well-guarded Treasure... Blessed is the one who aideth his Lord with goodly deeds and a spiritual character; he, truly, is reckoned among the people of Baha' in the Crimson Book

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: This beloved one has been and is mentioned in the prison, especially by the Branches of the Divine Lote-Tree...They repeatedly make mention of that beloved one and seek mention from the Supreme Horizon. In all conditions the rain of providence descends and the lights of the Orb of grace shine forth. Blessed art thou and joy be unto thee.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: O Kamal! Hearken unto that which the Dayspring of Names calleth out to thee from this most exalted Horizon... Blessed art thou for having attained unto this mighty station. We bear witness that thou hast fulfilled God's Covenant and His Testament, and remained steadfast when all who are in the heavens and on earth were struck with terror.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: Blessed is he in that he fulfilled God's Covenant and His Testament, and turned with his face toward the face of God, the Lord of the Day of Judgment...Blessing be upon thee, O thou who didst believe in God when most of His servants turned away from Him, and remained steadfast in His Cause when the feet of them that dwell on earth did slip

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: O handmaiden of the Lord! Behold the bounty of the Lord, that He guided thee to the straight path, made thee distinguished among handmaidens, led thee to the pathway of the Friend, appointed thee as guardian in the house of the Blessed Beauty, gave thee shelter in the precincts of the holy dust, and caused thy countenance to become radiant

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: Praised be God, the Pure. He hast raised from the weak substance of the female sex some women enbued with such powerful and significant realities that men envy them and heroes strive in vain to emulate their example. In steadfastness, they were like the immovable mountain, and in firmness and perseverance they were the unshaken foundation.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: As for the eloquent verses which are radiant gems and brilliant maidens, we have recited them with the utmost joy and fragrance. I beseech God to cause a spring of water to flow from thy pen through pure inspiration. Verily, He confirmeth whomsoever He willeth in whatsoever way He pleaseth. He is, in truth, the Generous, the All-Bestowing.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: O Ali! The Book hath come from the All-Giving, while people are in wondrous drunkenness. O Haydar-'Ali! By God! Sorrows have encompassed Us through what the hands of every doubting idolater have wrought. We have sent down the verses and manifested them in truth, but the people have denied what hath been sent down from God, the Lord of Days.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: O ye who are sincere! O ye who are firm! O ye who are steadfast! ... I praise God that ye were firm in faithfulness in that ye testified and acknowledged the efforts which Mirza Assad Ullah manifested in spreading the fragrances of and that ye thanked him for his labor and teaching for you, and this is what gladdens the heart of Abdul-Baha.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: The English people are firm and straight in all matters and do not waver at the occurrence of minor problems. They are not capricious, such that they would engage in something for a few days and then become weary and bored at the slightest cause and lose their enthusiasm and passion. Rather, they show firmness and steadfastness in matters.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: You had praised the justice of His Imperial Majesty and the benevolence and sincerity of the Grand Vizier and the protection, safeguarding and kindness of the government authorities. Truly I say, in reality this just monarch is distinguished from past kings, and His Excellency the Most Exalted Grand Vizier is aware of the results of justice.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: My spiritual friends! O my merciful companions! O my heavenly darlings! Whether I write about the grace and bountiful favor of the Beloved or speak of the purity and spiritual susceptibilities of the soul, whether I discourse on the bread of heaven or explain the special divine gifts, all of which pertain to the station of the people of Baha

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: Most of thy letters did not arrive, otherwise replies would have been written to the extent possible. However, all the friends must know that they are cherished in this court and that Abdul-Baha's heart overflows with love for the friends. In the middle of the night I engage in supplication and lamentation, and beseech infinite confirmations.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: O Ibn-i-Abhar, upon whom rest the Glory of God, Lord of Destiny! Be thou eloquent in the remembrance of thy Lord, steadfast in the service of His Cause, turning toward His horizon, and holding fast to His extended cord. Thus have We caused the pearls of knowledge to emerge from the shell of utterance. Blessed is he who hath witnessed and seen.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: Blessed is he who hath turned unto thee, and woe unto him who hath turned away from thee, O thou who calleth in the wilderness of guidance in the name of thy Lord, the All-Glorious. Blessed is he whose name was mentioned in thy letter. Blessed is the house wherein thou dwelt, for it is the object of thy Lord's glance, the Mighty, the Generous.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: O Baqir! Your petition arrived and the servant present mentioned it before the Face. Praise be to God that you have attained recognition and have heard the Word of Truth of which most are heedless. Blessed is the eye that has turned to the Most Exalted Horizon and blessed is the tongue that has spoken in praise of God, glorified be His majesty.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: Praise be to God that you have traversed the expansive plain of eloquence, ascended to the heavens of rhetoric, drunk from the wine of utterance at the dawn of certitude, attained the lofty stations of exposition which is the ultimate station of language, and brought forth in their completeness the pearls of speech from the shell of possibility.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: O family who have sacrificed their souls in the path of the All-Merciful!...that this family dwells beneath the sheltering shadow of the Ancient Beauty and this household is encompassed by boundless glory. For they were pillars who, on the Day of Manifestation, when the Light shone forth from Sinai, were attracted to the Lord, the All-Forgiving.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: All praise belongs to God Who has drawn His loved ones to the Most Great Word and granted them shelter beneath the canopy of His mercy. He has renewed the ancient splendor of the Holy Land with fresh adornment, such that pure ears can hear the call of His chosen ones and the cry of Here am I! Here am I! in the wilderness of love and faithfulness.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: Know that contentment lies in being content with God, and in these days His good pleasure cannot be attained except through being well-pleased with the Manifestation of His Self... Adorn thy temple with the ornament of certitude amidst the concourse of creation, then speak forth the praise of thy Lord, the Merciful, amongst His heedless servants.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: Verily, I saw your photographs, whose beauty proved the turning of your hearts unto the Center of Guidance and the dilation of your breasts by the appearance of the Kingdom of God. Thank God for that He enlightened your faces by the light of guidance, deposited in your hearts the sign of faith, and made you of the chosen ones in this new century.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: 'Abdu'l-Baha is in the utmost joy and delight from your character, manner and conditions. Through the abundant bounty and generosity of the Merciful Lord, it is hoped that day by day you will increase in progress and receive a fuller portion from the effulgence of divine manifestation, and become more successful in servitude to the Holy Threshold.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: O beloved of my heart! Make mention of one of Thy chosen ones who arose to serve Thy Cause and to aid that which Thou didst purpose in Thy dominion. O beloved of my heart and he who is mentioned in my soul! By God's life, the wine of thy remembrance hath intoxicated me, which the chosen ones of the verdant land and those around it caused me to hear.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: Blessed is the servant who has heard the call of his Lord and turned to Him, who has believed in that which has appeared from His presence and has set his face toward His countenance, casting all else behind him while turning to His horizon. He is verily of the people of the most exalted Paradise in the sight of our Lord, the Possessor of all names.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: You are like a nightingale, delighting in union with the rose... I love you with heart and soul, and I ask God that you may be a cause of the glory of the Cause and the divine friends, and that you may be so successful that your face will shine in the Abha Kingdom, and all the friends will suck you like sugarcane and taste you like honey and nectar.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: O my esteemed Mirza Abdul-Karim of Ishqabad! O faithful and energetic servant of the Blessed Beauty! Thou hast indeed been and art ever successful in rendering faithful service, and I am most pleased with thee. Particularly commendable is the zeal thou hast shown in connection with the Mashriqu'l-Adhkar of Chicago. May thy face be forever illumined!

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: We have turned toward you from the direction of the Ridvan and have mentioned you with such mention as hath enraptured the Concourse on High and those who are present before the Throne in this noble station...God willing, your honor will be successful and joyous through this spiritual glad-tidings which hath appeared from the horizon of divine favor.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: May my spirit be a sacrifice for your remembrance! The servant has received your letter and drunk from the choice wine of your remembrance and utterance, and beseeches God his Lord to grant you success and confirmation and bestow upon you His presence once again, for verily He is the Lord of all beings and the All-Powerful over whatsoever He willeth.

Subject: praise and encouragement
