Quotation: O Ali! Today the world is adorned with the springtime of inner meanings. Hidden mysteries are unveiled and treasured verses are resplendent, yet all remain heedless save whom thy Lord, the Strong, the Almighty, the All-Knowing, the All-Wise, hath willed. Today every harm that is suffered for the love of God manifests the effects of the Water of Life.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: The members of the Spiritual Meeting must endeavor, by the power of the Holy Spirit, to make the souls real Bahais. If they attain this glorious purpose, that country will be illumined and that land will become a veritable paradise, all nations will look to that assembly and from the explanation and exposition thereof receive realities and meanings.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: O thou pilgrim of the Sacred Dust! Render great thanks to God, the Most Glorious, the Lord Who hath guided thee unto this path and caused thee to enter the sanctuary of the All Knowing. Render thanks unto Him for having enabled thee to take shelter beneath His bountiful favour and attain that which is the hope and aspiration of the chosen ones of God.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: The Wronged One hath heard thy call and hath answered thee with that which was as the gentle rain of mercy unto blessed [good] soil, as the breeze of providence unto the gardens of knowledge, as the sun of certitude unto the heaven of utterance, as the river of life unto the thirsty one, and as the fragrance of the All-Merciful unto the people of Baha.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: O My Afnan! Upon thee be My glory and My mercy and My loving-kindness... We found therein that which beseemeth thee in the days of thy Lord, the All-Knowing, the All-Wise. We bear witness that thou hast arisen to serve the Cause and hast manifested that whose fragrance shall never be cut off throughout the endurance of the names and attributes of God.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: O my God! Praise be unto Thee, O Thou Who art my heart's Desire! Thanks be unto Thee for that which Thou hast bestowed upon Thy chosen ones, and granted unto Thy loved ones, and manifested unto them through the Manifestation of Thyself, and unveiled unto them Beauty through the appearance of the Dawning-Place of Glory from the dayspring of Thy lights.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: We make mention of him who was named Muhammad, that he may rejoice and be of the thankful ones. And We make mention that thou who hast turned to the lights of the Face, and thy brother who was named Aqa Kuchik - We beseech God to assist them and enable them to achieve that whereby their names shall endure in the Book of God, the Mighty, the Praiseworthy.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: Blessed is he whom the breath of God hath awakened, who hath turned to the sanctuary of the Messengers with a pure and luminous heart. O thou who art yearning! Blessed art thou, for thy face hath been illumined by the light that hath shone forth from the Day-Star of the horizons on this Day of the Covenant, and thou hast turned to the Qiblih of the worlds.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: Praise be to God that your family believes in the one God and in the divine path is the target of every stranger's taunts...Therefore be confident and joyous in the grace and gift of the Desired One, Who nurtured you under the blessed Tree and raised you to such a lofty station that the stones of reproach from all creation cannot reach that exalted height.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: Beloved art thou, for thou hast lighted the lamp of the love of God in the glass of America, called out in His Name among the people and guided them to the Kingdom of El-ABHA. O maid-servant of God! Fly away with joy, for God hath strengthened thee in this great gift, which is a glorious crown, the gems of which are scintillating with the light of guidance.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: O Muhammad! Blessed art thou, and blessed is he, and blessed is his mother who hath attained unto the recognition of her Lord... We testify that thou hast attained unto that which most of the servants have failed to attain. Thou didst hold fast unto goodly deeds and didst cleave unto that whereby the Cause of God, the Most High, the Most Great, was exalted.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: The waves of praise and glorification befit those servants who, through the power of God's Name, have rent asunder the veils of self and turned toward the highest horizon. Neither the grandeur and majesty of idols deterred them from the Lord of all beings, nor did the tyranny and rebellion of the iniquitous deprive these souls of the Salsabil of immortality.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: Then He said: Joking aside, what a wonderful table the Blessed Perfection has spread for His friends! Had kings come here they would have been served but this fervor and zeal of the friends would not have appeared for any one of them. These noble people who serve you love you with heart and soul and serve you without any fear, hope or expectation of reward.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: O Abdu'l-Husayn, son of Jinab-i-Samandar, upon both of you be the Glory of God! In the name of the Everlasting Speaker, We have heard thy call and from the direction of the Prison have turned toward thee, and make mention of thee with these sublime words, each of which hath shone forth like the Sun of Truth from the Dayspring of the mouth of the All-Merciful.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: O beloved of God, His chosen ones, His near ones and His guides! The ocean of your Most Merciful Lord's favors has surged with the waves of beneficence upon the shores of existence in the world of being. Those waves have cast the pearls of knowledge upon the beaches of human hearts. Blessed is he who has gathered those luminous gems and those peerless jewels.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: The highest wish of Abdu'l-Baha is that the loved ones of God in every country may be assisted by the manifold bounties of the Lord of mankind, and that, from the vivifying breeze, they might acquire spiritual refreshment and obtain celestial refinement, and be enabled to manifest, by their very deeds and their conduct, their servitude to His sacred Threshold.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: O Baqir, who hast attained unto the name of the Peerless Friend! Praise be unto the Best Beloved of all possibility, sanctified from all hint of utterance or explanation, Who of His all-encompassing mercy and perfect bounty guided thee to the shore of the Most Great Ocean and led thee into the presence of the Lord of Eternity. Count this favor as a precious gift

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: Glorified art Thou, O Lord my God! How plenteous, O my God, is the stream of Thy knowledge! How sweet, O my Beloved, is the injury which, in my love for Thee, and for the sake of Thy pleasure, I suffer from the darts of the wicked doers! How pleasing are the wounds which, in Thy path and in order to proclaim Thy Faith, I sustain from the swords of the infidels!

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: O perfumer! Although musk has a fragrant scent, the essence of the love of God has another sweet fragrance. The scent of musk and ambergris reaches only a short distance, but the perfumed fragrance of the love of God reaches the horizons of the world. Therefore give thanks to God that you are perfumed with this fragrance and scented with this musk and ambergris.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: Blessed is the one who deals kindly with the loved ones of God. The Tongue of Grandeur proclaims: Joy unto the servant who sheltered in his home those who have migrated unto God and treated them with the essence of love and affection. Blessed art thou, O Letter Ta, for that which hath proceeded from thee befitteth thee and the days of God, the Lord of the worlds.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: O people of Milan! Hearken unto the call of your Lord, the All-Merciful. He calleth you from the precincts of the Ridvan, that ye may arise to love Him and praise Him among the peoples of the world. Ye are among those upon whom the breezes of God wafted in His earliest days, awakening you from slumber - a bounty from Him bestowed upon you and upon other servants.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: O friends of God in Bahramabad and its environs! At this hour the Most Exalted Pen hath turned toward you from the Prison of Akka, revealing the pearls of consummate wisdom and sublime utterances, that joy and attraction may seize you to such a degree that the deeds of those who have denied God's proof, His testimony, His evidence and His signs may not grieve you.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: The drawings and pictures which flowed from thy pen were received through Abul-Fadl and brought joy when they were seen, for that young sapling in the rose garden of the love of the All-Glorious is growing and developing, occupied in acquiring spiritual and physical perfections. I hope that this sapling will become fruitful and attain boundless freshness and grace.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: O Amin! Listen with the ear of certitude to the call of the Lord of the worlds, and at all times gaze with the eye of certitude upon the Most Great Scene. All thy services are mentioned before the Throne, and the Supreme Pen hath borne witness concerning thee - a witness that hath been and shall ever be sufficient for thee. Be thou assured and of those who rejoice.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: O thou verdant myrtle planted in the Paradise of Sanctity! The smelling of the people of Baha is assuredly perfumed through the pure fragrance exhaled from the Garden of thine heart. Verily, I read those beautiful words traced by thy pen and asked God to make thee a sign of the Signs of His Power amongst His girls, to cause thee to be an emblem of this great Century

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: O faithful servant of the Blessed Beauty! Truly thou art a herald of the Covenant and one who sacrificeth his life in the path of the Luminary of the horizons... The denizens of the Abha Kingdom proclaimed "Blessed art thou! Again, blessed art thou!" to the hearing of those seated upon the most great throne, and the Concourse on High opened their tongues in praise.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: Then We took up Our Most Exalted Pen to make mention of My Afnan who soared in My atmosphere, outstripped My other Afnans, and traveled through the lands until he entered My prison and attained that which was revealed in My Books of old and of later times - he whom neither the might of tyrants, nor the hosts of Pharaohs, nor the clamor of the polytheists could deter.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: All praise is befitting and worthy of the Most Great Cause, which hath delivered the world and its peoples from the oppression of the polytheists and the hatred of the infidels, and appointed them their station beneath the blessed Lote-Tree of Justice, and gathered them together. Exalted be His grace, magnificent His compassion, glorious His grandeur and His bounty!

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: O thou who art attracted by the fragrances of God! Well done, well done, for thou hast turned unto God! Well done, well done, for thou hast been attracted by the divine fragrances! Well done, well done, for thou hast acquired from the fire kindled on the Sinai of divine manifestation the light of God's guidance! Be thou happy and joyous, and attain spiritual success.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: Praise be befitting unto the Desired One Who hath drawn pure, holy and sanctified souls through the movements of the leaves of the Divine Tree, guided them to the supreme horizon, and caused each leaf to be made manifest through a melody. One leaf speaketh forth this blessed word: By God, the Truth! The Beloved of all who are in the heavens and on earth hath appeared!

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: Praise be to Him Who hath appeared and revealed what He desired on a Day whereon the Pharaohs and their hosts were shaken and the tyrants and their ranks were made to tremble. Blessed is he who hath turned unto it and held fast thereunto. These are servants whom God hath described through the tongue of the Prophets and Messengers. Blessed are they and joy be unto them!

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: In the Name of the Everlasting Speaker! God willing, in this luminous morn when the world is illumined by the effulgent rays of the Sun of Truth, may you be occupied with the remembrance of the Friend, the praise of the Friend, and service to the Friend. Blessed are ye for having engaged in that which ye were commanded in the Book of God, the Lord of the seen and unseen.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: O Muhammad-Ibrahim! Your letter has reached Our presence in this prison, and We have found the fragrance of your love and recognized your sincerity towards God, your Lord and the Lord of all worlds. Those who have believed in God and held fast to the cord of His favor - upon them do the denizens of Paradise pray, and this is indeed a great bounty inscribed in the Tablet.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: O thou who art remembered by the Wronged One! The Afnan - upon them be My glory and loving-kindness - bear witness to the nature and character of God, exalted be His glory... O Afnan! Upon thee be My glory and loving-kindness. I testify that thou hast hearkened unto My call, both before and after, and hast arisen to serve My Cause and hast spoken in gracious praise of Me.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: "O thou servant of the Holy Threshold! Thank God that thou didst answer the call of "am I not your Lord?" with affirmation, become intoxicated with the Goblet of the Word of God and hastened toward the Abode of the Beloved, blessed thy face and hairs by kneeling at the Threshold of the Friend of the regions and associate with 'Abdu'l-Baha with infinite joy and fragrance."

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: All things proclaim that He Who is the Lord of Names is come. Blessed are ye for having heard, turned unto Him and said: "Here am I, O God of the worlds!" Blessed be your faces, for ye have turned unto Him Who is the Intended One; blessed be your hearts for having borne the trust of the love of the Beloved; blessed be your ears for having heard His sweet and wondrous call.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: O thou who art attracted to the Most Holy, Most Exalted, Most Great, Most Noble Beauty! Hearken unto the call of the Lord of Names, which hath been raised betwixt earth and heaven. Through your mention, the Most Great Remembrance hath rejoiced, and through your letter the Ancient Beauty, Who hath come from the heaven of certitude with proof and evidence, hath been gladdened.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: O Zein! The Supreme Pen hath mentioned and continueth to mention both great and small among the loved ones. At all times the mention of the All-Merciful is raised, and whatsoever proceedeth therefrom to the world of creation in its primal reality returneth unto those sanctified souls who have quaffed from the sealed wine and who are fixed upon the Name of the Self-Subsisting.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: Praise be to God! That land hath been adorned by the tongue of grandeur with the ornament of special distinction in the presence of the Countenance. Blessed is it and blessed are My party therein. I have been with its people and have heard their cry and remembrance in this Most Great Remembrance and this Mighty News - the men and women who have turned unto God and are devout.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: Praised be the work of those who have arisen to serve the Cause in such wise that neither the clamor of the people deterred them nor the tyranny of those in the land frightened them. They turned with supreme steadfastness to the Most Exalted Horizon until they beheld the fruits of what they had planted, the results of what they worked for, and the profit of what they had sown.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: O Haji Siyyid Mirza, upon him be the Glory of God! By the Name that has been raised from the most exalted horizon. Praise befits the Desired One Who bestowed new life upon the withered servants, nay rather the dead ones, through the breathings of verses and the Kawthar of clear proofs, and Who made all things fresh and verdant through the breezes of the morn of His Revelation.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: We testify that she turned to God and believed in Him, and heard and responded to her Lord. She attained unto the effects of My Most Exalted Pen time and again, and We mentioned her in terms wherewith the Concourse on High doth speak. We found from her the fragrance of certitude. By My life! Sufficient for her is what hath been revealed for her from her Lord's Pen at this time.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: "O ye illumined faces! O ye divine souls! and O ye spiritual temples!" "O servants of God! Sanctify the soul and dilate the breast by the promise your Lord gave you, that, verily, He confirms you through the hosts of inspiration. Ye will see (the time when) your faces shine as stars in the horizon of guidance and your heads crowned by the crown of success in the Supreme World."

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: O thou who art attracted to the divine! The time hath come for thee to sing, like unto the nightingale at dawn with various melodies, this verse...Therefore, kindle thou a brilliant flame and tell of the heat of the Fire of Sinai, that in the Sacred Valley thou mayest guide the seekers to the Most Great Fire of Guidance and become the cause of joy and gladness in that gathering.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: O Muhammad-Rida, upon thee be the Glory of God! He is the Rememberer and the Helper, He is the All-Loving and the All-Bountiful...thy letter which thou hadst sent to Aqa Muhammad was brought before Us by Badi'u'llah and was heard. Praise be to God, from every word thereof wafted the fragrance of divine love, and from the horizon of every letter shone forth the light of affection.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: Blessed art thou, O Salamander of Fire, inasmuch as thou hast been enkindled by the fire that hath appeared upon the Temple of the Chosen One in these days wherein veils have enshrouded all who are in the heavens and on earth, save for a number of the letters of Our Most Beautiful Names. By God, the True One! They are, at this hour, among those who dwell in the highest Paradise.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: Praise be to God Who hath revealed Himself through His Most Great Name, whereupon the limbs of the idolaters among the nations did tremble, and the faces of the monotheists were illumined amidst these intense and gloomy darknesses, and the doves of the Supreme Paradise warbled, and then the rustling of the Lote-Tree of the utmost boundary was raised in the most exalted Paradise.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: Today every soul who deals with the people with the utmost humility and submission, is kind and showing love to them, is considering them the members and limbs of one temple, receiving the stranger as the friend, the remote one as the near one, and is occupied in their guidance, the power of the Word of God will make time as a conquering army and an angel with far-reaching voice.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: Praise be to God! that I have come to Stuttgart, that I could meet with you. Praise be to God! because your faces are radiant with the light of the Glory of God; your hearts are attracted to the Kingdom of Abha. Thank God that you have heard the call of God. Thank God that you are the elect of God. He has elected you because of His own love. The mercies of God have surrounded you.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: Praise, sanctified above all change and extinction, eternally was and ever shall be befitting and worthy of that Imperishable Being, that Self-Sufficient Most High, Who through the fragrance of the garment of His grace guided the people of the Kingdom of Creation to the Most Exalted Horizon, and by the scratching of His Pen drew the peoples of the world to the Kingdom of Eternity.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: Blessed are they who have honored thy resting-place and seized the opportunity of attaining thy presence in the love of God, the Lord of the worlds. Say: O Rahim! Behold thy ardor and the fragrance of thy acceptance. We have verily strengthened thee and raised thee to a station wherein thou didst witness the Most Great Sign and didst hearken unto the call of thy Most Glorious Lord.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: O Ismi Mahdi! In truth these two brothers have been and continue to be engaged in service to the Cause in all conditions. From them hath appeared that which hath not been observed from others. They have attained unto true profit and are engaged in spiritual commerce. Blessed are they, and blessed is he who is with them, and blessed is he who remembereth them with joy and fragrance.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: O leaf stirred by the breeze of the love of God! Indeed, were you to open a hundred thousand mouths and sing with a hundred thousand tongues upon the branch of thanksgiving to the All-Merciful Lord, you would not fulfill the obligation of gratitude for this boundless favor of the Lord that you are mentioned at His threshold and renowned in the gathering of His friends and servants.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: We have heard thy call time and again, and witnessed thy turning toward the countenance of God, the Mighty, the Praiseworthy. We made thee to hear My call and We heard thy call, and showed thee My signs and beheld thee, as a grace from Us. Every word of thy words hath testified to God's Revelation and His sovereignty. Give thanks unto God for having aided thee in this mighty Cause.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: Blessed art thou for having attained unto the remembrance of God in the beginning and the end. Thou art the one that hath been named by this Name from the tongue of thy Lord, the Most Glorious, at a time when the light of manifestation shone forth and the Speaker of the Mount spoke forth in the nights and days. It behooveth thee to glory in this bounty and to shine upon all regions.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: O thou whom God hath assisted to believe and directed toward the Kingdom of the All-Merciful, and immersed in the ocean of grace and bounty, and made him a sign of His love and one who speaketh His praise and chanteth His verses, and chosen him for recognition among all mankind! Give thanks unto God for these favors and confirmations from God, the Mighty, the Powerful, the Bestower.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: Praise be to God that thou hast adorned the temple of thy being with the most great bestowal, and hast placed upon thy head the crown of supreme guidance, and hast illumined thy brow with the light of the love of the Manifest Light, and hast perfumed thy nostrils with the fragrance of the Most Glorious Paradise, and hast succeeded in visiting the spot round which circle the Cherubim.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: Praise be to God that thy letters are adorned with the virtues and qualities of the chosen ones. Each one of the chosen ones whom thou hast mentioned hath been blessed with remembrance of God, glorified be His majesty - a remembrance that, like the existence of Truth itself, hath no likeness or parallel, and hath been the sustenance of the lovers in the city of attraction and longing.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: The drawings and pictures which flowed from thy pen were presented through Mr. Abu'l-Fa?a'il and were observed, becoming a source of joy, for that tender plant in the rose-garden of the love of the All-Glorious is growing and developing and is occupied in acquiring spiritual and physical perfections. I hope that this sapling will become fruitful and attain endless freshness and grace.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: O Afnan of the Blessed Tree, his honor Haji Mirza Muhammad-Taqi, upon him be the Glory of God, the Most Glorious, consider: He is the Most Exalted, the Most Glorious Praise be to God Who hath brought forth a white pearl, a radiant gem, a luminous jewel, and a precious, pure pearl, scintillating, gleaming, brilliant, and effulgent like unto the resplendent flower in the highest horizon

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: O sapling of the garden of divine love! Be thou the praise of the Ancient Beauty and the laudation and glorification of the Most Great Name. That is, be thou so engaged in mentioning, thinking of, and offering praise and glorification to the Blessed Beauty that thou mayest become the embodied reality of praise and the personified form of laudation and glorification of the Lord of Glory.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: O thou flower of the Rose-Garden of the Love of God! Thou hast written regarding the arrival of the beloved maid-servant of God, Mrs. . . . . . . . . ; that she has lived for eighteen days in your house and become the cause of joy and fragrance among the believers. Praise be to God! that thou hast seen the effulgence of the light of the Covenant which hath enlightened all the countries.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: We have sent one of Our exalted words to one of Our handmaidens, that the word of her Lord might attract her and cause her to soar in this all-pervading, subtle and luminous atmosphere. O leaf of My Ridvan! Know thou that thy Lord remembereth His handmaidens, and hath ordained for them in the Tablet of Destiny that which will bring them into My presence and cause them to hear My verses.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: God willing, mayest thou be illumined by the light of the Cause and enkindled by its fire, in such wise that the coldness of the world and its chilling trials may not withhold thee from the warmth of God's love. We have designated thee for the reformation of the world and the healing of the hearts of the peoples. O Jamal! We have remembered thee with that which nothing on earth can equal.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: O fresh sapling of the divine garden! Although outwardly I have not written to you until now, yet the Blessed Beauty - may my spirit be a sacrifice for His enraptured loved ones - is witness that since the time your name was mentioned and your character became known, I have beseeched God that you might become a sign of divine knowledge and a manifestation of the bounty of the All-Merciful

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: O My Afnan! Upon thee be My glory and My favor. The Wronged One, in the midst of sorrows, maketh mention of thee with that which draweth thee nigh unto God, the Lord of the worlds. He hath aided thee through His verses and will aid thee through His clear proofs, and will assist thee through hosts whereby the doors of divine knowledge were opened to all who dwell in the realm of possibility.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: Upon you be My salutation. Your letter reached the Wronged One in the Most Great Prison. According to what was mentioned, you have desired to purify your heart and breast with the Kawthar of utterance which has flowed from the Pen of Evidence, and to turn toward the Most Exalted Horizon. Recognition of this most exalted station and supreme pinnacle is a bounty from God, exalted be His glory.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: O Persian soul! The radiance of the Parsees had for a time set in the west of forgetfulness, but it has now risen again from the east of the Creator-King's bounty with a fresh splendor and boundless grandeur, manifesting such might and majesty that it has illumined the horizons and set all creation in motion. Every tongue has been moved to praise, and all hearts have been stirred to excitement.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: O my two friends! Be happy and joyous, for you have found repose beneath the shade of the Tree of Hope. You have lit a lamp in the heart whose radiance is heavenly. You have planted a tree in the garden of being whose fruit is divine. You have donned a garment whose adornment is eternal brilliance, and you have drunk from a cup whose intoxication is everlasting felicity. May your souls be well!

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: Praised be God that the outpourings of grace from the Abha Kingdom have, even as the showers of spring, refreshed and revived the region of Stuttgart and bestowed beauty and freshness upon it. Some of the friends there are so dedicated that they have already gained admission into the Kingdom, have partaken of the effusions of His imperishable bounty, and are now making excellent progress day by day.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: O ye friends of God! At this time when we are seated in the garden of Ridvan, consorting with the companions, communing with each other and experiencing fellowship, I turn my thoughts to the Kingdom of mysteries and implore the divine bounties to surround my spiritual friends. In remembrance of them, I pray for their joy and enthusiasm, their exultation and rapture, their happiness and enkindlement.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: These are they who have believed in Thee and in Thy most exalted Word, who have clung to the hem of Thy favors in this nether world, who have turned their faces toward the Concourse on High, who have supplicated at the gate of Thy oneness, who have held fast to the sure handle of Thy divine decree, who have voiced Thy praise, whose faces have been illumined by the radiance of the lights of Thy oneness

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: Praise be to God - praise whereby the clouds pour forth their bounty and the near ones inhale the fragrance of the garment of our Lord, the All-Bestowing; praise whereby the lovers seek the presence of God, the Lord of the Covenant; praise whereby the sincere ones hasten to the station of unveiling and meeting, and the unitarians to the supreme heights; praise whereby rivers flow and trees yield fruit.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: "I thank God for that He ordered for thee thine affairs aright and that He aided thee by a company of the Concourse on high" "Blessed art thou, blessed art thou for this most great bounty! Happy art thou, happy art thou for this most great endeavor! Thou didst return victorious and triumphant; thou didst bequeath unto Us joy and gladness, and thou hast become of those that give praise and art grateful."

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: Although for some time thou hadst been turning toward the Abha Kingdom and hadst arisen to serve the Cause of God with the utmost endeavor, in this journey to America thou didst manifest such enthusiasm and attraction in the love of God, and delivered such eloquent and fluent speeches in great gatherings, that thou didst prove thyself to be a true handmaiden of Baha, and Abdu'l-Baha became well-pleased.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: Blessed art thou, O Lu?f-'Ali, in that the Desired One maketh mention of thee from this luminous horizon. The mercy that floweth from the chalice of thy Lord's benevolence be upon thee, O thou who didst believe in God and turn unto Him when every heedless one turned away. Thou art he who remained faithful to God's Covenant and His Testament, and answered His call when it was raised amongst the servants.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: Blessed art thou in that thou hast joined the hosts of God in days when all people were in drunkenness and mighty veils, and hast associated with the men of God and His chosen ones, then with His trusted ones and His loved ones, and hast attained the presence of the Beloved... How blessed art thou that the breezes of eternity have wafted upon thee from the Ridvan of My Most Exalted Name, the All-Knowing.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: To the honored Mr. Afnan, upon him be the peace of God and His favors, I convey my greetings. God willing, may they be assisted in all conditions and drink from the cup of joy at all times in such wise that the troubles of these days may not affect them nor deprive them of spirit and fragrance. O my brother, O my beloved! The ancient glory hath been ordained for them. Happy are they and blessed are they.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: The Most Esteemed Afnan, His Honor Haji Mirza Muhammad-'Ali, may the Most Glorious of all Glory and the Most Resplendent of all Resplendence rest upon him, is to behold with his luminous and pure gaze. Praise and thanksgiving beseem the Afnan of the divine Lote-Tree, who were not deterred by the hosts of idle fancies and the ranks of vain imaginings from the Most Great Announcement and the Straight Path.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: Through Mr. Mirza Ibrahim Zair, the Jew, upon him be the Glory of God, Mr. His respected father, Mr. Hakim Nasir, Mr. Ilia, Mr. Mirza Abdullah, Mr. Yaqub, Mr. Nusratullah, the maidservant of God Nush-Afarin, the maidservant of God Tavus, the maidservant of God Taji, the maidservant of God Tuba, Mr. Mahdi, Mr. Shalom, and all the friends of Sultanabad and its surroundings, upon them be the Most Glorious Glory.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: Praise be to God Who hath shone forth with the lights of Beauty upon His Name, the Beloved. Thereupon appeared Paradise anew with all therein of trees and fruits and flowers and rivers and mansions and chambers, and all the countenances therein spoke that which the Tongue of the Revealer of Verses had spoken. And praise be to God Who hath shone forth with the lights of Glory upon His Name, the Dearly-Beloved.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: who hastened to Thy sheltering shade when Thy manifest morn dawned forth, who rushed to Thy lofty refuge and took shelter in Thy impregnable fortress, who responded to Thy call and kissed Thy threshold, who were set ablaze with the fire of Thy love and were attracted by the holy fragrances of Thy grace, who have ever been servants of Thy Cause, prostrate before Thy countenance, and glorified beneath Thy shade

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: O people of Sisan! The Pen of the Most Merciful mentions you on this blessed night. His honor Amin, upon him be My Baha and My loving-kindness, arrived and made mention of you. Repeatedly before the Wronged One he spoke of your acceptance and your turning towards God. You are they who have attained to acceptance when the people of the cities and lands turned away, save whom God, the Lord of the worlds, willed.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: O Muhammad-Qabl-i-Kazim, upon whom be the glory of God, of Nasrabad! In the name of the All-Knowing, the All-Seeing! Praise be to God that through His boundless grace, mercy and loving-kindness, thou hast turned thy face to the Most Exalted Horizon and drunk from the hands of the Beloved of all possibility the living waters of immortality, and the tongue of the All-Merciful hath uttered: "Well is it with thee!"

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: Praise be to God Who hath manifested and revealed that which was hidden in knowledge and concealed from eyes and vision. Glorified be He Who hath caused all things to speak His praise and glorification, and Who hath summoned all to the Most Exalted Horizon wherefrom the call hath been raised: "The Kingdom and the Dominion, the Majesty and the Power belong unto God, the Omnipotent, the Mighty, the All-Choosing!"

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: O servant present! Praise be to God that his honor Asad, upon him be My glory, hath succeeded in assisting the Cause. We testify that he hath heard My call and turned toward My countenance and hath arisen to serve My mighty Cause. God willing, may he be engaged in serving the Cause of the Lord of all mankind throughout the nights and days. Divine confirmations have encompassed and will continue to encompass him.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: Blessed is the tongue that speaketh of His Name this day and blessed is the eye that gazeth toward His horizon. This blessed Day is truly mighty and great... God willing, thou shalt, through divine grace and heavenly confirmations, preserve thy station and likewise recognize its worth, for thou art recorded and inscribed among the foremost in the Book of 'Illiyin and art distinguished by the special favors of God

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: Blessed art thou. We were with her and witnessed her deeds and heard what she uttered, and We have revealed for her that which every letter thereof testifieth to My loving-kindness, My mercy and My tenderness towards her. O My Name! She must in all conditions praise the Beloved of the worlds, for He hath enabled her to attain unto that which shall never be overtaken by extinction nor comprehended by annihilation.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: Praise be to Him Who has risen and shone forth, Who has appeared and spoken forth, Who has ordained and made possible, Who has bestowed and permitted every luminous essence and divine reality to receive the outpourings of the rain-clouds of His mercy, to roar like lions in the thickets of His bounty, to swim like fish in the pools of His grace, and to warble like nightingales in the gardens of His loving-kindness.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: Man could be so honourable if he would tread the path of God. He would be so beauteous if the light of God could shine upon him and so wise were he was to seek the knowledge of the Kingdom. He would become so capable if he were steadfast in the path of God, so insightful if he were to turn his face towards the lights emanating from the Beauty of God, and so acute if he hearkened to the summons of the One True God.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: Praise be to God Who created all things through the movement of His Most Exalted Pen, and through that which appeared therefrom distinguished between the parties. Blessed be God, the Lord of lords and the Sovereign of beginning and return, Who through a single effulgence from the Sun of His Cause drew the sincere ones to Him, caused the near ones to soar, and moved the unitarians to hasten to the seat of detachment

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: How fortunate thou art to have entered this assembly and to have raised thy melody in this meadow. Thou hast received a portion from the bounty of God and gained a share from the radiance of the shining moon. Thou hast recognized thy Lord, plunged into the ocean of mercy, found repose beneath the shade of Shah Bahram and Hushidar, entered the garden of paradise, and become a sweetly singing bird in the rose garden.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: They are pure, their hearts are overflowing with love, their whole beings are filled with the Cause of God. They are sacrificial in their services and therefore they have won eternal glory. They are serving the Cause of God, not for name, fame and winning glory. Not simply because their sense of duty is strong, but a duty which is permeated with pleasure and joy. They are distinguished from all the western friends.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: O you who are enkindled with the fire of the love of God! Observe how you have become the manifestation of such bounty and the dawning-place of such favor - from the niche of divine unity you have acquired the lights of the gift of the Peerless Lord, and from the waves of the Most Great Sea you have taken your portion. You have been guided by the light of guidance and been made to overflow from the Kingdom of Abha.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: O Husayn! The Wronged One hath turned toward thee from the precincts of the Throne - this place that hath been named the Most Great Prison in the Book of Names, and the Heaven of heavens in My perspicuous Tablet. Thou didst hear thy Lord's call once from the Prison, and again from this Spot that hath been named the Most Exalted Paradise in the Crimson Scroll, which none hath understood save thy Lord, the All-Knowing.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: Praise be to the Desired One of the world, Who hath adorned the earth with a wondrous ornament, Who hath drawn those that had halted to the Most Exalted Horizon through the movement of the Supreme Pen, Who hath bestowed imperishable glory and matchless bounty. His generosity hath no end and His favors no beginning. His grace hath ever encompassed all things and ever shall. He, verily, is the Mighty, the All-Bountiful.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: How can I do this when pens are powerless to express it and tongues fail to explain it? By God's life! The heart is in rapture and ecstasy, the spirit in longing and attraction, and the inner being in burning and flame - passionate for the loved ones of God, in love with the trusted ones of God, enchanted by the chosen ones of God, and yearning to meet the servants who have soared in the atmosphere of the love of God.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: O My Afnan, O Ali! Upon thee be My peace! Thy mention is like daily sustenance and perpetual bounty flowing from tongue and pen. We beseech God, exalted be He, to manifest through thee that which shall testify to thee in all His worlds, to assist thee in that whereby My Most Great Name shall be upraised in the world of creation, and to aid thee in His remembrance and praise and in all that He hath revealed in His Book.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: O servant of God! Raise up two hands of thanksgiving to the threshold of the one true God and say: "O God! Thanks be unto Thee for having led this heart and soul to the Beloved, and bestowed upon this destitute one a boundless portion. Thou didst summon this lost one to Thy path and didst grant this wanderer shelter and refuge beneath Thy protection. Thou art the Giver, the Bestower, the Everlasting, the All-Merciful."

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: Praise be to God that thou hast been given to drink from the hands of the Cupbearer of Revelation and hast quaffed pure beverage from this camphor-tempered Chalice. Praise be to God that thou hast witnessed the effulgence of lights from Sinai and the Sacred Mount and hast taken shelter beneath the shadow of the All Forgiving Lord. Praise be to God that thou hast clung firmly unto the sure Handle of the Covenant of God

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: Observe the infinite favors of the All-Merciful Lord, Who has illumined those two lamps with the Greatest Light of Guidance and blessed those two dawn-birds in the rose garden of favors with the most wondrous melodies... Indeed you are deserving, for wherever you passed through, the signs of the friends' attraction and the guidance of seekers became evident and manifest. Blessed are you, and excellent is your destiny!

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: Praise be to God! The pearls in the shells of the sea of divine bounty are ever manifest and renowned. His signs have encompassed the world, and His evidences shine resplendent before all faces. Today the pavilion of glory hath been raised to its loftiest station, and the lights of the dawn of His Revelation have appeared from the Most Exalted Paradise in such wise that no fair-minded person hath denied or will deny it.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: The entire text is primarily a message of praise and encouragement to the Baha'is of Qazvin, particularly evident in passages like "His Honor the Trustee has praised and commended the friends of Qazvin to such a degree that my heart and soul were filled with the utmost joy" and the extended metaphorical praise describing them as "pure mirrors reflecting the light of reality and flowing springs of the water of guidance."

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: Praise be to God that his honor the Afnan, upon him be the peace and glory of the All-Merciful, attained from the earliest days to this most exalted station and supreme rank. The near ones and the sincere ones have been and continue to be witnesses to this mention. Praise be to God Who assisted His Afnan to achieve the greatest steadfastness and manifested through him that which caused the Most Exalted Word to be upraised.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: Be thou the glorious Solomon of the realm of the All-Merciful and receive a portion from the Most Glorious bounty. Gather and arrange around thee the beasts and birds of the Vale of Tur, spread the carpet of sovereignty in the Kingdom of divine gifts, and send forth the yearning hoopoe to the Sheba of lovers, that it may guide the enchanted Bilqis to the resplendent palace and bring her to the private chamber of mysteries.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: All praise is due to the Most Praiseworthy One, Who through His name Ahmad conquered the world and purified it from the dust and stench of polytheism, Who through "No" rolled up the carpet of idols and through "but" raised high the banner of unity. He is the Omnipotent One Whom the opposition and denial of the polytheists did not deter from His purpose. Holy, sanctified is our Lord and the Lord of the angels and the Spirit.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: Praise be to Him Whose throne was upon the water, and Who described it in His words and from water We made all things living, and it is the knowledge of Him - glorified and exalted be He - through which was accepted what was accepted before, and He is the First Goal and the First Station and the Supreme Summit and the Highest Rank and the Ultimate Purpose. Blessed is he who attains unto Him, and woe to every doubting denier.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: Pure praise and glorification befit the unitarians, before whose might the limbs of the polytheists tremble. These are the hosts of whom He said O hosts of God, mount ye! Their might obliterated the might of the world, and their power transformed the highest palaces of kings into the abode of spiders and owls. The arch of Chosroes stands as witness. The signs of victory and triumph were manifest in all regions and directions.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: O cherished maidservant of God! If you knew what bounty you have been granted and to what Kingdom you have found your way, surely from the intensity of joy and gladness the bird of your soul would not be contained in the cage of the body, but rather would take flight from the intensity of joy. Therefore blessed art thou for having found thy way to this Kingdom and received a portion and share of this supreme bounty and gift.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: Praise be to God, thou hast drunk from the ocean of divine bounty and turned thy face to the Most Exalted Horizon. Blessed art thou for having acknowledged that which God hath acknowledged and that which was inscribed in His Books, His Scriptures and His Tablets. Blessed art thou and blessed is he who hath heard thy words concerning this Cause. Blessed art thou and blessed is the house wherein My remembrance hath been raised.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: All praise be unto the Goal of the world Who, from the ocean of grace and bounty, summoned the world to the horizon of nearness and meeting, in such wise that every seeker turned towards the Sought One and every lover hastened unto the Beloved. Some turned towards Him and attained, while others, being immersed in the seas of doubt and fancy, remained deprived of the Goal, wandering and lamenting in the wilderness of confusion.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: In the name of the Peerless Friend! I swear by the Beloved of hearts and the Object of adoration of all possibility that if all the handmaidens of the earth were to hear with the ear of the heart this blessed word which hath dawned forth from the Dayspring of the utterance of the All-Merciful - wherein He addresseth thee saying: "O My handmaiden and daughter of My handmaiden!" - they would all sacrifice their lives in His Name.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: The hearts were moved at the news that, praise be to God, the favoured maidservants of the Lord of glory have been enabled to render the most distinguished services, to perform the most noble deeds... Such care and attention shall indeed be the cause of nearness to the incomparable Lord. Wherefore be happy and rejoice, and be free of all sorrow and grief, for engaging in such service and for partaking of such unfailing bounty.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: O thou son of the Kingdom! Thy most agreeable letters, with their pleasing style, ever gladden our hearts. When the song is of the Kingdom, it rejoiceth the soul. Praise thou God that thou hast travelled to that country for the purpose of raising up His Word and spreading abroad the holy fragrance of His Kingdom, and that thou art serving as a gardener in the gardens of heaven. Erelong shall thine efforts be crowned with success.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: The honored Afnan of the Blessed Tree have opened their tongues in praise of the Persian friends and ancient divine companions, saying that they truly desire truthfulness and friendship and peace and worship of truth. They are filled with the wine of the love of God and are diffusing the fragrances of divine knowledge. They cause no harm to any group in the world and are benevolent and well-behaved toward all peoples and nations.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: O Leaf of the Supreme Lote-Tree, upon thee be the Glory of God! O 'Aliyyih! The Hand of Loving-kindness took hold of thee and favored thee with Its confirmation. Through His bounty thou didst seek the most distant station, the ultimate goal and the supreme summit. Thou didst attain unto service and wert honored to hearken unto His call. Thy name is wondrous, thy mention is new, thine acceptance is recorded and thy love is accepted.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: Rejoice, rejoice, for thou hast taken up abode beneath the pavilions of ancient glory and hast sought refuge in the Cave of Guidance and the Shelter of the Concourse on High. Thou hast entered the Most Glorious Paradise and drunk from the cup of bounty of the King of Names and Attributes, and hast discovered the pathway of servitude to His Sacred Threshold. Therefore art thou the joy of the free and the sovereign of the eternal realm.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: Praised be His most sanctified and exalted Presence, immune from extinction and decline, Who hath brought forth the pearls of divine knowledge from the shells of the ocean of the hearts of the sincere ones and the monotheists, and made them manifest in the assemblage of the world, that eyes might be illumined by their vision and that these pearls might themselves guide humanity, leading all people and drawing them to the highest horizon.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: O Javad! Upon thee be the Glory of God, the Lord of Creation! Thou hast ever been and art still engaged in serving the Cause. All who have come, all who have sought, and all who have visited have made mention of thee. His honor Amin Abu'l-Hasan Ardikani, upon him be my Baha, hath made mention of thee both before and since. These matters are a truthful testimony and an eloquent witness to thy acceptance, thy devotion and thy steadfastness.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: The essence of praise in a hundred thousand tongues and the quintessence of thanksgiving in a hundred thousand utterances confess their impotence, evanescence, nothingness, and inability to ascend to or comprehend the Most High, the All-Merciful, Lord of all possibility - He before Whose ocean of utterance the seas themselves testify they are but a handful, and before Whose majesty and sovereignty the mountains confess they are but pebbles.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: The sentence is a play on words using his name. He so praised the friends in that land that it gladdened 'Abdu'l-Baha in this prison. Praised be God that the friends of Sangsar sacrificed head and heart for the Best Beloved, and the friends in Simnan were captivated by the His flowing locks and lost their hearts to that shining Moon. Night and day they learn how to sacrifice their lives, and day and night they seek the good-pleasure of God.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: O thou man of right guidance in this new age! I have received thy eloquent letter and read it, pondering deeply its meanings which bespeak the greatest servitude at the Most Great Threshold. I implore God to make thee a word of piety, a sign of guidance, and a scroll speaking praise of the Lord of the highest heavens - that thou mayest guide people to the Path, give them to drink from the cup of Salsabil, and direct them to the straight path.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: O thou who hast turned thy face toward the Kingdom of Holiness! I address thee from this sacred and blessed realm while thou art in that furthermost horizon, and I say: Loose the reins of thy tongue in praise of thy Lord, the Most Merciful, and give thanks unto God for this supreme bounty in that He hath guided thee to the straight path and the right way. Seek ever greater measure, at every moment and instant, of the grace of thy Ancient Lord.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: O thou that art enkindled with the fire of the love God! Thou didst witness the effulgence of the Speaker on Sinai in the day of the Manifestation. Thou didst hear the call: "Verily I am God!" from that blessed Tree on the Mount of the Lord. Thou didst drink of the pure beverage and partake from the camphor-tempered fountain. Thou didst turn towards the dawning place of all lights and thou didst supplicate unto the Kingdom of divine mysteries.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: In wretchedness I glorify Thee, O Thou the adored One of all that dwell in the heavens and on earth! And in affliction I surrender before Thy enlightenment, O Thou Whose attraction draws the hearts of all who yearn after Thee. In adversity I render abiding praise to Thee, O Thou Who art the object of the desire of those who yearn after Thee! And at ease I extol Thee, O Thou Who art remembered in the hearts of those who seek near access to Thee.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: Praise be to God that ye are present in this radiant assemblage and have turned your faces toward the Kingdom of Abha! That which ye behold is from the grace and bounty of the Blessed Perfection. Praise be to God! His signs are evident. Praise be to God! His light is shining. Praise be to God! His ocean is surging. Praise be to God! His radiance is intense. Praise be to God! His bestowals are abundant. Praise be to God! His favours are manifest.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: Praise be to God Who illumined the horizons with the light of effulgence and shone upon all creation with the radiant gleam of dawn before which eyes are dazzled, Who showered upon receptive realities the mysteries of the people of unity, whereupon they absorbed and drew forth and were illumined by this all-encompassing grace and perfect bounty, and were set ablaze with the fire of longing, and proclaimed the divine glad tidings before the lovers

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: O Mirza Yahya, who hath presented himself and attained unto My Name, the All-Knowing Speaker! O Yahya! I testify that thou hast heard the Call and drunk the wine of immortality from the hands of bounty, and visited the Kaaba of God, the Supreme, the Self-Subsisting, and found the fragrances of revelation while thou wert present before the Wronged One, and heardst His verses with thine ear and beheld the horizon of His manifestation with thine eye.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: O thou noble descendent of that illustrious person! I read the verses of thy humility and submissiveness to the Lord and I ask God to encompass thee with His loving-kindness in thy travels to other lands. Thou art permitted to undertake such travels. Well is it with thee to offer the residue remaining in every chalice in the path of God. I am pleased with thee in all aspects and in all conditions and pray that thou art confirmed by the grace of God.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: O Lion! We were walking in the House when the servant present before the Throne appeared with thy letter and presented it before the Face. When it was complete We sent down the answer from the heaven of Will and Power that thou mightest be thankful and be of them that attain. My Most Exalted Pen beareth witness that thou didst turn, didst hear, wast present, didst recognize, didst see, and didst attain unto the presence of God, and He is the Witness.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: O steadfast one in the Covenant! From its contents it became clear that you are pleased and satisfied with the friends in Qazvin. In truth, the friends in Qazvin possess a disposition sweet as honey and sugar, and the handmaidens of the All-Merciful are attracted to the Beloved. I too am delighted and pleased with them, satisfied and grateful, especially with His Honor Hakim and His Honor Samandar-i-Nar-i-Ilahi and His Honor Javad Farhad and the others.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: I testify that thou didst hold fast to the cord of the Cause in such wise that neither the happenings of the world nor the turning away of those who turned from Him Who in every condition proclaimeth "There is none other God but Him, the Mighty, the Beloved" could deter thee... Blessed art thou, O thou who hast turned toward the lights of the Face, who speaketh My praise amongst the servants, who hath clung to My robe and held fast to My stretched cord.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: Blessed art thou for having heard and turned towards God, the Lord of the worlds... Blessed art thou for having turned towards God when every polytheist and infidel turned away... Blessed art thou for having heard the call of God when it was raised in truth, and for having drunk the choice wine of knowledge from the hand of the bounty of thy Lord, the Lord of all Religions... Blessed art thou for having turned toward My ocean and desired My straight Path.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: He opened his tongue in praise and, like David of old with the melody of lute and harp, praised the friends. He says that Mr. Hashim prepares bread soaked in broth and adorns his home to host the friends, that Mr. Sha'ban finds repose through the divine breath, that Mr. Is?aq upholds rights, that Mr. ?aqq-Na?ar gazes upon the greatest vista, and that Mr. Faraj'u'llah proclaims "I ask of you no recompense for it - rather, your Lord's recompense is better."

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: O thou who art controlled by the attraction of the Holy fragrances of the gardens of God's Kingdom! Thy brilliant letter, which thou hast sent by the beloved . . ., was read by me. The bounty is of God for that He hath inspired thee with the word of fidelity and chosen thee from among those who are called, whether men or women. Therefore, thank thou thy Lord at morn and eve and glorify His praise for this favor. Verily a great favor is bestowed upon thee!

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: O ye servants of God! Your mention in this divine gathering is constant and continuous, and your remembrance is the companion of night and day. Behold ye the grace, care, protection and mercy of the Ancient Beauty and the Most Generous Lord, how in such a clime He fills the ancient friends with spirit and fragrance in remembrance of their old-time companions, and how He gladdens and delights the people of the East with the spirit of the people of the West.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: O My physician! We have loved thee and made mention of thee in divers Tablets. Verily thy Lord is with such of His servants as have turned unto Him and have detached themselves from all else. He is the Protector of them that have turned unto Him. Through thy gratitude to thy Lord the ocean of grace surgeth and mentioneth thee with this glorious mention. By My life! There hath been sent down for thee in the Tablets that which nothing in all creation can equal.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: O Salman! May God magnify thy reward and accept thy obedience, inasmuch as thou hast journeyed unto God time and again, and hast migrated unto God, and hast endured hardship on the path such that thou wert exposed to the heat of the sword and the cold of winter, until thou didst enter this remote prison. Well is it with thee for having been preceded by grace and encompassed by mercy, and for having entered the spot of acceptance and the station of attainment.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: One day this exalted word was heard from the tongue of the Lord of Names. He said: "O servant in attendance! Had the false Siyyid, who is known as the truthful one in the land of ?a, been the Sultan, he would have martyred those oppressed ones on the first day." Now all must pray for His Majesty the Sultan and ask for divine confirmation. This ends the quote. According to what was mentioned, of His own blessed accord He released the captives and showed favor.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: In truth, the cotton-carders have attained unto the fruit of existence. My Pen beareth witness to their detachment, My tongue to their acceptance, and My heart to their steadfastness in the Cause of God, the Self-Subsisting, the All-Compelling. They are among those souls who from the earliest days until now have been occupied with His praise and glorification and have been assisted in unity in His path, exalted be He. Well is it with them and joy be unto them.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: O ancient friends of the Lord God! Although in these times you have entered beneath the shade of the Tree of Life, in truth you were in a realm sanctified from time and place, and in the infinite expanse under the shadow of God. Therefore you are addressed as ancient friends, so that you may know that in all the worlds you were manifestations of the favors of that Heart-attracting Friend, and in this world too you have been specially blessed with this bounty.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: Praise be to God Who hath made known to us His Cause, taught us of His Revelation, guided us to His Path, and unveiled for us that which lay hidden in His knowledge and concealed within the treasuries of His power. Glory and splendor be upon His loved ones and chosen ones, whom the howling of wolves did not disturb, and who faltered not in their response when the Tongue of Grandeur spoke from its final habitation: There is no God but I, the Mighty, the Bestower!

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: O Shahryar! May God be your helper and supporter, that your heart and soul may become joyous and manifest the effulgence of divine favor. Strive with all your might to become a radiant candle and a beauty in the assembly, that you may be the cause of honor to your forebears and receive an abundant portion of the spirituality of the prophets. In every instance may you see your desire fulfilled and through the strength of your arm become victorious and triumphant.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: O people of truth! You are the lamps of guidance amongst creation. Praise be to God and thanks be to God! His grace seized you and the hand of bounty drew you to the highest horizon. The whole world awaited His manifestation and all beseeched God, exalted be His glory, yearning for the encounter of that Day. Yet on the Day of Reckoning most appeared in grievous error and remained deprived of recognizing the Purpose of all worlds. But you attained His recognition.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: Today what brings joy to the heart of 'Abdu'l-Baha is the wafting of holy fragrances from the gardens of the hearts of the loved ones. In a short time Jinab-i-Aqa Mirza 'Ali-Akbar has made good progress, having authored such a treatise, and likewise the treatise of Jinab-i-Aqa Siyyid Husayn, and likewise the treatise of Jinab-i-Aqa Mirza Rahim and [three] treatises of Jinab-i-Aqa Mirza Masih - all indicate that they have made remarkable progress in a short time.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: O Jafar, may the effulgent rays of the Most Great Countenance illumine thee! The successive calls and repeated voices raised by thee have reached the ears of the Lord of all beings. He calleth thee with the most excellent and wondrous call. Be thou gladdened by the favors of God and freed and detached from the veils of creation. Think not that thou art forgotten from His sight. He is possessed of great faithfulness. Thou art remembered and observed in most times.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: O assured leaf! On this plane there are handmaidens who are near to God, who are occupied day and night in remembrance of the Friend and familiar with the remembrance of the Beloved Beauty. Praise the All-Compelling Lord that you are gladdened by the remembrance of the Ancient Beauty and are in utmost joy and illumination of heart through mentioning the Most Great Name. Therefore, strive as much as you can in this station so that day by day you may draw ever nearer.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: Praise be to God, they are adorned with the light of recognition and are aflame with the fire of love. Through the tracing of the Most Exalted Pen they have found and attained unto the fruits of the Lote-Tree of the uttermost boundary. And that which was written concerning Aqa Mirza Husayn was observed and became the cause of joy and gladness. Verily We make mention of him through Our bounty, remind him through Our verses, and give him the glad-tidings of Our mercy.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: Let him be praised who is exalted in his station of glory and power! Praise be to God, who has singled Himself out to bear sorrows from all who dwell in the realm of possibility, and has distinguished Himself with tribulations from all that can be named as a thing in the dominions of creation. And the more afflictions increased, the more He manifested mighty signs - exalted be the Lord of Names and Creator of Heaven, whom the oppression of the servants did not deter.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: We have remembered you with a remembrance that no remembrance can equal, and We have revealed for you that whose fragrance shall never be cut off, and We have turned toward you with a favor that all the treasures of the heavens and earth cannot equal... The Tongue of Grandeur and the Most Exalted Pen bear witness that your days were adorned with service to the Cause of God. In truth, you performed that which became the cause of the Most Great Remembrance in God's Book

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: O 'Ali-Qabli-'Askar! Upon thee be the Glory of God, the Lord of Destiny. Praise be to God that thou didst leave thy earthly home, aspiring to reach the most exalted homeland. Should every drop of the ocean and every grain of sand be counted in the divine ledger as an age, and shouldst thou spend all that time in praise and thanksgiving to God, exalted be His glory, thou wouldst still not fulfill the obligation of gratitude for this supreme bounty and most great favor.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: Glad tidings! On this night, which is the first of the honored month of Rajab, the letter from the honored and compassionate Ali Akbar, upon him be God's peace, arrived. His verses were both flowing and witty, and were presented in the gathering of the chosen ones. In truth, the fragrance of sincerity and love wafted from it. Likewise, in the presence, it was favored with the glances of grace. Each of his words bore witness to love and testified to submission and affection.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: Today the Sun speaks with "The All-Bestowing One has come," and all things proclaim "The Creator of the heavens has come." The Divine Lote-Tree gives glad tidings to all trees, leaves and fruits, announcing the appearance of the Hidden Treasure and the Concealed Mystery, and congratulates the mountains of the world upon Mount Sinai, for in these days it drinks from the cup of reunion and partakes of the Kawthar of meeting after despair, finding intimacy with its Interlocutor.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: Praise be to God Who hath sent down the verses and revealed the clear tokens and fulfilled what He promised His servants in His Book through the tongues of His Messengers. Blessed art thou for having turned toward the Dayspring of Revelation and the Source of Inspiration whereby the ocean of knowledge surged in the contingent world. O people of Bonab! Praise ye the Desired One of the world, Who hath aided you to turn unto Him, to mention Him, and to recognize His sacred Being.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: Thank God, for that He hath made thee of the "Chosen Ones," not of those who were only "called"; hath assigned thee to the knowledge of His Manifest Beauty, during the Great Century; hath guided thee to the right Way; hath exhilarated thee from the Cup which is overflowing with the choice Wine of the Love of God; hath dilated thy breast with the light of knowledge of God; hath favored thee with His Gifts; and hath attracted thee from this world through the Magnet of the Kingdom.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: O thou tree of the orchard of His Holiness Moses! The honored Aqa Habibu'llah has arrived at the Refulgent Land, attained unto the Sacred Threshold and partaken of the spiritual assemblage. Meeting him has brought utmost cheer and vitality. He has written a letter and therein has spoken glowingly and most appreciatively of your manifold kindness and benevolence in raising him. Indeed, I was deeply thrilled and happy that, praised unto God, thou showed him such favor and generosity.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: O Sadiq! Know thou, O servant, that thou hast fulfilled God's covenant and His testament, and hast attained unto the highest pinnacle of His grace. Thou didst migrate with God, thy Lord, until thou didst enter this mighty prison, and didst endure hardships and tribulations, remaining steadfast upon the straight path of truth. Thou didst not oppose thy Lord in any matter, nor didst thou cause Him grief in all that befell thee during thy journey, as if thou wert among the content ones.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: O Firuzih of radiant essence! The jewelers maintain that the turquoise is a precious gem, superior to, better and more pleasing than any other gem in purity. Now it appears they are correct, right and accurate in this opinion, for our Firuzih is from the mine of divine bounty, and all the friends praise and extol his refinement, declaring him to be worthy of a king and of pure water. Praise be to God, he is from the mine of the love of God and from the quarry of the knowledge of God.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: O my friend! My tongue is occupied with Thy mention, my heart is familiar with Thy remembrance, and my soul is enamored with Thy love, for thou art a servant of the Abha Beauty and a worshipper at the threshold of the Most Exalted Lord. Thou keepest thy heart alive with the remembrance of that peerless Beloved and seekest a head filled with the tumult of love for that faithful Friend. Therefore thou art dear and inspiring, and the cause of spirit and fragrance to people of distinction.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: His blessed favor chose you from among the nations of the world, and clothed you with such a beautiful robe, and placed such a brilliant crown upon your head. I swear by that radiant countenance that in every moment you should spread your wings in joy and delight, soar to the heights of gladness, and begin to offer thanks to the Desired One with sweet melodies. O joy be unto you! O delight be unto you! O gladness be unto you! O good news be unto you of this great bounty and manifest light!

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: Blessed is he and blessed is he who has attained to the service of the Cause in the Days of God, the Lord of the worlds. O Mahdi! Rejoice thou in My remembrance of thee. We have sent down for thee in these days that which nothing in all creation can equal, and We have sent it to thee as a bounty from Our presence. Verily thy Lord is the All-Bountiful, the Most Generous. Thy deed hath previously been adorned with the ornament of acceptance. Give thanks unto God for this wondrous remembrance.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: Today the effulgences of the Sun of Truth have shone forth upon all, and cities and lands are in rapture and ecstasy from the attraction of the Call of the All-Chosen One. Worthy of mention and praise are those souls who today were not prevented by the taunts of the people, the cawing of the ravens, and the threats of the oppressors from the Light of the Manifest Horizon. They heard the Call of Truth and joined themselves unto it. These are the banners of guidance and the standards of grace.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: Praise be to God Who hath revealed what was hidden, brought forth what was treasured, and fulfilled what He promised on the Promised Day. Glory, radiance, remembrance and praise be upon the Hands of His Cause who have attained unto His presence and drunk the choice wine of revelation from the hands of their Lord, the Self-Sufficient, the Most High - those through whom the Euphrates of utterance hath flowed, the ocean of knowledge hath surged, and the dove of certitude hath warbled upon the branches.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: Numerous letters were received from thee containing subtle meanings indicating firmness, uttering the praise of the Lord of greatness and might, because He opened the doors of the Kingdom before the faces of the pious, removed the curtains and revealed the mysteries, so that the signs became famous and popular in the east of the earth and the west. Thank thou God for making thee a spreader of the banners of the Covenant, which is waving upon the horizons. Good is the reward of the people of harmony.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: O Ahmad! Hearken unto the melodies of divine revelation in the Persian tongue, that He may bestow upon thee wings and grant thee strength, that thou mayest soar in the atmosphere of His love and remain firm and steadfast in His Cause. Praise be to God, thou hast repeatedly attained unto that for which the world was brought into being. How many souls were observed to be deprived, while thou didst arrive and hear and see. Give thanks unto the Lord of all worlds that He hath aided thee and guided thee.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: O successor of that blessed predecessor! That predecessor was a sign of the All-Merciful and a standard of the Lord God. It is my hope that this successor may become a mercy unto the friends and a bounty and heavenly food, that the branch may follow the root and the son reveal the mystery of his father. May he bestow the fragrance of the rose-water and the jewel-laden branch bear fruit. May the hearts of the friends become joyous and glad and the hearts of the loved ones be companioned with happiness.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: Praise be to God, Who was and Who shall ever be as He hath been, and peace and blessings be upon the Lord of all possibility, through Whom was made manifest the essence of all religions and through Whom were sealed the commandments of God, our Lord, the Most Merciful, and upon His family and companions who acted in accordance with that which they were commanded in the Book. Your letter was received, bringing joy and gladness. We beseech the Truth to confirm you in that which He loveth and is pleased with.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: And unto God, after the Letters of Truth in creation, are hidden gems both male and female - these are they who, when they hear the mention of God, their hearts are moved, then they tremble from love of their Lord. They love God though they know not and recognize not, but when God maketh Himself known unto them that there is no God but I, then do they fall prostrate before God. God loveth them and they love God, and these are names that point to naught save God, and in the shade of God do they seek shelter.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: O ye two birds of the nest of divine knowledge! Praise ye God that ye are nestled together in the nest of divine knowledge and are in close embrace upon the branch of love and faithfulness in the Abha Paradise, singing and warbling with great fervor and excitement. This station hath been ordained for you and, God willing, ye shall become successful and confirmed therein. Your services to the loved ones of God are well-known and remembered, and in the divine Kingdom they are celebrated, praised and accepted.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: Praise, glorification, thanksgiving and splendor belong exclusively to the True Thankful One, Who through this Most Exalted Word summoned His servants to the supreme heights, as He, exalted be He, saith: "Be thankful unto Me and I will be thankful unto you." Glory be to God! Today the divine treasures and the repositories of eternal wealth are present and visible, and in the nights and days, from the Treasury of the Supreme Pen, the pearls of wisdom and utterance specifically for the Afnan are made manifest.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: God willing, thou shalt be mentioned among the people through the name of Truth and be accounted among the servants of the divine Cause, in such wise that at all times thou shalt be occupied with the remembrance of the All-Merciful. Praise be to the Beloved of all possibility that thy name hath flowed from the tongue of the Divine Unity and thy mention hath been recorded by the Pen of the Divine Command. This is a bounty that shall endure through the perpetuity of God, the Sovereign, the Mighty, the All-Wise.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: O Kazim! Praise the Desired One of the world Who granted you steadfastness. How many souls have turned towards Him and then, for the slightest reason, turned away from the True One! Blessed is the servant who fixeth his gaze upon the blessed words "He doeth whatsoever He willeth." Such a one is among the companions of the Crimson Ark. No command deterreth him, nor doth anything cause him to slip. He holdeth fast unto the cord of God in such wise that the peoples of the world are powerless to separate him from it.

Subject: praise and encouragement
