Quotation: The Wronged One hath made mention of thee in such wise that the Concourse on High perceived its fragrance, and hath uttered that whereby the dead were raised in the kingdom of creation. Blessed is he that heareth and seeth what hath appeared from the horizon of God's will, the Lord of the worlds. Thou art he who hath attained to that which flowed from My Most Exalted Pen and hast drunk the choice wine of My love from the hand of My bounty, and hast spoken in My praise when most of My servants turned away from Me.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: O Amin! Upon thee be the glory of God, His care and His mercy. The servant present submitted thy letters before His presence. Blessed art thou for having confined thy affairs to the love of God, His praise and the service of His Cause. We testify that thou didst hear and respond, and didst succeed time and again in attaining that which God revealed in the books of the past and future. Verily thy Lord is the Compassionate, the Bountiful. He it is Who aided thee and through thee set right the affairs of His loved ones.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: Blessed art thou in that the face of the Ancient One hath turned toward thee from the direction of His Most Great Prison and remembereth thee with that which hath caused the hearts of the people of immortality and the denizens of the Kingdom of Names to soar. Blessed is the house wherein the remembrance of God hath been raised, and blessed is the tongue that hath uttered My praise, and the face that hath turned toward My horizon, and the heart that hath tasted the sweetness of My remembrance, the Mighty, the Wondrous.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: Glory be to that sovereign Lord who has raised up among the servants of the world the banner proclaiming "Verily I am the Lord of existence." Through the sword of His utterance, He has freed the mute and stammering ones of the world from the darkness of names and the pit of suspicions and vain imaginings. The banner of His justice was not prevented by the oppression of the deniers, nor was His Testament of Truth followed by obliteration. Glorified be His majesty, all-pervading be His bounty, and exalted be His station!

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: They who place their trust in God - these are they who dwell in security. They who say there is no God but God - these are the true believers. They who say as God willeth and verily all bounty is from God and we are thankful unto Him - these are the God-fearing. They who praise God - these are they who, by God's leave, are sustained. They who give thanks unto God, their Lord, the Lord of the heavens and of the earth, the Lord of all worlds - these are they whom God increaseth in His favors, and these shall be the inheritors.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: And the people of that land, such as the honored Alif and Ha (M.Y.) -- upon him be the Most Glorious Glory of God -- and those related to them, and others -- upon them be the Glory of God -- who outwardly had no renown among men, are now mentioned in the Concourse on High and are known for their utmost exaltation and elevation, inasmuch as their names have flowed from the Most Exalted Pen and there hath appeared from the Tongue of Grandeur concerning them that which eternal mention itself is unworthy of, let alone aught else.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: Thy letter hath come and he who was present before the Wronged One read it. We heard and have answered thee with that which will gladden thy heart and solace thine eyes. Thou hast ever been mentioned in the presence of the Wronged One. Thou art among those souls whom God hath assisted and granted that which is the cause and source of the joy of the hearts of those near unto Him. The fragrance of thy sincerity is diffused throughout the world, and from all regions have come noble and wondrous accounts of thy character and deeds.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: Praise be to the Court of the Intended One, Whom neither the opposition and objection of the world nor the indifference and denial of nations could deter from His all-conquering, all-subduing purpose. In the dark night He guided His chosen ones to the Dawning-Place of the morn of utterance and led them into the luminous realm of certitude. Despite the denial of Iran's divines and the clamor of the wicked in that land, the light of the utterance of the Intended One of all worlds grows ever brighter, more manifest and more resplendent.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: Praise be to the pure Lord that you are intoxicated with the wine of that Peerless Beloved, that you belong to the realm above, that through the radiant bounty of the Lord you are luminous, joyous and beauteous, that on this triumphant day you are eloquent, hearing and seeing, and that you have adorned heart and soul with the effulgence of the celestial Sun. How wonderful, how wonderful is your nature! How wonderful, how wonderful is your blessed countenance! How wonderful, how wonderful is your becoming path! May your souls be gladdened.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: Blessed are the people of Baha! God beareth Me witness! They are the solace of the eye of creation. Through them the universes have been adorned, and the Preserved Tablet embellished. They are the ones who have sailed on the ark of complete independence, with their faces set towards the Dayspring of Beauty. How great is their blessedness that they have attained unto what their Lord, the Omniscient, the All-Wise, hath willed. Through their light the heavens have been adorned, and the faces of those that have drawn nigh unto Him made to shine.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: Praise be to the peerless Lord who, despite the convulsions of the world, the hatred of certain peoples, the calumnies of the slanderers, and the clamor of the deceivers, guided and led His loved ones to the Most Great Prison. Glory be to God! Despite a thousand intrigues and evil whisperings, through His absolute, prevailing, and penetrating Will, He gathered an assembly beneath the Blessed Tree, bringing together the sincere ones and the monotheists. During the nights and days, He favored each one with a mention and adorned each with a gift.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: O Dove! O thou who gazest toward the Supreme Horizon and drinkest My sealed nectar from the white fingers of My bounty! We have made mention of those servants concerning whom thou didst beseech God for their remembrance and the manifestation of His favors and bounties unto them. Give thanks unto God, thy Lord, for this great favor. Thou hast a station with thy Lord, the Mighty, the All-Praised. He shall assist thee in that which He loveth and is pleased with, and shall aid thee to make mention of Him in such wise as to attract hearts and minds.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: Blessed is he who hath attained unto the call of God... Blessed art thou, O Rahim, in that thou didst hasten to the Most Great Ocean when the Ancient Beauty was in His Most Great Prison. Thou didst turn toward Him and journey across land and sea until thou didst arrive at the White Spot wherein was raised the call of the Creator of heaven, Who came with the truth with manifest sovereignty. Joy be unto thee for having attained unto that which was recorded in the Books of God and promised in the Tablets of thy Lord, the All-Knowing, the All-Informed.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: Praise, glorification, remembrance and splendor befit those champions in the arena of meaning and utterance, whom neither the clamor of the polytheists, nor the tumult of the deniers, nor the croaking of men and the roaring of their mighty ones could debar from the light of attainment. With complete steadfastness they remain firm and steadfast in the Cause of God. They are the dawning-places of victory and exposition, and the daysprings of power and knowledge. They heard and responded; they saw and exclaimed: "Praise be unto Thee, O God of the world!"

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: O thou who art attracted by the fragrances of God! I have indeed chanted verses of thanksgiving to God for having illumined thy heart with the light of guidance, for having gladdened thine eyes by the vision of His most great signs, for having dilated thy breast with the light of knowledge, for having purified thine inner being through the outpourings of the All-Merciful, and for having caused thy spirit to rejoice through the holy fragrances that have wafted from the Kingdom of Glory. Blessed art thou for this cup which overfloweth with the gift of God.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: Praise be to God Who hath rent asunder the veil and lifted the covering, Who hath revealed Himself upon Sinai, kindled the fire of guidance in the luminous Spot, illumined the horizons with the light of dawning in the Vale of Tuwa, caused all things to speak forth in praise, showered His great bounty upon radiant realities, and shone forth with manifest light upon pure mirrors which were moved and attracted, enkindled and humbled, submissive and crying out, calling Glory be to our Lord, the Most High! Glory be to our Lord, the Most Glorious, the Most Luminous!

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: The honored Amin has opened his tongue in praise of those Afnans of the Blessed Tree, saying that, praise be to God, each one shines like the moon in the horizon of recognition, and each stands as firm in the Covenant as an immovable and mighty mountain with strong foundations. Through God's grace they are illumined, radiant and spiritual, and through the outpourings of the clouds of providence they are, like the trees of the paradise of oneness, in the utmost freshness, delicacy and vigor. This praise is the greatest adornment and ornament in the world of creation.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: O spiritual friends of Abdu'l-Baha! Praise be to God that you have all been mentioned in the kingdom of Abha and within the precincts of the Lord of grandeur. You are all well known in the world above and present in the heart of this Servant who is immersed in the ocean of poverty and selflessness. Each one of you holds a scroll in his hand vouchsafed unto him from the unseen realm. Each one has a mandate given to him by the bounty of God. Your heads have been crowned with the diadems of His loving providence and your bodies have been decked with the raiments of guidance.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: Among the greatest divine favors is that you came into existence in this glorious century, became one of those who bow in prostration, hastened to the holy court of the King of the unseen and seen realms, attained the honor of meeting, heard the perfect words from the sacred lips, and now have also achieved the privilege of circumambulating the spiritual sanctuary. You remain firm and steadfast in the Covenant and Testament, and cling to the hem of the All-Merciful Lord. Therefore give thanks to the pure God that you have been blessed and confirmed with all these bounties.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: O Na'im! Upon thee be My Baha! One of the Branches named ?iya' appeared before Me with thy letter. Blessed be thy tongue for having uttered the praise of God, and thy heart for having turned unto Him, and thy face for having been directed towards the light of His countenance, and thy pen for having flowed with His remembrance, and thy heart for having given birth to the maidens of remembrance and utterance. We beseech God to aid thee and to assist thee, and to make what hath flowed from thy tongue a treasure for thee with Him. Verily, He is the All-Bountiful, the Most Generous.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: O loving Rustam! Though Tahmtan was mighty as an elephant and the champion of every gathering, he grew weary from Suhrab's mace and fell into a perilous pit through his brother's deception. You who are the divine Rustam of Sistan and the lion of God's forest, scatter the armies of the ignorant and open the fortress and ramparts of hearts. Put to flight the tyrannical Afrasiyab and with an arrow bring down the demon Ashkabus. With the life-giving sword of the tongue, conquer the Eastern realm and bring the Western territories under the lofty banner of the Judge. May your soul be happy!

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: Praise be to Him Who hath unfurled His banners, revealed His signs, proclaimed His words, and made manifest His evidences. He hath expanded breasts through the light shining from the horizon of Revelation, stirred the surging ocean with the fire kindled upon the highest summit of the Mount, and made clear every decreed matter in the Preserved Tablet. Glory, praise, and radiant greetings be upon those souls who have forsaken their desires, clung to His guidance, been illumined by the light of His morning, and turned toward the Kingdom of their Lord in this noble century and glorious age.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: O servant! Read what hath reached thee of the signs of God with myriads of those who are nigh, that thou mayest be attracted thereby and attract through thy melodies the hearts of all created things. And whoso readeth the verses of God alone in his house, the angels that spread the divine fragrances will waft their perfume in all directions, and every pure soul will be transformed thereby, even though he may not be conscious of it at the time. Yet this grace will become manifest unto him in one of the days to come. Thus have the hidden mysteries of the Cause been ordained by the Ordainer, the Wise.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: In the Name of God, the Most Holy, the Most Glorious! Your letter hath come and been read before the Throne. Therein didst thou beseech God to number thee among them that circle round His court, that gaze upon His beauty, and that visit the Kaaba of His glory. Know thou that We have answered thee. We have inscribed thee by the Most Exalted Pen as one of those who have circled round My throne, who have attained My presence and heard My melodies, who have soared in the atmosphere of My nearness and reunion, who have been attracted by My verses, and who have detached themselves from all else besides Me.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: Blessed is he who chanteth them in such accents as to fill with ecstasy the Concourse on high, and to reach the ears of the dwellers of the Abha Kingdom. O God! Assist Thou its author through the confirmations of Thine Abha Kingdom; strengthen his loins by Thine almighty power; cause him to utter Thy praises in great assemblies; and make him Thy most mighty sign, a compelling proof in vindication of Thy Cause among all peoples, a resplendent sign in the world of creation, a standard raised above the pavilions of sublimest glory, a matchless pearl and a peerless jewel glittering in the diadem of loftiness.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: Through the grace and bounty of the merciful Lord and the generous Master, He gave shelter to this scattered assemblage beneath the shadow of His loving-kindness and caused them to dwell within the impregnable stronghold of His bounty. From one hand He gave them to drink of the sweet and pleasant water of the Kawthar, and from another hand He made them taste the choice honey of His radiant Beauty. And this bounty was through pure grace, not justice; it was a gift, not something deserved; it was loving-kindness, not due to capability. His is the praise and His is the thanks for this mighty and tremendous favor.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: O Jim! Hearken unto the call of thy Lord, the Merciful, from the direction of the Prison. Be thou in the Cause of thy Lord as sweet water, that there may grow from thee, in the soil of hearts, the trees of certitude and assurance. Or be as the breezes that waft from the direction of holiness, from which the servants who have turned towards the Most Great Scene, this hallowed and luminous horizon, perceive the fragrance of the garment. Thou hast been mentioned before the Throne. Soon there shall descend upon thee from the heaven of grace that which hath been ordained for thee by One Who is All-Knowing, All-Informed.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: O beloved friends of God, upon them be the Glory of God, the Most Glorious! O ye who are nigh unto the threshold of God! Your names are mentioned amongst the Concourse on high, ye are well-known in the Kingdom of Abha, and your attributes are lauded by the tongues of the people of sanctity, for ye have believed in Him Who is the Lord, the Most High, acknowledged the truth of the Manifestation of God, set your faces towards the Kingdom of Abha, taken hold of the sure Handle, quaffed from the chalice of certitude, and clung to the firm Cord. Ye are immersed in the ocean of bounty and set aglow with the light of faith.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: Praise be fitting unto the Lord of all desires, Who with a single effulgence illumined the horizons of discord with the light of unity and concord. His Will lent support and His Purpose penetrated through divine favor. Through that effulgence which encompassed the world through the radiance of the Muhammadan Sun, it seized all the palaces of the Caesars, the arches of the Chosroes, and the porticos of tyrants. In places where the banner of polytheism was raised, the standard of divine unity was hoisted, and gatherings once devoted to the mention of idols were transformed to circles remembering the Lord of all beings.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: O handmaid of God, pure and tranquil leaf, mother of Ali-Rida Khan! O thou maidservant of the Most Glorious Threshold! Give thanks unto God that thou wert blessed with a son who, turning his face toward God, traversed mountain, plain and desert, and like the wind crossed the wilderness, until he attained unto the sacred soil of the holy shrine, making his inner vision clear and his sight pure and free from every dust. Such a mother deserveth such a son, and such a son requireth such a mother. Blessed be the breast that gave him suck, and happy the bosom that nurtured him. Blessed art thou and blessed is he in all conditions.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: O beloved! Glad tidings unto thee for having drunk from the chalice of ruby from the hand of the Youth of the Kingdom! Blessed art thou for having heard the melodies of Paradise from the mouth of the Youth of companionship! How wonderful for thee to have known what none among created things have known, and none among all beings have preceded thee therein! Joy unto thee for having attained unto all good things and recognized thy Lord, the Most High, and for having been honored by meeting Him after recognizing His Self, and for having tasted the sweetness of His words, and been illumined by the wondrous splendors of His glances!

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: O my dear friend! Thanks be to God that thou art successful in serving at the Sacred Threshold and, with the utmost purity of intention and detachment, art occupied in promoting the divine counsels and exhortations. My heart is well-pleased with thee, my tongue is well-pleased with thee, my pen is well-pleased with thee, God is well-pleased with thee, the friends of God are well-pleased with thee, and the seekers after truth are well-pleased with thee. What more couldst thou desire? How excellent, how excellent that thou art thus near, the recipient of bounty, the object of affection, and a truthful servant of His Holiness the One!

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: O Haji Mirza 'Ali-Akbar from the land of Nur and Ra, upon him be [Baha'u'llah's] Glory... Praise and glory befit those souls at rest and those hearts of strength whom neither the swords of the wicked prevented from the traces of the Chosen One nor did the ranks of oppression hold back from manifesting justice. By their steadfastness the feet of the heedless were shaken, and by their arising the manifestations of power were brought low. They are the dawning-places of might among the servants and the manifestations of what God has willed in the lands. All created things offer prayers upon them when the lights of attributes shine forth.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: O spiritual youth! Upon thee be [the glory of the numbers] 966 [Baha'u'llah] Praise be to God that thou hast attained His presence and witnessed with thine outward eyes the waves of the ocean of utterance. For every moment in His presence a hundred thousand thanksgivings and praises are required, for despite the opposition of the peoples of the world, the tyranny and oppression of most nations, the prevention of hinderers and the enmity of opponents, the Hand of Power hath, through infinite means, guided thee to the Most Exalted Goal and Supreme End and caused thee to attain His presence - exalted be His dominion and great His power!

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: Praise be unto Him at Whose praise the Dove of Holiness warbleth in the gardens of inner meaning, at Whose remembrance the Lions of the Kingdom roar in the thickets of glory, by Whose name the Fish of the Spirit swim and glorify Him in the pools of the Seven Oft-repeated Verses, at Whose mention the Maidens of Paradise sing with most enchanting melodies and most wondrous tunes to the sound of strings and cymbals, and Who hath bestowed divine bounty and heavenly manifestation in the contingent world, whereby spiritual feelings and divine ecstasy were stirred in hearts, and souls were attracted by luminous effulgence to the Kingdom of the All-Merciful.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: O blessed souls! Your letter dated the 2nd of Jamadi'ul-Avval 1339 was received, though it spent considerable time in transit before arriving in these days. The contents of the letter bore spiritual glad-tidings and, like a pure mirror, reflected the radiance of the Sun of Truth's favors and evidenced the confirmation of the Ancient Beauty and the Most Great Luminary, may my spirit be sacrificed for His loved ones. The heart and soul of Abdul-Baha were filled with joy and gladness that, praise be to God, the true friends and lovers of the Heavenly Beloved, those enamored with the tresses of the Beauty of all horizons, are in complete unity and harmony.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: O thou who art firm in the Covenant and steadfast in heart and soul! That kind friend is ever in the thoughts of those who long for him, and this wanderer in the wilderness of the love of God is well-pleased and joyful with his conduct and behavior. In service to the manifest Light, thou hast shown no shortcoming from any direction, and hast expended praiseworthy efforts. Thou art mindful of guiding souls and strivest with all thy heart for the enlightenment of humanity, that thou mayest awaken one who sleepeth and make mindful one who is heedless, and beyond thy capacity thou engagest in diverse services. Assuredly thou shalt be confirmed and assisted.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: Praise be to God, Who hath adorned the brocade of the Book of Revelation with the letter Ha' following the letter Ba', through which the Trumpet was blown and all who are in the heavens and earth were thunderstruck, and through which the path of grace was raised up and the balance of justice established, and through which the limbs of all names trembled and the foundations of those who denied God, Creator of heaven, were shaken, and through which the tribes lamented and the widows cried out, and through which the banner "Verily He is God" was raised throughout all regions of existence and the standards "Truth hath come, the Knower of the unseen" were unfurled.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: O ye beloved of God and His sincere friends! By the life of God! The hearts are cheered whenever you are mentioned, the souls are comforted in your love, the holy spirits are captivated by your fragrance, the eyes are expecting to see you and the hearts are longing to meet you... Blessed are ye, O children of the Kingdom of God! Glad-tidings to ye, O friends of God! as He hath made your destiny great and your share victory and happiness, your lamps lighted and your spring to yield supply! Ye are the most brilliant stars! Ye are the most dazzling lamps! Ye are the green branches! Ye are the ripe fruits! Ye are the beautiful gardens! Ye are the overflowing bowls!

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: Praise, sanctified above the mention of the seen and unseen, befitteth the presence of that Self-Subsisting One Who was not prevented from His purpose by the consensus of the world, the agreement of nations, the manifestations of hatred in the realm of creation, and the opposition of the divines among mankind, nor was He deterred from His Will. The motion of the world diminished not His tranquility, and the resistance of nations altered not His power. Glorified be His majesty and triumphant be His might! Glory, praise and magnificence rest upon His loved ones, whom neither the onslaught of any oppressor could cause to stumble, nor the power of any aggressor could hold back.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: Praised be the exalted, the most high! The essence of glorification and the source of sanctification befitteth the sovereign of wondrous and lofty might who, through the outpourings of the oceans of His grace and bounty, caused the realities of beings and essences of all things to ascend from the abasement of nothingness to the throne of glory and existence. Through the trump of power and sovereignty He breathed the breath of life into the bodies of abstract essences and manifest realities, illumined the mirrors of subtle knowledge with the wondrous effulgence of His all-encompassing mercy, and made manifest the precious ornaments of the abstract realms from the dawning-place of beauty.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: Though time be short and opportunity more fleeting than the spark from flint and steel, yet his honor Mirza Abdullah, like unto a melodious bird with manifest songs and hidden harmonies, beseeched that this letter be written, saying that his honor Khan Jani hath a yearning heart and a radiant countenance. His face shineth with the light of the love of God, and his heart, like unto a rose garden and meadow, is deserving of attention and capable of ardent love. Should a call reach him and a voice be heard, he would be stirred with passion and zeal, with attraction and joy. He would set aflame the harvest of the dejected ones and kindle the souls of the withered ones. He is a sweet-singing bird and a high-soaring falcon.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: O our Lord! Thanks be unto Thee in that thou hast enabled us to hear Thy summons, Thou hast confirmed us in being attentive, Thou hast nourished us with Thy bounties and gifts, Thou hast raised us up in this Day of Meeting God from graves of self and desire, guided us to the Path of righteousness, illuminated our eyes with the light of guidance, dilated our chests so that we can behold the great signs, cheered our hearts with Thy glad tidings, strengthened our backs with the hosts of Thy Abha Kingdom, and fortified our being with a battalion from thy exalted dominion, so much so that the announcement of Thy Manifestation has reached all horizons and the seven firmaments have been embraced by the traces of Thy Appearance.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: Give thanks unto God for having chosen you to enter His Kingdom and to receive the effulgences of the Sun of Truth in all regions, and for having made you dawning-places of the lights of His grace, rising-points of the stars of His bounty, recipients of His inspiration, trustees of His mystery, and custodians of His Covenant, that ye may diffuse the divine fragrances throughout all regions, raise the standard of universal peace at the center of possibility, kindle the great lamp of love within the glass of the world of humanity, sow the seeds of fellowship and harmony in the field of all regions, and water it with the holy waters flowing from heaven, thus making the face of the earth a supreme garden and the Abha Paradise.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: Praise be unto Thee, O my God, God of all worlds, my Purpose and Purpose of the mystics, my Beloved and Beloved of the monotheists, my Adored One and Adored One of those near unto Thee, my Desire and Desire of the sincere ones, my Hope and Hope of the expectant, my Refuge and Refuge of the seekers, my Shelter and Shelter of those who take refuge, my Goal and Goal of those who turn unto Thee, my Vision and Vision of the beholders, my Paradise and Paradise of those who attain, my Kaaba and Kaaba of the yearning ones, my Attraction and Attraction of the lovers, my Light and Light of the bewildered and penitent, my Rapture and Rapture of those who remember, my Cave and Cave of those who flee, my Stronghold and Stronghold of the fearful, my Lord and Lord of all who are in the heavens and the earth.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: Through the dear daughter Mrs. Consul Schwarz, to the highly honored Mr. Wilhelm Herrigel. I was very pleased by this news; especially also because I see that the friends of God are immeasurably kind to one another. Mr. Rembold, his wife, his daughter and his son truly deserve a thousand praises, because they set out to serve the Cause of God. Mr. Gustav Götz is in reality attracted to and enkindled by the Cause. Mrs. Kühnel is indeed engaged in the service of the Kingdom of God and is the cause of progress among the sincere souls. Professor Friedrich Maier is the herald of the Kingdom of God and within a short time he will have a wonderful influence in those regions. Mrs. Consul Schwarz is the daughter of the Kingdom and a shining candle in the gatherings of the friends of God. Mrs. Schlag and Miss Stabler are two sweetly singing birds in the rose garden of God.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: Upon you, O ye Letters Ten, and upon all who have ascended unto God with you, from among the ancient and the latter generations, the outward and the inward ones, and upon all who have believed in God and His signs, God hath ever caused to descend from every splendor its most splendid, from every majesty its most majestic, from every beauty its most beautiful, from every grandeur its most grand, from every light its most luminous, from every mercy its most expansive, from every word its most perfect, from every name its most great, from every glory its most glorious, from every will its most resolute, from every knowledge its most complete, from every power its most potent, from every utterance its most pleasing, from every question its most beloved, from every sovereignty its most enduring, from every dominion its most excellent, and from every loftiness its most exalted.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: Mr. and Mrs. Hannen rendered outstanding services at this Convention and labored extensively, sacrificing themselves. Miss Beatrice Irwin sacrificed herself and strove with all her powers, and Miss Thompson was devoted to the Convention. The poems Mr. Hannen composed about the Convention are truly worthy of praise and commendation, having been composed with utmost eloquence and excellence. Miss Morton, Mrs. Van Patten, Mr. Maxwell, Mrs. Osgood, and Mr. Tobey rendered outstanding services in adorning and illuminating the Convention and displayed great effort. Mr. Wendell Dodge, Mrs. Fraser, Miss Root, Mr. Bert Randall, and Mr. Holley wrote beneficial articles in the newspapers, causing news of the Convention to spread far and wide. Mr. and Mrs. Harry Randall showed no shortcoming in their hospitality and financial support of the Convention, carrying out all that was necessary and befitting. Mr. Lunt and Mr. and Mrs. Ober demonstrated the utmost capability in their services and in organizing, arranging and perfecting the Convention's proceedings. Mr. Mills, Mrs. Alice Breed, Miss Lloyd, Mr. Wilhelm, Mr. and Mrs. Harris, and Mrs. Krug - these souls strove in every way to bring joy, contentment, hospitality and spirituality to the delegates and friends.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: You are the bearers of the name of God in this Day. You have been chosen as the repositories of His mystery.... You are the witnesses of the Dawn of the promised Day of God. You are the partakers of the mystic chalice of His Revelation.... You are the first Letters that have been generated from the Primal Point, the first Springs that have welled out from the Source of this Revelation. Beseech the Lord your God to grant that no earthly entanglements, no worldly affections, no ephemeral pursuits, may tarnish the purity, or embitter the sweetness, of that grace which flows through you. I am preparing you for the advent of a mighty Day.

Subject: praise and encouragement
Quotation: The days of thy presence have not been forgotten and will not be forgotten. Thou art remembered before this Wronged One. Verily, He seeth thee and remembereth thee, and He is the All-Remembering, the All-Knowing. We beseech God to assist thee in that which He loveth and is pleased with. He is the Almighty, the All-Powerful. BH10945O handmaid of God, esteemed and assured believer, honored Mrs. Jackson, upon whom be greetings and glory! O thou of pure heart, illumined spirit, whose soul is attracted to the Beauty of God! I am aware of your services to the Cause of God in America, your profound attachment to the Kingdom of God, and your earnest endeavors in Paris for fostering fellowship, unity, and hospitality toward the loved ones of God, both men and women. O handmaid of God! I tell you truly that the angels of heaven pray for you, and the denizens of the Abha Kingdom address you, saying: Glad tidings be unto thee, O honored one, for what thou hast rendered and continuest to render in service to God's Kingdom! Glad tidings be unto thee for thy attachment to the Beauty of God! Glad tidings be unto thee for thy faith and certitude in the signs of God! Glad tidings be unto thee for the noble sentiments showered upon thee from Abdul-Baha! Glad tidings be unto thee for this gift by which thy countenance shall shine among the angels of heaven in God's Kingdom!

Subject: praise of Eastern values; culture
Quotation: At the time when our ancestors in Europe were like beasts of burden, were naked and covered themselves with sheepskin, Iran enjoyed a tremendous civilization. I pray that Germany will bring Iran material progress, and Iran will teach us culture, humanity and spiritual civilization.

Subject: praise of Eastern values; culture
Quotation: The Blessed Perfection expressed always great love for the Parsee friends...The Zoroastrians of India have made great effort and served the Cause of God in the most unselfish manner...The Parsees have demonstrated very praiseworthy exertions in the promotion of Truth and have lived with utmost joy and fragrance.

Subject: praise of Eastern values; culture
Quotation: There is an intangible, ineffable Something in the Atmosphere of the Orient that causes the increase of spiritual susceptibilities. Life in the Orient is very simple, very charming, while in the occident it has become very complex and wheels within wheels. In the Eastern countries, the hearts are undisturbed and calm.

Subject: praise of Western values; culture
Quotation: The American people are not satisfied with their present day civilization. It is true that they have built a marvellous civilization of their own through giant-like forces and energy which in many respects is superior to the European civilization, yet they are striving for higher things, nobler ideals and universal principles. Look at the majority of the French people! How complacently satisfied they are! They think they have reached the highest acme of civilization and there is no further step to take. But with the Americans it is different. They may be proud of their civilization, because they have made the desert blossom like unto the rose, but they are not satisfied with it, they are seeking after new solutions of old and modern problems, they are thirsty for salubrious water, they are hungry for the bread of life, they are investigating the reality of everything. Their hearts are open, their minds receptive and in discussion never overbearing. They believe there is always a place on the top and so they go forward and forward. They never look backward or downward. They say, what we have accomplished in the past may be "all right", but we are going to do "the good" and after that, there is "the better" and then "the best" and is there any end to the infinite degrees of the "best"? for every "best" is followed by another "best" which is "better" than the former "best."... [This was the gist of the Master's talk with our newly acquired American friend.]

Subject: praise of Western values; culture
Quotation: You are known for your learning, character, fairness, and love of truth.

Subject: praise of Western values; culture
Quotation: "I hope that, as this century is a radiant century and this age a merciful age, the human world will become united and the standard of the solidarity of the human race will be hoisted in Paris; for Paris is a center of refined civilization and has advanced marvelously along the path of science... I hope that the soul of Paris will arise from the city of obscurity and progress steadily forward to the new civilization."

Subject: praise of Western values; culture
Quotation: In these days the Day-Star of the East hath invested the West with a wondrous grace.

Subject: praise of Western values; culture
Quotation: For America has developed powers and capacities greater and more wonderful than other nations... May the inhabitants of this country ... rise from their present material attainments to such a height that heavenly illumination may stream from this center to all the peoples of the world.

Subject: praise of Western values; culture
Quotation: they mentioned the German believers, saying how good they were since no offensive notes had been sounded there and, God willing, great souls would appear there.

Subject: praise of Western values; culture
Quotation: Indeed these blessed souls have the utmost desire for attraction to the divine fragrances, detachment from all else save God, exaltation of the Word of God, and service to the Cause of God.

Subject: praise of Western values; culture
Quotation: A single craft from among the crafts of the East and West that today serveth mankind and is the cause of ease and comfort for the servants is, in the sight of God, superior to all that those heedless souls have carried and declare from their pulpits.

Subject: praise of Western values; culture
Quotation: There is a great spiritual light in London, and the ideal of justice is strong in the hearts of the people...The news of this incident, being noised abroad, did much to show the Eastern people that British justice is in reality the same for the rich and for the poor, and therefore worthy of all respect.

Subject: praise of Western values; culture
Quotation: The Englishman has an unshakable sense of statesmanship, which is entirely entwined with his business sense; therefore he is the born conqueror and colonizer. The Englishman knows what he wants, and is capable of what he wants, and he does not want more than he is capable of. The Englishman is a realist, a man of the present and of facts. Therefore the world will at first belong to the Briton.

Subject: praise of Western values; culture
Quotation: The true, liberal, religious spirit is more witnessed in America than in Europe. From an ethical standpoint they are far ahead of European nations. The American people as a whole are a religious people. They investigate the reality and are free from the fetters of prejudices. The Americans are an inventive nation. In the light of their manifold inventions their services to the world of humanity are considered as incalculable.

Subject: praise of Western values; culture
Quotation: "The American women as a whole are better educated, more well-informed on classical as well as current subjects and the spreaders of the right ideals of education. They are endowed with a most wonderful power of assimilation and comprehend quickly the subtleties of philosophy and religion. A woman Principal in any of the high schools of the United States is more intelligent than the President of the University of El-Azhar in Cairo!"

Subject: praise of Western values; culture
Quotation: In this western world with its stimulating climate, its capacities for knowledge and lofty ideals, the message of peace should be easily spread. The people are not so influenced by imitations and prejudices, and through their comprehension of the real and unreal they should attain the truth. Yet because I find the American nation so capable of achievement and this government the fairest of western governments, its institutions superior to others

Subject: praise of Western values; culture
Quotation: What wonderful vigor, energy, force and intelligence do the American woman display! They show such sound judgment, such marvelous range of information. In undertakings and actions their men are giants. The Americans on a whole are very magnanimous and hospitable and their prosperity and success in material affairs proverbial. In the domain of spirituality and ethics there is also great awakening. One can speak more intelligently and reason more easily with a plain American citizen than hundred supposed learned men of Acca. They love the Beautiful and strive to embody in their lives the precepts of artistic purity and noble holiness.

Subject: prayer for assistance; intercession
Quotation: O Lord! Aid these servants and handmaidens of Thine by the outpourings of Thy mercy and the effusions of Thy grace.

Subject: prayer for assistance; intercession
Quotation: This servant of Baha also supplicates at His Threshold with humility and entreaty that you may be assisted and confirmed in all things.

Subject: prayer for assistance; intercession
Quotation: I have raised suppliant hands to the Supreme Kingdom, beseeching abundant bounty for that beloved one who is attracted to the Most Glorious Beauty.

Subject: prayer for assistance; intercession
Quotation: O God, I beseech Thee, O Succorer, O Help in Peril...that Thou convey my greeting to Thy righteous servants and Thy wanderers in the earth, and urge them to aid me and help me against my enemies.

Subject: prayer for assistance; intercession
Quotation: I seek the intercession of Muhammad and His family with Thee, by the glory of Thy grandeur. Look upon me with a near glance befitting the sovereignty of Thy might. Verily, Thou art the Generous, the Bestower.

Subject: prayer for assistance; intercession
Quotation: At a time when Abdul-Baha turns his face toward the Sacred Threshold and seeks intercession at the court of the Lord of Hosts, he remembered you and commenced writing this letter, offering prayers to the Abha Kingdom

Subject: prayer for assistance; intercession
Quotation: My God, my God! Leave me not to myself. Ordain for me that which Thou hast ordained for Thy loved ones. Then open before my face the door of Thy bounty. Verily, Thou art the Powerful, the Protector of what was and what shall be.

Subject: prayer for assistance; intercession
Quotation: O God! Praise be unto thee for all these. Assist thy servant who has turned unto Thee and who has clung to Thy Cord, adhered to Thy hem, so that he may attain that which is beloved and desirable in both this world and the world to come.

Subject: prayer for assistance; intercession
Quotation: O my Lord! I am he who hath turned toward the horizon of Thy bounty, clinging to the cord of Thy loving care and holding fast to the hem of Thy generosity. Send down, then, upon me from the clouds of Thy giving that which beseemeth Thee.

Subject: prayer for assistance; intercession
Quotation: I press my brow to the dust and soil my face with the earth of lowliness, powerlessness and utter submission, supplicating Thee at eventide and dawn, and beseeching Thee in the darkness of night and the brightness of day, that Thou mayest assist Thy servant

Subject: prayer for assistance; intercession
Quotation: My Lord and my Hope! Verily this servant of Thine, seeking Thy good-pleasure and striving to win Thy satisfaction, hath shown every effort to resolve this difficult matter and make it easy and simple. O Lord! Aid him in all affairs, exalt him among the people, and assist him with the successive and continuous hosts of Thy angels from Thy visible Kingdom. Verily Thou art the Beneficent, Thou art the Great, Thou art the All-Merciful, the Most Compassionate.

Subject: prayer for assistance; intercession
Quotation: Glorified art Thou, O God of all things, Who art established upon the throne of names! I beseech Thee by Thy sweetest utterance and the manifestations of Thy Cause in the kingdom of creation, by those whose faces Thou hast honored by turning them away from all else except Thee, and whose hearts Thou hast made the treasuries of the pearls of Thy knowledge and the repositories of Thy revelation, and whom Thou hast given insight from Thyself, to send down upon this servant of Thine that which will deliver him from all that preventeth him from turning unto Thee, O Lord of heaven and Master of the nations.

Subject: prayer for assistance; intercession
Quotation:
O my Lord! I am but a feeble ant, a frail gnat with broken wings, my feet weary from traversing the wilderness of separation. Behold my weeping eyes and witness my burning heart. My sighs and lamentations have caused all the birds to cry out, and the anguished sigh of my heart, like a consuming flame, hath set the world ablaze. From Thine all-glorious horizon, shower forth the effulgence of Thy lights, and from Thy most exalted Kingdom, bestow the gift of Thy mysteries. O Cloud of Grace, pour forth Thy copious rain, and O Sun of Truth, shed abroad Thy abundant radiance, that perchance these frozen hearts may be quickened and renewed, and these lifeless souls may attain boundless life.  AB07896
O my Lord and my Hope! Aid Thy servants who are afflicted in the hands of the wretched ones, who have turned toward Thy most exalted horizon in service to Thy Cause in the realm of creation.

Subject: prayer for children and youth
Quotation: O God! Guide me. Protect me. Make me a brilliant lamp. Make me a shining star. Thou art the Mighty and the Powerful.

Subject: prayer for children and youth
Quotation: O God! This is Thy young servant; nourish him from the breast of Thy loving-kindness, rear him in the cradle of Thy bounty and the embrace of Thy training

Subject: prayer for children and youth
Quotation: I ask Thee, then, O God of all existence and King of the Seen and the Unseen, to bestow upon me a healthy child that he may make mention of Thee in Thy earth and may sing Thy praises in Thy lands.

Subject: prayer for children and youth
Quotation: O God! I am a tender child. Protect me in Thy shelter. Bestow! Grant mercy! Train and raise me in the comfort of life. Confer capacity, so that I may become of the Kingdom, spiritual and illumined.

Subject: prayer for children and youth
Quotation: Verily, I beseech God to ordain an exalted station for thy honorable husband in the Kingdom of God; and to make thy dear son as a source of the Water of Knowledge, and a fountain of the Salsabil of the love of God!

Subject: prayer for children and youth
Quotation: I beseech the favors of the Blessed Beauty, may my spirit be a sacrifice for His loved ones, that He may make this newborn praiseworthy, and that He may nourish this child from the breast of the love of God and raise him up.

Subject: prayer for children and youth
Quotation: O my Lord. I dedicate that which is in my womb unto Thee. Then cause it to be a praiseworthy child in Thy Kingdom, and a fortunate one by Thy favor and Thy generosity; to develop and to grow up under the charge of Thine education.

Subject: prayer for children and youth
Quotation: We beseech God that he may be of pure lineage and noble, sanctified descent, born of both body and soul, and formed of both heart and clay. May he become a righteous successor and the manifestation of Grant me from Thyself a successor.

Subject: prayer for children and youth
Quotation: Praise be unto thee, O Lord my God, I beseech Thee...to protect every child that hath been admitted beneath the shade of Thy loving-kindness, and to have mercy, O my God, on those babes whom the people have banished from their homes while were still at their mothers' breasts

Subject: prayer for children and youth
Quotation: O Lord! Through the vernal showers of Thy mercy, bestow freshness and beauty upon these young trees and make them bear the blossoms of knowledge and learning and the verdant leaves of wisdom and science. Make this school of ours the envy of Paradise and a musk-diffusing rose-garden.

Subject: prayer for children and youth
Quotation: O my Lord! You have granted him daughters and bestowed upon him leaves. Therefore, preserve them in the cave of Your protection, O Lord of the earths and the heavens, and provide them with a garment that will protect them from the arrows of pain and shield them from the spearheads of tyranny.

Subject: prayer for children and youth
Quotation: O God! Make this child successful in faith and certitude, and make him firm and steadfast in the Covenant and Testament. Confirm him through Thy boundless grace, and make him a fruitful tree in the Abha Paradise. Make him aware and wise, make him one of Thy dependent ones, and make him distinguished among strangers and kin.

Subject: prayer for children and youth
Quotation: O my God! We are children who have drunk from the breast of Thy love the milk of knowledge, and have entered Thy kingdom in our earliest childhood. We implore Thee, by night and by day: O Lord! Make our footsteps firm in Thy Faith, and guard us within the shelter of Thy protection, and nourish us from the table of heaven. Make us signs of guidance and lamps of piety, and assist us through the angels of Thy kingdom, O Lord of might and grandeur! Verily, Thou art the Generous, the All-Merciful, the Most Compassionate.

Subject: prayer for children and youth
Quotation: O my God! We are children who have drunk from the breast of Thy love the milk of divine knowledge and have entered Thy Kingdom from our tenderest years. We implore Thee, by night and by day: O Lord! Make our feet firm in Thy Faith, preserve us within the shelter of Thy protection, feed us from the table of heaven, and make us signs of guidance and lamps of piety, and assist us through the angels of Thy Kingdom, O Lord of might and grandeur! Verily, Thou art the All-Bountiful, the Most Merciful, the Most Compassionate.

Subject: prayer for detachment
Quotation: O Kind Lord! Free this heart from every attachment

Subject: prayer for detachment
Quotation: O Lord! Deliver us from attachment to created things, from past sins and future afflictions

Subject: prayer for detachment
Quotation: O Lord! Sever the cord of my attachment to all things, sanctify me from all things, detach me from all things, and make my face pure for Thy gracious countenance that I may be cut off from all else but Thee in this mighty station.

Subject: prayer for detachment
Quotation: I beseech Thee by the ocean of Thy verses, and the sun of Thy loving-kindness, and by Thy radiant and resplendent light, and Thy unique and wondrous Cause, to ordain for me that which will make me detached from all else but Thee and holding fast to the hem of the robe of Thy mercy.

Subject: prayer for detachment
Quotation: Glorified art Thou, O my God! I beseech Thee by the lights of Thy Beauty and by the splendors of the Sun of Thy grace and bounty to detach me from whatsoever is in the heavens and earth, and to render me wholly devoted to Thy resplendent and most glorious Countenance and sincerely dedicated to Thy most exalted Faith

Subject: prayer for detachment
Quotation: O my God! Drive not this poor one from the door of Thy riches, nor this thirsty one from the Kawthar of Thy grace and the Tasnim. O my God! Leave me not to myself and my desires, then rend asunder the veils that have prevented me from arriving at the shore of the might of Thy mercy. O my God! Send down upon me from the clouds of Thy bounty the rains of Thy generosity and grace, then cleanse thereby my heart from the remembrance of all else save Thee.

Subject: prayer for fasting
Quotation: Grant, O my Lord, that this fast may become a river of life-giving waters and may yield the virtue wherewith Thou hast endowed it. Cleanse Thou by its means the hearts of Thy servants... Do not bring our fasts to an end with this fast, O my Lord, nor the covenants Thou hast made with this covenant.

Subject: prayer for fasting
Quotation: O my God and the God of names, and Creator of the heavens! I beseech Thee by Thy greatest signs and by the manifestations of Thy sanctification in the kingdom of creation, to adorn the temples of those who fast with the robe of Thy grace and forgiveness. Then ordain for them, through Thy bounty and favors, the good of this world and the next

Subject: prayer for fasting
Quotation: The days have been honored, O my God, by the days which Thou hast named Ha. Each day thereof Thou hast made a herald and messenger to announce unto men the days whereon Thou hast prescribed fasting for Thy creatures and Thy servants, that each soul may prepare for their arrival, designate a place for them in his heart, and purify it through Thy name, the Lord, for their descent upon him.

Subject: prayer for fasting
Quotation: This is the first day wherein Thou hast prescribed the fast for Thy loved ones. I beseech Thee by Thy Self and by him who hath fasted for love of Thee and Thy good-pleasure, not for his own desire and hatred of his Lord, and by Thy most excellent names and most exalted attributes, to purify Thy servants from the love of aught else but Thee and draw them nigh unto the Dayspring of the lights of Thy countenance and the Seat of the throne of Thy oneness.

Subject: prayer for firmness in the Covenant
Quotation: I beseech Thee by Thy chosen ones and Thy trusted ones to ordain for me what Thou hath ordained for them

Subject: prayer for firmness in the Covenant
Quotation: O Lord! Make firm their steps in Thy Cause, make weighty their measure in this Day of Thy Manifestation, and make them among the signs of Thy Book in the world of creation.

Subject: prayer for firmness in the Covenant
Quotation: This is Thy servant and the son of Thy servant...make him steadfast in Thy Covenant, whose mighty pillars cause the highest heavens to tremble due to its greatness and the difficulty of bearing it

Subject: prayer for firmness in the Covenant
Quotation: O God! O Thou Who illuminest the faces of those who are steadfast... preserve him from the arrows of doubts, and the spears of allusions, and the swords of interpretation... Make his heart firm in the Covenant like a building of iron plates

Subject: prayer for firmness in the Covenant
Quotation: O peerless God! We offer our supplication and prayer that Thou wouldst make these servants intimate with Thy mysteries and cause them to hear the call of the Concourse on High. Make them steadfast in Thy Covenant and Testament, and companions to the remembrance of Thy Blessed Beauty.

Subject: prayer for firmness in the Covenant
Quotation: O Thou Who dost strengthen the sincere ones with hosts from the Most Glorious Kingdom and Who dost confirm those firm in Thy Covenant with legions of angels from the Supreme Concourse!...O Thou Confirmer of those among Thy servants who are firm in Thy Covenant and Testament, which is the most firm handle extended from Thy Most Glorious Kingdom.

Subject: prayer for firmness in the Covenant
Quotation: O my Lord! Illumine his sight with the vision of the lights of the Covenant, gladden his heart with the musk-laden breezes wafting from the gardens of the Testament of the Light of the Horizons, make fragrant the garden of his heart with the outpourings of the clouds of harmony, and protect him from the evil of discord and the thunderbolt of hypocrisy.

Subject: prayer for firmness in the Covenant
Quotation: O Lord! Assist these brothers to serve the Covenant and to be illumined by the lights of the effulgences of the Kingdom throughout all regions, to drink from the cup of Thy favors which overflows with the wine of knowledge amongst the people of concord. Aid them through Thy Word, grant them Thy bounty, shower upon them Thy mercy and assist them in all things.

Subject: prayer for firmness in the Covenant
Quotation: O Lord! Aid me to be faithful and steadfast in Thy Cause amidst all humanity, and enable me to drink the cup of tribulation and fall into the depths of hardship and adversity, and to drink from the chalices of affliction and be refreshed by the breezes of fidelity in Thy path, O Thou in Whose hand is the kingdom of earth and heaven. Verily Thou art the All-Bountiful, the Most Exalted.

Subject: prayer for firmness in the Covenant
Quotation: O my God and the Helper of the sincere ones and those who are firm in Thy Covenant and are assured by Thy promise! Aid these, Thy servants, to serve at the threshold of Thy holiness, and make them signs of guidance and stars of piety, shining from the supreme horizon and gleaming from the highest zenith. Make firm their feet that they slip not through the doubts of the people of passion and desire.

Subject: prayer for firmness in the Covenant
Quotation: O Lord! Behold Thou Thy lovers in Thy lands, who have trembled at the onslaught of Thine enemies. I beseech Thee, by the light of Thy Countenance and the fire of Thy love, so to attract them by Thine utterance that they may not be affected by Thine enemies, and by the estrangement of the learned amongst Thy creatures who pretend to knowledge without any clear proof from Thee, or testimony on Thy part.

Subject: prayer for firmness in the Covenant
Quotation: My God, my God! The fire of Thy love hath enkindled me, and the fire of separation from Thee hath consumed me. I beseech Thee by Thy Name through which the decree of resurrection was manifested and those in the graves arose, and by Him through Whom the breezes of Thy Revelation and the fragrances of Thy Cause were wafted, through which the Ascension was adorned, and by Thy loved ones, to make me steadfast in Thy Cause.

Subject: prayer for forgiveness
Quotation: My God, my God! ... to forgive my grievous sins and my great transgressions.

Subject: prayer for forgiveness
Quotation: Forgive her, O my Lord, in this base world and in the Hereafter, the abode of glory.

Subject: prayer for forgiveness
Quotation: O God! I beseech Thee... to forgive me by "There is no God but Thee" [repeated throughout prayer]

Subject: prayer for forgiveness
Quotation: Therefore forgive us and pardon us and aid us through all Thy help against the transgressing people.

Subject: prayer for forgiveness
Quotation: O King, the All-Merciful! Bestow Thy grace upon me and forgive me, O Thou Evidence, O Thou Compassionate One!

Subject: prayer for forgiveness
Quotation: O All-Bountiful God! Cover over our faults and bestow upon us Thy freely-given grace and endless forgiveness.

Subject: prayer for forgiveness
Quotation: You see my position on the mountain, so forgive me and bestow your grace upon me, for you are the Best of forgivers

Subject: prayer for forgiveness
Quotation: O Lord! ...Forgive their sins, grant them forgetfulness, bestow joy, show them kindness, and vouchsafe them forgiveness.

Subject: prayer for forgiveness
Quotation: O God, Forgiver of sins, Remover of sorrows, Concealer of faults! [...] make him assured of Your pardon and forgiveness

Subject: prayer for forgiveness
Quotation: O my God, my Lord, my Beloved, my Goal! I have come unto Thee and I beseech of Thee that which is the cause of Thy forgiveness.

Subject: prayer for forgiveness
Quotation: Perfect, O God, His light and forgive us, and send down upon us the measures of Thy mercy, for Thou hast power over all things.

Subject: prayer for forgiveness
Quotation: I beseech You...by the river of Your mercy and the ocean of Your favor, to forgive me and accept what has appeared from me in Your days.

Subject: prayer for forgiveness
Quotation: My God, my God! The ocean of Thy mercy has surged...Verily, Thou art the Kind, the Forgiving, the Pardoning, the Generous, the Bestower.

Subject: prayer for forgiveness
Quotation: O thou forgiving Lord: Forgive my kind mother's sins. Pardon her shortcomings, cast a glance of Providence and usher her unto Thy Kingdom.

Subject: prayer for forgiveness
Quotation: O my Lord, the All-Forgiving, the All-Merciful...make her a sign of Thy forgiveness. Verily, Thou art the Ever-Forgiving, the All-Merciful.

Subject: prayer for forgiveness
Quotation: O Lord of pardon and forgiveness, Concealer of faults and Swift to bestow favors!...Verily, Thou art kind to Thy servants and generous to every penitent soul.

Subject: prayer for forgiveness
Quotation: Pour a drop of that divine wine to his desire that he might become joyous and diffuse the fragrance of musk. Immerse him in the ocean of pardon and forgiveness

Subject: prayer for forgiveness
Quotation: O God! Grant her Thy forgiveness and pardon, and in the world of mysteries immerse her in the ocean of lights. Verily, Thou art the All-Forgiving, the Compassionate.

Subject: prayer for forgiveness
Quotation: My Lord! Strip from her the garment of error and clothe her with the raiment of bounty and bestowal... Therefore immerse her in the seas of Thy pardon and forgiveness

Subject: prayer for forgiveness
Quotation: O Lord! Forgive them both and pardon them, and make them two brilliant stars in the horizon of Thy mercy, and two radiant lamps in the glass of Thy forgiveness and pardon.

Subject: prayer for forgiveness
Quotation: forgiveness was beseeched for him who ascended unto God, Aqa Mirza ?abib, that he may become the recipient of pardon, favors and the object of the benevolence of the merciful Lord

Subject: prayer for forgiveness
Quotation: Nevertheless, supplications and entreaties were made at the threshold of divine grace and favors, that pardon and forgiveness might encompass all and endless bounties might surround all.

Subject: prayer for forgiveness
Quotation: O Lord, forgive my sins and conceal my faults, and grant me a goodly exit, and purify me from the defilement of my errors, and cause me to enter into the ocean of Your pardon and forgiveness

Subject: prayer for forgiveness
Quotation: My God, my God! I commune with Thee with the tongue of supplication... I seek Thy forgiveness, O my God, for my sins and transgressions which have brought me shame and weighed heavily upon me...

Subject: prayer for forgiveness
Quotation: O God, my God! I have turned in repentance unto Thee, and verily Thou art the Pardoner, the Compassionate. O God, my God! I have returned to Thee, and verily Thou art the Ever-Forgiving, the Gracious.

Subject: prayer for forgiveness
Quotation: O Lord! I beseech Thee by Thy Name through which the greatest earthquake and the most mighty terror appeared, to unveil for me that which is hidden from me... [continues through lengthy prayer section]

Subject: prayer for forgiveness
Quotation: O God! O You Who illumine existence with praiseworthy light...I beseech You by Your mercy which has preceded all created things to embrace Your servant who has returned to You with Your infinite favors.

Subject: prayer for forgiveness
Quotation: O Lord! Make Khusraw Rustam a companion of forgiveness, grant Makhmal Bahram repose in Thy shelter, and make Sarv Salamat a manifestation of pardon. Thou art the Forgiver, the Bestower, and the Kind One.

Subject: prayer for forgiveness
Quotation: O Lord, forgive Your hopeful servant of yesterday and bestow upon her triumph, success, pardon and forgiveness. Immerse her in the ocean of Your bounty and cleanse and sanctify her from the filth of sin.

Subject: prayer for forgiveness
Quotation: O Thou kind Lord! My shortcomings are many and my righteous deeds are none. I am a sinner, an evil-doer...O my God! Grant Thy grace, bestow Thy favor, show Thy generosity, and deal with me through Thy mercy.

Subject: prayer for forgiveness
Quotation: O my God! I implore Thy forgiveness, for my very existence is a sin with which no other sin can compare. How can I not seek Thy forgiveness when Thou art the Possessor of boundless mercy and eternal forgiveness?

Subject: prayer for forgiveness
Quotation: Therefore, O my God, forgive me and my parents and those who have followed me in Thy decree. Send down upon us Thy breathings, honor us with Thy bounties, and preserve us from all evil through the sovereignty of Thine eternity.

Subject: prayer for forgiveness
Quotation: My God, my God! Aid the treacherous to be trustworthy, the slanderers to be truthful, and the polytheists to return to the Tree of Thy oneness and the gate of Thy forgiveness and bounty. Verily, Thou art the Almighty, the All-Powerful.

Subject: prayer for forgiveness
Quotation: With complete humility and supplication, prayers were offered for him at the Sacred Threshold. Again, in consideration of your request, God willing, prostrate at the Sacred Threshold, supplication will be made seeking pardon and forgiveness.

Subject: prayer for forgiveness
Quotation: O GOD the Forgiver! O Heavenly Educator! This assembly is adorned with the mention of thy holy Name. Thy children turn their face towards thy Kingdom, hearts are made happy and souls are comforted. Merciful God! cause us to repent of our shortcomings!

Subject: prayer for forgiveness
Quotation: O God, You whose mercy encompasses all things, whose bounty is perfected for all beings, and whose forgiveness aids the peoples of earth and heaven...O Lord! Make their morning blessed and illumine their lamp. Make their spirits attached to Your holy verses.

Subject: prayer for forgiveness
Quotation: O Lord! Forgive both me and him our sins, deliver him from afflictions, dispel his sorrows, lead him to the springs of bounty, give him to drink from the cup of fidelity, and make him a sign of grace and beneficence in the midst of Paradise and throughout the gardens of Heaven.

Subject: prayer for forgiveness
Quotation: O Lord! Thou hast chosen from among Thy righteous servants souls whom Thou didst enable to enter beneath Thy sheltering shade and attain unto the great triumph...Verily Thou art the Pardoner, the Forgiver, and verily Thou art the Generous, the Merciful, the Kind, the Compassionate.

Subject: prayer for forgiveness
Quotation: O Lord! Tears of grief have flowed for this severe calamity and sighs have risen in this great bereavement...O Lord! I implore Thee and lament and weep before Thee, and I beseech Thy countless favors and Thy boundless pardon and forgiveness for this blessed Branch who turned to Thee

Subject: prayer for forgiveness
Quotation: My God, my God! Praise be to Thee for having strengthened me, caused me to know Thee, made me to hear, and guided me unto Thy straight path and Thy mighty announcement. I beseech Thee... Forgive me through Thy grace and generosity, then ordain for me what Thou hast ordained for Thy chosen ones.

Subject: prayer for forgiveness
Quotation: O Kind One! O Radiant and Resplendent Bestower! [Name] was wandering and bewildered in this world. Grant him order and arrangement in Thy world. He was without refuge or shelter - give him a dwelling and abode in the shelter of Thy Great Mercy...Thou art the Forgiver, the Illuminator, the Kind One.

Subject: prayer for forgiveness
Quotation: "Mr. Mirza Haydar-'Ali Iskaui, with utmost humility and need, offered prayers and supplications to the Kingdom of Mystery, and sought endless forgiveness for you - that is, a spring like that of Job: 'This is a cool bath and drink' - so that you may be resurrected in perfect health, wellness and safety"

Subject: prayer for forgiveness
Quotation: I beseech Thee at this moment to forgive those who have been heedless of Thy Most Great Remembrance and have turned to that which their desires have craved. Then forgive them, for they are Thy servants and Thy bondsmen, and they possess for themselves neither profit nor loss, neither life nor resurrection.

Subject: prayer for forgiveness
Quotation: O Lord! Grant the parents of Haji Aqa a place in the shelter of Thy pardon and forgiveness and immerse them in the ocean of Thy mercy. Quicken souls and make them aware, and through Thy grace and great bounty forgive sin and grant access to the Kingdom of Thy favor. Thou art the Bestower, the Giver, and the Kind.

Subject: prayer for forgiveness
Quotation: I beseech God, blessed and exalted be He, to assist them to return unto Him, to turn in repentance at the door of His bounty, and to stand before the throne of His justice. Then I beseech Thee, O my God, to forgive me and my son, and whosoever hath held fast to the cord of Thy bounty and clung to the hem of Thy grace.

Subject: prayer for forgiveness
Quotation: O Lord! O Forgiver of sins! O Pardoning One! O Ever-Forgiving! Aid Thy repentant servant Qanbar, pardon him, forgive him, and cause him to enter the gardens of Thy good-pleasure. Immerse him in the seas of Thy forgiveness and bounty, and grant him the blessing of attaining Thy presence. Verily, Thou art the Generous, the Merciful, the All-Bestowing.

Subject: prayer for forgiveness
Quotation: O Forgiving and Kind One! O Just One! The handmaiden of Thy threshold, Malaki, has hastened to the realm of purity. Therefore, make her soul radiant and immerse her in the ocean of Thy forgiveness, and grant her a portion from Thy grace and favor. Forgive her and bestow Thy loving-kindness upon her, and in the realm of mystery make her the companion of the angels.

Subject: prayer for forgiveness
Quotation: O my God, with what tongue shall I implore Thy forgiveness and pardon? Not once did I draw a breath purely for Thy sake, freed from this cage of self, nor did I take a single step save in pursuit of my own desires. O my God, so immersed am I in transgression that I am ashamed of the very act of transgression itself, let alone standing before Thy most holy presence.

Subject: prayer for forgiveness
Quotation: Alas for me and for those who are like me and who walk in my path! It is as though I disobeyed Thee with every disobedience, O Thou in Whose hand is the dominion of forgiveness and pardon!...Then, O my God, did I return from all this unto Thee, disappointed, in loss, remorseful and abased, and I beseech Thee...that Thou show mercy unto me and forgive me and pardon me

Subject: prayer for forgiveness
Quotation: "O my God! O my God! These are maidservants who have arisen in faithfulness at Thy holy threshold, O Lord of the Most Beautiful Names, and hastened to the wellspring of Thy mercy in the world of eternity. O Lord! Immerse them in the seas of Thy great mercy, and shelter them at Thy luminous holy threshold, and forgive them through Thy mercy which has encompassed all things."

Subject: prayer for forgiveness
Quotation: I beseech boundless blessings for thee and for thy father Khudarahm, and seek the favors of the Most Merciful Lord. For Gulbanu Ardeshir, I seek sweet milk from the breast of forgiveness, and for the prosperity of Ardeshir, I ask for a portion and share of the bounty and pardon of the Lord of creation. And for Shahriyar Khudabakhsh, I seek endless blessings and infinite favors.

Subject: prayer for forgiveness
Quotation: I beseech Thee by the scratching of Thy Supreme Pen and the breezes of Thy Revelation, O Lord of the Kingdom of eternity, and by the pearls of the ocean of Thy knowledge and the rain-showers of the clouds of Thy bounty, that Thou forgive me and my father and my mother and my kinsmen, and whosoever hath held fast unto the cord of Thy loving care and clung to the hem of Thy bounty.

Subject: prayer for forgiveness
Quotation: O God, my God, my Creator, my Refuge and my Shelter! I implore Thy forgiveness for my sins, O Concealer of faults, and I seek pardon for my transgressions, O Bestower of gifts. My God, deal not with me according to my misdeeds, but rather treat me according to Thy grace and mercy. Let me drink from the cup of Thy pardon and forgiveness, and intoxicate me with the wine of Thy bounty.

Subject: prayer for forgiveness
Quotation: O Lord! I have committed that which no one among Thy servants hath committed. I am he who, O my God, hath transgressed against Thy Cause and done that which made the Most Great Spirit lament in the dominion of command and the dwellers of paradise tremble. Thus have I come unto Thee, O my Beloved, turning toward the direction of Thy forgiveness and gazing upon Thy grace and beneficence.

Subject: prayer for forgiveness
Quotation: My God, my God! I testify to the sanctity of Thy Being above mention and utterance, and the exaltation of Thy Self above what is ordained in contingent existence... O Lord! The thirst of separation from Thee hath consumed me - where is the sweet water of Thy mercy? My transgressions have removed me far from the court of Thy nearness - where are the waves of the ocean of Thy forgiveness?

Subject: prayer for forgiveness
Quotation: O Lord, O Forgiver, these are broken-winged birds - bestow upon them wings and feathers and enable them to soar in the heights of pardon and forgiveness. Grant these helpless ones shelter and refuge in the protection of Thy forgiveness. Forgive their errors, grant them Thy gifts, and fulfill what Thou hast promised. O Kind God, though we are sinners, we place our hopes in Thy forgiveness

Subject: prayer for forgiveness
Quotation: No deed have I done, O my God, to merit beholding Thy face, and I know of a certainty that were I to live as long as the world lasts I would fail to accomplish any deed such as to deserve this favour, inasmuch as the station of a servant shall ever fall short of access to Thy holy precincts, unless Thy bounty should reach me and Thy tender mercy pervade me and Thy loving-kindness encompass me.

Subject: prayer for forgiveness
Quotation: My God, my God! This servant of Thine has detached himself from all else save Thee and turned to the horizon of the heaven of Thy grace, and has affirmed Thy oneness and singleness, and acknowledged what hath been sent down from the heaven of Thy Will and the atmosphere of Thy Purpose... Thou art He through Whose power all things have testified and through Whose grace all created things have been manifest.

Subject: prayer for forgiveness
Quotation: Guide the lost one in the desert of longing to the pavilion of guidance, and direct the parched and burning one in the desert of remoteness to the sea of nearness and attainment. Immerse this assured leaf in this cool and healing water and wine, that she may be cleansed and sanctified from all the ills and diseases of the contingent world, enter Thy Kingdom of glory, and find rest beneath the tree of Thy mercifulness.

Subject: prayer for forgiveness
Quotation: O my God! I beseech Thee by Thy Godhead - there is none other God but Thee - O Thou besides Whom there is none other God, to forgive me by virtue of There is none other God but Thee. O my God! I beseech Thee by Thy creative power - there is none other God but Thee - O Thou besides Whom there is none other God, to forgive me by virtue of There is none other God but Thee. [continues through multiple verses with same pattern]

Subject: prayer for forgiveness
Quotation: O my God! How can I call upon Thee when my sins have encompassed me from every direction and weigh heavily upon my back as if they were a mountain? Glory be unto Thee, O my Beloved! Here am I, casting myself before Thee that Thou mayest forgive my sins and make me as I was on the day Thou didst create me. O my God! If Thou turnest not toward me, to whom shall I turn? And if Thou hast no mercy upon me, unto whom shall I flee?

Subject: prayer for forgiveness
Quotation: I beseech Thee, O my God, by Thy generosity and the ultimate extent of Thy mercy, to preserve the absence of Thy proof, son of Thy proof, whom Thou hast established in the station of Thy authority, the sign of Thy lordship, the sovereign of Thy dominion, the face of Thy oneness, the gate of Thy eternality, and the guardian of the days of Thy grandeur and majesty, for the establishment of Thy religion and the traditions of Thy Prophet, through all the hosts of the heavens and earth.

Subject: prayer for forgiveness
Quotation: After the performance of many ceremonials the Mullah in his most solemn voice asked the patient to repeat the formula "Oh God! I have sinned much. Confer upon me thy forgiveness." ... O Lord! O Lord! I am a real sinner and thou art the just God! I beg Thy Mercy! I have committed many sins. I have not done that which Thou hast commanded me and have practiced those things thou hast made unlawful. With humility and contrition I am standing in thy presence. Do with me whatever thou willest!

Subject: prayer for forgiveness
Quotation: O wise Nush! As thy kind father is loving towards thee and well-behaved and benevolent towards thy brothers, therefore this sinful servant beseecheth forgiveness and pardon from the Lord, that He may cleanse and purify him from the earthly realm and grant him entrance to the celestial sphere. This intercession with utmost supplication was solely for thy sake and that of thy brothers, that Gushtasp may become pure in spirit and that forgiveness and pardon may encompass that servant of God.

Subject: prayer for forgiveness
Quotation: O my Lord! I am Thy servant and the son of Thy servant. I bear witness with my outer and inner tongue that Thou art God; there is none other God but Thee, the One, the Single, the All-Powerful, the All-Knowing, the All-Wise... Thou seest and hearest, O my God, my sighing and my weeping, my crying and my lowliness and my tribulation. O Lord! The temple of disobedience seeketh the waves of the ocean of Thy forgiveness and pardon, and the essence of heedlessness seeketh the wonders of Thy gifts and favors.

Subject: prayer for forgiveness
Quotation: O Kind Lord! Send a wave from the ocean of forgiveness upon this helpless leaf, and waft a musk-scented breeze from the garden of pardon to the nostrils of that yearning soul. O Lord! Thou art the refuge and shelter of the sinful, and the Forgiver and the Merciful to the erring. This pure leaf hath soared to the Kingdom of Mystery; shelter her in Thy mercy and make her the confidant and companion of the birds of the holy garden. Thou art the Bestower, the Kind, Thou art the Forgiver, the Compassionate, the Bountiful.

Subject: prayer for forgiveness
Quotation: O my Lord and my Hope! O Forgiver of sins, O Remover of afflictions, O Concealer of faults! I ask Thy forgiveness for Thy handmaiden who hath returned unto Thee, drawn nigh unto Thee, and presented herself before Thee, humble, submissive, fearful of Thy chastisement, thirsting for the sweet waters of Thy river. O Lord! Strip from her the garment of sins and clothe her with the robes of forgiveness through Thy mercy, O Knower of the hidden and Concealer of faults! Verily, Thou art the Ever-Forgiving, the Merciful, the Pardoning, the Generous.

Subject: prayer for forgiveness
