Quotation: My God, my God! Verily, this pure and righteous one seeks Thy great mercy, fears the fires of retribution, seeks healing from Thy cup brimming with the wine of Thy supreme forgiveness, and yearns for the living waters in the Garden of Delight. O Lord! Enfold him within the glances of Thy merciful eye, grant him Thy gifts in the spiritual worlds, and pardon his transgressions through the outpourings of Thy divine mercy. Verily, Thou art the Forgiver of sins, the Concealer of faults, the Remover of difficulties, and verily Thou art the Mighty, the All-Forgiving.

Subject: prayer for forgiveness
Quotation: O Kind Lord! Surush has been stirred to fervor and supplication, and seeks forgiveness for his father, the pure-born Kayqubad. Thou art the Forgiver, the Kind One. Through the grace of this son, forgive that father and draw him nigh unto the threshold of Thy oneness. O All-Knowing Lord! This servant at Thy threshold, Bahman, begs pardon for the sins of his father Bahram. Therefore, through Thy grace and favor, grant refuge to Bahram Pulad in the shelter of Thy mercy and deliver him from the darkness of sin. Thou art the Forgiver, the Pardoner, the All-Merciful.

Subject: prayer for forgiveness
Quotation: O my God, my God! Thou seest mine eyes gazing toward the horizon of Thy grace, and the hands of this poor one raised toward the heaven of Thy generosity. Whenever I contemplate, O my God, Thy justice, my limbs tremble, my heart is troubled, my joints quiver, my sighs ascend and my tears fall... I have done in my days what Thou didst forbid in Thy Books and through the tongues of Thy Messengers. I acknowledge, O my God, my transgression against myself... O Lord! Thou seest the sinner seeking the ocean of Thy forgiveness, and him that is far removed yearning for the court of Thy nearness.

Subject: prayer for forgiveness
Quotation: O my Lord, my Hope, the Ultimate Goal of my desires, my Refuge and my Shelter! I implore Thee with the imploring of a supplicant before the transcendent King, and I beseech Thee to encompass with Thy favors Thy handmaiden who hath believed in Thee and in Thy signs. Immerse her in the ocean of Thy forgiveness and crown her with the crown of Thy pardon and beneficence. O Lord! Illumine her eyes with the vision of Thy beauty and expand her breast through her attainment of Thy presence in the gathering of mysteries and the kingdom of lights. Verily Thou art the Generous, the Mighty, the Merciful, the Compassionate.

Subject: prayer for forgiveness
Quotation: O My Lord! Guide the servants to the court of Thy bounty and gifts, and deprive them not of the wonders of Thy grace and favors, for they know not what Thou hast intended for them of Thy mercy that hath preceded all creation. O My Lord! These are the weak in public and orphans in private, and Thou art the Generous, the Lord of surpassing bounty, the Most Great. Deal not severely with them, O My God, but regard them until the time befitting Thy wondrous mercy, that perchance they may return unto Thee and seek forgiveness for that which they have committed in Thy presence. Verily Thou art the Forgiving, the Merciful.

Subject: prayer for forgiveness
Quotation: O God, O Generous One, O Merciful One, O Forgiving One! The assaults of the polytheists have scattered the strongholds of the monotheists to the winds, and from the bullets of the deniers the edifice of remembrance and knowledge has been shaken, and the hearts of those near unto Thee and the sincere ones are trembling and agitated. Although, O All-Knowing God, the deeds of this people and their actions have, after glory, brought abasement, and after power have revealed weakness, yet we beseech of Thee Thy ancient grace and we entreat Thee: look not upon our deeds and actions, for they were not and are not worthy of Thy glance. Look upon Thine own mercy and bounty.

Subject: prayer for forgiveness
Quotation: My God, my God! We are servants who have taken refuge at Thy most exalted threshold and sought shelter in Thy greatest gift. Therefore protect Thy servants in the shelter of Thy protection, and rain down upon us the downpours of Thy mercy, and cause us to enter the shelter of Thy care. We are weak servants, and Thou art the Glorious, the Generous to all creation. It behooveth Thy great favor to forgive every sinful servant. Our Lord! Take us not to task for our deeds, and punish us not with Thy wrath on the Day when the righteous and the wicked shall stand at the place of reckoning before the Mighty, the Compelling. Our Lord! We are sinners and Thou art the Pardoner, the Forgiving. Transform our evil deeds into good deeds and protect us from the evil of our souls, for they indeed command to evil, and we have no strength or power except through Thy confirmation, O our Lord, the Forgiving!

Subject: prayer for forgiveness
Quotation:
My God, my God! Forgive Thy servant, for Thou art verily the Forgiver of sins. My God, my God! Ordain for me that which is best for me, for Thou art verily the Trustworthy Ordainer. My God, my God! Aid me to serve Thee, for Thou art verily the Succorer of the worlds. My God, my God! Thou seest my transgressions; purify me from them, for Thou art verily the All-Powerful. My God, my God! Expiate my misdeeds, for Thou art verily the Bountiful, the Generous. O my Lord! Help me to act in accordance with that which Thou hast revealed, and enable me to fulfill that which Thou hast commanded me to do, for Thou art verily the Ancient Commander.  BH03754
may the forgiving Lord immerse the parents of that grateful servant in the ocean of forgiveness and confirm them in achieving the desires of their hearts and souls.

Subject: prayer for gatherings; meetings; assemblies
Quotation: He is God. O Lord! This is a servant who has presented himself before Thy servants and sought to attend the gathering which has been prepared for Thy loved ones, that they may be given to drink of the choice wine whose seal is the musk of Thy love, whose taste is the sweetness of Thy remembrance, whose fragrance is the perfume of Thy praise, and whose color is blood shed in Thy love and poured out in Thy path. O Lord! In that gathering are assembled souls whose faces are radiant with the lights of Thy love, whose breasts are dilated with Thy remembrance, whose hearts are attracted to Thy beauty, whose essences are illumined by Thy lights, whose realities overflow with Thy mysteries, whose spirits are refined by the signs of Thy holy might, whose bodies quiver with the breezes of Thy grace. O Lord! Make their assembly like the Pleiades in the Kingdom of Names, and their fellowship like the fellowship of brilliant pearls strung upon the necklaces of radiant maidens. Make their hearts united through Thy most great signs, their souls revived by the holy breaths in this most exalted gathering, their tongues a single tongue speaking in praise, their hearts a single sea surging with winds that blow from Thy most glorious Kingdom, and their joy arising from breezes wafting from the paradise of Thy most exalted Beauty. O Lord! Make firm their feet in Thy remembrance, strengthen their backs in Thy service, remove their grief through Thy grace, remind them of Thy verses, and make them the dawning-places of Thy inspiration, the daysprings of Thy traces, the rising-points of Thy lights, the sources of Thy praise, the torches of Thy love, the lamps of Thy knowledge, the stars in the heaven of servitude to Thee, and the planets in the horizon of bondage unto Thee. Verily, Thou art the Confirmer, the Supporter, the Mighty, the Generous.

Subject: prayer for gatherings; meetings; assemblies
Quotation: O Divine providence, shed a ray from the Sun of Truth upon this gathering that it may become illumined.

Subject: prayer for gatherings; meetings; assemblies
Quotation: O Thou Kind God! We have gathered together with the utmost humility and submission in this Spiritual Assembly.

Subject: prayer for gatherings; meetings; assemblies
Quotation: O my Ancient Lord! Aid the Assembly of Sanctification with Your assistance and protection in both worlds and with the Most Great Gift. O Lord! Make this luminous institution and noble gathering blessed through Your glorious bounty

Subject: prayer for gatherings; meetings; assemblies
Quotation: O God! O God! Thou dost look upon us from Thine unseen Kingdom of Oneness, [beholding] that we have assembled in this Spiritual Meeting, believing in Thee, confident in Thy signs, firm in Thy Covenant and Testament, attracted unto Thee, set aglow with the fire of Thy love, sincere in Thy Cause, servants in Thy vineyard, spreaders of Thy Religion, worshipers of Thy Countenance, humble to Thy beloved, submissive at Thy door and imploring Thee to confirm us in the service of Thy chosen ones.

Subject: prayer for gatherings; meetings; assemblies
Quotation: O Lord! Make these gathered ones radiant candles, and confirm these souls. Make their faces luminous and their dispositions like unto a rose garden and flower bed. Quicken their spirits through the holy breathings, and make their souls precious through Thy most great guidance. Bestow heavenly bounties, and make worthy of divine gifts. Keep them safe and protected in the shelter of Thy protection and preservation. Make them the recipients of endless favors and special confirmations. Thou art the Giver, the Bestower, and the All-Knowing.

Subject: prayer for governments and rulers
Quotation: Be well-wishers of the government and pray for the protection and preservation of state and nation.

Subject: prayer for governments and rulers
Quotation: O God, Almighty Protector! O Thou Who art the confirmer of every just power and equitable empire in eternal glory, everlasting power, continuance and greatness! Strengthen with the abundance of Thy mercy every government which acts with equity towards its subjects, and every dominion under whose flag the poor and weak find protection.

Subject: prayer for governments and rulers
Quotation: O Almighty God! Confirm the Greatest Emperor George V, through Thy divine confirmations, and strengthen him by Thy merciful power, and perpetuate his protecting shadow upon this noble land.

Subject: prayer for governments and rulers
Quotation: O Lord! Support the throne of the great ancient sovereignty and aid Thy servant who sits upon the mighty royal seat. Verily, Thou art powerful over what Thou willest, and Thou art the Strong, the Mighty.

Subject: prayer for governments and rulers
Quotation: O Lord! Aid His Majesty the Sul?an to assist the oppressed that he may protect them from the evil of their enemies. Verily Thou art powerful over whatsoever Thou willest and Thou art the Mighty, the All-Conquering, the All-Powerful.

Subject: prayer for governments and rulers
Quotation: O my Lord! Aid Thou the Most Great Emperor George V, the King of England, through Thine unfailing help and Divine assistance. Preserve Thou its [England] sheltering shadow over this glorious region through Thine aid, protection and preservation.

Subject: prayer for governments and rulers
Quotation: O Almighty God! Confirm the greatest Emperor, George V. through thy divine confirmation and strengthen him by thy merciful power and perpetuate his protecting shadow upon this noble land. This we ask through thy help and assistance and protection.

Subject: prayer for governments and rulers
Quotation: I beseech God, glorified be His majesty, for health, well-being, glory and elevation for the gentlemen... And we ask God to protect him with His hosts and to aid him in that whereby his mention shall endure in the Supreme Concourse and the Most Exalted Paradise.

Subject: prayer for governments and rulers
Quotation: O my God, my God! Aid the rulers of the earth and its learned ones to look upon what Thou hast manifested with justice and fairness. Then assist them, O my God, in that which will profit them in all the worlds of Thy worlds. Verily, Thou art the Almighty, the Glorious, the All-Choosing.

Subject: prayer for governments and rulers
Quotation: Pray and supplicate at the Threshold of God that day by day royal justice and worldwide dominion may increase. I swear by the Most Great Name that the confirmations of the Kingdom will arrive and the assistance and favors of the Sovereign of the Kingdom of Might will continuously be obtained.

Subject: prayer for governments and rulers
Quotation: O my God, my God! I beseech Thee by the waves of the ocean of Thy bounty and by the hidden and treasured mysteries in the hearts of Thy chosen ones to assist His Majesty the Sultan in that which will gladden eyes and tranquilize souls. Thou art verily the Omnipotent, the Dominant over what was and what will be.

Subject: prayer for governments and rulers
Quotation: O God, my God! Graciously aid Thou this renowned ruler through the potency of Thy compelling power which standeth supreme above all things. Grant that he may be as a shelter for the helpless, a refuge for the poor, a haven for the distressed, the desired goal of every seeker, a fountain of crystal water for the thirsty and an inexhaustible treasure to the needy

Subject: prayer for governments and rulers
Quotation: Today, through God's grace, the believers must, at the beginning of their prayers and the end of their devotions, seek divine confirmation and ask for heavenly success for His Imperial Majesty the just monarch and the perfect Prime Minister, that his country may prosper day by day and the crown of his sovereignty may shine ever more brightly, for his glory is the glory of all and his comfort the comfort of all.

Subject: prayer for governments and rulers
Quotation: O Lord! Aid them to carry out that which Thou hast commanded them in Thy Book, and illumine them with the lights of sincerity and purity. O Lord! Thou seest him clinging to Thee and holding fast to Thy luminous robe. I beseech Thee to exalt him above the kingdoms of the earth, from east to west, and to make him in all circumstances one who speaks, who remembers, and who stands firm in Thy Cause, the mighty, the impregnable. O Lord! Aid him with the hosts of the unseen and the visible, then preserve his dominions from the oppressors of creation.

Subject: prayer for governments and rulers
Quotation: Say: O God! Thou art the Possessor of the heavens and the earth and whatsoever is between them! Thou givest sovereignty to whom Thou willest and takest it away from whom Thou willest! Thou exaltest whom Thou willest and abaseth whom Thou willest! Thou strengthenest whom Thou willest and humblest whom Thou willest! Thou aidest whom Thou willest and forsaketh whom Thou willest! Thou enrichest whom Thou willest and impoverisheth whom Thou willest! In Thy grasp is the kingdom of all things. Thou createst what Thou willest by Thy command. Verily, Thou art the Sovereign, the Possessor, the King!

Subject: prayer for governments and rulers
Quotation: O Lord, aid the throne of the supreme sovereignty with the hosts of the Supreme Concourse, and guard it beneath the shadow of Thy Most Exalted Word with the eye of Thy loving-kindness. Shield it from harmful hands in this earthly life, and assist it with armies from the uttermost horizon. Make the banner of justice wave and the sign of victory manifest therein. O Lord, have mercy upon the weak among Thy creatures, the poor and the orphans, from this disorder; and preserve the state and nation from decline, and protect the kingdom from extinction and the realm from every wrathful oppressor.

Subject: prayer for healing
Quotation: From Thee shelter, from us illness. From Thee healing...bestow healing

Subject: prayer for healing
Quotation: O Lord! Give sight to the blind and hearing to the deaf. Heal the sick with heavenly medicine that they may find health and well-being.

Subject: prayer for healing
Quotation: If I am sick, I gain eternal health...O Thou Lord of the Kingdom! Cause Thou the rejoicing of my heart; empower my weak spirit and strengthen my exhausted nerves. Illumine Thou my eyes: suffer my ears to become hearing

Subject: prayer for healing
Quotation: O Lord! Ordain healing for Thy servant who supplicates to Thy most exalted Kingdom, and make him a sign of Thy mercy among all people, and decree for him recovery from every ailment and disease...deliver him from the depths of illness and disease

Subject: prayer for healing
Quotation: O Thou Whose remembrance is healing to the hearts of the righteous, Whose praise is a sovereign remedy for the free, Whose glorification is medicine curing the ailments of the pure ones, and Whose communion is a balm for the wounds of the God-fearing!

Subject: prayer for healing
Quotation: Thy Name is my healing, O my God, Thy remembrance is my remedy, Thy nearness is my hope, Thy love is my companion, Thy mercy is my physician and helper in both this world and the world to come. Thou, verily, art the All-Bountiful, the All-Knowing, the All-Wise.

Subject: prayer for healing
Quotation: O Lord! Heal the eyes of Thy servant and illumine his vision to behold the signs of Thy holiness, and cause him to hear the melodies of the birds of praise in the garden of divine unity, through Thy grace and bounty. Make him pure and sincere before Thy gracious countenance, for verily Thou art the Merciful.

Subject: prayer for healing
Quotation: O beloved physician! If thou art a skilled and accomplished healer, treat my affliction. I am ailing - prescribe for me an easy remedy. Grant peace and tranquility to my inner burning, and bestow relief upon the anguish of my heart. Apply a salve to my wounded liver, and grant soothing moisture to my scorched innards.

Subject: prayer for healing
Quotation: The prayers that have been revealed for healing encompass both physical and spiritual healing. Therefore, recite them for both spiritual and physical healing. If healing is suitable and beneficial for the patient, it will assuredly be granted. However, for some patients, healing may cause other harms - hence divine wisdom may not require the prayer's acceptance.

Subject: prayer for healing
Quotation: Thou seest one of Thy maidservants who desireth from this Thy servant that which Thou wouldst make a healing for her through Thy grace, and health from Thy presence, and well-being from Thy side...Then I beseech Thee by Thy Beloved One, through Whose advent the celestial spheres were honored, to send down upon her from the heaven of Thy healing that which will gladden the hearts of Thy servants and Thy handmaidens.

Subject: prayer for healing
Quotation: O God, my God! I have turned to Thee, supplicating bounties from the ocean of Thy healing. O God, enable me to serve Thy servants and assist in their healing. Confirm that my medicine may be a remedy for every sickness and ailment, infirmity and cold, and every other affliction. If Thou wert to refuse confirmation, then in no wise would my medication be a remedy for illness. O God, my God! Aid and assist me through Thy healing grace. Thou art the Healer, the Self-Sufficient, the Remover of every adversity and illness.

Subject: prayer for healing
Quotation: O Ever-Abiding One! Glory be unto Thee, O my God! I beseech Thee by Thy generosity through which Thou didst open the gates of bounty and bestowal, and through which the Temple of Thy Holiness was established upon the throne of eternity; and by Thy mercy through which Thou didst call all created things to the banquet of Thy favor and beneficence... that Thou protect the bearer of this blessed leaf, then him who readeth it, then him who hearkeneth unto it, then him who passeth by the house wherein it resideth; and heal through it every sick and ailing one and every poor one from all tribulation, malady, hardship and grief

Subject: prayer for married couples
Quotation: O God! O my God! Verily, these are Thy servant and Thy handmaiden who have gathered beneath the shadow of Thy mercy and united through Thy grace and bounty. O Lord! Assist them in Thy Kingdom and destine for them every good through Thy grace and bounty. O Lord! Support them and enable them to serve Thee and make them mindful of Thee in Thy Kingdom. O Lord! Protect them through Thy boundless favors in this world and the world to come. O Lord! They supplicate unto the Kingdom of Thy mercy and beseech the Realm of Thy oneness in obedience to Thy command. Make their union one of harmony and unity until the Day of Meanings. Verily, Thou art the Omnipotent, the All-Powerful.

Subject: prayer for married couples
Quotation: O my God, my God! This is Thy maidservant who supplicates to the kingdom of Thy mercy...Aid them both to be detached from all else save Thee, to be occupied with Thy remembrance and praise, and to be set ablaze with the fire of Thy love.

Subject: prayer for married couples
Quotation: O Lord! Make this marriage blessed, auspicious and prosperous. Unite these two and gladden the eyes of all through the fruits that shall be brought forth from this noble union. Preserve them within the cave of Thy protection and safeguarding, guard them with the eye of Thy loving-kindness, and make them signs of Thy remembrance amongst Thy creation and lamps of Thy knowledge within the glass of Thy bounty.

Subject: prayer for married couples
Quotation: O Lord of the worlds and Trainer of all who are in the heavens and on the earth! I beseech Thee by Thy Names, the Joyous and the Sorrowful, the Manifest and the Hidden, to bless these two souls, to ordain between them love and affection, and to protect them from the mischief of such as have disbelieved in Thy days and caviled at Thy signs. I beseech Thee, moreover, O my God, to write down for them both, by Thy Most Exalted Pen, the good of this world and of the world to come.

Subject: prayer for martyrs
Quotation: O Lord! Aid the kinsmen of the martyrs to serve Thy Cause, to exalt Thy Word, to spread Thy Faith, and to kindle the fire of Thy love in the hearts of Thy servants, and guide through them those who [wander] in the wilderness of error.

Subject: prayer for martyrs
Quotation: Glory be unto Thee, O God, my Lord! Send down Thy blessings upon those who have ascended unto Thee with dominion and kingdom. Glory be unto Thee, O God, my Lord! Send down Thy blessings upon those who have ascended unto Thee with power.

Subject: prayer for martyrs
Quotation: I swear by the Sun of the horizon of utterance that they melt the inmost hearts and cause the hearts to dissolve. God willing, all shall attain to what hath been revealed and shall visit and make mention of the martyred stranger, Ali-A'la, through that which hath flowed from the Most Exalted Pen.

Subject: prayer for martyrs
Quotation: O Lord! Honor the abode of this arrival and incoming guest, and grant him an exalted station in the vicinity of Thy great mercy and the Supreme Companion, in the boundless expanse of Thy forgiving kingdom, vast in its reaches and broad in its scope, which none comprehend save him who is taught by the One mighty in power.

Subject: prayer for martyrs
Quotation: O Mother of Muhammad-Mahdi who was martyred in My Most Great, Most Glorious Path! Glory be to Thee, O my God! I beseech Thee by Thy Name through which earthquakes seized all the tribes of the earth and the dwellers of the cities of creation were struck with terror, to protect Thy male and female servants beneath the shadow of Thy grace and favors

Subject: prayer for martyrs
Quotation: O Lord, accept from them this great gift and make these two deliverance for those lost in the wasteland of waywardness, aid them reach the dawning-place of Thy effulgent, enter them into the celestial paradise of Thy union in all the worlds of light and abide them in Thy resplendent Kingdom. O Lord, bestow upon them through Thy generosity and grace all that Thou has decreed in the Kingdom of Thy Light and grant patience upon those related to them.

Subject: prayer for martyrs
Quotation: Say: O God of Names and Creator of earth and heaven! We beseech Thee by this martyr who sacrificed himself in these days to manifest Thy Cause and exalt Thy Word, to send down upon Thy loved ones and chosen ones that which will preserve them from the claws of heedlessness and doubt. Then give them to drink, from the hand of Thy bounty, the Kawthar of certitude. Verily Thou art the Giver, the Bestower. There is no God but Thee, the All-Bountiful, the Most Generous.

Subject: prayer for martyrs
Quotation: O holy breath and merciful spirit that surrounds thy luminous shrine and thy purified tomb, and whose sweet fragrance wafts over thy radiant dust and purified body! I testify that thou didst sacrifice thy spirit and body in the path of God, didst hasten to the place of sacrifice, and didst endure the arrows of the enemies and the spears of hatred out of love for God. Thou didst never weaken nor falter in exalting the Word of God. My spirit be a sacrifice unto thee, and my soul be a ransom for thee! I beseech God to perfume my nostrils with the holy fragrances that waft from thy luminous shrine and thy spiritual body. May the Concourse on High and the dwellers of the Most Glorious Kingdom send their blessings upon thee throughout the hours of night and day. I beseech God to encompass thy visitors with the glance of His loving-kindness at all times. And upon thee be the Most Glorious Glory!

Subject: prayer for morning
Quotation: Occupy yourselves at dawn in praise of your Beloved, and raise your heads each morning from your couch in His remembrance.

Subject: prayer for morning
Quotation: Each of you should turn toward the Holy Land in the early morning hours - you will experience spiritual feelings with utmost clarity.

Subject: prayer for nearness to God
Quotation: O my God! Thy nearness is my hope and to commune with Thee, my joy.

Subject: prayer for nearness to God
Quotation: nor to suffer me to be far removed from the shores of Thy nearness and bounty

Subject: prayer for nearness to God
Quotation: I beseech Thee, O my Lord...to enter beneath Thy shadow that shadoweth all things.

Subject: prayer for nearness to God
Quotation: O Thou Who art aware of all secrets! O Guide of the righteous! O Companion of the free! ... My soul be a sacrifice for Thee!"

Subject: prayer for nearness to God
Quotation: I beseech Thee...to ordain for me, through Thy Most Exalted Pen, that which will preserve me from self and passion and draw me nigh unto Thee

Subject: prayer for nearness to God
Quotation: O thou who art turning unto God! Turn to the Abha Kingdom and seek assistance from the Concourse on High. Then open thy tongue in supplication

Subject: prayer for nearness to God
Quotation: I beseech Thee, O my Lord, to ordain for Thy loved ones that which shall draw them nigh unto the ocean whereof if one partaketh, no grief shall touch him in Thy Cause

Subject: prayer for nearness to God
Quotation: Glory be unto Thee, O my God! I beseech Thee...to ordain for me from the Pen of destiny that which will draw me nigh unto Thee and cause me to speak forth Thy beauteous praise

Subject: prayer for nearness to God
Quotation: Keep me in Your unity, be my companion in my loneliness, dispel my sorrow, enrapture me in Your beauty, occupy me with thoughts of You alone, attract me through Your holy fragrances

Subject: prayer for nearness to God
Quotation: O Lord! Deny me not the sweet-scented breezes of the garment of Thy Revelation... Send down upon me in all conditions that which beseemeth Thy presence and befitteth Thy sovereignty

Subject: prayer for nearness to God
Quotation: Give access to this servant of Thy threshold unto the court of Thy oneness, and let not this one who hopes in Thy mercy be disappointed. Make him firm and steadfast in Thy Covenant and faith.

Subject: prayer for nearness to God
Quotation: All praise be unto Thee, O Thou besides Whom there is none other God. Graciously enable me to ascend unto Thee, to be granted the honour of dwelling in Thy nearness and to have communion with Thee alone.

Subject: prayer for nearness to God
Quotation: I beseech Thee not to disappoint me of what lieth with Thee... Moreover I beseech Thee, O God of existence and Lord of the seen and unseen, by Thy grace to ordain for me the reward of attaining Thy presence

Subject: prayer for nearness to God
Quotation: that Thou keep me not far from the shore of Thy nearness and good-pleasure... Then send down upon me from the clouds of Thy mercy that which shall sever me from all else save Thee and draw me nigh unto Thee.

Subject: prayer for nearness to God
Quotation: I take refuge at the Threshold of the All-Knowing God and express utter lowliness and supplication, that He may make thee independent of all else save Him and make thee the intimate companion and confidant of the holy fragrances.

Subject: prayer for nearness to God
Quotation: Thou seest me supplicating the heaven of the splendor of Thy mercifulness, tearfully beseeching the loftiness of the station of thy Lordship, supplicating at the holy threshold of Thy Godhead, desiring the glorious presence of Thy oneness

Subject: prayer for nearness to God
Quotation: Glory be unto Thee, O God! Ordain for me from Thy presence every grace which Thy knowledge hath encompassed. Verily, Thou hast power over all things. Glory be unto Thee, O God! Write down for me from Thy presence that which shall gladden mine eyes.

Subject: prayer for nearness to God
Quotation: Glory be unto Thee, O my God! I am the leaf which Thy Will and Purpose have caused to grow until it appeared from Thy Branch. I beseech Thee, O Lord of the nations and Sovereign of eternity, to make me one of those who circle round Thee in every world of Thy worlds.

Subject: prayer for nearness to God
Quotation: My God, my God! I beseech Thee to make me steadfast in Thy service, gazing toward Thy horizon, and clinging to Thy mighty cord...O my Lord! Leave me not to myself. Take my hand with the hand of Thy power and deliver me from the clay of the vain imaginings of Thy servants.

Subject: prayer for nearness to God
Quotation: With the fire of Thy love sleep has fled from my eyes. In the morning hours I call upon Thee, hoping for Thy boundless grace, and in the evening I turn to the horizon of Thy mercy, yearning for Thy ancient bounty. I call upon Thee by Thy name, the All-Merciful, the Most Compassionate.

Subject: prayer for nearness to God
Quotation: My God, my God! My hope is to meet Thee, and my desire is to hearken unto Thy call, and my wish is to stand before Thy gate. By Thy might! I love Thy decree and tribulation in Thy path and spending in Thy love. O Lord! Thou seest me enkindled by Thy verses and holding fast unto Thy cord.

Subject: prayer for nearness to God
Quotation: I beseech Thee by Thy Name through which Thou didst take from all Thy servants a covenant concerning Thyself in Thy Books and Thy Scriptures and Thy Tablets, to cause me in all conditions to be immersed in the ocean of Thy love, speaking Thy praise, and turned toward the direction of Thy bounty.

Subject: prayer for nearness to God
Quotation: Send down upon me, O Beloved of the worlds, that which will dispel from me the odors of the world and purify me from all that Thy good-pleasure abhorreth, and aid me to recognize Thy most exalted Self. Verily Thou art my Beloved and the Beloved of the worlds and the Ultimate Goal of all who hope.

Subject: prayer for nearness to God
Quotation: O my Lord! You see me turning toward the heaven of Your bounty and awaiting the wonders of Your generosity. I beseech You by the rain-showers of the springtime of Your mercy to send down upon me that which will purify me from the mention of any save You and draw me near to the court of Your holiness.

Subject: prayer for nearness to God
Quotation: O my Lord! I am the sorrowful one, yet with Thee is the ocean of joy and gladness. I beseech Thee not to withhold me from it... O my Lord! I beseech Thee by Thy verses [...] and by Thy Most Exalted Horizon to ordain for me by the Pen of Thy Command that which will comfort mine eyes through Thy grace.

Subject: prayer for nearness to God
Quotation: O my God! Is there a way for me to the fortress which Thou hast made a prison for the Manifestation of Thyself? Have I any portion in the hearing of Thy call and beholding the lights of Thy countenance? Have I any share in the waves of the ocean of Thy revelation and in standing before the gate of Thy grandeur?

Subject: prayer for nearness to God
Quotation: O Lord! Gladden my spirit through the fragrances of Thy holiness, turn my heart toward the court of Thy bounty, inflame my heart with passionate love for Thee, and aid mine eyes to behold the signs of Thy manifestation, so that I may become occupied with naught but Thee, be drawn to Thy shelter, be moved to praise Thee

Subject: prayer for nearness to God
Quotation: O Sun of the highest heaven! O manifest Light of the supreme horizon! Cast an abiding ray upon the chamber of my heart, that I may ever be companion to the vision of Thy lights and always be mindful of the remembrance of Thy Most Great Name. Thou art the Generous, Thou art the Merciful, O Thou the Possessor of great bounty!

Subject: prayer for nearness to God
Quotation: My God, my God! I have longed for Thy nearness, and desired to appear before Thy face, to hearken to the scratching of Thy Pen, to behold Thy most exalted horizon and the seat of Thy Most Glorious Throne. Days and nights have passed, yet mine eyes have not been gladdened, mine ears have not been blessed, and my heart hath not rejoiced.

Subject: prayer for nearness to God
Quotation: Ordain for us in this hour, O my God, that which will draw us nigh unto Thee and bring us close to Thy presence, for Thou, O my God, art the Ultimate Goal of them that hope, and the End of the desire of them that are detached. None hath any glory except through obedience to Thee and Thy good-pleasure, nor any joy save in Thy nearness and Thy beauty

Subject: prayer for nearness to God
Quotation: I beseech Thee by the light of Thy Cause which hath illumined both earth and heaven, to make me in all conditions turn toward Thee, detached from all else save Thee, holding fast unto Thy cord and clinging to the hem of the robe of Thy bounty and generosity, and to choose for myself what Thou hast chosen for me through Thy great favor and Thy most great gifts.

Subject: prayer for nearness to God
Quotation: Thou too must turn to the Most Glorious Invisible Realm and say: "O Thou Who art aware of all mysteries! O Guide of the righteous! O Companion of the free! My soul be a sacrifice for Thee! O Beloved Who drawest hearts! O Rose-cheeked Moon-faced One! O gracious Lord! My soul be a sacrifice for Thee! Thou knowest my need though I keep it concealed. In every moment Thou art present. My soul be a sacrifice for Thee!"

Subject: prayer for nearness to God
Quotation: When the breezes of Revelation stir thee and the breaths of inspiration attract thee, turn with thy heart toward the Kaaba of mankind and say: Praise be unto Thee, O Revealer of verses and Manifester of clear tokens... O my Lord! Thou beholdest me turning toward Thee and clinging to Thy cord. I beseech Thee not to leave me to myself. Protect me through Thy hosts and ordain for me from the Pen of Thy decree the reward of attaining Thy presence.

Subject: prayer for nearness to God
Quotation: O God! The trials Thou sendest are a salve to the sores of all them who are devoted to Thy will; the remembrance of Thee is a healing medicine to the hearts of such as have drawn nigh unto Thy court; nearness to Thee is the true life of them who are Thy lovers; Thy presence is the ardent desire of such as yearn to behold Thy face; remoteness from Thee is a torment to those that have acknowledged Thy oneness, and separation from Thee is death unto them that have recognized Thy truth!

Subject: prayer for nearness to God
Quotation: Bestow upon me, O my God, from Thy treasuries that which will draw me nigh unto Thee. I desire not, O my God, what those who are veiled from Thy presence desire, nor what those who seek truth through other than Thee desire. Rather, I desire, O my God, Thy holy breathings, for they are more precious in Thy sight than all that existeth in the kingdoms of earth and heaven, and Thy innovative manifestations, for they are greater in Thy sight than all that existeth in the kingdom of names and attributes.

Subject: prayer for nearness to God
Quotation: I beseech Thee, O my Lord, by Thy Command through which the ocean of Thy knowledge surged and the fragrance of Thy garment was diffused, and by Thy Name through which the gate of song was opened before the faces of the poor, and the gate of wisdom before all creatures, and the gates of bounty and knowledge and bestowal before all who dwell in the kingdom of creation, and by the scratching of Thy Pen and the penetrating power of Thy Word, to ordain for me that which will draw me nigh unto Thee in all conditions

Subject: prayer for nearness to God
Quotation: My God, my God! Praise be unto Thee for having caused me to turn towards Thy most glorious horizon when the scratching of Thy Most Exalted Pen was raised up, and for having made me to hear Thy call and to recognize the Dayspring of Thy verses and evidences and the Dawning-Place of Thy lights. I beseech Thee to make me, in all conditions, acknowledging of Thy oneness and Thy singleness, moving by Thy will and Thy purpose, and well-pleased with and acting according to what Thou hast commanded me in Thy Book. Then ordain for me, O my God, that which will draw me nigh unto Thee.

Subject: prayer for nearness to God
Quotation: O my Lord! Thou seest me wandering in the wilderness of longing, consumed by the fires of separation. The resurrection of tears has come to pass, and the fire of burning hath been kindled. Wipe away my tears, calm my sighs, lighten my sorrows, and awaken me from my stupor through my ascension to the Kingdom of Thy sanctification, my rising to the threshold of Thy oneness, my entry into the presence of Thy uniqueness, and my arrival before the Beauty by whose light the worlds of the unseen and the visible were illumined, and my entrance into the court before which the necks of kings and subjects were brought low, and the necks of every proud and obstinate one were humbled.

Subject: prayer for nearness to God
Quotation: My God, my God! Praise be to Thee for having illumined my heart with the light of Thy knowledge and my being with the lights of the Day-Star of Thy grace. O Lord! My eyes yearn to behold Thee and my ears to hear Thy sweetest call at the dawning of the light of Thy nearness, O Lord of all beings! My Lord! Aid me to make mention of Thee amongst the people of Thy earth. Thou seest my condition and hearest my cries in Thy love and my remoteness from Thy presence. I beseech Thee to ordain for me that which will exalt me in every world of Thy worlds, and to change this remoteness into everlasting nearness, and this separation into a union that shall endure through the eternity of Thy names and attributes.

Subject: prayer for opponents; enemies of the Faith
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/prayer for opponents; enemies of the Faith.txt
Quotation: one of the great teachings of Baha'u'llah not found in previous dispensations, which is the prohibition of cursing enemies and to pray for their forgiveness

Subject: prayer for opponents; enemies of the Faith
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/prayer for opponents; enemies of the Faith.txt
Quotation: It is incumbent upon us to pray, and God confirmeth whomsoever He willeth in whatsoever He willeth. It is incumbent upon us to raise our hands in supplication to the Kingdom of Mystery and seek forgiveness for all.

Subject: prayer for opponents; enemies of the Faith
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/prayer for opponents; enemies of the Faith.txt
Quotation: O my God, my God! Aid Thy servants to return unto Thee, and transform their treachery into trustworthiness, their pride into submission, their falsehood into truth, and their fire into light. O Lord! Deprive them not of the sun of justice nor of the ocean of equity. Thou art the Dawning-Place of bounty and grace. There is no God but Thee, the Forgiving, the Generous.

Subject: prayer for opponents; enemies of the Faith
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/prayer for opponents; enemies of the Faith.txt
Quotation: O Lord! I beseech Thee by Thy Will which hath encompassed all created things, and by Thy Mercy which hath preceded all contingent beings, to aid the heedless to turn toward the ocean of Thy knowledge and the heaven of Thy grace. Then enable them to return unto the Dayspring of Thy signs and the Dawning-Place of Thy Revelation, and to repent before the door of Thy bounty which Thou hast opened through the key of Thy Most Great Name before the faces of all nations.

Subject: prayer for opponents; enemies of the Faith
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/prayer for opponents; enemies of the Faith.txt
Quotation: Say: O my God, my God! Thou seest Thy chosen ones and trustees in the hands of the calumniators and the treacherous ones who are consumed by the fire of greed, passion, tyranny and wickedness, who devour people's wealth without any proof from Thee or evidence from Thy presence, and who desire naught but harm to Thy trusted servants. I beseech Thee, O Lord, by the Most Great Word through which the Sun of Divine Unity hath shone forth from the horizon of the heaven of Thy Cause, and by which the hearts of Thy servants and creation have been illumined, to aid the heedless ones and calumniators to be trustworthy, pious, truthful and pure. O Lord! Help them to return to the court of Thy glory and the gate of Thy generosity.

Subject: prayer for parents
Quotation: Such a mother deserves such a son, and such a son requires such a mother. Blessed is the breast that suckled him, and happy the bosom that nurtured him.

Subject: prayer for parents
Quotation: He is God! Praised be Thou O Lord, My God! This is My mother who hath acknowledged Thy oneness, confessed Thy unity, attained the honour of meeting Thy Manifestations in Thy days, reached the station of recognition and entered the tabernacle of Heaven, for she loved Thyself and Thy Servant and held fast to the cord of Thy love through the sanctified Temples of Thy Sovereignty.

Subject: prayer for parents
Quotation: Glory be unto Thee, O God! Send down upon my father in his station that which will bring solace to his heart. Thou art, verily, the Lord of all the worlds. And send down, O my God, upon her who bore me - Thou art, verily, the Lord of all the worlds - that which befitteth the wonders of Thy mercy, for Thou art the Most Merciful of the merciful ones and Thou art the Most Generous of the generous ones.

Subject: prayer for parents
Quotation: Among the special favors of the Greatest Name - may my spirit be sacrificed for His loved ones - in this mighty Dispensation is that the son may seek forgiveness for the father, and descendants may intercede for their ancestors. Therefore, this servant beseeches at the threshold of the Lord that your father and mother may be immersed in the ocean of forgiveness.

Subject: prayer for peace and unity
Quotation: In any case, this servant and you and the monotheists dwelling in every land must, with complete helplessness and absolute humility, beseech God, exalted be His glory, for protection and the exaltation of the Word of Unity.

Subject: prayer for peace and unity
Quotation: O my Lord! Grant success to the victorious state and the brilliant community in achieving harmony after discord until they blend like water and wine, like spirit and peaceful body. My Lord! Bring accord between them and unite their hearts until these dense, heavy clouds covering the face of the horizons disperse and the sun of love and harmony shines forth with utmost brilliance.

Subject: prayer for pilgrims
Quotation: I have composed a prayer for His honor the Servant to recite in the Holy Shrine. When thou goest for pilgrimage, give it to them to read.

Subject: prayer for pilgrims
Quotation: Say: My God, my God! I beseech Thee by Thy Name through which Thou hast subdued the hearts of Thy servants and illumined their hearts with the light of Thy knowledge, to enable me to visit Thy Sacred House and to act in such wise as would cause my remembrance to endure amongst all remembrances. Thou art, verily, the Almighty, the Supreme, the All-Choosing.

Subject: prayer for pilgrims
Quotation: O my God! Thou seest my state and knowest my words. Thy knowledge of me sufficeth without my asking. I beseech Thee by the blood of the martyrs, the tears of the lovers, the sighs of the sincere ones, and the lamentations of the yearning ones, that Thou protect Thy servant who hath visited Thy Sacred House, attained unto the Sacred Monument and Station, stood before Thy gate, and answered Thy call. Shield him beneath Thy protection from the evil of the wicked among Thy creation. Grant him the good of this world and the next, and the life-giving waters of Thy grace, O Lord of all beings!

Subject: prayer for pioneers and travel teachers
Quotation: My God, my God! These are Thy trusted servants and Thy stranger bondsmen who have left their homes and taken refuge in these regions...Assist them all in what Thou lovest and art pleased with

Subject: prayer for pioneers and travel teachers
Quotation: "O God! O thou Attracted of the hearts...who is firm in the Ancient Covenant, fleeing from the people of darkness...who hath left his native abode...hastened to strange and unknown kingdoms..."

Subject: prayer for pioneers and travel teachers
Quotation: O GOD! O GOD! This is the attracted servant of Thy Bounty of Abha; ... He has travelled toward the West, leaving behind his sweet country, and has accepted hardships in Thy Path ... He has forsaken rest and composure, tranquility and peacefulness, serenity and calmness, and has journeyed to that distant clime - - a land which is not touched by the feet of his fathers and ancestors - - in order to diffuse Thy Fragrances, upraise Thy Flags, spread Thy Words and elucidate Thy Proofs.

Subject: prayer for pioneers and travel teachers
Quotation: O Lord, Lord! They have left their homelands, forgotten their nests, bid farewell to their kin, expended their souls, sacrificed their comfort and joy, shunned their happiness and delight, hastened to distant lands, and rushed to far-off regions - all for love of Thy Beauty, seeking to spread Thy traces, yearning to exalt Thy Word, and longing for the appearance of brilliant rays from the Kingdom of Thy mercy.

Subject: prayer for praise and gratitude
Quotation: Glorified be Thy Lord, the Lord of might, above what they describe, and peace be upon the Messengers, and praise be to God, the Lord of the worlds.

Subject: prayer for praise and gratitude
Quotation: Praise be to God Who created me by His command, then sustained me by His grace, then fed me when I was hungry. There is no God but He, the Mighty, the Wise.

Subject: prayer for praise and gratitude
Quotation: Praise be unto Thee, O Thou Who didst move Thy Most Exalted Pen by Thy Name! I testify that Thou art the Lord of the servants and the Educator of all who are in earth and heaven.

Subject: prayer for praise and gratitude
Quotation: O my God and my Beloved! This is the day of Naw-Ruz and the morning of divine favors, illumined with a radiant, brilliant, manifest light from the outpouring of Thy Most Glorious Kingdom.

Subject: prayer for praise and gratitude
Quotation: that we may arise to exalt Thy Word with the utmost joy and fragrance, remember Thee throughout the hours of night and day, call all to guidance, enjoin righteousness, and chant the verses of Thy unity amidst the concourse of creation

Subject: prayer for praise and gratitude
Quotation: Glory be unto Thee! O my God, Thou hast ever been sanctified from peers, and wilt ever remain, O my Desire, holy from all likeness. Thou art He Who hath originated all things through Thy Command, and brought all things into being through Thy wisdom.

Subject: prayer for praise and gratitude
Quotation: Send down upon them from the heaven of Thy grace the rains of bounty and bestowal, and ordain for their affairs goodness and blessing, and exalt their names among all creatures. Verily, Thou art the Gracious, the Giver, the Beneficent, the All-Bountiful.

Subject: prayer for praise and gratitude
Quotation: Allah-u-Abha! O Thou Glory of the Most Glorious! I have wakened on this Naw-Ruz morning to find the lights of Thy holiness gleaming from all regions, the verses of Thy unity recited by the tongues of all things, and the tokens of Thy singleness evident in the scroll of the Book of Creation.

Subject: prayer for praise and gratitude
Quotation: Glorified art Thou, O my God! I testify that I was as one dead, and Thou didst adorn me with the ornament of being; I was heedless, and Thou didst made known to me Thy extended path; I was silent, and Thou didst cause me to speak through Thy bounty which pervadeth both the seen and the unseen.

Subject: prayer for praise and gratitude
Quotation: Praised be Thou, O my God, my Lord, my Support and my Goal! I testify that Thou hast fulfilled Thy promise, manifested Thy Cause, distinguished between truth and falsehood, sincerity and deception, aided the oppressed, and revealed that which was hidden from the eyes of Thy servants and Thy creation.

Subject: prayer for praise and gratitude
Quotation: O God! Thanks be unto Thee for having led this heart and soul to the Beloved, and bestowed upon this destitute one a boundless portion. Thou didst summon this lost one to Thy path and didst grant this wanderer shelter and refuge beneath Thy protection. Thou art the Giver, the Bestower, the Everlasting, the All-Merciful.

Subject: prayer for praise and gratitude
Quotation: O my God! By the judgment of Thy servants and what Thou art worthy of, Thou shalt magnify the sovereignty of Thy dominion without anyone else magnifying it. Thine is the creation and the command, O my God, before and after. All the great ones bow down before Thy greatness, and all the mighty ones are humbled before Thy might.

Subject: prayer for praise and gratitude
Quotation: Glorified art Thou, O God! Thee do we worship before all worlds. Glorified art Thou, O God! Before Thee do we prostrate ourselves before all who prostrate. Glorified art Thou, O God! Unto Thee do we turn in devotion before all who are devoted. Glorified art Thou, O God! In Thee do we trust before all Thy servants who supplicate.

Subject: prayer for praise and gratitude
Quotation: O God! Send blessings upon the First Unity and its numbers among the people of Baha. O God! Send blessings upon the First Unity and its numbers among the people of Glory. [continues through all iterations] O God! Send blessings upon Him Whom Thou shalt make manifest and the letters of His Self among the people of Baha. [continues through all iterations]

Subject: prayer for praise and gratitude
Quotation: Glory be unto Thee, O God! Send down upon me at all times that which behooveth the wondrous nature of Thy mercy, for I worship none but Thee, and stand in devotion before none but Thee, and remember none but Thee, and testify to the unity of none but Thee, and sanctify none but Thee. Glory be unto Thee! There is no God but Thee! Glory be unto Thee! I am of them that remember Thee.

Subject: prayer for praise and gratitude
Quotation: Therefore, O my God, make all my glory in meeting Thee, not in meeting any besides Thee; and make all my majesty for the day of meeting Thee, not for the day of meeting any besides Thee; and make all my beauty for the day of meeting Thee, not for meeting any besides Thee; and make all my grandeur for the day of appearing before Thee, not for appearing before any other than Thee; and make all my light for the day when Thou shalt bring me into Thy presence, not into the presence of any besides Thee.

Subject: prayer for praise and gratitude
Quotation: O my God! How can I extol Thy majesty on this Friday, knowing my nothingness before Thee? Yet since Thou hast placed the signs of Thy Lordship within my soul, I commune with Thee in my solitude and exile midst the mountains during these changing circumstances, that perchance the angels may hear my voice and call upon Thee due to my grief. Through this, Thou mayest look upon me with a near glance that would transform my sorrow into the joy of the lights of Thy Self-Sufficiency, and my lamentations into the witnessing of Thy holy fragrances.

Subject: prayer for praise and gratitude
Quotation: Glory be unto Thee, O God! Send down upon the First Temple all the splendours of Thy most resplendent Beauty, and all the majesty of Thy most sublime Majesty, and all the comeliness of Thy most perfect Beauty, and all the grandeur of Thy most supreme Greatness, and all the effulgence of Thy most brilliant Light, and all the vastness of Thy most encompassing Mercy, and all the perfection of Thy most complete Word, and all the excellence of Thy most perfect Attributes, and all the greatness of Thy most mighty Names, and all the might of Thy most invincible Power, and all the potency of Thy most irresistible Will, and all the penetration of Thy most consummate Knowledge, and all the dominion of Thy most extensive Authority

Subject: prayer for prosperity
Quotation: I beseech Thee to ordain for this servant, who hath clung to the hem of Thy generosity, that which shall profit him in this world and the next.

Subject: prayer for prosperity
Quotation: I beseech God to shower all good upon you and your family and children, and that the glance of God's favor may surround them from all directions.

Subject: prayer for prosperity
Quotation: I beseech Thee by the Word which Thou hast made a sword for the polytheists and a mercy for them that believe in Thy unity, to ordain for me through Thy Most Exalted Pen the good of this world and of the world to come.

Subject: prayer for prosperity
Quotation: O my God, my Lord, and my Support! Ordain for Thy loved ones that which will gladden their hearts and minds, and transform their losses into profit in Thy days. Then assist them through Thy bounty, O Thou Who art the Lord of existence.

Subject: prayer for prosperity
Quotation: O Kind Lord! This group of farmers are Your friends and they till the soil in the field of Your near servant. O Lord Who bestows bounty! Make easy the blessings, grant sustenance, and bestow gifts. In this year fulfill the hopes of these men, cause the rain of heaven to pour down, and grant abundance and plenty.

Subject: prayer for protection
Quotation: Through pure bounty preserve us, and withhold not Thy protection and aid.

Subject: prayer for protection
Quotation: O Lord! ... preserve and protect him in the cave of Thy protection and safeguarding

Subject: prayer for protection
Quotation: My God, my God! ... shield me from wavering and perturbation, O Thou Lord of Lords!

Subject: prayer for protection
Quotation: O Lord! Protect them through Thy boundless favors in this world and the world to come.

Subject: prayer for protection
Quotation: I will supplicate at the Abha Kingdom on behalf of all, seeking assistance, protection, shelter and bounty.

Subject: prayer for protection
Quotation: O Lord! Strengthen them through Thy sovereignty; then preserve them, O my God, beneath the shade of Thy mercy

Subject: prayer for protection
Quotation: My God, my God! I am Thy servant and the son of Thy servant...protect me from the evil of Thine enemies.

Subject: prayer for protection
Quotation: Preserve her, O my God, from the evil of every evil-doer encompassed by Thy knowledge and recorded in Thy Book.

Subject: prayer for protection
Quotation: I beseech divine grace and bounty that He may preserve and protect you in the cave of His protection and shelter

Subject: prayer for protection
Quotation: I beseech Thee...to ordain for me, through Thy Most Exalted Pen, that which will preserve me from self and passion

Subject: prayer for protection
Quotation: I beseech Thee... to ordain for me that which will preserve me from all else save Thee and draw me nigh unto Thee.

Subject: prayer for protection
Quotation: O Lord! I beseech Thee to send down upon me from the heaven of Thy grace that which will preserve me from Thine enemies.

Subject: prayer for protection
Quotation: All must today beseech the True One to preserve the cities of the unitarians through the hosts of the seen and the unseen.

Subject: prayer for protection
Quotation: Is there any Remover of difficulties save God? Praised be God! He is God! All are His servants and all abide by His bidding!

Subject: prayer for protection
Quotation: O Lord! Guard them within the shelter of Thy protection, cause them to abide beneath the cave of Thy preservation and safekeeping

Subject: prayer for protection
Quotation: O Lord! Guard him with the eye of Thy most bountiful care and kindness, and protect him in this journey from every calamity and trial.

Subject: prayer for protection
Quotation: I beseech Thee... to clothe this Thy servant with the garment of Thy protection, the robe of Thy aid and the armor of Thy safeguarding

Subject: prayer for protection
Quotation: O Lord! Protect the lamp of Thy love from the winds of self and desire, then guard it through Thy conquering power and mighty strength.

Subject: prayer for protection
Quotation: Protect me, then, from every wicked and mendacious aggressor, and from every debased and profligate assailant that feareth not the Day of [...]

Subject: prayer for protection
Quotation: Thou art my refuge in my terror, my shelter in my anguish, my fortress in my distress, and my help in my desperation...O Lord! Raise me up to Thee, bring me before Thee

Subject: prayer for protection
Quotation: Protect that household of the love of God beneath the shadow of Thy providence from every affliction, and safeguard that family of faith in the shelter of Thy protection.

Subject: prayer for protection
Quotation: I beseech Thee, O my God, by the lights of Thy holy Oneness and the mysteries of Thy divine Unity, to preserve Thy chosen ones after me lest their feet slip from Thy path.

Subject: prayer for protection
Quotation: Lowly and suppliant, I implore Thee to shield me from the evil of the ungodly and to withhold me not from the shade of the Sacred Tree, nor from the Voice of Thy Pen of Glory.

Subject: prayer for protection
Quotation: I beseech Thee...to preserve this one who hath believed in Thee and in Thy mighty signs...and preserve him, O my God, in the depths of the seas and their waves and their billows

Subject: prayer for protection
Quotation: O Lord! Guard them with the eye of Thy loving-kindness in the shadow of Thy protection and preservation, and shelter them in the stronghold of Thy care from the evil ones among Thy creatures.

Subject: prayer for protection
Quotation: I beseech Thee, O Lord of the Kingdom of Names, by Thy Most Great and Most Glorious Name, to aid Thy loved ones to such steadfastness as no intimations of the polytheists... shall prevent them

Subject: prayer for protection
Quotation: The people of God must, in the nights and days, beseech the Truth, exalted be His glory, to protect the loved ones of this Most Great Revelation from the vain imaginings of the past and future.

Subject: prayer for protection
Quotation: O God! Protect Thy leaves from the transgressors amidst Thy handmaids...Protect her then from the stones of the suspicions of other women and from the darts of the vain imaginations of the sinful.

Subject: prayer for protection
Quotation: My God, My God! Thou seest Thy Afnan in the hands of the rebellious among Thy creatures and the oppressors among Thy people. Preserve them through Thy power and sovereignty and might and strength.

Subject: prayer for protection
Quotation: O God our Lord! Protect us through Thy grace from whatsoever may be repugnant unto Thee and vouchsafe unto us that which well beseemeth Thee... O God our Lord! Protect us through the potency of Thy might

Subject: prayer for protection
Quotation: Then write down for them that which will draw them nigh unto the sanctuary of Thy holiness, and send down upon them that which will preserve them from the promptings of the polytheists among Thy creation.

Subject: prayer for protection
Quotation: Do Thou clothe the hearts of Thy loved ones with the armor of steadfastness and assurance, that the arrows of the intimations of those who have disbelieved in the Sovereign of all possibility may not affect them.

Subject: prayer for protection
Quotation: I hope that through the grace of the Blessed Beauty you may ever be stirred by the breeze from the rose-garden of His bounty, and that night and day you may supplicate and seek aid and protection from His Divine Unity

Subject: prayer for protection
Quotation: I beseech Thee by Thy Most Glorious Name in Thy Later Manifestation that Thou protect me from the evil of every Satan and the call of every calf and the guile of every impostor and the filth of every wretched polytheist

Subject: prayer for protection
Quotation: Protect me in my sleep and wakefulness, and in all the worlds of Thy Command and Creation, in my absence and presence, in my beginning and end, in my outward and inward being, that I may act only in the ways of Thy good-pleasure

Subject: prayer for protection
Quotation: O Ever-Abiding One! Glory be unto Thee, O my God! I beseech Thee... that Thou protect the bearer of this blessed leaf, then him who readeth it, then him who hearkeneth unto it, then him who passeth by the house wherein it resideth

Subject: prayer for protection
Quotation: O my God! I beseech Thee to protect me and those who believe in the Bayan from the tree of negation and all that pertaineth unto it, and to grant me that which Thou hast ordained in the tree of affirmation and all that pertaineth unto it.

Subject: prayer for protection
Quotation: Therefore, O my God, send down upon them that which will turn them toward Thee. Then remove this youth who hath risen against Thee completely, and those who follow him in his desires, that Thy holy land may be purified from these unbelievers.

Subject: prayer for protection
Quotation: O my Lord! Protect this sinful servant from the evil of the doubts of the wicked ones, and keep him safe beneath the shade of Thy protection and aid. Give him to drink from the cup of Thy favors and grant him sustenance from the heavenly table.

Subject: prayer for protection
Quotation: O my God, my Adored One, my Desire! With utter helplessness and supplication I beseech Thee to protect this servant from the evil of the croakers, and deprive me not of the shade of the divine Lote-Tree and the shrill voice of the Most Exalted Pen.

Subject: prayer for protection
Quotation: Glory be unto Thee, O God! Preserve us from what lieth before us and behind us, and from our right and our left, and from above our heads and beneath our feet, lest we witness on that day what would grieve us, but rather what would gladden our hearts.

Subject: prayer for protection
Quotation: O Lord! Remove evil from him and leave him not to drown in the greatest depth of tribulations and the mightiest ocean of afflictions. Grant him bounties and reveal to him hidden things and protect him from death in the shelter of Thy greatest protection.

Subject: prayer for protection
Quotation: O my Lord! Pour forth upon me patience and grant me victory over the transgressing people...O Lord! Pour forth upon me patience and grant me victory over the idolatrous people who speak naught but their own vain imaginings and are moved only by their own desires.

Subject: prayer for protection
Quotation: O my God, and my Lord, and my Hope! I beseech Thee by Thy Most Great and Most Glorious Name, and by Thy Most Exalted and Most High Command, to protect him who hath turned unto Thee and dwelt beneath Thy shadow from the evil of the wicked ones among Thy creatures.

Subject: prayer for protection
Quotation: I beseech Thee by the Lord of "but for Thee," through Whose advent the celestial spheres were honored, to protect Thy monotheistic servants from the evil of Thine enemies and to assist them through the hosts of the unseen and the visible, through Thy power and might.

Subject: prayer for protection
Quotation: O my God! Look upon Thy Afnans with the glances of the eyes of Thy mercy and bounty...I beseech Thee, by the ocean of Thy verses and the lights of the Sun of Thy knowledge, to preserve them from the oppression of the enemies of Thy Self who have turned away from Thy horizon

Subject: prayer for protection
Quotation: O Lord! These are the remnants of the martyrs and the company of the blessed ones...deliver them from the oppression of those possessed of terrible might and restrain from them the hand of evil and leave them not to be played with by the claws of wolves and the fangs of dogs

Subject: prayer for protection
Quotation: I beseech Thee, O God of all beings and Lord of all things, by Thy Most Glorious Name and by the scratching of Thy Most Exalted Pen, to preserve me through Thy bounty and grace, and ordain for me through Thy tender mercy and favors the good of the hereafter and of this world.

Subject: prayer for protection
Quotation: I beseech Thee by the mysteries of Thy Dominion and the signs of Thy Kingdom to assist Thy loved ones to be steadfast in Thy Cause, then protect him, O my God, from the hosts of the Pharaohs who lay claim to knowledge without clear proof from Thee or evidence from Thy presence

Subject: prayer for protection
Quotation: I beseech Thee to protect me from the oppression of Thine enemies who have violated Thy Covenant and Testament, who have denied Thy signs, who have disputed Thy proof, and who have rejected what Thou hast sent down from the heaven of Thy Will and the atmosphere of Thy Purpose.

Subject: prayer for protection
Quotation: My God, my God! Praise be to Thee for having guided me, caused me to hear, and made me know. I beseech Thee by the rain-showers from the heaven of Thy grace and the waves of the ocean of Thy bounty to protect me from the doubts of the suspicious ones and the allusions of the polytheists.

Subject: prayer for protection
Quotation: Preserve them, O God, with Thy transcendent sovereignty over all things and protect them with the watchful eye of Thy care and protection between all mankind. Withhold from them, God, the extended hands, the pointed arrows and the directed spearheads, the bared teeth and intensified claws

Subject: prayer for protection
Quotation: Today all the people of the saved community must supplicate and beseech the Truth, exalted be His station, that through His boundless grace and generosity He may preserve the trees of the garden of unity from tempestuous winds, the saws of the transgressors, and the scythes of the hypocrites.

Subject: prayer for protection
Quotation: O Lord! I beseech Thee by them and by their glory, might and power to protect Thy loved ones from the polytheists who have encompassed Thy cities and lands without any proof from Thee, and who have committed that which hath grieved the hearts of Thy chosen ones and the hearts of Thy messengers.

Subject: prayer for protection
Quotation: You must begin to pray and repent for all that you have done which is wrong and you must implore and ask for help and assistance that you may become better than yesterday so that you may continue to make progress...That is why you must ask and implore and entreat: "O God, protect me from myself!"

Subject: prayer for protection
Quotation: O God! Protect us from the evil of those who have disbelieved and make us independent of all things. O Lord! I seek refuge in Thee from all that the accursed Satan may bring. O Lord! I seek refuge in Thee from all Thine enemies. O God! Protect me from the evil of the oppressors and from the followers of darkness.

Subject: prayer for protection
Quotation: Aid me then, O Thou Who didst rescue Jonah from the belly of the whale, Who didst deliver Abraham from the fire, Who didst remove the affliction of Job, Who didst dispel the grief of Jacob, Who didst relieve the sorrow of Joseph. For in Thy grasp lies all grace and power, and in Thy right hand all bounty and wisdom.

Subject: prayer for protection
Quotation: I beseech Thee...to preserve through Thy power Thy loved ones who have turned to the Dawning-Place of the lights of Thy countenance and have advanced toward the Dayspring of the manifestations of Thy Cause. Aid them with Thy confirmations, then ordain for them through Thy Most Exalted Pen the good of this world and the world to come.

Subject: prayer for protection
Quotation: My God, my God! Thou knowest and seest how the polytheists have surrounded Thy domains and desire to seize Thy lands. I beseech Thee by Thy light whereby the earth of Thy wisdom and the heaven of Thy utterance were illumined, to protect Thy trusted servants from the oppression of the treacherous ones and the aggressors and the slanderers.

Subject: prayer for protection
Quotation: O Lord, protect us through Muhammad and the family of Muhammad from what lies before us and behind us, from our right and our left, from above our heads and beneath our feet, and from every direction that pertains to us. For verily we are under Thy watch, Thy guardianship, Thy protection, Thy shelter, Thy fortress, Thy safeguard, and Thy sufficiency.

Subject: prayer for protection
Quotation: Glory be to Thee, O God! Protect me from before me and behind me, from my right and my left, from above my head and beneath my feet, by that through which Thou hast sustained the heavens and the earth and whatsoever is between them, and that which Thou hast given me through Thy mercy and bounty from Thy presence. Verily, Thou art the Best of protectors.

Subject: prayer for protection
Quotation: Glory be unto Thee, O my God! Protect me from before me and behind me, from my right and my left, from above my head and beneath my feet, by that through which Thou hast sustained the heavens and the earth and whatsoever is between them, and that which Thou hast given me through Thy mercy and bounty from Thy presence. Verily, Thou art the Best of protectors.

Subject: prayer for protection
Quotation: O Lord, O Thou Who art the Possessor of forgiveness, pardon and beneficence! Verily, this is a servant who is related to one whom Thou didst encompass with the glances of Thine all-merciful eyes in the world of lights. He seeketh Thy protection from the evil of the wicked ones, and taketh refuge in the shelter of Thy mercy - the gathering place of all hopes.

Subject: prayer for protection
Quotation: Lord! Remove this harm and repel this misery. Make hearts overflow with bounty, breasts expanded through Your greatest outpourings, and souls revived by the breezes of faithfulness, that they may glorify Your praise and sanctify You morning and evening, protected in Your shelter from the people of hypocrisy, rejoicing in Your pervasive and far-reaching victory.

Subject: prayer for protection
Quotation: I beseech Thee by Thy Name, the Restrainer, to withhold from us the maleficence of Thine adversaries who have disbelieved in Thy testimony, and caviled at Thy beauty. Shield them, by Thy Name, the Preserver, within the stronghold of Thy might and power, that haply they may be protected from the darts of doubt that are hurled by such as have rebelled against Thee.

Subject: prayer for protection
Quotation: O peerless Lord! Holy and sanctified art Thou. Merciful and kind art Thou. Thou art the Helper and the Defender. Grant these helpless ones a shelter beneath Thy protection, and in the stronghold of Thy safeguarding and care, preserve these lowly ones from the evil of the people of discord. Verily, Thou art the Protector, the Almighty, the Powerful, the All-Potent.

Subject: prayer for protection
Quotation: O my God, my Lord, and my Hope! I beseech Thee by the sovereignty of Thy power and the dominion of Thy might to protect Thy people from the whisperings of the devils and the promptings of the corrupters, and to guard the pearls of their love for Thee from the hands of the thieves. Verily, Thou art the Sovereign of all worlds and the Lord of the heavens and the earths.

Subject: prayer for protection
Quotation: O my Lord! Leave me not to myself, and deprive me not of the wonders of the outpourings of Thy grace in these days wherein all have risen against Thy beauteous, holy and wondrous Countenance. O my Lord! Open mine eyes through Thy favors that I may know Thee by Thyself and by that which proceedeth from Thee. Then sever me from all that hindereth me from the paths of Thy good-pleasure.

Subject: prayer for protection
Quotation: O Lord, Thou seest the unitarians among the idolaters, and what hath befallen them at the hands of the oppressors among Thy creation and the transgressors among Thy servants. I beseech Thee to preserve them through the hosts of Thy power and the legions of Thy might, then ordain for them what beseemeth the heaven of Thy generosity and the ocean of Thy mercy and the sun of Thy bounty.

Subject: prayer for protection
Quotation: Glory be unto Thee, O God! Protect us from whomsoever Thou willest from behind, and from whomsoever Thou willest from above our heads, and from whomsoever Thou willest from beneath our feet, and from every [...] unto the angels of the heavens and the earth and whatsoever is between them, then howsoever Thou willest and whensoever Thou willest. Verily Thou art the Preserver of all things.

Subject: prayer for protection
Quotation: O Lord of creation and Ruler over all lands! I beseech Thee by the Name through which was raised the scratching of Thy Most Exalted Pen between earth and heaven, to ordain for Thy chosen ones that which will bring tranquility to their souls and gladness to their hearts. O my Lord! Thou seest Thy loved ones in the hands of Thine enemies. I beseech Thee to decree for me and for them the good of this world and the next.

Subject: prayer for protection
Quotation: O Lord! Thou seest the monotheists among Thy servants under the rule of the oppressors and polytheists, such that the tyrants of the earth and pharaohs of the land have surrounded their cities and homes. O Lord! I beseech Thee to transform their weakness into strength, their powerlessness into might, their sorrow into joy, and their abasement into glory. Verily, Thou art powerful over whatsoever Thou willest. There is no God but Thee, the Strong, the Dominant, the Powerful.

Subject: prayer for protection
Quotation: O God! I seek Thy forgiveness, O my God, for what I have said before Thy Beauty and what I have committed before Thy Majesty. Verily, Thou sufficest all things and nothing sufficeth apart from Thee. Therefore suffice me, O God, through Thy generosity, and guard me through Thy grace, and assist me from Thy presence, and fill my heart with fear of Thee, and show me the countenance of Thy proof, and inspire me at all times with Thy beginning and Thy seizure, then with hope in Thee and Thy grace.

Subject: prayer for protection
Quotation: O my God and the God of the world, my Purpose and the Purpose of the nations! Strengthen the hearts of Thy party, draw them nigh unto Thee, and assist them in that which befitteth Thy unity and that which Thou hast revealed in Thy Book. O Lord! Thou seest them in the hands of the idolaters who have turned away from Thee, from Thy signs, and from that which Thou hast sent down from the kingdom of Thy utterance. I beseech Thee, O God of Names and Creator of heaven, to assist them with the hosts of the unseen and the visible.

Subject: prayer for protection
Quotation: I beseech Thee, O God of Names and Creator of Heaven, by the Crimson Scroll and by Thy Most Exalted Pen, to assist Thy chosen ones to celebrate Thy praise and glorify Thee. Then raise them up, O my God, amongst Thy servants and Thy creation. I implore Thee, O God of the Kingdom and the Realm, and Sovereign of the Celestial Dominion, by Thy Name through Whose manifestation all names bowed down in prostration and all things submitted themselves in humility before Thy Face and in lowliness at Thy Revelation, to aid Thy loved ones with Thy hosts and protect them from the enemies of Thy Self.

Subject: prayer for protection
Quotation: I beseech Thee by the cries of the hearts of them that are sincere, and by the yearning of the hearts of them that long for Thee, and by that Name through which Thou didst shatter the idols of vain desire and strip from the temples of the wayward the cloak of names, and by which all who are in the heavens and on earth were struck with terror, and they that dwell in the realms of Creation and Command were shaken with fear - to protect Thy servants from the signs of them that have denied Thy most exalted Self, and waxed proud before Thee, and warred against Thee, after Thou didst reveal unto them Thy proofs and the evidences of Thy Cause

Subject: prayer for protection
Quotation: Lord! Lord! Rescue these righteous ones from the oppression of the wicked, and protect them in the shelter of Thy protection from the predatory wolves in those regions and ferocious beasts who fear not the Mighty, the Compelling One, who dread not the consequences of this world, who awaken not from the slumber of passion, and who desist not from enmity and hatred. Lord! Thy sincere servants are under the claws of a ruthless, murderous band who show no mercy, and a group whose essence was kneaded with the water of injustice and pride. Lord! Guard Thy bondsmen with Thy watchful eye and preserve Thy loved ones beneath the glances of the eyes of Thy mercy.

Subject: prayer for protection
Quotation: O my God, I beseech Thee by Thy Name through which Thou hast manifested Thyself unto all things and through which Thou hast revealed the signs of Thy power in and the conditions in the kingdom of creation, to assist Thy servants with the waters which Thou hast caused to flow from the clouds of Thy mercy and the heaven of Thy grace, that they may turn unto Thee with purified hearts, sanctified souls, attentive ears, illumined breasts and submissive necks. Then gather them, O my God, beneath the shadow of Thy loving-kindness and bounty, and protect them from the evil of those who have forgotten Thy Most Exalted Remembrance. O Protector! O Protector! O Helper! O Helper! O Protector! O Protector! O Helper! O Helper! O Protector! O Helper! O Protector! O Helper!

Subject: prayer for purity; chastity
Quotation: I beseech Thee to make me pure in my love for Thee

Subject: prayer for purity; chastity
Quotation: O my God, my God! Preserve this servant from the evil of self and passion, and adorn him with the light of righteousness and godliness.

Subject: prayer for purity; chastity
Quotation: O my Lord! Purify the souls from the conditions of those who are heedless of Thy remembrance, who oppose Thy Cause, who are negligent of Thy Covenant, who are veiled from Thy effulgence.

Subject: prayer for purity; chastity
Quotation: I beseech Thee, O my God, by the Name through which the sincere ones hastened unto the seat of Thy throne and the unitarians unto the dawning-place of the lights of Thy countenance, to send down upon our hearts from the clouds of Thy bounty that which will purify them from all else beside Thee and sanctify them from the mention of aught except Thyself

Subject: prayer for purity; chastity
Quotation: O God, my God! Purify the hearts of Thy loved ones from attachment to aught else but Thee, and sanctify the hearts of Thy chosen ones from all save Thee.
