Make them detached from all affairs except the affairs of Thy mercy, and purified from every purpose save the manifestation of the lights of Thy spirituality. O Lord! Aid them to sincerity in all conditions and submission to Thy will in all matters and traces. Make them a sign of Thy oneness in the kingdom of earth and heaven, and a banner of Thy singleness among the concourse of created things, and the essence of detachment through Thy conquering power that transforms the reality of contingent beings. Verily, Thou art the Mighty, the Powerful, the Omnipotent.

Subject: prayer for sacrifice
Quotation: O Divine Providence! Lift to Thy lovers' lips a cup brimful of anguish. To the yearners on Thy pathway, make sweetness but a sting, and poison honey-sweet. Set Thou our heads for ornaments on the points of spears. Make Thou our hearts the targets for pitiless arrows and darts. Raise Thou this withered soul to life on the martyr's field, make his faded heart to drink the draught of tyranny, and thus grow fresh and fair once more.

Subject: prayer for service
Quotation: I beseech Thee by the lights of Thy Throne and whatsoever was hidden in Thy knowledge, to aid me to arise to serve Thee in the nights and days and in all conditions

Subject: prayer for service
Quotation: Enable us to serve Thy friends and confirm us in servitude to Thy loved ones. This is the ultimate desire of heart and soul, this is the ultimate hope of conscience and being.

Subject: prayer for service
Quotation: O my Lord! Strengthen my limbs for the service of Your Cause and illumine my sight with the light of meeting You. Then open before the faces of Your servants the gates of attaining Your presence.

Subject: prayer for service
Quotation: Assist us to serve at Thy Sacred Threshold, enable us to worship Thee at the Dawning-places of Thy remembrance, and ordain for us to spread the sweet fragrances of Thy holiness among Thy creation. Strengthen our loins in service to Thee amongst Thy servants

Subject: prayer for service
Quotation: My God, my God! Thou seest me turning toward Thee, gazing upon Thy horizon, and awaiting the wonders of Thy bounty. I beseech Thee by Thy prevailing Will and Thine all-encompassing Purpose to aid me under all conditions to serve Thy Cause and to achieve that whereby my remembrance may endure in Thy Book.

Subject: prayer for service
Quotation: O my Beloved and my Purpose! This is Thy servant who is detached unto Thee, who supplicates before Thee, who relies upon Thee. Assist him in all things, in places, times and conditions, for verily he is sincere servant and Thy slave who has sacrificed his spirit, his essence, his self and his comfort in Thy path. He has no wish save Thy good-pleasure, no desire except to exalt Thy Word throughout all regions.

Subject: prayer for service
Quotation: Say: Praise be unto Thee, O my God, for having turned toward Thy servant and mentioned him in Thy prison in days when the daysprings of polytheism and discord and the sources of infidelity and dissension have appeared. O Lord! Thou seest me clinging unto Thee and detached from all else besides Thee. I beseech Thee to assist me to serve Thy Cause and to arise to aid it through the hosts of wisdom and utterance.

Subject: prayer for service
Quotation: O Lord! Establish for them the luminous proof, guide them to the manifest way, sanctify them from self and desire, pour upon them patience in the face of tribulation, cause them to speak Thy praise, perfect Thy favors upon them, and make firm their feet upon the straight path, O Merciful, O Compassionate! Make them cupbearers of the celestial wine, that they may pass round the chalice from the vessels of Thy knowledge, O Lord of the most excellent names, until the seekers become intoxicated from these cups overflowing with Thy bounty, O Ever-Living, O Self-Subsisting!

Subject: prayer for service
Quotation: O my God, my God! These souls have arisen with all their strength to exalt Thy Word among the people, until the sweet fragrances of faithfulness waft through that luminous region, hearts are stirred by abundant grace, the fire of love burns within breasts and vitals, and eyes and hearts are illumined by the radiant lights shining from the horizon of manifestation. O Lord! Strengthen their arms in this praiseworthy cause, illuminate their consciences with brilliant rays from the horizon of Thy presence, and intoxicate them with the cups of joy whose essence is camphor.

Subject: prayer for service
Quotation:
O my God! O my God! This is Thy servant who has forsaken the pleasure of comfort, the rest of repose, might, glory and greatness, and has traveled to distant lands in Thy path, traversing valleys, crossing mountains and deserts, wandering through the regions, calling out Thy Name among the righteous, summoning souls to the Kingdom of mysteries, and enduring every hardship and tribulation in Thy path from the wicked ones. O Lord! Assist him with the hosts of the unseen and enable him to achieve the greatest hopes, so that signs may indicate mysteries, appearances reveal inner meanings, and the manifest disclose the hidden.  AB00302
O my God, my God! Verily, this servant of Thine is broken before the Kingdom of Thy mercy and supplicates Thee to assist him in serving Thy Cause, spreading Thy remembrance, and diffusing Thy praise and attributes. Aid him in this, for verily Thou art the Powerful, the Mighty, verily Thou art the Kind, the Compassionate, the Merciful.

Quotation: I beseech Thee to send Thy blessings upon Muhammad ibn 'Ali, Thy Proof and son of Thy Proof, with the most excellent blessings Thou hast ever sent upon any of Thy chosen ones or bestowed upon any of Thy sincere ones.

Subject: prayer for specific individuals; groups
Quotation: O Lord! Endear this household in both worlds! Bless this home. Illumine it forever and ever. Crown the head of Mrs Whyte with the Diadem of the Everlasting Glory so that its brilliant gems may shine upon centuries and cycles.

Subject: prayer for specific individuals; groups
Quotation: Aid Thou Mahdi, who hath emigrated from his homeland out of love for meeting Thee and standing before Thy gate. O Lord! Ordain for him what Thou hast sent down in Thy Book for those who are nigh unto Thee among Thy creatures.

Subject: prayer for specific individuals; groups
Quotation: This is a day among the days of Thy Ridvan wherein one of Thy servants invited the Manifestation of Thy Self and the Dayspring of Thy sovereignty, and adorned a place among the places of the prison for Thy Most Glorious Beauty.

Subject: prayer for specific individuals; groups
Quotation: O Haji Muhammad-'Ali, son of him who has ascended unto God, Haji Ahmad - upon him be the Glory of God, the Most Glorious... O Lord! Make them successful in all matters and affairs, make them signs of Thy bounty amongst all peoples

Subject: prayer for specific individuals; groups

Subject: prayer for specific individuals; groups
Quotation: O my God, my God! These are servants who have acknowledged the word of Thy oneness and recognized the manifestation of the Beauty of Thy singleness from the dawning-place of Thy mercy...Ordain for them every good through Thy great favor.

Subject: prayer for specific individuals; groups
Quotation: Peace and glory be upon thee and upon thy son ?abibu'llah. We beseech God to assist him to remember and praise Him, and to aid him in that which will draw him nigh unto Him. Verily He is the Ever-Flowing, the All-Forgiving, the All-Merciful.

Subject: prayer for specific individuals; groups
Quotation: Show utmost kindness on my behalf to Ustad Muhammad-Hasan-i-Banna. I seek abundant grace and favor from the Forgiving Lord on his behalf. I beseech assistance from the Court of Oneness for Jinab-i-Shamshad and pray for joy of heart and soul.

Subject: prayer for specific individuals; groups
Quotation: O thou who gazest toward the horizon! Thy letter hath reached the Most Great Prison, and the servant who standeth before the Throne hath read it. We have answered thee with that whose fragrance hath wafted between the heavens and the earths.

Subject: prayer for specific individuals; groups
Quotation: O Thou my God! O Thou joy of my heart and delight of my soul! Thou seest Thy beloved servant, the physician, roaming in the field of servitude, moving swiftly in the arena of devotion to Thy blessed Threshold and Thy holy and exalted Lordship.

Subject: prayer for specific individuals; groups
Quotation: O Shaykh Muhammad, Shaykh Ahmad, Shaykh Ghulamrida, Shaykh Husayn, Mirza Mahmud Khan, Mirza Husayn, Mirza Farajullah, Mashhadi Hasan, Ustad Husayn, Mashhadi Husayn-'Ali, and Mirza Isma'il Khan - upon them be the Glory of God, the Most Glorious!

Subject: prayer for specific individuals; groups
Quotation: O Light shining from the horizon of the heaven of bounty, and Manifestation radiating from the Will of God, Creator of the heavens and Sovereign of the Kingdom of Names! Upon thee, O mighty pillar of God, His great Cause, and His manifest Light!

Subject: prayer for specific individuals; groups
Quotation: O my God! O my God! This is a servant from whose eyes Thou hast removed the veil...make him a brilliant lamp, a shining star, and a firmly-rooted tree growing in an extended shade, fresh and verdant, watered by the outpouring of Thy praised cloud

Subject: prayer for specific individuals; groups
Quotation: I beseech from the court of the All-Knowing God his comfort and tranquility. I seek for him infinite protection and assistance from the grace and favor of the Divine Unity. I seek for him supreme spirituality and illumination of the higher realm.

Subject: prayer for specific individuals; groups
Quotation: O Mashhadi Nasru'llah, upon him be the glory of God! He is the Witness from His most exalted horizon. O Nasru'llah! Your name was present before the Wronged One, Who made mention of you with the verses of God, the Help in Peril, the Self-Subsisting.

Subject: prayer for specific individuals; groups
Quotation: We beseech God to forgive thy father and to send down upon him at all times a blessing from His presence and a mercy from His side, and to make him hear His verses and behold the mysteries of His dominion and kingdom. He is verily the Mighty, the All-Choosing.

Subject: prayer for specific individuals; groups
Quotation: O Lord! Thou seest him who hath turned unto Thee and held fast unto Thy cord, and whose words testify to Thy manifestation, Thy appearance, Thy transcendence, Thy sublimity, and Thy seat upon the throne of Thy grandeur. O Lord! Aid him in that which he desireth.

Subject: prayer for specific individuals; groups
Quotation: I beseech God to make the end of your life the beginning of favors, and to confirm your two distinguished sons, the comfort of your eyes, as two brilliant stars in the horizon of glory. And I ask God to make him ablaze with a flame soaring to the supreme heights

Subject: prayer for specific individuals; groups
Quotation: My request is that on my behalf, in the Holy Shrine, they recite this prayer in a state of weeping, utter helplessness and supplication, with a voice of pleading and imploring, with sighs and lamentation and cries, and that the listeners may pray for its acceptance.

Subject: prayer for specific individuals; groups
Quotation: O handmaid of God Rabbabih, upon her be the Glory of God! In the name of the Peerless Friend, thy mention hath been made in the presence of the Wronged One, and thy name hath been inscribed by the Pen of Divine decree. Give thanks unto thy Lord for this well-beloved grace.

Subject: prayer for specific individuals; groups
Quotation: O Jinab-i-Allah-Murad Khan! He is the All-Hearing, the All-Answering! We have heard thy call and, having accepted thy turning unto Us, have made mention of thee in such wise that the fragrance thereof shall endure throughout the eternity of the Most Beautiful Names of God.

Subject: prayer for specific individuals; groups
Quotation: O my Lord, what a lofty palace You have established for Your loved ones...nurture this family with the spring rains of Your mercy and preserve them in the cave of Your protection and shelter from tests and trials. Keep them firm in the Covenant and detach them from Satan's wiles.

Subject: prayer for specific individuals; groups
Quotation: O my God, my God! This is Your truthful and trustworthy servant... Lord, perfect through him Your mercy, complete through him Your bounty, establish through him Your proof, spread through him Your fragrances, make clear through him Your signs, and explain through him Your evidences

Subject: prayer for specific individuals; groups
Quotation: We beseech God to adorn him and the friends with the ornament of sanctity and detachment. Verily, He is the Most Merciful, the Compassionate. We beseech God to protect the believers from the evil of the polytheists and to create love between the hearts of those who believe in His unity.

Subject: prayer for specific individuals; groups
Quotation: O ye friends of 'Abdu'l-Baha! In this moment when I am intimate with the remembrance of the friends and occupied with the mention of the loved ones, the heart hath attained delicacy and the spirit gladness, and with utmost lowliness and supplication I entreat at the Threshold of Oneness

Subject: prayer for specific individuals; groups
Quotation: O Handmaiden of God, daughter of Ismi Asdaq, upon both of you be the Glory of God! He is the All-Witnessing, the All-Informed. O My handmaiden, upon thee be My glory! We have made mention of thee in numerous Tablets, both before and after, as a bounty from Us, and at this manifest hour.

Subject: prayer for specific individuals; groups
Quotation: O Beloved of the horizons and Adored One of every longing servant! These souls are precious through Thy grace and bounty, and these persons are among the sincere ones...Make all intoxicated with the wine of joy and grant them an abundant share of attraction, rapture, yearning and fervor.

Subject: prayer for specific individuals; groups
Quotation: O my God, praise be to Thee for having distinguished Thy servant whom Thou didst honor with Thy presence and caused to hear Thy verses. O Lord! Ordain for him and for those who have sought Thee that which befitteth Thy majesty. Then write down for them the good of this world and the next.

Subject: prayer for specific individuals; groups
Quotation: Thou seest Thy servant who was named Nabil before Sadiq, who hath turned toward the lights of Thy countenance after the passing of the people of Thy kingdom... O Lord! Make him so enkindled with the fire of Thy love that through him the inhabitants of Thy lands and realms may be set ablaze.

Subject: prayer for specific individuals; groups
Quotation: O My God! Glory be to Thee! Thou seest how Mahmud hath turned towards Thy praiseworthy station... Then write for him the good of this world and the next. Then cause him to rest beneath Thy shade and aid him to transcribe Thy verses, spread abroad Thy commandments, and manifest Thy knowledge.

Subject: prayer for specific individuals; groups
Quotation: Be assured that at all times I pray for you and beseech from the Lord of manifest signs your bodily health, nearness in prostration, the station of witnessing, and service to the Cause of the loving Lord, that God willing, you may become the cause of rendering a service to the Lord in that land.

Subject: prayer for specific individuals; groups
Quotation: O Lord! Tribulations ordained and decreed have time and again overtaken Thy servant Abdullah. O Lord! He hath held fast to the cord of patience in Thy path and steadfastness in Thy love. I beseech Thee to change their hardship into ease, their abasement into glory, and their distress into comfort.

Subject: prayer for specific individuals; groups
Quotation: I beseech manifold favors and bounties from the Incomparable Lord on his behalf. I implore assistance and bounty from the Court of Unity for his honor Mirza Ahmad Khan and all his relatives. I beseech God that they may become a lamp lit with the light of guidance and the cause of others' guidance.

Subject: prayer for specific individuals; groups
Quotation: O Lord! Make them tall-growing trees in the garden of Thy servitude, warbling birds in the meadows of Thy worship, prowling lions in the forests of Thy service, and fish swimming in the pools of Thy knowledge, speaking Thy praise, attracted to Thy beauty, stirred by Thy love, and moved by Thy Cause.

Subject: prayer for specific individuals; groups
Quotation: Through Khodadad Jamshid the pilgrim, upon him be the Glory of God, the Most Glorious - Mehtar Khodadad Shahvir, Mehtar Isfandiar Bahram, Mehtar Ardeshir Gushtasp, Mehtar Rustam Bahmard, Mehtar Bahram Gushtasp, Mehtar Bahram Baman, Mehtar Nush Gushtasp, Mehtar Baman Bahram - may their souls be happy.

Subject: prayer for specific individuals; groups
Quotation: O Lord! Make these two precious souls intimate companions with Thy remembrance, and guide these two yearning ones to the rose-garden of inner meanings and realities. Lead these two fish to the sweet waters of guidance, and bring these two gazelles of the wilderness of unity to the meadow of Thy bounty.

Subject: prayer for specific individuals; groups
Quotation: "We beseech God, exalted be His glory, to aid thee in that which pleaseth Him and to grant thee success in His remembrance and praise" and "in the nights and days I have beseeched and do beseech from God, exalted be His glory, glory and blessing and exaltation and bounty for you and the other gentlemen"

Subject: prayer for specific individuals; groups
Quotation: My God, my God! You see me aflame with the fire of Your love... Lord! Make them the lights of Your oneness, the banners of Your sanctification, the signs of Your glorification, Your all-embracing Words, the letters of Your unfurled scroll, and Your preserved Tablet, speaking forth Your perfect mysteries.

Subject: prayer for specific individuals; groups
Quotation: I beseech Thee not to disappoint me of that which Thou hast ordained for such of Thy servants as are sincere... O my Lord! Strengthen him and Thy handmaiden who hath believed in Thee and in Thy signs, that through them Thy remembrance may be exalted amongst Thy servants and Thy Cause amongst Thy creation.

Subject: prayer for specific individuals; groups
Quotation: O my Lord, my Master, my Shelter! You are my hope and You are my glory. Your grace is the ultimate goal of my aspirations and Your generosity is my greatest plea...that You make this branch moist, fresh, verdant, full of vitality, and beautiful in the sacred grove of Your oneness and the garden of intimacy with Your mercy

Subject: prayer for specific individuals; groups
Quotation: O Khorasan - Jinab-i-Mirza Kuchik, Jinab-i-Mirza Muhammad Naqqash, Jinab-i-Karbila'i Qasim, Jinab-i-Siyyid Haydar, Jinab-i-Rajab'ali Hisari, Jinab-i-Siyyid Ali-Muhammad, Jinab-i-Mirza Jalal, Jinab-i-Mulla Hidayatu'llah Mu'allim, and Jinab-i-Mulla Ghulam-Husayn Bishruyih'i - upon them be the Glory of God, the Most Glorious!

Subject: prayer for specific individuals; groups
Quotation: Through Jinab-i-Bashiru'llah to Jinab-i-Mirza Muhammad-'Ali Munshi, upon him be the Glory of God, the Most Glorious...Thy letter was received and perused, and supplications were offered at the Sacred Threshold of the Ancient Beauty and the Most Great Name, that a new confirmation may reach thee and a speedy recovery be granted

Subject: prayer for specific individuals; groups
Quotation: O Lord! Illumine his face with a ray that hath shone forth and gleamed from the dawn of Thy Oneness, occupy his heart with the remembrance of the beauty of Thy Singleness, gladden his spirit with the breezes that have wafted from the gardens of Thy mercy, and cause him to speak of Thy remembrance and praise amidst Thy creatures.

Subject: prayer for specific individuals; groups
Quotation: With all humility, attention, submissiveness and devotion, I commune with Thee with my tongue, my heart, my spirit, my innermost being, my consciousness and my soul, and I beseech Thee to ordain the greatest aspirations, the most excellent deeds, glory and perfection, bounty and beauty, prosperity and success for this family...

Subject: prayer for specific individuals; groups
Quotation: O ye who are steadfast in the Covenant! What shall I write, for ye are aware and conscious, wise and awakened. Through the grace of the Lord, with heart like unto the sun and soul captive to that musk-laden tress, a hundred times in every moment do I call you to mind and implore assistance and bounty from the threshold of the Lord

Subject: prayer for specific individuals; groups
Quotation: I asked God to make thee a sign of the Signs of His Power amongst His girls, to cause thee to be an emblem of this great Century, to strengthen thee in speech and explanation, to make thee attain the visit of the Holy Threshold and to enable thy father and mother in whatever conduces to salvation and life until the eternity of the eternities

Subject: prayer for specific individuals; groups
Quotation: I pray for divine forgiveness for Jinab-i-Siyyid 'Ali-Muhammad and that he may be immersed in the ocean of grace and bounty...I pray for the teacher of the Tarbiyat School and seek spiritual progress for the children...I seek a ray of divine favors for the maidservant of God Ruhiyyih and protection and assistance from the All-Merciful for all"

Subject: prayer for specific individuals; groups
Quotation: O Habibu'llah! We have answered thee and made mention of thee in this perspicuous Tablet. We have named the heavenly table "Mary" as a token of Our favor and a mercy from Our presence. We beseech God to bless her coming and to rain down upon her from the clouds of His grace the showers of His blessing, His bounty, His generosity and His gifts.

Subject: prayer for specific individuals; groups
Quotation: O Kind Beloved! These friends are intoxicated with the cup of the Covenant and wandering distracted in Their love for Thee, traversing the desert. They are aflame with separation from Thee and in utmost longing for Thy dawning light. Send forth a manifestation of grace from the invisible realm of the mystic Kingdom and scatter the rays of bounty.

Subject: prayer for specific individuals; groups
Quotation: "O Kind Beloved! Show the light of Thy countenance to the lovers and revive the yearning ones with the life-giving breeze. Give the living waters to the thirsty ones and bestow special gifts upon those attracted to Thee. Especially that family whose men were among the ancient friends and whose women were leaders among the handmaidens of the Merciful..."

Subject: prayer for specific individuals; groups
Quotation: O Lord! Immerse the handmaiden of Thy threshold, the mother of Rustam and his esteemed father, in the ocean of Thy mercy. Grant them dwelling and shelter under the canopy of Thy pardon and forgiveness, and favor them with Thy special bounties in the vicinity of Thy bestowals. Thou art verily the Forgiver, the All-Pardoning, the Merciful, the All-Merciful.

Subject: prayer for specific individuals; groups
Quotation: O Haji Abdul-Husayn, upon him be the Glory of God...O Lord! Thou seest him clinging to the hem of the robe of Thy generosity and holding fast to Thy sure handle and the cord of Thy Cause, O Lord of all names! Ordain for him what Thou hast ordained for Thy chosen ones, then send down upon him that which shall be a light unto him in all the worlds of Thy worlds.

Subject: prayer for specific individuals; groups
Quotation: I beseech Thee by the Manifestations of Thy signs, and the Daysprings of the lights of Thy Revelation, and by that which is hidden in Thy knowledge, to send down from the heaven of Thy bounty upon him who hath found Thee that which will cool his eyes, and tranquilize his heart, and give rest to his being, that the affairs of the world and what the nations possess may not trouble him.

Subject: prayer for specific individuals; groups
Quotation: My God, my God! This great company and mighty group has arisen to serve Thee and promote sciences with abundant resolve, without deficiency or weariness. Lord, accept from them this contribution and assist them with Thy hosts on the Day of the Covenant and make them mighty signs among all people. Verily Thou art powerful over whatsoever Thou willest and Thou art the Strong, the Mighty.

Subject: prayer for specific individuals; groups
Quotation: This is a servant whom Thou didst create from the elements of power and might... O Lord! Unite his scattered affairs, gather what is dispersed, cause his branch to grow, make his cloud to rain, spread his book, expand his breast, exalt his worth, illuminate his lamp, refine its glass, cause him to shine upon the horizons with the light of justice and fairness, establish him firmly in the earth

Subject: prayer for specific individuals; groups
Quotation: O my God! O my God! This, Thy servant, hath advanced towards Thee, is passionately wandering in the desert of Thy love, walking in the path of Thy service, anticipating Thy favors, hoping for Thy bounty, relying upon Thy kingdom, and intoxicated by the wine of Thy gift. O my God! Increase the fervor of his affection for Thee, the constancy of his praise of Thee, and the ardor of his love for Thee.

Subject: prayer for specific individuals; groups
Quotation: O Pure Lord! Draw near this ancient servant to the Supreme Horizon and honor this poor servant in the Great Kingdom. Quench this one who thirsts for favors from the Ocean of Beneficence, and assist this one who is turned to the horizon of Oneness with the confirmation of Thy Glorious Lord. And grant refuge to this wanderer in Thy lane, in the shelter of Thy aid and bounty, in this world and the next.

Subject: prayer for specific individuals; groups
Quotation: O Mirza Abdul-Husayn, upon him be the Glory of God, the Most Glorious! Lord, Lord! Strengthen Thy servant Abdul-Husayn, who is bound in servitude to Thy Most Great Name, to serve Thy Cause and hasten to the field of sacrifice through Thy help and favor, to proclaim Thy Covenant among all people, to propagate Thy Cause in all regions, and to spread the sweet fragrances of Thy holy gardens throughout all lands.

Subject: prayer for specific individuals; groups
Quotation: I beseech and implore God, exalted be His glory, to grant unto each one both outward and inward bounties, and sustenance both earthly and heavenly, and this will assuredly be answered through His generosity, which hath encouraged me, and through His bounty, which hath increased my certitude. And I implore God to bestow speedy recovery upon the honored beloved, His honor A.B., upon him be Baha'u'llah's [glory].

Subject: prayer for specific individuals; groups
Quotation: O Lord! Thou art the Strong, the Powerful, and Thy servants are weak and poor. Adorn them with the ornament of Thy strength and power. Verily, Thou art the Powerful, the Mighty, the Bestower. O Lord! Assist Thy Afnan through Thy bounty and generosity, then open before his face the doors of Thy grace and mercy - that whereby he may become known through Thy name, mighty through Thy might, and obeyed through Thy grace.

Subject: prayer for specific individuals; groups
Quotation: Your pure-hearted brother crossed the sea and arrived at the blessed, luminous Shrine. He circumambulated the point round which circle the Concourse on High. He laid his head upon the Sacred Threshold and sought assistance and bounty... I hope that by virtue of this prayer the greatest bounty will be attained and the mightiest blessing secured, closed doors will be opened, and scattered affairs will be joined together.

Subject: prayer for specific individuals; groups
Quotation: My God, my God! With all lowliness and brokenness, I cast myself upon the dust of poverty and need, and I commune with Thee with the tongue of my heart, with inner devotion, and with both hidden and manifest supplication, beseeching Thee to show loving-kindness to these noble and righteous ones - a kindness that will make them signs of Thy sanctification in all conditions and circumstances, O Thou Lord of Majesty and Grace!

Subject: prayer for specific individuals; groups
Quotation: O my God! Send down, O my God, on that day upon my father in his resting place that which will comfort his eyes and raise him to the ultimate reaches of Your mercy and the utmost bounds of Your grace and bounty. Likewise, include in all that we have beseeched You those households whose people have believed in You and were among Your worshippers, and those who believed in God and His signs and were among Your sincere servants.

Subject: prayer for specific individuals; groups
Quotation: Glory be unto Thee, O my God! I beseech Thee by Thy Most Great Name, whereby Thou hast guided the peoples to the shore of the ocean of Thy utterance and given them to drink of the Kawthar of attainment from the hands of Thy grace and bounty, to ordain for me through Thy Most Glorious Pen that which Thou hast ordained for the company of Thy chosen ones. Then send down upon me, from the clouds of Thy grace, the rain of Thy mercy.

Subject: prayer for specific individuals; groups
Quotation: This is Your servant who has submitted himself to the King of Your Oneness, who has humbled himself before the Presence of Your Singleness, who has believed in the Beauty of Your Unity, and who has supplicated to the Kingdom of Your Self-Subsistence. O my Lord! Answer his prayer, facilitate the fulfillment of his hopes, grant his request, bestow his desire, expand his breast, gladden his heart, and make him joyous through Your glad-tidings

Subject: prayer for specific individuals; groups
Quotation: O my God! These are servants and bondsmen whose innermost thoughts are pure, whose hearts are good, whose breasts and hearts are aflame with the fire of Thy love, whose cries in chanting the verses of Thy sanctification rise to Thy Supreme Concourse and Most Glorious Kingdom...Lord, Lord! Make them signs of Thy oneness in the world of creation and standards of Thy glorification waving in the winds of Thy confirmation throughout all regions.

Subject: prayer for specific individuals; groups
Quotation: O Lord my Creator, O my God, my Compassionate Lord! These Persians are ancient friends and true companions of the East. They are enamored and bewildered by Thy countenance, and lost and wandering in Thy path. For long years they gazed upon Thy radiant face and burned in the fire of love for Thee. Therefore open a door and bestow a ray of light that hearts may become as heaven and souls as rose gardens. Thou art the Mighty, Thou art the All-Seeing.

Subject: prayer for specific individuals; groups
Quotation: O my God, O my God, this is Thy servant who hath responded to Thy call, accepted Thy words and believed in Thy signs. He hath become versed in Thy proofs and evidences, enkindled with Thy fire, sought illumination from Thy light, and in the day Thou manifested Thyself - thunderstruck with Thy splendor - he prostrated himself at Thy threshold...O my Lord, aid him to carry out Thy will and Thy pleasure, and strengthen his loins by Thy grace and bounty, O Lord my God, The Most High.

Subject: prayer for specific individuals; groups
Quotation: O `Ali-Akbar Hakim, upon him be the Glory of God, the Most Glorious! I beseech the Kingdom of Thy most glorious mystery and the Dominion of Thy grandeur manifest in the visible things, that Thou look upon this servant with the gaze of Thy mercy, and turn toward him with the glances of the eyes of Thy oneness, and send unto him a breath from the breaths of Thy holiness, and comfort him in his loneliness, and quench his thirst, and cool his burning anguish, and remove his great distress

Subject: prayer for specific individuals; groups
Quotation: O my God! O my God! These are souls who have bowed their necks before Thy sovereignty, whose voices have been humbled by Thy grandeur, whose breasts have been dilated by the signs of Thy oneness, and whose hearts have been attracted by the fragrant breaths of Thy holiness. O Lord! Aid them through Thy confirmations, make them successful through Thy assistance, and send down upon them a blessing from Thy presence. Verily, Thou art the Mighty, the Powerful, the Supreme, the Self-Subsisting.

Subject: prayer for specific individuals; groups
Quotation: O handmaid of God, the supplicating Aftab, mother of Rahbar, upon her be the Most Glorious Glory of God! He is God! O thou who hast visited the gathering-place of the Supreme Concourse and the Most Exalted Station! We beseech the favors of the Lord of the Covenant that both Shamsu'd-Duha and Rahbar may ever remain safe and protected in the shelter of the Truth, and that thou too mayest ever be a manifestation of joy and delight beneath the shade of divine favors, and in the utmost enthusiasm and attraction.

Subject: prayer for specific individuals; groups
Quotation: O my God! This is Thy servant and the son of Thy servant. Illumine his sight with the vision of Thy holy signs, gladden his heart with the sweet fragrances from the gardens of Thy Kingdom of intimacy, expand his breast through Thy confirmation, purify his face for Thy generous countenance, and cleanse his hearing from all voices save Thy most sweet call from Thy most glorious Kingdom. Refresh his spirit with the breeze wafting from the source of Thy supreme favor. Verily, Thou art the Great, the Most Exalted.

Subject: prayer for specific individuals; groups
Quotation: O Lord! Thou seest one of Thy servants who was named Ali before Akbar raising his hands toward the heaven of Thy loving-kindness, beseeching from the wonders of Thy bounty that which shall adorn him with the ornament of Thy remembrance. [He is the one who] hath turned toward Thy horizon and acted according to what Thou didst command him in Thy Tablets. O Lord! Aid him to accomplish what Thou lovest and art pleased with, and ordain for him what Thou hast ordained for Thy loved ones in the latter and former days.

Subject: prayer for specific individuals; groups
Quotation: Say: Praise be to Thee, O my God, for having made me acknowledge the unity of Thy Being and the sanctity of Thy Self above the recognition of Thy creatures. I beseech Thee, O Bestower of bounties and Quickener of moldering bones, by Thy Most Great Name, to assist me to exercise justice and fairness. O Lord! Thou seest the monotheists in the hands of the polytheists who have broken Thy covenant and Thy pact and have surrounded Thy cities and lands. O Lord! Ordain for me and Thy servants the good of the hereafter and of this world.

Subject: prayer for specific individuals; groups
Quotation: O my God, my God! Verily Thy servant Hanna Dawud hath been set aflame with the fire of passionate love in Thy love, and hath emerged in the realm of existence with a power like the rumbling of thunder. He hath spoken Thy remembrance amongst the servants and become renowned throughout the land, while every envious one lieth in wait for him. O Lord! Protect him from the arrows of the corrupt ones and make him a brilliant sign shining upon the heads of all witnesses. Verily Thou art the Generous, verily Thou art the Mighty, the Bestower.

Subject: prayer for specific individuals; groups
Quotation: O Lord! This is a servant who has turned his face to the Kingdom of Thy oneness, who has been guided by the Fire kindled in the Tree of Thy singleness, and who has supplicated the Kingdom of Thy detachment, being assured of Thee and Thy signs, clinging to the cord of Thy favors, hoping for Thy help and protection, seeking Thy good-pleasure and yearning for well-being through Thy grace. O Lord! Open unto him the gates of joy, transform all his difficulty into ease, and grant him comfort in all affairs, O my Lord, the Compassionate, the All-Merciful!

Subject: prayer for specific individuals; groups
Quotation: O God! O You who attracts hearts through the magnet of love overflowing upon existence, who revives decayed bones through a spirit that refreshes hearts and souls, who shines with the Ancient Light upon the horizons of creation, and who gives everything a portion of Your vast mercy encompassing contingent being - I beseech You and implore You to look upon Your servant Vali with the gaze of Your hidden divine mercy, to envelop him with the grace of Your manifest bounty, and make him a brilliant star in those distant regions and far-reaching territories.

Subject: prayer for specific individuals; groups
Quotation: Through Mr. Zair Ardeshir, to Mr. Mehraban Pour Khodabakhsh and his esteemed wife, handmaid of God Dolat, upon them both be the glory of God. O ye two who are associated with the Supreme Threshold! Mr. Ardeshir, like a lion, made his way to the luminous forest and, like a fierce lion, reached these thickets. In this wilderness he roared, and at the Supreme Threshold he offered worship, and on your behalf he beseeched forgiveness and sought pardon. We implore the favors of the kind Lord that his needs may be fulfilled and his supplications in the court of the Lord of Signs may be answered.

Subject: prayer for specific individuals; groups
Quotation: O my God, my God! This is a servant who hath turned unto the Kingdom of Thy mercifulness, and placed his trust in the dominion of Thy oneness, and found solace in the fire kindled in the Tree of Thy unity, and hath been quickened by the spirit of communion beneath the shade of Thy divine Word. O Lord! Make firm his footsteps in Thy Cause, expand his breast through Thy light, gladden his spirit through Thy victories, spread through him Thy remembrance, make him speak forth Thy praise, clothe him in the robe of sincerity in Thy Cause, and through Thy grace admit him into the Garden of immortality.

Subject: prayer for specific individuals; groups
Quotation: O my Lord! I have traversed the desert, crossed the sea, until I reached the realm of light. I became a dweller at Thy threshold, sought refuge at Thy court. O Lord! Forgive my sins and make my heart and soul aware. Grant me steadfastness, open the gates of the exalted Paradise, make me a peacock of the highest heaven and bestow upon me colorful wings. Make me an ancient servant and adorn me with the ways of firmness and rootedness, that I may arise to serve Thee, burn and be content in Thy love, and play sweet melodies in Thy praise. Thou art the Bestower, the Kind, and Thou art the Forgiver of sins.

Subject: prayer for specific individuals; groups
Quotation: My God, my God! Praise be unto Thee for having caused me to hear Thy call, to behold Thy signs, and to recognize the Dayspring of Thy verses and the Dawning-Place of Thy clear tokens. I beseech Thee by Thy loved ones whom neither names could hold back from turning towards Thy most exalted horizon, nor could the doubts of men cause them to slip, to assist the children of the Friend to do that which beseemeth Thy days. O Lord! Withhold them not from the shore of the ocean of Thy bounty. Illumine their hearts with the lights of Thy knowledge and strengthen them to make mention of Thee and to praise Thee amongst Thy creatures.

Subject: prayer for specific individuals; groups
Quotation: My God, my God! Verily this handmaiden of Thine supplicates to Thee, relies upon Thee, and turns to Thee, seeking the encompassing of Thy merciful favors, the manifestation of Thy spiritual mysteries, and the dawning of Thy divine lights. O Lord, O Lord! Illuminate the vision of my spouse, expand his breast with the light of Thy knowledge, attract his heart to Thy manifest beauty, and gladden his spirit with the appearance of Thy radiant light. O Lord! Remove the veil from his sight, bestow abundant bounty upon him, intoxicate him with the wine of Thy love amongst all people, make him one of Thy angels walking upon the earth while his spirit soars in the heavens, and make him a lamp shining with the light of Thy knowledge among the concourse.

Subject: prayer for specific individuals; groups
Quotation: O King of Kings! Bless New York. Make the friends kind to one another. Sanctify the souls. Free the hearts. Illumine the realm of thought. Make the spirits joyous. Grant heavenly power and divine confirmation. Spread a merciful carpet that that city may become Baha-abundant, that New York may receive the blessing of the Abha Kingdom, that that land may become a supreme paradise, a divine garden, a heavenly orchard, and a merciful rose-garden. O King of Kings! Make Mrs. Krug a handmaiden of Baha, and make her illustrious daughter a brilliant light. Illumine that home and make that family the manifestations of endless favors, so that the handmaidens of the Merciful may arrange a feast with the utmost joy and fragrance and establish a celebration with complete delight and gladness.

Subject: prayer for specific individuals; groups
Quotation: Glory be unto Thee, O my God! Thou seest and knowest that one of Thy loved ones hath sought the shore of the ocean of Thy mercy, and hath drunk the choice wine of recognition from the cup of Thy bounty, and hath attained unto the presence of the Wronged One. That which he hath sent and that which he hath desired was for naught save to manifest his sincerity, humility, meekness, and his adherence to Thy verses and Thy robe in Thy days, and to that which hath appeared from Thee. I beseech Thee, O my Lord, by the Point through which the books of the world were distinguished, and by Thy Command whereby the nations were subdued, to make him a herald of Thy bounty unto Thy servants, and of the heaven of Thy generosity and the sun of Thy grace. O my Lord! Ordain for him that which will assist him in serving Thy Cause, then make him a champion of Thy Faith and a banner of Thy name amongst Thy servants.

Subject: prayer for specific individuals; groups
Quotation: At this moment when it is near sunset and all the people of the world seek rest and joy, Abdul-Baha with utmost faithfulness is occupied with your remembrance and engaged in writing this letter. He seeks no rest, desires no repose, and takes not a moment's ease. Ever remembering the friends, he is like a surging ocean in tumult, and offers prayers for the maidservants of the All-Merciful: O Lord! Make these handmaidens honored in Thy Kingdom of Glory, and accept these maidservants at Thy Holy Threshold. Illumine their hearts and purify their spirits. Make fragrant their nostrils that they may become worthy of Thy Most Holy Court and engage in worship, service, supplication, and utter humility and need. May they become quickened through Thy remembrance and attain everlasting life through Thy love. Verily Thou art the Generous, Thou art the Merciful, and Thou art the Mighty, the Kind, the Ancient Lord.

Subject: prayer for specific individuals; groups
Quotation: O my Lord, my Hope, my Refuge, my Resort and my Shield! Thou seest me raising my hands and extending my palms in utter supplication, helplessness and lowliness toward the Kingdom of Mysteries, and calling upon Thee in private and in public, O my Chosen Lord, to shower all Thy mercy upon these righteous ones, to support these excellent souls through Thy power, and to gladden their breasts through the effulgence of Thy lights. O Lord and Object of my desire! Hasten to aid them, dispel their sorrows, rejoice their hearts, perfect their happiness, and complete their light, that they may arise with all their powers to serve Thee amidst Thy creation, spread abroad Thy signs among Thy creatures, scatter the pearls of Thy remembrance upon the heads of Thy servants, and string the gems of Thy knowledge upon the necks of those souls who are drawn to Thy manifest light and are enkindled with the fire of Thy love amongst the worlds.

Subject: prayer for specific individuals; groups
Quotation: O honored pilgrim, Mirza Kazim, upon him be the Most Glorious Glory of God!

Subject: prayer for spiritual recognition
Quotation: O Heavenly Father! Make us successful in service to the Kingdom, acquaint us with divine mysteries

Subject: prayer for spiritual recognition
Quotation: I beseech God to ordain for us what He has ordained for His loved ones, for verily He is the Gracious, the Generous.

Subject: prayer for spiritual recognition
Quotation: O God! John is Your wanderer and Your helpless one. He has become estranged from himself to become acquainted with You.

Subject: prayer for spiritual recognition
Quotation: The entire text consists of prayers asking God to aid those who will recognize and believe in Him Whom God Shall Make Manifest

Subject: prayer for spiritual recognition
Quotation: I was astray - Thou didst guide me. I was blind - Thou didst give me sight. I was deprived - Thou didst made me privy to mysteries.

Subject: prayer for spiritual recognition
Quotation: I beseech You...to make me in all conditions turn toward Your most exalted horizon and hold fast to the cord of Your loving-kindness

Subject: prayer for spiritual recognition
Quotation: O Lord! I beseech Thee to ordain for Thy handmaiden that which shall profit her in this world and the next and in every one of Thy worlds.

Subject: prayer for spiritual recognition
Quotation: O my tender Lord! Cause me to enter into Thy laden Ark, and teach me Thy hidden mystery, and guide me to the shells of Thy treasured pearls.

Subject: prayer for spiritual recognition
Quotation: Grant me, by Thy Favour, O my Lord, that which shall profit me in this world and hereafter, and draw me nigh unto Thee, O Lord of all mankind!

Subject: prayer for spiritual recognition
Quotation: I beseech Thee by the lights of Thy Kingdom and the mysteries of Thy Dominion... through which Thou hast illumined the hearts of Thy servants

Subject: prayer for spiritual recognition
Quotation: Thou shouldst pray fervently and beseech confirmations from the Sacred Threshold that thou mayst succeed in meeting the prerequisites of divine love.

Subject: prayer for spiritual recognition
Quotation: The final portion is a prayer seeking divine knowledge - "I beseech Thee...to enable me to remember Thee and praise Thee and to stand firm in Thy Cause"

Subject: prayer for spiritual recognition
Quotation: Make her speak Your remembrance among Your maidservants and kindle in her heart the lamp of the lights of Your oneness and the mysteries of Your uniqueness

Subject: prayer for spiritual recognition
Quotation: I implore Thee, O my Lord, by whatsoever is of Thee, to send, from the right hand of Thy might, that which will exalt Thy loved ones and abase Thine enemies

Subject: prayer for spiritual recognition
Quotation: Praise be unto Thee, O Lord of all possibilities, for having adorned me with the ornament of recognition and illumined my heart with the light of utterance.

Subject: prayer for spiritual recognition
Quotation: O Just Lord! O God of loving-kindness! We are saplings in Thy garden, planted by the hand of Thy mercy, and upon our brows is inscribed the mark of Thy love.

Subject: prayer for spiritual recognition
Quotation: "One gleam from Thy face divine One melody from Thy sacred shrine Sweet fragrance from those locks of Thine One whiff of Thy presence fine Bestow on us from grace divine"

Subject: prayer for spiritual recognition
Quotation: Make me, O my God, among the people of Thy Cause who desire truth through truth and establish truth through truth, for besides this they have neither knowledge nor portion.

Subject: prayer for spiritual recognition
Quotation: O Lord! Expand the breasts of the sincere ones through witnessing the manifest light, heal the hearts of the unitarians with the cup of Thy grace overflowing with the living waters

Subject: prayer for spiritual recognition
Quotation: O Thou kind Lord! Grant us Thy bounty, illumine our hearts, make our eyes seeing, make our ears hearing, and suffer us to enter Thy kingdom. Thou art the Almighty, the All-Powerful.

Subject: prayer for spiritual recognition
Quotation: O Lord, Lord! We are powerless, and Thou art the Almighty, the Omnipotent. We are lowly, and Thou art the Exalted, the Glorious. We are poor, and Thou art the Wealthy, the Generous.

Subject: prayer for spiritual recognition
Quotation: Therefore, O my God, I beseech Thee at this moment to sever every soul from that which veils it from Thee in Thy presence, and to grant every soul that which draweth it nigh unto Thee

Subject: prayer for spiritual recognition
Quotation: O my God! Aid me through Thy grace and mercy, and cause me to speak Thy praise amongst Thy creation... Guide them to the straight path, delight their eyes with beholding Thy manifest light

Subject: prayer for spiritual recognition
Quotation: Verily, I beseech the manifest horizon that the Lord of the worlds may lead thee to the living waters, that thy thirst may be quenched, and thy burning desire cooled, and thy ailment healed.

Subject: prayer for spiritual recognition
Quotation: I ask the Blessed Beauty to assist you and confirm you. I beg of God that you may become more enlightened, more severed, more spiritual, more aflame and that you may be humble and submissive.

Subject: prayer for spiritual recognition
Quotation: O my Lord! O my Lord! Thou hast caused me to hear the Call, guided me unto the sea of favor, awakened me through Thy fragrance breeze, and quickened me by the spirit of Thy greatest guidance.

Subject: prayer for spiritual recognition
Quotation: O God, I entreat Thee by Thy divine sweetness to make my testimony a lamp unto my heart, and a source of light and illumination unto my face and my soul, in this world and in the world to come

Subject: prayer for spiritual recognition
Quotation: My God, my God! Illumine the hearts of Thy loved ones with the lights of Thy utterance and adorn them with that which will draw them nigh unto the court of Thy glory and the carpet of Thy grandeur.

Subject: prayer for spiritual recognition
Quotation: The closing prayer beginning with "My God, my God! I testify to that which Thy Most Exalted Pen and the Tongue of Thy Grandeur have spoken..." constitutes a powerful prayer for spiritual recognition

Subject: prayer for spiritual recognition
Quotation: O Lord! Confer upon this Thy servant and upon me the supreme bounty of being pleased with every soul and pleasing unto all. I beseech God to grant that we may both render service at His holy Threshold.

Subject: prayer for spiritual recognition
Quotation: My God, my God! You know what lies hidden in my heart and the depths of my being...Grant me the blessing of witnessing and attaining Your presence and entering beneath the shade of Your uttermost Tree.

Subject: prayer for spiritual recognition
Quotation: My God, my God! Adorn my heart with the ornament of Thy love, my tongue with Thy remembrance and praise, mine eyes with beholding Thy horizon, and my face with turning toward the lights of Thy countenance.

Subject: prayer for spiritual recognition
Quotation: Assist him to make mention of Thee and to praise Thee amidst Thy creatures, and cause him to speak forth Thy attributes and glorification in the gatherings of Thy oneness and the assemblages of Thy sanctification

Subject: prayer for spiritual recognition
Quotation: At midnight supplications and entreaties were offered at the Divine Court. I beseeched great assistance and bounty, that through pure bestowal He may grant such power that you may progress in all spiritual faculties.

Subject: prayer for spiritual recognition
Quotation: What thou didst write and the secret thou didst harbor became known and evident. The contents were replete with turning to the Kingdom of the Lord of Signs, and the meanings were supplication at the Divine Threshold.

Subject: prayer for spiritual recognition
Quotation: Grant me on that Day an all-encompassing knowledge. Grant me on that Day an intense love. Grant me on that Day an agreeable utterance. Grant me on that Day a pleasing speech. Grant me on that Day a mighty sovereignty.

Subject: prayer for spiritual recognition
Quotation: The prayer section beseeches God "by the light of Thy exalted and sublime countenance and the splendor of Thy exalted and mighty presence, that Thou say to what I have desired in the path of Thy love, 'Be!' and it is."

Subject: prayer for spiritual recognition
Quotation: O Lord my God! Send down Thy certitude into my heart, for it is more manifest than that I should seek evidence for anything besides it. For hadst Thou not created certitude within me, Thou wouldst not have decreed it for me.

Subject: prayer for spiritual recognition
Quotation: O Lord! This is a servant who hath turned toward the Kingdom of Thy oneness and hath been set ablaze and inflamed by the fire of Thy love in the heaven of Thy uniqueness...O Lord! Illumine his insight with the light of guidance

Subject: prayer for spiritual recognition
Quotation: I beseech Thee...to inscribe me with Thy Most Exalted Pen in the Crimson Book among those who have aided Thy Cause, who have bowed down before Thy Manifestation, and who have acted according to what they were commanded in Thy Book.

Subject: prayer for spiritual recognition
Quotation: Bless me, O my God, and those who will believe in Thy signs on the appointed Day, and such as cherish my love in their hearts -- a love which Thou dost instil into them. Verily Thou art the Lord of righteousness, the Most Exalted.

Subject: prayer for spiritual recognition
Quotation: My God, my God! I beseech Thee by Thy verses revealed at this time and by the station which Thou hast illumined with the light of certitude, to make me steadfast in Thy service, speaking Thy praise and clinging to Thy luminous robe.

Subject: prayer for spiritual recognition
Quotation: Praise be to Thee, O Lord of the world, and thanksgiving be unto Thee, O Beloved of the nations, for having illumined my heart with the light of Thy knowledge and adorned my temple with the ornament of turning unto Thee in Thy days.

Subject: prayer for spiritual recognition
Quotation: O my God, my God! Praise be unto Thee for having enabled me to recognize the Dawning-Place of Thy Revelation, the Dayspring of Thy signs, the Source of Thy Command, the Treasury of the pearls of Thy wisdom and the Heaven of Thy knowledge.

Subject: prayer for spiritual recognition
Quotation: Illumine the heart of this Thine servant with the light of Assurance, make firm his feet in the straight Path and Manifest Road and suffer him to drink from the Clear Spring and the Water of Tasneem. Verily, Thou art the Clement and the Merciful!

Subject: prayer for spiritual recognition
Quotation: O God, Thou knowest and art my witness that I have no desire in my heart save to attain Thy good pleasure, to be confirmed in servitude unto Thee, to consecrate myself in Thy service, to labour in Thy great vineyard and to sacrifice all in Thy path.

Subject: prayer for spiritual recognition
Quotation: O Lord! Thou seest the poor one hastening to the ocean of Thy riches, and the sorrowful one to the heaven of Thy grace. I beseech Thee to rain down upon Thy servant from the clouds of Thy mercy that which shall solace his eyes and tranquilize his soul.

Subject: prayer for spiritual recognition
Quotation: My God, my God! Praise and thanksgiving be unto Thee for having guided one among Thy handmaidens to the Dayspring of Thy Cause and the Dawning-Place of Thy grace, and for having given her to drink of the Kawthar of Thy knowledge from the hand of Thy bounty.

Subject: prayer for spiritual recognition
Quotation: Know ye the value of this station, and at times, with utmost supplication, visit the illumined grave of Shamsu'l-Vuzara on behalf of Abdu'l-Baha and light a few candles at that pure tomb, for this act is a cause of nearness to the threshold of the Almighty.

Subject: prayer for spiritual recognition
Quotation: O Lord! Plant this tender seedling in the garden of Thy manifold bounties, water it from the fountains of Thy loving-kindness and grant that it may grow into a goodly plant through the outpourings of Thy favour and grace. Thou art the Mighty and the Powerful.

Subject: prayer for spiritual recognition
Quotation: O my God! I beseech Thee by the scratching of Thy Most Exalted Pen and the Call that hath been raised from the Divine Lote Tree to grant me at all times the heavenly sustenance which hath been sent down from the heaven of Thy Will and the clouds of Thy Purpose

Subject: prayer for spiritual recognition
Quotation: Then ordain, O my God, for him and those with him, to attain Thy presence and to stand before Thee in the visible realm, and deprive him not of that which is with Thee... Then open before the face of him who desireth Thee the gates of Thy mercy and loving-kindness

Subject: prayer for spiritual recognition
Quotation: O Lord! Aid them with a new spirit and illumine their eyes with the witnessing of signs in the dark night and ordain for them every good in the Kingdom of mysteries and make them brilliant stars and trees laden with fruit and branches swaying in the morning breezes

Subject: prayer for spiritual recognition
Quotation: Praise be to thee, O God my Lord; I ask of Thee, by Thy prophets, Thy chosen and Thy redeemers, to send down upon me, from the heaven of Thy Bounty, Thy special Providence and Thy particular Mercy; and open, before my face, the doors of Thy gifts and blessings.

Subject: prayer for spiritual recognition
Quotation: I beseech Thee by the oceans of Thy mercy and the heaven of Thy favor, and by Thy Cause through which Thou hast guided the sincere ones to the ocean of Thy recognition and the unitarians to the sun of Thy bounty, that Thou aid Thy servants to remember and praise Thee.

Subject: prayer for spiritual recognition
Quotation: I beseech Thee by Thy Pen through which Thou didst give life to all worlds, and by Thy Name through which Thou didst create the heavens and the earths, to aid those who have turned unto Thee and have entered the stronghold of Thy Cause, detached from all who dwell on earth

Subject: prayer for spiritual recognition
Quotation: O my God and my Lord! These are servants who have sought refuge at the gate of Thy oneness and have been illumined by the fire of Thy love, kindled in the Tree of Sinai of Thy guidance, and have been enlightened by the light of Thy knowledge shining from the dawn of Thy bounty.

Subject: prayer for spiritual recognition
Quotation: O my God! This is a servant who has turned to the Dawning-Place of Thy oneness and the Recipient of the sign of Thy uniqueness...I beseech Thee...to assist this servant to discover the mysteries and the meanings of Thy recorded Book and Thy unfurled scroll and Thy preserved tablet

Subject: prayer for spiritual recognition
Quotation: Then assist me with every assistance encompassed by Thy knowledge and will, and raise me to a station wherein I shall hear naught except the wondrous melodies of the Dove of Thy holy oneness, and shall behold naught except the beauty of Thy creation, and shall turn to none besides Thee

Subject: prayer for spiritual recognition
Quotation: O my God, my God! I beseech Thee by Thy light that is never extinguished, by the fire of Thy love that is never veiled, and by Thy carpet that is never rolled up, to make me steadfast in Thy love, firm in Thy Cause, and upright in acting according to what Thou hast revealed in Thy Book.

Subject: prayer for spiritual recognition
Quotation: My God, my God! I have turned toward Thy Self when I was heedless of the wonders of Thy grace, and Thou didst call me when I was sleeping upon my couch in Thy days, and Thou didst remember me when I was silent in Thy remembrance, and Thou didst guided me when I was halting in Thy Cause.

Subject: prayer for spiritual recognition
Quotation: Today the rustling of the Divine Lote Tree is raised high, giving glad tidings to the people of earth and summoning them to the horizon of the Manifestation, the One Who conversed on Sinai. Blessed is the soul that has attained to hearing it and has become detached and free from all else.

Subject: prayer for spiritual recognition
Quotation: O my God! These hands of mine I have raised up for the descent of Thy mercy...I beseech Thee by Him Whom Thou hast made the Manifestation of Thy Self and the Source of Thy Being and the Repository of Thy glory, that Thou ignite us with the fire of Thy love and attract us through Thy light.

Subject: prayer for spiritual recognition
Quotation: O thou compassionate Lord! Praise be unto Thee that thou didst awaken me and raised me into consciousness. Thou didst give me a seeing eye and a hearing ear. Thou didst guide me to Thy Kingdom, led me to walk in Thy way, showed me the Straight Path, and caused me to enter the Ark of Salvation.

Subject: prayer for spiritual recognition
Quotation: And I beseech the All-Merciful, the Compassionate, to prepare the mighty cause and to establish the straight path, and to open wide before all faces the spacious gate, and to assist the sincere ones with the Great Spirit, and to illumine their insight through the outpourings of that glorious Day.

Subject: prayer for spiritual recognition
Quotation: "My God, my God, I testify to Thy oneness and Thy singleness, and to Thy might and Thy grandeur. I beseech Thee by the rustling of Thy Most Exalted Pen and by the fruits of the Sadratu'l-Muntaha to strengthen me in steadfastness in Thy Cause and in Thy remembrance and praise amongst Thy servants."

Subject: prayer for spiritual recognition
Quotation: I beseech You by Your Name through which You united the hearts of Your loved ones, made known to them Your path, and taught them that which draws them near to You in Your days, to make me in all conditions attracted to Your verses, detached from all else save You, and holding fast to Your mighty cord.

Subject: prayer for spiritual recognition
Quotation: Ordain for him the good of this world and the next, and assist him to remain steadfast in this Cause, at whose revelation the limbs of the learned and the princes have trembled. O Lord! As Thou hast called him unto the court of Thy grace, grant unto him that which Thou hast ordained for Thy loved ones.

Subject: prayer for spiritual recognition
Quotation: O my God, my God! Praise be unto Thee for having given me to drink from the hands of Thy bounty the living waters of Thy knowledge, and for having made known unto me the Dayspring of Thy signs, and for having guided me to the Most Great Ocean which hath surged in the world before the faces of all nations.

Subject: prayer for spiritual recognition
Quotation: Give the ears their share in hearkening to Thy call, and grant the eyes their portion of the lights of the Luminary of Thy Revelation. Besides Thee there is no refuge and never shall be. Aid us to detach ourselves from all else but Thee. May we see naught else save Thee, and desire naught else except Thee.

Subject: prayer for spiritual recognition
Quotation: At the Threshold of the Lord God, I made utmost supplication and lamentation that at least some comfort might be obtained for you. As long as the grace and favor of the Most Glorious Beauty is with us, be not grieved, be not sorrowful. The end will be the manifestation of favor and the appearance of bounty.

Subject: prayer for spiritual recognition
Quotation: O God! O Beloved of these enraptured ones and Goal of these bewildered ones! We are scattered - bestow upon us peace of mind. We are destitute - make us wealthy. We are afflicted - grant us healing. We are wounded and suffering - bestow upon us a balm. We are lost - guide us. We are thirsty - quench our thirst.

Subject: prayer for spiritual recognition
Quotation: O Beloved of these enamored ones, and Goal of these bewildered ones! We are scattered - bestow upon us unity of thought. We are destitute - make us wealthy. We are afflicted - grant us a remedy. We are wounded and in pain - confer upon us a healing balm. We are lost - guide us. We are thirsty - give us to drink.

Subject: prayer for spiritual recognition
Quotation: Glory be unto Thee, O God! Send down, therefore, from Thy presence upon the Letters of Truth, and upon all creation which Thy knowledge hath encompassed, that which shall cause them to enter on that Day into this Religion until the Day of Resurrection, and then on that Day into the Faith which Thou shalt inaugurate

Subject: prayer for spiritual recognition
Quotation: O thou Almighty! Glorify this one who longs for Thy Meeting in Thy Kingdom, and put on his head a crown of gift, clothe him with the garment of the most great guidance, bestow upon him an eloquent tongue and the gift of clear explanation, and show him the Power of Thy Kingdom and manifest to him the confirmation of the Holy Spirit.

Subject: prayer for spiritual recognition
Quotation: Glory be unto Thee, O my God! I beseech Thee by Thy Name, the All-Knowing, and glory be unto Thee, O my God! I beseech Thee by Thy Name, the Most Bountiful, and by Thy Most Great Name, through which Thou hast subdued the nations, to ordain for me that which Thou hast ordained for Thy chosen ones, Thy trusted ones, and Thy loved ones.

Subject: prayer for spiritual recognition
Quotation: I beg for thee from the Divine Threshold infinite bounty, and from the horizon of oneness I seek the dawning of the light of bestowal, that the cloud of mercy may pour down its rain, and the breeze of providence may waft, and the Sun of Truth may shine forth, and the field of heart and soul may attain boundless freshness and delicacy.

Subject: prayer for spiritual recognition
Quotation: My Lord and my Hope! Assist this servant in that wherein Thou didst assist me in servitude at Thy Holy Threshold. O Lord! Make his affairs easy, expand his breast, fulfill his hopes, strengthen his loins, forgive his burden, and make him a sign among the signs of Thy Kingdom amidst Thy creation. Verily, Thou art the Powerful, the Mighty.

Subject: prayer for spiritual recognition
Quotation: O Lord, Illuminator of the East and West, Lord of the two Orients! Aid Thy servant Husayn through Thy perfect grace and bounty. Admit him into the two dark-green gardens and let him drink from the two flowing springs, that he may become Thy greatest sign among all peoples and Thy supreme gift upon the earth, until he attains the Pleiades.

Subject: prayer for spiritual recognition
Quotation: My Lord! Assist Thy servant who has been illumined by the lights of Thy oneness from the lamp of Thy guidance, and has heard Thy sweetest call raised from Thy most glorious Kingdom. Strengthen him with mighty power, illumine his heart with the Greatest Sign, and expand his breast through Thy most exalted outpourings from Thy supreme heaven.

Subject: prayer for spiritual recognition
Quotation: O Lord! Delight their eyes with the vision of the lights, perfume their inner beings with the sweet scents of mysteries, and purify their consciences with the signs of light, that they may arise to serve Thee with such power as to shake the mountains, cause the limbs of men to tremble, and strike terror into the hearts of the mighty warriors.

Subject: prayer for spiritual recognition
Quotation: O my God! Deprive not Thy servants of the sweetness of Thy utterance, and withhold them not from that which hath appeared in Thy days. Take their hands with the hand of Thy power and deliver them from the ocean of vain imaginings, O Master of all names, and illumine them with the lights of the horizon of certitude, O Most Merciful of the merciful ones.

Subject: prayer for spiritual recognition
Quotation: O my God, my God! I beseech Thee by Thy unity, which none besides Thee hath fathomed, and by the stations of the Kaaba of Thy knowledge and the effulgences of the Sun of Thy wisdom, to protect Thy chosen ones and Thy loved ones from the cawing of the croakers, the doubts of the suspicious, the hints of the transgressors, and the onslaught of the oppressors.

Subject: prayer for spiritual recognition
Quotation: O spiritual youth and luminous son! Arise, turning thy face toward the divine horizon, supplicating to the heavenly Kingdom, submitting humbly and meekly to the divine Dominion. With a heart detached, a spirit directed heavenward, a soul attracted, and aflame with the fire that was kindled on Mount Sinai, seek the outpourings of the Spirit from all directions.

Subject: prayer for spiritual recognition
Quotation: My God, my God! Praise be to Thee for having brought me forth from the loins of one of Thy loved ones. I beseech Thee, O Creator of dawn and Sender of winds, to assist me to be steadfast in Thy Cause and in that which draws me near to Thee in all conditions. O Lord! I have turned to Thee and I ask Thee by Thy power to open before my face the door of Thy favors.

Subject: prayer for spiritual recognition
Quotation: Illumine the hearts with a brilliant ray from Thy Kingdom of Oneness, delight the eyes with beholding the signs of Thy mercy, and gladden the ears with hearing the melodies of the birds of Thy confirmation in the garden of Thy mercy, until they become like thirsty fish swimming in the pools of Thy guidance and like red lions roaring in the thickets of Thy bounty.

Subject: prayer for spiritual recognition
Quotation: My God, my God! Praise be to Thee for having called me unto Thee and drawn me nigh unto the ocean of Thy bounty and shown me that which was hidden from most of Thy servants. My God, my God! I testify that through the breathings of Thy revelation the world hath been perfumed. I beseech Thee not to withhold me and Thy loved ones from the outpourings of Thy wondrous Day.

Subject: prayer for spiritual recognition
Quotation: Glory be unto Thee, O my God! Have mercy, then, upon those who have previously entered into Thy Faith and upon those who will enter into that Faith, that Thou mayest draw them unto Thy Cause and enable them to recognize Thy Self, that they may testify before Thee that there is none other God but Thee, the Lord of the heavens and the Lord of the earth, the Lord of all worlds.

Subject: prayer for spiritual recognition
Quotation: Therefore, O God, make firm our hearts in Thy unity, for we have accepted Thee as Lord - Glory be unto Thee, there is no God but Thee, in truth, in truth. And send down upon our spirits that which will give them rest in Thy praise...and that which will give peace to our souls from the Manifestations of the lights of Thy countenance and the leaves of the Tree of Thine eternity.

Subject: prayer for spiritual recognition
Quotation: O Lord! He has taken refuge in the cave of Thy help and care, and sought shelter in the protection of Thy preservation and guardianship, and fled to the fortress of Thy safekeeping and defense...and quicken his heart with the sweet fragrances of Thy holiness, and expand his breast with the breezes of Thy companionship, and revive his inner being with the gentle winds of Thy sanctity

Subject: prayer for spiritual recognition
Quotation: O God, my God! This is a pure, refined and delicate reality, deriving illumination from the effulgence of Thy knowledge, receiving bounties from the Word of Thy Oneness, and supplicating to the Kingdom of Thy mercy. O Lord! Prepare for it the means of its growth, make its affairs easy, expand its breast, and make it Thy brilliant sign in those regions and Thy clear evidence in those parts.

Subject: prayer for spiritual recognition
Quotation: Glory be unto Thee, O my God! Grant me on that Day a resplendent glory. Glory be unto Thee, O my God! Grant me on that Day a brilliant light. Glory be unto Thee, O my God! Grant me on that Day an exalted loftiness. Glory be unto Thee, O my God! Grant me on that Day a radiant splendor. Glory be unto Thee, O my God! Grant me on that Day great names, for verily Thou art powerful over all things.

Subject: prayer for spiritual recognition
Quotation: O Lord, Sustainer of the poor! O Thou Who art self-sufficient! I was the essence of poverty, and Thou didst guide me to inexhaustible treasure. I was in want, and Thou didst led me to absolute wealth. I was abased, and Thou didst make me honored in Thy Kingdom. I was lost, and Thou didst bring me to Thy path. I was in darkness, and Thou didst illumine my sight with the light of Thy countenance.

Subject: prayer for spiritual recognition
Quotation: Send down, therefore, from the heaven of Thy love upon us the water of bounties, and bestow upon us the signs of majesty, for Thou art abundant in favors, mighty in power, possessed of strength and might, the Lord of bounty and beauty. Quicken, then, these decayed bones through Thy grace, O Lord of names and attributes, and illumine these darknesses through Thy favor, O Lord of earth and heaven.

Subject: prayer for spiritual recognition
Quotation: My God, my Protector, my Refuge, and my Helper! I commune with Thee in this daylight hour, supplicating toward Thy most exalted horizon, seeking shelter in the most faithful cave, and imploring assistance at Thy luminous threshold. O Lord! These are indeed pious servants who have heard the Call and responded to the Summons, saying Our Lord! We have believed, so forgive our sins and conceal our faults.

Subject: prayer for spiritual recognition
Quotation: O my God, my Lord, my Support, the Ultimate Goal of my desire, my Hope and the End of my aspirations! Thou seest me having departed from my homeland, making for Thy most exalted Station and Thy most glorious Horizon, that I might attain presence before Thy countenance, and find the breathings of Thy revelation, and hear the scratching of Thy Most Exalted Pen, and behold the horizon of manifestation

Subject: prayer for spiritual recognition
Quotation: Cause then, O my God, their hearts to be pure, their vision clear, and their hearing keen, that they may hear Thy verses with their own ears and not through the ears of others, and behold Thy beauty with their own eyes and not through the eyes of those besides them, and soar to the Most Luminous Horizon on the wings of their love, and ascend to the Most Exalted Horizon through the fire of their affection

Subject: prayer for spiritual recognition
Quotation: O Lord! Ordain for him whom Thou hast caused to enter Thy paradise that Thou shouldst cause him to enter into the manifestation of Him Whom Thou shalt make manifest on the Day of Resurrection through the signs of Thy power, that the fruits of what was created in that paradise might be made manifest on the Day when he shall be presented before Thee in Thy Most Exalted Paradise and Thy Most Glorious Manifestations.

Subject: prayer for spiritual recognition
Quotation: I beseech Thee, by the splendors of the lights of the Sun of Thy unity and the waves of the ocean of Thy bounty, to ordain for me from Thy Most Exalted Pen that which will draw me nigh unto Thee in all conditions...I beseech Thee, O God of Names and Creator of heaven, by Thy Most Great Name, the Most Glorious, to make me a servant of Thy Cause, and one who speaketh Thy praise, and one who gazeth upon Thy countenance.

Subject: prayer for spiritual recognition
Quotation: Suffer me not, O God, my God, to be kept back from the heaven of Thy bounties and the day-star of Thy favours. I beseech Thee by that Word through which Thou hast subdued all things visible and invisible to assist me and to assist Thy chosen ones to accomplish that which shall exalt Thy Cause amidst Thy servants and throughout Thy regions. Do Thou ordain for me, then, every good thing which Thou hast sent down in Thy Book.

Subject: prayer for spiritual recognition
Quotation: O God! O God! Thou dost behold me, how my forehead is laid upon the dust of humility and submission and how my face is covered in the ground of the threshold of thy singleness. O thou my Lord, the Unconstrained! Thou seest me lowly and contrite, supplicating, entreating and imploring toward the Kingdom of thy light by day and by night, that thou encircle us with the eye of thy providence and the glances of the outlook of thy mercifulness.

Subject: prayer for spiritual recognition
Quotation: My God, my God! Deprive not mine eyes from beholding the signs of Thy power in all things, nor mine ears from hearing the movement of Thy Pen in the kingdom of creation. O my Lord! This is Thy Day which Thou hast adorned with the manifestations of Thy grace and the revelations of Thy justice. I beseech Thee not to disappoint Thy servant from gazing toward Thy horizon, nor to withhold those who seek Thee from entering the precincts of Thy mercy.

Subject: prayer for spiritual recognition
Quotation: O thou who art mentioned before the Wronged One! Thy letter arrived, and each of its letters and words was a truthful witness and an eloquent testimony to thy turning and devotion to the Lord of all beings. We beseech God, blessed and exalted be He, to manifest for thee that which He hath ordained from the Pen of His decree, to raise thee up through His Name among His servants, and to make thee a helper of His loved ones and chosen ones and His Cause.

Subject: prayer for spiritual recognition
Quotation: My God, my God! I beseech Thee by Thy power which has conquered all created things, and by Thy might which has encompassed all existence, to assist me in that which Thou lovest and art pleased with, and to enable me to perform good deeds and display praiseworthy character. O Lord! Thou seest the seeker standing before the door of Thy grace - deprive him not of the wonders of Thy bounty and generosity. Ordain for him the good of this world and the next.

Subject: prayer for spiritual recognition
Quotation: "My God, my God! I beseech Thee by the oceans of Thy mercy and showers of Thy bounty and the effulgences of the lights of the Orb of Thy grace, to make me so detached from all else save Thee that I may move only through the breezes of Thy will and speak only through Thy bidding. Verily, Thou art powerful over whatsoever Thou willest. There is none other God but Thee, the Mighty, the Great."

Subject: prayer for spiritual recognition
Quotation: O my God! Thou hast exalted Thyself through Thy Most Great Manifestation evident in the horizon of Thy verses and Thou hast glorified Thy being through the Beauty of Thy most gracious Name manifest in the realm of Thy perspicuous signs. Blind are the eyes that behold not the traces of Thy sovereign power which has embraced all daysprings of existence and deaf are the ears that hear not Thy call in this Promised Day. Great is their loss in not attaining that special gift.

Subject: prayer for spiritual recognition
Quotation: O Lord, my Hope, my Refuge, my Shelter, my Asylum, and my Haven! How often do I commune with Thee, O my God, in the depths of night, and Thou art the One Who heareth those who call. How often do I supplicate Thee with humility, contrition and hope that Thou wouldst kindle and illumine the fire of guidance in the Sinai of the hearts of humanity, and cause them to drink from the clear waters that stream from heaven, whereby the thirst of the hearts of the chosen ones may be quenched.

Subject: prayer for spiritual recognition
Quotation: O my God, my Lord, my Support! Thy servant testifies at this hour that Thou hast desired for Thy servants naught save their purification from the desires of self and passion, and their adornment with the light of righteousness and piety. O Lord! Aid Thy servants to draw nigh unto the court of Thy glory and to turn unto the lights of Thy countenance. Verily Thou art the One Who hath power over whatsoever He willeth. There is none other God but Thee, the Single, the One, the All-Knowing, the All-Wise.

Subject: prayer for spiritual recognition
Quotation: My God, my God! I testify that before Thy Most Great Name all names have bowed down, and before Thy Command the earth and heaven have submitted.
