I beseech Thee by the light that shineth forth from the horizon of the heaven of Thy will, and by the Word whereby Thou hast illumined the hearts of Thy loved ones, to number me among such as have not been hindered by the censure of the censurers from turning to the lights of Thy countenance, nor by the scorn of the aggressors from drawing nigh unto Thy horizon.

Subject: prayer for spiritual recognition
Quotation: O thou who hast turned to the loving Lord! Raise thy hands in supplication to the threshold of the compassionate Lord and say: O Lord, Succorer of the poor! O Thou Who art free from all need! I was absolute poverty, and Thou didst guide me to inexhaustible treasure. I was in want, and Thou didst lead me to absolute wealth. I was abject, and Thou didst make me honored in Thy Kingdom. I was lost, and Thou didst bring me to Thy path. I was in darkness, and Thou didst illumine my sight with the light of Thy countenance.

Subject: prayer for spiritual recognition
Quotation: O my God! I beseech Thee by the lights of Thy countenance and the signs of Thy grandeur to aid me in all conditions to remember Thee, to praise Thee and to serve Thy loved ones. Glorified art Thou, O my God and the God of all things, my Beloved and the Beloved of the hearts of the chosen ones! I beseech Thee by the hearts that have melted in their love and ardor for Thee, and by the hearts that have been consumed in their separation from Thee, to ordain for me that which shall profit me in all the worlds of Thy worlds.

Subject: prayer for spiritual recognition
Quotation: O merciful and forgiving God! You are the Lord and Creator. Cover our faults, bestow Your gifts, set aside justice and show grace, give life and make us steadfast, remove estrangement and grant unity, let us drink from the chalice and taste the wine of the Supreme Concourse, make us intoxicated and enraptured, make us prosperous and flourishing, illumine the chambers of hearts and fill the garden of souls with roses and jasmine, grant the confirmations of the Abha Kingdom and bestow the victory of the Supreme Concourse.

Subject: prayer for spiritual recognition
Quotation: Lord! They are Thy sincere servants, Thy tested bondsmen, Thy faithful captives, constant in their servitude to Thee, steadfast in Thy Covenant, submissive to Thy sovereignty, humble before Thy proof, speaking Thy praise, gazing upon Thy gracious countenance, walking Thy straight path, and enduring painful torment out of love for Thy radiant beauty and longing to meet Thee in the Paradise of Delight. Lord! Revive their hearts, purify their souls, expand their breasts, ordain for them Thy presence, strengthen them with hosts, and aid them against every relentless enemy.

Subject: prayer for spiritual recognition
Quotation: My God, my God! I beseech Thee by Thy confirmation to turn unto Thy horizon, to hearken to the scratching of Thy Pen and to witness Thy signs. I beseech Thee by Thy fire whereby Thou didst guide them that drew nigh unto the Sinai of Thy knowledge and gave them to drink the Kawthar of proof from the hand of Thy bounty, and by the mysteries of the ocean of Thy wisdom and the pearls of the sea of Thy knowledge, that Thou wilt aid Thy servants to be fair in Thy Cause, that they may hear the rustling of the Divine Lote-Tree with their ears and behold its fruits with their eyes.

Subject: prayer for spiritual recognition
Quotation: My God, my God! I beseech Thee by the station honored by Thy footsteps, and by the Names which have won the glances of Thine eyes of grace, and by the House wherein was raised Thy most sweet call and the most exalted scratching of Thy Pen - by Thy might, the lovers have been consumed by the fire of remoteness in Thy days. The force of separation hath so seized them that their spirits have well nigh departed from their bodies. Look, O my God, upon those who seek Thee with the eyes of Thy mercy, and deliver them from the torment of remoteness through the grace of Thy nearness.

Subject: prayer for spiritual recognition
Quotation: My God, my God! These are servants who have walked the path of guidance, avoided error and transgression, turned to the Kingdom of the Most Beautiful Names, hastened to the shade of the pavilions of glory in the blessed spot, and have drunk the purest wine from the elegant cup passed round by the hand of grace in the gathering of reunion. My God, my God! The eyes have been solaced by beholding the Beauty, necks have bowed before the might of the Glory, ears have delighted in hearing the melodies in the verdant gardens, and hearts have been gladdened by the outpouring grace from the Kingdom of mysteries.

Subject: prayer for spiritual recognition
Quotation: My Lord! Aid me and Thy sincere servants in serving at Thy exalted threshold, in devotion to Thy merciful presence, and in humility before the gate of Thy oneness. O Lord! Make firm my steps upon Thy path, illumine my heart with a brilliant ray from the kingdom of Thy mysteries, revive my spirit with the wafting of a breeze blowing from the gardens of Thy pardon and forgiveness, gladden my heart with a fragrance diffused from the meadows of Thy holiness, make my face radiant in the horizon of the heaven of Thy unity, and make me one of Thy sincere servants and of Thy steadfast and firmly-rooted bondsmen.

Subject: prayer for spiritual recognition
Quotation: O God! O Bestower of gifts and Remover of veils, Thou Who aidest in guidance! Verily Thy servant, who supplicates unto Thee and implores in the darkness of blackest night unto Thy most exalted Kingdom, hath been overtaken by the intoxication of the wine of Thy love. The fire of faithfulness hath been kindled within his ribs and vitals by the breathings of Thy holiness. He hath turned to Thee with a throbbing heart and flowing tears, hoping that Thou wilt embrace him with the tender mercies of Thy compassion and remove from his sight every veil, that he may behold the lights of Thy oneness and witness the signs of Thy unity.

Subject: prayer for spiritual recognition
Quotation: Thou, Thou art our Lord! Send down upon this one who seeketh refuge at the gate of Thy oneness, from the outpourings of the heaven of Thy glorious unity, and attract him through the holy fragrances of Thy singleness. Expand his breast through the verses of Thy unity, illumine his sight through witnessing the signs of Thy sanctity, loose his tongue in Thy remembrance, raise his call in Thy praise and glorification, perfume his nostrils with the sweet scents of Thy knowledge, and make his soul fragrant with the aroma of Thy bounty. Verily, Thou art the Giver, the Compassionate to all who are faithful to Thy Covenant and Testament.

Subject: prayer for spiritual recognition
Quotation: O Lord of all names and Creator of the heavens! I beseech Thee by those whom neither the world nor its ornaments, nor its beauty, nor its glory, nor its might, nor its riches prevented from hearing Thy call, who said Yea, yea, O Lord of the mighty throne and the exalted seat! and whom the attraction of the call seized in such wise that they hastened to the place of sacrifice out of love for Thy beauty, that Thou make me in all conditions to stand firm in Thy service, to speak Thy praise, to gaze toward Thy horizon, to hearken unto the wonders of Thy verses, to hold fast unto the cord of Thy care, and to cling to the hem of the robe of Thy grace and bounty.

Subject: prayer for spiritual recognition
Quotation: My God, my God! Thou seest me turning unto Thee, clinging to the cord of Thy bounty, holding fast to the hem of the robe of Thy grace and favour. I beseech Thee by Thy Most Great Name through which Thou hast subdued the world and its peoples, and by the pearls of the ocean of Thy mercy and the splendors of the orb of Thy grace, and by Thy Prophets and Thy chosen ones, and by Him through Whom the breezes of revelation were stilled and the inspirations of divine grace were ended, to ordain for me that which Thou hast ordained for Thy trusted ones whom neither the treasures of the world could withhold from turning unto Thee nor the ascendancy of nations from drawing nigh unto the court of Thy holiness.

Subject: prayer for spiritual recognition
Quotation: O our Most Exalted Lord and our Most Glorious Beloved! The fire of ardent love has been kindled in our beings, the tribulations of sorrow have intensified, the winds of tests have risen, and the seas of trials have surged. Protect us in the most impregnable fortress and guard us, through Thine all-seeing eye, from the evil of enemies. Admit us into the stronghold of Thy protection, O Protector of the weak! Cause us to enter with truth and to depart with truth, unfurl over us the banner of Thy great mercy, gather us beneath the shadow of Thy most exalted Word, and make firm our steps in Thy Covenant, O Cleaver of the seed and Creator of the seed! Make us signs of Thy oneness among the people and words of detachment among humanity, bearers of Thy hidden mysteries in the hearts of the chosen ones and guardians of Thy manifest verses in the highest horizon. Through us spread abroad Thy sweet fragrances, exalt through us Thy Word, and make us among Thy sincere servants.

Subject: prayer for spiritual recognition
Quotation: O kind Lord, O Thou Who art merciful and compassionate! Illumine this gathering with the light of Thy love, and quicken these souls through the breaths of the Holy Spirit. Bestow heavenly radiance and confer the greatest gift. Send down divine confirmations and grant spiritual revelations. Enlighten the eyes with the light of guidance and make the hearts like unto a blooming garden through Thine infinite bounties. Give the greatest glad-tidings unto the spirits and glorify the souls with Thy most great favor. O Lord! We are poor--bestow upon us the treasures of Thy Kingdom. We are lowly--make us mighty in Thy realm. We are homeless--grant us shelter and refuge in Thy protection. We are seekers--guide us through Thine endless favors. We are silent--grant us eloquent speech. We are powerless--bestow upon us the might of Thy Kingdom. O Lord, O Forgiver! Overlook our failings, grant Thy gifts, pardon our sins, teach us heavenly ways. Thou art the Giver, Thou art the Bestower, Thou art the Kind One.

Subject: prayer for steadfastness; obedience
Quotation: O my Lord! ... make me steadfast in Thy love and firm in Thy Cause

Subject: prayer for steadfastness; obedience
Quotation: I beseech Thee to aid me in that which Thou lovest and art pleased with

Subject: prayer for steadfastness; obedience
Quotation: I beseech Thee...to make me in the nights and days stand firm in Thy service

Subject: prayer for steadfastness; obedience
Quotation: to make this servant of Thine steadfast in Thy Cause and vocal in Thy praise

Subject: prayer for steadfastness; obedience
Quotation: O Lord! Pour forth upon me patience in this tribulation, make firm my feet in Thy path

Subject: prayer for steadfastness; obedience
Quotation: to cause me to turn my face wholly towards Thee, and to seek Thy shelter, and to be steadfast in my love for Thee

Subject: prayer for steadfastness; obedience
Quotation: Therefore, O Kind Lord, keep us firm and steadfast in Thy Covenant and Testament, that we may become the cause of his joy and fragrance.

Subject: prayer for steadfastness; obedience
Quotation: I beseech Thee to aid me to such steadfastness as cannot be hindered by the world and its hosts and its ranks and its ornaments and its colors

Subject: prayer for steadfastness; obedience
Quotation: I beseech Thee by the Word through which Thou didst created all contingent beings and brought forth all existing things, to assist me to be steadfast in Thy love.

Subject: prayer for steadfastness; obedience
Quotation: O God! Make me steadfast, constant and firm. Protect me from grievous tests and keep me safe and sound in the impregnable stronghold of Thy Covenant and Testament.

Subject: prayer for steadfastness; obedience
Quotation: O Lord! I beseech Thee...to make me steadfast in Thy Cause in such wise that the laws and principles of men shall not prevent me from Thy commandments and ordinances

Subject: prayer for steadfastness; obedience
Quotation: O my God, my God! ... to make me in all conditions a helper of Thy Cause, one gazing toward Thy direction, speaking forth Thy praise, and standing firm in Thy service.

Subject: prayer for steadfastness; obedience
Quotation: I beseech Thee...to ordain for Thy loved ones that which befitteth Thy generosity and bounty...and have sought from Thy grace that which shall make me steadfast in Thy love

Subject: prayer for steadfastness; obedience
Quotation: O Lord! Make their hearts firm in Thy Covenant, preserve them in the cave of Thy protection and shelter, guard them beneath the shadow of the wing of Thy preservation and safekeeping

Subject: prayer for steadfastness; obedience
Quotation: O my Lord! I beseech Thee by the ocean of Thy knowledge and the sun of Thy grace to aid me in all conditions to be steadfast in Thy Cause. Verily Thou art the Powerful over whatsoever Thou willest.

Subject: prayer for steadfastness; obedience
Quotation: O my Lord! Strengthen my limbs through Thy strength and Thy sovereignty and Thy might and Thy power, in such wise that the happenings of the world shall not prevent me from Thy remembrance and Thy praise.

Subject: prayer for steadfastness; obedience
Quotation: Do Thou clothe the hearts of Thy loved ones with the armor of steadfastness and assurance, that the arrows of the intimations of those who have disbelieved in the Sovereign of all possibility may not affect them.

Subject: prayer for steadfastness; obedience
Quotation: I beseech Thee by Thy Name, the Manifest, the Hidden, to assist me to act according to that which Thou hast commanded me therein...to ordain for me that which will make me steadfast in Thy Cause and firm in Thy love.

Subject: prayer for steadfastness; obedience
Quotation: My God, my God! I beseech Thee by that treasure which Thou hast deposited in the hearts of them that are sincere amongst Thy servants to make me steadfast in Thy Cause, firm in Thy love and standing ready to serve Thee.

Subject: prayer for steadfastness; obedience
Quotation: Therefore, O my God, since his hands are cut off from the mantle of Thy nearness and reunion with Thee, let not the cord of Thy loving-kindness and the handle of Thy favors be cut off from his heart... Then make his feet firm upon the path

Subject: prayer for steadfastness; obedience
Quotation: My God, my God! I beseech Thee by Thy Most Great Announcement and Thy Straight Path to ordain for me that which shall protect me from the oppression of the oppressors and the cawing of the croakers who have broken Thy covenant and Thy testament and have disbelieved in Thy signs.

Subject: prayer for steadfastness; obedience
Quotation: "O my Lord! ...I beseech Thee by the Most Great Word through which the earth was cleft asunder and the heaven was rent apart, to ordain for me from Thy Most Exalted Pen that which will make me steadfast in Thy Cause, holding fast to Thy cord and clinging to the hem of Thy robe."

Subject: prayer for steadfastness; obedience
Quotation: O Baha'o'llah! This is Abdul-Baha! Confirm Abdul-Baha in Thy Threshold! Strengthen him in loyalty to Thee! Make him self-sacrificing! Make him homeless, and without rest! Fill his heart with Thy love, so he will forget all else save Thee,--seeking no other comfort, grace, health or life, and sacrificing all for Thee!

Subject: prayer for steadfastness; obedience
Quotation: My God, my God! Strengthen the hearts of Thy loved ones lest the opposers prevent them from turning to the court of Thy might and the carpet of Thy bounty. O Lord! Aid Thy loved ones to hold fast to the cord of Thy grace and to detach themselves from all else besides Thee. Verily, Thou art the Mighty, the All-Choosing.

Subject: prayer for steadfastness; obedience
Quotation: O my Lord! Deal with me according to Thy grace and bounty, then protect me from those who have denied Thy Manifestation and turned away from Thy Beauty. Make me then steadfast in Thy love in such wise that the winds that blow from the hearts of Thy heedless servants and the polytheists among Thy creatures shall not move me.

Subject: prayer for steadfastness; obedience
Quotation: O Lord! O Cleaver of the dawn, Quickener of spirits, and Creator of forms! All doors are closed to me save the door of Your mercy, and all paths are cut off except the path of Your bounty... Rather, I beseech You with all humility and supplication: Increase, O my God, my tribulation in Your path, and ordain for me every affliction in Your love

Subject: prayer for steadfastness; obedience
Quotation: My God, my God! Thou seest me turning toward Thee and holding fast unto Thy cord. I beseech Thee by the Word which Thou hast made as a fire unto the polytheists and a light unto the monotheists, and by Thy power which hath encompassed all existence, both seen and unseen, to aid me to perform such deeds as shall diffuse the fragrance of Thy good-pleasure.

Subject: prayer for steadfastness; obedience
Quotation: O my Lord and my Hope! Help Thou Thy loved ones to be steadfast in Thy mighty Covenant, to remain faithful to Thy manifest Cause, and to carry out the commandments Thou didst set down for them in Thy Book of Splendours; that they may become banners of guidance and lamps of the Company above, wellsprings of Thine infinite wisdom, and stars that lead aright, as they shine down from the supernal sky.

Subject: prayer for steadfastness; obedience
Quotation: O my God! Praise be unto Thee for having caused me to hear Thy most sweet call which was raised from Thy most exalted horizon, and for having made me recognize the ocean of Thy verses and the sun of Thy bounty. I beseech Thee by the waves of the ocean of Thy generosity and the rain-clouds of Thy grace to assist me to remain steadfast in Thy love. Verily, Thou art the All-Bountiful, the Most Generous.

Subject: prayer for steadfastness; obedience
Quotation: May he remain unshaken by the tempests of trials and unperturbed by the storms of tribulation, becoming as a mountain firmly established in Thy Cause and as a tree firmly rooted in the garden of Thy knowledge, and as a lamp brightly shining with the light of Thy love. O Lord! Assist him in all circumstances and conditions, protect him from the wrath of the people of error, and aid him with hosts from the Supreme Concourse.

Subject: prayer for steadfastness; obedience
Quotation: When thou attainest unto My Tablet and that which hath been revealed from My Most Exalted Pen, say: Praise be unto Thee, O Creator of the heavens and Possessor of all names! I beseech Thee by the ocean of Thy verses to assist me to be steadfast in Thy Cause and to ordain for me that which shall profit me in Thy worlds. Thou art, verily, the Omnipotent over whatsoever Thou willest. There is none other God but Thee, the Ordainer, the All-Wise.

Subject: prayer for steadfastness; obedience
Quotation: O my God, my God! Thou seest me turning toward the ocean of Thy bounty, voicing Thy praise, and seeking the vast sea of Thy mercy which surgeth through Thy Name. I beseech Thee, O Thou the Goal of the world and the Best-Beloved of nations, by the Tree of Divine Utterance which speaketh before the faces of all religions, to make me steadfast in Thy Cause, firm in Thy love, and speaking that by which the hearts of Thy loved ones are attracted.

Subject: prayer for steadfastness; obedience
Quotation: O My Name! The Wronged One hath made mention of thee with such mention as cannot be equaled by all the bounties of the world and whatsoever is seen therein. Verily thy Lord is the True One, the Faithful. They that have wronged thee and commanded thy imprisonment - these have no portion in the Book of God, the Possessor of this luminous Day. Thou hast attained unto that which none hath attained except whom God, thy Lord, the All-Merciful, the Most Compassionate, hath willed.

Subject: prayer for steadfastness; obedience
Quotation: Blessed is the ear that hath attained to hearing it and the eye that hath been honored to behold His verses which hold dominion over all that was and shall be...I beseech Thee by Thy Name through which Thou didst change fear into tranquility and denial into faith, and by the ocean of Thy utterance and the heaven of Thy bounty, to ordain for me that which will draw me nigh unto Thee and make me steadfast in Thy Cause, such that neither the hosts of the world nor the oppression of the nations shall hold me back.

Subject: prayer for steadfastness; obedience
Quotation: I beseech Thee by the light of Thy mercy which hath illumined the earth and the heavens, and by the holy fragrances which have perfumed the horizons on this Day of Deliverance, and by the ocean of Thy generosity whose waves have mounted high and encompassed all existence, wherein are immersed the people of adoration, to strengthen this servant of Thine to be patient in tribulation, to be content with Thy decree, to endure in hardship and distress, and to turn toward the Concourse on High, that he may chant the verses of Thy praise in the most exalted gatherings and arise with all his strength to worship Thee in the luminous sanctuaries.

Subject: prayer for strength
Quotation: O Lord! Strengthen me through Thy power to serve Thy Cause in such wise that the words issuing from the mouths of Thy servants may not deter me, nor the doubts of Thy creatures and the intimations of the people of Thy realm sadden me. O Lord! I am weak and have turned toward the direction of Thy strength and Thy might.

Subject: prayer for strength
Quotation: O my God! My God! Aid this servant to exalt Thy Word, promote Thy Faith, diffuse Thy fragrances. Strengthen his back and reinforce his limbs. Make him a lamp gleaming with the light of detachment and a tree flourishing through the outpouring of Thy favors. Aid him against those who have violated the Covenant and Testament, and make him one who calls out Thy name in all directions. Verily Thou art the Generous, the Merciful, the Compassionate.

Subject: prayer for strength
Quotation: O Thou kind Lord! Bestow Thy grace; grant us victory; help us to be as soaring birds; make us fruitful trees laden with blossoms and fruit; enable us to become brilliant stars; grant that we may prove to be a mighty host. Though we are drops, yet do Thou make of us the waves of the sea. Though we are but atoms, yet do Thou make of us the gems and pearls of Thy treasury. Though we are lowly, yet do Thou make us precious in Thy kingdom. Though we are powerless, yet do Thou make us the manifestations of Thy strength.

Subject: prayer for strength
Quotation:
O my God, my God! These are the servants at Thy Sacred and Radiant Threshold, and the attendants in Thy Holy Court among all peoples, who speak Thy praise and gaze toward Thy horizon, who chant Thy verses and promote Thy Faith, who guide Thy creation and protect Thy Law, who guard Thy Mighty Fortress and are soldiers of Thy Great Strongholds through Thy confirmation, O Lord of the Worlds! Lord! Lord! Strengthen them through Thy divine power and Thy merciful gift and Thy radiant angels and Thy mystic inspirations and Thy celestial outpourings.  AB09614
O Lord! Bestow wings upon this bird whose feathers are broken, and grant power and strength to this helpless servant. Raise up this fallen one from the dust of impotence and lamentation, and through the breaths of Thy Kingdom make this destitute one glorious.

Subject: prayer for teaching
Quotation: I beseech Thee to enable me to serve Thy Cause in this Day

Subject: prayer for teaching
Quotation: that we may guide the peoples to Thy Most Great Name and lead the nations to the shore of Thy Most Glorious Oneness

Subject: prayer for teaching
Quotation: Assist us...until we may guide the nations to Thy Most Great Name and lead the peoples to the most noble shore of the sea of Thy oneness

Subject: prayer for teaching
Quotation: O Lord! Open unto him the gates of joy in this praiseworthy century until there flow from him floods in teaching Thy Cause to every zealous and grateful one.

Subject: prayer for teaching
Quotation: O God... I beseech Thee not to disappoint me from that which is with Thee, that I may arise to serve Thee in Thy kingdom and to spread Thy signs throughout Thy earth.

Subject: prayer for teaching
Quotation: O Lord! Aid those whom Thou hast reared by the hands of Thy grace and acquainted with Thy straight path and Thy mighty Message to proclaim Thy Cause with wisdom and utterance. Then grant them the sustenance of Thy heaven and the blessing which Thou hast sent down from the kingdom of Thy Will.

Subject: prayer for teaching
Quotation: O Lord, Lord! Breathe into his spirit the breath of the All-Merciful, loose his tongue in the field of remembrance and utterance, inspire him with the verses of guidance among humanity...so that he may guide the people of error to the path of truth, lead the parched and thirsty to the sweet waters

Subject: prayer for teaching
Quotation: Assist him while returning to raise aloft the banner of Thy Godhead in the utmost poverty and to raise up the Tabernacle of Thy Cause in the Ark of salvation, and with the utmost effort and greatest striving to diffuse Thy lights from the dawning point of creation and to spread Thine exalted Word amongst mankind

Subject: prayer for teaching
Quotation: O Lord! Aid these souls to exalt Thy Word among humanity, to diffuse the fragrances of Thy holy gardens throughout all regions, and to raise Thy remembrance throughout the earth until the cry of glorification and magnification rises to the Supreme Concourse. Verily Thou art powerful over whatsoever Thou willest, and verily Thou art the Strong, the Mighty.

Subject: prayer for teaching
Quotation: O Lord! Assist him with the hosts of the Supreme Concourse and support him with a company of the angels of Thy Most Glorious Kingdom, that he may conquer the fortresses of hearts and strongholds of souls with armies of life and hosts of salvation. Verily Thou art the Helper, verily Thou art the Confirmer, and verily Thou art the Mighty, the Powerful, the Self-Subsisting.

Subject: prayer for teaching
Quotation: O Lord of Names and Creator of heaven! I beseech Thee by Thy Most Great Name whereby the hearts of nations were stirred, and by the lands which were honored by Thy footsteps, and by the air wherein Thy call was raised, and by the spot which Thou didst adorn with Thy presence and didst make the Greatest Panorama among mankind, to assist me to serve Thy Cause among Thy servants with wisdom and utterance.

Subject: prayer for teaching
Quotation: O my God O thou who quickenest the hearts with the fragrance of the Covenant, O thou who dost illumine the eyes! Assist thy humble servant, submissive at the door of thy oneness, that he may raise up thy Word in these remote regions, that he may spread abroad Thy fragrance in Thy Path, and gather together the believers beneath the sheltering beams of Thy perspicuous light and dilate their breasts with the manifestation of thy assistance from the Abha Kingdom.

Subject: prayer for teaching
Quotation: O my God, my God! Aid Thy merciful servant and Thy Baha'i adherent to spread abroad Thy sweet savors, to set forth Thy proofs and Thine evidence, to establish Thy conclusive testimonies and expound Thy brilliant demonstrations through Thy grace, Thy generosity and Thy benevolence. Cause him to speak with most wondrous utterance in the gatherings of men, that his tongue may flow with proof like a torrent cascading from mountain peaks. Verily, Thou art the Generous, the Merciful, the Munificent, the Mighty, the All-Bestowing.

Subject: prayer for teaching
Quotation: O my God! O my God! Verily, Thy repentant servant hath turned to those far-reaching regions, those distant lands of vast expanse, detached from all save Thee, attracted to Thy remembrance, speaking Thy praise, firm in Thy Covenant and Testament. He calleth the people unto Thee and humbleth himself before Thee. O Lord! Assist him with the hosts of Thy angels in Thy dominion and the armies of Thy Kingdom on Thy earth. O Lord! Illumine his face with the light of Thy favors and inspire his heart with the signs of guidance amidst humanity. Verily, Thou art the Generous, Thou art the Great, and Thou art the All-Merciful, the All-Compassionate.

Subject: prayer for tests and difficulties
Quotation: O God! Severe are Thy tests and Thy trials demolish foundations stronger than iron. Guard us and grant us strength.

Subject: prayer for tests and difficulties
Quotation: O Lord! O Lord! O Lord! Relieve the distress of Thy loved ones among Thy servants and handmaidens, and remove their anguish through Thy bounty and grace.

Subject: prayer for tests and difficulties
Quotation: I beseech Thee therefore, O my Beloved, by Him Whom Thou hast made the Ruler over all contingent beings and the Sovereign over all who dwell in the earths and the heavens, that Thou mayest purify my heart from the whisperings of Satan

Subject: prayer for tests and difficulties
Quotation: "there was constant supplication and entreaty to the Divine Kingdom that He may preserve and protect the friends of God from all afflictions in the shelter of His protection and ordain means for you to be completely and quickly freed from debts to foreigners"

Subject: prayer for the Babis; people of the Bayan
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/prayer for the Babis; people of the Bayan.txt
Quotation: I beseech Thee to have mercy and to bestow Thy grace upon the people of the Bayan, protecting them from that which may descend upon them from the signs of Thy wrath and the tokens of Thy anger and the manifestations of Thy might in these dark, destructive, temptation-filled, blind, deaf, pitch-black and gloomy days.

Subject: prayer for the departed
Quotation: My God, my God! This is Thy servant who has turned to the Dayspring of Thy mercy...Verily, Thou art the All-Generous, the All-Merciful, the All-Bestowing.

Subject: prayer for the departed
Quotation: Lord! Honor their abode, make sweet their resting-place, and admit them to the sanctuary of meeting and the gathering of divine manifestation in the world of eternity.

Subject: prayer for the departed
Quotation: My God! My God! Verily Your servant Nazim was one who suppressed anger and forgave sins and harm... make his arrival praiseworthy and his advent blessed, and immerse him in the seas of Your favors

Subject: prayer for the departed
Quotation: O Lord! These servants are Your friends and these handmaidens are Your cherished ones at Your threshold...Grant them entrance to Your Kingdom and bestow upon them a nest and dwelling in the eternal garden

Subject: prayer for the departed
Quotation: O God! O Thou Who hast shed the light of forgiveness upon human temples...Verily Thou art the Merciful, verily Thou art the Kind, verily Thou art the Forgiving, the Loving, the Compassionate, the All-Wise.

Subject: prayer for the departed
Quotation: O God! I beseech Thee, O Light of earth and heaven, and I implore Thee, O Creator of all beings... Verily Thou art the Generous, Thou art the Forgiving, the Merciful, Thou art the Mighty, the All-Pardoning.

Subject: prayer for the departed
Quotation: O God! O Remover of afflictions and Dispeller of calamities! I implore You as a captive implores an omnipotent, transcendent King, and I beseech You as a sinner beseeches the Lord of forgiveness and pardon...

Subject: prayer for the departed
Quotation: O Lord! Give these wandering souls shelter and protection in Your care, and bestow eternal life upon these lifeless spirits so that they may soar in the heights of forgiveness and establish an everlasting foundation.

Subject: prayer for the departed
Quotation: My God, my God! Thou art the Succourer and Thou art the Helper...Make him to graze in the meadows of Thy forgiveness, [to wade] in the waters of Thy pardon, and to delight in meeting Thee in the paradise of Thy oneness.

Subject: prayer for the departed
Quotation: These pure, content and well-pleased souls were confident in Thy favors, relied upon Thy attributes, and trusted in Thy aid... O Merciful Lord! They were hopeful - let them not be disappointed. They were yearning - make them content.

Subject: prayer for the departed
Quotation: O my God, my Lord, my Support, and the Ultimate Goal of my hopes! This servant was stirred by the fragrances of Thy holiness... Admit him into the lofty chambers of the highest heaven. Verily, Thou art the Most Merciful, the Compassionate.

Subject: prayer for the departed
Quotation: I stretch forth unto Thee the hands of supplication and entreaty, and call upon Thee with utmost humility and contrition, seeking forgiveness for Thy pure and holy handmaiden...My Lord! Embrace this tranquil soul with Thy pardon and forgiveness.

Subject: prayer for the departed
Quotation: O Lord! Verily Thy pure handmaiden, who is related to Thy servant Muhammad-Qabli-'Ali who hath ascended to the kingdom of Thy mercy...O Lord! Ordain for her every good in the next world and send down upon her the outpourings of mercy from heaven

Subject: prayer for the departed
Quotation: My God, my God! A bird from among the birds of the gardens of mystical knowledge has soared to Thy sacred gardens...O Lord! Illumine his countenance with the light of forgiveness and pardon, and cause him to enter Thy Kingdom, O my Merciful Lord.

Subject: prayer for the departed
Quotation: "My God, my God! Verily Your servant Ishaq has fallen into eclipse and departed this first life, bequeathing to his family grief, sorrow, regret and anguish. Their eyes overflow with tears and the fire of mourning blazes within their hearts and ribs."

Subject: prayer for the departed
Quotation: O my God! O my God! These two pure souls have turned to the Kingdom of Thy mercy...Make their final destination the beginning of Thy favors, admit them to the pavilion of Thy holiness, cause them to abide eternally in the gatherings of Thy companionship

Subject: prayer for the departed
Quotation: O Forgiver! The wise servant of the court, Gushtasp, turned his face from this dark world and hastened to the realm above... O Lord! Teach him supplication and prayer, forgive his sins, kindle the lamp of bounty, and burn away the veil of vain imaginings.

Subject: prayer for the departed
Quotation: O Forgiving Lord! The bodies of these grateful birds have become imprisoned in the hidden grave while their souls have taken flight to the flourishing realm... Keep them steadfast and established forever. Thou art the Forgiver, the Bestower, the Kind One.

Subject: prayer for the departed
Quotation: O God, O Bestower of bounty! Forgive Khudadad and make Firuzih victorious. Make these two pure souls radiant, and in the realm of the celestial spheres make them joyous and glad. O Lord! They have found release from the world of dust and have taken refuge in Thee.

Subject: prayer for the departed
Quotation: I supplicate before Thee with heart, spirit and tongue, beseeching mercy, kindness, pardon and forgiveness for Thy Hand of the Cause, Thy servant Adib, the beloved and noble one...O Lord, permit him to enter the kingdom of lights and abide in the sea of mysteries.

Subject: prayer for the departed
Quotation: O Lord of great forgiveness and supreme bounty! Thou forgivest whomsoever Thou willest, pardonest whomsoever Thou willest, and transformest evil deeds into good ones for whomsoever Thou willest...I implore Thee to forgive Thy servant who was overcome by Thy mysteries

Subject: prayer for the departed
Quotation: O pure Lord! This servant of Your threshold was seeking You with heart and soul, and was striding in the path of Your love... Grant solace to his kind father and free his loving uncles from grief and sorrow. Console the hearts and gladden the spirits with forgiveness.

Subject: prayer for the departed
Quotation: O my God! This is Your servant and the son of Your servant who was set aflame with the fire of Your love and was attracted by Your holy fragrances...until his spirit ascended to the vicinity of Your mercy and soared to the Kingdom of immortality through Your grace and gift

Subject: prayer for the departed
Quotation: O Lord! Your servant who drank the wine of Your knowledge and whose breast was dilated through the light of certitude in Your Cause has ascended to You...Immerse him in the ocean of forgiveness and cause him to enter under the shade of the blessed tree in the highest paradise

Subject: prayer for the departed
Quotation: O my kind Lord! This ancient servant and old attendant was, from early childhood, nourished at the breast of Thy love...Make him successful in the vicinity of Thy gifts and the paradise of Thy presence, grant him Thy greatest bounty and make him a manifestation of endless favors.

Subject: prayer for the departed
Quotation: This prayer was written seeking forgiveness for the ascended leaf, the sister of that person...grant her the blessing of meeting Thee and give her to drink from the cup of Thy faithfulness and shelter her near the House of Thy oneness and settle her in the gardens of reunion with Thee

Subject: prayer for the departed
Quotation: My God, my God! Thou hast created souls from the essences of existence who believed in Thee and in Thy signs... O Lord! Illumine his brow with the manifest light of Thy forgiveness, make his face radiant in Thy glorious Kingdom, clothe him in the robe of pardon through Thy mighty grace

Subject: prayer for the departed
Quotation: Verily We make mention of thy son who hath ascended unto God and thy brother, as a token of grace from Us, and We are the All-Bountiful. We beseech God to forgive them both and to purify them and sanctify them and cause them to enter the Most Exalted Paradise, as a mercy from His presence

Subject: prayer for the departed
Quotation: Prayer for forgiveness for the maidservant Kudarz-i-Mihrban who has ascended to the mercy of God... grant refuge and shelter to that helpless wanderer... grant that yearning one entry to the pavilion, and make that lonely one the intimate companion of Thy near handmaidens at Thy threshold

Subject: prayer for the departed
Quotation: O Kind One! O Radiant and Resplendent Bestower! [Name] was wandering and bewildered in this world. Grant him order and arrangement in Thy world. He was without refuge or shelter - give him a dwelling and abode in the shelter of Thy Great Mercy...Thou art the Forgiver, the Illuminator, the Kind One.

Subject: prayer for the departed
Quotation: this is Thy servant whom Thou didst create by Thy will and sustain by Thy desire...And then he returned to his place in the dust, to a house where none would visit him again and no soul would accompany him and no companion would befriend him and no merciful one would show him mercy and no lamp would illuminate him

Subject: prayer for the departed
Quotation: O Lord! Verily, Thy servant Muhammad-'Ali beseecheth forgiveness for his father and sister who have answered the call and returned unto Thee with hearts assured of Thy grace and bounty. O Lord! Forgive them through Thy mercy which hath preceded all things, and admit them into the precincts of Thy most great mercy.

Subject: prayer for the departed
Quotation: O Forgiver! Make these servants radiant and cause them to be singers in the rose garden of the highest realm. Make them musicians in the heavenly feast, players in the arena of nearness and reunion, and ones who recline upon the eternal pillow of glory. Thou art the Giver, the Bestower, the Forgiver, the Kind One.

Subject: prayer for the departed
Quotation: My God, my God! ... O Lord of the Most Beautiful Names! Make his end in this journey a beginning of favors, grant him relief, make him the essence of chastity, admit him into the kingdom of mysteries, adorn his face with the lights of forgiveness, grant him the blessing of meeting Thee in the Garden of Paradise...

Subject: prayer for the departed
Quotation: I beseech God, blessed and exalted be He, to cause her to enter the Most Glorious Paradise, to send down upon her mercy from His presence and grace from His own Self, and to forgive her through His bounty which hath encompassed existence and through His generosity which hath encompassed all who are in the heavens and the earth.

Subject: prayer for the departed
Quotation: I beseech You by Your all-embracing mercy that encompasses the worlds of the unseen and the visible, and by Your compassion that preceded all created things before their existence, to forgive Your deceased servant...O Lord! Have mercy on the root for the sake of the branches, and forgive the father out of kindness to the children

Subject: prayer for the departed
Quotation: I beseech God to make thee the symbol of forgiveness, surround thee with mercy and bounty, make thy countenance bright, thy station exalted, and thy face illumined like the clear morn. Blessed is the one who delighteth his senses with the fragrance of the dust of thy luminous tomb. May the faithful visitors be perfumed therewith.

Subject: prayer for the departed
Quotation: Therefore, O my God, waft over him from the Ridvan of Thine eternity the breezes of Thy essence and the winds of Thy oneness, that he may know the mysteries of Thy uniqueness in the temples of Thy detachment...Then raise him up, O my Beloved, from the graves of heedlessness and gather him among the company of the unitarians in the gardens of Thy exalted spirits

Subject: prayer for the departed
Quotation: O my Lord and my Hope! I beseech the Kingdom of Thy mercy to forgive Thy servant who hath ascended unto Thee, who hath humbled himself before the gate of Thy oneness, who is broken before the glory of Thy divinity. O Lord! Overshadow him with the clouds of forgiveness, immerse him in the ocean of pardon and bounty, and cleanse him from the stain of disobedience.

Subject: prayer for the departed
Quotation: O Forgiving and Kind One! O Just One! The handmaiden of Thy threshold, Malaki, has hastened to the realm of purity. Therefore, make her soul radiant and immerse her in the ocean of Thy forgiveness, and grant her a portion from Thy grace and favor. Forgive her and bestow Thy loving-kindness upon her, and in the realm of mystery make her the companion of the angels.

Subject: prayer for the departed
Quotation: O Lord! Honor her dwelling place and immerse her in the seas of Your mercy and cause her to dwell in the midst of the garden of eternity in the realm of lights, the center of mysteries...Shelter her in the proximity of Your greatest mercy, cause her to dwell in the gardens of Your supreme paradise, illumine her face with the light of contentment in the highest horizon

Subject: prayer for the departed
Quotation: O God! A group of friends have hastened toward Thee and galloped from this world to Thy world. They walked Thy path, sought Thy good-pleasure, and spoke of Thy mystery. O Lord! Make Khusraw Rustam a companion of forgiveness, grant Makhmal Bahram repose in Thy shelter, and make Sarv Salamat a manifestation of pardon. Thou art the Forgiver, the Bestower, and the Kind One.

Subject: prayer for the departed
Quotation: O Lord! Bahlul was captive to Thy love in chains and fetters. Thou didst favor him with entrance at the gate of Thy mercy and arrival at the fountain of Thy lordship...O Lord! Give him to drink from a cup whose mixture is of camphor, admit him into the garden of happiness, make him immortal in the world of light, and grant him the blessing of meeting Thee in the eternal Paradise

Subject: prayer for the departed
Quotation: O God! O Forgiver of sins, the Pardoning, the All-Forgiving, the Benevolent, the Compassionate, the Merciful to His sincere servants! Verily Thou knowest that Thy steadfast loved ones have stood firm in Thy manifest religion...Give them to drink from the cup of faithfulness, gather them in the world of eternity, and grant them a lofty station of truth in the Most Glorious Kingdom

Subject: prayer for the departed
Quotation: O my God, my God! I commune with Thee in the hidden recesses of my heart and soul, and with my tongue, in the depths of night, beseeching and supplicating at the gate of Thy oneness, imploring Thee to immerse Thy servant who hath ascended unto Thee in the oceans of Thy mercy, to illumine him with the lights of Thy forgiveness, and to shower upon him from the clouds of Thy bounty.

Subject: prayer for the departed
Quotation: My Lord, my Lord! You see me with trembling limbs, shaking pillars, and quivering parts due to my grief from the calamities that have befallen the loved ones in these severe years and intense upheaval...Lord! Let him drink from the cup of Your generosity and give him to taste of the pure wine of Your pardon and forgiveness. Verily You are the Generous One, You are the Forgiving, the Merciful.

Subject: prayer for the departed
Quotation: This is a handmaiden, assured in faith, believing and tranquil, who hath turned to Thee and drawn nigh unto Thee, and through Thy grace and bounty hath been protected from the torment of the hereafter...Through Thy loving-kindness make honorable her abode, refresh her spirit with the sweet fragrances of Thy holiness, immerse her in the oceans of Thy mercy, and make her a sign of Thy forgiveness.

Subject: prayer for the departed
Quotation: O God! Send blessings upon Muhammad and the family of Muhammad through all that Thou hast brought into being, and send blessings upon Muhammad and the family of Muhammad through all that Thou hast willed...and send blessings upon Muhammad and the family of Muhammad through all that Thou hast ordained...and send blessings upon Muhammad and the family of Muhammad through all that Thou hast decreed...

Subject: prayer for the departed
Quotation: O Lord! O Thou Forgiver of sins, Bestower of gifts, and Dispeller of afflictions! Verily I beseech Thee to forgive the sins of such as have abandoned the physical garment and ascended to the spiritual world. O Lord! Purify them from trespasses, dispel their sorrows, change their darkness into light, cause them to enter the garden of happiness, cleanse them with the most pure water, and grant them to behold Thy splendours on the loftiest mount.

Subject: prayer for the departed
Quotation: O my God! I turn from praising Thee to asking Thy forgiveness, Thy pardon and Thy favour for the one who was related to Thee, who put his reliance in Thee, and who hastened unto Thee that haply he might attain Thy presence... O my Lord! O my Lord! Give him to drink from the cup of forgiveness; bestow upon him Thy kindness and favour; cause him to enter the Kingdom of Mercy, O Thou Lord of Grace and Bounty!

Subject: prayer for the departed
Quotation: O Lord! Grant him an exalted station in Thy most glorious Concourse, and a seat of truth in Thy most sublime Kingdom. Give him an abundant share of Thy pardon and Thy greatest forgiveness, that the cup of bestowal may overflow for him, the vessel of bounty may rain upon him, the clouds of faithfulness may pour down, and he may enter the gathering of reunion and become intoxicated with the wine of immortality.

Subject: prayer for the departed
Quotation: He was a captive of Your love and a guide to Your knowledge, one who walked the path of Your guidance and was immersed in the sea of Your grace, sincere in Your religion and steadfast on the straight path in Your way...O Lord! Embrace him with Your mercy that encompasses all created things, intoxicate him with the choice wine of Your gift with which You have given drink to the sincere ones in the highest Paradise

Subject: prayer for the departed
Quotation: Prayer for forgiveness on behalf of His honor the refined and wise one, his eminence Andalib... Grant him an exalted station and heavenly gardens of nearness, that he may take refuge in the hem of Your forgiveness in Your presence and enter the paradise of meeting You and be immersed in the ocean of Your pardon and bounty. Send down solace and comfort upon his family and protect them through Your generosity and mercy.

Subject: prayer for the departed
Quotation: O my God! Thou seest me in these vast and distant lands, far from Thy Most Exalted Threshold, with a bleeding heart and tearful eyes and inflamed inner being...Honor her resting place and facilitate her desires and grant her wishes and cause her to enter the gathering of divine manifestation until she is immersed in the light of the One Who manifests and wanders in the lights of beauty and abides in the kingdom of glory.

Subject: prayer for the departed
Quotation: O my God, my God, my Goal, my Beloved, my Hope! I beseech Thee by the Law of Thy power and the Dispensation of Thy Prophets, and by Thy Hidden and Treasured Name which hath been concealed from all eyes since the beginning that had no beginning, to send down upon this handmaiden of Thine and upon Thy male and female servants at all times that which will draw us nigh unto Thee and enable us to stand firm in our love for Thee.

Subject: prayer for the departed
Quotation: O Forgiving Lord! Jamshid Tirandaz has taken flight to Thy garden, that like the birds of the meadow he may raise his voice and melody in the rose garden of oneness, offering praise unto Thee and seeking repose beneath the tree of hope. O Thou Bestower! Make that blessed friend radiant like a star in the east of bounty and forgiveness, and cause him to shine forth bright as the luminous moon. Thou art the Bestower, the Kind, Thou art the Forgiving Lord.

Subject: prayer for the departed
Quotation: "O God, my God! These two illustrious brothers and sons, kinsmen of thy servant who hath been called away by the Divine Voice... O Lord! Uplift them to lofty grades, enter them in the whole Kingdom of Thy names and attributes, immerse them in the sea of Thy mercy amidst Thy paradise, increase for them Thy grace and bounty, and make them burning lamps in the globe of Thy Kingdom and signs shining with the light of Thy forgiveness in the Celestial Threshold."

Subject: prayer for the departed
Quotation: O Lord! Two servants of Thy threshold, Isfandiyar Mihraban and Rustam Tirandaz, have hastened to the world of mystery. They have become detached from the realm of nothingness and taken flight to the celestial world of being. O Forgiver of every sinner! Through Thy pardon and forgiveness make them worthy of Thy outstanding favors. Grant them freely of Thy bounty. Make these two dear servants noble in Thy Kingdom and treat them in a manner befitting Thy grace.

Subject: prayer for the departed
Quotation: O matchless Lord! Mah Banu has taken wing toward Thy celestial realm, has spread her pinions and taken flight. Rustam and Suhrab were athirst for Thy ocean, yearned for Thy path, and hastened toward Thee that they might drink from Thy stream. O Forgiver! Withhold not Thy bounty, and cherish these helpless ones beneath Thy shelter. In the realm of mysteries, cause them to be intimate companions with the pure ones. Thou art the Giver, the Bestower, the All-Merciful.

Subject: prayer for the departed
Quotation: O Thou Kind Lord! The handmaid of God, Mrs. Hathaway, was a daughter of the Kingdom and was set ablaze with the fire of the love of God. She turned to Thee and was enkindled with the fire of Thy love. Her heart and soul were illumined by the light of guidance, and she ascended to Thy Kingdom in utmost supplication. O God! Grant her Thy forgiveness and pardon, and in the world of mysteries immerse her in the ocean of lights. Verily, Thou art the All-Forgiving, the Compassionate.

Subject: prayer for the departed
Quotation: O Lord! Khusraw Parsi and Gushtasb were disappointed in this world - make them successful in that world. Make them joyful, grant them a good end. Fulfill the desires of their hearts and souls. Forgive their sins, pardon and favor them. In the world of mystery, make them companions of the birds of the meadow. Grant them life-giving wings and enable them to soar to Thy precincts. Show Thy face and let them drink from Thy stream. Thou art the Bestower, the Kind. Thou art the Forgiver of sins.

Subject: prayer for the departed
Quotation: O Lord! This bird has soared to the meadows of Thy forgiveness and pardon, and this breeze has returned to the garden of Thy grace and bounty, and this servant has sought the shelter of Thy mercy. O Lord! Honor his resting place and shelter him near the Blessed Tree, and open unto him the gates of reunion, and grant him the highest station, and encompass him with the wonders of Thy supreme favors, and clothe him with the robes of munificence. Verily, Thou art the All-Bountiful, the Most Merciful.

Subject: prayer for the departed
Quotation: O loving Lord! Thy servant Furud has ascended to the highest horizon and entered the Abha Kingdom. Yearning for Thy presence, he took wing to the branches of mysteries. O Kind One! Grant him entry to the garden of meeting and bestow upon him a share from the gathering of divine manifestation. Show Thy beauteous countenance, comfort that good-natured one and make him joyous and glad. Forgive his sins and teach him wondrous melodies that he may delight the Concourse on High with his soul-stirring song.

Subject: prayer for the departed
Quotation: O Lord, O Thou Forgiver of sins and Concealer of faults! These two illumined souls have winged their flight unto the Kingdom of Light and hastened from this mortal world to the realm immortal. They have cast off these earthly frames and ascended unto the dominion of eternity. O Lord! They were two blessed beings, two favored servants, two trees of Thy garden. Grant that they may attain unto the summit of Thy bestowals, immerse them in the ocean of Thy forgiveness, and cause them to enter the loftiest paradise.

Subject: prayer for the departed
Quotation: O Thou Creator! O Thou Forgiver! Glorify the precious Robert in Thy Kingdom and in the garden of the Paradise of Abha. Bring him in[to] intimate association with the birds of the celestial meadow. O Thou Knowing God! Although that sinless one was black in color, like unto the black pupil of the eye, he was a source of shining light. O Thou forgiving Lord! Cause that longing one to attain Thy meeting and cause that thirsty one to drink the water of life in abundance. Thou art the Forgiver, the Pardoner, the Compassionate...

Subject: prayer for the departed
Quotation: O Kind Lord! Thou hast raised up that passionate handmaiden on the Day of Resurrection, poured the wine of gladness to her lips, and mingled truth and love like honey and sugar. Now she is the companion of the angels of the highest heaven, has heard the melody of the hidden Herald, and has fallen into the ocean of Thy forgiveness and pardon. O Lord! Forgive her and bestow Thy favors upon her, make her the companion of intimate prayer and supplication in that other world, and at the feast of meeting make her partake from the cup of Thy bounty.

Subject: prayer for the departed
Quotation: O my God, my God! Verily, Thy contented and well-pleased handmaiden Rubabih has found assurance in Thy grace, Thy pardon and Thy forgiveness, and has returned unto Thee, supplicating and imploring before the Kingdom of Thy mercy, that Thou mayest shelter her in the presence of Thy Most Great Mercy, admit her to the scene of reunion, and cause her to abide eternally in the realm of divine favors. O Lord! Make easy her hopes and grant her desire. Verily Thou art the Merciful, verily Thou art the Compassionate, verily Thou art the Mighty, the Bestower.

Subject: prayer for the departed
Quotation: O Lord! These pure souls have hastened from the earthly realm to the world of the celestial spheres. They acknowledge their sins and confess their shortcomings. They have no hope save in Thy grace and favor, and no desire except to take refuge in Thy forgiveness and pardon. These helpless souls had no capital except trust in Thee. They have clung to the hem of Thy loving-kindness. O Thou Forgiver! Pardon their sins, cover their faults, and bestow Thy gifts, that they may attain endless bounties in the hidden Kingdom and may be blessed to behold Thy beauty and perfection in the assemblage of splendor.

Subject: prayer for the departed
Quotation: O Lord, I entreat Thee, fervently and tearfully, to cast upon Thy handmaiden who hath ascended unto Thee the glances of the eye of Thy mercy. Robe her in the mantle of Thy grace, bright with the ornaments of the celestial Paradise, and, sheltering her beneath the tree of Thy oneness, illumine her face with the lights of Thy mercy and compassion. Bestow upon Thy heavenly handmaiden, O God, the holy fragrances born of the spirit of Thy forgiveness. Cause her to dwell in a blissful abode, heal her griefs with the balm of Thy reunion, and, in accordance with Thy will, grant her admission to Thy holy Paradise.

Subject: prayer for the departed
Quotation: O Lord, my God, my Pardoner, my Forgiver, my Compassionate Lord, my Gracious King, my Shield and Protection, my Shelter and Guard! ... Therefore, O my God, protect them from the flood of disobedience, and deliver them, O my Beloved, from whatsoever may prevent them from entering the scene of reunion, the Paradise of bounty. Fulfill their vision, grant them the meeting, and cause them to abide forever in the gathering-place of revelation. Verily, Thou art the Gracious, the Merciful, the Lord of bounty, and verily Thou art the Lord of forgiveness, kindness, and pardon, and verily Thou art the Mighty, the All-Merciful.

Subject: prayer for the departed
Quotation: O God! O Thou Who hast caused the sun of forgiveness to shine forth from the dawning-place of Thy bounty, and hast made the ocean of pardon, forbearance and forgiveness surge through the breezes of Thy grace! Thy helpless and distressed servant hath turned toward the kingdom of Thy forgiveness, and he who seeketh Thy protection hath, of his own free will, supplicated before the heaven of Thy providence. He beggeth, imploreth, grieveth and seeketh Thy forgiveness and pardon for his parents who honored his abode, showed him the utmost affection, reared him in the cradle of tenderness and comfort, and showered him with loving kindness.

Subject: prayer for the departed
Quotation: O thou Pardoning God! Ignite her candle and cause her star to become resplendent in the Immortal Realm. Let her memory be spread abroad over all regions and her name, like unto that of Mary Magdalene, be ever illustrious among the denizens of the Kingdom. Cause her fame to be world-wide and her voice to reach the ears of the Supreme Concourse. Exalt the members of her family and place upon their heads the diadem of everlasting glory; that they may appreciate the value of that honorable soul and may realize what a magnificent edifice she has erected for them and what a standard of everlasting glory she has hoisted, so that of her, her family and kindred may be eternally proud.

Subject: prayer for the departed
Quotation: O Lord! Godspeedily closed his eyes to this world and hastened to Thy realm that he might attain Thy bounties and find rest in the shade of the Tree of Hope. Grant his request and make him prosperous. Firuzih came as a beggar to Thy door with hope - therefore make him successful. He is in great need - make him a companion of forgiveness and an associate of the angels. And Faramarz was Thy servant, was seeking Thee, was treading the path to Thy dwelling that he might behold Thy countenance and drink from Thy stream - make Thy bounty worthy and free. And Rashid drank from Thy spring and heard Thy melody and ran toward Thee and flew to Thy realm - therefore grant him a nest and dwelling in the free cypress of Thy rose garden.

Subject: prayer for the departed
Quotation: My Lord and my Hope! A tender, fresh, and verdant branch from the tree of Thy mercy has been stripped of its earthly raiment of clay and elevated to the Supreme Companion, that Thou mayest clothe it in the garments of light and in beautiful, silken and ethereal robes, and admit it to the gatherings of divine manifestation in the unseen realm of the Kingdom of mysteries. O Lord! Embrace it in the cradle of Thy favors, honor it in the bosom of grace, bounty and beneficence, illuminate it with the lights of holiness in the world of vision and witnessing, and admit it to the gathering of divine presence - that resplendent assemblage illumined by the lights of beauty in the Kingdom of glory - through Thy grace and mercy, O Thou Possessor of bounty and perfection.

Subject: prayer for the departed
Quotation: O my God, O my God! This is a handmaiden who was related to the brother of the martyr, Thy servant Husayn, and who arose to worship Thee and serve Thy chosen ones throughout her life, sparing no effort in this from her beginning to her end. Rather, this was her ultimate desire until her breath was confined in her cage and she longed to ascend to an exalted station of truth, and flew on her wings to the summit of her prosperity and the center of her success. O Lord! Make her a sign of forgiveness among the concourse of women, purify her from the defilement of sin, lead her to the spring of life in the Garden of Paradise, and grant her the blessing of meeting Thee in the world of mysteries, the center of divine manifestation through the radiance of lights, throughout endless ages and cycles. Verily Thou art the Forgiving, verily Thou art the Kind, and verily Thou art the Pardoning, the Bestower.

Subject: prayer for the departed
Quotation: O Lord my God! Thy pure and radiant servant hath returned unto Thee, Thy devoted and joyful companion who hath believed in Thy days and testified to the truth of Thy words, who hath glorified Thy name and gazed upon Thy beauty, who hath perceived Thy mystery and arisen to spread abroad Thy sweet fragrances. He, verily, hath followed Thy path, O Lord, and quaffed from Heaven's soft-flowing waters. The drawn and gleaming sword of Thine enemies deterred him not from remaining steadfast in Thy glorious Cause. He hath called out in Thy name, invoked Thy kingdom, expounded Thy proofs, established Thine evidences, proclaimed Thy signs, guided others unto Thy path, enkindled Thy loved ones, and arisen in the service of Thy chosen ones. Lord! Lord! Make him a sign of Thy forgiveness, an emblem of Thy loving-kindness, a word of Thy benevolence, and a lamp of Thy pardon. Suffer him to arrive at Thy door, to attain unto Thee, to be blessed with meeting Thee, and to live forever within the paradise of Thy beauty.

Subject: prayer for the departed
Quotation:
O my God! O my God! Verily Thy servant Ali-Akbar believed in Thee on the greatest Day of Gathering, when the Hour drew nigh and the moon was cleft in twain, and all were in continuous gathering. O Lord! He endured every hardship and affliction and exile from his homeland, finding no rest for a moment. Heavy upon him were the chains and fetters and shackles of men, and the pearl necklaces around the necks of the faithful. Ever did he remember Thee in darkness, and stood with eyes flowing with tears, saying: 'Lord! I have sacrificed for Thy loved ones my spirit, my heart, my soul and my body. Enable me to serve Thee and make me steadfast in servitude unto Thee, and grant me an exalted station at Thy holy Threshold.' O Lord! Make heavy his scale of good deeds, make his balance preponderate, elevate his station, admit him to the gathering of divine manifestations, and gladden him through Thy grace and bounty, O Lord of the clear signs! Verily Thou art the Forgiving, verily Thou art the Kind, verily Thou art the Ever-Relenting, the Merciful.  AB04674
O my Lord! Ordain for them a bountiful reward, a beautiful provision, and abundant sustenance. Accept from them these good deeds and recompense them for their righteous acts. Admit them all through the gate of Thy bounty, O Creator of the heavens!
