Quotation: O Lord! Make easy, through Thy bounty and grace, all that is difficult, and answer, through Thy favor, bounty and generosity, all who supplicate Thee

Subject: prayer for the spiritual progress of others
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/prayer for the spiritual progress of others.txt
Quotation: O God! O my mighty refuge...Enable him to reveal the evidences of Thy grace amongst Thy servants by the manifestation in his luminous temple of the signs of Thy bounty.

Subject: prayer for the spiritual progress of others
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/prayer for the spiritual progress of others.txt
Quotation: O thou Compassionate God! Vouchsafe me a heart that may be luminous as a lamp enkindled with Thy love and give me thoughts that will illumine the world with spiritual bounties.

Subject: prayer for the spiritual progress of others
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/prayer for the spiritual progress of others.txt
Quotation: I beseech the Most High BAHA'O'LLAH that through His grace, He may endear these souls both in this world and that of the Kingdom, so that they may become the emblems of guidance

Subject: prayer for the spiritual progress of others
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/prayer for the spiritual progress of others.txt
Quotation: We beseech Him to water through thee the earth and all that is therein, that there may grow from it the grass of wisdom and utterance, and the ears of knowledge and understanding.

Subject: prayer for the spiritual progress of others
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/prayer for the spiritual progress of others.txt
Quotation: O Lord! Assist them in Thy Kingdom and destine for them every good through Thy grace and bounty. O Lord! Support them and enable them to serve Thee and make them mindful of Thee in Thy Kingdom.

Subject: prayer for the spiritual progress of others
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/prayer for the spiritual progress of others.txt
Quotation: We beseech God, blessed and exalted be He, to exalt him through His Name, to aid him through His verses, to protect him through the hosts of His revelation, and to draw him nigh unto Him in all conditions.

Subject: prayer for the spiritual progress of others
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/prayer for the spiritual progress of others.txt
Quotation: From the greatest bounty and bestowal, I beg for you heavenly gifts and seek the nurture of vernal showers. I seek the light of the Sun of Truth and the life-giving breeze from the source of divine favors.

Subject: prayer for the spiritual progress of others
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/prayer for the spiritual progress of others.txt
Quotation: Send down Thy blessings at this moment upon the hearts of those who have ascended unto Thee, and upon their spirits, their souls and their bodies, through all Thy grace and mercy, and Thy bounty and generosity

Subject: prayer for the spiritual progress of others
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/prayer for the spiritual progress of others.txt
Quotation: Therefore I beseech God that you may become pure and holy like your father, that you may sacrifice your life for the Blessed Beauty, and that you may be confirmed in all that your father was enabled to achieve.

Subject: prayer for the spiritual progress of others
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/prayer for the spiritual progress of others.txt
Quotation: We beseech God to make him successful in all conditions in that which He loveth and is pleased with...We beseech Him to ordain for His loved ones that which will bring joy to their eyes and gladness to their hearts

Subject: prayer for the spiritual progress of others
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/prayer for the spiritual progress of others.txt
Quotation: O God! My God! You are the Confirmer of those who turn their noble faces to You with sincerity, and the Helper of those whom You have guided to Your straight path and Your upright way...through Your mercy which encompasses all things.

Subject: prayer for the spiritual progress of others
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/prayer for the spiritual progress of others.txt
Quotation: O my Lord, my Lord! Cause wings to grow upon him that he may soar to the heights of glory and the highest horizon through Thy grace and generosity, and that he may wing his flight in the atmosphere of the heaven of Thy merciful Kingdom

Subject: prayer for the spiritual progress of others
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/prayer for the spiritual progress of others.txt
Quotation: O Lord! Grant these helpless ones a remedy, bestow healing upon these forsaken ones, and confer bounty and favor upon these destitute ones. Give these weak souls shelter beneath Thy protection, and grant strength to these frail and poor ones.

Subject: prayer for the spiritual progress of others
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/prayer for the spiritual progress of others.txt
Quotation: O my God! I beseech Thee...to cause this youth to ascend unto the heaven of the might of Thy Cause and the seat of the sanctity of Thy dominion. Then give him to drink that which shall open before his heart's face the gates of wisdom and utterance.

Subject: prayer for the spiritual progress of others
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/prayer for the spiritual progress of others.txt
Quotation: O Thou kind Lord! These souls are Thy lovers who wander in Thy realm...Let Thy soul-reviving breath pass over them, Thy musk-laden breezes revive them and the fragrance of Thy Paradise laden with sweet smelling flowers and herbs bring freedom to their hearts.

Subject: prayer for the spiritual progress of others
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/prayer for the spiritual progress of others.txt
Quotation: O my God! Thou art my refuge and the shelter of my hopes and the ultimate goal of my desire and the end of my aspiration. I beseech the Kingdom of Thy mercy to aid this servant to that which Thou lovest and approvest, by Thy mercy which hath preceded all things.

Subject: prayer for the spiritual progress of others
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/prayer for the spiritual progress of others.txt
Quotation: O Lord, my Lord! With utmost humility, supplication and devotion I lay my face upon the lowly dust and call upon You with lamentation and yearning...O Lord! Have mercy on these pure ones and make firm their feet on this Path that has no crookedness or deviation.

Subject: prayer for the spiritual progress of others
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/prayer for the spiritual progress of others.txt
Quotation: I beseech God to make you a lamp of guidance and a light of piety in a glass that is lit and shines between earth and heaven...Plant in his wings the splendors of power and might, and the pinions of glory and invincibility, that he may soar to the highest reaches of success

Subject: prayer for the spiritual progress of others
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/prayer for the spiritual progress of others.txt
Quotation: I beseech Thee, O my God...that Thou wouldst look upon Thy sincere servants with the eyes of Thy mercy, cast upon them the mantle of Thy light, make them steadfast in Thy Cause, and render them the dawning-places of Thy signs and the daysprings of Thy spirit and Thy fragrances

Subject: prayer for the spiritual progress of others
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/prayer for the spiritual progress of others.txt
Quotation: O Lord! Teach her the mysteries of the Kingdom of Your mercy and the realities of the realm of Your oneness, and loosen her tongue in expression of Your unity so that the hearts of the handmaids may be revived thereby and their spirits may be attracted to Your Most Glorious Kingdom.

Subject: prayer for the spiritual progress of others
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/prayer for the spiritual progress of others.txt
Quotation: O my kind Lord! Your servant Sulayman has grown weary of this world so that he may sit upon the Solomonic throne in the world above, see Your face and acquire Your attributes. O Forgiver! Forgive his sins, grant him shelter, make him aware, and in the world of mysteries immerse him in lights

Subject: prayer for the spiritual progress of others
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/prayer for the spiritual progress of others.txt
Quotation: I beseech God to cause you to speak forth praise of His Most Glorious Beauty - praise that would bewilder the minds of the eloquent and stupefy the thoughts of the learned - and to make you a sign of His bounty among the daughters and a brightly shining candle of His love unto all hearts and souls.

Subject: prayer for the spiritual progress of others
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/prayer for the spiritual progress of others.txt
Quotation: Were ye on that Day to behold the Letters of Truth, ye would deem it too great for your souls to believe in them. Yet ye were thus before and shall be thus after. Therefore follow ye the Command of God, for He knoweth best all who are in the heavens and on earth and whatsoever lieth between them.

Subject: prayer for the spiritual progress of others
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/prayer for the spiritual progress of others.txt
Quotation: O my God and the Helper of the sincere ones and those who are firm in Thy Covenant and are assured by Thy promise! Aid these, Thy servants, to serve at the threshold of Thy holiness, and make them signs of guidance and stars of piety, shining from the supreme horizon and gleaming from the highest zenith.

Subject: prayer for the spiritual progress of others
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/prayer for the spiritual progress of others.txt
Quotation: O Divine Providence! Now is the time for the hosts of the Abha Kingdom to charge forth. Now is the hour for the confirmations and assistance of the angels of the Concourse on high. Fulfil that which Thou didst promise, and into our cups, tainted with the dregs of sorrow, pour forth the wine of Thy favour.

Subject: prayer for the spiritual progress of others
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/prayer for the spiritual progress of others.txt
Quotation: Cause them to love one another so as to sacrifice their spirits, expend their money and give up their desires for each other's sake! O Lord, make to descend upon them quietness and tranquillity! Shower upon them the clouds of Thy Mercy in full abundance, and make them to characterize themselves with the characteristics of the spiritual!

Subject: prayer for the spiritual progress of others
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/prayer for the spiritual progress of others.txt
Quotation: Then gather them on the shore of Thy bounty and grace, then detach them from all else besides Thee such that they fear no one and are disturbed by no soul. Then open their eyes, O my God, through the wonders of Thy power and the sovereignty of Thy might until they witness all things in Thy grasp and every matter in the palm of Thy power.

Subject: prayer for the spiritual progress of others
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/prayer for the spiritual progress of others.txt
Quotation: O Lord! Fill that faithful servant like an overflowing cup of mercy, that he may intoxicate precious souls with the wine of love, engage in servitude at Thy sacred threshold, arise to serve Thy loved ones, rejoice in sacrificing his life, and through joy attain success. May he become a divine being and through the breath of the All-Merciful guide the seekers.

Subject: prayer for the spiritual progress of others
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/prayer for the spiritual progress of others.txt
Quotation: O kind Lord! These souls are Thy friends and this gathering is longing for Thee. They are captives of the lights of Thy Beauty and ecstatic by Thy musk-scented locks. Their hearts are Thine; they are Thy poor, humble and homeless; they have severed themselves from relative and stranger and have established the relationship of unity with Thee. They have adored Thee.

Subject: prayer for the spiritual progress of others
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/prayer for the spiritual progress of others.txt
Quotation: O God! Favor the wise friends, prepare a spiritual feast, adorn the heavenly banquet and show forth Thy luminous countenance. O Lord! Ennoble the righteous ones and manifest eternal bounty. Make mysteries manifest and diffuse the lights. Make every heart intimate with Thy remembrance and every eye bright and seeing. Make the friends precious and grant them wisdom and discernment.

Subject: prayer for the spiritual progress of others
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/prayer for the spiritual progress of others.txt
Quotation: O Lord! Make this poor servant honorable at Thy divine threshold, and make this helpless fallen one exalted and learned. Make his heart an ocean and his soul the companion of the world above, the confidant of the angel and in harmony with the melodious bird, so that like the birds of the heavenly rose-garden he may warble, and like the free cypress by the divine stream he may flourish and find repose.

Subject: prayer for the spiritual progress of others
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/prayer for the spiritual progress of others.txt
Quotation: O Lord! Illumine all eyes with the radiance of light, bring joy to all spirits through the pure wine that overfloweth from heavenly cups, perfume all souls with the gentle breeze wafting from the gardens of holiness across all regions. Make them flowers in the Garden of Refuge, lofty trees in the Supreme Paradise, birds singing Thy praise amidst all creatures, and stars rising in the horizon of glory.

Subject: prayer for the spiritual progress of others
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/prayer for the spiritual progress of others.txt
Quotation: O God! O Master of Kings and Merciful to the servants! I beseech Thee by Thy Most Great Name and Thy sovereignty which prevaileth over the nations to ordain for those who have laid fast hold on the Sure Handle and clung to the Snow-White Path and the Resplendent Law, and believed in that which hath been sent down from the heaven of Thy Will, that which is best for them in the hereafter and in this world.

Subject: prayer for the spiritual progress of others
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/prayer for the spiritual progress of others.txt
Quotation: May He make His friends detached from more and less, and cause them to be free from stranger and kin. May He make them entirely captivated by that musk-laden tress and enamored of that luminous countenance. In every moment may He grant a confirmation and in every instant bestow a healing balm, so that every wounded one may find rest and every frozen one become aflame, every silent one become articulate and every lifeless one spring forth.

Subject: prayer for the spiritual progress of others
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/prayer for the spiritual progress of others.txt
Quotation: O Lord! Assist Thy servants in that which Thou lovest and art pleased with, and enable them to manifest such virtues as will diffuse the fragrances of holiness throughout all regions, and establish them in the execution of Thy teachings and the following of Thy counsels and the implementation of Thy advices which have spread and been proclaimed throughout all horizons. Verily, Thou art the Generous, the Merciful, the Mighty, the Bestower.

Subject: prayer for the spiritual progress of others
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/prayer for the spiritual progress of others.txt
Quotation: I supplicated the Holy Threshold, the Circuit of the Supreme Concourse, to baptize thee with the water of knowledge and the fire of the love of God and to make thee a perfect and faithful servant in His Great Vineyard, so that thou mayest water the trees of the love of God in the Paradise of ABHA; and to make thee a sign of meekness and humbleness among the maid-servants of God and a promulgator of His Cause in those vast and extensive regions.

Subject: prayer for the spiritual progress of others
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/prayer for the spiritual progress of others.txt
Quotation: This is a handmaiden among Thy handmaidens and a leaf from among the leaves of the Tree of Thy mercy, who hath sprouted forth from the Lote-Tree of Thy oneness. I beseech Thee, by Thy Most Exalted Word which Thou hast made the sign of Thy oneness, to cause her to grow with a goodly growth, and enable her to be nourished from the breast of Thy lordship, and rear her in the cradle of the mercy of Thy oneness, and nurture her in the fortress of Thy mercy

Subject: prayer for the spiritual progress of others
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/prayer for the spiritual progress of others.txt
Quotation: O Lord! I implore Thee to remove the veils from insight and vision, to deliver souls from deception and pride, and to save those plunging in depths of darkness. O Lord! All are Thy servants and dwellers in Thy lands...I beseech Thee by Thy mercy that preceded all things to grant them a share of the lights of guidance, guide them to the path of right conduct, make them signs of Thy love throughout the lands, gather them beneath the shadow of the banner of the Covenant, and take them not to task for their heedlessness of Thy remembrance

Subject: prayer for the spiritual progress of others
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/prayer for the spiritual progress of others.txt
Quotation: O Lord! These souls are enamored of Thy countenance and lost in Thy path and in love with Thy nature and disposition. They are intoxicated with Thy cup and birds upon Thy roof. They are the tame birds of providence and the enchanted nightingales of the roses of truth. They are the thirsty ones at the fountain of mercy and the wanderers in the realm of grace. O Forgiver! Pardon the sins of Thy servants and grant refuge to the helpless ones...Grant strength to the weak and bestow healing upon the sick, make the poor honored and give fire to the cold.

Subject: prayer for the spiritual progress of others
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/prayer for the spiritual progress of others.txt
Quotation: This wanderer doth ever supplicate with utmost lowliness at the Threshold of the Lord God, seeking His favors for the friends, that each may become a majestic tree in the Abha Paradise, casting shade and yielding heavenly blessings. O Thou kind Lord! Make these trees the ornament of the Abha Paradise, and nurture them through Thy celestial bounty. Make them verdant and flourishing, and shower them with dewdrops. Clothe them in silken garments, and crown them with blossoms of sublime beauty. Grant them goodly fruit and bestow upon them sweet fragrance.

Subject: prayer for the spiritual progress of others
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/prayer for the spiritual progress of others.txt
Quotation: Oh Thou the Desire of them that yearn after Thee and the Object of such as are devoted to Thee and the Light of all who are in heaven and on earth, lowly and submissive unto the door of Thy divinity, I supplicate unto the kingdom of Thy unity and the realm of Thy oneness and implore Thine eternal godhead to look upon this Thy servant with the glance of Thy mercy. Help him, moreover, with the manifestations of the signs of Thine assistance and power and enrapture him with the revelations of the evidences of Thy bounty and purify his countenance at all times in the kingdom of Thy Revelation and Thy creation.

Subject: prayer for the spiritual progress of others
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/prayer for the spiritual progress of others.txt
Quotation: My God, my God! Thou art the One Who seeth my condition, Who heareth my call, Who art the Physician for my ailment and the Medicine for my healing. Praise be unto Thee for what Thou hast bestowed, conferred, graciously given, granted, made to drink, and caused to quaff from the Spring of Tasnim, the flowing waters, the Kawthar, and the Salsabil, and hast guided the seekers to the Straight Path and the manifest Light, and hast made firm their steps in the Ancient Covenant. O my Lord! These are Thy loved ones, Thy chosen ones, Thy elect, Thy friends, the best of Thy creation, and the most sincere among those who love Thee.

Subject: prayer for the spiritual progress of others
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/prayer for the spiritual progress of others.txt
Quotation: O Mighty Helper of the weak ones, Succourer of the poor, Haven of the free, and Refuge of the righteous! With a heart palpitating and wholly turned toward the Kingdom of Mysteries, I supplicate Thee, beseeching Thee night and day to waft the holy fragrances to those regions wherein traces have been spread abroad and lights have shone forth, that the surroundings may be perfumed by the fragrance of the garment of Joseph of Mysteries, and that there may be generated in all hearts attraction to Thy Beauty, yearning in Thy remembrance, and enkindlement with the fire of Thy love, and then supplication and imploration in the depths of night and at dawn.

Subject: prayer for the spiritual progress of others
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/prayer for the spiritual progress of others.txt
Quotation: I beseech Thee by the lights of Thy throne and the manifestations of Thy sovereignty to assist the people of unity to act according to what Thou hast revealed in Thy Book, whereby Thou didst separate between the monotheists and the polytheists, and guided those who turned unto Thee to Thy straight path, and taught them what would preserve them from that which harmeth them outwardly and inwardly. Then I beseech Thee, O Goal of the world and Object of worship of the nations, to enable them to do what Thou lovest and approvest, that perchance sorrows may be changed to joy, abasement to supreme glory, and weakness to the power which Thou hast mentioned in Thy mighty Book.

Subject: prayer for the spiritual progress of others
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/prayer for the spiritual progress of others.txt
Quotation: Make me attracted to the remembrance of Thy loved ones, enkindled with the flame of love for Thy chosen ones, with breast expanded in praise of Thy dear ones, and with eyes gladdened by beholding the faces of Thy servants. Strengthen their loins through Thy power, reinforce their backs through Thy might. O Lord! Cause the springs of inner meanings to flow from their hearts, unveil to their minds the mysteries of Thy words in the Seven Oft-repeated Verses, and guide them to Him Who guides to Thee in the Most Merciful Presence. O Lord! Illumine their eyes with the light of recognition, brighten their consciences with bounty and favor, cause them to speak with proof and evidence, inspire them with words of grace and kindness. Make them guides to Thy creation, trustees of Thy utterance, and protectors of Thy sanctuary.

Subject: prayer for the spiritual progress of others
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/prayer for the spiritual progress of others.txt
Quotation: O Lord! These are honored servants who bow before Thy Word and are humble, who are patient under Thy trials and show fortitude, who stand firm in Thy Cause and are steadfast, who call out Thy Name and teach, who spread abroad Thy sweet savors and propagate them. O Lord! Aid them with praiseworthy hosts and armies that scatter the beasts, teach them Thy verses, spread through them Thy clear proofs, exalt through them Thy Word, declare through them Thy wisdom, and establish them in hearts through Thy proof. Make them the banners of Thy guidance among Thy creation, the waves of the ocean of Thy bounty for those among Thy creatures who thirst, the rivers of Thy Kawthar of favors for the people of Thy kingdom. Make them the branches of the Tree of Life, the fruits of the Tree of the Divine Purpose, the flowers of a splendid garden, and the fish in a noble pool. Clothe them in the robes of guidance and cause them to speak Thy praise in the Most Exalted Paradise.

Subject: prayer for the spiritual progress of others
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/prayer for the spiritual progress of others.txt
Quotation: O my God, my Beloved, my Purpose, my Desire! Thou seest me communing with Thee by day and night, beseeching Thee with heart and tongue, and imploring Thy heavenly Kingdom with a spirit drawn to Thy divine Kingdom. Assist Thou those who have hearkened to the call and responded to the summons, who have been attracted to Thy most exalted Kingdom and been set ablaze by the fire kindled in the Tree of Sinai, who have turned their faces to Thee amidst all peoples, who have recited the verses of guidance among the concourse of creation, who have spoken forth in praise, raised high the standard of piety, and hastened to the field of martyrdom with hearts throbbing with love and devotion, and who have established proofs and testimonies among Thy creatures for the vindication of Thy Cause with such power as to cause the mighty ones to tremble. O Lord! Make these souls to be lamps of the night and keys to the gates of heaven, standards of the Most Great Name, and signs of the Book made manifest in the scriptures of old and the tablets of latter days, that they may place their trust in Thee, hasten unto Thee, and long for martyrdom before Thee.

Subject: prayer for unity
Quotation: so that we may become united and harmonized, associate with each other with the sweetness of honey and milk

Subject: prayer for unity
Quotation: Beseech God to remove that which hath come between Us and you, for He, verily, is the Almighty, the Glorious, the All-Choosing.

Subject: prayer for unity
Quotation: O Kind Lord! ...May all parties become united, seek eternal life, promote the oneness of the human world, and spread universal peace.

Subject: prayer for unity
Quotation: The most essential and greatest of all things is the unity of the friends. They must supplicate the True One to enable all to attain this most exalted station.

Subject: prayer for unity
Quotation: O Lord! They supplicate unto the Kingdom of Thy mercy and beseech the Realm of Thy oneness in obedience to Thy command. Make their union one of harmony and unity until the Day of Meanings.

Subject: prayer for unity
Quotation: My God, my God! We beseech Thee by the ocean of Thy bounty and the heaven of Thy bestowals to aid him in Thy remembrance and praise, and to enable him to that whereby the standards of Thy guidance may be raised in Thy lands and the banners of Thy oneness among Thy servants.

Subject: prayer for unity
Quotation: O Kind Lord! That scattered gathering belongs to You, and those companions are Your destitute ones. Grant a favor, bestow a gift, extend mercy, freely give aid and bounty so that all may become companions like the Pleiades constellation and sweeten one another's taste with sugar-laden words.

Subject: prayer for unity
Quotation: O my Lord! I beseech Thee by Thy Lamp which Thou hast preserved from the winds of rancor and hatred, and from the tempests of tyranny and wickedness, and from the storms of pride and vainglory, that Thou unite the hearts of Thy loved ones and assist them to serve Thy Cause through the hosts of Thy verses and Thy virtues.

Subject: prayer for unity
Quotation: Let us implore and beseech that God may create love in hearts. Let us implore and beseech that the Sun of Truth may shine upon all, that we may all be immersed in the ocean of the Lord's mercy. Let us implore and beseech that all who are imperfect may become perfect. Let us implore and beseech that all children may reach maturity. May the sun of love shine upon East and West, and may all hearts be illumined by the light of the love of God, and may all souls be quickened by the spirit of divine bestowals. May eyes be enlightened, ears become hearing, hearts be drawn to the divine fragrances, spirits be gladdened by the glad-tidings of God.

Subject: prayer for victory and requital; triumph of the Cause
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/prayer for victory and requital; triumph of the Cause.txt
Quotation: I beseech Thee... to make me to triumph over Thine enemies and to prevail over the rebellious among Thy creatures

Subject: prayer for victory and requital; triumph of the Cause
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/prayer for victory and requital; triumph of the Cause.txt
Quotation: I beseech Thee, O my Lord, by Thy Most Glorious Name, to send down from the heaven of Thy bounty that which shall exalt the monotheists and abase the polytheists.

Subject: prayer for victory and requital; triumph of the Cause
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/prayer for victory and requital; triumph of the Cause.txt
Quotation: I beseech Thee to assist Thy party through the hosts of the seen and the unseen. Verily Thou art God, the Almighty, the All-Compelling, the Mighty, the All-Choosing.

Subject: prayer for victory and requital; triumph of the Cause
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/prayer for victory and requital; triumph of the Cause.txt
Quotation: O God! O God! Verily, I implore Thee with throbbing heart and streaming tears to aid every one who endeavors for the erection of this edifice...Verily, Thou art the Generous, the Merciful, the Bountiful!

Subject: prayer for victory and requital; triumph of the Cause
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/prayer for victory and requital; triumph of the Cause.txt
Quotation: Send down upon them, O my Lord, that which will unmistakably reveal unto them the fury of Thy wrath and the ascendancy of Thy power, and will enable them to recognize the weight of Thy might and the greatness of Thy strength.

Subject: prayer for victory and requital; triumph of the Cause
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/prayer for victory and requital; triumph of the Cause.txt
Quotation: O God, my God! I supplicate...that Thou would confirm and strengthen the pillars of the house of Thy manifest religion, Thy straight path, and Thy exemplary way among humanity, and reinforce the backs of Thy loved ones in Thy Cause

Subject: prayer for victory and requital; triumph of the Cause
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/prayer for victory and requital; triumph of the Cause.txt
Quotation: We beseech from Him victory and deliverance for His servants who are encompassed by the ships of polytheism and the cannons of unbelief. O my Lord! Thou seest Thy weak servants - where is Thy strength, O Lord of the worlds, and where is Thy power, O Creator of the nations?

Subject: prayer for victory and requital; triumph of the Cause
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/prayer for victory and requital; triumph of the Cause.txt
Quotation: O God! I beseech Thee by Thy Divinity which is exalted above all things, to punish every being of Alif associated with the Tree of Negation, by Thy Sovereignty which is sanctified above all things. Verily, Thou art the Mighty, the Severe. [continues with similar verses throughout]

Subject: prayer for victory and requital; triumph of the Cause
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/prayer for victory and requital; triumph of the Cause.txt
Quotation: Thou seest, O my God, how Thy loved ones have been encompassed by the rebellious amongst Thy creatures and the wicked amidst Thy people. I beseech Thee by Thy Most Great Name to draw forth the hand of power from the bosom of Thy might and to assist therewith all them that love Thee.

Subject: prayer for victory and requital; triumph of the Cause
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/prayer for victory and requital; triumph of the Cause.txt
Quotation: I entreat Thee...to aid all them that are dear to Thee with both Thy visible and invisible hosts. Render them, moreover, victorious over all those who have so rebelled in Thy land, and dishonored Thy name, and disbelieved in Thy signs, and broken Thy Covenant, and cast behind their backs Thy laws

Subject: prayer for victory and requital; triumph of the Cause
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/prayer for victory and requital; triumph of the Cause.txt
Quotation: Glory be to Thee, O God! Destroy Thou every possessor of the letter Alif who believeth not in Him Whom Thou shalt make manifest, the Manifestation of Thy Greatest Proof, by Thy Divinity which is indeed exalted above all things. Verily Thou art powerful over all things. [repeating pattern through other letters]

Subject: prayer for victory and requital; triumph of the Cause
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/prayer for victory and requital; triumph of the Cause.txt
Quotation: that Thou mayest assist Thy servant - who turneth unto Thee, who boweth down in humility before Thee, who repenteth unto Thee - with the hosts of might and power and the armies of glory and sovereignty against every transgressor and doubter, against those condemned in the Book and those base-born traducers from among the people of the veil

Subject: prayer for victory and requital; triumph of the Cause
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/prayer for victory and requital; triumph of the Cause.txt
Quotation: O God, I beseech Thee by Thy Most Compelling Name, the Most Compelling Name, that compelleth all things created in the heavens and on earth. I implore Thee by this same Most Great Name to assist me and them that have believed in Thee and in Thy signs to obey Thee and to be steadfast in Thy Cause, and to protect them from those who have repudiated the truth of Thy tokens in Thy days.

Subject: prayer for victory and requital; triumph of the Cause
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/prayer for victory and requital; triumph of the Cause.txt
Quotation: Overpower by Thy Name, the All-Subduing, such as have wronged Thy Previous Manifestation Who hath now appeared invested with Thy title, the All-Glorious. Enable Thy loved ones, by Thy Name, the Victorious, to prevail against Thine enemies and the infidels among Thy creatures. Abase Thou, O my Lord, Thine enemies, and lay hold on them with Thy power and might, and let them be stricken by the blast of Thy wrath.

Subject: prayer for victory and requital; triumph of the Cause
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/prayer for victory and requital; triumph of the Cause.txt
Quotation: O Lord! I beseech Thee by Thy power which encompasseth all created things, and by Thy might whereby all possibilities are rendered powerless, to protect Thy unitarian servants from the idolaters and their cannons and rifles and swords. O Lord! Thou seest Thy party among the parties and beneath the claws of a pack of wolves. I beseech Thee, O Lord of Lords, by Thy Prophets and Thy Messengers and Thy Books, and by Him Whom Thou hast established in Thy stead in the kingdom of creation and chosen from among the Prophets to manifest Thy hidden mystery

Subject: prayer for victory and requital; triumph of the Cause
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/prayer for victory and requital; triumph of the Cause.txt
Quotation: O Lord! These are honored servants who remember Thee in the dark of night, the bright morn, the witnessed Day, and the extended shade. Lord! Cause their tongues to speak with Thy remembrance, make them signs of Thy mercy amidst humanity, manifestations of excellence, and dawning-places of Names. Establish them in those regions, make manifest through them the lamp of guidance in all directions, cause them to speak with proof and evidence, establish certainty in their hearts, preserve them beneath the wing of grace and bounty, and guard them with the eye of Thy care from abasement and degradation.

Subject: prayer for women
Quotation: O handmaiden of God...Do with this handmaiden of Thine as beseemeth Thy generosity and grace.

Subject: prayer for women
Quotation: O handmaidens of the All-Merciful! Raise your hands in supplication to the court of the Self-Sufficing Lord

Subject: prayer for women
Quotation: And the Spirit be upon thee and upon such handmaidens as God hath purified from the deeds of the polytheists

Subject: prayer for women
Quotation: [The entire prayer is for a female supplicant, referred to as "this handmaiden" and using feminine pronouns throughout]

Subject: prayer for women
Quotation: Entire prayer is addressed for a female believer named 'Abdu'llah, asking for her protection, spiritual elevation and enduring mention

Subject: prayer for women
Quotation: "engage day and night in humble entreaty and supplication. Show forth meekness and need, and become the intimate companion of prayer."

Subject: prayer for women
Quotation: O Faran, maidservant of God who is attracted to Him and accepted by Him...this is Your maidservant who has been ignited by the fire of Your love

Subject: prayer for women
Quotation: O my God! These are the five leaves from the tree of Thy mercy and the five handmaidens at the sacred threshold of Thy oneness...Verily, Thou art the Chooser!

Subject: prayer for women
Quotation: "O Maryam Sultan Bigum...I beseech Thee to number me among those who circle round Thy throne, then ordain for me that which shall profit me in this world and the next."

Subject: prayer for women
Quotation: O handmaid of God, upon whom Baha'u'llah hath showered His blessings...Ordain for her, O Thou Who art the Ruler of all names, from the Supreme Pen that which will gladden her heart.

Subject: prayer for women
Quotation: O handmaid of God, Hajiyih Bibi Sahib, may the glory of God rest upon her! He is God! O thou pure leaf! Raise thy hands in supplication to the threshold of Oneness and begin thy humble entreaty

Subject: prayer for women
Quotation: O My handmaiden! Hearken unto the Call from the precincts of the Prison, from the glowing, luminous Fire... I beseech Thee by Him and by Him Whom Thou hast willed, to make me steadfast in Thy Cause.

Subject: prayer for women
Quotation: O handmaiden of God, pure and sanctified leaf, wife of His Holiness Ali-Akbar, upon him be the Most Glorious Glory of God... Aid her to that which Thou lovest and approvest in Thy earthly and heavenly dominions.

Subject: prayer for women
Quotation: This is a leaf from the leaves of the trees in the garden of Thy Cause and a handmaiden among Thy handmaidens who hath turned unto Thee... O Lord! Enable me to remember Thee and praise Thee among Thy handmaidens.

Subject: prayer for women
Quotation: "My God, my God! Thou seest a handmaiden from among Thy handmaidens and a leaf among Thy leaves who hath turned toward the horizon of Thy manifestation, and hath heard Thy sweetest call, and hath witnessed Thy signs, O Lord of all beings!"

Subject: prayer for women
Quotation: Glorified art Thou, O my God! Thou seest how one of Thy leaves hath clung to the Tree of Thy Lordship, hath voiced Thy praise, and turned unto Thee when she heard Thy call...Then ordain for her in the Supreme Tablet that which shall gladden her eyes and rejoice her heart.

Subject: prayer for women
Quotation: O God! This is Your handmaiden who has believed in the Dawning Place of the Sun of Your Singleness and the Rising Point of the Luminary of Your Oneness... O Lord! Aid her in that which You love and are pleased with, and strengthen her with mighty power to remain firm in Your Covenant and Testament

Subject: prayer for women
Quotation: Thou seest a handmaiden from among the leaves of the Tree of Thy Revelation, who hath believed in Thee and in Thy signs and in what Thou hast sent down in Thy Books... Thou seest one of Thy handmaidens who hath turned toward the cloud of Thy mercy that it may rain upon her the showers of Thy grace.

Subject: prayer for women
Quotation: O my God, my God! Praise be to Thee for having guided me unto Thy path and illumined my heart with the light of Thy knowledge and sent down upon me the rain of Thy mercy. I beseech Thee by Thy light whereby earth and heaven were illumined, and by Thy fire whose call was raised from the Tree of Faithfulness, to enable me in all conditions to remember Thee and praise Thee and to hold fast to the cord of Thy bounty.

Subject: prayer for women
Quotation: O leaf of divine tree, Afnan, Mr. Mirza Aqa, upon him be the glory and favors of God! He is the Hearer, the Answerer! My God, my God! This is a fragrance from the fragrances of the garden of inner meanings that has turned to Thee on a day wherein the divines of Thy age and the clergy of Thy lands have turned away. I beseech Thee by Thy Beauty that hath appeared amongst Thy creatures, and by the power of Thy Pen and the penetrating influence of Thy Cause, to ordain for her through the pen of Thy bounty that which will draw her nigh unto Thee. Then I beseech Thee, O God of all beings and Goal of all created things, by the fragrances of Thy days through which the mountains were moved and the Cry was raised and the earth shone with Thy light, to ordain for her from Thy Most Exalted Pen the reward of attaining Thy presence and standing before Thy countenance. O Lord! Thou art the Generous One. Thy grace hath preceded and Thy mercy hath preceded. There is no God but Thee, the Forgiving, the Generous.

Subject: prayer to be recited at table
Quotation: He is God! Thou seest us, O my God, gathered around this table, praising Thy bounty, with our gaze set upon Thy Kingdom. O Lord! Send down upon us Thy heavenly food and confer upon us Thy blessing. Thou art verily the Bestower, the Merciful, the Compassionate.

Subject: prayer to be recited at table
Quotation: He is God! How can we render Thee thanks, O Lord? Thy bounties are endless and our gratitude cannot equal them. How can the finite utter praise of the Infinite? Unable are we to voice our thanks for Thy favors and in utter powerlessness we turn wholly to Thy Kingdom beseeching the increase of Thy bestowals and bounties. Thou art the Giver, the Bestower, the Almighty.

Subject: prayers (general or uncategorized)
Quotation: O Lord of Names and Creator of Heaven! Deliver Thy loved ones from the prison of the enemies.

Subject: prayers (general or uncategorized)
Quotation: O Lord! Renew the innermost hearts and purify the consciences through these manifestations at which sight is dazzled.

Subject: prayers (general or uncategorized)
Quotation: I beseech Thee...to comfort him in his loneliness, to quench his thirst, to cool his burning anguish, and to remove his great distress.

Subject: prayers (general or uncategorized)
Quotation: In any case, night and day we are occupied with thoughts of you, and in the Holy Shrine we are accustomed to offering prayers for your good

Subject: prayers (general or uncategorized)
Quotation: O Lord! Thou art the Generous, the Ancient in Bounty. Assist Thy loved ones to whatsoever Thou willest - verily Thou art the Mighty, the All-Choosing.

Subject: prayers (general or uncategorized)
Quotation: I beseech God that He may cause those pure souls to attain the court of divine manifestation in the luminous realm and be honored with the eternal meeting.

Subject: prayers (general or uncategorized)
Quotation: This is a prayer that was revealed at the beginning of the month of fasting. Blessed is the one who offers it to God, his Lord, the Mighty, the All-Knowing.

Subject: prayers (general or uncategorized)
Quotation: I beseech Thee... to send down upon Thy chosen ones and Thy trusted ones, from the heaven of Thy bounty and the clouds of Thy generosity, the rain of Thy mercy

Subject: prayers (general or uncategorized)

Subject: present and future calamities; war; universal convulsion

Quotation: Mention has been made of the grievous days in the Tablet of Steadfastness. The Truth has informed all in wondrous and sublime Tablets of the great tribulation

Subject: present and future calamities; war; universal convulsion
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/present and future calamities; war; universal convulsion.txt
Quotation: In a similar manner each one of the present overwhelming disasters contains a deep wisdom, which will become unveiled when this world-wide deluge is subsided.

Subject: present and future calamities; war; universal convulsion
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/present and future calamities; war; universal convulsion.txt
Quotation: Now that the world is in turmoil, let us see what will happen after this tempest; God willing, it will turn out well. We have cast both the world and ourselves into calamity.

Subject: present and future calamities; war; universal convulsion
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/present and future calamities; war; universal convulsion.txt
Quotation: The affairs of men have been thrown in confusion in both the East and the West. That is the time when calamities surround them, that perchance they may become repentant. That is the last remedy.

Subject: present and future calamities; war; universal convulsion
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/present and future calamities; war; universal convulsion.txt
Quotation: Soon shall clamor spread through cities and regions by reason of that which the hands of the misguided have wrought. This is what We foretold unto Our servants when We were in Zawra and in the Land of Mystery

Subject: present and future calamities; war; universal convulsion
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/present and future calamities; war; universal convulsion.txt
Quotation: The world is in upheaval while the people remain heedless. The dust of the deeds and words of the veiled ones hath obscured the luminous morn. Today every firm and mighty foundation is shaken, and every steadfast and upright foot hath faltered, save those whom thy Lord hath willed. The world's convulsions increase daily, yet its people perceive not the cause and reason, and remain veiled from what is with God by what is with themselves. The Sun of Truth is shining, the ocean is surging, the shrill voice of the Pen is raised, the Tree is speaking, and the Nightingale is warbling - yet all that is seen are deaf ears and blind eyes. Most of what was revealed by the Supreme Pen in sacred texts and tablets hath come to pass, as thou hast witnessed, and what remaineth suspended in the heaven of God's Will shall assuredly be made manifest. Woe unto the heedless when the Great Terror comes!

Subject: present and future calamities; war; universal convulsion
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/present and future calamities; war; universal convulsion.txt
Quotation: You had written about the turmoil in that region. This upheaval was promised and mentioned in the divine Tablets, and will certainly reach its utmost intensity, but afterward there will be tranquility and stability.

Subject: present and future calamities; war; universal convulsion
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/present and future calamities; war; universal convulsion.txt
Quotation: Those who have provided the means for transporting arms and ammunition and the instruments of wars and massacres on earth will do so in the air. There will come to exist such instruments as to cause all the means of destruction in the past to be looked upon as children's playthings.

Subject: present and future calamities; war; universal convulsion
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/present and future calamities; war; universal convulsion.txt
Quotation: The world is pregnant with oppression; each day is born from it that which thou dost witness. The earth's agitation and the severe trials befalling it from all directions shall not be removed nor find tranquility. This is the truth in which there is no doubt. Then it shall spread to all its members and parts. Verily thy Lord is the Informed, the All-Knowing.

Subject: present and future calamities; war; universal convulsion
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/present and future calamities; war; universal convulsion.txt
Quotation: The Blessed Beauty has written that there will be revolutions and disturbances. There are three classes. High-or educated-- middle and low classes, this (lower) class are dominating. The common classes will dominate and that will be revolution. Irreligion will prevail and at the end the whole civilization of the world will be destroyed.

Subject: present and future calamities; war; universal convulsion
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/present and future calamities; war; universal convulsion.txt
Quotation: It is the effects of these oppressions that have encompassed the world, with new calamities arriving each day. Soon will be witnessed the manifestation of all that remains of what was recorded by the Supreme Pen in God's Book - not a letter shall remain except that it will be visibly manifested in the world of creation, as indeed has occurred.

Subject: present and future calamities; war; universal convulsion
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/present and future calamities; war; universal convulsion.txt
Quotation: The Most Great Tribulation - none can bear it: not the heavens of glory, nor the thrones of grandeur, nor the manifestations of power. Neither realities, nor essences, nor the most resplendent lights can contain it. Therein shall slip the Foot of Eternity by virtue of that which is inscribed in this hidden yet manifest Path - how much more so the feet of the world!

Subject: present and future calamities; war; universal convulsion
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/present and future calamities; war; universal convulsion.txt
Quotation: Await ye the day wherein God shall come in the clouds of glory even as He came in truth, when the eyes of the sincere shall be gladdened and the faces of the idolaters shall be changed, when the heaven shall be cleft asunder and the mountains shall crumble. Then shall ye find the hypocrites in the abyss of wrath, and those who have recognized divine unity in the paradise of God, the Powerful, the Mighty, the Trustworthy.

Subject: present and future calamities; war; universal convulsion
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/present and future calamities; war; universal convulsion.txt
Quotation: In these days, both in the East and in the West, flames rise to the heavens. Millions of souls lie mingled with dust and blood on the battlefield. What wealth is plundered and pillaged! How many precious souls are subjected to the greatest abasement! How many cities have been utterly destroyed from their foundations! How many homes have been and continue to be completely obliterated! Humanity has risen in bloodthirst; all, like wolves and leopards, tear one another apart, giving not the slightest thought to what the consequence of this bloodthirst will be.

Subject: present and future calamities; war; universal convulsion
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/present and future calamities; war; universal convulsion.txt
Quotation: Soon the cry of the tribes of Africa and America, the clamor of Europe and Tajik, and the lamentations of India and the Chinese nation will be raised from far and near, and all will arise with their full strength in resistance. But the horsemen of the divine field, through a confirmation from the Abha Kingdom, will clearly prove through the power of certitude, the hosts of recognition and the army of the Covenant that "their troops, all combined, will there be routed."

Subject: present and future calamities; war; universal convulsion
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/present and future calamities; war; universal convulsion.txt
Quotation: Agitation among the nations and disturbance amidst the peoples is inevitable and predestined in the Day of the Appearance of the Most Great Name

Subject: present and future calamities; war; universal convulsion
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/present and future calamities; war; universal convulsion.txt
Quotation: It has been some time now that the battle-cry of war has been raised and East and West have become combat zones for military valour. From every direction the wild beasts agitate violently and in every land the bloodthirsty examine the sharpness of their teeth. The world of humanity, which is the arena for displaying heavenly virtues, has become the playhouse of ravenous wolves.

Subject: present and future calamities; war; universal convulsion
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/present and future calamities; war; universal convulsion.txt
Quotation: Tribulation hath encompassed the world. If perchance some good be observed therein, a great calamity is seen to follow, the cause and reason for which none among the dwellers of earth hath comprehended. The Lord of the Messengers and the Seal of the Prophets - may the spirit of all else be sacrificed for His sake - hath said: "A time shall come when no one's faith shall remain secure except for those who flee from peak to peak and from stone to stone." Likewise, Isaiah the Prophet hath spoken concerning the severity of these days: "Enter into the rock, and hide thee in the dust, for fear of the Lord, and for the glory of His majesty." This blessed verse he hath mentioned thrice, and this is the greatest proof and mightiest evidence of the severity of these days and the greatness of God's Cause. In another passage he saith: "And they shall go into the holes of the rocks, and into the caves of the earth, for fear of the Lord, and for the glory of His majesty." And further he saith: "To go into the clefts of the rocks, and into the tops of the ragged rocks, for fear of the Lord, and for the glory of His majesty."  Were this evanescent one to undertake mentioning the references from divine books and scriptures that have been sent down from the Kingdom of Will upon the Prophets and chosen ones, it would surely result in a book larger than all existing books. In truth, these are momentous days, for the fire of sedition is ablaze in the world, and cities and lands are besieged under the might of great cannons and in upheaval. Such means have been assembled in the world that the mighty ones of the age do whatever they are capable of doing. The intoxication of pride in these fleeting days hath so seized them that they hear not the cry of the oppressed. They show no mercy to young or old. God shall requite them for what they do.

Subject: present and future calamities; war; universal convulsion
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/present and future calamities; war; universal convulsion.txt
Quotation: Soon will the land of Secret (Baghdad) be changed, and that which is outside it, and it shall pass out of the hands of the King, and commotions shall appear, and the voice of lamentation shall be raised, and corruption shall become manifest on all sides, and affairs shall be disrupted by reason of that which hath befallen these captives at the hands of the hosts of oppression. The established order shall be changed, and conditions shall wax so grievous that the very sands on the desolate hills will moan, and the trees on the mountain will weep, and blood will flow out of all things, and thou shalt behold the people in sore distress.

Subject: present and future calamities; war; universal convulsion
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/present and future calamities; war; universal convulsion.txt
Quotation: Successive calamities have seized the earth and its people, yet no one has attempted to understand the cause or arise to remove it. We leave mention of the world and what is therein to remember My loved ones there and give them glad tidings of God's favor, grace, mercy and kindness.

Subject: present and future calamities; war; universal convulsion
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/present and future calamities; war; universal convulsion.txt
Quotation: One is bewildered - what has happened that calamities have rained and continue to rain like showers upon the lands of Islam in these numbered years? By Thy life, O my Beloved, I know that these are deeds made manifest, revealing signs of divine wrath. I beseech and implore the Truth, exalted be His glory, that He may aid all to return.

Subject: present and future calamities; war; universal convulsion
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/present and future calamities; war; universal convulsion.txt
Quotation: When dark clouds were predominate, and when all the heavenly stars were concealed to the eye... because there the obscurities of blind imitations, of religious, sectarian, racial, political, economic and home prejudices were in ascendency. The darkness of these prejudices had dominated the Oriental world to such a degree that it has blinded all the eyes and deafened all the ears. There prevailed quarrel and strife, warfare and bloodshed.

Subject: present and future calamities; war; universal convulsion
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/present and future calamities; war; universal convulsion.txt
Quotation: Affairs have been overturned, countries have been thrown into turmoil, and Islam has been weakened therein. Enemies have surrounded it, and it stands besieged. The fire of heedlessness hath encompassed the world, and whatsoever God, exalted be His glory, had formerly announced in the Books and Scriptures hath all become manifest and evident. The calamities and tribulations of the earth have become like ordinary food - every day they arrive. On one side calamities, on another side unjust wars, oppressive artillery, and rebellious, tyrannical rifles have encompassed the world and its people, yet none hath discovered the cause and reason thereof.

Subject: present and future calamities; war; universal convulsion
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/present and future calamities; war; universal convulsion.txt
Quotation: Indeed, the face of the world hath been turned toward irreligion. In all years, nay in all months, nay in all days, it hath been far from faith, certitude and knowledge, and close to conjecture and vain imaginings. And for a time they shall continue thus, even as the duration thereof hath been revealed and recorded in the Book of God. But be not grieved, for the effulgences of the Sun of Truth shall absorb the excess moisture of nature and shall gather together the scattered letters. This matter is not confined to this age alone, but hath been thus from ancient times, even as a drop from the hidden drops in the divine ocean of knowledge hath been revealed in the holy Tablet of Wisdom.

Subject: present and future expansion of arts and sciences; of technology

Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/present and future expansion of arts and sciences; of technology.txt

Subject: present and future expansion of arts and sciences; of technology
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/present and future expansion of arts and sciences; of technology.txt
Quotation: In this blessed Dispensation, knowledge shall make infinite progress. Therefore we hope that higher institutions will be established and schools founded with utmost order, and that knowledge in this blessed cycle will make infinite progress.

Subject: present and future expansion of arts and sciences; of technology
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/present and future expansion of arts and sciences; of technology.txt
Quotation: Science has made war expensive; so expensive it don't pay to fight... In modern times the science of war has reached such a stage of perfection that in twenty-four hours one-hundred-thousand could be sacrificed, great navies sent to the bottom of the sea, great cities destroyed in a few hours.

Subject: present and future expansion of arts and sciences; of technology
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/present and future expansion of arts and sciences; of technology.txt
Quotation: The rocky crags of this mountain shall be transformed into gardens of flowers and roses, and shall become a place of pilgrimage for all the peoples of the world. In the future, a form of electricity shall be discovered whereby, within the stone itself and without connection to any power plant, electric lights shall be illuminated.

Subject: present and future expansion of arts and sciences; of technology
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/present and future expansion of arts and sciences; of technology.txt
Quotation: The science of medicine is still in its infancy and has not yet reached maturity. But when it reaches that stage, treatments will be administered with things that are not repulsive to the senses of taste and smell, that is, through foods, fruits, and plants that have an agreeable taste and a pleasant smell. When this science reaches perfection, treatments will be administered with fragrant fruits and plants as well as with other foods, and with hot and cold waters of various temperatures.

Subject: present and future expansion of arts and sciences; of technology
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/present and future expansion of arts and sciences; of technology.txt
Quotation: Thus shall the divine foundation remove all that opposes it, and the world shall become another world, the earthly realm shall become a heavenly realm, the human world shall become the dawning-place of reality, and the rays of the Sun of the celestial realm shall shine upon it. East and West shall be illumined, South and North shall embrace one another, all religions shall seek and speak the truth, and everlasting foundations shall be laid in the world of humanity, and the edifice of the unity of the human race shall rise day by day.

Subject: present and future expansion of arts and sciences; of technology
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/present and future expansion of arts and sciences; of technology.txt
Quotation: Miss Stevens: "...the Blessed Manifestation is said to have warned against the great progress of technology, and there are said to be prophecies from the All-Highest Pen which do not prophesy anything good for the development of the age of the machine. May we, honoured Master, ask your wise tongue to pronounce on this?"  The Master: "O my daughter, in your utterances, contradictory as they may appear, there is no contradiction! But one should walk the depths and heights of prophetic knowledge thoughtfully, in order to get a clear understanding of the relationship of man and of the human race to technology....  The more man can increase the speed of transportation, the more he becomes a slave of time, he no longer has time for anything - not for his body, much less for soul and spirit, not for himself, not for his fellow men, he is more and more subject to the whistling whip of the god of time.  America will conquer the Old World, not with the weapons of war or the sword of the spirit, but through its industrialism, its technical large-scale industry and through the expansion of the technical environment. The machine will devour time; prosaic numbers and formulae, cold charts and measuring devices will suck dry the soul. Mechanical power with its symbols and expressions will rule men, nay enslave and exploit them, and finally the machine will displace man entirely from life and from work, after which the end of time will approach for our planet because, though one may mechanize towns to a large extent, where man is concerned there is a limit.... But should nine tenths of mankind fall victim to the demon of exaggerated technology, the end of the history of our earth will come about. The last of the Days of Judgment will dawn, when the Prophetic Cycle will have come to an end and the world returns to God, when all becomes lost in Him through the crashing and bursting of the elements, which means annihilation for those turned away from God, but spiritualization for those resting in God, and for those souls still in need of purification and development it is a triumphant sinking into God's infinite grace and mercy. And what is the Teaching of the Blessed Perfection Baha'u'llah, when we recognize the signs of the time and our souls would like to turn away trembling from the increasing devilry of the age of the machine?"

Subject: present and future expansion of arts and sciences; of technology
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/present and future expansion of arts and sciences; of technology.txt
Quotation: It may seem strange to you that the Holy Spirit should give designs for labor saving machines, but in reality every creative impulse of the brain can arise only through contact with the spirit. Without that the brain is merely capable of conventional and traditional action.... The labor saving machines were given to create leisure for all mankind.... The first decided shortening of the hours will appear when a legal working day of eight hours is established... But this working day of eight hours is only the beginning. Soon there will be a six hour day, a five hour, a three hour day, even less than that, and the worker must be paid more for this management of machines, than he ever received for the exercise of his two hands alone.... You cannot understand now, how the labor saving machines can produce leisure for mankind because at present they are all in the hands of the financiers and are used only to increase profits, but that will not continue. The workers will come into their due benefit from the machine that is the divine intention, and one cannot continue to violate the law of God. So with the assurance of a comfortable income from his work, and ample leisure for each one, poverty will be banished and each community will create comfort and opportunity for its citizens. Education will then be universal at the cost of the state, and no person will be deprived of its opportunity.

Subject: preservation; transcription of the Sacred Writings
Quotation: O people of the Bab! Make no distinction between the Books which have issued from the Bab. Gather them all together and preserve them with the utmost care, and transcribe them in the most excellent calligraphy upon refined, separate tablets.

Subject: preservation; transcription of the Sacred Writings
Quotation: Make copies of these and send them to various regions, that perchance the people may remember what was revealed therein and be among those who remember.

Subject: preservation; transcription of the Sacred Writings
Quotation: Now the copy of that writing is being sent. Since its beginning was separately copied in the Book of Verses, it is now also being sent separately along with the volume.

Subject: preservation; transcription of the Sacred Writings
Quotation: As to the Messenger, upon him be My glory and loving-kindness, in recent years he hath been engaged in service, ever holding fast to the transcription of verses and the teaching of the Cause.

Subject: preservation; transcription of the Sacred Writings
Quotation: Regarding what was written about making a copy, if your honor makes the copy yourself, it is not necessary for His Honor the Name of Bounty to make another copy. Otherwise the Name of Bounty must make a copy of it.

Subject: preservation; transcription of the Sacred Writings
Quotation: All through His power do gather all that hath been sent down from God. God beareth witness that there is none other God but Him. Say: All through His might do preserve all the verses and clear proofs that God hath revealed in the Book.

Subject: preservation; transcription of the Sacred Writings
Quotation: You shall command that someone write on each tablet nineteen houses with nineteen houses, and in each house shall be written "Allah-u-Akbar" in the most beautiful beloved script. And when completed, bind it in two fine bindings as commanded by some of the believers.

Subject: preservation; transcription of the Sacred Writings
Quotation: You must preserve these translations, original Tablets, and other divine books and scriptures with the utmost strength and protection, for if they fall into the hands of opponents it will cause much mischief and they will rise up strongly against you in Egypt and other places.

Subject: preservation; transcription of the Sacred Writings
Quotation: they have attributed the Book of Iqan, which was revealed from the heaven of grace in response to the Afnan Haji Mir Seyyed Muhammad (upon him be the glory of God and His forgiveness and mercy and bounty), to Yahya, saying it is from him, even though that heedless one was never with Us.

Subject: preservation; transcription of the Sacred Writings
Quotation: Thou hast shown the utmost care, first in preserving it...How excellent that thou shouldst bring into being and send five adorned Tablets of His traces in beautiful handwriting with the utmost joy and fragrance, and show the utmost care in preserving the traces of God, both those from aforetime and those newly revealed

Subject: preservation; transcription of the Sacred Writings
Quotation: This blessed book was revealed in Iraq and printed in India, but before comparison and collation, his honor Mirza Haydar-'Ali, upon him be the Glory of God and His favors, requested its correction from the Land of Sad. By command some have engaged in collation and God willing after correction it will be sent to that land as well.

Subject: preservation; transcription of the Sacred Writings
Quotation: According to His command, you must hold fast in all conditions to the cord of wisdom, and preserve whatever holy tablets and letters arrive from the Most Holy Court and from this servant. It would be regrettable were the signs of God to fall into the wrong hands. A secure place must be designated for the divine trusts - that is, the verses and words.

Subject: preservation; transcription of the Sacred Writings
Quotation: It was known to your honor that it would be best to match whatever copies possible with that book, as most were again presented at the Most Holy Court. Regarding what was written about certain remaining terms whose counterparts were made to conform to the rules, and which were to be recorded and sent on a page - these should certainly be written and sent.

Subject: preservation; transcription of the Sacred Writings
Quotation: O My Name! It is incumbent upon all to preserve the divine verses. In the Land of Ta, they seized every soul along with whatever they possessed, and all was plundered, despite Our repeated written instructions and commands to exercise the utmost effort in preserving that which hath been revealed and sent down from God. Nevertheless, that which occurred is the cause of eternal regret.

Subject: preservation; transcription of the Sacred Writings
Quotation: The people of God should do all that lieth within their power to protect and preserve the Tablets. In the Land of Ta whatever there was in the homes of the friends was taken and fell into the hands of the heedless. We have commanded all to safeguard that which hath proceeded from the Pen of the Most High.

Subject: preservation; transcription of the Sacred Writings
Quotation: And concerning what was written that his honor Aqa Mirza Mahmud, upon him be the Glory of God, is engaged in transcribing the verses of God, I beseech the True One, exalted be His station, to confirm both him and this servant in this most great service under all conditions and to grant success in such wise that no obstacle may have power to prevent and no veil intervene, that we may write and speak for the sake of our Lord, despite those who were heedless and denied that for which they were created.

Subject: pride; vanity; laying claim to inner knowledge
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/pride; vanity; laying claim to inner knowledge.txt

Subject: pride; vanity; laying claim to inner knowledge

Quotation: Then at this time the fire of pride and arrogance blazed up in their hearts and their lofty station became the cause of their exaggeration regarding the Beauty of the All-Knowing King

Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/pride; vanity; laying claim to inner knowledge.txt
Quotation: He [Kheirullah] wished to be made the leader of America and wrote plainly to me to this effect. One of the answers I gave him was, 'Cast aside all mention of the ruler and the ruled, the governor and the governed.'

Subject: pride; vanity; laying claim to inner knowledge
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/pride; vanity; laying claim to inner knowledge.txt
Quotation: Their ultimate desire and goal is that when they give speeches or pass through streets, people clap for them and they take pride in outward honor...all of it is for displaying their own personality and fame.

Subject: pride; vanity; laying claim to inner knowledge
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/pride; vanity; laying claim to inner knowledge.txt
Quotation: The heedless ones of that realm are audacious, and the ignorant ones of that land are proud and vainglorious. Their agitation and clamor arise from their fear lest their standing and respect be lost and they become abased and despised.

Subject: pride; vanity; laying claim to inner knowledge
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/pride; vanity; laying claim to inner knowledge.txt
Quotation: Some of the kings exhibited pride, one was the Ottoman king, Abdul Aziz Khan...You proclaimed once that you were a defender of the oppressed, but it becomes evident that you are not; rather, you magnify your own selfish desires and passions
