Quotation: The letter received from that known individual is steeped in pride and vanity... And in the Tablet of the Temple He explicitly states: "We chose one of our brothers and elevated him to a station where pride and arrogance seized him, therefore We returned him"

Subject: pride; vanity; laying claim to inner knowledge
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/pride; vanity; laying claim to inner knowledge.txt
Quotation: God forbid if a person is overtaken with pride. When a person becomes prideful, first he becomes self-centered. That is, he believes all his doings are correct and the best way. Secondly he causes dissension. His inner thoughts are then in conflict with his behavior, and this results in his quick demise.

Subject: pride; vanity; laying claim to inner knowledge
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/pride; vanity; laying claim to inner knowledge.txt
Quotation: Yet today thou mayest observe peoples who, in the temples and monasteries of the contingent world, would offer a thousand prostrations every minute, yet are steeped in pride, are haughty and obdurate. They have no knowledge whatsoever of submissiveness and humility before the threshold of the Self-Subsisting Lord, and they desire not to worship the King of the Kingdom.

Subject: pride; vanity; laying claim to inner knowledge
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/pride; vanity; laying claim to inner knowledge.txt
Quotation: Indeed, man is noble, for within all things the sign of God exists, but to regard oneself as more learned, superior, more excellent, more God-fearing and more exalted is a grievous error. Consider the divines of Persia - had they not regarded themselves as the most exalted and excellent of all creation, their unfortunate followers would not have engaged in cursing and denouncing the Object of all the worlds.

Subject: pride; vanity; laying claim to inner knowledge
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/pride; vanity; laying claim to inner knowledge.txt
Quotation: During this counseling, Mirza Yahya made him self-centered and a change occurred in him. In any case, at the time when Mirza Aqa Jan should have attained the good-pleasure of the Blessed One, at the critical moment, he lost himself because he imagined that this elevated station was of his own doing. In his final days, his audacity had reached such a degree that he declared in the presence of the Blessed Beauty that even if the Bab had been in his place, He would not have endured it.

Subject: pride; vanity; laying claim to inner knowledge
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/pride; vanity; laying claim to inner knowledge.txt
Quotation: Similarly Nimrod the obstinate - what great cities he had, what a vast country he possessed, what a conquering army he commanded. And likewise Pharaoh who cried out Is not the kingdom of Egypt mine? and declared These rivers flow beneath. His pomp and dominion were boundless, his star was brilliant and radiant, yet in a brief time he was obliterated and destroyed for he sought to resist the truth. God repeatedly addressed such warnings in the Quran to proud peoples, and the purpose was this: O peoples, be not deluded by your hosts and armies, your canopy and standard. Be not deceived by your overwhelming might and dazzling glory. Days shall not pass before all these will be obliterated and destroyed like other peoples, for these nations are like waves that shall all eventually disappear.

Subject: priestcraft
Quotation: Fear thou God, but not the priest. Let thine abode be under the stone, but seek not the shelter of the cleric.

Subject: priestcraft
Quotation: The Blessed Perfection has uptorn the root of the tree of superstitions and religious offices. In the past the ambitious leaders of religions have been the cause of the retrogression and ignorance of a nation. In this Cause there is no religious titles, no ceremonies of ordination. One is not respected simply because he wears a peculiar dress or carries a religious title or has inherited it from the Fathers.

Subject: priestcraft
Quotation: If one searches into the truth about Christianity one finds that all these rules are from the Council, who borrowed from the ancient nations. This Council adopted twenty-one things from the ancient nations:... That the priests should not marry. The religious leader should have a private room in the church. The religious leaders may have the right to excommunicate. Sacrifice, which they had. Transubstantiation. The priest would take the bread and bless it and bless also the wine and would give it to the people of the church. The clergy should have political as well as religious authority. There are twenty-one things and among these is monogamy which was instituted by that Council, according to the ancient customs.

Subject: primordial Covenant; the day of alast
Quotation: Say: O people of God! Did I not make a covenant with you that ye should worship none but God, my Lord?

Subject: primordial Covenant; the day of alast
Quotation: I beseech Thee by Thy Name through which Thou didst take from all Thy servants a covenant concerning Thyself in Thy Books and Thy Scriptures and Thy Tablets

Subject: primordial Covenant; the day of alast
Quotation: when she heard the divine call and tasted a draught of love's sweetness from the cup of Thy bounty, she beat the drum of "yea" in response to "am I not your Lord?"

Subject: primordial Covenant; the day of alast
Quotation: This is of thy Lord's bounty, for that thou didst say, on the Day when God, thy Lord, said: Am I not your Lord? Yea, glory be unto Thee! There is no God but Thee!

Subject: primordial Covenant; the day of alast
Quotation: O My Friends! Have ye forgotten that true and radiant morn, when in those hallowed and blessed surroundings ye were all gathered in My presence beneath the shade of the tree of life, which is planted in the all-glorious paradise? Awestruck ye listened as I gave utterance to these three most holy words: O friends! Prefer not your will to Mine, never desire that which I have not desired for you, and approach Me not with lifeless hearts, defiled with worldly desires and cravings. Would ye but sanctify your souls, ye would at this present hour recall that place and those surroundings, and the truth of My utterance should be made evident unto all of you.

Subject: principle of balance; moderation; equilibrium
Quotation: for any matter that reaches its ultimate degree must then decline.

Subject: principle of balance; moderation; equilibrium
Quotation: O God, grant moderation and bestow balance... Neither should excessive reason and culture prevent the diffusion of accepted fragrances, nor should artful, chain-breaking madness be beloved.

Subject: principle of balance; moderation; equilibrium
Quotation: Neither compulsion nor complete free will, neither constraint nor dominion. "The truth lies between the two extremes" means that existence is bestowed by God but the performance of deeds comes from creation... This is the meaning of "between the two extremes."

Subject: principle of balance; moderation; equilibrium
Quotation: Moderation is necessary in all affairs. Man must take a lesson from Divine actions and deeds, for God causes a tree to bear fruit over a long period, though He is able to make it bear fruit in an instant, but wisdom requires gradual development.

Subject: priority over other activities in teaching the Cause
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/priority over other activities in teaching the Cause.txt
Quotation: While we are carrying this load we cannot carry any other load! Now is the time of laying the foundation. Now must we gather brick, stone, wood, iron, and other building materials! Now is not the time of decoration. We must strive day and night and think and work. What can I say that may become effective? What can I do that may bring results? What can I write that may bring forth fruits? Nothing else will be useful, today. The interests of such a Glorious Cause will not advance without undivided attention.

Subject: priority over other activities in teaching the Cause
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/priority over other activities in teaching the Cause.txt
Quotation: Yes, to look after the weak and to teach the children and to take care of the poor and to administer the internal affairs are all existing work, yet they should not be given such attention that teaching the Faith will be forgotten and the affairs of the teaching spheres be left aside. Nay, the work of teaching the Cause should be performed and training the Baha'i teachers should be instituted and they should be dispatched far and wide to all parts of the world and to all peoples of humanity. Literature of Baha'i proofs and sacred thoughts should be produced and published for the propagation of the Cause. Then after the world has come under the shadow of the Word of God, the accomplishment of other things follows.

Subject: procession; appearance of the Word from God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/procession; appearance of the Word from God.txt
Quotation: "Letter" means a person. As the world came forth from the Mouth, that person is the reflection of the Light of GOD.

Subject: proclamation of the Cause (general or uncategorized)
Quotation: Say: O People of the Book! Do you resent us only because we believe in God and what has been revealed to us and what was revealed before?

Subject: proclamation of the Cause (general or uncategorized)
Quotation: The Pen in the Most Great Prison testifieth and calleth out amongst the nations: "The Kingdom is God's, the Lord of eternity!" Yet the people understand not.

Subject: proclamation of the Cause (general or uncategorized)
Quotation: O ye who are beloved of God among the Bedouins! Hearken unto the call of God from this Tree which hath been raised up in truth and every leaf whereof proclaimeth in all things that "Verily I am God, there is no God but Him, the Most Holy, the Mighty, the Generous."

Subject: proclamation of the Cause (general or uncategorized)
Quotation: Verily the Torah crieth out saying: "He Who revealed Me hath come with His mighty signs. Turn unto Him, O concourse of Jews!" The Gospel exclaimeth: "He hath come from heaven, He through Whose mention God, the Lord of the seen and unseen, adorned His Book." And the Qur'an calleth humanity unto the Truth Who was promised by the Most Exalted Pen in a preserved tablet.

Subject: proclamation to Christians
Quotation: The river Jordan is joined to the Most Great Ocean, and the Son, in the holy vale, crieth out: 'Here am I, here am I O Lord, my God!' This is the Word which the Son concealed, when to those around Him He said: 'Ye cannot bear it now.' Beware, O followers of the Son, that ye cast it not behind your backs. Take ye fast hold of it. Better is this for you than all that ye possess.

Subject: proclamation to Christians
Quotation: Say: Abandon the churches - the Church of God hath appeared upon the temple of man. Turn ye unto it, then remember it with this wise remembrance. Therein is raised the call of the Bell in His Holy Name, while ye remain dead within the veils of your selves. As to those who seclude themselves in churches - did We create them for eating and sitting idle? Nay, by My mighty and loving Self! Rather for this Day wherein He Who was hidden hath appeared with His Name, the Protector of the worlds.

Subject: proclamation to Jews
Quotation: O inheritors of Moses! Hear the call of the Lord of Hosts which hath been raised in the world of creation from the prison of Akka, summoning you to His most glorious horizon.

Subject: proclamation to Jews
Quotation: And Moses calls out: "He Whose beauty I was prevented from beholding has appeared. Hasten, O people of the Torah, unto the good-pleasure of God, the Almighty, the All-Choosing."

Subject: proclamation to Jews
Quotation: Today the Covenant of Israel is renewed, and We have made firm covenants with your fathers Abraham, Isaac and Jacob. O Children of Israel and heirs of Abraham and Moses! Today Jerusalem crieth out with most eloquent speech "The All-Merciful hath come!" and in the wilderness declareth "Here am I! Here am I!" Deprive not yourselves.

Subject: proclamation to Muslims
Quotation: Say: O concourse of the Quran! Fear ye the All-Merciful and follow not your idle fancies. Hearken unto the Call which, verily, hath been raised in truth, and take hold of the Book of God with the strength that proceedeth from Him, and be not of the heedless.

Subject: proclamation to Muslims
Quotation: Return ye to the sayings of your Imams, and the sayings of your Imams return to the words of your Prophet, to that which was revealed in the Furqan. There ye find your proofs. We have taken all that was of your religion and have begun a new creation as We please through Our command 'Be!' and it is.

Subject: proclamation to divines; to religious leaders
Quotation: O concourse of Muslim divines! By your deeds the exalted station of the people hath been abased, the standard of Islam hath been reversed, and its mighty throne hath fallen.

Subject: proclamation to divines; to religious leaders
Quotation: Say, O high priests! Ye are held in reverence because of My Name, and yet ye flee Me! Ye are the high priests of the Temple. Had ye been the high priests of the Omnipotent One, ye would have been united with Him, and would have recognized Him.

Subject: proclamation to divines; to religious leaders
Quotation: Say: O concourse of divines! Die in your wrath. The Hour hath come and ye are sleeping. The Cry hath been raised and ye are heedless. Say: The breeze of God hath wafted over you and ye are as dead. Say: Lift up your heads! Verily the Sun is shining from the horizon of the heaven of Revelation, would that ye perceive.

Subject: proclamation to divines; to religious leaders
Quotation: Say: O concourse of divines! How long will ye remain slumbering upon the couch of heedless negligence? The inhabitants of the cities of divine names have been seized with yearning at the wafting of the fragrance of the Divine Presence, inasmuch as He Who was recorded in the books of your Lord, the Mighty, the All-Knowing, hath appeared.

Subject: proclamation to divines; to religious leaders
Quotation: Say: O concourse of divines! By God, He Who was promised in God's Books hath come, and He Who was hidden in the knowledge of your Lord, the All-Knowing, the All-Wise, hath been manifest. Cast aside what ye possess and take hold of that which ye have been bidden by God, the Lord of all worlds. Do ye deny Him to Whom the Tongue of Grandeur bore witness in former ages? Fear God and follow not your idle fancies. Follow ye Him Who hath come to you with a perspicuous Book.

Subject: proclamation to kings; rulers; prominent individuals
Quotation: O King of the Earth! Hearken to the call of this Vassal

Subject: proclamation to kings; rulers; prominent individuals
Quotation: Tablets to the kings were revealed partly in Adrianople, partly in 'Akka. Only Queen Victoria replied.

Subject: proclamation to kings; rulers; prominent individuals
Quotation: This most exalted Tablet (Lawh-i-Sultan) was revealed - in it all modes are present, from weighty admonitions and loving counsels to Divine verses, prayers and Persian verses. It would suffice all peoples of the world, were they to judge fairly.

Subject: proclamation to kings; rulers; prominent individuals
Quotation: When Baha'u'llah was under chains He sent tablets to the kings. He admonished Napoleon Bonaparte severely. While in prison Baha'u'llah sent a tablet to Abdul Majid, father of the present Shah, arraigning him severely, telling him he would be dethroned.

Subject: proclamation to kings; rulers; prominent individuals
Quotation: O King! The lamps of equity have been extinguished, and the fire of tyranny hath so blazed on every side that My people have been led as captives from Zawra' to Mosul, known as Hadba'. This is not the first outrage that hath been suffered in the path of God.

Subject: proclamation to kings; rulers; prominent individuals
Quotation: Thus have We set forth the verses for thee and sent them down in truth that thou mayest find the sweetness of the table that hath descended from heaven. Until they cast Us into another prison, whereupon We arose with another call and conveyed the Command of thy Lord to kings and monarchs.

Subject: proclamation to kings; rulers; prominent individuals
Quotation: We have indeed sent down a Book unto the kings that they might know the innovative decrees from the presence of the Remnant of God, a just and upright Leader. O concourse of the people of Rome! Fear ye God, your Lord, the Most Merciful, regarding this decree, for it is truth like that which ye firmly believe in God's Covenant.

Subject: proclamation to kings; rulers; prominent individuals
Quotation: Similarly Badi', who bore the letter to the Sultan and stood before him, raised the letter and proclaimed: O King, I have brought thee from the Most Great Announcement a Mighty Book. Surely they have heard the details of how, with what power and might, he declared his mission before His Majesty the Sultan, while wearing but a single shirt.

Subject: proclamation to kings; rulers; prominent individuals
Quotation: "O King of Paris!" ... "O King! Bear thou witness unto that which God hath Himself and for Himself borne witness ere the creation of earth and heaven, that there is none other God but Me, the One, the Single, the Most Exalted, the Incomparable, the Inaccessible. Arise with the utmost steadfastness in the Cause of thy Lord, the All-Glorious."

Subject: proclamation to kings; rulers; prominent individuals
Quotation: O ye two kings! Follow the decree of your Lord, then present yourselves before God, then read the Book of Remembrance with justice, that ye may be numbered among the triumphant. We have indeed sent down the verses as a Book unto the king that thou mightest recite the Book of Command with truth, and be among those who in the Faith of God are well-assured.

Subject: proclamation to kings; rulers; prominent individuals
Quotation: O kings of the earth! We see you increasing every year your expenditures, and laying the burden thereof on your subjects. This, verily, is wholly and grossly unjust. Fear the sighs and tears of this Wronged One, and lay not excessive burdens on your peoples. Do not rob them to rear palaces for yourselves; nay rather choose for them that which ye choose for yourselves.

Subject: proclamation to kings; rulers; prominent individuals
Quotation: I swear by the truth of God! Wert thou to know that which I know, thou wouldst forgo the sovereignty of this world and of the next, that thou mightest attain My good-pleasure, through thine obedience unto the True One... Wert thou to refuse, the Lord of the world would raise up one who would exalt His Cause, and the Command of God would, verily, be carried into effect.

Subject: proclamation to kings; rulers; prominent individuals
Quotation: An epistle was written to Napoleon, but Napoleon did not take any notice of it. Then another epistle was revealed. In the second tablet he says: 'I wrote to thee to test thee. For thou hadst said when the Ottoman fleet was sunk by the Russians in the Black Sea and when the Czar of Russia said to thee, 'O Emperor, I am a Christian and thou art a Christian, why does thou not come to my assistance?'

Subject: proclamation to kings; rulers; prominent individuals
Quotation: The Emperor of France was one in his words greater than mountains, yet in his deeds less than a mustard seed. In the days when the Most Holy Land was made the seat of God's Throne, there was revealed from the heaven of divine Will a most holy and exalted Tablet addressed specifically to him. In that Tablet the Ancient Beauty had observed his kingly station, yet after its dispatch he failed to present a reply.  Thereafter another Tablet was revealed from the heaven of God's Will wherein He states, exalted be His utterance: "We have tested thee and found thee remote from the Word" - meaning, We put thee to the test and found thee estranged from the Word. Among his utterances was this: should there be found an oppressed one in the world who seeks justice, we shall come to his aid and deliver him from tyranny. Nevertheless, he sent no reply to the divine Tablet and arose not to render assistance. After this episode He declared that his likeness was as a cannon without shot - mighty in sound yet yielding no result. Some people are found to be of his kind: in words they claim that which far exceeds their station, yet in deeds they are nothing, nothing, nothing.

Subject: proclamation to kings; rulers; prominent individuals
Quotation:
Fifty years ago Baha'u'llah sent Epistles to all the kings and nations of the world, at a time when there was no mention of international peace. One of these Epistles was sent by Him to the president of the American democracy. In these communications He summoned all to international peace and the oneness of the human world. He summoned mankind to the fundamentals of the teachings of all the Prophets. Some of the European kings were arrogant. Among them was Napoleon III. Baha'u'llah wrote a second Epistle to him, which was published thirty years ago. The context is this: "O Napoleon! Thou hast become haughty indeed. Thou hast become proud. Thou hast forgotten God. Thou dost imagine that this majesty is permanent for thee, that this dominion is abiding for thee. A letter have we sent unto thee for acceptance with thy greatest love; but, instead, thou hast shown arrogance. Therefore, God shall uproot the edifice of thy sovereignty; thy country shall flee away from thee. Thou shalt find humiliation hastening after thee because thou didst not arise for that which was enjoined upon thee, whereas that which was a duty incumbent upon thee was the cause of life to the world. The punishment of God shall soon be dealt out to thee." This Epistle was revealed in the year 1869, and after one year the foundations of the Napoleonic sovereignty were completely uprooted. ABU0037
From His prison cell, He addressed letters to the kings and rulers of the world, calling them to justice and urging them to establish universal peace. The first thing he did was to write an epistle to all the kings of the earth and to the pope and to your President, then U.S. Grant, proclaiming the brotherhood of man and the importance of international peace.

Subject: proclamation to people of the Bayan
Quotation: O people of the Bayan! Let none among you reject another before the Sun of Eternity dawneth from its exalted heaven. We created you from one tree and as the fruits of one tree, that ye might find repose in one another. Look not upon others save as ye look upon yourselves, lest hatred appear among you whereby ye would be veiled from Him Whom God shall make manifest on the Day of Resurrection. Be ye all one people, then return ye unto Him Whom God shall make manifest.

Subject: proclamation to people of the Bayan
Quotation: O people of the Bayan! Cast aside what ye possess and take what ye have been given on this mighty, resplendent Day.

Subject: proclamation to people of the Bayan
Quotation: he was counseled by the Babis not to criticize and find fault with their deeds, just as they themselves practiced concealment and overlooked [faults].

Subject: proclamation to people of the Bayan
Quotation: Fear God, O people of the Bayan, and dispute not with Him for Whose meeting the denizens of the Highest Paradise and those who dwell in the Ark of Grandeur yearn.

Subject: proclamation to people of the Bayan
Quotation: O people of the Bayan! Fear the All-Merciful. He hath claimed neither Guardianship, nor the station of Mirrors, nor Custodianship. He hath manifested what the Mighty, the Powerful hath sent down.

Subject: proclamation to people of the Bayan
Quotation: O people of the Bayan! By the life of the All-Merciful! Until ye pass beyond the gulf of names, ye shall not enter the Most Great Ocean nor receive your portion. Abandon these names which have become the cause of the veiling of all.

Subject: proclamation to people of the Bayan
Quotation: O people of the Bayan! Consider the time as precious and arise to make good what hath passed you by. Return unto your Lord, the All-Merciful, with humility and penitence. Verily, He is the Ever-Forgiving, the Pardoner, the Merciful.

Subject: proclamation to people of the Bayan
Quotation: O people of the Bayan! Fear God and believe in Him Who hath come to you with a mighty sovereignty, on His right hand the hosts of revelation and inspiration, and on His left the angels and the Spirit, if ye be of them that know.

Subject: proclamation to people of the Bayan
Quotation: O people of the Bayan! The All-Merciful hath come, and that which ye possess shall profit you not this day. Cast it aside in My Name, then turn ye toward the light of the Face, as commanded by God, the Ordainer, the Most Praiseworthy.

Subject: proclamation to people of the Bayan
Quotation: O people of the Bayan! Fear God and spread not corruption in the earth after it hath been set in order, neither commit that which is unseemly. Purify yourselves from whatsoever hath been forbidden in the Book of God, the Most High, the Most Great.

Subject: proclamation to people of the Bayan
Quotation: O people of the Bayan! Fear God and dispute not with Him Who hath endured that which no one in all lands hath endured, Who hath suffered the arrows of the polytheists for twenty years, and Who hath arisen to establish the Cause with sovereignty and power.

Subject: proclamation to people of the Bayan
Quotation: O people of the Bayan! Know ye that Truth hath never been, and shall never be, known except through itself, though the chiefs of the Bayan imagine that through certain verbal fabrications and false, contrived traditions they can prevent people from reaching the most great Shore.

Subject: proclamation to people of the Bayan
Quotation: O people of the Bayan! If ye be in doubt concerning My religion, know ye that I have believed in God Who hath created you and created all things, and I will never follow you in your vain imaginations. I have been commanded to worship none but Him, and I am the first of them that worship.

Subject: proclamation to people of the Bayan
Quotation: O people of the Bayan! We have singled you out for the recognition of Our Self amidst all the worlds, and have drawn you nigh unto the right shore beside the Spot of Paradise -- the station whereat the Fire proclaimeth in all melodies that there is none other God but Me, the Most High, the Most Great.

Subject: proclamation to people of the Bayan
Quotation: O people of the Bayan! Fear ye your Lord, the All-Merciful, dispute not with Him, and oppose Him not. Fear God, O heedless ones! Say: O people of the Bayan! If ye persist in your ways, why then did ye leave the community of the Furqan and enter into the party of God, the Almighty, the Most Exalted, the Most Great?

Subject: proclamation to people of the Bayan
Quotation: Beware, O people of the Bayan, lest that which was revealed in the Bayan withhold you from His presence, or its letters prevent you from recognizing Him... Be fair, O people of the Bayan - ye were commanded not to look this Day to the Bayan and its letters, but rather to that which the Revealer of verses ordaineth for you.

Subject: proclamation to people of the Bayan
Quotation: O people of the Bayan! Return unto Me alone, for I address you with the tongue of the unseen, declaring: There is no God but I. By God, I have wept at these words in such wise that none can reckon save God, the All-Compelling, the Self-Subsisting. It is as though I perceived His sorrow and all that would befall Him through your evil surmises.

Subject: proclamation to people of the Bayan
Quotation: O people of the Bayan! By God, the Truth! The Sun of Knowledge hath risen from the horizon of glory and hath dawned from the chambers of the Ridvan Garden - this Youth, upon Whose countenance shineth the radiance of the All-Bountiful, in Whose hand is the Wine of Life, and Who giveth drink to all created things in My Most Glorious Name, this crimson Wine.

Subject: proclamation to people of the Bayan
Quotation: O people of the Bayan! Do ye claim faith within yourselves and seek to prove your cause through My verses revealed aforetime, yet deny My Self? Alas for you, O company of polytheists! By the True One! Ye have committed that which no peoples before you have committed, as doth bear witness the Tongue of God, the True, the Speaking, the Trustworthy King.

Subject: proclamation to people of the Bayan
Quotation: O people of the Bayan! By God, that which ye possess, and all that the world possesseth, shall profit you not this Day. God's Book beareth witness to this, if ye be of them that hear. The veils of idle fancy have prevented you from gazing toward the Most Exalted Horizon, and vain imaginings from hearkening unto the Word of God, Lord of the mighty Throne.

Subject: proclamation to people of the Bayan
Quotation: O people of the Bayan! The Hidden Treasure hath appeared, and He Who was concealed in God's knowledge, the Lord of all men, hath been made manifest. Say: The Sun hath risen, and the Light hath shone forth, and the Fire in the Tree on Sinai doth call aloud and give glad-tidings unto the people of this Revelation which was promised in the Books of God, the Lord of Lords.

Subject: proclamation to people of the Bayan
Quotation: O people of the Bayan! Cast aside your vain imaginings. The Sun of Certitude hath shone forth from the horizon of God's will, the Lord of the earths and the heavens. He who loved Me hath made mention of thee and hath spoken My praise, and We have sent thee from the direction of the Prison that which shall assist thee in guiding those who have broken the Covenant and the Testament.

Subject: proclamation to people of the Bayan
Quotation: Be fair, O people of the Bayan, concerning this Book which God hath made the point round which circle all the books of the world, and this Remembrance before which all remembrances bow down. Say: Present yourselves before the Face that your eyes may behold what no eyes have seen and your ears may hear what no ears have heard. Fear God, O people, and be not of them that go astray.

Subject: proclamation to people of the Bayan
Quotation: O people of the Bayan! We see you more veiled than these, for ye have turned away from Him through Whom the Bayan began and by Whose mighty mention it was sealed. You have rejected the Cause of God and turned away from Him through Whom every wise command appeared. All good hath been made dependent upon His mention and every matter upon His leave, were ye but among those who understand.

Subject: proclamation to people of the Bayan
Quotation: O people of the Bayan! Fear God and confuse not the matter to yourselves. Verily His melodies and His words and all that hath appeared from Him cannot be confused with aught else, could ye but understand. Can the buzzing of the fly be mistaken for the cooing of the Dove, or the croaking of the raven for the scratching of the Most Exalted Pen? Nay, by the Self of Baha, were ye to ponder the verses of your Lord.

Subject: proclamation to people of the Bayan
Quotation: O people of the Bayan! Fear the All-Merciful. By God! He hath come around Whom the Point of the Bayan hath revolved, accompanied by a company of the near-stationed angels. Say: Judge fairly, by God, concerning this Cause whereby the feet of the deniers have slipped - they who have disbelieved in God and His signs, and have turned away from this Momentous Announcement. Verily, they who dispute the signs of God are among the companions of hellfire.

Subject: proclamation to people of the Bayan
Quotation: If ye believe not in the Exalted One (the Bab), why do ye wage war against His Beloved with the swords of rejection? If ye show no mercy to Him, then have mercy upon yourselves and be not of the wrongdoers. Soon shall the angels of chastisement come unto you, and ye shall behold with your own eyes that which ye neglected, and ye shall say: Would that we had never been born, never been suckled, and never denied Him of Whom we were promised in the Tablets of God, the King, the Mighty, the Generous!

Subject: proclamation to people of the Bayan
Quotation: Thou art the One Who, O my God, counseled them in Thy mighty Book and didst say: "O people of the Bayan! Fear ye the All-Merciful, and deny not Him Who hath made the Bayan to be but a leaf amongst the leaves of His Paradise. Verily it was a gift from Me unto Him. Should He accept it, He, verily, is the Most Bountiful, and should He cast it away and reject it, He, verily, is the Just Judge in His judgment, the Praiseworthy in His deeds, and the Obeyed in His commands. To none is given the right to object to Him."

Subject: proclamation to people of the Bayan
Quotation: O ye people of the Bayan! By the righteousness of God, this is My beauty with which I pride Myself in My realm, and the denizens of My celestial kingdom seek blessings from My presence. Nay, rather, all else move by His Will, He verily is powerful over all that He willeth and He is the Gracious, the All-Bountiful. He appeared amongst you with such power that astonished them that devoutly worship Him. He rose alone before all that dwell in the heavens and earth with the power bestowed by Us and I, verily, am the Almighty, the All-Glorious.

Subject: proclamation to people of the Bayan
Quotation: O people of the Bayan! Keep yourselves apart from such as these, and turn not unto a people with whom God is wroth and whom He hath seized with vengeance from His presence. He, verily, is the most severe in punishment. Hasten unto God's good-pleasure and His satisfaction, then take up your abode in the secure station of this mighty Stronghold. Beware that ye draw not nigh unto them who have denied all the verses, whose eyes are veiled from My remembrance, and whose ears are wrapped in coverings from hearkening unto My holy, wondrous Words.

Subject: proclamation to the people of the world
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/proclamation to the people of the world.txt
Quotation: "He Who is the Ancient King hath come! The Kingdom is God's, the Almighty, the All-Choosing!"

Subject: proclamation to the people of the world
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/proclamation to the people of the world.txt
Quotation: O people of earth! Be fair in the Cause of God and be not of the transgressors. He hath come for your salvation.

Subject: proclamation to the people of the world
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/proclamation to the people of the world.txt
Quotation: O concourse of humanity! Fear God, the Lord of destiny. He Who was hidden from eyes and concealed in hearts has appeared.

Subject: proclamation to the people of the world
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/proclamation to the people of the world.txt
Quotation: Today the Book of God with eloquent and persuasive tongue calls all and invites them to the supreme horizon. O peoples of the earth! The Most Great Scene hath been adorned with the Lord of Destiny

Subject: proclamation to the people of the world
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/proclamation to the people of the world.txt
Quotation: O concourse of possibilities! By God, the All-Merciful hath appeared with a sovereignty that hath subdued all who are in the heavens and on earth. O people! By God, the Most Transcendent Scene hath appeared

Subject: proclamation to the people of the world
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/proclamation to the people of the world.txt
Quotation: O denizens of earth and heaven! By the one true God, verily, He Who is the Lord of Eternity hath appeared and shone forth above the horizon of creation through the power of His most lofty, His most exalted sovereignty.

Subject: proclamation to the people of the world
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/proclamation to the people of the world.txt
Quotation: O people of the earth! By God, the call hath been raised from the Most Exalted Horizon. Turn unto it with attentive ears, expanded breasts, illumined hearts, and radiant faces, and be not of those who see and deny.

Subject: proclamation to the people of the world
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/proclamation to the people of the world.txt
Quotation: O people! By God, the All-Bestowing One hath come at the setting-place, and He is the Hidden Book and the Treasured Mystery. He hath appeared and revealed whatsoever He desired, and He is the Almighty, the All-Choosing

Subject: proclamation to the people of the world
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/proclamation to the people of the world.txt
Quotation: O people! This is a Day wherein the Beauty of the Self-Subsisting hath appeared, the heaven hath been cleft asunder, and the smoke hath enveloped all in the world save those who have turned toward the Most Transcendent Scene.

Subject: proclamation to the people of the world
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/proclamation to the people of the world.txt
Quotation: O people! Answer Him Who speaketh this Day, and follow not the manifestations of fancy and idle imaginings. O people! Remember your Lord, the All-Merciful, and follow not every ignorant outcast. O concourse of earth! Grieve not for aught

Subject: proclamation to the people of the world
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/proclamation to the people of the world.txt
Quotation: O peoples of the earth! By God, the seal of the Choice Wine hath been broken, the Hidden Treasure hath appeared, the Kawthar of utterance floweth through all contingent beings, and the Salsabil of knowledge for the followers of all religions.

Subject: proclamation to the people of the world
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/proclamation to the people of the world.txt
Quotation: O people! The Self-Subsisting is come, and the command is God's, the Almighty, the All-Choosing. Beware lest ye deprive yourselves of this most great bounty. Cast away what the people possess and take what ye are bidden by God, Who illumineth the horizons.

Subject: proclamation to the people of the world
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/proclamation to the people of the world.txt
Quotation: O people of the earth! Fear God and follow not the footsteps of your divines. By the life of God! They lead you to the fire and guide you to perdition. O peoples of religions! Deprive not yourselves of the Most Great Ocean, which hath been mentioned in the Books of God, the Lord of all worlds.

Subject: progress and the continual ascent of material civilization
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/progress and the continual ascent of material civilization.txt
Quotation: The contingent world is like the human body that has grown from the embryonic state and reached maturity and perfection.

Subject: progress and the continual ascent of material civilization
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/progress and the continual ascent of material civilization.txt
Quotation: Consider then what will happen in the future: Wait till the dawn of its fortune breaks, All this is but the result of early morn.

Subject: progress and the continual ascent of material civilization
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/progress and the continual ascent of material civilization.txt
Quotation: They did not understand that wondrous inventions would make East and West intimate companions, and new discoveries would make North and South confidants.

Subject: progress and the continual ascent of material civilization
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/progress and the continual ascent of material civilization.txt
Quotation: In this radiant age, humanity has made extraordinary progress in every respect... How much has the world of industry advanced, how much has the scope of inventions expanded!

Subject: progress and the continual ascent of material civilization
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/progress and the continual ascent of material civilization.txt
Quotation: politics reaches its highest degree, wonderful industries prosper, commerce expands, courage raises its banner, the nation transfers from one plane to another, creation is renewed

Subject: progress and the continual ascent of material civilization
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/progress and the continual ascent of material civilization.txt
Quotation: Consider how great is this century and how mighty is this age! However, those early ones were the founders of sciences and arts, and in this respect they possess excellence and virtue.

Subject: progress and the continual ascent of material civilization
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/progress and the continual ascent of material civilization.txt
Quotation: Behold how great have been the advancements in this age by nations who are wholly unaware of God. They advance as day followeth day and gain ascendancy in the eyes of both strangers and their own people.

Subject: progress and the continual ascent of material civilization
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/progress and the continual ascent of material civilization.txt
Quotation: Evolution has now reached a period in the life of nations where commerce takes the place of warfare. Business is war, cruel, merciless... Competition of commerce is as severe, trying and as cruel as wars of olden time.

Subject: progress and the continual ascent of material civilization
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/progress and the continual ascent of material civilization.txt
Quotation: Strive for modern progress and make mighty efforts for sacred civilization... Similarly, strive and make effort in promoting industries and discovering new inventions, expanding the scope of commerce and industry, establishing the customs of civilization, adorning the country

Subject: progress and the continual ascent of material civilization
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/progress and the continual ascent of material civilization.txt
Quotation: Therefore, a wonderful movement and stirring has occurred in the world of existence, and a mighty blessing and revival has appeared. Minds have ascended and understanding has intensified. Movements have become rapid and progress in all ranks has manifested with utmost power.

Subject: progress and the continual ascent of material civilization
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/progress and the continual ascent of material civilization.txt
Quotation: Previously, explaining such matters was difficult, but now since this is the century of progress and education, it is simple and easy. Previously every nation and party had certain superstitions, but now due to education souls have become trained and those superstitions have been torn away.

Subject: progress and the continual ascent of material civilization
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/progress and the continual ascent of material civilization.txt
Quotation: While in times gone by material progress was not so rapid, neither was there bloodshed in such profusion. In ancient warfare there were no cannons, no guns, no dynamite, no shells, no torpedo boats, no battleships, no submarines. Now, owing to material civilization, we have all these inventions, and war goes from bad to worse!

Subject: progress and the continual ascent of material civilization
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/progress and the continual ascent of material civilization.txt
Quotation: let us take this room. Cyrus the great King of Persia could not enjoy the luxuries of a room like this. Solomon with all his glories had a mirror like this! Solomon had not an automobile but only a wooden carriage, a little gilded. The audience chamber of Alexander the great was not lighted with electricity. Now most everybody enjoys the possession of an automobile or his room is lighted with electricity.

Subject: progress and the continual ascent of material civilization
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/progress and the continual ascent of material civilization.txt
Quotation: Consider the well-ordered states of the West, like England, Germany, Switzerland etc, to name but a few, they enjoy the blessing of an ordered, educated and dependable class of officials. The leader of the Württemberg colonists in Haifa, once told us during one of his welcome visits in 'Akka that the great statesman of the Germans, Bismarck, is said to have exclaimed: 'The victorious war of 70/71 was actually won by the "German school-master"!'

Subject: progress and the continual ascent of material civilization
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/progress and the continual ascent of material civilization.txt
Quotation: Today throughout the five continents of the globe it is Europe and most sections of America that are renowned for law and order, government and commerce, art and industry, science, philosophy and education. Further, from the fifth century after Christ until the fifteenth, that period defined as the Middle Ages, such terrible struggles and fierce upheavals, such ruthless encounters and horrifying acts, were the rule among the peoples of Europe, that the Europeans rightly describe those ten centuries as the Dark Ages. The basis of Europe's progress and civilization was actually laid in the fifteenth century of the Christian era, and from that time on, all her present evident culture has been, under the stimulus of great minds and as a result of the expansion of the frontiers of knowledge and the exertion of energetic and ambitious efforts, in the process of development.

Subject: progress only takes place within its own degree
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/progress only takes place within its own degree.txt
Quotation: The law of God is one; the evolution of existence is one; the divine order is one. All beings great and small are subject to one law and one order. Every seed has from the beginning all the perfections of the plant. Similarly, the terrestrial globe was created from the beginning with all its elements, substances, minerals, parts and components; but these appeared only gradually: first the minerals, then the plants, then the animals, and finally man.

Subject: progress only takes place within its own degree
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/progress only takes place within its own degree.txt
Quotation: However much it progresses, it cannot develop eyes and ears. The highest station it can reach is that of the diamond. Its progress is confined to the mineral kingdom. The same is true of the vegetable kingdom. However much a flower progresses, it cannot have eyes and ears and understanding.

Subject: progress only takes place within its own degree
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/progress only takes place within its own degree.txt
Quotation: This stone can never show forth the characteristics of the brilliant star. The wood and the iron can never manifest the beauty and glory of the radiant orb.

Subject: progressive revelation; renewal of religion
Quotation: The question was asked whether after the further declaration of this Truth would the millennium begin at once?  Abdu'l-Baha:  No, gradually, for a plant that grows too quickly lasts only a short time.

Subject: progressive revelation; renewal of religion
Quotation: The Revelation of Baha'u'llah contains all the great laws and principles of social government. This development of humanity will be gradual, not sudden.

Subject: progressive revelation; renewal of religion
Quotation: Verily, just as those who were given the Gospel failed to comprehend after God sent down the Furqan, those who were given the Furqan failed to comprehend after God sent down the Bayan.

Subject: progressive revelation; renewal of religion
Quotation: each one of which was raised in the form of a Prophet and sent to one of the worlds which none hath numbered save God Who hath encompassed all created things through a letter of the Word that proceeded from His Pen

Subject: progressive revelation; renewal of religion
Quotation: But fear ye God on the Day when God shall come with His Command, for on that Day God will lift up what He hath sent down and will reveal other verses. God ordaineth what He willeth and confirmeth what He pleaseth, and unto Him shall all return.

Subject: progressive revelation; renewal of religion
Quotation: The Primal Mirrors shall never end, and likewise the mirrors of Their beauty, for the outpouring of God shall never cease. This is a truth that cannot be denied. And whoso saith that the Manifestations have ended in thy land - pay no heed to him

Subject: progressive revelation; renewal of religion
Quotation: All tables will be gathered up in a short time, but this divine spread and feast will be extended forever. The utmost is that it will be renewed until the new Manifestation and fresh revelation and dawning of the Sun of Truth is established and realized.

Subject: progressive revelation; renewal of religion
Quotation: There are seasons in the revelation from God as in the natural year, and just as the Christ had realized the Spirit of God in the flesh and had helped the earth in his time, now the message of Baha'o'llah was the medicine of which the world has much need.

Subject: progressive revelation; renewal of religion
Quotation: Adam influenced only his own immediate family; Abraham influenced a larger circle; Moses a still larger one--the Israelites; Christ influenced about one-fifth the world; Mohammed about one-tenth. Then came the Manifestation, who will conquer the entire world.

Subject: progressive revelation; renewal of religion
Quotation: The history of the prophets who came before Abraham and Moses is not known, but it is of those who came after them... After years had passed and the departure of Moses took place, the Jews became devoid of knowledge, and so GOD sent Jesus Christ to instruct them

Subject: progressive revelation; renewal of religion
Quotation: The second classification or division comprises social laws and regulations applicable to human conduct. This is not the essential spiritual quality of religion. It is subject to change and transformation according to the exigencies and requirements of time and place.

Subject: progressive revelation; renewal of religion
Quotation: From what hath been mentioned, it is established and proven that none can say We were created from intellect, and others from something else. The truth that shineth bright as the sun is that all have been created by the Will of God and have proceeded from a single source.

Subject: progressive revelation; renewal of religion
Quotation: In the coming of Christ, the divine teachings were given in accordance with the infancy of the human race. The teachings of BAHA'O'LLAH have the same basic principles, but are according to the stage of the maturity of the world and the requirements of this illumined age.

Subject: progressive revelation; renewal of religion
Quotation: From that time to the present we have had lesser cycles, such as the Adam of record, Noah, Abraham, Moses, Jesus, Muhammad, etc. Today, which culminates this long cycle - Baha'u'llah being, in the words of 'Abdu'l-Baha, "The expression of maturity and perfection of humanity."

Subject: progressive revelation; renewal of religion
Quotation: God sends Prophets for the education of the people and the progress of mankind. Each such Manifestation of God has raised humanity. They serve the whole world by the bounty of God. All the teaching of the Prophets is one; one faith; one Divine light shining throughout the world.

Subject: progressive revelation; renewal of religion
Quotation: Therefore reflect ye upon all the Revelations and take heed that what shall come is like unto what hath come before, what shall be decreed is like unto what was decreed, what shall pass away is like unto what hath passed away, and what shall appear is like unto what hath appeared.

Subject: progressive revelation; renewal of religion
Quotation: In previous cycles there was either the manifestation of the Beauty or the dawning of the lights of Glory, either the rising of "Thou art of an exalted character" or the dawning of "God is clear of the idolaters," either the radiance of the Brilliant Orb or the flash of the Drawn Sword.

Subject: progressive revelation; renewal of religion
Quotation: Indeed, the glory from God be upon the First Unity and upon those who resemble that Unity wherein naught is seen save the First Outward One. Furthermore, ye shall bear witness that the creation of a thing is not complete until it culminateth in the four stages which God hath ordained for it.

Subject: progressive revelation; renewal of religion
Quotation: Though Their appearance in the world be not identical, and each is manifested with distinct conduct and behavior, appearing between degrees of lesser and greater, yet They are like unto the moon in heaven which, though it appeareth in different phases, never suffereth diminution or cessation.

Subject: progressive revelation; renewal of religion
Quotation: In every age He hath made manifest the Sun of His mercy in supreme glory and with most resplendent light, causing it to speak and proclaim the most exalted path and way in the realm of existence... And in this Dispensation, as the divine requirements took effect and His decrees spread forth...

Subject: progressive revelation; renewal of religion
Quotation: Consider the term Divine Unity, which the Manifestations of God have uttered in every Dispensation, a goodly term which all the divers peoples and kindreds of the world have spoken. Nevertheless, in each Dispensation, it hath been made new and hath in no wise been divested of its novel character.

Subject: progressive revelation; renewal of religion
Quotation: Know thou that in every Dispensation that dawneth, all things take shelter beneath its shade according to their capacity, for it is the Manifestation of God [...] Therefore, it was due to the lack of capacity of the inhabitants of each Dispensation, otherwise the power from God had been conferred.

Subject: progressive revelation; renewal of religion
Quotation: Therefore, men have always been taught and led by the Prophets of God. The Prophets of God are the Mediators of God. All the Prophets and Messengers have come from One Holy Spirit and bear the Message of God, fitted to the age in which they appear. The One Light is in them and they are One with each other.

Subject: progressive revelation; renewal of religion
Quotation: Were faith the form of the servant, then upon the earth would be found numbered communities, each created in human form. How then, O Letters of the Qur'an, do ye not admit into faith the Letters of the Gospel, even as your Lord will not admit you into faith except that ye enter among the Letters of the Bayan?

Subject: progressive revelation; renewal of religion
Quotation: And I shall teach thee the essence of the Bayan in a surih from the Furqan that thou mayest comprehend all Books from a beginning that hath no beginning unto an end that hath no end according to this exposition. [Followed by detailed analysis showing how the meaning of Surah Al-Fatiha evolves across dispensations]

Subject: progressive revelation; renewal of religion
Quotation: When the days of your Lord, the Most Merciful, have passed, God shall manifest the Primal Tree, bringing forth the latter creation, and on that Day ye shall all be brought into the presence of God. Therefore put your trust in God and ask of His grace, that God may number you on that Day among His believing servants.

Subject: progressive revelation; renewal of religion
Quotation: In the time of Adam, the first prophet of record, we have the seed of Christ consciousness deposited embryonically by Adam. In Abraham it became the child of promise. In Moses the embryonic child had attained to boney structure, which was the Law. In Jesus it attained the birth into the world of Christ consciousness.

Subject: progressive revelation; renewal of religion
Quotation: At all times have the nightingales of utterance warbled upon the twigs of the Lote-Tree of proof, heralding unto all the way that they might attain the most exalted station. In every age and epoch He sent forth a messenger and gave His servants glad-tidings of everlasting bounties, eternal glory, and perpetual sustenance.

Subject: progressive revelation; renewal of religion
Quotation: Although the Caller was one and the same, that call was raised from tree and stone and clay, while this call was raised from the Most Great and Glorious Manifestation. That wine was passed round in an earthen cup, while this pure wine circulated in a crystal goblet adorned with lustrous pearls. Great indeed is the difference!

Subject: progressive revelation; renewal of religion
Quotation: And there is no difference in the ages, for they have all appeared through God's Cause, and the Cause is one from all eternity... Beware, O people of unity, lest ye make any distinction between the Manifestations of God's Cause or in what hath been revealed unto them of verses - this is true unity, if ye be of those who are certain.

Subject: progressive revelation; renewal of religion
Quotation: As in the physical world there are four seasons, so in the realm of religion there is the season of heavenly and spiritual springtime...This is the law of God and is in accord with the world of creation and this is the cause for the reappearance of holy Manifestations Who effect renewal and change in religious laws and commandments.

Subject: progressive revelation; renewal of religion
Quotation: That Manifest Light, His Holiness Abraham, prayed for his offspring, saying "O Kind Lord, make my progeny honored and leaders of the world." At the Divine Threshold, this prayer was accepted... until this Most Great Cycle arrived. The morn of the All-Merciful dawned, the dawn of oneness became bright, and the Sun of Truth shone forth.

Subject: progressive revelation; renewal of religion
Quotation: By God's life! The Truth, exalted be His glory, through His word the Day when mankind shall stand before the Lord of the worlds hath shown that the cessation of the Most Generous One's outpouring is neither permissible nor possible. Therefore, after the seal of prophethood He made mention of Divinity and taught mankind a new flight.

Subject: progressive revelation; renewal of religion
Quotation: Different teachings are needed for different people - if you gave the same teachings to all some might be retarded by them instead of helped...In the time of Moses, the law was given "an eye for an eye, or a tooth for a tooth" - it is very hard to see the wisdom of this - but the people then were in the wilderness and needed this teaching.

Subject: progressive revelation; renewal of religion
Quotation: From the cycle of Adam until today, which spans twelve thousand two hundred and ten solar years, in every Dispensation He has appeared with a different name. In each Dispensation, previous Manifestations have been denied and judged as being other than truth. He has caused all to believe in His novel manifestation and to await His subsequent appearance.

Subject: progressive revelation; renewal of religion
Quotation: Verily all the Manifestations that appeared before are manifest in this Revelation, and what shall appear hereafter is from that. In every subsequent Revelation, expect ye nothing after God, for there is naught after God, as ye know, nor is there aught before God, as ye know. When ye discover the Revelation of God in His Manifestation, ye shall know Him.

Subject: progressive revelation; renewal of religion
Quotation: The divine Manifestations since the day of Adam have striven to unite humanity so that all may be accounted as one soul. Their appearances have been successive and correlated; each One has announced and extolled the One Who was to follow, and all laid the foundation of reality. These holy Manifestations have been as the coming of springtime in the world.

Subject: progressive revelation; renewal of religion
Quotation: All Revelations have ended with this Most Great Revelation. This is He Whose covenant the Point of the Bayan took in the world of the Bayan, and Muhammad the Apostle of God in the world of the Furqan, and the Spirit in the world of the Gospel, and the Interlocutor in the world of the Torah, and the Friend in the world of the Command, if ye be of those who know.

Subject: progressive revelation; renewal of religion
Quotation: Send down, therefore, from Thy presence upon the Letters of Truth, and upon all creation which Thy knowledge hath encompassed, that which shall cause them to enter on that Day into this Religion until the Day of Resurrection, and then on that Day into the Faith which Thou shalt inaugurate, for verily it is nearer unto Thee than this, and verily it is the pure and unalloyed Truth

Subject: progressive revelation; renewal of religion
Quotation: We nurtured the creation of the Furqan for one thousand two hundred and seventy years, that perchance when they heard Our verses they might believe in Us and in Our proof. Thus have We admitted into the paradise of Our love those who followed Our verses and believed in Our proof, and We have forbidden from paradise those who, when they heard Our verses, said not "We are among the believers."

Subject: progressive revelation; renewal of religion
Quotation: Likewise, those who were given the Quran - had they recognized God their Lord when they heard a verse from God declaring There is no God but I, all would have believed in Him. But since they believed not, though they consider themselves religious in their own estimation, they must cause their souls to perish, for this is the foundation of their religion, but they understand not nor do they perceive.

Subject: progressive revelation; renewal of religion
Quotation: Were faith the form of the servant, then upon the earth would be found numbered communities, each created in human form. How then, O Letters of the Qur'an, do ye not admit into faith the Letters of the Gospel, even as your Lord will not admit you into faith except that ye enter among the Letters of the Bayan? Thus hath God exalted all the heavenly Books through the essence of pure and treasured camphor.

Subject: progressive revelation; renewal of religion
Quotation: Abraham proclaimed the Truth, Moses raised the Standard of Truth, Jesus established the Truth. Can we say that any one of them did not found it? All the prophets have been chosen by God to promulgate The Word. The teachings of the Manifestations are of two kinds;--first, the Word of God in its outer or material aspect;--second, the Word of God in its spiritual or inner significance. The first named is changeable; the second unchangeable.

Subject: progressive revelation; renewal of religion
Quotation: When the world becomes dark and gloomy and heedlessness appears, God sends a divine soul... Then gradually those divine traces were effaced and satanic desires and passions prevailed. Darkness encompassed all. Then again the voice of unity was raised... After a time, people forgot these divine laws, no reality remained, and darkness and heedlessness and ignorance encompassed all. Now Baha'u'llah has come and renewed that original foundation.

Subject: progressive revelation; renewal of religion
Quotation: The interpretation of this prophecy is this: the first Dispensation to which it refers is the Muhammadan Dispensation during which the Sun of Truth stood still for ten days. Each day is reckoned as one century. The Muhammadan Dispensation must have, therefore, lasted no less than one thousand years, which is precisely the period that has elapsed from the setting of the Star of the Imamate to the advent of the Dispensation proclaimed by the Bab.

Subject: progressive revelation; renewal of religion
Quotation: The example of the Manifestation of God is as the sun - though it should rise countless times as reckoned by those who count, it is but one sun, and though it should set countless times as reckoned by those who count, it is but one sun, if ye would observe with truth the primal Sun from the beginning that hath no beginning unto the end that hath no end. In all Manifestations ye are guided by the throne of God's Revelation, then are ye saved.

Subject: progressive revelation; renewal of religion
Quotation: He whom God shall make manifest shall appear after the lapse of time, and on a day after the lapse of time after He whom God shall make manifest, He Who shall appear after He whom God shall make manifest shall be made manifest, and on a day of He Who shall appear after He whom God shall make manifest, He Who shall appear after He whom God shall make manifest shall be made manifest, unto the end that hath no end, even as the beginning that had no beginning.

Subject: progressive revelation; renewal of religion
Quotation: Among the teachings of Baha'u'llah is that divine bounty is continuous. Divine manifestations are continuous. The breathings of the Holy Spirit are continuous. The doors of the Kingdom are open and the Sun of Truth always has its rising and setting. Divine sovereignty is continuous and does not end. The reality of Christ came before, has come again and will come again because this reality manifests in divine Manifestations. The sun is one sun but it has multiple rising places and horizons.

Subject: progressive revelation; renewal of religion
Quotation: Just as you observed that in the day of the manifestation of the Point of the Furqan (may my spirit be sacrificed for Him) the lights of bounties from that shining Luminary were clear and visible and radiant upon the world of existence, and for a thousand years that divine bounty flowed upon the hills and regions and realities of contingent beings, and when the cycle ended, those traces and lights returned to the Kingdom of the Unseen. Then there was a new effulgence and a new light dawned.

Subject: progressive revelation; renewal of religion
Quotation: As for the tradition that in former times two letters were revealed but in the time of the Qa'im all the remaining letters would be manifested - the meaning is that all the traces, sciences, laws, regulations, innovations, crafts and human perfections that appeared in former times were like two letters, but in this wondrous Revelation and emergence of the precious treasury, human perfections and virtues and infinite sciences and arts will reach such a degree as to be like all the remaining letters.

Subject: progressive revelation; renewal of religion
Quotation: Consider how one and the same light has reflected itself in the different mirrors or manifestations of it. The Sun of Reality revealed itself from the Mosaic mirror. The people who were sincere accepted and believed in it. When the same Sun shone from the Messianic mirror, the Jews who were not lovers of the Sun and who were fettered by their adoration of the mirror of Moses did not perceive the lights and effulgences of the Sun of Reality resplendent in Jesus; therefore, they were deprived of its bestowals.

Subject: progressive revelation; renewal of religion
Quotation: The divine religions, by which are meant those based upon divine revelation and possessing a book, are seven in number. Consider the great world religions of to-day. They are Zoroastrianism, Judaism, Christianity, Mohammedanism, Buddhism and Confucianism, each of which branches into many sects and denominations. According to the Bahai belief all the truth of these six religions is embraced within a seventh -- the revelation of Baha'o'llah -- which completes and fulfils the promises and prophecies of the prophets of the past.

Subject: progressive revelation; renewal of religion
Quotation: Abraham was a prophet for his own people; Moses was a prophet for the Israelites, and through his power other prophets were manifested among the Israelites. Jesus Christ, through his spiritual power, taught a few in his time, through in reality there were only twelve disciples, one of whom Judas Iscariot, who betrayed him, thus leaving eleven who remained with the Master. In the cycle of Muhammed, the prophet was a forcible power, and in the cycle of Baha'o'llah (Glory be to Him!) there existed the greatest spirituality and forbearance of oppression.

Subject: progressive revelation; renewal of religion
Quotation: Glorified, glorified art Thou! For I, O my God, despite my insignificance, surely witness the varieties of Thy creation: him whom Thou didst create through the Gospel - in those days my soul was not content; and him whom Thou didst create through the Torah thereafter likewise; and him whom Thou didst create through the Furqan thereafter similarly. Yea, in those days Thou wilt surely create me through the verses, but verily I witness with mine own eyes that Thou wilt surely create another creation and wilt surely make that creation like the former Books.

Subject: progressive revelation; renewal of religion
Quotation: The occurrences were repeated. We can not say that what happened in the time of Christ was remarkable, since the same had happened before. We can not say that it is extraordinary that the present springtime follows that of last year. We can not say this year that these blossoms are useless because the same ones appeared last spring. The last spring gave out its benefits, and summer, autumn, and winter followed. If a new spring did not come to the world everything would die. In every springtime there will be repeated what has happened in previous springtimes.

Subject: progressive revelation; renewal of religion
Quotation: Both these sayings have but one meaning, were you to ponder upon the Manifestations of the Unity of God with divine insight. Consider the sun. Were it to say now, I am the sun of yesterday, it would speak the truth. And should it, bearing the sequence of time in mind, claim to be other than that sun, it still would speak the truth. In like manner, if it be said that all the days are but one and the same, it is correct and true. And if it be said, with respect to their particular names and designations, that they differ, that again is true. For though they are the same, yet one doth recognize in each a separate designation, a specific attribute, a particular character.

Subject: progressive revelation; renewal of religion
Quotation: Materialism prevailed and all human thoughts were confined to the material world. None remained attentive to God. The gates of divine knowledge were closed, the fire of the love of God was completely extinguished, and all humanity was submerged in the sea of matter. Then Abraham appeared... After a time, those lights were again extinguished. Material darkness enveloped the world. People became heedless of God and paid no attention to the Kingdom. Moses appeared... After a time, that lamp was again extinguished... In such a state, the Star of Christ arose... Then Arabia grew dark... Muhammad appeared in Arabia... Then again, all was overturned... At this time, the Bab appeared in Persia. The Star of Baha'u'llah arose.

Subject: progressive revelation; renewal of religion
Quotation: We have been taught that BAHA'O'LLAH was the Seventh of a series of great World (Universal) Manifestations of this present cycle, Christ being the sixth, Melchesidec the fifth, while the first four were before the compilation of our present world history, and of them we have no records; that their teachings were applicable to all mankind under all conditions; while upon the other hand the Manifestations, such as Zoroaster, Abraham, Moses, Mohammed and the Bab were sent each to a certain people, bringing teachings which were applicable to those certain conditions and people only, while the teachings of the World Manifestations were not limited in their application to peoples. Is this teaching correct? A. --Yes, it is correct.

Subject: progressive revelation; renewal of religion
Quotation: Look thou with the gaze of the beginning at what thou beholdest concerning Adam, the First One, then those who came after him until the Cause reached unto 'Ali-Qabli-Nabil. Say: By God! All of them came from the Dayspring of the Cause with a Book, a Scroll, and a mighty Tablet, and each was given according to what was ordained for them, and this is of Our grace upon them, if ye be of them that know. And all of them delivered the messages of their Lord and gave glad-tidings unto the people concerning the good-pleasure of God, the All-Subduing, the Almighty, the All-Powerful, and brought forth the people from darkness unto light, and gave them glad-tidings of the meeting with God, even as ye have read in the scriptures of old.

Subject: progressive revelation; renewal of religion
Quotation: The divine religions are like the progression of the seasons of the year. When the earth becomes dead and desolate and because of frost and cold no trace of vanished spring remains, the springtime dawns again and clothes everything with a new garment of life. The meadows become fresh and green, the trees are adorned with verdure and fruits appear upon them. Then the winter comes again, and all the traces of spring disappear. This is the continuous cycle of the seasons -- spring, winter, then the return of spring. The divine Prophets are as the coming of spring, each renewing and quickening the teachings of the Prophet Who came before Him. Just as all seasons of spring are essentially one as to newness of life, vernal showers and beauty, so the essence of the mission and accomplishment of all the Prophets is one and the same.

Subject: progressive revelation; renewal of religion
Quotation: His Holiness Abraham (peace be upon Him) took the covenant of the Promised One, Moses, and gave tidings of His appearance. His Holiness Moses took the covenant of the Promised One, Christ, and gave the world glad tidings of His manifestation. His Holiness Christ took the covenant of the Paraclete and gave tidings of His appearance. His Holiness Muhammad took the covenant of the Bab, and the Bab was the Promised One of Muhammad, for He gave tidings of His appearance. The Bab took the covenant of the Blessed Beauty, Baha'u'llah, and gave tidings of His appearance, for the Blessed Beauty was the Promised One of the Bab. And the Blessed Beauty took the covenant of a Promised One Who will appear after a thousand or thousands of years - that Promised One is the Blessed Beauty and He will appear after a thousand or thousands of years.

Subject: progressive revelation; renewal of religion
Quotation: And if it be said that what appeared in this wondrous Revelation had no precedent and all is new, this saying too is correct and complete. For if God, exalted be His mention, should today utter a word that all people past and future have uttered and will utter, that word would be new, were ye to reflect. Consider the word of unity, which the Manifestations of Truth have uttered in every Revelation, and likewise all peoples of diverse faiths have uttered this goodly word. Yet in each Revelation it hath been renewed, and never hath its quality of innovation been taken from it. When God uttereth a word, a fresh spirit is breathed into that word, and the breezes of life from that word waft over all things, both outwardly and inwardly. None can tell for how long the effects of God's word, as manifested in the horizons without and within, shall endure.

Quotation: All things are known only through the manifestation of His light in the essential and accidental realities, so that each may attain, through knowledge of that station, to all the stations which God hath ordained for it in the verses of the manifestations of the Beginning and the appearances of the End, even unto the final goal.

Subject: proofs for the existence of God
Quotation: Some believe that the realization of things, the composition of beings, and their analysis arise from interaction, and therefore have no need of a true Director. In truth, there exists a wondrous connection between the component parts of creation, and from this connection interaction is clear and manifest. Were this mover not to exist, these interactions would not be realized. Thus it becomes clear that all these interactions depend upon an all-encompassing power through which these interactions systematically occur.

Quotation: Did God's Holy Ones find such comfort and ease in this mortal realm that They would continuously seek to return and repeat this life? Is not one instance of these sorrows, afflictions, calamities, blows and difficulties sufficient, that They should wish for repeated existence in this world? This cup was not so sweet as to desire its repeated draughts.
