Quotation: The first transgression committed in the Bayan was that he betrayed the sanctity of the Point's household, which was the mother of all servants, explicitly forbidden to all in every Book, as decreed in all heavenly scriptures and likewise explicitly prohibited in the Bayan. The flames of passion were so intense that they did not spare even God's sanctuary, and after violation, being disturbed, they passed her to another, as you have all heard.

Subject: rebellion and misdeeds of Mirza Yahya; the Azalis
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/rebellion and misdeeds of Mirza Yahya; the Azalis.txt
Quotation: Through Yahyai deception perpetrates corruption against these innocent ones... This party of Yahya, which among all the dispersed parties set everyone against each other so that perhaps in this struggle they might snatch the ball from the field and establish a government, has ruined Iran. Now they are honored and respected while this oppressed party, from whom nothing has emerged except the good of Iran, has become captive to the corruption of Iran's ill-wishers.

Subject: rebellion and misdeeds of Mirza Yahya; the Azalis
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/rebellion and misdeeds of Mirza Yahya; the Azalis.txt
Quotation: Beyond all this, consider the oppression and tyranny of My brother and his followers. Wherever We went, before many days had passed, he would come and dwell in perfect comfort and honor with his known women companions - as all have heard and know - protected beneath the pavilions of protection. Yet they call him the wronged one and attribute injustice to God, exalted be His glory! If this Wronged One was an oppressor, why did My brother proceed to that land and enter Our house?

Subject: rebellion and misdeeds of Mirza Yahya; the Azalis
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/rebellion and misdeeds of Mirza Yahya; the Azalis.txt
Quotation: Mirza Yahya had hidden himself in a thousand holes. The Cause of God had entirely vanished. In Baghdad, Mirza Yahya was selling Yemeni cloth in the Suq al-Shuyukh, wearing a turban as large as Mount Abu Qubays. Then he changed his name and became known as Haji Ali the cloth merchant. They had asked him, Why do you change your name every day and wear different clothes each day? He had replied, So that people won't recognize me. With such cowardice and foolishness he wanted to oppose the Blessed Beauty.

Subject: rebellion and misdeeds of Mirza Yahya; the Azalis
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/rebellion and misdeeds of Mirza Yahya; the Azalis.txt
Quotation: Now that he is under British protection in Cyprus he calls himself chief, and Mirza Yahya Dawlatabadi likewise claims successorship and vicegerency, counting himself a precious soul. Despite this he pronounces his disavowal and in your newspaper announces his repudiation of the Prince of the Wronged Ones. As for Mirza Yahya of Cyprus, after the martyrdom of the Bab, the grace that issued forth from this distinguished Siyyid was that during the days of mourning he took to his embrace in marriage the companion of that Wronged One, and not content with this, he divorced her and gave her in marriage to Siyyid Muhammad Isfahani.

Subject: rebellion and misdeeds of Mirza Yahya; the Azalis
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/rebellion and misdeeds of Mirza Yahya; the Azalis.txt
Quotation: All, both friend and stranger, know that in times of danger their leader would travel to every land in dervish garb, holding out an alms bowl on the roads saying "Something for God's sake." When the incident of Sadiq and Nasiri'd-Din Shah occurred, he abandoned all the friends under sword and chain in the district of Nur, and promptly fled to Mazandaran and Gilan. He wound a cord around his head, donned dervish garb, called himself Darvish 'Ali, and wandered through mountain and plain until the Ancient Beauty was exiled to Iraq. He then followed to Baghdad seeking divine protection, but remained hidden and fearful of all humanity.

Subject: rebellion and misdeeds of Mirza Yahya; the Azalis
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/rebellion and misdeeds of Mirza Yahya; the Azalis.txt
Quotation: But he saw himself as the Mirror and beheld himself as supreme, and did not relinquish the Cause - nay, worse than that, he made his son Mirza Ahmad his primary successor. Had We not manifested Our Cause, according to the testament of the Exalted One, it would have been incumbent upon him to advise the people of the Bayan, to prefer the words of another, and to relinquish the Cause. Another deed that blinded his inner eye was that the Point of the Bayan had called Himself the first to believe in him. When He appeared and His verses and proofs gave life to the dead, sight to the blind, and hearing to the deaf, he not only failed to acknowledge Him but arose to cut down the Divine Lote-Tree.

Subject: rebellion and misdeeds of Mirza Yahya; the Azalis
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/rebellion and misdeeds of Mirza Yahya; the Azalis.txt
Quotation: When my brother witnessed that the sun of certitude had dawned from the horizon of utterance through this Youth, Who stood at the center of all creation with the adornment of the All-Merciful, he emerged from behind the veil of concealment and rose up to war against the Beauty of the All-Glorious, becoming one of the antagonists. He pronounced against me what his self and passion commanded him. Then the hosts of victory descended from the direction of a mighty throne, and the vanguards of divine protection appeared from the horizon of glory. When he found himself disappointed in what he desired and dejected in what he sought, he devised another stratagem, whereby all names were disturbed in their kingdoms, and all existence, both seen and unseen, wept at what befell my soul - and God was witness over him and me.

Subject: rebellion and misdeeds of Mirza Yahya; the Azalis
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/rebellion and misdeeds of Mirza Yahya; the Azalis.txt
Quotation: One afternoon, He came out from the sanctuary, and all the emigrant servants were standing in His presence, including this servant, Haji Mirza Ahmad, Siyyid Muhammad and others. He said that a strange thing had been witnessed that day. These servants waited to learn what had occurred. After about ten minutes or more of silence, He turned to these servants and said that at dawn that day, a bird had perched on a branch of the tree by the house, saying these words: Muhammad has come and calamity has come, and the bird repeated these words three times. None of these servants imagined it referred to the present Muhammad. Even Siyyid Muhammad himself considered such a thing impossible regarding himself. After two full years had passed, that which was to appear appeared. At that time it became known who was meant by the mentioned Muhammad. By God! By God! His actions and deeds are not worthy of mention.

Subject: rebellion and misdeeds of Mirza Yahya; the Azalis
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/rebellion and misdeeds of Mirza Yahya; the Azalis.txt
Quotation: What manifestation occurred! And now too if a test should arise, by God besides Whom there is no God, you will immediately observe them mounting the pulpit declaring "We are innocent!", nay rather cursing and reviling. Ask these souls one proper question and say: O fair-minded ones, by God, after the shedding of the pure blood of the Bab, what did this Mirza Yahya do except constantly pursue marriage, taking a new wife each day, even transgressing against the honored wife who was the Mother of the Believers - something categorically forbidden by the text of all divine religions. Despite this he showed not even outward respect - he took possession of her himself and not content with this bestowed her upon another. Apart from this atrocious act what service did he render to God's Cause? Whom did he teach? What question did he explain? When did he arise in sacrifice? When did he manifest a divine spirit?

Subject: rebellion and misdeeds of Mirza Yahya; the Azalis
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/rebellion and misdeeds of Mirza Yahya; the Azalis.txt
Quotation: We arose alone before the gaze of the peoples of earth and heaven at a time when all had determined to slay us. While dwelling in their midst, We continually made mention of the Lord, celebrated His praise, and stood firm in His Cause, until at last the Word of God was vindicated amongst His creatures, His signs were spread abroad, His power exalted, and His sovereignty revealed in its full splendour. To this bear witness all His honoured servants. Yet when My brother beheld the rising fame of the Cause, he became filled with arrogance and pride. Thereupon he emerged from behind the veil of concealment, rose up against Me, disputed My verses, denied My testimony, and repudiated My signs. Nor would his hunger be appeased unless he were to devour My flesh and drink My blood. To this testify such of God's servants as have accompanied Him in His exile, and, beyond them, they that enjoy near access unto Him.

Subject: rebellion and misdeeds of Mirza Yahya; the Azalis
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/rebellion and misdeeds of Mirza Yahya; the Azalis.txt
Quotation: Be thou steadfast in the love of thy Lord, then detach thyself from the idolaters. And shouldst thou see the Satan from whom thou perceivest the stench of polytheism, shun him and be under mighty protection. He appears in human form and speaks of what was revealed in the Bayan, that he might cause confusion among Our weak servants. Say: Should anyone manifest the essence of piety and worship his Lord with the devotion of both worlds, yet not believe in this Revelation, God will render his deeds void and return him to his abode in hellfire.

Subject: rebellion and misdeeds of Mirza Yahya; the Azalis
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/rebellion and misdeeds of Mirza Yahya; the Azalis.txt
Quotation: During his stay in Iraq, he would secretly drink wine and engage in other improper acts. Toward the end of the Iraq period, he would sometimes transgress from secrecy to openness, yet those circling around would conceal it

Subject: rebellion and misdeeds of Mirza Yahya; the Azalis
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/rebellion and misdeeds of Mirza Yahya; the Azalis.txt
Quotation: Satan will appear on the Island of Qaf and prevent people from the All-Merciful. Hubab (name of Satan and serpent) will appear on his associated island (the island associated with Satan is Cyprus, called Satan's Island). He is short in stature, thick-bearded, narrow of forehead and chest, yellow of eye and hair, with camel-like fur on his back and goat-like hair on his chest.

Subject: rebellion and misdeeds of Mirza Yahya; the Azalis
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/rebellion and misdeeds of Mirza Yahya; the Azalis.txt
Quotation: The world of the Bayan hath been transformed into the world of the Shi'ih, in its essence, its outward form, its names, its attributes, its delusions and its imaginings. Nay, its people are seen to be more remote, more debased and more ignorant.

Subject: rebellion and misdeeds of Mirza Yahya; the Azalis
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/rebellion and misdeeds of Mirza Yahya; the Azalis.txt
Quotation: You have undoubtedly heard the details of what transpired in Adrianople, when Siyyid Muhammad, being confident that the Ancient Beauty would not confront one such as Yahya, told Mir Muhammad - who was one of the simple-minded followers - and likewise to some of the Persians of that land, that on the morrow so-and-so would come forth. If they spoke the truth, let them also come forth and meet at the Sultan Selim Mosque, that truth might be distinguished from falsehood. The next day, Mir Muhammad - upon him be the glory of God - came and conveyed this message to the Most Holy Court. At that moment, the Ancient Beauty arose and went forth from the gate of the private quarters, revealing divine verses in the most exalted voice as He proceeded, until He arrived at the mosque. Some Persians were present, listening in utter amazement, with tears streaming down their faces. He told Mir Muhammad: "Go and tell them to appear." After some time he returned and reported that the Chief of Liars had asked to be excused. The Ancient Beauty granted a further two days' respite. This incident occurred in the presence of seventy believers and others. Nevertheless, after arrival in the Most Great Prison, one day a well-known person came into the presence of the Most Great Branch - may my spirit, my being, and my essence be sacrificed for the dust of His most mighty footsteps - and reported that Siyyid Muhammad and Aqa Jan were claiming that in Adrianople it had been arranged for the Ancient Beauty to meet with him in one assembly for discourse, but while Mirza Yahya came, the Ancient Beauty did not appear, and this became evident to all the divines, notables and the governor. The Branch of God presented this before the Divine Throne, saying: "Such astonishment seized me that I was rendered incapable of response." Now observe how they have recounted and distorted such a clear and evident matter. They have attributed to themselves all the characteristics of the Ancient Beauty, and ascribed their own misdeeds to the Manifestation of sanctity and holiness. Throughout the years of their stay in Adrianople, they were occupied day and night with such activities. Thus whatever was manifested from the Most Great Branch in His childhood, Siyyid Muhammad-i-Isfahani would attribute to Ahmad, son of Yahya, and mention it in his name. The curse of God be upon the liars and the slanderers!

Subject: recompense; reward for belief; right action
Quotation: If a man commit a transgression he has been unjust to himself, and soon he will find that he is in manifest regret and remorse.

Subject: recompense; reward for belief; right action
Quotation: And as to those who disbelieve in that which was revealed unto Thee in that Book, after they had understood its truth, they are indeed of them who have joined partners with God, while the faithful, who whenever they hearken unto the words of God, prostrate themselves in adoration.

Subject: recompense; reward for belief; right action
Quotation: The perfections of man are really the rewards of man. One spirit may be perfect, wise, knowing, possessed of praiseworthy virtues and human perfections. These virtues are in themselves the reward of this spirit. One spirit may be radiant, lordly, merciful. These qualities are its reward.

Subject: recompense; reward for belief; right action
Quotation: God shall send down upon those who have believed in the Bayan whatsoever they ask of His bounty. These are they who shall inherit Paradise, wherein they shall abide forever. Therein shall they have whatsoever their souls desire, and God shall bestow more upon them from His presence. Verily, there is no God but He, the Help in Peril, the Self-Subsisting.

Subject: recompense; reward for belief; right action
Quotation: Now we are only believing in God, but we cannot realize the great blessing of this until we get into that condition. It is known that when we pass from this world to the other, that every good thing or delight or every bad thing will be the result of actions here. It is said by the Bab that Hell is prepared for man through his lack of belief in God, and Paradise is prepared by belief in God.

Subject: regarding the receptivity of the hearer in teaching the Cause
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/regarding the receptivity of the hearer in teaching the Cause.txt
Quotation: ...it is quite clear that one must speak according to the capacity of the listeners. That epistle was written because some relatives of the Primal Point, may our souls be sacrificed for all except Him, had doubts about certain matters and had not yet advanced from the Quran to the Bayan. Therefore, for the people of the Quran, Quranic verses were used as proof lest they become disturbed, as they did not yet accept the Bayan and thus could not be shown verses from the wondrous Bayan.

Subject: reincarnation
Quotation: The three spirits - the vegetable spirit, the animal spirit and the human spirit (that is, the rational soul) - do not return after death to this world of the first creation. However, the spirit of faith, which is the light of guidance, and the Holy Spirit, which is the reality of divine revelation, both return in every dispensation and cycle to this realm of the first creation.

Subject: reincarnation
Quotation: The divine worlds are infinite, and this fact, as well as the invalidity of the doctrine of reincarnation, are explicitly set forth in the Book of Certitude in clear terms

Subject: reincarnation
Quotation: And know thou, that verily, those whose were following the steps of Christ, detached their souls from the desires of the world, and made their hearts to depend on the bounties of heaven. Such are the people of the Kingdom and they are in no need of return for apprehending the bounty of the Kingdom. The consciences of such souls are clear, their inmost hearts are pure, [they] have obtained their aim, have betaken themselves to the vicinity of the mercy of their Mighty Lord, and thus they are in no need of being refined, developed and again endowed with sight.

Subject: reincarnation
Quotation: What the masters of the past have said concerning reincarnation is sheer superstition. When the human spirit departs, it does not return to this material world. For this world is but a single sphere, whereas the realms of the divine worlds are infinite.

Subject: reincarnation
Quotation: The first school believes that the spirit of man goes through infinite processes of birth and re-birth in the human kingdom, until it is refined and purified - finally attaining to the station of Nirvana. The second school believes that through the consequences of our deeds we may be born again into the lower kindgdoms of life - such as animals, birds, etc.

Subject: reincarnation
Quotation: But in this new world all those called into being are new souls. It is not that a former soul becometh incarnated in another person, or that another individual becometh the soul of a former individual. Nay, rather they correspond with each other through manifestations; that is to say, he will be in the station of his soul, but his soul is not incarnated and the state of the soul does not become embodied.

Subject: reincarnation
Quotation: The doctrine of reincarnation as taught by the Buddhists, and some of the ancient philosophers is not true. It was largely invented by those people who clung to this world and loved it so that they could conceive of no happiness apart from it. Many of the Theosophists have said that it was necessary for people to return again and again in order to attain to perfection. But there is no spiritual benefit in mere length of time.

Subject: reincarnation
Quotation: In the twenty-ninth chapter of the Book of Job, verses twenty-five, twenty-six and twenty-seven, which that person has used to argue for reincarnation, how contrary to truth it is and how clear, for He says: "I know that my redeemer liveth, and that He shall stand at the latter day upon the earth." This passage refers to the spiritual resurrection, for He says: "And though after my skin worms destroy this body, yet without my flesh shall I see God." He says without my flesh shall I see - this is spiritual vision.

Subject: reincarnation
Quotation: Their leader came to meet in Boston. He had written a detailed book with illustrations, then he became a believer. Now he has written works. I said to him, "Were you not satisfied with this journey that you wish to come again?" He said, "I suffered much hardship this time, the second time will be better." ... I said, "Let me tell you," then he did not conceal it and said that the Theosophists have two things that people really like: one is the matter of reincarnation, saying you do not perish but simply remove one garment and put on another, and the other is being immersed in the ethereal realm with no return.

Subject: reincarnation
Quotation: Each nation has expected a reincarnation of its greatest prophet, according to its religious belief. The Jews expected Moses to return as their Messiah; the Christians Christ; and the Mohammedans, Huseyn, the son of Fatima, with his twelve Imams. That is, they expected the return of the soul in its personality. When Christ was asked if John the Baptist was Elias He replied yes. When John the Baptist was asked the same question he replied no. Both answered truly. Christ's meaning was a spiritual one. John the Baptist came in the same spirit of God but not in the same soul. John meant that his soul and body were not those of Elijah.

Subject: reincarnation
Quotation: Thou didst write concerning the question of reincarnation. This belief in reincarnation is among the ancient beliefs of most peoples and nations, even being held by the philosophers of Greece, the sages of Rome, the ancient Egyptians, and the mighty Assyrians. However, before God all these sayings and imaginings are vain. The greatest argument of the reincarnationists was this: that divine justice requires each to receive his due. Thus whenever a person is afflicted with some calamity, we say it is because he committed some sin. But consider a child still in its mother's womb, whose embryo has just been conceived, and who is blind, deaf, lame, and malformed - what sin has such a child committed to deserve such punishment? They answer that although this child has outwardly committed no error in its mother's womb, in its previous form it committed some crime that made it deserve such punishment.

Subject: rejection by the people of the Bayan
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/rejection by the people of the Bayan.txt
Quotation: Fie upon the people of the Bayan, for they have exchanged the bounty of God and sold the Lord of Lords for a handful of dust, without any proof or scripture. Thus did their evil souls entice them to object to God, the Single One, the Mighty, the Praised. Behold their words and what floweth from their pens. By God! It testifieth against their own selves, yet the people remain heedless. Say: Praise be to God Who hath delivered me from the wrongdoing people and taken my hand with the hands of His power and brought me forth from among the company of the polytheists and purified my heart with the waters of His loving-kindness and sanctified me from the defilement of these deniers who claim faith while disbelieving in Him through Whose finger's motion all religions were abrogated and the laws of mighty glory were renewed.

Subject: rejection by the people of the Bayan
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/rejection by the people of the Bayan.txt
Quotation: O people of the Bayan! The names of the people will profit you not this day. Cast them aside and choose for yourselves a path unto God.

Subject: rejection by the people of the Bayan
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/rejection by the people of the Bayan.txt
Quotation: O people of the Bayan! Fear ye the All-Merciful, and be not of the transgressors. Judge fairly concerning that which hath appeared in truth, and be not of the wrongdoers.

Subject: rejection by the people of the Bayan
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/rejection by the people of the Bayan.txt
Quotation: O people of the Bayan! Fear ye the All-Merciful, and follow not every rejected transgressor and every veiled heedless one... Where, at last, hath fairness gone, and what hath become of justice? Through a brackish drop they deprived themselves of the Euphrates of mercy and were forbidden from the ocean of bounty.

Subject: rejection by the people of the Bayan
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/rejection by the people of the Bayan.txt
Quotation: By God's life, the Bayan lamenteth for what ye have perpetrated. Though divine counsel leaveth no impression and heavenly admonition beareth no fruit, for God's wrath hath seized them and the recompense of their deeds hath deprived them. By God's life, their mention is a deadly poison and their utterance a consuming fire.

Subject: rejection by the people of the Bayan
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/rejection by the people of the Bayan.txt
Quotation: Therefore fear ye God! Enter ye, then, into that which God hath ordained for you in every Dispensation, and be not veiled from God by that which ye acquired in your former manifestations. Pronounce that Name upon those who believe not in God, your Lord, and who follow not what hath been sent down in the Bayan, if ye desire to behold them abased beneath your feet. Say: God shall, verily, seize with a severe seizing those who have not believed in God and His signs.

Subject: rejection by the people of the Bayan
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/rejection by the people of the Bayan.txt
Quotation: Now certain ones among the people of the Bayan walk that same path and way. They have intended by their vain imaginings to afflict the helpless servants for another thousand years or more. The friends of God must gird up the loins of endeavor, that perchance the gates of falsehood may not be opened anew, and the cities of imposture not be built with the clay of suspicion. Soon will false preachers ascend the pulpits, and the possessors of wicked turbans busy themselves with intrigue.

Subject: rejection by the people of the Bayan
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/rejection by the people of the Bayan.txt
Quotation: Do ye imagine, O divines of the Bayan, that ye are different from the divines who were given the Psalms? When God revealed the Torah, they remained veiled from God's Book, and God rolled up their religion while they perceived it not and deemed themselves to be virtuous. Or do ye think yourselves different from the divines who were given the Gospel? When God revealed the Qur'an they paid no heed. God rolled them up and all they possessed, yet they perceived it not and deemed themselves virtuous.

Subject: rejection by the people of the Bayan
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/rejection by the people of the Bayan.txt
Quotation: And if thou lookest into all religions, thou seest the dwellers of His paradise and His fire through their following the bounds of their religion or their being veiled. And thou shalt not present thyself on the Day of Resurrection before Him Whom God shall make manifest except through thy following the bounds of the Bayan. For if thou presentest thyself to Him while being veiled from even one bound, thou art veiled from thy religion - how then could it be fitting that thou present thyself before God thy Lord?

Subject: rejection by the people of the Bayan
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/rejection by the people of the Bayan.txt
Quotation: Consider ye the peoples of former ages and centuries: certain souls who clung to names and who, night and day, occupied themselves with disputation and opposition, accounting themselves the most learned of all peoples and the most excellent of all nations. Yet when the dawn of the Day of His Manifestation broke forth and the Intended One appeared, all arose to shed His pure blood, save a few among the Shaykhis who attained. The Supreme Pen beareth witness that today the veiled ones of the Bayan are many times more heedless than that party.

Subject: rejection by the people of the Bayan
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/rejection by the people of the Bayan.txt
Quotation: When you believed in My Self and acknowledged My sovereignty and recognized My Book, We counseled you in all the Tablets not to do as did the idolaters from among Our heedless servants. Verily, We sent down the Bayan for no other purpose except to inform you of My Revelation in the dominions of the worlds. Yet when the Sovereign of Destiny appeared once again upon the clouds of decree, you denied Him and were among the deniers. You rejected what you had recognized, and turned away from that which you had accepted, and were among the idolaters.

Subject: rejection by the people of the Bayan
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/rejection by the people of the Bayan.txt
Quotation: Those who are given knowledge desire to cut you off from your tongues, then to make you enter into the true religion, so that after your death you may not enter the fire and may walk in the good pleasure of your Lord in your life and after your death. When one has attained the age of nineteen years and is among the believers in God and what was revealed in the Bayan, God shall make manifest Him Whom God shall make manifest on the night when his age enters into the twentieth year. Should he hear of the Manifestation of God or witness His signs and not be assured, then whatsoever he hath gained before shall be changed into that which God loveth not to mention.

Subject: rejection by the people of the Bayan
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/rejection by the people of the Bayan.txt
Quotation: For twelve hundred years the people of the Furqan (Muslims) clung to vain imaginings and idle fancies, depriving the servants of God from all the infinite divine bounties and heavenly sustenance, such that, as was witnessed, those imaginings and fancies caused the martyrdom of the Primal Point, may the spirit of all else but Him be sacrificed for His sake. I swear by the Sun of certitude that those fancies have been and will continue to be the cause and reason for the kindling of the fire of tyranny throughout the world. And now the people of the Bayan desire, through the same idle fancies of the past, to prevent people from drawing nigh unto the Dayspring of divine revelation and the Source of inspiration.

Subject: rejection by the people of the Bayan
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/rejection by the people of the Bayan.txt
Quotation: By the life of God! The deniers among the people of the Bayan are seen to be more debased and rebellious.

Subject: rejection by the people of the Bayan
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/rejection by the people of the Bayan.txt
Quotation: The harm to the Beloved of all possibility came from the people of the Bayan who, with the utmost effort and struggle, arose to waste away the Cause.

Subject: rejection by the people of the Bayan
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/rejection by the people of the Bayan.txt
Quotation: Several people of the Bayan were likewise so bereft of hearing and sight that they remained remote from the dawning of such a mighty Luminary and clung to such a soul, turning away from Him upon Whose word the entire Bayan depends, on account of the words of a mirror who is but a creation of the Bayan.

Subject: rejection by the people of the Bayan
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/rejection by the people of the Bayan.txt
Quotation: The Author of the Bayan wept by night and day at that which hath befallen My Self at the hands of those who deny the All-Merciful... When the horizon of heaven was illumined and the Morn of eternity breathed forth its fragrance, the Desired One appeared, whereupon the people of the Bayan rose in opposition

Subject: rejection by the people of the Bayan
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/rejection by the people of the Bayan.txt
Quotation: The people of the Bayan have clung to mere fancy and held fast to names, remaining deprived and veiled from that station through a single letter of whose Most Exalted Word the Kingdom of Names was created. Beseech ye God to transform weakness of vision into strength and grant a fresh light, that they might see and find.

Subject: rejection by the people of the Bayan
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/rejection by the people of the Bayan.txt
Quotation: If one were truly focused on the Point of the Bayan and His counsels, even if all the peoples of the world were to confront him with sharp swords and cut him to pieces, he would not hesitate regarding this Manifestation, for all that was recorded and revealed from the heaven of Will was and shall ever be explicitly about this Most Great Manifestation.

Subject: rejection by the people of the Bayan
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/rejection by the people of the Bayan.txt
Quotation: O people of the Bayan! Die in your wrath! By God, the Hidden One has come and that which was treasured in knowledge has been revealed, if ye be of them that know. Where were ye when the Light was shining forth from the Horizon of Revelation and speaking before all faces? Be fair, O people, and be not of those who exchanged the grace of God for unbelief and chose the path of perdition.

Subject: rejection by the people of the Bayan
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/rejection by the people of the Bayan.txt
Quotation: Know then that most of the people of the Bayan rose up against God and denied Him in Whom they had believed, and were among the losers. Say: O people, do ye imagine within yourselves that ye believed in the Revelation of 'Ali (the Bab)? Nay, by His Self, the All-Knowing, the Wise! For had ye believed in Him, ye would not have denied these verses which have descended from the heaven of mighty glory.

Subject: rejection by the people of the Bayan
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/rejection by the people of the Bayan.txt
Quotation: For the people of the Bayan, though but a short time hath passed since the manifestation of the King of divine revelation and though they witnessed with their own eyes the manner of His appearance, have become veiled as thou seest. What then will befall that resplendent Beauty? Alas for the servants! No Beauty appeareth unto them but they conceal His beauty behind veils of rancor and hatred, then mock Him

Subject: rejection by the people of the Bayan
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/rejection by the people of the Bayan.txt
Quotation: His [the Bab's] pen moved only in My remembrance, His tongue spoke only in praise of My Self, and His heart beat only with My Name, the All-Powerful, the All-Compelling, the All-Forgiving, the All-Bountiful. And now He [Baha'u'llah] findeth Himself beneath the claws and talons of the people of the Bayan, though He had enjoined them in all the Tablets not to be veiled by anything revealed in the Bayan at the time of His manifestation.

Subject: rejection by the people of the Bayan
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/rejection by the people of the Bayan.txt
Quotation: Despite this, how is it that ye have turned away from these verses that have filled the East and West of the earth, if ye be of them that comprehend? Yet ye, O people of the Bayan, have denied Me, calumniated Me, and rejected Me without any clear proof or illuminating Book. And whenever We increased the evidence, ye increased in your rejection, to such extent that ye kindled the fire of hatred in your breasts, O people of malice!

Subject: rejection by the people of the Bayan
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/rejection by the people of the Bayan.txt
Quotation: O people of the Bayan! The Most Merciful Himself hath come unto you, and by Him have been attracted the realities of all creation - they who have purified their vision from the limitations of the wicked ones and turned their gaze toward the scene of their Lord, the Chosen One, and were numbered among the triumphant. Yet ye deny Him and make mention of My Name, and imagine that ye are of them who sought My presence and attributed themselves unto My Self.

Subject: rejection by the people of the Bayan
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/rejection by the people of the Bayan.txt
Quotation: Among them is he who saith "I have believed in the Bayan." Say: Silence thy tongue, O thou denier and deceiver! The Bayan waileth by reason of thy deed, and with it wail the people of Paradise and the denizens of the holy sanctuaries at eventide and at dawn. If thou didst believe in the Bayan, why didst thou draw the sword of renunciation against the Beloved of the All-Merciful, through Whom the All-Glorious smiled and through Whom the brocade of the Book of Creation was adorned?

Subject: rejection by the people of the Bayan
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/rejection by the people of the Bayan.txt
Quotation: "By God! Those who were given the Furqan did not wrong Us - those who wronged this Beauty were of the people of the Bayan, who were renowned among all creation. They arose in such wise that none can recount it...They imagine within themselves that they have believed in God and the Manifestation of His Self, but when the veils were rent asunder and the Countenance of the Chosen One appeared, they dispersed from around Him, denied Him, warred against His Self, and disputed His verses."

Subject: rejection by the people of the Bayan
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/rejection by the people of the Bayan.txt
Quotation: Write to the loved ones that they should never associate with the polytheists from among the people of the Bayan. And if, perchance, one of the loved ones of God should unwittingly enter a gathering wherein mention is made in enmity to the Beauty of the All-Glorious, let him arise and smite his hand upon their mouths and say: The ear that hath heard the melody of God shall never hearken to the croaking of the polytheists. Fire be upon you for having disbelieved in Him in Whom ye had believed!

Subject: rejection by the people of the Bayan
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/rejection by the people of the Bayan.txt
Quotation: Observe how submissive and humble that Exalted One was in mentioning this Revelation. Now those who count themselves among the people of the Bayan have committed that which no other group hath ever done, and have perpetrated that which hath caused the very essence of creation to weep. Despite this mighty, firm, and supreme word, they have clung to certain passages of the Bayan and interpreted them according to their desires - passages whose fragrance they have not perceived, let alone their true meaning.

Subject: rejection by the people of the Bayan
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/rejection by the people of the Bayan.txt
Quotation: I swear by the Sun of sanctity that the deed of that ignorant one was like a sword placed in the hands of the enemies of truth from among the people of the Bayan. For all have heard that those who spent their entire lives engaged in corruption - now whatever hath occurred and transpired, they attribute it all to this servant. Thus in their book they have issued the decree to kill people, as ye all know, yet when news reached this land of what took place, they attributed it to this servant, though neither the mention of the killer nor the killed was ever made in this land.

Subject: rejection by the people of the Bayan
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/rejection by the people of the Bayan.txt
Quotation: O people of the Bayan! The Beloved of all possibility hath informed of your tyranny in that which was sent down from the heaven of mighty and exalted glory. He spoke, and His word is the truth: O people of the Bayan! After My testament I see you wrapped in a mighty veil. I revealed not the Bayan except for His Self and His remembrance, and My purpose in what I revealed was naught but His radiant and luminous Beauty. Yet ye do unto Him what neither the Jews did unto the Spirit (Christ), nor the people of the Furqan (Muslims) unto My Self, nor Nimrod unto God, the Mighty, the Wise.

Subject: rejection by the people of the Bayan
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/rejection by the people of the Bayan.txt
Quotation: Therefore say to those who are veiled that despite His Holiness the Bab declaring "Beware, beware lest thou be veiled from that Most Great Beauty by turning to me or to what was revealed in the Bayan," despite this, O heedless ones, from every direction you raise a cry. One says this is the Manifestation of Him Whom God shall make manifest, another says this falls short of Him Whom God shall make manifest, another declares this is the school of instruction of Him Whom God shall make manifest, and yet another says this is the cradle of the resurrection of Him Whom God shall make manifest.

Subject: rejection by the people of the Bayan
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/rejection by the people of the Bayan.txt
Quotation: The answer to the Yahyais is in the decisive texts of the Bab, Who states that if He Whom God shall make manifest appears now, I would be the first to believe in Him. Thus it becomes clear that it is possible. Similarly He addresses them saying that when He appears, Beware lest thou be veiled by any follower of the Bayan and take them as a standard. And the followers of the Bayan are the eighteen Letters of the Living, with the nineteenth being the Bab Himself. Therefore it becomes evident that when He Whom God shall make manifest appears, at least some of the followers of the Bayan would still be living. Furthermore, the Bab states that the fifty thousand years of the Resurrection passed in the twinkling of an eye. How then could the passing of two thousand and one years within fifty years be impossible and unattainable? Children are amazed and astonished at these words of the Yahyais. Glory be to God! How heedless and negligent are these souls!

Subject: rejection by the people of the Bayan
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/rejection by the people of the Bayan.txt
Quotation: The polytheists and the deluded ones among the people of the Bayan have now, contrary to the past, outwardly clung to that which leadeth to attainment and meeting.

Subject: rejection by the people of the Bayan
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/rejection by the people of the Bayan.txt
Quotation: The harm and abasement that have befallen the Cause of God have been greater and more grievous from the people of the Bayan. They are ablaze with the fire of self and passion, and perceive it not. With a hundred thousand tricks and schemes they are occupied with leading souls astray.

Subject: rejection by the people of the Bayan
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/rejection by the people of the Bayan.txt
Quotation: Justice remaineth behind Mount Qaf, and equity lieth concealed behind the clouds of tyranny. Vain imaginings have deprived the world from the Lord of Names. The kings are occupied with their dominions and treasures, the divines cling to the means of hypocrisy, and the people of the Bayan are engaged in calumnies.

Subject: rejection by the people of the Bayan
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/rejection by the people of the Bayan.txt
Quotation: Through personal intrigues and satanic whisperings, they arose to cut down the divine Tree, until the Hand of divine Power exposed the hidden secrets of their hearts to the realm of appearance and witness. Thus did the one commissioned for this repugnant task become agitated and, with utmost lamentation and grief, disclosed the details of his commission before the people of the Bayan who were gathered in that land.

Subject: rejection by the people of the Bayan
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/rejection by the people of the Bayan.txt
Quotation: And the people of the Bayan have so debased themselves as to cleave to one who hath ever commanded the shedding of blood and who walketh in the valley of his passions. They have turned away from the Truth and committed that which they have committed, attributing it to the Truth, despite the fact that all are aware that from the time of the dawning of the Day-Star of the horizons from the horizon of Iraq until this moment, He hath forbidden the people, night and day, from committing unseemly and unpleasing acts, as most have heard with their own ears and seen with their own eyes in the Tablets.

Subject: rejection by the people of the Bayan
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/rejection by the people of the Bayan.txt
Quotation: When the Sun of Manifestation shone forth from the horizons of all lands, the people of the Bayan rose in such opposition as nearly rent the heavens asunder and caused the hearts of the Messengers to melt.

Subject: rejection by the people of the Bayan
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/rejection by the people of the Bayan.txt
Quotation: The deniers among the people of the Bayan cling to the same vain imaginings. Through their attachment to names they have been deprived of the Dawning Place of the lights of inner meanings. Say: This is not a Cause that can be prevented by the cawing of crows or the clamor of divines.

Subject: rejection by the people of the Bayan
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/rejection by the people of the Bayan.txt
Quotation: In the days when the chiefs of the Bayan would pay dearly for women's veils to conceal and protect themselves from enemies, the Ancient Beauty arose to aid the Cause, although all peoples had risen to oppose Him. And when God's Cause was exalted, these hidden souls emerged like serpents from behind their veils of concealment, and their first act was to wage war against the Beauty of the All-Merciful.

Subject: rejection by the people of the Bayan
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/rejection by the people of the Bayan.txt
Quotation: But O Sun! What can this evanescent atom mention of how, at the exaltation and appearance of this Most Great Orb, what standards of rancor and hatred have been raised by the possessors of authority from the Bayan against this Beauty of the All-Merciful? By the One Holy and Unique Essence, never hath such a thing appeared in the world of creation. He whose very existence was created by a word hath repeatedly attempted to veil this Sun of Divine Beauty behind the clouds of rancor and envy, and to conceal His purified Beauty from the horizon of possibility.

Subject: rejection by the people of the Bayan
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/rejection by the people of the Bayan.txt
Quotation: God, exalted be His mention, hath not manifested such falsehood in any people as He hath in the people of the Bayan. For in every people, a thousand or more or less years would pass before one would appear by whom the truthful could be distinguished from the false, and the monotheist from the polytheist. But since the people of the Bayan regarded themselves as the most discerning among the peoples of the earth and superior to all creation - to such extent that they considered all others veiled while deeming themselves as having recognized God and among those who had attained His presence - therefore but one breath of test blew, and it caused them all to fall back to the lowest station of previous peoples.

Subject: rejection by the people of the Bayan
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/rejection by the people of the Bayan.txt
Quotation: Be not disturbed by the tumult of the followers of Yahya and others. These matters are like the foam of the sea - they come and go. However, it is not appropriate for the followers of Yahya to be present in your gatherings, for they have no purpose save casting doubts.

Subject: rejection by the people of the Bayan
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/rejection by the people of the Bayan.txt
Quotation: Far has he gone to present himself as impartial, that his calumnies might influence souls, though aware souls have from the beginning been cognizant of the secrets, events and traces, and likewise those who, in their firmness and steadfastness in the Cause of God, are as an unshakeable mountain. These calumnies are to them like the words and verses of Yahya's own "Cat and Mouse" poem, which only brings shame upon those who have instigated them.

Subject: rejection by the people of the Bayan
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/rejection by the people of the Bayan.txt
Quotation: The grievous events in Iran and the reprehensible efforts of the rebellious ones - the people of Yamut, who are called the people of Yahya. Observe how these people are of one mind internally, yet they join every party. It is clear their purpose is corruption and sedition. They should either be from the Moderate party, or the Independence party, or the Democratic party. How is it that a group internally of one heart and mind nevertheless has some in Darius's army and some in Alexander's? This clearly shows their aim is to sow discord and strife.

Subject: rejection by the people of the Bayan
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/rejection by the people of the Bayan.txt
Quotation: One of the friends should write in another newspaper, or spread among the people, that this calumny against the Baha'is comes from the Yahyai Babis, for these people are enemies of the Baha'is... But the Yahyai Babis, who are enemies of the Baha'is and who keep themselves hidden behind a veil, tell the constitutionalists that the Baha'is support the government, and tell the royalists that the Baha'is sacrifice themselves for the constitutionalists - so that they may incite both sides against the Baha'is and make them enemies

Subject: rejection by the people of the Bayan
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/rejection by the people of the Bayan.txt
Quotation: If Mr. Brown passes through Baku, surely show him the utmost love and kindness - perhaps he will abandon prejudice and speak with fairness, for the Yahyais have made the Cause unclear to him.

Subject: rejection by the people of the Bayan
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/rejection by the people of the Bayan.txt
Quotation: the matter of poison which Yahya the shameless himself gave to the Blessed Beauty, but in order to mislead, in Browne's writings this abominable act is attributed to the Manifest Beauty. Glory be to God! How oppressive become those souls who turn away from the shadow of the Cause!

Subject: rejection by the people of the Bayan
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/rejection by the people of the Bayan.txt
Quotation: The people of the Bayan opposed Him and grew arrogant towards Him, and behind them all peoples and nations, until He was imprisoned in this remote prison.

Subject: rejection by the people of the Bayan
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/rejection by the people of the Bayan.txt
Quotation: this Wronged One Who hath been afflicted at the hands of the polytheists from among the people of the Bayan, and Who found none to help Him save God

Subject: rejection by the people of the Bayan
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/rejection by the people of the Bayan.txt
Quotation: Thou knowest and seest how the waves of tribulation surge one after another upon Abdul-Baha, how the fire of faithfulness hath been kindled and the flames of estrangement blaze forth, how tribes and peoples have assailed him, how hearts are constricted and afflictions intensified, how the most violent tempests blow with utmost fury. He is the target of piercing arrows from the people of the Bayan, bearing pointed spears and drawn swords, aimed arrows and strung bows from every attacker, detractor, accuser and critic among nations near and far

Subject: rejection by the people of the Bayan
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/rejection by the people of the Bayan.txt
Quotation: Heed thou not the idle talk of the people of the Bayan, who pervert the meaning of every word.

Subject: rejection by the people of the Bayan
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/rejection by the people of the Bayan.txt
Quotation: Some among the people of the Bayan disguise themselves in any form to perchance entrap the believers.

Subject: rejection by the people of the Bayan
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/rejection by the people of the Bayan.txt
Quotation: O God! Do Thou assist the dwellers of the Paradise of the Bayan, and remove, O Lord, whatsoever Thou hast not caused to enter into that Paradise.

Subject: rejection by the people of the Bayan
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/rejection by the people of the Bayan.txt
Quotation: Were it not for My fear of the Nimrod of the Bayan, We would have given thee glad tidings with a word that would cause the realities of those who have drunk the pure wine from the Beauty of God, the Most Manifest, the Most Luminous, to rejoice, and would rend asunder the hearts of the polytheists.

Subject: rejection by the people of the Bayan
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/rejection by the people of the Bayan.txt
Quotation: Then enter the dwelling-place of the polytheists among the people of the Bayan who have disbelieved in God, the Creator of earth and heaven. Say: O people! Abandon that which is vain - the Self-Subsisting hath come upon the clouds of proof. Verily, He is your Lord, the All-Merciful, upon Whom the Bayan depended.

Subject: rejection by the people of the Bayan
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/rejection by the people of the Bayan.txt
Quotation:
Among them are those who have clung to the vain imaginings of the people of the Bayan, and thus have been kept back from the All-Merciful. Say: By God! What was revealed aforetime will profit you not today, except through your recognition of this Book which has been inscribed by the Pen of Revelation from God, the Mighty, the Beloved.   BH05523
O people of the Bayan! Fear ye the All-Merciful, and weigh what hath been sent down from the Kingdom of proof against what ye possess. Then be fair, and be not of the wrongdoers. Beware lest the calumnies of the people or the utterances of every associating soul who hath turned away from God, the Mighty, the Praiseworthy, hold you back.

Subject: rejection by the people of the Bayan
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/rejection by the people of the Bayan.txt
Quotation: Thou knowest, O my God, that had they drunk the choice wine of inner meanings from the cup of the Bayan and recognized the Manifestation of Thy name, the All-Merciful, they would not have opposed the Beloved of all possibility and the King of all worlds, nor would they have denied Him Whose praise and remembrance the Tongue of Grandeur hath ever spoken.

Subject: rejection by the people of the Bayan
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/rejection by the people of the Bayan.txt
Quotation: Consider the heedlessness of the people of the Bayan. They have turned away from One Who hath brought that which is equivalent to all the divine Books of the past and future, nay rather more than that - One through Whose Word was made manifest that which was hidden and concealed in the divine Books. Yet they imagine themselves to be the people of truth.

Subject: rejection by the people of the Bayan
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/rejection by the people of the Bayan.txt
Quotation: "Consider those who claim belief in the Bayan - they have disbelieved in God just as did the people before them. They are indeed among the most lost." "Reflect upon the baseness of the people of the Bayan - they have turned away from One from Whose pen flowed the equivalent of all the books on earth and all tidings past and future, and they busy themselves with their own vain imaginings. Fie upon them and their faithlessness!"

Subject: rejection by the people of the Bayan
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/rejection by the people of the Bayan.txt
Quotation: The people of the Bayan, like unto the people of the Furqan, have clung to vain imaginings and idle fancies, and are diligently engaged in leading the servants astray. Not for a moment have they pondered what the fruits of the deeds, words and beliefs of the Shi'ih party have been. By God! They are in manifest delusion. And now the people of the Bayan are seen to be even more lost, more astray and more remote. They have cast aside certitude and taken fancy as their lord instead of God. They are assuredly among the wrongdoers in God's Book, the Lord of all worlds.

Subject: rejection of Muhammad
Quotation: fabricated tales and mockery of Muhammad prevalent among people

Subject: rejection of Muhammad
Quotation: "To God do I complain of what has befallen Islam before and after. Our Lord! Pour forth upon us patience and grant us victory over the idolatrous people."

Subject: rejection of Muhammad
Quotation: Consider how many among the followers of Jesus were promised the advent of Ahmad (peace be upon Him and His family), yet how few were guided after His appearance.

Subject: rejection of Muhammad
Quotation: Would that he were content with even this much, but he is not. They have pronounced judgements that have caused the pillars of God's Most Great House to shake, yet they perceive it not.

Subject: rejection of Muhammad
Quotation: How many polytheists strove and labored to extinguish the Muhammadan Light, yet the Hand of Power preserved the lamp of His knowledge and wisdom within the glass of grace and bounty, despite the polytheists and the proud ones.

Subject: rejection of Muhammad
Quotation: Look, then remember those days wherein the Sun of Truth shone forth from the horizon of Hijaz. The learned and the literary opposed Him until they spoke of Him that which rent asunder the heaven of knowledge and disturbed the hearts of the righteous

Subject: rejection of Muhammad
Quotation: The polytheists denied Him and called Him a sorcerer, even though He was the Bearer of Glad Tidings from God - glorified be His majesty - and gave all people the glad tidings of the Days of God. All turned away and issued verdicts for the shedding of His most pure blood.

Subject: rejection of Muhammad
Quotation: Reflect upon the Sun of Batha (Muhammad): when the Hijaz was perfumed with the fragrance of God and illumined by the radiance of the Sun of Divine Unity, all turned away and committed that which caused the very essence of truth to weep, save for a few who detached themselves from creation and turned unto God.

Subject: rejection of Muhammad
Quotation: No doubt, a myriad books were written by the worldly wise and philosophers refuting the truth of Jesus, may my life be sacrificed for Him, and even more was written against Muhammad since thousands of writings by both Christian and Jewish clergy are today extant, all in opposition to the Prophet of God, may peace be upon Him. They have not relented and will continue to write.

Subject: rejection of Muhammad
Quotation: Consider what the Jewish clergy, Christian clergy, and the clergy of the idolaters did and said when its ordinance was revealed from the heaven of divine favor. With all their power, might and utmost hatred and malice they arose to extinguish the Muhammadan Light (peace be upon him and his family) and mocked his fasting, prayer, pilgrimage and deeds. But God made His Cause victorious though the polytheists detested it.

Subject: rejection of Muhammad
Quotation: Likewise, when the holy fragrances of Ahmad [Muhammad] perfumed the regions of Batha and Yathrib, and the life-giving breeze of divine teachings made the Arabian Peninsula the scene of a spiritual springtime, the Christian clergy clung to the outward meanings of the Clear Book and remained deprived of the rising of the Sun of the Highest Heaven, for according to the decisive apparent texts of the glorious Gospel, there would be no glad tidings after Christ.

Subject: rejection of Muhammad
Quotation: O Siyyid, reflect upon Muhammad - may the spirit of all else be sacrificed for Him - and His manifestation in Yathrib and Batha. The humiliation that befell Him was first from the opposition of His relatives and kin, second from the opposition of the divines and mystics, third from the neglect of the people of the city and surroundings, and fourth - which was greatest of all - from the seven scholars who later ascribed many partners to Him, even while they considered themselves monotheists and the most excellent of all people.

Subject: rejection of Muhammad
Quotation: The former people denied the verses and showed ingratitude for the special bounty. They kindled the fire of tyranny and burnt the pavilion of the glory and grandeur of God's Cause and rent the veil of sanctity. Glory be to God! In the nights and days they would beseech and implore to attain the presence of the Self-Sufficient, the Most High. Yet when the dawn of grace broke and the world was illumined by the effulgences of the Daystar of Revelation, they all drew swords and spears against the Goal of the worlds. They were polytheists yet counted themselves among the monotheists.

Subject: rejection of Muhammad
Quotation: The Khoreish tribe to which Mohamad belonged and whose leaders were inimical to the Cause of Islam rejoiced over this defeat of the Christians. They argued: 'The Greeks were the "people of the Book," the Persians fire-worshippers and not classed amongst the "people of the Book"; nevertheless the Christians were defeated by the idolatrous fire-worshipping Persians. In the same manner, Mohamad considered himself and his followers the people of the Book and the members of the Khoreish tribe idolaters and infidels. we who are idolaters shall in the long run overcome Mohamed and crush his religion of One God.'

Subject: rejection of Muhammad
Quotation: Nevertheless, they arose in opposition and kindled the fire of hatred until matters reached such a state that the verse of emigration was sent down from the heaven of the divine Will, and that Beloved of the Lord of all worlds turned His face from Batha toward Yathrib, and that land became illumined with the lights of the Sun of Prophethood. The ingratitude of the world deprived it of the robe of divine friendship. The opposition, corruption and hypocrisy of the Quraysh and His contemporaries is clear and evident. They visited upon Him that which most of the servants are aware of, and even now the community of mercy is observed to be silent regarding that which would exalt the Word of Unity.

Subject: rejection, opposition and persecution
Quotation: Consider the past. How many, both high and low, have, at all times, yearningly awaited the advent of the Manifestations of God in the sanctified persons of His chosen Ones. And whensoever the portals of grace did open, and the clouds of divine bounty did rain upon mankind, and the light of the Unseen did shine above the horizon of celestial might, they all denied Him, and turned away from His face-the face of God Himself.

Subject: rejection, opposition and persecution
Quotation: Should you acquaint yourself with the indignities heaped upon the Prophets of God, and apprehend the true causes of the objections voiced by their oppressors, you will surely appreciate the significance of their position.

Subject: rejection, opposition and persecution
Quotation: By the life of God, the arrows of greed, avarice and desire have been loosed against the Temple of the Cause of the Lord of all beings. That unjust one, despite infinite bounties - to which your honor and the manifestations of justice and fairness have testified and continue to testify - with utmost audacity drew the sword of hatred, greed and desire against the Wronged One and committed that which caused the very essence of justice to weep and fairness to lament.

Subject: rejection, opposition and persecution
Quotation: When God adorned the Ridván and made it the seat of the Throne, clamorous voices were raised from every direction, and each faction arose to extinguish the resplendent and shining Light of God. The leaders of these factions were the divines of various religions who rose against Us with such tyranny as caused the denizens of the Supreme Paradise and those who circle round the exalted Seat to lament. They perpetrated that which none among the servants had ever perpetrated

Subject: rejection, opposition and persecution
Quotation: The priests are like beasts of burden, and thus in common parlance they kick and strike out.

Subject: rejection, opposition and persecution
Quotation: Beware lest the opposition of the divines or the allusions of any polytheist outcast withhold thee.

Subject: rejection, opposition and persecution
Quotation: Some of the divines of Iran have, without any evidence or proof, issued death sentences against this community.

Subject: rejection, opposition and persecution
