Neither the opposition of the world nor the fear of the nations hath deterred Him, nor will they deter Him. Without veil or concealment He hath summoned all to that which He was commanded.

Subject: rejection, opposition and persecution
Quotation: How many of the great ones, the divines and princes, who in the nights and days would supplicate and seek after the appearance of the Truth, and when the Most Great Luminary rose above the horizon of the world, they all remained veiled by the veils of their own idle fancies, save whom thy Lord willed.

Subject: rejection, opposition and persecution
Quotation: Even in times when there was not a moment's hope of safety outwardly, as you have all seen and understood, when enemies from all sects lay in ambush for this celestial bird...Tablets have arrived from the land of Sad, and all are certain that that wicked associator has written falsehoods and calumnies.

Subject: rejection, opposition and persecution
Quotation: The lights of the Face have been altered by the slaps of them that have ascribed partners unto Thee, and the holy fragrances have been cut off from all creation by reason of what they have committed before Thy face, after Thou didst create them for Thyself and didst command them to appear before Thee.

Subject: rejection, opposition and persecution
Quotation: Thou knowest how I stood against the enemies with a sovereignty more manifest than the sun in its meridian. Thou wert not in Iraq in the days when nations and governments rose against Me - some saying "Let us seize him and send him to the King of Persia," and others saying "He will surely be taken and [...]"

Subject: rejection, opposition and persecution
Quotation: The government of S was disturbed, imagining that the shedding of the blood of the oppressed would remove its great sin against His Majesty the Sultan. God knoweth, and thou knowest, for what purpose the Wanderer turned towards this land, and how his petitions were rejected. His commander rose up in opposition

Subject: rejection, opposition and persecution
Quotation: None hateth Thee save he who knoweth not his father. The desires of those who know not their left from their right have raised him up. Those who cannot distinguish between the valuable and the worthless, the fat and the lean, have taken him as their protector instead of God. They are assuredly among the losers.

Subject: rejection, opposition and persecution
Quotation: The horizon of bounty hath been illumined and earth and heaven have been made to shine, and yet most of the people remain in doubt and dissension. They have clung to their own desires and have opposed Him through Whom all things have proclaimed: The Kingdom belongeth to God, the One, the Mighty, the All-Choosing.

Subject: rejection, opposition and persecution
Quotation: O thou who standeth in service to the Cause! Reflect upon the oppression and tyranny of the people. For forty years or more this Wronged One commanded the people of God to observe what is praiseworthy and forbade what is blameworthy... Nevertheless, each day some harm appeareth and some tyranny becometh manifest.

Subject: rejection, opposition and persecution
Quotation: As thou seest, they have all turned toward this All-Knowing Beauty with swords of the tongue and arrows of polytheism from every direction, although He appeared with such clear proof and came with such manifest power that from the beginning that hath no beginning until now, none hath heard or seen the like thereof.

Subject: rejection, opposition and persecution
Quotation: When my detractor's censure cometh from one who is himself deficient, it is but testimony that I am perfect. Leave them to their vain imaginings. Await the arrival of the ambassador. First and foremost, set all matters in order. If complete assurance of the vindication of rights is obtained, then make your petition.

Subject: rejection, opposition and persecution
Quotation: They said: "You have come with a white hand and radiant scrolls which our souls do not desire. You are but one of the mischief-makers." Whenever We recited clear verses unto them they said "These are forgeries," and when We showed them what their likes were powerless to produce, they said "This is manifest sorcery."

Subject: rejection, opposition and persecution
Quotation: My brother, prompted by Satan, twice submitted petitions to the Pasha of this land and committed other acts that are not fit to mention. Consider now the baseness of that soul and those who relied upon him, and the harm done to this servant - perchance thou wilt learn of some of the tribulations that have befallen Us.

Subject: rejection, opposition and persecution
Quotation: O Mahdi and Mahdi! Associate with people with perfect submission, contentment and goodly character, and be sagacious in the divine Cause, for today the deniers of the Manifest Beauty lie in ambush with utmost deceit. At all times take refuge in the Beauty of the All-Merciful and be protected in the fortress of His mercy.

Subject: rejection, opposition and persecution
Quotation: Furthermore, how can one speak of these ungrateful people whom you know, who harbor such envy in their hearts and conceal such malice in their breasts? They breathe not except in accordance with their own desires and seek naught but their own passions, even as He saith: "Seest thou him who taketh his own passion for his god?"

Subject: rejection, opposition and persecution
Quotation: The text mentions how religious authorities (ulama) would claim the Baha'is' honesty was artificial: "The ulama would even declare from their pulpits that the honesty and trustworthiness demonstrated by the Baha'is was beyond human capacity, though they would say the Baha'is act this way artificially in order to attract you."

Subject: rejection, opposition and persecution
Quotation: The dwellers of the Crimson Ark - namely the people of Baha - have, with Abraham's strength, shattered the idols of vain imaginings and idle fancies. How many souls counted themselves among the most learned, yet when the divine Word - which was the true touchstone - appeared, all returned to their stations save whom God wished.

Subject: rejection, opposition and persecution
Quotation: Even Mirza Muhammad-'Ali had promised the Investigation Committee that I have letters and correspondence from so-and-so who opposes the government - God forbid! Later he apologized saying it was not possible to obtain them, but that the book Mifta? Babu'l-Abvab, though critical of me, would suffice, as would the treatise Bushra.

Subject: rejection, opposition and persecution
Quotation: Consider thou the condition of these people after they had all testified that I had sacrificed Myself and My kindred in the path of God and to preserve their faith. I remained among the enemies in days when all souls were agitated and they concealed their faces from friends and foes alike, being occupied with preserving themselves.

Subject: rejection, opposition and persecution
Quotation: Regarding His Majesty the Sultan, in most of the Tablets there hath flowed from the Pen of the Lord of all beings that which diffuseth the fragrance of favor. Nevertheless, for forty years he hath not restrained his wrath for a moment, and thus have the rulers acted in ways the like of which the eye of creation hath never witnessed.

Subject: rejection, opposition and persecution
Quotation: During this period, this Wronged One clung to goodly exhortations and sufficient, healing counsels until it became evident and manifest to all that God hath appeared for the revelation of the treasures deposited within human souls. After all these trials, neither the princes of the state were satisfied nor the divines of the nation.

Subject: rejection, opposition and persecution
Quotation: I complain not of anything; I love all that hath befallen Me and befalleth Me in the path of God. The soul that in nights and days hath been under protection and favored with grace and engaged in service, through the instigation of an ingrate, intended harm against the Wronged One. And when We departed, tumult arose and clamor was raised.

Subject: rejection, opposition and persecution
Quotation: Guard thyself in the time when the cry of the Calf is raised amongst you. Beware lest ye draw nigh unto it or unto those from whom ye detect the odor of hatred toward this Most Holy, Most Pure, Most Glorious, Wondrous Youth. Soon shalt thou witness the deniers engaged in a deception the like of which hath never been witnessed in creation.

Subject: rejection, opposition and persecution
Quotation: We have witnessed no good from thee in all the worlds. In God's knowledge, none is more remote than he who hath slain the letter Ha' in the Qur'an, and God will never deliver him from the fire. And thou art more remote than he, for he committed his deed behind the veil of Ha', while thou hast desired to act behind the veil of the First One.

Subject: rejection, opposition and persecution
Quotation: In these days a person arrived who has been made governor of this city and its surroundings. The flames of his tyranny have reached everyone, and particularly this Wronged One. He has committed that which has caused all things to cry out. Whatever he has seen among the people he has demanded and taken, and whatever he has imagined he demands.

Subject: rejection, opposition and persecution
Quotation: The tribes of 'Ad and Thamud did unto ?ali? and Hud that which caused the Divine Lote-Tree to lament and the Concourse on High to cry out, as doth testify this wronged, grief-stricken and lonely One. By God! They crucified the Spirit, hamstrung the She-Camel, and shattered the Ark. They have slain My chosen ones and plundered their possessions.

Subject: rejection, opposition and persecution
Quotation: Consider how the enemies have surrounded the temple of the Cause from every direction: Muslims from one direction, Christians from another, Azalis from yet another and the infidels from all bearings. They all have circled the Faith of God and, with utmost determination, are working to eradicate this blessed Tree and totally obliterate its name.

Subject: rejection, opposition and persecution
Quotation: As for the Surih of Unity, the Shaykh of the land of ?ad came to the land of ?a, inflamed with the fire of hatred, making mention that the divines should translate the Surih of Unity and distribute copies thereof to all people, that they might know that the Truth "begetteth not, nor is He begotten," while the Babis believe in divinity and lordship.

Subject: rejection, opposition and persecution
Quotation: The clamor raised in places of darkness held Him not back from His purpose, nor did the calumnies of the people and the opposition of the hypocrites prevent His loved ones from turning unto Him. We have manifested the Cause despite every stubborn tyrant and sinful calumniator. Neither the weapons of the world nor the hosts of the nations hindered Us.

Subject: rejection, opposition and persecution
Quotation: These heedless souls have, through such calumnies, prevented the hapless servants from the Truth, just as previous factions prevented people from the Lord of all beings through vain imaginings. On the Day of Judgment, imaginary cities and false claims appeared as swords, and there befell the Lord of the world that which caused the atoms of creation to weep.

Subject: rejection, opposition and persecution
Quotation: "Although those divines who blindly uphold custom and the leaders of ignorance and iniquity display themselves boisterously now and parade themselves haughtily before the people, ere long ye shall witness these same persons seeking to hide like an owl in a dilapidated niche, running to the cavity of perpetual loss, and falling into the pit of eternal damnation"

Subject: rejection, opposition and persecution
Quotation: In these lands, one appeared by the name of Mahdi and none turned away from him. Now some hundred thousand souls have gathered around him although his true state is unknown. Yet when the Dawning-Place of divine verses and the Manifestation of the divine Self appeared in Iran, the divines gathered together and subjected Him to the gravest abasement and martyred Him.

Subject: rejection, opposition and persecution
Quotation: I make complaint unto thee concerning those who claim to love Me yet commit that which grieveth My heart, who follow their own desires and abandon that which they were commanded by One Who is All-Knowing, All-Wise. Thou knowest that should people witness any unseemly act from those who claim to love Me, they would attribute it to Mine own oppressed and lonely Self.

Subject: rejection, opposition and persecution
Quotation: The peoples of the world have ever striven throughout the ages and centuries to extinguish the light of the Eternal Beloved, and with the utmost persistence and effort have attempted to cut down the blessed Tree and quench its fire. However, God has manifested His Cause as He pleased, despite those who denied His proof and His evidence, His Revelation and His sovereignty.

Subject: rejection, opposition and persecution
Quotation: Thou seest Thy chosen servants in the hands of the wicked ones who have disbelieved in Thee and in Thy signs... Such is the extent of oppression that whenever anyone seeketh Thy presence, he is prevented from attaining unto the court of Thy mighty oneness, and whenever a soul turneth toward Thee, he is cast out by the idolaters who have denied the Manifestation of Thy Self.

Subject: rejection, opposition and persecution
Quotation: Let not the words of the unbelievers grieve thee. They are a people who perceive not. Say: Do ye rejoice in the tribulations that have befallen Us? By God! We have accepted them in God's path, and from beneath the sword We summon mankind unto the Lord of the Day of Judgment. None on earth can deter Us from that whereunto We were bidden by thy Lord, the Almighty, the All-Choosing.

Subject: rejection, opposition and persecution
Quotation: O Zayn! Upon thee be My glory! We are surrounded by the wolves of the earth, and there hath befallen Us that which hath befallen no one before. The door of lies, calumny, greed and passion hath been opened in the great city, and they have wrought that which hath caused every truthful one to lament, every just one to cry out, and hath burned the hearts of them that are nigh unto God.

Subject: rejection, opposition and persecution
Quotation: Consider how in the past year the enemies and ill-wishers of this wronged one rose up with utmost corruption and cast every slander and calumny upon this exile. They prepared petitions and sent them to high officials. An investigative committee was dispatched from the seat of supreme sovereignty and, by chance, they stayed directly at the homes of the accusers and became the guests of the enemies.

Subject: rejection, opposition and persecution
Quotation: In these days they have written from the Land of Sad that Mirza Hadi Dawlat-Abadi, having heard that some had called him a Babi, was overcome with perturbation and fear. For several days he ascended the pulpit and openly cursed Cyprus and those who dwell therein. Then, God forbid, going beyond that station, he turned to attack the Supreme Being, namely the Point, may our souls be a sacrifice for Him.

Subject: rejection, opposition and persecution
Quotation: And after that, he shall bear the wrath of God with divine anger, and for him shall be a grievous chastisement. Behold the champions of that band and their wolves who turned not unto any of the perfect ones...By Him in whose hand is my soul, if God were to subject all the kingdom of this world to me, it would not equal a single letter of these verses, nor a word glorifying before the Divine Majesty.

Subject: rejection, opposition and persecution
Quotation: Then did all arise in opposition. Among them were those who said: "This is naught but a man who hath forged a lie against God, the Ancient of Days." And among them were those who said he was possessed, as did one of the divines declare in My presence - and We are witness to this. And among them were those who said: "He speaketh not from his nature, but hath stolen God's words and combined them with his own words."

Subject: rejection, opposition and persecution
Quotation: They have reckoned the Dawning-Place of Supreme Mercy to be among the mischief-makers. We do not like to mention curses, otherwise We would say: The curse of God be upon the oppressive people. Let it not be thought that the oppressors are the rulers of the earth; rather, they are the divines thereof, for they were the first souls to turn away, to rise in opposition, and to kindle the fire of hatred among the servants.

Subject: rejection, opposition and persecution
Quotation: O faithful companions! The Cause, that divine Essence, hath reached such a pass that they have sullied that pure and subtle quintessence with the turbid waters of their selfish desires, and the people of the realm of mortality have veiled that Essence of immortality with the garment of passion and self. To every land they have dispatched tablets, inscribed with fingers of animosity, denouncing that subtle creative force.

Subject: rejection, opposition and persecution
Quotation: Thou seest me, O my God, as a target for the arrows of hatred and the object of the spears of rancor from souls whose insight and vision are blinded, whose ears are deaf to the melodies of the birds of mysteries, and whose hearts have hardened like rocks - nay, even harder - from which no rivers can gush forth. Lord! They are blind and deaf, and they aim their arrows at Thy humbled servant without shame, fear, or modesty.

Subject: rejection, opposition and persecution
Quotation: We have been afflicted among the people of Syria in whose hearts is concealed hatred for God, thy Lord, the Lord of all mankind. The peoples were promised the Lord of the Day of Remedy, but when He came with the truth, they turned away from the face of Beauty. The land of Syria was given glad tidings of the land of God, but when He came, they turned away from Him and arose in such hypocrisy as the eye of creation hath not seen.

Subject: rejection, opposition and persecution
Quotation: He whom the idolaters have taken to themselves as their lord, whereby they have risen in opposition to God, the mighty, the august, the beautiful--he was just like any of the servants. He used to come into my presence morning and night. Then there wafted upon him from the region of his base self the gales of passion, as a result of his past behavior. Finally, they cast him down off his seat and abandoned him in the lowest depths.

Subject: rejection, opposition and persecution
Quotation: Even though in these days He has come forth from the Most Great Prison with the utmost power and first adorned the garden with the ornament of the Greatest View, and then proceeded to a palace which is more elevated than all the palaces of these lands and is renowned in these realms, nevertheless one day He uttered a word which this servant himself heard, and that word indicated and proved that He preferred the Most Great Prison.

Subject: rejection, opposition and persecution
Quotation: The sinners shall be known by their marks. This is the Day wherein the secrets of hearts and the betrayal of eyes shall be revealed. Today in the Great City there hath appeared that which was hidden. They have clung to calumnies that have no likeness, neither now nor ever. No sooner doth anyone turn towards this land than instantly telegraph messages arrive claiming that such-and-such person hath committed theft and gone to 'Akka.

Subject: rejection, opposition and persecution
Quotation: These books, some published thirty years ago and others twenty years ago by the enemies themselves, are now in people's hands. Thus do the friends say to the wavering and the ignorant: Bring forth your book that we may show you the divine proof. When the book of refutation is presented, the friends point to these verses quoted from the Kitab-i-Aqdas and the Book of the Temple addressed to the sovereigns. Thus is the denier confounded.

Subject: rejection, opposition and persecution
Quotation: Moreover, consider how in this divine cycle infinite power has become manifest and evident. In the past, those who were veiled attributed ignorance and incapacity to the Divine Manifestations. One would say "Ye follow none other than a man bewitched," another would utter "He hath forged a lie against God or is possessed," and another would declare "When they see thee, they treat thee only as a jest saying 'Is this he whom God has sent as a Messenger?'"

Subject: rejection, opposition and persecution
Quotation: The doubters and transgressors have forbidden the servants from reciting the dawn prayer whose preface is adorned with this Most Exalted Name. With utmost clarity hath been mentioned that which causeth the hearts of the polytheists and the opposers to be consumed, for He saith that the Most Great Name is present and mentioned therein. Nevertheless, they have deprived the people of the outpourings of the True Bestower that lie hidden in those remembrances.

Subject: rejection, opposition and persecution
Quotation: As soon as He came down, however, from the heaven of majesty and power, Thy servants stretched out against Him the hands of cruelty and sedition, and caused Him to be afflicted with such troubles that the scrolls of the world are insufficient to contain a full recital of them. The eyes of the world were gladdened at the sight of Thy luminous countenance, and yet the peoples have united to put out Thy light, O Thou in Whose hands are the reins of the worlds!

Subject: rejection, opposition and persecution
Quotation: Whensoever the Cause of God was exalted and the Day-Star of His Revelation shone forth, some heedless one would emerge from behind the veil and act in such wise as would cause the servants to hesitate. In the Land of Mystery [Baghdad], despite the manifestation of the mubahalih [spiritual contest], and the exaltation of the Word, Siyyid Muhammad-i-Isfahani rushed to Mushiru'd-Dawlih--upon him be the Glory of God--seeking refuge and requesting a daily stipend.

Subject: rejection, opposition and persecution
Quotation: Despite the flames of hatred and malice and the shedding of the blood of the loved ones, all have clung to the cord of patience and resignation, and deemed it impermissible to transgress the divine command. Strange it is that the King of Iran hath not yet become aware of the divine favor, patience and forbearance. We have beseeched and continue to beseech the Truth that He may enlighten the sovereign. His true enemy is his son Zillu's-Sultan - all know this.

Subject: rejection, opposition and persecution
Quotation: Is there any supporter who will assist the Youth in these days wherein intoxication hath seized the dwellers of the heavens and earth save those who gaze toward the direction of nearness in this Beauty. Then He addresseth further: Say with thy inner tongue: Is there any helper who will help the Beauty of the Most High in this latter Manifestation? Is there any supporter who will assist the Latter Point Who hath appeared in this bright, most luminous Manifestation?

Subject: rejection, opposition and persecution
Quotation: Now they object to Him, saying why He does not act according to the deeds, even though all deeds revolve around His Cause. Observe the condition of the servants - yet they consider themselves possessed of sight, hearing and understanding. And what sorrow could be greater than these objections raised against the Beauty of Divine Unity? And what sword could be sharper than the sword of the tongues of these manifestations of Satan that at all times wound the Body of God?

Subject: rejection, opposition and persecution
Quotation: Sorrows have encompassed the Lord of all possibility and His loved ones through what hath been perpetrated against Him by the manifestations of idle fancies and vain imaginings. By the life of God! The Supreme Pen hath lamented in the Most Exalted Horizon, and Zion hath cried out, and the Mount of God hath crumbled through what the hands of those who denied God's proof and evidence have wrought after their confession, and who disbelieved in the Witness and the Witnessed.

Subject: rejection, opposition and persecution
Quotation: During the autocratic reign of Abdul Hamid, while I was closely incarcerated in the town of Acca, a man with a suspicious character called on me... At first glance, I realized that he was a spy of Abdul Hamid, and that he had been sent here expressly to find whether there were any political secrets in our Movement... It is most strange that Sultan Abdul Hamid was not even content with our imprisonment, but he sent continually a host of spies to pry into our open affairs.

Subject: rejection, opposition and persecution
Quotation: In Iran the clergy and leaders wrote many books to refute this Cause, seeking to eliminate it and completely destroy its foundation. One of those souls was Haji Muhammad Karim Khan who wrote several books, but they were all effaced [...] One of those souls was Haji Muhammad Karim Khan who wrote several books, but all of them were effaced and forgotten while the Cause of God became renowned throughout East and West and was spread among all the peoples and nations of the world.

Subject: rejection, opposition and persecution
Quotation: O My leaf! We have been encompassed by sorrows from all directions through that which the hands of those whom God created to aid My Cause have wrought, for they have instead aided Mine enemies who have pronounced judgment against Me with such injustice as hath caused the Holy Spirit to lament. Though outwardly His Majesty the King and the Minister remain silent and have even shown some measure of kindness toward this community, inwardly they persist in and act according to their own desires.

Subject: rejection, opposition and persecution
Quotation: They accused us before the government of such deeds which if any one had committed he should deserve to be condemned to death. For instance, they asserted that we had founded a new dynasty and established a new religion. The enemies even made a banner on which they displayed the Holy Words 'Ya Baha'ul-Abha', and sent it to The Porte, saying that we had hoisted that banner and carried it through the city among the tribes of the Arabs and incited the Arabs to rally around us to raise a revolt.

Subject: rejection, opposition and persecution
Quotation: As regards the Seyyed of Qum concerning whom you had written, there are many details about him and in truth this servant is ashamed to mention them. However, some will be mentioned so that his condition may not remain hidden from some. He it was who spat on the face of Quddus in the presence of the polytheists in the land of Tabarsi, and who struck the face of the Great One [Baha'u'llah], reviled Him, and professed unbelief, saying what he said - all to preserve his own wicked self for a few days.

Subject: rejection, opposition and persecution
Quotation: Sometime later, however, all his love and affection changed to anger and enmity. This happened because one of the friends arranged for a big celebration during the festival of Ridvan, which had coincided with Ashura, and he had openly demonstrated his joy and happiness. This incident made the Shi'i community extremely angry and caused Shaykh 'Abdu'l-Hamid to become such an enemy that, with a gun in hand, he went to the blessed house in the middle of the night to kill all the people who lived there.

Subject: rejection, opposition and persecution
Quotation: Never was it imagined that treachery and falsehood and calumnies would appear in the world to such an extent. In any case, they acted according to the decree of their guide - surely you know who their guide is. We beseech God, blessed and exalted be He, to assist the treacherous ones to trustworthiness, the liars to truthfulness, and the calumniators to justice and fairness. The treacheries committed have caused grief to the people of the city of justice and fairness. Each day a new calumny appears.

Subject: rejection, opposition and persecution
Quotation: His Majesty the Sultan hath acted in a manner that is manifest and evident, for as they have written, his blessed heart was moved of its own accord to release, with utmost honor, His Holiness Ismu'llah and those with him (may the Most Glorious Glory of God be upon them). Specifically, a trusted one went from among them to serve them, and likewise some of the princes mentioned to them with affection that We could accomplish nothing. Whatever we submitted was not heeded, until today when His Majesty the Sultan, of his own accord, sent us to take you out.

Subject: rejection, opposition and persecution
Quotation: In days which, through the tyranny of the oppressors and the rejection of the followers of religions, were like the darkest night, this Wronged One arose before the faces of all to render assistance, such that the effulgences of the light of the Luminary of Revelation became manifest from every direction. Then emerged from behind the wine-jars the embodiments of tyranny with swords of hatred, and there appeared from them that which testified to their lies and to the calumnies of their own selves, whereat the Tablet lamented and My glorious, wondrous Pen cried out.

Subject: rejection, opposition and persecution
Quotation: The divines, mystics and jurists of the earth, by night and by day, beseeched God, glorified be His majesty, for the meeting with His Manifestation and Speaker. Yet when the ocean of hope surged and the horizon of divine purpose dawned forth, all turned away - especially the Shi'ih sect who, with their tongues, uttered curses and, with their pens, issued verdicts for the shedding of His most pure blood, and with their hands wrought that which causeth the company of the Prophets and the chosen ones in the most exalted paradise and supreme station to weep and lament.

Subject: rejection, opposition and persecution
Quotation: When they witnessed the exaltation of the Cause, the fire of their opposition intensified and they strove to veil the Sun of God behind the veils of hatred, and in the City of the Command they were among the mischief-makers. Until the decree of destiny was manifest once again for the departure of His Most Exalted Being, and the sovereign requested to meet Him and witness His Cause, though they were secretly among the plotters. They schemed and deceived until they imprisoned Him in a mountain whose name none had heard and which was unknown among men, and in this mountain they made Him to dwell.

Subject: rejection, opposition and persecution
Quotation: The government of Iran, seeing that some Iranian citizens showed and still show affection towards me, determined to act against me. Every day, the Iranian consul would write a complaint to the (Ottoman) officials. Since I observed that such developments would lead to mischief, I explained things to the Governor of Iraq, Namiq Pasha. He felt that it would be wise to adopt Ottoman citizenship, and so some of my friends chose to become Turkish citizens. This, however, was contrary to the wishes of the government of Iran, and it was for this reason that they started in earnest to take action against me.

Subject: rejection, opposition and persecution
Quotation: In truth, such joy and delight has been experienced that I cannot describe, for that holy throne had been greatly dishonored by the people of darkness.

Subject: rejection, opposition and persecution
Quotation: Description of believers being turned away, imprisoned or exiled when trying to visit, including specific examples of Nabil, Mulla Ali Qa'ini, and others

Subject: rejection, opposition and persecution
Quotation: The ranks of the polytheists, the multitudes of the deniers, the might of the people of tyranny and error, and the tumult of the ignorant could not prevent His penetrating Will.

Subject: rejection, opposition and persecution
Quotation: Behold, then remember what befell the Youth in the nights and days at the hands of those who cast the Book of God behind their backs, clinging to idle fancies and vain imaginings.

Subject: rejection, opposition and persecution
Quotation: There hath appeared from among the people of Sad that which hath caused the near ones to lament. They have slain the family of the Messenger, imagining that they were helping the Cause of God

Subject: rejection, opposition and persecution
Quotation: "The friends of God, on the other hand, will shine brilliantly above the horizon of eternal glory. If ye ponder deeply, ye will perceive that troubles incurred in the path of the Peerless Lord are a gift."

Subject: rejection, opposition and persecution
Quotation: When he was about twenty-two years old, he was arrested, having become a disciple of the Bab...The people cried 'Crucify him.' Then turning towards her the mob cried 'And now let us kill this foolish mother.'

Subject: rejection, opposition and persecution
Quotation: In these days strange and wondrous news has arrived from the Land of Ta. From a position where they should seek counsel, they strive to extinguish His light. The sun and moon, nay all things bear witness that this Cause is free and sanctified from even an atom's weight of corruption, yet that which you know has come to pass.

Subject: rejection, opposition and persecution
Quotation: Little by little it was rumored around that Ostad Esmael is a Baha'i and the Mullahs did their best to arrest and do away with him. When the governor heard about this secret plan he sent for him and said: 'I cannot protect <you> thee any longer. The wolves are after thee and thy life is in danger. Thou must leave the city without delay!'

Subject: rejection, opposition and persecution
Quotation: O Muhammad! Reflect upon that which the wicked ones of Hijaz visited upon the Lord of the world, Ahmad. During the nights and days He was occupied with guiding the misguided and reforming their souls. Nevertheless they perpetrated that which caused the atoms to lament and the verses themselves to weep - a weeping that caused the dwellers of the heavens and earth to wail.

Subject: rejection, opposition and persecution
Quotation: Seven hundred horsemen were searching for the believers. In all the passages, the mullahs would stand and cry out: O people! If you want God, kill the Babis! If you love the Prophet, kill the Babis! If you want the Shah, kill the Babis! If you want religion and faith, kill the Babis! If you want to protect your life, property, and family, kill the Babis! If you want to protect your honor and dignity, kill the Babis!

Subject: rejection, opposition and persecution
Quotation: A group joined the Bab who were killed. Their women were taken captive. Their children were imprisoned. Their homes were burned. Even their corpses were burned. Their possessions were plundered and everything they had and didn't have was confiscated. Some were tied to cannons. Some were thrown alive into fire and burned. Some were hanged and the Bab Himself was exiled to a fortress then brought from that fortress and hanged and a regiment of soldiers made His chest the target of bullets.

Subject: rejection, opposition and persecution

Quotation: O Afnan! The deniers have appeared with calumnies unprecedented, and despite their greed, avarice, vain desire, and betrayal of people's wealth, they still claim truthfulness.
