Subject: rejection, opposition and persecution
Quotation: The world hath been created for the service of the Cause. Whosoever hath turned thereunto hath attained to that which is intended. 'The intention of the believer is better than his deed' applieth to this station, inasmuch as he hath intended to turn toward the prison and engage in service to the Cause.

Subject: rejection, opposition and persecution
Quotation: The Holy Land is disturbed due to harmful publications in Egyptian newspapers and some other newspapers, and the writing of numerous books against the Cause of God, and great calumnies from false persons...the storm of calumnies and opposition and attacks from all directions is continuous and successive

Subject: rejection, opposition and persecution
Quotation: Today the cawing and croaking of the polytheists who call themselves by the name of truth is raised up. We previously made mention of these matters and informed all. The treacherous appears in the name of trustworthy, the false one in the name of the truthful, and the denier in the guise of the believer.

Subject: rejection, opposition and persecution
Quotation: Know then, O Rida, that when the idolators witnessed how the Cause had been uplifted, the fire of jealousy and hatred was kindled in their breasts and they sought to scheme against their Lord's Cause, that they might instill hatred of the Youth in the hearts of the believers. Thus was the matter ordained.

Subject: rejection, opposition and persecution
Quotation: The world is opposed to this Cause to such an extent that it striveth with utmost diligence to extinguish its light. However, God hath, through the scratching of the Pen and to their dismay, assisted His Cause and exalted it. Neither the forces of the world nor its hosts can resist this power and ascendancy.

Subject: rejection, opposition and persecution
Quotation: "Say: O people of the Book! do ye not disavow us only because we believe in God, and in what He hath sent down to us." Evil plotters are enemies of [the noble ones] For such is God's method carried into effect of old, and such will it remain in the future, and no change can ye find in God's method of dealing.

Subject: rejection, opposition and persecution
Quotation: During these successive years, in every land they have repeatedly martyred ones from this oppressed community, yet they did not retaliate and left it to God. The martyrdom of this oppressed one which occurred in these days is a true testimony to the oppression of this community and the tyranny of the enemies.

Subject: rejection, opposition and persecution
Quotation: Consider the divines and what they have committed in My days. We created them and strengthened them to exalt My Cause, yet they pronounced judgment against My Self and against those whose sanctity was attested by the Concourse on High...In their vain imaginings they intended to extinguish the light of God's Cause

Subject: rejection, opposition and persecution
Quotation: According to what has been heard, certain powers such as England and others made insinuations to the Imperial Court and strove with utmost effort until the Imperial decree for confinement in the fortress was issued. It is not known how the Protestants achieved this aim of theirs, as there were no grounds for this.

Subject: rejection, opposition and persecution
Quotation: Lost indeed are they who denied the days of God and turned away from the Truth, following every remote polytheist. Particularly have these faithless people followed Hadi Dowlat-Abadi and Baqir Isfahani, who dwells in the land of Ta, though these two heedless ones are unaware of and veiled from the root of the Cause.

Subject: rejection, opposition and persecution
Quotation: Do they imagine they can extinguish the fire kindled by the hand of Power and Might? Do they suppose they can put out the light which God hath caused to shine forth from the Supreme Horizon? Nay, by His very Self, the True One! They are impotent, they are the losers, they are the deniers, they are the transgressors.

Subject: rejection, opposition and persecution
Quotation: My purpose is this: That his honor Mirza Abul Fazl has written a treatise answering the criticisms of a London preacher. It is published in Chicago; each one of you should have a copy of that book, and read, memorize and ponder over it. Then when anybody advances any accusations or criticisms, you will be well armed.

Subject: rejection, opposition and persecution
Quotation: If those that have erred grievously were aware of the hidden mysteries of martyrdom, they would in no wise commit such deeds. However, God hath caused them to be tongue-tied and bereft of sight, with their minds and power of perception reduced to naught, in such wise that they deem a priceless benefit a grievous loss.

Subject: rejection, opposition and persecution
Quotation: For some time now, the unacceptable deeds of the people of earth have materialized - sometimes in the form of cannons, sometimes as swords, sometimes appearing as fire in different lands. Most of the people in these lands are agitated, fearful and distressed. Tribulations have encompassed the earth from all directions.

Subject: rejection, opposition and persecution
Quotation: O 'Ali-Akbar! The realm of divine knowledge hath been encompassed, and the cities of remembrance and recognition forbidden. The lamp of justice hath been beset by the winds of oppression, and the countenance of equity lieth in ambush, threatened by the wolves of tyranny. The polytheists have surrounded the monotheists.

Subject: rejection, opposition and persecution
Quotation: O Muhammad! The monotheists of the world are encompassed by the hands of the polytheists. Cities and lands have been lost. We ask of God, and continue to ask, that He may grant strength and bestow power, that perchance the former glory may return, and that He may protect the monotheists and likewise the cities and lands.

Subject: rejection, opposition and persecution
Quotation: We counsel all to steadfastness, for the clamorous ones have been and are lying in wait for the monotheists and the sincere ones. Say: Should anyone come to you with the book of the netherworld and its pages, cast them behind you, then know that he is the clamorous one promised in the Books of God, the Mighty, the Loving.

Subject: rejection, opposition and persecution
Quotation: They have clung to perversion. Most are attached to vain imaginings and devoted to idle fancies. Hadi Dawlatabadi, like the deluded souls of the past, has occupied the helpless servants with those same vain imaginings. By the life of God! Neither are the eyes of such people worthy to behold, nor their ears worthy to hear.

Subject: rejection, opposition and persecution
Quotation: The winds of hatred have encompassed the Ark of Ba??a, by reason of that which the hands of the oppressors have wrought. How numerous the oppressors before thee who have arisen to quench the light of God, and how many the impious who murdered and pillaged until the hearts and souls of men groaned by reason of their cruelty!

Subject: rejection, opposition and persecution
Quotation: Afflictions have encompassed Me which none can reckon save God, the Knower of the unseen and the seen. The polytheists have gathered against Me from every direction with tyranny, to this do honored servants bear witness. Every harm hath been ordained for My person and every affliction for My Beauty, yet people do not understand.

Subject: rejection, opposition and persecution
Quotation: Yet ye have done unto His Self what neither the people of the Furqan did unto My Self, nor the concourse of the Jews unto the Spirit. Alas, alas, for the anguish of My heart and the lamentation of My soul for what hath befallen My Beloved at the hands of the idolaters! Fie upon you and upon your fidelity, O company of oppressors!

Subject: rejection, opposition and persecution
Quotation: We testify that they have wrought corruption in the land after its reformation, and rejected the blessing of tranquility after it had been established and spread through the justice of the Sovereign of the Kingdom and its Authority. They have slain him who believed in God, aided His Cause, and spoke His praise by night and by day.

Subject: rejection, opposition and persecution
Quotation: This land has not yet attained tranquility, nor will it soon... Be not grieved by the clamor of the people and the words of those who have no knowledge even of their own fathers... Do people imagine they can extinguish what God hath kindled with the hands of power and might? Nay, by His chosen Self! But the people do not understand.

Subject: rejection, opposition and persecution
Quotation: for years they have tried through various schemes to create a breach in public opinion but saw no fruit except disappointment and despair...Consider what painful events occurred in the Christian era, yet the divine lamp grew brighter. "They desire to extinguish God's light with their mouths but God refuses except to perfect His light."

Subject: rejection, opposition and persecution
Quotation: Finding themselves overcome, they hold to the means of the weak ones, and engaged themselves in rending asunder (the lambs of God) like wolves. This is the condition of the weak and baffled. Finding himself devoid of proof, weak in argument and destitute of true power, he resorts to the animal qualities and sheds the blood of the pure.

Subject: rejection, opposition and persecution
Quotation: a group of the frozen and dead have imagined they can prevent the Most Great Sea from its advancing waves, or deprive the Most Glorious Orb of its dawn-time rays, or deny the horizons of nations from the continuous outpourings of this daybreak. Vain indeed are their deeds. These fragments of clay intend Through envy to cover up Your sun

Subject: rejection, opposition and persecution
Quotation: Despite all this, those who are lukewarm in spirit shout: where is the light? Those souls who like the dead have buried themselves in the pits of doubt and suspicion cry: where is this radiance? And those benighted ones confined in their own gloom bewail their perdition. May God punish them and cast them out in the Great Day of Reunion!

Subject: rejection, opposition and persecution
Quotation: The Supreme Pen has in scriptures and tablets informed all of the appearance of the cawers, the heedless ones, and the atheists. Now from certain directions the cawing is raised...Pay no attention to the fly and its buzzing, nor to the crow and its cawing. Soon they shall return to their abode as returned those who wronged in those days.

Subject: rejection, opposition and persecution
Quotation: the Commission of Investigation made most thorough inquiries and investigations, but what the enemies - who are the harmful and deceitful companions of Mirza Muhammad Ali - said was according to his instructions... Consider that for thirty-six years we have been confined in this prison, withdrawn in a corner occupied with our own affairs

Subject: rejection, opposition and persecution
Quotation: Concerning the corruption of the mischief-makers about which you wrote, that they have seized the opportunity and spare no effort to harm the divine sheep - for fifty years they have been engaged in this work. What fruit have they seen? What benefit have they gained except manifest loss? And verily Our hosts shall be triumphant over them.

Subject: rejection, opposition and persecution
Quotation: He has no share from the chalice of mercy, and no portion from the cup of justice and equity. Not for a moment has he seen this servant, nor gathered in any assembly, nor sought companionship for an hour. Yet he has taken up the pen of oppression, writing with the blood of the oppressed, and has spoken certain meaningless words to a group.

Subject: rejection, opposition and persecution
Quotation: "I know not, O my God, for what reason they have risen up to oppress me, and by what proof they have turned aside from Him Who is the Day-Spring of Thy signs... They have so grievously wronged me that the Lote-Tree of Thy Revelation moaneth, and the inmates of the Tabernacle of Thy majesty and the dwellers of the cities of Thy names lament."

Subject: rejection, opposition and persecution
Quotation: All the peoples and factions of the world are attacking with all their might, assaulting with all their power and force, striving day and night to destroy and obliterate the people of God. The blameworthy and vacillating people too, through various internal and external means, are engaged in destroying the Cause of God and harming holy souls.

Subject: rejection, opposition and persecution
Quotation: However, the ignorant have presumed to suppress this illumination and think in its stead to spread the darkness that emanates from their selfish desires and passions. Praised be to God! Can darkness ever obliterate the light or is it not light that overcomes the darkness? What vain imaginings are these! What foolish thoughts of ignorant minds!

Subject: rejection, opposition and persecution
Quotation: Observe how despite such tyranny that hath encompassed the world, they count themselves among the people of truth. They martyred His sons without any guilt. It is not known whether the properties were infidel or their owner. If by the assumption of those idolatrous souls the owner was an infidel, for what reason did they plunder the properties?

Subject: rejection, opposition and persecution
Quotation: Verily this mine of contentment, this wellspring of fidelity, this fountain of purity was afflicted with severest cruelty from the people of hatred and rancour. O Lord! Reza suffered intense hardship and grievous persecution at the hands of the stubborn ones, falling repeatedly into the claws of ravening wolves and the grasp of ferocious beasts

Subject: rejection, opposition and persecution
Quotation: Mirza Taqi, Governor of Amol, with 700 riflemen, surrounded the room of Jamali Mobarak. They looted everything that was there. They brought Jamali Mobarak to the town where the Mullahs were gathered in the Mosque. They brought Jamali Mobarak and His companions there, and after questions and answers, the Mullahs passed sentence of death on him.

Subject: rejection, opposition and persecution
Quotation: Regarding the books thou hast mentioned which have been written by certain Muslims about the Cause of Baha'u'llah, know that it is written in the Qur'an that some scholars learned in the Torah and the Gospel wrote refutations against the Prophet of God (Muhammad) and claimed their rejection to be based on biblical evidence and therefore of God.

Subject: rejection, opposition and persecution
Quotation: But the opponents still raised armies and came after Him to kill all the men and take the women captive... But the opponents would return and wage war against the Messenger again, for they were bloodthirsty. There was constant warfare between them, and they took pride in killing people, plundering property, and taking women and children captive.

Subject: rejection, opposition and persecution
Quotation: At this time, such a matter would greatly disturb and agitate minds, and the slanderers would open their tongues and convey a hundred thousand calumnies to the government. Although now the purpose of this Spiritual Assembly is the administration of spiritual affairs, the accusers will not say this - they will spread a hundred thousand calumnies.

Subject: rejection, opposition and persecution
Quotation: But what benefit is there in this, for it has become the hunting ground of wolves and the arena of the fierce beasts of the horizons, and for the friends it is the cause of endless trials and tribulations. The pure-hearted believers who were gathered in that land like stars have been scattered and dispersed, and have become homeless and destitute.

Subject: rejection, opposition and persecution
Quotation: This is the Day wherein the hearts of men are sorely troubled and the foundations of all lands are shaken by the might of those who have denied God's truth and His proof. This is a Day wherein the religion of God lamenteth and every wise command crieth out. The heedless have cast the Cause of God behind their backs, clinging to their vain desires.

Subject: rejection, opposition and persecution
Quotation: The cities and habitations of the people of divine unity are surrounded, while the polytheists encompass them. Every day a tree is uprooted by devastating winds and a lamp is extinguished. This most grievous malady hath seized the realm of the people of unity, yet despite this they neither have sought nor seek to remove this darkest of afflictions.

Subject: rejection, opposition and persecution
Quotation: In Sangsar the cruel ones severely persecuted the spiritual friends and showed complete aggression. Worst of all, in Tabriz the faithless mujtahid Mirza Hasan explicitly and clearly issued a fatva ordering the execution of all Baha'is. Two persons were immediately cut to pieces, and if the friends had not dispersed, all would have been put to death.

Subject: rejection, opposition and persecution
Quotation: Abdul Hamid, the Sultan of Turkey, was the greatest despotic monarch of Turkey. He dealt with us very unjustly. He was so cruel that in the middle of the night he did away with people who displeased him. He tied very heavy stones to the feet of his victims and cast them into the sea. For forty-five years God protected us from the tyranny of such a man!

Subject: rejection, opposition and persecution
Quotation: When the adherents of the former despotic government of Persia found that this unity and harmony was being accomplished among the followers of Baha'o'llah, they arose in bigotry and persecution against them. The clergy especially perceived that their vocation and means of livelihood were threatened. They persecuted the Bahais with bitterness and ferocity.

Subject: rejection, opposition and persecution
Quotation: When the light of His Cause dawned from the dayspring of divine will, the idolaters sought through rejection and denial to extinguish it. Thus did they turn from the land of ?a to the land of Zawra, and this denial became a herald for the light. And from Zawra to the land of mystery did He journey, through that which the hands of the oppressors had wrought.

Subject: rejection, opposition and persecution
Quotation: Look, therefore, at the one who said There is no God but God, for he was the first whom We tested with There is no God but I, and We distinguished the truthful from others. For he who spoke those words before only spoke what God had revealed in the Qur'an, and the authority of the Qur'an was only established through the inability of all on earth to match it.

Subject: rejection, opposition and persecution
Quotation: But, of a certainty, the hand of the selfish clerical leaders is at work. Outwardly, they desire a national parliament and raise a hue and cry. But secretly, they are endeavoring to spread turmoil, to instigate, and to oppose the good intentions of the State. Most secretly of all, they have no desire whatsoever to see the establishment of a national parliament.

Subject: rejection, opposition and persecution
Quotation: this Cause, whereby the limbs of them that denied God's right and His sovereignty did quake, and who disputed His signs, and turned away from His luminous countenance... We make mention of God's loved ones in that land, whom the circumstances of the tyrannous ones did not frighten, and whom the power of those who disbelieved in the Day of Judgment did not weaken

Subject: rejection, opposition and persecution
Quotation: And when he had become known far and wide by this new name, the clergy, envious and malevolent, arose, and informed against him, sending their calumnies on to Tihran, so that Na?iri'd-Din Shah rose up in wrath. Terrified of the Shah, the Amir attacked Nabil with all his might. Soon the whole city was in an uproar, and the populace, lashed to fury, turned upon him.

Subject: rejection, opposition and persecution
Quotation: But in these days when the cawing of the polytheists has been raised and the braying of the calumniators has ascended... When he found himself disappointed in what he had intended, he opened his tongue of calumny that he might cast doubt in hearts that were not firm, and he wrote words about which any soul with the least discernment would testify to their falsity.

Subject: rejection, opposition and persecution
Quotation: O Nasr! By the life of God, this Wronged One, though in the dragon's mouth, calleth all unto the horizon of the All-Merciful. The corrupt ones of the Threshold are occupied with spreading false and slanderous reports. Glory be to God! Every person of insight is astonished that one whose treachery is evident as the sun still claimeth religiosity and trustworthiness.

Subject: rejection, opposition and persecution
Quotation: O Lord! Thou seest Thy friends in adversity who have been visited in Thy path with such tribulations as have caused every just one to weep and every discerning eye to shed tears. We testify that those foreigners who have violated Thy Covenant and Testament have oppressed them and committed that which hath caused the hearts of Thy loved ones in Thy dominion to melt.

Subject: rejection, opposition and persecution
Quotation: Then God is witness to what has befallen Me from one for whom I exerted mighty efforts night and day for his protection, education and training. When I became assured of his character, he arose to kill Me... Afterward he spread abroad what he had done and made accusations against this servant such as no one has ever made against another, sending these to all regions

Subject: rejection, opposition and persecution
Quotation: The bonds have been tightened around you, and leg has been bound to leg. The oppressors have attacked with utmost hatred and hypocrisy. But fear not, for they are a people accustomed to inflicting harm, who have abandoned faithfulness and persisted in cruelty. Indeed, they are but fierce wolves and worthless dogs who drink blood and devour the flesh of the loved ones.

Subject: rejection, opposition and persecution
Quotation: I find no place for myself in Thy earth whereon to set my foot or wherein to abide, for Thy servants hate me and banish me, and every day they conspire to slay me and say concerning me what they please and judge me as they desire, such that I have become bewildered in my affair and find neither refuge to flee to, nor place to settle in, nor sanctuary wherein to dwell.

Subject: rejection, opposition and persecution
Quotation: Consider how a group of meaningless turbaned ones and senseless headgear-wearers in the land of Kaf raised the banner of opposition and spread calumnies in all directions. However, after the matter was presented before His Majesty the Sultan, he delivered the oppressed from the evil of the oppressors, protected them, and of his own accord released the prisoners of ?a.

Subject: rejection, opposition and persecution
Quotation: As for the matter of molestation and persecution, Zaim-ud-Dawlih himself surely knows it has no basis - let him be the judge, for he came to Akka and observed our conduct, behavior, deeds and actions, and became acquainted with our speech and character, witnessing the utmost love, respect and kindness. Glory be to God! How could this matter become confused despite this?

Subject: rejection, opposition and persecution
Quotation: We came to Europe and found that some people from Iran, meaning a few unimportant individuals who care nothing for religion or the order of the human world, oppose us. They even speak ill of us to Christians, although if we have not been the cause of Iran's glory and prosperity, we have not caused its ruin either, and we have not interfered in any way in these upheavals.

Subject: rejection, opposition and persecution
Quotation: Since Mirza Hasan the mujtahid issued a fatwa calling for the killing of all the friends and one of the friends was torn to pieces, and they announced that all Baha'is must be killed...If this had not happened, all the divine friends in Azerbaijan would have been killed...the esteemed Aqa Siyyid Yahya was also martyred in Sirjan and the government did not seek retribution

Subject: rejection, opposition and persecution
Quotation: In the thick of those calamities, when the enemy attacked, they stoned our house and it had filled up with stones. We had nobody to help us... Immediately he called out, 'This one is a Babi!' and the boys ran after me... When I left the place, the boys came after me again, shouting and throwing stones, following me until I got close to the store of Aqa Muhammad ?anduqdar.

Subject: rejection, opposition and persecution
Quotation: Under no circumstances should you be at ease with anyone. There have been and are investigators among the people; one cannot be at ease with any soul, for they conduct their investigations with the utmost friendship and unity. Since that beloved one has the affairs of the people in hand, they must be most vigilant. The polytheistic souls will surely give information to others.

Subject: rejection, opposition and persecution
Quotation: The chief of this land has risen to cause harm and has repeatedly and continuously complained to his superiors that caravans of Babis arrive every day, along with other fabrications, until finally an official was appointed and came to this land solely to investigate and search. The emigrants were present at the first appearance of these events and they relate the circumstances.

Subject: rejection, opposition and persecution
Quotation: O Lord! Thou seest how Thine enemies have encompassed the white path, and each day they gather and plot. The matter hath reached such a pass that the wicked have gained ascendancy over the free. Thou hearest, O my God, the sighing of those near unto Thee and the crying of the sincere ones beneath the claws of the transgressors among Thy servants and the idolaters among Thy creatures.

Subject: rejection, opposition and persecution
Quotation: Now what hath befallen that spiritual friend is even greater than that... The oppression of this community reached such a point that in one city, on the word of a single attendant, twenty people were martyred. In any case, persecuting the oppressed is easy and unimpeded, but if at any time or moment the sun of justice should shine forth, the deeds of all will become clear and evident.

Subject: rejection, opposition and persecution
Quotation: World upon world of praise and realm upon realm of glorification befit and beseem the revelation of the Most Great Name, Whom neither the opposition of the divines, nor the clamor of the learned, nor the objections of the mighty, nor the power of princes, nor the vain imaginings of the people of creation could deter from His purpose or prevent from the execution of His decree and Will.

Subject: rejection, opposition and persecution
Quotation: Therefore you must proceed to punish those who martyred one of the Bahais, Seyid Yah Yah, in the city of Sirjan. He was a most learned man. They martyred him simply because he was a Bahai. Therefore you must avenge the murder. In another city, Sangsar, the natives arose against those persons. Also another person, Mullah Hassan, in the city of Tabriz, gave a command to kill the Bahais.

Subject: rejection, opposition and persecution
Quotation: Sixty years have rolled by and the Bahais have been the object of the sword of affliction and the target of the arrows of oppression. Thousands of houses have been destroyed, children became captives, women became prisoners, property was pillaged and not even a small child remained safe; yet, notwithstanding all of this, not one single Bahai took refuge under the flag of a foreign power!

Subject: rejection, opposition and persecution
Quotation: Faces have turned black and souls have been perturbed when God came with the Kingdom of verses. One said: "Why hath He come?" Say: "Despite thy will, O thou who art a polytheist and filled with doubt!" Another said: "Hath the appointed time come?" Say: "Yea, by Him Who sendeth down the rain! The appointed time is none other than His own Self, could ye but understand, O people of insight!"

Subject: rejection, opposition and persecution
Quotation: The confused and erroneous statements of that fool and the unseemly actions of him and his like brought matters to the point where people attributed every ugliness and corruption to the original Cause, and every pretext fell into the hands of the enemies of the Cause. Security was completely removed. All people became certain that the Babis were enemies of people's property, lives and honor.

Subject: rejection, opposition and persecution
Quotation: Concerning what you wrote about the friends in Jasb, upon them be the Glory of God, and likewise the mention of Mulla Ghulam-Rida, upon him be the Glory of God and His favors, and his imprisonment and afflictions - observe now to what degree oppression has reached! Hearts have melted and lands have lamented at what has befallen them, yet the people remain in evident error and strange slumber.

Subject: rejection, opposition and persecution
Quotation: Two of the loved ones of God - one whose blessed name was Kazim and the other Siyyid Aqa Jan - were confronted with hostility. By order of the Imam of the polytheists and Baqir, one of that city's ignorant ones who is known for his learning, those two noble souls were brought to the city in utter humiliation. They went before the governor and resorted to a hundred thousand lies and calumnies.

Subject: rejection, opposition and persecution
Quotation: The enemies sit upon thrones of gold while the friends languish in prison. Glory be to God! Such heedlessness hath seized the negligent that they have become oblivious to that which profiteth them and are occupied with that which harmeth them. These holy souls have been seized with utmost tyranny, though they themselves went forth and spoke with perfect steadfastness of truth and righteousness

Subject: rejection, opposition and persecution
Quotation: This Day hath come while the people are in evident drunkenness - they heard the call yet turned away from it, thus did their souls entice them. Verily they are in manifest loss. By its call were all things attracted, and by its manifestation did all names bow down, and by its mention were agitated the hearts of the polytheists who denied God and cast aside His Book out of their hatred for Him.

Subject: rejection, opposition and persecution
Quotation: As to other news of this land, despite the encompassing presence of the heedless and the clamor of the polytheists, the divine fragrances of the Cause are spreading. Some time ago, the situation in this land became very severe, that is, the governor here rose up in opposition. Praise be to God, very soon the fire of his rancor was extinguished and the spark of his envy perished and disappeared.

Subject: rejection, opposition and persecution
Quotation: They said: We shall never believe in thee, nor in Him Who sent thee. Thou art but one who wishes to turn us away from that which our fathers worshipped. Thus did they recognize Him, and saw in Him none other than one of those who fabricate lies against God. And whenever We counseled them with the counsel of truth, they turned not unto it, until the fire of waywardness increased within their souls.

Subject: rejection, opposition and persecution
Quotation: The pretenders to the Cause and the liars of the world have appeared and will appear to such an extent that in all cities and villages the cawing of ravens will be raised. Perhaps in Akka too the cawing of a raven has been raised. We beseech God, blessed and exalted be He, to assist you to achieve the most great steadfastness and to protect you from the calumnies of the godless ones and the slanderers.

Subject: rejection, opposition and persecution
Quotation: Those who, bound by their own suspicions and fancies, dispatch certain ones to various regions ostensibly to protect properties and lives - each of these becomes as a ravening beast, attacking the bodies and possessions of helpless souls. May God destroy them, save whom He willeth, for at times there may be some who are, to the extent possible, adorned with the ornament of religiosity and trustworthiness.

Subject: rejection, opposition and persecution
Quotation: According to reports, an evil person in those regions attacked both rich and poor, harming friend and stranger alike. He plundered and pillaged, and extracted tribute and tax. He exempted no one and left not a penny...Twelve thousand oppressive troops attacked the Blessed Beauty's village in Mazandaran. They plundered so thoroughly that no trace of goods or property, not even grain, remained for the villagers.

Subject: rejection, opposition and persecution
Quotation: One person in Iraq and another in Bulaq have authored books, but with lies and calumnies against the Wronged One of the horizons. They imagine they can extinguish the rays of the Sun of Truth, still the waves of the Most Great Sea, put out the light of the radiant moon, and cool the sphere of fire. Glory be to God! What delusions are these and what false thoughts! How vain the notion! How impossible the fancy!

Subject: rejection, opposition and persecution
Quotation: As for what you wrote regarding the upheaval in the Land of Purpose - by your life, no eye hath seen nor ear heard the like. Though outwardly it occurred without permission and was the cause of great harm, yet for those evil souls it was pure justice - their deeds were embodied and suddenly seized those wicked ones. Upon them be the curse of God and the curse of His chosen ones and the curse of the near angels.

Subject: rejection, opposition and persecution
Quotation: During those thrilling times, the Blessed Beauty, Baha'o'llah, never changed his attitude. Every day, as usual, he went to the bank of the Tigris river, accompanied only by Agha Mirza Mohammed Kuli. No matter how much the friends tried to interfere, telling him that the multitudes were rising against him, he paid no attention... 'All of the ulama are urging others from Nadjaf and Karbala to wage a holy war upon us.'

Subject: rejection, opposition and persecution
Quotation: When they attained unto full strength they rose up against God in opposition, following their own selves and desires. Therefore do all the tribes in the realms of eternity lament My tribulations...Give thanks unto thy Lord for having aided thee to recognize His Self, while all others have opposed Him. Soon shall He requite them for what their hands have wrought, their tongues have uttered, and their hearts have harbored.

Subject: rejection, opposition and persecution
Quotation: This servant remains perpetually bewildered and astounded, for he observes that the peoples of the world, from diverse nations and parties, are each striving with utmost determination to cling to some cause and exert themselves to the fullest extent to promote it. Yet this Most Great, Most Holy Cause, which has no peer or likeness in all creation, has appeared in Iran, while its people remain utterly heedless and veiled from it.

Subject: rejection, opposition and persecution
Quotation: If they are accused of unbelief, if lies are attributed to God, if they say "Did he invent a garden?", if when seeing you they mock, saying "These are confused dreams - nay, he has fabricated it - nay, he is just a poet", if they say "He is surely possessed", if they pronounce you unbelievers and attribute polytheism to you - it does not matter. All these events cause the exaltation of God's Word and spread of divine fragrances

Subject: rejection, opposition and persecution
Quotation: When the divine lion rushed forth from the All-Merciful jungle, he roared and bellowed with such force that the foxes of ignorance and the jackals stained from the dye-vat fled from the field, abandoning their schemes of deception and trickery. They stirred up the dust of tyranny and cruelty, scattered the soil of abasement upon their own heads, and now, in the corner of obscurity and silence, they mingle their moaning and lamentation.

Subject: rejection, opposition and persecution
Quotation: In Baghdad, all the people continuously attacked the honored House - the clergy, officials and common folk - attempting through various schemes to seize this circumambulation place of the Supreme Concourse...All cried out that this is not a house - it is the Kaaba of the Baha'is and the sanctuary of the misguided ones. Therefore the government must demolish this edifice so that the foundation of the Baha'is may be scattered to the winds.

Subject: rejection, opposition and persecution
Quotation: How can I cast upon all created things the signs of the glory of Thy sovereignty when the idolaters have encompassed Me on every side and laid hands of bondage upon this luminous, mighty and beloved Mouth? And when I mention among them wondrous remembrances, it but increaseth the hatred in the breasts of these wicked ones... Know then that a sedition has appeared whereby the heavens of idle fancy were cleft asunder, the sun of creation darkened

Subject: rejection, opposition and persecution
Quotation: O Lord! Thou seest Thy loved ones beneath the talons of hatred and Thy chosen ones under the swords of the enemies. I beseech Thee, O Protector of the world and Deliverer of the nations, to free them from the oppressors among Thy creatures and the tyrannical ones among the people of Thy realm. We make mention of thee at this hour when the Wronged One is seated upon the throne of prison through that which the hands of the oppressors have wrought.

Subject: rejection, opposition and persecution
Quotation: O Mother, Mother of the Most Holy, Most Great, Most Glorious Emigrant! Glory be to Thee, O my God! The lamp hath been surrounded by the winds of hatred and animosity - where is the glass of Thy protection, O Protector of the worlds? And Thou seest the Dove in the talons of the workers of iniquity - where are the manifestations of Thy power, O Thou Who art powerful over the worlds? Thou seest the Wronged One amidst the hosts of tyranny and hypocrisy

Subject: rejection, opposition and persecution
Quotation: Then, when they saw hundreds from their own rank with fire and zeal adopting the banner of Baha'o'llah, all the sects with one accord united to suppress this spirit which grew stronger with opposition. Driven to desperation they exhorted their followers thus: "Let us arise and kill these people, imprison their women and children and destroy them to the root. They seek to change the old, well-established order of things and nothing of us will remain."

Subject: rejection, opposition and persecution
Quotation: Therefore in these days when ill-wishers have stirred up dust and engaged in slanders and hostility, making representations to the seat of the supreme sovereignty (may God strengthen it) that have caused disturbance of thoughts and agitation in all hearts... Despite this the hateful ones fabricate lies and the agitators spread falsehoods, every day striving to create corruption and whispering all manner of lies and enmity, casting us into the dark pit.

Subject: rejection, opposition and persecution
Quotation: Among the people are those who heard and responded to their Lord, and among them are those who heard but denied the proof of their Lord, the Goal of All Desires... Reflect upon the bygone ages and what befell the Manifestations of the Cause from every ignorant learned one and every cunning knower. By God's life! They denied the Prophets and Messengers and pronounced against them with such injustice as caused the heavens to lament and the mountains to crumble.

Subject: rejection, opposition and persecution
Quotation: Indeed, there is upheaval throughout all the countries of the world, but in Iran the ill-wishers are seething with intense jealousy. They observe that the Blessed Tree is growing day by day while the uprooted tree has no stability. Assuredly they are boiling with utmost enmity, and the enemies, especially the Party of Death, in their extreme decline and fall, spend their time in death throes and find no rest, but in the end they shall be disappointed and frustrated.

Subject: rejection, opposition and persecution
Quotation: This man thinks that he is uprooting the Tree of the Cause and does not know that he is promoting the Divine Faith. The Ancient Beauty has stated, "Whosoever arises to harm us is indeed a teacher of the Cause of God." This newspaperman writes, "Alas Muslims! With utmost audacity, these people have built their mosque in Chicago and erected their Mashriqu'l-Adhkar in the mid-heart of America! Is there not a Muslim left, or has Islam been robbed of its courage to protest?"

Subject: rejection, opposition and persecution
Quotation: It is recorded in history that while Mohamad II was bombarding the wall of Constantinople and his victorious army were hastening the downfall of the Byzantium Empire; one of the Ministers of the State called on the Great Patriarch and found him much occupied over some manuscript...It is most natural that the Christian missionaries may write articles to disprove this Cause...There is a Catholic priest in Acca who has been and is still writing false statements against this Cause.

Subject: rejection, opposition and persecution
Quotation: The blessed letter of His Holiness the Afnan of the Sacred Tree was like a penetrating light and a pervasive spirit... By God! My heart has lamented, My Pen has cried out, and My heart has been set ablaze by the oppression of My servants, the like of whom the eye of creation has not seen, nor the ear of possibility heard. In their tyranny they have reached a state from which Dhi'l-Jawshan, Ibn-i-Anas, and Ibn-i-Asbahi seek refuge in God, the Just, the Compassionate, the Generous.

Subject: rejection, opposition and persecution
Quotation: Time and again these obsolete verses made this community distorted, yet still the people of Iran cling to their garments. My hope is that that noble person may succeed in establishing good order and bringing peace and tranquility to Iran. Praise be to God, the shameless chief of mischief-makers has been exposed, and it has become known from what source this secret sedition and corruption originated. But what benefit, when the prime minister became an intercessor for that evil-doer?

Subject: rejection, opposition and persecution
Quotation: O Pen! Reflect upon what hath befallen this Captive. God, the Tablet and the Pen bear witness that My sole purpose hath been the reformation of the world, the unity of nations, the advancement of existence and the upliftment of souls. Yet that which hath come to pass hath caused the Pen to tremble in its recounting. Since it hath occurred for the sake of God, it hath attained the station of life itself - tribulation in His path is rest, and calamity in His love is counted as bounty.

Subject: rejection, opposition and persecution
Quotation: What befell him in the path of God - he has endured great hardships: on one side the oppression of the polytheists and enemies, and on the other the oppression of the internal hypocrites - the latter oppression being greater and more severe. Thus after this matter was submitted in the Most Holy and Most Exalted Presence, the Tongue of Grandeur spoke this verse: "Indeed, as was said of old: The oppression of kinsmen is more painful to bear for man than the blow of a polished sword."

Subject: rejection, opposition and persecution
Quotation: O handmaid of God! Pay no heed to the derision, reproach and mockery of other peoples and former religions. In the days of Christ, they mocked a hundredfold more than this, and in the end they fell into manifest loss. Consider that although Christ's Cause in His day was confined to Palestine, it later encompassed both East and West. Observe, then, the Cause of the Blessed Beauty, which even now hath embraced all horizons. Therefore, attach no importance to the mockery of the people.

Subject: rejection, opposition and persecution
Quotation: Glory be to God! What hath possessed these people that they should imprison the friends of God and cast them into dungeons? Thou hast seen that Name of God. By My life! He desired naught save righteousness and prosperity from God, glorified be His majesty, and in the nights and days he would beseech God, glorified be His majesty, for bounty, mercy, loving-kindness and compassion for all the peoples of the world. Naught but good was mentioned by him. Nevertheless, there befell him what befell him.

Subject: rejection, opposition and persecution
Quotation: "The manifestations of polytheism have arisen to conceal Its evident lights and hide Its mighty proof from view. They seek to turn Its spiritual springtime into autumn and fall, to render Its celestial power weak and feeble, to extinguish Its bright lamp and veil the purity of Its rose garden, to still the waves of Its boundless ocean and silence the call and melody of Its heaven, to hold back the outpouring of Its January cloud and prevent Its supreme paradise from infinite freshness and grace."

Subject: rejection, opposition and persecution
Quotation: They raised the banner of oppression and enmity, destroyed thousands of Baha'i establishments, and made thousands of blessed souls the target of arrows and spears. At least twenty thousand people were cut to pieces and plundered. They caused fathers to mourn for sons and left sons fatherless. They left children and women homeless. Even suckling infants had their throats cut by the dagger of tyranny and oppression. How many were tortured, punished, branded on chest and face, and finally beheaded.

Subject: rejection, opposition and persecution
Quotation: It is therefore evident what result these weak forces shall yield. At most, a few weak and mindless souls shall waver, but in the end this fire shall be extinguished. Read in church history the account of Arius, Patriarch of Alexandria - despite having a million and a half followers and the support of the greatest emperor, he was ultimately obliterated leaving no trace. Likewise, wherever there is carrion, inevitably some crows and base dogs will gather, but they shall eventually scatter and disperse.

Subject: rejection, opposition and persecution
Quotation: Concerning what thou hadst written about the publications of him who hath calumniated God, all the Hands must unanimously designate one or two from among the Hands to respond to these calumnies, compose a treatise, publish it and disseminate it. Those souls in Istanbul resorted to every means and through the meaningless Jamalu'd-Din gained some influence. They used the unknown Jamalu'd-Din, due to his closeness to His Imperial Majesty the Sultan, as an instrument for all kinds of corruption and sedition.

Subject: rejection, opposition and persecution
Quotation: Despite this penetrating power and might, lost souls seek to extinguish the divine lamp and block the divine path, casting stones at the glass of infinite bounty. A thousand regrets that they are accustomed to heedlessness and deny what is evident. When the Cause of God was confined to Shiraz, they arose in opposition and sought to extinguish its radiant lights. They raised the banner of tyranny and unsheathed the sword of oppression, and with utmost power sought to uproot and destroy it, but they could not.

Subject: rejection, opposition and persecution
Quotation: When the luminous morn dawned from the horizon of the All-Merciful, those possessed of sight arose to sacrifice their lives, while the blind, like bats, arranged gatherings of opposition. One said "This is but a mortal like ourselves", while another uttered "He hath forged a lie against God, or is possessed." One declared "Will ye submit to sorcery while ye see it?", while another threatened "We augur ill from you. If ye desist not, we will surely stone you, and a grievous chastisement will befall you from us."

Subject: rejection, opposition and persecution
Quotation: Nevertheless, you witness the conduct of those associated with the government - how they daily inflict harm upon ones such as yourselves, whom all know harbor no ill intent toward anyone and who deal with God's servants with trustworthiness, love and kindness. Glory be to God! One is bewildered how they could consent to attribute theft to you who are among the most honored people of Iran, spreading it by word in that city and by telegraph to outlying regions, executing and carrying out whatever the slanderers say.

Subject: rejection, opposition and persecution
Quotation: In these days news has arrived that his honor Haji Haydar from Najafabad was executed by firing squad in Isfahan at noon prayer by order of the evil divines. In brief, if the present government desires divine confirmation, it must undertake retribution and justice. This matter is most important. All the friends in Najafabad, men and women, young and old, are disturbed by this incident. In Najafabad, Fath'ali Khan and his agents are showing the utmost aggression, transgression, oppression and tyranny toward the friends.

Subject: rejection, opposition and persecution
Quotation: When the divines of Tehran, at the time they entered Tehran from Qum with the Grand Vizier in their train, with the utmost pomp and circumstance and glory beyond description, and all the people of Tehran received them with the highest respect and illuminated the city for three days and nights, the friends of God were seized with the utmost fear and trepidation. For the divines, though they had for some time been utterly humiliated, were nevertheless in the extremity of pride and hostility toward the oppressed community.

Subject: rejection, opposition and persecution
Quotation: For in every age and century, when the Sun of Truth appeared, the divines, mystics and rulers rose up in opposition and exerted their utmost to extinguish the divine light. Consider ye the appearance of Christ - how the Jewish divines caused Him to suffer that which none before Him had ever suffered. Likewise observe how the divines of idolatry and the Gospel treated the Seal of the Prophets. I swear by the Sun of Truth that they inflicted upon Him that which caused the denizens of the highest Paradise to weep and lament.

Subject: rejection, opposition and persecution
Quotation: Consider the divines of Hijaz, and its men of letters and eloquence who lived in the time of the Messenger of God. For years they persisted in opposition and objection, and when they witnessed the penetrating power of the Divine Word in the early years, they finally decreed that no one should associate with Him and His companions, nor inquire about any matter from them. They even prohibited face-to-face encounters, clinging to the notion that these people were sorcerers and whoever turned to them would surely follow them.

Subject: rejection, opposition and persecution
Quotation: Repeatedly have the embodiments of polytheism and hypocrisy attempted to extinguish the divine light, and with utmost might and power have they risen to inflict harm and perpetrated that which caused the greatest terror among mankind, imagining they could suppress the fire of the Divine Lote-Tree and extinguish the light of oneness. However, God drove them away through His power, His sovereignty, His grandeur and His might, and raised up His Cause despite them and those who denied the signs of God, the Mighty, the Praiseworthy.

Subject: rejection, opposition and persecution
Quotation: The people of Iran failed to recognize God's blessing and denied it. Had they been endowed with true vision, they would have acknowledged what they have lost in a time unequaled by centuries and in days around which ages revolve. God, exalted be His glory, desired for all comfort, mercy, tranquility, bounty and freedom. However, the people of that land neither recognized nor appreciated this, and thus lost this supreme blessing, surrendering themselves, their religion, faith, station and dignity into the hands of the oppressors.

Subject: rejection, opposition and persecution
Quotation: Corruption and tyranny have ever appeared from these heedless souls. Some who have drunk from the ocean of guidance are like sight for the temple of the world, while others are like smoke, becoming a veil between eyes and the witnessing of the lights of Beauty. They imprisoned the Name of God without any crime or sin by the decree of those evil, heedless souls. With utmost tyranny they have seized some, banished some, imprisoned some, and plundered and killed others - every kind of torment have they inflicted upon these holy souls.

Subject: rejection, opposition and persecution
Quotation: When they circled round this Fire and acquired illumination from the lights of the Tree of Command through the power of the Lord of the Kingdom of Might, the hearts of mysteries were stirred, and the banners of hatred and enmity were raised against God's chosen servants, preventing them from turning toward their Lord, the Mighty, the Chosen One. O my God, my Master, and my King! There remains no land in Thy domains but hath been reddened with the blood of Thy chosen ones, and no tree but is adorned with the bodies of Thy loved ones.

Subject: rejection, opposition and persecution
Quotation: Now He has said: Let them proceed, trusting in God and content with His command and will, toward the ultimate goal, but they must act with perfect wisdom and hold fast to prudence. Repeatedly from the Tongue of Grandeur this most exalted word was heard: He says the Manifestation of Truth is for the revelation of the Most Great Bounty and the Greatest Joy, that all might attain His presence and drink from the Kawthar of reunion, but enemies and the bearers of hatred have become like clouds between the Sun of Truth and His loved ones.

Subject: rejection, opposition and persecution
Quotation: This Wronged One has been and continues to be between the fangs of wolves. When the effulgences of the Sun of Revelation encompassed the world, a faction arose with sword and spear against the Desired One of all worlds. The call hath been raised, and the Wronged One hath ever been in the hands of enemies. The tyranny of the oppressors, the turning away of the deniers, the onslaught of the transgressors, the malice of the divines and the hatred of the rulers have not prevented Him from mentioning the Lord of Names and the Creator of heaven.

Subject: rejection, opposition and persecution
Quotation: The Blessed Beauty was preserved from a great calamity that bewilders the mind. Among the incidents was when the Blessed Beauty, along with eleven others, mounted horses and moved toward the fortress. Great commotion ensued and all the divines gathered in the mosque and had the Blessed Beauty brought forth. All the townspeople assembled--carpenters with their saws and axes, builders and laborers with their shovels and pickaxes, butchers with their knives and kebab-makers with their skewers--all gathered together. They issued a death sentence.

Subject: rejection, opposition and persecution
Quotation: Let not the cawing of the female polytheists nor the braying of the male polytheists disturb thee, for most people have turned away from Him Who created them for this Day and gave them glad tidings of this luminous, resplendent Manifestation. Among them are those who openly denied God and warred against Him and pronounced judgment against Him and were numbered among the polytheists. And among them are those who disputed His verses and denied His proof and rose up against Him with swords of hatred that were a thousand times sharper than swords of steel.

Subject: rejection, opposition and persecution
Quotation: We have heard from the heedless what no ear hath ever heard, and We have witnessed what no eye in all the world hath seen, and I am the True One, the Trustworthy. The heedlessness of some people hath reached such a state that the Supreme Pen is bewildered. For twelve hundred years they claimed to love and beseeched God, glorified be His majesty, for the meeting with the Promised One by night and day. Yet when the clouds were rent asunder by the finger of divine will and the Day-Star of Revelation shone forth from the horizon of the world, all turned away.

Subject: rejection, opposition and persecution
Quotation: During the years of My sojourn in Iraq thou wert circling round Me and didst witness how the peoples and nations rose up to slay Me, and how I stood alone amidst enemies like unto the sun in its splendor, never for a moment seeking concealment or refuge, for I beseeched God that I might be given to drink of the cup of martyrdom. Then did the hand of divine power raise up the tabernacle of victory, and the Sovereign Who doeth what He willeth vanquished the enemies. And now in this remote prison, behind a thousand mountains, We remain imprisoned and confined.

Subject: rejection, opposition and persecution
Quotation: In the early centuries of the Prophetic Dispensations, how many diverse and varied tales and traditions came to be! How many books of refutation were written! Even some of the Greek and Roman philosophers wrote and published books in refutation of the Spirit of God. It is evident that in those times, the words of philosophers were regarded among the peoples as divine revelation. In the end, all those books fell into oblivion - some of them remain in European libraries as sustenance for moths, while the melody of the glorious Gospel reached the ethereal heaven.

Subject: rejection, opposition and persecution
Quotation: When he walked through the streets and bazars, the people pointed their fingers at him, calling him a Baha'i. Whenever trouble broke out, he was the one to be arrested first. He was always ready and waiting for this, since it never failed. Again and again he was bound with chains, jailed, and threatened with the sword. Things came to such a pass that in the end whenever there was an uproar Mulla 'Ali would put on his turban, wrap himself in his 'aba and sit waiting, for his enemies to rouse and the farrashes to break in and the guards to carry him off to prison.

Subject: rejection, opposition and persecution
Quotation: "When the deniers witnessed that the verses had been sent down from the heaven of Command and had encompassed the worlds, they arose to slay Me. When the hosts of victory descended and God preserved Me from their evil, they arose with another plot through what Satan had whispered in their hearts, and thus was the matter, wert thou of them that hear. They fabricated against Me that which beseemed their own selves and attributed unto Me that which their own souls and hands had committed, that they might cast the fetters of the Youth into the hearts of the unitarians."

Subject: rejection, opposition and persecution
Quotation: Consider that two despotic governments strove for years to uproot and destroy this exile, especially 'Abdu'l-?amid... But this servant placed his trust in God and resisted with all his might and remained steadfast. In the end their vast palace was laid waste while this servant's weak foundation became manifest. They scattered their crown and throne to the wind, and despite two million troops were vanquished and defeated, while this servant, without helper or assistant, alone and single, was imprisoned in the fortress of Akka in a state of captivity and helplessness.

Subject: rejection, opposition and persecution
Quotation: "Consider that in Iran, both nation and government previously arose with utmost might to extinguish the divine lamp, raised the standard of tyranny and oppression, demolished thousands of Baha'i establishments, and made thousands of blessed souls targets of arrows and spears. At least twenty thousand were cut to pieces and plundered. They made fathers mourn for sons and sons fatherless. They left children and women helpless. Even nursing infants had their throats cut by the dagger of cruelty and oppression. How many were tortured, punished, branded on chest and finally beheaded."

Subject: rejection, opposition and persecution
Quotation: Several others disappeared completely, and it is not known what calamity befell them. About a thousand people from Yazd fled to the wilderness and desert, and some perished from severe thirst in the mountains and plains. All properties were plundered and looted, and tyranny and injustice so utterly destroyed the foundation of these oppressed ones that the families, dependents and children of those innocent martyrs spent several days in basements, weeping, burning with grief and trembling, hungry and thirsty. They could not even ask for water, and no one showed mercy except to inflict wounds.

Subject: rejection, opposition and persecution
Quotation: The Governor of Beirut, Khalil Pasha, sent Abdul Rahman al-Hut as his representative to 'Akka to investigate me. When they summoned me, the friends intended to accompany me to the government house and its palace, but I did not approve and said, What benefit is there in your coming? Whatever they wish to do, they will inevitably do, and it is better that I go alone. When I reached the governor, he showed me an official telegram addressed to 'Abbas without titles and said, We have received news that two foreigners have sent you harmful political documents. Where are they and where are the documents?

Subject: rejection, opposition and persecution
Quotation: During the Shah incident, how much they tormented the friends! Among them was a Tabrizi man whom they tortured to reveal other believers but he would not. They cut off his nose, cut off his ears, tore his ears with pliers, finally flayed his scalp and poured lime on it, and after all this poured hot oil - at last he died. Later when they caught believers they did not torment them as much because they would not confess. There was a Qumi Seyyed Motavalli-bashi. That wretch caused great harm to many believers. They branded him eighty times to make him confess - whoever confessed suffered more torment.

Subject: rejection, opposition and persecution
Quotation: We sent a message to the divines in the Holy Shrines saying that if they wished to understand our Cause, We were ready to manifest whatever they desired, and if their intention was to create tumult, then by God, the All-Protecting, the Self-Subsisting, I would send two persons who would chase them all to the gates of Karbila. He said: We told them to have all the divines unite and request one verse, and write that if what they requested appeared at the appointed time, they should cease their persecution and oppression, and if it did not appear, they could pronounce Our Cause false. But no one came forward.

Subject: rejection, opposition and persecution
Quotation: How the Jews and even the Romans refused to have him buried in their cemeteries, and at last he was interred in a dung-hill which they now call Golgotha. How in the second century after Christ some of the so-called learned people sprang up and wrote many books in which they denied Christ and his appearance among the people. They have not seen anything yet. They will be attacked by all the people around them, ridiculed and despised for his sake. A great many books will be written against them and the papers will attack them very severely. A woman of great ability will write an article against the believers full of lies and false things.

Subject: rejection, opposition and persecution
Quotation: In the future, people will inevitably arise to oppose the Cause and write treatises against it. But what fruit will these efforts bear, except to make the people more aware and better informed of the Cause? In Persia, the divines and other leaders have written many books in repudiation of this Cause, with the aim of uprooting it and completely obliterating the foundation on which it rests. Among these people was Haji Muhammad Karim Khan, who wrote several books to that end - but they have all been totally forgotten, while the Cause of God has gained renown in both the East and the West, and been promulgated amidst the peoples and kindreds of the earth.

Subject: rejection, opposition and persecution
Quotation: O Thou Lord! Glory be to Thee, O God of Names and Creator of earth and heaven! I beseech Thee by Thy greatest signs and by Thy light that shineth from the horizon of the heaven of Thy will, O Lord of all beings, to assist Thy loved ones in that which will cause Thy Cause to be exalted amongst Thy servants and Thy decree to prevail throughout Thy lands. O Lord! Thou seest them in the hands of the oppressors among Thy creatures who have violated Thy Covenant and Testament and have reached such a state of wickedness that they have pronounced judgment against them with such tyranny as hath caused the people of the cities of Thy justice and bounty to lament.

Subject: rejection, opposition and persecution
Quotation: In Iran they have assailed the friends, plundering their properties and imposing enormous fines, to such an extent that they were forced to disperse. Trials and tribulations have encompassed them from all sides. The general interpreters, bereft of justice and true religion, have cloaked themselves in religious prejudice and incite people against this oppressed community, claiming they defend Islam while being utterly ignorant of it. They present themselves as pure Muslims while fomenting corruption. They go before the clergy, wailing that the Baha'is have deviated from the way of Muhammad, asking why they should not uproot them and arrange for their execution.

Subject: rejection, opposition and persecution
Quotation: A Motosarraf named Abdorrahman Pasha became most inimical against us. He did his best to find a pretext, no matter how inaccurate and thus sentence us to exile or other forms of punishment. One evening he called on the Mofti and told him that he has received a cablegram from the Sublime Port which states that Abbas Effendi's power has become so paramount in Acca that the influence of the local authorities has become negligible. Therefore some practical steps must be taken to stop the further spread of his power. The first thing to be done tomorrow is to close the shops of all the Persians, arrest them and throw them into the prison; then arrest Abbas Effendi himself.

Subject: rejection, opposition and persecution
Quotation: For some time this land was greatly disturbed. He intended to close the shops of those who were engaged in trade and imprison those souls in a special place. He held a meeting at night and in the morning intended to carry out his inherent evil designs. After sunrise he went to the market himself to close the shops, but observed that none of the friends' shops were open and none had come to the market, unaware that the All-Knowing, the All-Informed had taught them. In any case, he then sat in a place in the market waiting for the friends to come so that after they opened their shops he could harass them, when suddenly the telegram of his dismissal arrived and was handed to him in that very spot.

Subject: rejection, opposition and persecution
Quotation: Among them were those who clung to the notion that what al-Baqir had related concerning the signs of the Manifestation had not appeared, and likewise what a?-?adiq had uttered they had not witnessed. Thereby did they deprive themselves of all good and stood at the brink of the pit of polytheism, bereft of truth. And among them were those who said: "It hath been established with us through multiple transmission, as set forth by the Imams of religion and the Four Gates, that the Qa'im will not be born but is living and will appear when God wisheth and willeth. But he who hath appeared was born, and we shall not believe in him even if he should bring forth every sign or manifest a matter that would render all worlds impotent."

Subject: rejection, opposition and persecution
Quotation: But alas, a snake will not become a friend, and an owl will not become a royal falcon perched on the arm of the king. You strove for reconciliation, but a hypocrite will not become sincere, and savagery will not become civilization... The result was that in Paris he secretly formed connections with strangers... Upon arrival in Tehran, he joined with other snakes and made several others his confidants and intimate friends. Outwardly he was part of the Unity Assembly but had hidden intentions... until he caused this great mischief that nearly made the divine friends fall upon each other, and through this means the enemies could completely demolish the divine foundation and set traps from every direction to catch the divine friends.

Subject: rejection, opposition and persecution
Quotation: Time and again it has occurred that certain ones, motivated by ulterior purposes, have opened their tongues in calumny and attributed corruption to this community, claiming that - God forbid - the intentions of these helpless ones are thus and their corruptions are such; that they harbor seditious thoughts and are possessed by the passion for tumult and infamy; that they - God forbid - desire uprising. Due to such accusations they became objects of wrath and targets of punishment and chastisement, to such extent that whoever wished stretched forth the hand of aggression and tested the strength of his arm and grip. Some were arrested, groups were imprisoned in chains, and due to accusations, this entire company was scattered by calumnies.

Subject: rejection, opposition and persecution
Quotation: He composed absurdities of his own making that would make even the bereaved laugh. The endorsements in the book are all from Shi'ite divines, and these endorsements themselves attest to this fact. The author seeks to ingratiate himself with the eminent leaders of the Shi'ite party and thereby derive benefit from them. All these machinations are from the Iranian mujtahids and Arab Shi'ites in Iraq and Persia. When you examine the contents of the book, it will become immediately evident that they are fabrications by the people of hatred, and the proof lies therein. In Persia, the religious scholars have composed many similar works, printed them and distributed them among the people, but they have only increased in punishment and tribulation.

Subject: rejection, opposition and persecution
Quotation: These words of censure and severe addresses are also recorded and extant in books written in refutation of this Cause during the time of the deposed Sultan. During the reign of Abdul-Hamid, time and again petitions were submitted to the Imperial Court from enemies both known and unknown, claiming that this servant was in league with the Ottoman liberals and was expending effort day and night to destroy the foundation of independence. Time and again, investigative committees came from the Imperial Court and subjected this servant to restrictions, interrogations and torments, inflicting severe injuries. In prison too I was surrounded by satanic spies, confined with wardens and guards. Every day there were coded telegrams, and every evening ominous events would unfold. At times there were threats of exile to Fazzan, at others intimidation of drowning in the endless sea.

Subject: rejection, opposition and persecution
Quotation: Mirza Muhammad Ali exerted his utmost to bring about my exile from Akka, in the vain hope that in my absence the believers would obey him, or that he would be protected! But he is too heedless to know that in case my life is destroyed, he too shall be afflicted with a great calamity.... Mirza Muhammad Ali went even so far as to occasion the shedding of my blood. That is, he sent Jamal directly from here to Tihran. The latter went to the Ottoman Ambassador and said that he 'had lived for years in the Turkish countries and enjoyed the blessings of peace and freedom under that government; that he had thereby become such a well-wisher of Turkey that in order to express his gratitude to the authorities, he deemed it his duty to inform them of a matter which is vital to the protection of Turkey,' etc. Then he said to the Ambassador of that 'vital matter' to wit: 'Abbas Effendi has brought the British people into Akka and is considering turning over Syria to Britain, that he is in cooperation with the young Turk party, the Sultan's enemies,' etc.

Subject: rejection, opposition and persecution
Quotation:
When the Commission of Inquiry came [in 1904], they made matters difficult for us. They closed the roads, installed a magistrate, guards and gendarmes and made us the object of their slander and calumny. All of our enemies in or outside 'Akka now became informants, preparing reports to send to Istanbul. The very people that had instigated this event were now appointed as investigators and inquisitors. It should be obvious what was wrought by these people. For instance, they wrote that I had established a new sovereignty in 'Akka and had built a fortress on Mount Carmel. They accused Me of raising the banner [of the Greatest Name], circulating it in 'Akka and then exporting it to the various Arab tribes and factions through Mirza Dhikru'llah in Galilee and Shaykh Mahmud ['Arrabi]. The illustrious personages [i.e. members of the Commission] announced this as a grievous matter. Our enemies then wrote them that 'Abdu'l-Baha had raised the standard of "Ya Baha'u'l-Abha" and then appeared before the Commission of Inquiry to testify to the validity and accuracy of this charge. To affirm this falsity, they even arrayed a line of other witnesses. Mirza Muhammad-'Ali had the Greatest Name scribed by some on a piece of white cloth which he presented to the Commission of Inquiry [as evidence]. The chief of the Commission announced, "Sultan 'Abdu'l-Hamid has promised me the governorship of Beirut, and my first act will be to crucify 'Abdu'l-Baha at the gate of 'Akka!" Then by telegraph they inquired if an uprising would ensue should 'Abdu'l-Baha be sent to Fizan? The reply was negative.   ABU0533
After declaring His mission, Baha'u'llah was immediately subjected to severe persecution. The Shah of Persia and the religious authorities opposed Him vigorously. He was imprisoned, His properties were confiscated, and He and His family were exiled from place to place.

The first is through the agency of organs and instruments; that is to say, with the eyes it sees, with the ears it hears, and with the tongue it speaks. When these instruments are in action, it is the soul which motivates them. Although these faculties [such as sight and hearing] appear to be from the body, they really proceed from the soul. The second way of acting is without the use of instruments. In the world of the dream, the soul sees without eyes, it hears without ears, speaks without a tongue, and travels without movement.

Subject: relationship of the soul to the body

Light needs not the crystal but shines forth, while the crystal needs the light to become illumined. Likewise, the spirit needs not the body, but the body needs the spirit. The spirit is not alive through the body; the body is alive through the spirit. Observe that however much the body may diminish, the spirit remains in its might and power. If a person's hand is severed, the spirit maintains its power and dominion. If the eye becomes blind, the spirit retains its vision. But if the spirit's effusions are cut off from the body, the body instantly perishes.

Thomas was a feeble character who believed the Cause was lost. After a little time he saw that, though Jesus was killed, the Cause of God still continued and then he realized and believed.
