When one stops (advancing) he descends. A bird when it is flying, soars; but as soon as it stops flying it falls. While man is directed upward he develops. As soon as he stops he descends. Therefore I wish the beloved of God always to ascend and to develop.

From the untrained self of the child grows the desire of the youth to be some-thing, and from this there will arise in the mature man, besides the desire for respect, the feelings of being misunderstood, of being underrated, of being slighted.

Subject: selfishness; self-love; egotism; self-indulgence
Quotation: It is evident that divine teachings are contrary to self and desire. How can a soul carry these out if it has no faith? Divine teachings constitute the legislative power. A legislative power requires an executive power. The divine ordinances constitute the legislative power. However, it requires an executive power, and the executive power cannot be achieved except through faith and investigation. Despite divine teachings in every age and dispensation, particularly in this Most Great Cycle, those souls who have faith are prevented by their own selves and desires from acting according to these teachings; rather, they arise in complete opposition to it.

Subject: service to others; to the Cause of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/service to others; to the Cause of God.txt
Quotation: Strive that thou mayest attain unto that which is meet and seemly on this day...I beseech Thee...to aid me to serve Thy Cause with such steadfastness as cannot be shaken by the conditions of creation

Subject: service to others; to the Cause of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/service to others; to the Cause of God.txt
Quotation: Therefore man must engage his talents through such channels which are services to the Kingdom of God. The end of all these undertakings that you observe is ruin except service to the Kingdom of Abha.

Subject: service to others; to the Cause of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/service to others; to the Cause of God.txt
Quotation: inasmuch as rendering service to the maid-servants of God is a mighty crown, which all the greatest queens among women will glory to wear...I beg of God to enable thee to serve Him in His glorious vineyard

Subject: service to others; to the Cause of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/service to others; to the Cause of God.txt
Quotation: he hastened to this blessed clime and engaged in service, becoming a source of comfort. With the utmost sincerity and purity, love and faithfulness, he has devoted himself to service at the Divine Threshold

Subject: service to others; to the Cause of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/service to others; to the Cause of God.txt
Quotation: If one is situated with a family or a number of people who are in need of help and assistance, and one should have tried his best to assist them...Man is responsible to the degree of his power and capacity.

Subject: service to others; to the Cause of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/service to others; to the Cause of God.txt
Quotation: Praise be to God that in these days you are engaged in the service of the word of God, in the spreading of the divine fragrances, in the promulgation of the manifest verses and in the teaching of seeking souls.

Subject: service to others; to the Cause of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/service to others; to the Cause of God.txt
Quotation: O My loved ones! This is the day of triumph and victory. Arise to serve the Cause by leave of your Lord, the All-Choosing. Beware lest anything prevent you from making mention of this All-Wise Remembrance.

Subject: service to others; to the Cause of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/service to others; to the Cause of God.txt
Quotation: O servants! The triumph of this Cause hath depended, and will continue to depend, upon the appearance of holy souls, upon the showing forth of goodly deeds, and the revelation of words of consummate wisdom.

Subject: service to others; to the Cause of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/service to others; to the Cause of God.txt
Quotation: I became most pleased with them, because they are assisted to render such a service... I am most pleased with thy services and I hope that these services of thine shall make thee a Standard in the Divine Kingdom.

Subject: service to others; to the Cause of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/service to others; to the Cause of God.txt
Quotation: Through divine confirmations they arose to render services and through heavenly assistance they engaged in guiding souls...the services of that family will forever be on the tongues of the people of understanding

Subject: service to others; to the Cause of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/service to others; to the Cause of God.txt
Quotation: In this day service at the sacred Threshold of the Blessed Beauty and steadfastness in His Cause is the real sacrifice of the self. God willing thou shalt attain this service through all its grades and conditions.

Subject: service to others; to the Cause of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/service to others; to the Cause of God.txt
Quotation: Many maidens, in Baghdad, in Adirnih, in this Most Great Prison, hoped for this bounty, but it was not given to them. You must render thanks unto God for this great bounty, and this exalted bestowal given unto you.

Subject: service to others; to the Cause of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/service to others; to the Cause of God.txt
Quotation: Your services at the Threshold of the Incomparable Lord have been accepted, for you have arisen to serve the free souls...I hope that day by day you will increase in service and show kindness to the divine friends.

Subject: service to others; to the Cause of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/service to others; to the Cause of God.txt
Quotation: that we may kindle a flame and scatter its radiance, that we may show forth power and render service, that we may become the cause of illumination in this dark world and of spirituality in this transient dust-heap.

Subject: service to others; to the Cause of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/service to others; to the Cause of God.txt
Quotation: In the East there are loved ones who are the essence of existence, the bright candle of every gathering, promoters of peace and reconciliation among nations, and well-wishers of all parties and peoples of the world.

Subject: service to others; to the Cause of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/service to others; to the Cause of God.txt
Quotation: Lord! He has exalted Your Word, served Your threshold, spread Your mention, proclaimed Your fame, made clear Your proof, established Your evidence, thanked for Your favors, and endured every tribulation in Your love.

Subject: service to others; to the Cause of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/service to others; to the Cause of God.txt
Quotation: How fortunate and blessed in destiny you are that you have been successful in serving the friends and especially His Holiness the Afnan. This is not service - it is sovereignty. This is not servitude - it is nobility.

Subject: service to others; to the Cause of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/service to others; to the Cause of God.txt
Quotation: God hath ordained for every soul to serve His Cause and to promote His commandments...All creation hath been created for the service of God, and God hath ever gazed and continueth to gaze upon the servants of His Cause

Subject: service to others; to the Cause of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/service to others; to the Cause of God.txt
Quotation: Let your highest endeavor be to guide a soul from the abyss of extinction to the fountain of everlasting life, and to conduct yourselves among the servants in such wise that the signs of Truth may be manifest from you.

Subject: service to others; to the Cause of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/service to others; to the Cause of God.txt
Quotation: We, praise be to God, are engaged in servitude at the Sacred Threshold and comfort every broken heart. We have no whispered prayer save servitude at the Sacred Threshold, and we are in harmony with every melodious song.

Subject: service to others; to the Cause of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/service to others; to the Cause of God.txt
Quotation: I beseech from the protection, preservation and favor of His Holiness, the Divine Unity, that throughout all your days you may be stirred by the holy fragrances and be devoted and engaged in service to the Cause of God.

Subject: service to others; to the Cause of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/service to others; to the Cause of God.txt
Quotation: Among the greatest of all services that can possibly be rendered by man to Almighty God is the education and training of children... It is, however, very difficult to undertake this service, even harder to succeed in it.

Subject: service to others; to the Cause of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/service to others; to the Cause of God.txt
Quotation: The honored uncle spends his time in service to the Cause of God and in servitude at the Sacred Threshold. He never seeks comfort, finds no rest, desires no ease, and craves not the pleasures and joys of this mortal world.

Subject: service to others; to the Cause of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/service to others; to the Cause of God.txt
Quotation: O Lord, O Lord! Make me a sacrifice for Thy handmaidens and a martyr in Thy path, humble and submissive before Thy creatures, loving toward all Thy servants, and a servant of universal peace, reconciliation, love and safety.

Subject: service to others; to the Cause of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/service to others; to the Cause of God.txt
Quotation: Through faith and service to the Cause of Christ she became the pride of men and renowned throughout the horizons... Therefore everlasting honor and life lie in forsaking personal desires and serving at the Divine Threshold.

Subject: service to others; to the Cause of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/service to others; to the Cause of God.txt
Quotation: Serve the friends of God under all circumstances and conditions. This is the station of the spiritual ones; this is the honor of the Bahais; this is the glory of the sincere ones and this is the sovereignty of the unitarians.

Subject: service to others; to the Cause of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/service to others; to the Cause of God.txt
Quotation: O thou who art occupied with the service of the Cause of God! Thanks be to the pure Lord that thou hast been assisted with such grace and bounty and distinguished with such a favor - that which all those near to God longed for.

Subject: service to others; to the Cause of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/service to others; to the Cause of God.txt
Quotation: Your services and labors in this most glorious Cause are well-known and renowned, and the honored Tavangar has written of them in detail. But for this service at the Sacred Threshold, great thanksgiving is necessary and ordained

Subject: service to others; to the Cause of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/service to others; to the Cause of God.txt
Quotation: that the friends may become physicians and cure the chronic diseases of the body of the world with the antidote of divine teachings, make the blind seeing and the deaf hearing, bring the dead to life and awaken those who slumber.

Subject: service to others; to the Cause of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/service to others; to the Cause of God.txt
Quotation: Do you know what is the cure of my wounds? It is only when I hear that the Bahais are up and doing and it is with feeling sure that I shall not die before seeing the objects of Baha'o'llah attained that some of my wounds are cured.

Subject: service to others; to the Cause of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/service to others; to the Cause of God.txt
Quotation: Praise be to God, thou art set aglow with the fire of the Love of God and hast arisen in the service of the Cause of God. Thank thou God that thou hast become related to the Kingdom and art an object of the favors of the Lord of Might.

Subject: service to others; to the Cause of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/service to others; to the Cause of God.txt
Quotation: Today, whosoever serves the loved ones of God is a servant of the Most Glorious Beauty and a prince in the realm of the Supreme Concourse. He is the dust at the threshold of the friends and a servant with ring in ear to the truthful ones.

Subject: service to others; to the Cause of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/service to others; to the Cause of God.txt
Quotation: Service to the friends is a gift from the All-Merciful, and servitude to the loved ones is freedom in both worlds. The servant of the loved ones is the servant of the Beauty of Abha, and the attendant of the friends is the lord of both worlds.

Subject: service to others; to the Cause of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/service to others; to the Cause of God.txt
Quotation: Thou didst protect a believer and show kindness to an illustrious soul, delivering him from the hands of oppressive adversaries. This service is manifest in the Kingdom of the Most Holy One and is the cause of eternal glory and endless bounty.

Subject: service to others; to the Cause of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/service to others; to the Cause of God.txt
Quotation: Indeed you have labored and served and shown sincere intention, and solely for the promotion of the affairs of the Mashriqu'l-Adhkar hastened from Tehran to that land. Your service is accepted and beloved, and your labor is praised and appreciated.

Subject: service to others; to the Cause of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/service to others; to the Cause of God.txt
Quotation: That you may acquire the attribute of the emigrants who migrated in the path of God and fled from strangers, and with perfect joy and gladness and yearning and enthusiasm hasten to the City of Love and become engaged in work in that land and region.

Subject: service to others; to the Cause of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/service to others; to the Cause of God.txt
Quotation: Today whosoever desireth to render assistance must not look to that which benefiteth himself, but rather to that which is with God. He must not consider that which profiteth him, but that whereby the Word of God, the Sovereign Truth, may be uplifted.

Subject: service to others; to the Cause of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/service to others; to the Cause of God.txt
Quotation: Jinab-i-Jamshid is with us and is engaged in gardening in the Garden of Paradise, which was for several years blessed by the presence of the Blessed Beauty...he is an accepted servant at the Divine Threshold, engaged in service, striving day and night

Subject: service to others; to the Cause of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/service to others; to the Cause of God.txt
Quotation: If you are sincere in your love for me, then love and serve your fellow-men. All through my life I have carried on my back, gladly, the burdens of the believers; but now I ever anticipate hearing the good news of service actually accomplished by them.

Subject: service to others; to the Cause of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/service to others; to the Cause of God.txt
Quotation: The honored uncle, in the blessed days, served with utmost truthfulness and trustworthiness, and was the means for transmitting Tablets and letters. He had no purpose except the good-pleasure of the Blessed Beauty, no desire except service to the Cause.

Subject: service to others; to the Cause of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/service to others; to the Cause of God.txt
Quotation: Be a treasure to the poor, an admonisher to the rich, an answerer of the cry of the needy... Be a home for the stranger, a balm to the suffering, a tower of strength for the fugitive. Be eyes to the blind, and a guiding light unto the feet of the erring.

Subject: service to others; to the Cause of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/service to others; to the Cause of God.txt
Quotation: As to general protection, the believers are enjoined to look after one another. If, perchance, one is unfortunately attacked by accident or a decree of Providence, or is afflicted with a certain ordeal, they must try to release him from it. This is a duty.

Subject: service to others; to the Cause of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/service to others; to the Cause of God.txt
Quotation: If the veil were to be removed and the covering lifted, if the eye of insight were to be opened and the countenance of truth were to appear, it would become evident that this is not service - it is sovereignty over both worlds and dominion over the universe.

Subject: service to others; to the Cause of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/service to others; to the Cause of God.txt
Quotation: Thine honoured father spent all the days of his life in sacrifice until he won the garland of victory in the field of service...he left thee in this world as a remembrance so that thou mayest flood the river of his hopes and water his fertile fields of servitude.

Subject: service to others; to the Cause of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/service to others; to the Cause of God.txt
Quotation: Such undertakings as are beneficial to the poor, the weak and the helpless should be pursued in order that, on that day, through the unity of all and through great meetings, results may be obtained... The friends of God should be confirmed in service and servitude.

Subject: service to others; to the Cause of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/service to others; to the Cause of God.txt
Quotation: I beseech God to make thee the cause of steadfastness for all those whose feet slip from this path, and a herald of my servitude at the Threshold of Baha, and of my self-effacement, my evanescence, my utter nothingness and my complete sacrifice in the path of Baha.

Subject: service to others; to the Cause of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/service to others; to the Cause of God.txt
Quotation: They teach the Cause of God, educate the ignorant, and draw heart to heart in brotherly kindness. They help the poor and needy and give to them their daily bread. They love and care for the sick and are messengers of hope and consolation to the desolate and oppressed.

Subject: service to others; to the Cause of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/service to others; to the Cause of God.txt
Quotation: O servant present, write to her: This day is the most excellent of days. Every soul must arise for God's sake, speak for God's sake, turn unto God, and become evanescent in God. Say: O my handmaiden! Strive thou to attain unto such service as befitteth this divine Day.

Subject: service to others; to the Cause of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/service to others; to the Cause of God.txt
Quotation: Thy wish is to serve thy father, who is dear to thee, and also to serve the Kingdom of God, and thou art perplexed as to which of the two thou shouldst do. Assuredly engage in service to thy father, and as well, whenever thou findest time, diffuse the divine fragrances.

Subject: service to others; to the Cause of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/service to others; to the Cause of God.txt
Quotation: Praise be to God that the confirmations of the Blessed Beauty encompassed you and divine grace accompanied you, enabling you to leave your home, forsake comfort and ease, and like this servant, hasten to cities and villages, guiding souls day and night to the Abha Kingdom.

Subject: service to others; to the Cause of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/service to others; to the Cause of God.txt
Quotation: Strive that there may appear from thee in service to the Cause that which will make mention of thee in every world of the worlds of thy Lord, the All-Knowing. The glory shining from the horizon of eternity be upon those who have arisen to serve the Cause in all conditions.

Subject: service to others; to the Cause of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/service to others; to the Cause of God.txt
Quotation: It is my earnest hope that the Baha'is will become great factors in this universal reawakening, become the sowers of the seeds of good-fellowship, the planters of the trees of hope, the servants of the Cause of universal Peace and the teachers of compassion and commiseration.

Subject: service to others; to the Cause of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/service to others; to the Cause of God.txt
Quotation: Indeed, he is a diffuser of the divine fragrances and a faithful servant of the Lord of manifest signs. And if you join together and by mutual agreement raise the standard of guidance and grant the deprived ones a share of the eternal bounty, it would surely be most pleasing.

Subject: service to others; to the Cause of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/service to others; to the Cause of God.txt
Quotation: One must always try to bring comfort and well-being to others; otherwise, bringing comfort to oneself alone is easy and can be readily achieved. The essence of My words is that, at all times, a person must be thinking of protecting others and not concerned merely with himself.

Subject: service to others; to the Cause of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/service to others; to the Cause of God.txt
Quotation: Praise be to God, you have spent your life engaged in service and passed your days in servitude to the Mighty, the All-Knowing. You had no desire save His good-pleasure and no intention but service at His threshold. Such a person, though infirm, is young; though old, is a prince.

Subject: service to others; to the Cause of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/service to others; to the Cause of God.txt
Quotation: I testify that thou art alive in the Most Exalted Horizon and that thy name hath been recorded in the Crimson Scroll. I testify that thou didst, verily, attain unto the Days of God, didst ascend to heaven in His days, and didst consecrate thine own days to the service of His Days.

Subject: service to others; to the Cause of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/service to others; to the Cause of God.txt
Quotation: "But that which is essential to the acknowledgment of this word is attraction to the love of God, service to the Cause of God, diffusing the Word of God, severance from all else save God, affinity, union and oneness, humility, meekness, nothingness and servitude to the beloved of God."

Subject: service to others; to the Cause of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/service to others; to the Cause of God.txt
Quotation: Let us rather become the cause of enflaming the fire of the Love of God and instruments for the spreading of the divine fragrances. In every gathering let us shine resplendent and unto every soul be a fragrant breath of life. Let us not rest for one-minute nor be tranquil for a moment.

Subject: service to others; to the Cause of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/service to others; to the Cause of God.txt
Quotation: Those souls who are engaged in serving the prisoners and the captives are truly worthy of a hundred thousand favors. I beseech God, exalted be His Glory, to accept their service and to send down for them from the Kingdom of Utterance that which is adorned with the ornament of His presence.

Subject: service to others; to the Cause of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/service to others; to the Cause of God.txt
Quotation: In secret, with all his powers he kept on spreading the Faith and setting forth its proofs, and was a guiding lamp to many souls. He became penniless in Bukhara and a prey to many troubles, until at the last, far from his homeland, he died, hastening away to the Kingdom where no poverty exists.

Subject: service to others; to the Cause of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/service to others; to the Cause of God.txt
Quotation: This day is the day of turning toward God, the day of severance from all else save God, the day of lowliness and humiliation, the day of serving the beloved ones of God, the day of becoming utterly destitute of and free from egotism and desire and the day of purity and sacrifice in the path of God.

Subject: service to others; to the Cause of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/service to others; to the Cause of God.txt
Quotation: I hope that through the favors of the Desired One thou wilt succeed, in the company of that respected person, in serving the Most Great Name, and that thou wilt spread the breath of life in Kirman and become the cause of training souls in divine qualities, heavenly attraction, and human perfections.

Subject: service to others; to the Cause of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/service to others; to the Cause of God.txt
Quotation: They stand aloof from selfish thought, and dedicate their lives to the common good. They are the life-giving element of the body of Iran, and are manifest signs in their righteous intentions. They strive mightily to reform morals and spare not their hearts and souls in pursuit of divine good-pleasure.

Subject: service to others; to the Cause of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/service to others; to the Cause of God.txt
Quotation: The sovereignty of both worlds lies in service to the friends, especially to the pilgrims of the All-Merciful's Ka'bih. Though the value of this bounty and favor remains hidden now, in the future this gift shall shine forth in such splendor that the kings of the world will yearn for but a moment of it.

Subject: service to others; to the Cause of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/service to others; to the Cause of God.txt
Quotation: Visit your neighbors when they are sick or in trouble, offer your services to them, try to show them that you are longing to serve them. Feed the poor, divide what you have. Be contented to remain where God has placed you; be faithful in your care of those to whom He has trusted you, never waver in this

Subject: service to others; to the Cause of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/service to others; to the Cause of God.txt
Quotation: I beseech the All-Forgiving Lord to assist you in gathering together God's sheep, His sincere servants, and uniting the scattered ones among God's loved ones, His monotheistic bondsmen. This is true triumph and prosperity, power and success, so that you may become a shepherd of God's flock in those regions.

Subject: service to others; to the Cause of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/service to others; to the Cause of God.txt
Quotation: Praise be to God that in those regions you are engaged in service at the Threshold and devoted to servitude to the All-Merciful. My hope is that sincerity of purpose and truthfulness of intention may become evident, and that spirituality and detachment from all else save God may be embodied in your reality.

Subject: service to others; to the Cause of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/service to others; to the Cause of God.txt
Quotation: Furthermore the spiritual assembly must serve the human world day and night and become the manifestation of heavenly happiness. Strive as much as you can to become the mercy of the Lord and the gift of the Creator. Be the cause of the progress of the human world in all degrees, whether spiritual or physical.

Subject: service to others; to the Cause of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/service to others; to the Cause of God.txt
Quotation: Blessed art thou for having fulfilled My Covenant, and there hath appeared from thee that which caused the Concourse on High and the near angels to praise thee. Give thanks to God for this greatest favor and say: 'Praise be unto Thee, O Thou Who hast assisted me to serve Thy binding, mighty and beloved Cause.'

Subject: service to others; to the Cause of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/service to others; to the Cause of God.txt
Quotation: No matter how much the friends and servants of the Threshold would submit that too much work was harmful to His blessed health, He would say "I want to see to what degree health will assist Me in My work. I have made a promise to the eastern friends, therefore I must be engaged in work and attend to affairs."

Subject: service to others; to the Cause of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/service to others; to the Cause of God.txt
Quotation: Be thou loving to every afflicted one, a dispeller of sorrows to every grieved one, a refuge to every fearful one, a heavenly food to every destitute one, a balm to every wounded one, a consolation to dejected hearts, a blessing to unfortunate souls, a treasure to every begging one and a succor to every lamenting one

Subject: service to others; to the Cause of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/service to others; to the Cause of God.txt
Quotation: for he is infinitely ashamed and chagrined that he has not yet been assisted in servitude. Perchance, through traveling in this land, he may be assisted in the future to some small service...so that all of us may participate and become partners in the servitude of the Holy Threshold and be aided in accomplishing one service

Subject: service to others; to the Cause of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/service to others; to the Cause of God.txt
Quotation: The servant of the loved ones is the servant of the Beauty of Abha. He who loves Him serves His loved ones. This servant's utmost desire is to become a faithful servant to the friends of the Beauty of Abha and a devoted attendant. Day and night I gird up the loins of service and seek to bear fruit from the tree of existence.

Subject: service to others; to the Cause of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/service to others; to the Cause of God.txt
Quotation: You can offer services in English, and in America you can offer a better service in English. If your word concerns GOD it is good be it spoken in Hebrew or Syriac. If you seek GOD it is good whether you come to Him in one place or another. Therefore, his honor, Mr. --- will do well when he does a thing for GOD be it in English or Persian.

Subject: service to others; to the Cause of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/service to others; to the Cause of God.txt
Quotation: You turned your attention to the Supreme Concourse and engaged in service to the loved ones of God. You served the servants of Truth and showed humility in the presence of those near to the Divine Grandeur. What station is more noble than service to the loved ones of God, especially those whom God has distinguished with His grace and gift.

Subject: service to others; to the Cause of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/service to others; to the Cause of God.txt
Quotation: The intention should be dedicating one's life to serving the Cause of God, but whenever one wishes to marry, they can. My sister (the Greatest Holy Leaf) has dedicated her life to the Cause of God, but not with thoughts of monasticism and seclusion - rather she has devoted her life purely for service at the threshold of the Beauty of Abha.

Subject: service to others; to the Cause of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/service to others; to the Cause of God.txt
Quotation: They sacrifice themselves for both government and people, and are the cause of true progress for the people of Iran. They are content with modest wages, and wash their hands of improper income and customary bribes. Through all means they strive for the happiness of the nation, and in every way they seek that which leads to Iran's advancement.

Subject: service to others; to the Cause of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/service to others; to the Cause of God.txt
Quotation: O 'Abdu'l-Husayn! O you who share the name of this lowly servant! Come, come, let us join hands and become confidants, and in accordance with this name let us fill a cup with honey-sweet wine and engage in servitude and service, and attain the station of one soul. Should I fall short, you shall perfect it; should I falter, you shall press forward.

Subject: service to others; to the Cause of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/service to others; to the Cause of God.txt
Quotation: The intention should be to consecrate one's life to serving the Cause of God, but if he should ever wish to marry, he is free to do so. My sister (the Greatest Holy Leaf) has consecrated her life to the Cause of God, but not with the goal of asceticism or seclusion; rather, she has dedicated herself solely to serving at the threshold of the Abha Beauty.

Subject: service to others; to the Cause of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/service to others; to the Cause of God.txt
Quotation: that they may become the manifestation of "Those who manage affairs." ... that the consultative assembly may become the manifestation of divine assistance, protection and bounty, that it may be successful in serving the Cause of God, and that they may be loving caregivers to all the friends and think about the comfort, ease, joy and gladness of other friends.

Subject: service to others; to the Cause of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/service to others; to the Cause of God.txt
Quotation: "By day and by night he attended to the flowers and the trees and supplied them with water, even as supplying water to the Sacred Mosque. And he knew not tiredness or weariness nor toil and weakness... His other brother who wast named Ibrahim arose to serve Thee at even and at morn, weakened not in his servitude to Thee in the daytime and in the night season."

Subject: service to others; to the Cause of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/service to others; to the Cause of God.txt
Quotation: O Lord! He has forsaken soft beds and chamber comforts, companionship of kith and kin, tables of bounty and blessings, ease and luxury. He has traversed mountains, valleys and wilderness, diffusing Thy sweet fragrances, promoting Thy verses, speaking Thy praise, calling others to Thy Covenant, and inviting them to the dawning-places of the lights of Thy signs.

Subject: service to others; to the Cause of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/service to others; to the Cause of God.txt
Quotation: Be thou loving unto every poor one, a protector of every abased one, a physician to every sick one, a father to every child, a son to every elderly one, a fountain of crystal water to every thirsty one, a heavenly table to every hungry one, a guide to every seeker, a refuge to every fearful one, an intercessor for every sinner, and a joy to every sorrowful one.

Subject: service to others; to the Cause of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/service to others; to the Cause of God.txt
Quotation: In thankfulness of such tender mercies and so marvellous a favour, it behoveth thee to bow down in gratitude and pray to be graciously assisted in these days to render new and wondrous services, whose sweet savours may, for evermore, perfume the nostrils of the spiritually minded, and their signs and tokens may, eternally, beam forth upon the horizon of Oneness.

Subject: service to others; to the Cause of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/service to others; to the Cause of God.txt
Quotation: This is a servant sincere in Thy service, faithful among Thy creation, striving with his spirit, being and body in Thy Cause, seeking naught but Thy good-pleasure, desiring only the exaltation of Thy Word, the dawning of Thy lights and the manifestation of Thy signs. He hath spent what he had and all that he possessed in Thy path and expended his all in Thy love.

Subject: service to others; to the Cause of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/service to others; to the Cause of God.txt
Quotation: When a person is engaged in service, they are fresh and vibrant, always in the utmost joy and gladness, hopeful, and full of spirit and fragrance. Conversely, when one is idle, they become dejected, listless, lifeless, utterly withered, like unto a dead person, and all the moments of their life are wasted except for those hours spent in servitude at the Sacred Threshold.

Subject: service to others; to the Cause of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/service to others; to the Cause of God.txt
Quotation: To assist anyone according to one's capacity is acceptable, and service at the Threshold of the One is essential throughout one's life, for it leads to the exaltation and ascension of human reality and brings about the acquisition of spiritual perfections which are infinite.

Subject: service to others; to the Cause of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/service to others; to the Cause of God.txt
Quotation: She was ever a guide to the handmaidens of the All-Merciful, a leader of the hosts of divine knowledge, eloquent in the gatherings of detachment, gladdened by Thy verses, a herald of Thy Name, radiant in Thy remembrance, and immersed in the ocean of tribulation. She perfected souls through a pure, holy, fragrant and redolent breath that delighted the nostrils of those illumined ones.

Subject: service to others; to the Cause of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/service to others; to the Cause of God.txt
Quotation: These souls have arisen to serve Thee well and have begun servitude. Confirm them and aid them. Encourage each by promises of Thy divine favors and make them of the elect. Through God's infinite bounty, I hope that the friends of God in America will be confirmed and assisted in establishing this mighty and solid foundation, and that its dependencies will gradually be built and completed.

Subject: service to others; to the Cause of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/service to others; to the Cause of God.txt
Quotation: Although it is impossible for any one of us to serve the Cause of Baha'u'llah as it deserves...This is the fruit of existence! If the fruit of the existence of man is not servitude at the Threshold of the Almighty, I declare by the Living, Self-subsistent God that life is death, existence is non-existence, non-being is better than being, pleasure is pain, joy is sorrow, immortality is mortality.

Subject: service to others; to the Cause of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/service to others; to the Cause of God.txt
Quotation: I hope that we may all share in servitude at the Sacred Threshold and arise to serve the Most Great News, and stand up to spread the divine teachings and heavenly guidance throughout all regions. We are servants of the Threshold and guardians of the Court of Oneness. Eternal glory lies in service to the Cause of God, and everlasting bounty in exalting the Word of God.

Subject: service to others; to the Cause of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/service to others; to the Cause of God.txt
Quotation: What harm is there, if a person plan the design of his life after the pattern of the life of Mirza Abul Fazl? What danger befalls him if he divest his mind from every other thought save the spread of the Religion of God? What wrong comes to him if he consecrate his life to the diffusion of the Fragrances of God? He will be flavored in the sight of God. He will be honored in the estimation of all the people.

Subject: service to others; to the Cause of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/service to others; to the Cause of God.txt
Quotation: O thou who has sacrificed his spirit in the service of the Cause of God! Praise be to God that thy services were accepted. They have been much praised at the threshold of the Abha Beauty and thou hast been loved and sought after in the presence of the Supreme Concourse. The highest wish of the Supreme Concourse is the good pleasure of the Abha Beauty and His good pleasure is dependent on service to His Cause.

Subject: service to others; to the Cause of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/service to others; to the Cause of God.txt
Quotation: Some here wished to journey to those parts to assist in this matter, but this servant has entrusted this service to you who are enraptured with the Divine Beauty, out of my love for you. This is the extent of my love and intense devotion to you. Therefore give thanks to God for this gift which all the sincere ones would envy. You should take pride in this service over all who are in the heavens and the earth.

Subject: service to others; to the Cause of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/service to others; to the Cause of God.txt
Quotation: Make them Thy conclusive proofs, Thy clear evidences, Thy manifest signs, Thy flowing banners, Thy shining lamps, Thy brilliant stars, Thy victorious hosts, and Thy advancing armies, that they may conquer the realms of nations through a divine power, an eternal spirit, a celestial might, with swords of love and peace, weapons of concord and righteousness, and the clashing of spears that speak Thy praise amidst all peoples.

Subject: service to others; to the Cause of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/service to others; to the Cause of God.txt
Quotation: Service, social, moral, intellectual service must be the sole aim of a soul. Bahais must clothe themselves with the robe of service, sit around the table of service, eat the food of service, drink the elixir of service, talk the problems of service, hold communication with the King of service, walk in the path of service, crown their heads with the diadem of service, and quaff the salubrious water from the fountain of service.

Subject: service to others; to the Cause of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/service to others; to the Cause of God.txt
Quotation: Their services at the Sacred Threshold are accepted and their endurance of difficulties is known and witnessed. This is not service - it is glory. This is not hardship - it is bounty. If the queens of the world were to perceive the results of this service, they would all surely hasten to become handmaidens to these dear ones and would arise with the utmost humility and submissiveness to serve the handmaidens of the All-Merciful.

Subject: service to others; to the Cause of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/service to others; to the Cause of God.txt
Quotation: That I may arise with all power to serve Thy loved ones, and strive with my spirit and heart before Thy friends, and supplicate Thee with my tongue and heart that Thou may assist Thy servants in that which Thou lovest and approvest for Thy chosen ones, and make them the most honored of Thy creation, the leaders of Thy creatures, the defenders of Thy Faith, and the trusted ones of Thy Cause, that through them Thy religion may be exalted, the light of Thy Manifestation may shine forth, Thy Word may be uplifted

Subject: service to others; to the Cause of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/service to others; to the Cause of God.txt
Quotation: Make him a blessed pillar among Your loved ones, a herald of Your Covenant and Testament among Your chosen ones, a banner raised upon the highest peaks in Your land, and a true dawn in Your heaven, so that he may assist Your Cause, exalt Your remembrance, heal the breasts of the monotheists, illumine the insight of the seekers, open the ears of the deaf, give speech to the mute tongues, remove the veil from blind eyes, guide the thirsty to the waters of Your mercy, direct the hungry to the banquet table of Your feast, clothe the naked in the garments of Your virtue

Subject: service to others; to the Cause of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/service to others; to the Cause of God.txt
Quotation: O ye believers of God! Is it befitting that we rest for one moment after the departure of the Beauty of the Clement, or seek the organization of committees, or exhale one breath of comfort, or taste the honey of fleeting pleasure, or lay our heads on the cushions of repose, or pursue the luxury and affluence of the world of creation? No! I declare by God! This is not the condition of loyalty nor the state of faithfulness and appreciation. Therefore, O ye friends! With heart and soul yearn for the service of the divine threshold and like unto the righteous ones become ye the guardians of the court of the merciful.

Subject: service to others; to the Cause of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/service to others; to the Cause of God.txt
Quotation: Every faculty of the faculties of man which is used in the path of the Blessed Perfection is like the oil which burns in this lamp - illumining this room;- whether it is the faculty of memory or the power of speech or the art of music and song or the gift of writing or the talent of painting or the endowment of poetry etc, it will produce infinite results. Now we must use all our faculties in the path of the Cause. Our utmost hope and desire must be to surrender entirely our wills to the Will of the Blessed Perfection, to become non-existent at the Holy Threshold. All our physical and spiritual faculties must be consecrated to the progress of the Movement.

Subject: service to others; to the Cause of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/service to others; to the Cause of God.txt
Quotation: Be occupied with service to the Cause in the nights and days.

Subject: service to others; to the Cause of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/service to others; to the Cause of God.txt
Quotation: sacrifice our lives in this path and strive with heart and soul

Subject: service to others; to the Cause of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/service to others; to the Cause of God.txt
Quotation: All gain is loss, except in the great business of serving God.

Subject: service to others; to the Cause of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/service to others; to the Cause of God.txt
Quotation: thou art sacrificing thy life in the path of the Blessed Beauty

Subject: service to others; to the Cause of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/service to others; to the Cause of God.txt
Quotation: arisen to mention thy Lord and serve His Cause... assist me to serve Thy Cause

Subject: service to others; to the Cause of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/service to others; to the Cause of God.txt
Quotation: Surely you are striving to serve and making great effort in fellowship, unity and love.

Subject: service to others; to the Cause of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/service to others; to the Cause of God.txt
Quotation: You must help me and I will help you to increase our service in the Cause of Baha'o'llah.

Subject: service to others; to the Cause of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/service to others; to the Cause of God.txt
Quotation: you have no purpose except service to the Cause of God and promotion of the divine teachings

Subject: service to others; to the Cause of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/service to others; to the Cause of God.txt
Quotation: service at the threshold in that region is also among the greatest hopes of those drawn nigh

Subject: service to others; to the Cause of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/service to others; to the Cause of God.txt
Quotation: Your daughter is doing a lot of good work...In reality, your daughter is serving Baha'u'llah.

Subject: service to others; to the Cause of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/service to others; to the Cause of God.txt
Quotation: I beseech Thee...to make me a standard of Thy Cause in Thy lands and an ensign amongst Thy servants.

Subject: service to others; to the Cause of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/service to others; to the Cause of God.txt
Quotation: O thou who standeth in service at the Holy Shrine! This service is a crown placed upon thy head from heaven.

Subject: service to others; to the Cause of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/service to others; to the Cause of God.txt
Quotation: Blessed are those souls who speak forth the praise and glorification of God and who are engaged in service to His Cause.

Subject: service to others; to the Cause of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/service to others; to the Cause of God.txt
Quotation: Thou too must engage in service to the Ark of the Covenant, that thou mayest become the cause of deliverance to all regions

Subject: service to others; to the Cause of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/service to others; to the Cause of God.txt
Quotation: I beseech God to assist him to serve His Cause, exalt His Word, diffuse His fragrances, and expound His proofs and evidences

Subject: service to others; to the Cause of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/service to others; to the Cause of God.txt
Quotation: Therefore, strive with heart and soul to raise the banner of service and to harmonize with the people of the Most Glorious Kingdom.

Subject: service to others; to the Cause of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/service to others; to the Cause of God.txt
Quotation: In reality, thou art engaged in service and art devotedly working in the Cause of God. I know this! Suppose not that I neglect this!

Subject: service to others; to the Cause of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/service to others; to the Cause of God.txt
Quotation: arose to serve the Cause of God and diffuse the divine fragrances, spoke truth before all, presented conclusive proofs to every soul seeking guidance

Subject: service to others; to the Cause of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/service to others; to the Cause of God.txt
Quotation: Truly, thou hast shown and art showing the utmost self-sacrifice in the path of the Most Great Name, His Holiness the Glory of the heavens and earth.

Subject: service to others; to the Cause of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/service to others; to the Cause of God.txt
Quotation: Assist these righteous ones to serve Thy Being which is sanctified above all things in the world of lights, and enable them to exalt Thy Word among Thy servants

Subject: service to others; to the Cause of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/service to others; to the Cause of God.txt
Quotation: That true friend is truly exerting his utmost effort to render service at the Sacred Threshold. I hope through God's favors he will be confirmed in all matters.

Subject: service to others; to the Cause of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/service to others; to the Cause of God.txt
Quotation: I beseech Thee by Thy most sweet call and the scratching of Thy Most Exalted Pen to assist me to serve Thy Cause and to arise before the gate of Thy bounty and might

Subject: service to others; to the Cause of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/service to others; to the Cause of God.txt
Quotation: You are engaged in service, familiar with servitude, and intimate with exalting the Word of God. This service is identical to attaining the threshold of the Divine Unity.

Subject: service to others; to the Cause of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/service to others; to the Cause of God.txt
Quotation: And concerning your request to be engaged in service to the Cause, God willing, you shall be assisted therein. O Abu'l-Hasan! God willing, may you be engaged in service to the Cause.

Subject: service to others; to the Cause of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/service to others; to the Cause of God.txt
Quotation: This is better for you than the sovereignty of all horizons. In the world of existence, whatever you see will ultimately become nonexistent and lost except services to the Loving Lord

Subject: service to others; to the Cause of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/service to others; to the Cause of God.txt
Quotation: I hope that you will always be the servant of the Kingdom of GOD, thy services will be accepted in the Holy Threshold, and (Divine) assistance and success will successively reach thee!

Subject: service to others; to the Cause of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/service to others; to the Cause of God.txt
Quotation: Praise be to God! the tree of Mr. Chase's life brought forth fruit. It gave complete fruit, therefore he is free. He attained to eternal rest. He is now in the Presence of BAHA'O'LLAH.

Subject: service to others; to the Cause of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/service to others; to the Cause of God.txt
Quotation: All that thou seest shall soon vanish like unto a mirage, save service to the Kingdom of God and the proclamation of the appearance of the Lord of Hosts - this alone shall remain and endure

Subject: service to others; to the Cause of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/service to others; to the Cause of God.txt
Quotation: As to the Messenger, upon him be My glory and loving-kindness, in recent years he hath been engaged in service, ever holding fast to the transcription of verses and the teaching of the Cause.

Subject: service to others; to the Cause of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/service to others; to the Cause of God.txt
Quotation: "They sacrifice their lives to exalt the Word of God and are carried away in diffusing the divine fragrances." "Today there is no greater nearness than this and no more perfect service than this."

Subject: service to others; to the Cause of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/service to others; to the Cause of God.txt
Quotation: We have heard the call of those who have been arisen to serve His Cause with a clear covenant and firm pledge...the Hands of the Cause of God are arising with complete dedication to serve the Cause

Subject: service to others; to the Cause of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/service to others; to the Cause of God.txt
Quotation: I have not placed these Persians in 'Adasiyyih to serve themselves. They are not occupied with serving themselves; they are occupied with serving the Holy Shrine. The Blessed Beauty is their helper.

Subject: service to others; to the Cause of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/service to others; to the Cause of God.txt
Quotation: This is contingent upon thy being able to travel with the utmost joy and fragrance; otherwise, remain at thy present post where thou art still a servant of the Cause and a diffuser of its fragrances.

Subject: service to others; to the Cause of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/service to others; to the Cause of God.txt
Quotation: This is of God's bounty -- He bestoweth it upon whomsoever He willeth. How many monarchs expressed their longing and desire to be engaged in some service or to be confirmed in some endeavor in this day

Subject: service to others; to the Cause of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/service to others; to the Cause of God.txt
Quotation: Verily, I do not forget the services of thy noble father and thine own effort and endeavor in the Cause of thy Gracious Lord. I pray for thy confirmation and success, morning and evening, day and night.

Subject: service to others; to the Cause of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/service to others; to the Cause of God.txt
Quotation: Gird up thy loins to serve God and remember Him. He will verily aid thee through the truth... Confine thy affairs to the remembrance of God and the promotion of His Cause. This will profit thee in this world and the next.

Subject: service to others; to the Cause of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/service to others; to the Cause of God.txt
Quotation: I beseech Thee by the Cause before which no cause can stand, to assist Thy loved ones and friends to serve Thee and Thy Cause. His honor must arise to serve the Cause with utmost dedication, that its signs may appear in creation.

Subject: service to others; to the Cause of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/service to others; to the Cause of God.txt
Quotation: Make mention of him who turned to the Countenance, whose letter appeared before the Throne, sent by one who spoke My praise, who arose to serve My Cause, who turned toward My horizon, and who would transcribe My verses by night and day.

Subject: service to others; to the Cause of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/service to others; to the Cause of God.txt
Quotation: O precious souls! Your letter was received, and its contents brought the utmost joy, for those pure souls are swift and nimble in service in the field of servitude, and are engaged night and day in the most earnest supplication and entreaty.

Subject: service to others; to the Cause of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/service to others; to the Cause of God.txt
Quotation: For some time you were engaged in outstanding services in the Most Great Prison and undertaking necessary tasks. Your service was accepted and your efforts were pleasing. Now return to that land and occupy yourself with your previous services.

Subject: service to others; to the Cause of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/service to others; to the Cause of God.txt
Quotation: Arise thou to serve the Cause and take hold of the reins of the people by thy Lord's leave, the Ancient of Days. Remind them in all matters and leave them not to themselves. Be steadfast in the Cause and be a leader of the servants unto the Lord of creation.

Subject: service to others; to the Cause of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/service to others; to the Cause of God.txt
Quotation: O Lord! O Lord! Aid them to serve Thy Cause, to persevere in worship of Thee, to become intoxicated with the wine of Thy love, to delight in the gardens of Thy bounty, to turn wholly unto the Kingdom of Thy Oneness, to chant Thy verses and expound Thy words.

Subject: service to others; to the Cause of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/service to others; to the Cause of God.txt
Quotation: Indeed, you are a true servant of the Abha Kingdom and a faithful and steadfast servant of the Blessed Beauty. Thus you have been confirmed in a service whose effects will extend through successive centuries and ages, and this lofty endeavor will become an enduring sign

Subject: service to others; to the Cause of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/service to others; to the Cause of God.txt
Quotation: "I have had no purpose except service to the Cause of God and no intention except the exaltation of the Word of God...night and day I am occupied with exalting the Word of God and diffusing the divine fragrances, and I have had and have no purpose except service to His Cause."

Subject: service to others; to the Cause of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/service to others; to the Cause of God.txt
Quotation: Ordain for him, O my God, that which will cause the fragrance of Thy Cause to waft throughout Thy kingdom and the sweet-scenting breeze of Thy victory to spread throughout Thy lands... aid him to transcribe Thy verses, spread abroad Thy commandments, and manifest Thy knowledge.

Subject: service to others; to the Cause of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/service to others; to the Cause of God.txt
Quotation: He forsook his ease and comforts in Yazd, and hastened to 'Ishqabad in service to the Cause of God. How self-sacrificing he was in the rearing of the Mashriqu'l-Adhkar! He completely dedicated his life until he succeeded in establishing the first Mashriqu'l-Adhkar in that land.

Subject: service to others; to the Cause of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/service to others; to the Cause of God.txt
Quotation: Emphasis on performing deeds that exalt the Cause: "This lowly one beseeches from the ocean of God's grace and mercy, exalted be His glory, that He may assist His loved ones to perform such deeds and actions as will cause the exaltation of the Cause and the upliftment of the Word of God."

Subject: service to others; to the Cause of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/service to others; to the Cause of God.txt
Quotation: In truth, not even to the extent of a needle's eye has anyone's reward been or will be lost. He said that from the earliest days until now, Muhammad has stood firm in service and held fast to the cord of grace, and throughout this long period nothing appeared from him contrary to His good-pleasure.

Subject: service to others; to the Cause of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/service to others; to the Cause of God.txt
Quotation: His Holiness the Name of God hath offered endless praise of you, that, praise be to God, you are striving with heart and soul in service to the Cause of God and drinking from the cup of attraction. You are in the utmost radiance and the highest state of supplication, steadfast and firm, established and receptive.

Subject: service to others; to the Cause of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/service to others; to the Cause of God.txt
Quotation: You must nurse and water and take care of the Blessed Tree of the Cause of God,- so that It may grow and develop. Its branches giving shade to the people of the East and the West, and Its luscious fruits satisfying the hunger of mankind. If you do not arise, in the accomplishment of this service, who then will arise?

Subject: service to others; to the Cause of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/service to others; to the Cause of God.txt
Quotation: What greater bounty is there for one than this, that from the start of one's life, one might implore and beseech God, one may chant songs of praise and gives life to others by one's words, unloose one's tongue in eloquence to guide souls to the Faith of God and with all one's heart seek to serve the sacred Threshold.

Subject: service to others; to the Cause of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/service to others; to the Cause of God.txt
Quotation: Therefore, become a companion of Abdul-Baha and share in the afflictions of this servant. Arise in service at the Sacred Threshold and seek the gifts of the Abha Kingdom. Lay thy head upon the threshold and join the company of the righteous ones, that thou mayest witness the bestowals of the Court and observe the radiance of summer.

Subject: service to others; to the Cause of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/service to others; to the Cause of God.txt
Quotation: People are not equal - some act purely for God's sake and seek no reward for their efforts except nearness to the Divine Threshold, and this is correct and complete. But some companions seek "Our Lord, grant us good in this world and good in the Hereafter." One must deal with souls with kindness, otherwise the work becomes difficult.

Subject: service to others; to the Cause of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/service to others; to the Cause of God.txt
Quotation: We counsel thee and those who have believed to be trustworthy and religious, and to that which elevateth the station of man. Aid ye My Cause with these My hosts. Thus were ye commanded aforetime in diverse Tablets, as attesteth he who hath in his possession a perspicuous Book. Aid your Lord through wisdom and utterance, through deeds and character.

Subject: service to others; to the Cause of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/service to others; to the Cause of God.txt
Quotation: Therefore, thank God that thou art among those souls who today hold in their hands the bouquet of the love of God and offer it to receptive nostrils, and who have lit the lamp of the knowledge of God in the glass of the heart, illumining that region with its lights. Thou hast raised the call of truth among those tribes and peoples and spread the Word of God.

Subject: service to others; to the Cause of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/service to others; to the Cause of God.txt
Quotation: Live and act in accordance with the Teachings of Baha'u'llah. There is no straighter road or better road than this. His Holiness Baha'u'llah has given teachings for all the people. Whosoever desires to be with Baha'u'llah and serve Baha'u'llah, and receive a portion of the Ocean of His mercy, must live in accord with the behests and exhortations of Baha'u'llah.

Subject: service to others; to the Cause of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/service to others; to the Cause of God.txt
Quotation: Observe that some souls guarded themselves and kept hidden from stranger and kin, did not open their tongues to teach, and in the end remained without fruit or trace. But other souls sacrificed themselves in the path of truth, opened their lips to guide mankind, and acted according to the divine counsels. Those souls shine in the horizon of sanctity like the morning star.

Subject: service to others; to the Cause of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/service to others; to the Cause of God.txt
Quotation: Therefore, O faithful friends, you must all become partners and associates of 'Abdu'l-Baha in sacrificing your lives, serving the divine Threshold, and in servitude to the court of the Infinite One. If you succeed in attaining this supreme bounty, in a brief time all horizons will become the dawning-place of lights, and the Beloved of the unity of the world of humanity will appear with utmost charm at the pole of existence.

Subject: service to others; to the Cause of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/service to others; to the Cause of God.txt
Quotation: Assist them then by Thy grace to consecrate themselves to Thy service, that through them whatsoever Thou desirest for Thy realm may be realized, and with their exertions the ensigns of Thy victory be unfurled in Thy lands... Exalt them then as to become the hands of Thy Cause, that through them Thy wondrous signs may be spread far and wide throughout Thine earth and the emblems of Thy sanctity be manifested amidst Thy people.

Subject: service to others; to the Cause of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/service to others; to the Cause of God.txt
Quotation: But for us the desire is that we may be instrumental and thus we may be crowned there. Otherwise, God is able to create instruments whereby his Cause shall be spread, whereby his Word shall be published broadcast. But the desire is that to-day the Word may be spread, that our motion shall be beneath this banner and standard, that we may be the cause of giving forth the summons of God, that we may invite the souls to the kingdom, that we may be the guides of the souls.

Subject: service to others; to the Cause of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/service to others; to the Cause of God.txt
Quotation: Therefore, we must strive and not rest, that we might gain even a drop from the ocean of servitude to these blessed souls. At least if we are deprived of the ocean, let us not be deprived of a drop, for servitude to these Holy Manifestations is like the sun and we are like particles. The particle becomes visible in the light of the sun; likewise, we become visible in servitude to the Sacred Threshold. Without the ray of the sun, the particle has no visibility, as if it were a thing unmentioned.

Subject: serving humanity; working for progress, betterment of the world
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/serving humanity; working for progress; betterment of the world.txt
Quotation: service to all humanity

Subject: serving humanity; working for progress, betterment of the world
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/serving humanity; working for progress; betterment of the world.txt
Quotation: this Wronged One hath come for the reformation of the world. He hath not followed and will not follow the corrupt, even should all the wolves of the earth gather against Him

Subject: serving humanity; working for progress, betterment of the world
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/serving humanity; working for progress; betterment of the world.txt
Quotation: God hath ordained upon every soul the betterment of the world and the refinement of the souls of nations.

Subject: serving humanity; working for progress, betterment of the world
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/serving humanity; working for progress; betterment of the world.txt
Quotation: They must exert every effort for the advancement of the souls in all stages of existence. They must educate the children and teach them useful arts, reach ever higher degrees of civilization, multiply national crafts and industry, promote trade, improve agriculture, provide learning for all, educate women and honour them, and show consideration for the handmaidens of God. They must strive with heart and soul to create love and unity among the friends, to serve the government, and to be true to the royal throne, the well-wishers of everyone, and obedient to the valiant sovereign.

Subject: serving humanity; working for progress, betterment of the world
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/serving humanity; working for progress; betterment of the world.txt
Quotation: to guide through you all things unto that whereby the world may be civilized and the affairs of nations be set in order, and souls may ascend unto the Kingdom of the knowledge of the Cleaver of Dawn.

Subject: serving humanity; working for progress, betterment of the world
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/serving humanity; working for progress; betterment of the world.txt
Quotation: Baha'o'llah revealed heavenly teachings that will reform the phenomenal world, the world of spirits and hearts, the world of thought and capacity, the world of religion and philosophy. Verily the revelation of Baha'o'llah will reform all that pertains to man.

Subject: serving humanity; working for progress, betterment of the world
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/serving humanity; working for progress; betterment of the world.txt
Quotation: It is my hope that this dust may settle and that Iran may experience comfort and composure, that its heaven may be illumined, that a divine civilization may be founded there; that Persians may so advance as to shine throughout the world, become exemplars to all nations, lay the foundation of human perfections, progress both materially and morally

Subject: serving humanity; working for progress, betterment of the world
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/serving humanity; working for progress; betterment of the world.txt
Quotation: God willing, may the people of the Crimson Ark, both men and women, succeed in fulfilling that which hath been revealed from the Most Exalted Pen, and may they appear adorned with such virtues as shall cause them to become the educators and refiners of the souls of the world. For in the Book of God, all are commanded to reform the world and educate the nations.

Subject: serving humanity; working for progress, betterment of the world
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/serving humanity; working for progress; betterment of the world.txt
Quotation: Any plan undertaken with the universal good in mind is of God. Although undertakings relating to the general good hath been partially attained in progressive countries, only those endeavours which are directed in their entirety towards universal well-being can reflect the sacred Word of God and His wisdom. Therein doth lie the ultimate source of that power which can transform the world of being and cause fundamental change. This force is creative, it is generative and transformative, and will bring forth a new creation.

Subject: serving humanity; working for progress, betterment of the world
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/serving humanity; working for progress; betterment of the world.txt
Quotation: His aim is good and a service to the world of humanity.

Subject: serving humanity; working for progress, betterment of the world
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/serving humanity; working for progress; betterment of the world.txt
Quotation: Servitude to all the human race is my perpetual religion.

Subject: serving humanity; working for progress, betterment of the world
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/serving humanity; working for progress; betterment of the world.txt
Quotation: Hands which have labored in the Cause of education are ever blessed. I am pleased with your hands. I love such hands very much, because they have worked for the children. May thou become a great educator and guide to humanity!

Subject: serving humanity; working for progress, betterment of the world
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/serving humanity; working for progress; betterment of the world.txt
Quotation: This too is a noble service, therefore I interpret you as divine deliverance, for you are truthful, trustworthy, steadfast and resolute. My hope is that you may be successful in serving the world of humanity and render distinguished service.

Subject: serving humanity; working for progress, betterment of the world
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/serving humanity; working for progress; betterment of the world.txt
Quotation: Lead the thirsty to the spring of living waters and give true healing to the sick. Become students of truth and divine physicians. Treat the sick among humanity, make the deprived ones intimate with mysteries, give hope to the hopeless, awaken those who sleep, make the heedless mindful.

Subject: serving humanity; working for progress, betterment of the world
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/serving humanity; working for progress; betterment of the world.txt
Quotation: Beseech thou God that thou mayest embrace a Faith that is heart-delighting and sweet as sugar, which is the essence of the manifest Religion - and that is this: that thou mayest become a mercy from the Lord and a gift from the Creator, and through thy words and deeds bestow life upon the world of humanity.

Subject: serving humanity; working for progress, betterment of the world
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/serving humanity; working for progress; betterment of the world.txt
Quotation: Our duty is to counsel and advise humanity, educate the ignorant, and guide the wayward. We absolutely have no interference in any affairs except giving counsel and guidance, directing people to seek the good pleasure of the Lord, educating humanity in the intellectual and spiritual perfections of the human world

Subject: serving humanity; working for progress, betterment of the world
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/serving humanity; working for progress; betterment of the world.txt
Quotation: The friends of the All-Merciful must dedicate their time to serving humanity and spreading divine qualities. They must guide all people to love and fellowship, and lead all souls to truthfulness, purity, peace, harmony, reconciliation, faithfulness, integrity and friendship, so that the innate oneness of human nature may eliminate acquired estrangement.

Subject: serving humanity; working for progress, betterment of the world
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/serving humanity; working for progress; betterment of the world.txt
Quotation: "Serve God? There is no one in this world who can serve God, because we are not able to see Him. He is above our human ken. In my mind the only way we can serve Him is to serve mankind he should not rest day or night but rather serve the government and nation, demonstrate the utmost truthfulness, honesty, trustworthiness, purity and nobility, be content with his salary however small it may be, and be free and sanctified from all defilement - so that it may become evident that the Baha'is are heavenly angels who have no desire except service to humanity, especially to their homeland

Subject: serving humanity; working for progress, betterment of the world
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/serving humanity; working for progress; betterment of the world.txt
Quotation: And convey my message to Mr. Baker that your endeavors for the world of humanity and your service to human society are evident and acceptable before the Lord of Hosts. My hope is that you may succeed in serving in the realm of heavenly morals and the divine Kingdom. This is a tree that is fruit-bearing and will yield eternally. It is the cause of the spirit's persistence and the reason for eternal life.

Subject: serving humanity; working for progress, betterment of the world
