Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/serving humanity; working for progress; betterment of the world.txt
Quotation: O friends of God! Serve humanity with utmost joy and radiance, and show forth love to all mankind. Look not upon any limitations and be not restricted by any bonds, for limitations and restrictions become dark veils preventing the manifestation of human perfections, while freedom causes the appearance of divine bounties. Find not a moment's rest, seek not a minute's respite, take not a breath's repose. Be turbulent like the sea and roar like the leviathan of the ocean of eternity.

Subject: serving humanity; working for progress, betterment of the world
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/serving humanity; working for progress; betterment of the world.txt
Quotation: To the orphans be ye kind fathers, and to the unfortunate a refuge and shelter. To the poor be a treasure of wealth, and to the sick a remedy and healing. Be a helper of every oppressed one, the protector of every destitute one, be ye ever mindful to serve any soul of mankind.

Subject: serving humanity; working for progress, betterment of the world
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/serving humanity; working for progress; betterment of the world.txt
Quotation: Guide the people.

Subject: serving humanity; working for progress, betterment of the world
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/serving humanity; working for progress; betterment of the world.txt
Quotation: Never talk to God to a man with an empty stomach. Feed him first.

Subject: serving humanity; working for progress, betterment of the world
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/serving humanity; working for progress; betterment of the world.txt
Quotation: "The intention should be the prosperity of the world and the civilization of humanity."

Subject: serving humanity; working for progress, betterment of the world
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/serving humanity; working for progress; betterment of the world.txt
Quotation: serve faithfully the world of humanity... become lovers of humanity from the depths of their hearts

Subject: serving humanity; working for progress, betterment of the world
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/serving humanity; working for progress; betterment of the world.txt
Quotation: I desire naught in Thy Dominion save to better the condition of the world and improve the character of peoples of different nations

Subject: serving humanity; working for progress, betterment of the world
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/serving humanity; working for progress; betterment of the world.txt
Quotation: As much as you can, help the weak and protect the poor... Serve and show love to the world of humanity and be the cause of human happiness.

Subject: serving humanity; working for progress, betterment of the world
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/serving humanity; working for progress; betterment of the world.txt
Quotation: They must become the cause of the adornment of the world and comfort of humanity...becoming manifestations of divine favor and the cause of comfort.

Subject: serving humanity; working for progress, betterment of the world
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/serving humanity; working for progress; betterment of the world.txt
Quotation: Your letter was just now read aboard ship and brought joy, for praise be to God, the purpose is glorious and the intention is to render service to the world of humanity.

Subject: serving humanity; working for progress, betterment of the world
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/serving humanity; working for progress; betterment of the world.txt
Quotation: that they may be favored with the privilege of serving the world of humanity, that they may help to establish universal peace and lay the foundation of the oneness of the world of humanity

Subject: serving humanity; working for progress, betterment of the world
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/serving humanity; working for progress; betterment of the world.txt
Quotation: We must serve the world of humanity in a befitting manner. We must be self-sacrificing. We must pray to God that He may assist us in the accomplishment of real services in His heavenly Vineyard.

Subject: serving humanity; working for progress, betterment of the world
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/serving humanity; working for progress; betterment of the world.txt
Quotation: We beseech God that He may aid him and others to serve the Cause and exalt the Word, and enable them to achieve that which will lead to the reformation of the world and the education of its peoples.

Subject: serving humanity; working for progress, betterment of the world
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/serving humanity; working for progress; betterment of the world.txt
Quotation: Praise be to God that thou art assisted in the service of the world of humanity and art the manifestor of divine Confirmations; for the service in which thou art engaged is the magnet which attracts the heavenly assistance.

Subject: serving humanity; working for progress, betterment of the world
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/serving humanity; working for progress; betterment of the world.txt
Quotation: The real enjoyment of the world of humanity consists in the fact that every individual may think of the wellbeing of others and sacrifice his own rest for the rest of his fellowman. Then and not until them will he be really happy.

Subject: serving humanity; working for progress, betterment of the world
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/serving humanity; working for progress; betterment of the world.txt
Quotation: In the midst of this concourse of the world's factions, the party of God has the desire to serve the world of humanity. God willing, they will efface these calamities by the power of the proof, the divine confirmations, and boundless determination.

Subject: serving humanity; working for progress, betterment of the world
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/serving humanity; working for progress; betterment of the world.txt
Quotation: "It is my hope that the material services of that honoured soul to the world of humanity will be joined with spiritual service to the Kingdom of God." "Proceed to Switzerland to engage in charitable service and become a loving mother to these orphaned children"

Subject: serving humanity; working for progress, betterment of the world
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/serving humanity; working for progress; betterment of the world.txt
Quotation: What delightful service is this to the world of humanity! What fruitful exertion is this in the Universe of God! What noble striving is this in the path of the Kingdom! What heavenly privilege is this in the promulgation of Truth! What divine splendor in the illumination of the souls of mankind.

Subject: serving humanity; working for progress, betterment of the world
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/serving humanity; working for progress; betterment of the world.txt
Quotation: Your intention is to serve the world of humanity, your purpose is to obtain divine good-pleasure, and your ultimate hope is to enter the Kingdom of God. Exert yourself to the utmost of your capacity and strive with intense effort and high endeavor that you may become accomplished in diverse arts and that through learning you may benefit humanity at large.

Subject: serving humanity; working for progress, betterment of the world
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/serving humanity; working for progress; betterment of the world.txt
Quotation: For the duties of the friends are these: they must engage themselves in diffusing the Lights of the Sun of Truth; arise to guide the inhabitants of the world; bestow life upon the dead; lead the erring ones to the apex of Guidance; sing the melody of the Kingdom; summon the souls to the Divine Goal of Truth and be occupied with the training of the world of humanity

Subject: serving humanity; working for progress, betterment of the world
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/serving humanity; working for progress; betterment of the world.txt
Quotation: I beseech God that thou mayest succeed in thine intent so that these inner motives might find outward expression. Good intentions are of two kinds in the world of creation. One kind is aimed at a specific goal, a particular group, and its scope is extremely narrow. The other kind is directed towards all created things. It is a goodwill that is extensive in range and absolute in nature.

Subject: serving humanity; working for progress, betterment of the world
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/serving humanity; working for progress; betterment of the world.txt
Quotation: They have no other aim, no other intention save service to the world of humanity.... in this Cause there is no relationship sane the relationship of service and self-sacrifice. Today the field of the service in the Cause is open to all. Every one has a chance to try his mettles. I am encouraging all to arise and serve the Cause. I went out myself and called mankind to the Kingdom of Abha. Let every one do the same and God shall assist

Subject: serving humanity; working for progress, betterment of the world
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/serving humanity; working for progress; betterment of the world.txt
Quotation: They must think only of drawing near to God, arising to serve His good-pleasure, and becoming the cause of comfort, ease, joy and gladness to the world of humanity. Today the world of humanity is in need of the improvement of character, education through the divine breaths, and the establishment of the foundation of love, truthfulness, peace, reconciliation, reality, uprightness and fellowship among all members of humankind. We must serve this vital cause.

Subject: serving humanity; working for progress, betterment of the world
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/serving humanity; working for progress; betterment of the world.txt
Quotation: "They must concentrate their thoughts day and night on helping the fallen, making fresh and verdant the withered one, bringing the dead to life, healing the sick, nursing the ill, becoming a refuge and shelter for the homeless, placing a salve on wounds, becoming a remedy for the afflicted, becoming a kind father to an orphan, becoming a helper and assistant to a captive, becoming a helper and responder to a poor one, bestowing melody on the melody-less, clothing the naked, giving drink to the thirsty."

Subject: serving humanity; working for progress, betterment of the world
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/serving humanity; working for progress; betterment of the world.txt
Quotation: The light of truth is shining everywhere; endeavour that the eyes may be opened to behold its signs and splendour. O how pitiful were the children of men to deprive themselves of God's boundless grace in this most holy age, this illumined century! Wherefore, offer up thy life as a sacrifice unto the Cause of humanity, that, through thee, the poor may obtain their share of heavenly Treasure, the sick may find their way to the divine Physician, the helpless may be strengthened with the power of the Kingdom, the orphan may find his heavenly Father, the faint may be cheered, the disconsolate may be comforted through the bounty of the All-merciful, the sore-athirst may attain unto the fountain of Life and they that are in fear obtain the shelter of peace and calm

Subject: serving humanity; working for progress, betterment of the world
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/serving humanity; working for progress; betterment of the world.txt
Quotation: The purpose is that you should seek with heart and soul the comfort and ease of all people, and the joy and delight of humanity.

Subject: serving humanity; working for progress, betterment of the world
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/serving humanity; working for progress; betterment of the world.txt
Quotation: Be a well-wisher of humanity and a servant of mankind. Thus will the power of the Kingdom sustain thee and the paths of revelation be opened unto thee.

Subject: serving humanity; working for progress, betterment of the world
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/serving humanity; working for progress; betterment of the world.txt
Quotation: God willing, may he be adorned with the ornament of wisdom and utterance and be occupied with the reformation of the world and the refinement of the nations

Subject: serving humanity; working for progress, betterment of the world
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/serving humanity; working for progress; betterment of the world.txt
Quotation: the people of Baha had not and have not any aim save the prosperity and reformation of the world and the purifying of the nations.

Subject: serving humanity; working for progress, betterment of the world
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/serving humanity; working for progress; betterment of the world.txt
Quotation: The wise ones of other lands acknowledge that today the cause of the success and prosperity of the human world are the teachings of the Blessed Beauty, and except through this supreme remedy, there can be no health and well-being from this deadly poison that has affected the life of the world.

Subject: serving humanity; working for progress, betterment of the world
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/serving humanity; working for progress; betterment of the world.txt
Quotation: Reflect ye upon this wondrous and beauteous utterance which hath flowed from the Supreme Pen in divers places: "Glory is not for him who loveth his country, but for him who loveth the world." Man hath not been created for sedition and corruption, for contention and strife. Nay, verily, he hath been created for a mighty purpose! Were these stations to be expounded in detail, tablets would not suffice for their elucidation. Know ye your stations, your conditions, and your ranks before God, your Creator and Fashioner, your Sustainer and Beloved, Who answereth your call.

Subject: servitude; submission to God; repentance
Quotation: Seeking forgiveness and turning to God in repentance

Subject: servitude; submission to God; repentance
Quotation: we share together in servitude at the Threshold of Baha

Subject: servitude; submission to God; repentance
Quotation: become more successful in servitude to the Holy Threshold

Subject: servitude; submission to God; repentance
Quotation: You are known and recognized for your servitude at the Court of Divine Unity

Subject: servitude; submission to God; repentance
Quotation: O Lord! Thy leaf was stirred by Thy Will and has resigned its affair unto Thee.

Subject: servitude; submission to God; repentance
Quotation: "We had no other aim save God and entertained no longing except his servitude."

Subject: servitude; submission to God; repentance
Quotation: a man leans trustingly on the Lord and bows in lowliness at the Threshold of Grandeur

Subject: servitude; submission to God; repentance
Quotation: We are bound for Thy mansion. We circumambulate Thy city. We are servants of Thy Cause.

Subject: servitude; submission to God; repentance
Quotation: Unto God boweth down in adoration whatsoever is in the heavens and whatsoever is on earth

Subject: servitude; submission to God; repentance
Quotation: I am a servant who has believed in God and His verses, and I am not among the polytheists.

Subject: servitude; submission to God; repentance
Quotation: Under all conditions, continue to be engaged in remembrance, praise and service to the Cause.

Subject: servitude; submission to God; repentance
Quotation: They are indeed honored servants who speak not until He hath spoken, and who act by His command.

Subject: servitude; submission to God; repentance
Quotation: describes the importance of humility, submissiveness, and self-effacement before God's chosen ones

Subject: servitude; submission to God; repentance
Quotation: O Lord! Grant that this dearly-loved maidservant of Thine may proclaim the servitude of Abdu'l-Baha.

Subject: servitude; submission to God; repentance
Quotation: I am Thy servant and the son of Thy servant... and submissive before the manifestations of Thy sovereignty

Subject: servitude; submission to God; repentance
Quotation: thy servitude to the One God...thou servest the friends of God and thou waitest at the Threshold of the Merciful

Subject: servitude; submission to God; repentance
Quotation: Take up the way of servitude and pursue the path of humble service...Servitude and childlike humility is freedom

Subject: servitude; submission to God; repentance
Quotation: "If one submits himself to God he is happy." "When man surrenders himself everything will move according to his wish."

Subject: servitude; submission to God; repentance
Quotation: Unto God boweth down in worship whatsoever is in the heavens and whatsoever is in the earth; we are all His worshippers.

Subject: servitude; submission to God; repentance
Quotation: Praise be to God, you have drunk from the wine of love and are adorned with the ornament of servitude unto God, the Truth.

Subject: servitude; submission to God; repentance
Quotation: I believe in what God hath revealed unto me and I am of those who repent... Repent unto God, O ye people, all of you.

Subject: servitude; submission to God; repentance
Quotation: O my God and Master of my destiny... Thou art the Giver and I am the suppliant. Do with me as befitteth Thy generosity and bounty

Subject: servitude; submission to God; repentance
Quotation: Today I seek God my Lord's forgiveness for all that I manifested...I seek God my Lord's forgiveness and turn to Him in repentance.

Subject: servitude; submission to God; repentance
Quotation: You should therefore follow the way of that honored one and, like her, spend your days and nights in servitude at the Sacred Threshold

Subject: servitude; submission to God; repentance
Quotation: Most assuredly make amends for this corruption, for today the Truth will not be pleased with you except through recompense for the past.

Subject: servitude; submission to God; repentance
Quotation: Assist me in worshipping Thee, strengthen my back in serving Thee, aid me in my servitude to Thee, make me constant in obedience to Thee

Subject: servitude; submission to God; repentance
Quotation: In gratitude for God's heavenly bestowals, arise to serve at the threshold of His oneness, that thou mayest become a cherished handmaiden

Subject: servitude; submission to God; repentance
Quotation: Verily we are all His servants and slaves, and we supplicate upon the dust of lowliness and implore in the court of poverty and evanescence

Subject: servitude; submission to God; repentance
Quotation: All are submissive unto Him. Say: All bow down before Him. Say: All remember Him. Say: All render thanks unto Him. Say: All praise Him.

Subject: servitude; submission to God; repentance
Quotation: The prayer asks to "make me a servant of Thy Cause" and acknowledges God's absolute power: "Verily, Thou art powerful to do what Thou willest"

Subject: servitude; submission to God; repentance
Quotation: Unto God boweth down in worship whatsoever is in the heavens and whatsoever is in the earth, and unto God do all return. Say: All are humble before Him.

Subject: servitude; submission to God; repentance
Quotation: I beseech Thee to make me detached from my own will and desire, abiding in Thy will, acting according to Thy desire, and hoping for that which Thou lovest.

Subject: servitude; submission to God; repentance
Quotation: "I am a servant of the friends of God" ... "The Blessed Beauty has trained me to serve-----You must follow my example. I cannot be the Master if I don't serve."

Subject: servitude; submission to God; repentance
Quotation: we are all prostrate before Him. Verily, I have been of those who prostrate themselves, and verily praise belongeth unto Thee, Thou alone, the Lord of the worlds.

Subject: servitude; submission to God; repentance
Quotation: My glorious crown is my servitude toward God! My dominion is my humility, my submissiveness, my lowliness, my abasement, my supplication and my beseeching unto God

Subject: servitude; submission to God; repentance
Quotation: God is My witness that I have never seen the book you refer to. I regard, however, through the power of God, ... whatever you wish me to do as easy of accomplishment.

Subject: servitude; submission to God; repentance
Quotation: "This is a servant who has presented himself before Thy servants...the stars in the heaven of servitude to Thee, and the planets in the horizon of bondage unto Thee"

Subject: servitude; submission to God; repentance
Quotation: The bearing of tribulations and trials is the very essence of servitude, for in times of comfort anyone will offer praise, but in times of test, prayer is acceptable.

Subject: servitude; submission to God; repentance
Quotation: Turn thy face to the unseen Kingdom and, like 'Abdu'l-Baha, occupy thyself with servitude to the Ancient Beauty, that thou mayest place the crown of glory upon thy head.

Subject: servitude; submission to God; repentance
Quotation: I beg of God that thou mayest become an associate and partner of 'Abdu'l-Baha in servitude to the Holy Threshold of Baha, that thou mayest praise me in my pure servitude

Subject: servitude; submission to God; repentance
Quotation: Thou art accepted at the Divine Threshold - speak of servitude to this Servant. Having attained freedom in both worlds, make service to 'Abdu'l-Baha thy constant refrain.

Subject: servitude; submission to God; repentance
Quotation: All are worshippers of God. Say: All prostrate themselves before God. Say: All are submissive unto God. Say: All are humble before God. Say: All are lowly before God.

Subject: servitude; submission to God; repentance
Quotation: 'Abdu'l-Baha's desire is that praise should be directed solely to servitude unto the Most Glorious Beauty and nothing else. All else falls outside the subject and predicate.

Subject: servitude; submission to God; repentance
Quotation: have no thought or mention save service at the Sacred Threshold...in servitude to the Threshold of the Ancient Beauty and bondage at the Court of the Point of Sanctification

Subject: servitude; submission to God; repentance
Quotation: I am unable to remain silent or praise Thee after knowing the bounds of Thy justice. By the honor of Thy sufficiency, there is no power nor strength except through Thy Lord.

Subject: servitude; submission to God; repentance
Quotation: We are all devoted servants unto God. Say: We are all prostrate before God. Say: We are all workers for God. Say: We are all mindful of God. Say: We are thankful unto God.

Subject: servitude; submission to God; repentance
Quotation: Thou hast ordained for me nothing save servitude before Thy face, prostration before the manifestations of Thy sovereignty, and humble devotion at the gates of Thy bountiful mercy.

Subject: servitude; submission to God; repentance
Quotation: The mystery of servitude is revealed when the light of the divine Identity shines forth upon the world of the heart and the lamp of reality is kindled within the chamber of the soul.

Subject: servitude; submission to God; repentance
Quotation: We beseech God that each one of us may stand in servitude at His exalted Threshold, and that we may not transform this servitude into the lordship conceived by the people of the world.

Subject: servitude; submission to God; repentance
Quotation: Thou art indeed a servant ('Abd), but a servant of Husayn...that thou mayest arise to fulfill the duties of servitude, so that thou mayest be distinguished by the gifts of His Lordship

Subject: servitude; submission to God; repentance
Quotation: O renowned Amir! In the ethereal realm, true sovereignty lies in servitude to the Glorious and Great Threshold, and all else is but captivity and lowliness, even if it be world conquest.

Subject: servitude; submission to God; repentance
Quotation: Praise be to God that you have become so successful and confirmed in service and have arisen in servitude to the Sacred Threshold. This is eternal sovereignty and this is everlasting bounty.

Subject: servitude; submission to God; repentance
Quotation: O my God! I am Thy servant and the son of Thy servant. I have recognized Thee in Thy days and have turned to the shore of Thy oneness, acknowledging Thy singleness and submitting to Thy unity

Subject: servitude; submission to God; repentance
Quotation: However, to the taste of 'Abdu'l-Baha, the honey of servitude is most delectable. As much as thou art able, compose quintets of servitude, sextets of submissiveness, and octets of pure evanescence

Subject: servitude; submission to God; repentance
Quotation: From the beginning of life until this day, not a word indicating existence has issued from my tongue or pen, and with this servitude I have a radiant face and a heart like a rose garden and meadow.

Subject: servitude; submission to God; repentance
Quotation: O my Master! Thy servant maketh mention of Thee, and his eyes have ever been expectant of Thine infinite favors. Open, then, the door of Thy mercy and bestow Thy portion upon this dependent servant.

Subject: servitude; submission to God; repentance
Quotation: God always loves those who repent and are sorry for what they have done. Such people are ashamed before God and become very humble. But the only thing is this: One should remain firm in his repentance.

Subject: servitude; submission to God; repentance
Quotation: Though he possessed bracelets, diadems and the crown of empire, you should wear the emblem of servitude and freedom at God's threshold. Hearken to this: Such servitude is superior to a thousand kingdoms.

Subject: servitude; submission to God; repentance
Quotation: I beseech Thee, O Lord! by Thy Most Great Countenance and the mysteries of destiny to ordain for me and for Thy loved ones that which will adorn us with the ornament of patience, forbearance and resignation.

Subject: servitude; submission to God; repentance
Quotation: The call to servitude rings out like the trumpet blast, and the cry of bondage resounds throughout East and West...pursue servitude at the threshold of the Most Glorious Beauty...yearn for bondage at His Court

Subject: servitude; submission to God; repentance
Quotation: His Holiness Christ said, that the one who wishes to be greatest among you must be your servant. One must be either a serpent or a servant: he must choose. The people who are arrogant are serpents not servants.

Subject: servitude; submission to God; repentance
Quotation: Unto God prostrate themselves all who are in the heavens and all who are on earth. We are all prostrate before Him. We are all submissive unto Him. We are all submissive unto God. We are all prostrate before God.

Subject: servitude; submission to God; repentance
Quotation: Therefore it is beloved that they who drink from the Kawthar of inner meanings should entrust all matters to the Truth and fix their gaze upon the will of the Truth, exalted be His glory, not upon their own wills.

Subject: servitude; submission to God; repentance
Quotation: Know thou that it belongeth to the weak to make entreaty to the Source of strength, and that it becometh the petitioner of heavenly grace humbly to supplicate to Him Who is the All-Glorious, the Lord of grace abounding.

Subject: servitude; submission to God; repentance
Quotation: O thou who art enkindled with the fire of the love of God! The most resplendent and glorious jewel in the noble crown is none other than servitude at the Sacred Threshold and humility and lowliness at the gate of Oneness.

Subject: servitude; submission to God; repentance
Quotation: Servitude at the court of the Abha Beauty is sovereignty in the celestial realm and glory in the Concourse on High. Think not that there exists in the contingent world any station more exalted than this most great bounty.

Subject: servitude; submission to God; repentance
Quotation: Seek none other than His face, pursue no path but His path, and speak naught but His praise, that thou mayest become the tranquil soul, content and pleasing unto Him, and be accepted and beloved at the Threshold of His oneness.

Subject: servitude; submission to God; repentance
Quotation: Unto God do prostrate all who are in the heavens and who are on the earth - we are all prostrate before Him. Unto God belongeth the creation of the heavens and the earth and whatsoever is between them - we all beseech His grace.

Subject: servitude; submission to God; repentance
Quotation: We are all submissive unto God. We are all prostrate before God. We all beseech God's grace. We all act by God's command. Our Lord is the Lord of the heavens and the earth and whatsoever lieth between them, the Lord of all worlds.

Subject: servitude; submission to God; repentance
Quotation: "I hope that perhaps in the East I may be able to draw a breath in servitude at the Threshold" ... "The mention of servitude caused the utmost joy, for 'Abdu'l-Baha's hearing is stirred boundlessly by the melody of servitude to Baha"

Subject: servitude; submission to God; repentance
Quotation: Unto God belongeth the creation of the heavens and the earth and whatsoever lieth between them. Say: All are submissive unto Him. Unto God prostrateth whosoever is in the heavens and whosoever is on earth. We are all submissive unto Him.

Subject: servitude; submission to God; repentance
Quotation: God beareth witness that there is none other God but Him. We are His worshippers. God beareth witness that there is none other God but Him. We are His servants. God beareth witness that there is none other God but Him. We are devoted to Him.

Subject: servitude; submission to God; repentance
Quotation: Therefore, unto Thee do I flee, O Bestower, and in Thee do I seek refuge, O Oft-Returning! From Thee unto Thee do I flee, and from Thee unto Thy presence do I hasten. Thou art the King, the All-Powerful, and the Sovereign, the Administrator.

Subject: servitude; submission to God; repentance
Quotation: Return ye unto God and enter into the true religion, for there is no turning back for whomsoever God willeth, then Muhammad, then those who were witnesses after Him, then the Gates of Guidance - this is from God's command if ye would understand.

Subject: servitude; submission to God; repentance
Quotation: This servant was not successful in living up to the requirements of his own name, but God willing, thou shalt be successful and confirmed. And the Glory be upon thee and upon all who arise to fulfill what the meaning of their honored name requires.

Subject: servitude; submission to God; repentance
Quotation: All are His servants, standing before Him by His command. All are God's servants, working by His command. All are God's servants, worshipping Him night and day. All are God's servants, and at all times do they, by His command, bow down in adoration.

Subject: servitude; submission to God; repentance
Quotation: Before Him bow down in worship all who are in the heavens and all who are on earth, for God is the All-Hearing, the All-Seeing. All bow down before Him in worship. All are submissive unto Him. All are humbled before Him. All are reverent before Him.

Subject: servitude; submission to God; repentance
Quotation: O thou who standeth in the stations of servitude! The requirements of servitude are purity of intention and complete effacement and annihilation - that is to say, in all things absolute nothingness, utter poverty, and complete and perfect sacrifice.

Subject: servitude; submission to God; repentance
Quotation: O my God! Thou knowest my station and beholdest my inner being, and Thy knowledge encompasseth my disobedience... I seek Thy forgiveness and turn to Thee in repentance, and confess my sin and the evil my hands have wrought, hoping for Thy forgiveness

Subject: servitude; submission to God; repentance
Quotation: The author emphasizes his servitude repeatedly: "For I am but an owned and sustained servant who possesses no benefit or harm for myself. I know nothing in the heavens or earth except what God wills...I am a servant who has believed in God and His signs."

Subject: servitude; submission to God; repentance
Quotation: Abdul-Baha in the utmost humility, submissiveness, evanescence and self-effacement stands in servitude at the Sacred Threshold, causing East and West to quiver, heaven and earth to move in delight, and the Concourse on High to be attracted and enraptured.

Subject: servitude; submission to God; repentance
Quotation: Thou seest me turning toward the gate of the city of Thy grace, which Thou hast opened before the faces of such servants as have fulfilled Thy Covenant... O Lord! I am he who hath turned toward Thee, clung to the hem of Thy robe, and held fast to Thy cord.

Subject: servitude; submission to God; repentance
Quotation: O Jalal! Turn thy face toward the Kingdom of Beauty and seek the endless bounty and seek the greatest of hopes - and that is servitude at the Sacred Threshold of the Most Glorious One. And His servitude cannot be fully expressed in words nor easily realized

Subject: servitude; submission to God; repentance
Quotation: He hath no escape or refuge except to repent and return unto God with an illumined heart. Say: He desireth naught for Himself and is indeed independent of all created things. He desireth naught save what God desireth, and willeth naught save what He willeth.

Subject: servitude; submission to God; repentance
Quotation: the Messenger has conveyed what he was commanded and we have heard his command and we were among those who gazed upon his tablet... and we are, God willing, among those who obey His command and who submit to the command of His Supreme and Mighty Remembrance

Subject: servitude; submission to God; repentance
Quotation: Exalted is our Lord, the Most Merciful, Who has made us aware of our impotence, poverty, and lowliness. These are servants who move not except by His command, incline not save by His will, and choose naught but what God has chosen for them through His bounty.

Subject: servitude; submission to God; repentance
Quotation: O my God! I have drawn nigh unto Thee with pure devotion at all times, and verily this is not except through Thy might and Thy power. And I testify, and all things testify, that there is no might nor power except with God, the Sovereign, the Self-Subsisting.

Subject: servitude; submission to God; repentance
Quotation: Say: God is Lord and all else besides God is servant, and all bow down before Him. Say: God is the Creator of all things, and all stand firm by His command. Say: God is Truth and all else besides God hath been created by His command, and all are in His grasp.

Subject: servitude; submission to God; repentance
Quotation: Turn thou thy face to the Divine Kingdom, and, with the utmost humility, contrition, supplication and submission, ask forgiveness and pardon. Be thou penitent regarding what has happened... Make me mindful and awakened, and cause me to be penitent of my action.

Subject: servitude; submission to God; repentance
Quotation: O beloved of the heart and soul, ask God the Eternal that we may attain unto that which is worthy and befitting for this day, and that is that we utterly forget ourselves and all else and arise to serve, as with a hundred thousand bodies and a hundred thousand lives.

Subject: servitude; submission to God; repentance
Quotation: Thou knowest, O my God, that I have not followed my will, but rather Thy will, nor my desire, but rather Thy desire, and I love naught except what Thou lovest...Thine is the command and the bestowal in all conditions, and for Thy servant is submission and contentment.

Subject: servitude; submission to God; repentance
Quotation: Today the eternal glory of the human world lieth not in pride and grandeur. It is for this reason that I have addressed thee as the humble 'Ali, for the greatness of thee and me and the honor and station of all lies in servitude and lowliness at His blessed Threshold.

Subject: servitude; submission to God; repentance
Quotation: My God, my God, my Lord, my Lord, my Support, my Support! I love to make mention of Thee in such wise that all created things may speak thereof and all existing things be set ablaze thereby. O Lord! Make me a servant of Thy Cause, then accept me through Thy grace and bounty.

Subject: servitude; submission to God; repentance
Quotation: O servant, arise with all thy power to serve the Cause of God, and join me in servitude at the threshold of His Most Glorious Beauty...Today is the day of servitude at the Sacred Threshold. Come, let us all arise together in unity and agreement to serve at His Most Holy Court

Subject: servitude; submission to God; repentance
Quotation: Servitude is wonderful to behold, and bondage is before the eyes of the discerning... For this is the comfort of my spirit, the joy of my heart, the healing of my illness, the cooling of my burning, the quenching of my thirst, the light of my countenance, the solace of my eyes

Subject: servitude; submission to God; repentance
Quotation: O servant! This is not a day of trial and testing, nor the day which thou hast imagined. This is a day whereon it behooveth every soul, upon hearing the call from the Kingdom of his Lord, the Most Glorious, to detach himself wholly from all things created between earth and heaven.

Subject: servitude; submission to God; repentance
Quotation: And thou didst arrive with thy Lord in Zawra, the place which the All-Merciful made the seat of His throne for successive years... And thou wert with Him for numbered years, and present before the Wronged One morning and evening, until thou didst soar on the wings of longing unto God

Subject: servitude; submission to God; repentance
Quotation: How excellent are the words: I became the master of all creation when I became Thy servant. The lordship of both worlds lies in servitude at the threshold of the Kind Friend. Every penitent servant draws near to the Ever-Forgiving Lord, and every humble and reverent soul is a radiant light.

Subject: servitude; submission to God; repentance
Quotation: O thou that hast attained certain faith in the signs of God! Implore the one true God that thou mayest become a true servant at His threshold and be like a moth that encircles the flame of His shining Reality. One meaning of "parvaneh" is a true and constant servant at the court of the king.

Subject: servitude; submission to God; repentance
Quotation: Draw me unto Thee, even if by chains and fetters... cause me to dwell in the Garden of Eternity, the station of those among Thy servants who are at peace and those among Thy chosen ones who are steadfast, who have no will save what Thou hast willed and no purpose save what Thou hast decreed.

Subject: servitude; submission to God; repentance
Quotation: O servant of the Ancient Beauty! Though thou art His servant, yet art thou the master of the world, for thou art the devoted bondsman of the Abha Beauty, the King of Kings. Therefore, arise thou, even as this servant, to serve His Holy Threshold, for this is the greatest gift in all existence.

Subject: servitude; submission to God; repentance
Quotation: I am Your servant and I am in Your grasp, seeking refuge at Your threshold, taking sanctuary in Your presence, clinging to the sovereignty of Your mercy, and beseeching the King of Your grace... Glory be unto You! I have been foremost among sinners, and You are the Most Merciful of the merciful.

Subject: servitude; submission to God; repentance
Quotation: The essential freedom hath submitted to that servitude which hath appeared through the love of God and His Cause. It behooveth you to see yourselves above the world and all therein of creation, and what they possess of conjectures, idle fancies, and statements arising from darkened and heedless hearts.

Subject: servitude; submission to God; repentance
Quotation: Be thou steadfast in the love of God and His Cause in such wise that neither the doubts of them that have turned away nor the allusions of the heedless shall deter thee. Drink thou at all times from the Salsabil of divine knowledge on this Day whereon the All-Merciful hath come with manifest sovereignty

Subject: servitude; submission to God; repentance
Quotation: These two servants turned their faces to the Luminary of the horizons and the Light of the East, and were illumined by the resplendent Light shining forth from both horizons. They served at Thy exalted Threshold and called upon Thy Name in that distant region, and raised their voices in Thy remembrance.

Subject: servitude; submission to God; repentance
Quotation: Verily unto Him do all return. We belong to God, and we are His servants. We belong to God, and we are His worshippers. We belong to God, and we are prostrate before Him. We belong to God, and we are devoted to Him. We belong to God, and we are submissive to Him. We belong to God, and we are humble before Him.

Subject: servitude; submission to God; repentance
Quotation: These are they whose hearts are purified from aught else save the remembrance of their Lord, and they worship God alone and bow down before Him. Verily we were His worshippers, and we were those who bowed down before Him, and we were devoted to Him, and we were submissive unto Him, and we were humble before Him.

Subject: servitude; submission to God; repentance
Quotation: O my God! Glorified art Thou! This is Thy servant who hath been heedless of the wonders of Thy remembrance, and whom transgressions have veiled to such degree that he became occupied with what is other than Thee and turned away from Thy beauty...and returned unto Thee as he had fled from Thee in the midst of his affairs

Subject: servitude; submission to God; repentance
Quotation: O God, my God! I have turned in repentance unto Thee, and verily Thou art the Pardoner, the Compassionate. O God, my God! I have returned to Thee, and verily Thou art the Ever-Forgiving, the Gracious. O God, my God! I have clung to the cord of Thy bounty, and with Thee is the storehouse of all that is in heaven and earth.

Subject: servitude; submission to God; repentance
Quotation: As for the Blessed Beauty, He is established upon the throne of Lordship while we all are initiated in the path of servitude, and in servitude to the Sacred Threshold we are linked in one chain. No greater matter than this can be conceived for the friends - that they share with Abdul-Baha in servitude to the Sacred Threshold.

Subject: servitude; submission to God; repentance
Quotation: By self-surrender and perpetual union with God is meant that men should merge their will wholly in the Will of God, and regard their desires as utter nothingness beside His Purpose. Whatsoever the Creator commandeth His creatures to observe, the same must they diligently, and with the utmost joy and eagerness, arise and fulfil.

Subject: servitude; submission to God; repentance
Quotation: Verily, despite this Cause wherewith God hath honored me through His bounty - a Cause that hath rendered all the worlds impotent - by God, besides Whom there is no other God, I am naught but a servant of God and shall never be aught save a servant to the Manifestations of His Self, and in this do I glory amidst all created things.

Subject: servitude; submission to God; repentance
Quotation: Yet in all this was I heedless of Thy remembrance and far removed from the gardens of Thy nearness and forgetful of the wonders of Thy tenderness and the essences of Thy loving-kindness, until I did what I did and earned what I earned...Then, O my God, did I return from all this unto Thee, disappointed, in loss, remorseful and abased

Subject: servitude; submission to God; repentance
Quotation: The station of this servant is servitude, not authority; bondage, not vicegerency. Glory be to Him above what they ascribe to Him! And the servitude of this servant is literal servitude, not servitude that is interpretative, or explanatory, or allusive, or figurative, but like the servitude of Bilal the Ethiopian to the Master of Quraysh.

Subject: servitude; submission to God; repentance
Quotation: Upon thee be the duty to arise with me in servitude at His Most Exalted Sacred Threshold, and in lowliness, submissiveness, helplessness and supplication with me at the court of His Grandeur. By God the Truth, verily servitude at that Sacred Threshold is more glorious than crowns, and bondage in that Court is more exalted than the diadems of kings.

Subject: servitude; submission to God; repentance
Quotation: Abdu'l-Baha's utmost desire is servitude to these holy Divine Manifestations, and his highest aspiration is to lay down his life and attain supreme martyrdom in their path. This servitude is the radiant light upon my brow, the gleaming pearl in the shell of my grieving heart, and the lamp in the glass of my sorrowful soul. This is my eternal glory.

Subject: servitude; submission to God; repentance
Quotation: And harmonize with my self-effacement, annihilation and servitude at the threshold of His oneness... By the face and nature of the Beloved I swear that my soul yearns for servitude and my heart longs for freedom from every name, title and attribute. We have passed beyond all names and have placed the ring of servitude in our ear at His holy threshold.

Subject: servitude; submission to God; repentance
Quotation: God willing, thou shouldst speak with utmost joy and fragrance in remembrance of the Best Beloved of all possibility, with perfect wisdom, and in all matters keep thy gaze fixed upon the horizon of His good-pleasure. The essence of unity is that assured souls should, in all conditions, turn to the One True God alone and act according to His good-pleasure.

Subject: servitude; submission to God; repentance
Quotation: \"O my Lord! I testify that I was heedless of the ocean of Thy knowledge and the heaven of Thy wisdom, and turned away from the Dayspring of Thy Revelation and the Dawning-Place of Thy signs. I beseech Thee by Thy mercy that hath preceded all created things, and by Thy grace that hath encompassed all contingent beings, to forgive me and to remit my sins.\"

Subject: servitude; submission to God; repentance
Quotation: Therefore fear God, O all ye who are on earth together! He is the One before Whom prostrate themselves all who are in the heavens and on earth, and verily He is in the most exalted horizon, the Transcendent, the Supreme. All prostrate themselves before God. Before Him prostrate themselves all who are in the heavens and on earth, and unto Him are all turned.

Subject: servitude; submission to God; repentance
Quotation: Then prostrate yourselves before God and utter not a word. God hath not ordained for you words more fitting than these. Recite ye these verses on the Day when God shall manifest Me, and be not veiled. Ye were created only to worship Him on that Day. Ye were created only to prostrate before Him on that Day. Ye were created only to be devoted unto Him on that Day.

Subject: servitude; submission to God; repentance
Quotation: Know that what We desire to set forth with the pen of ink upon this Tablet of righteousness is the station of submission to the Lord of all beings... The limit of contentment is that thou shouldst be as content with abasement as with glory, with poverty as with wealth, with hardship as with ease, and with sorrow as with joy in the conditions decreed for thee by God.

Subject: servitude; submission to God; repentance
Quotation: For servitude is a trust mentioned in the blessed verse, and the heavens and earth are incapable of bearing it - consider the verse "We offered the trust unto the heavens and the earth and the mountains, but they refused to bear it and shrank from it. Yet man took it up - lo! he is unjust, ignorant." Observe how difficult and arduous is servitude to the Divine Court.

Subject: servitude; submission to God; repentance
Quotation: We are all servants of God and unto Him do we prostrate ourselves. We are all servants of God and unto Him are we all submissive. We are all servants of God and unto Him are we all humble. We are all servants of God and unto Him are we all devoted. We are all servants of God and by His command do we all act. We are all servants of God and unto Him shall we all return.

Subject: servitude; submission to God; repentance
Quotation: I bear witness unto Thee, O God, my Lord, that I claim naught for them save servitude unto Thee, and none knoweth them as they are in their servitude save Thee alone, Who hast no partner. They can neither benefit nor harm themselves, and they act only according to Thy will, and desire naught except what Thou hast desired, and judge not in any matter save by Thy sovereignty

Subject: servitude; submission to God; repentance
Quotation: Indeed, the verses were the epitome of eloquence and rhetoric, and were the distillation of clear divine inspiration. However, to Abdul-Baha, eloquence and rhetoric consist in expressing pure servitude at the threshold of the Most Glorious Beauty. I am the guardian of that threshold and the keeper of that court. I am secluded at that doorstep and seek refuge in that sanctuary.

Subject: servitude; submission to God; repentance
Quotation: Through Thee shall I speak, through Thee shall I be still, through Thee shall I move, through Thee shall I contend, through Thee shall I prevail, through Thee shall I triumph, through Thee shall I judge, through Thee shall I stand firm, through Thee shall I expound, through Thee shall I guard, through Thee shall I possess, and through Thee shall I inherit the lofty chambers of Thy paradise

Subject: servitude; submission to God; repentance
Quotation: The Arab poet saith: Deaf am I when called in the tribe by my name, Yet when addressed as His servant, how keen is my ear! The meaning of this verse is that should they call me by any name and raise their voice, that call would not harmonize with my ear nor would it would not be heard, save when someone addresses me as His servant - then instantly the ear becomes attentive and the mind alert.

Subject: servitude; submission to God; repentance
Quotation: Make me ready, in all circumstances, O my Lord, to serve Thee and to set myself towards the adored sanctuary of Thy Revelation and of Thy Beauty. If it be Thy pleasure, make me to grow as a tender herb in the meadows of Thy grace, that the gentle winds of Thy will may stir me up and bend me into conformity with Thy pleasure, in such wise that my movement and my stillness may be wholly directed by Thee.

Subject: servitude; submission to God; repentance
Quotation: Say: All besides God is His creation, and all are subservient unto Him. Say: God is truth and all besides God is His creation, and all prostrate themselves before Him. Say: God is truth and all besides God is His creation, and all are subservient unto Him. Say: God is truth and all besides God is His creation, and all are humble before Him. Say: God is truth and all besides God is His creation, and all submit unto Him.

Subject: servitude; submission to God; repentance
Quotation: O my God, my God! Quotation: Therefore, when the Command descended, it became seven, and thus did the Imam say: "Nothing exists, neither in earth nor in heaven, save through these seven: Will, Purpose, Destiny, Decree, Eternity, Duration, and the Book. Whoso asserteth the absence of any one of these hath verily disbelieved."

Subject: seven stages of creation
Quotation: Praise, sanctified above the mention of all the worlds, befitteth the Most Holy and Most Exalted Court of the Desired One, Who hath ordained for every being seven stages: Will, Purpose, Destiny, Decree, Permission, Term, and Book. Each of these stages is a fathomless ocean, sanctified beyond all limits. The pearls thereof lie preserved and concealed within the shells of God's protection, exalted be His glory. In truth, were one to attempt to describe these stages and stations, each of which is a dawning-place of divine knowledge and a dayspring of heavenly wisdom, this pen and paper would not suffice, nor would all the pens and pages in the realm of knowledge, which is the station of them that are nigh unto God....  Concerning what you wrote about felicity, acceptance, destiny and fate - that which is outwardly established and witnessed accords with what has been stated: "Nothing exists in heaven or earth except through Will, Purpose, Destiny, Fate, Permission, Term and Book." Every soul that comes into the world brings with it countless means, though these may not be visible to the outward eye. This station is in truth established. That which is counted among the irrevocable things cannot be changed, while other than this changes through means and deeds. The first inclination that arises in man before the appearance of means is the station of Will; the first conception of means is the station of Purpose; Destiny is the station of measure and proportion, meaning the appearance of means in measure; and Fate is the composition of what was destined. They have described the station of Destiny as most great, as it is said: "Destiny is a secret among God's secrets, a command among His commands, and a protection among His protections, sealed with God's seal..." until He says "it is a surging ocean which you cannot enter, and a dark night which you cannot traverse, abundant with fish in its depths which extend between heaven and earth, and its width extends between east and west, and in its depths is a sun that gives light." Man observes these stations in his own stations, meaning the seven degrees that were mentioned. After the appearance of Fate, the execution is witnessed, which is the same as Permission. For everything there is and has been a Term, meaning the duration of its existence. Then appears the Book, which is the station of the completeness of the thing. Praise be to God that today the Mother of Stations is manifest, and that is severance from all things and committing all affairs to Him. In this case, these stations themselves are unveiled.

Subject: seven stages of creation
Quotation: Glory be to God, the All-Knowing, Who created things through the crafting of choice according to what befits Him from the wonders of lights - through the Will, the mystery of contingent beings; through the Purpose, the secret repository of existing things; and through Destiny, the ruling of trinity for the sake of limitation's consciousness. From this the Christians took the form of the cross and the descent of the divine into the human realm. The Beloved has informed of their corrupt inner thoughts: "The Christians say: 'He is the third of three,' while He is but one God. Glory be to God above what they associate with Him." The All-Merciful decreed, after creating Destiny, through the fixed Decree for the people of effacement and confirmation, that "I would not have enacted upon you the decree of alteration were it not for what God knew in your souls of requirement." God carries out what He decrees, and there is no suspension of God's command. The All-Merciful warned His servants after the decree of effacement and confirmation, lest people say about God anything but the truth. The Imam, peace be upon him, said: "The spirits of those who deny divine determination are displayed to the Fire morning and evening until the Hour arrives. When the Hour arrives, they will be punished with the people of the Fire with various punishments. They will say: 'O our Lord, You have punished us specially and generally.' The guardians of Hell will reply to them: 'Indeed, We created everything according to a measure.'" The All-Merciful established, after the decree through implementation, that nothing is seized or extended, nor is anything in contingent existence, except by permission of the All-Merciful. God decreed that implementation due to what God placed in the decree through the mystery of requirement. You will never find any change in God's practice. The Wise One informed, after the five rulings, of the ruling of term and book, so that nothing would be missed regarding the rulings of the Gate. God established the term for the sake of causes, and God raised the book through the rulings of effects, so that nothing of existence would be missed from the Book except that they would find it explained as to causes in this Book and clarified as to reasons in the mystery of this Gate. God made that Book the Greatest Tablet and decreed in it what He originated in the beginning and the end. God ordained for that Book two gates: the mystery of the two seas in the two gulfs - one being the sweet water, the realities of the exalted ones from among the people of the two Easts from those near, and the second being the bitter salt water from among the people of the two Wests from those remote. God formed upon each gate the forms of trinity, and in the form of trinity the temple of trinity for completing the gates of Hell in the twenty-nine arrows from the Ancient Judge. God placed within that Tablet mercy and rest, and in its exterior, from before God, punishment.

Subject: seven stages of creation
Quotation: Know thou that the Point of Existence, which is the station of the Absolute Effulgence and the rank of the radiant, unified Primal Will in the Muhammadan Presence, hath caused the sun of creation to dawn, O Identity, and the moon of origination through oneness. Then after the station of the Point is the station of the Hidden Alif, which is the station of the First Effulgence's manifestation, expressed as the rank of Will, and the investiture of light in the house of outward Guardianship appearing in the form of abstraction, whereof it was said: "Its outward aspect cannot be described and its inner reality is an impenetrable mystery that cannot be grasped." Then after the station of the Hidden Alif is the rank of the Soft Alif, which is the station of Destiny and contingent geometry, expressed as the station of Beauty. Then the station of the Unjoined Alif is the rank of Decree, Implementation and Origination. Then the station of the Joined Alif is the station of the Qa'im, which is the rank of Permission. Then the station of the Letters, which is the station of the Eight Imams and is the rank of Term. Then the station of the Word, which is the station of Fatima. These are the seven ranks through which nothing in contingent existence can come to be except through them, as is clearly stated in the tradition of the Truthful One, who said, exalted be His remembrance: "Nothing existeth in earth or heaven save through seven: through Will, Purpose, Decree, Destiny, Permission, Term and Book. Whoso claimeth one of these to be lacking hath indeed disbelieved."

Quotation: Thou hast written that some of the friends have informed thee that if man does not progress, he will perish and become nonexistent. What is intended is not absolute nonexistence. The meaning is that the existence of a heedless person in comparison to the existence of a perfect individual is like being nonexistent. For instance, a stone is nonexistent in comparison to man, even though it existeth in the mineral condition. In brief, all souls exist, but the existence of the heedless and the ignorant in comparison to the existence of the perfect and the wise is like nonexistence. The intention of this discourse is that both the ignorant and the wise possess existence, but the existence of the ignorant is like that of a stone, while the existence of the perfect individual resembleth the existence of man. The stone in comparison to man is nonexistent.

Quotation: Answer to the first question: The spirits of the children of the Kingdom, after separation from this body, ascend to the eternal world of existence. But if the question is about location, know that the world of existence is one world, but with different ranks. For example, the mineral existence has its rank, but the mineral being has no knowledge of the plant world - it is completely unaware, rather according to its condition denies it. Similarly, the plant being has no knowledge of the animal world - it is completely heedless and unaware, for the animal rank is above the plant rank, and the plant according to its condition is veiled from and denies the animal world, even though animal, plant and mineral all exist in the world of existence. Likewise the animal is completely unaware of the human rational faculty which comprehends universals and discovers the mysteries of creation - how one can sit in the East and organize and arrange affairs in the West, discover mysteries, while in Europe discover America, while on Earth discover the realities of the stars. The animal is completely unaware of this discovering rational faculty which comprehends universals - rather it denies it. Similarly the people of the material world are completely unaware of and deny the Kingdom, saying "Where is the Kingdom and where is the Lord of the Kingdom?" These souls are like minerals and plants that are completely unaware of the animal and human worlds - they neither see nor find it. Yet mineral, plant, animal and human all exist in the world of existence.
