Quotation: That life and death were the same, there was little change; and as human beings helped each other on the earthly plane, they could still continue to show affection and give support to each other after the apparent separation. That in heaven there was no descent possible, only unbroken progress.

Subject: soul; spirit after death
Quotation: These pure souls have been released from this prison of dust and have winged their flight to Thy world. Now they have flown to the world of mystery in order to build a nest and haven in the precincts of Thy mercy upon the Blessed Tree, where they are singing and chanting with wondrous melodies.

Subject: soul; spirit after death
Quotation: This news greatly saddened me, yet I was consoled that that honored lady was freed from the prison of this dusty world and hastened to the divine realm. She was a drop that reached the ocean, a ray that returned to the sun, a bird that took flight to the divine rose garden, a star that entered the solar sphere.

Subject: soul; spirit after death
Quotation: Those who have passed on through death, have a sphere of their own. It is not removed from ours; their work--the work of the Kingdom--is ours; but it is sanctified from what we call 'time and place.' Those who have ascended have different attributes from those who are still on earth, yet there is no real separation.

Subject: soul; spirit after death
Quotation: Thy handmaiden ?iya' [...] hath ascended unto Thee. O Lord! Her tranquil soul was a luminous flame, from whose heart radiated the lights of faith, who was intoxicated with the wine of certitude, whose eyes were solaced by witnessing the proof and evidence, whose consciousness was attracted by the spirit and sweet fragrance.

Subject: soul; spirit after death
Quotation: Although your precious child has passed from this mortal world, yet praise be to God, he lives in the eternal realm. You will find him in the Kingdom of God. This is not death but life, this is not destruction but salvation, for that precious child has hastened to the Kingdom [of Paradise] in the utmost spirituality and radiance.

Subject: soul; spirit after death
Quotation: The angels drawn nigh welcomed thee from the highest paradise until they reached thee between earth and heaven... We took thee with the hand of mercy and caused thee to ascend to a station which We had ordained for thee... Therefore, walk thou through the levels of paradise and partake of the fruits of the holy Lote-Trees as thou pleasest

Subject: soul; spirit after death
Quotation: At last, while supplicating and with the utmost humility, he ascended unto the Supreme Horizon. What blessing is greater than this? If a person departeth from this world in such a state, it is life, not death; it is discovering existence, not giving it up; it is becoming illumined, not being extinguished; it is remaining in thoughts, not being forgotten.

Subject: soul; spirit after death
Quotation: That radiant star has set from this world below that it may rise effulgently from the Supreme Horizon. He has arisen from a horizon that knows no setting and has hastened unto a realm that is infinite. He has been detached from this world below and has attained into Everlasting Life. He has ascended from this gloomy world and hastened to the Center of Light.

Subject: soul; spirit after death
Quotation: Thou hast asked about the passing of the soul of a believer. Know that each thing eventually returneth to its origin, for that whereby each thing existeth is with God in His paradise, and delightful is His grace. He returneth its body to clay, its essential body to the gates, and its essential self to the Manifestation of praise, which is the Daystar of Truth.

Subject: soul; spirit after death
Quotation: O thou tranquil soul! Repair unto thy Lord, pleased and pleasing unto Him departed this earthly home, and winged his flight unto the kingdom of eternity, the Divine home Honor his last resting-place, and grant him an exalted seat of truth, transported by the wine of reunion in the Most Sublime Paradise, immersed in the oceans of lights in the Kingdom of Mysteries

Subject: soul; spirit after death
Quotation: The believer attains to eternal life in this world, but the unbeliever is eternally veiled from the presence of God. Eternal life is knowledge of God and eternal punishment is deprivation of the Sight of God. According to the statements in the Gospel, those who do not believe are eternally condemned, while those who are believers will be in eternal joy and happiness.

Subject: soul; spirit after death
Quotation: The three spirits - the vegetable spirit, the animal spirit and the human spirit (that is, the rational soul) - do not return after death to this world of the first creation. However, the spirit of faith, which is the light of guidance, and the Holy Spirit, which is the reality of divine revelation, both return in every dispensation and cycle to this realm of the first creation.

Subject: soul; spirit after death
Quotation: but those souls who have discovered the mysteries of the kingdom, and who have obtained grace from the dawning place of light, even though in the beginning they were poor, eventually they will attain the treasures that will never end. If in this world they see suffering in their body and soul, in the worlds of the kingdom they will obtain the utmost bounty and treasures of the spirit.

Subject: soul; spirit after death
Quotation: Know thou, that thy beloved son hath soared, with the wing of soul, up to the loftiest height which is never-ending in the Kingdom of God. Truly, I say unto thee, wert thou informed of the position in which is thy son, thy face would be illuminated by the lights of happiness and thou wouldst thank thy forgiving Lord therefor and thou wouldst long for ascending to that praiseworthy position.

Subject: soul; spirit after death
Quotation: However, for them this departure and passing was a blessing and joy, for those two ailing ones drank of the honeyed Salsabil, and those two yearning souls hastened to the gathering place of the manifest Light of the horizons. Those two gazelles released their musk-fragrance and perfumed the nostrils of the invisible friends. They were freed from the cage and reached the eternal rose garden.

Subject: soul; spirit after death
Quotation: That world cannot be revealed and known through the conceptions and expressions of this world. That world in comparison to that world is like a womb. Just as in the uterine world it is impossible and inconceivable to describe the greatness of this external world, in like manner, it is impossible and inconceivable to describe that divine world by means of the words and expressions of this world.

Subject: soul; spirit after death
Quotation: For this mortal world is like the womb, wherein the physical perfections and deficiencies of man are not evident. When one emerges from the world of the womb into this world, physical perfections and deficiencies become manifest and clear, though in the womb one is unaware of both. When he hastens to the other world, he observes that he has been delivered from a narrow and dark world and has entered into the divine world.

Subject: soul; spirit after death
Quotation: For in that world the veil is torn asunder and one becometh immersed in an ocean of feeling and perception. Thy loving mother perceiveth the condition of her daughter and, rejoicing in her fortitude and patience, experienceth felicity in the eternal realm...Thy mother hath hastened to a world sanctified above the reach of human understanding, and hath been delivered from all sorrow, vexation, hardship, trouble, and misfortune.

Subject: soul; spirit after death
Quotation: And when it has reached this most mighty and perfect station, this most pleasant, most pure, most sweet destination, and has drunk from these clear spring waters of Saba, it will attain to the station of submission and contentment, it will leave behind its searching and neediness and will entrust its affairs to God, the Mighty and Eternal King. It will rely upon Him and recline against the cushion of His bounty and beneficence.

Subject: soul; spirit after death
Quotation: Though thou art hidden from sight, praise be to God, thou didst raise daughters who, like thee, have arisen to serve the Kingdom and guide souls. They are radiant lamps in the assembly of divine knowledge, sacrificing themselves in the path of God, tending thy rose garden and watering thy orchard. How blessed art thou to have eternal life in the Kingdom of Glory and to have left behind such respected and loving remembrances in this world!

Subject: soul; spirit after death
Quotation: When the hour of death comes, the angel takes what has fallen upon the mirror of his misdeeds and conditions. At that moment, the believing servant ascends to Him with joy and fragrance in such wise that were all the hosts of heaven and earth to try to hold him back they would be powerless to cause his return. And the polytheist servant flees in such terror that were all the hosts of heaven and earth to seize him, he would be unable to accept.

Subject: soul; spirit after death
Quotation: That lofty branch hath ascended to the highest heaven, that brilliant star hath risen in the celestial realm, that morning bird hath started to sing exhilarating melodies in the garden of God, and that noble river hath returned unto the Most Great Ocean... The pinnacle of the Kingdom is the place of gathering, and the shadow of the loving Lord is the place of meeting. That meeting is eternal, that gathering is everlasting, and that pleasure and delight is perpetual.

Subject: soul; spirit after death
Quotation: From it will appear the signs of God and His qualities, the providence of God and His bestowal. Blessed is the spirit which abandons the body, previously sanctified and freed from the doubts of the nations. Verily, it moves in the atmosphere of the will of its Lord, and enters into the Supreme Paradise. It associates with the prophets of God, and His chosen ones, and it converses with them, and relates to them those events which have happened to it in the path of God.

Subject: soul; spirit after death
Quotation: Do not feel grieved or disconsolate, therefore, at the ascension of that bird of faithfulness; nay, under all circumstances pray for that youth, supplicating for him forgiveness and the elevation of his station...My hope from the infinite bounties of God is that He may shelter this dove of the garden of faith, and cause him to abide on the branch of the Supreme Concourse, that he may sing in the best of melodies the praise and glorification of the Lord of Names and Attributes.

Subject: soul; spirit after death
Quotation: Thou hast quit this earthly world and risen upward to the Kingdom, thou hast reached unto the grace of the invisible realm, and offered thyself at the threshold of its Lord. Thou hast left the lamp that was thy body here, the glass that was thy human form, thy earthy elements, thy way of life below. Thou art now a bird of Heaven, thou hast quit thine earthly nest, and soared away to a garden of holiness in the kingdom of thy Lord. Thou hast risen to a station filled with light.

Subject: soul; spirit after death
Quotation: The breezes of divine grace have seized her and purified her from sin. Thus hath the grace of Thy Lord, the All-Merciful, surrounded her, and His grace, verily, encompasseth the worlds. Happy is she, for she hath quaffed from the chalice of sanctity and visited the beauty of God in the paradise of inviolable splendor. The moment she ascended to the tree of eternity, the maids of heaven came forth from their chambers of glory and welcomed her, and with them came a band of angels.

Subject: soul; spirit after death
Quotation: He was freed from the constraints of contingent existence and soared to the realm beyond space. He became detached from the body and rushed to the world of the spirit, attaining the presence of the Beloved. Though for that celestial bird it was liberation from the cage and deliverance from the prison of desire and passion - a drop that hastened to the ocean, a particle that sped to the heights of the sun, a yearning soul that found its way to the chamber of the Beloved of all horizons

Subject: soul; spirit after death
Quotation: And as to thy question regarding how rights can be restored in the world after death and how the rights of people can be fulfilled in the Greater Resurrection, which hath been interpreted as the Day of Recompense, and how this can be conceived and made possible, given that these ornaments, properties and rights which are sought after and visible in this vain life have no existence in the worlds beyond death, and even if they did exist would yield no benefit or fruit to the rightholders - how then can the restoration of rights be spoken of in those worlds

Subject: soul; spirit after death
Quotation: The desire of the spirit and its inclination are to return to the Supreme King, for it was sent forth from His Command. When the hour of death arrives, the Sovereign Lord observeth that which hath appeared upon the mirror, all its shortcomings and all its worthy conditions. When a faithful servant ascendeth to Him in spirit, should the hosts of heaven and earth attempt to prevent him, they shall not succeed, and he returneth unto God. And though the infidel fleeth before His awful Majesty, yet must he submit to the judgment of God, even should the hosts of heaven and earth combine to assist him.

Subject: soul; spirit after death
Quotation: As to what thou hast asked about the ascension of the soul, know thou that the soul of him who hath believed in his Lord, the Most Glorious - by God, it ascendeth unto heaven and soareth in the holy and luminous atmosphere, yearning for the station which We have ordained for it until it reacheth the Most Glorious Companion, the station wherein shineth forth one of the effulgences of this Most Great and Supreme Name. At the time of its ascension, the souls of the Prophets and Messengers receive it. By God, it soareth wheresoever it willeth, and all the doors of grace are opened before its face, if thou be of them that know. The denizens of the Supreme Paradise inhale from it the fragrance of the garment of this Revelation which hath dawned upon all things through His Most Glorious Name. Blessed is he who hath found its fragrance in these days wherein the Beauty of the Ancient of Days hath appeared with manifest sovereignty.

Subject: soul; spirit after death
Quotation: For just as the fruits and results of embryonic life are not found in that dark and constricted realm, and only upon transfer to this vast world do the benefits and advantages of growth and development in that previous world become evident - likewise the reward and punishment, heaven and hell, and the recompense for deeds and actions in this present life become manifest in the world beyond this world. And just as if embryonic life and existence were confined to the womb it would be purposeless and irrelevant, so too if the life of this world and its deeds and fruits did not emerge in another world, it would be entirely purposeless and irrational.

Subject: soul; spirit after death
Quotation: That bird hath flown unto the retreats of the Concourse on high, and that thirsty fish hath hastened unto the ocean of the Kingdom of Abha. If that bird hath flown to the nest of the birds of heaven, become a graceful cypress in the garden of mercy, ascended as a star above the horizon of the Lord, and become a shining candle in the assembly of God, thou must not be grieved or saddened thereby, for, in truth, this is loving-kindness unalloyed, a pure gift and absolute bounty. Happy is he and blessed be his return. That graceful bud has veiled its countenance from the furnace of this world, but has blossomed in the rose garden of the Abha Kingdom and revealed its face and become gladdened. If you were to know in what station she is established, you would find perfect solace and complete tranquility.

Subject: soul; spirit after death
Quotation: Thou hast asked concerning the spirits of men. They are not at all annihilated. They are immortal. But the spirits of heavenly souls will find eternal life, that is, they will attain to the highest and most great stations of perfection. But the spirits of the heedless souls although they are immortal yet they are in a world of imperfection, concealment and ignorance. This is a concise answer. Contemplate, and meditate upon it in order that thou mayest comprehend the reality of the mysteries in detail. For instance, no matter how much the mineral has existence and life yet, in comparison with man, it is entirely non-existent and deprived of life. When man is transformed, translated, from life to death, his comparative station will be that of the mineral existence. In such wise, the mineral life typifies the death of man. This is a brief answer.

Subject: soul; spirit after death
Quotation: When the souls of the sincere depart (from this body), then their unreal vision (i. e., seeing) is changed into a vision of reality....  As to the question whether the souls will recognize each other in the spiritual world: This (fact) is certain; for the Kingdom is the world of vision (i. e., things are visible in it), where all concealed realities will become disclosed. How much more the well-known souls will become manifest. The mysteries of which man is heedless in this earthly world, those will he discover in the heavenly world, and there will he be informed of the secret of truth; how much more will he recognize or discover persons with whom he hath been associated. Undoubtedly, the holy souls who find a pure eye and are favored with insight will, in the kingdom of lights, be acquainted with all mysteries, and will seek the bounty of witnessing the reality of every great soul. Even they will manifestly behold the Beauty of God in that world. Likewise will they find all the friends of God, both those of the former and recent times, present in the heavenly assemblage.... The difference and distinction will naturally become realized between all men after their departure from this mortal world. But this (distinction) is not in respect to place, but it is in respect to the soul and conscience. For the Kingdom of God is sanctified (or free) from time and place; it is another world and another universe. But the holy souls are promised the gift of intercession. And know thou for a certainty, that in the divine worlds, the spiritual beloved ones (believers) will recognize each other, and will seek union (with each other), but a spiritual union. Likewise, a love that one may have entertained for any one will not be forgotten in the world of the Kingdom. Likewise, thou wilt not forget (there) the life that thou hast had in the material world.

Subject: soul; spirit after death
Quotation: Observe the Paradise which is the station of the perfection of creation, for therein every bird warbles all melodies, every tree bears fruits of diverse hues, every food contains the taste of all foods, and all that exists therein of fruits and trees and rivers possesses feeling and life and perception and consciousness even as man. To this did the Shaykh (may God's peace be upon him) refer in his commentary on the principles, where he said: "As for what is general, verily all that is in Paradise of animals, plants and minerals is alive with animal life conjoined with consciousness and feeling, which are linked to discernment and reason. Nothing exists therein to which existence can be attributed save as we have described." God, the Exalted, hath said: 'Verily the abode of the Hereafter - that is indeed Life!' And verily I saw in a dream as though I had come to one of the gardens of Paradise wherein were trees and plants, and I saw all the leaves of those trees and plants looking at me, each with two eyes - the gaze of reason - being both leaf and animal. This is but a brief allusion to the life of the Hereafter, and the matter is greater, far greater." Thus ended his words - may God exalt his station.

Quotation: He must answer the questions of all the sages, solve all the difficult problems of humanity... His Knowledge must be infinite and his wisdom all-comprehensive.

Subject: special knowledge of the Manifestation of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/special knowledge of the Manifestation of God.txt
Quotation: The Holy, Divine Manifestations are even superior and distinguished in their physical powers from the rest of mankind. For example, even when the Blessed Perfection was not feeling well his pulse did beat regularly like the pulse of a young man of 20 yrs old... His sense of smell was very keen indeed and up to the end of his life he read the finest types without the aid of glasses.

Subject: special knowledge of the Manifestation of God

Quotation: J. E.: would Abdul Baha tell us about the knowledge of Baha'o'llah.  Abdul Baha: It was infinite, unlimited. This is clear. Can a limited lpower raise such a cause? This is apparent. Even the enemies of Baha'o'llah admit this. They say there is extreme power in this personage.  J. E.: I have been told of a tablet in which he said that whenever he wanted to know anything, there it was before him in a clear and manifest tablet.  Abdul Baha: When he wished anything it would be accomplished. (Leaving prison).

Subject: special knowledge of the Manifestation of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/special knowledge of the Manifestation of God.txt
Quotation: As to the pronouncements which, through divine revelation, have issued from the Prophets regarding the advent of the Promised One of the Torah, these likewise were not the cause of Christ's appearance. But the hidden mysteries of the days to come were revealed to the Prophets, who thus became acquainted with future events and who proclaimed them in turn. This knowledge and proclamation were not the cause of these events.

Subject: spirit of faith [ruh-i-'iman]
Quotation: "And it is the spirit of faith that illumines the soul and give light to the human conscience."

Subject: spirit of faith [ruh-i-'iman]
Quotation: The human spirit, which distinguishes man from animal, is the rational soul, and these two terms - the human spirit and the rational soul - refer to one and the same thing. This spirit, which philosophers call the rational soul, encompasses all other created things and, to the extent of human capacity, discovers the realities of things and gains knowledge of the properties and effects of contingent beings and the characteristics and particulars of physical existence. However, unless it is assisted by the spirit of faith, it will not become aware of divine mysteries and heavenly realities. It is like a mirror - though it be clear, delicate and bright, until the rays of the sun shine upon it, it cannot discover divine mysteries.

Subject: spirit of faith [ruh-i-'iman]
Quotation: The three spirits - the vegetable spirit, the animal spirit and the human spirit (that is, the rational soul) - do not return after death to this world of the first creation. However, the spirit of faith, which is the light of guidance, and the Holy Spirit, which is the reality of divine revelation, both return in every dispensation and cycle to this realm of the first creation.

Subject: spirit of faith [ruh-i-'iman]
Quotation: That which is born of the flesh is flesh; and that which is born of the Spirit is spirit. Similarly, He said: Let the dead bury their dead, because those souls did not believe in God. Although they possessed the human spirit, they were deprived of the spirit of faith.

Subject: spirit of faith [ruh-i-'iman]
Quotation: The spirit of faith endows man with the capacity to love God and to know God. If the spirit of man, his perceiving soul, be confirmed by the spirit of faith so that it loves and knows God, and if it be guided by the guidance of God, and if the divine attributes be manifested in it, then there is a living soul which attains to eternal life. The spirit of faith is as the radiance of the lamp: and therefore those whose souls have not been led to the shadow of the wings of God are as though dead. The spirit of faith is like the ether regarded as the vehicle of light.

Subject: spirit of faith [ruh-i-'iman]
Quotation: Man is not human by virtue of his body; man is human by virtue of his spirit. For in physical matters, man shares attributes with animals, but through the spirit he is distinguished from them. Consider how the rays of the sun illuminate the earth; likewise does the spirit illuminate bodies. It is the spirit that makes man heavenly; it is the spirit that makes man recipient of the Holy Spirit's breaths; it is the spirit that discovers the realities of things; it is the spirit that has produced all these effects; it is the spirit that has established all sciences; it is the spirit that bestows eternal life; it is the spirit that unites different nations; it is the spirit that brings together East and West; it is the spirit that makes the human world divine.

Subject: spiritual assemblies; administrative matters
Quotation: It is incumbent upon all to submit to the Spiritual Assembly and show it the utmost respect.

Subject: spiritual assemblies; administrative matters
Quotation: The consultative spiritual assembly, as well as the Mashriqu'l-Adhkar, are of great import and have beneficial consequences.

Subject: spiritual assemblies; administrative matters
Quotation: However, seek permission from the Spiritual Assembly, for the Spiritual Assembly is the reference point for the friends, and in all matters one must turn to the Spiritual Assembly.

Subject: spiritual assemblies; administrative matters
Quotation: I asked 'Abdul Baha what are the qualifications necessary for the members of the Spiritual Meeting. He answered, The members of the spiritual assembly must be well known and firm Baha'is.

Subject: spiritual assemblies; administrative matters
Quotation: This Assembly was organized at the right time. It is my hope that it become a magnet of confirmation. If it remain firm and steadfast this Assembly will become so illumined that it will be a full, refulgent moon in the horizon of everlasting glory.

Subject: spiritual assemblies; administrative matters
Quotation: As it appears, the Spiritual Assembly has formed other assemblies, and since these assemblies are for service to the Cause of God, it is hoped that they will prove beneficial. Surely they must strive with heart and soul and render meritorious services at the threshold of the Forgiving Lord.

Subject: spiritual assemblies; administrative matters
Quotation: If the people of a locality themselves wish to establish a consultative assembly, meaning to organize a spiritual assembly according to electoral principles, very good. But we cannot now pursue this matter, as some would be pleased, some saddened, and some annoyed. This matter is up to the people of each locality.

Subject: spiritual assemblies; administrative matters
Quotation: As to thine own duty about which thou didst inquire - residence in that land and the unification of the hearts of the friends - whatsoever the members of the Spiritual Assembly have deemed advisable, that same is fitting. Thou must certainly accept it and utter not a word. And thou must attend the Spiritual Assembly meetings.

Subject: spiritual assemblies; administrative matters
Quotation: Therefore, the Spiritual Assembly should correspond with all assemblies, and this will cause the exaltation of the Word of God and the diffusion of the divine fragrances. I have the utmost joy in the members of the Spiritual Assembly of Mashhad, and I seek their appreciated efforts, and await the appearance of abundant services.

Subject: spiritual assemblies; administrative matters
Quotation: O my beloved friends and respected members of the Spiritual Assembly! Verily your Lord, the All-Merciful, shall shower that spiritual assembly with lights and shall manifest Himself unto them through His Name, the All-Merciful, the All-Compassionate, and shall assist them with hosts from His holy angels, and shall confirm them with spiritual victory and triumph.

Subject: spiritual assemblies; administrative matters
Quotation: The meaning of taking votes refers to the votes of the Spiritual Assembly, for the Spiritual Assembly is elected by general vote; their vote represents the general vote. Otherwise, every matter would require reference to general voting, for any decision would be subject to criticism by some. Then the Assembly would have no authority whatsoever, and order would cease to exist - chaos would ensue.

Subject: spiritual assemblies; administrative matters
Quotation: Concerning what you wrote about the consultative assembly, this is most befitting. You must strive with heart and soul to ensure that gathering becomes a center for divine inspirations and enters beneath the shadow of the protection and shelter of the Divine Unity. The more it gains in strength and influence, the greater will be the penetrating power of the Word of God, and the wider will the doors of divine confirmation be opened.

Subject: spiritual assemblies; administrative matters
Quotation: Thy services on the Spiritual Assembly are acceptable at the Divine Threshold and well-known among the friends.

Subject: spiritual assemblies; administrative matters
Quotation: As to the House of Spirituality the first question related to its election. The election should be carried out with sincerity and good will. People should be elected who when united together will give the most harmony. No one should be elected who would cause inharmony.

Subject: spiritual assemblies; administrative matters
Quotation: The Convention in New York was truly magnificent and shall become historic in the Divine Cause, yielding momentous results.

Subject: spiritual assemblies; administrative matters
Quotation: A Spiritual Assembly must have at least nine members; more are permissible, but not to such extent as would cause discord in opinions.

Subject: spiritual assemblies; administrative matters
Quotation: Regarding the establishment of a Spiritual Assembly that you wrote about, it is very appropriate. I hope they will be confirmed and successful.

Subject: spiritual assemblies; administrative matters
Quotation: To the Spiritual Assembly of Tehran, upon them be the Most Glorious Glory of God... The Spiritual Assembly must certainly exert its utmost effort in this matter.

Subject: spiritual assemblies; administrative matters
Quotation: Thou hast written that the assembly of Esslingen is progressing. This news was the cause of great joy...Thank God, that the assembly of Stuttgart is also progressing

Subject: spiritual assemblies; administrative matters
Quotation: Every Spiritual Assembly that is formed through divine favor, whose members are in the utmost sincerity and attraction to the Kingdom of God and are firm in the Covenant

Subject: spiritual assemblies; administrative matters
Quotation: Obey the Convention - travel and teach for a while, then devote yourself to perfecting your art, for both obedience to the Convention and perfecting one's craft are necessary

Subject: spiritual assemblies; administrative matters
Quotation: The assembly that has been elected with nine members is most blessed, and when they arise to serve, the light of the favors of the Lord of the Kingdom will illumine that gathering.

Subject: spiritual assemblies; administrative matters
Quotation: The letter discusses challenges with Spiritual Assemblies and elections, including severe disagreements that arose regarding the election process and the role of permanent vs. elected members.

Subject: spiritual assemblies; administrative matters
Quotation: To the members of the Spiritual Assembly of Baku, upon them be the Most Glorious Glory of God... The purpose is that the Spiritual Assembly should serve the friends with the utmost spirit and joy

Subject: spiritual assemblies; administrative matters
Quotation: When the illustrious Hands of the Cause of God make a decision in any gathering, all must obey and submit, and carry it out with the utmost joy and acceptance, for this obedience is obligatory and necessary.

Subject: spiritual assemblies; administrative matters
Quotation: Regarding the Spiritual Assembly about which you wrote - if I were to write something it would cause sadness to some, therefore it is better that you strive in a pleasant manner to organize the Spiritual Assembly

Subject: spiritual assemblies; administrative matters
Quotation: The Assembly, which has been formed at Washington, must be in perfect steadfastness, because no edifice, without firmness and erectness, lasts long and no tree, without being firmly rooted, becomes ornamented with leaves and fruits.

Subject: spiritual assemblies; administrative matters
Quotation: Your honor must go temporarily to Tehran regarding the purchased land where someone has claimed a conditional sale. Some of the notables and trustees are seeking information, so you should also meet with them, as this work can be accomplished by you.

Subject: spiritual assemblies; administrative matters
Quotation: Do not entrust orphans' funds to a single individual, for such dangers may result. Rather, let them be placed in a bank or special fund for orphans under the administration of the Spiritual Assembly, and they must be managed with the Assembly's knowledge.

Subject: spiritual assemblies; administrative matters
Quotation: Therefore, select individuals in Tehran to be named as members of this executive committee, and likewise send copies of this letter along with copies of Mr. Ahmad's letter to other Assemblies in surrounding areas so that each Assembly may select five people.

Subject: spiritual assemblies; administrative matters
Quotation: If you observe that through a general election the Spiritual Assembly will gain increased influence and no one will have cause for objection or hesitation, and all will acknowledge the decisions of the Spiritual Assembly, in such case a general election would be better and more fitting.

Subject: spiritual assemblies; administrative matters
Quotation: Should you observe that through general election the Spiritual Assembly would gain greater influence and no one would have cause for objection or hesitation, and all would acknowledge the decisions of the Spiritual Assembly, in such case general election would be better and more fitting.

Subject: spiritual assemblies; administrative matters
Quotation: These matters pertain to the Spiritual Assembly. No individual can execute any matter independently by themselves, even if it conforms to the constitution ratified by the nation and government. Rather, at present it must be executed with permission of the Spiritual Assembly and then through the government.

Subject: spiritual assemblies; administrative matters
Quotation: Every assembly has tested members who possess the worthiness of membership and capacity of character, and likewise a spiritual assembly and divine gathering must have members who attain capability and capacity for this most exalted station and who become tested members of that assembly through a spiritual power.

Subject: spiritual assemblies; administrative matters

Subject: spiritual assemblies; administrative matters

Subject: spiritual assemblies; administrative matters

Subject: spiritual assemblies; administrative matters

In any matter where you observe that it is approaching the level of enmity and threats, immediately postpone that matter so that dispute, contention, and tumult may cease, until a suitable time arrives.

Subject: spiritual assemblies; administrative matters
Quotation: First establish a consultative assembly in the Western center for this purpose, and through general election choose capable and competent members from among the divine friends, so that work may proceed on a firm foundation and all affairs may be conducted after consultation. First the foundation must be made firm, then attend to the branches.

Subject: spiritual assemblies; administrative matters

The Master calls it "Spiritual Assembly.") are organized in various parts, the members of which consult together about matters pertaining to the Cause, such as the education of the children, taking care of the orphans, helping the incapacitated and diffusing the Fragrances of God etc. The members of such an 'Spiritual Assembly' are elected according to the rule of majority.

Subject: spiritual assemblies; administrative matters

As to the copying of the Tablets in a book for the House of Spirituality, this dependeth upon the consent of the receivers of the Tablets. If the owners of the Tablets consent, copies should be kept and collected in the House of Spirituality and it will be acceptable. Nevertheless, this should be with perfect consent of the receivers.

Such a meeting is without result; eventually it sinks into forgetfulness. Another meeting is similar to the meeting of the sun with the mirror. The rays of the sun shine upon the mirror. Again, there may be a meeting like the coming together of combustible wood with fire, or the mingling of oil with fire. As soon as contact is effected, combustion takes place. Ah, such a meeting is good! Again, there is a meeting which is like unto the contact of the gentle zephyrs with the trees, which verdure; such a meeting is verily a meeting resulting in fruits and flowers.

Quotation: from its expression was inhaled the fragrance of the love of the Beloved of the worlds... if people would rend asunder the veils and hearken with the ear of their true nature to the Call of God raised from the right side of the luminous Spot, all would turn with illumined hearts toward the Beloved

Subject: spiritual emotions and susceptibilities
Quotation: O beloved of my heart and soul, I know not whether the pen hath been so inebriated by the love of the King of eternity that it is uttering these words; or whether the writer will quench the fire of regret, at not having attained to that which is worthy in this day, with the water of these utterances.

Subject: spiritual emotions and susceptibilities
Quotation: Suddenly a cry was heard. Standing, He said to see who it was. Upon investigation it became clear that a lady wanted to reach His most pure presence. However much she tried to reach the Most Luminous Countenance through the crowd, she could not, and this heart's knot caused her wailing and lamentation.

Subject: spiritual emotions and susceptibilities
Quotation: Verily, Thy loved ones in that land have tasted the sweetness of Thy life-giving love and have drunk the choice wine of Thy knowledge with the righteous. The tokens of unity have sprung forth in their hearts, and from their breasts have risen the sighs of the fire of Thy love amidst the people of detachment.

Subject: spiritual emotions and susceptibilities
Quotation: "My heart is satiated with this life. It is filled with sorrow. I wish to live no longer." "I long for something to rekindle the fire of my faith." "My heart longs for that Thing the nature of which is unchangeable, but you are offering me things which are not only changing but shall increase my heedlessness."

Subject: spiritual emotions and susceptibilities
Quotation: At one time, they would be beset with spark-inflaming sighs. At another time they would raise lamentations early at daybreak full of anguish and sorrow. And yet another time they would be with eyes full of tears, a consumed heart, and a concealed grief, like unto a blazing candle glowing with the flaming fire.

Subject: spiritual emotions and susceptibilities
Quotation: When I had thy letter in my hand, I was in such a condition that the breeze of the love of God cheered me and I was thereby moved with such joy that the place was filled with the spirit of the love of God. No doubt thy heart hath been also impressed by this spiritual joy, merciful attraction and ecstatic love.

Subject: spiritual emotions and susceptibilities
Quotation: Thereupon the souls of them that are endued with understanding cried out a bitter cry. When she became aware of this she retired to her mansion, sorely grieved and lamenting. And from the depths of her being she groaned with so vehement a cry that it might have caused the entire creation to perish and disappear.

Subject: spiritual emotions and susceptibilities
Quotation: These are men whom darkness cannot conceal and who fear not destruction in the path of God, nor do they heed intimations. Rather, their hearts are purified and sanctified through certitude, through their love for the wondrous Leaf of the blessed Tree whose oil would well-nigh shine forth though no fire touched it.

Subject: spiritual emotions and susceptibilities
Quotation: when the eye of insight was illumined by witnessing the lights of the Kingdom, the spiritual hearing was delighting in the melody of the Supreme Concourse, and the heart was stirred by the breathings of the Holy Spirit...it was evidence of the attraction of hearts and the rapture and joy of souls from God's grace

Subject: spiritual emotions and susceptibilities
Quotation: The letter from that spiritual friend was received and caused the utmost joy. Praise be to God that thou art ever dwelling beneath the shade of grace and art the object of loving attention. Though outwardly distant, in truth thou art near, nay, nearest. After attainment and arrival, no trace of remoteness remaineth.

Subject: spiritual emotions and susceptibilities
Quotation: My heart had many varying desires/But when mine eyes beheld Thee, all desires were united./Now those whom I envied have come to envy me/And I became lord of all creation when I became Thy servant./I left to others their religion and their world,/Being occupied with Thy remembrance, O Thou Who art my religion and my world!

Subject: spiritual emotions and susceptibilities
Quotation: O pure souls and spirits enamored with the beauty of God! Don your armor of patience in the path of God, be ignited with attraction to the Abha Kingdom, sing with joy in the love of God, rend your garments in separation from the Beauty of God, turn towards the highest horizon, and commune with your Lord morning and evening

Subject: spiritual emotions and susceptibilities
Quotation: By God the Truth! The Concourse on High takes pride today in a soul who arises to remember God and praise Him, to exalt the Word of God and His proof, to manifest the power of God and His sovereignty, and to diffuse His holy fragrances which, when they waft, perfume the horizons and return spirits to the bodies of the dead.

Subject: spiritual emotions and susceptibilities
Quotation: Although outwardly thou art deprived of hearing, yet praise be to God that thou art a keen listener to the Call of the Ancient Beauty and the Voice of the Concourse on High. An ear is needed that can hear the melody of the celestial herald; otherwise, in terms of this physical ear, even the rabbit shares this faculty with man.

Subject: spiritual emotions and susceptibilities
Quotation: this wandering and madness and notoriety may become known throughout the world...If you knew what crown from the bounty of the Desired One is upon your head and what robe of honor you wear, you would surely soar like grateful birds in the heights of acceptance and become intimate companions with the beauty of joy and gladness

Subject: spiritual emotions and susceptibilities
Quotation: Sometimes the material things have a spiritual effect. For instance, music is material but has an effect over the spirit. A sweet perfume is material, but its effect is spiritual. Cleanliness is material, but has an effect upon the spirit. It is our hope that although this is material food, yet it may have a spiritual effect.

Subject: spiritual emotions and susceptibilities
Quotation: During the nights of those days we could not sleep, because we fancied in our minds the unparalleled joy of meeting Baha'u'llah in the morning; standing in His presence, receiving His Graces and listening to His Words. It is impossible to describe with words the beatific vibrations with which we were surrounded in those days.

Subject: spiritual emotions and susceptibilities
Quotation: Generally when anyone heareth mention of death, sorrow and dejection appear upon him, yet this lowliest of servants is gladdened by its mention and made joyous by its thought. And in another place: Although at my death friends will be sorrowful and enemies will rejoice, yet since I myself am joyful, let the friends be joyful too.

Subject: spiritual emotions and susceptibilities
Quotation: When those souls came together it was as if the spiritual love and joy was so great it could not be borne or contained. It was not a physical attraction but a spiritual union. They were like two clear crystal goblets filled with pure water, so clear the goblets could not be seen - only the water rising and overflowing until united.

Subject: spiritual emotions and susceptibilities
Quotation: They possess enthusiasm and rapture in their hearts, and in their innermost being lies joy and exultation. They are intoxicated with the wine of the All-Merciful's utterance and, through their love for the Divine Beauty, have kindled a fire and become as moths consumed by the flame. They have shut their eyes to all save the Beloved.

Subject: spiritual emotions and susceptibilities
Quotation: It is dawn, and everyone is captivated and gladdened by some thought, while I have taken up pen and ink that perchance the spirits and hearts of the handmaidens and servants of the All-Merciful may be stirred and rejoiced, may be filled with joy and delight, and may find a new spirit through the verses of love for the Ancient Beauty.

Subject: spiritual emotions and susceptibilities
Quotation: In the feast of the love of God, so fill and empty the goblet of divine knowledge, and so fill and drain the wine-cup of intimate communion, that at this Baha'i festival, amid the circle of those inebriated with divine love, such jubilation and revelry may arise that the Angel of the celestial realm will be moved to ecstasy and rapture.

Subject: spiritual emotions and susceptibilities
Quotation: Say: O people! When the Messenger of God approacheth you with His Tablet, rise from your seats, then go forth to meet Him and take it with the fingers of certitude and assurance. Then inhale from it, when ye perceive therefrom the fragrance of utterance and the sweet perfume from the garment of the mercy of your Lord, the Most Merciful.

Subject: spiritual emotions and susceptibilities
Quotation: Glory be upon thee and upon those who have quaffed the wine of life in My days, and have soared on the wings of longing in My atmosphere, and have detached themselves from all else but Me, and have been attracted by the scratching of My Pen, and the rustling of the winds of My loving-kindness, and the murmuring of the waters of My bounty.

Subject: spiritual emotions and susceptibilities
Quotation: Some are able to breathe in the fragrant breezes of purity and others have dulled senses and cannot enjoy the perfume of the Divine. Render thou thanks to God therefore that thou hast been blessed with such a pure potential and hast opened thyself to true insights and hast borne witness to the lights of the All-Merciful and His great signs.

Subject: spiritual emotions and susceptibilities
Quotation: until the candle burns it gives no light; until the cloud weeps the meadow does not smile; and until the dove laments the cypress does not grow tall. The enkindled face of the Beloved causes the burning heart of the sorrowing lover to grieve, and the manifestation of the beauty of the rose becomes the cry and lamentation of the nightingale.

Subject: spiritual emotions and susceptibilities
Quotation: From the account of the guardian angel complete joy was obtained. We supplicate at the threshold of the Luminary of Truth - may my spirit be a sacrifice for His loved ones - that He may transform that guardian angel so that he may not lose the way and may become a guide to the path, and that whatever is your ultimate desire may be fulfilled.

Subject: spiritual emotions and susceptibilities
Quotation: At that time there were many severe tests, but there was abundant spirituality. We were walking on the earth, but in reality we were soaring towards the Supreme Concourse. During the eventful days of Nassr Ed Din Shah, those people who were Bahais were fearless, filled with the glad-tidings of God, overflowing with supplication and communion.

Subject: spiritual emotions and susceptibilities
Quotation: Therefore, it befitteth so noble a person as thyself to imbibe the beverage of the All-Merciful; so spiritual a one as thee must needs enjoy the ecstasy and delight that accrue therefrom. This giveth a heavenly existence, the other is mere drunkenness; this bestoweth spiritual awareness, whereas the other only causeth drowsiness in the morning.

Subject: spiritual emotions and susceptibilities
Quotation: Since thou art assured in God, attracted to the Kingdom of Abha and firm in the Covenant, thou art present at the Threshold of the Blessed Beauty - may my spirit be a sacrifice for His loved ones - and thou art immersed in the ocean of favors. Therefore, ever seek this station and pursue this bounty until thou findest rest in the highest horizon.

Subject: spiritual emotions and susceptibilities
Quotation: O ye sons and daughters of the Kingdom! Your letter dated September 30 of this year hath been received, and from the contents it became clear and evident that the fire of the love of God hath burst into a flame in that region -- a flame that can illumine the whole world and transform the East and the West into a field for the knights of the Kingdom.

Subject: spiritual emotions and susceptibilities
Quotation: Glory be to God! From one exalted word this fire of seeking has been ignited and the highest degrees of yearning and longing have become manifest, to such an extent that from all directions countless faces are turned toward the Face of God. These are days in which the flame of divine love appears from the hearts of lovers and speaks in the Tree of Being.

Subject: spiritual emotions and susceptibilities
Quotation: Give thanks to God that in this journey you traveled with Mr. Harris, the herald of the Kingdom of the All-Merciful, and became companions with His Holiness Ibn-i-Abhar, Hand of the Cause of God, and became confidants with the faithful servant at the Threshold of Baha, Aqa Mirza Mahmud. This bounty is worthy of thanksgiving and this success deserves gratitude.

Subject: spiritual emotions and susceptibilities
Quotation: In the dark of night, when thoughts of the righteous pass through my mind, my dwelling and nest become illumined, and the court of my heart becomes the envy of rose-garden and meadow. Immediately do I turn to supplication and seek infinite bounty, begging divine gifts for the friends. With tear-filled eyes and a heart aflame, I implore at the Threshold of the Lord

Subject: spiritual emotions and susceptibilities
Quotation: Say: This is a proof whereby the hearts of them that glorify God have been drawn unto Him. Say: This is a proof whereby the spirits of them that praise God have been drawn unto Him. Say: This is a proof whereby the souls of them that profess His unity have been drawn unto Him. Say: This is a proof whereby the bodies of them that magnify Him have been drawn unto Him.

Subject: spiritual emotions and susceptibilities
Quotation: When she reached that place she rose to her full height in the midmost heart of creation, And sought to inhale their fragrance at a time that knoweth neither beginning nor end. She found not in them that which she did desire, and this, verily, is but one of His wondrous tales. She then cried aloud, wailed and repaired to her own station within her most lofty mansion

Subject: spiritual emotions and susceptibilities
Quotation: The breeze of supreme mercy has risen from the holy Paradise of eternity, and the northern wind of highest favor has been stirred from the eternal Ridvan of the spirit. It has set in motion the holy and glorious spirits with wings of fellowship in the sweet atmospheres of the unseen, and causes the temples of spiritual attraction to move through the spiritual realms.

Subject: spiritual emotions and susceptibilities
Quotation: Through the grace of the All-Merciful, thou must become so intoxicated and attracted by the choice wine of the utterances of the Lord of all possibility that the heat of thy love may influence the hearts of men. God willing, mayest thou discover the sweetness of this blessed word as befitteth it, that its delight may endure throughout the kingdom of earth and heaven.

Subject: spiritual emotions and susceptibilities
Quotation: O ye who are near ones! O ye who are attracted! O ye who are aflame with the fire of the love of God in this witnessed Day! Praise be to God that through the help, protection and favor of the Divine Unity, the land of ?ad hath been perfumed with holy fragrances. After stillness it hath been stirred to motion, and after being extinguished its flame hath been rekindled.

Subject: spiritual emotions and susceptibilities
Quotation: That which emerged from the spiritual throat of that bird of the garden of attraction reached the ear of acceptance and was chanted in the sacred sanctuary with wondrous melodies. It cast a fire into the heart and soul of the dwellers of the sanctuary of the All-Merciful and ignited a flame in the hearts and innermost beings of the birds soaring in the atmosphere of the Lord.

Subject: spiritual emotions and susceptibilities
Quotation: But the believers of God, no matter how poor they may be, have the spiritual consolation. Their hearts are illumined with the bestowals of God, and their spirits rejoiced with the Glad-tidings of God. We were stationed in the supreme station of joy - invariable and unchangeable. Our hearts were stirred by the Breaths of the Holy Spirit and our souls vivified by the Fragrances of God.

Subject: spiritual emotions and susceptibilities
Quotation: Music is a divine art and capable of unlimited progress. It uplifts human soul towards his Maker and opens before the vistas of his eyes, the fair panorama of heavenly Bliss. The life of a person who has learned to appreciate the artistic value and moral significance of music is redolent with brightness, health and joy. In every object he will see symmetry, proportion, beauty and concord.

Subject: spiritual emotions and susceptibilities
Quotation: The mirror, when it becomes pure and clear, reflects those stars which are at the furthermost distance, making them appear present, manifest and visible therein. That is to say, thousands upon thousands upon thousands of leagues between the mirror and the star do not prevent their reflection. Likewise are the loved ones of God, and this is through the bounty and favor of the Ancient Beauty.

Subject: spiritual emotions and susceptibilities
Quotation: By Thy glory! If at this moment Thou wouldst accept from me what I have mentioned of what Thou hast taught me through Thy generosity and caused to flow through my pen by Thy grace, then I would do what befitteth Thy station and perform what beseemeth Thy grace and favor - as a manifestation of Thy generosity and honor toward Thy servant, though I deserve none of this and am not worthy of less than this.

Subject: spiritual emotions and susceptibilities
Quotation: O thou spiritual youth! Thou art ever remembered and never forgotten. I beg for thee from the Divine Threshold infinite bounty, and from the horizon of oneness I seek the dawning of the light of bestowal, that the cloud of mercy may pour down its rain, and the breeze of providence may waft, and the Sun of Truth may shine forth, and the field of heart and soul may attain boundless freshness and delicacy.

Subject: spiritual emotions and susceptibilities
Quotation: Your coming here is like one who will go to the sea-shore; if he does not know how to swim, he cannot go in the water and he will always remain on the shore. Or it is as one who enters a garden and through a cold, being unable to smell, will not inhale the perfume of the flowers; or it is also, as a man who will go to fountain of sweet water, and unless he is thirsty he will have no share of that sweet water.

Subject: spiritual emotions and susceptibilities
Quotation: The tumult of the world ariseth from the curling locks of the Beloved, and the trembling of the nations from the power of the manifestation of the Lord. When the beauty of the Merciful Joseph shineth forth in the market-place of Canaan, assuredly there ariseth a commotion in the divine Egypt, and a hundred thousand aging souls and a hundred thousand Zulaykhas of chastity and purity become captive in the realm of conscience.

Subject: spiritual emotions and susceptibilities
Quotation: Though the multitude of preoccupations, thoughts, difficulties and important matters prevented the sending of writing to that great gathering of the loved ones of God, I swear by the luminous countenance and fragrant nature of the Ancient Beauty - may my spirit be a sacrifice for His loved ones - that not for the twinkling of an eye am I forgetful of you, nor have I forgotten those friends for a moment, nor will I ever do so.

Subject: spiritual emotions and susceptibilities
Quotation: To those bewildered in the wilderness of silence, bring a message from the source of awareness. To those thirsting in the desert of confusion, offer cups of inner meaning from the heavenly fountain and the ruby of Badakhshan. Seat those immersed in the sea of nothingness in the Ark of eternity. Find those consumed in the fire of separation from behind the pavilion of reckoning and set them straight by the holy and true balance.

Subject: spiritual emotions and susceptibilities
Quotation: In the tavern of blissful rapture and divine attraction, Thou hast inebriated them with the prepared wine, and even as they revelled in Thy mention and praise, Thou didst intoxicate them with the crimson wine from the time that hath no beginning. In their hearts Thou didst ignite a candle, and all Thou didst teach the ways, the manner and the utterance of Thy righteous friends. Thou didst burn away their hearts with the fire of Thy love.

Subject: spiritual emotions and susceptibilities
Quotation: Indeed, the sweet savors of the holy and sanctified Lord have wafted over the realm of souls. The wings of the peacock have unfurled in the heights of paradise. The Birds in the garden of Revelation have melodiously warbled on the day when the Day-Star of Mount Sinai dawned forth. The Kindled Fire of God has blazed in the loftiest summits of joy. A wine-cup tempered with camphor has circulated and souls have become intoxicated with that crimson wine.

Subject: spiritual emotions and susceptibilities
Quotation: Hearts that are enkindled with the fire of the love of God have no need for a kindled fire or temple of love, meaning a person to move and guide them. Those afflicted with coldness are in need of a flame from the fire of God's love. Therefore, that censer of the fire of love must blaze forth amidst those lethargic ones, that both the moist and dry may be set ablaze, and even the hardest stone may send forth towering flames. And this is not difficult for God.

Subject: spiritual emotions and susceptibilities
Quotation: Here, I illuminate the night with the light of His favor, and make the day, in remembrance of His face, the envy of rose garden and meadow. The ultimate desire and hope is to sacrifice and offer up one's life in the path of that Lord of bounty. These trials and tribulations, these hardships and difficulties, these pains and struggles, this yearning and burning, since they are in the path of His love, are honey though they be poison, are sugar though they be bitter.

Subject: spiritual emotions and susceptibilities
Quotation: From their lips Thou shalt hear naught but the strains of My praise; unto this Thy Lord beareth Me witness. The existence of these people, however, hath remained concealed from the eyes of all who, from everlasting, have been created through the Word of God. These are they who, in truth, were not enjoined to prostrate themselves before Adam. They have never turned away from the countenance of Thy Lord, and partake at every moment of the gifts and delights of holiness.

Subject: spiritual emotions and susceptibilities
Quotation: Although the occurrence of this new matter and the separation of the Leaf from the Blessed Tree outwardly caused sorrow, grief and sadness, yet as she attained unto the effects of the Blessed Pen and ascended from the lowest station to the Supreme Companion, it brought solace. We praise Him for all of this and thank Him for what hath come upon us from His prevailing and immutable decree. That which was revealed concerning her is the cause of solace to sanctified hearts and assured souls.

Subject: spiritual emotions and susceptibilities
Quotation: The musk-scented breeze is shedding its fragrance and the gentle wind from the rose-garden is reviving the souls of the righteous. And yet the heedless are as dead, the ignorant are fast asleep, the wavering are withered and the frozen are downcast, for the sun sheds illumination upon the eyes of the seeing, not of the blind; the songs of David transport the spirits of the hearing, not of the deaf; and the nectar of eternal life is sweet in the mouths of those who can taste, not of the dead.

Subject: spiritual emotions and susceptibilities
Quotation: O beloved of the Beloved! I know not by what remembrance to recall the wondrous tokens of Thy separation and estrangement, nor by what description to recount the brilliant signs of Thy remoteness and detachment. For after the manifestations of the fire of separation appeared on the horizons, the remembrances of longing were obliterated from the hearts of lovers, and with the emergence of the decree of divorce in all regions, the light of yearning was extinguished in the hearts of the faithful.

Subject: spiritual emotions and susceptibilities
Quotation: enkindled with the fire of Thy love, illumined by the light of Thy knowledge surging like the sea at the mention of Thee and billowing like the surging waves at Thy behest while he buries his face in the dust at Thy Holy Presence and covers his face in the dust at the Threshold of Thy nearness and his face is illumined by beholding Thy signs and his nostrils are perfumed by the fragrant breaths of the Blessed Spot and his soul is revived by the breezes of Thy breath that waft from the sanctified garden

Subject: spiritual emotions and susceptibilities
Quotation: One who voyages upon the sea must needs sometimes witness the surging of waves and sail and gaze upon their crest, and at times descend from those heights. Sometimes one observes intense turbulence, and at other times beholds the sea in stillness. These variations in condition are requisite to the journey and cause no harm. If, however, stillness should prevail and one should remain wholly deprived of waves, and no turbulence or agitation should return - this is blameworthy, for it indicates the journey has reached its end.

Subject: spiritual emotions and susceptibilities
Quotation: But know this much: the divine lamp shall be lit and the brilliant star shall shine upon the gathering, the divine sea shall surge and the whale of the Most Merciful ocean shall roar, the nightingale of the Baha'i rose-garden shall burst into song and the mystic bird of the divine garden shall trill endlessly. Then the hearing ear that is accustomed to the nightingale's song will hear the angel's call that "Holy and Sanctified! This is My nightingale of the rose-garden, this is My bird of the garden, this is My lamp of the horizons."

Subject: spiritual emotions and susceptibilities
Quotation: When I gazed upon their countenance and brow, the signs of love and the manifest light were evident, and in their eyes shone forth the signs of intelligence and perspicacity, and in their faces spiritual joy was apparent, and in their visages divine gladness was clear, and from their beauty radiated and shone forth Baha'i sweetness and divine grace. Thus was joy and gladness attained, and soul and heart became happy and delighted, and attention was turned to the Most Great Name, and eternal bounty and everlasting bestowals were beseeched.

Subject: spiritual emotions and susceptibilities
Quotation: Yet despite this, Thou seest my breast expanded through the fragrant breezes of Thy holiness, my heart attracted to the signs of Thy oneness, my eyes solaced by beholding Thy lights, and my spirit revived by the gentle winds that waft from the garden of Thy loving-kindness. I pay no heed to the arrows, nor do I regard the spears, nor do I concern myself with any affairs, but rather I cling to the hem of patience, arm myself with the armor of supplication and entreaty, and quench the flames ignited by the hands of the wicked with tears that flow night and day.

Subject: spiritual emotions and susceptibilities
Quotation: Some have attained the ultimate of what they sought of the gems of Thy mercy and the essence of Thy bounty, while others have perished in their exile and separation from Thee, never finding the path to Thy nearness and meeting with Thee. Whenever I consider my self and my deeds in Thy kingdom, bewilderment and sorrow seize me to such degree that I become despairing of the sweet fragrances of Thy glorious mercy and deprived of the glances of Thine eye of grace. Yet whenever I turn, O my God, to the wonders of Thy mercy and the gems of Thy bounty, the breezes of assurance waft upon me from the direction of grace and loving-kindness.

Subject: spiritual foundations of true knowledge
Quotation: They should develop spiritual feelings. By these means they will become enlightened and well educated

Subject: spiritual foundations of true knowledge
Quotation: Moses hearkened unto the divine call in the Sinai of recognition, and it is that same call that He Who is the Desire of the world now voiceth. Strive, that this most great bounty may remain and endure.

Subject: spiritual foundations of true knowledge
Quotation: You must ever concentrate your thoughts on the acquisition of knowledge, so that unlimited confirmations may continually descend upon you from the Kingdom of God

Subject: spiritual foundations of true knowledge
Quotation: They say that the divine Plato was of the people of illumination and the chief of the people of harmony. If this be so, his mention is as honey and sweetness, for the essence of illumination is the jewel of harmony

Subject: spiritual foundations of true knowledge
Quotation: the heart has become weak from the absence of spiritual power, it can no longer observe divine mysteries and its future affairs...if you want to have lofty aspirations, you must set the heart in motion to unite with knowledge

Subject: spiritual foundations of true knowledge
Quotation: Whereas the development of good character and refinement of morals is more important than the acquisition of sciences...on condition that the pursuit of knowledge be coupled with refinement of character and inspiration from the light of divine effulgence

Subject: spiritual foundations of true knowledge
Quotation: Just as the amelioration and perfection of the world of humanity is dependent upon the progress of sciences and art, so also the refinement of the spirit and the cultivation of the highest ideals of morality is made possible through celestial sciences and art.

Subject: spiritual foundations of true knowledge
Quotation: The heavenly food is good. This food gives trouble (indigestion). That heavenly food gives strength and salvation. The effect of this food is only for a day; but the strength of that is everlasting. It is strange that the people are so ignorant about it and are unaware of the heavenly food.

Subject: spiritual foundations of true knowledge
Quotation: Now you must lay foundations whose roots are in this world but whose ends are in the zenith of eternal glory, and you must raise a melody in the assemblage of this life that its intoxicating effects will be in the kingdom of the divine. Therein lies the fruit of one's existence, therein lies the manifest mystery.

Subject: spiritual foundations of true knowledge
Quotation: "This is also one of the most distinctive signs of the Baha'i cycle that a person who has never entered the doors of a school, who has not studied grammar and syntax sits down and writes such scholarly works... This is purely through the gift of the Lord! Because their hearts are so attached to the Cause, that that very attachment becomes an unerring teacher. Their words have life..."

Quotation: Every assembly held for the purpose of bringing about unity and concord will be conducive to turning strangers into friends and aliens into companions.

Subject: spiritual meetings; gatherings; devotional gatherings; feasts
Quotation: O Divine providence, shed a ray from the Sun of Truth upon this gathering that it may become illumined.

Subject: spiritual meetings; gatherings; devotional gatherings; feasts
Quotation: adorn the gatherings of existence with the grace of firmness and steadfastness

Subject: spiritual meetings; gatherings; devotional gatherings; feasts
Quotation: gather the steadfast friends together every week to engage in divine remembrance

Subject: spiritual meetings; gatherings; devotional gatherings; feasts
Quotation: It is better if in meetings one of those present reads from the Tablets of Baha'u'llah and others listen.

Subject: spiritual meetings; gatherings; devotional gatherings; feasts
Quotation: Thank God that you have made your home a gathering place for the friends and an assembly for the loved ones.

Subject: spiritual meetings; gatherings; devotional gatherings; feasts
Quotation: adorn the meetings with the commemoration of God and train the individuals with the breath of the merciful One

Subject: spiritual meetings; gatherings; devotional gatherings; feasts
Quotation: "But if they chant supplications together (and in company), in a good and effective voice, that is very good."

Subject: spiritual meetings; gatherings; devotional gatherings; feasts
Quotation: God willing, mayest thou abide beneath the shade of the Divine Lote-Tree and remember Him in the nights and days.

Subject: spiritual meetings; gatherings; devotional gatherings; feasts
Quotation: Such Feasts are very beloved, for they are the causes of the gathering of the believers and the happiness of souls.

Subject: spiritual meetings; gatherings; devotional gatherings; feasts
Quotation: contrasts different types of gatherings and their songs, emphasizing the spiritual nature of the addressees' gathering

Subject: spiritual meetings; gatherings; devotional gatherings; feasts
Quotation: This letter appears to be written following a devotional gathering where prayers were offered for a group of believers.

Subject: spiritual meetings; gatherings; devotional gatherings; feasts
Quotation: That honored lady must engage, throughout the days and nights, in bringing together the hearts of the handmaidens of God

Subject: spiritual meetings; gatherings; devotional gatherings; feasts
Quotation: Assemble ye the friends of Paris together and gather them in one place and raise loud the sacred melodies in this meeting.

Subject: spiritual meetings; gatherings; devotional gatherings; feasts
Quotation: The emphasis on the importance and effects of spiritual gatherings, both the disciples' gathering and the current gathering

Subject: spiritual meetings; gatherings; devotional gatherings; feasts
Quotation: Complete the spiritual gatherings in New York and persist in them, so that blessed results may be achieved through steadfastness.

Subject: spiritual meetings; gatherings; devotional gatherings; feasts
Quotation: The Baha'i New Year's festival that you celebrated was very appropriate and good. The Holy Spirit shines forth from this festival.

Subject: spiritual meetings; gatherings; devotional gatherings; feasts
Quotation: make their radiant faces lamps of guidance in the gatherings of divine knowledge and signs of bounty in the assemblies of exposition

Subject: spiritual meetings; gatherings; devotional gatherings; feasts
Quotation: I hope thou wilt memorize all the poetry of the Blessed Perfection and chant with wonderful melody in the assemblages and gatherings.

Subject: spiritual meetings; gatherings; devotional gatherings; feasts

Subject: spiritual meetings; gatherings; devotional gatherings; feasts

Those days are the days of forgiveness and pardon, days of cheer and enjoyment, days of affection and attraction, days of blessings.

Quotation: O my spiritual friends! The heavenly bestowals are fully manifested and the effusions of His grace are like vernal showers around us.
