The world of being is astir with movement and contingent existence is alive with the spirit of His loving Providence.

Subject: spiritual meetings; gatherings; devotional gatherings; feasts
Quotation: Do not say 'gathering' - say 'assembly of spiritual ones,' say 'congregation of divine ones,' say 'retreat of the merciful ones,' say 'court of the glorified ones,' for each member of that assembly is a bright candle, and that gathering is like the mansions of the stars and moon, confirmed by the assistance of the Lord of humanity, and promoting the Feast mentioned in the Most Holy Book.

Subject: spiritual meetings; gatherings; devotional gatherings; feasts
Quotation: This is a heavenly feast, an excellent meeting. Surely this is praiseworthy. The Supreme Concourse now is beholding this assemblage, proclaiming aloud: "Blessed are ye! Blessed are ye! Blessed are ye who are the servants of Baha'o'llah! Blessed are ye who are the manifestors of faith! Blessed are ye who have such radiant countenances! Blessed are ye whose hearts are like unto rose gardens!"

Subject: spiritual meetings; gatherings; devotional gatherings; feasts
Quotation: Your letter describing the Ridvan feast and spiritual gathering was read with utmost joy. Praise be to God that there was an assembly in complete attraction [...] who are turned toward the Abha Kingdom and desire to sacrifice their lives in the path of God. However, with wisdom, they should always arrange feasts on the appointed days and hold heavenly gatherings and engage in the mention of God.

Subject: spiritual meetings; gatherings; devotional gatherings; feasts
Quotation: Increase your gladness and joy moment by moment, adorn the gatherings of fellowship, mingle with one another in holy fragrances, and show forth such love for each other that whoever beholds you will see you as lovers of one another and servants of each other. Yet act with wisdom and stray not from its bounds. Gather not in any place more than nine persons, and if necessary let not exceed nineteen.

Subject: spiritual meetings; gatherings; devotional gatherings; feasts
Quotation: Give the utmost importance to the 19 day Feasts, so that the Friends of God and the Maidservants of the Merciful may turn their faces to the Kingdom, read the supplications, entreat for confirmation, be attracted with love for one another, add to their holiness, virtue and sanctity, resist the army of passion and desire, be abstracted from the elemental world and submerged in the sea of spiritual emotions.

Subject: spiritual meetings; gatherings; devotional gatherings; feasts
Quotation: The spiritual gathering you have established in that illumined city was most fitting and effective. Indeed, you have shown great effort, taken precedence, arisen in servitude at the Most Great Threshold, and attained a bounty. Now you must gather in that radiant assembly with perfect vigor and spirituality, chant the verses of the Perspicuous Book, engage in the remembrance of God, present proofs and evidences

Subject: spiritual meetings; gatherings; devotional gatherings; feasts
Quotation: In these days when the Lamp of the Covenant hath been lit in the apex of the horizons and the lights of the emanations of the Most Great Luminary from the Kingdom of the Unseen have made East and West the envy of the world in their radiance, the divine foundation must be laid upon humility and lowliness. The spiritual loved ones must, night and day, occupy themselves with enkindling and setting ablaze the hearts.

Subject: spiritual meetings; gatherings; devotional gatherings; feasts
Quotation: When heavenly gatherings are held therein, devotions are offered, divine verses are intoned in wondrous voices and prayers are chanted, the inhabitants of the Concourse on High hearken unto them and cry out with the call of "blessed, blessed are ye!" that, praise be unto God, in the lower realm, angels from Kingdom of Glory have arisen to pray and supplicate and to intone the verses of Divine Unity in a holy gathering.

Subject: spiritual meetings; gatherings; devotional gatherings; feasts
Quotation: The report of [your meeting] was noted. All the arrangements of the meeting are suitable and acceptable. Regarding arrangements for the Bahai Sunday meeting for the purpose of worship, this is very suitable. But, in a meeting for worship, first, prayer should be chanted and supplication made until all gather; then communion should be made. After praying, sacred readings with melodious voices should be read by all together.

Subject: spiritual meetings; gatherings; devotional gatherings; feasts
Quotation: The greatest meeting held during the day of Christ was the Lord's supper. There were only twelve. The meeting was held in a very humble quarter with no table, no chairs and no rugs. They sat around a simple wooden heard and spoke on the glad tidings of the Kingdom. Now consider the results of that one Supper. One end of Christ's table is in the East, the other is in the West and many nations and tongues are sitting around it!

Subject: spiritual meetings; gatherings; devotional gatherings; feasts
Quotation: Blessed are the homes that serve as gathering places for the loved ones of God. He hath caused souls to be attracted and hath adorned those places with the presence of His chosen ones. Blessed is the land that hath attained in My days, which God hath made a dwelling place for My pure ones, and blessed is the house wherein the fragrance of My loved ones is found, and blessed are the faces illumined by the Sun of My loving-kindness.

Subject: spiritual meetings; gatherings; devotional gatherings; feasts
Quotation: Should a soul dwelling in the furthermost lands fix his gaze upon God, the word of nearness shall be revealed concerning him. But blessed and excellent is the one who attaineth unto both! By Him Who hath made Me abased for the glory of the worlds and imprisoned for the liberation of all peoples - if with pure intent one beholdeth the Countenance of the All-Merciful but once, it equalleth all the good deeds of the first and the last.

Subject: spiritual meetings; gatherings; devotional gatherings; feasts
Quotation: But, praise be to God in Hamadan the merciful assembly is organized. That assembly must be illumined. The illumination of every assembly is teaching the Cause of God. The spirituality of every meeting is the diffusion of the Fragrance of God. The mercifulness of every gathering-place is to correspond the deeds, actions and behaviour in accord with the Teachings of God. This is the meeting! This is the assemblage! This is the gathering!

Subject: spiritual meetings; gatherings; devotional gatherings; feasts
Quotation: The feast (supper) [every nineteen days] is very acceptable and will finally produce good results. The beloved and the maid-servants of the Merciful must inaugurate the feast in such wise as to resurrect the feast of the ancients--namely, the "lord's supper." That meeting for feast for which thou wert preparing and providing, should recur every so often, so that it may prove a means of attracting the confirmation of the Kingdom of ABHA.

Subject: spiritual meetings; gatherings; devotional gatherings; feasts
Quotation: Make Thou them the magnets of love so that they may attract the hearts to the Kingdom of ABHA! Grant Thou to them assistance. Open Thou before their faces the closed doors and make them intimate with the fragrances of holiness, so that they may become the confident friends of each other; raise the melody and the song of joy and sing the harmony of heaven, in order that they may exhilarate and gladden the regions of the West and impart attraction and ecstasy!

Subject: spiritual meetings; gatherings; devotional gatherings; feasts
Quotation: Therefore, I have taken up the pen and begun writing this letter. I beseech from God's infinite favors that in all conditions you may perfume your nostrils with the holy fragrances wafting from the Blessed Garden and make your souls fragrant. And in the utmost joy and delight, attraction and rapture, may you be occupied with stringing the pearls of praise and diffusing the holy fragrances of glorification of the Most Glorious Beauty among the peoples of the world

Subject: spiritual meetings; gatherings; devotional gatherings; feasts
Quotation: Every gathering that is adorned with the remembrance of Truth - its radiance illumines East and West, and its fragrances perfume the nostrils of those present and absent. With perfect wisdom, whenever possible, a gathering of remembrance and devotion should be arranged and the verses of divine unity should be chanted, so that the taste buds of the Concourse on High may be delighted and the hearts of the people of the Most Glorious Kingdom may be gladdened and rejoiced.

Subject: spiritual meetings; gatherings; devotional gatherings; feasts
Quotation: If it be possible, the seven gatherings, which are established in Philadelphia, may have on special days, several times in a year, one big meeting and spread a Persian Feast. In such a Feast it is not necessary to have many servants. The aim is the gathering together of the Friends. If it is possible let the dinner be a Persian one, and one dish, then you can spend that day, like the one of Naw Ruz, in the utmost happiness and be engaged in the mentioning of the True One.

Subject: spiritual meetings; gatherings; devotional gatherings; feasts
Quotation: I chant verses of thanksgiving at the Most Exalted Threshold for having enabled you to gather and establish this spiritual assembly in that blessed city, which I hope God will make a center of lights radiating to all directions, and that He will assist the members of the Spiritual Assembly in the important divine affairs, in establishing His Kingdom, in developing heavenly character, in achieving spiritual perception, and in attaining the greatest gifts in the world of humanity

Subject: spiritual meetings; gatherings; devotional gatherings; feasts
Quotation: The feast you arranged where the friends of the All-Merciful gathered in fellowship, chanted the clear verses, and became attracted to the Abha Kingdom--that gathering was, in the words of Christ, the Lord's Supper, meaning a heavenly feast and celestial table "wherein is whatever the souls desire and the eyes delight in." You wrote about the gathering of the friends during Ridvan in the garden, that it was astounding. God willing, many such heavenly gatherings will be formed in those regions.

Subject: spiritual meetings; gatherings; devotional gatherings; feasts
Quotation: His Holiness the Wronged One, meaning the Name of God - upon him be all glory most glorious - in correspondence sent to this servant has greatly complained about the unwisdom shown in the Land of ?a. In one letter he wrote that this servant was invited to a place, but upon arrival it was observed that fifty or sixty of the friends were gathered. I said: 'Have you not heard of wisdom, that it has been ordained that gatherings should not exceed nine persons?' Similarly, other gatherings were observed.

Subject: spiritual meetings; gatherings; devotional gatherings; feasts
Quotation: When this assembly was established in the Blessed Day and was graciously named by the Pure Tongue, being called "spiritual", we supposed that at all times we would inhale the holy fragrance from its centers of activity and breathe in the merciful breaths of spirituality from heart and soul. We expected to hear each day such news as would cause hearts to expand and breasts to dilate, and that lights would radiate from that gathering like unto a candle, bringing solace to hearts and guidance to all in the land.

Subject: spiritual meetings; gatherings; devotional gatherings; feasts
Quotation: The gathering of the believers is the assembly of the spiritual ones. The spirit of God descends upon the assemblages of the friends. They are the spiritual power-houses and confer bliss and joy. Therefore if a meeting is held, the general discussion of which is spiritual, undoubtedly that meeting is godlike. Strive day and night that your assemblage may become radiant and the hearts illumined. Consort with each other so that your spirits may be stirred into cheerfulness through the Glad-tidings of the Kingdom.

Subject: spiritual meetings; gatherings; devotional gatherings; feasts
Quotation: News continually arrives from those friends that, praise be to God, they are engaged in service and each has taken up a lamp of guidance to dispel the darkness of vain imaginings and doubts...My hope is that her luminous gathering continues and that the handmaids of the Merciful assemble in that place, are engaged in the mention of the Lord, occupied with spreading the divine teachings, and strive for unity and harmony. The days when meetings were held in her home and I would attend and speak will not be forgotten.

Subject: spiritual meetings; gatherings; devotional gatherings; feasts
Quotation: Through it, the hearts are illumined, the souls become spiritual and the fragrances of the Kingdom of Glory are inhaled. The human world becometh another world, and the susceptibilities of the soul are heightened to such a degree that they encompass the entire creation. Behold how abundant the beauty, tenderness, spirituality, and radiance that are attained when ye gather in that gathering place of the spirit, occupy yourselves at dawn with the remembrance of God, and, after offering prayers, make mention together of the Most Bountiful Lord in sweet melodies.

Subject: spiritual meetings; gatherings; devotional gatherings; feasts
Quotation: Gatherings are in no wise permitted. If several separate meetings be held, this would be more agreeable. When the Most Great Luminary was rising from the horizon of the Land of Mystery, this servant was commanded to write to him who was named Mahdi, whom God caused to dwell in His house after his migration, saying that ye should follow in the footsteps of the Lord of all beings, and associate with the people of the world in the utmost spirit of joy and fragrance, lest alarm and anxiety be aroused among the people and become a cause of disturbance to weak souls.

Subject: spiritual meetings; gatherings; devotional gatherings; feasts
Quotation: He hath written that the honored beloved, the Physician, upon him be the Glory of God, the Most Glorious, hath arrived safe and well and is engaged in holy remembrance in gatherings of fellowship. After this matter was presented at the Most Holy Court, He said: We have created all for this purpose, and We beseech God to make you as one soul and to strengthen you in such wise that you may summon all who are in the world, and gather together in My remembrance, the promotion of My Cause, the spreading of My verses, and the manifestation of My power and sovereignty through wisdom and utterance.

Subject: spiritual meetings; gatherings; devotional gatherings; feasts
Quotation: establish spiritual gatherings and divine assemblies which are the foundation for spreading God's fragrances, exalting God's Word, causing God's light to shine forth, promoting God's religion, and disseminating God's teachings...These spiritual gatherings are supported by the Spirit of God and their protector is Abdul-Baha who spreads his wings over them...These spiritual gatherings are brilliant lamps and heavenly gardens from which the fragrances of holiness are diffused over all regions, the lights of knowledge shine upon all created things, and the spirit of life flows to all directions. They are the most powerful means for the progress of man in all conditions.

Subject: spiritual meetings; gatherings; devotional gatherings; feasts
Quotation: At the Alliance Spiritualiste meeting in Paris (21 Rue Vieille Columbier, Saint-Germain) on 18 Dhi'l-Qa'dah 1329, where the president of the society spoke with utmost respect and admiration for the Baha'is, 'Abdu'l-Baha said: I am deeply grateful for the president's words and heartfelt sentiments, and I thank God that I am present in such a spiritual gathering in Paris. If we look with the eye of reality, the atmosphere of this meeting is surging with spirit. Heavenly bounties are encompassing us, and the confirmations of the Holy Spirit are evident. Praise be to God, these hearts are overflowing with spiritual sentiments and are stirred by the movements of the spirit.

Subject: spiritual meetings; gatherings; devotional gatherings; feasts
Quotation: You had written that in New York you joined with the enkindled handmaiden of God Juliet, the assured handmaiden of God Mother Beecher, the handmaiden of God aflame with the fire of the love of God Mrs. Brittingham, Mr. Woodcock, and other friends, and held a feast where you and Juliet were the hosts. How blessed you are to have been confirmed in such service and assisted in arranging such a feast. Now strive in Montreal that these feasts may continue and become the cause of firmness and steadfastness of the friends and handmaidens of the All-Merciful. May the fragrances of the divine rose garden waft and the life-giving breeze of the Most Glorious Paradise pass by. May those present be stirred with joy and become attuned to endless delight.

Subject: spiritual meetings; gatherings; devotional gatherings; feasts
Quotation: O ye enamored of the Face of God! It befitteth the friends to hold a gathering, a meeting, where they shall glorify God and fix their hearts upon Him, and read and recite the Holy Writings of the Blessed Beauty -- may my soul be the ransom of His lovers! The lights of the All-Glorious Realm, the rays of the Supreme Horizon, will be cast upon such bright assemblages, for these are none other than the Mashriqu'l-Adhkars, the Dawning-Points of God's Remembrance, which must, at the direction of the Most Exalted Pen, be established in every hamlet and city... These spiritual gatherings must be held with the utmost purity and consecration so that from the site itself, and its earth and the air about it, one will inhale the fragrant breathings of the Holy Spirit.

Subject: spiritual meetings; gatherings; devotional gatherings; feasts
Quotation: You wrote about the reception of the handmaid of Baha Miss Barney which was in the utmost spirituality, and Mr. Mayo's melodies, the handmaid of Baha's speech, the reading of Mr. Dreyfus's book, and Mr. Hannen's words caused the attraction of the hearts of those present, and likewise the speech of the attracted handmaid of God Mrs. Getsinger which was in the utmost effect and attraction, and Mr. Remey's words and Mrs. Dixon's speech, and also the second speech of the handmaid of Baha which explained the penetrating power of the Greatest Name in the hearts and realities of all peoples, and the establishment of universal peace through the all-encompassing power of the Ancient Beauty, and the unification of different religions under the banner of the Covenant

Subject: spiritual meetings; gatherings; devotional gatherings; feasts
Quotation: Thou hast written concerning the meetings and the gathering-places of the believers of God. Such assemblies and congregations will greatly aid the promotion of the Word, and all the audience, whether friends or not friends, become affected. But when the friends have the intention of entering in these meetings and assemblies, they must first make their purpose pure, disengage the heart from all other reflections, ask the inexhaustible Divine Confirmation and with the utmost devotion and humility set their feet in the gathering-place. Let them not introduce any topic in the meeting except the mentioning of the True One, neither must they confuse that merciful assembly with perplexed outside questions. They must either teach or open their tongues in propounding argument, either commune or supplicate and pray to God, either read Tablets or give out advices or exhortations.

Subject: spiritual meetings; gatherings; devotional gatherings; feasts
Quotation: This feast was established as one of the nineteen days by the Bab, and the Blessed Beauty likewise commanded, encouraged and urged its observance. Therefore it is of the utmost importance. You must certainly exercise the greatest care regarding it and give it importance, so that it may become established and permanent. The friends of God should gather together and associate with one another in the utmost love and fragrance, conducting themselves with the greatest dignity and propriety. They should chant the divine verses, read beneficial articles, study the letters of 'Abdu'l-Baha, encourage one another to love all mankind, pray with the utmost joy and fragrance, recite poems, praises and glorification of the Self-Subsisting Lord, deliver eloquent speeches, and the host himself must personally serve the friends and show kindness to all with the utmost humility. If the gathering is held as it should be, in the manner described, that supper is the Lord's Supper, for its result is the same result and its influence the same influence.

Subject: spiritual meetings; gatherings; devotional gatherings; feasts
Quotation: The friends arrange four gatherings each week, and through chanting verses and diffusing the divine fragrances enliven heart and soul

Subject: spiritual meetings; gatherings; devotional gatherings; feasts
Quotation: This is a Baha'i house. Every time such a house or meeting place is founded it becomes one of the greatest aids to the general development of the town and country to which it belongs.

Subject: spiritual meetings; gatherings; devotional gatherings; feasts
Quotation: You must conduct your meetings with great dignity and treat with honor those who come to them. Should there be any strangers, treat them with perfect friendship and love. All must feel perfect at home, and especially, free to ask questions. In fact, you must conduct these meeting that they become sociable and charming. You must always read the Words of Baha'o'llah, from the Ighan. In your meetings there must always be shown respect for one another and for the Cause of GOD.

Subject: spiritual prerequisites of teaching the Cause
Quotation: Into whatsoever land they may enter, let them be as life-giving waters unto the thirsty and as luminous lamps unto those souls who have drunk from the fountain of vain imaginings whilst wandering in the darkness of conjecture and illusion. We enjoin upon all to array themselves with praiseworthy character, that hearts may be enkindled with the fire of My love, and that they may be reminded through My beauteous remembrance.

Subject: spiritual prerequisites of teaching the Cause
Quotation: God hath prescribed unto everyone the duty of teaching His Cause. Whoever ariseth to discharge this duty, must needs, ere he proclaimeth His Message, adorn himself with the ornament of an upright and praiseworthy character, so that his words may attract the hearts of such as are receptive to his call. Without it, he can never hope to influence his hearers.

Subject: spiritual prerequisites of teaching the Cause
Quotation: the teacher himself must be infinitely affected at the time of teaching

Subject: spiritual prerequisites of teaching the Cause
Quotation: Today praiseworthy character is the helper of the Cause. We beseech God to aid all to do that which is acceptable in His presence.

Subject: spiritual prerequisites of teaching the Cause
Quotation: Wisdom must be observed in all conditions. Indeed, even if the authorities were to take steps in this matter, it would have no validity, for people will inevitably gather, whereupon the authorities will unite with them for apparent interests. In any case, one must engage in teaching the Cause secretly with perfect wisdom until the people of every city attain divine love. Once this is achieved, none will be able to object or oppose.

Subject: spiritual prerequisites of teaching the Cause
Quotation: move forward with wisdom

Subject: spiritual prerequisites of teaching the Cause
Quotation: The tongue must have remembrance and minds must have thought.

Subject: spiritual prerequisites of teaching the Cause
Quotation: but hath been illumined with the light of piety and detachment

Subject: spiritual prerequisites of teaching the Cause
Quotation: Never talk to God to a man with an empty stomach. Feed him first.

Subject: spiritual prerequisites of teaching the Cause
Quotation: O Muhammad Mahdi Cham, who art the herald between earth and heaven!

Subject: spiritual prerequisites of teaching the Cause
Quotation: transcending idle fancies and holding fast to the cord of knowledge

Subject: spiritual prerequisites of teaching the Cause
Quotation: thou hath cast away vain imaginings and turned unto God, the Lord of Days

Subject: spiritual prerequisites of teaching the Cause
Quotation: This field is indeed vast and requires heavenly power for one to move within it

Subject: spiritual prerequisites of teaching the Cause
Quotation: Emphasis on humility, submission and spiritual qualities needed for teaching work

Subject: spiritual prerequisites of teaching the Cause
Quotation: Now is not the time for you to read and write. It is time to arise and cry out "O my God!" in prayer.

Subject: spiritual prerequisites of teaching the Cause
Quotation: God has commanded them to manifest qualities, conduct and deeds that attract the hearts of the unitarians

Subject: spiritual prerequisites of teaching the Cause
Quotation: conversation should focus on spiritual matters, not worldly topics; need for mastery of proofs and arguments

Subject: spiritual prerequisites of teaching the Cause
Quotation: the text emphasizes the need for "passionate love for the Blessed Beauty" and focusing all thought on teaching

Subject: spiritual prerequisites of teaching the Cause
Quotation: Make pure thy intention and exalted thy resolve - then shalt thou witness the confirmation of the Abha Kingdom.

Subject: spiritual prerequisites of teaching the Cause
Quotation: O thou who art young in years but great in gifts! For thou wert born of souls who believed in God and His signs

Subject: spiritual prerequisites of teaching the Cause
Quotation: implies that spreading the divine Tablets requires great sacrifice and dedication, traversing physical hardships

Subject: spiritual prerequisites of teaching the Cause
Quotation: Be thou a sign of remembrance, and like an overflowing cup, be filled to the brim with the wine of the love of God.

Subject: spiritual prerequisites of teaching the Cause
Quotation: This recognition is the greatest bounty of the All-Merciful. There is no greater affliction than lack of recognition.

Subject: spiritual prerequisites of teaching the Cause
Quotation: being a channel for the Holy Spirit in teaching the Cause "O thou who art attracted by the breaths of the Holy Spirit!"

Subject: spiritual prerequisites of teaching the Cause
Quotation: pure deeds and steadfastness are prerequisites - "Today is the day of pure deeds and the manifestation of steadfastness"

Subject: spiritual prerequisites of teaching the Cause
Quotation: sacrifice your soul, spirit and peace of mind so that you may become the manifestation of divine grace from all directions

Subject: spiritual prerequisites of teaching the Cause
Quotation: becoming so attracted and enkindled that your songs of praise and glorification to the Desired One reach the Supreme Concourse

Subject: spiritual prerequisites of teaching the Cause
Quotation: They should only be souls who are detached from the world, attracted to the holy fragrances, and in utmost sanctity and purity.

Subject: spiritual prerequisites of teaching the Cause
Quotation: I will pray to God that you may succeed in giving sufficient and healing words, turn to the Holy Spirit, and open your tongue.

Subject: spiritual prerequisites of teaching the Cause
Quotation: When they become successful and confirmed in these attributes, the assistance of the invisible Kingdom of Abha will encompass them.

Subject: spiritual prerequisites of teaching the Cause
Quotation: Be thou engaged in the refinement of souls... Strive that ye may guide one who hath gone astray and give drink to one who thirsteth.

Subject: spiritual prerequisites of teaching the Cause
Quotation: And thou, sanctify thyself from vain desire, then enter the most exalted horizon and follow not those who fly with the wings of passion.

Subject: spiritual prerequisites of teaching the Cause
Quotation: But you must become believing and assured, and the light of the love of God must radiate from you, in order that prayer may take effect.

Subject: spiritual prerequisites of teaching the Cause
Quotation: Therefore, each of the loved ones of God who truly turns to the enduring horizon will be granted that which will enable them to guide humanity.

Subject: spiritual prerequisites of teaching the Cause
Quotation: Now that you have returned to your familiar place, you must be there as a ray of divine bounty and the heat of the Sun of grace of the All-Merciful Lord.

Subject: spiritual prerequisites of teaching the Cause
Quotation: being enkindled; reborn in teaching the Cause: "occupy yourself night and day with diffusing the divine fragrances with perfect steadfastness and firmness"

Subject: spiritual prerequisites of teaching the Cause
Quotation: God hath set the crown of guidance upon thine head, that thou mayest cry out and proclaim the Abha Kingdom in that city and become the cause of guiding souls

Subject: spiritual prerequisites of teaching the Cause
Quotation: Whoso ariseth to teach Our Cause must needs detach himself from all earthly things, and regard, at all times, the triumph of Our Faith as his supreme objective.

Subject: spiritual prerequisites of teaching the Cause
Quotation: Make mention of Him amongst the servants with manifest gentleness... Be thou the cup-bearer of the Kawthar of divine knowledge throughout all contingent being.

Subject: spiritual prerequisites of teaching the Cause
Quotation: Cast aside all that preventeth thee from recognizing God and His Cause...Strive that the clay fragments of the world deprive thee not of the flowers of inner meanings.

Subject: spiritual prerequisites of teaching the Cause
Quotation: rather it requireth divine attraction and spiritual illumination, true knowledge and heavenly tidings, detachment from this mortal world and merciful deeds and actions

Subject: spiritual prerequisites of teaching the Cause
Quotation: Rest thou assured that divine confirmations will reach thee and thou wilt be successful in service, and for this reason thou wilt be assisted by heavenly confirmations.

Subject: spiritual prerequisites of teaching the Cause
Quotation: Do not look to yourselves; look to the Bounty of Baha'o'llah; constantly look to His Favor. Do not say you have not capacity; look to the great bounties of Baha'o'llah.

Subject: spiritual prerequisites of teaching the Cause
Quotation: From its contents and verses, signs of supplication and entreaty were evident. This spiritual melody attracts divine inspirations and is the cause of heavenly confirmations.

Subject: spiritual prerequisites of teaching the Cause
Quotation: One word that emerges from a pure and sanctified heart educates the world of creation and draws it to the court of the Friend. His is the praise and bounty in all conditions.

Subject: spiritual prerequisites of teaching the Cause
Quotation: Strive thou that the dawning-places of love may seek thee out and gather round about thee. It is beloved that thou be called, in the presence of the Face, the father of mankind.

Subject: spiritual prerequisites of teaching the Cause
Quotation: O Sakinih Khatun, by the name of the All-Knowing Speaker! O Sakinih, thou hast heard the call of the Wronged One, before and after, and hast drunk from the choice wine of utterance.

Subject: spiritual prerequisites of teaching the Cause
Quotation: I have inhaled the fragrance of thy sincerity from the gardens of its contents and meanings. I rendered thanks unto God for having confirmed thee in gaining insight and illumination

Subject: spiritual prerequisites of teaching the Cause
Quotation: Yet capacity is required. Pure soil is needed for the rain of mercy to bring forth flowers and sweet herbs, and a pure jewel is required to receive the bounty of the sun of the heavens.

Subject: spiritual prerequisites of teaching the Cause
Quotation: This is not possible unless souls are holy, eloquent and awake day and night, supplicating and imploring. Turn to the Kingdom of ABHA, rely upon Him, then unloosen the tongue and speak!

Subject: spiritual prerequisites of teaching the Cause
Quotation: Be confident in the bounty of the All-Merciful Lord and be ever mindful of the remembrance of the All-Bountiful Beauty. Think day and night of rendering some service at the Sacred Threshold.

Subject: spiritual prerequisites of teaching the Cause
Quotation: O blessed leaf! Praise God that you have grown from the Sacred Tree and are related to the Holy Threshold. Now, in gratitude for this bounty and gift, you must engage in love and faithfulness

Subject: spiritual prerequisites of teaching the Cause
Quotation: This servant, at the threshold of servitude, doth supplicate with the utmost lowliness, pleading and entreaty for heavenly aid and bounty on behalf of that one enkindled with the fire of love.

Subject: spiritual prerequisites of teaching the Cause
Quotation: being a channel for the Holy Spirit in teaching the Cause; being a source of guidance to others: "she hath guided thee to the Divine Kingdom and led thee to the noblest station of the human world"

Subject: spiritual prerequisites of teaching the Cause
Quotation: Description of Vahid who "traveled through the lands, traversing hills and plains, heights and valleys, calling out Your name before all people, and guiding souls to the wellspring of Your mercy"

Subject: spiritual prerequisites of teaching the Cause
Quotation: O thou who art attracted to reality, render thanks unto God that the breeze of bounty hath wafted and the light of guidance hath shone forth, and the pavilion of heart and soul hath been illumined.

Subject: spiritual prerequisites of teaching the Cause
Quotation: Thou art the object of the glance of favor and art encompassed by the glances of the eye of the All-Merciful. Thou dwellest beneath the shade of the Word and holdest fast to the hem of the Lord of Grandeur.

Subject: spiritual prerequisites of teaching the Cause
Quotation: Make the heart pure and spiritual until from it radiates the illumination of the Word of God; and devote thyselves to the work and action which will be the cause of the awakening and education of the people.

Subject: spiritual prerequisites of teaching the Cause
Quotation: Every man wishing to turn his face to the Supreme Horizon must purify his inside and outside and abstain from what is forbidden in the Book of God. He ought to consider everything besides God as a handful of dust.

Subject: spiritual prerequisites of teaching the Cause
Quotation: Therefore, strive within thyself lest thy feet slip from this exalted and extended Path. And if thou findest a pure heart, cast upon it what We have cast upon thee; otherwise, conceal it with the utmost concealment.

Subject: spiritual prerequisites of teaching the Cause
Quotation: Blessed are they who have not deprived themselves of the outpourings of the All-Bountiful Lord... O people of God! With pure hearts advance ye toward the praiseworthy station and turn ye to the Most Exalted Horizon.

Subject: spiritual prerequisites of teaching the Cause
Quotation: When the friends do not endeavour to spread the message, they fail to remember God befittingly, and will not witness the tokens of assistance and confirmation from the Abha Kingdom nor comprehend the divine mysteries.

Subject: spiritual prerequisites of teaching the Cause
Quotation: Yet we should strive as far as possible, for "that which cannot be fully achieved should not be wholly renounced". I cherish the hope that, through the boundless favors of the All-Glorious, thou mayest attain unto both.

Subject: spiritual prerequisites of teaching the Cause
Quotation: This is what the Tongue of Grandeur spoke: O thou who hast turned thy face towards My horizon, who art mentioned in My court and inscribed in My Book by the Pen of My will, and who dost soar in the atmosphere of My love!

Subject: spiritual prerequisites of teaching the Cause
Quotation: Today, all rising and sitting, movement and rest, should be manifested for the sake of God. Ye should aid the Cause of God through the hosts of remembrance and utterance, and through deeds and conduct befitting the Day of God.

Subject: spiritual prerequisites of teaching the Cause
Quotation: Practice pure righteousness and harbor no thoughts save of God, and block not the flowing spring of the illumined heart with the thorns of greed and passion, and hold not back the flowing fountain of the heart from its course.

Subject: spiritual prerequisites of teaching the Cause
Quotation: O physician! Observe now how this pure gem hath become sullied with the dust of vain imaginings and through the tyranny of the ignorant hath reached such a state that it hath become the cause of enmity between the servants of God.

Subject: spiritual prerequisites of teaching the Cause
Quotation: they are well-informed of the mysteries of the world of being; that they raise such a call in their glorification and praise of the Greatest Name as to cause the inmates of the Fanes of the Kingdom to become attracted and overjoyed

Subject: spiritual prerequisites of teaching the Cause
Quotation: Consider that the most important of all things is the guidance of souls and the exaltation of the Word of God. You must at all times direct your gaze toward the Kingdom of God and engage in that which is conducive to the guidance of souls.

Subject: spiritual prerequisites of teaching the Cause
Quotation: If like Abraham I must enter the fire/Or like John offer my blood on Your path/If like Joseph You cast me in well and prison/Or like Jesus son of Mary make me poor/I'll not turn my head or turn from You/For Your command I offer soul and body

Subject: spiritual prerequisites of teaching the Cause
Quotation: thou mayest thyself become a speaking letter from 'Abdu'l-Baha, so that in the gatherings of the friends, like the Bird of Paradise, with the most wondrous melodies thou mayest be occupied with praise and glorification of the All-Merciful Lord

Subject: spiritual prerequisites of teaching the Cause
Quotation: Let your words be so sincere and your manner so convincing as to attract the listeners to the Kingdom of God. Let the exaltation of the Cause of God be your supreme concern. Like unto the lamps give light to all those who come in touch with you.

Subject: spiritual prerequisites of teaching the Cause
Quotation: Be submissive and humble before the handmaidens of the All-Merciful, and be an example to women who are attracted to the spirit of sanctification and detachment, and a goodly model of heavenly attributes through the spirit of divine confirmation.

Subject: spiritual prerequisites of teaching the Cause
Quotation: Adorn the temples of the friends with the ornament of the mention of the Intended One of all possibility. Say: Know ye your worth and recognize your stations. At all times hold fast unto the Strong Cord, for the cawing of devils hath been raised.

Subject: spiritual prerequisites of teaching the Cause
Quotation: When she drew nigh to the Tree of Thy divinity and sought refuge in its leaves, and held fast to its branches and found shade beneath it and tasted of its fruits, she journeyed unto it and migrated with it toward it until she reached its nearness.

Subject: spiritual prerequisites of teaching the Cause
Quotation: God willing, may the friends of God ever be gathered together, engaged in the remembrance and praise of the Truth. First they must seek to remedy whatever they observe that causes division, and then engage in service with joy, fragrance and wisdom.

Subject: spiritual prerequisites of teaching the Cause
Quotation: "The believers must not expect anything from one another; they must expect only from Baha'O'llah. If they are sad they must not express it. When they see each other, they must feel the vibration of the heat. That is the condition of being a Bahai."

Subject: spiritual prerequisites of teaching the Cause
Quotation: Make firm thy steps in the Cause of God, trust in God, rely upon the jealous Lord, and be confident in the bounty of thy Master. Verily, He will confirm thee and prosper thee in all things, and grant thee from His bounty until thou art well-pleased.

Subject: spiritual prerequisites of teaching the Cause
Quotation: O My Name! Be steadfast in the Cause, then remind the people of that which the Spirit hath inspired thee. If thou findest one receptive, turn to him; if thou findest one thou turneth away, turn from him. Fear not, but put thy trust in God, thy Lord.

Subject: spiritual prerequisites of teaching the Cause
Quotation: I desire that you may be filled with Baha'u'llah. You must concentrate all your ideas and thoughts around the promotion of the Word of God. Just as the cup is filled with the wine, so thy heart must be overflowed with the Love of the Blessed Perfection.

Subject: spiritual prerequisites of teaching the Cause
Quotation: They departed from here with utmost sincerity of purpose and devotion to Baha'u'llah...Every soul who gives up his own thoughts and desires and mingles with the people with utmost sincerity, such an one is surrounded by the Hosts of the Supreme Concourse

Subject: spiritual prerequisites of teaching the Cause
Quotation: In generous conformity with Baha'o'llah's teachings that "our words should not exceed our deeds," he left twenty golden sovereigns and many handfuls of silver with Colonel Spencer of the Army, so that the poor might enjoy a similar dinner New Year's night.

Subject: spiritual prerequisites of teaching the Cause
Quotation: One must first drink from the chalice of divine knowledge oneself before teaching others: "take thou the chalice of divine knowledge in the name of thy Lord, the All-Merciful, and drink therefrom first, then give to drink them that dwell in the realm of possibility"

Subject: spiritual prerequisites of teaching the Cause
Quotation: The first sign of faith is trustworthiness. He who has no trustworthiness has no faith. Man must be trustworthy - all souls must trust in his dealings, trust in his honesty, trust in his fairness, trust that he will not oppress. If man has no religion, he has no trustworthiness.

Subject: spiritual prerequisites of teaching the Cause
Quotation: If thou desirest confirmation from all directions, loose thy tongue to spread divine proofs. Make the sightless eyes to see and rend asunder the veil of the heedless ones' estrangement. Awaken those who slumber and open the gates of knowledge before the faces of the ignorant ones

Subject: spiritual prerequisites of teaching the Cause
Quotation: Today every soul is commanded to invite the people of the contingent world to the Truth through wisdom and utterance, and to arise with supreme steadfastness in the Cause of the Lord of Names - an arising that no sitting down shall overtake and no cawing of the polytheists shall disturb.

Subject: spiritual prerequisites of teaching the Cause
Quotation: Leave, then, the people to God and to that which hath been sent down in the Bayan and be not of those who fear. Say: O people! Fear God and follow His precepts with both your inner and outer being and been not of the negligent, lest negligence debar you from each Court of divine nearness.

Subject: spiritual prerequisites of teaching the Cause
Quotation: Now that you are returning to your respective homes you must be like unto the ignited candles and set aglow the hearts of all the believers. Now like unto a company of tuneful birds you must sing every melody...May each one of you shine upon each city through which you pass as a radiant star!

Subject: spiritual prerequisites of teaching the Cause
Quotation: Although in this earthly world the arena is exceedingly confined, and the knights of the field and the standard-bearers from Our presence are without means and limited in speech - nevertheless, loose thy tongue and occupy thyself with praise, glorification and attributes of the Peerless Beauty

Subject: spiritual prerequisites of teaching the Cause
Quotation: Now return to India and occupy thyself with diffusing the holy fragrances among the diverse peoples. Divine confirmations shall surely encompass thee and infinite heavenly favors shall unveil their countenance. In all affairs thou shalt witness the signs of the bounty of the All-Forgiving Lord.

Subject: spiritual prerequisites of teaching the Cause
Quotation: Whatever that honored person requires of you, accept it - there is no harm in this. Deliver the enclosed letter to him and say that the assistance and favor of the Most High depends upon and is conditional on perfect wisdom in the fellowship of one or two holy souls, and avoiding heedless and hostile persons.

Subject: spiritual prerequisites of teaching the Cause
Quotation: O servant of God, show forth effort, gird up thy loins, and aim for a station higher than the heavens. O servant of God, the swift steed is ready, the vast arena lies before thee, the ball of success awaits, and the mallet of grace is in thy hand - it is time to gallop forth and seize the ball from the field.

Subject: spiritual prerequisites of teaching the Cause
Quotation: Fear God, O people, and be not among the wrongdoers. Fear God, O people, and be not among the transgressors. Be not like the heedless Shi'ih party who would first lament from the pulpit the oppression of the Letters of the Furqan, and then at the end would curse the Chief of those Letters and decree His death.

Subject: spiritual prerequisites of teaching the Cause
Quotation: "Therefore you must render thanksgiving unto the Lord of mankind that ye are in the utmost state of joy and happiness and that God through his own mercy hath chosen you and granted you entrance into his divine Kingdom. The value of His bestowal is not known at present; it will become appreciated in the future."

Subject: spiritual prerequisites of teaching the Cause
Quotation: Hear with the ear of the spirit the call of Him Who summons to the All-Merciful. His call is today the sweet water of life for the bodies of all beings. By the Lord of all possibility, if all who are on earth were to attain but one drop thereof, all would turn, living and enduring, toward the Object of worship.

Subject: spiritual prerequisites of teaching the Cause
Quotation: The confirmations of the Holy Spirit are obtained by attractions of the heart. Without these attractions, the former is unobtainable. The proof of this is evident. The teacher himself must be set aglow, attracted and zealous. If he possess these states, surely will he thereby attract the confirmation of the Holy Spirit.

Subject: spiritual prerequisites of teaching the Cause
Quotation: Turn your gaze away from that which is fleeting and transitory, whether little or much, and fix your eyes upon the ocean that hath neither beginning nor end. Rather, with firm resolve, steadfast hearts, penetrating vision and the light of certitude, appear amongst men with the utmost trustworthiness and goodly character.

Subject: spiritual prerequisites of teaching the Cause
Quotation: The Bahai must first be informed of the Principles and teaching of BAHA'O'LLAH, then go forth and spread the Message. It is like unto a soldier, who must arm himself with the buckler and armor, and then he enters the battlefield to fight against the foe. But if he goes to fight without arming himself, he will be defeated.

Subject: spiritual prerequisites of teaching the Cause
Quotation: I hope that you may become baptized with the Fire of the Love of God and the Water of the Holy Spirit, and that each of you may become a Divine Farmer and sow in the farm of humanity the seeds of reality, irrigating them with the Waters of the Teachings of Baha'u'llah, so that the Light of Truth may illumine that country.

Subject: spiritual prerequisites of teaching the Cause
Quotation: O leaf of the All-Merciful! You are ever remembered in this presence and renowned among the handmaidens of God for your firmness and steadfastness. I hope that through God's grace and favor you will be so enkindled with the fire of the love of God that you will set ablaze and attract all the maidservants of the All-Merciful

Subject: spiritual prerequisites of teaching the Cause
Quotation: I beseech the True One to raise thee up in such a state that thou mayest be restless and impatient, that thou mayest surge and roar like the sea, and that, like a fire, thou mayest blaze forth and flame up. May thy tongue become eloquent in the mention and praise of God, and thine ear attentive to the call of the All-Merciful.

Subject: spiritual prerequisites of teaching the Cause
Quotation: In the dawn of creation and the daybreak of invention, a divine light shone forth with such brilliance that its rays spread throughout all regions. But alas, a hundred times alas, that the blind did not see it, and a thousand regrets that the veiled ones did not behold it. Therefore, ask ye of God that ye may see with your own eyes

Subject: spiritual prerequisites of teaching the Cause
Quotation: This will only be possible when thou art detached from worldly ties by donning the garment of sanctity and confining all thy thoughts and remembrances to the mention of God, diffusing divine fragrances, performing good deeds, awakening the heedless, healing the blind, deaf and mute, and reviving the dead through the power of the Spirit.

Subject: spiritual prerequisites of teaching the Cause
Quotation: And when he determineth to leave his home, for the sake of the Cause of his Lord, let him put his whole trust in God, as the best provision for his journey, and array himself with the robe of virtue. When he is enkindled with the fire of His love and adorned with the ornament of detachment, his words shall set ablaze those that hear him.

Subject: spiritual prerequisites of teaching the Cause
Quotation: O my friend, isolate all thy faculties and senses from every other mention and thought, and follow the example of Abdul-Baha in servitude to the Holy and Exalted Threshold. Hasten to the field of sacrifice, craving for the most great martyrdom; expend thy life and all of thy grades in love for God and in attraction to the Beauty of El-ABHA.

Subject: spiritual prerequisites of teaching the Cause
Quotation: True sweetness and delight lie in divine guidance and spiritual attraction. Every sweetness ultimately turns to bitterness, and every delight ends in sorrow, except the sweetness of God's guidance which increases with the passage of time and recurring days - its intensity and potency grow stronger and become ever sweeter to the palate and taste.

Subject: spiritual prerequisites of teaching the Cause
Quotation: I declare by him beside whom there is nought else, if we live in accord with one of the teachings we will become radiant like unto this lamp. If we confess verbally that Baha'o'llah's principles are the cause of eternal salvation and the means of nearness unto the throne of God and yet do not live according to their instructions we are not Bahais.

Subject: spiritual prerequisites of teaching the Cause
Quotation: Hearken, O handmaiden who art extinguished in the ocean of faithfulness, if thou art of the devoted ones! Turn not to anyone except God if thou art of those who draw nigh. Gaze upon the countenance of Beauty if thou art of those who witness, and testify in thy heart that verily He is the Truth, there is no God but Him, and be not of the corrupt ones.

Subject: spiritual prerequisites of teaching the Cause
Quotation: A teacher of the Cause is in need of 3 attributes. 1st severance, sanctity and purity, 2d The mention of the Lord of the worlds must be his constant companion. 3d Knowledge, wisdom, vision and inspiration. Then he can create a new soul and fashion a new heart in the body of man. Then he will be enabled to show others the path of attraction and severance.

Subject: spiritual prerequisites of teaching the Cause
Quotation: A teacher must be a joy-carrier and a moral purifier. He must be living in a spiritual condition, inhale the roses of attraction, quaff the cup of sanctity and drink the wine of independence. His spiritual life must be contagious - so that whosoever associates with him may become affected, leave his materialism and be robed with the garment of spirituality.

Subject: spiritual prerequisites of teaching the Cause
Quotation: But about the supernatural power: Without advancing toward the Kingdom of ABHA, it is impossible and inaccessible. But should a soul enter under the shadow of the Blessed Perfection, step into the divine Kingdom, act according to the councils and exhortations of God and practice the New Teachings, unquestionably he will become endowed with a supernatural power.

Subject: spiritual prerequisites of teaching the Cause
Quotation: if thou goest according to the teachings of El-Abd and followest the steps of Him who is annihilated in God, thou shalt see that the cohorts of the kingdom of God will come to thy help, one after another, and that the hosts of the Might of God will be in thy presence in steady succession, the gates of the great victory opened and the rays of the brilliant morning diffused!

Subject: spiritual prerequisites of teaching the Cause
Quotation: Today every soul who deals with the people with the utmost humility and submission, is kind and showing love to them, is considering them the members and limbs of one temple, receiving the stranger as the friend, the remote one as the near one, and is occupied in their guidance, the power of the Word of God will make time as a conquering army and an angel with far-reaching voice.

Subject: spiritual prerequisites of teaching the Cause
Quotation: Rest assured that the breathings of the Holy Spirit will loosen thy tongue. Speak, therefore; speak out with great courage at every meeting. When thou art about to begin thine address, turn first to Baha'u'llah, and ask for the confirmations of the Holy Spirit, then open thy lips and say whatever is suggested to thy heart; this, however, with the utmost courage, dignity and conviction.

Subject: spiritual prerequisites of teaching the Cause
Quotation: After the Dawning-places of sanctity became companions and intimates of pain and tribulation and the target of curse and reproach, we must follow the chosen ones - we must not become sorrowful from any calamity nor become grief-stricken. Rather, we must strive with our souls so that the gift of the Lord may encompass all creation and all eyes may be illumined by the light of guidance.

Subject: spiritual prerequisites of teaching the Cause
Quotation: O thou who art steadfast and established and confirmed through the bounty of God!...Roar like a lion, O lion of God! I swear by the face and hair of that veiled Beloved that in those very lands, through the aid and favor of the Ancient Beauty (may my spirit be sacrificed for the dust of His threshold), such a fire of the love of God will blaze forth that its flames will reach to the zenith of heaven

Subject: spiritual prerequisites of teaching the Cause
Quotation: O bondsmaid of the True One...receive the Kawthar of meaning from the hand of the divine Youth and quaff it, and close thine eye to the whole world, for sight is created to behold the beauty of the Beloved, and heart has been brought into being for His recognition. If they do not attain that great honour, they would be fruitless, and like unto a dark lamp they would be useless and without any worth.

Subject: spiritual prerequisites of teaching the Cause
Quotation: Therefore, it is very necessary at first to treat such trees very mildly and take much care of them until they become very strong, solid and firm. Consequently the guides and teachers who are in charge of this field must first deny themselves and practice chastity, purity, and love all sincerely, cut their hearts from the world and not care for the comforts of their bodies or for any other worldly thing.

Subject: spiritual prerequisites of teaching the Cause
Quotation: You must conduct yourself with the utmost kindness and compassion, and call the people with wisdom, lest anyone act unwisely and cause disturbance among the weak ones. This matter is most essential. In the previous year, many acted unwisely and caused an uproar among the polytheists. By the life of God, had the friends acted according to what God ordained, you would surely have witnessed the earth transformed.

Subject: spiritual prerequisites of teaching the Cause
Quotation: for the teacher himself must be infinitely affected at the time of teaching so that his words may have the effect of a flame of fire and burn away the veils of self and desire. And he must be in the utmost humility and submissiveness so that others may be awakened, and he must be in the utmost evanescence and self-effacement so that he may teach with the melody of the Concourse on High - otherwise it will have no effect

Subject: spiritual prerequisites of teaching the Cause
Quotation: We beseech God to protect His servants and handmaidens from association and fellowship with the polytheists, both men and women. Today the Holy Spirit is present before all faces, and the Most Great Spirit is manifest and speaking above the nations, while the Maidens of Paradise on high, with wondrous and sweet melodies, give glad-tidings to the handmaidens of the earth of the supreme horizon, the most exalted Summit, and the utmost Goal.

Subject: spiritual prerequisites of teaching the Cause
Quotation: You have always been in my thoughts and we are accustomed to remembering you. The days of our meeting have not been forgotten - your face and countenance are ever before my eyes. From the Kingdom of Verses I seek confirmations that day by day you may become more gracious and sweeter, that through the sweetness of the love of God you may sweeten others' palates, and that you may become the cause of firmness and steadfastness of the precious friends

Subject: spiritual prerequisites of teaching the Cause
Quotation: Journey, O people, with your hearts and not your feet... Say: those who have forsaken their selves and journeyed towards God and entered paradise - the abode where the Beauty of the All-Merciful was seated upon the Throne of His Name, the Most Mighty, the Great - and were honored by attaining the presence of the All-Glorious, and the glance of God, the King, the Powerful, the Almighty, the All-Knowing turned towards them; they have, verily, attained unto all good.

Subject: spiritual prerequisites of teaching the Cause
Quotation: Any soul who speaketh a word that would cause fear among the people of the earth or would suggest opposition to kings and others - all must move with wisdom and utterance, and with the utmost righteousness and good conduct, detached from corruption, they must be known and remembered in the lands in the name of the Creator. Especially those souls who have returned from the Sacred Presence must act with perfect courtesy, both outer and inner, and with the revealed wisdom among the people.

Subject: spiritual prerequisites of teaching the Cause
Quotation: The divine table, which is an expression of divine knowledge, has descended from the Kingdom of God and has spread to all regions. But those who were invited did not respond to the call due to their ignorance, heedlessness, pride and arrogance. Praise be to God, we have answered the call and attended the table, partaking of those delicious spiritual foods and enjoying this bounty by which spirits are given life. And we shall host nations and tribes at this table which is the life of the world.

Subject: spiritual prerequisites of teaching the Cause
Quotation: A Baha'i teacher should have sociability and affability. He should be the essence of sanctity and holiness. He should have conversance. He himself should have been affected by the divine teachings. He should have knowledge and should be informed. His heart should be a treasury of the jewels of the love of God. His soul should be vibrated by the fragrances of God. He should be the embodiment of human attributes and divine attributes. He should possess the faculty of self-explanation and illustrations. He should be eloquent and fluent.

Subject: spiritual prerequisites of teaching the Cause
Quotation: The disciples of Christ forgot themselves and all earthly things, forsook all their cares and belongings, purged themselves of self and passion, and with absolute detachment scattered far and wide and engaged in calling the peoples of the world to divine guidance; till at last they made the world another world, illumined the surface of the earth, and even to their last hour proved self-sacrificing in the pathway of that Beloved One of God. Finally in various lands they suffered glorious martyrdom. Let them that are men of action follow in their footsteps!

Subject: spiritual prerequisites of teaching the Cause
Quotation: The first implement, the most essential one, is severance. Severance means that the heart must be detached from the things of the world. The second implement is the love of GOD. This is the great implement. The third implement is the knowledge of GOD. When the servant becomes awakened to the knowledge of GOD and confirmed therein, then he can teach. The fourth implement is endeavor. The servant must endeavor. Without endeavor he can accomplish nothing. The fifth implement is praiseworthy attributes. The teacher must be adorned with infinite virtues, and his attributes must be radiant. The sixth implement is eloquence. The servant must be possessed of eloquence.

Subject: spiritual springtime
Quotation: O loved ones of God! The divine Faith is in its youth, and the wondrous Cause is in the springtime of a new age. This is the beginning of the first cycle, and this century is the chosen century of the one true God. The horizons of contingent being are illumined by the manifestations of the Sun at the zenith of divine knowledge, and the East and West of the world are perfumed and made fragrant by holy and sanctified breezes. The countenance of the new creation appears with utmost beauty and grace, and the temple of the wondrous Cause stands in the fullness of might and freshness.

Subject: spiritual springtime
Quotation: Dost thou not observe how the bounty of the spring rain quickens the black earth, makes the withered tree green and beautiful, nay rather, makes the pure dust the envy of the celestial sphere?

Subject: spiritual springtime
Quotation: The divine springtime has arrived, the season of the flower garden has come, and the time for strolling in the rose garden has begun.

Subject: spiritual springtime
Quotation: That region and territory will soon become a garden of mysteries, and that land will become a supreme paradise. That country will become illumined and that realm will become a heaven of delight.

Subject: spiritual springtime
Quotation: Whatsoever is latent in the innermost of this holy cycle, shall gradually appear and be made manifest, for now is but the beginning of its growth and the dayspring of the revelation of its signs.

Subject: spiritual springtime
Quotation: The spiritual springtime has made the world fresh and new, and the divine springtide has caused the garden of inner meanings to flourish and become adorned with flowers and blossoms. The human saplings in the divine garden have attained infinite delicacy and freshness.

Subject: spiritual springtime
Quotation: The spring breeze and the clouds of March renew the outer world by God's command, exalted be His glory. However, today a different decree has come and a different command. The world of reality has been adorned by the breezes of the divine spring and the rain-clouds of God's wondrous bounty. The nightingales of divine knowledge warble upon the branches.

Subject: spiritual springtime
Quotation: O ye heedless ones, awaken! For the fragrances from the rose-garden of Abha are wafting, and the breezes from the gardens of the Supreme Concourse are blowing. The ancient lights are shining forth in this darksome night, the outpourings of the Most Great Unity are descending from the clouds of bounty, and the waves of the Most Great Sea are surging upon the shores of humanity.

Subject: spiritual springtime
Quotation: At this time when favorable winds are blowing from the direction of divine favor and the breezes of the Abha Kingdom are wafting, if the ship of being does not reach the shore of its goal, in what time will it find the haven of salvation? And if man does not find wealth and prosperity from this endless treasure, in what age will he become prosperous and see perpetual riches? And if the sapling of hope does not become verdant and flourishing through the merciful breezes in this glorious age, in this spiritual springtime, and if it does not receive freshness and grace from the April showers of bounty, in what season will it grow tender leaves, adorn the garden's expanse with blossoms, and yield fresh fruits?

Subject: spiritual springtime
Quotation: In this divine season and merciful springtime you have been gathered together and become renowned. Therefore, through God's aid, you must become wholly blossoming and manifest among the people with the goodly fruits of divine characteristics, becoming renowned thereby.

Subject: spiritual springtime
Quotation: The outward spring, which is charged with the nurturing of all visible things by the command of the Creator of Names, appeareth but once a year, and likewise the spiritual spring, which traineth spirits and illumined hearts and bestoweth eternal and everlasting life, doth appear but once in a thousand years or more

Subject: spiritual springtime
Quotation: The weeping of the clouds of Bahman (January) is followed by the laughter of rose gardens and meadows, and greenery and freshness and blossoms and flowers and fragrant herbs appear in succession... For Bahman and Isfand (February-March) lead to the pleasing Farvardin, when the bounties of the spiritual springtime appear and the outpourings of the All-Merciful are unveiled

Subject: spiritual springtime
Quotation: This time of the world may be likened to the equinoctial in the annual cycle. For, verily, this is the spring season of God... At the time of the vernal equinox in the material world a wonderful vibrant energy and new life-quickening is observed everywhere in the vegetable kingdom; the animal and human kingdoms are resuscitated and move forward with a new impulse. The whole world is born anew, resurrected... Likewise, the spiritual bounty and springtime of God quicken the world of humanity with a new animus and vivification.

Subject: spiritual transformation
Quotation: when one is steadfast, fire becomes light.

Subject: spiritual transformation
Quotation: Strive and endeavor to draw closer to God day by day.

Subject: spiritual transformation
Quotation: make human souls into heavenly angels through divine guidance

Subject: spiritual transformation
Quotation: awakened and become aware of the appearance of the Lord of Hosts

Subject: spiritual transformation
Quotation: cast it upon the brass and iron of souls to transform them into pure gold

Subject: spiritual transformation
Quotation: victorious and triumphant in resistance against the hosts of self and desire

Subject: spiritual transformation
Quotation: thou hast turned from the realm of darkness unto the sanctified realm of light

Subject: spiritual transformation
Quotation: Thou didst remove the veil from before him so that he beheld Thy greatest signs

Subject: spiritual transformation
Quotation: He made ready the honey of love and faithfulness for the sting of enmity and hatred

Subject: spiritual transformation
Quotation: He may make thee a sign of faith and illumine thy heart with the light of assurance

Subject: spiritual transformation
Quotation: My hope is that thou mayest become the cause of guidance to stranger and friend alike

Subject: spiritual transformation
Quotation: this creation, which is the means for the advancement of stations in the appointed Day

Subject: spiritual transformation
Quotation: Therefore strive thou and be enkindled until thou attainest seeing eyes and hearing ears

Subject: spiritual transformation
Quotation: Rejoice in that thou hast turned unto Him when every polytheist and doubter turned away.

Subject: spiritual transformation
Quotation: This valor shall ultimately yield the everlasting kingdom and conquer the realm of heaven.

Subject: spiritual transformation
Quotation: I beseech and implore from the Abha Kingdom that thou mayest be quickened with a new spirit

Subject: spiritual transformation
Quotation: "observe how the mystic must draw from the divine sea to become a true and profound mystic"

Subject: spiritual transformation
Quotation: Cleanse me from defilement; turn my ease into pain; Roll up at last the scroll of remoteness.

Subject: spiritual transformation
Quotation: strive with all your might and determination to acquire both outward and spiritual perfections

Subject: spiritual transformation
Quotation: Kindle a flame in the horizons of the hearts, and light a lamp in the glass of contingent being.

Subject: spiritual transformation
Quotation: You have been baptized with the water of life, the fire of the love of God, and the Holy Spirit

Subject: spiritual transformation
Quotation: And if that second person is also conscious and repentant, return unto Us is easier than slumber

Subject: spiritual transformation
Quotation: This is the Day whereon Pharaoh was drowned and Moses beheld the Beauty of God, the Most Glorious

Subject: spiritual transformation
Quotation: Thereby is the crooked branch made straight, and the thorny thicket transformed into a rose-garden.

Subject: spiritual transformation
Quotation: Lord! Their origin was pure, their inner beings were refined, and their consciences were illumined.

Subject: spiritual transformation
Quotation: "She is truly breathing into you the spirit of eternal life, which is the teachings of Baha'u'llah."

Subject: spiritual transformation
Quotation: the pure spirit be adorned with the vestment of glad tidings that it may return to the spiritual Canaan

Subject: spiritual transformation
Quotation: penetration of the Cause into the "veins and nerves of the world" enabling new possibilities for women

Subject: spiritual transformation
Quotation: The overall message encourages spiritual insight and transformation through understanding divine guidance

Subject: spiritual transformation
Quotation: Thou hast kindled in thy heart a fire from the flame of Moses and burned away the veil of self and desire.

Subject: spiritual transformation
Quotation: yet most men are asleep...Remember thy Lord amongst His servants, that perchance the slumberers may awaken

Subject: spiritual transformation
Quotation: This new Joseph hath been delivered from the well of heedlessness by the Leader of the Most Great Guidance.
