Quotation: This is a Book sent down in truth for whosoever taketh unto Him a way, that the verses of God may draw him to a station wherein he ariseth to serve the Cause and remindeth the people of that which draweth them nigh unto Him on a Day illumined by the lights of His countenance.

Subject: spiritual transformation
Quotation: O noble Branch of the Divine Lote-Tree... may at all times be stirred and quickened by the holy fragrances of the All-Merciful, and be fresh and verdant, and be gladdened and expanded through the breezes of the gardens of beauty and the sweet-scented breaths of God's paradise.

Subject: spiritual transformation
Quotation: You became intoxicated from the cup of glad tidings of the Exalted One and were moved to ecstasy by the wine of love for the Abha Beauty. You became a bright candle in the assembly of lovers and perfumed your nostrils with the holy fragrances from the gardens of the Covenant.

Subject: spiritual transformation
Quotation: Thou didst become a precious gem and a unique pearl, for thou didst obtain thy brilliance and delicacy from the light of the love of the Sun of Truth. This is a light that transformeth crude pebbles into precious pearls and worthless pottery into precious pearls of great price.

Subject: spiritual transformation
Quotation: When the Luminary of the Concourse on High became the Ornament of the Supreme Assembly, a tumult seized the pillars of the world and a quaking shook the foundations of nations. For it was decreed that "He maketh your highest to become lowest, and your lowest to become highest."

Subject: spiritual transformation
Quotation: The struggle which Jesus experienced was that between the higher and lower selves. In this struggle Jesus perceived that the things of the senses and the world are impermanent and futile. He conquered his lower nature, and his higher self-that which was of God-became ascendant.

Subject: spiritual transformation
Quotation: That is to say one must be born again - born of the spirit. Every soul who is spiritually born - through the assistance of the Holy-Spirit - that soul which receives the Breath of the Holy Spirit will have an upward journey and attain to a lofty station in the spiritual world.

Subject: spiritual transformation
Quotation: Your hearts are illuminated, your inner vision clear. Your spirit rejoiced in the glad tidings of the Kingdom of God. The world must be rejuvenated. Eternal life must be made possible. The rays of the Kingdom must shine forth. The breath of the Holy Spirit can quicken the dead.

Subject: spiritual transformation
Quotation: The loved ones of Truth are cold to fire and dry to water - meaning their affairs are wholly different from the affairs of the people of the world. In every transaction, the profit is with them, to which every discerning heedless one and every fair-minded hearer beareth witness.

Subject: spiritual transformation
Quotation: Through heavenly training... thou hast obtained thy brilliance and delicacy from the light of the love of the Sun of Truth. This is a light that transformeth the coarse pebble into a precious jewel, and changeth worthless clay into a pearl of great price within a precious shell.

Subject: spiritual transformation
Quotation: When one sets his face toward this station and yearns for this rank, all existence stands beneath its shade. What need then of house and home? For every divine bird, hearts are the nest and shelter; it makes its dwelling in hearts and takes up residence in the innermost spirits.

Subject: spiritual transformation
Quotation: You became detached from self and desire, and longed to behold the peerless Beauty. You have turned away from all save God, hastened to the blessed valley, recognized the blessed Tree, witnessed the flame and light of the kindled Fire, heard the divine call, and reached your goal.

Subject: spiritual transformation
Quotation: till these frenzied beasts change to gazelles in the meadows of oneness, and these wolves to lambs of God, and these brutish creatures to angelic hosts; till the fires of hatred are quenched, and the flame coming out of the sheltered vale of the Holy Shrine doth shed its splendors

Subject: spiritual transformation
Quotation: Come, let us rend our garments and, like those mad with love, become notorious throughout the world for our love of the Most Glorious Beauty. Let us become wandering and possessed, free and infamous, that we may kindle a fire of the Most Glorious Beauty in the pole of the horizons.

Subject: spiritual transformation
Quotation: Before anyone can comprehend all the Most Beautiful Names of God and all His Supreme Attributes - which none can enumerate - if thou dost comprehend the stations of Unity, thou hast comprehended them all, for all were guided by their guidance at the inception of that Manifestation.

Subject: spiritual transformation
Quotation: Divine favors encompass your condition and heavenly bestowals are directed towards you. Strive that from this mighty grace and ancient bounty fruits may appear from the tree of your being that will sweeten the taste of the spiritually-minded and delight the palate of the godly ones.

Subject: spiritual transformation
Quotation: like unto a bird of the Garden of Eternity, spread thy wings and take flight from this dark cage to the most exalted Summit and the Abha Kingdom, that thou mayest become familiar with the mysteries of the Realm of Power and attain awareness and knowledge of the realities of Lordship

Subject: spiritual transformation
Quotation: The occurrence of fatigue from the excess of work and business in this transient world is itself an evidence of turning to the kingdom of God. This is the first fragrance from the merciful one that refreshes one's nostrils, this is the first attraction which illuminates one's heart.

Subject: spiritual transformation
Quotation: I hope that the highest spirituality may be attained and that the spring of divine knowledge may well up in your hearts. May your tongues become eloquent in praise of the Kind Beloved, and may your hearts become as rose gardens of mysteries through the love of the Most Merciful Lord.

Subject: spiritual transformation
Quotation: God has ordained stations for His loved ones in all ranks and conditions, and He has called them to striving and seeking that He might bestow upon them that which they desire. He has commanded them to manifest qualities, behaviors and deeds that attract the hearts of the monotheists.

Subject: spiritual transformation
Quotation: You too should praise the Pure God that you have become a heavenly army, have come under the divine banner, have placed upon your heads a crown of God's love, and have attained to the diadem of nobility in both worlds. This sovereignty is endless and this glory is in the hidden world.

Subject: spiritual transformation
Quotation: O handmaiden of God! On the Day of Splendor, certain handmaidens became attracted to the lights of the Orb of the horizons, and in response to "Am I not your Lord?" they raised the cry of "Yea!" to the seven spheres. They experienced rapture and joy, and found eagerness and enthusiasm.

Subject: spiritual transformation
Quotation: When these two lights are kindled, human reality is freed from worldly darkness and becomes adorned and radiant with the effulgent lights of divine characteristics... souls may progress day by day until they associate with people [with qualities] that are the ornament of human reality

Subject: spiritual transformation
Quotation: In truth, should any soul truly hearken to the utterance of the All-Merciful, he will find himself detached and freed from the world and all who dwell therein, and will become so enkindled by the fire of the Word that its effects shall become manifest and evident throughout all regions.

Subject: spiritual transformation
Quotation: This Dove hath states and melodies at this moment with God that the ears of the unitarians cannot bear to hear - how much less the ears wherein is the cotton of heedlessness. They shall never hear, and if they hear they hear naught save the utterances of the polytheists from their likes.

Subject: spiritual transformation
Quotation: I pray that ye may at all times drink of the wine of inner meanings from the chalice of the All-Merciful's bounty...whosoever drinketh thereof shall be freed from the idle fancies and vain imaginings of men, and, detached from all else, shall turn his face toward the Most Exalted Horizon.

Subject: spiritual transformation
Quotation: Now, with moistened mind and perfumed spirit, return to Iran as a new creation. Through divine aid and favor we must be raised up with the essence of sanctification and the reality of detachment, so that we become holy signs of the Ancient Beauty and clear proofs of the Most Great Cycle.

Subject: spiritual transformation
Quotation: Through divine bounty, it is hoped that day by day you will make infinite progress in spiritual perfections, so that the page of the heart will, through the intensity of its purity, reflect the lights of the Supreme Concourse and you will manifest divine characteristics in the human world.

Subject: spiritual transformation
Quotation: O thou maidservant who art stirred by divine love! The women of the world are all like lost sheep in the wilderness, without guidance or direction. But thou hast found the heavenly Shepherd and entered His blessed flock. Thou art under divine protection and art aware of heavenly mysteries.

Subject: spiritual transformation
Quotation: The time has come for you to don the garment of innovation and put on a new robe and place upon your head a blessed crown. This glorious diadem is the crown of being set ablaze with the fire of the love of God, and this new garment is the robe of being enkindled with the remembrance of God.

Subject: spiritual transformation
Quotation: Salutations and praise be upon the ears that have heard this Call, and upon the souls that have drunk of this crimson wine and become intoxicated from this cup brimming with the outpourings of God, and have arisen with all their powers to diffuse the divine fragrances throughout all regions

Subject: spiritual transformation
Quotation: Though that illustrious branch was severed from the garden of contingent being, yet it became joined to the divine Lote-Tree and flourished fresh and verdant in the garden of the placeless. It was watered from the spring of Tasnim and stirred by breezes from the gardens of the Abha Kingdom.

Subject: spiritual transformation
Quotation: I have read thy letter which voiced praise of thy Lord, the Most High, for having guided thee to the law of divine knowledge, quickened thy heart with the spirit of faith, showered upon thee the clouds of bounty, and opened thy vision to witness His most great signs in the world of humanity.

Subject: spiritual transformation
Quotation: Hath the sweetness of the divine call attracted thee, or hath the pure water of the All-Merciful's Kawther seized thee? Hath the scratching of the Supreme Pen or the rustling of the Lote-Tree drawn thee from worldly conditions to the most holy station of "Every day He is in a new condition"?

Subject: spiritual transformation
Quotation: that the call of the All-Merciful may draw her nigh unto the station which God hath sanctified from the mention of every mentioner and the description of every describer...whereby the hearts of them that are endued with understanding have been attracted, and all things have turned towards God

Subject: spiritual transformation
Quotation: O Sun! Subject: spiritual transformation
Quotation: The radiance of the heavenly Sun was hidden for a time from the East of Iran. Subject: spiritual transformation
Quotation: Unless the seed is planted it will not become a fruitful tree; unless the water flows gardens will not become verdant. If thou desirest the gloom of the world of nature to pass away, thou shouldst illumine the candle of guidance, and if thou seekest a ripe harvest then plant thou a pure seed.

Subject: spiritual transformation
Quotation: Know that attainment to the station of your sign is attainment to your Lord. And this is the station of pure piety towards God, exalted be He, as when one of the prophets asked of God, praised be He, "How can we attain to Thee?" God, may he be exalted, said, "Throw down thyself and rise to Me."

Subject: spiritual transformation
Quotation: You shall have every blessing. Be not anxious for with a little time and patience your mother and brother and all of your family will believe. Every blessing is coming to you for yourself and all whom you love. Your breast shall be widened and your heart filled with the fire of the love of God.

Subject: spiritual transformation
Quotation: A mention from the Wronged One to him who desires to drink of the choice sealed wine, the seal of which was broken by the fingers of the power of God... This is a day wherein any deed that appeareth from anyone, purely for the sake of God, shall endure throughout the kingdom of earth and heaven.

Subject: spiritual transformation
Quotation: O thou who art guided by the light of guidance! Praise be to God that such a light of guidance hath shone forth in the court of thy heart and soul. Thou wast athirst and didst attain unto the fountain of the water of life. Thou wast sick and didst find the supreme remedy of the All-Glorious Lord.

Subject: spiritual transformation
Quotation: That gift is a virtue which, in the blessed Tablets, is the guide for the sincere ones and the path of every loving friend - the path of the free spirits which gives life to the people of this world and the next...They have detached themselves from the human realm and realized the angelic reality

Subject: spiritual transformation
Quotation: These beloved servants and handmaidens of God - when the rain of mercy from the All-Knowing Lord pours upon the human world's powerlessness and weakness like dark soil, it causes crimson tulips to grow from dusty earth and transforms black soil into a radiant rose garden of the Supreme Concourse.

Subject: spiritual transformation
Quotation: In like manner, when the Holy Manifestation of God, Who is the Sun of the world of creation, casts His splendor upon the world of spirits, minds and hearts, a spiritual springtime is ushered in and a new life is revealed. The power of the divine spring appears and wonderful bounties are displayed.

Subject: spiritual transformation
Quotation: O thou who art guided by the light of guidance! Raise both hands in thanksgiving to the threshold of the one true God and offer praise that thou hast attained the fruit of creation, opened the eye of insight, accepted the way of the divine friends, and been nurtured beneath the shadow of His favor.

Subject: spiritual transformation
Quotation: Apathy is death; being extinguished is unworthy; silence is not speaking; sleeping is not wakefulness; negligence is not awareness. The peace of the soul is to be ablaze with the fire of the love of the All-Merciful, and the tranquility of the heart is to suffer adversity in the path of the Beloved.

Subject: spiritual transformation
Quotation: When will you behold light upon light, joy upon joy, absolute happiness reigning everywhere, the people of the religions consorting together in fragrance and felicity, this world in its maturity becoming the reflection of the eternal Kingdom and this terrestrial abode of man the very paradise of God.

Subject: spiritual transformation
Quotation: O respected lady! Subject: spiritual transformation
Quotation: You have gathered beneath the sheltering Tree of companionship in the highest Paradise, upon the carpet of the bounty of the Most Glorious Beauty... You are immersed in the ocean of the benevolence of the Blessed Beauty and are at rest and illumined beneath the shade of the mercy of the Most Great Name.

Subject: spiritual transformation
Quotation: Consider how intensely vivid the potential of the human spirit, in its aspiration, in its sensitivity of heart, in its mental achievements, in the sublimity of its arts, in its spiritual knowledge, through its wondrous discoveries, with the improvement of its morals and in the illumination of the world.

Subject: spiritual transformation
Quotation: Drink and give to drink the sealed wine in the name of the Self-Subsisting, that perchance troubled hearts may attain peace and withered souls may be adorned with freshness. Quicken the dead through the name of the Beloved of all possibility, and guide those who remain behind to the Kawthar of guidance.

Subject: spiritual transformation
Quotation: Though it would be sweeter to cleanse the tablet of light, which is of the pages of illumined hearts, from the intimations of this one and that, and to gallop naked in the vast arena of the spirit. Subject: spiritual transformation
Quotation: O handmaiden of God! You have come under the shadow of chastity, believed in God and become certain of the verses of God. Subject: spiritual transformation
Quotation: The breezes of grace have wafted, and by them were all things borne, and God is witness to what I say. Then shall the idolaters flee to the right and to the left, and shall find for themselves no secure refuge.

Subject: spiritual transformation
Quotation: The lightning flash of truth hath bestowed an indescribable radiance upon all regions and made hearts the centers of divine inspirations and souls the source of spiritual mysteries. It hath cast tumult into minds and opened the gates of joy unto hearts and granted the bounty of attainment unto His presence.

Subject: spiritual transformation
Quotation: O thou who art Nush [sweet], the wine of consciousness is sweet, and this is the time of ferment and tumult. Turn thine ear to the celestial realm that thou mayest hear the melody of the Divine Spirit and catch the secret whispers of the angels. The cup of wine is overflowing and the flask is shedding tears.

Subject: spiritual transformation
Quotation: You have opened the eye of insight and unstopped the ear of the soul. Subject: spiritual transformation
Quotation: Therefore, one must play such melodies that bring the Concourse on High to delight and whose results and effects remain lasting...Strive to attain such a station. Seek eternal joy, establish divine festivities, arrange heavenly feasts, spread the celestial table of life, and grant everlasting life to humanity.

Subject: spiritual transformation
Quotation: transmutation of the soul by the divine elixir - "offer in these days, through the blessed name of the Self-Subsisting, the sealed wine to the heedless servants, that perchance those who are lost in the valley of error and deprivation may turn to the horizon of the All-Merciful and drink from the water of life"

Subject: spiritual transformation
Quotation: They were blessed with a heavenly, merciful, and spiritual blessing whose lights shine forth from their foreheads. Subject: spiritual transformation
Quotation: O Mirza Abu-Talib! Subject: spiritual transformation
Quotation: O thou who art thoughtful and mindful! Know thou the value of this station, and think upon gathering the fruits from the tree of acceptance and faith.

Subject: spiritual transformation
Quotation: Behold the bounty of the Lord, that He guided thee to the straight path, made thee distinguished among handmaidens, led thee to the pathway of the Friend, appointed thee as guardian in the house of the Blessed Beauty, gave thee shelter in the precincts of the holy dust, and caused thy countenance to become radiant

Subject: spiritual transformation
Quotation: Make them dawning-places of inspiration, daysprings of lights, and rising-points of stars and traces...seeking for the old friends and new companions confirmation of steadfastness and firmness, that they may at every moment become intimate with a bounty, and with every breath find new life through the divine breath.

Quotation: Reinforce thy back! Strengthen thy knees! Subject: spiritual transformation
Quotation: praise be to God that from among the Parsees, such pure souls from among the ancient friends have arisen who are like bright candles and like flowers in the garden and meadow...They have turned to the Abha Kingdom and, inhaling the holy fragrances from the Supreme Concourse, they have arisen to serve the Lord of Hosts.

Subject: spiritual transformation
Quotation: O thou cup overflowing with the Wine of the Love of God! Know thou that the doors of the Kingdom are being opened to the East and West. Subject: spiritual transformation

Quotation: When one looks at the people on the streets of Haifa, it seems as if one hundred years would be required for their spiritual development... These souls have lived not spiritual life. Quotation: Earth can never cloud its splendor, nor water quench its flame. All the peoples of the world are powerless to resist its force. Subject: spiritual transformation
Quotation: Praise be to God that from the beginning of her life she trod the path of salvation and grew and developed under the blessed Tree, until she attained the ultimate aspiration of the holy leaves. Subject: spiritual transformation
Quotation: The thirsty fish found its way to the ocean of mercy, and the silent bird took wing to the divine rose garden, breaking into the most wondrous melodies in the branches of oneness. Subject: spiritual transformation
Quotation: O Rustam! Your namesake became renowned throughout the horizons for physical bravery. You must become known in the world for spiritual manliness and detachment. Subject: spiritual transformation
Quotation: O Muhammad-Qablé-Rida! This is the most glorious, most impregnable, most holy and most exalted station.

Subject: spiritual transformation
Quotation: I was absolute poverty, and Thou didst guide me to inexhaustible treasure. I was in want, and Thou didst lead me to absolute wealth. Subject: spiritual transformation
Quotation: The drops from the cloud of bounty have made the realm of existence verdant and flourishing, and the divine trumpet blast has brought the world of humanity to life...Soon will the pavilion of tranquility be raised and its extended shade encompass all. Subject: spiritual transformation
Quotation: Should the soul of man become confirmed with the breaths of the Holy Spirit, then will it become a true soul. Subject: spiritual transformation
Quotation: Keep the heart, which is the dawning-place of divine manifestation, sanctified and purified from aught else but Him, that the lights of the manifestation of the true Sovereign may appear therein. Subject: spiritual transformation
Quotation: O thou who hast inhaled the fragrance of the gardens! Quotation: And bind thy heart so firmly to the Beauty of the Glorious Lord that thou wouldst cause the fire of Nimrod to grow cold, and migrate from the land of self and passion to the blessed spot of Mount Sinai, and hasten from the realm of Nimrod's darkness to the luminous white spot of the Loving Lord, and be honored with divine manifestations

Subject: spiritual transformation
Quotation: Let us hearken to a Melody which may stir the world of humanity... Then we can obtain universal results. Subject: spiritual transformation
Quotation: Paul became Paul, not because he was a learned man but because he followed Christ; likewise Peter, otherwise they were men like any other Jews who lived at that time. Subject: spiritual transformation
Quotation: Ask thou of God that He may purify the eyes from the ophthalmia of desire and free the hearts from the veils that hinder... that perchance through the effulgences of the Sun of divine bounty the servants may become illumined and sense such a station that the splendor and worth of these outward, ephemeral stations may be erased from the heart.

Subject: spiritual transformation
Quotation: Blessed the lifeless one who is quickened through My reviving breaths. Blessed is he who hath remained faithful to My Covenant, and whom the things of the world have not kept back from attaining My Court of holiness.

Subject: spiritual transformation
Quotation: How can he be saved from all these imperfections and vices and become enabled to acquire all the virtues? Since he is ignorant of God, he must be put in touch with God. Subject: spiritual transformation
Quotation: Thou must, with the utmost attraction, encourage and urge the friends and maidservants of the Merciful to follow the divine counsels, instructions and teachings, that each may become a pure spirit and an embodied light, and may center their attention wholly on the good-pleasure of God, seeking none but Him and walking in no path save His path.

Subject: spiritual transformation
Quotation: It hath been ordained for every soul that, when he heareth the Call from the direction of the snow-white Spot, he should hasten and say: "Here am I, O God of earth and heaven, Creator of names!" Woe betide them who were not stirred by the breezes of the All-Merciful in those days and were not awakened by the scratching of His Most Exalted Pen.

Subject: spiritual transformation
Quotation: Assist then, that these souls who are sore athirst in the wilds of remoteness to attain unto the limitless Ocean, and that they who languish in the wastes of yearning to be led unto the tabernacle of the light of the world; so that neath the shadow of Divine Unity, they may become engaged in Thy glorification and may be inebriated with Thy Cup.

Subject: spiritual transformation
Quotation: O people! We created hearts for the descent of the splendor of Our lights. Quotation: Stand firm in the Cause of thy Lord, then rend asunder the veils of idle fancy through Our power and authority, and fear thou no one, even should all who are on earth rise up against thee. Subject: spiritual transformation
Quotation: And shouldst thou return unto God, God will surely send down His mercy upon thee and will surely forgive thee - verily He is the Forgiving, the Self-Subsisting, the Pardoning. Subject: spiritual transformation
Quotation: O thou who art enkindled with the fire of guidance! Thou hast traversed the wilderness of deprivation and reached the destination of certitude and the Ka'bah of mystic knowledge. From the garden of guidance thou hast plucked the fruit of divine favors, and from the breeze of true understanding thou hast inhaled the life-giving breath of existence.

Subject: spiritual transformation
Quotation: All that thou seest in the world of existence is but a mirage not a water, it's a mere mist not a thirst allaying drink, it is veering towards destruction and non existence, it's a mere show, a mere supposition. The only reality which is true existence and the true entity is the wave of the eternal ocean and the new hosts of this wondrous kingdom.

Subject: spiritual transformation
Quotation: The time of words hath passed away, and the age of deeds hath dawned. Blessed is he who hath clung to pure deeds in the Cause of God, the Lord of all worlds. Blessed is the servant whom neither hopes nor riches have withheld from his ultimate destiny, who came forward when the Call was raised between earth and heaven, and answered his Ancient Lord.

Subject: spiritual transformation
Quotation: If you were to learn of the glorious gifts of the Abha Kingdom, I swear by the Educator of the seen and unseen that from the intensity of gladness and joy you would blaze like a sphere of fire and ignite the hearts of all horizons, kindle a bright lamp in the glass of contingent being, and freely give your heart and soul in the path of the Beloved

Subject: spiritual transformation
Quotation: In this Most Great Century and Most Noble Cycle, when subtle and pure realities have been illumined by the shining rays from the Sun of Truth... Base realities are transformed into pure gold through contact with this Greatest Elixir, and the breasts of seekers, which are vessels for receiving grace, become like overflowing cups from this outpouring.

Subject: spiritual transformation
Quotation: Whoever becomes a porter at this threshold / Becomes sovereign over the realm of heart and soul / Though he be but a weak ant altogether / He becomes Solomon over all climes / Like a mote in the rays of the sun / He becomes manifest through the light of truth / Though he be but a drop bereft of existence / He becomes an ocean full of pearls and coral

Subject: spiritual transformation
Quotation: Render a hundred thanks that in this gathering of the All-Merciful thou didst hear the mention of God, and didst cling to the hem of forgiveness and pardon. Thou didst drink from the fountain of life and taste of purified honey, and didst enter beneath the shade of the blessed Tree, and didst witness the light of guidance from the horizon of eternity.

Subject: spiritual transformation
Quotation: When the rays of the Morn of guidance flash forth and scatter their radiance from the horizon of truth, the illumined heart of man partaketh of that guidance through the light of the All-Merciful. Then doth the lamp of divine bounty shine resplendent, casting abroad the light of Oneness, and the fire of love is kindled, setting the human heart aflame.

Subject: spiritual transformation
Quotation: O Muhammad-Qabli-Hashim! In these days the Full Moon of utterance is rising and shining from the horizon of the heaven of the Divine Will. Blessed is he who hath seen and attained, and woe unto them that remain veiled. Remember thy Lord at all times. He is with whosoever remembereth Him, and remembereth him at morn and at eventide, at night and at dawn.

Subject: spiritual transformation
Quotation: Praise be to God that the hand of abundant grace hath given thee to drink from the cup tempered with camphor, hath lit the lamp of supreme guidance in the glass of thy heart, hath cast the light of divine manifestation upon thy sight and insight, and the Beloved of inner meanings hath, with divine radiance, revealed Himself in the sanctuary of the spirit.

Subject: spiritual transformation
Quotation: Make them the banners of Thy guidance among Thy creation, the waves of the ocean of Thy bounty for those among Thy creatures who thirst, the rivers of Thy Kawthar of favors for the people of Thy kingdom. Make them the branches of the Tree of Life, the fruits of the Tree of the Divine Purpose, the flowers of a splendid garden, and the fish in a noble pool.

Subject: spiritual transformation
Quotation: Although I have no time, nevertheless I have engaged in mentioning thee, that thou mayest find joy and delight and arise to render thanks for the favors of the Peerless Lord - for the escort of His grace hath arrived, the light of guidance hath shone forth, and in the night-chamber of heart and soul the lamp of the Most Merciful's bounty hath been kindled.

Subject: spiritual transformation
Quotation: Thou hast expressed a desire to become my partner in trials; this desire is the Cause of the attainment to the divine gift and the entrance to the Kingdom of His Highness the Single One. This desire is everlasting glory and eternal life. This desire is conducive to the spirituality of thy heart and soul, the illumination of thy mind and perfect development.

Subject: spiritual transformation
Quotation: Some (persons) can be compared unto prepared lamps, only waiting the Spirit's breath to illumine them; while others are still unprepared. There is some wood that is inflamed at once; there is a damp, wet wood that has to be warmed before the flame can penetrate the heart. Again there is a wood as hard as stone and verily, in vain the heat and flame caress it.

Subject: spiritual transformation
Quotation: Lord, he has rent asunder the veil, torn away the covering of vain imaginings, removed the shroud, and his eyes have been gladdened by witnessing Thy greatest signs. Lord, raise him from the grave of nature, expand his breast with the spirit of truth, and illumine his heart with the lamp of Thy love, that this brilliant glass may shine forth and radiate light.

Subject: spiritual transformation
Quotation: Make your way to the sanctified Concourse and become an intimate companion of the denizens of the Abha Kingdom... Therefore for all of us it is far better to spread our wings and fly from this perilous depth, entering a world that is sanctified from these dangers, so that we may find rest in that soul-stirring atmosphere of the Ever-Living, the Omnipotent One.

Subject: spiritual transformation
Quotation: O Lord, this believing maidservant and assured handmaiden, when she heard the divine call and tasted a draught of love's sweetness from the cup of Thy bounty, she beat the drum of yea in response to am I not your Lord? and became intoxicated in the feast of faith, and was reckoned among the assured and believing handmaidens beneath the shade of Thy Divine Unity.

Subject: spiritual transformation
Quotation: When a gentle breeze passes over a weak body, it experiences joy and expansion, finding life and invigoration. Consider, then, what happens when the breezes from the Abha Kingdom waft across the expanse of the hearts of the loved ones. Without doubt, it bestows life and grants a goodly existence. It brings ecstasy and rapture, and increases yearning and devotion.

Subject: spiritual transformation
Quotation: In this Most Great Resurrection, this overwhelming catastrophe, and this supreme gathering, whosoever was raised up in the most goodly form became assured of the Great Announcement and was intoxicated with the ancient wine, cast aside the veil from his face, raised high the call "Would that my people knew!", pitched his tent and pavilion in the most exalted station

Subject: spiritual transformation
Quotation: They have been stirred to ecstasy and rapture, sacrificing both life and wealth, until in these days they have striven and contributed to the building of the Mashriqu'l-Adhkar. They have opened the eye of spiritual perception and witnessed the greatest signs. They have attained the station of certitude and assurance, and have inhaled the holy and musk-laden breeze.

Subject: spiritual transformation
Quotation: Let the mysteries become apparent to one and all, so that the sleepy ones may be awakened, the lukewarm refreshed, and the agitated soothed and calmed. May those who are deprived become the repositories of mysteries and those who are perplexed become knowledgeable and wise. May the blind see, the deaf hear, the sleepers wake and be enkindled, and the lost ones found.

Subject: spiritual transformation
Quotation: Say: The rain-showers of the heaven of divinity are the verses of God from the presence of the Primal Tree, whereby the soil of your hearts, spirits, souls and bodies is quickened, and ye are all adorned by the words of God. Make not the soil of your hearts like dead earth after God hath quickened you through His remembrance, if ye be of those who are alive and guided.

Subject: spiritual transformation
Quotation: ascending from the realm of the earthly world to the zenith of the celestial realm, and traveling from creation to the Truth...Surely this bounty must show its influence and its confirmation must become manifest. May you become successful in attaining human virtues and be confirmed with the divine breaths. May you become the essence of spirit and the reality of light.

Subject: spiritual transformation
Quotation: Among the people is he who came to the Most Great Scene, and We shed upon him the lights of the Face, whereupon he was thunderstruck. When he recovered, he believed in God, the Mighty, the Beloved. And among them is he by whom We passed in the marketplace, and who heard a verse from the verses of his Lord, whereupon longing seized him and he turned to the Intended One.

Subject: spiritual transformation
Quotation: O servant of the Most Glorious Beauty! Rejoice that thou hast been present at the heavenly feast and hast been nourished by the spiritual food. Thou hast perfumed thy nostrils with the holy fragrance and illumined thy countenance with the light of recognition. Thou hast quaffed the cup of the most great bounty and hast sweetened thy taste with the honey of the love of God.

Subject: spiritual transformation
Quotation: these children, fostered by grace in the way of salvation, growing like pearls of divine bounty in the shell of education, will one day bejewel the crown of abiding glory... these children, reared one and all in the holy Teachings, will develop natures like unto the sweet airs that blow across the gardens of the All-Glorious, and will waft their fragrance around the world.

Subject: spiritual transformation
Quotation: O Lord! Though we are but worthless grass, yet we are nurtured by the rain of Thy bounty. Though we are but saplings bearing no fruit, yet we are made verdant through the outpourings of the clouds of Thy favor. Though we are mere dust, yet we are illumined by the bright rays of the Sun of Truth. Though we are lowly earth, yet we are made to flower in the garden of Thy oneness.

Subject: spiritual transformation
Quotation: thou wilt guide people to the running water of life and lead them to the field of knowledge; thou wilt give them to drink the wine of assurance and quicken them with the fragrances of the Merciful One; thou wilt clothe them with the robes of bestowal and give them to drink the wine of faithfulness in love for Baha', so that they will be awakened from the sleep of selfish desires

Subject: spiritual transformation
Quotation: Today is a day wherein the rustling of the Divine Lote-Tree is raised high and the flow of the Kawthar of life is crystal clear, and every possessor of hearing doth hear it. God willing, thou shalt attain unto His special favors and become detached and free from the world and all who dwell therein. Today the call of the All-Merciful is raised, and likewise the shrieking of Satan.

Subject: spiritual transformation
Quotation: O thou who art enamored of the Beauty of Truth! Thy name is Qasim, thy path is straight, thy reality is steadfast, and thy qualities are perfect. Thou mayest ask how I can attain these great virtues and become the possessor of these sublime gifts. Through the grace of the Ancient Beauty, every difficulty is made easy and every impossibility becomes possible and freely attainable.

Subject: spiritual transformation
Quotation: O thou who art longing to behold the eternal Beauty! As much as thou canst, be swift and agile in the divine path, and be fearless and undaunted before the enemies, that thou mayest soar on wings to the zenith of heaven and circle and gaze in the heights of ancient glory. Become intoxicated from the immortal cup and from the pure fountain become saturated and enamored of the sea.

Subject: spiritual transformation
Quotation: Physical fasting is a symbol of that spiritual fasting - meaning "O Lord! As I have remained aloof from physical desires and occupation with food and drink, purify and sanctify my heart and soul from love of any besides You, and protect my self from base desires and satanic qualities, so that spirit may take pleasure in holy breaths and fast from mention of all else besides You."

Subject: spiritual transformation
Quotation: The faded hearts are quickened and rejuvenated; and the withered bodies are vivified with the stimulus of infinite beauty and utmost charm...For this is the beginning of the Age of Grace, the time of the downpour of the rain and the season of the heavenly spring. Its freshness is heart-entrancing and its charm most wonderful. Its beauty is captivating and its elegance very exquisite.

Subject: spiritual transformation
Quotation: Through divine favor thou hast a tongue that speaketh, and through God's bounty a heart that is free. In the path of God thou hast drunk the pure water of affliction, and in thy love for the Most Glorious Beauty thou hast tasted the venom of tribulation. Through the gifts of the Kingdom thou hast a gladdened heart, and through the bestowals of the Realm of Might thou hast expectant eyes.

Subject: spiritual transformation
Quotation: Those who seek the sublime world, who crave to become heavenly creatures like the prophets and the holy saints, and merciful souls attracted to the kingdom of God...study thou the divine teachings and act in accordance with the heavenly counsels. Acquire the attributes of the merciful, be thou attracted to the holy fragrances so that thou mayest be revived by the breaths of the Holy Spirit

Subject: spiritual transformation
Quotation: When man allows the spirit, through his soul, to enlighten his understanding, then does he contain all Creation; because man, being the culmination of all that went before and thus superior to all previous evolutions, contains all lower world within himself. Illumined by the spirit through the instrumentality of the soul, man's radiant intelligence makes him the crowning-point of Creation.

Subject: spiritual transformation
Quotation: Praise be to God that thou hast been saved from the darkness of error and hast been illumined by the light of guidance. Thou hast been delivered from the greatest abasement and hast been confirmed in everlasting glory. Thou hast drunk the cup of bounty from the hand of the Cup-bearer of faithfulness and hast partaken of the heavenly feast at the table of the bounty of the Most Glorious Beauty.

Subject: spiritual transformation
Quotation: Thus the descent of the Holy Spirit means that the Apostles were attracted by the messianic Spirit, attained constancy and steadfastness, found a new life through the spirit of God's love, and saw Christ to be their ever-living helper and protector. They were mere drops and became the ocean; they were feeble gnats and became soaring eagles; they were all weakness and became endowed with strength.

Subject: spiritual transformation
Quotation: A Bahai child must be trained according to the moral precepts of BAHA'O'LLAH, he must be taught daily of the love of God: the history of the Movement must be read to him, the love of humanity must be inculcated into every fibre of his being and the universal principles be explained to him in as easy a manner as possible to be devised. Then the power of great faith will take possession of his heart.

Subject: spiritual transformation
Quotation: The Beginning and the End bore allusion to one blessed Word, and that hath come and is made manifest. That Word is the Soul of the divine books and epistles, which hath been and will be forevermore. In this Day the new heaven hath appeared and the earth is renewed. Were ye to behold with pure eyes, ye will see the New Jerusalem; and were ye to turn with attentive ears, ye will hear the voice of God.

Subject: spiritual transformation
Quotation: O Ahmad! God willing, through divine grace thou shalt be the custodian of the Living Waters. This is a Day in which all atoms cry out "The Revealer of verses hath appeared!" Thou must, with perfect wisdom and utterance, summon the people of the contingent world to the Lord of Mercy, and give them to partake of the living waters which flow and stream forth in all times from the Pen of the All-Merciful.

Subject: spiritual transformation
Quotation: Through divine assistance and the boundless outpouring of mercy, the cherished one rose from the depths of the well to reach the zenith of the moon... we hope that, through the power of God, thou wilt find deliverance from the dark pit of contingent worlds and from the narrow gloom of earthly conditions, attaining to the heights of ancient glory and entering the vast expanse of everlasting sovereignty.

Subject: spiritual transformation
Quotation: O 'Ali of Light! In this Most Merciful Court seek thou a firm establishment, and in this Abha Paradise take thy recreation, and in this Ocean of the All-Compelling God immerse thyself deeply, and to these musk-laden tresses of the peerless Beloved attach thy heart, and in this Most Great Mosque engage in night-vigil, and in this love and passion and rapture cast off all else and rend asunder every veil.

Subject: spiritual transformation
Quotation: O handmaiden of God! Give thanks that thou hast drunk from the cup of the Friend wine whose admixture is camphor, and attained unto the flowing spring of Tasnim, and tasted of the Kawthar of Salsabil, and been delivered from the snare of vain imaginings, and discovered the inner sanctum of mysteries, and hastened to the court of the favors of the Chosen Beauty, and recognized the countenance of thy Lord.

Subject: spiritual transformation
Quotation: O Zaman! Transform space into spacelessness, and cease to divide time. Seek eternal life and desire endless joy. This bounty will appear when the divine light illumines the heart, and illumination comes through spirituality - that is, when thou art freed from physical limitations, divested of human conditions, and become a celestial angel, a mercy unto all the worlds and a bounty unto all spiritual beings.

Subject: spiritual transformation
Quotation: O thou world of humanity! Awake! Awake! O thou negligent of the Kingdom of God! Revive! Revive! O thou prisoner of nature! Liberate thyself! Liberate thyself! O thou afflicted with antiquated dogmas! Get clear of superannuated imaginations! Free thyself of this Inertia! O thou deprived of the heavenly Bestowals! Acquire a share! Acquire a share! O thou heedless of the Divine World! Be informed! Be informed!

Subject: spiritual transformation
Quotation: O thou who gazest upon God! Take shelter beneath the Sadratu'l-Muntaha and make thy dwelling and habitation in the garden of Paradise. Through the bounty and gift of the All-Merciful, seek wings and feathers and soar in the Abha Paradise which is the image and sign of the Abha Kingdom, that thou mayest become a holy dove in the gardens of sanctity and a nightingale of intimacy in the rose-gardens of detachment.

Subject: spiritual transformation
Quotation: I praise Thee, O my God! For what was decreed for her in the realms of detachment unto the depths of Thy love, and I swear by Thy glory that I have witnessed naught in her save heedlessness, excess, remoteness and forgetfulness. The clay of my being had been stained with the mention of duality and could not be established upon the throne of oneness except through a glance of Thy providence and the dawning of Thy love.

Subject: spiritual transformation
Quotation: O divine friends! It is the night season and all the peoples of the world are bound in chains and confined in straitened cells, except such as have attained freedom through God, such righteous ones as are unencumbered at the sacred threshold of the Eternal. Whenever a soul escapes from the limitations of his mortal cage, he breathes a sigh of relief, for he is free whilst all the rest remain enslaved by water and clay.

Subject: spiritual transformation
Quotation: Verily, you have received that excellent chalice, have achieved nearness to the Divine Mercy, have found a place for retreat under the far stretched celestial shadow, have obtained such a lofty station, have attained the presence of the Loving Lord and ascended into the Orb of Effulgence shining bright with the Light of the Glorious Beauty, intoxicated with the Wine of Union and realized eternal life that hath no parallel.

Subject: spiritual transformation
Quotation: When thy feet are made firm upon this path, thou shalt see the bounty of God encompassing thee even as the rays from the Sun of Truth encompass the moons - a star rising from the dawning-place of lights, flowing forth in the ocean of mysteries, and sailing upon the ark of salvation, until thou shalt find thyself a trusted keeper of the mysteries of the Kingdom and a mirror reflecting the effulgence of the realm of divinity.

Subject: spiritual transformation
Quotation: Lord! Make these faces brilliant stars, these hearts resplendent mirrors, these breasts overflowing fountains, and these souls pure, tranquil, content, well-pleasing, holy and transcendent, so that the world of existence may be adorned through the diffusion of the Holy Spirit in the reality of all created things, and the world of visibility may be embellished with perpetual, eternal outpourings from the mystery of existence.

Subject: spiritual transformation
Quotation: That family is, praise be to God, beneath the shelter of the All-Merciful Lord and under the protection of the Kind God. They are clinging to the blessed Tree and holding fast to the firm handle, and are turned toward the Sun of Truth, the Most Glorious Beauty. When that brilliant Sun shed its radiance upon the horizons, seeing eyes were illumined, pure realities received the light, and became the dawning-place of mysteries.

Subject: spiritual transformation
Quotation: Know thou that the light hath dawned forth, the fountain of life hath gushed out, the cloud of guidance hath poured down its rain, and the Sun of Truth hath illumined the horizons with an everlasting radiance. Know thou, furthermore, that the breaths of the Spirit are healing to every sick one, nay rather, the breezes of the Spirit are life to the dead, and the Word of God is that which influenceth the realities of all things.

Subject: spiritual transformation
Quotation: Through the grace and bounty of the All-Glorious One, thy noble grandfather advanced from the ranks of those who stand at the threshold to the seat of glory, and ascended from the depths of ignorance and unawareness to the summit of the dignity of knowledge. He drank the cup of recognition from the hand of the Merciful Cup-bearer, and beheld with both outer and inner vision the mighty signs of the Beauty of the Most Great Name.

Subject: spiritual transformation
Quotation: Say: Through the remembrance of God are all hearts made steadfast from all hidden things. Say: Through the remembrance of God are all spirits revived among those who have believed in God and His signs, and who place their trust in their Lord. Say: Through the remembrance of God are all souls assured - the souls of all within the kingdoms of heaven and earth and all that lieth between them - if they be of them that are convinced.

Subject: spiritual transformation
Quotation: If ye observe with the eye of reality, ye will recognize that this banishment is a blessing, this homelessness is freedom, and this destitution is everlasting glory. But when he gazeth toward the overflowing bounties of God, he perceiveth this calamity as a gift, and he beholdeth this abasement as an honor. He apprehendeth this cruelty as pure light, and seeth a brilliant and shining morn following this night of grievous sorrows.

Subject: spiritual transformation
Quotation: I pray to God that He may cause to descend upon thee a heavenly blessing, quicken thy heart with the Holy Spirit into an everlasting life and make thy heart a source of merciful sentiments; so that thy breath may become a quickener of the souls, thine attractions may move the heart of the world, thy strong love may attract the hearts of men, and that thine abundant affection may become a mercy to mankind in the world of existence.

Subject: spiritual transformation
Quotation: Through the efforts of that faithful one, the Russian lady has in this journey become a guide to the Friend...The Russian Gulnar came to Alexandria and we met. She showed some spiritual feelings but as she was thinking about returning to Kazan, her mind was very preoccupied and she had no peace at all. Correspond with her so that perhaps through your guidance and that of the Russian lady, she may gradually become properly awakened.

Subject: spiritual transformation
Quotation: O 'Ali! Hearken unto the call of Him Who through thy tyranny hath fallen into this bottomless pit, His garment sprinkled with the truthful blood of thy hatred, and from the depths of the pit He calleth saying: O brother! Deal not with thy brother as the son of Adam dealt with his brother. O brother! Fear God and dispute not My verses, war not against My Self, and slay not Him Who hath made His breast a target for the sword of enemies

Subject: spiritual transformation
Quotation: Some time ago a letter was sent, and now another letter is being written with the pen of longing, that it may cause the intensity of attraction and may completely take the reins of free will from the hand of power, and may make thee so intoxicated with the cup of "Am I not your Lord?" that thou mayest dance with goblet in hand in the arena of sacrifice and, taking heart and soul in thy palm, scatter them at the feet of the Kind Beloved.

Subject: spiritual transformation
Quotation: Your letter was received. Its composition had the fragrance of the rose garden of Persia and brought joy like a stream of truthfulness. It was heart-engaging and colorful, sweet as sugar and honey, and a sample of that dear one's harvest. Praise be to the pure Lord that He made you brave and fearless in this battlefield, and made you agile and swift. You defeated Ahriman and became intoxicated and wine-worshipping in the celestial tavern.

Subject: spiritual transformation
Quotation: Without this attainment, there is true deprivation and the torment of hellfire. Therefore, the Baha'is must fix their gaze upon this crucial matter, lest they, like the followers of other religions, content themselves with clamor and commotion and meaningless words. Rather, they must arise in all things to manifest divine characteristics and virtues and the conduct of heavenly souls, proving themselves true Baha'is and not mere empty words.

Subject: spiritual transformation
Quotation: When his heart is glad, a man is happy, though in prison. When his heart is sad, he cannot be happy, though in a paradise. A lighted lamp is still alight, though it be in a cellar or a cave. Therefore was the imprisonment of the faithful their path to God, a heaven for them. That which was real in them was as the gold which becomes purer the longer it remains in the fire; or like good soil, which becomes more fruitful the more it is ploughed.

Subject: spiritual transformation
Quotation: O ye who have turned towards God! O ye who are accepted at the Divine Threshold! Enter beneath the shade of the Word of Unity, and drink from the wine of detachment. The lights of sanctity from the horizon of divine uniqueness have cast their radiance upon the dawning-places of the hearts of those friends. The darkness hath vanished, the dwelling-place of the heart hath been illumined, the ears have been opened and the eyes have become seeing.

Subject: spiritual transformation
Quotation: My hope is that by the bounty of God and through the severity of these tribulations, these adversities and afflictions, the ardour of the love of God will increase in the hearts of the friends and the lights of truth will become more and more manifest. May this material world become a visible proof of the faithfulness of the friends and may each of us, one and all give up our hearts and souls with eager love in the path of the One alone Beloved.

Subject: spiritual transformation
Quotation: The might of the world did not prevent the Ancient King from declaring His Cause, even though in the Most Great Prison, during the early years, He was in the midst of the heedless. These days are as the spirit unto all ages and centuries, and as the greatest fragrance unto the temple of creation. This most glorious and exalted station is hidden from all save those souls who have turned to God, who journey toward God, and who speak and act for the sake of God.

Subject: spiritual transformation
Quotation: The true Beloved, like unto Joseph of Canaan, unveiled His countenance and entered the marketplace of Persia. Some desired to purchase Him with mere words, while others sought to win His love through self-sacrifice. Those who wished to purchase Him with words showed no steadfastness and soon afterwards believed themselves deceived. But those who came forward with the spirit of self-sacrifice found the Beautiful Joseph in the embrace of supplication and prayer.

Subject: spiritual transformation
Quotation: O thou who gazest upon the Kingdom of God! Be thou alert and nimble in the path of the love of the Lord, that with a single stride thou mayest traverse the heavens and take thy seat upon the throne of the Kingdom, that in the world of earth thou mayest become celestial, raise thy head from the collar of the realm of might, and hasten to the vastness of the realm of divine power. Thou shalt become a heavenly being and a servant at the threshold of the All-Merciful.

Subject: spiritual transformation
Quotation: They were sons of earth; Thou hast made them new fruits of the Kingdom. They were plants of the desert of bereavement; Thou hast made them trees of the rose-garden of knowledge. They were silent; Thou hast made them speak. They were extinct; Thou hast lighted them. They were sterile soil; Thou hast made them the rose-garden of significances. They were the children of the world of humanity; Thou hast caused them to attain development and the maturity of the Kingdom!

Subject: spiritual transformation
Quotation: When a tree takes root it becomes verdant and fresh, putting forth leaves and blossoms and yielding delectable fruit. When a foundation is firmly laid, it becomes a porch, then a magnificent palace and a mighty pillar. Therefore, show forth constancy and steadfastness to the utmost degree, that ye may become the manifestations of the favors of the Glorious Lord, that ye may witness the effulgences of the All-Merciful and observe the outpourings of the unseen realm.

Subject: spiritual transformation
Quotation: Take the cup of bounty in your right hand and pass it round to the companions among the people of knowledge, and intoxicate them with the wine of utterance - an intoxication and ecstasy from which they shall never recover throughout all eternity, and by which they shall be enraptured in the gatherings of the horizons. By God the Truth! This overflowing cup of the pure wine of sanctification bestows life upon the dead who lie decaying in the graves of vain imaginings.

Subject: spiritual transformation
Quotation: It causes extinguished fires to blaze forth and stagnant waters to flow. It bestows wondrous life upon barren lands where eternal lilies had never bloomed, and adorns them with the ornament of true and colorful flowers. And it honors and exalts the withered plants of the deserts of remoteness and bewilderment - which had dried and wilted in longing and separation from that divine living water - with boundless gifts of branches, arts, leaves and fruits of paradisiacal trees.

Subject: spiritual transformation
Quotation: O thou who art mindful of the remembrance of the All-Merciful! Praise God that thou hast entered beneath the shade of this divine Tree, and hast arrived at the shore of the sea of eternity, and hast drunk from the living, life-giving spring, and hast been nourished by the fruit of the Lote-Tree beyond which there is no passing, and hast inhaled the holy fragrances from the gardens of certitude, and hast been enkindled by the divine Word in the fire kindled by the All-Merciful.

Subject: spiritual transformation
Quotation: Throughout life, all moments were spent in pursuit of God's good-pleasure, and in acquiring both outward and inward perfections. At the dawn of immortality, the lights of truth were attained; at the daybreak of the All-Merciful Sun from the Most Glorious Horizon, the cup of yea was taken from the hand of the Cup-bearer of Am I not?, the sweetness of attraction was tasted, and across the desert of longing did they run, until reaching the court of the presence of the eternal Lord of Majesty.

Subject: spiritual transformation
Quotation: The latent realities were stirred and the expectant beings were raised up. Their inner consciousness was purified and their intimate thoughts were made good. They became illumined and enlightened, they received abundance and radiance, they became resplendent and attracted, they arose in remembrance of their Lord, in the manifestation of their Creator, in the outpouring of their Originator, and in the gifts of their Fashioner. For they became refined and pure, became subtle and shed light upon all regions.

Subject: spiritual transformation
Quotation: O Javad! I impart unto thee a single word - a token of loving-kindness and compassion - that hath been garnered from the gems of Holy Books and the essences of Sacred Scriptures, that the water of eternity may flow from the clouds of the Divine Unity upon thy reality and the realities of all servants, enabling you to attain unto life everlasting and eternal existence. And it is this: "Possess ye a pure, goodly and illumined heart, that ye may possess a sovereignty imperishable, everlasting, ancient and eternal."

Subject: spiritual transformation
Quotation: O Thou the Generous! Suffer us to walk the straight path and bestow upon us a sanctified heart. Appease us with Thy consummate grace, grant us the delights of paradise, and protect us from a grievous chastisement! Bestow upon us guidance, quicken us with life, endow us with true knowledge, and give us a seeing eye and a hearing ear, that we may grasp the true significance of things, rend asunder the veils, partake of this glorious grace, and be, under all conditions, renowned for unity and freed from the misery of estrangement.

Subject: spiritual transformation
Quotation: It is related that one of the people of God said to a Bektashi dervish, who was intoxicated day and night, Why do you not pray? The Bektashi replied that it was difficult and troublesome. That wise person said, O Bektashi, follow me for forty days and engage in prayer. You will become accustomed to it and develop an attachment to it. Afterward, you will not be able to abandon it and will continue steadfastly. The Bektashi replied, Why make it so lengthy? Follow me for one night and take a drink. If you can forsake it, I will submit.

Subject: spiritual transformation
Quotation: Ye shall bear witness that there is no God but Him, the Truth beyond doubt, and that all else are His creatures, and all are His worshippers. Whoso is content with Me and believeth in My signs, verily he is content with God his Lord; and whoso knoweth Me not and believeth not in Me, how can he be content with God as his Lord? For verily He is this: There is no God but I, the Lord of the worlds. And ye shall recite Our verses, for verily this is the sustenance of those who have believed in God and His signs until the Day of Resurrection.

Subject: spiritual transformation
Quotation: This Cause regenerates the souls. Everyone receives a new baptism and attains to the station of the new birth. If he was a liar, he becomes truthful. Whereas formerly he was coward, he becomes courageous. Whereas formerly he was morally soiled, he becomes pure. Whereas formerly he was ignorant, he becomes wise. He is transformed entirely into the angelic state. If a person is dark he becomes illumined he becomes characterized with the attributes of Holiness and Sanctity; he will be set aglow with the Fire of the Love of God; he will become a new creation.

Subject: spiritual transformation
Quotation: All that I might say is only one drop of that illimitable sea. My duty is to explain, to elucidate, to interpret the writings of Baha'o'llah. For example: we must investigate the reality; we must show real love to the world of humanity; we must work for the establishment of universal peace; we must sacrifice our lives in the guidance of mankind; we must be kind to all the creatures of God; we must raise the call of the Kingdom; we must characterize ourselves with spiritual characteristics; we must show forth in our words and deeds the attributes of the holy ones.

Subject: spiritual transformation
Quotation: O thou who art firm in the Covenant! Your letter was received and its contents brought joy and utmost delight, for praise be to God, the newcomers to the Abha Paradise are in the utmost freshness and grace from the drops of the cloud of bounty, and are growing and developing through the spring rain of the Most Great Guidance, advancing day by day. It is certain that each one will become a standard of guidance and a sign of the gifts of the Abha Kingdom, sweet-singing nightingales in the garden of divine knowledge and graceful gazelles in the wilderness of the love of God.

Subject: spiritual transformation
Quotation: Verily those who followed the verses of God that were sent down in truth are they whom God made the word of His victory and rendered them triumphant in the exalted realm of immortality. He strengthened them with a spirit from His Command and sent upon them the breezes of Paradise, ordaining for them a station that transcendeth comprehension. He gave them wings of ruby that they might soar in the atmosphere of nearness, taught them the ways of piety, showed them the kingdom of all things, and caused them to be attracted by the melodies of glory in the Paradise of immortality.

Subject: spiritual transformation
Quotation: O Breeze of God, blow fragrant! O Zephyr of God, waft sweet-scented! Direct thyself toward the valley of the All-Merciful, the realm of mystical knowledge in the land of Khurasan. Spread thy perfume before the loved ones of God and His trustees, and make fragrant the nostrils of the saints of God and His chosen ones - they whose faces have become illumined, whose stars have grown dark, whose feet are firmly established, whose banners are unfurled, whose hearts are steadfast, whose roots and branches have flourished, whose souls are revived, and whose breasts are dilated on the Day of Meeting

Subject: spiritual transformation
Quotation: The first kind is only in the realm of word. It is not transmuted into action. For example the black stone of Mecca was, is and will ever remain a black stone but because it is connected with the name of Mohamad every year thousands of men and women undergo the severe hardships of long journey to see, touch and kiss it; or the water of Jordan is the same as the water of any other river, but simply because it is attributed to Christ the Christians ship it therefore to foreign countries for benefic purposes. The real revival therefore is the revival of conscience and heart and not the change of name.

Subject: spiritual transformation
Quotation: O servant! Strip thyself of the allusions of the people, then adorn thy temple with the raiment of resplendent glory, for We have made thee the herald of Our Cause in that land, that thou mayest acquaint the people with that which the Spirit hath inspired in thee from Our presence, and be of wondrous remembrance. By My beauty! He in whose heart there is love for aught created between the heavens and the earth shall never be able to bear this firm, mighty, and exalted Cause. Purify thyself with this heavenly stream which floweth from the fountainhead of eternity, then purify therewith the hearts of the seekers.

Subject: spiritual transformation
Quotation: If a thorn partakes, it becomes a hyacinth; if an atom partakes, it becomes a radiant sun; if a drop partakes, it becomes the vast ocean; if a gnat partakes, it becomes an eagle soaring in the heavens; if dust partakes, it becomes flowers and herbs; if a stone partakes, it becomes hyacinth and sweet basil; if a coward partakes, he becomes a man of the arena; if a wise one partakes, he becomes the chief of the mystics; if a manifestation of Satan partakes, he becomes a manifestation of the All-Merciful; if rock and clay partakes, they become rubies of Badakhshan; if pottery and jet partake, they become gleaming pearls.

Subject: spiritual transformation
Quotation: Having found them clinging to the cord of devotions while heedless of the Sovereign of all created things - through but one word from Whom the laws of the Cause were made to flow in the rivers of wisdom - We left them to their vain imaginings and ascended to hidden sanctified destinations, soaring in the atmosphere of nearness until We reached the ultimate station possible in existence: a blessed valley of glory. There We found a people among the unitarians who would unitize God in both private and public, witnessing God's handiwork in the horizons of possibilities and in themselves - thus was the matter truly witnessed.

Subject: spiritual transformation
Quotation: in this prison, human life is like death - there is no comfort, no pleasure, no joy and no solace, unless one is overtaken by perpetual intoxication and remains constantly inebriated, becoming completely deprived of perception and feeling...But in this pitch darkness there exists a world-illumining candle, and in this sea of mortality there appears a ship of salvation. For this deadly poison there is a supreme antidote, and for that bitter colocynth there is refined sugar - and that is the spiritual sensibilities of man, the merciful inspirations of God, the divine manifestations of knowledge, and the heavenly intimations of the compassionate Lord

Subject: spiritual transformation
Quotation: Consider the date stone: if the hand of men's training should plant it in blessed and goodly soil, ere long a tree will appear, and lofty and wondrous fresh dates will become manifest and visible. Now if thou shouldst regard this with an eye that seeth no end, thou wouldst behold this tree and its fruits unto an end that hath no end, for from a single date stone a hundred thousand dates become manifest. Now that a hundred thousand stones have appeared, how can the fruits thereof have any end? However, had that first stone been cast upon barren and unsuitable ground, none of these fruits and trees and branches would have appeared in the realm of being. Therefore, O Mahdi, surrender the seed of thy being to the control of God's conquering and omnipotent hand, that He may plant it in the blessed and holy soil of His paradise, that from it may appear everlasting branches, eternal boughs, and never-ending fruits.

Subject: spiritual transformation
Quotation: from the intensity of gladness and joy you would blaze like a sphere of fire and ignite the hearts of all horizons, kindle a bright lamp in the glass of contingent being

Quotation: The Sun of the Face is manifest and shining from the horizon of appearance - every possessor of sight beholds it.
