Quotation: The Parliament of man will be established; humanity will be spiritualized and the Standard of Peace will be hoisted above every home.

Subject: spiritualization of humanity in the future; a new race of men
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/spiritualization of humanity in the future; a new race of men.txt
Quotation: But there is no limit to spiritual progress and its results are infinite and glorious... spiritual progress is the cause of eternal joy and the source of education and protection of the human world and everlasting happiness for humankind.

Subject: spiritualization of humanity in the future; a new race of men
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/spiritualization of humanity in the future; a new race of men.txt
Quotation: so that the friends may be raised up with a character and demonstrate a conduct that will make the world a paradise of good-pleasure and the face of the earth a supreme heaven...so that the reality of divine attributes may become manifest in the realm of possibility, and the human world may become a mirror of the Most Great Beauty. Faith, certitude, mystic knowledge, truth, integrity, reconciliation, worship of truth, love, oneness, fellowship and wisdom may become realized and renowned among all peoples.

Subject: station of the Manifestation of God
Quotation: Moses beheld the light of guidance from the kindled fire in the Sinai Tree...But thou hast beheld the light of the Most Great Guidance in the blessed Mount of Certitude, the holy valley of the All-Merciful, as a kindled fire in the Blessed Tree of Man

Subject: station of the Manifestation of God
Quotation: His Holiness, BAHA'O'LLAH, is unique and peerless. All must turn to BAHA'O'LLAH.

Subject: station of the Manifestation of God
Quotation: He is the One Who gazeth from His most exalted horizon... He hath come for the salvation of the world

Subject: station of the Manifestation of God
Quotation: That which hath come unto you from your Lord is better for you - the Remnant of God, the Expected Leader.

Subject: station of the Manifestation of God
Quotation: The Balance is He Who is manifest from His most exalted horizon...and I am the Straight Path...and I am the Luminous Horizon.

Subject: station of the Manifestation of God
Quotation: Whoso hath turned unto Him hath turned unto God, the Lord of all men, and whoso hath turned away is assuredly among the losers

Subject: station of the Manifestation of God
Quotation: He is the One Who gazeth from His most exalted horizon...Verily, there is none other God but Him, the Mighty, the All-Bountiful.

Subject: station of the Manifestation of God
Quotation: God have mercy on one who knows his station and rank at the time when Names were bestowed upon the world. You did not exist then.

Subject: station of the Manifestation of God
Quotation: Verily I am the Fire of the Interlocutor around the Mount that spoke in the Tree: There is no God but He, and God hath ever been My witness.

Subject: station of the Manifestation of God
Quotation: The text discusses the four stations or levels of the Manifestation: servitude, Imamate, Prophethood, and divine station ("Verily I am God").

Subject: station of the Manifestation of God
Quotation: Verily, I am the Manifestation Who shall not be questioned of His doings, whereas all else besides Me shall be questioned of what they do.

Subject: station of the Manifestation of God
Quotation: In prayer one must turn his face towards the sanctified Reality of His Holiness Baha'u'llah - that Reality which surrounds all phenomena.

Subject: station of the Manifestation of God
Quotation: Turn with illumined hearts toward the Crimson Tree which speaketh at all times: "Verily, there is none other God besides Me, the Mighty, the Generous."

Subject: station of the Manifestation of God
Quotation: He is manifest in that Temple, the Temple of God in the kingdom of the heavens and the earth and whatsoever is between them, and unto Him shall all return.

Subject: station of the Manifestation of God
Quotation: To comprehend the Sun of Reality we would have to be greater (than the Sun). The Mirror of the Prophet cannot expand sufficiently to comprehend the Infinite.

Subject: station of the Manifestation of God
Quotation: I seemed to be standing...in the place of the Imam himself. More and yet more crowded in, taking their places in rows behind Me, until there was a vast multitude.

Subject: station of the Manifestation of God
Quotation: This is the time wherein He Who conversed with God on Sinai hath seated Himself upon the throne of Revelation, despite every remote scholar and suspicious commander.

Subject: station of the Manifestation of God
Quotation: Compare not the Soul of God with any other, nor His words with that which people utter, nor what He possesseth with what ye possess, if ye be of those who comprehend.

Subject: station of the Manifestation of God
Quotation: It is worthy of a perfect being to have a sweet and fragrant disposition and temperament. Loving-kindness befits Him, not wrath! Sweet honey is worthy of Him, not poison.

Subject: station of the Manifestation of God
Quotation: The Mystic is he who knoweth the Manifestation of My Self in My Beauty which dawneth forth through My Name in the vesture of Mine Order that is sanctified from all except Me

Subject: station of the Manifestation of God
Quotation: O people of earth! Hearken unto the call of God from this Arabian Youth, whom He hath chosen for Himself. He is, in truth, by the truth, ordained to be round about the Fire.

Subject: station of the Manifestation of God
Quotation: He Who was hidden in the eternity of eternities, and Who is the Speaker of the Mount Who proclaims: "Verily, there is no God but I, the Protector, the Self-Subsisting."

Subject: station of the Manifestation of God
Quotation: In the Manifestation of the Holy Divine Manifestations, these hearts are purified from outward effects. The Holy Divine Manifestations have come to give insight to creation.

Subject: station of the Manifestation of God
Quotation: The Most Great Glory, the power and might and sovereignty and inner grandeur, belongs to that Lord of the world and Pride of Adam, which was and is and ever shall be with Him

Subject: station of the Manifestation of God
Quotation: The story of Baha'u'llah's response to the two believers debating whether he was God or the reflection of God demonstrates the complex nature of the station of the Manifestation.

Subject: station of the Manifestation of God
Quotation: He, verily, is the One Who speaketh the truth at the heart of the world...The Light walketh, and the Book speaketh, and the Ancient Beauty calleth out in the midst of the atmosphere

Subject: station of the Manifestation of God
Quotation: The Exalted One (may my spirit be sacrificed for Him) was content with being the Gate; the people did not accept it. He said "I am the Remnant of God"; the people did not accept it.

Subject: station of the Manifestation of God
Quotation: "She hath believed in the Manifestations of Thy unity appearing in the garments of Thy eternity and recognized the Dawning-places of Thy constancy in the holy temples of Thy sovereignty."

Subject: station of the Manifestation of God
Quotation: Description of His sovereignty that cannot be withstood: "He Who was promised hath appeared with such sovereignty as neither the might of princes nor the clamor of divines could withstand"

Subject: station of the Manifestation of God
Quotation: Verily I say! No one hath apprehended the root of this Cause. None among the Manifestations of old, except to a prescribed degree, hath ever completely apprehended the nature of this Revelation.

Subject: station of the Manifestation of God
Quotation: Our Lord said the Muhammadans were accustomed to think Mahomet the greater because of his title "Seal of the Prophets," but in the time of Jesus spirituality and spiritual life was far greater.

Subject: station of the Manifestation of God
Quotation: A Manifestation that has remembered God, glorified be His glory, with utmost greatness, testified to His knowledge, and confessed His sanctification and transcendence above all peers and likeness

Subject: station of the Manifestation of God
Quotation: He has appeared with sovereignty from His presence and has revealed what He willed. He is the Mighty, the Powerful...He is the One before Whom, when He appeared, the verses bowed down in submission

Subject: station of the Manifestation of God
Quotation: The Person of the Manifestation hath ever been the representative and mouthpiece of God. He, in truth, is the Day Spring of God's most excellent Titles, and the Dawning-Place of His exalted Attributes.

Subject: station of the Manifestation of God
Quotation: They had likewise announced that at the time of the manifestation of that Dawning-Place of divine effulgences, all the Prophets and Messengers, even the Qa'im Himself, would gather beneath His blessed standard.

Subject: station of the Manifestation of God
Quotation: Remember the Wronged One, He Whose mention all the Prophets and Messengers have heard in the divine Books, Tablets and Scriptures, and Who, by divine command, they have all given glad tidings of to all created things.

Subject: station of the Manifestation of God
Quotation: until ye drove from His homeland this Bird that dwelt therein by the command of the All-Wise, the All-Knowing... inform thy people that the Bird hath taken flight - the Bird whose departure or death was their only desire

Subject: station of the Manifestation of God
Quotation: For verily I am the Manifestation of God and all besides God is His creation, and the Letters of Truth are nearer than all else unto God. Through them God initiated this creation and through them will He cause it to return.

Subject: station of the Manifestation of God
Quotation: they whom God hath made the guides of His creation and the manifestations of His Cause and the dawning-places of His revelation and the treasury of the pearls of His utterance and the repository of the mysteries of His days

Subject: station of the Manifestation of God
Quotation: O Mahdi! This is a station that none among the servants hath known from the beginning that hath no beginning, nor shall anyone ascend unto it save through My might, My power, and My sovereignty that hath encompassed all regions.

Subject: station of the Manifestation of God
Quotation: And Muhammad, the Apostle of God, ascended not unto heaven until He had perfected the entire Faith... And verily in relation to His own essence, no one can know Him save God and that which was above Him in the station of Lordship.

Subject: station of the Manifestation of God
Quotation: He summoned the servants unto Thee and commanded them to pure piety in Thy days, and to gaze toward the horizon of Thy glory and to turn to the court of Thy grace...the Manifestation of Thy Cause and the Dawning-Place of Thy signs

Subject: station of the Manifestation of God
Quotation: Thus does thy Lord choose thee and teach thee the interpretation of sayings and perfect His favor upon thee... We have chosen thee in truth and taught thee from the interpretation of the Book that which beseemeth none besides thee.

Subject: station of the Manifestation of God
Quotation: From the day of His manifestation to the present time He has been resuscitating hearts and quickening spirits. He has exercised that vivifying influence in the realm of hearts and spirits; therefore, His resuscitation is everlasting.

Subject: station of the Manifestation of God
Quotation: Divine Manifestations are a different creation...Prophets, therefore, have a station of their own...But observe what a banner of unique being Christ unfurled without friend or helper. All are from God but all have different stations.

Subject: station of the Manifestation of God
Quotation: The Book declares. What It declares? It declares that the Mystery has come. The Shell declares: The ideal Pearl has come. The Horizon declares: The most great Orb had dawned. The Sinaitic Mountain declares: The Interlocutor has appeared.

Subject: station of the Manifestation of God
Quotation: He manifesteth Himself once unto all created things through His Most Great Name, then through His other Name, then again He manifesteth Himself through that which transcendeth all names and all who dwell in the most exalted Paradise.

Subject: station of the Manifestation of God
Quotation: The Holy Tree (Sadrat) is, in a sense, the Manifestation of the One True God, exalted be He. The intent of all exalted names and titles revealed in the Bayan and from the Pen of the Most High in this Revelation is the Manifestation of God Himself.

Subject: station of the Manifestation of God
Quotation: Baha'u'llah is the perfection and maturity of the essence of humanity, manifesting this in Fatherhood with command and Authority, and we find in the Surat-u'l-Hykl that Baha'u'llah said: "Verily we have seized the lives and are beginning a new creation."

Subject: station of the Manifestation of God
Quotation: The Beloved bears witness: By God! This indeed is the Best-Beloved. He, verily, is the One intended in the Tablets of God, the Mighty, the Praised. The Interlocutor bears witness: The All-Bountiful has come and from Him has issued forth every wise command.

Subject: station of the Manifestation of God
Quotation: "Outwardly the holy Manifestations of God were completely humiliated and despised. They were mocked by all. But in a short space of time the penetrative influence of their words filled the hearts and the sun of their greatness and majesty illumined the world."

Subject: station of the Manifestation of God
Quotation: For the Sun of Thy Revelation is one, though it rise infinitely unto infinity - it is but one fruit, though its rising in each Manifestation be according to what Thou hast ordained for it. Thus do I testify that it is a Mirror that speaketh naught except from Thee

Subject: station of the Manifestation of God
Quotation: The seat whereon I am established is the Throne of God. Imagine not a throne for your Lord God in heaven, for He is in heaven a God established upon His throne, and on earth a God established upon His throne, and between them a God established upon His throne.

Subject: station of the Manifestation of God
Quotation: How mighty is Your right, how great what befits the wondrous nature of Your station, the loftiness of Your rank, and the sublimity of Your manifestations! You have severed yourself unto God with all you possess to a summit of elevation none has preceded or shall attain

Subject: station of the Manifestation of God
Quotation: Baha'u'llah is the Dawning Place of Holiness. Baha'u'llah is the Source, the One Who has illumined this dark world, made corporeal into spiritual, quickened the dormant minds, changed the earthly souls into heavenly ones and given life to the dead and sight to the blind.

Subject: station of the Manifestation of God
Quotation: And I bear witness that Muhammad is Thy servant whom Thou didst choose from the midst of eternity above all peoples, and didst select to stand in Thy station in creation and invention, for Thou hast never been and wilt never be associated with the making of created things

Subject: station of the Manifestation of God
Quotation: And if beauty were as ye behold it, then ye would find this upon the earth - and how do ye not see it as animal? Nay, your souls desire not to be cut off unto it, for within it exists not the form of the One in Whom is the Beauty of God through which God hath manifested His Self.

Subject: station of the Manifestation of God
Quotation: Through Thee hath God opened what He hath opened, through Thee hath God originated what He hath originated, through Thee hath God sent down what He hath sent down, through Thee hath God brought forth what He hath brought forth, and through Thee hath God created what He hath created.

Subject: station of the Manifestation of God
Quotation: And in this station His Holiness is the First Mention and the Wondrous Adam, which is the station of the determination of the First Point. And in this station he is mentioned by his self, essence, hand, face, eye, hearing, sight and all active names in their state of attribution to God.

Subject: station of the Manifestation of God
Quotation: Lastly the perfect man, the Prophet, is one who is transfigured, one who has the purity and clearness of a perfect mirror -- one who reflects the Sun of Truth. Of such a one -- of such a Prophet and Messenger -- we can say that the Light of Divinity with the heavenly Perfections dwells in him.

Subject: station of the Manifestation of God
Quotation: The Point of the Bayan hath said that a one-year old seed of the Day of His Revelation is mightier than all who are in the Bayan. And likewise He hath said: "I have written a gem concerning His remembrance: He shall not be indicated by My indication, nor by what hath been revealed in the Bayan."

Subject: station of the Manifestation of God
Quotation: And among the meanings of the mystery of sacrifice is that the Point of Truth becomes manifest and evident in all aspects, effects, ordinances and deeds in universal and particular manifestations - meaning that souls become illumined by Its effulgences and hearts become enlightened by Its lights.

Subject: station of the Manifestation of God
Quotation: Denial of the Covenant annuls the station of every soul and all promises of prophets of past and present ages. So how can now a denyer hope to retain that which is a title in this world, and that dependent upon true service and obedience. And having disobeyed, fell like Lucifer never to rise again.

Subject: station of the Manifestation of God
Quotation: The Manifestation possesses essential infallibility as an inseparable aspect of their reality and station. They are the embodiment of "He doeth whatsoever He willeth" and their words and actions are identical with truth and conformable to reality. No believer has the right to object to their commands.

Subject: station of the Manifestation of God
Quotation: Know that, while the Manifestations of God possess infinite virtues and perfections, They occupy but three stations: the first is the station of the physical realm, the second is the station of the human soul, which is the intermediate realm, and the third is that of Divine appearance and celestial splendour.

Subject: station of the Manifestation of God
Quotation: These Souls are the universal Manifestations of God and have been sent forth to the entire world and the generality of mankind. But the universal Manifestations are all-encompassing: They are like the root, and all others are as the branches; they are like the sun, and all others are as the moon and the stars.

Subject: station of the Manifestation of God
Quotation: Verily this is how it is, for through the mere flowing of the water of that river, none hath entered God's religion save those rarer in existence than red sulfur. They are the chosen ones who have reached the summit of detachment. May God grant me to meet them in the holy land without mention of separation or prevention.

Subject: station of the Manifestation of God
Quotation: I am the Primal Point from which have been generated all created things. I am the Countenance of God Whose splendour can never be obscured, the Light of God Whose radiance can never fade. Whoso recognizeth Me, assurance and all good are in store for him, and whoso faileth to recognize Me, infernal fire and all evil await him...

Subject: station of the Manifestation of God
Quotation: The ultimate truth is that these holy Manifestations are like mirrors and the rays of the Sun of Reality are reflected in these mirrors. Thus if that Sun which is reflected in the mirrors says "I am the Sun," it is absolute truth. Despite this, it does not say it has incarnated, for that Sun is eternally in its exalted sanctity.

Subject: station of the Manifestation of God
Quotation: The Promised One hath come with the signs of signs from the dawning place of thy Lord's loving-kindness, the Mighty, the Powerful. Verily He attracts thee to the Most Exalted Horizon, the station wherein was raised the rustling of the Divine Lote-Tree and wherein the Tongue of Grandeur spoke while seated upon the Throne of Divine Evidence.

Subject: station of the Manifestation of God
Quotation: This is the Manifestation which none hath known save he who hath cast away what the people possess and turned wholly unto the Countenance of God, the Radiant, the Luminous. God hath made His Day transcend understanding, even as His own Self transcendeth comprehension. Thus hath the decree been sent down from One Who is All-Knowing, All-Wise.

Subject: station of the Manifestation of God
Quotation: The difference between Christ as a divine Manifestation and the Pope as a religious leader is shown through their respective stations: Christ's election was from God while the Pope's was from men. Though Christ was persecuted and crucified, His divine station and glory endures eternally, while the Pope's earthly authority and fame quickly fades.

Subject: station of the Manifestation of God
Quotation: The bearer of that Most Great Standard was the Primal Mirror, the Seal of the Prophets - may the spirit of all else be sacrificed for His sake. Through Him He made manifest the pearls of the ocean of knowledge and displayed them before the eyes of true money-changers. Exalted, exalted be His station, and exalted, exalted be His power and sovereignty!

Subject: station of the Manifestation of God
Quotation: Every remembrance from the light of thy remembrance originates in existence and every light from the lights of the garments of thy countenance rises from the treasury of the unseen to the horizon of limitations...glory be unto God - greatness hath submitted to the majesty of thy greatness and power hath humbled itself before the sovereignty of thy might

Subject: station of the Manifestation of God
Quotation: A great Master will be the Educator of the world of humanity... His Knowledge must be innate and spontaneous and not acquired... He must answer the questions of all the sages, solve all the difficult problems of humanity and be able to withstand all the persecutions and sufferings heaped upon him... His Knowledge must be infinite and his wisdom all-comprehensive.

Subject: station of the Manifestation of God
Quotation: Then He chose from among His creation a Hidden Essence, a Treasured Purity, a Camphorated Glory, and made it the Sun of His Countenance, the Garment of His Face, the Reality of His Oneness, and the Object of His Eternal Self-Subsistence...He made it the Primal Point, the Most Exalted Paradise, the Most Glorious Summit, the Greatest Sign, and the Most Evident Countenance.

Subject: station of the Manifestation of God
Quotation: The likeness of the Point of the Bayan is as the likeness of this sun - when it riseth ye see nothing in the sky save it. Even so, on that Day ye shall see no truth except before Me, and likewise on the Day when God shall make Me manifest - on that Day there shall be no truth except with Me, and all shadows prostrate themselves before God, and all are worshippers of Him.

Subject: station of the Manifestation of God
Quotation: Therefore, O my God, shower upon it all Thy blessings, and send down upon it Thy manifestations, and ordain for it in the Kingdom of the hereafter and the present all Thy attributes, for this is an Essential Reality, a Pure Essence, an Abstract Spirit, and a Camphorated Soul, a pristine Being, which hath no will save the essence of Thy Will, and no desire save the essence of Thy Desire.

Subject: station of the Manifestation of God
Quotation: The Ancient Beauty hath ascended the throne of His Most Great Name, and the bird of the throne is warbling in His presence, proclaiming... He, verily, is the One Whose mention hath enraptured the inmates of heaven and the Concourse on High, and Whose remembrance hath been extolled by all created things and hath prompted them to proclaim: "No God is there but Him, the All-Knowing, the All-Wise!"

Subject: station of the Manifestation of God
Quotation: Praise be to God Who hath made known to creation the station of His manifestation through His own Self, and hath decreed the signs of knowledge without likeness through His wisdom, and hath deposited the example of separation in the realities of hearts without similitude from His own Self, and hath sent down the signs of Sinai upon the forms of all created things without definition from aught else.

Subject: station of the Manifestation of God
Quotation: The first in the world is first, and among its realms is the world of man, and among them the world of jinn, and among them the world of dominion, and among them the station of minerals, and among them the station of plants, and among them the station of inanimate objects. Indeed, all the ranks of all atoms speak of naught but the manifestation of His prophethood in the kingdom of names and attributes.

Subject: station of the Manifestation of God
Quotation: With such a decisive text, how can testing come into play? His Holiness the Prince [Ali], peace be upon him, was standing in an elevated place when a denier said, "O Ali, are you confident in God's protection?" He replied "Yes." Then he said "Throw yourself down from this high place and trust in God's protection." In reply he said "It is not for me to test God, rather it befits God to test His servant."

Subject: station of the Manifestation of God
Quotation: Having barred the way that leadeth unto Thee, thou hast, by virtue of Thine authority and through the potency of Thy will, called into being Them Who are the Manifestations of Thy Self, and hast entrusted Them with Thy message unto Thy people, and caused Them to become the Day-Springs of Thine inspiration, the Exponents of Thy Revelation, the Treasuries of Thy Knowledge and the Repositories of Thy Faith

Subject: station of the Manifestation of God
Quotation: Today we believe Baha'o'llah to be an educator of humanity, as Abraham, Moses and Jesus were educators. Are His teachings worthy of serious attention? He originated and proclaimed them. He caused others to believe and follow them. What is the function of a teacher and educator of humanity? By what evidence shall we recognize him? Is it not his power to train and develop, as children are trained at school?

Subject: station of the Manifestation of God
Quotation: The Apostles of Christ attained to the greatest station in life, yet they were vilified and scorned in their days because they were followers of the humble Nazarene and they were considered us the most despised and ignorant! But now the brilliant lights of their stations have flooded the whole world with knowledge and wisdom. Each one of the Apostles is shining like unto a star from the horizon of Eternal Glory.

Subject: station of the Manifestation of God
Quotation: The sublimity of glory, the exaltation of beauty, the transcendence of deeds, and the supremacy of self-subsistence and independence - who can describe Him by that which is attributed to Him? For every description is described through the manifestation of itself, and every attribute is attributed through the manifestation of its own nature. This is the mirror wherein none shall see God except God, before and after.

Subject: station of the Manifestation of God
Quotation: He hath made them guides to Thy names and channels for the manifestation of Thy knowledge and examples. All besides them among Thy creatures are created through them, sustained through them, caused to die through them, and given life through them. Thou hast distinguished them with Thy remembrance only because they believe in the Manifestation of Thy Self, their Names in every Dispensation and Concealment from Thee.

Subject: station of the Manifestation of God
Quotation: The Truth, exalted be His station, is the possessor of the Most Great Infallibility, and the meaning of the Most Great Infallibility is that error, mistake and forgetfulness have no access whatsoever to that realm. This is the station of "He doeth what He willeth and ordaineth what He pleaseth." If He declares the qiblih to be toward the east, it is the indubitable truth, and if He declares it to be toward the west, likewise.

Subject: station of the Manifestation of God
Quotation: Consider his Holiness Christ: He appeared in the world as one of the poor. He was born of a lowly family; all the apostles of Christ were of humble birth and His followers were of the very poorest of the community. If wealth were a necessity, Christ would have wished it for himself. He lived a simple life, and one of the titles of Baha'o'llah was 'the poor one.' In Persian His title was 'darvish' and that means one who has not a slave.

Subject: station of the Manifestation of God
Quotation: A Perfect Man is needed in this perspicuous age...to deem him who will be the World Teacher to be in need of education by others is like trying to create a resplendent Sun by using the oil and wick of a candle. But the light of this Perfect Man must be heavenly, not earthly; His perfections must be innate, not acquired; and His writings must be unbounded bestowals, not the products of the finite disciplines of this limited and contingent world.

Subject: station of the Manifestation of God
Quotation: This has been the mission of all the divine messengers -- to make man conscious of his eternal part. "By God, who is the only God and there is no God but he, this servant swears the masters did not come that man should adore them, or worship them or acknowledge their prophethood. Nay, rather, the masters of all time have suffered for none other than this -- the fleshly veils might be rent asunder and reality become manifest."

Subject: station of the Manifestation of God
Quotation: Nay, by Thy glory, the Manifestation of Thy Self, Who is the Point, and whosoever is endued with His attributes, will never love to witness aught save in those who obey Thee and walk in the ocean of Thy good-pleasure. And should He witness one who obeyeth Thee not and walketh not in the ocean of Thy good-pleasure, there is no doubt that should such a one turn unto Him, He will don the garment of Thy severity, Thy grasp, Thy forbearance and Thy conquest.

Subject: station of the Manifestation of God
Quotation: As to the manifestation of the Greatest Name (BAHA'O'LLAH): This was the Divine Manifestation which appeared upon the earthly world. This is He whom God promised in all His Books and Scriptures, such as the Bible, the Gospels and the Koran. All of these Books indicate this fact, and the least doubt cannot possibly occur to the minds concerning this clear fact, as is recorded in detail in the heavenly Books, especially in the brilliant and holy Tablets.

Subject: station of the Manifestation of God
Quotation: And peace and blessings be upon the Point of Existence, the Ultimate Goal, and the Possessor of the Praiseworthy Station, through Whom God revealed His names and attributes, sent down His principles and ordinances, and exalted the station of His loved ones. He it is through Whom the hidden secret and the treasured matter were revealed, through Whom divine favors were completed, clear proofs were concluded, and the blessings of revelation and utterance were cut off.

Subject: station of the Manifestation of God
Quotation: First Visitation... God beareth witness that there is none other God but Him. His are the most excellent names. All that are in the heavens and on the earth and whatsoever lieth between them sing His praise. There is none other God but Him, the Sovereign, the Self-Subsisting. And verily the Glory from God was upon the Throne of Reality in the Qur'an, wherein all who are in the heavens and who are on the earth and whatsoever lieth between them were illumined by the light of His Being.

Subject: station of the Manifestation of God
Quotation: He Who hath come from the heaven of divine revelation is the Hidden Secret, the Impenetrable Mystery, Whose advent hath been foretold in the Book of God and hath been heralded by His Prophets and Messengers. Through Him the mysteries have been unravelled, the veils rent asunder and the signs and evidences disclosed. Lo! He hath now been made manifest. He bringeth to light whatsoever He willeth, and treadeth upon the high places of the earth, invested with transcendent majesty and power.

Subject: station of the Manifestation of God
Quotation: I gave an exposition regarding the claim of the Divine Manifestations, Who considered Themselves God's mirror. I also considered the situation appropriate for saying, His Holiness the Bab states, 'I am the Mirror of God.' His purpose is to show the Sanctified Manifestations teach that, 'God's Effulgence shines upon Us, and from Us shines upon the creation.' It is in this station that They claim divinity. If the sun shining in the mirror claims that it is the sun, indeed it has spoken the truth.

Subject: station of the Manifestation of God
Quotation: The Blessed Perfection and the Bab are Unique and Peerless in this Dispensation - until the next Manifestation. The belief, the opinion and the thought of all the believers must revolve around this common Center. This oneness of belief must become fully realized; so that in the future there may arise no difference. His Holiness the Bab was the Morn of Guidance; the Blessed Perfection the Desired One of all the religions and nations and all of us are under the Blessed Shade, non-existent and evanescent.

Subject: station of the Manifestation of God
Quotation: Man, therefore, on the plane of the contingent world is the most perfect being. By man is meant the perfect individual, who is like unto a mirror in which the divine perfections are manifested and reflected. But the sun doth not descend from the height of its sanctity to enter into the mirror, but when the latter is purified and turned towards the Sun of Truth, the perfections of this Sun, consisting of light and heat, are reflected and manifested in that mirror. These souls are the Divine Manifestations of God.

Subject: station of the Manifestation of God
Quotation: Nay, that which the Manifestation of Thy Self doeth, that is what Thou hast done, and that which the Manifestation of Thy wisdom decreeth, that is what Thou hast decreed. And verily it is one Essence, were it to rise with that which hath no beginning, and one Reality, were it to set with that which hath no equal, and one Simplicity, were it to rest in the heaven of majesty with that which hath no peer. For its likeness before Thee is as the likeness of the sun which Thou didst not create except through manifestation.

Subject: station of the Manifestation of God
Quotation: He hath come Who was mentioned in the hearts of the Prophets and inscribed by the Most Exalted Pen in the Books of God. Say: He hath appeared and made manifest that which was hidden in knowledge, and hath spoken before the faces of the world in such wise that neither the veils of the wrongdoers nor the gestures of the heedless have hindered Him. The Sovereign of existence Who from the beginning of the Cause stood before the faces of all nations and spoke forth in praise and glorification, Who brought that which all the books of the past cannot equal.

Subject: station of the Manifestation of God
Quotation: I testify that Thou art He through Whom the Beauty of the All-Glorious was established upon the throne of His name, the All-Merciful, and through Whom the Primal Will was manifested unto all created beings, and through Whom the bounty of Paradise descended from the heaven of grace from Thy Lord, the Mighty, the Bestower, and through Whom the Command of God, the Supreme, the Powerful, the Mighty, the Omnipotent, was revealed. I testify that Thou wert the first Light that shone forth from the Beauty of Divine Unity and the first Sun that dawned from the horizon of Divinity.

Subject: station of the Manifestation of God
Quotation: I testify, O my God, that from the first moment Thou didst manifest the Manifestation of Thyself, it was the first Day of Resurrection. Thou didst make Thyself known to all things as Thou wert known by all before, lest any should be veiled from Thy countenance after Thy making Thyself known and Thy revelation of Thy verses. For whoso had known Thee before was certain that none but Thee could reveal a verse, and after one hath seen, no path remaineth save to be convinced that both are from Thee, for none but Thee hath ever been the Source of Messengers or the Revealer of Books.

Subject: station of the Manifestation of God
Quotation: When He created the Sun of Truth through the Tongue of God by itself - for example, when God revealed to Muhammad, the Messenger of God, that there is no God but Him - He manifested unto him that he should speak from God, saying: Verily We have sent thee as a witness, a bearer of glad tidings, a warner, one who summoneth unto God by His leave, and as a luminous lamp. Through this Word was the Sun of Truth created, such that from the beginning that hath no beginning it hath been the Throne of God's manifestation, and unto the end that hath no end it shall be the Seat of God's revelation.

Subject: station of the Manifestation of God
Quotation: So grievous have become all matters unto Me from every direction that I have accepted for Myself that which no one among all the peoples of the world would accept for himself. If My crime be that there have been revealed unto Me the verses of God, then by God, this hath not proceeded from Me but rather from One mighty and beautiful. By God, I am not the first to have committed this crime - nay, most of the Prophets committed it, among them Ali before Nabil, and before him Muhammad the Apostle of God, and before him the Spirit (Christ), and before him He Who conversed with God (Moses) - all spoke that which the Spirit inspired them from the Kingdom of God, the All-Possessing, the Almighty.

Subject: station of the Manifestation of God
Quotation: Blessings and peace be upon the first ear that was blessed to hearken unto the call of the Lord of Names, and the first eye that witnessed and beheld the greatest signs of its Lord, and the first hand that was raised to the heaven of bounty, and the first foot that hastened to the seat of the throne of the Creator of heaven, and the first countenance that turned toward the lights of the Face, and the first light that shone forth from the horizon of the heaven of the Cause whereby surged the ocean of knowledge in creation and the mysteries of the Books were revealed through clear proof and evidence, and through whom the stations of revelation and inspiration were completed and the messages of God, the Lord of all beings, were sealed.

Subject: station of the Manifestation of God
Quotation: Know that the human spirit is one, but it manifests itself in various members of the body in a certain (measure or) form. The human spirit is existent in the sight (eyes); it is also existent in the brain, which is the location of great functions and powers; it is also existent in the heart, which organ is largely connected with the brain or the center of the mind, and the heart, or that center which is connected with the brain, has a distinct and separate function, effect and appearance. In this connection, the hair and the nails have no command (or direct feeling). Figuratively speaking, the Father is the center of the brain and the Son is the center of the heart; the rest of the Prophets are members and parts. Fatherhood and Prophethood, in this case, are two expressions of the same thing, as man and creature are two names of the same reality.

Subject: station of the Manifestation of God
Quotation: Know that verily I have been and remain a believer, confessor, submitter, proclaimer, rememberer, speaker, caller, crier, exclaimer, declarer, conveyor, and one who announces with the loudest voice that He is the Lord of the Most High, the Lote-Tree beyond which there is no passing, the Tree of the Uttermost Boundary, the Kingdom on High, the Dominion of the Cloud, the Divine Realm of Immortality, the Spirit of Glory, the Most Great Mystery, the Most Perfect Word, the Ancient Manifestation, the Most Noble Temple, the Secret Symbol, the Lord of Nations, the Surging Ocean, the Most Exalted Word, the First Pearl, the Hidden Scroll, the Treasured Book, the Beauty of Divine Unity, the Manifestation of Identity, and the Dawning-Place of Divine Unity. But for Him, existence would not have appeared, nor would the Intended One be known, nor would the Beauty of the Adored One have shone forth. By God! By His Name were created the heavens and all therein, and the earth and all thereon. Through Him the seas were set in motion, the rivers flowed, the trees bore fruit. Through Him were the religions established and the Beauty of the All-Merciful was made manifest.

Subject: station of the Manifestation of God
Quotation: All that God hath revealed aforetime, or in this Book, or will reveal hereafter through the appearance of His Self - that is the appearance of the Primal Tree which reciteth the verses of God.

Subject: station; mission; authority of Abdu'l-Baha
Quotation: This Servant so far has not called Himself the Greatest Branch, but Abdu'l-Baha. At most, on a rare occasion, even more exceptional than rare, has the Son of Baha been revealed by His pen. This also has been due to profound mysteries, otherwise, I consider Myself as the Servant of His servants, and My position, words and deeds attest to this matter.

Subject: station; mission; authority of Abdu'l-Baha
Quotation: Do you know how I administer this Faith?  I pull he sails of the ship firmly and fasten the ropes tight. I locate my destination and then by the power of My will I hold the wheel and head out. No matter how strong the storm, no matter how dangerous the threat to the safety of the ship, I do not change course. I do not become agitated or disheartened; I persevere until I reach my goal. If I were to hesitate or change direction at the sight of every danger, the Ark of the Cause of God would surely fail to reach its destination.

Subject: station; mission; authority of Abdu'l-Baha
Quotation: 'Abdu'l-Baha is the Expounder of the Word, not the law-giver. 'Abdu'l-Baha has explained the divine law - whoso wishes may accept it, and whoso wishes not need not accept it. In any case, it is incumbent upon us to explain God's law and interpret the meaning of the concise verses. As for ordinances not mentioned in the Book, these all revert to the House of Justice, not to 'Abdu'l-Baha, for He is the Interpreter of what is mentioned in the Book, not the Author of unrevealed laws.

Subject: station; mission; authority of Abdu'l-Baha
Quotation: Hold fast to the Covenant which hath emanated from the Supreme Pen and which is scintillating with the light of the Orb of the Horizons. Know thou verily, BAHA'O'LLAH is the Promised One in all the Books and Tablets, and verily, this servant, is the herald of the Kingdom of God.

Subject: station; mission; authority of Abdu'l-Baha
Quotation: after the Ascension He raised high the Standard of the Covenant in the shade of the Tree of Life and appointed the Center of the Covenant

Subject: station; mission; authority of Abdu'l-Baha
Quotation: The point is that the Blessed Beauty has no like or peer, He is unique in His essence and sanctified and holy in His attributes. I am under His shadow and a servant at His Threshold.

Subject: station; mission; authority of Abdu'l-Baha
Quotation: Firmness in Covenant means love and obedience to the Command of Abdul-Baha.

Subject: station; mission; authority of Abdu'l-Baha
Quotation: If the Branch sprung from the Ancient Root - who is explicitly designated in the Mighty Text and clearly appointed in the Perspicuous Book and who, by the decisive command of God and the explicit text of the Testament of the All-Merciful, is to be obeyed and referred to by all - is counted as the chief of the polytheists, while all the branches, leaves, kindred and beloved ones are commanded to turn to him and look to him, would there remain any mention, respect or existence for anyone else? No, by God!

Subject: station; mission; authority of Abdu'l-Baha
Quotation: The Ancient Beauty and the Greatest Name nourished this servant with the milk of servitude and raised him in the embrace of servitude.

Subject: station; mission; authority of Abdu'l-Baha
Quotation: when Huquq is given Abdu'l Baha will ascertain how much of it is for the Mashriq'u'l Adhkar, how much for teaching and how much for the needy, etc.

Subject: station; mission; authority of Abdu'l-Baha
Quotation: As the Centre of the Covenant of God, I promulgate the laws of God, interpret His Holy Word, protect His Cause and raise the banner of divine Unity. However, I do not legislate.

Subject: station; mission; authority of Abdu'l-Baha
Quotation: They must hold fast to whatever this servant sayeth or writeth...The tongue of the friends of God must be the interpreter of this servant's tongue, and their pen the interpreter of this servant's pen.

Subject: station; mission; authority of Abdu'l-Baha
Quotation: Whosoever claims that Abdul-Baha has given to him a tablet or sent a cablegram he must prove it (by showing it). He must bring forth the unmistakable and valid evidence, signed by my own written signature

Subject: station; mission; authority of Abdu'l-Baha
Quotation: O Ali! Know with absolute certainty that my name is Abdu'l-Baha, my title is Abdu'l-Baha, my attribute is Abdu'l-Baha... This is my path, my religion, my way, my character, my acknowledgment and my confession

Subject: station; mission; authority of Abdu'l-Baha
Quotation: This servant has only the station and name and designation of Abdu'l-Baha, nothing more. I have no name and attribute and title and reality and essence and being and mention and praise except this renowned name.

Subject: station; mission; authority of Abdu'l-Baha
Quotation: He arose with such selflessness, evanescence and servitude at the Sacred Threshold that it has no equal or likeness. He is even shy to mention himself as a Branch. His name is 'Abdu'l-Baha and his initials are 'A.A.

Subject: station; mission; authority of Abdu'l-Baha
Quotation: The Master is Our shield and the shield of everyone else. It is the Master who stands up to everything and supplies the means for the well-being and peace of all the friends. May God preserve Him from the evil of the envious and inimical.

Subject: station; mission; authority of Abdu'l-Baha
Quotation: Since this servant's ultimate desire is to be accepted at the threshold of the Blessed Beauty in utter servitude, no title is sweet to his taste save the call of O `Abdu'l-Baha, and every other form of address becometh the cause of reproach.

Subject: station; mission; authority of Abdu'l-Baha
Quotation: We pray but God bestows healing. We do not make claims for ourselves. We are only the expounders of the Word. We are all promulgating the Cause of Baha'u'llah. I am 'Abdu'l-Baha. Address your needs to Him. I am only the expounder and promulgator of the Word.

Subject: station; mission; authority of Abdu'l-Baha
Quotation: The friends of God and the handmaids of the All-Merciful should know that in every movement of 'Abdu'l-Baha, in every word He uttereth, there lieth a great wisdom. If what He doeth appeareth to be strange, this is because the wisdom is not known to the friends.

Subject: station; mission; authority of Abdu'l-Baha
Quotation: And if I were to want a station for myself, God forbid, what station is greater than being a branch branched from the Ancient Root? By God the Truth, the necks of every station have been humbled and the heads of every station and rank have bowed before this mighty station

Subject: station; mission; authority of Abdu'l-Baha
Quotation: The Branch shall build the Temple of the Lord. The Temple means the religion in twelve nations and the country of holy places and the Holy Tombe. To disobey Abdul-Baha is to disobey Baha'o'llah. Their Station is equal in degree and their authority in those days with the people.

Subject: station; mission; authority of Abdu'l-Baha
Quotation: By God the Truth! 'Abdu'l-Baha is supported by the Most Glorious Beauty and aided by a power before which all necks shall bow. Soon you shall see the banner of hypocrisy reversed, the edifice of discord demolished, and the standards of peace and harmony waving over the horizons.

Subject: station; mission; authority of Abdu'l-Baha
Quotation: Moreover, until now what soul has been able to make such addresses in my presence, that he should be the second? For 'Abdu'l-Baha's mention and utterance are verses of servitude at the Divine Threshold, and the power of divine confirmation and assistance is from the All-Merciful.

Subject: station; mission; authority of Abdu'l-Baha
Quotation: The test of 'Abdu'l-Baha is not beautiful and befitting. As it is related from His Holiness the Prince [Imam 'Ali] - and this tradition is also mentioned in the Mathnavi and is well-known among all people - the Center of the Covenant should test the people of the Cradle, not vice versa.

Subject: station; mission; authority of Abdu'l-Baha
Quotation: However, in relation to this servant, nothing beyond the word 'Abdu'l-Baha is permissible, and whatever exceeds this is contrary to the divine foundation and opposed to the good-pleasure of this ephemeral servant. This is my station, this is my position, this is my praise, and this is my portion.

Subject: station; mission; authority of Abdu'l-Baha
Quotation: He turned, by My leave, toward My Prison, and entered the seat of the Throne, and attained the presence of the Face, and heard the call of his Lord, the Mighty, the Wise. We beseech God to assist him in serving His Cause and to grant him that which befits the days of his Lord, the Manifest, the Speaking, the All-Informed.

Subject: station; mission; authority of Abdu'l-Baha
Quotation: Thou hast observed with what power I sold your lands - which had no deed or documentation, and which you yourselves had hoped at most to sell for three hundred liras, and to which no one would come near, and which had completely slipped from your grasp - for five hundred liras, and you paid the claim of Siyyid 'Ali-Akbar.

Subject: station; mission; authority of Abdu'l-Baha
Quotation: Now either we must say the Blessed Beauty was mistaken or we must obey. And 'Abdu'l-Baha has no cause to call people to obedience except the spreading of the divine fragrances, the exaltation of the Word of God, the promotion of the unity of the human world, the establishment of universal peace, and similar divine commands.

Subject: station; mission; authority of Abdu'l-Baha
Quotation: It was like unto a sea of pure honey, or a fountain from the salsabel of the heavenly water or the Spring of Eternal Life flowing out of the Supreme Paradise... I declare by thyself that I have become enthralled with thy love, obligated to thee for thy affection and the prisoner of the Majesty of this title ('Abdu'l-Baha).

Subject: station; mission; authority of Abdu'l-Baha
Quotation: "Should the Universal House of Justice be operating, by the one True God, beside Whom there is no God, I would have been the first to obey its decree, even if it should be against me. It is true that that Body does not possess inherent infallibility, but it is under the shadow of the protection and shelter of the Blessed Beauty."

Subject: station; mission; authority of Abdu'l-Baha
Quotation: I am the servant of Baha'u'llah and nothing more; Abdu'l-Baha is the sum of all perfections. They must not attempt to surpass that name, "'Abdu'l-Baha". All must say to others that he claims for himself to be 'Abdu'l-Baha and the believers must call him by his name as he wishes. This is the only name he has appointed for himself.

Subject: station; mission; authority of Abdu'l-Baha
Quotation: But the Center of the Covenant is the reference point for all people and the interpreter of the Book, and all Baha'is are under his shadow. If anyone interprets the divine Book according to their own understanding contrary to the explicit text of the Pen of the Covenant, it is not acceptable and causes differences among the loved ones of God.

Subject: station; mission; authority of Abdu'l-Baha
Quotation: But my name should be confined to Abdul-Baha in all writings. This is the collective name which will gather all the people, and it is the strong fortress and protection of the Cause of God. The beloved ones must limit themselves to this. However, ye may mention me as the Light of Love of God, the Flame of the Guidance of God and the Banner of Peace and Harmony.

Subject: station; mission; authority of Abdu'l-Baha
Quotation: They found no means to accuse this servant of the Threshold except to open their tongues in calumny that "he claims lordship." Could there be any greater nonsense than this? No, by God! Setting aside all humanity, the very rocks, clods of earth and trees testify that 'Abdu'l-Baha desires nothing save servitude at the Threshold, and no word indicating existence ever issues from his mouth.

Subject: station; mission; authority of Abdu'l-Baha
Quotation: "Regarding myself, I am the Servant of Baha'u'llah and nothing more; 'Abdu'l-Baha is the sum of all perfections, they must not attempt to surpass that word, 'Abdu'l-Baha." He made it clearer to us by saying: master is one ray, one attribute of God, Lord is another, Christ is another; other terms of endearment are but rays. Under the name 'Abdu'l-Baha, all perfections are found. To call Him by any other name we take away from Him rather than exalt Him.

Subject: station; mission; authority of Abdu'l-Baha
Quotation: No Feast Days can be set aside or introduced except those relating to the Blessed Beauty and His Highness the Exalted Bab. Then, very earnest, very emphatic, addressing all of them, He said, 'Do you understand what I am saying? For if anything contrary to this be done, the Faith would become similar to those sects which have so many holidays and feasts that out of three hundred and sixty-five days in the year, some one hundred and eighty are feast days.'

Subject: station; mission; authority of Abdu'l-Baha
Quotation: In the Kitab-i-Aqdas, in two instances, He explicitly gave a decisive command and clearly designated the Interpreter of the Book. And in all divine Tablets, especially the Suriy-i-Ghusn, the meaning of which is entirely the servitude of 'Abdu'l-Baha - that is, whatever was necessary was revealed from the Supreme Pen about 'Abdu'l-Baha, and since 'Abdu'l-Baha is the Interpreter of the Book, He says this Suriy-i-Ghusn means the servitude of 'Abdu'l-Baha and nothing else.

Subject: station; mission; authority of Abdu'l-Baha
Quotation: The station of this servant is servitude to the Holy Threshold (BAHA'O'LLAH) and I glory and honor in this. Abdul-Baha is the standard of the divine love, the sign of the gift of God, the servant of the assemblage of the merciful ones, the light of the meeting of the spiritual ones. He is the orb of peace and reconciliation and the light of love in the world of humanity. He is the herald of the Kingdom of the Merciful One and the promulgator of the religion of rectitude and security. This is the station of this servant! This is the Truth!

Subject: station; mission; authority of Abdu'l-Baha
Quotation: You must not look upon the personality of Abdul-Baha, for he will eventually bid ye farewell. Nay, ye must observe the Word of God. If the Word of God is in the ascendant, be ye happy, joyous and thankful, even if Abdul-Baha be under a sword or beneath fetters and chains; for importance is in the holy temple of the Cause of God, and not in the physical mould of Abdul-Baha. Abdul-Baha is the servant of the Word of the Blessed Beauty and the manifestation of absolute servitude in the threshold of the Lord. He has no other station, grade, class or power. This is my utmost hope, and my abiding paradise.

Subject: station; mission; authority of Abdu'l-Baha
Quotation: In any case, convey my longing greetings to all the loved ones of God in Abadih. And if any mention is made in that land regarding the station of Abdul-Baha, nothing but this word is acceptable or beloved - all must utter only this word: Abdul-Baha. For example, if someone asks what is the meaning of The Branch that has branched from this Ancient Root, the answer is Abdul-Baha. How should one's attention be directed? The answer is Abdul-Baha. What is the meaning of the Surih of the Branch? The answer is Abdul-Baha. In short, if any word other than Abdul-Baha is uttered by any tongue regarding this servant, it is in opposition to the explicit text of this servant.

Subject: station; mission; authority of Abdu'l-Baha
Quotation: But as for me - my name is 'Abdu'l-Baha, my being is 'Abdu'l-Baha, my attributes are 'Abdu'l-Baha, my reality is 'Abdu'l-Baha, my praise is 'Abdu'l-Baha, for servitude to the Blessed Beauty is my glorious crown and service to all humanity is my perpetual religion. Through the bounty and favor of the Blessed Beauty, 'Abdu'l-Baha is the banner of the Most Great Peace that waves in the supreme heights, and through the gift of the Greatest Name, he is the lamp of universal peace that shines with the light of the love of God. He is the herald of the Kingdom who awakens East and West, and the voice of friendship, truthfulness, reality-worship and reconciliation that has created a tumult throughout all regions.

Subject: station; mission; authority of Abdu'l-Baha
Quotation: Now some capricious ones have appeared who have secretly started whispering, and when confident of someone, they openly mention it too. One says the Blessed Beauty made all independent, leaving no need - his secret intention being there is no need for the appointed station. Another says infallibility was confined to the Blessed Beauty, no one else is infallible - his inner meaning being that He Whom God Has Chosen can err. Another that whoever was accepted in the blessed days or was a believer, or had a tablet revealed for them, cannot become rejected - his true purpose being that if one opposes the good-pleasure and dares to show enmity, it causes no harm. They promote such statements secretly and openly, and the intention of all these sayings is to break the Covenant and Testament.

Subject: station; mission; authority of Abdu'l-Baha
Quotation: At that time [the ascension of Baha'u'llah] these words, meaning the term 'infallibility,' were never heard so that it could be determined whether it existed or not. These friends [the Covenant-breakers] first gradually introduced these words and spread them by word of mouth to divide the believers into two groups - one group to affirm and another to deny - and thereby create an opening to weaken the Covenant and Testament. But I swear by your precious life that I exist in a realm where I flee from all such thoughts. I know no infallibility except service at the Sacred Threshold and seek no unity except immersion in the ocean of His love. With my life I guard this Threshold - whoever agrees with me and girds up their loins, excellent is their aim, and whoever opposes, they know best - to them their religion and to me mine.

Subject: station; mission; authority of Abdu'l-Baha
Quotation: In utmost secrecy, they [the Covenant-breakers] sometimes say "The Book of God sufficeth us," and at times they utter "the day when God will enrich all through His abundance." At one moment they claim that infallibility is denied and error and mistake are possible and expected; at another, they outwardly profess unity with their tongues while in reality they seek to demean and disparage. They utter "the One Lord hath no partner" yet through these words they aim to confuse minds and disturb thoughts. This is indeed "a word of truth intended for falsehood," for the Ancient Beauty--may my soul be offered up for His exalted threshold--hath no partner or likeness. God forbid! Indeed, befitting servitude and true worship of Him is impossible and unattainable, for He alone wished to be the Beloved of the worlds and the Goal of the mystics. However, through such intimations, the people of doubts aim to scatter the Word of God, divide the party of God, and demean the Covenant and Testament of the All-Merciful, so that they might shake the weak souls with ornate speech. When such thoughts cross their minds, they raise the question of infallibility, while no one claims infallibility. When the weak-minded accept this, they secretly raise objections, and when this too is heard, they deny the Covenant and Testament from its foundation.

Subject: station; mission; authority of Abdu'l-Baha
Quotation: Then by the Supreme Pen the Book of the Covenant was inscribed and the Preserved Tablet of the Testament written, commanding all with explicit clear instruction to turn to, submit to, obey and follow

Subject: station; mission; authority of Abdu'l-Baha
Quotation: And in the Book of the Covenant He explicitly states that what is meant by this separated Branch is the Most Great Branch, and He commands all the Branches, Twigs, relatives and friends to turn to him.

Subject: station; mission; authority of Abdu'l-Baha
Quotation: O handmaid of the Lord, My title is 'Abdu'l-Baha, address Me with this title of glorious meaning.

Subject: station; mission; authority of Abdu'l-Baha
Quotation: As for my station, it is that of 'Abdu'l-Baha - the manifestation of servitude at the threshold of the Most Glorious Beauty.

Subject: station; mission; authority of Abdu'l-Baha
Quotation: I have no difference with anybody. I am busy in servitude to the Threshold of Baha'u'llah. Everybody who agrees with me, I feel attached to.

Subject: station; mission; authority of Abdu'l-Baha
Quotation: Now again the same is the case in the Manifestation of BAHA'O'LLAH. I beg of God that thy dear husband be guided through the light of guidance and become a sign of the gift of the Kingdom of ABHA.

Subject: station; mission; authority of Abdu'l-Baha
Quotation: My power consists of the Bestowals of the Blessed Beauty. They are all spiritual Favors given to me by BAHA'O'LLAH. From Early morning until now I have been reading and writing and I am feeling exceedingly well.

Subject: station; mission; authority of Abdu'l-Baha
Quotation: The light which I receive from his Holiness Baha'o'llah I give (that) unto you. Every grace which I receive from Him I give back to you. The teaching I have received from Baha'o'llah, I give unto you. The food which His holiness Baha'o'llah has given to me, I have made you my partners in it.

Subject: station; mission; authority of Abdu'l-Baha
Quotation: I am 'Abdu'l-Baha and no more. Whosoever praises me with any other title I am not pleased with him. I am the Servant at the Threshold of the Blessed Perfection and I hope that this servitude of mine shall become acceptable. Whosoever mentions any other name save this, I am not at all pleased with him. 'Abdu'l-Baha and no more.

Subject: station; mission; authority of Abdu'l-Baha
Quotation: When asked about his titles and names, 'Abdu'l-Baha emphasizes his preference for the name "'Abdu'l-Baha" while acknowledging other titles given by Baha'u'llah, stating "I like this name but the Blessed Beauty has given other names also." He explains his approach of humility, saying "One cannot speak in glorification of one's self. The others should do that."

Subject: station; mission; authority of Abdu'l-Baha
Quotation: Through the bounty and favor of the Blessed Perfection, Abdul-Baha is the ensign of the Most Great Peace, which is waving from the Supreme Apex; and through the gift of the Greatest Name, he is the lamp of universal salvation, which is shining with the light of the love of God. The herald of the Kingdom is he, so that he may awaken the people of the East and of the West. The voice of friendship, uprightness, truth and reconciliation is he, so as to cause acceleration throughout all regions.

Subject: station; mission; authority of Abdu'l-Baha
Quotation: Take me as thy example in all thy conduct and dealing. Look at me! Therefore you must strive as much thou canst not to sadden any heart. I desire that thou mayst walk in my footsteps!

Subject: station; mission; authority of Abdu'l-Baha
Quotation: In the Kitab-i-Aqdas, which is the reference for all, and in the Book of the Covenant, which is the last Tablet of the Blessed Beauty and the product of the Supreme Pen, He clearly and explicitly addresses first the Aghsan, then the Afnan, then the relatives, then all the loved ones to turn to the Center of the Covenant. Verses have been revealed in the Kitab-i-Aqdas stating that after the ascension you should turn to the Branch that has branched from the Ancient Root. In the Book of the Covenant, He explicitly states that this refers to the Center of the Covenant, and in clear terms in the special Tablet which is accepted by all, He names the center of violation explicitly, stating that should he deviate even slightly from the shadow of the Cause, he would cease to be a Branch.

Subject: station; mission; authority of Abdu'l-Baha
Quotation: Among the distinctive features of this Dispensation of Baha'u'llah, which did not exist in previous dispensations, is that Baha'u'llah left no room for discord, for in His blessed day He took a covenant and testament by the pen of the Most High, designated the reference point for all, explicitly appointed the Interpreter of the Book, and closed the doors of interpretation.

Subject: station; mission; authority of Abdu'l-Baha
Quotation: The swift remedy for this illness that has afflicted the Assembly is remembrance and reflection upon the Covenant - whether the Blessed Beauty took this Covenant for the obedience of all or for opposition. If it was taken for opposition, we have nothing to say, but if it was taken for obedience and agreement, then wavering causes evident loss and disobedience and inattention is a great error.

Subject: station; mission; authority of Abdu'l-Baha
Quotation: Abdul-Baha is the ark of the new covenant provided by Baha'o'llah in this day. Those who enter into this protection will avoid the flood of doubts and uncertainty which is gradually engulfing the world.

Subject: station; mission; authority of Abdu'l-Baha
Quotation: But being a Branch, through the clear saying of the Blessed Perfection, depends upon turning to and obeying the Centre of the Covenant and the Point of Promise. The Branch will be entirely cut off, if it ceases to turn (to this Centre).

Subject: station; mission; authority of Abdu'l-Baha
Quotation: They must not attempt to surpass that name, "'Abdu'l-Baha". All must say to others that he claims for himself to be 'Abdu'l-Baha and the believers must call him by his name as he wishes. This is the only name he has appointed for himself.

Subject: station; mission; authority of Abdu'l-Baha
Quotation: This mighty Covenant and Testament He took from all the friends through the Supreme Pen, first from the Branches, Twigs and relatives, and commanded obedience and turning to him, and through the Supreme Pen clearly stated that the intention of this verse of the Kitab-i-Aqdas referred to the Most Great Branch

Subject: station; mission; authority of Abdu'l-Baha
Quotation: Were not the mighty stronghold of the Cause of God to remain protected by the power of the Covenant, there would arise in a single day a thousand different sects among the Baha'is, even as was the case in former Dispensations. But in this holy Dispensation, to ensure the preservation of the Cause of God and to avoid dissension amongst His people, the Blessed Beauty -- may my soul be a sacrifice unto Him -- hath, through the agency of His supreme pen, established a Covenant and Testament and appointed a Centre, who is the expounder of the Book and the dispeller of discord. Whatsoever this Centre doth write or say is conformable to the truth and free from error under the protection of the Blessed Beauty. The very purpose of this Covenant and Testament is to dispel discord throughout the world.

Subject: status of kings; future of monarchy
Quotation: The kings and rulers of the world are not yet ready to acknowledge that universal peace is conducive to the life of the world of humanity.

Subject: status of kings; future of monarchy
Quotation: The monarchy continued in his family until Bonaparte's time when it became a republic. Constantine entered under the shadow of Christ and his reign extended until the time of Islam.

Subject: status of kings; future of monarchy

Subject: status of kings; future of monarchy

Subject: status of kings; future of monarchy
Quotation: Thou hadst written about the Crown Prince's accession to the throne of sovereignty. We hope that he may be assisted and confirmed, and that the means of comfort and tranquility for Iran and the Iranians may be secured.

Subject: status of kings; future of monarchy
Quotation: Know ye that God hath entrusted the earth to the hands of kings and made them the manifestations of His power amongst all created things, should they enter beneath the shadow of the Tree of His Cause. Apart from this, the matter resteth in His hands.

Subject: status of kings; future of monarchy
Quotation: In the blessed Tablets, mention of the justice and excellent governance of the august British government was repeatedly made, but now it has become evident. Indeed, the people of this land, after severe tribulations, have attained to comfort and tranquility.

Subject: status of kings; future of monarchy
Quotation: "There will be constitutional monarchy, but they will have no independent power. Baha'o'llah says that in each country there should be one head (king) but there will not be a supreme king for the whole world. The universal Beit-ul-Adl will be the supreme authority."

Subject: status of kings; future of monarchy
Quotation: Now observe what was revealed by the Most Exalted Pen upon first arrival in the prison. He says that glory has been taken from two groups - from kings and from divines. This theme has been repeatedly revealed, and enlightened, steadfast and successful souls have seen and heard it.

Subject: status of kings; future of monarchy
Quotation: submit to the threshold of the All-Knowing Lord that the fortress of the kingdom is protected and the throne is safeguarded under the protection of the Omnipotent Lord. The crown of sovereignty shall illuminate the realm and the royal throne shall attain ultimate stability and permanence.

Subject: status of kings; future of monarchy
Quotation: The King of Glory hath entrusted all the earth, both land and sea, to the hands of the kings - they are the manifestations of divine power, each according to his degree. Should they enter beneath the shadow of the Truth, they would be reckoned as of the Truth; otherwise, thy Lord is verily the All-Knowing, the All-Informed.

Subject: status of kings; future of monarchy
Quotation: Kings are the manifestations of the power, and the daysprings of the might and riches, of God. Pray ye on their behalf. He hath invested them with the rulership of the earth and hath singled out the hearts of men as His Own domain. It is incumbent upon everyone to aid those daysprings of authority and sources of command who are adorned with the ornament of equity and justice.

Subject: status of kings; future of monarchy
Quotation: And if thou shouldst meet with the Ambassador, say to him that this Cause, in Europe and America, hath revived the mention of the kings of Asia and spread their fame, and hath made clear that they are deserving of obedience, consideration, respect and honor, according to explicit texts from Baha'u'llah. We pray for their victory, confirmation, exaltation, success and endurance

Subject: status of kings; future of monarchy
Quotation: Praise be to God, His Imperial Majesty the Shah is just, perfect and kind, and a monarch of such kindness, pure intention and benevolence is rare to find. Therefore the friends of God must show appreciation and not, like other groups, display ingratitude for this blessing. Night and day they must engage in prayers for good, and with heart and soul seek divine confirmation and assistance.

Subject: status of kings; future of monarchy
Quotation: The truth is as thou hast written. We hope that through the divine bounty and loving-kindness, this just King and generous Sovereign succeeds in all his endeavors which will result in tranquility and well-being for his nation, so that the tabernacle of the ancient glory of Persia is raised in the midmost heart of the world and the reign of his majesty the King achieves its former rank and dignity.

Subject: status of kings; future of monarchy
Quotation: As the government gains strength, God willing, these parties shall face the severest upheaval. Therefore, we pray that God may grant strength and victory to the government. Soon you will observe that the government will gain strength, and when it acquires power to maintain order, these problems will be solved. Rest assured that if the government finds relief from the Bolsheviks, it will gain strength

Subject: status of kings; future of monarchy
Quotation: At such a time precisely I wrote to him not to be sorry or grieved, for GOD would help him. Therefore GOD assisted him and he overcame all. All the kings of the world were at first despotic, but later they have become either constitutional or republican. Even some of the kings, by their own will, granted a constitution; such as the Mikado of Japan, who willingly granted one, and two years ago the Ameen of Montenegro, in Turkish Europe, also granted one.

Subject: status of kings; future of monarchy
Quotation: The Shah of Persia came twice to Stuttgart. Although he was a royal King he did not find one real heartfelt friend. The utmost was the government received him officially according to its long-established custom just as it would have received any other royal Personage. The holy divine Manifestations of God through whom this mighty and potent power appears are the very quintessences of existence and the plain people who follow their Teachings are greater than the Kings and queens of the earth.

Subject: status of kings; future of monarchy
Quotation: The Emperors and Kings of Europe are so situated today that either by inclination or rivalry; political considerations or patriotic motives, geographical locations or fear of foreign invasion - cannot take an initiative in the Cause of Universal Peace and the reduction of armaments. So long as this mad competition exists amongst them they think they must go on increasing their Military and Naval budgets and pile destructive armaments upon armaments until millions of souls are crushed under its sheer weight.

Subject: status of kings; future of monarchy
Quotation: Thus Mikado, the Emperor of Japan, as well as the Governor of Montenegro, having realized the benefits of a constitutional government, consented, of their own accord, with none's insistence or force, to convert their absolute reign into a constitutional government. Consider how his royal highness, the King of England, spendeth his days, in the plenitude of happiness, of tranquility, of peace and prosperity, and is the most exalted Monarch among the kings of the world. Neither is he responsible for a matter, nor doth he take any blame.

Subject: status of material wealth; wealth and poverty

Subject: status of material wealth; wealth and poverty

Quotation: Enricher of the poor, Provider for the weak...provide for us from whence we know not, and enrich us through Your riches...and open for us the treasures of mercy in hearts, of divine gifts in spirits, and of wealth in bodies

Subject: status of material wealth; wealth and poverty
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/status of material wealth; wealth and poverty.txt
Quotation: His holiness Muhammad, the Messenger of God, called his blessed self a pauper and declared "poverty is my glory." This poverty is not the lack of worldly goods and is not need for the worthless treasures of this mortal world.

Subject: status of material wealth; wealth and poverty
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/status of material wealth; wealth and poverty.txt

Subject: status of material wealth; wealth and poverty
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/status of material wealth; wealth and poverty.txt
