Give us our daily bread therefore, with utmost thankfulness and happiness, I am returning these $1000, so that you may spread it yourself in my name, in good works for humanity.

Subject: status of material wealth; wealth and poverty
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/status of material wealth; wealth and poverty.txt
Quotation: Glory be to God! The wealthy among the friends show no initiative and render no service because of their attachment to worldly wealth. But by chance after their death their wealth falls into the hands of their enemies who consume it and, as common people say, recite the prayer for the dead.

Subject: status of material wealth; wealth and poverty
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/status of material wealth; wealth and poverty.txt
Quotation: if a person willingly shows mercy to the poor and joyfully gives of their wealth, such a person is near to the divine threshold - just as many of the loved ones of God have, with utmost joy and delight, spent their wealth on the poor and practiced complete sharing, but of their own free will.

Subject: status of material wealth; wealth and poverty
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/status of material wealth; wealth and poverty.txt
Quotation: In spite of poverty he acquires a sense of affluence and in a state of riches and power he offers help and protection to the weak... How many are the people who have all means of comfort, luxury, security and wealth and every means of enjoyment and good living, yet they have no peace of mind and are ever anxious and uneasy!

Subject: status of material wealth; wealth and poverty
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/status of material wealth; wealth and poverty.txt
Quotation: As to comfort and wealth, the Supreme Lord hath not, as a pure bounty, provided for us the means of comfort and riches, so that the sincerity of hearts and the detachment of souls might become evident and manifest. For if we had comfort and ease, they would suppose that we had hastened to the Divine shelter merely to attain these.

Subject: status of material wealth; wealth and poverty
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/status of material wealth; wealth and poverty.txt
Quotation: Wealth becomes the cause of heedlessness to many souls with the exception of those who are believers in God and read the verses of God. But blessed is the rich man whose wealth and opulence do not prevent him from turning his face toward God and whose heart is not attached to his possessions. Such a rich man is the light of the world.

Subject: status of material wealth; wealth and poverty
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/status of material wealth; wealth and poverty.txt
Quotation: In every world there is a treasure that is accepted, and in every market a merchandise that is desired. In the divine world, gold and silver are baser than dust, and precious jewels have fallen from the rank of worth. The gold and silver of that realm is the cash of the love of God, and its glittering gems are the pearls of inner meanings.

Subject: status of material wealth; wealth and poverty
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/status of material wealth; wealth and poverty.txt
Quotation: The rich show no mercy to the poor, and they themselves are tormented. If they showed mercy, both they and the poor would be at ease. Wealth is good for such times - otherwise what good is it? One should save and preserve it, and if successful in such an endeavor, one's heart is gladdened that, praise be to God, one has succeeded in rendering some service to the poor.

Subject: status of material wealth; wealth and poverty
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/status of material wealth; wealth and poverty.txt
Quotation: Most of those present at that feast today are the poor. This is why Christ said "Blessed are the poor." For the rich, wealth is a barrier to entering the Kingdom, as Christ said it is easier for a camel to pass through the eye of a needle than for a rich person to enter the Kingdom of God. However, if wealth and earthly riches and material glory do not prevent a rich person from entering the Kingdom, that rich one is near to the divine threshold and accepted by the Lord of the Kingdom.

Subject: status of material wealth; wealth and poverty
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/status of material wealth; wealth and poverty.txt
Quotation: The riches of gold and silver become the cause of increasing need and engagement, as thou observest that the greatest of the world's wealthy ones are the crowned heads, yet despite this they are in the most extreme state of need, and are indebted, at a loss, and afflicted. But those souls who have drunk from the brimming cup of "God will render each of them rich through His abundance," though outwardly poor and possessing not a penny, yet they have a flowing treasure in their sleeve, and the kingdom of the placeless beneath their signet ring, and the treasures of the Kingdom concealed within.

Quotation: Let not this cause you grief, but be content with what hath been ordained by Him, for this is the ultimate purpose...Let nothing cause thee grief, but place thy trust in God, thy Lord, the Mighty, the Witness

Subject: steadfastness; perseverance; faithfulness
Quotation: Today steadfastness in the Cause is accounted as the most great of deeds before God, for the satans lie in ambush from every side. Ask God to protect thee and those who have believed from the greatest terror.

Subject: steadfastness; perseverance; faithfulness
Quotation: Now strive that thou mayest remain steadfast in His Cause, for the evil ones are, in the name of truth, engaged in leading astray the sincere ones and the unitarians. Know thou this and be among the firm ones.

Subject: steadfastness; perseverance; faithfulness
Quotation: Hold fast to the cord of My loving-kindness and cling to the hem of My all-embracing favor. Strive that you may drink from the Salsabil of detachment and receive your portion from the Kawthar of steadfastness.

Subject: steadfastness; perseverance; faithfulness
Quotation: Before mention and utterance and counsels and admonitions and commands and ordinances, We commanded all to the Most Great Steadfastness. Some heard and held fast to what God desired, while others were heedless.

Subject: steadfastness; perseverance; faithfulness
Quotation: Thou must not become weary or dispirited, but rather remain steadfast in thy benevolent intention. This is no deficiency, but the purpose is that man must inevitably encounter difficulties in momentous affairs.

Subject: steadfastness; perseverance; faithfulness
Quotation: God willing, through the grace of the Lord, exalted be His glory, thou shalt drink from the Kawthar of steadfastness and receive thy portion of the choice sealed Wine, and engage in service to the divine Cause.

Subject: steadfastness; perseverance; faithfulness
Quotation: This is the Day of steadfastness and the Day of assistance through goodly deeds and pleasing conduct. Blessed are they that are firmly rooted. Blessed are they that are steadfast. Blessed are they that are firm.

Subject: steadfastness; perseverance; faithfulness
Quotation: Strive thou that such deeds as befit the station of man may be made manifest from thee...I beseech Thee by the trees of Thy lands and the fruits of the Tree of Thy utterance to aid me to be steadfast in Thy Cause

Subject: steadfastness; perseverance; faithfulness
Quotation: And thou, grieve not over anything, but be patient, yea be patient, for verily the end belongeth to the patient ones. And if tribulations touch thee, be not troubled but trust in God, the Everlasting, the Mighty.

Subject: steadfastness; perseverance; faithfulness
Quotation: Glory and remembrance and praise be upon you and upon them that are detached and steadfast and firm and upright and standing firm in the Cause of our Lord and the Lord of all who are in the heavens and the earths.

Subject: steadfastness; perseverance; faithfulness
Quotation: Though the opposing winds of nations and peoples prevail with utmost force, he remains enkindled and illumined, trusting in God... and this candle has the niche of steadfastness in the Cause of the Lord of Majesty

Subject: steadfastness; perseverance; faithfulness
Quotation: Blessed is the soul who arose with perfect steadfastness to promote the Cause of the Lord of all beings...We beseech Him to assist thee and bestow upon thee the Kawthar of steadfastness from the hand of His bounty.

Subject: steadfastness; perseverance; faithfulness
Quotation: Be assured of God's loving-kindness...These are the days for the manifestation of the most great steadfastness. Blessed is the soul that hath drunk from this most pure wine and partaken of this most luminous nectar.

Subject: steadfastness; perseverance; faithfulness
Quotation: they are steadfast in the Living, Self-Subsisting Cause and firm in faith and certitude like a lofty mountain...will place the crown of steadfastness on their heads, will adorn themselves with the diadem of firmness

Subject: steadfastness; perseverance; faithfulness
Quotation: The condition of Faith requires that man ascend to and abide in the station of sacrifice. Without this attainment, one faith is not perfect. Their faith was so firm that none of these tragic vicissitudes moved them.

Subject: steadfastness; perseverance; faithfulness
Quotation: O Qasim! A remembrance unto My servant who hearkened unto that which God, the Lord of the worlds, proclaimed and responded to Him in days when the skin of the learned ones trembled and the feet of the mystics slipped

Subject: steadfastness; perseverance; faithfulness
Quotation: Stand firm in the Cause of God with such steadfastness that it will cause the steadfastness of all the peoples of the world... In all conditions hold fast to the cord of grace and cling to the greatest steadfastness

Subject: steadfastness; perseverance; faithfulness
Quotation: We counsel thee to remain steadfast in the Cause of thy Lord - this is among the greatest of matters with God, the One, the Single, the Mighty, the Powerful. Be among the stars of steadfastness amidst all creatures.

Subject: steadfastness; perseverance; faithfulness
Quotation: O people of Baha! Beware lest the might of the mighty frighten you, or the power of those who have denied God's Cause, the Exalted, the Great, weaken you. By God's life! Soon shall all that the people possess perish.

Subject: steadfastness; perseverance; faithfulness
Quotation: Thy letter... through it the hearts of the friends were set aglow. Thou hast indeed arisen, beyond all capacity, to render service to His Cause, and thy recompense from the Lord of Lords is ascertained and ordained.

Subject: steadfastness; perseverance; faithfulness
Quotation: Stand thou firm then in thy love at the time when the breezes of hatred waft upon thee from every sinful polytheist, in such wise that thy feet shall not slip even should all the small and the great unite against thee

Subject: steadfastness; perseverance; faithfulness
Quotation: These are servants in whose praise have spoken the tongues of the Prophets and Messengers. Their steadfastness is praised such that neither the pharaohs of the people nor the tyrants of the age could turn them aside.

Subject: steadfastness; perseverance; faithfulness
Quotation: Be not grieved by the events of the world and what hath befallen you in the path of God, the Glorious, the Great. Set aside what the people possess and take what hath been given you from the All-Knowing, the All-Wise.

Subject: steadfastness; perseverance; faithfulness
Quotation: "These illumined souls are the result of the light of Baha'o'llah, who attracted them to the kingdom of God with such reflective power that like fixed stars these martyrs will ever shine from the horizon of El-Abha."

Subject: steadfastness; perseverance; faithfulness
Quotation: Convey on behalf of this Wronged One greetings to all the leaves and handmaidens, particularly those leaves who have arisen to serve His loved ones and the Cause, and who have attained unto the most great steadfastness.

Subject: steadfastness; perseverance; faithfulness
Quotation: Praise be unto God that thy steps are firm in the Covenant and thou didst shine in the fire of tests like pure gold. I beseech the one true God that ye may increase in thy steadfastness and continue in thy perseverance.

Subject: steadfastness; perseverance; faithfulness
Quotation: God willing, thou wilt be numbered among those whom the braying of the heedless, the clamor of the deniers, and the croaking of the polytheists did not prevent from the Manifest Truth nor hold back from the Straight Path

Subject: steadfastness; perseverance; faithfulness
Quotation: Be thou steadfast in the Cause and make up for what thou hast missed... Arise to mention thy Lord with such steadfastness as cannot be prevented by the cawing of the impious nor the braying of those who have disbelieved

Subject: steadfastness; perseverance; faithfulness
Quotation: How excellent was that which one of the loved ones of the All-Merciful spoke in the Dispensation of the Criterion - he who was named Sa'd in the Book of Names...He said: "The decree of God is dearer to Me than mine eye."

Subject: steadfastness; perseverance; faithfulness
Quotation: Glory and praise and honor be upon you all and upon those whom God hath adorned with His most wondrous and exalted garments, namely the Most Great Steadfastness in the Cause of God, the Lord of the Beginning and the End.

Subject: steadfastness; perseverance; faithfulness
Quotation: They remained firm in the Covenant and shunned the evil of hypocrisy. They were attracted by the sign of unity and drawn to the light of dawning splendor. They ceased not to remember Thee even when affliction was severe.

Subject: steadfastness; perseverance; faithfulness
Quotation: The Supreme Pen has, in most Tablets, commanded the servants and handmaidens to show forth the most great steadfastness... God willing, thou shalt attain unto the wine of steadfastness and shall remain firm in His Cause.

Subject: steadfastness; perseverance; faithfulness
Quotation: Walk thou steadfastly in My Cause and follow not the ways of those who, upon attaining unto the object of their desire, denied God, the Lord of Lords. Be thou steadfast in the Cause of God and extol thy Lord morn and eve.

Subject: steadfastness; perseverance; faithfulness
Quotation: From this servant's handwriting I have inhaled the fragrance of steadfastness, faithfulness, sincerity and beyond. In the nights and days I beseech God, exalted be His glory, for their confirmation and seek their success.

Subject: steadfastness; perseverance; faithfulness
Quotation: Ye are steadfast in the Covenant! Ye are ever before Mine eyes and vision, and are present in My thoughts. Not for a moment do I cease to remember you, and I beseech infinite favors for you from the Court of Divine Unity.

Subject: steadfastness; perseverance; faithfulness
Quotation: Though these days the test is severe, yet the confirmations of the Great Luminary strengthen hearts through the outpourings of the Lord of Loving-kindness. Blessed are the steadfast ones! Blessed are those who remain firm!

Subject: steadfastness; perseverance; faithfulness
Quotation: My hope is that you will be assisted and confirmed in this...have submitted to Your dominion among the worlds, have shown humility before Your sincere loved ones, and have chosen tribulation over a life of ease in Your path

Subject: steadfastness; perseverance; faithfulness
Quotation: Patience is necessary. In all lands the divine banner will be raised high, and if wisdom is exercised, comfort and security will also pitch their tents... In brief: do not look to the past, take the future as the standard.

Subject: steadfastness; perseverance; faithfulness
Quotation: Beseech God that those devoted souls who have drunk from the cup of tribulation and adversity in the path of the Lord of Names may shine forth with the utmost joy and radiance from the horizon of the heaven of steadfastness.

Subject: steadfastness; perseverance; faithfulness
Quotation: We further counsel you regarding that which hath been sent down in the Book from the presence of One mighty and powerful. Beware lest the conditions of the Pharaohs frighten you or the doubts of the oppressors... sadden you.

Subject: steadfastness; perseverance; faithfulness
Quotation: Beware lest ye exchange nearness for remoteness and acceptance for rejection. We desire to behold you possessed of such steadfastness as would cause the hearts of the people to tremble and the feet of the polytheists to slip.

Subject: steadfastness; perseverance; faithfulness
Quotation: Take the chalice of salvation in the name of the Cleaver of the Dawn, then drink therefrom with His remembrance whereby the unitarians have hastened to the Supreme Horizon and those near unto God to the Dawning-Place of Names.

Subject: steadfastness; perseverance; faithfulness
Quotation: Despite facing unbearable difficulties, their enthusiasm and devotion increase day by day, and their steadfastness and firmness progress toward perfection. Young and old, strong and weak, all are ready to sacrifice their lives.

Subject: steadfastness; perseverance; faithfulness
Quotation: Thou didst turn with the greatest steadfastness... Thou wert steadfast in the love of thy Lord such that obliteration took thee not, and standing such that sitting followed it not, and speaking such that silence overtook it not

Subject: steadfastness; perseverance; faithfulness
Quotation: These are the souls who are mentioned in the Books of old and of latter days, whom neither the doubts of the peoples, nor the signs of the world, nor the clamor of the polytheists, nor the commotion of the heedless have deterred.

Subject: steadfastness; perseverance; faithfulness
Quotation: Indeed, until now you have walked and moved steadfastly on the path of the Ancient Light, and God willing, you will now be even more confirmed in your steadfastness in the Covenant and will become the cause of guidance to others.

Subject: steadfastness; perseverance; faithfulness
Quotation: Be as you were before. Verily your Lord is the All-Seeing, the All-Informed...hold fast in all conditions with the most great steadfastness...The beginning of the Cause is the knowledge of God and its end is steadfastness therein.

Subject: steadfastness; perseverance; faithfulness
Quotation: Be patient within thyself and put thy trust in God, the Mighty, the Powerful...Be patient and grieve not within thyself, and be of the patient ones...Be thou patient in this separation which hath consumed the hearts of the mystics.

Subject: steadfastness; perseverance; faithfulness
Quotation: The reproach of the enemies did not deter him; rather, he remained as firm as the mighty mountains...Yet he continued on the path, guiding to the way, engaging in prayers to the Lord of Signs with complete steadfastness and firmness

Subject: steadfastness; perseverance; faithfulness
Quotation: The friends were zealous and enthusiastic, in the greatest happiness. There were about 30 or 40 of the friends. Every day they used to come and martyr a few. When the executioner came to call a prisoner, he would rise up and dance.

Subject: steadfastness; perseverance; faithfulness
Quotation: This is the day of steadfastness, for from every direction some matter appears and from every quarter some commotion arises. All must occupy themselves with the utmost steadfastness and with wisdom and utterance in capturing hearts.

Subject: steadfastness; perseverance; faithfulness
Quotation: in such wise that neither the power of the mighty nor the hosts of the earth shall prevent you from the Creator of heaven...you must arise to serve the Cause of the Beloved of all possibility with perfect steadfastness and composure

Subject: steadfastness; perseverance; faithfulness
Quotation: From every word was diffused the fragrance of steadfastness, devotion, arising to serve, orientation toward God, and detachment. Take ye the chalice of steadfastness in My Name, then drink from it in remembrance of Me, the All-Wise.

Subject: steadfastness; perseverance; faithfulness
Quotation: The grace and kindness of God has never been and is not conditional upon anything save love and certitude. That which is befitting and proper today, and upon which God's gaze is fixed, has been and is faith and steadfastness therein.

Subject: steadfastness; perseverance; faithfulness
Quotation: The day of patience hath come, and the hour of steadfastness and remembrance of God, the Sovereign, the All-Choosing. In truth, this is the day of patience. That honored one must become the dawning-place of patience and steadfastness.

Subject: steadfastness; perseverance; faithfulness
Quotation: Yet despite all these afflictions, trials, and firm tribulations, there remains hope that he shall not cease from service, that his foot shall not slip from steadfastness, and that his eyes shall stand in service in place of his feet.

Subject: steadfastness; perseverance; faithfulness
Quotation: The faithful friends sacrifice their lives day and night at the Threshold of Baha'u'llah and arise to serve, having no desire except the dawning rays of the Luminary of the horizons, and are utterly firm and steadfast in the Covenant.

Subject: steadfastness; perseverance; faithfulness
Quotation: From the dawning of the morn of guidance, this family had been ready to sacrifice their lives and served in all circumstances. Now too, praise be to God, they are confirmed in divine good-pleasure and assisted in the path of sacrifice.

Subject: steadfastness; perseverance; faithfulness
Quotation: We have found from you the fragrance of steadfastness and faithfulness... We counsel you to preserve your stations and give you glad tidings of what has been ordained for you from the presence of the Truth, the Knower of things unseen.

Subject: steadfastness; perseverance; faithfulness
Quotation: We have made mention of him who is named Muhammad-Rida, then of him who is named Mahdi, in the Book of God, the Mighty, the Praiseworthy. The Glory from Us be upon you and upon those whom the hosts of the oppressors have not frightened.

Subject: steadfastness; perseverance; faithfulness
Quotation: Hasten! Hasten! O free ones, to steadfastness and stability! Hasten! Hasten! O righteous ones, to firmness in this Cause which will forever shake the pillars of discord! Hasten! Hasten! O lights, to shine with the lights of faithfulness

Subject: steadfastness; perseverance; faithfulness
Quotation: Through divine confirmation, we hope that day by day thy steadfastness may increase, so that through thy sweet scent, thy fair countenance and thy goodly character, thou mayest adorn the garden of existence like unto a delectable fruit.

Subject: steadfastness; perseverance; faithfulness
Quotation: By the life of our Beloved and the Beloved of all who are in earth and heaven, the manifestations of steadfastness have circled and will circle round such a being - nay, steadfastness itself hath appeared from him and returneth unto him.

Subject: steadfastness; perseverance; faithfulness
Quotation: I beseech Thee by Thy Will, which Thou hast made the Dawning-Place of the manifestations of Thy grandeur and the daysprings of Thy power and might, to cause me and Thy loved ones to hold fast unto the cord of Thy Cause in all conditions.

Subject: steadfastness; perseverance; faithfulness
Quotation: I hope that thou mayest be a firm and steadfast servant of the Truth, and ever arise to serve the Cause, so that the signs of steadfastness, detachment and holiness may become manifest and evident in all thy conditions and circumstances.

Subject: steadfastness; perseverance; faithfulness
Quotation: O friends! Be steadfast and firm in the Cause. O Ghulam-'Ali! Hearken unto the voice of the Wronged One and be steadfast in the Cause of God in such wise that thou mayest find thyself, through God's grace, independent of all else but Him.

Subject: steadfastness; perseverance; faithfulness
Quotation: O ye who are steadfast in the Covenant! Ye have always been and continue to be remembered in this divine gathering...when the ignorant deal cruelly with us in the path of servitude to Thee, it is like faithfulness to the ancient covenant.

Subject: steadfastness; perseverance; faithfulness
Quotation: The winds of tests have not caused thee to waver, and the intensity of trials hath not disturbed thee. Like unto a mighty mountain thou art firm and steadfast, and like a manifest standard thou art in the utmost steadfastness and constancy.

Subject: steadfastness; perseverance; faithfulness
Quotation: Whoso hath turned unto Him hath indeed attained salvation, and he that hath turned away is assuredly among the perishing ones...O Javad! Hold thou fast, under all conditions, to the Crimson Cord which hath appeared from the seat of thy Lord

Subject: steadfastness; perseverance; faithfulness
Quotation: Friends, do not forget the union of souls while you are in the affliction of separation. Lament this departure, but sow the seed of patience in the good earth of the heart, watering it with your tears, so that it will give forth sweet fruit.

Subject: steadfastness; perseverance; faithfulness
Quotation: Be thou steadfast in the Cause of thy Lord and grieve not over anything, for verily He is the Protector of those who turn unto Him. He guardeth whomsoever He pleaseth by His command and aideth whom He willeth through the hosts of the unseen.

Subject: steadfastness; perseverance; faithfulness
Quotation: Their steadfastness is highlighted: "They stood firm in Thy Covenant and held fast to Thy Testament... They did not weaken in Thy service nor flag in their servitude. Rather, they arose to exalt Thy Word with steadfast heart and open breast."

Subject: steadfastness; perseverance; faithfulness
Quotation: Take hold of the Book as a command from Us, detached from the world and clinging to the cord of God, the Lord of Hosts... O people! Take My Book with a power that the might of the oppressors cannot prevent, then read it with joy and fragrance.

Subject: steadfastness; perseverance; faithfulness
Quotation: The divine friends in Yazd are truly in the utmost steadfastness, firmness and love. Despite all the trials, afflictions and calamities, they remain firm in step and steadfast in heart, and in all circumstances they manifest signs of constancy.

Subject: steadfastness; perseverance; faithfulness
Quotation: We counsel thee and them that have believed to show forth the supreme steadfastness in this Cause whereby the hearts of the men of insight have been troubled and the foundations of those who denied the Witness and the Witnessed have been shaken.

Subject: steadfastness; perseverance; faithfulness
Quotation: O My handmaiden! Be thou steadfast in the Cause of God, thy Lord, for thou hast been acquainted with matters of which none else hath been informed. Be thou firm, and regard all else save God as non-existent, and fix thy gaze upon God's direction

Subject: steadfastness; perseverance; faithfulness
Quotation: Rest ye assured. I am happy that ye shall be confirmed in everything. They must not be shaken by anything. They strove night and day. Then it is evident how much we must show self-sacrifice, service and steadfastness to the Most Holy Threshold!

Subject: steadfastness; perseverance; faithfulness
Quotation: Say: O friends! This is the day of steadfastness and firmness. Ye must rend asunder the veils of idle fancy through the power of the Lord of Names and manifest such steadfastness in God's Cause that none may find occasion to turn away or object.

Subject: steadfastness; perseverance; faithfulness
Quotation: Hold fast unto the cord of steadfastness and cleave unto the hem of thy Lord's mercy. We counsel you to steadfastness in the Cause of God, for it shall profit you in this world and the next. Verily your Lord, the All-Merciful, is the All-Knowing.

Subject: steadfastness; perseverance; faithfulness
Quotation: We desire to make mention of Our loved ones who have held fast to God's Covenant and His Testament, who cast not away His perspicuous Book, and upon whom there descended from the enemies that which caused the rock to cry out and the clouds to weep.

Subject: steadfastness; perseverance; faithfulness
Quotation: stand firm with all thy being in His love... Beseech ye God that ye may remain firm in His love and hold fast unto the Tree from which ye have sprung forth, that the winds of trials and the tempests of tests may not sever those leaves from the Tree

Subject: steadfastness; perseverance; faithfulness
Quotation: After recognition of God, the greatest of all things is steadfastness in His Cause. Hold thou fast unto it and be of the steadfast. No deed hath been or is greater than this - it is the king of all deeds, by thy Lord, the Most High, the Most Great.

Subject: steadfastness; perseverance; faithfulness
Quotation: O servant of the Abha Beauty! The cup of contentment is supremely sweet, but let us see what the cup of destiny will bring. Those who have tasted the sweetness and honey of contentment have found the bitterness of destiny sweeter than mother's milk.

Subject: steadfastness; perseverance; faithfulness
Quotation: Those who wished to purchase Him with words showed no steadfastness and soon afterwards believed themselves deceived. But those who came forward with the spirit of self-sacrifice found the Beautiful Joseph in the embrace of supplication and prayer.

Subject: steadfastness; perseverance; faithfulness
Quotation: In brief, the point is that now you must resist with the utmost calm, dignity, steadfastness and firmness, and know with certainty that this state will not endure, for this tempest too shall end and tranquility and assurance will once again prevail.

Subject: steadfastness; perseverance; faithfulness
Quotation: Stand thou firm in the Cause of God, thy Lord, and detach thyself from all else save Him. Stand thou firm in such wise that all who are in the heavens and on earth shall not cause thee to slip, nor shall the whisperings of Satan cause thee to waver.

Subject: steadfastness; perseverance; faithfulness
Quotation: Be ye in such a state and condition that the affairs of the world shall not prevent you from the Lord of earth and heaven...We beseech God to make you steadfast in His Cause in such wise that the whisperings of the deniers shall not cause you to slip

Subject: steadfastness; perseverance; faithfulness
Quotation: Stand firm in such wise that the limbs of those who have disbelieved in God, the Lord of all men, may quake. Amidst darkness the light hath shone, and in tribulation this Man hath remained steadfast in such wise that the mountains cannot rival Him.

Subject: steadfastness; perseverance; faithfulness
Quotation: The conditions of the world have not hindered Him. He hath arisen with the truth and summoned the nations to the straight path. How many a servant heard and turned away, and how many a servant hastened and said: Here am I, O Beloved of them that know!

Subject: steadfastness; perseverance; faithfulness
Quotation: The breeze of constancy and steadfastness is ever blowing from that region and perfuming the nostrils with its fragrance. Therefore, O companions, give thanks unto your Creator that ye have been enabled to follow in the footsteps of the Blessed Beauty.

Subject: steadfastness; perseverance; faithfulness
Quotation: My Most Exalted Pen testifieth to thy patience and steadfastness in the path of God, the Lord of the worlds...My handmaidens who have not broken God's Covenant and His Testament, and whom the clamor of the world hath not held back from the Most Great Name

Subject: steadfastness; perseverance; faithfulness
Quotation: Blessed are those who have turned towards Me, whom the allusions and doubts of the people of the earth did not prevent from the Creator of heaven and the Lord of Names. They have grasped with the hand of certitude and clung to the hem of the All-Bountiful

Subject: steadfastness; perseverance; faithfulness
Quotation: And as to Aqa Siyyid Mu?sin; he was in Iraq and attained the presence of the Day-Star of the world. He proved self-sacrificing to the last breath, and was the cause of the guidance of many souls. He was forbearing, long-suffering, thankful, and steadfast.

Subject: steadfastness; perseverance; faithfulness
Quotation: We beseech God to assist you in negating negation and affirming affirmation, in such wise that neither the opposition of the polytheists nor the denial of the transgressors may hinder you... Be patient, verily your Lord is the All-Patient, the All-Knowing.

Subject: steadfastness; perseverance; faithfulness
Quotation: Today must such a breeze of steadfastness waft from the loved ones of God that none can prevent those enkindled souls from the divine Unity. Say: Take ye the chalice of steadfastness in the name of your Lord, then drink therefrom with this wise Remembrance.

Subject: steadfastness; perseverance; faithfulness
Quotation: Thou didst arise with supreme steadfastness and called all to Thy most exalted horizon... Then make me steadfast in Thy Cause and firm in Thy love, such that neither the crushing doubts of the learned nor the tempestuous allusions of the divines may move me.

Subject: steadfastness; perseverance; faithfulness
Quotation: The assured believer among the servants is the locus of manifestation of divine signs...It is fitting and proper for those firm in the Covenant and Testament that in times of captivity and imprisonment they strive to serve those imprisoned in the path of God

Subject: steadfastness; perseverance; faithfulness
Quotation: Stand firm then in His love and inhale the fragrance of holiness from My garment that hath been suspended between the heavens and the earth...Grieve not in His path, but place thy trust in Him. He will, in truth, protect thee from the harm of the corrupt ones.

Subject: steadfastness; perseverance; faithfulness
Quotation: Follow thou the religion of God and His Faith in this Cause which hath appeared and shone forth from the horizon of the Spirit from the presence of One mighty and powerful. Arise to serve the Cause and detach thyself from all who are in the heavens and earth.

Subject: steadfastness; perseverance; faithfulness
Quotation: Be thou firm and steadfast, straight and resolute... The sweet fragrance of sincerity in the Cause of God was inhaled, and the sweetness of steadfastness and firmness in the love of God and adherence to His Covenant and Testament reached the taste of the soul.

Subject: steadfastness; perseverance; faithfulness
Quotation: Now it behooveth the loved ones of God to withstand these events with the utmost firmness and steadfastness. They must not be disheartened by the incident in Namiq, inasmuch as others started the aggression. Let nothing grieve you, for ye are the exalted ones!

Subject: steadfastness; perseverance; faithfulness
Quotation: Although they remained frozen and withered for a long period from the bitter cold of winter, in this divine spring and heavenly season they became verdant and joyous and attained boundless freshness and delicacy...But steadfastness is the condition of the path

Subject: steadfastness; perseverance; faithfulness
Quotation: "God willing, thou shalt manifest the most great steadfastness, in such wise that the hosts of the idolaters shall not hold thee back from the Lord of the Day of Judgment." "We convey greetings to all the friends and command them to the most great steadfastness"

Subject: steadfastness; perseverance; faithfulness
Quotation: Be thou steadfast in thy love for thy Lord in such wise that thou hearest not from anyone on earth that which is contrary to the command of thy Lord...Be thou so steadfast that the words of those who have turned away from God, the Lord of Lords, grieve thee not.

Subject: steadfastness; perseverance; faithfulness
Quotation: Go thou straight on and persevere in that which the Pen of God, in truth, commandeth thee, and remain upon the straight path of God, steadfast in His Cause. Be thou steadfast in the Cause of God, and in that which hath been prescribed unto thee, and fear no one.

Subject: steadfastness; perseverance; faithfulness
Quotation: In all conditions thou art mentioned before the Wronged One and art present before His face. His grace hath not deprived the polytheists and the opposers, how much less the monotheists and those who have accepted, how much less those who are detached and sincere.

Subject: steadfastness; perseverance; faithfulness
Quotation: A station hath been ordained for thee with thy Lord, and soon shalt thou attain unto it, if thou remainest steadfast and firm in His love. Therefore, beseech thou God that thou mayest be sustained from the chalice of certitude and partake of the wine of assurance.

Subject: steadfastness; perseverance; faithfulness
Quotation: Though you be in the clutches of ferocious beasts and in the talons of the predatory birds of the wilderness, despair not of God's grace. Soon shall the veil be lifted, by God's leave, from the face of His Cause, and this radiance shall shine forth to all regions.

Subject: steadfastness; perseverance; faithfulness
Quotation: "Go thou straight on and persevere in that which the Pen of God, in truth, commandeth thee, and remain upon the straight path of God, steadfast in His Cause... Be thou steadfast in the Cause of God, and in that which hath been prescribed unto thee, and fear no one"

Subject: steadfastness; perseverance; faithfulness
Quotation: We make mention of him who was named Muhammad-'Ali and counsel him to manifest great steadfastness in this Cause which hath made the limbs of all names to quake... We beseech God to make thee steadfast and firm in this Most Great Cause and this Mighty Announcement.

Subject: steadfastness; perseverance; faithfulness
Quotation: May my spirit be a sacrifice for thy steadfastness! This evanescent servant hath been honored to receive thy noble letter and distinguished missive... I beseech God to assist them to such steadfastness as would cause every lofty and impregnable mountain to tremble.

Subject: steadfastness; perseverance; faithfulness
Quotation: Faithfulness requires that I find not a moment's rest of soul in the love of Baha, nor seek an instant of peace of conscience, and walk in no path except the path of faithfulness, and speak of nothing but the mystery of His love. This is the essence of faithfulness.

Subject: steadfastness; perseverance; faithfulness
Quotation: Be thou steadfast in the Cause in such wise that the winds that blow from the hearts of the heedless cannot move thee. We see nothing greater than steadfastness in God's Cause. Hold thou fast unto it through thy Lord's sovereign might, the Almighty, the All-Powerful.

Subject: steadfastness; perseverance; faithfulness
Quotation: This is the day of steadfastness, the day of service, and the day of arising. By God's life! Every steadfast soul is today the recipient of an everlasting sovereignty - a sovereignty that cannot be described and that thought cannot comprehend before its manifestation.

Subject: steadfastness; perseverance; faithfulness
Quotation: This is the station of the most great steadfastness, the ultimate goal, and the highest summit... Be dawning-places of steadfastness amidst all creation, that the imaginings of every imaginer may not cause you to slip, nor may the conditions of the heedless occupy you.

Subject: steadfastness; perseverance; faithfulness
Quotation: "The believers must not be influenced by the conditions in Akka, be Akka in a state of calm or confusion. No matter what happens in Akka, the believers in every country must look upon the Cause of God which is increasingly Calm and Mighty - even if Akka is in turmoil."

Subject: steadfastness; perseverance; faithfulness
Quotation: This is the day when all things are seen as dead save the letters of the Face which are inscribed in the Book of God - they are the souls who have attained unto the greatest steadfastness and who gaze toward the highest horizon. Blessed are they, then blessed are they!

Subject: steadfastness; perseverance; faithfulness
Quotation: hold fast unto the cord of faithfulness in such wise that the promptings of them that have disbelieved in God, the Lord of all worlds, shall not prevent you... A river named Faithfulness - whoso drinketh therefrom hath indeed attained unto the most great steadfastness.

Subject: steadfastness; perseverance; faithfulness
Quotation: Ask thou of God, glorified and exalted be He, for steadfastness, inasmuch as this is accounted among the most mighty of all things in the sight of God. We beseech God to assist His handmaidens to remember and praise Him, and to aid them to remain steadfast in His Cause.

Subject: steadfastness; perseverance; faithfulness
Quotation: Blessed is he who standeth firm, whose foot hath not slipped from the straight Path of God... O my Lord! I beseech Thee... to aid me to remain steadfast in the Greater Steadfastness, whereby neither the doubts of the divines nor the might of princes shall hold me back.

Subject: steadfastness; perseverance; faithfulness
Quotation: Let not the transient manifestations and conditions of these fleeting days cause thee to forgo the eternal realm. With the power of certitude, rend asunder the veils of idle fancies and, like the morning star, shine forth from the horizon of the heaven of steadfastness.

Subject: steadfastness; perseverance; faithfulness
Quotation: By My life! The steadfastness and detachment of the martyrs in the land has astounded the Concourse on High, let alone the realm of creation. Though each was inwardly a surging ocean, outwardly they manifested the radiance of beauteous patience and glorious forbearance.

Subject: steadfastness; perseverance; faithfulness
Quotation: You bore every hardship and suffering in the path of your Lord, affliction and calamity befell you, arrows of hatred were aimed at you, and they launched fierce attacks against you...you remained firm like a mighty mountain and resisted the attack of every powerful army

Subject: steadfastness; perseverance; faithfulness
Quotation: In the midst of tribulations and ordeal, it speaketh in praise of the Lord of the seen and unseen...The glory shining from the horizon of the heaven of My mercy be upon him who hath held fast unto the cord of patience in that which hath befallen him in My straight Path.

Subject: steadfastness; perseverance; faithfulness
Quotation: How regrettable would it be now to lose these eternal bounties through imaginary concerns. Hearken unto the call of the trusted Counselor and be not content with abasement after such supreme glory...Strive ye therefore and adorn your deeds with the crown of steadfastness.

Subject: steadfastness; perseverance; faithfulness
Quotation: Blessed is he who hath stood firm in the Cause of God and desired that which his Ancient Lord desired. What is beloved of all is steadfastness in the love of God. If they remain firm in this station through God's grace, they shall comprehend all inner and outer effusions.

Subject: steadfastness; perseverance; faithfulness
Quotation: Be steadfast in serving thy Lord in such wise that neither the hints of the divines nor the power of princes - who have violated God's Covenant and His Testament and have disputed His verses when they were sent down from His mighty, impregnable kingdom - shall deter thee.

Subject: steadfastness; perseverance; faithfulness
Quotation: Differ not in the Cause of God and fear no one, but place your trust in God, the Mighty, the Wise...This is a Dove that feareth no one and is not disturbed by any soul, though all the kings of the earth and behind them the company of the hypocrites should gather against It

Subject: steadfastness; perseverance; faithfulness
Quotation: Be thou steadfast in the love of God and His Cause, then aid Him with what thou art able, and this is better for thee than what hath been and what shall be. The Spirit be upon thee and upon thy sister and upon those who have stood firm in this mighty and irrevocable Cause.

Subject: steadfastness; perseverance; faithfulness
Quotation: Happy art thou for thou art steadfast in the Covenant. Happy art thou for thou art illumined by the light of the love of God, art humble, evanescent and a true servant, for such are the attributes of the sincere. These are the conditions of such as have drawn nearer to God.

Subject: steadfastness; perseverance; faithfulness
Quotation: The Blessed Perfection and the First Point have withstood all the different classes of people including the governments. He was so steadfast that He strengthened His Cause while in Persia, and the more the people wanted to extinguish His lamp, the more it became brilliant.

Subject: steadfastness; perseverance; faithfulness
Quotation: Hear the call of this servant and with complete steadfastness protect the Cause of God from the oppression of the polytheists of the Bayan...However, you must stand firm in the Cause with perfect steadfastness and teach God's Cause with tongue and pen to the extent possible.

Subject: steadfastness; perseverance; faithfulness
Quotation: O thou who art steadfast in the Covenant! The letter was an illustrious one, and its contents were gems and pearls. For it was the evidence of thine enrapture, and the proof of thine fervour, and it was a clear testimony to thy firmness and steadfastness in the Cause of God.

Subject: steadfastness; perseverance; faithfulness
Quotation: That you wrote your joy increases daily, that you are always content, and that tests and tribulations have increased your steadfastness - considering these afflictions as pure mercy - greatly pleased me, for it indicates that spiritual progress will be achieved in the future.

Subject: steadfastness; perseverance; faithfulness
Quotation: Today is the day of steadfastness, for the cawing of the deniers, repudiators, and transgressors is raised from all directions. Yet, by the Sun of the heaven of truth, to those of insight and before the Most Great Scene, it is like the buzzing of a fly, nay, more contemptible.

Subject: steadfastness; perseverance; faithfulness
Quotation: He endured countless tribulations, bore hunger, thirst and affliction under arrow and bullet fire. Yet through all this, he remembered Thee with his tongue and in the depths of his heart, supplicating to Thee, detached from all else, communing with the kingdom of Thy holiness

Subject: steadfastness; perseverance; faithfulness
Quotation: Today is the Day for the manifestation of supreme steadfastness. Whosoever attains unto it has attained unto all good...Ye must be so steadfast in the Cause that neither the clamor of the world nor the parties of the nations shall prevent or debar you from the Most Great Name.

Subject: steadfastness; perseverance; faithfulness
Quotation: We counsel you to show forth supreme steadfastness and to observe that which God hath revealed from the Supreme Pen in the Crimson Tablet. Guard your stations with supreme steadfastness lest the allusions of them who have disbelieved in the Lord of all worlds cause you to slip.

Subject: steadfastness; perseverance; faithfulness
Quotation: O friends! Steadfastness is a matter of tremendous significance, and whoso attaineth unto it hath attained unto all good. Glory and radiance be upon thee and upon every believer who hath believed in God on the day of His manifestation and remained steadfast in His mighty Cause.

Subject: steadfastness; perseverance; faithfulness
Quotation: Be ye steadfast and firm, and pay no heed to the ignorant masses. Even should all who are on earth turn away, it mattereth not, for in the sight of God, all who have denied this Manifestation -- after which no likeness hath appeared in creation -- are as though they existed not.

Subject: steadfastness; perseverance; faithfulness
Quotation: Blessed is the strong one whom the power of princes hath not weakened, and the steadfast one whom the doubts of the divines have not caused to slip, and the stranger who hath sought the Most Exalted Homeland, and the doer who hath done what he was bidden in His perspicuous Book.

Subject: steadfastness; perseverance; faithfulness
Quotation: What you wrote to Mr. Aqa Siyyid Taqi was noted. It had pleasing contents and delightful meaning, for it indicated steadfastness and firmness in the Faith of God - that the trials and tests that have occurred have not caused any weakness or defect in your firmness and rootedness.

Subject: steadfastness; perseverance; faithfulness
Quotation: It is as you have written - today my joy and gladness lie in the steadfastness and persistence of the loved ones of God, the attraction of hearts to the divine fragrances, the detachment of souls from the desires of self and passion, and complete connection to the Kingdom of God.

Subject: steadfastness; perseverance; faithfulness
Quotation: O seeker of righteousness, be steadfast in the station of unity! God, the Exalted, hath said: As for those who say 'Our Lord is God' and then remain steadfast, the angels descend upon them, saying: 'Fear not, neither be grieved, and rejoice in the Paradise which ye were promised.'

Subject: steadfastness; perseverance; faithfulness
Quotation: Stand firm in what thou hast been commanded by One All-Knowing, All-Wise. Be ye steadfast in the Cause in such wise that neither the tales of the past nor what is with them who have disbelieved in God when He came with His kingdom, the Mighty, the Sublime, shall cause you to slip.

Subject: steadfastness; perseverance; faithfulness
Quotation: Strive ye to act in accordance with what hath been revealed by the Most Exalted Pen in the Book...Soon shall the tongues of the world make mention of you and the Kingdom of Glory circle round about you. Know ye your worth and recognize the value of these days and preserve your stations

Subject: steadfastness; perseverance; faithfulness
Quotation: Say: O peoples of the earth! Fear God and be not of the ignorant ones. Cast away idle fancies and vain imaginings, and take hold of that which ye are commanded by God, the All-Knowing, the All-Wise... We counsel thee and those who have believed to manifest the most great steadfastness.

Subject: steadfastness; perseverance; faithfulness
Quotation: Strive then with utmost endeavor to remain steadfast in thy Lord's Cause, firm in His love and established in His guidance...And the glory be upon thee, O Mustafa, and upon thy wife, if thou remainest steadfast in the Cause and turnest not thy face from the court of His grace and glory.

Subject: steadfastness; perseverance; faithfulness
Quotation: We counsel the men and women servants to show forth the greatest steadfastness in this Cause whereby the feet of the chosen ones have slipped save those who were taken by the breezes of their Lord's mercy, the Generous One. Hold fast to the cord of service to your Lord, the All-Merciful.

Subject: steadfastness; perseverance; faithfulness
Quotation: We must become impervious to criticism, unconscious of attack and abuse, nay, rather welcoming persecution, hostility and bitterness as the means of testing and increasing our supreme faith in God... Be therefore as spiritual adamant against these darts, arrows and swords of infliction.

Subject: steadfastness; perseverance; faithfulness
Quotation: These are servants whom the tempests of hatred did not move and the storms of hardship did not prevent. They arose to promote the Cause with such steadfastness as made the feet of the polytheists slip and the hearts of the deniers quake and the foundation of every heedless doubter shake.

Subject: steadfastness; perseverance; faithfulness
Quotation: You have spurred your steed in the field of endeavor and seized the ball of divine guidance. You have grasped the hem of grandeur and delivered yourself from grievous perils. Now too, hold fast to the firm covenant and cling with might, that you may demonstrate steadfastness and constancy

Subject: steadfastness; perseverance; faithfulness
Quotation: The Wronged One...bids thee to beautiful patience...to make me steadfast in Thy Cause and firm in Thy religion, such that neither the clamor of the ignorant nor the might of those who have denied Thy proof and Thy testimony and have violated Thy Covenant and Thy Testament shall prevent me

Subject: steadfastness; perseverance; faithfulness
Quotation: O thou whom God hath reserved for the exaltation of His Word and steadfastness in His Faith! ...strive with perfect steadfastness and firmness to protect and safeguard the mighty fortress of God's Cause, and encourage and urge all to remain firm and steadfast in God's Covenant and Testament

Subject: steadfastness; perseverance; faithfulness
Quotation: The trials and tribulations in the path of truth are the ultimate aspiration of the denizens of the highest heaven. Though outwardly they appear as poison, in reality they are honey in the mouths of the wavering ones. Though bitter to the taste of the steadfast, they are as sugar and candy.

Subject: steadfastness; perseverance; faithfulness
Quotation: O thou leaf who art assured, serene and well-pleased! In the Abha Kingdom thy mention is upon the tongue of the faithful ones, and in the most exalted Paradise thy remembrance dwelleth in hearts and souls, for thou art among the steadfast believing women and among the firm, preceding leaves.

Subject: steadfastness; perseverance; faithfulness
Quotation: Be ye steadfast in the Cause, then assist your Lord, the All-Merciful, through remembrance and utterance...might make them steadfast in My Cause in such wise that neither the oppression of any oppressor, nor the prevention of any preventer, nor all the hosts of the earth shall turn them aside

Subject: steadfastness; perseverance; faithfulness
Quotation: O people of K! We counsel you to be steadfast in these days in such wise that the hearts of the doubters who have broken God's Covenant and His Testament, and have turned away from Him Who hath come with what they possessed of the Books of God, the Lord of the worlds, may be sorely troubled.

Subject: steadfastness; perseverance; faithfulness
Quotation: Be steadfast, O seeker of piety, in the station of affirming the divine unity. God, exalted be He, said: AS FOR THOSE WHO SAY "OUR LORD IS GOD" THEN CONTINUE STEADFAST, THE ANGELS DESCEND UPON THEM SAYING "FEAR NOT, NOR BE GRIEVED, AND RECEIVE GOOD NEWS OF THE GARDEN WHICH YE WERE PROMISED!"

Subject: steadfastness; perseverance; faithfulness
Quotation: He is a very blessed soul. He is very detached. During his life-time he has had no attachment to this world and did not care for the means of living. He was attached to nothing. He always used to travel from city to city teaching the Cause. He was much persecuted. He never wavered nor faltered.

Subject: steadfastness; perseverance; faithfulness
Quotation: Consider ye the past centuries, how a single one of the beloved of God withstood all the people on the earth because of his firmness in the love of God, and his entire turning of the heart toward the Kingdom of God and with the cup of his heart overflowing with the wine of the knowledge of God.

Subject: steadfastness; perseverance; faithfulness
Quotation: We counsel you to manifest supreme steadfastness, even as We counseled you before - a command from One Who is knowing. Soon shall be made manifest the station of every one who hath turned unto Him, the rank of every one who remembereth Him, and the glory of every one who standeth firm and upright.

Subject: steadfastness; perseverance; faithfulness
Quotation: Today, every soul that hath turned unto Him, his light is manifest before the Throne and his cause is evident. That which is necessary today is steadfastness in the Cause. [...] Would that all souls who are firm in the Truth and detached from aught else would hold fast to such lofty and goodly deeds.

Subject: steadfastness; perseverance; faithfulness
Quotation: One must be like the luminous sun rising and appearing from the horizon of tests and trials, and like firm mountains, steadfast and unmoved...All the friends of God held fast to this most firm handle of patience and thankfulness for tribulations in the path of God, and thereby reached lofty stations.

Subject: steadfastness; perseverance; faithfulness
Quotation: And thou, O servant, hold fast unto the cord of the Cause and be not disturbed when the clamor of the polytheists is raised, when the pillars are shaken and every lofty mountain is laid low. Stand thou firm in the Cause of God in these days the like of which the eyes of creation have never witnessed.

Subject: steadfastness; perseverance; faithfulness
Quotation: "Thou art he through whose steadfastness the feet of the servants were shaken, and through whose tranquility the hearts of the wicked were disturbed...Blessed art thou and joy be unto thee for having shown patience in the days of God and for having been content with whatsoever befell thee in His path"

Subject: steadfastness; perseverance; faithfulness
Quotation: Blessed is he who hath been named with the Name that hath borne tribulations in every age and dispensation in the path of Thy love... I saw her steadfast in Thy love and firm in Thy Cause and obedience. Blessed is she for having fulfilled Thy promise and not broken the Covenant on this Day of Separation.

Subject: steadfastness; perseverance; faithfulness
Quotation: Stand firm as an immovable mountain in the Cause of thy Lord. He is with thee and will preserve thee in truth by His command... Walk thou in My footsteps in such wise that nothing shall sadden thee, even should the arrows of tribulation rain down upon thee from the clouds of the hearts of the wicked ones.

Subject: steadfastness; perseverance; faithfulness
Quotation: several souls who had no standing whatsoever among the people were raised up with supreme steadfastness and with what eagerness and longing hastened to the Supreme Horizon, such that they were never perturbed or shaken in times of tribulation, freely sacrificing their lives in the path of the All-Merciful.

Subject: steadfastness; perseverance; faithfulness
Quotation: O steadfast sapling! In truth you exerted the utmost effort in the Primary School, and now in the School of Tarbiyat as well you have engaged in teaching children freely. This too is a noble service, therefore I interpret you as divine deliverance, for you are truthful, trustworthy, steadfast and resolute.

Subject: steadfastness; perseverance; faithfulness
Quotation: "Verily, We pronounce from this station Our 'Allah-u-Akbar' upon their faces, and nothing that hath been created in the realm of possibility can equal this pronouncement. We beseech Him, exalted be He, to aid them to remain steadfast with the greatest steadfastness in this Cause whereby feet have slipped."

Subject: steadfastness; perseverance; faithfulness
Quotation: We beseech God to assist thee and ordain for thee the best in this world and the next, and to send down upon thee that which will make thee powerful, steadfast, firm and immovable in the Cause of thy Lord in such wise that neither the veils of glory nor the might of the people of error shall hold thee back.

Subject: steadfastness; perseverance; faithfulness
Quotation: The hair of these men has been made white (through their services) in the cause of God both during the days of the Blessed Beauty and afterwards. They had no ease day no night - had no intention save service in the cause of God - had no other thoughts. Notwithstanding this they remained firm and steadfast.

Subject: steadfastness; perseverance; faithfulness
Quotation: O ?abib, in the Persian tongue it is set forth in truth: If mankind were to reflect on this one theme, they would bear witness that this constancy and steadfastness, this forbearance and patience during times of calamities and afflictions, whether in open or in secret, is possible only through a divine power.

Subject: steadfastness; perseverance; faithfulness
Quotation: O My Name! Hearken unto My Voice from the direction of My throne. He desireth to make mention of thee at all times, inasmuch as He hath found thee steadfast in celebrating His praise amongst men. Thy Lord loveth faithfulness as found in the realm of creation, and hath placed it ahead of most other qualities.

Subject: steadfastness; perseverance; faithfulness
Quotation: They must be so steadfast that no one will find occasion to speak. Today all must stand firm and steadfast in the Cause of the Luminary of the horizons in perfect unity. The favors of the Revealer of verses have encompassed and will continue to encompass those who have turned towards Him and remained steadfast.

Subject: steadfastness; perseverance; faithfulness
Quotation: Do not be saddened by tests, for they are the cause of progress, but one must remain firm and steadfast. When you show fortitude, ultimately the darkness of tests will be transformed into light, hardship will be changed to mercy, loss will result in profit, and annihilation will become the cause of immortality.

Subject: steadfastness; perseverance; faithfulness
Quotation: But steadfastness and persistence are necessary, not that it continue for just a few days and then gradually be forgotten. The condition is steadfastness, and in every matter where there is firmness and steadfastness, it will surely yield results. Otherwise it will last for a few days and then become disrupted.

Subject: steadfastness; perseverance; faithfulness
Quotation: Man should not be like a chameleon, having a different state each hour and a different disposition each day. One must establish for oneself a definite course and fix a point of attention. One should move along that course toward that point which is the ultimate goal and desire. Never should there be any wavering.

Subject: steadfastness; perseverance; faithfulness
Quotation: Be thou steadfast in the love of thy Lord in such wise that the winds of trials move thee not...Say: O my God and my Beloved! I beseech Thee by Thy Name through which Thou hast subdued all in the lands to make me steadfast in Thy Cause, firm in Thy love and immovable in that whereunto I have attained in Thy days.

Subject: steadfastness; perseverance; faithfulness
Quotation: They arose to champion the Cause with such firmness that neither the devastating winds of the polytheists nor the tempests of the infidels could shake them. These are they who are described by the tongues of the Prophets and Messengers, they whose mention hath been made in the divine Books of both past and present.

Subject: steadfastness; perseverance; faithfulness
Quotation: Glory, remembrance, praise and salutations be upon you and upon those whom the doubts of men have not withheld from the Lord of Destiny, and whom the oppression of the oppressors hath not frightened from this Cause, whereby the limbs of all names have trembled, save such as God, the Lord of the worlds, hath willed.

Subject: steadfastness; perseverance; faithfulness
Quotation: I ever beseech the one God to cause you to grow daily in steadfastness and constancy, and to become the cause of quickening souls. That which is the cause of everlasting life in humankind and that which is permanent and lasting is the knowledge of God, the love of God, faith, certitude, steadfastness and constancy.

Subject: steadfastness; perseverance; faithfulness
Quotation: Be thou steadfast in the service of thy Lord, and vocal in His remembrance and praise amongst the servants. Thus doth the Mother Book command thee. God willing, all should observe the verses of Truth, nay rather memorize them, that they may at all times be blessed with the sweetness of the water of divine knowledge.

Subject: steadfastness; perseverance; faithfulness
Quotation: And God willing, from now on thou shalt remain firm, steadfast and upright in the Cause of God in such wise that the vain imaginings of malicious souls shall not prevent thee from the court of divine unity...May they be so firm in the Cause that the schemes of schemers shall not hold them back from the straight path.

Subject: steadfastness; perseverance; faithfulness
Quotation: Fear not, neither be ye sorrowful. By the Sun of Truth, there hath been ordained for you that which the treasures of earth and heaven cannot equal. Praise be to God that hearts have been illumined with the light of recognition and have been sanctified and purified from corruption, conflict and whatsoever is unseemly.

Subject: steadfastness; perseverance; faithfulness
Quotation: Through God's grace, remain firm and joyous, and free and detached from all else...God, the Exalted, will, God willing, protect all and give them to drink from the Kawthar of steadfastness...Exalted is the station of one who hath attained unto supreme steadfastness and remained firm and steadfast in the Cause of God.

Subject: steadfastness; perseverance; faithfulness
Quotation: Be patient in My Cause and grieve not within thyself, for though separation is more bitter than any bitterness, yet following Me is sweeter than any sweetness. Then I counsel thee, O 'Ali, to patience in this greatest terror and to forbearance in this constraint, then to firmness in the love of God and His loved ones.

Subject: steadfastness; perseverance; faithfulness
Quotation: These two have drunk from the chalice of faithfulness and have received their portion from the light of detachment. From the earliest days they arose to serve the Cause. Neither the authority of the oppressor nor the wrath of the transgressor prevented them from drawing nigh, nor held them back from turning toward God.

Subject: steadfastness; perseverance; faithfulness
Quotation: Firmness and steadfastness are, in this day, the greatest of all things. Unless a tree be steadfast, it will not bear fruit; and unless a foundation remain firm, it will not endure. There is no higher virtue in the human world than steadfastness; he who manifesteth it shall receive the confirmation of the Holy Spirit.

Subject: steadfastness; perseverance; faithfulness
Quotation: Thy loved ones who have surrendered all their affairs to Thy will, O my compassionate Lord, and are content with Thy decree, patient under Thy trials, have drunk the cup of Thy faithfulness, responded to Thy call, and turned to Thee with throbbing hearts, joyful souls, and spirits yearning for the kingdom of Thy mercy.

Subject: steadfastness; perseverance; faithfulness
Quotation: We counsel them to manifest supreme steadfastness in this mighty Cause whereby all who are in the heavens were thunderstruck, save whom God willed, the Almighty, the Powerful. A letter from S hath come before Our presence. We have read it and found from it the fragrance of steadfastness. This indeed is a great victory.

Subject: steadfastness; perseverance; faithfulness
Quotation: Be thou steadfast in the Cause in such wise that neither the cawing of the infidels nor the utterances of the polytheists shall deter thee. Hold fast unto this strong and mighty cord - verily it is God's handle between the heavens and the earth. Blessed is he that holdeth fast thereunto, and woe unto the heedless ones.

Subject: steadfastness; perseverance; faithfulness
Quotation: Be strong, be firm and steadfast, be resolute. When a tree takes root and remains steadfast, it yields fruit. Therefore, be not disturbed by any test. Be not disheartened, be not despondent, for divine tests are numerous, but if a person remains firm and steadfast, the very test itself becomes the cause of his progress.

Subject: steadfastness; perseverance; faithfulness
Quotation: Be thou steadfast in the Cause of thy Lord, and firm in such wise that thereby the servants may be made firm... I testify that thou didst believe in God when the horizon of Manifestation was illumined with the light of certitude, and thou didst not hesitate for less than a moment when thou didst hear the call of thy Lord

Subject: steadfastness; perseverance; faithfulness
Quotation: Despite this he did not flag or fall short...The proof of steadfastness is to acquire the characteristics of the people of sanctity - truthfulness, trustworthiness, love, religious devotion, enthusiasm and warmth, tranquility and detachment, diffusing the divine fragrances, and exalting the Word of God in speech and deed.

Subject: steadfastness; perseverance; faithfulness
Quotation: The True One is patient and counseleth His loved ones to gracious patience. His Honour Mishkin, upon him be My glory, made mention of thee. We have remembered thee in this Most Holy, Most Exalted Tablet. Every word recorded today by the Supreme Pen shall not be erased, nor shall the passage of centuries and ages affect it.

Subject: steadfastness; perseverance; faithfulness
Quotation: Say: O people of God! Take the chalice of steadfastness in the name of the Lord of all created things, then drink therefrom in such wise that neither the hosts of the oppressors nor the ranks of the Pharaohs who have adorned their heads with turbans and have disbelieved in God, the Mighty, the Praiseworthy, may hinder you.

Subject: steadfastness; perseverance; faithfulness
Quotation: Soon all shall turn toward the intended Goal, but alas for those souls who today remain deprived of the shining lights... Although today the enkindled and devoted souls have been encompassed by abasement due to their turning to the Word of God, yet soon all on earth shall engage in glorifying their mention with utmost honor.

Subject: steadfastness; perseverance; faithfulness
Quotation: We beseech God, exalted be His glory, to make each one of His party like unto a mountain rather than a straw. The hurricanes and tempests of the polytheists have never been and shall never be capable of moving the former, by God's might and power; however, the latter is moved by every wind and inclines toward any direction.

Subject: steadfastness; perseverance; faithfulness
Quotation: Now what is required is steadfastness in the Cause and teaching the people with wisdom and utterance...It is hoped that from your honor and the friends of that land the effulgences of the light of steadfastness will at all times appear and shine forth...to make each one of them a firmly-fixed mountain, steadfast in His Cause

Subject: steadfastness; perseverance; faithfulness
Quotation: We counsel the friends of God, exalted be His glory, to be trustworthy and religious, and to that which is the cause of the exaltation and elevation of the Word of God. O people of God! From your qualities the qualities of God should be observed, and your deeds and your rest and motion should become mirrors of the will of God.

Subject: steadfastness; perseverance; faithfulness
Quotation: Convey greetings to the friends on behalf of the Wronged One. Say: It behooveth you to vie with one another in love, fellowship, steadfastness, purity and faithfulness, and to know the worth of your stations. By My life and yours! Soon shall the tongues of the world speak of your mention, your acceptance and your steadfastness.

Subject: steadfastness; perseverance; faithfulness
Quotation: Be patient, O servant, in this firmly established and mighty decree. Put thy trust in God, thy Lord, then commit thy affairs unto Him, for He is the best of helpers and protectors. Though in this separation the pillars of the unitarians be demolished, yet patience therein is nearer unto righteousness, if ye be of those who know.

Subject: steadfastness; perseverance; faithfulness
Quotation: "He stood firm even as the lofty mountains, and such as those who art devoted to Thee, he pursued steadfastly the path of Thy Cause on the Day of Thy Presence... These two brothers wert steadfast in Thy Covenant and Testament and their footsteps slipped not by the tempests of trials and the whirlwinds of the violent commotions."

Subject: steadfastness; perseverance; faithfulness
Quotation: They had expressed the utmost praise and commendation for the steadfastness and firmness of that divine branch, for praise be to God, he is a fruitful and verdant sapling in the garden of unity, and in the meadows of servitude at the Sacred Threshold, he is a fully blooming hundred-petaled rose in the utmost freshness and grace.

Subject: steadfastness; perseverance; faithfulness
Quotation: We counsel thee to manifest supreme steadfastness in this Cause whereby the feet of those who bear names have slipped, save whom God willeth, the Lord of the Return. Be thou of such constancy that shouldst the learned of the earth bring forth all that is with them, thou shalt behold thyself radiant from the horizon of certitude.

Subject: steadfastness; perseverance; faithfulness
Quotation: And praise be unto Him, for He is the Goal of all who know and the Beloved of the sincere ones... Blessed is the soul that hath discovered the fragrance of Thy verses, turned unto Thee, hastened to Thy supreme horizon--the Station wherein naught is mentioned save Thyself, O Lord of all beings and Sovereign of the earth and heaven.

Subject: steadfastness; perseverance; faithfulness
Quotation: Today is the day of steadfastness and triumph, and the source of this peerless pearl is the reality of man. It is hoped that through the endeavors of the loved ones, the heedless may become aware, the sleeping may lift their heads from the couch of negligence, and the bewildered may find their way to the horizon of divine bounty.

Subject: steadfastness; perseverance; faithfulness
Quotation: thou must remain firm and steadfast in the Cause of God through a celestial power and heavenly confirmations, and stand immovable like a mighty mountain and an impregnable foundation, like an intervening barrier and complete shield. Be not disturbed by the breezes of tribulations, and be not shaken by the intensity of calamities.

Subject: steadfastness; perseverance; faithfulness
Quotation: In the time of Jesus Christ the greatest one of the disciples was Peter, yet he denied his Master three times. But the followers of Baha'o'llah under the most severe torture, were repeating the Name of Baha'o'llah and never denied it, not only one, a hundred or a thousand, but twenty thousand followers hastened thus to martyrdom.

Subject: steadfastness; perseverance; faithfulness
Quotation: This is the Day of steadfastness, firmness and constancy. Blessed is he who hath attained unto the Greater Steadfastness in this Mighty Cause. Whatsoever hath befallen thee hath been in the path of God. This is among God's ways, from time immemorial and unto all time to come. Verily, He is with thee and with His steadfast servants.

Subject: steadfastness; perseverance; faithfulness
Quotation: Praise be to God that you did not waver under the tests, but remained firm and steadfast. When a tree takes root in the soil, it yields blossoms and fruit. Now, praise be to God, you are firm and steadfast in this Day of the Kingdom, and rest assured that you shall become the recipient of divine confirmations and endless bounties.

Subject: steadfastness; perseverance; faithfulness
Quotation: This scion, truly, followed the example of his august father in treading the Straight Path and the Undeviating Way He was touched by trials and tribulations, and bore every hardship and adversity, thanking Thee the while for each direst calamity Never throughout his life did he repose, nor spare any effort in serving Thy loved ones

Subject: steadfastness; perseverance; faithfulness
Quotation: I am He, O my God, Whom the hatred of Thine enemies hindereth not from loving Thee, nor doth the clamor of those who have disbelieved in Thy signs silence me from praising Thee. By Thy might! Should all who are on earth unite to oppress me with tyranny and injustice, my tongue would still mention Thee and praise Thee in their midst.

Subject: steadfastness; perseverance; faithfulness
Quotation: He faltered not in teaching Thy Cause out of fear or dread, neither did the might of the oppressors frighten him nor the punishment of every vile and wicked slanderer daunt him. He spoke with most eloquent utterance and wondrous proof with manifest authority, such that the hearts of those present were astounded by this steadfast man

Subject: steadfastness; perseverance; faithfulness
Quotation: We counsel them to patience. The station of patience is most exalted. In the Qur'an He says, blessed and exalted be He: O ye who believe! Seek help with patient perseverance and prayer, for God is with those who patiently persevere. He mentioned patience before prayer, even though prayer is a pillar of the divine tabernacle of glory.

Subject: steadfastness; perseverance; faithfulness
Quotation: The friends in Bashruyah are very old. They have suffered all manner of persecutions, many of them were martyred, yet they remained firm and steadfast and their faith increased. While surrounded on all parts by these unbearable hardships, the countenance of their faith remained undimmed and their firmness and steadfastness unshaken.

Subject: steadfastness; perseverance; faithfulness
Quotation: Thy steadfast loved ones have stood firm in Thy manifest religion and have been steadfast in Thy mighty Cause with such firmness that the pillars of the Covenant-breakers were shaken and the limbs of the violators trembled...They never faltered in servitude at Thy Most Exalted Threshold and never weakened from the intensity of trials

Subject: steadfastness; perseverance; faithfulness
Quotation: Blessed is the one whom vain imaginings did not deprive of the horizon of certitude, and whom the clamor of the turbaned ones did not prevent from turning to the most exalted horizon...We beseech God to aid thee to stand firm with supreme steadfastness, in such wise that all the peoples of the world shall be powerless to prevent thee.

Subject: steadfastness; perseverance; faithfulness
Quotation: Hold fast to the cord of steadfastness and place your trust in God, the Almighty, the All-Powerful... All must remain steadfast and firm in the Cause of the Beloved of all possibility with the utmost joy and fragrance, in such wise that the opposition and objection of the people of the world shall not debar them from the straight path.

Subject: steadfastness; perseverance; faithfulness
Quotation: O Mahmud! Upon thee be the Glory of God, the Mighty, the Loving. Thy letter reached the Most Holy Court and from it wafted the fragrance of turning, attraction and steadfastness. Praise be to God that the clamor of the polytheists and the doubts of the atheists did not prevent or deprive thee from drawing nigh unto the supreme horizon.

Subject: steadfastness; perseverance; faithfulness
Quotation: Stand firm in the Cause of God with such firmness that all who are in the heavens and earth shall be made firm by your steadfastness... O loved ones of God, detach yourselves from all else but God and hold fast unto Him and seek His presence, and stand firm in the Cause of God that ye may be safe from the terror of the Most Great Fear.

Subject: steadfastness; perseverance; faithfulness
Quotation: With complete steadfastness they arose to offer praise and thanksgiving, to teach the Cause and to exalt it. They are the horsemen in the arena of wisdom and utterance, and the hands of the Cause amongst religions. Their hearts are purified from rancor and hatred, and their breasts are illumined with the lights of the Most Exalted Word.

Subject: steadfastness; perseverance; faithfulness
