Quotation: You are saplings in the divine garden: when a sapling's roots are firm, it will grow and thrive, becoming a tree of utmost freshness and grace, but when its roots are weak it will surely wither, fade and dry up. Praise be to God that you are a sapling with firm roots, and thus you shall remain safe and protected from the winds of tests.

Subject: steadfastness; perseverance; faithfulness
Quotation: Some time ago thy letter was received, and from it wafted the fragrance of sincerity and steadfastness. We testify that thou hast attained unto the mention of God and the traces of His Most Exalted Pen, and hast arisen to serve the Cause in such wise that neither the doubts of the wicked nor the onslaught of the evil ones deterred thee.

Subject: steadfastness; perseverance; faithfulness
Quotation: Say: O loved ones of God! Time and again ye have been the target of affliction's arrows in the path of the Lord of Names. Which prison hath not witnessed your presence, and which oppression hath not befallen you in the path of the Beloved? Ye have seen and borne countless trials. Preserve this most exalted station and most glorious rank.

Subject: steadfastness; perseverance; faithfulness
Quotation: O friends! Arise with utmost steadfastness in the Cause of the Beloved of the worlds, in such wise that the entire world may testify to this most great station. The degrees of steadfastness, detachment, firmness and constancy become apparent only at the time when the clamor of the barking ones, the polytheists and the atheists is raised.

Subject: steadfastness; perseverance; faithfulness
Quotation: The beginning of the matter is the recognition of God, and its end is steadfastness in His Cause... Be not grieved by any matter... Though for some days affairs may be observed contrary to what is pleasing, be not saddened... Glory be upon you and upon those who have attained unto the Most Great Steadfastness in this mighty, exalted Cause.

Subject: steadfastness; perseverance; faithfulness
Quotation: The text praises the steadfastness of martyrs who remained firm despite persecution: "In the land of Sad, despite their wealth and status, the might of the oppressors did not shake them. With joy and radiance they sacrificed their lives, which are the most precious and exalted of all things in the world, in the path of the peerless Friend."

Subject: steadfastness; perseverance; faithfulness
Quotation: O thou who art steadfast in the Covenant! The manifold adversities and afflictions and the successive trials and hardships have served to adorn thy brow with the crown of steadfastness and have caused thee to quaff from the chalice of fidelity. Thou hast been subjected to every test and trial and hast emerged therefrom radiant and victorious.

Subject: steadfastness; perseverance; faithfulness
Quotation: O Lion! God willing, thou shalt be reckoned among the lions of the thicket of steadfastness. Blessed are they whom the power of oppression prevented not and whom the doubts of the dawning-places of idle fancies deprived not of the Truth. These are of the valiant ones, these are of the men of might, and these are the people of the Crimson Ark.

Subject: steadfastness; perseverance; faithfulness
Quotation: Through the power and might of God, they must shun and avoid that from which the odor of corruption can be detected. This is a firm ordinance that hath been sent down and issued forth from the will of the Lord of eternity and the Most Great Name. Blessed is he who hath heard and acted upon that which God, the Ancient Commander, hath ordained.

Subject: steadfastness; perseverance; faithfulness
Quotation: Blessed is he who hath stood firm in this Cause, at whose appearance the heaven of idle fancies was cleft asunder and the hearts of the wicked were shaken. We have ordained that turning unto Us should be with the hearts, inasmuch as the barking of dogs hath increased around the city wherein the call of God, the Lord of lords, hath been raised.

Subject: steadfastness; perseverance; faithfulness
Quotation: O Attar! Upon thee be My glory! Upon thee be the Most Great Steadfastness in the Cause of thy Lord, the Lord of all beings. Say: My God, my God! Shut me not out from the gate of Thy grace, and deprive me not of the ocean of Thy utterance. I beseech Thee to make me so steadfast in Thy Cause that the hosts of the oppressors shall not frighten me.

Subject: steadfastness; perseverance; faithfulness
Quotation: From the horizon of every deed of those who have turned to God, the Sun of truth and steadfastness rises and shines forth. How many holy souls who possessed wealth, position, honor and bounty have, nevertheless, with complete submission and contentment spent all they possessed in the path of the One True Friend and freely sacrificed their lives.

Subject: steadfastness; perseverance; faithfulness
Quotation: We counsel thee to remain steadfast in the Greatest Steadfastness and to preserve that which thou hast been given from the presence of the All-Forgiving, the Most Generous. Blessed art thou for having turned unto God on a Day whereon every learned one turned away and every mystic objected and every religious leader pronounced his remote judgment.

Subject: steadfastness; perseverance; faithfulness
Quotation: They remained firm in the Covenant, cast away hypocrisy, turned deaf ears to croaking voices, shunned discord, and arose with utmost dedication to serve Thee after the Luminary of the horizons, the Center of the lights of Beauty, disappeared behind the clouds of glory. They sacrificed their souls in Thy path - this was their dearest wish and hope.

Subject: steadfastness; perseverance; faithfulness
Quotation: Thus mayest thou become firm in trials and bear every difficulty and, like unto the mountains, hold thy feet firm and steadfast, so that thou mayest not be shaken by the adverse winds... The essential thing is firmness and steadfastness. I hope that all the friends and the maid-servants of the Merciful One may be strengthened and confirmed therein.

Subject: steadfastness; perseverance; faithfulness
Quotation: Be as thy Lord hath been, such that neither the gestures of the ignorant disturb thee nor the darkness of the desires of those who judge alarm thee. Remember thy Lord at all times and turn not unto those who have cast the covenant and testament of God behind their backs and followed the promptings of their own desires - these are indeed the losers.

Subject: steadfastness; perseverance; faithfulness
Quotation: Glory and remembrance and praise be upon your honor, upon those with you, upon God's friends, His loved ones, His handmaidens and leaves there and in all regions - those whom nothing whatsoever can distract, nor can worldly events sadden them from the remembrance of God, our Lord and the Lord of earth and heaven and the King of the Kingdom of Names.

Subject: steadfastness; perseverance; faithfulness
Quotation: Yet he remained patient under all manner of afflictions, and thankful in adversity, comporting himself with dignity amongst all people, oblivious alike of the blame of the blamer, and the dominion of the reviler. Rather, he stood as firm as the mountains before the iniquity of the people of error, and ever invoked Thee with all lowliness and fervour

Subject: steadfastness; perseverance; faithfulness
Quotation: In the gathering of the effulgent Beauty of the Manifestation of Sinai thou didst witness, and in the assembly of the people of the Covenant thou didst shine forth like unto a candle. Now thou hast attained the honor of visiting the point of circumambulation of the Concourse on High. This is the sign of contentment, this is the mark of faithfulness.

Subject: steadfastness; perseverance; faithfulness
Quotation: O Lord! I beseech Thee by Thy Beloved One, and by his yearning and his attraction when he heard Thy call and was given the glad tidings of meeting Thee above the heavens of Thy power and the firmaments of Thy grandeur, to make me and those with me the dawning-places of truthfulness and purity, and the daysprings of trustworthiness, faith and fidelity.

Subject: steadfastness; perseverance; faithfulness
Quotation: O leaf! Hold fast unto the firm Branch of the Tree, lest thou be stirred by the transient and darksome winds and be cut off from the Tree of divine unity. Throughout the passing of days, abide beneath the divine springtime, that thou mayest remain forever fresh, verdant and flourishing in such wise that the name of extinction shall never overtake thee.

Subject: steadfastness; perseverance; faithfulness
Quotation: This is a Day wherein all who dwell on earth are seen to be thunderstruck and fallen prostrate by the divine trumpet-blast, save only for certain letters of thy Lord's countenance - they who are the people of the Crimson Ark... That which is accounted this day as the most glorious of all deeds in the sight of God is steadfastness in His Most Great Cause.

Subject: steadfastness; perseverance; faithfulness
Quotation: Be firm in the faith and let no doubts come to your mind, for this century is the most important of all. You have to be firm and solid. If success in the worldly things (which are nothing in comparison with spiritual) depends on firmness, how much more is the spiritual? He who stands firm will succeed, but the cowards who draw back will never see success.

Subject: steadfastness; perseverance; faithfulness
Quotation: O thou who hast drunk from the cup of fidelity, who gazest toward the Most Exalted Horizon, and who soarest in the atmosphere of the love of the All-Merciful! Be moved by the breezes of thy Lord's will even as trees are moved by the winds. Be thou content at all times with what hath been and will be ordained by God, the Commanding, the Mighty, the Praised.

Subject: steadfastness; perseverance; faithfulness
Quotation: And if steadfastness be lacking, the one who maketh mention will have no effect. Say: O friends! Fear and anxiety befit women. If the friends of God were to reflect even briefly upon the world and the differences manifest therein, the might of the oppressors would not frighten them and they would soar upon the wings of longing to the Daystar of the horizons.

Subject: steadfastness; perseverance; faithfulness
Quotation: Today We desire steadfastness for those who have turned to God and for the believers, for the thieves lie in wait in their hiding places. Beseech God that He may protect all and adorn them with the raiment of steadfastness, that they may not be deprived of the rays of the Sun of Divine Unity which is shining resplendent from the highest horizon of the world.

Subject: steadfastness; perseverance; faithfulness
Quotation: The letter to his honor Afnan was read and joy and delight were obtained from your faithfulness to the friends. Thus should the workers work. Do not forget the friends and do not remain silent from their remembrance. This is a clear proof for the wayfarers on the path and a sign of firmness and steadfastness in the Cause of the All-Merciful, the Compassionate.

Subject: steadfastness; perseverance; faithfulness
Quotation: Praise be to God that in all conditions the hands of divine justice are engaged among the servants in executing that which they are bidden, and in distinguishing and separating between the manifestations of tyranny and justice. Glory be to Him Who hath cast away oppression and chosen justice for the preservation of His servants and the development of His lands!

Subject: steadfastness; perseverance; faithfulness
Quotation: O Mahdi! Magnify in My name the faces of My loved ones. We counseled them before and counsel them now concerning the trust wherewith God hath adorned the temples of those near unto Him and the sincere ones, and whereby God hath tested His servants in His earth. Blessed is he who is illumined by its light and adorned with its radiance, and woe unto the heedless.

Subject: steadfastness; perseverance; faithfulness
Quotation: It is as though they were kneaded from the waters of certitude and nurtured at the table of steadfastness. They have rent asunder the veils and torn away the shrouds, guiding those souls who are ready among the servants to the pavilions of grandeur of the Lord of creation. In truth, these souls who are firm, steadfast, certain and upright are the pathways of God

Subject: steadfastness; perseverance; faithfulness
Quotation: Now the station of steadfastness that hath been revealed in the Tablets of God becomes evident. In numerous passages this verse hath been revealed from the Divine Pen: "Verily this Day is great, great, and the Cause is great, great." Where are the mighty hearts? Where are the powerful souls? Where are the steadfast feet? Where are the firm and well-grounded souls?

Subject: steadfastness; perseverance; faithfulness
Quotation: Thou hast borne what thou hast borne in love for thy Lord... Grieve thou not over anything. Put thy trust in God. He will set aright what thou hast intended... And verily the glory be upon thee and upon those who are with thee and upon those from whom hath appeared the supreme steadfastness amidst the hosts of creation. They are indeed among the firmly rooted ones.

Subject: steadfastness; perseverance; faithfulness
Quotation: Such as thyself must needs be patient and forbearing. By My life! There hath befallen Us in this land that which hath caused sighs to ascend and tears to fall...Thou too must choose patience in such matters. Forbearance and tolerance are necessary. No harm shall come to thee from conflict and dispute, from vain imaginings and suspicions, from backbiting and taunts.

Subject: steadfastness; perseverance; faithfulness
Quotation: The most excellent of deeds today is steadfastness, for the cawers and the liars and the infidels have appeared and will appear in every land... Blessed are they who drink the wine of steadfastness in this mighty Cause... God willing, all the friends must at all times speak in remembrance of the Beloved of the worlds and hold fast to the strong cord of steadfastness.

Subject: steadfastness; perseverance; faithfulness
Quotation: In truth, they were a paradise reflecting praise and thanksgiving, and speaking of that which indicateth the Most Great Steadfastness. We counsel them in all conditions to that whereby the Cause of their Lord, the Self-Sufficient, the Most Exalted, may be uplifted, and to draw nigh unto the Divine Lote-Tree and to turn with heart and soul toward the Most Exalted Horizon.

Subject: steadfastness; perseverance; faithfulness
Quotation: Have you ever heard of an invalid, whose health is in extreme upheaval, writing a letter to someone in the middle of the ocean during sleep? Yet 'Abdu'l-Baha does this while all the people on the ship are resting comfortably in their beds and sleeping peacefully, while this sick one, captivated by love for the friends, has been occupied with writing from sunrise until now

Subject: steadfastness; perseverance; faithfulness
Quotation: Truly I say he was in a state of the utmost severance, and adorned with the highest virtues of firmness and steadfastness. He was absolutely detached from everything. From the day that he became a believer up to the last moment of his life, he was occupied in the service of the Cause of God; either he conveyed the message or wrote books proving the validity of this Cause.

Subject: steadfastness; perseverance; faithfulness
Quotation: Be patient, O handmaiden of God...I beseech Thee, O Lord of the worlds and Educator of the nations, by Thy Most Great Name, and by Thy Sacred House, and by the ocean of Thy bounty which surgeth in the Sacred Place and Station, and by the Beloved through Whose advent the celestial spheres were honored, to make me content with Thy decree and fixed upon Thy Will and Purpose.

Subject: steadfastness; perseverance; faithfulness
Quotation: Lament not because of the wicked. Thou wert created to bear and endure, O Patience of the worlds. Verily, I have heard Thy call, O All-Glorious Beloved; and now is the face of Baha flaming with the heat of tribulation and with the fire of Thy shining word, and He hath risen up in faithfulness at the place of sacrifice, looking toward Thy pleasure, O Ordainer of the worlds.

Subject: steadfastness; perseverance; faithfulness
Quotation: The calumnies of the calumniators and the opposition of the polytheists have not prevented the Supreme Pen from remembering, during the nights and days, the true loved ones and spiritual friends. The denial of the Day Star of affirmation hath not deprived it of sincerity and purity, nor hath its darkness prevented the light of justice from shining forth and being manifest.

Subject: steadfastness; perseverance; faithfulness
Quotation: How many are the princes of the earth who today are deprived of the rustling of the Divine Lote-Tree and the scratching of the Most Exalted Pen, while thou hast attained and hast turned toward the Dawning-Place of verses, the Dayspring of clear proofs, and the Source of commandments and ordinances. Let not this most exalted station and most glorious rank slip from thy grasp.

Subject: steadfastness; perseverance; faithfulness
Quotation: Blessed is the soul that hath borne tribulations in the path of God, the Lord of the Day of Mutual Summoning. O son of Abhar! A hundred thousand praises be unto the Purpose of the world Who, through the Most Great Name, hath opened the gates of the hearts of nations. Through His Name, He hath transformed fear into tranquility, remoteness into nearness, and darkness into light.

Subject: steadfastness; perseverance; faithfulness
Quotation: Why art thou dejected? Thou hast kindled in the lamp of thy heart a brilliant flame of love for the Blessed Beauty - why then art thou downcast? Thy countenance is illumined with the light of devotion to the Most Glorious Kingdom - wherefore then thy grief and lamentation? In this day, every soul who remaineth firm in the Covenant shall be assisted and confirmed in all things.

Subject: steadfastness; perseverance; faithfulness
Quotation: The greatest of all things is steadfastness and unity around God's all-embracing Word. God willing, through divine grace and heavenly bounty, may ye all attain unto this. All must hold fast unto the cord of steadfastness and cling to the hem of unity and concord. They must be so firm in the Cause that the fragrance thereof may guide aright those who are unsettled and wavering.

Subject: steadfastness; perseverance; faithfulness
Quotation: The text praises the steadfastness of the deceased: "The Most Exalted Pen beareth witness to thy turning, thy faith, thy recognition, thy certitude, and thy steadfastness in days wherein smoke enveloped all possibility... Thou art he whom the rapture of the call so seized that neither the clamor of the divines, nor the might of names, nor the hosts of princes could weaken thee."

Subject: steadfastness; perseverance; faithfulness
Quotation: Blessed is he who hath quaffed from the Kawthar of steadfastness in such wise that all that is with men hath not withheld him from God, the All-Glorious... How many were the souls who claimed the utmost steadfastness, yet were deprived of the Day-Star of inner meanings after but a slight test. Beseech God that He may protect all and adorn them with the ornament of steadfastness.

Subject: steadfastness; perseverance; faithfulness
Quotation: O honored one, his eminence the Afnan, the venerable Haji Mirza Buzurg, upon him be the Glory of God, the Most Glorious, may he take note. May my spirit be a sacrifice for your steadfastness, your firmness and your service. I beseech Thee to assist Thy chosen ones to achieve such steadfastness as cannot be shaken by the clamor of the deniers nor the murmuring of the polytheists.

Subject: steadfastness; perseverance; faithfulness
Quotation: Blessed is he who possesses such power that the calumnies of the people prevent him not from revealing the truth, and who appears from the horizon of might, detached from all who dwell on earth and whatsoever is treasured therein, manifesting with most eloquent utterance and with the light of certitude before the faces of the world that which befits His holy and sanctified Cause.

Subject: steadfastness; perseverance; faithfulness
Quotation: During these days of trial those blessed souls have withstood every test in the utmost steadfastness and perseverance. Like unto pure and unadulterated gold they shone with infinite brilliancy in the flaming fire of tests. But all this is conditioned upon firmness and steadfastness throughout all trials. Not until the tree is rooted and firmly implanted, can it give forth fruit.

Subject: steadfastness; perseverance; faithfulness
Quotation: Hold fast unto the cord of thy Lord's loving-kindness and cling to the hem of bounty in this wondrous Day. At all times thou must attain unto that which He loveth and that which pleaseth Him. Great is this Day, and great are the deeds befitting it, and that is steadfastness in this Cause, the mention of whose greatness hath been recorded in the Books of the past and of the future.

Subject: steadfastness; perseverance; faithfulness
Quotation: Although the sorrows that have occurred have encompassed the worlds of justice and equity, yet this Wronged One, through divine strength and celestial power, standeth firm before all faces and speaketh forth. The clamor of the heedless ones, the croaking of the croakers, and the oppression of the oppressors have not prevented Him, nor held Him back from that which God hath willed.

Subject: steadfastness; perseverance; faithfulness
Quotation: Beseech God to make thee steadfast in His love, that the signs of those who judge according to their own understanding without true comprehension may not cause thee to waver... O servant! The station of steadfastness is most great. Ask God to enable thee to achieve it. Many are the souls who reached the shore of oneness, yet afterwards were deprived by a single word from the Truth.

Subject: steadfastness; perseverance; faithfulness
Quotation: O Husayn! The Wronged One hath turned toward thee from the precincts of the Prison, that thou mayest rejoice and be of the thankful. That which is necessary today is the greatest steadfastness in the Cause of God's momentous News. Whoso hath attained thereunto hath attained unto all good, and whoso hath denied and turned away is accounted among the oppressors in My perspicuous Book.

Subject: steadfastness; perseverance; faithfulness
Quotation: O thou spiritual beloved, do ye not become sad, neither lose your enthusiasm, on account of the occurrences of incidents in this Blessed Spot, and the oppression of enmity toward this Prisoner, also the descent of various test and calamities. Be ye engaged in your own affairs. Whatever happens is identical with mercy, and whatever transpires is the gift of His Highness the Merciful.

Subject: steadfastness; perseverance; faithfulness
Quotation: Hold ye fast unto steadfastness, then again unto steadfastness, lest your feet slip from His Straight Path. Say: This is My greatest counsel and My most mighty trust unto you. We have counseled Our loved ones who soar in My atmosphere and drink the choice wine of My utterance to observe the Most Great Steadfastness in My Tablet and My Leaf and My Scriptures and My Pages and My Books.

Subject: steadfastness; perseverance; faithfulness
Quotation: Blessed art thou, O Muhammad, and joy be unto thee, O Mustafa! Thou art he who hath been confirmed in the love of God, the Lord of Names, and hast called the people to His supreme horizon, and hast remained steadfast in His Cause in such wise that neither the whisperings of the servants nor the doubts of those who disbelieved in God, the Lord of the Day of Judgment, caused thee to slip.

Subject: steadfastness; perseverance; faithfulness
Quotation: O beloved, what joy unto thee for having been patient in the face of hardships in the path of thy Lord when thou wert walking towards the Throne unshod, and when the heat of the sun touched thee in the summer days! What glory unto thee for having been patient in the Cause of God and having borne hardships within thyself, then afflictions touched thee after thy return from before the Throne.

Subject: steadfastness; perseverance; faithfulness
Quotation: Blessed is the soul that hath attained unto the Most Great Steadfastness, and woe unto every lying doubter! Souls who have been nourished by the fruits of the Supreme Pen behold themselves free from vain imaginings, confused dreams and fancies, and are so steadfast in the Cause that all the books of the world cannot turn them away from the Ancient Beauty, much less such delirious utterances.

Subject: steadfastness; perseverance; faithfulness
Quotation: I testify that thou wert steadfast when the foundations of the world were shaken, and tranquil when the hearts of the nations were troubled, and calm when limbs trembled in fear of God's Most Great Name. Thou art he whom the Call attracted when it was raised between earth and heaven, such that thou didst forsake the world and turn thy face toward the Countenance after the passing of all things.

Subject: steadfastness; perseverance; faithfulness
Quotation: God willing, may you all drink of the wine of steadfastness in such wise that should Satan appear with all his insinuations and whisperings, you would regard him as absolute nothingness. Blessed is he who acts according to that which he hath been commanded with utmost steadfastness as made the pillars of those who disbelieved in God, the Single, the One, the Mighty, the Praiseworthy, to quake.

Subject: steadfastness; perseverance; faithfulness
Quotation: We counsel him to manifest supreme steadfastness in this Cause whereby the hearts of all beings were troubled, the company of the divines lamented, and the feet of the mystics slipped. I beseech Thee by Thy perspicuous Book, by Thy mighty Prison, by the rustling of Thy Lote-Tree, and by the light of Thy Cause, to make me one of those whose feet have not slipped and whose hearts have not wavered.

Subject: steadfastness; perseverance; faithfulness
Quotation: Verily, He is the Protector of those who remember Him, the Guardian of those who are steadfast, the Friend of those who are firm, the Helper of those who are patient, and the Supporter of those who act. Blessed is the soul who does not lose this station due to vain imaginings and the affairs of this transient world, and who, through the Name of God, exalted be His glory, succeeds in preserving it.

Subject: steadfastness; perseverance; faithfulness
Quotation: "Today the greatest of goodly attributes is steadfastness and perseverance in the Divine Covenant for the winds of tests do blow with great severity. Praise be to God that thou art confirmed, that thou art steadfast and staunch. I beg of God that thou mayest increase daily in thy perseverance so that like unto an impregnable building thou mayest withstand the tidal waves of tests and tribulations."

Subject: steadfastness; perseverance; faithfulness
Quotation: For you are the faithful servants of the Blessed Beauty, steadfast in the Covenant and Testament, attracted to the divine fragrances, and tested in the path of God. Through the endless favors of the Almighty Lord, I hope that day by day you may become more steadfast, more detached, and more attracted, and strive night and day until you become signs of guidance and standards of the Supreme Concourse.

Subject: steadfastness; perseverance; faithfulness
Quotation: Today is the day for the revelation and manifestation of what lies within all existence. For forty years We have dwelt in the realms of this eternal state and have been patient and grateful in times of hardship and tribulation. Praise be to God that forty years have passed and nothing hath been witnessed from this oppressed people save patience and forbearance in the face of tribulations and hardships.

Subject: steadfastness; perseverance; faithfulness
Quotation: Today one drop of deeds is as an ocean, and an atom like unto the sun, inasmuch as these are the days of the Most Great Manifestation. Beware lest the happenings of the world sadden thee. Take hold of the Book with the strength granted from Us. We shall verily aid thee and protect thee from those who have disbelieved in God and His signs, and turned away from Him when He came with manifest sovereignty.

Subject: steadfastness; perseverance; faithfulness
Quotation: Happy is the man who hath not allowed the doubts and suggestions of those who have gone astray to deter him from the Revealer of Verses, who with perfect steadfastness hath quaffed the choice sealed Wine proffered by the hand of the Self-Subsisting, and who is occupied with the praise and glorification of the Lord of all names. Today is the day of steadfastness, for the croaking of the ravens is upraised.

Subject: steadfastness; perseverance; faithfulness
Quotation: The most excellent of all deeds in this Day is steadfastness in the Cause of God, such that the vain imaginings of the deluded pretenders may not hold back the loved ones of God from the court of oneness...We beseech God to protect His loved ones from the evil of these people and to make them so steadfast that the clamor of every clamorer will not change them nor the doubts of the doubtful cause them to slip.

Subject: steadfastness; perseverance; faithfulness
Quotation: If they adorn themselves with the luminous robe of steadfastness, both outward and inward bounties and heavenly sustenance will encompass them all. We beseech God, exalted be His glory, to make them aware that they may witness and recognize the fruits of their deeds, for if they attain to this most exalted and sublime station, they will not be debarred or deprived by any matter or thing from the Lord of Names.

Subject: steadfastness; perseverance; faithfulness
Quotation: "This evanescent servant has, in most of his petitions, mentioned to the extent possible that which he knew would cause steadfastness and assurance of the friends, and has not, nor will he, fall short to the extent of his capacity. The assured, steadfast, content and well-pleasing souls must, with perfect kindness and wisdom, convey that which causes the exaltation and ascendancy of the steadfastness of souls."

Subject: steadfastness; perseverance; faithfulness
Quotation: The friends must not oppose anyone and must act according to the Book. Some souls are observed to be anxious and fearful in times of hardship, and this is not and has never been befitting, for death is inevitable and will come. If it should come in the path of God, this is surely sweeter and more beloved. God has been and ever shall be triumphant, powerful and mighty. All must manifest steadfastness and assurance.

Subject: steadfastness; perseverance; faithfulness
Quotation: I swear by the Educator of the seen and the unseen that such a perfumed fragrance is ascending and descending that with a single passing it can make the whole world fragrant with musk and transform the realms of existence into a rose garden of crimson flowers. Yet what benefit is there when the sense of smell is impaired and beings are afflicted? The complete remedy lies in steadfastness in the Covenant and Testament.

Subject: steadfastness; perseverance; faithfulness
Quotation: He persevered in immersing himself in the oceans of Thy knowledge and continued to wander in the arena of trials. The slander of the evil plotters or the clamor of the ignoble, the onslaught of people of rancor or the abuse of the circle of fierce attackers, hindered him not. Nay, rather, he walked steadfastly in the path of Thy love, and grew firm from the rain of Thy favors pouring out of the clouds of Thy knowledge.

Subject: steadfastness; perseverance; faithfulness
Quotation: O Muhammad! The Wronged One of the horizons hath turned toward thee and maketh mention of thee with verses from whose fragrance the people of the graves have arisen. God, exalted be His glory, hath regarded and continueth to regard His loved ones, but the veils of heedless souls and thick coverings have become an obstacle. Verily, He desireth whomsoever hath desired Him and turneth unto whomsoever hath turned unto Him.

Subject: steadfastness; perseverance; faithfulness
Quotation: Today the friends of God must all attain to this station, that is, to be ready at all times to carry out His commandments and laws. Mention of steadfast souls who in every age and century have drunk from the ocean of certitude and been adorned with the ornament of steadfastness has been revealed and recorded in the sacred Books and Scriptures. These are honored servants who speak not until He hath spoken, and who do His bidding.

Subject: steadfastness; perseverance; faithfulness
Quotation: O Ali! The servant present here brought thy letter and presented it before the Wronged One. We heard and have answered, and verily We are the Hearer, the Answerer. Thy letter testified to thy love, affection, devotion, humility and lowliness before God. Divine confirmations have reached thee and will continue to reach thee. Gird up the loins of service and counsel the friends of God as behooveth them on behalf of the Wronged One.

Subject: steadfastness; perseverance; faithfulness
Quotation: Firmness is the beginning of spiritual happiness. Christ appeared in Palestine and was held in contempt because He was from Nazareth. Only twelve believed in Him; one deserted Him. There were other believers, but they were not troubled with doubts and afterward fell away. Mary Magdalene held steadfastly to Christ and made others firm. God will assist all who are firm in His Cause. Firmness is the beginning of spiritual happiness.

Subject: steadfastness; perseverance; faithfulness
Quotation: The hardships, afflictions and overwhelming difficulties facing that one intoxicated with the wine of love are evident and known... Now consider that if souls who in past ages became so intoxicated with just a whiff of the fragrances of the love of God that they accepted the cup of trials, how much more should we who are bewildered by the cup of bounty in this Day of Manifestation remain alive and fresh despite severe tribulations.

Subject: steadfastness; perseverance; faithfulness
Quotation: Be thou steadfast in the Cause and hold fast unto His firm cord. Thou shouldst at all times fix thy gaze upon the Truth and remain firm on His path. The world hath neither permanence nor faithfulness. By the Sun of Truth which shineth from the horizon of the heaven of the Prison, the station of steadfastness is great and mighty in the sight of God. Blessed is the servant who holdeth fast unto it, and woe unto him who turneth away therefrom.

Subject: steadfastness; perseverance; faithfulness
Quotation: Then know thou that We have not differed in Our utterance, but the polytheists have differed and were in manifest treachery. They violated the Covenant of God after its confirmation and cast the Testament of God behind their backs and were engaged in great deception and guile. And thou, be patient in thyself, then show forth patience in what hath befallen thee, then be content with what hath been ordained from the glorious and resplendent Pen.

Subject: steadfastness; perseverance; faithfulness
Quotation: Blessed be thy patience, and blessed be thy deeds of detachment and attraction! The angels of the Kingdom pray for thee and the Concourse on High call out to thee: Blessed art thou, O blessed one, for thou hast been patient under tribulation, hast not complained in hardship and adversity, and hast shown fortitude in the face of mighty trials in the path of God. Upon thee be beautiful patience, upon thee be beautiful patience in this grievous day.

Subject: steadfastness; perseverance; faithfulness
Quotation: How then can this feeble plant withstand such winds except through Thy protection and preservation? If Thy mighty assistance reaches me, I shall withstand swords of steel wielded by every obstinate oppressor, and if the glances of Thine eye of favor encompass me, I shall be manifestly protected. Make our feet firm in faithfulness until our hearts overflow with the wine of fidelity and we sacrifice our souls at every moment in the field of sacrifice.

Subject: steadfastness; perseverance; faithfulness
Quotation: Be thou steadfast in the love of thy Lord to such a degree that even if thou wert to become the only one in all the world among those who have believed in God and His signs, thou wouldst arise by thyself and help thy Lord to the extent of thy capacity, and be among the helpers. Therefore hold thou fast, lest the winds of polytheism move thee, and be thou steadfast in the love of thy Lord, mentioning the people at all times and being of them that remember.

Subject: steadfastness; perseverance; faithfulness
Quotation: You must at all times hold fast to the cord of steadfastness and cling to the hem of grace. Through your steadfastness, the hearts of the people of enmity were disturbed, and through your firmness on the path of the Cause, the limbs of the people of tyranny and corruption trembled. We beseech God, exalted be His glory, to honor His loved ones at all times with the robe of steadfastness and to make them firm and steadfast as mountains in times of hardship.

Subject: steadfastness; perseverance; faithfulness
Quotation: These are the souls whom neither the might of the world nor the power of nations could deter, and whom neither doubts, insinuations, commerce, the wealth of servants, nor whatsoever is in the lands could deprive. With the finger of detachment they rent asunder the veils and tore away the shrouds. With celestial power they arose to serve the Cause - an arising that caused the polytheists to sit, and with an assurance that caused the transgressors to tremble.

Subject: steadfastness; perseverance; faithfulness
Quotation: He hoped that the friends will never become defeated. The more they are surrounded with tribulations and ordeals the greater may become their firmness and steadfastness. A person who withstands the attack of the army of persecutions and sufferings will become inherently great. He hoped that in the Cause of Baha-Wollah each one of the Baha'is may become like unto a solid and immovable mountain and withstand firmly before every attack of calamity and adversity.

Subject: steadfastness; perseverance; faithfulness
Quotation: Blessed is the strong one whom neither the happenings of the world nor the doubts of those who have disbelieved in God, the Lord of Lords, have weakened. The people of the Crimson Ark must manifest such steadfastness that all upon earth shall find themselves powerless to prevent them. We hope that such souls will be raised up and become manifest in these blessed, luminous and promised days beneath the shade of the divine Lote-Tree of the Beloved of all worlds.

Subject: steadfastness; perseverance; faithfulness
Quotation: May my soul be a sacrifice for your steadfastness, love and service. The blessed tablet penned by the Most Pure Pen of my Lord and Master, the Most Great Branch - may my soul and being be a sacrifice for the dust of His footsteps - illumined the eyes of body and soul and the vision of heart and reality. Most of that blessed tablet concerned mention of His steadfastness, attention, sincerity, service and devotion. Every word thereof testified to His love and affection.

Subject: steadfastness; perseverance; faithfulness
Quotation: Now must ye hold fast to the cord of steadfastness, for mighty indeed is this Cause. At all times take refuge with the True One, that He may protect you from the harm of the barking ones, the opposers, and the deniers. God willing, the loved ones of God must be observed to be so steadfast that all who dwell on earth shall be powerless to prevent them. We counsel you to manifest supreme steadfastness and that whereby the Cause of God is exalted between earth and heaven.

Subject: steadfastness; perseverance; faithfulness
Quotation: The friends in Persia have indeed endured steadfastly whatever tribulation befell them, at every moment they tasted of the cup brimming over with poison, and wrapt in blissful joy, they quaffed from the chalice of sacrifice. At one time, they were under captive chains, and at another they were threatened by the sword. They are tested believers; and have remained steadfast and unswerving. Each one is a shining lamp, and every precious soul rejoiceth with evident gladness.

Subject: steadfastness; perseverance; faithfulness
Quotation: Yet despite these afflictions which ye have seen, heard and know of, the tongue remained engaged in praise, the heart illumined with the greatest joy, and in prison this blessed verse was uttered: "He is sufficient unto me and sufficient unto all things. God sufficeth as protector." All assured and tranquil souls uttered the same, and when their voices were raised, the prisoners would become bewildered and perplexed. Through all conditions We have been thankful and content.

Subject: steadfastness; perseverance; faithfulness
Quotation: May my soul be a sacrifice for Thy imprisonment, O Thou Who art wronged in the land of ?a, and may my whole being be a sacrifice for your steadfastness, O ye through whom the pillars of polytheism were shaken, the lands of infidelity were made to tremble, the heaven of vain imaginings was cleft asunder, the sun of idle fancies was darkened, and the moons of idols were eclipsed--they who cast the command of God behind their backs and followed what their own desires bade them.

Subject: steadfastness; perseverance; faithfulness
Quotation: O Lion! There hath come before the Wronged One a letter wherein mention was made of thee. We make mention of thee as a token of Our grace. Thy Lord, verily, is the All-Knowing Remembrancer. Be thou enkindled with the fire of the love of God and adorned with the light of His knowledge. He, verily, is with whosoever hath turned toward His supreme horizon and is numbered among those endued with certainty. Beware lest the affairs of the peoples prevent thee from the Ancient King.

Subject: steadfastness; perseverance; faithfulness
Quotation: Were the heedless to consider, this clear proof and mighty, firm evidence would suffice them, for Thou hast said--and Thy word is the truth--"Wish ye, then, for death, if ye are truthful." By the life of your Ancient Lord! Man is bewildered by the rebelliousness of the people of loss. They witnessed manifest signs and brilliant evidences, and observed from those who turned to Him and the sincere ones a steadfastness the like of which had never been heard of in previous centuries.

Subject: steadfastness; perseverance; faithfulness
Quotation: Associate not with those who have openly denied God, for by their presence every sweet air is corrupted and every pure, sweet and lofty water is defiled. Rejoice within thyself, for thy Lord hath fulfilled what He promised thee and honored thee with the meeting of His Manifestation once again, as thou wert promised in the Tablet, if thou be of them that know. Associate not with the enemies of God, neither secretly nor openly. Shun them and remain steadfast with mighty constancy.

Subject: steadfastness; perseverance; faithfulness
Quotation: The hosts of God, who are the supporters and helpers of His Cause, in this Most Great Revelation have ever been and shall continue to be goodly deeds and praiseworthy conduct. All must render assistance to the Cause of God through these divine hosts. Today is the day of mention and praise, and today is the day of deeds. Likewise, may ye be confirmed to strengthen the foundation of steadfastness, which today is greater than any good deed and taketh precedence over every other matter.

Subject: steadfastness; perseverance; faithfulness
Quotation: And now in the streets and markets, the children of the enemies, having memorized these utterances, sing them in melodies and songs. Likewise, those who survived the martyrs, with the utmost patience, composure and dignity, open their tongues in gratitude to the Lord that they were made the target of this great calamity in the path of the Blessed Beauty. Observe this steadfastness and constancy: Saint Peter the Apostle, when he found the situation difficult, denied Christ three times.

Subject: steadfastness; perseverance; faithfulness
Quotation: O Lord! No night passes but they are pierced by the arrows of the misguided, and no day concludes but they are struck by the spears of pain and the darts of those possessed by vain imaginings. Yet despite this, O my God, they cease not from Thy remembrance, nor do they falter in Thy Cause, nor do they desist from Thy praise, nor do they stop speaking of Thee. Rather, they join night to day, persisting at eventide and dawn in their devotion and supplication to the Kingdom of Mysteries.

Subject: steadfastness; perseverance; faithfulness
Quotation: Praise, remembrance, thanks and glory befit the loved ones of the one true Goal, who have held fast to the cord of faithfulness and clung to the hem of steadfastness. The gratitude of the loved ones is their faithfulness, sincerity, assurance and steadfastness. Since they have manifested that which was incumbent upon them, therefore hath the Ancient Beauty, exalted be His glory, revealed in the Psalms and Tablets, specifically for them, that which transcendeth understanding and reason.

Subject: steadfastness; perseverance; faithfulness
Quotation: Blessed are they who, with supreme steadfastness, remain firm and immovable in the Cause of the Lord of all beings. The understanding and perception of most people is such that should one of the evil ones arise to lead them astray, wavering and instability would be observed in their steadfastness, firmness and constancy. Today, those who gaze toward the most exalted horizon and have quaffed from the waters of reunion must manifest such steadfastness that none upon earth can prevent them.

Subject: steadfastness; perseverance; faithfulness
Quotation: Every tree that hath firm roots will benefit from the tempest and winds and whirlwind, for its roots are firm; while every tree whose roots are weak will be shaken by the gentlest breeze, let alone by violent storms and devastating whirlwinds, for the tests are severe. This is why He saith: "All men are in perdition save the believers; and all believers are in perdition save those who are tested; and all who are tested are in perdition save the sincere; and the sincere are in grave peril."

Subject: steadfastness; perseverance; faithfulness
Quotation: God willing, may all be assisted to achieve that which is beloved and acceptable in His presence. Let all fix their gaze upon this blessed Word which hath shone forth like the sun from the horizon of the divine Tablet: Return ye to the divine verses, O ye who are endowed with insight! Say: O friends! The precious pearl is distinguished from aught else, and the cooing of the nightingale is evident and distinct from croaking. Strive that ye may attain to the lights of the sun of steadfastness.

Subject: steadfastness; perseverance; faithfulness
Quotation: O beloved! Arise to assist the Cause of God with such steadfastness as may lead to the firmness of souls. Your chief concern must be to make the loved ones in that place steadfast in the Cause of God, in such wise that they regard all else as non-existent. O brother! Bewilderment upon bewilderment! To the extent possible, you and the honored ones dwelling in that land must strive that all may drink from the wine of steadfastness and remain firm and immovable as a mountain in the Cause of God.

Subject: steadfastness; perseverance; faithfulness
Quotation: Throughout all these agonizing trials he remained staunch in his faith. The hunger lasted eighteen days. It was a terrible ordeal. To begin with, they were far from home, surrounded and cut off by the foe; again, they were starving; and then there were the army's sudden onslaughts and the bombshells raining down and bursting in the heart of the Fort. Under such circumstances to maintain an unwavering faith and patience is extremely difficult, and to endure such dire afflictions a rare phenomenon.

Subject: steadfastness; perseverance; faithfulness
Quotation: Hold fast to unity and harmony. Great is this Day, and the Cause of God hath appeared like the sun from its horizon and is manifest. Hold fast to consultation and occupy yourselves with teaching. This is the assistance that hath been revealed from the Supreme Pen in the Tablets of the past and future. Hold fast unto it and be of them that render assistance. We beseech God to grant strength that all may arise with supreme steadfastness and firm certitude to turn towards the cities of hearts and minds.

Subject: steadfastness; perseverance; faithfulness
Quotation: O friends! Let not tales and stories of the ancients withhold you from the Lord of the Day of Judgment. The ancient veils have been rent asunder by the finger of divine power, yet the opposers of the Cause are occupied with fashioning them anew. God protect us and you from the evil of such people. For twelve hundred years the leaders of the followers of the Qur'an led people astray. They were themselves astray and caused others to go astray, yet they counted themselves among the guides and the Mahdi.

Subject: steadfastness; perseverance; faithfulness
Quotation: Be thou enkindled with the fire of the love of God in such wise that neither doubts nor intimations shall prevent thee... ye must soar in the atmosphere of certitude on the wings of detachment, and in all times be occupied with the remembrance of the All-Merciful with such steadfastness that its effect shall become manifest in the world of creation. Blessed art thou and blessed is he who hath drunk the choice wine of steadfastness from the hands of the bounty of his Lord, the Forgiving, the Generous.

Subject: steadfastness; perseverance; faithfulness
Quotation: That which is incumbent upon you and all the friends of God in this day is steadfastness and arising to serve the Cause. Make mention, on My behalf, of My loved ones who have drunk the wine of steadfastness in My days, who have clung to My robe, who have cast aside all else besides Me, who have soared in the atmosphere of My nearness, who have been nourished by the fruits of the Tree of My knowledge, and who have been illumined by the Luminary that hath shone forth from the horizon of My tender mercy.

Subject: steadfastness; perseverance; faithfulness
Quotation: These are the servants who, as soon as Thy call reached them, hastened in the direction of Thy mercy and were not kept back from Thee by the changes and chances of this world or by any human limitations... Cause me, O my Lord, to be reckoned among them who have been so stirred up by the sweet savors that have been wafted in Thy days that they have laid down their lives for Thee and hastened to the scene of their death in their longing to gaze on Thy beauty and in their yearning to attain Thy presence.

Subject: steadfastness; perseverance; faithfulness
Quotation: Today all must be adorned with the ornament of steadfastness, for the devils lie in wait and have been lying in wait, and the croaking hath been raised and shall be raised. Before this these tidings were revealed and sent down from the Pen of the All-Choosing. Well is it with them that understand. Say: O loved ones of the All-Merciful! Hearken unto the call of God. Verily He calleth you and counseleth you to observe the most great steadfastness and that whereby His firm and mighty Cause may be uplifted.

Subject: steadfastness; perseverance; faithfulness
Quotation: Give thanks unto God for having aided thee to recognition and for having revealed unto thee that which shall profit thee throughout the duration of His kingdom and dominion, shouldst thou remain steadfast in this Cause whereby the feet of the learned have slipped and the hearts of the mystics have been perturbed. O Ali! We counsel thee to be steadfast in this mighty Cause. How many a servant hath claimed steadfastness within himself, yet when We tested him with but a word he faltered and was among the losers.

Subject: steadfastness; perseverance; faithfulness
Quotation: In any case, they endured many hardships at the outset of the incident, bore afflictions, and manifested the utmost firmness and steadfastness in the Cause of God. Blessed is he, and again blessed is he, and joy be unto him. Furthermore, the letter of M.H.M.S., upon him be 966 [the Glory of God] the Most Glorious and the grandeur of God, the Most Mighty, Most Exalted, Most High, arrived and this servant attained the honor of reading it. Indeed they have been and are showing complete firmness and steadfastness.

Subject: steadfastness; perseverance; faithfulness
Quotation: No sooner did she behold the face of her son, than she spoke to him such words as caused the hearts of the lovers of God, and beyond them those of the Concourse on high, to cry out and be sore pained with grief... "My son, mine own son! Fail not to offer up thyself in the path of thy Lord. Beware that thou betray not thy faith in Him before Whose face have bowed down in adoration all who are in the heavens and all who are on the earth. Go thou straight on, O my son, and persevere in the path of the Lord, thy God."

Subject: steadfastness; perseverance; faithfulness
Quotation: At every moment they seek guidance from God's guidance, then with their hearts they journey toward the fields of love, detached from all who are in the kingdom, gazing upon the Face of Beauty in the pavilion of glory. At every instant their longing increaseth for the gardens of reunion, and by God's leave they enter the land of eternity. When the blame of the blamer, or the assault of the hypocrite, or the spear of the transgressor assaileth them, they break not God's covenant and are content with perfect yearning.

Subject: steadfastness; perseverance; faithfulness
Quotation: I remember well that I was teaching thee at that time how to stand firm in the torrent. I told thee to place thy back to the torrent and put thy hands firmly on the ground, plant thy feet strongly on the rocks and bend thy neck a little. Soon the torrent reached and circled us and we found ourselves in the path of the most terrific storms. The noise and the voices of the waters were awful and almost everything was washed before it. We sat steadfastly in our places, sometimes the turbulent water reaching to our necks.

Subject: steadfastness; perseverance; faithfulness
Quotation: And thou, O Muhammad, when thou reachest thy land, give glad tidings from Us to the loved ones of God and His friends. Then remind them with a wondrous remembrance. Say unto them: O My loved ones! Be not heedless of Us and what hath befallen Us, and be not of them that are negligent. Remember Our days, then Our exile, then Our migration, then Our tribulation at the hands of the idolaters. Say: O people! Fear God, then walk upon a path of mighty radiance, and fear no one even if all the wrongdoers should gather against you.

Subject: steadfastness; perseverance; faithfulness
Quotation: Wherefore must the loved ones of God, laboriously, with the waters of their striving, tend and nourish and foster this tree of hope. In whatsoever land they dwell, let them with a whole heart befriend and be companions to those who are either close to them, or far removed. Let them never lose heart, never be despondent, never feel afflicted. The more antagonism they meet, the more let them show their own good faith; the more torments and calamities they have to face, the more generously let them pass round the bounteous cup.

Subject: steadfastness; perseverance; faithfulness
Quotation: Blessed is the strong one who hath arisen with the pillar of fire among the wicked and hath spoken forth this wondrous Name. The All-Merciful calleth and saith: "Blessed art thou, O servant, for thou hast turned thy face toward My countenance, hast drawn nigh unto My court, hast spoken My praise, hast borne tribulation in My love, hast accepted fate for My Name's sake, and hast drunk the choice wine of utterance in the days of thy Lord, the All-Merciful, after all the polytheists had turned away from it in their remoteness."

Subject: steadfastness; perseverance; faithfulness
Quotation: The divine friends must resist the winds of trials with utmost steadfastness. In brief, these are days of test... Always is the touchstone of tests present, and pure gold becomes distinct from adulterated copper. The divine friends, being from the mine of the All-Merciful, must surely shine forth in the fire of tests and manifest boundless delicacy and sweetness. The thunderbolts of these tests have fallen upon the Center of the Covenant. Praise be to God that until now He has remained firm, steadfast, standing and resistant.

Subject: steadfastness; perseverance; faithfulness
Quotation: This is the Day of steadfastness and the Day of utterance. This is the day of steadfastness, this is the day of triumph, and this is the day for the appearance of the gems of human meaning from the mine of man. In truth I say: whosoever appeareth today with the light of supreme steadfastness is recorded and inscribed by the Most Exalted Pen in the Crimson Book as being of the company of the exalted ones. Each one of the friends must be as firm and steadfast as a mountain and must regard the opposers and deniers as non-existent.

Subject: steadfastness; perseverance; faithfulness
Quotation: O Khan Vazir of Isfahan, thou who art firm in the Covenant and steadfast in faith! Nevertheless, this lowly one doth not deem any hesitation or shortcoming permissible in serving the manifest Light. Rather, more than ever before shall he sacrifice his life, no blame from any blamer shall deter him in the path of God, nor shall he fear the might of any oppressor. Therefore have I taken up writing this letter, that thou mayest show forth steadfastness and firmness, and become my partner and companion in serving the Holy Threshold.

Subject: steadfastness; perseverance; faithfulness
Quotation: That which was written by thy musk-laden pen brought great joy to our hearts. It imparted the glad-tidings of the cheer and exultation of the believers and the joyful news of the spirit of fellowship among the friends. None had imagined that, despite the intensity of tests, those souls would remain happy and beaming with joy! This can be attributed to naught but the great bounty of God in these days-- that in the depths of sacrifice, His loved ones stand firm and immovable and are constant and steadfast in the Covenant and Testament.

Subject: steadfastness; perseverance; faithfulness
Quotation: "Since bearing hardship and tribulation in these days, and likewise patience and steadfastness under afflictions, are accounted before God as among the most excellent and most praiseworthy of deeds, there is no cause for concern." "From every letter We have detected the fragrance of thy love, thy steadfastness, and thy patience in what hath befallen thee. Verily, God is the All-Patient, and He hath commanded His servants to observe gracious patience. A bountiful reward for the patient ones hath been recorded by the Most Exalted Pen in God's Book."

Subject: steadfastness; perseverance; faithfulness
Quotation: Today they must drink, with perfect certitude and assurance, from the choice wine of the utterance of the Goal of all the worlds. This hallowed wine has been and ever will be free from intoxication, and bestows eternal joy and everlasting delight. Take it in My name and for love of Me, despite My enemies who denied God's proof and evidence after their confession, and whom earthly ornaments so deluded as to prevent them from turning to the splendors of the Face, from holding fast to the Most Great Announcement, and from turning toward the Straight Path of God.

Subject: steadfastness; perseverance; faithfulness
Quotation: Peace, praise, glory and splendor be upon those who have held fast to God's Covenant and His Testament, whom neither the ranks of the Pharaohs, nor thousands of tyrants, nor the weapons of the infidels have kept back from God. These are servants whom God hath described in His Books of old and in the Qur'an as honored servants who speak not until He hath spoken, and who do His bidding. These are the stars of steadfastness in the heaven of certitude, whose light neither the veils of the divines nor the doubts of the mystics nor the power of princes can obscure.

Subject: steadfastness; perseverance; faithfulness
Quotation: One must show persistence in the affairs of the Cause and be strong and steadfast. No tree will bear fruit unless constancy be produced, and no business shall bring forward consequences, without the same. Consider the disciples of his holiness Christ, Mary Magdalene, Mary the mother of James and Saint Barbara who did not gain any result excepting through steadfastness. Then thou must, like a ponderous mountain, and like a great tree put forth roots of constancy and withstand the gale and tempest. Every tree having a strong root will grow better in the violent wind.

Subject: steadfastness; perseverance; faithfulness
Quotation: I beseech the Ancient Beauty that day by day He may increase your love, your joy, your devotion and servitude at the Threshold of Oneness, and that moment by moment you may progress to the true heights. Although for some time I have not had the opportunity to write and correspond, resulting in a deficiency in sending letters, yet at all times there has been no slackening in seeking confirmations from the Abha Kingdom on behalf of the friends, and always from that direction a sweet fragrance has reached the nostrils - a fragrance of steadfastness and an aroma of firmness.

Subject: steadfastness; perseverance; faithfulness
Quotation: Today the blessed, all-embracing Word hath encompassed all things and the Sun of Revelation hath shone forth and become manifest from the horizon of the heaven of power. The loved ones of God must, through kindly counsels and praiseworthy character, purify and sanctify the people of the earth from bestial qualities and guide them to the horizon of justice. When the sun of trials dawned from the horizon of the heaven of the Will of the Desired One of all worlds, some hearts were troubled, some feet faltered, while a group, by God's might and power, remained firm and steadfast.

Subject: steadfastness; perseverance; faithfulness
Quotation: Then make firm the feet of the faithful upon Thy Covenant and Testament, O Creator of earth and heaven, and aid them to hold fast unto the Sure Handle and to cling to the hem of the robe of grandeur. Then preserve them, through Thy mercy, O Ancient of Days, from the doubts that have spread in certain regions, in the fortress of steadfastness and the cave of constancy, and make them brilliant lamps within the glass globes of attraction, and radiant and resplendent stars in the horizons of firmness in the Covenant, and mountains immovable upon the earth of steadfastness and certitude.

Subject: steadfastness; perseverance; faithfulness
Quotation: We testify that ye drink, in remoteness, the wine of nearness, and in separation, the water of reunion, and We perceive from you the fragrance of faithfulness. This is a station none hath attained save he who hath shattered the idol of associating partners with God through power and dominion. They who have been faithful to God's Covenant are among the choicest of creation. He hath prospered who hath remained steadfast, and hath lost who hath turned away from God, the Lord of all men. Soon shall come a day wherein God will exalt those who have held fast to the cord of His Cause and have attained unto the Dayspring of lights.

Subject: steadfastness; perseverance; faithfulness
Quotation: Indeed, there should be at least five men and women. However, your presence in those regions is necessary for you are truly a faithful servant of God's Cause and a steadfast soldier of God's Kingdom. Indeed, you have shown patience and endurance in utmost poverty and have borne countless hardships and difficulties. Today it befits those steadfast in the Covenant to endure the utmost difficulties, calamities, trials, tribulations, poverty and want, that they may attain success and confirmation. Now you are truly one of those souls. I hope that in return for this patience and endurance you will attain the utmost joy and gladness.

Subject: steadfastness; perseverance; faithfulness
Quotation: O people of God! The followers of the Bayan have clung to matters which have ever been and shall ever be rejected in the sight of God. Should anyone today meditate upon the blessed word "He doeth whatsoever He willeth," he would find himself freed and detached from the dawning-places of idle fancies and vain imaginings. Whosoever has drunk from the hidden Kawthar of this blessed word, neither the clamor of the followers of the Furqan nor the doubts of the people of the Bayan shall prevent him from the Goal of all worlds. The people of God must be so firm and steadfast in the Cause that all the peoples of the world would be powerless to prevent them.

Subject: steadfastness; perseverance; faithfulness
Quotation: He remained firm and steadfast through severe tests. For instance, consider how in the fortress, while besieged, the cruel oppressors continuously bombarded the fort with cannons, and the friends, including Ismu'llah, went eighteen days without food, to the point where they ate the leather of their shoes. Finally, they were reduced to water alone. Each morning they would drink just one sip of water, and from weakness, all had fallen to the ground. Whenever the army would attack the fortress, a divine strength would come upon them, and they would rise [...] In any case, despite these severe tribulations, Jinab-i-Ismu'llah showed not the least weakness.

Subject: steadfastness; perseverance; faithfulness
Quotation: O son of A?daq the sanctified! Counsel everyone to justice, fairness, steadfastness, and harmony. They must shun any matter from which they detect even an atom's weight of corruption. This is the divine counsel that hath been revealed and sent down from the Pen of Command in scriptures and tablets. Blessed are they that act, and blessed are they that understand. It is hoped that the loved ones will at all times drink from the cup of the greatest steadfastness, for if they attain unto this, the breezes of idle fancies and vain imaginings will not keep them from the straight path, and each one will manifest such power as to see the world as but a shadow.

Subject: steadfastness; perseverance; faithfulness
Quotation: The winds of trials and tests have ever blown, and shall continue to blow, from the dawning-place of the justice of the All-Merciful, that the one who turneth away may be distinguished from the one who advanceth. Yet blessed are they who remain unperturbed when these winds blow. God willing, all must remain so steadfast in the path of God's Cause that the opposition and objection of all on earth shall not cause them to slip. In times when the winds of tests blow, the lovers of the Beauty of the All-Merciful are distinguished from the people of loss, and they who remain steadfast in these days are accounted before God among the people of the shadowless Paradise and are so recorded.

Subject: steadfastness; perseverance; faithfulness
Quotation: These martyrs held in their hands rock candy for the express purpose of offering it to the executioner to whom they said: 'Have a sweet taste before offering us the cup of sacrifice.' Thus did they show such kindness to those who hatefully discharged their arrows at them, and used their revolvers and swords against them. Notwithstanding these occurrences, to-day the remaining numbers are the most enkindled ones among the friends. They are in the utmost of poverty, and yet are fully engaged in teaching, and night and day are they occupied with the commemoration of GOD. What firmness is this! These are real believers! Well assured, self-sacrificing, enraptured with the Blessed Beauty!

Subject: steadfastness; perseverance; faithfulness
Quotation: Dost thou remember the day when thou didst stand before the gate of grandeur, desiring to migrate from thy Lord's land? Then did We hang about thy neck God's hidden trust which had ever been preserved behind an inviolable veil, and We took from thee a covenant in the name of God, thy Lord, the Glory, the King, the Best-Beloved, the Mighty. Thou wert so consumed with love that the flames of passion were kindled in thy heart, and thou wert among those who were set ablaze. Then did We take from thee the covenant that thou wouldst take none other but Him as thy Beloved, and seek none other but Him as the Object of thy desire, and neglect Him not for less than the twinkling of an eye, and be at all times in great remembrance.

Subject: steadfastness; perseverance; faithfulness
Quotation: In the human world, the attribute of faithfulness is the cause of attaining the greatest desires and aspirations, and the means of drawing near to the Divine Threshold. Every faithful one is accepted at the Threshold of the Lord, and every faithless one is rejected from the Divine Court.

Subject: steadfastness; perseverance; faithfulness
Quotation: Be steadfast, O servant, in thy love and turn not aside unto that which might deter thee from the love of the Youth, even should it be the essences of the heavens and the earth, or forms and bodies.  BH03660They endured every tribulation and in every instance showed forth steadfastness and constancy. They found the honey of martyrdom to be pure nectar, and considered wandering and homelessness as their comfort and settlement. What joy is theirs for this steadfastness and firmness!

Quotation: it is said that at one time a King went out travelling incognito. He did put on a humble suite of cloth[es] and started on his way. After a few days journey he lost his way in the scorching desert and finally reached at the door of an Arab tent. [Full story follows]

Subject: stories; anecdotes
Quotation: A detailed narrative about Mirza Mohamad Ali Gaini, including his early imprisonment in Tehran, meeting with Baha'u'llah, and later business venture selling needles in Nazareth, with an amusing story about his failed partnership due to giving too many needles per egg.

Subject: stories; anecdotes
Quotation: When the beauty of the Merciful Joseph shineth forth in the market-place of Canaan, assuredly there ariseth a commotion in the divine Egypt, and a hundred thousand aging souls and a hundred thousand Zulaykhas of chastity and purity become captive in the realm of conscience.

Subject: stories; anecdotes
Quotation: Nadir Shah was one of the great rulers of Persia and during his military career he conquered India and many other countries. He was a resourceful leader as well as a noble warrior. Once he collected a huge army and marched against Bagdad. [continues through entire narrative]

Subject: stories; anecdotes
Quotation: When Joseph said to his father: O father! I saw eleven stars and the sun and the moon, I saw them bowing down before me. When Husayn said to his father one day: I saw eleven stars and the sun and the moon, I saw them encompassing me, prostrating to God, the Ancient, in truth.

Subject: stories; anecdotes
Quotation: Reference to the story of Joseph and his brothers plotting against him: O My son! Do not recount your vision to your brethren lest they devise a plot against you... Indeed, Joseph's brethren learned a word of the secret of his affair - a secret veiled and enshrouded in mystery.

Subject: stories; anecdotes
Quotation: God has indeed ordained for Joseph a journey from Gate to Gate according to the decree of the Book around the Fire, concealed. And God hath made the pilgrims to Husayn a caravan unto the Sacred Precinct, save by leave of God, the Most High (and He is God, the Mighty, the Wise).

Subject: stories; anecdotes
Quotation: I remember many years ago there was a great migration of locusts between the plain of Acca and Haifa, to such extent that the ground was covered with these insects. While they were flying the air was filled with thousands of storks and they began to each and cut them to pieces.

Quotation: When I was in Bagdad, one day I was walking through the poor quarter of the city. [entire narrative through] "now start eating but with the same thankfulness you ate your bread yesterday." I did not need to say that, he would have done it anyway, but we enjoyed seeing him so thankful.

Subject: stories; anecdotes
Quotation: Mu'tamidu'd-Dawlih of Isfahan, Manuchihr Khan, built extensively. He owned many villages around Tehran. For several days he protected the Blessed Beauty from enemies in his private quarters. At first he outwardly sent Him away but then kept Him protected in his private covered quarters.

Subject: stories; anecdotes
Quotation: One remembers an anecdote from a lecture by Ru?iyyih Khanum, about a Christian woman named Lydia who came time and again complaining about her husband to 'Abdu'l-Baha. One day He said to her, 'Lydia, Lydia, you cannot put up with this one man, and I have to put up with the whole human race.'

Subject: stories; anecdotes
Quotation: I had a servant who was black; his name was Isfandiyar. [Entire story about Isfandiyar's character, loyalty and paying of debts] He was a point of light. Although his color was black, yet his character was luminous; his mind was luminous; his face was luminous. Truly, he was a point of light.

Quotation: After the departure of His Holiness to the Supreme Paradise, the disciples who had followed His teachings met together in consultation upon the summit of a mountain near Jaffa. Such a consultation was never before held. [Followed by the entire account of the disciples' consultation and covenant]

Quotation: The entire text is a moral tale about a miserly merchant and his clerk, including the clerk's attempt to gain favor through a gift, the merchant's extreme stinginess in eating the sheep's head over seven days, and the eventual revelation that the merchant's son spent all his father's hoarded wealth.

Quotation: At the time of our arrival in Bagdad I was a small lad, taking an active part in all the diversions and plays [illeg.] to that period of life. I remember one day, accompanied by a number of grown-up people we called on the Persian Consul who was considered an amateur sport and hunter... [full anecdote]

Subject: stories; anecdotes
Quotation: Travel and observe in the deserts, like the cities of Thamud and ?ali?, and the sand dunes where dwelt the people of Hud, and the cities of Lot, and the city of Sheba, and the cities of the people of Rass, and Midian, and other regions. See how they lie scattered about these deserts like defeated armies.

Subject: stories; anecdotes
Quotation: During our stay in Bagdad there lived in that city one of the Ameers of Afghanistan. He was reputed to be very wealthy and cultured. He used to frequent our house and ask questions concerning the Islamic religion. One morning he invited me to tea and I accepted his invitation. [continues through end of text]

Subject: stories; anecdotes
Quotation: "?atim of Tayy bestowed dirhams and dinars and horses and camels and brocades and garments. He spread the feast of food and the table of bounty. And this giving and bestowing made his name endure in this transient world. But his food was the flesh of desert camels and his drink the water from dangerous wilderness pits."

Subject: stories; anecdotes
Quotation: When Baha'u'llah left Bagdad and without the knowledge of the friends went to Soleymanie, one day he saw a boy in the streets weeping...Then all the learned and wise men of the city gather around him and after a time finding that these men have taken all his time, he retired to the mountains where nobody could reach him.

Subject: stories; anecdotes
Quotation: It has been reported many years ago that a young Moslem fell desperately in love with a beautiful Jewish girl...Then bringing down the white sail and extinguishing the light, like the last glimmer of sunset, the boat vanished into the dark, stormy night. The next day the lover and the loved one were united in happy wedlock.

Subject: stories; anecdotes
Quotation: Therefore, O thou who seekest to behold the countenance of the Chosen Beauty, become as the symbol of friendship like His Holiness Abraham, and sacrifice thy life like His Holiness Ishmael, that thou mayest find the gates of bounty opened from every direction and behold the favors of the King of Oneness like unto a shining light.

Subject: stories; anecdotes
Quotation: When Sergius met Mohamad he was so impressed by his general bearing and coupled with an intuitive knowledge he was convinced that later in life this youth will become a King. Hence he took him aside and said:- 'What wilt thou give me if I made thee a King, a ruler over many nations and tribes?' [continues through entire dialogue]

Subject: stories; anecdotes
Quotation: We sent Badi` with our grace and a noble Book. We intended thereby only to bring the servants near to the ultimate Seat... Remember when he appeared before the Throne and the Spirit of Power and Might was breathed into him from a Powerful, Faithful One. The raptures of longing seized him after he was thunderstruck by the First Word.
