Quotation: All know that from the earliest days until now, this servant hath been in the hands of his enemies, and despite the afflictions that befell him, and imprisonment in the land of ?a and the land of Mim, and captivity and exile, the Pen hath not ceased for a moment, until in every place the Word was raised and the light of the Cause shone forth.

Subject: suffering and imprisonment
Quotation: O Alif Ha! Hearken unto the voice of Him Who hath been wronged. And among them are those who denied God's Cause and rejected His favor and spoke that which made the clouds to wail. And among them are those who pronounced sentence for the shedding of His blood through injustice whereat tears were shed and the hearts of the righteous were consumed.

Subject: suffering and imprisonment
Quotation: I am always in great danger. Perhaps in an hour a telegram may come and everything here be changed. My only desire is to give all I have in the Path of GOD. Therefore, be not sorrowful for My hardships and calamities. Be happy, be extremely gladdened, - because the more calamities are inflicted upon Me, the more the Cause of GOD will be uplifted.

Subject: suffering and imprisonment
Quotation: Say: The Beauty of the Lord was amongst you and His Countenance shineth like unto a shimmering and lustrous gem betwixt earth and heaven, and you wert shut out as by a veil from Its glory in such wise that none amongst you recognized Him, could ye but comprehend it. The veil to His Countenance was not but His manifestation, if ye but understand it.

Subject: suffering and imprisonment
Quotation: O Ahmad! Hearken unto the call of the Luminary of the horizons at a time when the eclipse brought about by the people of hypocrisy hath prevented Him from shedding His radiance upon the realm above. Wherefore did the eyes of eternity weep in the Most Holy Habitation behind the pavilions of immortality, and the faces of them that are nigh turned pale.

Subject: suffering and imprisonment
Quotation: When I arose in Thy name to fulfill Thy Cause and called all to Thine all-highest horizon through Thy power and sovereignty, and made manifest the ocean of Thy grace and the heaven of Thy bounty and the sun of Thy loving-kindness, then did the polytheists among Thy creatures rise up against me and clamored and arose to harm me and to subvert Thy Cause.

Subject: suffering and imprisonment
Quotation: His Holiness Baha'o'llah during his lifetime was subjected to every hardship and ordeal. Many nights did he pass in his chains, and many days in fetters. How many months was he imprisoned in the dungeon and many were the severe blow at him. Many were the years he passed in exile and tribulation. Many years did he pass in the Most Great Prison -- Akka.

Subject: suffering and imprisonment
Quotation: Every day the herald calls out: 'We shall slay so-and-so, that the Sultan may know we supported him before the people of other lands.' Thus did their souls entice them to a matter, and they are among the most lost in the clear Book. This is what befell Us in the land called Amul, where We witnessed from its people what the eye of creation hath not seen.

Subject: suffering and imprisonment
Quotation: From the earliest days until now, this Wronged One hath been in the hands of the oppressors. Were the events of the prison and what hath befallen Us to be mentioned, it would surely cause the greatest sorrow. Nevertheless, the Lamp of God's Will remaineth bright and luminous, and His Hand of Power hath protected it from the violent and tempestuous winds.

Subject: suffering and imprisonment
Quotation: Today the rays of the sun of grace have encompassed the world. Blessed is the soul that hath attained unto it, and woe unto every doubting heedless one. How many a bondsman hath been entranced by the Call of God, and how many a ruler hath risen in tyranny such that the dwellers of the highest Paradise and the people of this glorious station have lamented!

Subject: suffering and imprisonment
Quotation: They face with their breasts the arrows of the base and the spears of the foolish. No night passes but their eyelids overflow with tears of love for Your beauty, and no day comes but their hearts burn with longing for reunion with You. Lord! They have borne every hardship and tribulation in Your path and endured every calamity and cruelty in Your service.

Subject: suffering and imprisonment
Quotation: This is a day whereon thy scratching and thy plaintive cry should be raised by reason of what hath befallen the Wronged One and His loved ones at the hands of the manifestations of tyranny and oppression and the dawning-places of heedlessness who attained not unto the choice wine of justice on this Day wherein the horizons were illumined by this effulgence.

Subject: suffering and imprisonment
Quotation: Thou seest this Wronged One lonely in exile: Where are the hosts of the heaven of Thy Command, O Sovereign of the worlds? I have been forsaken in a foreign land: Where are the emblems of Thy faithfulness, O Trust of the worlds? Thou seest this Wronged One veiled in tyranny among the Syrians: Where is the radiance of Thy dawning light, O Light of the worlds?

Subject: suffering and imprisonment
Quotation: By God! By God! The Hidden One would move about in such a way - I am ashamed to describe it - lest anyone recognize Him. Afterwards the Ancient Beauty would not go anywhere Himself, and the people all turned away, with no association occurring through which they might hear a word that could lead them from the darkness of heedlessness to the dawn of guidance.

Subject: suffering and imprisonment
Quotation: And among them are those who falsely accuse the servant, saying that he composeth these words himself and attributeth them to God. Say: Woe unto you! Do ye not witness how the verses are sent down in truth and how the water floweth through the realities of all things, and how the sun from the lights of this Countenance hath risen from the horizon of holiness?

Subject: suffering and imprisonment
Quotation: They have indeed rejected Thee and Thy signs, and have turned away from the proofs which Thou didst send down from the heaven of Thy grace and the clouds of Thy glory. They have perversely spurned the Cause of God and warred with Him Who is the Supreme Being, and have violated Thy Covenant and Thy Testament, and turned back from Thy commandments and Thy laws.

Subject: suffering and imprisonment
Quotation: With all their might and power they have striven and continue to strive to extinguish the divine light. If souls in the past derived any profit or beheld any fruit from their rejection, denial, degradation, persecution and shedding of blood, these heedless oppressors shall likewise see. Woe unto them, their like, their hosts, their ranks and their strongholds!

Subject: suffering and imprisonment
Quotation: They have committed around Me that which none before hath committed. Whenever We counseled them, they increased in transgression, and when We banished them, they spoke that which caused the hearts of those who circle round the Throne to burn. The stories of the Youth cannot be borne by the tablets of creation, nor can the Pen flow with what hath befallen Him.

Subject: suffering and imprisonment
Quotation: Be thou patient, O My brother, in all that befallest thee, remember My days at every morn and eventide, and recall My banishment and My separation, My troubles and My needs, My sweet melodies and My utterances, My intonations and My beauty, the calamity and the tribulations I suffer and the imprisonment and banishment that hath beset me in this forbidden land.

Subject: suffering and imprisonment
Quotation: O my God! Thou dost witness and behold how they who have violated Thy sanctity, neglected Thy Cause, broken Thy Covenant, perverted Thy verses and Thy Word, cast aside Thy laws, abandoned Thy commandments, and opposed this Servant Who hath sacrificed His spirit in Thy path, through whom Thy Cause became renowned, Thy remembrance exalted, Thy countenance revealed

Subject: suffering and imprisonment
Quotation: This Wronged One, in the nights and days and in all conditions, summoned the people to the Self-Subsisting Lord. And when the Cause became manifest and We chose not concealment and flight, We were repeatedly cast into prison, sometimes with chains and fetters and sometimes without. And in the land of Mim befell what tongue and utterance are powerless to describe.

Subject: suffering and imprisonment
Quotation: All the peoples of the world were expectant, and in the nights and days made mention of the days of His manifestation. Yet when the arena of existence was illumined with the lights of the Luminary of His Cause, instead of submission, hatred appeared, and in place of acceptance, denial became manifest, and at the time of turning towards Him, aversion was witnessed.

Subject: suffering and imprisonment
Quotation: The Blessed Perfection and the Most Great Name â€" may my life be a ransom to his believers, arose in the city of self-sacrifice like unto the banner of Guidance. While he was under the chain he was a help to every oppressed. From the Manifest horizon he shone forth with the rays of trials! In the midst of the world he withstood the attack of infinite persecutions

Subject: suffering and imprisonment
Quotation: By God! The Beauty of the Divine Will hath been altered through the oppression of the enemies, and the Temple of Volition hath come to rest upon ashes, and Destiny hath rent the garments of patience, and Fate hath been prevented from its execution by reason of what hath befallen the Most High God in His latter Manifestation at the hands of the hosts of the wicked.

Subject: suffering and imprisonment
Quotation: But due to the revolution of the spheres and the decrees of Him but for Whom the spheres would not have been created, and because of the changes and doubts of the inverted people, there have been inauspicious and obscured influences which have caused the delay of royal attentions and resulted in remaining at Mount Mahku and the vast promises of His Majesty's realm.

Subject: suffering and imprisonment
Quotation: In the land of ?a, this Wronged One was imprisoned with chains and fetters in four cities. These afflictions occurred repeatedly, yet as they were in the path of God, they strengthened the spirit and renewed the body. Though outwardly weakness was apparent, inwardly the Light of Power shone forth, radiant and resplendent from the horizon of the heaven of the heart.

Subject: suffering and imprisonment
Quotation: All these tribulations and ordeals have I borne that perchance ye might be guided by God's guidance. I swear by thy life, O Munir! Were they to ponder the trials that have befallen the Beauty of the Divine Unity, all would hasten from the mirage of the desert to the shore of the sea of oneness. For My deeds were a clear proof unto all creation and a decisive evidence.

Subject: suffering and imprisonment
Quotation: Verily, the decree hath not prevented the Glory from mentioning the Creator of all things, though at every moment He hath been slain by the swords of hatred through that which the hands of the wicked have wrought. Were thou to behold My shirt with Mine eyes, thou wouldst see it pierced by the arrows of hatred through that which the hands of the polytheists have wrought.

Subject: suffering and imprisonment
Quotation: The Blessed Beauty was imprisoned in the city of Amul, and when the divines gathered in the mosque and the Blessed Beauty was handed over to them, those unjust ones arose in tyranny and inflicted various forms of cruelty and torment, causing unlimited harm. Among other things, they beat the Blessed Beauty to such an extent that His blessed feet were wounded for some time.

Subject: suffering and imprisonment
Quotation: As to the question of this servant's imprisonment: In truth, it occurred during the days of the late Sultan Abdul-Aziz Khan. At that time, the enemies found an opportunity and it so happened. And since Abdul-Baha is grateful and satisfied with this imprisonment, therefore, until now he has never made any attempt to remove this imprisonment and it has remained unspoken of.

Subject: suffering and imprisonment
Quotation: Consider the Shi'ih sect - they were the most lost among men, yet counted themselves the most profitable. To this day, in every land they occupy themselves with cursing and reviling the Goal of all creation, and they visited upon the Primal Point - may the spirit of all else but Him be sacrificed for His sake - that which caused the heavens to weep and the earth to lament.

Subject: suffering and imprisonment
Quotation: Remember My exile and My imprisonment and My tribulation, and that which hath befallen Me in this year at the hands of those who have denied the Witness and the Witnessed. By My life! Were anyone to look and observe My limbs, he would find in every part of My frame the mark of the sword of every polytheist who hath turned away from God, the Lord of the unseen and the seen.

Subject: suffering and imprisonment
Quotation: And if thou shouldst travel to other lands and anyone should enquire about the Youth of the Spirit, say: I left Him at a time when His garment was bespattered with the blood of hatred and the darkness of the earth encompassed Him from every side, while He called out amongst them with such a cry that all things between earth and heaven were shaken, if ye be of them that know.

Subject: suffering and imprisonment
Quotation: O My Name! Remember when thou wert with Me on the mountain and didst witness the moaning of My heart and became acquainted with the ocean of My grief at what was inflicted upon Me by those who dwelt round about Me and in My vicinity. By the life of God! Were I to recount My tribulations, all things would cry out and weeping would be raised between the heavens and the earths.

Subject: suffering and imprisonment
Quotation: The jail wherein Baha'u'llah was imprisoned was a dark and gloomy cell, underground, and had no aperture, and no window save a small door. A thick, heavy chain called 'GarÃ© Kahar,' the heaviest and the thickest chain of the time, was placed around his Holy Feet, the end of which was dragged along the ground. His neck was also chained with heavy fetters and his hands manacled.

Subject: suffering and imprisonment
Quotation: We mention to him what has befallen Us from the hosts of the oppressors when they brought Us to this place. The matter became so severe it cannot be described in words. Each day the affliction increases - one day they prevent people from attaining the presence of this Noble Scene, another day they quarrel with the loved ones of God and prevent them from tending to their needs

Subject: suffering and imprisonment
Quotation: O Mulla Ali! Ponder thou upon the divines of this age. Throughout all ages they beseeched and implored God, exalted be His glory, for His manifestation. Yet when the veil was rent asunder and the Beauty of the Divine Countenance shone forth even as the sun, they all turned away, though they had reckoned themselves the most learned, the most ascetic, and the most pious among men.

Subject: suffering and imprisonment
Quotation: He bore all these ordeals and catastrophies and difficulties in order that, in the world of humanity, a selflessness might become apparent. During all His lifetime He had no moment's rest! He did not pass one night in restful sleep for His body! He bore all these ordeals and catastrophes and difficulties in order that, in the world of humanity, a selflessness might become apparent.

Subject: suffering and imprisonment
Quotation: From beneath chains He raised His call, and in fetters and shackles He cried aloud. From the beginning of His Cause until His ascension, He was in the hands of hostile peoples. When He was freed from the prison of Tehran and turned His face from His native land, banished by decisive decree, He became renowned throughout East and West in Iraq, and fell into hardship with all peoples.

Subject: suffering and imprisonment
Quotation: Consider how all the Prophets of God were persecuted and what hardships They experienced. Jesus Christ endured affliction and accepted martyrdom upon the cross in order to summon mankind to unity and love... Moses was persecuted and driven out into the desert, Abraham was banished, Muhammad took refuge in caves, the Bab was killed and Baha'u'llah was exiled and imprisoned forty years.

Subject: suffering and imprisonment
Quotation: The polytheists failed to recognize the essence of Thy Being and covered their eyes with the veils of associating partners with Thee, to the point where they ruled to put to death the Manifestation of Thy most glorious Self, and arose to that end that people might rise in support of this deed, and caused some to stray from Thy path through the false words that issued from their mouths.

Subject: suffering and imprisonment
Quotation: Know thou that the idolaters have imprisoned Us in this prison behind mountains beyond counting, and beyond them surgeth between Us and thee a vast ocean whose mighty waves rise within itself. Thus have the idolaters dealt with Us, that no one from among the people of the earth might draw nigh unto Us, and that the hands of all the lovers might be prevented from attaining unto Our hem.

Subject: suffering and imprisonment
Quotation: Through them every denier denied and every rejecter turned away, and the gate of fire was opened unto the faces of those who followed them without clear proof or Book from God, the Lord of all worlds. They followed vain imaginings and idle fancies after the Most Exalted Horizon had shone forth with the light of certitude and the ocean of knowledge had surged through this wondrous Name.

Subject: suffering and imprisonment
Quotation: When thou hearest My most sweet call from Mine all-highest horizon, say: O Creator of the heavens and Possessor of all names! Praise be unto Thee for having guided me and caused me to hear and to know Thee on a day wherein the divines and jurisprudents have ascended pulpits in houses built in Thy name, yet openly denied Thee and Thy signs and that which hath appeared from Thy presence.

Subject: suffering and imprisonment
Quotation: And finally, I was cast by the transgressors into the prison-city of 'Akka, and my kindred were made captives in Ba?gh_dad. Though - as Thou beholdest me, O my God - I be dwelling in a place within whose walls no voice can be heard except the sound of the echo, though all the gates of ease and comfort be shut against us, and thick darkness appear to have compassed us on every side

Subject: suffering and imprisonment
Quotation: The Ancient Beauty was always, for fifty years, caught in calamities and adversities, tribulations and afflictions, blows and oppression and cruelty. That Peerless Beloved constantly tasted the bitterness of deadly poison - how then can we drink the cup of honey and sugar? He saw severe blows - how then can we seek new comfort? He went under chains - how then can we mix sugar and milk?

Subject: suffering and imprisonment
Quotation: "He is a liar. He is the false Christ. Believe Him not. Beware lest ye listen. He will mislead you, will lure you from the religion of your fathers, and will create a turmoil amongst you." Then the scribes and Pharisees consult together: "Let us hold a conclave and conceive a plan. This man is a deceiver. We must do something. What? Let us expel Him from the country. Let us imprison Him."

Subject: suffering and imprisonment
Quotation: Neither the books of the past nor what We revealed unto the Point can compare with that which hath been sent down in this Revelation from the heaven of the will of the All-Merciful. Yet what they have said and continue to say! They have turned away from the Sun of Truth and have turned instead to the idols fashioned by their own vain imaginings. Such is the state of deluded, heedless souls.

Subject: suffering and imprisonment
Quotation: When he witnessed the matter thus and became assured in himself, he emerged from behind the veil and denied his Lord and rejected what He had bestowed upon him through His grace, until he arose to slay Him... By God! He did this only because he knew the people to be worthless rabble, else how could he deny this grace which was more manifest than the light of the sun in the midst of heaven?

Subject: suffering and imprisonment
Quotation: If you but knew in what affliction Abdul-Baha is tormented and caught, alone and solitary amidst the people of rebellion and the party of enmity, and in what ocean of grief he is submerged and drowning, you would surely find no moment of rest, nor lay your head upon a pillow, and tears of blood would surge like the Oxus River. I swear by your precious soul that there is not a moment's peace.

Subject: suffering and imprisonment
Quotation: Still when His Holiness Baha'u'llah,- Him whom God shall Manifest â€" appeared and revealed His Universal Mission in Verses and Tablets, there were many amongst the followers of the Bab who rejected Him and advanced not toward Him; notwithstanding the fact that the Proofs and evidences corroborating the Manifestation of the Blessed Perfection were as numerous and luminous as the rays of the Sun.

Subject: suffering and imprisonment
Quotation: Thou seest Thy dear One, O my God, lying at the mercy of Thine enemies, and hearest the voice of His lamentation from the midst of such of Thy creatures as have dealt wickedly in Thy sight. Look Thou, then, upon His loneliness, O my God, and behold Him fallen into the hands of them that have disbelieved in Thy signs, have turned their backs upon Thee, and have forgotten the wonders of Thy mercy.

Subject: suffering and imprisonment
Quotation: O my Lord! The wicked doers despoiled him, wrongfully, offensively, high-handedly and tyrannically, of his wealth and chattels, and ever, throughout his life, assailed him with arrows, spears and lances, and goaded him with lashing tongues, while the abject tormented him with their gloating and censure; neither did they weary of inflicting harm upon him, or cease from their enmity and oppression.

Subject: suffering and imprisonment
Quotation: In this darksome night they brought great joy and gladness, for these spiritual letters arrived at a time when the hosts of trials had encompassed and assailed from every side and direction, when the clouds of afflictions were raised on high and the rains of tests and trials descended in succession, when the tempests of tribulation were blowing and the storms of hardship and adversity were passing.

Subject: suffering and imprisonment
Quotation: Imagine the conditions and surroundings when we were exiled by the Turkish Government and were imprisoned in the barracks of 'Akka; Baha'u'llah occupied one room; His family and several other families were forced to occupy one room. Aside from the severe illness that was raging, and the death of many among us prisoners â€" adults and children â€" on account of unsanitary surroundings and starvation

Subject: suffering and imprisonment
Quotation: In a word, His Holiness Baha'o'llah shone forth from the Horizon of the Orient, even as the sun, casting a radiance over the world. During His lifetime He did not rest a moment, nor did He repose comfortably one night. He suffered many trials. He was a prisoner. He was enchained. He was exiled. All these ordeals did He endure in order that perfect fellowship and love should blend the hearts together.

Subject: suffering and imprisonment
Quotation: For about 46 or 47 years we have been living in this prison, desolate town. In the beginning we were all shut up in the military barrack â€" men, women and children. Conditions were most severe and the health of every member of this little community was threatened by the attack of diseases. At the gate of the barrack was stationed many guards and no communication was permitted with the outside world.

Subject: suffering and imprisonment
Quotation: If thou shouldst see Abdul-Baha encompassed by tribulation, know thou that this is supreme joy and the greatest bounty and favor from the Blessed Beauty, for He hath deemed His servant worthy of trials in His path and hath bestowed such favors freely and abundantly. If thou shouldst observe Abdul-Baha in comfort and ease, then be thou saddened, for his existence would be fruitless and his time wasted.

Subject: suffering and imprisonment
Quotation: Thou art witness to how I have been afflicted among Thy servants and Thy creatures, such that the spirit was nearly separated from the body through what the hands of the hypocrites have wrought out of envy. The matter became so severe that they expelled us from our homes, seized our properties, killed our loved ones and took our families captive without any proof from Thee or decree from Thy presence.

Subject: suffering and imprisonment
Quotation: Dost thou not witness and see how the dogs of the earth from all regions have gathered against Me, attributing to Me that which cannot be uttered in speech nor flow from the pen? These transgressors shot at Us the arrows of rancor though We called them to naught but God and desired for them only that which would transform them from the left hand of self and passion to the right hand of glory and eternity.

Subject: suffering and imprisonment
Quotation: Remember thou the time when Muhammad, the Apostle of God, appeared from the horizon of Hijaz - the divines opposed Him and denied the signs of God, the Mighty, the All-Knowing. Then consider the time when the Spirit came with clear signs from the presence of One mighty and knowing. The leaders of that age from among the possessors of the Torah opposed Him, rejected Him, and denied Him with great injustice.

Subject: suffering and imprisonment
Quotation: Six years ago we were invited at the Ottoman suggestion and we have accepted. Later, without having committed any fault and at the request of Persia we were sent from Baghdad to Constantinople. After a stay of 4 months, we were exiled to Adrianople. Now, once again, we are being exiled from Adrianople witout the knowledge of where we are destined and without any reason, all our possessions were disposed of.

Subject: suffering and imprisonment
Quotation: O Muhammad! Were I to recount to thee My grief and what hath befallen Me from one of My brothers, thou wouldst leave thy house and lament and weep and cry out, saying: Alas, alas for what hath befallen the Dayspring of God's verses and the Dawning-Place of His Revelation, through what the hands of the unbelievers have wrought, who denied His Name and rejected what appeared from Him in His forbidden station!

Subject: suffering and imprisonment
Quotation: Then he asked: Are his believers from the nobles, aristocrats, learned and accomplished ones, or from the poor, destitute and base people? He said: Not at all - reasonable, knowledgeable people, accomplished scholars and the wealthy are not with him. Again he asked: Do those who join him become respected, wealthy and comfortable? He said: No, they all become more abased and are forced to flee their homelands.

Subject: suffering and imprisonment
Quotation: For more than twenty years this people have, day and night, been subjected to the fury of the Sovereign's wrath, and have been scattered by the tempestuous gales of his displeasure, each to a different land. How many the children who have been left fatherless, and how many the fathers who have lost their sons! How many the mothers who have dared not, out of fear and dread, to mourn their slaughtered offspring!

Subject: suffering and imprisonment
Quotation: For the companions of God, exalted be His glory, in whatsoever hath befallen or may befall them in the path of God, there is a true profit, and its reward is a treasure with God, the Lord of the first and the last. Blessed is the state of those three souls who were afflicted with the taunts of enemies in the path of God. There hath befallen them what befell Us - nay, what befell Us was more grievous and bitter.

Subject: suffering and imprisonment
Quotation: Praise be to God Who ordained imprisonment for Himself through a wisdom known to none save His Own Self, the One Who dominates earth and heaven... For numbered years the Ancient Beauty and Most Great Name dwelt in the prison-house, sometimes in the most dilapidated of dwellings and at times in a more habitable abode. Yet always we passed our days and nights in a single room, the door of which was usually locked

Subject: suffering and imprisonment
Quotation: By Thy might, O my God and my Master, not even a spot remains in my body that has not been struck by their swords time and again. Dost Thou not hear the cry of the distressed, O Thou in Whose hands lie the reins of all the worlds? Wilt Thou not answer the prayer of one who calls upon Thee? Wilt Thou not remove the evil from this poor, wretched one whom Thou hast placed under the hands of all, both small and great?

Subject: suffering and imprisonment
Quotation: After this they sent Him off with several mounted guards (amongst them Muhammad Big, the courier) to Tabriz and Maku. Although He remained forty days in the city of Tabriz the learned doctors did not condescend to approach Him and did not deem it right to meet Him. Then they sent Him off to the Castle of Maku, and for nine months lodged Him in the inaccessible castle which is situated on the summit of that lofty mountain.

Subject: suffering and imprisonment
Quotation: "Learn ye perseverance from your universal teacher, BAHA'O'LLAH, who was not disheartened by any obstacle from irrigating the hearts of humanity. Kings and nations arose against Him, and banished Him to distant lands and countries. Nevertheless, whenever He entered a new place, fearlessly He occupied His time in the spiritual irrigation and the sowing of the seeds of knowledge and wisdom in the prepared fields of spirit."

Subject: suffering and imprisonment
Quotation: When Abdul-Baha was sent to Akka, he experienced three kinds of persecution. Two kinds were easy to bear. When he arrived in Akka they placed chains upon his limbs and circlets of steel were locked around his ankles and knees... After many years the doors of Akka were opened, the prison walls thrown down and the chains which Abdul Hamid had placed upon the body of Abdul-Baha were put around the neck of Abdul Hamid himself.

Subject: suffering and imprisonment
Quotation: The highest wish of 'Abdu'l-Baha is for suffering and pain; the cause of his true spiritual happiness is the cruel hurt caused by the heedless ones. The cross is his highest throne and cruel death the source of life-abounding. The bitterest affliction to his taste is sweet as honey and the poison of persecution as like nectar to him. For 'Abdu'l-Baha sees everlasting life in dissolution and He sees eternity in death itself.

Subject: suffering and imprisonment
Quotation: Consider what fiery ordeals Baha'o'llah was called to endure! After a long incarceration he was exiled; yet day and night he diffused the light and guided men to truth. Baha'o'llah was imprisoned in an underground cell where he was chained for four months, then exiled to Bagdad, Constantinople, Adrianople and finally to Acca. One knows the prison there. For two years he lived in a dark cell and for seven years in one room.

Subject: suffering and imprisonment
Quotation: "The Blessed Beauty (Baha'Ullah) loved the friends so much that for their sakes he accepted a thousand difficulties and afflictions. Four times he was exiled. He was banished from one place to another. His properties were confiscated. He gave all â€" his family, his relatives, his possessions. He accepted imprisonment, chains and fetters. His holy person was imprisoned in the fortress of Acca until the last moment of his life."

Subject: suffering and imprisonment
Quotation: "Nevertheless, when the morn of the divine Day dawned and the horizons were illumined with the lights of the Sun of manifestation, all were observed to be veiled by the darkness of their idle fancies from the Dayspring of light. Consider the remaining proofs: The people of the Torah were veiled from the Truth by the Torah itself, and likewise all other peoples, each clinging to a book, remained deprived of Him Who revealed it."

Subject: suffering and imprisonment
Quotation: Although the great ones of the State, the majority of the people, and religious leaders arose to destroy and annihilate Him, He withstood them alone and set all Persia in motion. Many were the divines, religious leaders and people who joyously sacrificed their lives in His path and hastened to the field of martyrdom. The government, nation, religious doctors and great personages sought to extinguish His light, but they could not.

Subject: suffering and imprisonment
Quotation: The weather was so cold that the water was frozen in copper jars and vases and as a result, they were broken in pieces. My fingers were congealed to the bar of iron and when I tried to push them back the skin was torn off... Although we had several rooms in the house, we decided that twelve of us stay in one room to get warmer. We did not have any heavy clothings and the one who had a light overcoat was considered most fortunate.

Subject: suffering and imprisonment
Quotation: O people! Do ye dispute with Him Who, beneath the sword, calleth you unto God, the Lord of the Day of Mutual Calling? Doth He seek from you any recompense? Nay, by the Lord of all names! Doth He seek any reward? Nay, by this Dayspring that hath dawned from the horizon of the Divine Will with sovereignty and power! Were He to find that which ye imagine, whence would He find life for Himself, after being between the fangs of wolves?

Subject: suffering and imprisonment
Quotation: For forty-three years 'Abdu'l-Baha was imprisoned in the city of 'Akka and conducted himself in such a way that all strangers acknowledged that in all matters He acted in conformity with the good-pleasure of the Incomparable Lord. The decree of the unjust king was most severe, mandating strict imprisonment such that none could attain the Most Holy Presence, and that the Ancient Beauty should remain alone day and night under guard.

Subject: suffering and imprisonment
Quotation: Ye have expressed words of solicitude and anxiety over the troubles and persecution, which have fallen upon this Imprisoned One. Do not be at all sad, be ye not affected. Do not worry for incarceration to this Prisoner is a feast of bliss and a perpetual Paradise. Persecutions and adversities are the Merciful Gifts. If these persecutions and sufferings did not exist in the Path of God how could 'Abdu'l-Baha obtain happiness and peace.

Subject: suffering and imprisonment
Quotation: However, the transgressors and oppressors have arisen with utmost might and power to obstruct and prevent this, and have exerted and continue to exert their utmost efforts to extinguish the divine light and the fire of the Sacred Tree...God hath manifested Himself for the preservation and reformation of the world and for its life, yet the people of tyranny and wickedness have striven to harm Him and have issued death warrants against Him.

Subject: suffering and imprisonment
Quotation: There was no communication whatever with the outside world. Each loaf of bread was cut open by the guard to see that it contained no message. All who believed in the universal precepts of BAHA'O'LLAH, children, men and women, were imprisoned with us. At one time there were one hundred and fifty of us together in two rooms and no one was allowed to leave the place except four people who went to the bazaar to market each morning under guard.

Subject: suffering and imprisonment
Quotation: He is in this prison while ye rest upon your seats. He drinketh of His own blood while ye drink from every cup. He is imprisoned in a strange land while ye abide secure in your homelands. Be patient in adversities, for verily thy Lord hath been in grievous tribulation, such that the gates of joy were closed before His face, yet He was content with what God was content with for Him and what was decreed for Him in the preserved Tablet of glory.

Subject: suffering and imprisonment
Quotation: This is a letter from the Prisoner to the loved ones of God who have heard My call from this Prison and be apprised of what has befallen Me at the hands of the legions of Satan. Know ye that at all times I drink from the cups of destiny, though I called the servants to naught but God, the Single, the One, the Mighty, the Powerful. And whenever I called them, their hatred increased until they arose to shed My blood. God is witness to what I say.

Subject: suffering and imprisonment
Quotation: They seek to slay Him with the swords of hatred, then raise an outcry among themselves that they might cause doubt to enter the hearts of them that have believed and taken the path unto this station. By God! Such tribulation and hardship have befallen Me as no loving ear can bear to hear with steadfastness. Know thou that My brother desired to kill Me and shed My blood, but God sent the hosts of the unseen and prevented him from what he purposed.

Subject: suffering and imprisonment
Quotation: O second Husayn! By God! Wert thou to become aware of what hath befallen Me of tribulation and adversity, thou wouldst be struck with such terror that the supreme terror would become manifest between the heavens and the earths through thy terror...But this Husayn hath stood before the enemies, and among them are those who mock him, and those who dispute with him, and those who violate his honor, and those who pronounce death sentences against him.

Subject: suffering and imprisonment
Quotation: O people of polytheism! Is there not among you a soul who feareth God for His own sake and would bring water to water, while life remained, in truth and by the truth, for God's sake - even a small drop? God knoweth Husayn's heart and its burning from mighty thirst, and his patience in God, the One, the Ancient. And God was witness to this in truth. By God the Truth! We found his heart that day hotter than a piece of iron heated in the ancient fire.

Subject: suffering and imprisonment
Quotation: Nevertheless, they acknowledged Him not, but denied His proof and rejected His evidence of their own accord. Nor were they content with this, but visited upon Him that which I am ashamed to mention to those in whose hearts the fire of love hath been kindled by the breezes of faithfulness. Such was their way aforetime, if ye would observe with the eye of God. The matter reached such a pass that they drew forth the sword in truth and struck their necks.

Subject: suffering and imprisonment
Quotation: These days, I am in the utmost danger. Perhaps I will be martyred. Tell the friends not to be saddened or perturbed. I said to the Mutasarrif of 'Akka, "Tell Khalil Pasha, the Vali of Beirut, that God has not decreed abasement for Me. The Vali thinks that if I was compelled into manual labor, beaten in the head, made the target of various sufferings, imprisoned or killed, that would be My humiliation. Astaghfiru'llah! That would be My greatest glory!"

Subject: suffering and imprisonment
Quotation: Wherefore, when God's appointed time was fulfilled and the idolaters cast Us into prison, We lifted the veil from the face of the Cause and manifested Our own Self through the truth, despite those who associated partners with their Lord. Then remember My days, morn and eve, My exile and separation, My distress and tribulation, My melodies and utterance, My chants and beauty, My trials and ordeals, My imprisonment and estrangement in this forbidden land.

Subject: suffering and imprisonment
Quotation: The deniers, the idolaters, and the heedless have arisen with utmost effort that perchance they might conceal the rays of the Sun of certitude through their idle fancies and extinguish the fire of the Divine Lote-Tree. The widows laugh at their minds, how much more the men and the brave ones! From the beginning of the Cause until now they have striven to extinguish the divine light and have wrought that which the pen is powerless and incapable to recount.

Subject: suffering and imprisonment
Quotation: Consider how other Manifestations each confronted a people or tribe, or engaged in dispute and battle. Thus Abraham confronted Nimrod the rejected and his obstinate people; Moses became the target of the arrows of the vile Pharaoh; Jesus fell into the snare of the obstinate and denying Jews; the Pride of the Messengers was afflicted by a tribe of highway robbers; and the Bab-may my soul be sacrificed for Him-fell prey to the claws of the Shiite beasts.

Subject: suffering and imprisonment
Quotation: Yet now Thou beholdest Thy Beloved One in the hands of these oppressors, and they have assailed Him such that He findeth not a moment to weep for Himself. When He turneth to the right, He is met by the spear of the polytheists, and when He turneth to the left, He is wounded by the arrows of the hypocrites. Then witness Me in tribulations the like of which the eye of creation hath never beheld, after Thou didst sanctify Me from all mention and novel praise.

Subject: suffering and imprisonment
Quotation: Then came the order from His Presence to journey to Maku, before I even had a month to prepare for the journey. Alas, alas for what transpired, until I arrived at a village whose people were ignorant. I swear by the Most Great Lord that if you knew where I am residing, you would be the first to have mercy upon me. In the midst of a mountain there is a fortress, and in that fortress, through His grace, its inhabitants are limited to two guards and four dogs.

Subject: suffering and imprisonment
Quotation: For this holy purpose and sanctified and evident aim, He made His breast the target of a hundred thousand arrows of affliction and accepted a hundred thousand spear-wounds as the greatest healing balm with perfect joy and contentment. The blessed Temple never rested and the sacred heart never found a moment's peace. How many nights He spent under chains, and how many days He passed as a captive and prisoner in hostile lands with a hundred thousand calamities.

Subject: suffering and imprisonment
Quotation: yesterday, and in the end Thou didst deliver me into the hands of the wrathful and those wielding tyrannical might. Many a night I found no rest from the weight of chains and fetters, and many a day I had no peace from the assaults of hands and tongues. For a time they denied me the food and water which Thou, in Thy bountiful mercy, hadst made lawful even to the beasts of the field, and they permitted against this servant what was not permitted against rebels

Subject: suffering and imprisonment
Quotation: Would that this evanescent servant had a hundred thousand tongues to proclaim Thine be the praise, O God of all worlds! In truth, the bounty has reached such a station that no possessor of understanding can adequately describe it. Whenever the fire of oppression was kindled, the Tongue of Grandeur spoke with perfect power. The tribulations of the world, the tyranny of the nations, the opposition of the divines, and the clamor of the ignorant did not prevent Him.

Subject: suffering and imprisonment
Quotation: While I was in Shiraz the indignities which befell Me at the hands of its wicked and depraved Governor waxed so grievous that if thou wert acquainted with but a tithe thereof, thou wouldst deal him retributive justice... I swear by the Most Great Lord! Wert thou to be told in what place I dwell, the first person to have mercy on Me would be thyself. In the heart of a mountain is a fortress [Maku] ... the inmates of which are confined to two guards and four dogs.

Subject: suffering and imprisonment
Quotation: Thus did they turn from the land of ?a to the land of Zawra, and this denial became a herald for the light. And from Zawra to the land of mystery did He journey, through that which the hands of the oppressors had wrought. Thereafter, the heedless ones, fearing lest that radiance should illumine the land of mystery and its surroundings, and deliver them from the darkness of tyranny, under the pretext of protecting that realm banished its Guardian to the prison of 'Akka.

Subject: suffering and imprisonment
Quotation: This is the Ancient Beauty and He is standing between heaven and earth weeping and crying out. My food is the fragments of My broken heart, and My drink the droplets of My blood. He hath fallen under the spears and the swords of these malicious ones. Thereby the eyes of grandeur have wept within the tabernacle of God and the eyes of sanctity in the pavilion on high, and the eyes of reunion in the sanctuary of the Kingdom and the eyes of the denizens of heaven and earth.

Subject: suffering and imprisonment
Quotation: O Lord! Thou seest the Wronged One among those who have denied Thy right and turned away from Thy sovereignty. He around Whom circle the proofs, and in Whose name and by Whose sovereignty the Evidence crieth out at the highest pitch amidst all created things - they have committed in His days what no pen can recount, and perpetrated that which hath caused the Spirit to lament and the denizens of the Kingdom and the dwellers of the pavilions of the Realm of Might to cry out.

Subject: suffering and imprisonment
Quotation: The Holy Manifestations fell into the abyss of pain and trials, torment and punishment from every idol-worshipper and fire-worshipper, and the taunts of foes and enemies. They found not a moment's rest nor an instant's repose. They were consumed in the fire of the denial and pride of strangers. Every evening They drank from the cup of tribulation and every morning They tasted the poison of destruction. At times They were bound in chains, at times under threat of arrow and sword.

Subject: suffering and imprisonment
Quotation: When thou dost inhale the fragrance of My words and attain unto the traces of My Pen, make mention of My days and what I have endured at the hands of Mine enemies who cast the Command of God behind their backs, following every rejected learned one and every ignorant reprobate. They who arose at Our mention pronounced judgment against Us, and when We manifested the Cause, they turned away from Us and objected to Us with such injustice as caused the denizens of the Kingdom to lament.

Subject: suffering and imprisonment
Quotation: Verily, this is He Who was suspended in the air in the path of God, His Lord, and upon Whom befell that which caused the pillars of the mighty throne to tremble. Were We to recount to thee what hath befallen Us, thou wouldst weep and lament. Therefore do We conceal it from thee as a token of Our grace, for We are the Forgiving, the Merciful. I have been touched by tribulations that have caused the hearts of the chosen ones to burn, and then the hearts of the Prophets and Messengers.

Subject: suffering and imprisonment
Quotation: How many were the holders of high office who attained to the service of God's Cause and assisted His loved ones to the utmost possibility in creation, and how many were the divines and jurisprudents who, in the nights and days, claimed to celebrate His praise and awaited the days of His manifestation, yet when the horizon of the world was illumined by the Most Great Light, all remained veiled. Would that they had been content with this, but they even pronounced the verdict for His death.

Subject: suffering and imprisonment
Quotation: Baha'u'llah lived in 'Akka nine years. Two years were passed in the barracks and seven years in a house in the city. During our stay in the barracks it was very difficult. No one was allowed to go to the baths. Every morning four of the friends accompanied by four gendarmes would go to the market to buy provisions. When we left the barracks we were all sent to a caravansary in the city but Baha'u'llah went to a house with his family. All the time He was in one room, during the seven years.

Subject: suffering and imprisonment
Quotation: After fourteen days, in chains, with bare feet and head, accompanied by some of his followers, they sent him to Teheran, a distance of about three farsakhs (9 miles). His hardships on that journey were beyond description - barefooted, bareheaded, his neck loaded with chains. The guards would urge on their horses and they brought him to a dungeon in Teheran. For four months the trial continued. That prison was underground about ten or fifteen steps down. There was but one door and no apertures.

Subject: suffering and imprisonment
Quotation: The Blessed Beauty of El-Abha (Baha'o'llah) â€" may the divine souls of the existence be a ransom to his friends! â€" endured personally, all kinds of calamities and bore the most violent ordeals. There remained no torture which did not come to his holy body, and no suffering which did not descend upon his pure spirit. How many nights he could not take rest under the chains and heaviness of fetters and how many days he gave himself not a minute's repose because of the burden of fetters and chains!

Subject: suffering and imprisonment
Quotation: O Salamander! Behold thou the pure essence of My nature, that if all the tongues of creation were to make mention of My Lordship and Divinity, He would surely find His luminous heart grieved thereby. Nevertheless, His tribulation hath reached such a pass that a handful of dust which He took up with His merciful grasp, into which He breathed the spirit of grace, and which He nurtured with the hands of His favor, hath risen up to war against His very Self. Yet he counteth himself among the oppressed.

Subject: suffering and imprisonment
Quotation: But this people have striven to cut down the divine Tree, and when they found themselves powerless, they loosened their tongues in calumny. Surely by now the clamor of the polytheists hath reached that land. Yet praise be to God that they have attributed to this most pure Essence such things that any soul possessing the least grain of discernment and the tiniest particle of insight would perceive that these calumnies have issued from the source of rancor, the treasury of envy, and the mine of hatred.

Subject: suffering and imprisonment
Quotation: Through all this We give thanks unto God, the Lord of the worlds, and praise Him in every condition. Verily, He is witness over all things. Not for a moment did He seek to preserve Himself. From the earliest days He was at the mercy of His enemies. Nevertheless, at all times He summoned kings and monarchs, divines and princes, jurists and philosophers and mystics with a clear and manifest Command to the Truth, exalted be His glory, and desired for all eternal life, everlasting rest and perpetual favor.

Subject: suffering and imprisonment
Quotation: The return of the Blessed Beauty hath occasioned the utmost anxiety and distress, for what will transpire in that cramped house in this intense heat? There is no doubt that great harm will befall that blessed Being. If it were winter, it would be somewhat easier, but this summer, with the poor conditions, and in the Most Great Prison - I swear by the Ancient Beauty that even were eyes to weep blood and hearts to melt, it would not suffice. And this is naught but from His ancient and mighty forbearance.

Subject: suffering and imprisonment
Quotation: From the beginning until now, We have been manifest among both friends and foes, and even in times when calamities and tribulations surrounded Us from all sides, We summoned the people of the earth to the Most Exalted Horizon with utmost power. The Supreme Pen desireth not to mention Its own afflictions in this regard, for this would surely cause grief to those who are near, to the sincere ones, and to them that are devoted. Most days We were in the hands of Our enemies, and now We dwell among serpents.

Subject: suffering and imprisonment
Quotation: Remember thy Lord throughout all days and be not heedless of this Youth Who hath been imprisoned in this remote prison through what the hands of the oppressors have wrought, and beyond this prison hath fallen into the well of envy... By God, O handmaiden of God, My shirt hath been reddened with the blood of hatred. Weep thou within thyself for this Wronged One, the alone, the unique. Beware lest thou forget My anguish, then My trials, and what hath befallen Me of adversity from the souls of the heedless.

Subject: suffering and imprisonment
Quotation: By God, wert thou to behold it with thine eyes, thou wouldst find it pierced by the spears of the polytheists and the arrows of the deniers. Every thread thereof crieth out between earth and heaven saying: "O peoples of earth and heaven! If ye desire to gaze upon your Best Beloved, the Most High, look upon me that ye may know what hath befallen Him at the hands of the hosts of Satan. Behold, O people, the blood that floweth from me - it is indeed the blood of God, yet the people are in manifest heedlessness."

Subject: suffering and imprisonment
Quotation: What has befallen the Tree, its branches and leaves hath caused the Cause of God to be exalted, yet the people remain behind a veil and covering. Whatsoever harm hath come upon Us, We have made it a means of exalting God's Cause, the Lord of creation. We have knowledge of what hath befallen them in the path of God, and We have sent down for each one of them that which shall solace their eyes. Marvel not if We jest in prison, for grief hath never overtaken Us in the path of thy Lord, and We are in wondrous joy.

Subject: suffering and imprisonment
Quotation: The Divine Educators who have brought the Light of Guidance to this world found neither rest nor comfort by day or night. Abraham, Moses, Jesus, Mohammed, Baha'o'llah,-all the Heavenly Messengers suffered the utmost privation and underwent extreme hardships in the Pathway of God. They were exiled from their native land, imprisoned, driven from city to city; they were homeless, hungry and found no rest; they lived in the fields and hid in caves among the mountains; the sky was their canopy, the hard earth their bed.

Subject: suffering and imprisonment
Quotation: Neither the might of the powerful, nor the armies of monarchs, nor the doubts of the divines, jurists and scholars could deter Him from His purpose. The clamor of which We had informed thee beforehand hath been raised, and that which had been inscribed by My Most Exalted Pen in various Tablets hath come to pass. The oppression of the divines and that which hath befallen the friends at the hands of rulers hath been and continueth to be the cause of the exaltation of the Word, as hath been witnessed in the past and present.

Subject: suffering and imprisonment
Quotation: Now it is observed that certain barking ones, corrupters and doubters are endeavoring to veil people even more than before. For one thousand two hundred and more years, the people of the Furqan, namely the Shi'ah sect, were uttering certain words and counting themselves the most exalted of creation and the saved and favored community. When the test appeared, they were seen to be the most wretched of all, to such extent that they martyred the Beloved of all possibility with the bullets of hatred and rancor in the land of Ta.

Subject: suffering and imprisonment
Quotation: The doctors, however, considering this arrangement as a weakening of the Law, did not agree, but held a conclave and wrote, If there be doubt in the matter there is need of assembly and discussion, but as this person's disagreement with the most luminous Law is clearer than the sun therefore the best possible thing is to put in practice the sentence of the Law. These learned doctors and honorable scholars, unwilling to bring the Perspicuous Law into contempt, did not approve discussion and controversy with a young merchant.

Subject: suffering and imprisonment
Quotation: Observe how a sanctuary wherein the sacred essence of the Praised One is considered veiled and limited - how can patience and forbearance remain with these continuous, unceasing hostile and idolatrous breaths? By God! Now patience has rent the garment of forbearance and endurance has cast off the cloak of composure from its temple. In brief, the mention of the Incomparable One and the tribulations that have befallen His Beauty cannot be confined to how and why, nor can they be known through utterance or inscribed by the pen.

Subject: suffering and imprisonment
Quotation: And He, from the depths of the well, calls out saying: O people! Forget not the days in which the Beauty of God shone upon you and His tongue spoke unto you from the holy, mighty, powerful and wise verses of God... Then remember My tribulations which have befallen Me in this remote prison... And if harm befalls you, be patient, then show forth yet more patience, then remember My harm. And if sorrow comes upon you, be patient, then reflect on the sorrows that have befallen the Beauty of your Lord, the Merciful, the Compassionate.

Subject: suffering and imprisonment
Quotation: Had the possessors of the Gospel recognized Muhammad as the Truth from God and followed Him, none would have been veiled from Him. But they judged the Truth as they judged falsehood, thinking they did well. Likewise those given the Qur'an - had they recognized the Primal Point as the Truth from God, none would have been veiled from Him. But they judged concerning the Truth other than the Truth, after God and those endowed with knowledge had testified that He was indeed the Truth wherein there is no doubt, and that all were believers in Him.

Subject: suffering and imprisonment
Quotation: O My Lord! I praise Thee for the wondrous aspects of Thy firm and steadfast decree that have befallen this unique Beauty in His love for Thee and in delivering Thy word. What more can this lowly one say regarding that which flowed from the tongue of the All-Merciful at this station? By God, all the realities of existence, both seen and unseen, are engaged in lamentation and wailing over the tribulations that have befallen the King of Divine Unity, while those embodiments of polytheism are occupied in mockery, play, and misleading the people.

Subject: suffering and imprisonment
Quotation: All praise unto the Almighty, the Sanctified - glorified be His power - Who hath ordained that the tyranny of the unjust and the violence of the oppressors should become the means whereby the true lovers draw nigh unto the glorious habitation of the Best Beloved and the sincere among His servants attain the Paradise of communion with Him Who is the Desire of all men, and that sufferings and tribulations should serve as the instrument whereby His Word of command is spread abroad and the standards of His praise are unfurled in all regions.

Subject: suffering and imprisonment
Quotation: As for thee, ponder in thine own self upon My tribulations and that which hath befallen Me. By God! No one before Me hath endured that which I have endured, nor could the heavens and earth bear it. From every direction have trials intensified against Me to such extent that I have become content with that wherewith no one else in all the worlds would be content for himself. Thus was I tormented among these people, while behind them lurked the thickets of malice, and the darkness of hatred encompassed Me on My right, and God is witness to what I say.

Subject: suffering and imprisonment
Quotation: Whenever I dwelt in a city by Thy command and leave, the tyrannous among Thy creatures and they who denied Thy bounty, which Thou didst send down from the heaven of Thy grace and the clouds of Thy will, drove us forth therefrom... And in every city wherein we raised Thy remembrance and Thy name, there gathered against us those servants who denied Thy Self and turned away from Thy presence and arose in hypocrisy, until they expelled us therefrom and caused us to wander from city to city, until they unjustly brought us into this fortress built of solid rock

Subject: suffering and imprisonment
Quotation: Hath it ever been heard that when a soul arose with the divine Cause, and God, glorified be His majesty, adorned him with the ornament of Prophethood and Messengership for the guidance of creation and humanity, the people of that age accepted his words and hearkened to his utterance? Nay, by God! Such a thing hath never been heard from the beginning of the world until now. Whenever a light shone forth from the heaven of God's will, glorified be His majesty, all arose to extinguish it and stood with utmost determination to deny it, turn away from it, and harm it.

Subject: suffering and imprisonment
Quotation: These indeed are servants whom God hath raised up through His power, the like of whom the eye of creation hath not seen, and whose deeds have astounded the denizens of the Supreme Concourse, how much more those below them! Say: O people of the earth! Consider how the hand of divine Will hath rent asunder the veils of contingent beings and brought forth from behind them a numbered few, and caused them to ascend unto the Lote-Tree of the uttermost boundary, while leaving those who disbelieved and associated partners with God in their abode at the root of the fires.

Subject: suffering and imprisonment
Quotation: The Wronged One hath, in every condition, summoned all unto the Most Exalted, the All-Glorious. There hath not been a night or day but that the shrill voice of His Most Exalted Pen was raised in such wise that none can deny it save every froward infidel. By God's life! We have not protected Ourselves. We have revealed the Cause with a sovereignty from Us and summoned both kings and subjects unto God, the One, the All-Choosing. The first to turn away from Us and oppose Us were the divines of the earth, whom We had honored with a word from Us and elevated by Our command.

Subject: suffering and imprisonment
Quotation: All the peoples of the world count themselves among the faithful and assured, yet when the test came and the light of recognition shone forth from the direction of Mecca, all the divines - whether idol-worshippers, Jews, or Christians - arose in opposition, though that Holy Being called all to the word of unity. Glory be to God! The ears of the polytheists were deprived of His call and the eyes of the heedless were prevented from beholding the splendors of His beauty. Finally they issued the decree for His death and arose with utmost hatred and malice to shed His most pure blood.

Subject: suffering and imprisonment
Quotation: Despite the upheaval of the world and the perfidy of most nations and the kindling of the fire of hatred, the True One, exalted be His glory, hath granted success and guided His loved ones to the stream of His love. Glory be to God! The treacherous ones and the highway robbers are present in every direction and stationed at every outpost; nevertheless the Most Exalted Pen moveth, its scratching is raised, and its call is loud. We testify that He is the One with power over whatsoever He pleaseth. Neither the onrush of the oppressors nor the tyranny of the aggressors can hinder Him.

Subject: suffering and imprisonment
Quotation: All days have passed, yet the tribulations of Thy chosen ones have not ceased; every matter hath ended, yet the afflictions of Thy trusted ones do not end. It is as though adversity hath become eternal through the eternity of Thy Being, and hardship abiding through the permanence of Thy Self, and enduring through the endurance of Thy Countenance, wherein all things in Thy dominion change save the tribulations of Thy loved ones, and all things in Thy realm are transient save the abasement of Thy chosen ones. Every day they conspire to banish me, and every night they gather to slay me.

Subject: suffering and imprisonment
Quotation: The Manifestations of divine power - that is, the kings and sovereigns - have not accepted the Cause of the Wronged One, and the cause of their non-acceptance hath been the Shi'ih divines. Throughout ages and centuries they awaited the days of His appearance and sought His days with lamentation and weeping. Yet when the morn of divine favor dawned and the Speaker of Sinai purposed to appear, all turned away and arose with stones of idle fancy and swords of vain imaginings to bring about His abasement, and wrought that which caused the near angels and the bearers of the mighty throne to weep.

Subject: suffering and imprisonment
Quotation: Then know, O My loved ones, weakness hath seized Me to such degree that My tongue is hindered from remembrance and utterance. When a Tablet or two descend from the direction of the Throne, weakness overtaketh Me on account of what hath befallen My body from those who turned away from the Countenance and showed pride before God, the Mighty, the Wise. When the idolaters cast Us into this Most Great Prison, We desired to convey the Cause to the kings and rulers, and We did convey it to them with a sovereignty from Us and a power from Our presence, even while We were in the hands of Our enemies.

Subject: suffering and imprisonment
Quotation: O friends! Thirty years have passed since this world became My throne of glory. What afflictions I have purchased for My Being, into what manner of pits have I descended! Despite My power, might and riches, I became familiar with chains and fetters. At times like captives of Europe from Ray, we hastened without delay to Baghdad. At times toward Rum like a prisoner did I proceed, though I am sovereign of the heavens. Sometimes Adrianople, sometimes Akka was My dwelling, like prisoners ever without rest. Seven years have passed that for the sake of the world, the Most Great Prison became My abode.

Subject: suffering and imprisonment
Quotation: As to Shaykh Muhammad El-Kharrashi, praised be God that he failed not to discern the truth in spite of the calumnies for which God hath awarded no sovereignty. Let him recite: Glorified art Thou O My Lord! This is verily a great falsehood asserted by them who follow in the footsteps of those of previous generations. They claimed that the revealed word was a 'confused heap of dreams' or that the Prophet was insane; nay rather that he was a poet, 'let him come unto us therefore with some miracle, in like manner as the former prophets were sent'. This hath ever been the practice of them who spread lies.

Subject: suffering and imprisonment
Quotation: By the life of God, wolves have surrounded Me from every direction. They have wrought that which hath caused the Most Exalted Pen to lament, and the Tablet of God wherein were inscribed the mysteries of the first and the last... Verily, He is under the claws of hatred. Alas, alas, for that which hath befallen Me from every oppressor, from every sinner, from every liar, from every heedless one, from every denouncer, from every vain imaginer, and from every deceitful traitor... Verily, It is beneath the swords of the people. Alas, alas, for that which hath befallen the Wronged One from the hosts of the wicked ones.

Subject: suffering and imprisonment
Quotation: None can rival Him in all that is in the heavens, if ye but discern with the eye of God in His days. They said: We shall never believe in thee, nor in Him Who sent thee. Thou art but one who wishes to turn us away from that which our fathers worshipped. Thus did they recognize Him, and saw in Him none other than one of those who fabricate lies against God. And whenever We counseled them with the counsel of truth, they turned not unto it, until the fire of waywardness increased within their souls. They gathered together to slay Him, and consulted with the divines of the age, and thus did they scheme in God's religion.

Subject: suffering and imprisonment
Quotation: Blessed is He Who hath sent down upon His Servant such tribulations as have melted the hearts of them that dwell within the Tabernacle of eternity and the souls of those who have drawn nigh unto their Lord. Blessed is He Who hath showered upon His Servant, from the clouds of His decree, the darts of affliction, and Who beholdeth Me enduring them with patience and fortitude. Blessed is He Who hath ordained for His Servant that which He hath destined for no other soul. Blessed is He Who hath caused to rain down upon His Servant from the clouds of enmity, and at the hands of the people of denial, the shafts of tribulation and trial

Subject: suffering and imprisonment
Quotation: O My brother! Thou hast slandered Me, exerting all the power thou didst possess, after I had nurtured thee with Mine own hands and shielded thee from the harm of all peoples. How many were the nights when thou didst rest peacefully in thy bed while I kept watch around thy house as thy protector! How many were the days when thou didst live in comfort with thy wives while I stood before the presence of the oppressors, lest harm touch thee or aught befall thee that would grieve thee! Yet despite all this, thou didst secretly conspire against Me, seeking to find an opportunity to act in ways that would shake the pillars of a mighty throne.

Subject: suffering and imprisonment
Quotation: When we arrived in 'Akka, though we were in such affliction and all were in hardship and tribulation, we experienced a joy and delight that cannot be expressed in words. When seventy companions were imprisoned in the fortress, all were afflicted with severe fever to such a degree that none could move except myself and Aqa Rida, who were occupied with nursing the friends and preparing medicine and broth. By chance, my quarters were also in a room whose floor was stone and very damp, and that room had been built as a washing room. Yet despite these afflictions, in the shadow of Baha'u'llah we were so joyous that we considered every hardship a comfort.

Subject: suffering and imprisonment
Quotation: The Lord of existence is seen beneath the claws of hatred. [...] I swear by the ocean of utterance, had We not borne hardships in God's path, His Cause would have remained behind a veil. [...] We were seated upon the thrones and speaking in praise when a new governor arrived in this city which was named with the Most Beautiful Names by the One Who is All-Knowing, All-Informed. When he was established in [the seat of] power, he committed that which caused the Concourse on High and the denizens of the Most Exalted Paradise to lament, and said that which caused the hearts of those who circle round God's throne, the Protector, the Self-Subsisting, to burn.

Subject: suffering and imprisonment
Quotation: The Wanderer was seized. The hidden things became manifest and the treasured things appeared. The government of S was disturbed, imagining that the shedding of the blood of the oppressed would remove its great sin against His Majesty the Sultan. God knoweth, and thou knowest, for what purpose the Wanderer turned towards this land, and how his petitions were rejected. His commander rose up in opposition - such an opposition that caused the angels near unto God to lament, and the Tablet and the Pen to weep - a weeping that caused the dwellers of the most exalted Paradise and the companions of the highest Heaven to weep, and to cast themselves upon the dust.

Subject: suffering and imprisonment
Quotation: Heavy chains and fetters weighed upon the blessed neck of the Most Great Name (may my spirit be sacrificed for His loved ones), and in this state they brought Him bare-headed and barefooted from Niyavaran to Tehran. And such tribulations - which the pen trembles to mention - befell that pure Beauty over fifty years: first, exile from Iran; second exile from Iraq to the city of the Ottomans; third exile to the European territory of the Ottomans and Bulgaria; and fourth exile to the depths of this prison, the Most Great Prison of the Merciful One. Likewise, a hundred thousand afflictions and calamities, both internal and external, descended during this period.

Subject: suffering and imprisonment
Quotation: Despite having heard that the one in question stood ready to kill the Ancient Beauty - and all these emigrants are witness to this - and moreover his own writings in his own hand exist to this day, that vile one hath still not realized that had the Most Glorious Beauty (may the spirit of all else be sacrificed for Him) wished for a moment to harm His brother, he would never have continued to exist. And this servant is aware, having been with him day and night for fourteen years while none else knew - by God, O people, throughout these successive years that this servant was with him, I observed him daily lying in wait to harm the Ancient Beauty in various ways

Subject: suffering and imprisonment
Quotation: From every cup He tasted deadly poison and from every chalice lethal venom. He became captive to chains and fetters and abased by iron manacles. In prison He was companion to criminals and in jail associate of sinners. He became the target of punishment and object of torment. He was banished from His land and home and exiled to Iraq and Bulgaria. He was tormented by denial and pride and afflicted at the hand of every oppressor. He became the target of arrows of hatred and rancor and shield for spears of tyranny and enmity. He settled in the Most Great Prison and dwelt in the dark dungeon. At all times He was under threat of sword and blade and in every moment captive and imprisoned.

Subject: suffering and imprisonment
Quotation: By God! What flowed from thy pen regarding morals hath caused the faces of glory to fall upon the earth's dust, rent asunder the veil of grandeur in the Ridvan of eternity, and convulsed the hearts of those near unto God. When thou didst travel with Me on this journey which caused tears to flow down the radiant cheeks of the dwellers in the chambers of glory - despite all thou didst ask of Me and seek My permission for, I spoke not a word, for I perceived in thee what none else in the world had perceived. When thou didst travel and enter this land, thou didst rise against Me every day, nay every hour. By God! No spot remained on My body that was not struck by the arrows of thy schemes.

Subject: suffering and imprisonment
Quotation: I was imprisoned by two monarchs for forty years who were in utmost enmity. They blocked all paths - not one person could leave the fortress of 'Akka. And in the latter days the house was surrounded by police and spies, encompassed from every direction - they would not allow anyone to come near or let me go out - in utmost hardship and difficulty. Through Baha'u'llah's help and favor, I resisted and confronted. No one imagined I would come out. Despite extreme hardship and prohibition, I placed my trust in the Blessed Beauty until suddenly God removed the chains from my neck and placed them on 'Abdu'l-?amid's. I came out of the fortress, he went in; I became free, he became imprisoned.

Subject: suffering and imprisonment
Quotation: Through thee was manifested the Most Great Sacrifice, and its decree was established among the nations. O thou who bearest the name of ?a! By God! Through thee hath shone forth the horizon of faithfulness and appeared that whereby God's Cause, the Creator of the heavens, hath been spread abroad. Blessed is the eye that hath wept for thy tribulations, and the ear that hath heard thy praise, and the face that hath turned toward thee, and the soul that hath hastened until it reached thy resting-place - that station which hath been honored by thy noble body and thy sacred and glorious temple. By God's life! Hearts have melted at thy calamity and livers have been rent asunder at thy affliction.

Subject: suffering and imprisonment
Quotation: they who claimed Thy love and spoke Thy praise and beseeched their Lord in the nights and days for Thy manifestation and meeting, and who would rise at the mention of Thy Herald saying "May God hasten His relief," and who lamented in His separation and shed tears in His absence - when the appointed time came and the Light shone forth from the horizon of manifestation, they denied Him and His verses, rejected His right, and denounced Him openly from the pulpits until they pronounced sentence for the shedding of His blood and killed Him with such injustice as caused the dwellers of the pavilions of Thy greatness and the inhabitants of the Most Exalted Paradise and the Sublime Garden to lament.

Subject: suffering and imprisonment
Quotation: O thou who art mentioned in the presence of the Throne! Thou shalt find their faces darkened by the fire of hell, uttering that which the followers of the Qur'an uttered at the hour when the heaven of the Cause was cleft asunder and God came in the shadows of the clouds. Be thou enkindled with this fire which hath been ignited in the midmost heart of eternity and which the idolaters have sought to extinguish. Say: O people! The Primal Point crieth out in the highest Paradise, saying: Fie upon you, O people! By God! There hath appeared that which hath never appeared in creation, yet ye have turned away therefrom after We had summoned you unto it in all Our Tablets, nay in every impregnable line.

Subject: suffering and imprisonment
Quotation: At one time Thou didst deliver me into the hands of Nimrod, then into the hands of Pharaoh, and there befell me that which Thou hast reckoned in Thy knowledge and encompassed by Thy will. At another time Thou didst confine me in the prison of the idolaters because I had related to the people of the realm of glory a letter from the vision which Thou hadst inspired me with through Thy knowledge and made known to me through Thy sovereignty. At another time my head was severed at the hands of the infidels, and at yet another time Thou didst raise me upon the cross because I had revealed in the kingdom the gems of the mysteries of Thy glorious oneness and the wondrous tokens of Thy sovereign singleness.

Subject: suffering and imprisonment
Quotation: What distant journeys thou didst traverse on foot before My countenance, and what arduous deserts thou didst run through with loving feet! Would that I had not been born of a mother or drunk pure milk from the breast, or had not, after attaining maturity, proclaimed God's Cause, for this station hath been and shall be the cause of the enemies' hatred. By Him Who caused the Bird of Immortality to warble in My breast! I strove greatly that no Cause be manifested at all, and that I might leave the people in their realm of fancy, but the Spirit left Me not in peace, established Me in the Cause, and made Me speak between the heavens and the earth. In brief, such tyranny hath been inflicted as hath no likeness in creation

Subject: suffering and imprisonment
Quotation: O Khalil! Wert thou to be informed of the afflictions that have befallen Me, thou wouldst surely not be content with the transformation of fire, but rather wouldst implore God for fire and burn thyself, that thou mightest not hear of the tribulations that have descended upon the Beauty of the Divine Unity. O Khalil! Would that thy Beloved had never been, and had never come from nothingness into being, and would that My mother had never borne Me! Consider that throughout My days I have either been afflicted with imprisonment, chains and fetters, or been an exile in foreign lands. Many a night in the prison of Ta (Tihran) I found no rest from the weight of iron, and many a day I found no peace from the tyranny of enemies.

Subject: suffering and imprisonment
Quotation: Recall thou to mind My sorrows, My cares and anxieties, My woes and trials, the state of My captivity, the tears that I have shed, the bitterness of Mine anguish, and now My imprisonment in this far-off land.
