Every morning I arose from My bed, I discovered the hosts of countless afflictions massed behind My door; and every night when I lay down, lo! My heart was torn with agony at what it had suffered from the fiendish cruelty of its foes. With every piece of bread the Ancient Beauty breaketh is coupled the assault of a fresh affliction, and with every drop He drinketh is mixed the bitterness of the most woeful of trials. He is preceded in every step He taketh by an army of unforeseen calamities, while in His rear follow legions of agonizing sorrows.

Subject: suffering and imprisonment
Quotation: Indeed, they repeatedly squeezed His blessed throat until He nearly declared Verily we are God's, and to Him do we return. As it is recorded in the books that one day Abu Jahl squeezed His throat in the House of Ka'bah until He was near to yielding up His spirit. When His Holiness observed the extreme intensity of the opposition of the people of Mecca, He hastened to Ta'if, that perchance they might hearken to the Word of Truth. The youth and rabble of Ta'if gathered around His Holiness and began to mock Him, and struck stones at His blessed heels until blood flowed. From the intensity of pain His Holiness sat down. The opposers came and made Him stand up, saying He must leave. When He moved they again struck stones at His blessed heels and heaped abuse and insult upon Him.

Subject: suffering and imprisonment
Quotation: We behold you in your station and hear your call. Know ye that We are in the Most Great Prison between two factions among the nations, and there befalleth Us at all times that which hath not befallen any of the Messengers. Whereat the Dove hath lamented and the Beauty of the Ancient of Days hath mourned in the pavilion of grandeur. We have veiled that which hath befallen Us; were We to unveil it the trees would be overturned, the spirits would swoon, the rivers would cease to flow, the fruits would fall, the mountains would crumble, and they that are in the heavens and on earth would be sorely troubled. How wonderful are these tribulations that have descended in the path of God, and how wonderful are these hardships that have encompassed Me in the Cause of your Lord and the Lord of all worlds!

I swear by God that there has recently befallen this wronged Temple in these days a matter whereby the cries of the holy maidens were raised in the pavilions of eternity, the hidden lament was lifted in the most remote retreats, all the denizens of the Supreme Paradise and dwellers of the canopy of concealment wept, and nigh did the pillars of pre-existence scatter, the Most Great Throne collapse, eternity perish, all existence be nullified, all pavilions of sanctity and grandeur fall, and the houses of the Cause be laid waste.

Subject: suffering and imprisonment
Quotation: At one point He was held captive in a dark prison and at another He was chained with the fetters of His jealous brethren. At one time in Mazandaran He fell into the hands of His enemies and at another He was tortured and tormented with a thousand blows before the multitudes. For a while He languished in the prison of Tehran beneath the galling weight of chains and fetters that gave Him not one moment's rest, and later He was exiled to Iraq. In one season He was the target of a hundred thousand arrows of malice and in another He wandered for several years in utter meekness in the mountains of Kurdistan, homeless and comfortless, alone and companionless. From the wildernesses of Iraq He was banished to the city and again after more years to the land of mystery Adrianople where He was the object of hatred from both sides.

And as for food â€" bread that resembled that of the Sudanese people. By the life of God, in the early days, even that was not to be had! This Wronged One was brought bareheaded and barefoot in chains from Niyavaran to the prison of Tihran. That which is beyond human endurance was inflicted. This Wronged One was repeatedly imprisoned, and all have heard of the afflictions that befell Us in the land of Mim. They paraded Us through the streets, and one day they delivered this Wronged One into the hands of the tyrannical divines. God alone knoweth what they did and said and what befell Us. For months they applied ointments and treated the wounds inflicted.

Quotation: By God the Truth! Whosoever uttereth this word, his name hath been recorded in the Tablets with the Jews, were ye but to perceive it. The body of God hath been pierced by the arrows of your rancor while ye rejoice within yourselves and are of those who are glad. Say: Hast thou not heard, O idolater, that He was cast into prison four times in the path of God, the Supreme, the Mighty, the Praised? In each instance there befell Him what had befallen no one before Him, as witnessed by the dwellers of the cities of eternity, and beyond them, My Own invincible, mighty, and peerless Self. Apart from imprisonment, I stood against the enemies in My days, and there fell upon Me at every moment arrows of hatred and rancor from diverse peoples, as ye have heard and are among those who have heard. O Name of Victory! Know thou that in My days My food was but morsels of My own liver, and My drink naught but the blood of My heart.

We were protecting them from the harm of those among the peoples of the earth who sought to slay them, and We made My kindred serve them at every hour and every moment. Until at last they arose to slay Me, yet I pardoned them despite My power and concealed their deeds despite My sovereignty.

Quotation: the text emphasizes that teaching God's Cause is "confirmed" and promises divine support, stating that even the weakest person who arises to teach will become powerful through heavenly assistance

Subject: teaching the Cause; call to teach
Quotation: "My health and happiness are in this, when I see the friends of God engaged in spreading the divine fragrances, arising to serve the Cause of God, forgetting every thought save that of teaching"

Subject: teaching the Cause; call to teach
Quotation: if you wish to become honored in the divine Kingdom, arise to fulfill the counsels and exhortations of the merciful Lord and become the cause of enkindling the fire of the love of God in Germany.

Subject: teaching the Cause; call to teach
Quotation: We have ordained that striving in the path of God be through the hosts of wisdom and utterance, and of goodly character and deeds. Thus hath the matter been decreed by One Who is Mighty, Powerful.

Subject: teaching the Cause; call to teach
Quotation: We beseech God to aid him to guide the servants and teach them to soar, that they may fly with sanctified wings from the clay of idle fancies in the atmosphere of the love of the Lord of all names.

Subject: teaching the Cause; call to teach
Quotation: God willing, mayest thou ever be a promoter of the Cause of God and a cupbearer of the Kawthar of God, that perchance those who thirst in the valley of error may attain unto the Kawthar of guidance.

Subject: teaching the Cause; call to teach
Quotation: O thou spiritual friend! Thank thou God that thou art not an unserviceable and idle instrument. Thou art working. Thy example is like unto an active army engaged in the front in the thick of battle.

Subject: teaching the Cause; call to teach
Quotation: I beg of the Beauty of Abha, in lamenting and supplication, that thou mayest open thy tongue in divine utterance and guide thy neighbors and kinsfolk and cause them to reach the Fountain-head of Life

Subject: teaching the Cause; call to teach
Quotation: all, in accordance with divine counsels and exhortations, seek servitude at the Sacred Threshold and arise to serve, open their tongues in teaching and seek the endless favors of the eloquent decree

Subject: teaching the Cause; call to teach
Quotation: He summoned the people to the religion of God; he suffered them to enter into the Kingdom of God; he wrote books and articles regarding the proofs and evidences of the Manifestations of BAHA'O'LLAH.

Subject: teaching the Cause; call to teach
Quotation: Be thou a lamp of knowledge among the servants, that through thee the hearts of those who advance may be illumined. Be thou as the vernal breeze, that through thee the withered trees may be quickened.

Subject: teaching the Cause; call to teach
Quotation: O thou ready lamp! Be thou enkindled with the Fire of the Love of God as much as thou canst and illumine those countries, so that thou mayst find Eternal Life and shine forth upon all ages and cycles.

Subject: teaching the Cause; call to teach
Quotation: Furthermore, those regions are today in need of teachers. Engage in teaching to the extent thou art able. This bounty is greater than attaining presence, though God willing thou shalt succeed in both.

Subject: teaching the Cause; call to teach
Quotation: Abdul-Baha inhales the fragrance of the love of God from every gathering where thou dost speak the Word of God and mention the proofs and evidences whose lights have shed their rays across the horizons

Subject: teaching the Cause; call to teach
Quotation: In these days all must be enkindled with the fire of the Word and occupied with service to the Cause. They should regard time as precious and enlighten the people of the world with wisdom and utterance.

Subject: teaching the Cause; call to teach
Quotation: Be a guide in the path of God and become a lamp of guidance in divine recognition. In the rose garden of love, become a nightingale of mystery, and in the flower garden of longing, be a melodious bird.

Subject: teaching the Cause; call to teach
Quotation: One must not rest for a moment nor find tranquility for an instant, but call out thirsty and naked in utter detachment until this trumpet blast and these psalms of the House of David reach the horizons.

Subject: teaching the Cause; call to teach
Quotation: Strengthen him with Thy confirmations that he may arise to serve Thee, never faltering in Thy worship, and give the seekers to drink from the crimson wine of Thy guidance from the chalice of Thy bounty.

Subject: teaching the Cause; call to teach
Quotation: The education of children is explicitly obligatory according to the sacred text, therefore teachers are servants of the All-Merciful Lord, for they are engaged in this service which is an act of worship.

Subject: teaching the Cause; call to teach
Quotation: O spiritual leaf! Rejoice in the glad-tidings of God, be stirred by the breezes of God, and be attracted by the address of 'Abdu'l-Baha, so that God may make thee a sign of guidance among the handmaidens

Subject: teaching the Cause; call to teach
Quotation: In thankfulness for this favor and blessing, arise with such power of the love of God as to set Khurasan in motion, nay rather, to perfume the East and the West with the sweet savors of the All-Merciful.

Subject: teaching the Cause; call to teach
Quotation: He who inviteth the people in My Name, he is of Me, and from him will appear that which will be beyond the power of all that is in the earth. Then follow the path of the Lord, and follow not the heedless.

Subject: teaching the Cause; call to teach
Quotation: the beloved of God must with great wisdom strive to strengthen the pillars of the Cause of God, to establish and promote the religion of God, to diffuse the fragrances of God, and to exalt the Word of God

Subject: teaching the Cause; call to teach
Quotation: Be thou firm in the Cause and be engaged in service. Awaken the souls and make mindful the (heedless) minds. The spiritual outpouring will become uninterrupted and the meetings of heart to heart constant.

Subject: teaching the Cause; call to teach
Quotation: With the utmost attraction, rapture, yearning and enthusiasm, one should strive to raise up the Cause of God and exalt the Word of God... we must strive to diffuse the divine fragrances and educate souls

Subject: teaching the Cause; call to teach
Quotation: Let him endeavor to guide a few souls, yet a true believer can transform ten souls in but an hour. He makes the thief trustworthy, brings the coward to the heights of courage, and purifies the defiled one.

Subject: teaching the Cause; call to teach
Quotation: that with every breath you may attract a soul to the divine fragrances and set them ablaze with the fire of the love of God. This field is indeed vast and requires heavenly power for one to move within it.

Subject: teaching the Cause; call to teach
Quotation: And if your Lord's decree permits entry to that island, it is prescribed that you inform the people of the mention of your Lord's name clearly... But aid the word of your Lord and fear no one in God's path

Subject: teaching the Cause; call to teach
Quotation: Day and night occupy yourself with thoughts of teaching and travel to surrounding areas. Among the tribes and nomads spread the holy fragrances of the Glorious Lord until you witness universal confirmations.

Subject: teaching the Cause; call to teach
Quotation: She should explain about this blessed Cause which is a universal religion that brings all religions and sects under the shade of the Sun of Truth, creates complete unity among them, and makes them one nation.

Subject: teaching the Cause; call to teach
Quotation: I have heard that thou didst meet with the mother of Nasiru'd-Din Mirza and hadst good conversations. It is hoped through the favors of the Blessed Beauty that thou wilt ever open thy tongue to present proofs.

Subject: teaching the Cause; call to teach
Quotation: Association with the deniers is not permissible except for the purpose of conveying the Word of Truth. Ask God to make thee so enkindled that no opportunity for rejection and denial will remain for the deniers.

Subject: teaching the Cause; call to teach
Quotation: Every Bahai must acquire the lessons of teaching. This will yield results. No other service is as important as this. This service of the promotion of the revelation of Baha'o'llah is the most confirmed service.

Subject: teaching the Cause; call to teach
Quotation: Mayest thou be reared beneath the Word of Divine Unity and the Tree of Oneness, and become so attracted to the holy fragrances that thou wilt bring all the handmaidens of God into a state of joy and excitement.

Subject: teaching the Cause; call to teach
Quotation: Then make me steadfast in Thy Cause in such wise that I may summon all who are in the realm of creation to turn away from all else and face towards the sanctuary of Thy knowledge and the Kaaba of Thy revelation.

Subject: teaching the Cause; call to teach
Quotation: Purify thou thy vision from human limitations, then arise before God's most pure Manifestation, then convey unto the people that which the Spirit hath conveyed unto thee in this holy, mighty and wondrous Tablet.

Subject: teaching the Cause; call to teach
Quotation: Today is the day of remembrance and utterance, and the day to aid the Goal of all the worlds. This aid hath been and ever shall be through utterance, as well as through such deeds and conduct as befit these days.

Subject: teaching the Cause; call to teach
Quotation: The important thing is to spread the teachings of Baha'o'llah in our own century. Whoever listens to these teachings properly expounded will say, "Here is the truth - that which will render life a greater thing!"

Subject: teaching the Cause; call to teach
Quotation: This is the century of the Sun of Truth and the cycle of the Ancient of Days...The weapons of the divine friends are peace and reconciliation, and their world-conquering sword is utterance, expression and speech.

Subject: teaching the Cause; call to teach
Quotation: He has journeyed to that distant clime - - a land which is not touched by the feet of his fathers and ancestors - - in order to diffuse Thy Fragrances, upraise Thy Flags, spread Thy Words and elucidate Thy Proofs.

Subject: teaching the Cause; call to teach
Quotation: How many philosophers and professors there are and yet God hath set the crown of guidance upon thine head, that thou mayest cry out and proclaim the Abha Kingdom in that city and become the cause of guiding souls.

Subject: teaching the Cause; call to teach
Quotation: "He thanks Allah that He has aided you in His Cause and made known to you what most of the servants are veiled from, that He heard your call and answered you so that you may rejoice and be among the thankful ones."

Subject: teaching the Cause; call to teach
Quotation: Blessed is he who proclaimeth the truth and striveth to serve the Cause of his Lord, the Mighty, the Powerful...Gather thou together the loved ones of God in that place, then remind them of My gracious remembrance.

Subject: teaching the Cause; call to teach
Quotation: We commanded thee before to emerge from behind the veil of silence and to speak forth between earth and heaven concerning this Most Great Remembrance...Raise thy call throughout the land and make mention of thy Lord

Subject: teaching the Cause; call to teach
Quotation: Take thou the Book with the power of the Lord of lords, and call out in thy Lord's Name amongst the parties, and guide them to the path of the Mighty, the Bestower, that perchance they may awaken from their slumber.

Subject: teaching the Cause; call to teach
Quotation: that he may speak with eloquent tongue and tear asunder the veils of people's vain imaginings with effective speech, so that he may baptize souls with the fire of the love of God and the water of life and the spirit

Subject: teaching the Cause; call to teach
Quotation: It is time for you to make Kerman the envy of the Garden of Paradise through the fragrances of the All-Merciful, for the capacity in that region is boundless and they have attained the ability to hear the Word of God.

Subject: teaching the Cause; call to teach
Quotation: May they scatter the seeds of faithfulness and plant the sapling of the Most Great Gift. May they become heralds calling out in the name of Truth and explain, interpret and expound the meanings of the divine teachings.

Subject: teaching the Cause; call to teach
Quotation: Today, confirmation is with those souls who arise to teach. The souls, who are engaged in teaching the Cause, resemble the full-blown flowers. Sweet fragrances are being diffused from the rose gardens of their hearts.

Subject: teaching the Cause; call to teach
Quotation: Day and night they must employ every means to diffuse the divine fragrances and exalt the Word of the All-Merciful, and sacrifice their lives for the spread of the Cause of the Lord. This Cause alone is assisted today.

Subject: teaching the Cause; call to teach
Quotation: My hope from the grace of the One True God is that thou wilt be enabled to spread the fragrances of God among the tribes. This is extremely important. Exert thy utmost effort in this regard so that souls may be educated

Subject: teaching the Cause; call to teach
Quotation: Purify thy heart from the world, then convey unto the people this hidden Announcement...Then will thy words influence the hearts of the servants and from them will spread the fragrances of the Cause throughout all lands

Subject: teaching the Cause; call to teach
Quotation: God hath prescribed unto everyone the duty of teaching His Cause. Then convey the Cause of thy Lord with wisdom and utterance, that perchance the people may remember the mention of their Creator and be of the steadfast.

Subject: teaching the Cause; call to teach
Quotation: God willing, you must, through divine grace, return to your homeland and kindle all souls with the fire of the All-Merciful's love. Now strive to become the cause of unity of hearts and enkindling of souls in that land.

Subject: teaching the Cause; call to teach
Quotation: "Proclaim the words of thy Lord unto His servants" ... "Remain there, then remind those who come to you, then convey to them what God has conveyed to you, and be among those who speak concerning the Cause of their Lord."

Subject: teaching the Cause; call to teach
Quotation: I beseech God to make thee the spirit of its life and a guide unto the path of its salvation, that the light of guidance may shine forth while thou dost chant the verses of divine unity and expound their clear evidences.

Subject: teaching the Cause; call to teach
Quotation: O dear friend, the wise farmer sows pure seed in pure soil, and that pure seed is the new heavenly teachings, and the pure soil is the hearts of the chosen ones. Become a heavenly farmer - do not sow seed in barren land.

Subject: teaching the Cause; call to teach
Quotation: We counsel thee with that wherewith We have counseled Our chosen ones. Thy Lord is, in truth, the All-Commanding, the All-Knowing. Blessed is he who hath heard My call and acted according to that which was commanded by Me.

Subject: teaching the Cause; call to teach
Quotation: Regarding what you wrote about Jinab-i-Mulla Husayn, upon him be the glory of God, having guided several souls to the ocean of divine knowledge - this account, as well as mention of various souls, was presented before Him.

Subject: teaching the Cause; call to teach
Quotation: "If thou wish to advance daily endeavor in guiding the creatures, raise the summons of the Kingdom" "In short: Teaching the Cause of God is the cause of life to the souls and a magnet for attracting Divine, Invisible aid."

Subject: teaching the Cause; call to teach
Quotation: And with perfect severance, spirituality and the best intent and effort must they hasten to promulgate the Divine Teaching, and above all they must act according to the precepts and exhortations of His Holiness BAHA'O'LLAH

Subject: teaching the Cause; call to teach
Quotation: His Honor Ismullah should arrange for one or two persons specifically for this work, and they should undertake whatever will promote the Word of God, diffuse the fragrances of God, and preserve God's Covenant and Testament.

Subject: teaching the Cause; call to teach
Quotation: Today the greatest of divine bounties is that you should open your tongue to guide humanity, take no rest, and to the extent of your ability diffuse the divine fragrances in whatever land you wish and wherever you may pass.

Subject: teaching the Cause; call to teach
Quotation: This Prisoner beseecheth the True One, exalted be His glory, on behalf of himself and the loved ones and friends, for assistance to hold fast unto such deeds as will cause the Word to be exalted and His loved ones to ascend.

Subject: teaching the Cause; call to teach
Quotation: Now all efforts must be one effort and the aim must be one aim, and that is the diffusion of the divine fragrances and the exaltation of the Word of God. Today no endeavor except the guidance of souls receives confirmation.

Subject: teaching the Cause; call to teach
Quotation: O Abu'l-Hasan! God willing...thou shall cause thee to traverse the lands of God with complete eagerness and longing, and to perfume all with the fragrance of divine remembrance and the sweet scents of the Merciful's raiment.

Subject: teaching the Cause; call to teach
Quotation: exhortations to teach the Cause: "Therefore, in this interval they should engage with perfect freedom in spreading guidance and leading souls to the supreme gift, the great unity, and the fellowship of the Concourse on High."

Subject: teaching the Cause; call to teach
Quotation: Now his honor Mr. MacNutt and Dr. Fareed do I send to Washington and Chicago with a new confirmation. The purpose is the spread of the Divine Fragrances and the promulgation of the Word of God wherein they shall be confirmed.

Subject: teaching the Cause; call to teach
Quotation: And I hope that through God's favors, He may create the means by which you will find rest and comfort, and attain prosperity in your livelihood, and acquire an eloquent tongue, and arise to teach and promote the Cause of God.

Subject: teaching the Cause; call to teach
Quotation: Put thy tongue and utterance to use in promoting the religion of God and exalting the Word of God, that thou mayyst, like a polished sword, conquer the realms and, like the morning breeze, bestow new life upon yearning hearts.

Subject: teaching the Cause; call to teach
Quotation: "Thus every soul must strive to impart that joy and happiness to mankind the nature of which are permanent." "Now it is clear that were they able to give her the glad-tidings of the Kingdom she would not have drowned herself."

Subject: teaching the Cause; call to teach
Quotation: Associate with the Theosophists, show utmost love and kindness...for they have capacity. In their gatherings speak with perfect spirituality, love, unity and oneness, and make them soar until they are moved to joy and gladness

Subject: teaching the Cause; call to teach
Quotation: You must work hand in hand to teach the Cause and know that the confirmations of Baha'u'llah will descend upon you. Undoubtedly whenever you arise to serve and proclaim the Cause you shall be assisted and shall attain success.

Subject: teaching the Cause; call to teach
Quotation: Therefore, rest not as much as ye are able, arrange gatherings, and demonstrate the power of the Most Great Name. Verily, your Lord will assist you with hosts from the Concourse on High and armies of the near-stationed angels.

Subject: teaching the Cause; call to teach
Quotation: The point is that utmost effort must be made to attend that meeting and deliver eloquent speeches, and these speeches should be prepared and ready from now. This is a most important matter; you must certainly make every effort.

Subject: teaching the Cause; call to teach
Quotation: That honored one must, in the nights and days, with wisdom and utterance, make the people aware, that all may arise to serve, detached from all else that beseemeth not the days of God, and hold fast unto that which is befitting.

Subject: teaching the Cause; call to teach
Quotation: Consider what bounty and bestowal the Lord of Hosts hath vouchsafed unto thee, in that He hath made thee an army of salvation and a host of life. Thou givest life rather than taking it away, and makest others hearing and seeing.

Subject: teaching the Cause; call to teach
Quotation: The loved ones of God are commanded to teach the Cause, which is true support, and the purpose of this command is that all may attain the exalted station of "whosoever quickens a soul is as though he has quickened all humanity."

Subject: teaching the Cause; call to teach
Quotation: Now it behooveth thee to rest not for a moment nor seek repose. Night and day, like unto a candle, thou must burn and bestow the light of guidance upon all. With heart and soul, occupy thyself with spreading the divine fragrances.

Subject: teaching the Cause; call to teach
Quotation: Jinab-i-Aqa Siyyid Asadu'llah and Jinab-i-Aqa Mirza Hassan Nush-Abadi are striving and endeavoring. I beseech God to assist them both in diffusing the divine fragrances. His Honor Avarih is serving uncontrollably and managing well.

Subject: teaching the Cause; call to teach
Quotation: thou didst hasten to all regions, opened thy tongue in praise of Him Who is wondrous in His bounties, kindled a flame in hearts, and bestowed passion and rapture upon souls, and became the cause of the exaltation of the Word of God

Subject: teaching the Cause; call to teach
Quotation: I am longing with heart and soul for the divine friends, and in Paris I am engaged day and night in teaching to distinguished souls and in public gatherings. Praise be to God, the divine fragrances are spreading to the utmost degree.

Subject: teaching the Cause; call to teach
Quotation: He opened his tongue to spread the divine teachings. He left the comfort of his homeland and hastened to distant lands in the East. He gave the glad-tidings of the appearance of the Kingdom and became the cause of guidance for souls.

Subject: teaching the Cause; call to teach
Quotation: Thou didst become a handmaiden of the Lord of Hosts, became the cause of guiding souls, and wert the recipient of the favors of the Desired One. Thou didst guide the wayward and granted a portion of the heavenly feast to the deprived.

Subject: teaching the Cause; call to teach
Quotation: duty/responsibility of teaching the Cause - "Numerous Tablets were previously sent through messengers, with the purpose that you might arise to serve the Cause of God and quicken lifeless, withered souls through the divine fragrances."

Subject: teaching the Cause; call to teach
Quotation: These days are the days of God. Thou must engage in teaching the Cause for the sake of God, that perchance the turning away of the servants may be transformed into acceptance, their unbelief into faith, and their polytheism into unity.

Subject: teaching the Cause; call to teach
Quotation: Know for a certainty that this light of reality shall eventually envelop the world, illuminating the East and the West entirely...during the period of cessation of communication, no failure obtained in the delivery of the Word of God.

Subject: teaching the Cause; call to teach
Quotation: Regarding what you wrote about the journalists - these newspapers are of no importance. The more attention you pay them, the worse they become and the more they engage in inappropriate articles. Therefore pay them no attention at all.

Subject: teaching the Cause; call to teach
Quotation: He said I desire to travel to all parts of America and summon the people to the Covenant of God so that excellent reports be forwarded to you about me. I knew his secret aim, but I agreed with him and showed to him love and friendship.

Subject: teaching the Cause; call to teach
Quotation: Each one of the friends should try to guide one soul. Those who are worthy; not the persons who enter the Cause and bring degradation to it.... Every one should try to invite his own friends. At least he must make one Baha'i each year.

Subject: teaching the Cause; call to teach
Quotation: He opened his tongue in teaching and engaged in educating the new believers of God. Praise be to God, he trained peerless saplings in the Abha Paradise who, after him, will open their tongues in teaching and deliver eloquent discourses.

Subject: teaching the Cause; call to teach
Quotation: Leave the idolaters behind thee, then speak forth in praise of My Self and fear not the hosts of Satan... If thou hearest the clamor of those who have disbelieved, grieve not, but rather convey the Cause of thy Lord with spirit and joy.

Subject: teaching the Cause; call to teach
Quotation: Upon thee be attraction! Upon thee be enkindlement! Upon thee be occupation in service day and night, that God may thereby bring about a mighty cause - namely, the exaltation of the Word of God and the diffusion of the divine fragrances.

Subject: teaching the Cause; call to teach
Quotation: O my dear one! You must publish this letter and spread it among the friends in America so that they may become united and harmonious, loving one another - nay, rather, that they may love all mankind and sacrifice their souls for one another.

Subject: teaching the Cause; call to teach
Quotation: My greatest wish is to teach this Message. 'Abdu'l-Baha said, I will pray God to assist you. It has often happened that one who is not able to teach would be sent forth, and when the time came, that one would be found powerful and eloquent.

Subject: teaching the Cause; call to teach
Quotation: In these days a wondrous readiness has been achieved in Iran and throughout the world. The time must be counted as precious and the opportunity must not be lost. Therefore, the Hands of the Cause of God must spend all their time in teaching.

Subject: teaching the Cause; call to teach
Quotation: I supplicate unto God that He may make thee a sign of guidance, a lamp enkindled with the fire of the love of God, and a herald of His Name amongst the people, so that the mention of God may spread throughout those vast and spacious regions.

Subject: teaching the Cause; call to teach
Quotation: I am sending you now to serve the Cause of God and spread the divine fragrances. Service to the Cause of God takes precedence over all matters - trade, earning a living, and caring for wife and children come after service to the Cause of God.

Subject: teaching the Cause; call to teach
Quotation: Today, whoever opens their tongue in teaching will be confirmed through the breaths of the Holy Spirit with eloquent and persuasive speech, and will be granted from the center of celestial sovereignty a royal decree of success in both worlds.

Subject: teaching the Cause; call to teach
Quotation: Therefore, kindle thou the flame of illumination and speak of the heat of the Fire of Sinai, that thou mayest guide the seekers in the sacred valley to the Most Great Fire of Guidance and become the cause of joy and gladness in that gathering

Subject: teaching the Cause; call to teach
Quotation: May ye so kindle the fire of divine love at the pole of contingent being and heart of the world that its flames may reach all corners, and may the holy fragrances from the rose garden of divine knowledge spread throughout the entire Caucasus.

Subject: teaching the Cause; call to teach
Quotation: O Mahdi! Guide thyself, then guide the people by this Sun which hath dawned from the horizon of holiness with manifest sovereignty, that perchance the people may recognize their Creator, differ not in His Cause, and find unto Him the true path.

Subject: teaching the Cause; call to teach
Quotation: Call to dedicate all energy to spreading the divine fragrances and exert mighty efforts in diffusing the holy perfumes. Encouragement to take firm steps and make great endeavors so each believer may rout the army of heedlessness and stir hearts.

Subject: teaching the Cause; call to teach
Quotation: Thou shouldst do this same also in spreading the Breaths of God. Verily, verily thou hast done thy best, since thou hast returned to America in thy work, for the Kingdom. Rest assured that the confirmations of the Holy Spirit will support thee!

Subject: teaching the Cause; call to teach
Quotation: My meaning is that the choice is one's own to make: one can consecrate one's life to the Kingdom of God if one so wishes, or hope that you will occupy yourself with teaching the Cause of God. One can promote the Word of God in a variety of ways.

Subject: teaching the Cause; call to teach
Quotation: As to the 50,000 booklets that you have distributed, this act is highly befitting and the two packages which you had sent by mail have been received. Do not place these booklets in public places for their dignity and worth will thereby decrease.

Subject: teaching the Cause; call to teach
Quotation: You must take firm and determined steps in the Cause. Write to the steadfast handmaiden of God, General Jack, not to return to Europe but to proceed to Toronto in Canada and to St. John's, and there to engage in the promotion of the Faith of God.

Subject: teaching the Cause; call to teach
Quotation: Like divine candles, they shine with all human virtues. This is eternal glory, this is everlasting life, this is the highest human distinction, this is exaltation in the divine world. Now, praise be to God, you are confirmed and assisted in this.

Subject: teaching the Cause; call to teach
Quotation: Friends have arisen in the utmost joy and fragrance and have engaged in promoting the teachings of the Ancient Lord, giving the deprived their share and portion from the fountain of supreme guidance, and directing the lost onto the straight path.

Subject: teaching the Cause; call to teach
Quotation: The most excellent of all deeds today is to teach His Cause with joy and fragrance. Whosoever achieves this has achieved all good. This matter--namely, teaching--is most great. If you hold fast to it, it is, in the sight of God, closest to godliness.

Subject: teaching the Cause; call to teach
Quotation: Thou who art intoxicated with the wine of divine mystery - bestir thyself! Burn away the veil of fancy from the frozen ones and kindle the fire of the soul in those who are dead, that they may become eternally alive and receive the rays of the Sun.

Subject: teaching the Cause; call to teach
Quotation: Your teaching in the sphere of knowledge attracts divine bounties and draws forth heavenly favors. I hope that through divine fragrances you may transform Jandaq into an exalted palace and, with perfect wisdom, guide souls to the light of guidance.

Subject: teaching the Cause; call to teach
Quotation: Cry at the top of your voices similar utterances in those meetings before the concourse of humanity. The effect of your words will be conditioned upon the degree of your attraction and exultation. Then you will observe what an effect this will have.

Subject: teaching the Cause; call to teach
Quotation: exhortations to teach the Cause; power/influence of a single soul in teaching the Cause: "with all thy might and attraction to the love of God, cry out while teaching the Cause of God, and know with certainty that the Holy Spirit will confirm thee."

Subject: teaching the Cause; call to teach
Quotation: When Professor and Mrs. Cheyne pay thee a visit at thy summer home, make thou an effort, that they may become wholly spiritual and illumined, and that, in the latter days of his life, he may light a candle whose radiance may endure for all eternity.

Subject: teaching the Cause; call to teach
Quotation: Thou wert, it appeareth, in doubt as to whether to write, or to teach the Faith. Teaching the Faith is essential, and for the present teaching is preferable for thee. Whenever thou dost find an opportunity, loose thy tongue and guide the human race.

Subject: teaching the Cause; call to teach
Quotation: that thou mayest scatter pearls and, through sacrificing thyself, lift the veil from the eyes of others, that in the assemblage of the world thou mayest raise high thy head like the standard of Kavian, and melt hearts with the fire of the love of God

Subject: teaching the Cause; call to teach
Quotation: Thou wilt light a lamp that will remain forever ablaze. Thou wilt plant a sapling that will ever yield delectable fruit. Thou wilt unseal a musk-laden packet whose sweet fragrance will perfume the nostrils throughout the passage of centuries and ages.

Subject: teaching the Cause; call to teach
Quotation: And amidst all these tasks it was decided that his honor Siyyid Sadr must make an effort and if possible proceed to Hamadan and if feasible engage in teaching in the surrounding areas so that the holy fragrances may be diffused through his utterance.

Subject: teaching the Cause; call to teach
Quotation: The foundation of this palace is to summon the people to the Call of the Kingdom of God; its galleries are the Principles of Baha'o'llah and its decorations the writings of the world of humanity; its radiant lamps are the lights of the Divine Kingdom.

Subject: teaching the Cause; call to teach
Quotation: They inquired of Aqa Mirza Mihdi about the condition of the people of China. Aqa Mirza Mihdi responded. Then They said it would be good for the Muslims to teach the Chinese. As soon as a few are taught, the Blessed Cause will afterward spread in China.

Subject: teaching the Cause; call to teach
Quotation: May you become educators of souls and teachers of knowledge... that they may guide Thy servants to the straight course and the right path, that Thy manifest religion may be exalted among the worlds and Thy traces may be spread between the East and West.

Subject: teaching the Cause; call to teach

Quotation: You must be utterly grateful to Mrs. Maxwell, for she was the cause of your guidance, and you should forever implore divine favors for her, as she opened your eyes. The love she has shown you - its worth is not apparent now, but in the divine Kingdom after your ascension from this mortal world it will become known and evident.

Subject: teaching the Cause; call to teach
Quotation: Let them shun silence and stillness, turn to the seekers of truth, associate with all as honey and milk, show forth the path of salvation, chant the clear verses, raise high the standard of truth, and create a stir throughout the world of humanity, for they are cognizant of the mystery and are in the utmost lowliness and need.

Subject: teaching the Cause; call to teach
Quotation: The sending of teachers to different parts is highly acceptable and praiseworthy. Act in accordance with the instructions previously sent. The journey of teachers to different parts is like unto the rays of the sun which radiate from a central point to the surrounding regions and undoubtedly great illumination will be obtained.

Subject: teaching the Cause; call to teach
Quotation: Like unto a dove I carry a Message with me wherever I go. BAHA'O'LLAH has written a letter, a Message; He has put it on my wings; through His power He has made me to soar and I have brought that Message here. That letter contains the glad tidings of God; that letter is the call of the Kingdom; that letter is the heavenly signs.

Subject: teaching the Cause; call to teach
Quotation: They gathered on top of a mountain, and made a pact whereby they would consent to bear tribulations, renounce their comfort, and spread guidance. When they came down from the mountain, each of them went in a different direction and never returned. In various regions, they all arose and summoned the people to the Kingdom of God.

Subject: teaching the Cause; call to teach
Quotation: Though you are students now, it is hoped you will become teachers. In the garden of knowledge and wisdom, like flowers and fragrant herbs, may you grow and develop through the drops of the cloud of grace, and may each of you become a fruitful tree and a plant of utmost freshness and grace and a mighty tree full of sweet fruits.

Subject: teaching the Cause; call to teach
Quotation: O Javad! Arise among the servants through My power and say: O people of the earth! By God, the call hath been raised from the Most Exalted Horizon. Turn unto it with attentive ears, expanded breasts, illumined hearts, and radiant faces, and be not of those who see and deny. Say: No call raised before or after can equal this call.

Subject: teaching the Cause; call to teach
Quotation: "O, my soldiers! My beloved soldiers! Forward! Forward! Have no fear of defeat--do not have failing hearts. Our Supreme Commander is Baha'o'llah. From the heights of Glory He is directing this dramatic engagement. He commands us! Rush forward! Rush forward! Show the strength of your arms. Ye shall scatter the forces of ignorance!"

Subject: teaching the Cause; call to teach
Quotation: In those luminous gatherings 'Abdu'l-Baha is present in spirit, praising and thanking the All-Forgiving Lord for having made those blessed souls such manifestations of His infinite favors... Praise be to God that the teaching gatherings in Tehran are in accordance with the desire of 'Abdu'l-Baha. All are successful and confirmed.

Subject: teaching the Cause; call to teach
Quotation: His Holiness Sadru's-Sudur established classes for teaching and strove with utmost effort and diligence. In this divine garden he nurtured new saplings and bestowed boundless delicacy and freshness. He made the silent birds to speak and made uninformed children become bearers of glad tidings of the Most Glorious and Great Beauty.

Subject: teaching the Cause; call to teach
Quotation: O thou who art firm in the Covenant! I know what enthusiasm and passion thou hast, therefore thou must engage in teaching important souls and become the cause of guidance for the learned and distinguished ones, so that in Iran there may arise wise and knowledgeable ones who are well-wishers of the government and kind to the nation

Subject: teaching the Cause; call to teach
Quotation: Take My Book with a power from Me. Let not the swords of the world and the hosts of the nations frighten thee. By the life of the Most Merciful! There hath been ordained for thee that which minds cannot reckon and thoughts cannot encompass. Cast aside the world and all that is therein, turning with thy heart to My glorious horizon.

Subject: teaching the Cause; call to teach
Quotation: must all arise with all their powers to diffuse the divine fragrances and exalt the Word of God. They must sacrifice their transient days for eternal life and expend their physical comfort in the path of spiritual glad-tidings...but with the utmost effort they must teach individually and not lose time and count the days as precious

Subject: teaching the Cause; call to teach
Quotation: I hope that through your efforts some centers of the Cause will be established in those places. It is my hope that Mrs. and Mr. Hildenbrand will arise with all their strength in the service of the Kingdom, so that Göppingen will become the rose garden of God, from which the sweet fragrance of the Kingdom of God will spread further.

Subject: teaching the Cause; call to teach
Quotation: If their work is confined to goodly conduct and kind exhortation, no progress will be made. The tongue must be loosened to present proofs, and clear and conclusive evidence must be offered for the appearance of the Sun of Truth, that souls may be stirred, hearts attracted, spirits gladdened, and eyes turned toward the Abha Kingdom.

Subject: teaching the Cause; call to teach
Quotation: Thou hadst written that the daughter of the Kingdom, Asia, is studying Persian, and thou art teaching English to Mirza Farajullah Khan. Turn ye to the Abha Kingdom and seek confirmation. Strive that all may soon succeed in acquiring Persian, and that Jinab-i-Mirza Farajullah Khan may likewise gain proficiency in the English tongue.

Subject: teaching the Cause; call to teach
Quotation: Day and night he was engaged in teaching the Cause and conveying the message. Notwithstanding the weakness of constitution, the infirmity of the body and the nervous fever, every night I was in a city and each day amongst a community. Although at times I could not speak one word, before large audiences I delivered lengthy addresses.

Subject: teaching the Cause; call to teach
Quotation: If it is convenient (or possible) for thee, travel to other parts, carry no provision, and call in the Name of thy Lord, the Merciful, the Clement. Call upon (or contact with) every maid-servant who believes, and is firm in the Covenant, and remember her by the remembrance of her Lord, and the Appearance of the Kingdom at this time.

Subject: teaching the Cause; call to teach
Quotation: Undoubtedly whenever opportunity affords, the believers of Washington must go to Baltimore, become engaged in teaching the Truth, spread the carpet of feasting and prepare the heavenly table. O thou divinely attracted one! Day and night, with an eloquent tongue, teach thou the heedless one; awaken those who are speechless and silent.

Subject: teaching the Cause; call to teach
Quotation: Therefore we must strive day and night so that these trees of the temples of humanity become fruitful, the extinct lamps become ignited, the thorny desert become a rose-garden, the wild jungle an orchard, the dark world illumined, the infernal terrors be changed into divine splendors and the satanic reality into the merciful reality.

Subject: teaching the Cause; call to teach
Quotation: In any case, as much as thou canst, sound the call for souls to enter through the Gate of Salvation, and make minds the dawning-places of the effulgences of the knowledge of the Forgiving Lord. Make the darkened ones illumined, and transform the satanic into the divine. Guide children to maturity and direct them to the brilliant star.

Subject: teaching the Cause; call to teach
Quotation: O herald of the Kingdom of God! The poet says: "Yesterday, the Shaykh with his lamp was roaming about the city, saying: 'I am weary of demon and beast. My heart yearns for a true human being.'" Now, praise be to God, you desire to guide souls so that you may discover a treasure in every corner. I hope that you will be assisted in this.

Subject: teaching the Cause; call to teach
Quotation: Restrict all thy time to the spreading of the fragrances of God and be thou engaged in the guidance of souls. Ere long thou shalt behold that innumerable centers are going to be organized in America for the purpose of the promotion of the Cause of God and hearing the speeches of the maid-servants of the Merciful and the believers of God.

Subject: teaching the Cause; call to teach
Quotation: call to action; importance of protection and wisdom in teaching: "However God's loved ones in different regions must all conduct themselves with perfect wisdom and render assistance. No action should occur that would cause affliction to those souls, for if all are afflicted, who would call people to God? Therefore protection is necessary"

Subject: teaching the Cause; call to teach
Quotation: Those souls who accept this revelation and then do not engage in teaching and conveying it to others will remain stationary and do not advance. Every soul that is anxious to be drawn nigh unto the Kingdom of Abha and become nearer and nearer, he must unloose his tongue by day and by night in the delivery of the message and never rest still.

Subject: teaching the Cause; call to teach
Quotation: I hope that through the Baha'is' great love for them they will be guided toward that divine city - the center. I hope that you will become the means of directing their journey toward that center. Be very kind to them. Treat them most gently. Associate with them. Invite them to your home, perchance you may become the cause of their guidance.

Subject: teaching the Cause; call to teach
Quotation: By God! O dear one, thou art truly serving with the utmost power, delivering eloquent speeches in gatherings and revealing divine mysteries. This attracts heavenly confirmations and is a magnet for divine favors. I hope that day by day thou wilt gain greater power from the breathings of the Holy Spirit and deliver even more eloquent speeches.

Subject: teaching the Cause; call to teach
Quotation: I swear by the Lord of the unseen and the seen that in that moment when that Manifest Light sat upon the two knees of unity and was occupied with exalting the Word of God and diffusing the divine fragrances, the dwellers of the Most Glorious Pavilion looked forth from their chambers exclaiming "Well done! Well done!" and offering their praise.

Subject: teaching the Cause; call to teach
Quotation: Praised be God that thou art now in an important place, a place where there is great capacity for the propagation of the divine teachings. For some time it hath been my wish that the call of the Kingdom of God may be raised in that great land. I am confident, and thou shouldst likewise be confident and engage in spreading the teachings of God.

Subject: teaching the Cause; call to teach
Quotation: By God! He who attaineth today unto one word from God hath attained unto all good. Blessed are they who attain! Beseech ye God that He may aid His servants, that perchance He may not deprive them of the waves of the ocean of meanings which in every instant speaketh forth through a book, and withhold them not from the lights of the Sun of Truth.

Subject: teaching the Cause; call to teach
Quotation: In truth, thou art serving with the utmost power and art delivering eloquent speeches in meetings and art revealing divine mysteries. This is the cause of attaining heavenly confirmations and the magnet of divine favors. I hope that day by day thou wilt find greater strength from the breaths of the Holy Spirit and deliver more eloquent speeches.

Subject: teaching the Cause; call to teach
Quotation: Now, the Cause did require that I travel to these parts, and had I divulged my intention at that time, many difficulties would have arisen...Tell the friends, how, under severe circumstances of bodily weakness, I have accepted the hardships of travelling to promote the Word of God, to spread the Cause of God and to diffuse the Fragrances of God!

Subject: teaching the Cause; call to teach
Quotation: Then counsel them with Our counsel, lest they transgress that which they have been commanded by the Mighty, the All-Knowing. Say: O people! Be among mankind with pure justice, such that neither treachery and enmity, nor backbiting and hatred, nor sedition and misery shall appear from you, that ye may be the standards of guidance among the people.

Subject: teaching the Cause; call to teach
Quotation: O Solace of the Eye! Deal not harshly with the people of blindness, for they are orphans bereft of the remembrance of the Most Great Remembrance. Guide them to the subtlest waters in a glass vessel most delicate, for they are indeed bondservants to the mystery, and thou art the Truth, possessed of great bounty, and God is witness over all things.

Subject: teaching the Cause; call to teach
Quotation: As the real guides of humanity, illumine the ignorant with the Light of Wisdom, raise the lowly, inspire with noble ideals the despondent, and lead the erring ones into the Path of Truth. Like unto the sanctified Apostles of Christ, summon ye, the people to the Kingdom of God, and invite them to walk in the Road of Heavenly Prosperity and Success.

Subject: teaching the Cause; call to teach
Quotation: Know with absolute certainty that for anyone who guides a soul in the path of God, their brilliant traces will remain eternal and everlasting in all worlds, even in the lowest realm which is this earthly plane of dust, and the star of their noble deeds will shine forth from the horizon of contingent being like the lights of the realm beyond place.

Subject: teaching the Cause; call to teach
Quotation: Some souls need no teaching. These are like unto eyes - and eyes need not be taught to see. Likewise, ears need not be taught to hear. When opened through the aid of the Spirit, they perceive of themselves. Yet at all times one must seek refuge with the Countenance of the All-Merciful, lest disease or other ailment afflict them and become a barrier.

Subject: teaching the Cause; call to teach
Quotation: My spirit and heart be a sacrifice unto thee! This evanescent servant hath been honored to receive thy letter which was the source of love and affection, and found therein that which brought joy to the heart. We beseech God, exalted be He, to make thee a key to the doors of hearts, that through thee beings may be drawn to God, the Mighty, the Beloved.

Subject: teaching the Cause; call to teach
Quotation: This Cause of God needs teachers. They should always move from land to land. And those teachers who are knowledgeable and ablaze should be in their travelling like the breezes of the Spring which give life to the trees, while the Autumn winds bring destruction and extinction. For two hundred years, all thoughts should be confined to teaching the Faith.

Subject: teaching the Cause; call to teach
Quotation: Day and night he was engaged in the diffusion of the Fragrances of the Merciful. He was occupied in the service of the King of heaven and was teaching the people the statutes of the Lord. From Bagdad Nabeel returned to Gaiin, his native town in Persia. Truly I say he illumined the district of Gaiin and guided many souls to the fountain-head of Reality.

Subject: teaching the Cause; call to teach
Quotation: Now in America all these means are lacking, yet the Cause of God has spread through the power of the Holy Spirit. Soon you will observe that it has spread throughout all Europe. Therefore, O chosen one of Abdu'l-Baha, arise with upright stature, let your face shine forth, show your countenance, roll up your sleeves, seek illumination, and raise the call.

Subject: teaching the Cause; call to teach
Quotation: But the delivery of the Cause of God depends upon the diffusion of the Fragrances of God, severance from the world, engagement in the commemoration of God in independence of the rich. But if thou desirest to teach the Truth of God and sleekest to promulgate the Word of God; that reqires the confirmation of the Holy Spirit and not the means of sustenance.

Subject: teaching the Cause; call to teach
Quotation: Blessed art thou for guiding Fred Cobourn unto the Fountain of the Water of Life, caused him to enter the Ark of Safety, demonstrated unto him the manifest signs, and proved to him the elegant proofs. Therefore, continue spreading the fragrances of God in this new age, which dawns as the sun with the lights of favors unto the horizon of ages and centuries.

Subject: teaching the Cause; call to teach
Quotation: In all churches I raised the cry of Ya Baha'u'l-Abha, and in all great gatherings I proclaimed Ya 'Aliyyu'l-A'la. Should the friends open their tongues in teaching, without doubt in a brief time the world will become another world, the lights of the Most Great Luminary will shine forth, and darkness will be transformed into the illumination of East and West.

Subject: teaching the Cause; call to teach
Quotation: Now thou must gird up the loins of endeavor and occupy thyself with spreading the divine fragrances in those regions, and through eloquent speech, fluent tongue, divine morals, and spiritual conduct, guide souls to the light of guidance. Make extraordinary effort to acquire proficiency in the English language to such a degree that thou wilt excel all others.

Subject: teaching the Cause; call to teach
Quotation: For today all must be focused on another matter, which is the teaching of souls with wisdom and utterance, so that the copper of the existence of servants might be transformed into pure gold through the elixir of the divine Word and turn toward the supreme horizon. Today man is able to acquire eternal stations, and whatever is lost today can never be regained.

Subject: teaching the Cause; call to teach
Quotation: We beseech God to aid thee through His might and power, to assist thee in that which will draw thee nigh unto Him, and to ordain for thee that which perisheth not through the perpetuity of His most excellent names. Verily He doeth what He willeth. We send greetings to the loved ones in that land and counsel them to that which causeth the advancement of existence

Subject: teaching the Cause; call to teach
Quotation: Today is the Day of vision, for the Countenance of God is manifest and evident from the horizon of manifestation. Today is the Day of hearing, for the Divine Call is raised. All must today cling to and speak of that which hath appeared from the Dayspring of the Books, the Dawning-Place of Revelation, the Manifestation of Knowledge and the Source of divine wisdom.

Subject: teaching the Cause; call to teach
Quotation: The spiritual meeting must be in the utmost of ecstasy and tumult. The supplication must be perused, the Tablets and verses be read, eloquent speeches be delivered, divine proofs be explained, the audience be encouraged and incited to enter the Kingdom of God, the news received from different parts be read and at the end they may collectively read a supplication.

Subject: teaching the Cause; call to teach
Quotation: You should become so enkindled that the heat of your fire will set ablaze the neighboring regions, and the fragrances from the gardens of your hearts will perfume the nostrils of the Concourse on High. Let the flood of grace flow from that plain and mountain range upon the horizons, and let the rivers of knowledge flow from that city upon the valleys and deserts.

Subject: teaching the Cause; call to teach
Quotation: You wrote that you were a guest with the Secretary of the Interior at Mrs. Parsons' home, where you had fellowship and discussed various matters, and that he invited you to frequent the Interior Department. Observe how the light of the Blessed Beauty's favor makes His loved ones so honored and exalted, raising them to such degrees as could not have been imagined.

Subject: teaching the Cause; call to teach
Quotation: In that city the Cause was most wonderfully spread. In churches and gatherings public and detailed addresses were delivered; and one evening your friend Miss Nichols sent out special invitations and a number of prominent people were present. For two hours I spoke to them. They asked many questions, answers to which were given. They became very grateful and happy.

Subject: teaching the Cause; call to teach
Quotation: Freely bestow endless bounties and grant hidden favors, so that each one may become a rosebush of guidance in this garden of truth, and every soul may spread sweet fragrances of guidance through the divine breath. May they open their tongues in utterance and occupy their speech with proofs. May they establish conclusive arguments and demonstrate brilliant evidences

Subject: teaching the Cause; call to teach
Quotation: You have heavenly confirmation and divine success - in every gathering you speak and in every assembly your words are heeded. People listen to your words with perfect joy, and if any denier or opponent appears, they ultimately become aware and awakened. Mr. Wilhelm exerts the utmost effort in all matters and gives and spends generously in promoting the teaching work.

Subject: teaching the Cause; call to teach
Quotation: In Paris, one must manifest such purity and sanctity as to completely cleanse souls from the contamination of passion and desire, for in that city souls are in the utmost heedlessness and immersed in carnal desires. If the power of the Kingdom becomes manifest, it will surely have a mighty influence and bring those souls to life through the breaths of the Holy Spirit.

Subject: teaching the Cause; call to teach
Quotation: Indeed the friends of God were successful in rendering great services at this congress...The results of those speeches will become apparent. And likewise the meetings that were established in Portland and the souls who gave speeches - they too sowed pure seeds in that pure soil. Mr. Remy and Mr. Latimer indeed show the utmost effort in spreading the divine fragrances.

Subject: teaching the Cause; call to teach
Quotation: On this trip, through the assistance and providence of God, you must perform miracles. Your speeches must be delivered with the utmost spirituality... Speak in public meetings. God will support you. Deliver talks on universal love, the greatness of the cause of BAHA'O'LLAH, the penetration of the Word of God, and the general principles of the Revelation of BAHA'O'LLAH.

Subject: teaching the Cause; call to teach
Quotation: "Unloose therefore thy tongue in truth, and announce unto the people that whereof, by the power of the Spirit, He hath informed thee in this Tablet" ... "Write then in vindication of this Cause whatsoever the Spirit infuseth into thy breast; He, verily, will inspire thee with the truth, and assist thee in a matter whose outcome hath been predetermined by the Pen of God."

Subject: teaching the Cause; call to teach
Quotation: This is the day wherein thou must make mention of thy Lord amongst the people and convey to them what We imparted unto thee when thou wert in Our presence and the Sun of Beauty shone upon thee from the horizon of this heaven. Deliver the Cause of thy Lord unto those whom thou findest heedless of Him, that perchance they may arise from slumber and remember this Wronged One

Subject: teaching the Cause; call to teach
Quotation: Thus hath the Pen spoken while the Lord of Eternity was in His Most Great Prison. Glory be to God! The lights of His Revelation have encompassed the world, and the Cause of God hath appeared manifest as the sun. Yet the peoples of the world remain occupied with their own concerns, deprived and forbidden from the rain of divine mercy and the spring showers of heavenly grace.

Subject: teaching the Cause; call to teach
Quotation: This is the station of the noble ones, and this is the station of the righteous ones...Know ye of a certainty that in this Day whosoever, with utter humility and lowliness, submission and meekness, absolute nothingness and complete evanescence, diffuses the divine fragrances, the Kingdom of existence will confirm them and the powers of the Realm of Names will grant success.

Subject: teaching the Cause; call to teach
Quotation: At this moment, while these Tablets were being written, there came a call from the right hand of the Throne saying: Write to the servants and inform them that all are today commanded to teach this wondrous and exalted Cause. Should an ignorant one don this robe and desire to teach all the learned ones, verily he shall be enabled to do so, for the Holy Spirit will assist him.

Subject: teaching the Cause; call to teach
Quotation: I hope you may become enkindled like two lamps with the Light of the Love of God...I beg for them infinite bounty and assistance so that day and night they may engage their time in teaching the Cause of God and spreading the Fragrances of God--in order that the Love of Baha-ollah may so overwhelm their hearts and fill their minds that there may be left place for nothing else.

Subject: teaching the Cause; call to teach
Quotation: Day and night he engaged in teaching, making his prayers and devotions into a single prayer and his state an eternal service. Although lacking strength to utter a word, he would teach continuously for two hours in great gatherings. This work yields results, whereas from differences of opinion no fruit is gained save that Abdu'l-Baha is put to shame before friend and stranger.

Subject: teaching the Cause; call to teach
Quotation: God will cast into thy heart that which shall cause thee joy throughout all eternity, and will make thee speak in such wise that thou thyself shalt be amazed, and thou shalt say: Blessed am I for this great gift! Glad tidings be unto me for this mighty bestowal, in that my Lord hath confirmed me in this and enabled me to exalt the Word of God and diffuse the divine fragrances.

Subject: teaching the Cause; call to teach
Quotation: When you meet one another, let each one give glad tidings to the other and make her hopeful of the favors and bounties of the Ancient Living One, speak of proofs and evidences, and open her tongue to the mysteries of the Kingdom, so that the spirit of reality may flow through the temple of possibility and the mysteries of what was and what will be may become clear and evident.

Subject: teaching the Cause; call to teach
Quotation: O Ahmad! Ask God to grant thee that whereby the doors of the hearts of men may be opened, and to confirm thee in that which shall cause thy mention to endure throughout the kingdom of earth and heaven. Confine matters to the remembrance of thy Lord, that perchance every sleeping one may be awakened thereby, every seated one may arise, and every heedless doubter may find assurance.

Subject: teaching the Cause; call to teach
Quotation: In brief, thou art really a herald of the Kingdom, a harbinger of the Covenant. Thou art self-sacrificing, and showing kindness to all the peoples of the earth. Thou art now sowing a seed that in the long run will yield thousands of harvests. Thou art now planting a tree that shall everlastingly put forth leaves, blossoms and fruit and whose shadow shall grow in magnitude day by day.

Subject: teaching the Cause; call to teach
Quotation: At present the whole world is endued with the capacity to hearken to the Call of the Abha Kingdom. As a result of the past war a wonderful receptivity hath been infused into all men, inasmuch as the well-being and tranquility of mankind and the establishment of universal peace form the basic foundation of the divine Teachings. All ears are alert for the summons to the Most Great Peace.

Subject: teaching the Cause; call to teach
Quotation: O beloved of my heart! The world's desires have prevented it from recognizing its ultimate end, and wealth hath veiled it from its highest purpose. They cling to a drop while heedless of the ocean; they hold fast to the book while deprived of the Mother Book. What intoxication is this that hath encompassed the world, such that they truly cannot distinguish between the sun and its shadow?

Subject: teaching the Cause; call to teach
Quotation: He became a herald of the Kingdom and hastened to China, India and Japan. Divine confirmations assisted him until he attained such a heavenly bounty. He became the cause of glory for the friends in Baltimore and brought joy and delight to the friends and maidservants of the Merciful. He sacrificed his life in the path of the Kingdom and became the cause of eternal life for certain souls.

Subject: teaching the Cause; call to teach
Quotation: Praise be to God that thou hast observed how thou wert confirmed and assisted in guiding eminent men. The great souls of the world did not find such confirmation nor were they blessed with such success. Praise be to God that the hand of providence hath placed this crown upon thy head. God hath prepared the means from all directions so that thou mightest be confirmed in guiding eminent men.

Subject: teaching the Cause; call to teach
Quotation: Regarding thy question about traveling to various parts of the world for teaching: as much as possible, remain steadfast in Rasht and engage in teaching guidance in those regions. However, if that proves impossible, and there is capacity and means available, then proceed to Paris and America for the purpose of guidance, and manifest complete detachment, so that the word may prove effective.

Subject: teaching the Cause; call to teach
Quotation: At this moment this most exalted Word hath appeared from the Dawning-Place of the utterance of the All-Merciful. Blessed and exalted be His words: O Muhammad-Rida! God willing, thou shalt be enkindled in this time with the fire of the utterance of the All-Merciful - an enkindlement that shall never be extinguished. Thou shalt arise to make amends and in all conditions remain turned toward God.

Subject: teaching the Cause; call to teach
Quotation: Now that you have taken flight, I hope the doctor will also become swift of wing. With the doctor's permission, invite all the friends of God one day and convey to all of them my message of love and longing, and say that I am waiting for New York to become blessed and for the call of firmness in the Covenant to reach all horizons from that city, and for it to become distinguished in every way.

Subject: teaching the Cause; call to teach
Quotation: Therefore, rejoice within thyself that We have named thee the herald of the Cause. Then pass round the crimson wine in My Most Glorious Name between earth and heaven, that thereby may be quickened the spirits of those who, when the verses of their Lord, the Most High, are recited unto them, fall prostrate upon their faces in the dust, submissive before God, the Almighty, the Powerful, the Mighty.

Subject: teaching the Cause; call to teach
Quotation: "Victory is of two kinds: the conquest of strongholds and the conquest of hearts. The conquest of strongholds is easy, for they can be subdued with a certain amount of explosive materials. But the conquest of hearts is difficult, except through the power of the Greatest Name and the hosts that ye cannot see. Therefore, strive thou with heart and soul that thou mayest succeed in conquering hearts"

Subject: teaching the Cause; call to teach
Quotation: Therefore a glorious future is ordained for that land. Thou must, with the utmost attraction, encourage and urge the friends and maidservants of the Merciful to follow the divine counsels, instructions and teachings, that each may become a pure spirit and an embodied light, and may center their attention wholly on the good-pleasure of God, seeking none but Him and walking in no path save His path.

Subject: teaching the Cause; call to teach
Quotation: When thou dost enter a city in India associate with the people in the beginning as a tourist, as a person interested in India and a lover of Indian people and institutions. Meet all those who come to see thee or thou callest on them with sympathy and do not in the least prejudice them. If some one ask thee 'who art thou, and why hast thou come to India.' Answer. 'I am a teacher of the Baha'i Cause.

Subject: teaching the Cause; call to teach
Quotation: It is part of the Divine Wisdom that I should keep silent for a time! All that was required of me, that is, to raise my voice in the churches, synagogues, conventions, and meetings, calling the attention of the people to the Kingdom of God and the appearance of BAHA'O'LLAH--praise be to God! through the confirmation of the Blessed Perfection--is accomplished. Now it is the turn of the believers of God.

Subject: teaching the Cause; call to teach
Quotation: Be thou a lamp of the love of thy Lord amongst His servants, that the receptive ones may be illumined thereby. Consider the lamp: though it be but one, yet from it can be lit, as God willeth, lamp after lamp, all drawing their light therefrom. Deliver unto the people the Cause of thy Lord and deal with them with patience, for they have not attained the summit of utterance and are among the weak ones.

Subject: teaching the Cause; call to teach
Quotation: And concerning what they wrote about sending to various regions accounts of what has befallen the oppressed ones of the world, it was submitted and He said: This is not the first deed to appear from him in the Cause. Praise be to God that with utmost effort he has been and continues to be engaged in manifesting the Cause and its exaltation, the comfort of the friends and the awakening of the heedless.

Subject: teaching the Cause; call to teach
Quotation: The purpose of these utterances is that assured and tranquil souls may arise with the utmost joy and fragrance to teach the Cause of the All-Merciful, expending unlimited effort, that perchance heedless souls may, through the blessing of pure breaths, turn toward the shore of the sea of oneness and become the cause of the appearance of prior grace and mercy and all-encompassing and pervading bounties.

Subject: teaching the Cause; call to teach
Quotation: Gather all the loved ones of the land of Kha around the all-embracing Word, the brilliant gift, the manifest sign and the resplendent banner of the Book of God and the Religion of God, that they may be quickened and refreshed by the fragrances of this supreme bounty and be so enkindled by the fire burning in the Tree of Sinai that each may become a brilliant torch, a rising star, and a shining planet

Subject: teaching the Cause; call to teach
Quotation: For indeed his intentions are good and his aim is service to the human world. Lately he hath become somewhat disappointed and depressed because leaders of religion have rejected him. Perhaps for this reason he may now have acquired the capacity to respond to the influence of the Word of God. If possible Mr. Kenworthy should set out to visit him and speak to him about the foundation of this great Cause.

Subject: teaching the Cause; call to teach
Quotation: Ere long, a wondrous spiritual delight shall appear. When once the divine fragrances wafted through the regions of Bandiyan, that area, being remote and isolated, was left without provisions. For some time no news hath been received. With the utmost wisdom, souls must be sent to those regions so that several who have withered may become fresh and verdant, and a few who have grown cold may be set ablaze.

Subject: teaching the Cause; call to teach
Quotation: Teaching is the Divine command, provided it be undertaken with wisdom... Wondrous and incomparable Verses have been sent down especially for thee. Please God, thou mayest attain unto them all, and, with perfect wisdom and eloquence, engage in service to the Cause - service such as will be permanent and lasting, to the degree that the evanescence of the world and all its vicissitudes shall never change it.

Subject: teaching the Cause; call to teach
Quotation: O Rustam! Though Dastan's Tahmatan was a lion-tamer, yet through physical might his desires were not attained, for in the end a pit became his resting place. Therefore, seize thou the ways of the Most Glorious Beauty and seek the path of that Beloved One - that is, array the heavenly battle lines and become a world-conqueror through the sword of faith, the blade of certitude, and the banner of the Covenant.

Subject: teaching the Cause; call to teach
Quotation: effective initiatives must be undertaken in Baku and Balakhani, indeed throughout the Caucasus, so that souls may benefit from divine favors and, being delivered from the darkness of ignorance and error, may become luminous beings. If you can establish a school for youth to study the art of teaching with Aqa Shaykh Ali-Akbar and become acquainted with divine proofs and evidences, it would be most suitable.

Subject: teaching the Cause; call to teach
Quotation: 'No! let it burn! I am enjoying it! This is the day of my happiness! Let me continue to tell you about Baha'u'llah and his life and his teachings.' I hope that all the believers of God may attain to this exalted station and be so engulfed in the ocean of super-human emotions so as to forget themselves and the world; thus opening the eloquent tongue and receiving the successive assistance of the Kingdom of Abha.

Subject: teaching the Cause; call to teach
Quotation: Lord! Verily, when this servant heard the Call, he cried out: Our Lord! We have heard a Caller calling to faith, saying 'Believe in your Lord,' and we believed. In every moment he longed for martyrdom and strove in Thy path with his life and substance, with a heart firm in faithfulness. He established proof and evidence with all power and authority, brought forth clear arguments and guided to the straight path.

Subject: teaching the Cause; call to teach
Quotation: Call to arise and teach the Cause to bring people to recognition of God's sovereignty, with wisdom and according to their capacity: "Arise and say: O people! By God, the Promise hath come and He Who was promised hath appeared with such sovereignty as neither the might of princes nor the clamor of divines could withstand...God willing, be ye cupbearers of the wine of divine knowledge among the people of the world"

Subject: teaching the Cause; call to teach
Quotation: Say: O people! This is the Day of Teaching. Cast aside what ye possess, clinging to the cord of God, the Lord of the Day of Resurrection. O My loved ones! This is the Day of triumph and the Day of utterance. Arise to teach the Cause of God, and in all conditions bestow with spirit and fragrance, with wisdom and utterance, from the choice sealed wine which hath been unsealed by the finger of the bounty of the Lord.

Subject: teaching the Cause; call to teach
Quotation: Concerning Dr. Fisher about whom you had written, praise be to God you have found an assistant for him and he will soon travel to Germany. Indeed the dear maidservant of God Miss Alma Knobloch is most suitable. It was good that you appointed her as she is suitable in every way. As for the duration of her travel, it should be as long as possible. I hope the efforts of these two sisters will cause tremendous effects.

Subject: teaching the Cause; call to teach
Quotation: Today the promotion of the Cause is beloved, but with wisdom and utterance, so that the divine word may find its place in good soil and spring forth verdant. The friends of God who have drunk from the wine of utterance must exert great effort in teaching the Cause with perfect wisdom. This matter is most important and very great, but with wisdom lest the cawing of the crows and the clamor of the heedless be raised.

Subject: teaching the Cause; call to teach
Quotation: Thy letter concerning the group in Florence, who are interested in the Teachings of Baha'u'llah, was received.
