However, the Teachings of Baha'u'llah have been spread all over the world and you can obtain the translation of some of His Tablets from America, as well as copies of the talks that I delivered in America and Europe, some of which are printed in newspapers and some have already been compiled and published.

Subject: teaching the Cause; call to teach
Quotation: O thou who art firm in the Covenant! In those regions, prevent contention as much as thou canst. Let discussions be about glad-tidings, attraction and ecstasy, so that souls may be moved, and when they show the least turning, arrange that they may associate with each other in the utmost kindliness, love and intimacy. This itself will cause the diffusion of the divine fragrances and the exaltation of the Word of God.

Subject: teaching the Cause; call to teach
Quotation: Indeed, whenever the Baha'is of Iran would go to any town or village, they would specifically engage in teaching until all the people became aware and were stirred to excitement and tumult, raising outcries and clamor. And when the Baha'is were confident that everyone had learned of the Cause and had been moved to agitation, they would then depart from that village or town to other regions and begin teaching in another city.

Subject: teaching the Cause; call to teach
Quotation: O handmaid of God! I beseech God that thou mayest arrange gatherings in San Francisco and speak about the Kingdom of God with the utmost eloquence and fluency, for until thou speakest clearly and openly, souls will not be attracted. O handmaid of God! The divine glad-tidings must be spread with the utmost dignity and nobility, and until one ariseth with all that is required for such proclamation, the words will have no effect.

Subject: teaching the Cause; call to teach
Quotation: You had written that the friends are still engaged in teaching during these difficult times. This is a characteristic of those near to God and a trait of the sincere ones - that they are not prevented by any obstacle nor deprived by any event. Rather, in the utmost hardship and tribulation they engage in promoting the teachings of the Most Exalted Kingdom, and under sword and chain they raise the cry of "O what joy! O what delight!"

Subject: teaching the Cause; call to teach
Quotation: Therefore mention of the Cause to the government is not and has never been permissible. In any case, the seeds of wisdom must be deposited in receptive soil. Verily, He commands what is best for you - act upon it and be among those who are firm. The teaching work is contingent upon several conditions which all must observe, that it may cause acceptance rather than rejection, and extinguish the fire of corruption rather than ignite it.

Subject: teaching the Cause; call to teach
Quotation: All the meetings must be for teaching the Cause and spreading the Message, and suffering the souls to enter in the Kingdom of BAHA'O'LLAH. Look at me. All my thoughts are centered around the proclamation of the Kingdom. I have a Lamp in my hand searching through the lands and seas to find souls who can become heralds of the Cause. Day and night I am engaged in this work. Any other deliberations in the meetings are futile and fruitless.

Subject: teaching the Cause; call to teach
Quotation: All the meetings must be for teaching the Cause and spreading the Message, and suffering the souls to enter in the Kingdom of Baha'o'llah. Look at me. All my thoughts are centered around the proclamation of the Kingdom. I have a Lamp in my hand searching through the lands and seas to find souls who can become heralds of the Cause. Day and night I am engaged in this work. Any other deliberations in the meetings are futile and fruitless.

Subject: teaching the Cause; call to teach
Quotation: She too remembers you and is occupied with your mention. In any case, I beseech God and implore at the threshold of divine glory, supplicating confirmation and success for you, that you may become celestial, heavenly, angelic and divine; that you may be freed from every attachment and released from every preoccupation; that you may remember the Beloved day and night and become accustomed to diffusing the holy fragrances day and evening.

Subject: teaching the Cause; call to teach
Quotation: Therefore thank God for having kindled in the glass of thy heart the lamp of guidance and caused thee to hear the call of the Supreme Concourse from the most glorious Kingdom, until thou wert attracted by the holy fragrances that have perfumed the nostrils of the faithful. Rejoice then in the glad-tidings of God, arise to serve the Cause of God, summon the people to guidance, and be confident in the confirmations of thy Most Exalted Lord.

Subject: teaching the Cause; call to teach
Quotation: You should remain in Mashhad for some time and engage in teaching. Khurasan has been the focus of the favors of the Lord, and the Cause of God spread there more than in other regions. My hope now is that in that land the outpourings of the Ever-Living, the Self-Subsisting Lord will so appear as to illumine plain and wilderness, and that the kindled fire of the love of God will raise its flame to the highest heaven and illuminate all regions.

Subject: teaching the Cause; call to teach
Quotation: Verily, by Truth, every seed cast in this great and magnificent century will be cultivated by God and produce plants through the abundance of the clouds of His mercy, which preceded the postulates, and from which all the existing beings have been awakened and issued, and to which they will return. Therefore, use thy utmost power to sow and cast those pure seeds, the divine teachings, in the hearts which move and cheer by the fragrance of God.

Subject: teaching the Cause; call to teach
Quotation: Therefore he hastened to the realm of the Egyptian Canaan so that in this land the call of the Cause of God and the fame of the appearance of the Most Great Name might be raised, and the holy fragrances might perfume the nostrils... my hope is such that the divine friends in these days will raise an enthusiasm and fervor greater than before, open their tongues to teach the heedless, create another excitement and throw the city into commotion.

Subject: teaching the Cause; call to teach
Quotation: O namesake of Tahmuton! Like Rustam the mighty elephant-bodied warrior who roared in the arena of lions and grappled with living elephants, don thou also the divine helmet of heavenly aid and put on the armor of celestial protection. Draw forth the sword of thy tongue and enter the arena of divine knowledge, engaging in combat with all the peoples of the world, that thou mayest witness the power of the Lord and behold the might of the divine arm.

Subject: teaching the Cause; call to teach
Quotation: Blessed art thou for having composed an epistle in remembrance of thy Lord, the All-Merciful, containing manifest proofs of the appearance of God's Kingdom in this most exalted age with such glory, grandeur and majesty as hath no parallel, reinforced by the hosts of the angels of heaven led by the Cherubim and Seraphim, accompanied by the sound of the Most Great Trumpet--that Trumpet being the Call of the Covenant and the Melody of the Testament.

Subject: teaching the Cause; call to teach
Quotation: The sanctified souls must ponder and reflect upon the methods of teaching. From the divine holy Books they should memorize phrases and passages bearing on various instances, so that in the course of their speech they may recite divine verses whenever the occasion demandeth it, inasmuch as these holy verses are the most potent elixir, the greatest and mightiest talisman. So potent is their influence that the hearer will have no cause for vacillation.

Subject: teaching the Cause; call to teach
Quotation: Now is not the time for interpretation. This is the time of teachings. All the believers must unloose the tongue of teaching the Cause of God. For teaching is the cause of the guidance of all the inhabitants of the earth; teaching is the means of the illumination of mankind; teaching is conducive to the enlightenment of the world of humanity; teaching is productive of the confirmations of the Breaths of the Holy Spirit. This is the most great affair!

Subject: teaching the Cause; call to teach
Quotation: Today, the most important of all matters for you is teaching and the earnestness of students in their studies, for divine confirmation lies in this. It is hoped that the number of seventy students will reach seven hundred, then seven thousand, and the light of manifest knowledge will surge across the entire earth. Look not to yourself, lest weakness become apparent; look to the favors of the Desired One, Who grants extended shade to a blade of grass.

Subject: teaching the Cause; call to teach
Quotation: Even as the cloud that rains its bounty upon the earth, traverse the land from end to end, and shower upon its people the blessings which the Almighty, in His mercy, has deigned to confer upon you. Those whom you find receptive to your call, share with them the epistles and tablets We have revealed for you, that, perchance, these wondrous words may cause them to turn away from the slough of heedlessness, and soar into the realm of the Divine presence.

Subject: teaching the Cause; call to teach
Quotation: The loved ones must, one and all, with spirit and fragrance, with wisdom and utterance, awaken those who slumber and deliver those who waver from the limitations of the polytheists. The former people clung to [names] and were thus deprived of their Goal. Therefore were they barred from the ocean of mercy of the Ancient Lord Who hath appeared through His Most Great Name, and they remain, like the Jewish people, wandering in the wilderness of perplexity.

Subject: teaching the Cause; call to teach
Quotation: Today that which all must arise to accomplish with the utmost power is the guidance of all who dwell on earth unto the shelter of the divine Tree, and the adorning of themselves with the attributes of God, so that the servants of the All-Merciful may appear among the concourse of creation with all the perfections of excellence. Say: Unto everyone who hath believed in God - bring forth the deeds of the sincere ones, if thou be of them that speak the truth.

Subject: teaching the Cause; call to teach
Quotation: For two days we have been spending our time in utmost joy and fragrance with the honored and near handmaiden of God Mrs. Cooper at Mr. Paul's home, engaged in mentioning the Ancient Beauty and speaking of the divine Kingdom with a gathering of the people of this city. We hope through the favors of the Blessed Beauty that this pure seed may sprout forth and through the bounty of the cloud of guidance this plain and mountain may become verdant and flourishing.

Subject: teaching the Cause; call to teach
Quotation: All must hold fast unto wisdom and occupy themselves with teaching the Cause. That which today causeth the clamor of the polytheists and deniers is outside the bounds of wisdom. The people of Baha must at all times partake of the water of life with perfect wisdom and offer it to others. Teaching God's Cause through wisdom is beloved. The soil of hearts and souls must first be prepared for the casting of the seed, and then one may proceed with what is intended.

Subject: teaching the Cause; call to teach
Quotation: Thou knowest, O God of the world and Lord of nations, Who hath been made manifest through the Most Great Name, that I have not been remiss in proclaiming Thy Cause. I summoned the people to the ocean of Thy gifts and the horizon of Thy favors even whilst bound in chains and fetters, whereby We caused all created things to hear the scratching of Thy Most Exalted Pen and revealed unto them that which the dwellers of the cities of names were powerless to recount.

Subject: teaching the Cause; call to teach
Quotation: Now the friends of God must strive night and day to promote the Word of God and diffuse the divine fragrances. This is the important matter, and pursuing anything else will lead to lukewarmness...all the friends must concentrate their thoughts on exalting the Word of God...Focus all effort on what is the greatest of matters, and that is teaching the Cause of God, just as all the blessed Tablets are focused on this - in no Tablet is there mention of anything else.

Subject: teaching the Cause; call to teach
Quotation: O My Name! God willing, steadfast and receptive souls will be assisted to recognize this Most Great Cause. After recognition of God - exalted be His glory - the command to teach is the greatest and most mighty. A witness to its greatness is what God hath revealed in the Book aforetime: 'Whoso quickeneth a soul is as though he had quickened all mankind.' Blessed is he who hath arisen to serve the Cause and hath been moved by the will of God, the Lord of the worlds.

Subject: teaching the Cause; call to teach
Quotation: Those waves beat against the shores of existent beings with the utmost strength and vigour and they shed pearls and precious things. And those hosts of the kingdom beat against the nations and peoples of the world with the utmost power and strength and disperse hosts of opposition. Thus O thou who art possessed of valiant endeavour strive that thou mayest be as a leader of this army as a General of this Host and this is not hard for thy Lord to confirm thee therein.

Subject: teaching the Cause; call to teach
Quotation: In this day that which is acceptable before the Throne is the teaching of God's Cause, and thus hath the Command been ordained by the One Who is the All-Choosing. However, teaching through goodly utterance and exalted mention is acceptable, not through disputation and conflict. Do good even as God hath done good unto you. The triumph of the Cause hath been made to depend upon utterance and mention by the tongue. Thus hath the Command been ordained by the All-Merciful.

Subject: teaching the Cause; call to teach
Quotation: Furthermore, the work of teaching must be extended at all times, for divine confirmations depend upon it. If a soul does not arise with utmost dedication to teach the Cause of God, he will surely be deprived of the confirmations of the Abha Kingdom. But teaching must be done with wisdom. Wisdom means teaching through divine moderation, love, kindness, patience, forbearance, heavenly attributes and godly deeds and actions - not through silence and complete forgetfulness.

Subject: teaching the Cause; call to teach
Quotation: Now it is your turn - you must kindle their lamp and burn away the veils of the people and store up spiritual treasure and seek your daily portion and sustenance from the heavenly table. Travel to India provides great opportunities - if in those regions you engage in explaining the clear verses, open eloquent speech, and expound the mysteries of divine wisdom, be aflame and attracted and enkindled and occupied, take no rest day or night and lay not your pillow of comfort

Subject: teaching the Cause; call to teach
Quotation: If the friends of God act in accordance with the teachings of Baha'o'llah, become confirmed in guiding the nations, ever serving the cause of the oneness of the world of humanity and ever offering their assistance toward the establishment of international peace, undoubtedly Los Angeles will become a center of the kingdom, the lights of divinity will shine, the heavenly manna will descend, and you will attain to that which was the utmost desire of sages and heavenly ones.

Subject: teaching the Cause; call to teach
Quotation: Today is the day of assistance, and assistance hath never been nor shall be by the sword, for in this Most Great Manifestation all are forbidden from corruption, contention and strife. In truth, the purpose of holy war in every age hath been to guide people to the Divine Court, even if by force. However, in such case it would not be known who became intoxicated with the wine of Divine mercy and turned toward God, and who entered beneath the blessed Tree by force and chains.

Subject: teaching the Cause; call to teach
Quotation: At the first encounter with any soul, it is not permissible to disclose everything, for his station and rank are yet concealed. One must speak such words as would cause attraction and encouragement, so that what is hidden within him may be revealed. Only after such manifestation should the Word of the Beloved be conveyed. Were this Name to be mentioned at the outset, assuredly would clamor be raised. While some may be attracted, others would most certainly engage in mischief.

Subject: teaching the Cause; call to teach
Quotation: O Shahriyar! Raise thy call, for the age of the manifestation of Baha'u'llah is the revelation of the Beloved and the diffusion of His musk-laden fragrance throughout the world. Praise be to God that thou hast arisen to teach the Cause of God, engaged in service, raised high the standard of servitude, and rushed forth into the vast arena until thou didst accomplish the work of others - that is, thou didst become the cause of the guidance of souls and the means of enlightening hearts.

Subject: teaching the Cause; call to teach
Quotation: According to reports, the regions of India have attained boundless capacity. If possible, with the Most Great Glad-Tidings and the power of confirmation from the Abha Kingdom, direct thy steps to those regions for a time and guide receptive souls with sufficient and satisfying utterances. This is contingent upon thy being able to travel with the utmost joy and fragrance; otherwise, remain at thy present post where thou art still a servant of the Cause and a diffuser of its fragrances.

Subject: teaching the Cause; call to teach
Quotation: O ye two firm ones in the Covenant! Your letter was received. Praise be to the Lord of Divine Purpose that, like the morning breezes and the fragrance of flowers, ye traversed every region and district of that land. Souls were perfumed, hearts were illumined, and spirits were gladdened. The passage of steadfast friends, like springtime clouds, makes the lands fertile, sets barren and lifeless soil in motion, and adorns it with the flowers and sweet herbs of inner meanings and realities.

Subject: teaching the Cause; call to teach
Quotation: Your letter was received and from its contents it became known that you have guided one of the maid-servants of the All-Merciful, Mabel Wise, to the light of guidance. Well done! For this is the highest attribute of the human world - that you should guide souls to the divine Kingdom, offer them an overflowing cup of the wine of the love of God, and cause them to attain eternal life. This work is enduring and permanent, while all else that you have seen and heard is transient and impermanent.

Subject: teaching the Cause; call to teach
Quotation: Let the friends and handmaidens be steadfast and firm in Faith. Let them, like Mary Magdalene, galvanize the disciples of this Day to serve the Most Perspicuous Light that the musk-laden fragrance of His breath may perfume the world and His manifest light may shine across those regions. Then shall the light of bounty truly shine and the grace of heaven be manifest. Then will the penetrating power of the Word of God be seen by all and the power of the hosts of the Concourse on High be evident.

Subject: teaching the Cause; call to teach
Quotation: Say: O concourse of men! By God, this is the Day of victory and triumph. Aid your Lord through that which We have revealed in the Scriptures and Books and in this glorious and wondrous Tablet. All must hold fast to the propagation of the Cause and present proofs and evidences of this Most Great Revelation and of Him Who sacrificed His life for My sake. The divine verses are effective - in one station they are the Water of Life for the servants, and in another the Teacher of all created things.

Subject: teaching the Cause; call to teach
Quotation: That which is needed today is to prevent the servants from turning towards the Most Exalted Horizon. In truth I declare and with the tongue of reality I mention that every lover who is enkindled with the fire of longing and attainment must act according to what was previously mentioned. By the life of God, in this case he will be recorded by the Supreme Pen in the Crimson Book as one of those who have attained His presence and meeting, and as one of the companions of witnessing and hearkening.

Subject: teaching the Cause; call to teach
Quotation: power/influence of a single soul in teaching the Cause; spiritual prerequisites of teaching the Cause<<you have traveled to various regions and scattered the fragrance of mysteries and the perfumed musk throughout the world. You have passed through every country and bestowed abundant bounty. Like the cloud of guidance, you have freely and generously showered the drops of supreme guidance upon every land, and like the morning breeze, you have stirred and awakened souls in every clime you reached

Subject: teaching the Cause; call to teach
Quotation: The loved ones in that land, that is the land of T, must become so enkindled with the fire of divine love that the waters of the world would be powerless to extinguish it, and must be so steadfast that the whisperings of devils and the schemes and plots of the croakers would not hinder them. By the life of God! Today an atom is able to attain the station of the sun, and a drop is empowered to achieve the greatness of the sea, for the effulgences of the Sun of Revelation have encompassed the world.

Subject: teaching the Cause; call to teach
Quotation: O servant present! The poetry and prose of Ali-Qabl-i-Akbar exude from each line the fragrance of devotion, and every word thereof bears true witness to humility and submissiveness before God, the Lord of all worlds. Give him glad tidings of the acceptance of what flowed from his pen in remembrance of this Remembrance, round whom circles the Faithful Spirit. O Ali-Akbar! Upon thee be My glory! Illumine and kindle the friends of God with the light of recognition and the fire of the Divine Lote-Tree.

Subject: teaching the Cause; call to teach
Quotation: O Muhammad! Hear the divine call in the Persian tongue. The days are passing, and all that is witnessed returneth to nothingness. Strive that perchance thou mayest succeed in performing a deed that will be adorned with the ornament of divine acceptance and good-pleasure. Today the ocean of generosity surgeth before all existence, and the lights of the Sun of grace shine forth and gleam from the horizon of the heaven of bounty. Arise for the sake of God and awaken the heedless servants for His sake.

Subject: teaching the Cause; call to teach
Quotation: Give thanks to God that you are successful in serving the Sacred Threshold, sacrificing yourself in His servitude, familiar with the holy fragrances, and divinely assisted. Should you observe any slackening in people's response, be not saddened, but continue sowing these pure seeds. Assuredly they will flourish and this garden will bear fruit. We are commanded to sow the seeds; their growth rests with God. Surely one day the rain of mercy and the warmth of the Sun of Truth will cause them to sprout.

Subject: teaching the Cause; call to teach
Quotation: And because he began to teach openly and boldly, they hung a halter on him and led him about the streets and bazars of the city. Even in that condition, composed and smiling, he kept on speaking to the people. He did not yield; he was not silenced. When they freed him he left Shiraz and went to Khurasan, and there, too, began to spread the Faith. Ismu'llah did not slacken under fire. Once freed, he taught more widely than ever. He spent every waking breath in calling the people to the Kingdom of God.

Subject: teaching the Cause; call to teach
Quotation: I cherish the hope that by whatever land thou passest, thou mayest, even as vernal showers, revive every human soul and cause it to become verdant and refreshened; or as the life-imparting breeze, reinvigorate the feeble and the sick. Mayest thou scatter in every clime the perfume of the love of God; raise aloft the standard of the oneness of mankind; uproot every form of prejudice, sectarian, national, racial or political; and promote the cause of love and unity amongst the diverse peoples of the world.

Subject: teaching the Cause; call to teach
Quotation: Let us serve the Beloved for a time. In the Qur'an He says: "O you who believe! When the call is made for prayer on Friday, then hasten to the remembrance of God and leave off trading." Therefore in this Most Great Day one must engage in the most mighty prayer which is the teaching of God's Cause. By God the Truth! This indeed is a profitable trade, perfect wealth, conquering sovereignty, brilliant glory, an enduring kingdom, an established throne, and a mighty station with every person of mighty portion.

Subject: teaching the Cause; call to teach
Quotation: Azerbaijan is in a state of agitation and has attained great receptivity. Multiple teaching gatherings are needed. Some of the friends must establish bonds of fellowship with the prominent people of the country and show them utmost love, so that they may become informed of the ways of the Baha'is, the teachings of the All-Merciful, and the penetrating influence of the Word of God throughout all the world. When one such soul becomes attracted, others will soon be transformed, for people follow their leaders.

Subject: teaching the Cause; call to teach
Quotation: You guided people to the living waters, the manifest light, and the path of the Beloved of those drawn nigh, until souls were guided, hearts were attracted, and spirits rejoiced... You composed a work proving the manifestation of the Most Great Name in the world of creation, demonstrating through clear proofs, conclusive arguments, transmitted traditions and revealed verses the appearance of the Promised One... Then you migrated from your familiar homeland to other lands to spread the fragrances of guidance.

Subject: teaching the Cause; call to teach
Quotation: As to what thou didst write concerning Faridan being far from the equator and therefore cold by nature - the Sun of Truth passeth directly overhead in all lands, its heat is equal in all climes, and its rays strike at acute angles. When thou considerest carefully, thou wilt observe that the lands most remote from the Dayspring of lights are, outwardly, the western regions. Yet now thou canst see what enthusiasm, rapture and attraction have been raised up in the western lands, and what melodies have been lifted up!

Subject: teaching the Cause; call to teach
Quotation: Fresh tidings have arrived that Ardabil has received its portion and share from the lights of the Glorious Lord and has acquired new illumination from the manifest horizon. This news had such an effect that tears of joy were shed and hearts were gladdened, for praise be to God, that region has become the dawning-place of stars and those frontiers have become the niche of light. Those regions have become the dawning-place of divine fragrances and those meadows and plains have become the rose-garden of the love of God.

Subject: teaching the Cause; call to teach
Quotation: The initiative you have taken in sending teachers to various regions is most beloved and acceptable, and this is among the greatest services to the Court of the Intended One, for it is the sowing of seeds and the diffusion of divine fragrances. The teachers are truly arranging battle lines at the frontiers and are an active army, not a stationed force. Through the power of supreme guidance, they conquer the fortresses and strongholds of hearts and perfume the nostrils of the people of all regions with holy fragrances.

Subject: teaching the Cause; call to teach
Quotation: O thou herald of the Call! Proclaim "Come ye unto prosperity," for the gates of the Kingdom are opened wide and the lights of the Realm of Might are streaming forth from the Invisible Domain of Grandeur. The lamp of favors is gleaming bright within the glass of teaching, and the hosts of divine confirmation accompany him who speaks forth the Most Great Name. As much as thou art able, diffuse the divine fragrances and strive with all thy might to spread the lights of the Kingdom of God and exert effort in all directions.

Subject: teaching the Cause; call to teach
Quotation: O bright pearl! Arise with utmost striving and hasten to the Kingdom of thy Lord, thy Lord of manifest, clear and evident signs. By God the Truth, every seed that is sown in this glorious age will be made to grow by God through the bounty of His clouds of mercy which preceded all contingent things, and from which and through which all existing things were awakened and issued forth, and unto which they shall return. Therefore strive to sow the pure seed of divine teachings in hearts that are stirred by the breaths of God.

Subject: teaching the Cause; call to teach
Quotation: Furthermore, today that honored one must gather the scattered letters unto the comprehensive Word, and exert the utmost effort in this mighty endeavor. Travel throughout the lands is necessary and obligatory, for satanic gems in human temples have set out to lead people astray. Though the hosts of God have been and shall ever be victorious, such that if today a single soul remained steadfast in this Cause, he would have power over all souls. Nevertheless, the decree of striving and conveying the message is never abrogated.

Subject: teaching the Cause; call to teach
Quotation: The foundation of the spiritual meetings must be the teaching and delivering of the Cause of God. In these meetings the believers and maid-servants of the Merciful must proclaim the proofs and arguments and explain the signs of the appearance of the Beauty of Abha--May my life by a sacrifice to the beloved ones! But the fundamental principle of the establishment of spiritual meetings is for the sake of teaching and delivering the Truth so that those souls who are present may become informed of the Divine Evidences and Proofs.

Subject: teaching the Cause; call to teach
Quotation: When the friends do not endeavour to spread the message, they fail to remember God befittingly, and will not witness the tokens of assistance and confirmation from the Abha Kingdom nor comprehend the divine mysteries. However, when the tongue of the teacher is engaged in teaching, he will naturally himself be stimulated, will become a magnet attracting the divine aid and bounty of the Kingdom, and will be like unto the bird at the hour of dawn, which itself becometh exhilarated by its own singing, its warbling and its melody.

Subject: teaching the Cause; call to teach
Quotation: The friends may become the manifestors of the qualities of the Merciful and Clement and arise in the service of all humanity; nay, rather they must be most kind toward the animals; for verily His mercy hath encompassed all things. A number of the merciful friends forsook their material tranquillity and composure and traveled from city to city, nay, rather, village to village, in order to diffuse the fragrances of God. These souls, endowed with such pure spirits, became the objects of the commendation of the Supreme Concourse.

Subject: teaching the Cause; call to teach
Quotation: The matter of teaching, which is among the most momentous of all matters, has in God's Book been made contingent upon wisdom. He says: With wisdom and utterance. First wisdom, then utterance. Man can refresh the dispirited with the waters of grace and quicken the dead with the living waters without uttering what would be objectionable in the estimation of men. And He said: Blessed is he who giveth the people to drink from the sea of the utterance of the All-Merciful without speaking a word that would cause rejection and objection.

Subject: teaching the Cause; call to teach
Quotation: O thou whose breast is dilated by the Fragrances which have wafted from the Kingdom of God! Verily thy gracious letter reached me and I prayed God to confirm thee to guide the people to the Dawning-Place of Lights; to satisfy the thirsty ones with pure and peaceful water; to lead the sick to the Glorious Physician; to guide those who are led astray unto the Path; to give drink to all who thirst from this heavenly spring; and to feed every hungry soul with this heavenly food which hath descended from the heaven of thy Lord, the Glorious!

Subject: teaching the Cause; call to teach
Quotation: It is binding and incumbent upon such souls to arise with the utmost endeavor and wisdom to awaken the people of the world from the slumber of heedlessness through goodly remembrances and guide them to the Source of mercy. And if ye observe among those who have turned to God a soul who is capable of teaching this irresistible Cause of God and is adorned with the qualities mentioned in the Tablets, his turning to various regions for the purpose of spreading the Cause according to the wisdom revealed in the Tablets hath been and will be beloved.

Subject: teaching the Cause; call to teach
Quotation: May the Glory of God illumine him! He that hath arisen to serve the Cause of the Ancient Beauty must be steadfast and unwavering in his purpose, and consider not aught save His good-pleasure. He must not allow the censure of the froward to deter him from his path, nor suffer the praise of people to deflect him from his goal. He must with the utmost wisdom testify to the truth of His Cause and proclaim the verities of His Faith. He must not rest until the banner of His Lord be unfurled in every land and His Faith be established throughout all regions.

Subject: teaching the Cause; call to teach
Quotation: Stand thou firm in the Cause of God like unto a tree firmly rooted, with massive trunk, widespread branches and abundant fruits, that thou mayest become a manifestation of that which the glorious Lord hath said in the Gospel: "By their fruits ye shall know them." The fruit today is the knowledge of God and the effulgences of His ancient Kingdom. Therefore, render thanks unto God for having caused thee to yield such fruits and for having illumined thy countenance with these effulgences, and for having made thee a teacher of His Cause in those regions.

Subject: teaching the Cause; call to teach
Quotation: And if thou perceivest the sweet fragrance of holiness from God's Tablet and its influence, then cleanse thyself in the living waters that flow from this fountain of camphor, this Salsabil whose source God hath made His Pen of Command, and from which He hath manifested that which purifieth the hearts of them that are possessed of true knowledge. Then detach thyself from all who are in the heavens and on earth, and be thou a herald among the servants of this Tablet which hath appeared and shone forth from the horizon of the finger of transcendent glory.

Subject: teaching the Cause; call to teach
Quotation: Today ye hearken unto that which in no other time could be heard. Strive ye that ye may attain unto everlasting remembrance... Although the Cause of Truth has never needed and needs not the help of others, and will soon become evident like fire upon a mountain, yet the likes of this servant who spent precious life engaging in forbidden pursuits should take heed from the utterances of the Revealer of verses and engage in teaching God's Cause, that perchance they may quicken dead souls with the water of life and adorn the heedless with the ornament of awareness.

Subject: teaching the Cause; call to teach
Quotation: The Baha'is are practiced sailors and trained fishermen who with the net of the Love of God and the strength of the Word of God deliver the poor fishes from the whirlpool of destruction and bring them to the haven of salvation. The Baha'is are displaying great effort and manifesting far-reaching magnanimity. The Confirmation of the Blessed Beauty is their net, Unity and Concord is their bait; attraction and enkindlement is their trap, service and self-sacrifice is their reliance. They cast their net into this great, turbulent sea and day by day are delivering new fishes.

Subject: teaching the Cause; call to teach
Quotation: "O thou who believest in God! When thou readest the Tablet of thy Lord and art seized by the breezes of the Spirit that waft from the direction of the verses from the traces of thy Lord, arise to teach by Our command and be not among the patient ones...Deliver unto the people the remembrance of thy Lord, the Most Merciful, and fear not the manifestations of Satan...When thou openest thy tongue in utterance, then shall the Holy Spirit confirm thee, and the Spirit of Glory shall teach thee from the direction of eternity, and the Spirit of Truth shall speak upon thy tongue."

Subject: teaching the Cause; call to teach
Quotation: thou art a speaker, not silent, and successful in serving the school of human oneness. Thou must thank God that thou art honored with such a service, even though there are countless difficulties...You had given glad tidings of the unity and harmony of the friends in Isfahan - that the teaching study circle is illumined, and Aqa Mirza Inayatu'llah is the flower of the rose garden, and the nobles' gathering is radiant through the efforts of his honor Rahbar, and teaching gatherings are established in the home of Aqa Mirza Nasru'llah and the residence of his honor Isfandiyar.

Subject: teaching the Cause; call to teach
Quotation: Give thanks unto God that thou wert enabled to compose this treatise, to render such a notable service at the Threshold of the Divine Unity, and in this Most Great Cycle to leave behind a work that shall, like a banner in all ages and centuries, promote the hidden mystery. If it were possible for several knowledgeable souls in every city to gather together in meetings when opportunity allowed, and ever discourse on proofs and demonstrations and the evidences of the All-Merciful, it would greatly expand minds. However, speech must be confined to this subject and kept within bounds.

Subject: teaching the Cause; call to teach
Quotation: And thou, O servant, hearken unto the call of thy Lord, then detach thyself from all that hath been created between earth and heaven. Then summon the people unto this Cause through which the sun of the Bayan hath shone forth from the horizon of thy Lord's will, the Mighty, the Bountiful, and the Cock of the Throne hath crowed in this Paradise which hath appeared in the name of God, the Almighty, the Exalted, the All-Wise. Beware lest anything prevent thee from the remembrance of thy Lord. Stand thou firm in the Cause with steadfastness from Us, and fear not the hosts of the polytheists.

Subject: teaching the Cause; call to teach
Quotation: The Baha'is of Persia would travel to every city and hamlet expressly to teach the Faith. They would persist in their efforts until all the people there had been informed of the Faith - and, as a result, these people would at times be roused to agitated excitement, engaging in assaults, issuing words of slander, and raising great clamours. When the Baha'is were certain that all the people in that area had been apprised of the Faith, and had been stirred to their cores after learning of it, they would depart from that place and travel to another where they would continue to teach the Faith.

Subject: teaching the Cause; call to teach
Quotation: It behooveth him who desireth to journey for the sake of God, to deliver His Word and quicken the dead, to cleanse himself with the water of detachment and adorn his temple with the ornament of resignation and contentment. Let his armor be reliance upon God, his provision trust in Him, his garment the fear of God, his helper patience, his succorer virtuous character, and his hosts righteous deeds. Then will the Concourse on High sustain him, and the denizens of the Kingdom of Names will move with him, while the standards of glory, victory and triumph will march before him and at his right hand.

Subject: teaching the Cause; call to teach
Quotation: Through God's boundless favor, thy devotion hath been accepted and thy pilgrimage approved. This is from God's grace which He bestoweth on whomsoever He willeth. Journey to this land is not permitted in these days, for conditions are and have been unsettled. Since thou hast attained unto this station, which is the station of God's testimony, having achieved union and meeting, strive that thou mayest succeed in teaching His Cause, for this duty hath been enjoined upon all according to their capacity and station. However, this must be done in accordance with the principles revealed in the divine Tablets.

Subject: teaching the Cause; call to teach
Quotation: O thou who art firm in the Covenant! Praise be to God that thou art sacrificing thyself in the path of God and yearning for the altar of love. Although thou art in Kermanshah where danger threatens and thou art deprived of rest and comfort due to the onslaught of enemies, and though thou mayest spend thy days in another city, yet Kermanshah is in great need of teachers. The few respected souls who were there have also dispersed. If several souls, in the utmost purity and detachment, with perfect steadfastness and constancy, and with the greatest wisdom, were to spend their days in that land, great results would certainly be achieved.

Subject: teaching the Cause; call to teach
Quotation: Therefore one must gird up the loins of service to the Cause with the utmost power, might and endeavor, and like a conquering lion and victorious beast, raise a mighty roar in this thicket of Divine Unity. Raise thou a mighty roar like a lion, O lion of Truth! Until that roar ascendeth unto the seventh sphere--nay, I ask God's forgiveness--until that mighty cry reacheth unto the Kingdom of Abha and the Dominion on high, and until the voice of praise from the assemblies of the Supreme Concourse, the gatherings of the Most Exalted Dominion, and the retreats of the Kingdom of His transcendent oneness reacheth the ears of the people of God.

Subject: teaching the Cause; call to teach
Quotation: He is God! O thou candle of guidance! Guidance is the love of the Beauty of Oneness. Praise be to God that its lamp is lit within thy heart, and that the gift of guidance leadeth to the path of the Kingdom. Praise be to God that through this bounty thy heart is like unto a rose garden and meadow. Put forth a hand from thy sleeve and scatter the treasure of the spirit throughout the regions of the world. Put thy tongue and utterance to use in promoting the religion of God and exalting the Word of God, that thou mayest, like unto a polished sword, conquer territories and, like unto the morning breeze, bestow fresh life upon yearning hearts.

Subject: teaching the Cause; call to teach
Quotation: And concerning what you wrote about teaching the Cause, we beseech God to confirm you in this mighty matter. O My beloved! The heart of this evanescent one is aflame like a blazing fire, for we observe that the Truth is manifest, the Kingdom of utterance is resplendent, and the Day of God is witnessed; yet souls who purely for the sake of God remind people and call them to the truth are as rare as the philosopher's stone. How many lands have remained without cultivation and tillage, how many lands were tilled and cultivated but remained without water, and how many lands whose harvest time has come but there was no harvester to harvest them!

Subject: teaching the Cause; call to teach
Quotation: Strive that perchance ye may quicken the dead in the valleys of heedlessness through the infinite waters of mercy flowing from the Divine Pen, and revive the withered plants. By the life of God! That which had ever been preserved and concealed within the treasury of divine protection and the repository of heavenly wisdom hath been made manifest. Hold fast to the propagation of the Cause of God. Praise be to God, thou art enkindled with the heat of His Word, adorned with its light, and aware of its manifestation and exaltation. In the nights and days thou shouldst be occupied with conquering hearts and minds through the hosts of knowledge, wisdom and utterance.

Subject: teaching the Cause; call to teach
Quotation: The believers with the utmost steadfastness and firmness must engage in the teaching of the Cause. Now all aims must verge toward one spring, and all efforts be centralized in one object, and that is: the diffusion of the Fragrances of the Merciful, and the promulgation of the Word of the Almighty. The aim of all the friends must be this: -- the diffusion of the Fragrances of Holiness. When a man's efforts are concentrated on this one object, he will undoubtedly reflect the confirmation of the Manifest Light. Except for the guidance of souls, no other cause is equally confirmed. If any person entertains other thoughts than this, he will unquestionably regret them.

Subject: teaching the Cause; call to teach
Quotation: Shouldst thou have in thy possession a copy of the Narrative, send him thereof however much he wisheth, and write to him that Mirza Abu'l-Fadl hath composed a treatise concerning this Cause, which hath been translated, and printed in America. Let him request it of the friends in Paris, and likewise the book Some Answered Questions, which hath been rendered into the French and English tongues. If he is able, let him render the Narrative into the German tongue and likewise the translation of the Tablets ?arazat, Tajalliyat, Kalimat, Bisharat, and Ishraqat. In fine, whatever books there are about this Cause may be found with Mr. Dreyfus in Paris: Let him obtain them from him.

Subject: teaching the Cause; call to teach
Quotation: O my Lord! This is a servant whose very being hath been stirred by the breezes of Thy sanctity, whose vision hath been illumined by beholding the signs of Thy oneness, whose heart hath taken wing through excessive longing for the kingdom of Thy uniqueness, who hath guided Thy creatures to the word of Thy sanctification, who hath directed the seekers to the fountain of Tasnim, who hath called out Thy name amongst the worlds, whom the might of the oppressors hath not frightened, and whom the power of the evil divines from among the most loss-bearing people hath not prevented from calling out Thy name, from guiding others to Thee, from detachment unto Thee, and from humility before Thee.

Subject: teaching the Cause; call to teach
Quotation: And while translating the words with Mirza Asadu'llah in gatherings, thou mayest raise thy call and lift up thy voice, crying: O people! The lights of Truth have shone forth! The verses of Truth have appeared! The ocean of grace is surging! The Sun of Reality hath shed its radiant beams! The horizon of existence hath been illumined! The face of the earth hath become a shining page! The divine springtime hath pitched its pavilions with infinite majesty! The cloud of mercy is pouring down its rain! The Orb of bounty is radiating its splendor! The breeze of eternal life is wafting! The gates of the divine Kingdom are flung open! How long will ye remain withered and faded? Awake! Awake! Be vigilant! Be vigilant!

Subject: teaching the Cause; call to teach
Quotation: The importance of this Tablet will be revealed in the future. In these vast sixteen states the lights of the Sun of Reality shall shine with great power and the dark clouds of ignorance and human prejudices will be dispelled from its horizon. The believers of God with the utmost firmness and steadfastness must go forth and teach the heavenly institutes to the inhabitants of the South. Every person in accordance with his capability and ability must engage in teaching the Cause of God and show an effort in the illumination of the souls, so that praiseworthy results may appear and become manifest from him. I desire nothing else from the believers of the states save teaching the Cause of His Highness, the Almighty.

Subject: teaching the Cause; call to teach
Quotation: The way to serve the world of humanity is the way that is paved by Baha'o'llah. The path of Baha'o'llah is the path of unification and peace. It is the path of the oneness of the realm of humanity. It is the path of the investigation of Reality. It is the path of equality between the children of men. It is the path of corresponding religion with science, and it is the path of the Manifestation of the protection of the Holy Spirit. It is the road toward the life eternal. It is the road of being born from the world of materiality into the World Divine; and it is the world of baptism with the Holy Spirit. Walk in this road. Such a straight path! Such an illumined path! Such a spiritual path! Walk in it; I instruct you.

Subject: teaching the Cause; call to teach
Quotation: O physician, O beloved! Why dost thou not cry out with thy soul and strive with heart and body? When wilt thou seek a better time than this, and search for an opportunity more pleasant? The pearl-scattering clouds of the Supreme Kingdom are pouring down their bounties, and the limitless ocean of the Lord is bestowing its gifts. The life-giving breeze of divine favors is wafting, and the heat of the Sun of Truth is shining with utmost brilliance. When wilt thou find a better time than this to scatter seeds, when the moment thou sowest, they spring forth, becoming green and verdant, forming ears of corn, ready for harvest and yielding abundant sheaves? Make trial of this, put it to the test, and observe how it will grow!

Subject: teaching the Cause; call to teach
Quotation: Through the grace and great bounty of the Almighty Lord, He has raised up souls who, with the utmost vigor, might and power, arise to serve the Sacred Threshold, who hasten to excel in the field of servitude, and who seek to outrace one another in the vast expanse of devotion to the Most Glorious Kingdom. Now that the gaze of favor has encompassed all and the rain of bounties has poured forth, and this radiant crown of grace has been bestowed, you must not rest for a moment day or night, nor draw a single breath in repose, nor lay your head upon the pillow of comfort, nor seek ease in the bed of tranquility. Day and night you must remain in a state of supplication and entreaty, passing your time in the greatest spirituality.

Subject: teaching the Cause; call to teach
Quotation: It would be well-pleasing if one or two steadfast, upright and united souls who are adorned with the ornament of utterance were to arise in that land to teach the Cause with wisdom and eloquence. The friends themselves are unaware of certain matters, as even until now some have not understood the meaning of wisdom, and others know not the cause and reason of this Revelation. A steadfast believer and wise expounder should occupy themselves with refining the souls of the friends and awakening the heedless, that the light of recognition, sanctification and detachment might dawn from the horizons of hearts, and all may attain unto certitude and know that God, exalted be His glory, has come for reformation, not for corruption and strife.

Subject: teaching the Cause; call to teach
Quotation: That which thou hadst written was noted and became the cause of joy and gladness. Indeed, the verses were in the utmost eloquence and eloquence, and from the gardens of their meanings the life-giving fragrance of the love of God was inhaled, for they were in praise of the Light of Truth and in glorification of the Center of Divine Mercy, and were a call to the peoples of the world, inviting them to enter into the impregnable stronghold. Although this call which thou hast raised hath not many hearers in those regions at present, yet know thou of a certainty that ere long multitudes will respond to thy call with yea, and will chant this anthem with the most delightful melody and song, bringing the world to a state of joy and gladness.

Subject: teaching the Cause; call to teach
Quotation: One day in New York, we were invited to a church. A nobleman from India who had come to New York and changed his attire saw that we were going to church and thought we were going to become Christians. He became very distressed. He followed behind to see what was happening. When he came to the church, he heard the minister say that this person has come from the East and will present new teachings. Listen and see what he has to say. As it happened, in that church we proved the prophethood of Muhammad. This nobleman was astounded that the prophethood of Muhammad was proven before thousands of souls in a church. When we came down, he mentioned with great joy and delight that this was what he had thought. He was very pleased and declared his faith.

Subject: teaching the Cause; call to teach
Quotation: Arise to serve thy Lord's Cause in that far-off land, and call unto thy Lord with clear, sufficient, adequate and guiding utterance to the straight path and the right way. By God the Truth! The hosts of the Supreme Concourse will assist thee, the angels of the Abha Kingdom will succor and make thee happy, and the dwellers of the holy precincts praise thee, pray for thee and regard thee. Therefore gird up thy loins, tuck up thy sleeves, make for the lands of the All-Merciful, speak with proof, illuminate eyes by witnessing the signs, remind the righteous of the Kingdom of Light, and remove the veil from the eyes of the wayward, that perchance they may be guided by the light of guidance in this glorious age and peerless cycle, the dawning-place of the manifest morn and the source of thy Lord's gifts, the Mighty, the Praiseworthy.

Subject: teaching the Cause; call to teach
Quotation: O Lord! This is a servant broken by Thy Cause, a slave intoxicated with the wine of Thy love, submissive before the door of Thy oneness, excelling in teaching Thy Manifestation, speaking Thy proofs and evidence, and humble before Thy might and sovereignty. He travels through the land fearing not arrest, calling out with eloquent tongue and spreading proof with persuasive speech. Every seeker listens to him and every pursuer is convinced by his proof. He ceaselessly moves from cities to villages, crossing hills and mountains and deserts, calling people to guidance, never tiring in Thy remembrance morning and evening, but joining night to day, speaking with most eloquent words, spreading Thy decisive proofs among people of understanding, bearing every affliction and remaining patient under trials even should hunger and thirst destroy him.

Subject: teaching the Cause; call to teach
Quotation: As a teacher of the Faith, he spoke with such eloquence, such extraordinary power, that his hearers were won over with great ease. After he had come to Baghdad and attained the presence of Baha'u'llah, he was seated one day in the courtyard of the men's apartments, by the little garden. I was in one of the rooms just above, that gave onto the courtyard. At that moment a Persian prince, a grandson of Fat?-'Ali Shah, arrived at the house. The prince said to him, Who are you? Ismu'llah answered, I am a servant of this Threshhold. I am one of the keepers of this door. And as I listened from above, he began to teach the Faith. The prince at first objected violently; and yet, in a quarter of an hour, gently and benignly, Jinab-i-Ismu'llah had quieted him down. After the prince had so sharply denied what was said, and his face had so clearly reflected his fury, now his wrath was changed to smiles and he expressed the greatest satisfaction at having encountered Ismu'llah and heard what he had to say. He always taught cheerfully and with gaiety, and would respond gently and with good humor, no matter how much passionate anger might be turned against him by the one with whom he spoke. His way of teaching was excellent.

Subject: teaching the Cause; call to teach
Quotation:
You are the bearers of the name of God in this Day. You have been chosen as the repositories of His mystery. It behoves each one of you to manifest the attributes of God, and to exemplify by your deeds and words the signs of His righteousness, His power and glory. The very members of your body must bear witness to the loftiness of your purpose, the integrity of your life, the reality of your faith, and the exalted character of your devotion. For verily I say, this is the Day spoken of by God in His Book: 'On that day will We set a seal upon their mouths yet shall their hands speak unto Us, and their feet shall bear witness to that which they shall have done.' Ponder the words of Jesus addressed to His disciples, as He sent them forth to propagate the Cause of God. In words such as these, He bade them arise and fulfil their mission: Ye are even as the fire which in the darkness of the night has been kindled upon the mountain-top. Let your light shine before the eyes of men. Such must be the purity of your character and the degree of your renunciation, that the people of the earth may through you recognise and be drawn closer to the heavenly Father who is the Source of purity and grace. For none has seen the Father who is in heaven. You who are His spiritual children must by your deeds exemplify His virtues, and witness to His glory. You are the salt of the earth, but if the salt have lost its savour, wherewith shall it be salted? Such must be the degree of your detachment, that into whatever city you enter to proclaim and teach the Cause of God, you should in no wise expect either meat or reward from its people. Nay, when you depart out of that city, you should shake the dust from off your feet. As you have entered it pure and undefiled, so must you depart from that city. For verily I say, the heavenly Father is ever with you and keeps watch over you. If you be faithful to Him, He will assuredly deliver into your hands all the treasures of the earth, and will exalt you above all the rulers and kings of the world.' O My Letters! Verily I say, immensely exalted is this Day above the days of the Apostles of old. Nay, immeasurable is the difference! You are the witnesses of the Dawn of the promised Day of God. You are the partakers of the mystic chalice of His Revelation. Gird up the loins of endeavour, and be mindful of the words of God as revealed in His Book: 'Lo, the Lord thy God is come, and with Him is the company of His angels arrayed before Him!' Purge your hearts of worldly desires, and let angelic virtues be your adorning. Strive that by your deeds you may bear witness to the truth of these words of God, and beware lest, by 'turning back,' He may 'change you for another people,' who 'shall not be your like,' and who shall take from you the Kingdom of God. The days when idle worship was deemed sufficient are ended. The time is come when naught but the purest motive, supported by deeds of stainless purity, can ascend to the throne of the Most High and be acceptable unto Him. 'The good word riseth up unto Him, and the righteous deed will cause it to be exalted before Him.' You are the lowly, of whom God has thus spoken in His Book: "And We desire to show favour to those who were brought low in the land, and to make them spiritual leaders among men, and to make them Our heirs.' You have been called to this station; you will attain to it, only if you arise to trample beneath your feet every earthly desire, and endeavour to become those 'honoured servants of His who speak not till He hath spoken, and who do His bidding.' You are the first Letters that have been generated from the Primal Point, the first Springs that have welled out from the Source of this Revelation. Beseech the Lord your God to grant that no earthly entanglements, no worldly affections, no ephemeral pursuits, may tarnish the purity, or embitter the sweetness, of that grace which flows through you. I am preparing you for the advent of a mighty Day. Exert your utmost endeavour that, in the world to come, I, who am now instructing you, may, before the mercy-seat of God, rejoice in your deeds and glory in your achievements. The secret of the Day that is to come is now concealed. It can neither be divulged nor estimated. The newly born babe of that Day excels the wisest and most venerable men of this time, and the lowliest and most unlearned of that period shall surpass in understanding the most erudite and accomplished divines of this age. Scatter throughout the length and breadth of this land, and, with steadfast feet and sanctified hearts, prepare the way for His coming. Heed not your weaknesses and frailty; fix your gaze upon the invincible power of the Lord, your God, the Almighty. Has He not, in past days, caused Abraham, in spite of His seeming helplessness, to triumph over the forces of Nimrod? Has He not enabled Moses, whose staff was His only companion, to vanquish Pharaoh and his hosts? Has He not established the ascendancy of Jesus, poor and lowly as He was in the eyes of men, over the combined forces of the Jewish people? Has He not subjected the barbarous and militant tribes of Arabia to the holy and transforming discipline of Muhammad, His Prophet? Arise in His name, put your trust wholly in Him, and be assured of ultimate victory. BBU0001
become the cause of guidance for others

Subject: teaching the Cause; call to teach
Quotation: You opened your tongue in proof and established clear evidences and decisive arguments for the appearance of the Promised Beauty. You wrote apologetic treatises and spread them throughout all the countries of the world.

Subject: teachings as spirit of the age
Quotation: When His Holiness Baha'o'llah appeared he gave forth the declaration concerning the oneness of the world of humanity. He expounded the principles of international peace. He sent epistles to the kings and rulers.

Subject: teachings as spirit of the age
Quotation: Consider His Holiness Baha Ollah and His teachings. They are the spirit of this cycle, the light of this century, and they illuminate the dark corners of humanity. Whosoever has heard them has confessed that these teachings are in accord with the spirit of this period.

Subject: teachings as spirit of the age
Quotation: At a time when the Orient was in the dark night of cataclysmic ignorance, His Holiness BAHA'O'LLAH, like unto a glorious sun, shone forth from the eastern horizon. In the midst of contention and the clashing rivalries of the Oriental peoples he boldly proclaimed the doctrine of the oneness of the world of humanity.

Subject: teachings as spirit of the age
Quotation: Consider His Holiness Baha'o'llah and his teaching. They are the spirit of this cycle - the light of this age. They illumine the dark places of humanity, for they address themselves to the heart of the race. For instance, the greatest evil of this century is war. In the new age Baha'o'llah has prohibited war. The need of this century is universal peace - Baha'o'llah has instituted it.

Subject: teachings as spirit of the age
Quotation: Thou shalt see with the eyes of joy that the bird of the love of God has spread its wings on all horizons as a result of the teachings of Baha'u'llah, because they are the spirit of the world of being in the body of mankind, and the light that is shining upon the horizons of creation.

Subject: teachings as spirit of the age
Quotation: For all the teachings of the Blessed Beauty are peace and amity, justice and equity, the progress of humankind, advancement in the degrees of illumination, the proclamation of the oneness of the world of humanity, the promotion of useful sciences, the spread of universal knowledge, the expansion of innovations and crafts, and the abandonment of religious, racial, national and political prejudices.

Subject: teachings as spirit of the age
Quotation: He proclaimed the oneness of mankind. He announced that all humanity are the sheep of One Shepherd, and God is the only true Shepherd. Baha'o'llah proclaimed the ideal of universal peace among religions. The fundamental principle of religion is one and the same—all the prophets guided mankind to divine love. They have called them to the knowledge of God. They have taught them the unity of the human race.
