Quotation: One must endure the internal difficulties, calamities and afflictions of the Baha'is which are greater than martyrdom. Inner troubles and afflictions increase day by day. Until now, I alone have endured and continue to endure them.

Subject: tests and trials; sacrifice and suffering
Quotation: In any case, it is inevitable that this journey will bring much hardship and difficulty, but God willing, it will not last long and some comfort will eventually be attained. Either one must endure hardships or seek comfort and ease.

Subject: tests and trials; sacrifice and suffering
Quotation: Tribulations are evident from every direction, and afflictions are countless and beyond reckoning. By the life of the Beloved, the arrows of the enemies fly at all times, and hardships and distress stand before Our face night and day.

Subject: tests and trials; sacrifice and suffering
Quotation: Should the sea of tests become almost overwhelming, it must not have any effect upon them. Call them to steadfastness and firmness in the Cause of God so that the calamities and hardships may not become the cause of their relaxation.

Subject: tests and trials; sacrifice and suffering
Quotation: Man must become accustomed to all things, and taste of both the cold and heat, the joy and sorrow of the world, and turn not away from fullness or hunger. When he has accustomed himself to all things, then shall he find contentment...

Subject: tests and trials; sacrifice and suffering
Quotation: Thou art he who heard the blame of the blamers in the path of God... by the hearts that are entangled in separation from Thee, and by the livers that melted in remoteness from Thee, and by the breasts that faced the arrows in Thy path

Subject: tests and trials; sacrifice and suffering
Quotation: Tribulations in God's path, exalted be His glory, distinguish and make manifest the lovers from the people of the world, and set apart the steadfast from those who waver. It is the true Distinguisher, the All-Knowing, the All-Powerful.

Subject: tests and trials; sacrifice and suffering
Quotation: And if some have stumbled and do stumble at trials and tests, such souls have not in truth attained unto this station. For instance, if one truly heareth the cooing of the dove, he will surely not be deterred by the croaking of animals.

Subject: tests and trials; sacrifice and suffering
Quotation: We have accepted to be tried by ills and troubles, that ye may sanctify yourselves from all earthly defilements. We have sustained the weight of all calamities to sanctify you from all earthly corruption, and ye are yet indifferent.

Subject: tests and trials; sacrifice and suffering
Quotation: I have accepted all tribulations and desired afflictions in their most severe form. Were We to detail this station, sorrows would overtake you, therefore We have veiled and do veil it. Verily thy Lord is the Concealer, the Responsive One.

Subject: tests and trials; sacrifice and suffering
Quotation: We have indeed tried men with Our signs. Say: Those who follow the Command of God - these are they who are guided. And those who follow their idle fancies - God will never accept any of their deeds, and these are they who are the losers.

Subject: tests and trials; sacrifice and suffering
Quotation: "Thou art he who didst drink from the cup of tribulation for the love of God, the Sovereign of the Kingdom of Names, and didst bear hardships purely for His sake...Thou art he who wast my partner in tribulation and in chains and fetters."

Subject: tests and trials; sacrifice and suffering
Quotation: If occasionally, in accordance with the exigencies of God's consummate wisdom, an untoward incident should befall the friends, it would undoubtedly serve as a means whereby divine gifts and heaven-sent bounties will be vouchsafed unto them.

Subject: tests and trials; sacrifice and suffering
Quotation: The shocking news of this grave calamity has arrived, causing profound grief and sorrow to all hearts. Undoubtedly it has deeply affected your honor and caused great distress. Yet these divine decrees are based on an all-encompassing wisdom.

Subject: tests and trials; sacrifice and suffering
Quotation: O servant! Grieve not for what hath befallen thee, for there hath befallen Us what hath befallen no one before... Know thou that God hath ordained for this Revelation souls whom neither the winds of trials nor the tempests of tests can move.

Subject: tests and trials; sacrifice and suffering
Quotation: This year some tests will arise, for in every year they are tested once or twice...tests are the means of adorning the beauty of the lovers, and tribulation and persecution are the cause of spirituality and faithfulness of the yearning ones.

Subject: tests and trials; sacrifice and suffering
Quotation: Know thou that trials are like winds which, after their passing, cause weak souls to fall from the divine Tree. Though outwardly the tribulations endured in the path of God appear as fire, their inner reality hath been and ever shall be light.

Subject: tests and trials; sacrifice and suffering
Quotation: The disorder in your affairs is solely so that you may share in the trials and tribulations of 'Abdu'l-Baha, for in times of ease and comfort every soul would participate, keep company, show friendship, act in accordance, and remain steadfast.

Subject: tests and trials; sacrifice and suffering
Quotation: Glory to Thee, O my God! But for the tribulations which are sustained in Thy path, how could Thy true lovers be recognized; and were it not for the trials which are borne for love of Thee, how could the station of such as yearn for Thee be revealed?

Subject: tests and trials; sacrifice and suffering
Quotation: O my God! Thou seest that the descendant of Mahmud hath been seized with trembling and shock from every stubborn enemy, and the space hath become straitened unto him through the intensity of tribulation and the abundance of cruelty and estrangement

Subject: tests and trials; sacrifice and suffering
Quotation: Verily in the trials of the Lord of all possibilities at all times are signs for all who dwell in the worlds. He hath accepted hardship for the ease of all created things, and difficulty for the comfort of all who dwell in the realm of possibilities.

Subject: tests and trials; sacrifice and suffering
Quotation: Now it has been several years in that city that those souls have perpetrated against the party of Akka that which none but God knows. Yet in all conditions, praise be to the Goal of the world Who aided us to patience, forbearance, calm and tranquility.

Subject: tests and trials; sacrifice and suffering
Quotation: for due to the abundance of sorrows and trials, I have been remiss and even negligent in writing replies...Everyone has their test, and every claim requires proof and evidence. Praise be to God, like pure gold you have shone forth in the flame of tests

Subject: tests and trials; sacrifice and suffering
Quotation: From this blessed verse it is clear and evident that whoever travels the divine path, the wealthy become poor, not the poor wealthy - it works in reverse...poverty, abasement, tribulation and trials are essential requirements of sacrifice in God's path

Subject: tests and trials; sacrifice and suffering
Quotation: "Ye have been made homeless, suffered anguish, and lost all your possessions because ye surrendered your comfortable homes and sheltering nests to the hands of pillagers and plunderers. Ye have borne a grievous calamity and sustained a cruel injustice."

Subject: tests and trials; sacrifice and suffering
Quotation: who have patiently drunk from the cup of bitterness at the hands of enemies, out of love for Thy Beauty, submission to Thy Majesty, passionate devotion to Thy love, persistence in Thy remembrance, seeking Thy good-pleasure and acquiescence to Thy decree

Subject: tests and trials; sacrifice and suffering
Quotation: Never hath thy test occurred to My mind, be thou assured of this. And whatsoever thou imaginest to be a test is not so - there is a wisdom in it that if any soul were to discover it, that soul would itself declare that this is the very essence of wisdom.

Subject: tests and trials; sacrifice and suffering
Quotation: Though you expressed the hardships of traveling to Baghdad...this dust of sorrows settle, and this wandering be transformed into rest...this upheaval of circumstances will be transformed into tranquility, and this agitation of heart be changed to assurance.

Subject: tests and trials; sacrifice and suffering
Quotation: Ye have borne hardships and carried afflictions in the path of the Beloved of all possibility...There hath befallen you what befell the Truth, and this is a station which the concourse of the near ones and the sincere ones have yearned for and hoped to attain.

Subject: tests and trials; sacrifice and suffering
Quotation: Grieve not for what hath befallen thee in the path of thy Lord. By God! Those who are nigh unto Him yearn for tribulations in the paths of God even as the thirsty yearn for the Kawthar of God's mercy, and as the suckling babe yearneth for its mother's breast.

Subject: tests and trials; sacrifice and suffering
Quotation: Though heart and soul have become the target of arrows and spears, yet it is in the path of the Beloved, and in the way of the Kind Friend...Though home and dwelling were laid waste...Therefore every blow that befalls one's being in the path of Truth is a bounty

Subject: tests and trials; sacrifice and suffering
Quotation: A group from Qazvin submits that if we deny this true Cause in our province, we may perhaps be able to remain with a thousand mockeries and taunts, otherwise they deem our death obligatory. Those who fear not strive in God's path and fear not the blame of any blamer.

Subject: tests and trials; sacrifice and suffering
Quotation: Thy hardships in this journey are boundless and limitless and mighty difficulties are evident and manifest. Yet since the intention is for God and in God's path, every difficulty becometh easy and every hardship bringeth comfort to the heart and joy to the conscience.

Subject: tests and trials; sacrifice and suffering
Quotation: From the recompense of thirteen hundred years' deeds hath weakness resulted. Had our deeds been worthy of the court of the Self-Sufficient, the Supreme, assuredly the might of polytheism would not have seized us, nor would we have been afflicted with countless trials.

Subject: tests and trials; sacrifice and suffering
Quotation: We are a company of homeless wanderers, exiled and afflicted with hardship. Although we have been scattered from our homeland, yet we have gathered together in the rearing of this edifice. Although we are bewildered and afflicted, yet our faces are turned towards Thee

Subject: tests and trials; sacrifice and suffering
Quotation: Man must endure if he would obtain treasure. Unless the friends are self-sacrificing, wonderful signs will not become manifest. The Blessed Beauty, Baha'o'llah, was fifty years in hardships and afflictions. He quaffed from every cup of calamity and suffered every pain.

Subject: tests and trials; sacrifice and suffering
Quotation: Even the Sword is no test to the Persian believers. They are given a chance to recant; they cry out instead: 'Ya Baha'u'l-Abha!' Then the sword is raised -- they cry out all the more 'Ya Baha'u'l-Abha!' But some of the people here are tested if I don't say 'How do you do?'

Subject: tests and trials; sacrifice and suffering
Quotation: My heart was saddened and the hearts of the devoted ones were distressed by the painful events and afflictions and tribulations that you had described. But, O my dear one, these tribulations are in the path of the Blessed Beauty. Do you know how sweet and precious they are?

Subject: tests and trials; sacrifice and suffering
Quotation: The people of the earth know not what hath come to pass. The religious leaders have prevented the hapless souls from the straight path and deprived them of the ocean of utterance. All that they have endured in the path of God in these days is recorded at the Most Holy Court.

Subject: tests and trials; sacrifice and suffering
Quotation: O servant! Blessed art thou, inasmuch as hardships have touched thee in the path of God, and thou hast borne difficulties in the ways of His good-pleasure... In times when hardships and trials descend, we must be patient, and in times of comfort and ease we must be grateful.

Subject: tests and trials; sacrifice and suffering
Quotation: The world's harm is severe and frightful for its people, but for the people of Paradise it hath been and shall ever be a blessing, exaltation and glory. Soon shall sorrows be transformed into spirit and fragrance, and grief and care into the grace of His Name, the Self-Subsisting.

Subject: tests and trials; sacrifice and suffering
Quotation: for that port fell into the crucible of tests and oppressors extended their hands of tyranny, sparing no effort in causing harm and cruelty... They have plunged into seas of hardship and calamity and fallen under the claws of fierce beasts and into the clutches of ravenous wolves.

Subject: tests and trials; sacrifice and suffering
Quotation: The gloating of enemies and reproach of the unfaithful are like medicine for the sick - though bitter at first, it becomes sweet in the end. Whatever befalls one in the path of the love of God is a blessing...One must endure every hardship and tribulation with patience and gratitude.

Subject: tests and trials; sacrifice and suffering
Quotation: By Thy might! It is as though I see this station of mine as the summit of Paradise, for whoever is able to praise Thee cares not for the displeasure of Thy servants, and whoever finds delight in intimacy with Thy presence misses no good thing in the presence of the realm of Thy might.

Subject: tests and trials; sacrifice and suffering
Quotation: This abasement is eternal glory, this humiliation is everlasting forgiveness, and this captivity is divine freedom...But that nightly captivity was better than a thousand years of comfort in the embrace of temporal glory, for this captivity brings in its wake a hundred thousand virtues

Subject: tests and trials; sacrifice and suffering
Quotation: Suddenly and unexpectedly a furious and raging torrent rushed down from the height of the mountain sweeping everything before it. The waters fought their way down the rocks with great impetuosity... We sat steadfastly in our places, sometimes the turbulent water reaching to our necks.

Subject: tests and trials; sacrifice and suffering
Quotation: Now that tribulations come successively and calamities follow one after another, and we are deprived of comfort from every direction and are ever in great peril, it becomes clear and manifest that we had no desire save the field of sacrifice and seek no joy but in laying down our lives.

Subject: tests and trials; sacrifice and suffering
Quotation: For every precious and valuable thing has its thieves lying in wait...This unique gem, which is the love of God, must be preserved from thieves and traitors through His Most Great Name. For in most lands, clamor has been raised and the croaking of the ravens has become manifest and evident.

Subject: tests and trials; sacrifice and suffering
Quotation: O Muhammad-Sadiq, the Wronged One is seen beneath the claws of hatred. At every moment there hath befallen Him that which melteth the hearts to recount. In all circumstances We are grateful and patient. Whatsoever hath occurred or may occur in the path of God is the cause of joy and gladness.

Subject: tests and trials; sacrifice and suffering
Quotation: For in this year many souls who counted themselves among the assured shall return to the abode of fancy, and many servants who deemed themselves possessed of knowledge shall turn to the seat of ignorance. For the mighty touchstone of God hath appeared, separating and distinguishing every atom.

Subject: tests and trials; sacrifice and suffering
Quotation: Be not grieved if the affairs are made difficult and troubles have waxed intense upon thee from all sides! Verily thy Lord changeth the hardships into facility, troubles into ease and afflictions into greatest composure. Tests and trials shall soon arise, blessed are those who endure patiently!

Subject: tests and trials; sacrifice and suffering
Quotation: And if you wish to be established upon the throne of praise, there is no prevention for one like you, but knowledge of the intensifying directions of tests is true. So I beseech God to remove those false presentations through His grace - verily He is the Possessor of praiseworthy sanctification.

Subject: tests and trials; sacrifice and suffering
Quotation: O servant of the Truth! On the path of God you have been subjected to hardships and difficulties, and have wandered through mountain and desert. This is from the utmost divine favor, that a servant among His servants should traverse the wilderness in His path of love and become lost and wandering.

Subject: tests and trials; sacrifice and suffering
Quotation: Through Mr. Yunis Khan, to Mr. Mirza Mehdi, son of Malik al-Mutakallimin, upon him be Baha'u'llah's glory. O wanderer from home, your letter was received and its contents made known that you are distressed due to severe hardship. You are right - exile is full of affliction, but one must endure it.

Subject: tests and trials; sacrifice and suffering
Quotation: Until the severity of winter, snow, blizzards, ice, cold and uprooting winds intensify and the air becomes harsh, the life-giving spring will not come... Until these severe tests arise and the cry of the weak reaches heaven and the wavering ones appear, the banner of the Covenant will not be raised

Subject: tests and trials; sacrifice and suffering
Quotation: Grieve not because of tribulations. Through them God hath distinguished between the sincere ones and the doubters. Erelong shall the unitarians behold the glory of their souls and the loftiness of their station, and that which hath been ordained for them from the presence of a Mighty, Powerful One.

Subject: tests and trials; sacrifice and suffering
Quotation: I swear by His heart-entrancing countenance and His musk-scented locks that this fire is light itself, and this deadly poison is the pure wine and camphor-tempered nectar. Therefore, give thanks unto God that thou art a partner in tribulations and trials, and a companion in hardships and calamities.

Subject: tests and trials; sacrifice and suffering
Quotation: However, from another perspective, ye know what a tempest the hardship of life in these days representeth. Iran is in ruins, nay rather, all the regions of the world are in turmoil. As the poet sayeth: Tumult and sedition pervade every atom of the universe. Therefore, be not saddened by this hardship.

Subject: tests and trials; sacrifice and suffering
Quotation: How are you? I am very glad to see you. I am well excepting this broken leg which has kept me in bed a long time. I am impatient to be up and out to work for the Cause. You must not be sad. This affliction will make you spiritually stronger. Do not be sad. Cheer up! Praise be to God, you are dear to me.

Subject: tests and trials; sacrifice and suffering
Quotation: The tests of God are surrounding you from all directions and many afflictions have occurred...anybody can be happy in the state of comfort, ease, health, success, pleasure and joy; but if one will be happy and contented in the time of trouble, hardship and prevailing disease, it is the proof of nobility.

Subject: tests and trials; sacrifice and suffering
Quotation: We hope that, God willing, through His blessed favors He may desire to detach us from all directions, and in the places of tests - which cause all hearts, mysteries, and realities of Prophets, near ones, and sincere ones to tremble in fear - make us firm and steadfast in His love, that our feet may not slip.

Subject: tests and trials; sacrifice and suffering
Quotation: All those sanctified souls who attained to the station of glory, are those who gave up their material joy, physical pleasures, comfort, rest and even life for the sake of the Truth. They were subjected to the utmost ignominy, oppression, imprisonment, their possessions were pillaged and many of them were martyred.

Subject: tests and trials; sacrifice and suffering
Quotation: As evidenced throughout the entire text, particularly: "I call upon Thee when calamities descend from the clouds of Thy decree and tribulations rain down from the heavens of Thy command" and "I find no sweetness save in the descent of Thy trials, and I behold no glory except in the appearance of Thy tribulations."

Subject: tests and trials; sacrifice and suffering
Quotation: Through thy calamity surged the ocean of sorrows and blew the winds of forgiveness. Thou art she who soarest in the atmosphere of My love, who turnest toward My face, and who speaketh in My praise! We have sent down for thee a remembrance which the vicissitudes of centuries and the events of ages shall not efface.

Subject: tests and trials; sacrifice and suffering
Quotation: "When God loves a servant, He tests him." Though thou art physically sick and ill... Many of God's loved ones were afflicted with this ailment, but as they were blessed with true spiritual health, they paid no heed to it. Rather, they offered thanks that they became the target of trials and the manifestation of tests."

Subject: tests and trials; sacrifice and suffering
Quotation: Be not grieved at what hath befallen you in the path of the Desired One of the world. Death shall overtake all, and its agility shall encompass all. Blessed is the state of one who hath harmed no one and who endureth harm from these base people in God's path, and who holdeth fast to the cord of patience and resignation.

Subject: tests and trials; sacrifice and suffering
Quotation: Gracious God! How strange that every calamity and tribulation, rather than causing one to languish, hath instead imparted strength and vitality, and every affliction, far from weakening and debilitating, hath granted fresh capacity and renewed vigor. This is among the mysteries of God and a token of His consummate wisdom.

Subject: tests and trials; sacrifice and suffering
Quotation: "The great majority of people are like rootless trees. They can be uprooted with the slightest gale that blows but those trees which have their roots spread deep and wide and are strong and firm, such trees will never be shaken by any wind and will despite the storms continue to sprout forth leaves and branches and fruit."

Subject: tests and trials; sacrifice and suffering
Quotation: Such tumult and murmur will certainly not remain without incidents and events, and such thunder and lightning and rain cannot exist without storms. Inevitably events will sometimes occur... Until self-sacrifice and endurance of hardships in this mortal world occur, joy and success in the divine world will not be realized.

Subject: tests and trials; sacrifice and suffering
Quotation: Indeed, it is difficult to endure hardship after ease, but one must share in the trials and tribulations of the beloved Friend - this is necessary and must be one's portion. Therefore, if difficult days befall you, this is due to the blessing of your destiny. Be not sorrowful - these days more bitter than poison shall pass.

Subject: tests and trials; sacrifice and suffering
Quotation: They have trodden the path and endured the burning fire that they might attain the best of companions and raise Thy remembrance in that far-off land, and guide a company of seekers to the path of guidance in the promised age. They have fallen under the claws of ravening wolves and the talons of fierce and destructive beasts.

Subject: tests and trials; sacrifice and suffering
Quotation: O Lord! Verily Thy chosen servants and noble ones have long plunged into the seas of tribulation and been immersed in the depths of trials. No day has passed save that the cup of oppression was passed round unto them, and no night has fallen save that they lay prostrate in the dust of abasement at the hands of the malevolent.

Subject: tests and trials; sacrifice and suffering
Quotation: O Letter of Ba! Hearken unto the call of Him Who summoneth thee at a time when the dogs of the earth from every direction have gathered against Him with claws of strange hatred... And thou, O Baqir, grieve not for what hath befallen Us, and be not of them who are distressed in tribulation nor of them who are content therewith.

Subject: tests and trials; sacrifice and suffering
Quotation: From the beginning of the dawning of the Day-Star, thou didst become illumined by the lights of the recognition of the Beloved of all horizons, didst shatter the idol of vain imaginings, and in the path of the Beloved of the worlds, didst endure severe hardships and difficulties and taste the bitterness of trials and tribulations.

Subject: tests and trials; sacrifice and suffering
Quotation: Successive calamities have befallen you, unrelenting hardships have been your lot, and ye have endured the most vehement persecution. Tests and trials must be borne with patience and long-suffering; nay, we should offer thanks that, praise be to God, for His sake, we have been graciously made the targets of such severe afflictions

Subject: tests and trials; sacrifice and suffering
Quotation: There has befallen Us in this land that which has befallen no one else. To this bears witness every fair-minded and discerning soul. Every day have We quaffed from the cup of tribulation that which none but God, the All-Informed, knows. Blessed is he who has borne tribulations in the love of God. He is worthy of this exalted station.

Subject: tests and trials; sacrifice and suffering
Quotation: 'Abdu'l-Baha is in boundless joy and delight from this calamity and tribulation, for after the Ascension of the Blessed Beauty, the prosperity and happiness of the loved ones of God lies in turmoil and tribulation and endless adversity. That is, the pit is the ascent to the moon, and the mat of abasement is the throne of sovereignty.

Subject: tests and trials; sacrifice and suffering
Quotation: Grieve not over what hath befallen thee. Reflect upon what thy Lord hath endured in manifesting His Cause. God is well aware of thine exile from thy native land and thy drawing nigh unto another land. Grieve not on this account. This is what God hath written for Himself, as thou seest Him in the land of exile in a far-off prison.

Subject: tests and trials; sacrifice and suffering
Quotation: And matters have reached such a state that I am cut off from all the delights of earthly blessings, and if I desire to drink water, I drink from my heart's blood, and if I wish to take food, I eat from a piece of my liver. All this, O my God, is from those things which have befallen me in Thy love and descended upon me in Thy service.

Subject: tests and trials; sacrifice and suffering
Quotation: those souls who have been afflicted with all manner of tribulations in the path of God...Since ye have taken the cup of tribulation in the path of the Lord of Names and have drunk therefrom...Since ye have drunk from the ocean of sorrows...Blessed is the soul whom the loss of all things deterreth not from that whereunto he was created.

Subject: tests and trials; sacrifice and suffering
Quotation: Though you have been persecuted, made homeless, and humiliated, this was in the path of that loving Friend. However much the oppressors persecute you, still the faithful and loving Friend will bestow this healing ointment upon that wound, and counter that poison with this sweet nectar. Were it any other way the souls could not develop.

Subject: tests and trials; sacrifice and suffering
Quotation: I thank Thee, O my God, in these days when the oppressors among Thy creation and the rebellious among Thy creatures have gathered against us, and rejoice in what Thou hast sent down upon us of the mysteries of Thy decree and the gems of Thy ordination, after this hath been Thy way with Thy loved ones and Thy custom with Thy chosen ones.

Subject: tests and trials; sacrifice and suffering
Quotation: Be thou happy in the face of troubled affairs, for disturbance itself ultimately leads to prosperity and development, and scattered thoughts become the cause of focused attention. Such is the principle and law in the Cause of God: every abasement is glory, every poverty is wealth, every dispersion is unity, and every ruin is prosperity.

Subject: tests and trials; sacrifice and suffering
Quotation: "shun every comfort save hardship in the path of Glory... flee from every blessing save tribulation in the love of Glory, and quench thy thirst from no spring save the spring of trials in the Cause of Glory. Satisfy thyself with no food save the pieces of thine own liver through the intensity of pain and calamities in the path of Glory"

Subject: tests and trials; sacrifice and suffering
Quotation: This was a general tempest which submerged the entire Egyptian realm. Many possessors of wealth became destitute, many companies sustained losses, the rich became poor, and the mighty were brought low. The point is that this was a universal tempest, not a particular one - an unexpected calamity, not an anticipated one in any human heart.

Subject: tests and trials; sacrifice and suffering
Quotation: The purpose of sacrifice and offering in the cycle of His Holiness Abraham was the station of sacrifice, not butchery and bloodshed. This is the mystery of sacrifice, and the mystery of sacrifice has limitless meanings. Among them is freedom from self and passion, and giving one's life in the path of guidance, and detachment from all save God.

Subject: tests and trials; sacrifice and suffering
Quotation: By Thy might and Thy majesty! Had patience not been destined for me in these days, I would have been rent asunder more swiftly than an egg would break upon a rock. And thus it was decreed. When I perceived that the oppressors were intent upon my death, I migrated from that land unto this place, where I witnessed what Thou knowest better than I.

Subject: tests and trials; sacrifice and suffering
Quotation: Indeed, you are right, and such calamities that have become dominant from every direction have not occurred in any age...In any case, indeed severe blows have befallen you and I hope that at every moment you will freely sacrifice a hundred lives in the path of that Life-cherishing Beloved and have endured and will endure the greatest afflictions.

Subject: tests and trials; sacrifice and suffering
Quotation: What tribulations were endured and what afflictions were visited from before - assuredly you have heard. And in this realm too I stand alone before the enemies, surrounded on all sides by foes, with none to help Me. At every moment We await the surrender of this earthly frame to those who claim it, that We might take Our abode in the divine nest.

Subject: tests and trials; sacrifice and suffering
Quotation: All the sufferings you pass through in gaining the Kingdom of God will be obliterated when you attain its perfect happiness. It is as a man who has been ill and helpless for two or three years and afterwards becomes well and strong, then all remembrance of his pain vanishes. Whatever troubles we have on our way to the Kingdom are a test to the soul.

Subject: tests and trials; sacrifice and suffering
Quotation: Indeed, that renowned one showed great determination in that city and was exiled for teaching. What glory for him! What honor for him! What nobility for him in that he achieved exile in the path of his Glorious Lord! One must follow the example of the Most Great Beauty in bearing trials. Through tribulation, the face of Glory is ignited and illumined.

Subject: tests and trials; sacrifice and suffering
Quotation: Tribulation in our days is not strange, but safety therein is the strangest of all strange things. This is evidence of nearness to the Divine Threshold and of being enkindled by the fire burning in the Tree of Sinai. Give thanks to God that you have become the target of persecution and trials in the path of God, and subjected to curses and afflictions.

Subject: tests and trials; sacrifice and suffering
Quotation: Your sincere and trusted servant - his unity has been scattered by successive tribulations, his gathering dispersed by repeated destiny and decree, his ease transformed to hardship, afflictions and adversities repeatedly visited upon him, his strength has weakened, his supports shaken with anguish, and crises have intensified upon him from all directions.

Subject: tests and trials; sacrifice and suffering
Quotation: If you reflect upon what befell the Manifestations of old, trials, exile and affliction shall become easy for you. Consider what the All-Merciful revealed in the Qur'an - His exalted Word: 'We shall surely try you' to the end of the verse. Likewise in previous Books, all that hath occurred and shall occur in the world hath flowed from the Most Exalted Pen.

Subject: tests and trials; sacrifice and suffering
Quotation: Successive afflictions have withheld the pen of the Most High from laying bare that which is hidden from the eyes of Thy creatures, and incessant trials have hindered the tongue of the Divine Ordainer from proclaiming the wonders of Thy glorification and praise. But for tribulations, how could the assured be distinguished from the doubters among Thy servants?

Subject: tests and trials; sacrifice and suffering
Quotation: Blessed are they who have tasted the food of tribulation in the path of the Lord of Names. By the truth itself, they are the triumphant ones, they are the knowing ones, they are the near ones, they are the sincere ones. One must beseech the Truth at all times, by night and by day, to keep him steadfast that he may be enabled to preserve what has been bestowed.

Subject: tests and trials; sacrifice and suffering
Quotation: "Praise be to God Who hath trained His loved ones in His path through adversity and tribulation, that all may fix their gaze upon Him and turn unto Him in all conditions, whether in hardship or ease, in poverty or wealth." "In truth, the station of the lovers and their characteristics have become and are becoming evident and manifest through trials and tribulations"

Subject: tests and trials; sacrifice and suffering
Quotation: Then God tested them in the secret of secrets and tried them with the spirit of spirit through something more subtle than spirit and brighter than light. Then they became veiled from beholding the Divine Presence and were removed from the court of reunion and meeting, and descended from the thrones of glory, and were barred from the wellspring of the spirit of glory.

Subject: tests and trials; sacrifice and suffering
Quotation: If thou seeketh the living waters of the fountain of life, hasten into the darkness of trials. If thou desirest the martyrdom of Karbila, plunge into the sea of tribulation and calamity. Whatever conditions, events, occurrences, calamities and trials may arise in the path of God - all serve to strengthen divine confirmations and are glad-tidings from the Glorious Lord.

Subject: tests and trials; sacrifice and suffering
Quotation: The more difficulties one sees in the world the more perfect one becomes. Therefore, the more sorrows one sees the more perfect one becomes. That is why, in all times, the Prophets of God have had tribulations and difficulties to withstand. Therefore I am happy that you have had great tribulations and difficulties. For this I am very happy--that you have had many sorrows.

Subject: tests and trials; sacrifice and suffering
Quotation: The righteous ones are detached and the true lovers are happy when they meet suffering in the path of the All-Merciful Beloved... without these trials they could not attain the station of true submission... the friends have attained this degree of submission and have submitted their all in the path of the True One and are radiantly acquiescent in sacrificing their lives.

Subject: tests and trials; sacrifice and suffering
Quotation: Praise be to God Who has strengthened His loved ones through tribulation and elevated their station through the manifestation of trials in the kingdom of creation, that He might test those who claim belief and who confess with their tongues His singleness and oneness. This is a Day wherein the secrets of hearts are tried and that which is hidden in the breasts is revealed

Subject: tests and trials; sacrifice and suffering
Quotation: Verily God cannot be doubted, and everyone who claimeth faith must needs be tested and tried until their truthfulness is distinguished from others. I have distinguished among all people through the words There is no God but God and I have sent to one - therefore seek ye him, for he is rarer than red sulphur. For red sulphur cannot save you, but this one can be your salvation.

Subject: tests and trials; sacrifice and suffering
Quotation: Indeed at that moment such souls will rejoice with exceeding gladness and will be so carried away by the joyful tidings of God that they will wing their flight to the heaven of eternal glory with the utmost ecstacy, exultation and spiritual blissfulness... these calamities and sufferings are a glorious diadem whose glittering gems will shed lustre upon ages and centuries to come

Subject: tests and trials; sacrifice and suffering
Quotation: I know what hardship and difficulty you are in, but since it is in the path of the All-Merciful Lord, it is the very essence of joy. He caused the sea of tribulation to surge for His own precious Self, and out of pure bounty ordained a drop of that ocean for us. And for the earth is a portion from the cup of the noble ones. Without this, the world would not become a supreme paradise.

Subject: tests and trials; sacrifice and suffering
Quotation: You did not know that you would fall into such severe trials and become caught in such mighty tribulations... Indeed, were it not for the trials in the divine path, with what would the palate of the lovers of beauty be sweetened? And were it not for drinking the cup of tribulations and pains in the love of the All-Merciful, with what would the taste of the yearning ones be delighted?

Subject: tests and trials; sacrifice and suffering
Quotation: We are but a handful of dust and a scattered, homeless group without refuge or safe shelter. The arrows of oppression fly from every direction and the flood of cruelty flows from every mountain...When tribulations appear in the path of Thy love, they are a great gift and evident grace...We find sweetness in abuse and seek comfort and joy of spirit from the impact of arrow, spear and sword.

Subject: tests and trials; sacrifice and suffering
Quotation: Your tribulations as a wanderer in the wilderness of trials caused deep sorrow and regret. O pure soul! The vast expanse of the globe is narrow and dark, let alone Qaratepe, Dehne, and the Turkmen frontier. The world has grown confined for the friends in all regions, and every nameless, shameless, unbridled rebel... Well can one imagine what afflictions and what sorrows and pains may arise.

Subject: tests and trials; sacrifice and suffering
Quotation: "Think men that when they say, 'We believe,' they shall be let alone and not be put to proof?" Bitter trials and violent commotions are of imperative necessity. "With somewhat of fear and hunger, and loss of wealth, and lives, and fruits, will we surely prove you: but bear good tidings to the patient, Who when a mischance chanceth them, say, 'Verily we are God's, and to Him shall we return.'"

Subject: tests and trials; sacrifice and suffering
Quotation: in the past year the loved ones of Nayriz drank a brimming cup from the wine of tribulation...The ordeal was severe...those trials and tribulations became the cause of glory and nobility...Truly one must supplicate the Court of Oneness with the utmost lowliness and lamentation, seeking preservation and protection, for the test is severe and the tempestuous winds of trial are at their most intense

Subject: tests and trials; sacrifice and suffering
Quotation: Indeed, this hardship and difficulty of yours has weighed heavily upon all the friends...For the faithful servants of the Blessed Beauty must endure persecution in His path and bear thousands of trials. They should not seek comfort and ease, nor desire luxury and adornment. Rather, they should make their breasts the target for the arrows of tribulation so they may obtain the pearl of divine bestowal.

Subject: tests and trials; sacrifice and suffering
Quotation: You had complained about the afflictions and hardships, that the friends in Iran are constantly in trouble and suffering, and are in tribulation and hardship from the oppression and tyranny of the religious scholars and the people. Rather, we must, with utter helplessness and need, with weeping and lamentation and complete restlessness, beg for tribulation and lay our heads before the sword of cruelty

Subject: tests and trials; sacrifice and suffering
Quotation: The circumstances will be severe for every thankful servant in those boundaries and countries. The people shall arise against you with the most bitter hatred, opposition and envy. Swords of persecution and curses shall be thrown at you by all the nations. The wind of tests and trials shall fiercely blow and thereby the weak trees, which are not firmly rooted in this wonderful vineyard, shall be uprooted.

Subject: tests and trials; sacrifice and suffering
Quotation: Though the cup of trials and tribulations is brimming over for all, and each soul is afflicted according to their capacity - for in this dusty heap there is neither peace of soul, nor heart's desire, nor gladness of conscience...But we, the servants of the Sacred Threshold, praise be to God, have doors of consolation open and accessible from all directions, and means of joy prepared and ready from every side.

Subject: tests and trials; sacrifice and suffering
Quotation: Whensoever the clouds of tribulation have rained down the darts of affliction in the path of God, the Lord of all names, I have hastened to meet them, as every fair-minded and discerning soul shall attest. How many the nights which found the beasts of the field resting in their lairs, and the birds of the air lying in their nests, while this Youth languished in chains and fetters with none to aid or succour Him!

Subject: tests and trials; sacrifice and suffering
Quotation: If a test occurs, it occurs in relation to the human station, not to the luminous reality. And this test is also according to how people see it - that is, it appears that the human nature of the Holy Manifestations was outwardly tested. And when steadfastness and firmness are demonstrated with the utmost power and might, others learn from it and become aware of how to show steadfastness and firmness when tested.

Subject: tests and trials; sacrifice and suffering
Quotation: Many a time, a calamity becomes the means to a bounty. Not until man has endured hardship because of a thing will he appreciate the full value of the thing. The more one suffers on account of an object, the greater he realizes its worth. For the people of Faith, calamities, trials and tribulations are conducive to spiritual progress; provided one endures them patiently and with severance from all else save God.

Subject: tests and trials; sacrifice and suffering
Quotation: What hath befallen that beloved one caused the utmost grief to become manifest. However, since it occurred in the path of the love of the Friend, it is easy to bear, and its reward is treasured and destined and concealed in God's repositories. Praise be to God that you have been made to partake of the cup of tribulation in the path of the satisfaction of the Lord of Names, and have received your portion and share.

Subject: tests and trials; sacrifice and suffering
Quotation: Whenever thou art overcome by the turbidity of this contingent world and physical weariness and hardship, retire to a solitary place and, with utmost supplication, commune with the divine threshold. That turbidity and weariness will be completely dispelled. Until one endureth grievous trials and mighty tribulations in the path of God, the ship of one's hopes and aspirations will not reach the shore of the All-Merciful.

Subject: tests and trials; sacrifice and suffering
Quotation: I have always said that the believers will be blamed for this cause. I promised you this. Before leaving America I mentioned in many meetings the things that would happen. I said that after I left, the clergy would begin to cause many doubts, that the believers would be blamed and found fault with and that they would fall into many tests, but that the ones who would remain firm would be established in the Kingdom of God.

Subject: tests and trials; sacrifice and suffering
Quotation: Although the suffering, tribulation, injury, cruelty, persecution, and injustice inflicted by the enemies is relentless, nevertheless, praise be unto God, the friends there have shown forth steadfastness, fortitude, and long-suffering, nay even thankfulness. Be not disconsolate and heartbroken should calamities befall you in the path of God. Rather, prepare a banquet of happiness and arrange a festival of joy and delight.

Subject: tests and trials; sacrifice and suffering
Quotation: The Bahais in Persia fell greatly under tests, their blood was shed, their lives were given. They used to be caught, killed, imprisoned; they were beaten, they were fined, they were exiled. Notwithstanding this they remained firm and steadfast. When such tests come to America and the believers remain firm, then it will be well. For instance, now there are no tests (save) spiritual tests. When there are material tests those are real tests.

Subject: tests and trials; sacrifice and suffering
Quotation: When pain and sorrow are present and ready, gladness and joy have a special splendor and in such a state felicity becometh manifest, for in times of comfort every discomfort turneth to laughter and expresseth joy and gladness. True accomplishment is to find freedom in bondage and to attain joy and gladness in times of sorrow and pain. This verily is the mark of the sincere ones and this is the characteristic of them that are near unto God.

Subject: tests and trials; sacrifice and suffering
Quotation: My final counsel unto thee is this: Grieve thou not for the tribulations and hardships which have befallen thee. Know well that the world and all that is therein will perish. That which hath been ordained for thee is verily, by His righteousness, better for thee than all that you witness on earth or is known to the men of insight, wert thou to observe diligence in all matters and believe in God thy Lord, and be not weighed down by troubles.

Subject: tests and trials; sacrifice and suffering
Quotation: And verily today everyone is being tested by what I have patiently endured in the path of God, and have been content with God's decree in dwelling upon the mountain, that We might test the souls and try the hearts according to the meaning of that sacred verse "Say: I ask of you no recompense..." etc., and the people's adherence to the law of kinship with the Messenger of God... the Cause of God and His wondrous wisdom "Do men think..." etc.

Subject: tests and trials; sacrifice and suffering
Quotation: However He has always been patient and longsuffering and has accepted these tests with the utmost joy. In order to accomplish great and important affairs, one must bear the trials and overcome the difficulties, especially the greatest bounty of the world of humanity which is calling the people to the Kingdom of God. It is certain that man is submerged now and then in the sea of vicissitudes and tests and he becomes the object of great calamities.

Subject: tests and trials; sacrifice and suffering
Quotation: From infancy and earliest childhood this Imprisoned One has been nursed the milk from the Holy Breast of Tests and nurtured in the arena of the greatest vicissitudes, and until the present time has been the intimate friend of pains and troubles and the companion of hardships and afflictions. To such an extent that torture has become ease, calamity has become ease, calamity has become a bounty (bestowal) and adversity has become tranquility (composure).

Subject: tests and trials; sacrifice and suffering
Quotation: Tests are a means by which a soul is measured as to its fitness, and proven out by its own acts. God knows its fitness beforehand, and also its unpreparedness, but man, with an ego, would not believe himself unfit unless proof were given him. Consequently his susceptibility to evil is proven to him when he falls into the tests, and the tests are continued until the soul realizes its own own unfitness, then remorse and regret tend to root out the weakness.

Subject: tests and trials; sacrifice and suffering
Quotation: Indeed, what transpired was a lesson for those of insight and understanding. In truth, if one encounters no difficulty in God's path and remains ever in comfort, this has not been and is not beloved in the sight of the lovers and those filled with longing. Through tribulation the book of faithfulness is adorned and the tablet of steadfastness is embellished. Thus in one place He says: "Were it not for tribulation in Thy path, my life would have no sweetness."

Subject: tests and trials; sacrifice and suffering
Quotation: The mind and spirit of man advance when he is tried by suffering. The more the ground is ploughed the better the seed will grow, the better the harvest will be. Just as the plough furrows the earth deeply, purifying it of weeds and thistles, so suffering and tribulation free man from the petty affairs of this worldly life until he arrives at a state of complete detachment. Look back to the times past and you will find that the greatest men have suffered most.

Subject: tests and trials; sacrifice and suffering
Quotation: Still greater things than these will happen, all of which have been prophesied. All of the believers must be in such a mood that when calamity exists in the greatest degree, they must rejoice exceedingly. Neither hunger nor thirst, nor confinement in prison, nor bloodshed, nor martyrdom, should prevent us from being true to the Blessed Perfection. We should accept all of these things all of our lives; we should hope for them, and then we will be happy when they come.

Subject: tests and trials; sacrifice and suffering
Quotation: In truth, you have endured unbearable trials and tribulations in the path of the Beloved of the horizons, and suffered severe hardships. Your frail body received harsh blows and your weak frame bore heavy burdens...Sometimes when various ailments take hold of the body and multiple diverse illnesses arise, as soon as tribulations intensify and calamities grow severe, the illnesses immediately vanish and health, well-being and comfort are attained with perfect joy and delight.

Subject: tests and trials; sacrifice and suffering
Quotation: O my Lord, my Beloved, and the Attractor of my innermost being! Behold this wronged servant, cast upon the dust beneath the swords of Thine enemies. By Thy glory, O Beloved of my heart, I render thanks unto Thee in this hour and in this state, wherein I am alone and friendless, fallen into the hands of the oppressors. I am content with whatsoever hath befallen this wronged one in Thy path, and with all the tribulations that have descended upon me in the way of Thy good-pleasure.

Subject: tests and trials; sacrifice and suffering
Quotation: And be not sorrowful or grief-stricken by the tribulations and afflictions that have befallen you. After the Most Great Calamity and Supreme Ordeal which shook the pillars of the world and raised a tumult in the hearts enkindled with the fire of the love of God, no tribulation can have effect and no ordeal can have force. One who witnesses the mightiest tempest will not fear the motion of a wave, and one who beholds the greatest earthquake will not be saddened by the movement of a leaf.

Subject: tests and trials; sacrifice and suffering
Quotation: O companions of `Abdu'l-Baha! Praise be to God that in the path of His love ye have drained the cup of woe and tasted the venom of cruelty. Ye have severed yourselves from all else besides the matchless Beloved, soared to the highest summit, attained the desire of all God's chosen ones, hearkened to the divine summons, witnessed the most great signs, became enchanted by that radiant Countenance, offered yourselves to God, and through your self-sacrifice obtained the fruition of your lives.

Subject: tests and trials; sacrifice and suffering
Quotation: As to the subject of babes and infants and weak ones who are afflicted by the hands of oppressors: This contains great wisdom and this subject is of paramount importance. In brief, for those souls there is a recompense in another world and many details are connected with this matter. For those souls that suffering is the greatest mercy of God. Verily that mercy of the Lord is far better and preferable to all the comfort of this world and the growth and development of this place of mortality.

Subject: tests and trials; sacrifice and suffering
Quotation: By Thy might! It is as though I see this station of mine as the summit of Paradise, for whoever can praise Thee cares not for the displeasure of Thy servants, and whoever delights in intimacy with Thy presence misses no good in the presence of Thy dominion. Therefore, praise be to Thee in this station of mine - a radiant, brilliant, sanctified praise that excels all praise and glorification as Thy Self excels all that Thou hast created, for Thou hast freed me on this mountain for Thy worship.

Subject: tests and trials; sacrifice and suffering
Quotation: Thou seest me immersed in an ocean of calamities that surges with afflictions, restless with tribulations. O Lord, Lord! Strengthen me in Thy Cause, grant me patience from Thy presence, and protect me from stumbling beneath the shelter of Thy protection upon this straight path. Guard me from anguish, pain and trembling in this mighty tribulation. Lord, Lord! Thou seest that the firm mountains have been shaken by the tempests of trials, and deeply-rooted trees have been uprooted by the storms of temptation.

Subject: tests and trials; sacrifice and suffering
Quotation: At a time when an ocean of trials and tribulations was surging up and flinging its waves to the heavens, when multitudes were assailing us and the tyrannical were inflicting upon us crushing wrongs... In spite of everything, this homeless prisoner remained inwardly tranquil and secure, trusting in the peerless Lord, yearning for whatever afflictions might have to be encountered in the pathway of God's love. For bolts of hate are, in our sight, but a gift of pearls from Him, and mortal poison but a healing draught.

Subject: tests and trials; sacrifice and suffering
Quotation: Afflictions have encompassed Me which none can reckon save God, Knower of the unseen and the seen. The polytheists have gathered against Me from every direction with tyranny, to this bear witness honored servants. Every harm hath been ordained for My person and every affliction for My beauty, yet the people understand not. We, in all conditions, summon the servants unto the Mighty, the Loving. What befalleth Us deterreth Us not, even as what befell Us in the past deterred Us not, and thy Lord is witness to what I say.

Subject: tests and trials; sacrifice and suffering
Quotation: Concerning the trials and tribulations that have befallen the friends of the Lord, of which thou didst write - this is from God's grace and favor, that He maketh His loved ones partners with Him in the tribulations of His path. This is of God's grace which He bestoweth upon whomsoever He willeth, and God is the possessor of great bounty. Have ye forgotten the tribulations that befell His blessed Person? May my spirit be a sacrifice for His tribulations! What in the path of God's love could be sweeter than tribulations?

Subject: tests and trials; sacrifice and suffering
Quotation: Neath a sharpened sword I recognize Thy infinite bounties, O Thou beside Whom there is none other God but Thee! And at my dwelling Thine is perfection, O Thou beside Whom there is none other God but Thee! Within a palace Thine is generosity, O Thou beside Whom there is none other God but Thee! And amidst the dust Thine is Magnanimity, O Thou beside Whom there is none other God but Thee! In prison Thine is fidelity, O Thou the Bestower of all gifts! And in captivity Thou art the Ever-Abiding, O Thou Sovereign of Eternity.

Subject: tests and trials; sacrifice and suffering
Quotation: For the Beloved hath shed His kindness among mankind, the true Joseph hath showed His face in the marketplace of existence. This is not the condition of faithfulness. Rather, we must become more fervent moment by moment and, like leviathans in the sea of love, raise our cry. We must regard every affliction as the greatest comfort and count every tribulation as sweet waters. We must see oppression as faithfulness and pain as purity. In brief, in the path of His love we must consider every calamity and every hardship as a bounty.

Subject: tests and trials; sacrifice and suffering
Quotation: Praised and glorified art Thou. How often did adversities descend upon Me and Thou didst temper them and avert them through Thy gracious favour; and how many times were commotions stirred up against Me at the hand of the people, while Thou didst cause them to subside through Thy tender mercy. How numerous the occasions when the Nimrods kindled fires wherewith to burn Me, but Thou didst make them balm for Me; and how manifold the instances when the infidels decreed My humiliation and Thou didst turn them into marks of honour for Me...

Subject: tests and trials; sacrifice and suffering
Quotation: Although during the night they were deprived of sleep, traversed the desert, and endured hardship and difficulty, yet when morning comes and they reach their destination, they become joyous and glad because of their night journey. Such is the case now. The times of the friends are spent in night-travel. God willing, the dawn shall come. Although this very night is morning, this poison is honey, this wrath is grace, and this tribulation is a gift, yet its sweetness is tasted in the palate of the lovers and the mouth of the yearning ones.

Subject: tests and trials; sacrifice and suffering
Quotation: In the blessed verse He says: "We seized them with lesser punishment before the greater punishment, that they might return." But alas, alas! Where is awakening and where is awareness? Heedlessness has so encompassed them that warning does not awaken them...Do you think that you will enter Paradise while yet there has not come to you the like of what came to those who passed away before you? Affliction and adversity befell them and they were shaken until the Messenger and those who believed with him said: 'When will the help of God come?'"

Subject: tests and trials; sacrifice and suffering
Quotation: The divine tests are violent, yet are they conducive to the life of the soul and the heart. The more often the pure gold is thrown into the furnace of test, the greater will become its purity and brilliancy and it will acquire a new splendor and brightness. Consider thou the lives of the former sanctified souls; what tests have they not withstood and what persecutions have they not beheld; while they were surrounded with calamities they increased their firmness and while they were overwhelmed with tests they manifested more zeal and courage.

Subject: tests and trials; sacrifice and suffering
Quotation: The afflictions and tribulations which you formerly endured, and the cup of woe which you tasted, are all known and evident. In Rafsanjan you fell under the oppression of the tyrannical, and in Tabas you were consumed by the fire of tribulation in the path of Truth. From these trials and sufferings you surely became sweetened, and you counted these hardships as the utmost mercy, for though the days of suffering have passed, their remembrance brings joy to the friends and gladness to the heart and soul, as they occurred in the path of the Lord.

Subject: tests and trials; sacrifice and suffering
Quotation: "The beloved of God obtained the Kingdom by the sacrifice of their lives, under calamities and oppressions. Their houses were destroyed and their honour lost. All their properties were pillaged. Their families and children were taken as captives, and at last they themselves were martyred." "Now the purpose is this: that you also should procure the Kingdom with so many sacrifices. It is possible you may have these calamities and difficulties. The people will accuse you, blame you and injure you, but you must show forth firmness and steadfastness."

Subject: tests and trials; sacrifice and suffering
Quotation: In this Trial the feet of the mystics who know God by God shall slip, even those who in every moment behold the mysteries of the Cause and Truth with penetrating vision. Say: Verily this is a Trial wherein the veils of hidden things shall be rent asunder and the secrets of confidential matters shall be uncovered, then shall the treasures of hearts be revealed [...] By God, there shall be tested in this test, and cast into the fire, servants who never entertained in their minds even an atom's weight of the thought that they worshipped aught but God.

Subject: tests and trials; sacrifice and suffering
Quotation: I swear by Thy glory, O my Lord, that all these tribulations are sweeter than any honey and more pleasing than any spirit, for the seekers of the Ka'bah of reunion will not rejoice in the manifestation of Beauty until they pass beyond the bounds of majesty, and will not reach the fountain of eternity until they drink from the cup of evanescence, and will not be honored with the exalted robe of wealth until they don the garment of poverty in the path of Thy good-pleasure, and will not find the abode of healing until they become ill from the pain of love.

Subject: tests and trials; sacrifice and suffering
Quotation: O Mahdi! Hearken unto the call of Him Who is immersed in the ocean of tribulation, and when the waves grant Him respite, He raises His head, gazing toward the East, and proclaims: "The Beloved is come, turn ye unto Him!" Then do the waves overtake and submerge Him. And when they subside, He lifts His head again, looking toward the West, crying out in His loudest voice: "This is the Beloved of the worlds! He is come for your life and the exaltation of your station. Yet ye have abandoned Him in this tribulation, the like of which the eye of creation hath never beheld."

Subject: tests and trials; sacrifice and suffering
Quotation: For all people are tested at the time of the subsequent Manifestation, when the followers of the former Manifestation desire to establish it but thereby exclude themselves. Consider those who accepted Islam - they all desired to establish the religion of Muhammad but were veiled from Muhammad in His subsequent appearance. Otherwise they would never have opposed Him themselves, much less opposed His followers. This pattern exists in all religions - they all desire to establish their religion but were veiled from God's Manifestation, and thus entered into the fire wherein they shall not be helped.

Subject: tests and trials; sacrifice and suffering
Quotation: Whenever Thou givest me sorrow, I grasp a portion of my Lord's robe crying: "My Lord, my Lord, my Lord, my Lord, my Lord, my Lord, my Lord! Cast me not from Thy door and deal not with me according to Thy justice, for I am captive to Thy praise, seeking refuge at Thy threshold, fearful of Thy justice and in need of Thy mercy." O my God! Whenever affliction descendeth upon me I say this is naught but from Thy mercy, and whenever joy cometh to me I say this is naught but from Thy test, that Thou mightest try me with the blessings of Thy kingdom away from Thy face, then take me through my self-hood.

Subject: tests and trials; sacrifice and suffering
Quotation: Calamities and afflictions have encompassed all regions, yet the people remain in strange slumber. Successive years have passed, yet the tempests of wrath and the hurricanes of divine decree have not subsided, by reason of what the hands of men have wrought. On one day thou seest the fire of conflict ablaze amongst the servants, and on another thou hearest the sound of guns and rifles from diverse lands. How many cities have been swallowed up, how many lands laid waste by earthquakes, how many regions encompassed by other calamities through God's decree, the Lord of all men, and how many lands submerged and lofty buildings fallen!

Subject: tests and trials; sacrifice and suffering
Quotation: At one time He casteth him, Abraham-like, into a blazing fire; at one time He confineth him to chains, as the truth-speaking Joseph. At one time, He maketh him, like unto Moses, a wanderer in the Midian desert and a homeless shepherd in mountains and fields. At another, He delivereth him, as the Chaste One (John the Baptist), to the oppression of the prideful Herod, and tingeth the earth with his blessed blood. And yet another time doth He expose his sacred breast to a thousand bullets of tyranny, like unto the Primal Point. We shall surely try you with something of fear and hunger, and loss of goods and lives and fruits; but give glad tidings to the patient.

Subject: tests and trials; sacrifice and suffering
Quotation: Not for a moment has he found rest in a secure place, nor for an instant has he settled in a station of glory. No water has he drunk save the blood of the heart, and no food has he been provided save pieces of his own liver. At times a captive of the infidels and wandering through cities, at times companion to chains and fetters. Especially in these days when he has become the target of the arrows of two parties and the object of vengeance of two factions. The friends derive glory from my abasement and joy from my sorrow, while the enemies harbor rancor in their hearts from my existence. Many are the hatreds concealed in breasts, and what enmities are hidden in hearts.

Subject: tests and trials; sacrifice and suffering
Quotation: "Beware lest ye test your Master and your Lord, neigh it is for your Beloved to test His servants who turn to Him. Heard ye not that Ali, peace be upon him, was on the brink of a lofty mountain, when one of the doubters said to him, 'Do you rely, O Ali, on God and His protection and xxx and His great assistance?' He said: 'And how could I not do so when He is the All-Protector, the All-Kind.' He said: 'Then throw yourself from the peak of this lofty mountain, if you are certain.' He said, peace be upon him: 'It is not for the servant to test his lord, neigh it is for God to test the servant.' This is sound judgement in speech and decision and the most convincing answer."

Subject: tests and trials; sacrifice and suffering
Quotation: the earthquake of tests is so severe that it would uproot a firmly-fixed mountain from its foundation. And so it must be, for it would be contrary to faithfulness that the Blessed Beauty should spend fifty years under chains and shackles and exile and banishment in various lands, enduring the gloating of enemies and the harm and cruelty of the unfaithful, while we, after His ascension and passing, should find comfort and see ease and seek blessing and desire security. Rather, we must make our breasts the target of arrows and our hearts the vessel of every turbidity and pain. We must spend our days in hardship and tribulation, and devote our times to countless difficulties.

Subject: tests and trials; sacrifice and suffering
Quotation: Like precious pearls they are nurtured in the embrace of affliction's shell, and like pure gold they acquire a pleasing hue in the heat and glow of fire, their lips overflowing with thanksgiving. Sometimes in the mighty deluge of trials they steer the ark like Noah, and sometimes when the fierce winds of fate blow they find peace and tranquility like Hud. At times like the majestic Abraham they illuminate their countenance in the fire of cruelty, and at times in the intensity of illness and disease they burn painfully with fever like Job. Sometimes like Joseph they make the chains and fetters of prison into golden necklaces and royal ornaments in love of the All-Merciful's beauty.

Subject: tests and trials; sacrifice and suffering
Quotation: Praise be to God Who hath made tribulation the key to His exalted Paradise, whereby those who followed their desires fled while the people of Baha drew nigh, those who cast away this world and took hold of that which would profit them in the Hereafter and in this life. Every calamity in Thy good-pleasure is joy, And every sorrow in Thy love is gladness, Every tribulation in Thy love is comfort, And every hardship in Thy days is ease. Every poison in aid of Thy Cause is healing balm, and every bitterness in service to Thee is surpassing honey. By God! Not an atom of what hath befallen that honored one hath been, or shall ever be, effaced from the page of creation. Blessed art thou for having drunk the cup of tribulation in love of thy Lord, the Lord of all names.

Subject: tests and trials; sacrifice and suffering
Quotation: In these days the winds of tests will blow from the direction of trials, and the whirlwind of examination will move from every direction, and all that was foretold in the Divine Tablets will become manifest. As the Cause is mighty, surely the tests will be mighty. Every year whose spring rivals the gardens of Paradise, whose season is gentle and wondrous, whose flowers and herbs, hyacinths and thyme are the essence of freshness and grace, and whose fruits and fragrant produce are the height of sweetness - surely its torrential rains, winter storms, snow and ice, and rushing floods will also be more severe. Until this intense cold encompasses all, that life-giving spring will not adorn the world, the beauty of flowers will not be revealed, the birds of the meadow will not sing, and mountain and plain will not rival the highest paradise.

Subject: tests and trials; sacrifice and suffering

Pass beyond comfort and ease and close your eyes to the adornments of the created world. Know the thorns of tribulation as silk and brocade and count the burning fire as a flower garden and rose bower. Drink the bitter salt of torment like sweet fresh water and know the arrowheads as the fountain of life and seek sword and spear like honey of security.

Subject: tests and trials; sacrifice and suffering
Quotation: How pleased will I be when we are reviled in the streets and made the objects of reproach and persecution! This would be a cause for celebration; it is nothing short of our greatest wish and ultimate aspiration. What could be better than this, that one should become a wanderer abased in the path of God? From this abasement, he will discover such delight as can never be described. When we first arrived in 'Akka, we were in the direst of straits and stricken with some toil or calamity -- and yet, so great was our joy and delight that it cannot be put into words. At one point, seventy of our companions were imprisoned in the fortress, and they had all fallen sick with a fever so debilitating that it robbed them even of the ability to move. This illness had afflicted everyone but me and Aqa Rida; consequently, we tended to the believers, preparing medicine and soup for them. It so happened that I had been made to dwell in a room of that fortress that had been paved with stones. It was an exceedingly humid room, one that had originally been built as a place where the dead were washed. And yet, despite all these tribulations, so joyous were we beneath the sheltering shade of Baha'u'llah that we accounted every toil and trouble as comfort and ease.

Subject: thankfulness; gratitude
Quotation:
Thankfulness is of various kinds. There is a verbal thanksgiving which is confined to a mere utterance of gratitude. This is of no importance because perchance the tongue may give thanks while the heart is unaware of it. Many who offer thanks to God are of this type, their spirits and hearts unconscious of thanksgiving. This is mere usage, just as when we meet, receive a gift and say thank you, speaking the words without significance. One may say thank you a thousand times while the heart remains thankless, ungrateful. Therefore, mere verbal thanksgiving is without effect. But real thankfulness is a cordial giving of thanks from the heart. When man in response to the favors of God manifests susceptibilities of conscience, the heart is happy, the spirit is exhilarated. These spiritual susceptibilities are ideal thanksgiving.   ABU0579
Know well the value of this gift, and like grateful birds perched upon the branches of supplication and entreaty, sing His praise and render thanksgiving.

Quotation: Question: You have stated that we are living in a universal cycle, the first Manifestation of which was Adam and the universal Manifestation of which is Baha'u'llah. Quotation: From the cycle of Adam until today, which spans twelve thousand two hundred and ten solar years, in every Dispensation He has appeared with a different name. In each Dispensation, previous Manifestations have been denied and judged as being other than truth. He has caused all to believe in His novel manifestation and to await His subsequent appearance. He enjoined the people of the Bayan to humble themselves before His gate and turn towards His direction, and took from all created things a covenant concerning His own Self. As it was an old custom of that city to claim loss three times in the indigo trade, after three days someone came into His presence and stated that the King of Merchants was claiming a loss in this transaction. Upon hearing these words, His Holiness withdrew from the original transaction completely.
