Subject: the Word of God; influence and centrality of
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/the Word of God; influence and centrality of.txt
Quotation: He is the One Who creates what He wishes by His command Be! and it is.

Subject: the Word of God; influence and centrality of
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/the Word of God; influence and centrality of.txt
Quotation: "From the rustling of the Most Exalted Pen this most sublime word was heard"

Subject: the Word of God; influence and centrality of
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/the Word of God; influence and centrality of.txt
Quotation: Who besides God is able to send down the like of this Book, if ye but knew?

Subject: the Word of God; influence and centrality of
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/the Word of God; influence and centrality of.txt
Quotation: He is the One Who createth whatsoever He willeth through His command Be, and it is!

Subject: the Word of God; influence and centrality of
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/the Word of God; influence and centrality of.txt
Quotation: Such is the power of God's Word that it hath not been created from aught else.

Subject: the Word of God; influence and centrality of
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/the Word of God; influence and centrality of.txt
Quotation: "...caused me to hear Thy sweetest call and the scratching of Thy Most Exalted Pen."

Subject: the Word of God; influence and centrality of
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/the Word of God; influence and centrality of.txt
Quotation: "A Book sent down in truth from the Kingdom of God" and "didst send down the verses"

Subject: the Word of God; influence and centrality of
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/the Word of God; influence and centrality of.txt
Quotation: He hath come down from the heaven of Proof with the standards of Perspicuous Utterance.

Subject: the Word of God; influence and centrality of
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/the Word of God; influence and centrality of.txt
Quotation: Today the rustling of the Divine Lote-Tree is raised and the scratching of the Pen is manifest.

Subject: the Word of God; influence and centrality of
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/the Word of God; influence and centrality of.txt
Quotation: The Hidden hath appeared and the Treasured hath emerged...heard the shrill voice of My Most Sweet Pen

Subject: the Word of God; influence and centrality of
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/the Word of God; influence and centrality of.txt
Quotation: O thou who art a letter of the Word! Hear the call of thy Lord from this blessed, unified, eternal Spot

Subject: the Word of God; influence and centrality of
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/the Word of God; influence and centrality of.txt
Quotation: Verily, we sent down the decree on whom we will among our servants according to a predetermined amount.

Subject: the Word of God; influence and centrality of
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/the Word of God; influence and centrality of.txt
Quotation: This is the Day whereon the Most Exalted Pen hath appeared from the fingers of your Lord, the Most High

Subject: the Word of God; influence and centrality of
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/the Word of God; influence and centrality of.txt
Quotation: We prescribe unto all men that which will lead to the exaltation of the Word of God amongst His servants

Subject: the Word of God; influence and centrality of
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/the Word of God; influence and centrality of.txt
Quotation: From door and wall arose the song of "O how wonderful! O how wonderful!" and they began melody and song.

Subject: the Word of God; influence and centrality of
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/the Word of God; influence and centrality of.txt
Quotation: by Thy most sweet Voice and by Thy most exalted Word... make me drink of the choice wine of Thine utterance

Subject: the Word of God; influence and centrality of
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/the Word of God; influence and centrality of.txt
Quotation: All were created by His command and all act according to His bidding...His Book is the Sovereign of all books

Subject: the Word of God; influence and centrality of
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/the Word of God; influence and centrality of.txt
Quotation: O my brothers! The scratching of the Supreme Pen is far more distinct and excellent than the buzzing of flies.

Subject: the Word of God; influence and centrality of
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/the Word of God; influence and centrality of.txt
Quotation: I beseech Thee by the Name through which was raised the scratching of Thy Most Exalted Pen between earth and heaven

Subject: the Word of God; influence and centrality of
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/the Word of God; influence and centrality of.txt
Quotation: References to divine revelation: "Who sent the Messengers and revealed the Books for the guidance of His creation"

Subject: the Word of God; influence and centrality of
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/the Word of God; influence and centrality of.txt
Quotation: The passage discusses how divine revelation has been expressed through sacred texts across religious dispensations.

Subject: the Word of God; influence and centrality of
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/the Word of God; influence and centrality of.txt
Quotation: That is the Day whereon the Primal Tree shall recite from God that which God desireth to decree concerning all things.

Subject: the Word of God; influence and centrality of
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/the Word of God; influence and centrality of.txt
Quotation: Blessed are ye for having taken hold of the words of God and preserved them from the touch of every rejected polytheist.

Subject: the Word of God; influence and centrality of
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/the Word of God; influence and centrality of.txt
Quotation: Verily from heaven He hath sent down a Book - nay, all that ye recite is from God, my Lord. Thus doth God reveal unto Me.

Subject: the Word of God; influence and centrality of
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/the Word of God; influence and centrality of.txt
Quotation: This is a Book sent down by the Sovereign of Might...The Sovereign has come and taken His seat upon the throne of utterance

Subject: the Word of God; influence and centrality of
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/the Word of God; influence and centrality of.txt
Quotation: The ear of the world is cleansed from what it heard in the world, As soon as it entereth the circle of His enrapturing Call.

Subject: the Word of God; influence and centrality of
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/the Word of God; influence and centrality of.txt
Quotation: who took the cup of utterance in the name of the Beloved of all possibility from the hands of bounty and drank it in His name

Subject: the Word of God; influence and centrality of
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/the Word of God; influence and centrality of.txt
Quotation: He Who hath sent down from the clouds of His bounty upon His servants and people of His lands the rain of wisdom and utterance

Subject: the Word of God; influence and centrality of
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/the Word of God; influence and centrality of.txt
Quotation: My Pen hath found no rest or repose at any time. Its scratching hath been raised and hath summoned all unto God, the Lord of the worlds

Subject: the Word of God; influence and centrality of
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/the Word of God; influence and centrality of.txt
Quotation: The text references Qur'anic verses and discusses their inner meanings, particularly the verse about houses raised for God's remembrance.

Subject: the Word of God; influence and centrality of
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/the Word of God; influence and centrality of.txt
Quotation: And unto God belongeth the words of the heavens and of the earth and of whatsoever lieth between them, and God was the Lord of mighty truth.

Subject: the Word of God; influence and centrality of
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/the Word of God; influence and centrality of.txt
Quotation: The Book of God speaks: "Verily there is no God but I, the All-Knowing, the All-Informed." It guides people to His mighty, praiseworthy path.

Subject: the Word of God; influence and centrality of
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/the Word of God; influence and centrality of.txt
Quotation: The Word of God is more pleasing in the kingdom of the heavens and the earth and whatsoever is between them than the word of all peoples.

Subject: the Word of God; influence and centrality of
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/the Word of God; influence and centrality of.txt
Quotation: That which was hidden from eyes hath been revealed, and that which was treasured in God's knowledge, the All-Knowing, the All-Wise, hath appeared.

Subject: the Word of God; influence and centrality of
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/the Word of God; influence and centrality of.txt
Quotation: We have mentioned in the Book that which draweth men nigh unto the straight path... Thus hath the Tongue spoken what the All-Merciful hath sent down

Subject: the Word of God; influence and centrality of
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/the Word of God; influence and centrality of.txt
Quotation: Verily He Who sent down these verses from His presence hath power to send down the like thereof hereafter, for He is, in truth, potent over all things.

Subject: the Word of God; influence and centrality of
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/the Word of God; influence and centrality of.txt
Quotation: O concourse of divines! Put down your pens, then hearken to the scratching of the Most Exalted Pen which hath been raised between earth and heaven.

Subject: the Word of God; influence and centrality of
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/the Word of God; influence and centrality of.txt
Quotation: The Most Exalted Pen moveth at all times and maketh mention of the loved ones of the All-Merciful. Indeed, it is the Kawthar of Life amidst all created things.

Subject: the Word of God; influence and centrality of
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/the Word of God; influence and centrality of.txt
Quotation: He it is Who createth whatsoever He willeth by His command Be! and it is. Say: He is the Subduer over His servants, and He is the Supreme, the Self-Subsisting.

Subject: the Word of God; influence and centrality of
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/the Word of God; influence and centrality of.txt
Quotation: He speaketh naught but the truth, and by His Word are all things created. Say: His Word is the truth, and His command is nearer than to say unto it Be and it is.

Subject: the Word of God; influence and centrality of
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/the Word of God; influence and centrality of.txt
Quotation: This is a Day wherein the squeaking of the Most Exalted Pen hath been raised and the Herald hath proclaimed: "The Promised One hath come with manifest sovereignty."

Subject: the Word of God; influence and centrality of
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/the Word of God; influence and centrality of.txt
Quotation: This is what We have sent down... He it is Who hath sent down the Book in truth... And verily this is a Book from before the Glory... God mocketh at you in the Book

Subject: the Word of God; influence and centrality of
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/the Word of God; influence and centrality of.txt
Quotation: Yea, those who recite the Book of God, these are they who abide beneath His shade, without any diminution whatsoever of that letter. Say: All abide beneath His shade.

Subject: the Word of God; influence and centrality of
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/the Word of God; influence and centrality of.txt
Quotation: I beseech Thee by Thy Name before which all names bow down in adoration, and by the light of Thy countenance before which all on earth and in heaven humble themselves

Subject: the Word of God; influence and centrality of
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/the Word of God; influence and centrality of.txt
Quotation: Then hearken unto the scratching of His Pen, at whose ascension the realities of all things were attracted... with verses that all the books of the world cannot equal

Subject: the Word of God; influence and centrality of
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/the Word of God; influence and centrality of.txt
Quotation: The Command of ten words lieth concealed in a single word, the oceans of utterance are hidden in a single letter, and the pearls of wisdom are treasured in a single shell.

Subject: the Word of God; influence and centrality of
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/the Word of God; influence and centrality of.txt
Quotation: Hath the scratching of the Supreme Pen or the rustling of the Lote-Tree drawn thee from worldly conditions to the most holy station of "Every day He is in a new condition"?

Subject: the Word of God; influence and centrality of
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/the Word of God; influence and centrality of.txt
Quotation: He spoke the Primal Word, whereby all things between earth and heaven were transformed. He is the One at Whose revelation the Kingdom of Utterance appeared amidst all creation.

Subject: the Word of God; influence and centrality of
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/the Word of God; influence and centrality of.txt
Quotation: He it is Who through His most exalted Word hath revealed the hidden and treasured mysteries, and from His Most Exalted Pen hath caused to shine forth the gleaming and luminous pearls.

Subject: the Word of God; influence and centrality of
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/the Word of God; influence and centrality of.txt
Quotation: For if God, glorified be His Name, should today speak a word that all people have spoken heretofore and shall speak hereafter, that word would still be new, were ye to reflect upon it.

Subject: the Word of God; influence and centrality of
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/the Word of God; influence and centrality of.txt
Quotation: The Cause has appeared and the verses have been sent down, and the Desired One has ascended the throne of His name, the All-Wise. We have sent down the verses and manifested the signs.

Subject: the Word of God; influence and centrality of
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/the Word of God; influence and centrality of.txt
Quotation: And beyond them all the Tongue of Grandeur and Glory bears witness: He Who is mentioned has come, He by Whose name the heaven of Revelation was adorned and the earths have passed away.

Subject: the Word of God; influence and centrality of
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/the Word of God; influence and centrality of.txt
Quotation: I testify that the Day is Thy Day and the Cause is Thy Cause. I beg of Thee by Thy Straight Path and Thy wondrous Message, graciously to aid me to glorify Thy Cause amidst Thy servants.

Subject: the Word of God; influence and centrality of
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/the Word of God; influence and centrality of.txt
Quotation: "What a Book inscribed by what a Pen - the Pen of God, the All-Subduing, the Self-Subsisting! What a Tablet traced by what a Reed - the Reed of God, Lord of what was and what shall be!"

Subject: the Word of God; influence and centrality of
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/the Word of God; influence and centrality of.txt
Quotation: They have forsaken a Truth before a single verse of which all the books of the past and future bow down in humility and submission, and have clung to and followed the vain tales of old.

Subject: the Word of God; influence and centrality of
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/the Word of God; influence and centrality of.txt
Quotation: The Bayan is Our proof against all things; all the worlds are powerless before its verses. These are all Our verses from before and after, just as thou art, at this moment, all Our proof.

Subject: the Word of God; influence and centrality of
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/the Word of God; influence and centrality of.txt
Quotation: Verily the Word of God createth the Holy Land from its borders just as it was created by the word of him whom God made His Prophet. Thus doth God's command penetrate all things by His order.

Subject: the Word of God; influence and centrality of
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/the Word of God; influence and centrality of.txt
Quotation: Should all who are in the heavens and on earth and between them gather together to produce the like of a verse which God sendeth down through His knowledge, they would be powerless and unable.

Subject: the Word of God; influence and centrality of
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/the Word of God; influence and centrality of.txt
Quotation: All similitudes testify to God, thy Lord, that there is none other God but Him, the Almighty, the All-Wise. Glorified be He Who createth what He willeth through His command Be, and it is.

Subject: the Word of God; influence and centrality of
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/the Word of God; influence and centrality of.txt
Quotation: Now strive ye, that perchance ye may receive your portion from the ocean of utterance of Him Who is the Goal of all worlds. When thou hast drunk the choice wine of utterance from the cup of My bounty...

Subject: the Word of God; influence and centrality of
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/the Word of God; influence and centrality of.txt
Quotation: Through thee was opened the gate of bounty upon the face of the world and surged the ocean of utterance in all possibility. Exalted is the All-Merciful Who hath come with the truth through a wondrous command.

Subject: the Word of God; influence and centrality of
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/the Word of God; influence and centrality of.txt
Quotation: A Book sent down by the Ancient King... This is a Day wherein the Pen hath moved by the will of the Ancient King and there hath appeared what was hidden in knowledge and treasured in the sanctified repositories

Subject: the Word of God; influence and centrality of
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/the Word of God; influence and centrality of.txt
Quotation: We revealed in the Qur'an that none other than God can send down a single verse, that perchance they who were given the Qur'an might remember when they hear God's verses from His Proof, and then attain certitude.

Subject: the Word of God; influence and centrality of
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/the Word of God; influence and centrality of.txt
Quotation: In this Cycle you have heard the Call of the Word of God! in this Cycle you have witnessed the marvels of the Majesty of the Lord! In this Cycle ye are perfumed with the Holy Fragrances of the garden of the Merciful!

Subject: the Word of God; influence and centrality of
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/the Word of God; influence and centrality of.txt
Quotation: One Who hath brought that which is equivalent to all the divine Books of the past and future, nay rather more than that - One through Whose Word was made manifest that which was hidden and concealed in the divine Books.

Subject: the Word of God; influence and centrality of
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/the Word of God; influence and centrality of.txt
Quotation: He it is Who sent down the Books wherein are verses, and moreover verses, that ye should bow down before none save God, Who bringeth forth that which is hidden in the heavens and on earth and all that lieth between them.

Subject: the Word of God; influence and centrality of
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/the Word of God; influence and centrality of.txt
Quotation: when the lights of the Tablet shine forth upon thee from the horizon of the Finger of the Youth... then recite from the verses of thy Lord, for they will assuredly draw thee in truth to a station of praiseworthy holiness

Subject: the Word of God; influence and centrality of
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/the Word of God; influence and centrality of.txt
Quotation: His command is nearer than Be, and it is! Thus doth God bring forth the latter creation through His mercy. The All-Merciful is established upon the throne. He createth whatsoever He willeth through His command Be, and it is!

Subject: the Word of God; influence and centrality of
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/the Word of God; influence and centrality of.txt
Quotation: He verily seeth that which appeareth in His good-pleasure and heareth the call of them that have turned towards Him and voiced His beauteous remembrance... and draweth by His utterance all who are in the heavens and on earth.

Subject: the Word of God; influence and centrality of
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/the Word of God; influence and centrality of.txt
Quotation: This Book is from God, the Truth. Indeed it hath been sent down unto Us with pure truth upon the Alif, established in the Most Great Word, concerning the truth around the First Veil. And verily God hath power over all things.

Subject: the Word of God; influence and centrality of
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/the Word of God; influence and centrality of.txt
Quotation: No words have been perfected save as God hath revealed them in the kingdom of the heavens and of the earth and all that lieth between them, and verily they have been perfected and completed and exalted above all the worlds.

Subject: the Word of God; influence and centrality of
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/the Word of God; influence and centrality of.txt
Quotation: We have indeed revealed it to the people with truth, and nothing is required of the people except submission and humility, and nothing is required of the Remembrance except a wondrous declaration of the truth from God, the Exalted.

Subject: the Word of God; influence and centrality of
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/the Word of God; influence and centrality of.txt
Quotation: Thus endeth the Word. Praise be to God! The ocean of bounty is surging, the sun of grace is shining, and the heaven of mercy is elevated. From the verses sent down from the heaven of God's Will, His infinite favors are made manifest

Subject: the Word of God; influence and centrality of
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/the Word of God; influence and centrality of.txt
Quotation: The fragrance of the All-Merciful's utterance is wafting with such intensity that all who dwell on earth are powerless to reckon it, and the Supreme Pen moveth and floweth in such wise that all fall short of describing and praising it.

Subject: the Word of God; influence and centrality of
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/the Word of God; influence and centrality of.txt
Quotation: By the Ancient Beauty! The Sun of Words shining forth from the Pen secretly educateth all people, even as the physical sun nourisheth the earth. The time shall come when the effects of this education will become manifest in all hearts.

Subject: the Word of God; influence and centrality of
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/the Word of God; influence and centrality of.txt
Quotation: We have sent down the verses and made manifest the clear proofs, yet the people are in strange doubt. By the life of God! In every letter of My Book are treasured sciences which none hath discovered save God, the Single, the All-Informed.

Subject: the Word of God; influence and centrality of
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/the Word of God; influence and centrality of.txt
Quotation: The Tree which God shall manifest - whatsoever is attributed unto it is in truth attributed unto God. Thou canst not say aught save that there is no God but Him. He sendeth down whatsoever He willeth through His command Be!, and it is.

Subject: the Word of God; influence and centrality of
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/the Word of God; influence and centrality of.txt
Quotation: God hath sent down the verses in this Book that men might be witnesses of Our signs in this Gate. We, verily, have sent down the command unto Our servant according to what was ordained in the Mother Book, in truth by the truth, all together.

Subject: the Word of God; influence and centrality of
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/the Word of God; influence and centrality of.txt
Quotation: O Pen! Make mention of him who hath turned unto My countenance, soared in My atmosphere, and held fast unto that which hath been revealed from My presence, that thy scratching may draw him to a station wherein My sweetest call hath been raised

Subject: the Word of God; influence and centrality of
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/the Word of God; influence and centrality of.txt
Quotation: Were all who dwell on earth to gather together and prostrate themselves before Him, then declare There is none other God but He, the Mighty, the Beloved, they would not have fulfilled the right of even a single letter from the Book of God.

Subject: the Word of God; influence and centrality of
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/the Word of God; influence and centrality of.txt
Quotation: The scratching of the Most Exalted Pen has been raised up, and the rustling of the Lote-Tree beyond which there is no passing. The ocean of utterance has surged before your faces, and the fragrance of God, the Lord of all worlds, has been wafted.

Subject: the Word of God; influence and centrality of
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/the Word of God; influence and centrality of.txt
Quotation: Today the scratching of the Most Exalted Pen and the rustling of the Lote-Tree of the utmost boundary are raised up. Blessed are the leaves who have attained to hearing them and who are stirred by the winds of the will of God, exalted be His glory.

Subject: the Word of God; influence and centrality of
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/the Word of God; influence and centrality of.txt
Quotation: Is not that Book sufficient for you wherein lieth the judgment of all things? Will ye not then be thankful? Say: A single verse sufficeth as a proof from God for all who are in the heavens and the earth and whatsoever is between them, if ye but knew.

Subject: the Word of God; influence and centrality of
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/the Word of God; influence and centrality of.txt
Quotation: For the Command of God is like unto these verses - were God to make the seas of the heavens and earth their ink, they would be exhausted. Therefore fear ye God, then grow in fear. For these verses are in themselves a proof, independent of aught else.

Subject: the Word of God; influence and centrality of
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/the Word of God; influence and centrality of.txt
Quotation: Today is the pavilion of grace raised aloft and the tent of glory pitched upon the highest standards. Blessed is the servant who in this wondrous, glorious Day attaineth unto the Word of God. None of what is witnessed can compare with the Word of God.

Subject: the Word of God; influence and centrality of
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/the Word of God; influence and centrality of.txt
Quotation: This is a Book sent down by Him Who is the Creator of the heavens and the Sovereign of the Kingdom of eternity unto him who hath turned towards the Most Sublime Horizon when the people of the earth, their princes and their divines turned away from Him.

Subject: the Word of God; influence and centrality of
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/the Word of God; influence and centrality of.txt
Quotation: He is the One Who createth what He willeth by His command Be! and it is. He is the Creator of the heavens and the earth and whatsoever lieth between them, the Mighty, the Beloved. He is the One Who createth what He willeth by His command Be! and it is.

Subject: the Word of God; influence and centrality of
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/the Word of God; influence and centrality of.txt
Quotation: The text speaks extensively about the "Sun of the Word of God" and its transformative effects: "the Sun of the Word of God to rise from the dawning-place of hopes, making its light encompass the world and its rays shine forth from the ethereal sphere"

Subject: the Word of God; influence and centrality of
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/the Word of God; influence and centrality of.txt
Quotation: He hath appeared with the truth and hath revealed that whereby the foundations of the world and the very limbs of the nations who cast behind their backs the Book of God, clinging to their own idle fancies and vain imaginings, have been made to tremble.

Subject: the Word of God; influence and centrality of
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/the Word of God; influence and centrality of.txt
Quotation: O My Pen! I bear witness that thou hast not fallen short in that which was commanded thee from before God, the Lord of all worlds. Thy scratching was raised up on a day wherein every learned one turned away, every mystic objected, every oppressor denied

Subject: the Word of God; influence and centrality of
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/the Word of God; influence and centrality of.txt
Quotation: O beloved of my heart! This day is a blessed day. God willing, the people of Baha will drink from the chalice of steadfastness, lest names hold them back from their Kingdom and their Creator, and lest the world, its riches and its ornaments prevent them.

Subject: the Word of God; influence and centrality of
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/the Word of God; influence and centrality of.txt
Quotation: And thou, O friend, draw near unto this Fire, And surrender thy spirit therein that thou mayest behold therein the Beauty of God made manifest. Then take therefrom flames with thy spirit and consume thereby All existence, both the unseen and the manifest.

Subject: the Word of God; influence and centrality of
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/the Word of God; influence and centrality of.txt
Quotation: This is a Book sent down in truth from God, the Protector, the Self-Subsisting, unto him who hath believed in God and His signs when most of the servants disbelieved, and who hath acknowledged His Revelation when the heedless and the contentious denied it.

Subject: the Word of God; influence and centrality of
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/the Word of God; influence and centrality of.txt
Quotation: This is a command from God unto Him Whom God shall make manifest, that ye speak not concerning that which God hath not mentioned in the Bayan as ye spoke before concerning the Quran, for both have been revealed by Him, and all else is created by His leave.

Subject: the Word of God; influence and centrality of
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/the Word of God; influence and centrality of.txt
Quotation: The verses have been sent down from this heaven which hath encompassed the kingdom of earth and heaven, and the clear tokens have appeared from this Station which hath been illumined by the lights of the Face of God, the Help in Peril, the Self-Subsisting.

Subject: the Word of God; influence and centrality of
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/the Word of God; influence and centrality of.txt
Quotation: "Letter" means a person. As the world came forth from the Mouth, that person is the reflection of the Light of GOD. It is the Letter in which are all the mysteries of the Holy Books. It is the Letter that came forth from the Mouth of the Blessed Perfection.

Subject: the Word of God; influence and centrality of
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/the Word of God; influence and centrality of.txt
Quotation: All that hath appeared hath been through a single Word, and this Word hath no likeness to what came before or after it, inasmuch as in one station it is interpreted as the Truth Itself, and in another as the Mother Book, and likewise by all the divine names.

Subject: the Word of God; influence and centrality of
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/the Word of God; influence and centrality of.txt
Quotation: During the nights and days the Pen of the Lord of all beings has not been still. In all conditions it has been moved to mention the friends and has uttered that which leads to the exaltation of the Cause, the upliftment of souls, and the tranquility of people.

Subject: the Word of God; influence and centrality of
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/the Word of God; influence and centrality of.txt
Quotation: Praise be to God Who hath spoken through His mighty verses and commanded all humanity to follow that which was revealed therein, and forbidden all from following self and idle fancy. None is to follow save that which hath been revealed in the Books and Tablets.

Subject: the Word of God; influence and centrality of
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/the Word of God; influence and centrality of.txt
Quotation: The verses in this Most Great Revelation have filled the horizons and its evidences have encompassed the world, such that whatsoever subsequently came to pass was explicitly set forth, word for word, in the Tablet to Ra'is, the Surih of Kings, and other Tablets.

Subject: the Word of God; influence and centrality of
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/the Word of God; influence and centrality of.txt
Quotation: This is a written Book sent down from God, the All-Protecting, the Self-Subsisting. Verily it is a Book through whose appearance the ocean and its waves have appeared... It proclaimeth with the most exalted call: 'O concourse of names! Cast away what ye possess.'

Subject: the Word of God; influence and centrality of
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/the Word of God; influence and centrality of.txt
Quotation: Arise through God's might and power and say: The names have returned to their Kingdom, the words to their treasuries, all paths have led to the Most Great Path, and every tributary that branched from the Ancient Ocean hath returned unto it, were ye but to know it.

Subject: the Word of God; influence and centrality of
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/the Word of God; influence and centrality of.txt
Quotation: This is the Most Great, Most Holy, Most Exalted Book which hath been sent down in truth. Verily it is a revelation from God, the Lord of the worlds. We have adorned the heaven of utterance with the stars of divine wisdom and holy ordinances as a bounty on Our part.

Subject: the Word of God; influence and centrality of
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/the Word of God; influence and centrality of.txt
Quotation: In truth, were the world to sacrifice itself for a single word of the divine utterances that have shone forth from the horizon of the heaven of grace, it would be little, nay, nothing. His is the grace and the bounty, and His is the generosity and the transcendence.

Subject: the Word of God; influence and centrality of
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/the Word of God; influence and centrality of.txt
Quotation: The ocean of knowledge hath surged and the fragrance of the All-Merciful hath wafted, yet most of the people remain heedless. Say: O people, fear God! He hath come unto you with oceans of verses and proofs, and hath called all on earth unto God, the Lord of creation.

Subject: the Word of God; influence and centrality of
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/the Word of God; influence and centrality of.txt
Quotation: The verses of mercy, loving-kindness, grace and bounty that have been revealed are, as attested by all things and all those near unto God, without parallel since the beginning of the world - neither hath any ear heard their like nor hath any eye beheld their similitude.

Subject: the Word of God; influence and centrality of
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/the Word of God; influence and centrality of.txt
Quotation: "The Most Exalted Pen hath moved, yet most of the people understand not...We have indeed revealed the clear proofs and informed the people of what hath appeared and what shall appear hereafter. To this beareth witness this sealed Book which calleth out amongst mankind..."

Subject: the Word of God; influence and centrality of
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/the Word of God; influence and centrality of.txt
Quotation: The Tablets were gathered before God and then spread forth to the right and to the left. God looketh upon the writings of those who believe in His unity and act according to His command. God will surely answer each one according to what is ordained for him in the Mother Book.

Subject: the Word of God; influence and centrality of
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/the Word of God; influence and centrality of.txt
Quotation: These are in truth the verses of Ali. Beware lest you wax proud against them; rather be among those who humble themselves... All that ye possess and that wherein ye pride yourselves is confirmed by the verses of God, and these are His verses sent down from the heaven of creation.

Subject: the Word of God; influence and centrality of
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/the Word of God; influence and centrality of.txt
Quotation: Through the meeting of these two pillars have the flowers of wisdom and utterance appeared, and through this wisdom and utterance hath the world of being been illumined. Its order is the cause of tranquility to all servants and of rest and assurance to all that dwell in every land.

Subject: the Word of God; influence and centrality of
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/the Word of God; influence and centrality of.txt
Quotation: It is plainly stated in the Bible that when the Spirit of Truth shall come, He shall lead you to all truth, for now ye cannot bear these things. This refers to the Manifestation. Jesus says that the Father is in Him. How could the Father be in Him, except by the power of the spirit?

Subject: the Word of God; influence and centrality of
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/the Word of God; influence and centrality of.txt
Quotation: Through Him was the standard raised before the faces of all people, and through Him was manifested the oneness of God, His sovereignty, His power and His might. The ocean of utterance surged in the world of being and the luminary of grace shone forth from the horizon of the heaven of proof.

Subject: the Word of God; influence and centrality of
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/the Word of God; influence and centrality of.txt
Quotation: I beseech Thee, O Cleaver of the Dawn and Subjugator of the Winds, by the rustling of the Divine Lote-Tree and the scratching of Thy Pen, O Lord of humanity and Sovereign of the throne on high and of the dust below, and by the waves of the ocean of Thy utterance and the mysteries of Thy Book

Subject: the Word of God; influence and centrality of
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/the Word of God; influence and centrality of.txt
Quotation: By God! One glance toward Him is better than the worship of both worlds, and hearing one word from Him is more excellent than all ye have heard before or shall hear hereafter, for thereby are attested and known the Scrolls of God, the Most High, the Sovereign, the All-Knowing, the Most Great.

Subject: the Word of God; influence and centrality of
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/the Word of God; influence and centrality of.txt
Quotation: Their sword shall be the Word of God, their weapon peace, their army the knowledge of God, their commander the fear of God, their supporter the Concourse on High, their helper the Lord of the exalted heavens, their provision trust in God, and their power successive confirmation from the Mighty One.

Subject: the Word of God; influence and centrality of
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/the Word of God; influence and centrality of.txt
Quotation: The equivalent of all the Books, Scriptures and Psalms of the past, nay more, hath been sent down from the heaven of the Divine Will, in such wise that a single verse thereof would attract all who dwell on earth, were they to approach it with fairness and adorn themselves with this most holy ornament.

Subject: the Word of God; influence and centrality of
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/the Word of God; influence and centrality of.txt
Quotation: The Word of God is more truthful than every word - will ye not then believe it? Say: All that ye have heard, verily it hath descended from Paradise - such is what hath been sent down from God, and verily it is from Me - such is the truth of the Cause with God and the essence of His good-pleasure.

Subject: the Word of God; influence and centrality of
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/the Word of God; influence and centrality of.txt
Quotation: This is what We have sent down to him who was the second to believe in God and His signs, and verily We are the Senders. Verily this is a Book from the Glory to him who was the second to believe in God, as a light from Us to the worlds. We have sent it down in that Book, and verily We were its Senders.

Subject: the Word of God; influence and centrality of
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/the Word of God; influence and centrality of.txt
Quotation: Therefore must the friends of God who have drunk from the living waters of the All-Merciful's love and have attained to hearkening unto the call of the Beloved of all possibility, awaken the heedless to the blessedness of the divine Word and quicken the dead through the outpourings of the ocean of utterance.

Subject: the Word of God; influence and centrality of
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/the Word of God; influence and centrality of.txt
Quotation: We reveal not a verse but We breathe into it the spirit of life for the God-fearing and the spirit of death for the dead - they who read God's Book aforetime yet now remain veiled from Our verses. And the likeness of that with God is all the aspects of your religious and worldly knowledge, though ye know it not.

Subject: the Word of God; influence and centrality of
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/the Word of God; influence and centrality of.txt
Quotation: Today nothing but the all-encompassing power of the Word of God, which rules over the realities of all things, can bring the thoughts, minds, hearts and spirits of the world of humanity under the shade of one tree. It is the penetrator of all things, the mover of souls, and the binder and regulator in the human world.

Subject: the Word of God; influence and centrality of
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/the Word of God; influence and centrality of.txt
Quotation: All that is witnessed, whether by the outward eye or the inner vision, and all that is comprehended by the minds and hearts of humanity, are but His creation, brought from nothingness into being through His Will. All these He hath caused to be manifested upon a single plane through a single Word and a single revelation.

Subject: the Word of God; influence and centrality of
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/the Word of God; influence and centrality of.txt
Quotation: And ye should write your books in the finest script that the words of God may draw you to the highest horizon where ye will gain the power to remain steadfast. That is the horizon where, when ye hear the verses of God, ye instantly fall prostrate, saying We believe in God and His verses, and we are workers for His sake.

Subject: the Word of God; influence and centrality of
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/the Word of God; influence and centrality of.txt
Quotation: For the meaning of what God revealed unto Muhammad, and the meaning of what was revealed unto Muhammad, the Apostle of God, is what was revealed in the Bayan unto the Primal Point, and the meaning of what was revealed in the Bayan is what God shall reveal unto Him Whom God shall make manifest on the Day of Resurrection.

Subject: the Word of God; influence and centrality of
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/the Word of God; influence and centrality of.txt
Quotation: Know thou that a single letter thereof is better than the kingdom of the hereafter and of the former time, if ye would but behold the verses of God with His vision. And a single Tablet from His trace is God's proof unto His creation, His evidence unto His creatures, and His authority unto all who are in the heavens and earth

Subject: the Word of God; influence and centrality of
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/the Word of God; influence and centrality of.txt
Quotation: God hath made the matter of remembrance solely Our command, exalted in truth by the truth. God hath sent down the verses in this Book that men might be witnesses of Our signs in this Gate. We, verily, have sent down the command unto Our servant according to what was ordained in the Mother Book, in truth by the truth, all together.

Subject: the Word of God; influence and centrality of
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/the Word of God; influence and centrality of.txt
Quotation: Through it the believers in divine unity became steadfast and the idolaters were seized with terror. Whoso calleth upon Thee through it hath indeed called upon Thee Thyself, and whoso turneth away hath not truly called upon Thee, even should he invoke Thee throughout the duration of Thy sovereignty and the permanence of Thine essence.

Subject: the Word of God; influence and centrality of
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/the Word of God; influence and centrality of.txt
Quotation: Praise be to God Who has caused all things to speak forth His remembrance and glorification, and peace and blessings be upon the best of His Messengers and Prophets, through whose Praised Name the brocade of the book of existence was adorned, and through whose Most Lauded Name the dove of utterance cooed upon the branch of divine knowledge.

Subject: the Word of God; influence and centrality of
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/the Word of God; influence and centrality of.txt
Quotation: When thou hast quaffed the choice wine of My utterance and attained unto My Book, arise, turning toward the Qiblih of all being, and say: I testify that by Thee the Resurrection hath appeared, by Thy manifestation the trumpet hath been blown, and by Thy supreme Word all things have spoken: The Kingdom is God's, the Single, the All-Informed.

Subject: the Word of God; influence and centrality of
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/the Word of God; influence and centrality of.txt
Quotation: These are the verses of God, the All-Encompassing, the Self-Subsisting, unto those who have believed in God and His verses, and who are secure from the terror of polytheism. Say: O people! Why do ye deny Me when ye witness that I have come to you with verses that cause the hearts of them that have believed to tremble and minds to be bewildered?

Subject: the Word of God; influence and centrality of
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/the Word of God; influence and centrality of.txt
Quotation: The verses have been sent down and the evidences have appeared, yet most of the people understand not. The Most Great Prison hath been adorned through the appearance of the Lord of Eternity, yet the people perceive it not. This is a Day wherein the Mother Book proclaimeth that there is none other God but He, the Self-Subsisting, the All-Compelling.

Subject: the Word of God; influence and centrality of
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/the Word of God; influence and centrality of.txt
Quotation: When ye have heard a verse or witnessed it, Our proof hath been perfected against you, if ye would but reflect a little on the verses of God. We revealed aforetime in the Furqan that none but God can reveal a verse, that perchance those who were given the Furqan might, after years of darkness, remember when they hear God's verses, and then believe.

Subject: the Word of God; influence and centrality of
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/the Word of God; influence and centrality of.txt
Quotation: Then were all created things thrown into commotion and all contingent beings were stirred by the fragrances that wafted from His Pen as it raced across the field of wisdom and knowledge. By God's life! The Tongue of Grandeur hath repeatedly and continually spoken this word, saying - and His word is the truth: "By My life, the Cause is mighty, mighty indeed!"

Subject: the Word of God; influence and centrality of
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/the Word of God; influence and centrality of.txt
Quotation: The Most Great, Most Holy Tongue of Pre-existence speaks and says: O concourse of the learned ones in the world! Your pens should become still when moves the Most Great Pen as it is between the fingers of your Lord, the Most High, the Most Great. Hold your tongues from that which the Tongue of Grandeur speaks - this behooveth you, if ye be of them that know."

Subject: the Word of God; influence and centrality of
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/the Word of God; influence and centrality of.txt
Quotation: He hath sent forth the Messengers and revealed the Books to manifest His grace and demonstrate His bounty and generosity. He hath made them the dawning-places of His revelation, the daysprings of His Cause, the manifestations of His Self and the sources of His wisdom, until the Books were sealed with the Qur'an and the Messengers with the Lord of all possibility

Subject: the Word of God; influence and centrality of
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/the Word of God; influence and centrality of.txt
Quotation: And on the title page of the translation of the sacred Book of Iqan, write: This is the translation of the Preserved Tablet, the Outspread Parchment, the Divine Seal, the All-Merciful's Decree - the Book of Iqan - which hath proceeded from the Supreme Pen and been revealed from the pure lips of the Blessed Beauty, may my spirit be a sacrifice for His loved ones.

Subject: the Word of God; influence and centrality of
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/the Word of God; influence and centrality of.txt
Quotation: Be assured concerning My verses and My beauty! These are My verses which have descended through grace from the heaven of the Most Exalted Name. Fear God and do not reject the truth through your own devices, nor follow your own desires, for all matters end with the verses of God, which have descended in the most melodious tones from a holy and resplendent heaven.

Subject: the Word of God; influence and centrality of
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/the Word of God; influence and centrality of.txt
Quotation: The Mother Book is the verses of God. Were He to send them down upon those who believe that they believe not, their very beings would be transformed. Do ye not then fear God? And were God to send them down upon those who believe not that they do believe, their very beings would be transformed. Such is the proof that maketh fire into light and light into fire.

Subject: the Word of God; influence and centrality of
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/the Word of God; influence and centrality of.txt
Quotation: He is a surging, wave-filled ocean wherein neither the ships of mystic knowledge, nor the vessels of utterance, nor the boats of remembrance can sail. Its waves arise not from winds but from a motion which none hath understood save Him...This is the motion that appeared from the stirring of the Primal Word - glorified be its Originator, its Speaker and its Manifestor.

Subject: the Word of God; influence and centrality of
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/the Word of God; influence and centrality of.txt
Quotation: The Most Great Word hath been made manifest by the command of the Lord of all names, and that blessed, firm, and mighty Word hath been interpreted through all the most beautiful names and most exalted attributes. Through it were the realities of all things attracted, and the Kingdom of Names was revealed, and every seeker hastened unto God, the Cleaver of the heavens.

Subject: the Word of God; influence and centrality of
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/the Word of God; influence and centrality of.txt
Quotation: The Book of God hath been sent down in truth - verily it is a perspicuous Book. The seas have surged, the trees have yielded their fruits, the rains have fallen, the birds have sung their songs, yet ye walk in the wilderness of ignorance. The Sun hath testified to this resplendent Light, and the atoms have proclaimed this Name that dominateth all who are in the heavens and on earth.

Subject: the Word of God; influence and centrality of
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/the Word of God; influence and centrality of.txt
Quotation: This is a Book that speaketh the truth before the faces of all mankind, though most of them neither understand nor hearken. The verses have encompassed all directions - blessed is he who hath heard and attained, and woe unto every heedless and veiled one. We have sent down the verses and manifested the clear proofs in such wise that none deny them save the heedless among the servants.

Subject: the Word of God; influence and centrality of
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/the Word of God; influence and centrality of.txt
Quotation: That which compelled the philosophers to speak of fixed archetypes and the simple reality is their station of affirmation in the knowledge of God, glorified be He[...] Indeed, to affirm that God's knowledge comes from creation is falsehood and untruth, for God's knowledge has ever been for Himself alone, and there was no object of knowledge with Him, and none knoweth how He is save Him.

Subject: the Word of God; influence and centrality of
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/the Word of God; influence and centrality of.txt
Quotation: Through it the spirit of life was breathed into the world. When it issueth forth from the mouth of God the whole creation is perfumed with its fragrance, yet none can perceive it save those who have turned to His Countenance with manifest sincerity. At times thou seest it as fire among the righteous, and at times as water whereby God quickeneth every mouldering bone, and at times in human form.

Subject: the Word of God; influence and centrality of
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/the Word of God; influence and centrality of.txt
Quotation: The verses are indeed God's Most Great Name; none among His creation can produce them. Desire this not, for this belongeth exclusively unto God Himself. Whoso claimeth to possess verses without proof, believe him not unless ye recognize that there is no God but I or there is no God but He, for none besides God can manifest such verses naturally, producing them as He willeth without constraint.

Subject: the Word of God; influence and centrality of
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/the Word of God; influence and centrality of.txt
Quotation: Baha'o'llah has clearly explained and defined the "Word". Christianity, as explained by its followers has taught that Christ is the Word and the Son of God. What is the meaning of this? Baha'o'llah has explained that seers and prophets are as letters incomplete in meaning. He shows that human intellects are imperfect, incomplete, but Christ was the All-Surrounding Word and synonymous with Perfection.

Subject: the Word of God; influence and centrality of
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/the Word of God; influence and centrality of.txt
Quotation: God hath revealed no Book but it beginneth with the mention of His Name. There is no God but Him, the Mighty, the Beloved. Say: All enter into the Truth through what God hath ordained for me, and all enter through me the gates of Paradise. Whosoever mentioneth me without believing in God, his Lord, My remembrance shall not be lawful unto him. Thus hath God purified me from all save the believers.

Subject: the Word of God; influence and centrality of
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/the Word of God; influence and centrality of.txt
Quotation: Then the Tongue of Grandeur spoke that which I am unable to mention, until He said: "O servant present before Me! Convey My glorification to those who have attained to My recognition and My presence, who have immersed themselves in the ocean of My proof, who soar in the atmosphere of My love, who drink the choice wine of My remembrance and praise, who have turned toward My face, and who stand before My gate."

Subject: the Word of God; influence and centrality of
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/the Word of God; influence and centrality of.txt
Quotation: And praise be to God Who hath revealed His Word whereby the fragrance of His grace hath been wafted throughout creation, and His mercy hath preceded all contingent beings. Through it the call was raised on the Sinai of divine manifestation to the son of Imran, and on the Sinai of divine knowledge to His Beloved, through whom the ocean of utterance surged and the sun of proof shone forth for the followers of all religions.

Subject: the Word of God; influence and centrality of
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/the Word of God; influence and centrality of.txt
Quotation: The verses are indeed God's possession wherein all things exist and naught can be compared unto them. Thus doth God create whatsoever He willeth by His command. He, verily, is the Mighty, the Best-Beloved. Say: The verses are indeed the splendor of thy Lord whereby ye are illumined. Say: In the verses is the majesty of God whereby ye are clothed with grandeur. Say: In the verses is the beauty of God whereby ye are drawn.

Subject: the Word of God; influence and centrality of
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/the Word of God; influence and centrality of.txt
Quotation: KalÃ¡m appears in three types. One is oral, which is composed of airwaves, impacts the orifice of the ear and is made and assembled of letters. The other is intellectual: that is, things that a person will comprehend after one has contemplated over them. And lastly, spiritual. The first two are created, but the third one is ancient, since it pertains to divine knowledge, and has its beginning in the knowledge of God, which is eternal.

Subject: the Word of God; influence and centrality of
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/the Word of God; influence and centrality of.txt
Quotation: Verily We have sent it down as an Arabic Qur'an that ye might understand. Ta Ha. God hath sent down the Qur'an unto His servant that men might know that God hath power over all things. He it is Who hath sent down the Criterion in Arabic, free from crookedness, unto His servant in pure truth as a revelation, that He might show you of His signs and the interpretation of utterances upon the straight path with unerring truth in wondrous wise.

Subject: the Word of God; influence and centrality of
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/the Word of God; influence and centrality of.txt
Quotation: This is a proof that hath been exalted above all proofs in the kingdom of the heavens and the earth and whatsoever is between them, and in all worlds. Say: This is a proof that hath appeared unto all who dwell in the kingdom of the heavens and the earth and whatsoever is between them, and in all worlds. Say: This is a proof that hath been concealed in the kingdom of the heavens and the earth and whatsoever is between them, and in all worlds.

Subject: the Word of God; influence and centrality of
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/the Word of God; influence and centrality of.txt
Quotation: Today is the Day that hath been mentioned and recorded in all the divine Books and Scriptures, past and future. Today is the day of seeing, for the Dawning-Place of Divine Revelation and the Dayspring of God's Command declareth Look and thou shalt behold Me. And today is the day of hearing, for from all directions the call of the Revealer of Verses is raised. The Mother Book hath been sent down, yet the people are occupied with trifling diversions.

Subject: the Word of God; influence and centrality of
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/the Word of God; influence and centrality of.txt
Quotation: The Word through whose breezes We quickened the kingdom of creation now lamenteth My sorrow and that which hath befallen Me at the hands of them that have violated My Covenant and Testament, and have chosen for themselves a loved one other than Me. From every word of thy Lord hath flowed the living waters of proof and evidence, yet the people are in manifest doubt. The ocean of wisdom hath surged before all faces, yet most of the people remain heedless.

Subject: the Word of God; influence and centrality of
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/the Word of God; influence and centrality of.txt
Quotation: In the Most Great Station, all verses that were revealed concerning God in His first and last Manifestation, and concerning His sanctity, shall be inscribed upon the Temples of Personification according to the order of Glory - exalted be His majesty and magnificent His order. That sublime order is such that the verses of God should be arranged according to their themes as they were revealed - that is, verses and prayers to their end, each according to its theme.

Subject: the Word of God; influence and centrality of
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/the Word of God; influence and centrality of.txt
Quotation: And verily that Primal Reality hath ascended beyond the bounds of expression and risen above the limits of similitude until it reached the station of humanity. There the worlds of the unseen appeared at the Dawning-Place of the visible, as 'Ali - peace be upon him - clearly stated in this station from that sermon, these being his words: I am that Manifest Light, I am that Resplendent Proof, and what was revealed unto Moses was but a particle of a particle of an atom.

Subject: the Word of God; influence and centrality of
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/the Word of God; influence and centrality of.txt
Quotation: In truth, it was a rose from the garden of love and a messenger from the city of affection. After inhaling its fragrance of humility, submissiveness, sincerity and acceptance, I flew on wings of longing until I stood before the countenance of the Lord of the Covenant and presented that which thy loving tongue had uttered in the garden of praise and glory. Thereupon did the Face of the Desired One turn toward me, and He spoke that which transcendeth all description and utterance.

Subject: the Word of God; influence and centrality of
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/the Word of God; influence and centrality of.txt
Quotation: Verily this Book is a decree from God unto all who dwell on earth. Verily it is a Book wherein there is no doubt, revealed by His servant, the Most High, the All-Wise. Were the Qur'an to be revealed as a single verse, could anyone speak even partially about its letters? Should all humanity gather together to produce the like of this Book which We have now sent down unto thee, they would never be able, nor would they have the power, even if the jinn were to aid them to the utmost.

Subject: the Word of God; influence and centrality of
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/the Word of God; influence and centrality of.txt
Quotation: They who dwell in the kingdom of names and attributes bear witness - as do all created things - that the Essence of the Seven Letters is His servant and His Word. God hath chosen for Him primary names, then immersed them in the limitless ocean beyond count or bound. Thus hath He filled His heavens and earth with the testimony that there is no God but Him, the One, the All-Compelling. Through this Point of the Bayan hath God created all letters infinitely unto infinity, and all abide by His command from Him.

Subject: the Word of God; influence and centrality of
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/the Word of God; influence and centrality of.txt
Quotation: These are the verses of God which have been sent down in truth. Verily they are the water of life for the people of the Supreme Concourse, the food of eternity for the dwellers of the cities of names, the white light of the Cause for those who abide behind the pavilions of the divine cloud, the Most Great Sea for the whales of knowledge and utterance. Say: By God! Every letter of God's Book hath an effect in the realm of being, whereby it giveth every rightful one his right and raiseth up its voice at all times.

Subject: the Word of God; influence and centrality of
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/the Word of God; influence and centrality of.txt
Quotation: Let not the entreaties of those who have been given the Bayan or their devotions in their religion on the day of Thy manifestation deceive Thee, for most of them act without being aware. Muhammad, the Apostle of God, trained those who were given Islam for one thousand two hundred and seventy years, and they reached the utmost degree of their supplications and prayers for the Manifestation of God. But when We made Ourselves known unto them, behold what happened in the Bayan, and be thou of them that bear witness.

Subject: the Word of God; influence and centrality of
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/the Word of God; influence and centrality of.txt
Quotation: O you who have written that He has established His truth through verses and proven His own truth through verses - these very words if thou but knowest have flowed from the Pen in proof of this Cause, yet you have failed to comprehend. For these verses you mention - either you are certain of them or not. If you are not, then all these words you have written were and shall be vain. And if you are certain, then why do you deny and turn away from these revealed verses which descend like abundant rain at every moment?

Subject: the Word of God; influence and centrality of
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/the Word of God; influence and centrality of.txt
Quotation: Today, through the existence of the Quran, there is established for the specific prophethood of the Ahmad Being, God's blessings be upon him, that which the sun of beginning never rose upon in the beginning, nor did the sun of ending set upon in the ending. Indeed, were one who beholds the stations of witnessing to seek proof from every letter of the Quran for his specific prophethood for all created things, they would be able to do so. For God has revealed the Quran in such manner that none can produce its like.

Subject: the Word of God; influence and centrality of
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/the Word of God; influence and centrality of.txt
Quotation: He hath chosen for Himself such letters of His oneness wherein naught can be seen save the manifestation of His revelation, encompassed by His knowledge unto infinity, for whatsoever God hath revealed through His signs and exalted through His words hath no will save what He hath willed, no purpose save what He hath purposed, no decree save what He hath decreed, no judgment save what He hath judged, no permission save what He hath permitted, no term save what He hath ordained, and no book save what He hath sent down.

Subject: the Word of God; influence and centrality of
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/the Word of God; influence and centrality of.txt
Quotation: The word of God, the logos, is God's highest, overflowing (emanating) love, kindness and the being in all that is and has been; that is, goodness [kindness] and love, thought of as logos, are the resting pole in the transientness [evanescence] of appearances. Verily, there is no difference between the word of God and the world. The word of God, the logos, is His highest, all pervasive grace. Yes, the word of God, the logos, is the only being, the creative reality (engendering essence) in all that is, was and will be.

Subject: the Word of God; influence and centrality of
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/the Word of God; influence and centrality of.txt
Quotation: O people! These are God's verses revealed unto Me in truth, and I have proclaimed them unto both East and West. By God! They are not of Mine own accord, but rather from One mighty and well-beloved. I am but a servant who hath believed in God and His verses. I possess no power over Mine own movement or stillness, standing or sitting, life or death, or resurrection. Whenever I remain silent in My house and cease from utterance, the Spirit of Holiness raiseth Me up to proclaim the Cause and giveth Me speech between heaven and earth.

Subject: the Word of God; influence and centrality of
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/the Word of God; influence and centrality of.txt
Quotation: In any case, being enkindled with the fire of love in one's heart impelleth man to utterance and expression. Through a single effulgence from the Sun of Will and Purpose He appeared, and from Him a Word was made manifest in the realm of creation, and from that Word infinite worlds were brought into being. At times He called it the Trumpet, at others the Bugle, now the Straight Path, then the Balance. And all the signs of the Day of Resurrection and the tokens of the Hour appeared through this wondrous and mighty Word by the command of the Lord of Oneness.

Subject: the Word of God; influence and centrality of
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/the Word of God; influence and centrality of.txt
Quotation: The banners of justice and fairness are raised before him. We beseech God to aid and protect His Majesty with the hosts of the exalted ones and the cherubim. He is powerful and mighty over all things. In any case, gatherings are not favored by any of the sovereigns, and this community must hold fast to that which pleases His Majesty the Sultan and act accordingly. If your honor were to come alone and then return, there would be no harm in this. Today all must hold fast to that which causes the exaltation of the Word and the manifestation of praiseworthy conduct.

Subject: the Word of God; influence and centrality of
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/the Word of God; influence and centrality of.txt
Quotation: If God had not established between Him and you these verses, how could ye attain unto faith, and how could ye submit, and how could ye testify to His oneness, and how could ye magnify Him? Therefore exalt ye the station of these verses to the utmost of your ability, for by them were your hearts created and through them do ye glorify; and by them were your spirits created and through them do ye render praise; and by them were your souls created and through them do ye testify to His unity; and by them were your bodies created and through them do ye magnify Him.

Subject: the Word of God; influence and centrality of
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/the Word of God; influence and centrality of.txt
Quotation: Consider the dawning of God's Word like unto the dawning of the sun. Just as the sun, after its rising, shineth upon all things, in the same way doth the Sun of the Word, which hath dawned from the horizon of divine will, shed its radiance upon all. I seek God's forgiveness for this comparison, for the visible sun deriveth from the all-embracing Word. By Him Who holdeth my soul in His hand! Were the inner power and sustaining force of the Divine Word to be withdrawn for but a moment from the world and its peoples, all would cease to exist and pass into nothingness.

Subject: the Word of God; influence and centrality of
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/the Word of God; influence and centrality of.txt
Quotation: Such is the Creator of the heavens and the earth and whatsoever is between them, the Mighty, the Beloved. Say: The measures of all things lie in the Word of God, not in the thing itself, did ye but know. When God nameth the night as day, do ye remember aught besides Him? And were God not to make the air purifying, ye would not be purified thereby. Are ye able to do this? This is that ye may witness that the Word of God purifieth you, even though He mentions it through the mention of air. And similarly in all things doth God's command take effect and is realized - not the thing itself, though it appeareth not save through it.

Subject: the Word of God; influence and centrality of
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/the Word of God; influence and centrality of.txt
Quotation: That life-giving water appeared in the form of the Word among creation and shone forth through a single effulgence, and that effulgence was manifested according to the diversity of mirrors in the forms of mirrors. That Word is the Primal Form into which the Divine Spirit breathed the Merciful Spirit, whereby He took hold of all spirits and bestowed upon them a new spirit. In some mirrors it appeared in the form and effect of light, and He guided it to the Dayspring of revelation; and in others it appeared in the form of fire, and He caused it to return to the evil dwelling place which is the abode of the wicked. This blessed Primal Word hath been called by all names - in one place as the Trumpet, in another as the Bugle, and likewise as the Path, the Balance, and the like.

Subject: the Word of God; influence and centrality of
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/the Word of God; influence and centrality of.txt
Quotation: Every breath of the Jesus of Truth is the bounty of the Greatest Name

Subject: the Word of God; influence and centrality of
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/the Word of God; influence and centrality of.txt
Quotation: This is verily the Most Great Book at which hearts are bewildered and eyes intoxicated.

Subject: the Word of God; influence and centrality of
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/the Word of God; influence and centrality of.txt
Quotation: An ocean of knowledge and wisdom lieth concealed in every word of the divine utterances.

Subject: the Word of God; influence and centrality of
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/the Word of God; influence and centrality of.txt
Quotation: Thus have We adorned the brocade of inner meanings with the light of wisdom and utterance.

Subject: the Word of God; influence and centrality of
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/the Word of God; influence and centrality of.txt
Quotation: The text interprets the symbolic meanings contained within the Quranic verse about divine light

Subject: the Word of God; influence and centrality of
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/the Word of God; influence and centrality of.txt
Quotation: Today the preface of the Book of Existence hath been adorned with this blessed and most exalted Word

Subject: the Word of God; influence and centrality of
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/the Word of God; influence and centrality of.txt
Quotation: The entire passage is an extended metaphorical description of divine revelation using natural imagery

Subject: the Word of God; influence and centrality of
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/the Word of God; influence and centrality of.txt
