Subject: the Word of God; influence and centrality of
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/the Word of God; influence and centrality of.txt
Quotation: The Most Holy, Most Great Book of Ha' hath in truth been sent down in this eventide from the All-Glorious.

Subject: the Word of God; influence and centrality of
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/the Word of God; influence and centrality of.txt
Quotation: Take hold of the Book of God with a strength from Him, then make mention to the servants in the nights and days

Subject: the Word of God; influence and centrality of
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/the Word of God; influence and centrality of.txt
Quotation: The Word of God is likened unto different things in different stations, showing its multiple meanings and aspects

Subject: the Word of God; influence and centrality of
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/the Word of God; influence and centrality of.txt
Quotation: This is a Book from God, the All-Compelling, the Self-Subsisting, unto God, the All-Compelling, the Self-Subsisting

Subject: the Word of God; influence and centrality of
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/the Word of God; influence and centrality of.txt
Quotation: the Tree beyond which there is no passing speaketh the truth...the Dove warbleth upon the branches in diverse melodies

Subject: the Word of God; influence and centrality of
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/the Word of God; influence and centrality of.txt
Quotation: The Kawthar of utterance is the Purpose of all worlds. Through it He hath quickened and continueth to quicken all beings.

Subject: the Word of God; influence and centrality of
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/the Word of God; influence and centrality of.txt
Quotation: How many servants there were unto whom We revealed that which all who are in the heavens and earth were powerless to produce

Subject: the Word of God; influence and centrality of
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/the Word of God; influence and centrality of.txt
Quotation: praise be to God that his holiness Baha'o'llah, has spread before us the heavenly table upon which one finds every kind of food

Subject: the Word of God; influence and centrality of
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/the Word of God; influence and centrality of.txt
Quotation: We have revealed unto thee from the hidden treasures deposited within Our Most Exalted Pen the pearls of loving-kindness and favor

Subject: the Word of God; influence and centrality of
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/the Word of God; influence and centrality of.txt
Quotation: Compare: "Thus doth God set forth truth and falsehood" - showing how divine verses contain deeper meanings about truth and falsehood

Subject: the Word of God; influence and centrality of
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/the Word of God; influence and centrality of.txt
Quotation: Take hold of the Book with strength, then recite it by night and day, that thou mayest discover the fragrance of thy Lord, the All-Merciful.

Subject: the Word of God; influence and centrality of
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/the Word of God; influence and centrality of.txt
Quotation: ...That which is in the Book is the success of what appears in the temples of effulgence through that which dawned from the Morn of Eternity...

Subject: the Word of God; influence and centrality of
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/the Word of God; influence and centrality of.txt
Quotation: This is a preserved Tablet sent down from God, the Protector, the Self-Subsisting. Within it flows the Kawthar of life - verily it is a sealed nectar.

Subject: the Word of God; influence and centrality of
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/the Word of God; influence and centrality of.txt
Quotation: Verily, they are the verses of God, the King, the Truth, the Manifest... Verily, they are the wisdom of God and by them every firm command is sent down

Subject: the Word of God; influence and centrality of
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/the Word of God; influence and centrality of.txt
Quotation: Into every word that God doth speak a new spirit is breathed, and the breezes of life are wafted therefrom upon all things both outwardly and inwardly.

Subject: the Word of God; influence and centrality of
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/the Word of God; influence and centrality of.txt
Quotation: In every word oceans of meanings and utterance lie concealed, nay in every letter, nay in every dot that after combination appeareth in the form of letters.

Subject: the Word of God; influence and centrality of
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/the Word of God; influence and centrality of.txt
Quotation: Praise be to God Who has distinguished between creation through the Most Exalted Word, whereby the imaginary has ebbed and the seas of knowledge have surged.

Subject: the Word of God; influence and centrality of
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/the Word of God; influence and centrality of.txt
Quotation: In every word We have concealed and sent forth oceans of meanings, and We have hidden and dispatched in the depths of letters the mysteries of countless books.

Subject: the Word of God; influence and centrality of
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/the Word of God; influence and centrality of.txt
Quotation: This is a Book which the All-Merciful hath sent down for all who dwell in the realm of possibility, that it may draw them nigh unto God, the Lord of all worlds.

Subject: the Word of God; influence and centrality of
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/the Word of God; influence and centrality of.txt
Quotation: He teacheth you these verses wherein lie the jewels of all the Names - would ye but ponder them. Therein lie the jewels of all religions - would ye but remember.

Subject: the Word of God; influence and centrality of
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/the Word of God; influence and centrality of.txt
Quotation: And one letter of Our verses is more precious to God than the kingdom of the hereafter and this world, for it is a revelation from the presence of a manifest Leader.

Subject: the Word of God; influence and centrality of
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/the Word of God; influence and centrality of.txt
Quotation: In the nights and days the rain of mercy descendeth from the heaven of bounty, and the pearls of wisdom and utterance appear from the treasury of the Most Exalted Pen.

Subject: the Word of God; influence and centrality of
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/the Word of God; influence and centrality of.txt
Quotation: Know thou that the chalice is My Word, and the Water of Life is that which lieth concealed within it of meanings which none hath understood save God, the Lord of existence.

Subject: the Word of God; influence and centrality of
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/the Word of God; influence and centrality of.txt
Quotation: Today all things speak forth the blessed word "The Glory has come!" This is that Name at which the joints of the polytheists tremble and the hearts of the monotheists find peace.

Subject: the Word of God; influence and centrality of
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/the Word of God; influence and centrality of.txt
Quotation: The cup of truth that brimmeth over with the wine of divine knowledge is passed around. The servants of the Divine zephyr have spread the bejewelled cloth of truth and inner meanings.

Subject: the Word of God; influence and centrality of
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/the Word of God; influence and centrality of.txt
Quotation: He it is Who hath detailed for you in the Book the paths of guidance from error, and hath sent down therein verses explaining all things, as guidance and light for people who use their reason.

Subject: the Word of God; influence and centrality of
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/the Word of God; influence and centrality of.txt
Quotation: I beseech Thee by the mysteries of Thy Book, the treasuries of Thy knowledge, and the pearls of the ocean of Thy wisdom, to ordain for Thy chosen ones the good of both this world and the next.

Subject: the Word of God; influence and centrality of
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/the Word of God; influence and centrality of.txt
Quotation: Verily God hath ordained therein precious books concerning the most hidden mystery, which none can touch save after the spreading of the pages of clear evidence from before the Gate, as witnessed.

Subject: the Word of God; influence and centrality of
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/the Word of God; influence and centrality of.txt
Quotation: The horizon of utterance hath dawned forth from the Sun of My remembrance, the Mighty, the Inaccessible. We have manifested the Cause and sent down the verses, yet the people are in evident doubt.

Subject: the Word of God; influence and centrality of
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/the Word of God; influence and centrality of.txt
Quotation: This is the Most Great Book which hath been inscribed by My Most Exalted Pen. Exalted is the Lord of creation Who hath sent it down and manifested it through a Name that hath encompassed the worlds.

Subject: the Word of God; influence and centrality of
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/the Word of God; influence and centrality of.txt
Quotation: This is a word which God hath made a fire unto them that deny and are proud, and a light unto them that have discerned the seat of the Cause in this Beauty Who hath been afflicted among these polytheists.

Subject: the Word of God; influence and centrality of
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/the Word of God; influence and centrality of.txt
Quotation: Consider thou how the beauty of the Pillar of the Greatest Name proceedeth only from the beauty of the Pillar of Divine Unity, and the Unity only from the Praise, and the Praise only from the Glorification.

Subject: the Word of God; influence and centrality of
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/the Word of God; influence and centrality of.txt
Quotation: The Book of Wonders hath been sent down in truth from God, the Exalted, the Great. Verily it is a sign of truth among creation and a proof from the All-Merciful unto all who are in the heavens and the earth.

Subject: the Word of God; influence and centrality of
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/the Word of God; influence and centrality of.txt
Quotation: These are the verses of God which have been sent down in truth from the heaven of glorious and wondrous might. God hath made them a proof from His presence and a testimony from His court unto all the worlds.

Subject: the Word of God; influence and centrality of
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/the Word of God; influence and centrality of.txt
Quotation: The essence of the matter and the finest explanation is that the entire Qur'an was manifested through the Praise (Al-Hamd), and it was manifested through the Bismillah, and it was manifested through the Point.

Subject: the Word of God; influence and centrality of
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/the Word of God; influence and centrality of.txt
Quotation: This is a Book sent down in truth for people who comprehend. Verily it hath been sent down from God, the Protector, the Self-Subsisting. It guideth mankind unto His path and giveth them to drink of His sealed wine.

Subject: the Word of God; influence and centrality of
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/the Word of God; influence and centrality of.txt
Quotation: the light of utterance hath shone forth from the horizon of the Will of God...When thou hast attained unto the Tablet of God and His signs, and hast quaffed the choice wine of utterance from the chalice of His bounty

Subject: the Word of God; influence and centrality of
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/the Word of God; influence and centrality of.txt
Quotation: Today the gate of utterance hath been unlocked by the Key of the Most Great Name, and the breezes of revelation and inspiration have, by leave of the Lord of all names, been wafted over the East and West of the world.

Subject: the Word of God; influence and centrality of
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/the Word of God; influence and centrality of.txt
Quotation: Through them is the existence given to drink what descends from the clouds of grace and bounty, and through them is adorned the brocade of the Book of Creation and embellished the Kingdom of Heaven with the lights of God

Subject: the Word of God; influence and centrality of
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/the Word of God; influence and centrality of.txt
Quotation: The dawn of guidance hath drawn breath, and the fire of the Tree of Sinai hath been ignited, and the ocean of grandeur surgeth, and the orb of the highest horizon shineth forth with a light that hath illumined both earth and heaven.

Subject: the Word of God; influence and centrality of
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/the Word of God; influence and centrality of.txt
Quotation: For each of the exalted letters, there exist with God innumerable books and volumes. Should He so desire, He would cause to appear from each letter the treasuries of knowledge and wisdom, and the repositories of understanding and proof.

Subject: the Word of God; influence and centrality of
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/the Word of God; influence and centrality of.txt
Quotation: I beseech Thee by Thy verses, which Thou hast made as light for Thy chosen ones, as fire for Thine enemies, as glory and honor and treasure for Thy loved ones, and as abasement and conquest and torment for the oppressors among Thy creatures

Subject: the Word of God; influence and centrality of
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/the Word of God; influence and centrality of.txt
Quotation: And if thou findest within thyself capacity and power, then ascend again and again that thou mayest witness the manifestations of thy Lord and that the lights of thy Lord's countenance, the Mighty, the Most Exalted, may be revealed unto thee.

Subject: the Word of God; influence and centrality of
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/the Word of God; influence and centrality of.txt
Quotation: Glorified be He Who hath spoken and caused all things to speak in His remembrance and praise, Who hath revealed from the Point the mysteries of the Books, and from the drop the secrets of the sea, and from the atom the effulgences of the Sun.

Subject: the Word of God; influence and centrality of
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/the Word of God; influence and centrality of.txt
Quotation: He is, verily, the Commander, the Almighty, the All-Glorious, the All-Bountiful. By God, the appointed time hath elapsed, and the Self-Subsisting hath come, and through Him hath been fulfilled that which God foretold in the Scriptures and Tablets.

Subject: the Word of God; influence and centrality of
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/the Word of God; influence and centrality of.txt
Quotation: Christ said to His disciples: "I am the bread which came down from heaven: whosoever eateth of this bread shall never die." He meant that the reality of Christ was the heavenly food, and whosoever partakes of this heavenly food attains eternal life.

Subject: the Word of God; influence and centrality of
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/the Word of God; influence and centrality of.txt
Quotation: And were all the waters in the sea to become ink for the verses of thy Lord, whose wisdom none can alter, verily the sea would be exhausted ere the light of a light from Our verses would be revealed - and thy Lord God is indeed the Strong, the Mighty.

Subject: the Word of God; influence and centrality of
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/the Word of God; influence and centrality of.txt
Quotation: God will cause you to understand the proof of Truth at the time of its manifestation, if ye believe in what God causeth you to understand and act accordingly. God hath created nothing more mighty than this, if ye would be guided by what God bestoweth upon you.

Subject: the Word of God; influence and centrality of
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/the Word of God; influence and centrality of.txt
Quotation: His is the Command! There is no God but Him. Say: All shall return unto Him. He is the One Who createth whatsoever He willeth by His command, and unto Him shall all return. He is the One Who bringeth into being whatsoever He desireth through His command Be, and it is.

Subject: the Word of God; influence and centrality of
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/the Word of God; influence and centrality of.txt
Quotation: The breezes of utterance have wafted, the fragrance of divine knowledge has been diffused, the sun of unity has shone forth, the moon of oneness has appeared, the rustling of the Divine Lote Tree has been raised, and the scratching of My Most Exalted Pen has been heard.

Subject: the Word of God; influence and centrality of
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/the Word of God; influence and centrality of.txt
Quotation: And verily He is the Mystery in the Words of Sinai from the Book of thy Lord - there is none other God but He - say: Be ye God-fearing. And every name of every created thing hath been sent down in the Book of thy Lord - there is none other God but He - say: Worship ye Him.

Subject: the Word of God; influence and centrality of
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/the Word of God; influence and centrality of.txt
Quotation: What hath been inscribed therein by the Most Exalted Pen are the jewels of the treasuries of the books of the ancients. Were God to desire to detail from one word thereof what is hidden in the treasuries of a preserving Tablet, He would be able, for He is the Ruler over what He willeth.

Subject: the Word of God; influence and centrality of
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/the Word of God; influence and centrality of.txt
Quotation: Present yourselves before him in the nights and days, and be engaged in the recitation of the decisive verses. Through them shall be kindled in your hearts the fire of the love of God and the light of His knowledge, and from the horizon of the heaven of your hearts shall rise the sun of His utterance.

Subject: the Word of God; influence and centrality of
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/the Word of God; influence and centrality of.txt
Quotation: Today, pure deeds are befitting those who possess the Mother Book. Blessed are they who have purified themselves from all imperfections, veils and doubts through the living waters of divine mercy and have set their faces toward the Most Exalted Horizon. This is the Day of deeds and the Day of virtuous character.

Subject: the Word of God; influence and centrality of
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/the Word of God; influence and centrality of.txt
Quotation: This is a noble Book sent down in truth from the presence of One mighty and all-knowing. Verily it is the Spirit of the Command through which the hearts of them that know are quickened, and verily it is the Lamp of God between the heavens and the earths, and verily it is a mercy and remembrance for all the worlds.

Subject: the Word of God; influence and centrality of
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/the Word of God; influence and centrality of.txt
Quotation: Compare the provided text to each of the subject categories on the list, and produce a ranked list, from strongest to weakest match, of all matches within the text to the list of subject categories, including for each subject category the relevant matching passage (exact translation, not a paraphrase) from the text.

Subject: the Word of God; influence and centrality of
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/the Word of God; influence and centrality of.txt
Quotation: And if it descendeth upon one who is not a believer but desireth to be guided, God will guide him thereby... For this is indeed a Book which, when it descendeth upon a believer, becometh light upon light and grace upon grace, and he will be assured by it and will stand firm in the Cause of his Lord like unto a mighty mountain.

Subject: the Word of God; influence and centrality of
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/the Word of God; influence and centrality of.txt
Quotation: Is this a glorious Book, or the temple of man wherein hath been inscribed by the Pen of the All-Merciful the knowledge of what hath been and what is to come? If this be a Book, by My life, it is verily the King of Books. If thou sayest it is man, by My beauty, it is the apple of the All-Merciful's eye, made manifest in creation.

Subject: the Word of God; influence and centrality of
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/the Word of God; influence and centrality of.txt
Quotation: This Day is the Day whereof all Prophets and Messengers have, from the Lord of the worlds, given glad-tidings unto all peoples...Now there hath appeared and been made manifest that which equalleth all the heavenly Books of the past and future, that concerning which every person of insight hath testified that it hath no peer or likeness.

Subject: the Word of God; influence and centrality of
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/the Word of God; influence and centrality of.txt
Quotation: Every attentive ear that heard this soul-stirring call responded with "Here am I!" and cried out from the depths of their soul "Our Lord! We have heard one calling to faith, saying 'Believe in your Lord!' and we believed." But every soul who manifested "deaf, dumb, and blind, they will not return" said "These are but tales of the ancients."

Subject: the Word of God; influence and centrality of
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/the Word of God; influence and centrality of.txt
Quotation: Verily, it is the Most Holy Book which hath been sent down from the heaven of the will of your Lord, the King of Kings. Hold fast unto the commandments of God; they are better for you than all that hath been and shall be. Verily, it is God's treasure among you, wherein are preserved the pearls of knowledge and wisdom, could ye but understand.

Subject: the Word of God; influence and centrality of
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/the Word of God; influence and centrality of.txt
Quotation: For the houri of meaning had been concealed from all eternity behind the pavilions of divine purity. Then she sought permission from the holy court of the sovereign to depart from the chambers of spiritual solitude and enter the compassionate, divine assemblage, and to shed upon the worlds of holiness and unity one of the hidden rays of epiphany.

Subject: the Word of God; influence and centrality of
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/the Word of God; influence and centrality of.txt
Quotation: How great, O my God, is Thy proof to myself and to whomsoever seeketh Thy testimony! How mighty, O my God, is Thy evidence in my inmost heart and outwardly, and to whomsoever seeketh the ways of Thy proof! Through Thee have I known Thee, O my God, and there is no God but Thee. Through Thee have I found proof of Thee, and there is no God but Thee.

Subject: the Word of God; influence and centrality of
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/the Word of God; influence and centrality of.txt
Quotation: Such verses and manifest, resplendent evidences have been vouchsafed unto you. By the rays of the Sun of Truth, nothing that exists or is hidden can equal a single letter thereof. Blessed is he who in this most glorious dawn hath attained unto the mention of the Lord of all names. This is the treasure that perisheth not and that moths cannot corrupt.

Subject: the Word of God; influence and centrality of
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/the Word of God; influence and centrality of.txt
Quotation: The wine of the utterance of the All-Merciful hath seized all who are in the realm of possibility, save those who violated the Covenant and broke God's pledge on the Day of Meeting. That which was hidden from time immemorial hath been revealed, and He hath summoned all unto Him on a Day wherein the gentle breeze hath wafted and the Herald hath proclaimed.

Subject: the Word of God; influence and centrality of
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/the Word of God; influence and centrality of.txt
Quotation: This is the Day whereon the All-Merciful hath come with manifest light and mighty sovereignty. This is the Day whereon the Interlocutor proclaimed: The Kingdom belongeth unto God, the Lord of the worlds. And Christ proclaimed: O concourse of earth and heaven! He Who is the Possessor of the Kingdom of Names hath come, and calleth you unto the Most Exalted Paradise.

Subject: the Word of God; influence and centrality of
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/the Word of God; influence and centrality of.txt
Quotation: Verily in the verses is God's might, whereby ye are made mighty. Say: Verily in the verses is God's will, whereby ye exercise will. Say: Verily in the verses is God's purpose, whereby ye form purpose. Say: Verily in the verses is God's knowledge, whereby ye gain knowledge. Say: Verily in the verses is God's wisdom, whereby ye excel one another and bear witness.

Subject: the Word of God; influence and centrality of
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/the Word of God; influence and centrality of.txt
Quotation: With this Word hath the brocade of the Book of Grace been adorned. Blessed is he who hath held fast unto it, perceived its fragrance, and acted according to that which is contained therein. Were the people of the world to partake of the living waters of the inner meanings which lie hidden within the divine Word, all would attain unto that which causeth certitude and assurance.

Subject: the Word of God; influence and centrality of
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/the Word of God; influence and centrality of.txt
Quotation: Observe in the Point that therein the letter Nun is the manifestation of transcription, Qaf the manifestation of praise, Ta the manifestation of unity, and Ha the manifestation of magnification. When the symbol in the Point is thus, then by the same token must thou infer regarding all letters and be inspired by them to the essences of the Most Unique of the unique - those letters.

Subject: the Word of God; influence and centrality of
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/the Word of God; influence and centrality of.txt
Quotation: In the Word He placed the effect of the sword, and in utterance the effect of the water of life. At times He takes, and at times He gives - meaning that the spirit's manifestation and emergence is a divine trust. In the Word are concealed both the ocean of mercy and the preordained sword. These mysteries are witnessed in the divine verses. One word gives life while another takes it away.

Subject: the Word of God; influence and centrality of
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/the Word of God; influence and centrality of.txt
Quotation: Know thou that in these days there hath been sent down from the heaven of the will of thy Lord, the All-Merciful, that which is the spirit of life for the body of the world and the cause of everlasting life for those who have turned unto God, the Lord of all men. It hath been named the Most Holy Book, and therein have been revealed the laws and whatsoever God hath sanctified from all directions.

Subject: the Word of God; influence and centrality of
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/the Word of God; influence and centrality of.txt
Quotation: Were all who are in the earth and whatsoever lieth between to gather together to produce a Book from God like unto this, they could never do so, nor would they be able, save Him Whom God shall make manifest on the Day of Resurrection. For God shall cause to be revealed unto Him the like of what He hath revealed unto Me, and His tongue shall speak forth, reciting the verses of God as He willeth.

Subject: the Word of God; influence and centrality of
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/the Word of God; influence and centrality of.txt
Quotation: When the choice wine of verses hath taken hold of you and the breezes of revelation have attracted you... This choice wine in one station representeth the verses of God, glorified be His majesty, in another station His remembrance and praise, and in yet another His bounty and grace. This choice wine in one station is the cause of the life of the world, and in another the cause of the preservation of the peoples.

Subject: the Word of God; influence and centrality of
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/the Word of God; influence and centrality of.txt
Quotation: Thus have the gates of Paradise been opened and the Youth of Holiness hath appeared with a manifest serpent. Glad tidings! This Youth of Eternity hath come with crystal water, and upon His face is a veil woven by the fingers of might and power. Glad tidings! This Youth of Eternity hath come with a great name, and upon His head is the crown of beauty, whereby the inhabitants of the heavens and earth are illumined.

Subject: the Word of God; influence and centrality of
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/the Word of God; influence and centrality of.txt
Quotation: By God's life! The seas of inner meanings lie concealed in his words and hidden in the treasuries of his knowledge. Blessed are they who, despite the peoples of the world, turned unto him and drank therefrom. The sealed wine is the divine utterances which none had attained unto until this Revelation, but the Finger of Power in this Most Great Revelation hath unsealed it that all may drink thereof and attain unto it.

Subject: the Word of God; influence and centrality of
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/the Word of God; influence and centrality of.txt
Quotation: Today, no one will be benefitted by anything but clinging to the praiseworthy pearl Handle. And if they say, 'He forged it,' reply, 'then produce forgeries the like of what has been revealed!'--so that they may witness their own impotence and may be among those who comprehend. Say: By God, were you to gather together with all those on the earth so as to produce a similar verse, they would be unable to accomplish it.

Subject: the Word of God; influence and centrality of
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/the Word of God; influence and centrality of.txt
Quotation: We have indeed sent down verses for every occasion, yet most of the people are wrapped in heedlessness and veils. Every letter, every word, and every line in the Books of God hath testified to this Tablet which hath appeared in the temple of man, and verily this is the Tablet which hath been preserved from all eternity within the pavilions of immaculacy, through a command from the presence of the Beloved, the All-Glorious.

Subject: the Word of God; influence and centrality of
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/the Word of God; influence and centrality of.txt
Quotation: Consider how heedless the people are. Like Siyyid Yusuf and his like, they make claims to truth while remaining heedless and turning away from the exalted Truth. They make claims to truth while remaining heedless and turning away from the exalted Truth. By His mighty and exalted word: People are weak and immature, having drunk the milk of heedlessness from the breast of desire, afflicted with the chronic diseases of ignorance and foolishness.

Subject: the Word of God; influence and centrality of
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/the Word of God; influence and centrality of.txt
Quotation: Through it were opened the gates of the treasuries of heaven and the Kingdom of Names was revealed. Through it the Trump was blown and the Call was raised amidst the concourse of creation. Through it the mountains of idle fancies were scattered and the heavens of vain imaginings were cleft asunder and the earths of knowledge were split among the peoples. At times thou seest it flowing like water in the valleys, and at other times blazing like fire upon the heights.

Subject: the Word of God; influence and centrality of
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/the Word of God; influence and centrality of.txt
Quotation: They who are today deprived of the knowledge of God, glorified be His majesty, are accounted as dead in the sight of God. Today, life is not manifested through movement, nor sight through observation, nor hearing through listening. Ponder the Furqan, which distinguisheth between truth and falsehood. They who are bereft of the ornament of faith are not reckoned among those endowed with sight and hearing, nay rather, they are not accounted among the living before God.

Subject: the Word of God; influence and centrality of
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/the Word of God; influence and centrality of.txt
Quotation: As the holy Manifestation hath a composed perspicuous Book, His inmost divine reality and essence is the Mother Book of creation, the Guarded Tablet, the Scroll unfolded, and the Decree inscribed. And as the composed Book of laws and ordinances containeth chapters, verses, words and letters, the reality of faith, that is, the Book of creation, likewise embraceth and includeth verses, words and numbered letters in respect to names, attributes, ordinances and effects.

Subject: the Word of God; influence and centrality of
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/the Word of God; influence and centrality of.txt
Quotation: O thou who art listening! If thou desirest to reach the ocean of meanings which surgeth in the land of the heart, and to witness the waves of the sea of realities which billoweth in the hearts of those possessed of love and righteousness, then hear what I speak in this moment as I sit before God and rest upon the dust of servitude before His face. Know thou that this verse hath meanings which none among the people of creation can reckon save him whom God, the Lord of earth and heaven, doth aid.

Subject: the Word of God; influence and centrality of
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/the Word of God; influence and centrality of.txt
Quotation: O thou Phoenix of fire! Conquer hearts through the remembrance of thy Lord, the Mighty, the All-Choosing. Then give the contingent beings to drink from the chalice of divine verses through the hands of maidens who dwell in the chambers of the words of the Revealer of mysteries, whom no strangers or evil ones have touched, and whose presence God has made exclusive to those among His servants possessed of insight, who were among the choicest of creation and held fast to the cord of God, the Almighty, the Compelling.

Subject: the Word of God; influence and centrality of
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/the Word of God; influence and centrality of.txt
Quotation: Therefore He did not create more than twenty-eight letters, nor more than one thousand letters of the unseen - neither less nor more than that is possible. This is the first mystery in the creation of letters, and all of this returns to four points: The first for the one, the second for the tens, the third for the hundreds, and the fourth for the thousands. When combined it is identical to the thousand, as we shall mention, God willing, in the station of mentioning the thousand. These four points in the science of letters form a circle of manifestation, which is the greatest method in that art, from which can be derived knowledge of what was and what will be through those four points.

Subject: the Word of God; influence and centrality of
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/the Word of God; influence and centrality of.txt
Quotation: And in the Mother Book there are four signs for those who ponder upon the creation of their own selves and upon the horizons. Say: If ye desire to drink of water that altereth not, from the hand of God, then recite ye the verses of God. And if ye desire to drink of milk whose taste changeth not, from the hand of God, then recite ye the verses of God. And if ye desire to drink of crimson wine, then recite ye those verses. And if ye desire to drink of clarified honey before the presence of God, then recite ye those verses. Say: All these streams flow within the verses of God, then within the Scriptures, then within the clear proofs, then within the Words; and in each one these streams do flow, would ye but ponder thereon.

Subject: the Word of God; influence and centrality of
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/the Word of God; influence and centrality of.txt
Quotation: Know ye then, O people, that God hath made each letter of these words a paradise more vast than can be reckoned by all who dwell within the realm of possibility. And they who remain behind the veils of light at the manifestations of this Revelation, wherein are seated the Maids of inner meanings and utterance from the mysteries of this divine Youth Who is established upon the throne of forgiveness - were but the beauty of one of these to be unveiled before the dwellers of earth and heaven, all would be thunderstruck, nay, would cease to exist, save those who hold fast to the cord of the beauty of Him Who is peerless throughout creation in His all-bountiful Self, and in whose breast the Beauty of the Unseen speaketh at all times, saying: Thou art God; there is none other God but Thee, the All-Compelling, the Most Generous.

Subject: the Word of God; influence and centrality of
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/the Word of God; influence and centrality of.txt

Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/the Word of God; influence and centrality of.txt

Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/the Word of God; influence and centrality of.txt

Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/the Word of God; influence and centrality of.txt

Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/the Word of God; influence and centrality of.txt

Subject: the Word of God; influence and centrality of
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/the Word of God; influence and centrality of.txt

Subject: the Word of God; influence and centrality of
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/the Word of God; influence and centrality of.txt

Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/the Word of God; influence and centrality of.txt

Subject: the Word of God; influence and centrality of
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/the Word of God; influence and centrality of.txt

Subject: the Word of God; influence and centrality of
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/the Word of God; influence and centrality of.txt

Subject: the Word of God; influence and centrality of
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/the Word of God; influence and centrality of.txt

Subject: the Word of God; influence and centrality of
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/the Word of God; influence and centrality of.txt

Subject: the Word of God; influence and centrality of
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/the Word of God; influence and centrality of.txt

Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/the Word of God; influence and centrality of.txt

Subject: the Word of God; influence and centrality of
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/the Word of God; influence and centrality of.txt

Subject: the Word of God; influence and centrality of
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/the Word of God; influence and centrality of.txt

Subject: the Word of God; influence and centrality of
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/the Word of God; influence and centrality of.txt
Quotation: Whoso hath attained unto it hath attained unto that which his Lord, the Gracious, did desire, and whoso hath shown pride, he is truly among the losers.

Subject: the Word of God; influence and centrality of
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/the Word of God; influence and centrality of.txt

Subject: the Word of God; influence and centrality of

Subject: the Word of God; influence and centrality of
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/the Word of God; influence and centrality of.txt

Subject: the Word of God; influence and centrality of
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/the Word of God; influence and centrality of.txt

Subject: the Word of God; influence and centrality of
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/the Word of God; influence and centrality of.txt
Quotation: If until now all had acted according to what has flowed from the Supreme Pen, all would have found themselves in the cradle of peace, security and greatest rest.

Subject: the Word of God; influence and centrality of
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/the Word of God; influence and centrality of.txt

Subject: the Word of God; influence and centrality of
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/the Word of God; influence and centrality of.txt

Subject: the Word of God; influence and centrality of
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/the Word of God; influence and centrality of.txt

Subject: the Word of God; influence and centrality of
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/the Word of God; influence and centrality of.txt

Subject: the Word of God; influence and centrality of
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/the Word of God; influence and centrality of.txt

Subject: the Word of God; influence and centrality of
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/the Word of God; influence and centrality of.txt

Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/the Word of God; influence and centrality of.txt
