Quotation: Were the people of the world to partake of the living waters of the inner meanings which lie hidden within the divine Word, all would attain unto that which causeth certitude and assurance.

Subject: the Word of God; influence and centrality of
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/the Word of God; influence and centrality of.txt
Quotation: He uttered the Most Exalted Word. At that instant the ocean of recognition surged, the fragrance of the All-Merciful wafted, and the light of certitude shone forth from the horizon of proof.

Subject: the Word of God; influence and centrality of
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/the Word of God; influence and centrality of.txt
Quotation: In each word surgeth the ocean of names from the Fashioner of earth and heaven. And in each verse thereof is ordained the creation of that which none knoweth save God, the Lord of all worlds.

Subject: the Word of God; influence and centrality of
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/the Word of God; influence and centrality of.txt
Quotation: The Lord of the Day of Judgment hath sent it down; verily it hath been revealed from before God, the Lord of the worlds, and guideth the people to His straight path and His mighty announcement

Subject: the Word of God; influence and centrality of
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/the Word of God; influence and centrality of.txt
Quotation: The Most Exalted Pen hath appeared and its shrill voice hath been raised before the faces of all peoples. Blessed is he who hath heard and turned and attained, and woe unto every froward infidel!

Subject: the Word of God; influence and centrality of
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/the Word of God; influence and centrality of.txt
Quotation: And these souls shed such radiance upon the horizons that its world-embracing rays encompassed earth and heaven, and its all-surrounding ocean continues to surge against the shores of the world.

Subject: the Word of God; influence and centrality of
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/the Word of God; influence and centrality of.txt
Quotation: The Word of God giveth life to bodies and sustaineth spirits. Its fragrance hath perfumed the worlds of justice and fairness, and its light hath illumined the hearts of them that are nigh unto God.

Subject: the Word of God; influence and centrality of
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/the Word of God; influence and centrality of.txt
Quotation: He is the One Who sendeth down the verses from His presence as He pleaseth according to a determined measure. He is the One Who hath revealed in the Book the measures of all things by His command.

Subject: the Word of God; influence and centrality of
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/the Word of God; influence and centrality of.txt
Quotation: Reference to the supreme power of the divine Tablet. "this Tablet, before which, when it was sent down from the kingdom of the command of thy Lord, all the books of the world bowed down in submission"

Subject: the Word of God; influence and centrality of
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/the Word of God; influence and centrality of.txt
Quotation: Nothing in the heavens or on earth or between them can frustrate Him, nor can anything in the kingdom of command and creation and what lieth beneath them elude His knowledge. He is witness over all things.

Subject: the Word of God; influence and centrality of
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/the Word of God; influence and centrality of.txt
Quotation: This Cause whereby existence, both seen and unseen, hath been illumined, and the faces of them that have turned aside have been darkened... the Dayspring of Beauty Who hath appeared with mighty sovereignty

Subject: the Word of God; influence and centrality of
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/the Word of God; influence and centrality of.txt
Quotation: This is a garden beneath whose shadows flow rivers from this Tree which hath been raised up in truth - verily He is the Speaker, the All-Seeing... Through Whose word the Prophets and Messengers were created

Subject: the Word of God; influence and centrality of
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/the Word of God; influence and centrality of.txt
Quotation: "This is a Day wherein the True One hath appeared in His Own Person, and the equivalent of all the aforementioned Books possessed by the people is, should God so will and desire, revealed in but a few days."

Subject: the Word of God; influence and centrality of
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/the Word of God; influence and centrality of.txt
Quotation: Hearken unto that which the Word of God doth speak from the prison. Verily He did make mention of thee aforetime in such wise as did cause the fragrance of the All-Merciful to be wafted throughout all creation

Subject: the Word of God; influence and centrality of
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/the Word of God; influence and centrality of.txt
Quotation: The chains which Christ places around the neck of Satan are the breaking of his influence, the repelling of his dominion, and the scattering of his hosts through the power of divine revelation and inspiration.

Subject: the Word of God; influence and centrality of
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/the Word of God; influence and centrality of.txt
Quotation: Verily, it is the Path that crieth out among the servants, and the Balance that speaketh with justice, and the Standard which, through this Name, hath been raised by the hand of power upon the most lofty heights.

Subject: the Word of God; influence and centrality of
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/the Word of God; influence and centrality of.txt
Quotation: The True One, exalted be His glory, has remembered His male and female servants, and declares that in the nights and days the Most Exalted Pen has not paused - this is from the great bounty of the Lord of the world.

Subject: the Word of God; influence and centrality of
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/the Word of God; influence and centrality of.txt
Quotation: there floweth from His Pen that which His will had not preceded, and before which the mountain of the mystics who look not toward the Most Exalted Horizon and who were gazing through veils and allusions would crumble

Subject: the Word of God; influence and centrality of
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/the Word of God; influence and centrality of.txt
Quotation: When its meanings overflow, they encompass creation and the dead are raised from their graves. Soon shalt thou witness how the breath of God hath quickened the horizons even as the vernal breezes give life to the trees.

Subject: the Word of God; influence and centrality of
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/the Word of God; influence and centrality of.txt
Quotation: We have revealed for thee that which hath caused all things to turn towards thee and to hear what hath been sent down in thy name in the Scriptures and Tablets... at whose revelation the Bayan hath bowed down in submission

Subject: the Word of God; influence and centrality of
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/the Word of God; influence and centrality of.txt
Quotation: We have sent down from the heaven of revelation that which profiteth the servants... The Hidden Treasure hath appeared, yet the people perceive it not. The Mother Book hath been sent down, yet the people understand it not.

Subject: the Word of God; influence and centrality of
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/the Word of God; influence and centrality of.txt
Quotation: The entire first paragraph details the power and effects of the Word of God in transforming individuals and the world: "and with a single glance transformed a world and cleared the dust from the hearts of those who knew it"

Subject: the Word of God; influence and centrality of
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/the Word of God; influence and centrality of.txt
Quotation: We have sent down for them a Tablet whereby the fragrance of the All-Merciful hath been wafted throughout all worlds, that they may rejoice and stand firm in this wondrous Cause...and remembrance whereby creation is influenced.

Subject: the Word of God; influence and centrality of
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/the Word of God; influence and centrality of.txt
Quotation: This is a Book which the All-Merciful hath sent down for all who are in the realm of possibility. Verily it summoneth all to a station wherein naught is seen save the splendors of the face of God, the All-Knowing, the All-Wise.

Subject: the Word of God; influence and centrality of
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/the Word of God; influence and centrality of.txt
Quotation: Now the Euphrates of wisdom and utterance floweth from the right hand of the throne of the All-Merciful, and from the treasury of the Most Exalted Pen appear and shine forth the pearls of knowledge and the gems of understanding.

Subject: the Word of God; influence and centrality of
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/the Word of God; influence and centrality of.txt
Quotation: Today the penetrative power in the world of existence is the confirmation of the Kingdom of Abha. Every plan and system which is assisted by this power will be established in the world of humanity and will be realized among men.

Subject: the Word of God; influence and centrality of
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/the Word of God; influence and centrality of.txt
Quotation: Through it hath God raised up whom He willeth and distinguished between the polytheists and the monotheists. It is a fire unto them that have waxed proud, and a light unto them that have turned towards the Dayspring of Revelation.

Subject: the Word of God; influence and centrality of
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/the Word of God; influence and centrality of.txt
Quotation: The gate of heaven hath been opened by the key of the Most Great Name, yet the nations have risen in opposition, to such extent that the dwellers of the highest Paradise and the inhabitants of the most exalted Garden have lamented.

Subject: the Word of God; influence and centrality of
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/the Word of God; influence and centrality of.txt
Quotation: Were all of creation to come together, and even if We were to assist them by doubling their number, they will be powerless to bring forth a verse like unto those we revealed for you in that Book, and God is the Powerful and Mighty.

Subject: the Word of God; influence and centrality of
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/the Word of God; influence and centrality of.txt
Quotation: The greatest philosophers without this Spirit are powerless, their souls lifeless, their hearts dead! Unless the Holy Spirit breathes into their souls, they can do no good work... No capacity is limited when led by the Spirit of God!

Subject: the Word of God; influence and centrality of
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/the Word of God; influence and centrality of.txt
Quotation: The Kawthar of utterance hath flowed from the mouth of the Will of your Lord, the Most Merciful. Fear God and deprive not yourselves thereof. Drink ye therefrom, that it may purify you from the defilement of every rebellious polytheist.

Subject: the Word of God; influence and centrality of
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/the Word of God; influence and centrality of.txt
Quotation: Were ye to behold but one of the revelations that have shone forth from the horizon of the Face, ye would surely rend your hearts with your own hands and say: "This is none other than the Beloved of those who are in the heavens and on earth."

Subject: the Word of God; influence and centrality of
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/the Word of God; influence and centrality of.txt
Quotation: The Word hath so influenced the rocks that rivers have flowed from them, yet it hath not influenced those whose eyes are blinded from beholding the Most Exalted Horizon and whose ears are deafened to hearkening unto this perspicuous utterance.

Subject: the Word of God; influence and centrality of
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/the Word of God; influence and centrality of.txt
Quotation: All that thou hast witnessed before in this earthly life is elevated by a single word from thy Lord's remembrance of thee. Thus doth God ordain the measure of all things for those endowed with knowledge who are assured of God and His signs.

Subject: the Word of God; influence and centrality of
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/the Word of God; influence and centrality of.txt
Quotation: Through His might He manifested the Most Exalted Pen, whereby He opened the cities of hearts and minds. At times it appears as a cutting sword, sparing not the wicked, and at others as a moving light, proceeding before the faces of the righteous.

Subject: the Word of God; influence and centrality of
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/the Word of God; influence and centrality of.txt
Quotation: This is a Book which the All-Merciful hath sent down unto all who are in the realm of possibility, that the utterance may draw them to the horizon from which the Luminary of Manifestation hath shone forth in this blessed, mighty and wondrous Day.

Subject: the Word of God; influence and centrality of
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/the Word of God; influence and centrality of.txt
Quotation: Know then that what flows from the Most Exalted Pen is for the loved ones of God, the Lord of Names. Whoever holds fast to it is of Him and whoever turns away - God is quit of him... and whatsoever flows from the Most Exalted Pen holds sway over all.

Subject: the Word of God; influence and centrality of
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/the Word of God; influence and centrality of.txt
Quotation: Then take the Book of God with a strength from Him and recite it with the melodies of the unitarians, that it may draw thee away from thy self and thy desires and bring thee to this hallowed station whose courtyard the Spirit of Truth sweepeth clean.

Subject: the Word of God; influence and centrality of
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/the Word of God; influence and centrality of.txt
Quotation: The Kawthar of life hath flowed from His utterance throughout all possibility, and the ocean of knowledge hath surged before the faces of all religions. Blessed is he who hastened, and partook, and drank, detached from the world and all that is therein.

Subject: the Word of God; influence and centrality of
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/the Word of God; influence and centrality of.txt
Quotation: None denieth it save every rejected polytheist. Whoso denieth it hath denied his Lord from all eternity. Unto this doth the King of Kings bear witness, Who hath spoken: "There is none other God but Me, the All-Compelling over what was and what shall be."

Subject: the Word of God; influence and centrality of
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/the Word of God; influence and centrality of.txt
Quotation: Were He to send them down upon those who believe that they believe not, their very beings would be transformed. Do ye not then fear God? And were God to send them down upon those who believe not that they do believe, their very beings would be transformed.

Subject: the Word of God; influence and centrality of
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/the Word of God; influence and centrality of.txt
Quotation: Glorified is He Who hath sent down the verses in truth and created through them whatsoever He hath willed. He is verily the Powerful, the All-Choosing. All things have submitted to His sovereignty, and through it the mountain of idle fancies hath crumbled.

Subject: the Word of God; influence and centrality of
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/the Word of God; influence and centrality of.txt
Quotation: This Most Holy, Most Wondrous, Most Great Book speaks with truth between the heavens and the earth. Whoso hath hearkened unto it is assuredly of the people of Baha inscribed in the Tablet of Eternity, and whoso hath turned away is among the people of error.

Subject: the Word of God; influence and centrality of
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/the Word of God; influence and centrality of.txt
Quotation: "Outwardly the holy Manifestations of God were completely humiliated and despised. They were mocked by all. But in a short space of time the penetrative influence of their words filled the hearts and the sun of their greatness and majesty illumined the world."

Subject: the Word of God; influence and centrality of
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/the Word of God; influence and centrality of.txt
Quotation: He walketh and speaketh that which exalteth the Word of God and your stations. This is a Day wherein verses have been sent down before the faces of the loved ones who have left their stations, turning toward the Most Exalted Station in the All-Glorious Horizon

Subject: the Word of God; influence and centrality of
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/the Word of God; influence and centrality of.txt
Quotation: for in these days from every pit hath emerged a serpent of polytheism that rusheth forth behind every soul, and when it reacheth that soul it stingeth and destroyeth it instantly, except for one who possesseth the antidote of the name of thy Lord, the Most High.

Subject: the Word of God; influence and centrality of
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/the Word of God; influence and centrality of.txt
Quotation: These are the holy verses sent down in truth from the clouds of a wondrous grace, whereby the hearts of the servants are purified from the defilement of self and desire, and they drink from cups whose admixture is the remembrance of the Beloved and the Dear One.

Subject: the Word of God; influence and centrality of
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/the Word of God; influence and centrality of.txt
Quotation: The verses have been sent down in such wise that none can deny them save him whom the wrath of his Lord hath overtaken by reason of that which his hands have wrought aforetime. And power hath been manifested in such wise as to encompass all who are in the worlds.

Subject: the Word of God; influence and centrality of
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/the Word of God; influence and centrality of.txt
Quotation: Verily it is the Ancient Sign amongst the nations and the Lamp of Guidance for whoso is in the earths and heavens. Verily it is the Water of Life for the life of all who dwell in the realm of possibility, and the Proof of the All-Merciful to every discerning mystic.

Subject: the Word of God; influence and centrality of
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/the Word of God; influence and centrality of.txt
Quotation: And He giveth you life through this, the Lord of all the worlds. Say: Verily in the verses is God's might, whereby ye are made mighty. Say: Verily in the verses is God's power; therefore remember God, your Lord, the Merciful, for verily He is the Powerful, the Mighty.

Subject: the Word of God; influence and centrality of
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/the Word of God; influence and centrality of.txt
Quotation: The effulgences of the Sun of Grace have shone forth in such wise that none except God, exalted be His glory, can reckon them. In truth, countless oceans surge within the divine verses, and they were sent to India. Each one hath had and shall have its effect and fruit.

Subject: the Word of God; influence and centrality of
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/the Word of God; influence and centrality of.txt
Quotation: By the Sun of existence, whatever you have seen of his that might have been somewhat bearable to hear had no connection to him whatsoever. God willing, we hope that if the words of truth do not benefit those who are in error, they may affect and benefit the fair-minded.

Subject: the Word of God; influence and centrality of
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/the Word of God; influence and centrality of.txt
Quotation: O people! If ye deny this power and this proof, by what evidence can ye establish your faith in your Lord, the Most Merciful? Nay, by Him through Whom the earth and heaven were illumined with the light of Baha, they shall find for themselves no path unto the truth.

Subject: the Word of God; influence and centrality of
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/the Word of God; influence and centrality of.txt
Quotation: The clouds and mists, the rain and trees and fruits, all bear witness that the Supreme Pen was never still in any state. If at times it appeared outwardly to pause, inwardly it was engaged in spiritual motion, revealing to the world of being whatsoever was meet and seemly.

Subject: the Word of God; influence and centrality of
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/the Word of God; influence and centrality of.txt
Quotation: Through it the Fire of God was kindled and appeared from the Tree, and it spoke: "Verily, there is none other God but Me, thy Lord and the Lord of thy forefathers!" The ears were prevented from hearkening unto this Call save those whom God, the Lord of all worlds, hath willed.

Subject: the Word of God; influence and centrality of
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/the Word of God; influence and centrality of.txt
Quotation: The Word of God shineth forth among words even as the sun at high noon. We have sent down unto thee a Tablet whereof were but one letter to descend upon every mountain, thou wouldst surely behold it soaring, out of longing, toward the Dawning-Place of Names and Attributes.

Subject: the Word of God; influence and centrality of
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/the Word of God; influence and centrality of.txt
Quotation: and by it all who are in the heavens and earths were struck with terror, and by it God distinguished between the unitarians and the polytheists, and by it the breezes of forgiveness wafted upon the temples of the sinners, and by it the sun of wealth shone upon the poor and needy

Subject: the Word of God; influence and centrality of
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/the Word of God; influence and centrality of.txt
Quotation: This call is the source of life for the world. This call hath appeared from the Dawning-Place of grandeur. Soon will its effects become manifest and evident throughout all regions of the world, and none among the princes and divines of Iran have been or shall be able to conceal it.

Subject: the Word of God; influence and centrality of
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/the Word of God; influence and centrality of.txt
Quotation: Those who wrote treatises proving the falsity of religions and establishing naturalism, who were averse to all the Prophets and Messengers, are now engaged in promoting the Cause of God with perfect firmness and steadfastness... Observe to what degree the Word of God has influence!

Subject: the Word of God; influence and centrality of
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/the Word of God; influence and centrality of.txt
Quotation: The pavilion of the world's order is upheld by two pillars: punishment and reward. Should people observe with fairness the divine words - that which the All-Merciful hath revealed in the Quran - all would testify that in every word from that Kingdom lies concealed governance and law.

Subject: the Word of God; influence and centrality of
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/the Word of God; influence and centrality of.txt
Quotation: He is the One calling between earth and heaven! Glorified be He Who speaks in the nights and days, at eventide and dawn, and sends down verses as He wishes in such wise that neither the tyranny of the Pharaohs of the earth nor the oppression of the tyrants of the lands can prevent Him

Subject: the Word of God; influence and centrality of
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/the Word of God; influence and centrality of.txt
Quotation: Verily the Word of God bringeth you to faith, not that which ye practice, for on that Day ye shall follow the Faith of God which He hath sent down aforetime. How then can God testify to your faith? This is that ye may witness that faith is created by the Word of God according to His will.

Subject: the Word of God; influence and centrality of
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/the Word of God; influence and centrality of.txt
Quotation: The Supreme Elixir is none other than the Word of God which hath indeed changed the world of contingent reality to become resplendent with Lordly illumination and hath perfumed the horizons with the fragrances of holiness. By its power and strength it hath conquered the East and the West.

Subject: the Word of God; influence and centrality of
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/the Word of God; influence and centrality of.txt
Quotation: The very verses have humbled themselves before my countenance, and all sounds are submissive before my wondrous and most amazing melodies. This is my palm, which God has rendered white for all the worlds. And this is my staff. Were we to cast it down, it would attain to the entire creation.

Subject: the Word of God; influence and centrality of
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/the Word of God; influence and centrality of.txt
Quotation: When clear proofs appear they pant, and when verses are recited unto them they turn away...verses have been sent down for thee which, were We to cast them upon the mountains, would transform them into rubies, and were their fragrances to pass over stones, rivers would burst forth from them

Subject: the Word of God; influence and centrality of
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/the Word of God; influence and centrality of.txt
Quotation: By God besides Whom there is no God, if the friends were to follow the teachings and exhortations of the Blessed Beauty, then the necks of the kings of the earth would be humbled. If we were to follow the teachings and dictums of the Blessed Beauty, even stones and plants would be affected.

Subject: the Word of God; influence and centrality of
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/the Word of God; influence and centrality of.txt
Quotation: Through His heralds and messengers adorned the horizons of the world with unity and concord. He is the Omnipotent One Whom the polytheism of the polytheists and the protestations of the opposers did not veil His oneness, and did not prevent the sincere ones and near ones from turning to Him.

Subject: the Word of God; influence and centrality of
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/the Word of God; influence and centrality of.txt
Quotation: I swear by the Sun of Revelation that if people would hearken to the divine utterances for but a few brief moments, they would surely become sanctified from the world and all who dwell therein and would arise to serve His Cause in such wise that no tribulations would hinder them or deprive them.

Subject: the Word of God; influence and centrality of
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/the Word of God; influence and centrality of.txt
Quotation: The illiterate fishers and savage Arabs were thereby enabled to solve such problems as were puzzles to eminent sages all through the ages. It awakens within us that brilliant intuition which makes us independent of all tuition and endows is with an all-embracing power of spiritual understanding.

Subject: the Word of God; influence and centrality of
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/the Word of God; influence and centrality of.txt
Quotation: The Banner of the Revelation hath been raised upon the highest summit of the Mount, yet most of the people comprehend it not. Lo, the Divine Lote-Tree calleth out in the midmost heart of Paradise, and the nightingales of mystic knowledge warble upon the highest branches, yet the people hear it not.

Subject: the Word of God; influence and centrality of
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/the Word of God; influence and centrality of.txt
Quotation: He it is Who hath sent down the Bayan wherein is detailed all things, a guidance and remembrance for those who ponder the signs of their Lord. His are all things that dwell in the night and in the day, and verily He is the Peerless, the Inaccessible, the All-Protecting, the Mighty, the Best-Beloved.

Subject: the Word of God; influence and centrality of
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/the Word of God; influence and centrality of.txt
Quotation: This Pen moveth not save as moved by the fingers of the Ancient One from the Kingdom of Command. To this testifieth that which floweth from it of the waters of holiness and that which drippeth from it of the dewdrops of Tasnim from this Salsabil which floweth from the right hand of the mighty Throne.

Subject: the Word of God; influence and centrality of
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/the Word of God; influence and centrality of.txt
Quotation: Were ye on that Day to behold the Letters of Truth, ye would deem it too great for your souls to believe in them. Yet ye were thus before and shall be thus after. Therefore follow ye the Command of God, for He knoweth best all who are in the heavens and on earth and whatsoever lieth between them.

Subject: the Word of God; influence and centrality of
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/the Word of God; influence and centrality of.txt
Quotation: O people, this is God's proof among you - differ not concerning it. Fear God in His Cause, then hold fast unto God, your True Lord. This is what you have been counseled in mighty, impregnable Tablets. O people, these are God's verses - take them with the power that comes from Him and mock them not.

Subject: the Word of God; influence and centrality of
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/the Word of God; influence and centrality of.txt
Quotation: Thou must awaken them in regards to the Divine Kingdom, for their intentions are good but they do not know that all the powers in the world are incapable of establishing universal peace and promulgating the oneness of the world of man save the power of the Word of God and the breaths of the Holy Spirit.

Subject: the Word of God; influence and centrality of
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/the Word of God; influence and centrality of.txt
Quotation: This is a Book sent down through grace from God, the Most High, to him who is named Abdul-Ghani, that the verses of his Lord might draw him to a station wherein all things proclaim: The Kingdom belongeth unto God, Lord of the Day of Judgment! We have sent down the verses and made manifest the clear tokens.

Subject: the Word of God; influence and centrality of
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/the Word of God; influence and centrality of.txt
Quotation: For this reason hath this blessed Day been specifically distinguished and become known as the Day of God, although the days of the appearance of each Manifestation are, in their own station, the Day of God. The cause of this Day's distinction is evident and manifest to those possessed of insight and knowledge.

Subject: the Word of God; influence and centrality of
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/the Word of God; influence and centrality of.txt
Quotation: Through Thy will the ocean of knowledge hath surged before the faces of all religions, and the Dove of Utterance hath warbled upon the highest branches, even as the Tongue of Thy grandeur had spoken before the creation of all possibility: Mine is the Kingdom and the Dominion! Mine is the Glory and the Majesty!

Subject: the Word of God; influence and centrality of
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/the Word of God; influence and centrality of.txt
Quotation: We have aided the Cause through this Pen which neither the veils of the people could obscure, nor the coverings of fancy impede. The Word of God hath ever been and shall forever be enduring. All things shall be seized by extinction, but that which hath flowed from His Pen shall remain forever, eternally, imperishably.

Subject: the Word of God; influence and centrality of
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/the Word of God; influence and centrality of.txt
Quotation: In every city the signs of the Most Exalted Pen are evident and His Tablets are manifest and available. Blessed is the tongue that hath been honored to read His verses, blessed the eye that hath been honored to behold His signs, and blessed the ear that hath been privileged to hear that which hath flowed from His Pen.

Subject: the Word of God; influence and centrality of
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/the Word of God; influence and centrality of.txt
Quotation: Know ye that the decree of this Servant is like unto the decree of the Gates before Him. We have sent Him unto you with clear signs - were all men to gather together to produce the like of one verse of that which the Spirit revealeth unto Him, they would be unable and powerless, even if they were to help one another.

Subject: the Word of God; influence and centrality of
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/the Word of God; influence and centrality of.txt
Quotation: The Word of God creates all things. Will you not then remember? This is a proof that were God to place it upon one who has no equal in knowledge on earth, He would make him as dust, as though he knew nothing. And were God to place it upon one who knows nothing, He would make him like unto one who knows all things.

Subject: the Word of God; influence and centrality of
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/the Word of God; influence and centrality of.txt
Quotation: Consider how all people who lived in the past affirmed that Isaac was the sacrifice, and likewise the followers of the Qur'an have affirmed this station for Ishmael... Therefore, the appearance, manifestation, establishment and realization of all names, things and stations depend upon and are contingent on the Word of God.

Subject: the Word of God; influence and centrality of
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/the Word of God; influence and centrality of.txt
Quotation: The power of BAHA'O'LLAH'S words is compelling -- therefore, you must know and love them. For instance, in the spring season trees burst forth into verdure, though they are not conscious of the sunshine, of the falling rain or the gentle breeze -- nevertheless, the power of nature urges them on to yield forth their fruits.

Subject: the Word of God; influence and centrality of
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/the Word of God; influence and centrality of.txt
Quotation: The Command hath come unto you from God, blessed in truth. Hearken then unto that which thy Lord revealeth unto thee. Verily He is the Truth, there is no God but Him, and God hath power over all things. God hath sent down the Book wherein is the explanation of all things, and a mercy and glad tidings to Our first followers.

Subject: the Word of God; influence and centrality of
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/the Word of God; influence and centrality of.txt
Quotation: If anyone today denies these divine attributes and lordly manifestations and revealed verses which have appeared in this most holy and exalted Revelation, flowing like torrential rain, he hath denied the Truth and all the Messengers, and he is of the polytheists - thus was it inscribed in the Mother Book by the Pen of Command.

Subject: the Word of God; influence and centrality of
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/the Word of God; influence and centrality of.txt
Quotation: By the True One Himself, that which has been ordained for even a single word revealed from the Pen of the All-Merciful specifically for His friends is such that were its radiance to appear even to the extent of a needle's eye, all would be struck unconscious. And assuredly its effects have appeared and will appear in the earth.

Subject: the Word of God; influence and centrality of
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/the Word of God; influence and centrality of.txt
Quotation: Blessed is he who has been mentioned and attained this Most Great Remembrance, at whose appearance all other remembrances bowed down... By My life, whenever remembrance emerged from the mouth of the Divine Will in this Most Exalted Station, the ocean of grace surged and the fragrance of the mercy of the Lord of Lords was diffused.

Subject: the Word of God; influence and centrality of
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/the Word of God; influence and centrality of.txt
Quotation: Today the Word of God is the healer of all the world's diseases and the quickener of the dead among the nations. Blessed is the soul that hath not been debarred from the Lord of the Kingdom of Names by the attractions of the world, whom names have not hindered, and whom the power of the deniers and the rejecters hath not made weak.

Subject: the Word of God; influence and centrality of
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/the Word of God; influence and centrality of.txt
Quotation: The text emphasizes the supreme power and penetration of the divine Word: "Neither the might of the polytheists nor the clamor of the heedless could prevent the penetration of His perfect Word, nor could the power of the aggressors weaken the authority of His Most Exalted Pen. With but a single pen He arose against the whole world."

Subject: the Word of God; influence and centrality of
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/the Word of God; influence and centrality of.txt
Quotation: Glory be to God! Observe the penetrating power of the Word of God, that a Zoroastian person hastens from India to Paris and London to attain the presence of the Western Baha'is. What connection is this, and what heart attachment! May my soul be sacrificed for the Baha'is who have been so educated under the shadow of the Word of God.

Subject: the Word of God; influence and centrality of
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/the Word of God; influence and centrality of.txt
Quotation: This is a proof that hath drawn unto God the hearts of them that glorify Him. Say: This is a proof that hath drawn unto God the spirits of them that praise Him. Say: This is a proof that hath drawn unto God the souls of them that profess His unity. Say: This is a proof that hath drawn unto God the frames of them that magnify Him.

Subject: the Word of God; influence and centrality of
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/the Word of God; influence and centrality of.txt
Quotation: This matter is extensively recorded in the books, and this was that people's final remedy, yet no cure came of it. And likewise for these who have barred people from the Most Great Ocean. These very statements are a conclusive proof of that people's heedlessness and of the power of the Word of God, which holds sway over all the worlds.

Subject: the Word of God; influence and centrality of
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/the Word of God; influence and centrality of.txt
Quotation: O Mahdi! Nevertheless, some of the veiled ones among the people of the Bayan have preferred and chosen the buzzing of flies over the wondrous melodies of the Lord of Names and Attributes. This is indeed oppression, wert thou to perceive it. They have abandoned the most pure and fragrant Kawthar and turned to the putrid and noxious pool.

Subject: the Word of God; influence and centrality of
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/the Word of God; influence and centrality of.txt
Quotation: He is the One by Whose finger were rent asunder the veils of humanity and the veils of those who were debarred from the ultimate Purpose and the loftiest Summit. He is the One Whom the Book praised, the pebbles celebrated, the seas proclaimed His sovereignty, the mountains His power, the winds His might, and the signs His glory and splendor.

Subject: the Word of God; influence and centrality of
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/the Word of God; influence and centrality of.txt
Quotation: Exalted be its power, exalted be its sovereignty, and all-encompassing be its light through its manifestation! The trumpet was sounded and they that lay in their graves arose, and through its orientation all created things turned to the lights of the Face, and through its movement all contingent beings were moved in the precincts of the Throne.

Subject: the Word of God; influence and centrality of
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/the Word of God; influence and centrality of.txt
Quotation: This is a Day wherein the Light hath shone forth from the horizon of Sinai, and the Temple of the Manifestation hath been established upon the throne of divine knowledge by God, the Lord of Religions. That which was revealed transcended the comprehension of the Manifestations of verses and the understanding of the Dawning-places of clear signs.

Subject: the Word of God; influence and centrality of
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/the Word of God; influence and centrality of.txt
Quotation: He it is Who hath sent down from the Kingdom of Utterance that which hath stunned the very essence of knowledge and understanding. When they recovered, they proclaimed and bore witness that the ocean of knowledge is stirred by the waves of Thy knowledge, and the essence of understanding is struck down before the effulgent rays of the Sun of Thy wisdom.

Subject: the Word of God; influence and centrality of
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/the Word of God; influence and centrality of.txt
Quotation: Verily, he was named Zaynu'l-Muqarrabin in the Mother Book. O Zaynu'l-'Abidin! The Wronged One makes mention of thee with such mention that, when it appeared, the world trembled with longing for the meeting with the Ancient Lord, and the Maids of Paradise emerged from their chambers to hearken to the call of their Lord, the Possessor of the Final Return.

Subject: the Word of God; influence and centrality of
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/the Word of God; influence and centrality of.txt
Quotation: By the life of God! Should anyone partake of this blessed word's ocean, he would observe himself to be detached and free. He would abide beneath the canopy of certitude and would, at all times, drink from the chalice of assurance, for he would attain to a station wherein whatsoever proceedeth from God, exalted be His glory, he would see and know as truth.

Subject: the Word of God; influence and centrality of
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/the Word of God; influence and centrality of.txt
Quotation: I swear by the Sun of the horizon of Truth that if a soul should arise today for the sake of God to serve the Cause with wisdom and utterance, his soul will surely prove influential. The world will soon return to nothingness, and that which remains permanent and enduring is the word of acceptance that appears from the Pen of the Manifestation of God's Cause.

Subject: the Word of God; influence and centrality of
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/the Word of God; influence and centrality of.txt
Quotation: Praise be to God Who fulfilled His promise and sent to His servant Javad what He had promised him, and sent down from the heaven of meanings to him who was named Muhammad-'Ali that which caused all things to soar and the hearts of the enemies to quake. In truth, one breath from the fragrances of each of its utterances has perfumed the world of knowledge and wisdom.

Subject: the Word of God; influence and centrality of
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/the Word of God; influence and centrality of.txt
Quotation: This Wronged One is occupied night and day with proclamation and utterance, and the servant present recordeth them. Were it not for My protection and bounty and power, the world would [swoon away] at but a single gleam from the gleams of the Sun of My Word, through which the suns have shone forth in every world of the worlds of thy Lord, the All-Wise, the All-Informed.

Subject: the Word of God; influence and centrality of
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/the Word of God; influence and centrality of.txt
Quotation: Throughout the nights and days the Supreme Pen moved and spoke, the Voice of Sinai proclaimed. We beseech God, exalted be His glory, to grant His servants attentive ears and pure hearts that they may comprehend that which is manifest and evident today, and make up for what they have lost. The Command is in His grasp. He doeth what He willeth and ordaineth what He pleaseth.

Subject: the Word of God; influence and centrality of
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/the Word of God; influence and centrality of.txt
Quotation: Verily the verses from His presence are a proof unto all who dwell in the kingdom of the heavens and of the earth and all that lieth between them, and by them are ye all created. Verily the scriptures from His presence are a clear and decisive evidence unto all who dwell in the heavens and on the earth and all that lieth between them - all receive their sustenance thereby.

Subject: the Word of God; influence and centrality of
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/the Word of God; influence and centrality of.txt
Quotation: From each letter of His utterance the kingdom of speech is stirred, and from each of His mentions the dominion of knowledge is enraptured. He can quench with one drop from the ocean of His utterance the thirst of one who has been parched for a hundred years, and with one breath of His mention He can bestow life upon one who has been dead for a thousand years and revive him.

Subject: the Word of God; influence and centrality of
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/the Word of God; influence and centrality of.txt
Quotation: This power above and beyond the powers of nature must needs be brought to bear, to change this black darkness into light, and these hatreds and resentments, grudges and spites, these endless wrangles and wars, into fellowship and love amongst all the peoples of the earth. This power is none other than the breathings of the Holy Spirit and the mighty inflow of the Word of God.

Subject: the Word of God; influence and centrality of
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/the Word of God; influence and centrality of.txt
Quotation: Though the army of bodies may be like fierce lions, yet their purpose is to demolish foundations and bring death to humanity. But the hosts of certitude and knowledge bestow life upon souls and consciousness, offer the cup of life and taste the honey of salvation. They confer eternal life upon the dead and make the deprived ones intimates of the sanctum of the placeless realm.

Subject: the Word of God; influence and centrality of
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/the Word of God; influence and centrality of.txt
Quotation: His is the creation and the command, from before and from after, and unto Him shall be the return. None may speak concerning His truth or in His presence save to affirm that there is no God but Him, and that all else beside Him are His creation, and all are created by His command. Say: God hath not sent the Messengers, nor revealed the Books, nor created anything except through Him

Subject: the Word of God; influence and centrality of
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/the Word of God; influence and centrality of.txt
Quotation: Write thou that these verses are the Most Great Name, which if God should place it upon a mountain, He would make it Sinai, and if upon the earth, He would make it the Sacred House through His command. Verily He is knowing of all things. And when God placeth it upon any soul, He bringeth forth from it whatsoever He willeth from its resting place. Verily He hath power over all things.

Subject: the Word of God; influence and centrality of
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/the Word of God; influence and centrality of.txt
Quotation: This is a Book sent down by the Lord of Names and Creator of the heavens, that He may draw those who dwell in the realm of creation near unto the Most Exalted Horizon. When He appeared, He uttered a Word whereby the ocean of utterance surged, and the fragrances of the All-Merciful were diffused, and through it the trees spoke, the fruits appeared, the rivers flowed, the rocks trembled

Subject: the Word of God; influence and centrality of
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/the Word of God; influence and centrality of.txt
Quotation: The Most Great Elixir hath been the Word of Truth, which the Hand of Power hath manifested from the Hidden Mine through the Hidden Name. Nurture it in the retort of the heart with the fire of love, and after its effect appeareth in all the pillars, if but an atom thereof be bestowed upon the people of possibility, thou shalt behold all the copper of existence transformed into pure gold

Subject: the Word of God; influence and centrality of
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/the Word of God; influence and centrality of.txt
Quotation: He hath sent down by His command a Word in truth and made it the sword of His Cause between the heavens and the earth, whereby He distinguisheth between the polytheist and the believer in divine unity, for He is powerful over all things. He hath made it the magnet of attraction between the heavens and the earth, drawing unto itself the essences of existence while leaving behind mere accidents

Subject: the Word of God; influence and centrality of
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/the Word of God; influence and centrality of.txt
Quotation: This is a proof that has perfected the ordinances of the Book aforetime and has abrogated the religions that were sent down before from God. By it God reforms all things, if you would but remember. This is a proof that were God to place it upon the night and desire to make it day, then behold - day would you proclaim it. This is a proof by which God names all things and transforms them as He wishes.

Subject: the Word of God; influence and centrality of
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/the Word of God; influence and centrality of.txt
Quotation: These are the verses of God which have been sent down in truth from the Heaven of Eternity. God hath made them a testimony from Him and a proof from His presence unto all who are in the heavens and on earth, from this day until the Day when the standards of discord shall be obliterated and the Luminary of the horizons shall shine forth from the Dayspring of His Name, the Most Merciful, the Compassionate.

Subject: the Word of God; influence and centrality of
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/the Word of God; influence and centrality of.txt
Quotation: This is the Day wherein the attractive Word of God is suspended between earth and heaven, drawing unto itself the essences of the hearts of all created things. I swear by the Sun of inner meanings that were there to be found but a particle - nay, less than that - of the essence concealed in a mountain, the attractive and distinguishing Word would assuredly draw that particle and separate it from that mountain.

Subject: the Word of God; influence and centrality of
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/the Word of God; influence and centrality of.txt
Quotation: Not an atom of good deeds hath been or ever shall be lost in the sight of God. Whoso pondereth upon former ages will witness that which the Tongue of the Wronged One hath witnessed in this noble station. This is a Day wherein the Ark of the Bayan hath sailed upon land and sea, and the tongue of the All-Merciful hath spoken in the kingdom of utterance that which hath enraptured the hearts of them that are nigh.

Subject: the Word of God; influence and centrality of
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/the Word of God; influence and centrality of.txt
Quotation: The verses are indeed God's possession wherein all things exist and naught can be compared unto them. Thus doth God create whatsoever He willeth by His command. Say: In the verses is the might of God whereby ye are rendered mighty. Say: In the verses is the Will of God whereby ye will. Say: In the verses is the Purpose of God whereby ye purpose. Say: In the verses is the knowledge of God whereby ye learn.

Subject: the Word of God; influence and centrality of
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/the Word of God; influence and centrality of.txt
Quotation: Verses have been sent down and clear signs revealed; divine encompassment exists and heavenly power is visible; the ocean of knowledge surgeth and the sun of utterance shineth forth. Nevertheless, the heedlessness, ignorance, denial and estrangement of the peoples of the world cannot prevent the penetration of the Most Sublime Word, nor can all the powers of the world compare with the might of the Most Exalted Pen.

Subject: the Word of God; influence and centrality of
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/the Word of God; influence and centrality of.txt
Quotation: Praise be to God that the invisible springs of life that were concealed behind the divine veil are now abundantly flowing from the reality of the Word by virtue of the confirmations of the exalted holy spirit. Yes, the renowned fountain of life, in search of which some have set out, was said to bestow physical life. But the spring of life that flows unseen in the words of the All-Praised grants eternal life and holy spirit.

Subject: the Word of God; influence and centrality of
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/the Word of God; influence and centrality of.txt
Quotation: From every letter of the words of God there is created in the realm of creation that which none knoweth save God and those whom He hath made the manifestations of His knowledge. The people of insight behold the effects of the Word in those who have believed even as they behold the radiance of the sun in the horizons when it riseth from the horizon of heaven. Verily thy Lord's Word hath encompassed the heavens and the earth.

Subject: the Word of God; influence and centrality of
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/the Word of God; influence and centrality of.txt
Quotation: How many were the divines and mystics who occupied themselves night and day with the acquisition of knowledge and learning, that perchance they might ascend the ladder of knowledge and attain the lights of the Name 'the Self-Subsisting.' Yet when the Sun of Revelation dawned from the horizon of God's Will, they were found to be deprived of the knowledge of the Dayspring of divine knowledge and the Source of heavenly revelation.

Subject: the Word of God; influence and centrality of
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/the Word of God; influence and centrality of.txt
Quotation: Through Him the Salsabil of utterance hath flowed throughout all possibility and all things have spoken: "The Kingdom belongeth unto God, the Almighty, the Glorious, the All-Bountiful." He is the One through Whom the earth hath recounted her tidings and revealed her treasures, and the sea of knowledge its pearls, and the heaven of utterance its stars and its lights, and the Lote-Tree its rustling, and the Pens their shrill voice.

Subject: the Word of God; influence and centrality of
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/the Word of God; influence and centrality of.txt
Quotation: And verses concerning the innate nature of things, power and might flow forth such that all who dwell on earth from among the ranks of subjects are powerless to produce verses like unto them. And consider the station wherein in six hours a thousand verses of communion flow from My pen - verses which none of the mystics and divines are capable of comprehending, and which none can distinguish from the prayers of the immaculate Household.

Subject: the Word of God; influence and centrality of
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/the Word of God; influence and centrality of.txt
Quotation: Were it not for the power of the Word of God such a meeting were impossible. Therefore, the Word of God decomposes the selfishness of people, their evil habits, their bad morals, and afterward composes them. For instance, the power of the Word takes away the ideas of the nations - as with the Jews, the Christians and Mohammedans - and gives them and other nations a new idea through which they become united. Therefore, the different nations become one.

Subject: the Word of God; influence and centrality of
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/the Word of God; influence and centrality of.txt
Quotation: No matter how much they heard the rebuke of the heedless ones, observed the censure of the relatives, were afflicted with the injury of the oppressors and thrown into abjection, yet that ignominy finally became eternal glory... no rampart is able to obstruct the descent of the waves of the Most Great Sea; no veil can conceal the rays of the Sun of Truth; no wall can stay the wafting of the Divine Breeze; and no power is able to resist the Spirit of God.

Subject: the Word of God; influence and centrality of
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/the Word of God; influence and centrality of.txt
Quotation: God hath caused suns to dawn from the horizon of these words, whose number none knoweth save God, the Counter, the All-Knowing. By each one thereof He nurtureth a world among His worlds whereof none among all created things is aware save God, the All-Knowing, the All-Informed. Verily, a single letter of this Tablet sufficeth as proof and evidence for all who are in the heavens and on earth, though none comprehendeth this save every just and insightful one.

Subject: the Word of God; influence and centrality of
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/the Word of God; influence and centrality of.txt
Quotation: The fragrance of spring is distinct from autumn, and the scent of the rose is clear and evident from all else. The breezes of God's verses have never been confused with aught else, nor shall they ever be, and His evidences are not concealed from those endowed with vision and the people of the Most Sublime Vision. In all the books of old, mention hath been made of this Day and that which hath appeared therein, and it hath been recorded by the Most Exalted Pen.

Subject: the Word of God; influence and centrality of
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/the Word of God; influence and centrality of.txt
Quotation: He Who, through His wondrous favor, abolished the law of the sword and raised in its stead the standard of utterance. He summoned all on earth to the most exalted horizon and commanded the triumph of His Cause, limiting victory to utterance alone, that the sincere ones, the near ones, the assured ones, and the wise ones might, through the wisdom revealed and the utterances of the Lord of Oneness, awaken the heedless people and draw them to the pavilion of divine majesty.

Subject: the Word of God; influence and centrality of
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/the Word of God; influence and centrality of.txt
Quotation: The Book of God, the All-Subduing, the Self-Subsisting. He is the Speaker, the Hearer, the All-Knowing, the All-Wise. This mercy is of two kinds: one is the rain from the visible clouds, through which He hath perfected His outward bounty unto all who dwell on earth; and the other is that true rain which descendeth from the heaven of divine utterance. This rain adorneth the earth of the hearts of His servants with the flowers and leaves of true understanding and knowledge.

Subject: the Word of God; influence and centrality of
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/the Word of God; influence and centrality of.txt
Quotation: Thus hath the Tongue of God bear witness at this moment, if thou be of them that hear. Though We desire not to tarry in mentioning the loved ones of God, yet We desire to make mention according to what is possible, lest they pause regarding that which hath been revealed unto them. Otherwise, by Him Who holdeth my soul in His hand, were We to find in any soul the warmth of the love of God, We would assuredly cast upon it, in number as the raindrops, verses of impregnable glory.

Subject: the Word of God; influence and centrality of
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/the Word of God; influence and centrality of.txt
Quotation: We beseech God that He may aid thee in all conditions, and cause to grow from the fruits of certitude wondrous trees in the blessed and goodly soil, and from those trees bring forth other fruits and leaves. The believer in God who hath drunk from the Kawthar of certitude from the munificent hand of the Desired One of the worlds - the fruit thereof hath not been and will never be cut off from the world. From that blessed fruit there grow wondrous trees and new saplings from the goodly soil.

Subject: the Word of God; influence and centrality of
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/the Word of God; influence and centrality of.txt
Quotation: O people! Can any of your partners send down unto you the verses? Say: Glory be to God! None can send them down save Him. His is the creation and the command, and all are turned unto Him. Say: By God! This Book cannot be fabricated, but rather it confirmeth that which ye possess of the Books of God, the Most High, the Most Exalted, the All-Knowing, and is a strengthening of your hearts, a hope for your souls, a light that moveth before you, and a remembrance and guidance, yea a guidance and remembrance for all the worlds.

Subject: the Word of God; influence and centrality of
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/the Word of God; influence and centrality of.txt
Quotation: What this Wronged One hath spoken and continueth to speak is potent and sovereign, were they to cleave unto it and act accordingly. At present most are occupied in relating the words of others. God willing, may all be purified and sanctified through the water of the All-Merciful's utterance and arise to teach the Cause. This is a station which the pen faileth to describe and understanding falleth short of comprehending. The words of holy souls are so effective and penetrating that they can revive a withered tree and adorn it with fresh and tender fruits.

Subject: the Word of God; influence and centrality of
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/the Word of God; influence and centrality of.txt
Quotation: Therefore be thou assured that this call to the Manifestation of Baha'u'llah, this proclamation of the Word of God and the promulgation of His Covenant, shall influence stone and clay, how much more the children of men. These cathedrals which now appear in utmost splendour throughout the world are but masses of stone and clay; however, as a result of the influence of the Word of God they have become mighty cathedrals. This illustration is given, that thou mayest appreciate the truth and grasp how the potency of the Word of God is infused into all created things.

Subject: the Word of God; influence and centrality of
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/the Word of God; influence and centrality of.txt
Quotation: Until this time they have not comprehended the Day of God, nor have they attained unto a drop from the ocean of the blessed word "He doeth whatsoever He willeth." For in truth, had they been illumined by the light of this exalted word, they would have closed the door of objections and turned with their whole being toward the Beloved of all possibility. By God's life! The ears that exist in the world were not and are not worthy to hear this call, nor are the eyes capable of beholding the Supreme Horizon. This Day is a mighty Day and this Cause is greater than every great thing.

Quotation: Consider, O servant, the people and their understanding. They have denied the Most Great Manifestation of God though His radiance hath encompassed the world and His sovereignty hath prevailed over all who are in the heavens and on earth. Hath anyone in any age witnessed a Manifestation greater than the Manifestation of our Lord, the All-Merciful, in these days wherein trembling hath seized all tribes, the pillars of the polytheists have quaked, and the hearts of the sincere have rejoiced? Hath anyone heard verses mightier than those which in these days flow from the mouth of the Will of the Lord of all beings?

Thereupon the sincere were attracted, the unitarians drew near, the near ones took flight, the seekers sought, and those who turned did turn. The wine of the utterance of the All-Merciful so intoxicated all contingent beings that every extinguished one was set aflame, every frozen one was melted, every sleeper was awakened, every fallen one arose, and every seated one hastened forth, as though every atom among the atoms of creation turned towards the Dawning-Place of verses and the Day-Spring of clear signs.

Say: O people! Read ye the words of God in the sweetest of melodies, that the denizens of earth and heaven may be drawn unto them. By the True One! Should anyone recite that which hath been sent down from the heaven of immortality by the All-Glorious Beauty of God, the Most Exalted, God will surely raise him up in the eternal Paradise with such beauty that the dwellers of the Supreme Concourse will be illumined by the light of his countenance.

Subject: the animal kingdom
Quotation: For instance, how much must a person toil and labor to secure his livelihood, and even then hardly one in a thousand succeeds in fully providing for his needs. But observe a bird that builds its nest on a lofty mountain overlooking the sea and plains, on the highest branch of a tree. Better than any royal palace, this nest commands a view in all directions. When the wind blows, it rocks like a cradle. In this nest, the bird inhales the gentle breeze in perfect peace of mind, free from care and sorrow. The vista is supremely sweet, the water perfectly pure, all harvests are its wealth--without toil or effort, without struggle, the entire plain belongs to it. Consider a cow in a meadow among springs and forests--no cares, no sorrows. The forests all belong to it, the waters all belong to it. A deer--all meadows and plains belong to it, never any sorrow, never any toil.

Subject: the cloud ['ama]

Indeed the word cloud is known from blindness, for there was naught there save God, and vision was blind to His countenance and eyes were blind to His presence. It is an absolute cloud, pure, unmixed, complete - naught was seen in its hiddenness or manifestation, in its outwardness or inwardness, save God, the Single, the One, the Eternal, the Unique, besides Whom there is no god, and there was naught with Him save Him.

Subject: the cross and the trinity
Quotation: It is said that once John of Chrysostom was walking along the seashore, thinking over the question of the trinity, trying to reconcile it with finite reason. Suddenly his attention was attracted by a boy sitting on the shore, putting water into a cup. Approaching him, he asked, My child, what art thou doing? I am trying to put the sea into this cup he answered. How foolish art thou, John replied, in trying to do the impossible. The child rejoined, Thy work is stranger than mine, for thou art labouring to bring within the grasp of human intellect the conception of the trinity.

Subject: the cross and the trinity
Quotation: But as to the question of the Trinity, know, O advancer unto God, that in each one of the cycles wherein the Lights have shone forth upon the horizons (i.e., in each prophetic dispensation) and the Forgiving Lord hath revealed Himself on Mount Paran or Mount Sinai, or Mount Seir, there are necessarily three things: The Giver of Grace, and the Grace, and the Recipient of the Grace; the Source of the Effulgence, and the Effulgence, and the Recipient of the Effulgence; the Illuminator, and the Illumination, and Illuminated.

Subject: the cross and the trinity
Quotation: Glory be to God, the All-Knowing, Who created things through the crafting of choice according to what befits Him from the wonders of lights - through the Will, the mystery of contingent beings; through the Purpose, the secret repository of existing things; and through Destiny, the ruling of trinity for the sake of limitation's consciousness. From this the Christians took the form of the cross and the descent of the divine into the human realm. The Beloved has informed of their misguided inner thoughts: "The Christians say: 'He is the third of three,' while He is but one God. Glory be to God above what they associate with Him."
