Nicodemus had an earthly mind, and only understood earthly things. heavenly things are alone understood by heavenly minds.

Subject: two kinds of knowledge [ilm and irfan]; sight and insight
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/two kinds of knowledge [ilm and irfan]; sight and insight.txt
Quotation: Although the discovery of the North Pole was an important matter--I do not meant to abase this effort; it was a great endeavor achieved by Mr. Peary--yet the purpose is this: If he had discovered the mysteries of the Kingdom, he could train some souls who would be able to discover all the poles; the physical pole as well as the spiritual pole; the earthly as well as the heavenly pole.

Subject: two kinds of knowledge [ilm and irfan]; sight and insight
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/two kinds of knowledge [ilm and irfan]; sight and insight.txt
Quotation: Man is possessed of two types of susceptibilities. One is physical, the other spiritual, in character. Physical susceptibilities have their avenues of expression, and spiritual susceptibilities likewise have their avenues. The physical, or material susceptibilities have their channels of expression in the physical realm. Earthly fraternity is due either to a family relationship, or to a commercial bond, or to a bond of love based upon policy or politics, or to a racial bond which supplies that affection, or to a bond patriotic in foundation. These are physical susceptibilities and ordinary outward love. But spiritual susceptibilities, namely, real love and heavenly fraternity, emanate through divine channels. They emanate from faith, or they emanate from knowledge, or they emanate from the bounty of the Holy Spirit, or they emanate from the effulgence of the Sun of Reality.

Subject: two kinds of knowledge [ilm and irfan]; sight and insight
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/two kinds of knowledge [ilm and irfan]; sight and insight.txt
Quotation: Furthermore, knowledge is of two kinds: One knowledge relates to the Divine Essence - it is essential divine knowledge, identical with the Essence, not distinct from it, for in that station there is pure unity, and the Essence comprises all names and attributes. That essential divine knowledge is incomprehensible. The other knowledge is in the realm of action, meaning it is identical with what is known, and that is realization externally. Sight connects with an existent thing, not with a non-existent thing. Knowledge can connect with a non-existent thing, but sight cannot. This is why He says "when He created, He saw that it was good." Those versed in divine mysteries maintain that knowledge is of two kinds: One kind is perception of a thing without a distinct form in the mind - this is essential knowledge. The second knowledge is formal knowledge, which is witnessed knowledge, meaning perception of a thing with its distinct form in the mind. This witnessing of Truth refers to witnessed knowledge. But existential knowledge is identical to God's Essence - like God's Essence it cannot be comprehended, and none can fathom its essential reality.

Subject: twofold; threefold station of the Manifestation of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/twofold; threefold station of the Manifestation of God.txt
Quotation: One station physical and one station spiritual. In other words, one station of humanity and one station of divine reality.

Subject: twofold; threefold station of the Manifestation of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/twofold; threefold station of the Manifestation of God.txt
Quotation: After God hath ordained for His Friend the period of occultation, then shall ye be guided by His light. And from the first day when God desireth to raise up the religion of truth, then shall He grant leave unto His Friend to recite from the Book of his Lord as He willeth by His command.

Subject: twofold; threefold station of the Manifestation of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/twofold; threefold station of the Manifestation of God.txt
Quotation: All Divine Manifestations give up all personal conditions, considerations and grades in the Cause of God to such an extent that there is nothing judged of their personality; that is, they sacrifice their personality entirely in the world; their life is only the life of God, their thought is the thought of God and their grades are those chosen by God.

Subject: twofold; threefold station of the Manifestation of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/twofold; threefold station of the Manifestation of God.txt
Quotation: Therefore, all the Prophets from a beginning that hath no beginning find their existence in Him Whom God shall make manifest, and all who shall appear unto an end that hath no end derive their reality from Him Whom God shall make manifest. Thus in the ocean of names, if thou hast comprehended page 24 and aided it, thou shalt see naught but God, for these are mirrors wherein naught is seen save God.

Subject: twofold; threefold station of the Manifestation of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/twofold; threefold station of the Manifestation of God.txt
Quotation: For the Merciful Manifestation, the Divine Dawning-Place, and the Eternal Setting-Place hath two stations in the world of appearance and two ranks in the realm of manifestation. In the first station, He is the source of the water of life, the heavenly spring of salvation, and the spirit that pervades the realities of all things. In the second station, He is the fire kindled in the Blessed Tree, the blazing flame in the sacred Sinai, and the luminous flash in the mount of the divine spot.

Subject: twofold; threefold station of the Manifestation of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/twofold; threefold station of the Manifestation of God.txt
Quotation: And since there hath never been and can never be any connection, relationship, harmony or resemblance between the created and the Creator, between the temporal and the eternal, between the contingent and the Absolute, therefore in every age and dispensation He manifesteth a pure essence in the realm of earth and heaven, and createth this divine subtlety and heavenly mystery from two elements: the outward physical element and the hidden divine element. And He createth in him two stations: one the station of reality, which is the station wherein he speaketh only by God his Lord, concerning which it is said in the tradition, "I have states with God wherein I am He and He is I, except that I am I and He is He," and likewise, "Stand still, O Muhammad, for Thou art the Beloved and Thou art the Love," and also, "There is no difference between Thee and them, save that they are Thy servants"; and the other the station of the human, concerning which He saith, "I am but a man like unto you," and "Say: Glory be to my Lord! Am I aught but a mortal messenger?"

Subject: twofold; threefold station of the Manifestation of God
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/twofold; threefold station of the Manifestation of God.txt
Quotation: The first station is connected to Their physical frame, which is subject to human limitations, such as movement and stillness, ascent and descent, sickness and health. The second station is that of the rational soul. In this station, They too experience afflictions, poverty, hardship, and such human conditions. The third station is that of Divine manifestation and the outpouring of ancient glory. In this station, all that pertains to Them is divine, and all that is expressed by Them is heavenly and of the Kingdom, for this station is neither of the contingent realm nor of the created world. Rather, it is a station sanctified above all earthly conditions.

Subject: unchastity and adultery
Quotation: Say: Ye are forbidden to commit adultery, sodomy and lechery. Avoid them, O concourse of the faithful. By the righteousness of God! Ye have been called into being to purge the world from the defilement of evil passions. This is what the Lord of all men enjoineth you, if ye be of them that comprehend.

Subject: unity in diversity
Quotation: See that in minerals, colors do not cause difference. In plants, the colors of multicolored flowers do not cause difference but rather are the cause of garden's adornment, for a single color has no ornament.

Subject: unity in diversity
Quotation: praise be to God, the rose garden of the West, in a short space of time, has assumed most delightful freshness. Most magnificent flowers have become apparent therein. Variegated flowers can be seen there. White flowers have grown in it; colored flowers have grown in it; red flowers can be seen in it; and yellow flowers can be seen in it, and all of these together are in the utmost of freshness and verdure, and each lends a charm and harmony to the others. Each one is a cause of adornment to the others.

Subject: unity in diversity
Quotation: His Holiness Baha'u'llah has opened a great Door of interdependence of all nations before the faces

Subject: unity in diversity
Quotation: constitute the five continents as one continent; suffer the various races of men to become as one race

Subject: unity in diversity
Quotation: they have called the church "bay'ah" in the terminology of the holy books, meaning a place for gathering of different peoples and races

Subject: unity in diversity
Quotation: Therefore wherever we see the lights of peace and welfare we must worship and welcome them, even if they come from any region or language.

Subject: unity in diversity
Quotation: "We all appreciate your blessed visit and we believe what you said is the truth. But we are sorry we cannot include religion in our organization. Our members are composed of all kinds of religions and sects - the Protestant, Catholic, Jew, etc; naturally everyone prefers his own belief and will protest if any religion besides his own is favored." To this 'Abdu'l-Baha said, "Your members may be compared to beams of different metals and you are trying to unite them as you would tie these fingers together with a string." Here 'Abdu'l-Baha brought His own five fingers close together to illustrate His point. "See, no matter how you tie them, still they shall remain separate. But the only way to make these metals into one alloy, is to put them into a crucible and apply intense heat to melt them all. For our melting-pot, we use the fire of the love of God."

Subject: unity in diversity
Quotation: In this world the people are not of one kind. Their comprehension differs; their thought varies; their understanding is not the same and their capacity also differs. Therefore because of this difference, friendship and unity are difficult; although the improvement and happiness of the human world depend upon concord and harmony. For this reason a collective power is needed to over-shadow these conditions; and that collective power must be very mighty, that it may dominate the differences and remove every misunderstanding.... As the spirit of man unites and harmonizes the different organs of the body, so the Word of God shall unite the differ nations of the world.

Subject: unity in diversity
Quotation: These essential differences are the source of the splendor of the garden of humanity, not an obstacle to the manifestation of unity and fellowship among nations and religions

Subject: unity in diversity
Quotation: Through divine power and heavenly bounties and merciful confirmations these two seas of East and West may become one, and these two branches may be grafted to become a single branch

Subject: unity in diversity
Quotation: to prepare them to hearken unto that which conduces to the sanctifying and purifying of the people of the world from strife and discord resulting from differences in religions or sects

Subject: unity in diversity
Quotation: It is good that this church is open to everyone, and is the cause of fellowship among every sect and creed, inasmuch as whatever is universal is of God, and that which is particular is of humanity.

Subject: unity in diversity
Quotation: Praise be to God that the favored community is adorned with the crown of recognition and the ornament of unity, and in the nights and days utters and remembers the blessed words "There is none other God but God."

Subject: unity in diversity
Quotation: Whether we live in the East or in the West, the invisible Power of BAHA'O'LLAH is unifying our scattered forces and training us for the service of His Kingdom--the kingdom of universal love and inter-racial amity.

Subject: unity in diversity
Quotation: The world of humanity is like unto a rose garden and the various races are like unto different colored flowers which make the garden more attractive and beautiful. In the animal kingdom also there are different colors.

Subject: unity in diversity
Quotation: Taking the material ocean as an illustration, 'Abdu'l-Baha said, The atoms composing an ocean are, in appearance the ocean, but the identity of the atoms remains. So it is with our individuality in the ocean of life, it remains.

Subject: unity in diversity
Quotation: the Manifestation of Truth is for love, unity, oneness, agreement, sincerity and fairness...Surely the friends of God will not be content that while I hope for affection and unity, I see signs of trouble and discord. I become very saddened and grieved.

Subject: unity in diversity
Quotation: The slaves of vain imaginings deemed themselves unitarians, and the worshippers of their own conjectures counted themselves as detached. Yet when the sun of trial shone forth from the horizon of the All-Merciful's purpose, all were found in manifest loss.

Subject: unity in diversity
Quotation: Consider that if those prejudices and superstitions existed among us, would it be possible for these different souls from various religions and distant lands to find such fellowship and harmony with each other, and to show such love and kindness to one another?

Subject: unity in diversity
Quotation: Verily, thou art from the West and we are from the East, the distance between is great. Nevertheless, it is as if we were from one native land, one city, one house and one household. The love of God gathered us all under the shade of one tent, beneath one banner.

Subject: unity in diversity
Quotation: The word of truth is current on the tongues of all people, yet all are heedless of it. They utter a word with their lips, but are oblivious of its meaning. They worship the name, not the Named One. They cling to the hem of the name but mix not with Him Who is named.

Subject: unity in diversity
Quotation: What evil is there when the people of the world learn to love and care for one another as this assemblage does? This gathering is indeed a brilliant example of the mighty institutions and momentous movement of 'Abbas Effendi which in the future will unite the world.

Subject: unity in diversity
Quotation: "If the Zionists will mingle with the other races and live in unity with them, they will succeed. If not, they will meet certain resistance...The Zionists should make it clear that their principle is to elevate all the people here and to develop the country for all its inhabitants."

Subject: unity in diversity
Quotation: Your letter conveyed glad tidings of the unity and love among the friends of God and service to the oneness of the human world. My hope is that the friends may become the cause of establishing love and fellowship among all religions, and that all different races may embrace one another.

Subject: unity in diversity
Quotation: When we look upon the ocean of existence, we see the handiwork of the divine sea. When we gaze upon the waves, we know they all belong to the sea. Though the waves be diverse, the sea is one. One sun shines upon all created things, and the light is one light, though creation be diverse.

Subject: unity in diversity
Quotation: Between these two races certain points of agreement and points of distinction exist which warrant just and mutual consideration. The points of contact are many.... In fact numerous points of partnership and agreement exist between the two races, whereas the one point of distinction is that of color.

Subject: unity in diversity
Quotation: Though the friends may be distinguished from one another in form and custom, in character and spirit and reality they must be as one soul. They are drops of one ocean, fruits of one garden, lamps of one portico, brilliant stars of one horizon, ranks of one army, and the inebriated ones of one feast.

Subject: unity in diversity
Quotation: Man must be a lover of the light, no matter from what dayspring it may appear. He must be a lover of the rose, no matter in what soil it may be growing. He must be a seeker of the truth, no matter from what source it come. Absolute verities, no matter in what book they be recorded, must be accepted.

Subject: unity in diversity
Quotation: 'Abdu'l-Baha explains His statement about flowers of different colors, applying it to racial harmony: "these colors should not clash with each other but rather should blend, for this diversity of human colors is like the diversity found among flowers in a garden and is the cause of the garden's beauty."

Subject: unity in diversity
Quotation: The Americans may be protected in taking some measures against the Japanese.....But if they prohibit the buying of land it will create animosity. Yes, they should regulate it. Some laws should exist regulating immigration for instance, if a man goes to this country to profit, he should become an American.

Subject: unity in diversity
Quotation: In Persia many meetings are being held in which different religions are represented, Jewish, Christian, Mohammedan and Zoroastrian. There is harmony and friendship among them. They are at all times ready to sacrifice their lives for one another. They serve with heart and soul in the cause of international peace.

Subject: unity in diversity
Quotation: Observe in a garden that, although flowers of various colors blossoms, fragrances of different quality are emitted and fruits of distinct verities are born upon the trees, yet this difference is, in reality, a cause of unity, adornment and beauty. Differences do not exist therein. Nay, rather, the very difference is a point of unity.

Subject: unity in diversity
Quotation: God createth not a single thing but He createth from itself what He willeth through His command, which quickeneth all things. God createth not a single entity but He createth from itself its counterpart, for God, the Lord of all worlds. And God createth not a pair but He createeth from itself a single entity, for God, the Lord of all worlds.

Subject: unity in diversity
Quotation: Despite these successive and continuous hardships and tribulations, the discord among the friends has become such a great calamity that I cannot describe nor express it. When all these nations are opposed to us, we should at least unite in defense, lest these nations prevail and harm the friends, and rejoice in the discord among the loved ones.

Subject: unity in diversity
Quotation: Convey my greetings and praise and my abundant longings to my loved ones in that city which hath become the City of the Covenant and the dwelling-place of the love of God... Verily, I love the beloved ones in that city with all my heart and soul, inasmuch as they cherish unity, harmony and concord, and stand firm in resisting the people of discord.

Subject: unity in diversity
Quotation: There in these meetings you will often see Christian, Mohammedan, Jew, Zoroastrian and Buddhist speaking and discovering with each other as tho' they were the members of one family. All unite and agree, there is no quarrel nor strife nor bloodshed nor warfare - they have realized the fellowship and affinity are the greatest attainments of this world.

Subject: unity in diversity
Quotation: Consider what the power of the Covenant has done! It was an impossibility for a Zoroastrian to unite with a Sid and a mulla with a Jew. And for these to assemble with a Christian was an absolute impossibility. But the power of the Covenant has even so gathered them that they are accounted as one spirit. Although the bodies are numerous, the spirit is one.

Subject: unity in diversity
Quotation: In Persia, among those who have harkened to the admonitions of Baha'o'llah, you will find Zoroastrian, Jew, Christian, Mohammedan, Buddhist, associating one with the other in perfect accord and good will, entertaining no ill thought or enmity, no rancor, no feeling of estrangement or alienation, but all living together in complete understanding and love.

Subject: unity in diversity
Quotation: Allah is Most Great! What a paradise has been opened in these days, and what a carpet of divine unity has been spread, such that if a servant among God's servants be in the East of the world and another servant in the West, always does the easterner inhale the holy divine fragrances from the direction of the West, and this westerner catches the sweet scents of the spirit of love from the East

Subject: unity in diversity
Quotation: Every soul saith unto another thou art cold, while each doth prove his claim through the Word of God, and I declare that both of ye speak truly and are justified, on condition that thou sayest not unto him thou art zealous, nor he unto thee thou art cold. For thou wert created by that verse which none can surpass, while he was created by that verse which perceiveth a station beneath thy being.

Subject: unity in diversity
Quotation: The beloved of God should today be like waves in the ocean of oneness; each one should be like the breeze wafting in the garden of loving providence. For if thy sights be fastened on the reality of divine grace, thou wouldst see that the friends are all the waves of one ocean and the overflowing streams of a single river. They are the illumination of one lamp and the bright beams of the same sun.

Subject: unity in diversity
Quotation: O Zayn! The Wronged One hath sacrificed Himself and accepted the tribulations of the world that perchance the horizons might be illumined with the light of unity and adorned with the ornament of concord. Until now, the fragrance of unity and concord hath not been diffused among the loved ones. Unseemly manifestations and displeasing matters are continuously observed, but God hath been and is the Concealer.

Subject: unity in diversity
Quotation: According to these divine teachings, the Turk as well as the Tagik, the European as well as the American, the Asiatic as well as the African-all shall rest under the shadow of this pavilion. The friends of God must therefore deal with the communities of the world with the utmost truthfulness and friendship without any distinction of race, so that all may embrace one another and with the utmost harmony and love may engage in the glorification of the Lord of the Kingdom.

Subject: unity in diversity
Quotation: Today is a beautiful day. I have been longing to see such a day. I am very happy. My happiness is from the point that it is the power of God which has gathered us together, that while before we were far apart now we are together. We are all gathered together in love. While it is possible for different nations to arrange a meeting together still their hearts are not united. But such a meeting as this, of different nations united in heart, is from the power of the Word of God.

Subject: unity in diversity
Quotation: God maketh no distinction between the white and the black. If the hearts are pure both are acceptable unto Him. God is no respecter of persons on account of either color or race. All colors are acceptable to Him, be they white, black, or yellow. If you go into a garden and find all the flowers alike in form, species and color, the effect is wearisome to the eye. The garden is more beautiful when the flowers are many-colored and different; the variety lends charm and adornment.

Subject: unity in diversity
Quotation: The collective center among humans may be unity of interests, but this is temporary and transient. Or the collective center may be language - you see different peoples speaking one language. Unity of language creates fellowship. Among all these, what truly serves as the collective center for human society is religion. It unites different religions, unites different nations, unites different races, unites different homelands, blends individuals together, dissolves them and casts them anew.

Subject: unity in diversity
Quotation: Consider the flowers of a garden: Though differing in kind, color, form and shape, yet, as they drink from the same water, and grow in the same breeze.  When they grow and develop under the warmth and light of one sun, such diversity and difference becomes the cause of enhancing each other's charm and beauty. Once the collective aspect, which is the penetrating power of the Word of God, is achieved, these differences in customs, habits, thoughts, opinions and temperaments become the adornment of the human world.

Subject: unity in diversity
Quotation: The differences in hue, shall lend a charm and harmony to the whole, and such a difference or disagreement is agreement itself, for it lends attraction. Were you to enter a certain garden, and where all the flowers were white in color, or yellow, or all blue, there would be no attraction, but when they are variegated, then it is perfectly charming. In short all the personalities which we possess are admirable, and we hope that the difference of personalities may be that source of attraction which lends charm to this garden.

Subject: unity in diversity
Quotation: Stand firm in the divine Cause and conduct yourselves with one another in perfect love, purely for the sake of the Beloved. Burn away the veils of self with the fire of oneness, and associate with each other with radiant and joyous faces. We hope that you will conduct yourselves with one another in perfect harmony, love and friendship, to such degree that through your unity the standard of oneness may be raised aloft and the banner of polytheism may be destroyed, and that you will vie with one another in good deeds and in showing contentment.

Subject: unity in diversity
Quotation: The kingdom of God is also likened unto the temple of man. We know very well that such temple is composed of many members which differ greatly in shape, form, action and office, and when these different members act in harmony with each other and have the real perfect affinity and attraction among them, they form together that temple which will be thoroughly ready to receive the spirit. The kingdom of God is also likened into a garden of trees. We all know that a garden in order to be beautiful must contain a good number of trees, various in size and different in colors, flowers and fruits.

Subject: unity in diversity
Quotation: This is a beautiful assembly. I am very happy that white and black are together. Among the animals colors exist. The doves are white, black, red, blue; but notwithstanding this diversity of color they flock together in unity, happiness and fellowship, making no distinction among themselves, for they are all doves. How beautiful to see blacks and whites together! I hope, God willing, the day may come when I shall see the red men, the Indians, with you, also Japanese and others. Then there will be white roses, yellow roses, red roses, and a very wonderful rose garden will appear in the world.

Subject: unity of existence [wahdatu'l-wujud]
Quotation: However, the mystics imagine that this existence is like an ocean and all beings are like its waves. This metaphor and expression is deficient, for if you look at reality, it would necessitate that the Pre-existent descend to the realm of the contingent, the Absolute Rich take on the form of poverty, Pure Being adorn itself with non-existence, and Divine Light assume the form of worldly darkness. In short, in their view existence is limited to Truth and creation with no third between them - its inner reality is Truth, its outer form creation; the reality is the ocean and the form is the wave.

Subject: unity of existence [wahdatu'l-wujud]
Quotation: Oneness, in its true significance, means that God alone should be realized as the one power which animates and dominates all things, which are but manifestations of Its energy.

Subject: unity of existence [wahdatu'l-wujud]
Quotation: For verily, whosoever claims distinction between life and knowledge in the Divine Essence hath indeed strayed from the path of truth, for in the Essence there is no differentiation.

Subject: unity of existence [wahdatu'l-wujud]
Quotation: The meaning of unity is not to see two or ten as one - this is the very essence of polytheism and atheism itself - rather, the one who believes in unity is he who sees the Truth as one from all directions, sanctified from all names and likenesses, and beholds all else as subsisting through Him and existing by His command.

Subject: unity of existence [wahdatu'l-wujud]
Quotation: may the multiplicities of the worlds of existence, which are clothed in the limiting garment of the limited self, become extinct and perish, so that the eternal countenance of the Face may emerge from behind the veils of beauty, and the Face of Glory - "All things perish save His Face" - may become manifest and apparent from behind the veil

Subject: unity of existence [wahdatu'l-wujud]
Quotation: This supreme reality has been likened to the water of the sea, and material things to its waves. Again, the single Reality has been likened to unity, material things being the manifestations of that Reality as numbers are the manifestations of unity. As one plus one equals two, one plus one plus one equals three, and thus from one all numbers come, so all things are made up from the one Reality.

Subject: unity of existence [wahdatu'l-wujud]
Quotation: Existence is synomymous with reality. Non-existence is the anthesis of reality. Reality is like unto the sun. In the world there are many luminaries...but the center of light is the sun itself. Likewise with reality. Although in the world of existence reality exists, in each one of the phenomenon you see the traces of reality, because each phenomenon amongst phenomena has a portion of existence, and existence is reality.

Subject: unity of existence [wahdatu'l-wujud]
Quotation: Those pre-eminent Sufis who founded the doctrine of the "unity of existence" never intended by this term the universally predicated existence which is conceived by the mind. For such an existence is but an accident among others occurring in association with the realities of things. That is to say, these realities are the substance, whereas that existence which is conceived by the mind, the universally predicated existence, is but an accident associated with them. Rather, what these pre-eminent figures have alluded to is an existence compared to which the realities of all things are mere accidents. By this is intended an existence that is pre-eternal whilst all other things are contingent. Thus, the existence to which they refer is that ineffable Reality whereby all things are realized, or, in other words, by virtue of which all things subsist, but which itself remaineth self-subsistent above the heavens and the earth. And since that existence whereby all things are realized is one, there is "unity of existence".

Subject: unity of existence [wahdatu'l-wujud]
Quotation: Thus they say: The knowledge of God in its fullness encompasses all things, and His knowledge is His very Essence, and the objects of His knowledge, which are created things, are therefore identical to His knowledge, which is identical to His Essence. And since His Essence is pre-existent, the forms of His knowledge, which are the realities of things, must also be pre-existent. Hence they speak of the unity of existence, maintaining that all things are that one Reality and that one Reality has become manifest in all things, even as the sea that appears in countless forms as its waves.

Subject: unity of existence [wahdatu'l-wujud]
Quotation: Beware, beware lest thou imagine any divergence from the different names and terms that appear in the expositions of the philosophers of this work, and thereby remove thyself from the sacred court of unity and the holy precinct of oneness. Know thou with certainty that all these manifestations that appear proceed from a single reality, and all these names that are heard refer to one reality, and in truth it is one reality and one essence that is differentiated in the worlds of existence and, in the stages of manifestation and determination in the realm of limitations, is mentioned in each station by a particular designation and confined within specific bounds.

Subject: unity of governments; political unity
Quotation: "Just as there is unity among the states of the United States of America, it is possible to have it among the nations of the world"

Subject: unity of governments; political unity
Quotation: We wish well for both sides and guide both toward unity, so that, God willing, government and people may blend together like milk and sugar.

Subject: unity of governments; political unity
Quotation: The fifth candle is unity of nations -- a unity which in this century will be securely established, causing all the peoples of the world to regard themselves as citizens of one common fatherland.

Subject: unity of governments; political unity
Quotation: This association must gradually attain such organization and connection that truly no similar association shall have been established from the beginning of history until now. This must be the first association founded under such a title.

Subject: unity of governments; political unity
Quotation: until the government and nation mix together like honey and milk, prosperity and success is impossible, Iran will be ruined and it will ultimately lead to the interference of neighboring powers. Therefore, the divine friends must strive with heart and soul to bring about reconciliation between the government and nation

Subject: unity of governments; political unity
Quotation: According to recent telegrams, good news of unity between government and people has arrived. His Majesty has ordered the implementation of constitutional government... prosperity and success are confined to unity between government and people. Until government and people mix like milk and sugar, comfort and ease is impossible

Subject: unity of governments; political unity
Quotation: Your aim, of course is the realization of universal Peace, but with what power or what executive force will you be able to bring it about? I hope that you will find this propelling power so that you may become assisted. In the matter of universal Peace, a great universal Power is necessary, what we may name a "Universal Collective Center." In the past there have appeared several "Collective Centers." These "Collective Centers" not being general in their various aspects have given only limited results. One of the "Collective Centers" has been and is yet considered the "spirit of nationalism."... Another "Collective Center" is "patriotism" the watchword and the battle-cry of the present nations. A third "Collective Center" is politics. ...all these "Collective Centers" instead of helping the cause of international Peace prevent its realization. Consequently in this illumined century, the intellectual evolution of humanity has advanced far enough as to create a "Universal Collective Center" around which all the nations may revolve, thus sacrificing their petty interests for the progress of the whole.

Subject: unity of governments; political unity
Quotation: You can render this priceless service to your country and the world at large by calling together an International Congress of Universal Peace to be held annually in Egypt and invite to it hundreds of the world's foremost thinkers, scholars, philosophers and statesmen - in brief a Parliament of the world of humanity, a symposia of the East and the West, the North and the South.

Subject: unity of governments; political unity
Quotation: If there has been possible in the past the formation of a United States of America, the next natural step will be the constitution of a United States of Europe, each state autonomous within its boundary, interdependent and working for the common prosperity, general advancement, expansion of commerce, diffusion of learning, the welfare of the whole community, the socialization of industries and the improvement of arts, inventions, crafts and sciences.

Subject: unity of governments; political unity
Quotation: As the foundation of His Holiness Baha'u'llah, who is our leader, is international peace in the world of humanity, therefore we have come to visit those who are interested in these problems, and find out to what degree they have advanced. H. H. Baha'u'llah, 50 years ago, proclaimed universal peace to the nations, declared universal peace amongst the peoples, declared universal peace amongst the religions, invited people to universal peace amongst nativities, summoned people to international peace amongst religions.

Subject: unity of thought and belief
Quotation: Be ye united, O My loved ones, then gather yourselves together under the law of My Cause, and be not of them that differ.

Subject: unity of thought and belief
Quotation: Make not the religion of God a cause of variance among you. Verily of a truth, it was revealed for the unifying of the whole world.

Subject: unity of thought and belief
Quotation: The friends must certainly be united themselves in order to unite others.

Subject: unity of thought and belief
Quotation: Though outwardly scattered, they are inwardly united and in the utmost joy and delight

Subject: unity of thought and belief
Quotation: You have no contending thoughts and seek no divergent opinions. You are united and in agreement

Subject: unity of thought and belief
Quotation: The highest wish of them that are filled with the Divine Spirit is unity and harmony amid the friends and spiritual connection among the hearts of the believers

Subject: unity of thought and belief
Quotation: For the sincere monotheists, pure in faith, must have a unifying center, a single unifying word, a mighty fortress, an impregnable shelter, a lofty refuge, a strong wall, and a safe haven. When they take refuge in it and hasten to it, they are protected from the overwhelming calamity, the widespread attack, the great upheaval, and the mighty blow.

Subject: unity of thought and belief
Quotation: Praise be to God that you are a united group of believers. I hope you will remain so firm and steadfast in faith and covenant that you may withstand thousands of hostile forces.

Subject: unity of thought and belief
Quotation: Praise be to God that the hearts of all members of this gathering are united with each other, and all have one intention and purpose. No signs of differing thoughts exist among them.

Subject: unity of thought and belief
Quotation: All is to bring love to your hearts. For this purpose you must prove the means of unity to the inhabitants of the earth. This is His hope for you. If among yourselves there is no love, no unity, how can this become possible?

Subject: unity of thought and belief
Quotation: You are a small army and very few in number in comparison to those around you. If dissension is existing among you and your opinions are different, everyone of you wishing to fight with a special sort of arms, i.e. some with swords, some with rifles, some with spears and some with guns, what will be the result? Defeat! And you will never see victory. But if you will unite together with one heart, one mind, one opinion, and one word, you will be able to fight all the armies of the world, and stand firmly before them.

Subject: unity; oneness of humanity
Quotation: I hope that all the people of the world become united and cemented. The Blessed Perfection hath appeared for the sole purpose of the unification and solidarity of the people of the world, so that all of them may enter under the shade of one tree, sing one melody in one rose-garden and adorn the universe with love and oneness. Every assembly held for the purpose of bringing about unity and concord will be conducive to turning strangers into friends and aliens into companions.

Subject: unity; oneness of humanity
Quotation: My object is none other than the betterment of the world and the tranquillity of its peoples. The well-being of mankind, its peace and security, are unattainable unless and until its unity is firmly established.

Subject: unity; oneness of humanity
Quotation: The souls of wolves and dogs are separate/But united are the souls of God's lions/Their bodies are like waves in number/Which the wind has brought forth

Subject: unity; oneness of humanity
Quotation: May we be like these trees, though outwardly they are numerous, they spring from the same Earth. I ask God day by day that your unity and accord may augment, that day by day your fellowship may increase, God willing, that you may be the cause that all humanity may become unified. The hearts of all the world shall find this spirit of Oneness, may all become one in kind, may all the people of the world become as flowers, however variegated their aspect; in short, all belong to the same garden, all received their charms from the same sun, all are nurtured beneath the gentleness of the same shower.

Subject: unity; oneness of humanity
Quotation: The third Ishraq is union and concord amongst the children of men. From the beginning of time the light of unity hath shed its divine radiance upon the world, and the greatest means for the promotion of that unity is for the peoples of the world to understand one another's writing and speech.

Subject: unity; oneness of humanity
Quotation: Be ever conducive to unity and harmony. Do not let this opportunity slip out of your fingers. The core of truth is Unity. Work for it. Let not your steps falter. Work for the cause of Unity. Marshal your intellectual and moral forces on the side of Unity. Let not doctrinal uncertainties confuse you. Pierce through the thick veils of the theological dogmas. In the royal court of the Almighty there is no diversification, no class hatred, no denominational bigotries, no racial distinctions, no spiritual lepers and no infernal prejudices. There, we are all one. In short a Baha'i is a remedy for every ailment, a balm for every wound and a consolation for every despondent heart. To the needy he is the source of supply; to the oppressed he is the shelter and protection; to the stranger the loving companion; to the helpless the staff of strength; to the defenceless the bulwark of security and to the deprived one the fountain of Mercy.

Subject: unity; oneness of humanity
Quotation: serve the unity of the kingdom of humanity

Subject: unity; oneness of humanity
Quotation: "How will the unity of mankind be established?"  Abdul Baha's answer was: When you remove the [impediments] thereof. These causes are racial, patriotic and religious bias or prejudice. This bias will be removed and when it is removed, people will live in friendliness, kindness and love which will bring forth unity.

Subject: unity; oneness of humanity
Quotation: proclamation of the oneness of the world of humanity

Subject: unity; oneness of humanity
Quotation: It was a melody of unity and a banner of detachment.

Subject: unity; oneness of humanity
Quotation: I have come to America to promote the unity of mankind

Subject: unity; oneness of humanity
Quotation: All must illumine the horizons with the lights of unity.

Subject: unity; oneness of humanity
Quotation: I hope such success is achieved that we all become united

Subject: unity; oneness of humanity
Quotation: He is the essence of unity and the embodiment of the oneness of mankind.

Subject: unity; oneness of humanity
Quotation: the unity of the human world will pitch its tent at the axis of possibility

Subject: unity; oneness of humanity
Quotation: become the cause of the appearance of the oneness of the Kingdom of humanity

Subject: unity; oneness of humanity
Quotation: They must strive with heart and soul to create love and unity among the friends

Subject: unity; oneness of humanity
Quotation: "teachings of Baha'u'llah...will establish the oneness of the world of humanity"

Subject: unity; oneness of humanity
Quotation: unity/oneness of humanity: "It has raised the banner of the oneness of humanity"

Subject: unity; oneness of humanity
Quotation: Now today we cry out: "O Baha'o'llah! What hast thou done! Thou hast unified us!"

Subject: unity; oneness of humanity
Quotation: all who dwell on earth might gather at one fountain and be assembled under one law

Subject: unity; oneness of humanity
Quotation: I counsel thee with that which is the cause of unity of hearts and harmony of souls

Subject: unity; oneness of humanity
Quotation: that the pavilion of the unity of the human race may cast its shade upon East and West

Subject: unity; oneness of humanity
Quotation: The Teachings of His Holiness Baha'u'llah declare the oneness of the world of humanity

Subject: unity; oneness of humanity
Quotation: thou didst join the people of unity, and didst distance thyself from the party of discord

Subject: unity; oneness of humanity
Quotation: "proclamation of human oneness and universal fellowship" will raise the banner of justice

Subject: unity; oneness of humanity
Quotation: and possess a heart alive with the spirit of human oneness and sentiments of universal peace

Subject: unity; oneness of humanity
Quotation: You must become distinguished for love toward every human being, for unity and accord with all people.

Subject: unity; oneness of humanity
Quotation: ye have arisen with all your power to serve the Kingdom of God, that is, to promote the unity of the world of humanity

Subject: unity; oneness of humanity
Quotation: The East and West are embracing each other! Asia and America, like unto two lovers, are holding the hands of each other!

Subject: unity; oneness of humanity
Quotation: Thou hast enabled the hearts to be virtually merged into a single heart and caused the souls to be identified as one soul.

Subject: unity; oneness of humanity
Quotation: elaborate thou on the benefits of harmony and the harms of discord, on the readiness of the human world in these troubled times

Subject: unity; oneness of humanity
Quotation: The standard of the oneness of the world of humanity is upheld. It is absolute love, perfect unity and accord among all mankind.

Subject: unity; oneness of humanity
Quotation: Unity and fellowship flow from the two fingers of the Lord of creation, yet all wander in the wilderness of perplexity and discord.

Subject: unity; oneness of humanity
Quotation: Make not the religion of God a cause of variance among you. Verily of a truth, it was revealed for the unifying of the whole world.

Subject: unity; oneness of humanity
Quotation: 'Abdu'l-Baha expects that luminous divine assembly to illumine the region of ?ad and establish the unity of the world of humanity.

Subject: unity; oneness of humanity
Quotation: The text celebrates an act of international solidarity and brotherhood through American children sending gifts to European children

Subject: unity; oneness of humanity
Quotation: Members should be elected who when united together will give the most harmony. No one should be elected who would cause inharmony.

Subject: unity; oneness of humanity
Quotation: I hope through divine favors that those noble souls, especially your kith and kin, may be confirmed in perfect fellowship and unity.

Subject: unity; oneness of humanity
Quotation:
The Blessed Beauty has provided the means for the unification of the world of humanity and has removed religious and social conflicts.   ABU3293
"Glory is not his who loves his homeland, but glory is his who loves the world." Thus hath spoken the Wronged One in this mighty prison.

Subject: unity; oneness of humanity
Quotation: Baha'u'llah raised the tent of the unity of the human world. Whoever enters under the shadow of this tent will certainly leave other tents.

Subject: unity; oneness of humanity
Quotation: I called all to the unity of the human world...so that struggle and conflict may not remain between human beings, all may become one family

Subject: unity; oneness of humanity
Quotation: Unity and harmony in every age have been the cause of elevation and advancement, while discord has been the cause of weakness and abasement.

Subject: unity; oneness of humanity
Quotation: Consider how love has gathered us together from the East and the West! Love draws us in friendship to the people of every race and religion.

Subject: unity; oneness of humanity
Quotation: All must strive for the betterment of the world. The earth is but one country and mankind its citizens, if they but knew it. All must endeavor with perfect unity and agreement to rebuild it.

Subject: unity; oneness of humanity
Quotation: He has made the people of the East and of the West love one another. Praise be to God that we are united and that we are of one heart and soul.

Subject: unity; oneness of humanity
Quotation: "Nothing causes me more unhappiness than disunity, and this can only be remedied by obedience to the command of the Universal House of Justice."

Subject: unity; oneness of humanity
Quotation: BAHA'O'LLAH speaks to humanity in a different tone, declaring humanity to be like the leaves of a single branch, the branches of a single trunk.

Subject: unity; oneness of humanity
Quotation: which is the oneness of the human world... I hope that God will assist you to serve all humanity without distinction between sects and religions

Subject: unity; oneness of humanity
Quotation: Be ye united in God's Cause and in His love, and differ not in any matter. Through your unity will God's Cause be made manifest among His servants

Subject: unity; oneness of humanity
Quotation: "Strive as far as you can in the establishment of love and reconciliation amongst the religions and service to the Oneness of the World of Humanity."

Subject: unity; oneness of humanity
Quotation: Baha'o'llah has created a marvelous love in the hearts, and a wonderful bond among the souls. He has caused the hearts to be attracted to one another.

Subject: unity; oneness of humanity
Quotation: O My friends! Be ye united and in agreement. Each one must be set ablaze with the fire of divine love, that its effects may encompass the earth of God.

Subject: unity; oneness of humanity
Quotation: The text specifically mentions establishing the oneness of humanity as one of the assembly's purposes: "establish the oneness of the world of humanity"

Subject: unity; oneness of humanity
Quotation: Let the loved ones of God gather upon the Most Great Word - this is better for them than whatsoever hath been created between the heavens and the earths

Subject: unity; oneness of humanity
Quotation: Multiple references to unity: "The lamp of unity must be lit in the glass of oneness, and the blessed tree must raise its height in the paradise of unity"

Subject: unity; oneness of humanity
Quotation: Cooperation and mutual assistance are the fundamental principles of the religion of God. The East must assist the West, and the West must assist the East.

Subject: unity; oneness of humanity
Quotation: the light of the oneness of humanity may shine brilliant and manifest as the sun; perfect love and harmony may reign among the races, religions and nations

Subject: unity; oneness of humanity
Quotation: It is hoped that through the endeavors of the honorable Haji, upon him be peace and grace, the light of unity may shine forth from the horizon of that land.

Subject: unity; oneness of humanity
Quotation: The community of humanity, the human species, are like children in a school...Help one another so that all may unitedly and harmoniously become as one body.

Subject: unity; oneness of humanity
Quotation: Today the greatest divine bounty is the unity and agreement of the friends, so that this unity and agreement may promote the oneness of the world of humanity

Subject: unity; oneness of humanity
Quotation: This yields results and is the cause of joy and fragrance and enduring glory...strive in the important matter, which is harmony and oneness among the friends.

Subject: unity; oneness of humanity
Quotation: Through you the unity of His Being and the sanctity of His Essence are established. What is needed is unity and harmony and wisdom and moderation in all matters.

Subject: unity; oneness of humanity
Quotation: The Son of Greatness hath said that which is revealed from the heaven of Will in this Supreme Manifestation is to unite the people in love and friendship toward all.

Subject: unity; oneness of humanity
Quotation: Therefore, we must lay aside all prejudice -- whether it be religious, racial, political or patriotic; we must become the cause of the unification of the human race.

Subject: unity; oneness of humanity
Quotation: Although the leaders have different opinions, the body of the nation should seek one unifying spiritual force that will bring them together. Iran now needs this force.

Subject: unity; oneness of humanity
Quotation: Indeed, the world of humanity is like one kindred and one family. Because it is of one race unquestionably there must be unity and harmony and no separation or discord.

Subject: unity; oneness of humanity
Quotation: If there has been estrangement between two individuals, they should cancel it out as this day dawns, for bliss should be the bond of all who come together at this Feast.

Subject: unity; oneness of humanity
Quotation: If the friends and handmaidens of the All-Merciful in America may become the cause of unity between East and West and raise aloft the standard of the oneness of mankind.

Subject: unity; oneness of humanity
Quotation: Today the world of humanity is in need of international unity and conciliation...Among the principles of spiritual civilization is the oneness of the kingdom of humanity.

Subject: unity; oneness of humanity
Quotation: The news of the unity and harmony of the friends brought great joy and delight. I hope that through your efforts, love and affection among hearts will increase day by day.

Subject: unity; oneness of humanity
Quotation: Praise be to God Who hath illumined the horizons with the light of unity and adorned the world with this radiance which He hath made the source of union among His servants.

Subject: unity; oneness of humanity
Quotation: These essential differences are the source of the splendor of the garden of humanity, not an obstacle to the manifestation of unity and fellowship among nations and religions

Subject: unity; oneness of humanity
Quotation: All human beings are brothers, and the conditions of brotherhood are many. Among them is that whatsoever one desires for oneself, one should desire the same for one's brothers.

Subject: unity; oneness of humanity
Quotation: Promote the oneness of the foundation of religions, the oneness of races, and the oneness of nations, and raise the pavilion of universal peace and unity of the world of humanity

Subject: unity; oneness of humanity
Quotation: Indeed, God willing, that Assembly may reach such a degree as to establish the foundation of the oneness of the world of humanity and achieve the utmost unity, harmony and oneness.

Subject: unity; oneness of humanity
Quotation: Abdul-Baha said that one must always remember that one is working for the world, not for a town or even a country, but as all are brothers so every country is as it were one's own.

Subject: unity; oneness of humanity
Quotation: We beseech and supplicate God that perchance His all-encompassing grace and manifest bounty may preserve the people of unity from the oppression and transgressions of the polytheists.

Subject: unity; oneness of humanity
Quotation: this blessed Cause which is a universal religion that brings all religions and sects under the shade of the Sun of Truth, creates complete unity among them, and makes them one nation.

Subject: unity; oneness of humanity
Quotation: The unity of mankind: all peoples are God's lambs and God is the loving Shepherd. He is kind to all His lambs, has created them all, fed and protected them; this is proof of His love.

Subject: unity; oneness of humanity
Quotation: to prepare them to hearken unto that which conduces to the sanctifying and purifying of the people of the world from strife and discord resulting from differences in religions or sects

Subject: unity; oneness of humanity
Quotation: When the Hand of Divine Power raised the eternal tent of glory of the oneness of the human world at the pole of contingent being, it opened the gates of the Most Great Mercy to all of us.

Subject: unity; oneness of humanity
Quotation: "It is God's will that the differences between nations should disappear. Those who help the Cause of Unity on, are doing God's work. Unity is the Divine Bounty of this brilliant century."

Subject: unity; oneness of humanity
Quotation: Therefore, it is better that ye learn the heavenly teachings, play a sweet melody throughout all regions, raise the standard of the unity of the human world, and establish universal peace.

Subject: unity; oneness of humanity
Quotation: This is the Surah of Unity. God hath made Unity for those who seek at Our gate and for those who stand in the depths of Oneness by Our leave, who have been upright around the Gate in truth.

Subject: unity; oneness of humanity
Quotation: I beseech the Truth to make all the loved ones of that land steadfast in His Cause and to adorn all with the ornament of love and unity, that the fragrance of discord may be utterly cut off.

Subject: unity; oneness of humanity
Quotation: You yourself know that the purpose is to establish harmony and unity between hearts... and upon their families and companions through whom God illumined the world with the light of His oneness

Subject: unity; oneness of humanity
Quotation: Strive thou with all thy heart, to the best of thy ability, to bring into close union the friends of the East and the West, that thereby an enduring connection may be established amongst them.

Subject: unity; oneness of humanity
Quotation: It seems as though all creatures can exist singly and alone... God has not created any difference. He has created all as one that thus this family might live in perfect happiness and well-being.

Subject: unity; oneness of humanity
Quotation: May all arise in unity and harmony to diffuse the divine fragrances. We are all servants of one threshold and bondsmen at the court of one Lord - we are fellow-servants, promised the best of rewards.

Subject: unity; oneness of humanity
Quotation: May you raise the standard of the oneness of the world of humanity, root out religious, national, racial and political prejudice and become the cause of fellowship and unity among different peoples.

Subject: unity; oneness of humanity
Quotation: We have ever besought and continue to beseech the Truth that He may illumine hearts with the light of harmony and agreement, and confirm each one in that which leadeth to the exaltation of existence.

Subject: unity; oneness of humanity
Quotation: Conduct yourselves with perfect unity and concord, and let not wisdom slip from your grasp. Corruption and contention are condemned. O people of God! Aid ye the Wronged One through deeds and character.

Subject: unity; oneness of humanity
Quotation: May it be the first nation to proclaim the unity of mankind... The American people are indeed worthy of being the first to build the tabernacle of the great peace and proclaim the oneness of mankind...

Subject: unity; oneness of humanity
Quotation: To show compassion and goodwill to all mankind. To render service to humanity. To endeavour to guide and enlighten those in darkness. To be kind to everyone, and show forth affection to every living soul.

Subject: unity; oneness of humanity
Quotation: O My loved ones! Gather ye around the Most Great Word in such wise that the veils of the idolaters may not withhold you. Beware lest ye differ concerning this Cause which is established upon the Throne

Subject: unity; oneness of humanity
Quotation: "These souls are the essences of existence and the subtleties of being who...raise high the banner of the oneness of humanity, deliver the world from the bonds of ignorance, demolish the foundation of prejudice"

Subject: unity; oneness of humanity
Quotation: The teachings of BAHA'O'LLAH declare the unity of the world. The teachings of BAHA'O'LLAH will dispel all national disunion, all racial disunion, and the teachings of BAHA'O'LLAH will conquer the economic difficulties.

Subject: unity; oneness of humanity
Quotation: Religion must become the cause of the affinity of humanity, racial zeal must be transformed into species zeal, the earth must become one homeland, and the human world must become the mirror reflecting the divine realm.

Subject: unity; oneness of humanity
Quotation: what is beloved is that all the world be seen as one homeland... so that all regions may attain to the light of unity, and the people of the earth may receive their share from the sun of knowledge and the ocean of wisdom

Subject: unity; oneness of humanity
Quotation: "That which they wrote concerning the harmony and unity of the two stars, upon them both be my Baha and my loving-kindness and my mercy - the horizon of grief hath been illumined and made radiant with the light of joy."

Subject: unity; oneness of humanity
Quotation: He opened the doors of love and fellowship and laid the foundation of oneness and affection...Ask God that through the assistance of the Abha Kingdom you may become the manifestation of love and affection to all humanity

Subject: unity; oneness of humanity
Quotation: How wondrous is this assembly and how lofty this pavilion! From earth appears water, and from fire shines brilliant light. In one place the pure and purifying call is heard, and from it the decree of water is made manifest.

Subject: unity; oneness of humanity
Quotation: and that God's light of primal oneness and spirituality may penetrate the world of humanity like unto a brilliant light. Then and only then will the veils of vain imaginings, of hatred, of discord and enmity be eliminated.

Subject: unity; oneness of humanity
Quotation: We are thinking of what might be done so that unity and concord might be established among the people and the nations of the world. We shall assuredly establish the foundation of love and concord among the children of men.

Subject: unity; oneness of humanity
Quotation: The Beauty of the Most Glorious manifested the unity of the human world upon the horizons... so that in the pole of the horizons the pavilion of the unity of the human world might be raised and the banner of oneness might wave.

Subject: unity; oneness of humanity
Quotation: Otherwise, a new sect would arise every day, complete dispersion would result, and the Cause of God would be utterly destroyed. If the preservation of Baha'i unity were possible through any other power, I would summon all to it.

Subject: unity; oneness of humanity
Quotation: both races, praise be to God, are under the protection of the All-Knowing God; therefore, the lamps of unity must be lighted in these meetings in such a manner that no distinction may be perceived between the white and the black

Subject: unity; oneness of humanity
Quotation: The greatness of the Cause eliminates differences, just as when health gains strength in the human body, all illnesses and diseases are eliminated through this mighty matter. Our hope is that no differences whatsoever will remain.

Subject: unity; oneness of humanity
Quotation: So that through the confirmations of the Kingdom the tabernacle of the oneness of humanity may be raised at the pole of the horizons, and all humanity in general may find rest and tranquility of heart, soul and body beneath its shade

Subject: unity; oneness of humanity
Quotation: It had no purpose except service to all humanity, the promotion of universal peace, and the removal of misunderstandings between religions so that all on earth may find rest and comfort under the shade of the unity of the human world

Subject: unity; oneness of humanity
Quotation: Moreover, they are all mankind. They have grown from one common trunk and are the branches of one tree. These boundaries that you have defined are the greatest illusions that man could ever conceive in his mind. They have no reality.

Subject: unity; oneness of humanity
Quotation: O peoples of the world! Ye are all the fruits of one tree and the leaves of one branch. Walk with perfect love, unity, fellowship and concord. I swear by the Sun of Truth that the light of unity will illumine and brighten the horizons.

Subject: unity; oneness of humanity
Quotation: You are all waves of one sea, rays of one sun, flowers of one garden, lions of one forest, birds of one meadow, and sweet herbs of one rose garden. Therefore you have the status of one soul and this letter is in truth written to each one.

Subject: unity; oneness of humanity
Quotation: You must discover the means of peace; invent guns of love which shall shake the foundations of humanity... You must work and experiment along this line. This work and accomplishment will be more wonderful than all you have done heretofore.

Subject: unity; oneness of humanity
Quotation: The circle of friendship among the human race must be enlarged and you must associate and unite with the good souls who have no purpose save goodness and are striving for universal peace and desire the solidarity and the oneness of the human world.

Subject: unity; oneness of humanity
Quotation: Exert thy utmost effort and endeavor to unite the people of the land... O 'Ali! God willing, thou must be as a fire to ignite the hearts and as a spirit to quicken souls, that all may gather in perfect unity and harmony upon the enduring divine Law.

Subject: unity; oneness of humanity
Quotation: O ye men of wisdom among nations! Shut your eyes to estrangement, then fix your gaze upon unity. Cleave tenaciously unto that which will lead to the wellbeing and tranquillity of all mankind. This span of earth is but one homeland and one habitation.

Subject: unity; oneness of humanity
Quotation: And 'Abdu'l-Baha has no cause to call people to obedience except the spreading of the divine fragrances, the exaltation of the Word of God, the promotion of the unity of the human world, the establishment of universal peace, and similar divine commands.

Subject: unity; oneness of humanity
Quotation: The tabernacle of the oneness of humankind shall be raised in the midmost heart of the world. The community of the human race will lift its banner on the hills, the mountains, and the valleys; it will fly high above the palaces and on the fortress walls.

Subject: unity; oneness of humanity
Quotation: The most urgent requisite of mankind is the declaration of the oneness of the world of humanity - this is the great principle of Baha'o'llah. That which will leaven the human world is a love that will insure the abandonment of pride, oppression and hatred.

Subject: unity; oneness of humanity
Quotation: There is no greater joy for my heart than the unity and agreement of the friends, for the happiness of the human world, the illumination of hearts, and the life of souls are achieved through the exaltation of the Word of God and through unity and agreement.

Subject: unity; oneness of humanity
Quotation: "Through solidarity. In some animals mutual co-operation is frequently seen; when in time of danger, each will try to surpass the others in help... Consider how much solidarity makes for life as compared to the fighting for self interest which destroys it."

Subject: unity; oneness of humanity
Quotation: This news brought much joy, inasmuch as the abundant effusions of the Kingdom of God and the heavenly outpourings of His grace and His unfailing celestial assistance are directed towards the establishment of unity, harmony, and fellowship amongst all mankind.

Subject: unity; oneness of humanity
Quotation: that the diverse peoples of the world have been gathered neath the shadow of a single Word, that hatred and enmity have been eradicated, that none is considered a stranger, but rather that all faiths and nations are viewed with utmost love and affection as friends

Subject: unity; oneness of humanity
Quotation: All mankind was held in the grip of anguish, and calamities afflicted every soul...that He may draw the hearts together, cause displeasure to vanish in the twinkling of the eye, and that thou mayest be the cause of joy and fragrance among the servants of the Merciful.

Subject: unity; oneness of humanity
Quotation: It is hoped that the light of unity may illumine that land and its horizons, and that those who believe in the oneness of God may hold fast unto that which is conducive to the exaltation of the Word and the light of unity and the extinguishing of the fire of polytheism.

Subject: unity; oneness of humanity
Quotation: reality is the oneness of humanity, reality is fellowship between people, reality is friendship, reality is justice, reality is equality between people...I ask God that you may become the cause of the unity of the human world, so that all humanity may embrace each other

Subject: unity; oneness of humanity
Quotation: The text emphasizes the importance of unity and fellowship, with 'Abdu'l-Baha stating: "I hope you will remain protected and preserved under the safeguarding protection of the Blessed Beauty and become a cause of fellowship and unity and love among the divine friends."

Subject: unity; oneness of humanity
Quotation: We wish well to all, and offer our prayers and supplications at the Throne of God that He will reconcile these two honourable elements with one another, so that they may become one element, and may work together for the glory and advancement of both Government and people.

Subject: unity; oneness of humanity
Quotation: The believers must love each other and must reflect the love of God. Some may say the lamp is a light; others may say the lamp is the manifestation of light. Both statements are correct; but what is wrong is to quarrel, because it is contrary to the foundation laid by God.

Subject: unity; oneness of humanity
Quotation: Mayest thou scatter in every clime the perfume of the love of God; raise aloft the standard of the oneness of mankind; uproot every form of prejudice, sectarian, national, racial or political; and promote the cause of love and unity amongst the diverse peoples of the world.

Subject: unity; oneness of humanity
Quotation: Praise be to God Who hath adorned human reality with the resplendent signs of divine love and compassion, and Who hath shone upon all created things with the light of attraction, such that they have become united, harmonious and mutually attracted through a spiritual power.

Subject: unity; oneness of humanity
Quotation: "For six thousand years misunderstandings have kept humanity divided. All nations have been in a state of strife, of warfare and bloodshed...Now, praise be, a century of light has appeared, and superstition shall pass away...Veils will be torn asunder and all nations shall be united."

Subject: unity; oneness of humanity
Quotation: In this transient world, we seek to raise the banner of human unity and pursue universal agreement, unity, and peace. We call to unity those nations and peoples who are estranged from one another, so that we may transform hostile and conflicting groups into harmonious and loving ones.

Subject: unity; oneness of humanity
Quotation: God has created mankind from the same progeny in order that they may associate in good fellowship, exercise love toward each other and live together in unity and brotherhood. God is one. He is the Shepherd of all. We are His sheep and, therefore, should live together in love and unity.

Subject: unity; oneness of humanity
Quotation: With heart and soul we yearn for the day when the pavilion of human unity will be raised in the midst of the world and the banner of universal peace will wave over all horizons. Therefore the unity of the human world must be established so the edifice of universal peace can be erected.

Subject: unity; oneness of humanity
Quotation: This evanescent servant beseecheth the eternal Truth to adorn all those who are related to Him and are known by His name with the ornament of unity and harmony, and to aid them in serving His Cause, that all may arise to guide mankind and become leaders of the way and guides unto the path.

Subject: unity; oneness of humanity
Quotation: For they are waves of one sea and drops of one river, stars of one horizon and rays of one sun, trees of one garden and flowers of one rose garden. If unity of condition and unfailing oneness does not appear among them, that gathering will be scattered and that assembly will be disordered.

Subject: unity; oneness of humanity
Quotation: We hope that the people of those regions may attain unto them and drink therefrom, that the world may be illumined by the lights of the Most Great Name and all peoples may be seen as one soul, that they may grasp with one hand and soar with one wing and see with one eye and hear with one ear.

Subject: unity; oneness of humanity
Quotation: For the first principle of divine teaching is the unity of humanity - that all creation are the sheep of God, and the merciful Lord is the kind Shepherd. This Shepherd loves His sheep, and this is clear and evident, for He is the Creator of all, the Provider for all, and the Protector of all.

Subject: unity; oneness of humanity
Quotation: Their souls are intimate and harmonious with each other. Therefore Abdul-Baha offers thanks at the threshold of the Blessed Beauty that those ancient friends in this mighty Cause are intimate and close with us, and are partners and sharers in servitude at the threshold of the Blessed Beauty.

Subject: unity; oneness of humanity
Quotation: This attainment is conditioned upon unity and agreement. The more perfect the love and agreement, the more the divine confirmations and assistance of the Blessed Perfection will descend. Strive with all your hearts and with the very power of life that unity and love may continually increase.

Subject: unity; oneness of humanity
Quotation: importance of love and unity among the believers: "They have no quarrel with anyone and no dispute with any soul. They are in utmost peace and purity, friendship and faithfulness with all. They are the unique friends of both stranger and kin, and the faithful companions of friend and stranger."

Subject: unity; oneness of humanity
Quotation: Hold fast unto what is good and vie ye with one another in good deeds. Thus have ye been commanded by God, the Lord of the worlds... All must, through divine assistance and in perfect unity, gather at the table of the love of the All-Merciful, regard their aims as one and their purposes as united

Subject: unity; oneness of humanity
Quotation: Among the forms of unity is the unity of souls and possessions, and with this station We conclude Our mention of unity, as a command from Us, and verily I am the Mighty, the All-Choosing. This unity is a unity which is the source of joy, gladness and delight, were they but to understand and know.

Subject: unity; oneness of humanity
Quotation: The oneness of mankind shall be promulgated, in that the Baha'is will endeavour with all their power and capacity (might) to bring about peace among peoples. From this will grow, as one of the peaceful fruits of justice, the brotherhood of mankind, based on the new Religion of Unity (Baha'i Teaching).

Subject: unity; oneness of humanity
Quotation: It is very good for the friends in Germany and America to correspond with each other, as this will increase affection and connection of hearts. How joyous it is that the power of Baha'u'llah's Cause has brought us together, bringing souls close despite great distances, and such nearness has been achieved.

Subject: unity; oneness of humanity
Quotation: I ask God that thou mayest become a sincere lover of the world of man and benevolent to all humanity; and become the promoter of union and harmony; so that ignorant prejudices may be dispelled from among nations and communities; and that they may enter under the ensign of the oneness of the kingdom of man.

Subject: unity; oneness of humanity
Quotation: This issue must flow and circulate like a spirit through the arteries and nerves of the body of the world... The Baha'is, according to the decisive texts of Baha'u'llah and His binding commands, sacrifice their lives in all international matters that spring from the intention of the unity of the human world

Subject: unity; oneness of humanity
Quotation: They are the well-wishers of all kindreds, show kindliness to all peoples, and guide all men to unity and fellowship - the bedrock foundation of progress and order. They have uttered no word, entertained no ill-feeling, and reproached no people, but rather, they have extolled the unity and oneness of humankind.

Subject: unity; oneness of humanity
Quotation: God willing, may they ever be gathered on the carpet of love, affection and unity, in such wise that the fragrances of their unity may unite all scattered peoples. As for the matter of the honored Mulla Husayn who has separated from them, this incident was not favorable, as unity among the loved ones is beloved.

Subject: unity; oneness of humanity
Quotation: The world is but one country, and all mankind its citizens. Not he who loves his country is worthy of pride, but rather he who loves mankind. The fundamental purpose of the Faith of God and His Religion is to protect the welfare and foster the unity of humanity, and cultivate love and fellowship among all people.

Subject: unity; oneness of humanity
Quotation: Baha'o'llah proclaimed the cause of human brotherhood. In the midst of calamities he waved aloft the standard of universal peace; from captivity he summoned the kings of the earth to the cause of unity and world-wide love. The more they tried to stifle the proclamation the more it resounded throughout the world.

Subject: unity; oneness of humanity
Quotation: Different tribes and diverse peoples became united... He has proclaimed the unity of humanity and spread the equality of mankind. Therefore, you all must strive with heart and soul and live with love among all people so that complete unity may be achieved, ignorant prejudices may vanish, and all may become united.

Subject: unity; oneness of humanity
Quotation: Unity is an Ideal which is confirmed by the Almighty. How I love to see the friends so united as to be one soul in many bodies! The leaders of mankind must at all time work for the spread of the principles of Unity. Unity is the light that illumineth every path. Our origin has been one and our end must be also one.

Subject: unity; oneness of humanity
Quotation: This evanescent servant beseeches night and day that perchance the light of unity and concord may appear and illumine the horizons. Two souls sit together and converse with the utmost love, but when religion is mentioned and differences appear, at that moment they turn away from one another and arise in great enmity.

Subject: unity; oneness of humanity
Quotation: Thus may war and conflict finally be eliminated from the face of the earth and hatred and rancour be effaced.
