Thus might the morning light of the love of God shine and such a concord be established amongst the children of men that they may see each other, one and all as pearls of one ocean and myrtle's of one meadow.

Subject: unity; oneness of humanity
Quotation: Now this Convention which is held every year - whatever decisions are reached must be accepted, for this is a general gathering. To a certain degree it is like the House of Justice, but it is not the House of Justice. Baha'o'llah says, 'Whatever the House of Justice does that is my command. They cannot go against it.'

Subject: unity; oneness of humanity
Quotation: Were not the Revelation of Baha'o'llah one adaptable to the entire world and its diverse nations, it could not be a unique and universal Revelation, but its elasticity adapts itself to all conditions, and its spirit is one that moulds itself into every vehicle and need for the accomplishment of the divine plan of unity.

Subject: unity; oneness of humanity
Quotation: In most of the Tablets We have commanded all the friends to unity and harmony, for from a collective body another effect becomes manifest and a special influence becomes evident. Therefore must the loved ones of God gather at the wellspring of divine love, and that collective body will have a perfect effect in the world.

Subject: unity; oneness of humanity
Quotation: raised the standard of love, fellowship, oneness, peace, amity, reconciliation, truthfulness and uprightness at the pole of the world. He has freed countless numbers from among hostile nations and conflicting religions from hatred and enmity, bringing them beneath the shade of the pavilion of love, fellowship and oneness

Subject: unity; oneness of humanity
Quotation: "That is the essence of My teachings. All nations and all religions must be united. By that unity perfect peace would reign among men." "My purpose is to bring about the oneness of humanity and to secure accord and fellowship among all mankind, so that all may dwell together finally as one family. They were so originally."

Subject: unity; oneness of humanity
Quotation: O Ali-Qabl-i-Naqi! Through the light of unity is the world illumined, and through the warmth of concord are the horizons set ablaze. For all things that are perceived and that enter the realm of observation there has been and is an effect, and likewise the taste and fragrance of the effects of unity and concord are most mighty.

Subject: unity; oneness of humanity
Quotation: May they rend asunder the veils of idle fancies, uproot the foundation of estrangement, raise high the banner of oneness, become the light of truth and dispel the darkness of the world, become spiritual friends and employ the antidote of divine knowledge, and bestow the power of God's love upon the structure of the human world

Subject: unity; oneness of humanity
Quotation: The beloved of God must be friendly even with strangers and intimate even with outsiders--how much more with others among the righteous believers! I hope all the friends of the East and West shall rest in the same assemblage and adorn one gathering, appearing with all the heavenly attributes and virtues in the world of humanity.

Subject: unity; oneness of humanity
Quotation: Through the power of the Word of God they have unfurled the banner of the oneness of the kingdom of humanity upon the apex of the world with deeds and actions; and through the bounty of Bahaâ€™oâ€™llah they have spread the proclamation of the brotherhood of man and the universal equality among the people of the East and the West.

Subject: unity; oneness of humanity
Quotation: Were they to attain the honor of hearkening to the Word of the Prophets, they would remove these differences and all would see themselves as people of one homeland, speaking one language and writing in one script. Should they reach this station, they would be illumined by the rays of the Sun of Divine Unity, and all would find rest.

Subject: unity; oneness of humanity
Quotation: Baha'o'llah addresses himself to the world of man saying, "Ye are all the leaves of one tree and the fruits of one arbor." That is, the world of existence is no other than one tree, and the nations or peoples are like unto the different branches or limbs thereof, and human individuals are similar to the fruits and blossoms thereof.

Subject: unity; oneness of humanity
Quotation: Should any discord appear amongst you, behold Me before your faces, and overlook that which hath appeared, for My sake and out of love for My resplendent Cause. We love to behold you at all times in My paradise of contentment, with spirit and fragrance, and to inhale from you the sweet savours of fellowship, affection, love and unity.

Subject: unity; oneness of humanity
Quotation: Night and day He counseled and advised that they should enter beneath the shade of the word of unity and come to the shore of the sea of detachment, drink from the spring of paradise, and strive for the unity of the world, uproot differences between factions from their foundation and eliminate conflicts between nations from their root.

Subject: unity; oneness of humanity
Quotation: Therefore, in thanksgiving for this divine bestowal, deal with one another in unity and oneness. Be immersed in the sea of unity, become intoxicated from the cup of singleness, be illumined with the lights of oneness, and become manifest with the mysteries of bounty, so that you may truly appear with the attribute of real sanctification.

Subject: unity; oneness of humanity
Quotation: Let us all gather at one point, and that point is the unity of humankind. Our hope is that the unity of mankind will spread abroad, that hatred and enmity between people will be dispelled, that the Most Great Peace will become manifest, so that all nations will associate with one another and all governments will intermingle with each other.

Subject: unity; oneness of humanity
Quotation: The infinite bounty of God hath resuscitated the whole world, and the East and West have come united with the bond of the summons of God. Today the call of the Kingdom of God hath reached the hearing of the far and near of all the continents of the world and the standard of the solidarity of mankind is held aloft by the grasp of Divine Power.

Subject: unity; oneness of humanity
Quotation: In this day the manifestation of the All-Merciful has appeared and He has established all humanity beneath the shade of the divine Lote-Tree...it is hoped that He will bestow upon all peoples the utmost fellowship and connection with each other beneath this blessed Tree, making them as one sea and one paradise and as stars in a single firmament

Subject: unity; oneness of humanity
Quotation: Thou hadst written about the formation of meetings. Thou art, God willing, confirmed. If, through divine assistance and grace, agreement, progress and harmony are achieved with the various groups, it will become the cause of guidance for numerous souls, and I hope that all may become united and of one accord in servitude at the Sacred Threshold.

Subject: unity; oneness of humanity
Quotation: Heedlessness hath laid waste the world. The foundation of the word of unity is observed to be shaken through the dissension and cawing of the polytheists. The banner of God's word hath been raised and planted at the highest station of the world for thirteen hundred years, yet now it hath inclined due to the transgressions of evil and wayward souls.

Subject: unity; oneness of humanity
Quotation: When the Sun of Reality dawned from the horizon of sanctification upon all regions, it shed the lights of unity of thoughts, unity of views, unity of beliefs, and unity of truth, so that the human world might gather at one point regarding thoughts and beliefs, and all differences, conflicts and disputes might be completely removed from the human world

Subject: unity; oneness of humanity
Quotation: That is why His Holiness Baha'o'llah addresses humanity, saying, "Ye are all the leaves of one tree and the drops of one sea." That is to say, the world of humanity, representing all the religions, representing all the races, may be likened to a tree. Every nation of the nations is like a branch thereof, and every soul amongst them is like unto a leaf.

Subject: unity; oneness of humanity
Quotation: Praise be to God! You are free from such prejudice, for you believe in the oneness and solidarity of the world of humanity. The supreme need of humanity is cooperation and reciprocity. The stronger the ties of fellowship and solidarity amongst men, the greater will be the power of constructiveness and accomplishment in all the planes of human activity.

Subject: unity; oneness of humanity
Quotation: Now they must roar like sea-lions and make up for the war years, setting that region in motion with their intoxicated song and loving melody, until the light of spirituality so illumines hearts that the rays of oneness shine forth and the darkness of estrangement is dispelled. May all peoples mix together and spread sweetness in their love and affection

Subject: unity; oneness of humanity
Quotation: If only the whole world would acknowledge the greatness of Muhammad and all the Heaven-sent Teachers, strife and discord would soon vanish from the face of the earth, and God's Kingdom would come among men...If men could only learn the lesson of mutual tolerance, understanding, and brotherly love, the unity of the world would soon be an established fact.

Subject: unity; oneness of humanity
Quotation: Let us promote equal rights amongst all men, spread far and wide the divine favors, and offer the love of God to all who dwell on earth, so that the power of the spirit may become manifest with the utmost splendor, bodies may become spiritualized, and souls may govern. Then humanity will be reckoned as a single soul and the unity of mankind will be realized.

Subject: unity; oneness of humanity
Quotation: O friends of God, gird up your loins to serve and be so enkindled by the divine kindled fire that you may illumine and enlighten both East and West... The friends of that land must become so intoxicated with the wine of unity that they acquire the character of a single sea - though the waves are many, the sea is one sea; multiplicity does not prevent unity.

Subject: unity; oneness of humanity
Quotation: Through spiritual susceptibilities we have been brought together despite differences in nativity, language, climate, and religious prejudices. The oneness of spiritual emanations have brought us together. Baha'u'llah accepted all trials and hardships so that the oneness of humanity might become a shining star, and that unity might be established in the hearts.

Subject: unity; oneness of humanity
Quotation: The people have imagined this mighty Cause and momentous matter to be a source of corruption and disunity, whereas the divine Law commands humanity only to love and abandon enmity. For in this Revelation, Thou didst command them only to strive to remove hatred and rancor, to exert effort in eliminating discord, and to manifest love and harmony among all peoples.

Subject: unity; oneness of humanity
Quotation: We commanded them to wisdom and unity, but they differed in what they possessed... God willing, through your efforts the luminous lamp of unity will be lit and shine forth in that land. The harm of discord exceeds all reckoning - it is the cause of wasting God's Cause and extinguishing souls. Its example is like autumn winds, while unity is like spring breezes.

Subject: unity; oneness of humanity
Quotation: The friends must become the cause of harmony among humanity and promote unity and oneness among peoples and nations through the divine breath. As much as we can, we establish the foundation of fellowship and remove estrangement between religions and nations. We seek universal peace and desire truthfulness, friendship, and reconciliation among peoples and tribes.

Subject: unity; oneness of humanity
Quotation: And concerning what thou didst write about the unity, harmony, joy, gladness, delight and happiness of the Afnan and the loved ones - this became the cause of joy and exultation. We beseech God to assist all to remain steadfast in what was mentioned at every moment, for truly the manifestation of discord hath been and is the cause of the dissipation of God's Cause.

Subject: unity; oneness of humanity
Quotation: Were they united together the results of their deliberations would have been marked improvement in the life of the nation. The Persian Nationalists have loved to theorize on certain democratic principles without understanding their real significances and thus they came to a sad and calamitous end. They did not pull together but each person pushed in a different way.

Subject: unity; oneness of humanity
Quotation: The real temple is the very Word of God; for to it all humanity must turn, and it is the center of unity for all mankind. It is the collective center, the cause of accord and communion of hearts, the sign of the solidarity of the human race, the source of eternal life. The first of these institutions and foundations is the oneness of humanity and love among mankind.

Subject: unity; oneness of humanity
Quotation: His Holiness Baha'u'llah has commanded the Baha'is to consort with all the religions and nations with the utmost concord and harmony. In our estimation mankind are the children of God and as the children of the Almighty it is enjoined upon us to love one another and co-operate with each other. The cycle of the oneness of the world of humanity is being ushered upon us.

Subject: unity; oneness of humanity
Quotation: The purpose of this community is to become the cause of the unity of the world and the oneness of mankind. Yet now a partnership has been formed among a few souls, designated as spiritual and priding itself on the Blessed One's confirmation, which could not endure for even five days - its pillars found no rest, it was utterly dispersed, and its foundation was laid waste.

Subject: unity; oneness of humanity
Quotation: It is evident to the wise, to people of thought and to those possessed of knowledge that disunity in the world of humanity - that is to say, separation - is the cause of their degradation, the cause of their disorder, the cause of their ignorance. However, if they form a social body, it becomes the cause of their progress, the cause of their civilization - this is certain.

Subject: unity; oneness of humanity
Quotation: Essential unity should be so manifest that we become like one sea, one ray, one spirit and one breath. Though there are multiple lamps, praise be to God the light emanates from one sun. Though bodies differ, praise be to God life comes from one spirit. Today there is no greater victory for God's Covenant than unity and harmony, and no greater insult than discord and division.

Subject: unity; oneness of humanity
Quotation: Thus it became obvious that mankind is in need of true and universal Educators Who will bring together the divers peoples of the world under the sheltering shadow of a single Word, will enable to contending nations to drink from the same Fountain, will turn animosity and hatred into love and fellowship and will cause conflict and contention to be changed into peace and harmony.

Subject: unity; oneness of humanity
Quotation: O divine friends! Among the divine gifts bestowed upon human society and the happiness of humanity is the matter of cooperation and mutual assistance. For the friends of God are like a human body, and each soul is like one of its parts. Therefore there must be constant and strong cooperation and mutual aid between the parts so that all parts may live in perfect comfort and joy.

Subject: unity; oneness of humanity
Quotation: This good news has made everybody hopeful that soon the torch of the Oneness of the world of Humanity may be enkindled in New York. I hope from the bounties of the Kingdom these souls may enlighten the world of humanity, may promulgate the oneness of the world of existence, and, like unto stars, may shine upon men by the light of union and concord from the horizon of the world.

Subject: unity; oneness of humanity
Quotation: Be very kind to those people, explain to them the oneness of the world of humanity, which is one of the basic principles of His Holiness Baha'o'llah that all the people are the sheep of God, and God is the affectionate shepherd. He is affectionate to all his sheep, this is the policy of God. Therefore to us the Chinese, Japanese, French, English, Persians, and Germans are all one.

Subject: unity; oneness of humanity
Quotation: His Holiness, Baha'u'llah promulgated certain institutes. The first institute of Baha'u'llah is the Oneness of the world of humanity. Addressing the human kind He says "you are all of one tree, each one of you constitutes a certain leaf or certain blossom and fruit, you all belong to the Adamic tree, you are all one family, you are all the servants of God, you are all the sheep of God".

Subject: unity; oneness of humanity
Quotation: His Holiness, Baha'o'llah, has admonished the Bahais, in many tablets, that they should not have religious differences and racial or patriotic prejudices, that they must gather under the banner of the world of humanity. O, people of the world! Ye are the fruits of one tree and the leaves of one branch. Glory is not for the one who loves his country, but for the one who loves the world.

Subject: unity; oneness of humanity
Quotation: Under all conditions, hold fast unto that which is right. Soon will a barking one and a liar pass through that land. We have informed all of this beforehand. Ye must arise to serve the Cause with perfect unity and accord, and should any matter arise that would cause discord between you, strive with all your might to remove it, that all hearts may be adorned with the seal of We are God's.

Subject: unity; oneness of humanity
Quotation: The purpose was that they might be occupied and enjoy the bounties of these few earthly days, while beseeching God - exalted be His glory - night and day for the salvation of all on earth, that perchance through the grace of the sincere ones and the monotheists the fire of envy and hatred might be extinguished and all might gather as one soul beneath the shade of the Tree of Divine Unity.

Subject: unity; oneness of humanity
Quotation: Support today consists of goodly deeds, praiseworthy conduct, and unifying words - this has been and will continue to be so, as revealed and recorded in most of the Tablets. You must surely strive with the utmost effort and care to unite hearts, bring about agreement among souls, and follow what has been revealed in the Book, so that all may dwell in one pavilion and speak with one voice.

Subject: unity; oneness of humanity
Quotation: Unity is good. These meetings teach us that Unity is good, and that suppression (slavery under the yoke of traditions and prejudices) is the cause of disunion. We hope the people will realize and know that Unity is good, and we also hope that they will not be content to stand still in that knowledge. Do not only say that Unity, Love and Brotherhood are good; you must work for their realization.

Subject: unity; oneness of humanity
Quotation: Blessed are they who through the promptings of malicious souls have not been debarred from the shores of the sea of oneness, and who through the favors of the Lord of creation have rent asunder the veils of idle fancy. The greatest of all things is steadfastness and unity around God's all-embracing Word. All must hold fast unto the cord of steadfastness and cling to the hem of unity and concord.

Subject: unity; oneness of humanity
Quotation: Daily has this most blessed and exalted word been heard from the tongue of the Ancient One - blessed and exalted be His utterance: O servant present! This exalted word from the Most Exalted Pen is as an ornament upon the brow of the divine victory, glorified be His majesty: 'Verily all success lieth in unity and concord.' For should the foundation of fellowship be shaken even slightly, complete ruin would result.

Subject: unity; oneness of humanity
Quotation: Second, the declaration concerning the oneness or the solidarity of human kind. God is one and the world of humanity is one. That which is lacking is simply the education of those who are still deficient, and who can become thereby illumined, so people who are illiterate shall be literate, but ever He declared humanity in its entirety is the servant of God. God loveth all. Why should we be unkind to our fellowman?

Subject: unity; oneness of humanity
Quotation: The joyous news of the unity and concord among the friends in Alexandria was received. What wonderful tidings it was that was the cause of joy and upliftment to the heart of 'Abdu'l-Baha. Since the foundation-stone of the Cause of God is unity, concord and love that must so encompass the hearts, spirits and souls of the loved ones of God that all may become as one merciful body, and each one as parts and members thereof.

Subject: unity; oneness of humanity
Quotation: All the holy and inspired messengers who have shone in the history of the world have, as the fulfillment of their mission, the promotion of love and amity in the hearts of the people. In order that the members of the world of humanity might associate with each other, these Divine Souls have utilized every means, for it has been the aim of all the Prophets of God to bring about reconciliation and fellowship among the sons of men.

Subject: unity; oneness of humanity
Quotation: Strive, strive always that ye may be united. If one single sheep strays away from the fold, do all in your power to bring it back. Kindness and Love must be your means of gathering all together! This is the cause of My great happiness - seeing America and the East joined together in love and spiritual unity. May all the beloved in the world be so joined, until all mankind shall come under one rule; all nations be as one family.

Subject: unity; oneness of humanity
Quotation: God endured all these tribulations and trials so that unity of humankind might be established among people, and oneness and unity might be founded, and the foundation of discord and estrangement might be completely destroyed. In all His tablets He urged, encouraged and explicitly stated that prosperity and success are confined to the unity of the human world, which must spread through all horizons like the rays of the morning lamp.

Subject: unity; oneness of humanity
Quotation: It behooveth thee to spend thy life, body and blood in the path of God, for this mighty gift. It is incumbent upon you (to act) with merciful harmony and spiritual unity, so that the bounties of your Lord may embrace you and make you as waves in this sacred, moving sea. This is seemly of the believing women! This is the spirit of the assured women! This is the light of the peaceful women! This is the ultimate wish of the attracted women!

Subject: unity; oneness of humanity
Quotation: The divine religions were founded for the purpose of unifying humanity and establishing universal peace. All created beings are dependent upon peace and coordination, for every contingent and phenomenal being is a composition of distinct elements. And now let us consider the various peoples of the world. All the nations -- American, British, French, German, Turkish, Persian, Arab -- are children of the same Adam, members of the same human household.

Subject: unity; oneness of humanity
Quotation: The indication of unity and harmony among the Israelite and Muslim friends has become the cause of glad tidings and joy...This is the best of all glad tidings because it is the divine foundation and essence. The sending of all Prophets and Messengers, the revelation of all scriptures and books, the self-sacrifice of all the saints of God, and the endeavors of the divine scholars - their wisdom and result is the unity of souls and the fellowship of hearts.

Subject: unity; oneness of humanity
Quotation: O how I long to see the believers shouldering the responsibilities of the Cause! This is the time of love and unity. This is the moment for the affection of the loved ones of God. My only joy is the glad tidings of the unity and oneness of the people of Baha. My desire is to see the friends so united that they become like a string of pearls, like the Pleiades, like the rays of one sun, and like gazelles in the field of unity, gathered together and in agreement.

Subject: unity; oneness of humanity
Quotation: I hope you will establish perfect harmony and love with the diffuser of the fragrances of God, Mirza Ahmad Sohrab. Should the slightest trace of ill-feeling arise between you, given that the ill-wishers lie in wait and are day and night occupied in confusing minds here and there, seeking by whatever means possible to shake the friends' steadfastness, they would completely uproot the foundation of unity through your discord and proceed with the utmost oppression.

Subject: unity; oneness of humanity
Quotation: This discord and displeasure emboldens others and leads to disobedience among the believers...This servant's intention and desire is that all the Hands of the Cause of God become as one spirit, one heart and one soul...And this will not happen unless they have the utmost unity and harmony with each other...Consider this point - that from the beginning of the world until now, every united group has succeeded while every scattered one has failed and been dispersed.

Subject: unity; oneness of humanity
Quotation: The second principle of Baha'o'llah proclaims the oneness of the human race. He states that humanity constitute the sheep of God. God is the real shepherd. When this shepherd is compassionate and kind, why should the sheep quarrel amongst themselves? Addressing all humanity, Baha'o'llah says, "Ye are the fruits of one tree and the leaves of one branch. All the nations, peoples and tongues are the branches, leaves, blossoms and fruits of this great tree of humanity."

Subject: unity; oneness of humanity
Quotation: So intensely hath the glory of Divine Unity penetrated souls and hearts that all are now bound one to another with heavenly ties, and all are even as a single heart, a single soul. Then will all humankind, because of this fresh and dazzling bounty, be gathered in a single homeland. Then will conflict and dissension vanish from the face of the earth, then will mankind be cradled in love for the beauty of the All-Glorious. Discord will change to accord, dissension to unison.

Subject: unity; oneness of humanity
Quotation: Today all must fix their gaze upon the supreme horizon alone, detached from all else, and beseech God, exalted be His glory, to grant victory to the people of divine unity. Today the world of polytheism is united while the realms of unity are divided, and this division hath caused the abasement of the people of truth. Unity and accord have ever been the cause and means of exalting the Word. We beseech God to illumine the horizons of the hearts of His loved ones with the light of unity.

Subject: unity; oneness of humanity
Quotation: This Wronged One beareth witness that servants have been brought from nothingness into being for the betterment, fellowship and unity of mankind. Corruption and conflict have ever been and are condemned. The divine Books, Tablets and Scriptures have given the glad-tidings that the purpose of this Most Great Manifestation is none other than the reformation of the world and its peoples, that perchance through the power of utterance military might be abolished, and the world be governed through the power of love.

Subject: unity; oneness of humanity
Quotation: Discord among the loved ones is a fire that consumes good deeds and actions. Today the glory of God's Cause lies in the unity and harmony of those who seek the Ka'bah of divine knowledge, and this matter has become the cause of grief to the Ancient Beauty, for it exalts the word of unity yet wastes the Cause through discord. You must strive with utmost determination that the sun of unity may dawn from the horizons of hearts, and that the flames of discord may be quenched by the waters of remembrance and utterance.

Subject: unity; oneness of humanity
Quotation: We must all become united and harmonized in order to illumine this gloomy world; to abolish the foundations of hostility and animosity from among mankind; to perfume the inhabitants of the universe with the holy fragrances of the nature and disposition of the Beauty of Abha; to enlighten the people of the East and West with the light of guidance; to hoist the tent of the love of God and suffer each and all to enter under its protection; to bestow comfort and tranquillity upon every one under the shade of the Divine Tree.

Subject: unity; oneness of humanity
Quotation: His honor Haji Ahmad, upon him be the Glory of God, hath laboured greatly and demonstrated from that Presence that which proved his faith and certitude. A Most Holy, Most Exalted Tablet was also revealed and bestowed specifically for him. At this moment, in the presence of the Ancient Beauty, exalted be His grandeur, He commanded: Write to Ali-Qabli-Akbar, upon him be My glory and favors, that which is regarded by God as the most excellent of deeds and upon which depends the exaltation of the blessed Word - unity and concord.

Subject: unity; oneness of humanity
Quotation: The manifestation of the Light of Unity is for binding together the people of the world. If this unity is not attained, the tree of life is made fruitless, the heavenly bounty is not utilized. The blessed blood (of the saints) was shed for bringing about unity and harmony. These souls gave their lives as sacrifice in order to produce the love that bindeth the hearts of all the people. Therefore, ye should all spend your efforts in uniting and reconciling (the people), so that the light of God's love may permeate the universe.

Subject: unity; oneness of humanity
Quotation: The souls who act according to the Teachings of Baha'o'llah are the lovers of the world, friendly to all nations, their utmost desire being the unity and association of all denominations, service to all the human race, occupations with servitude to GOD and promulgation of the Fragrances of GOD. For mere acquisition of a treasure, or the conquest of a domain,-they hurt no soul. All their hopes and desires are these: that they may become the manifestation of the Mercy of the Lord and the cause of rest, repose, joy and happiness for all the servants of GOD.

Subject: unity; oneness of humanity
Quotation: They had covenanted together, so they wrote, to remain at one in all things, and the signatories one and all had pledged themselves to make sacrifices in the pathway of the love of God... The more this compact is reinforced, the happier and the better shall all things be, for it will draw unto itself the confirmations of God. If the lovers of the Lord are hoping for grace to win as their friends the Company on high, they must do all they can to strengthen this compact, for such an alliance for brotherhood and unity is even as watering the Tree of Life: it is life everlasting.

Subject: unity; oneness of humanity
Quotation: O ye that dwell on earth! The religion of God is for love and unity; make it not the cause of enmity or dissension. Say: O servants! Let not the means of order be made the cause of confusion and the instrument of union an occasion for discord. We fain would hope that the people of Baha may be guided by the blessed words: 'Say: all things are of God.' This exalted utterance is like unto water for quenching the fire of hate and enmity which smouldereth within the hearts and breasts of men. By this single utterance contending peoples and kindreds will attain the light of true unity.

Subject: unity; oneness of humanity
Quotation: They see the human world as a single tree, and consider all human beings as its leaves, blossoms and fruits. Their supreme desire is universal peace, and their conviction is the oneness of humankind... It is for this reason that I have accepted this long journey and come here, that East and West may find complete harmony, achieve the utmost connection, assist one another, and become the cause of each other's comfort. If East and West become united, the banner of universal peace will wave and the oneness of humankind will be manifested, and comfort and tranquility will be achieved for all.

Subject: unity; oneness of humanity
Quotation: That which thou hadst written was noted. Concerning the unity and harmony of the friends, thou hadst written that thou hadst arranged a Covenant gathering and established affinity and unity between the Spiritual Assembly of men and the Spiritual Assembly of women. This matter brought the utmost joy and gladness to the heart of Abdul-Baha. Today there is no matter greater than unity and harmony, more noble than affinity and fellowship, and more sacred than the connection and association of the friends of God and the handmaidens of the Merciful. Each one must exert complete effort in this important matter.

Subject: unity; oneness of humanity
Quotation: Therefore, how excellent and befitting it would be if the thoughts of the world's wise ones were devoted to spreading the power of love, which is the cause of unity and healing, the cause of eternal glory, the cause of the comfort of the human world. Similarly, when we think carefully, we observe that they all dwell in one territory - in Europe. Therefore, if they say it is because of religious differences, they have one religion; if they say it is because of racial differences, all are of one race; if they say it is because of differences of homeland, all dwell in one territory. Beyond all this, they are all human beings, grown from one garden and one tree.

Subject: unity; oneness of humanity
Quotation: That soul which hath itself not come alive, Can it then hope another to revive? Note how easily, where unity existeth in a given family, the affairs of that family are conducted; what progress the members of that family make, how they prosper in the world. Their concerns are in order, they enjoy comfort and tranquillity, they are secure, their position is assured, they come to be envied by all. Such a family but addeth to its stature and its lasting honour, as day succeedeth day. And if we widen out the sphere of unity a little to include the inhabitants of a village who seek to be loving and united, who associate with and are kind to one another, what great advances they will be seen to make, how secure and protected they will be. Then let us widen out the sphere a little more, let us take the inhabitants of a city, all of them together: if they establish the strongest bonds of unity among themselves, how far they will progress, even in a brief period and what power they will exert. And if the sphere of unity be still further widened out, that is, if the inhabitants of a whole country develop peaceable hearts, and if with all their hearts and souls they yearn to cooperate with one another and to live in unity, and if they become kind and loving to one another, that country will achieve undying joy and lasting glory.

Subject: unity; oneness of humanity
Quotation: Seek fellowship and unity, and forget estrangement and alienation. The human world requires fellowship, and what befits humanity is forgiveness and love.

Subject: unity; oneness of humanity
Quotation: In this century the Bahais have sacrificed their lives so that fellowship and affection may become realised in the hearts, so that the world of humanity may become radiant, the children of men be resuscitated with a new life, and the earthly world become a mirror reflecting the divine world.

Subject: unity; oneness of humanity
Quotation: to astonish the enemy by the manifestation of the utmost love...to reach the ears of the inhabitants of the Kingdom with the outcry--"Verily the earth is illumined by the lights of its Lord." This is reality! This is guidance! This is service! This is the consummation of the perfection of the realm of humanity.

Subject: unity; oneness of humanity
Quotation: Exercise toward all the utmost friendliness and amity. Perchance through the Providence and Bounty of God the horizon of mankind may become purified and sanctified from these black clouds of unenlightened bias and dark hostility and aversion. Strive that day by day you may become the cause of love and amity amongst all the nations of the world...

Subject: unity; oneness of humanity
Quotation: The beaming shafts of the light of cosmic ideals must pierce through the hearts of men. Human power is limited in its influence. It can unite two persons, or two tribes, or two communities, or at the utmost two nations. At the same time it confesses that this unity is temporal and may be abrogated by the whim of either of the high contracting parties. But the divine power unites nations and peoples and cements together in the bond of brotherhood and peace for ages and cycles.

Subject: unity; oneness of humanity
Quotation: "For in all the world of creation all the existent beings are in the utmost connection. Through this connection, mutual helpfulness and co-operation is realized. This mutual helpfulness and co-operation is the origin of the conservation of the forces of life. If for one instant this mutual helpfulness and co-operation were cut off from the sources and realities of things, all the existent beings and things would be thrown into confusion and chaos and be reduced to nothingness and annihilation."

Subject: unity; oneness of humanity
Quotation:
O ye believers of God! Be not concerned with the smallness of your numbers, neither be oppressed by the multitude of an unbelieving world. Five grains of wheat will be endued with heavenly blessing, whereas a thousand tons of tares will yield no results or effect. One fruitful tree will be conducive to the life of society, whereas a thousand forests of wild trees offer no fruits. The plain is covered with pebbles, but precious stones are rare. One pearl is better than a thousand wildernesses of sand, especially this pearl of great price, which is endowed with divine blessing. Erelong thousands of other pearls will be born from it. When that pearl associates and becomes the intimate of the pebbles, they also all change into pearls.  AB00169
He continued to reveal divine teachings and wrote numerous tablets and books, proclaiming the principles of the oneness of humanity, universal peace, and the unity of religion.

Quotation: foster the universalization of education

Subject: universal education
Quotation: As for the name of the school, call it "Universal," meaning it is for all peoples.

Subject: universal education
Quotation: differences that arise from oppression and transgression, and from prejudice and ignorance, are eliminated through good education and wisdom

Subject: universal education
Quotation: The seventh teaching of Baha'o'llah concerns itself and is in accord with this system of universal education; it is that all the children should study and acquire a profession, that there should not remain a single individual without a profession whereby he can earn his livelihood.

Subject: universal education
Quotation: The only remedy is education, opportunity; for equality means equal qualification. If a pupil is told that his intelligence is less than his fellow pupils, it is a very great drawback and handicap to his progress. He must be encouraged to advance by the statement, "You are most capable, and if you endeavor, you will attain the highest degree."

Subject: universal education
Quotation: In this wondrous Cycle, the firm foundation is the establishment of education in sciences and knowledge, and by explicit text all children must acquire sciences to the necessary degree. Therefore, schools and educational institutions must be established in every city and village, and all children must strive to acquire learning to the necessary degree in cities and villages.

Subject: universal education
Quotation: Truly God has created all the beings, but has created them that they may be educated. And through education transforms stone into crystal, brings the light from the oil, changes an ignorant man into a clever one, and places him above the animal. Civilization makes man understand all discoveries and invent all things. Education gives sight to the blind, and civilization changes the savage into an angel.

Subject: universal education
Quotation: If man himself is left in his natural state, he will become lower than the animal and continue to grow more ignorant and imperfect. If we wish to illumine this dark plane of human existence, we must bring man forth from the hopeless captivity of nature, educate him and show him the pathway of light and knowledge, until, uplifted from his condition of ignorance, he becomes wise and knowing; no longer savage and revengeful, he becomes civilized and kind.

Subject: universal human capacity for spiritual recognition
Quotation: The One Creator hath created all people equal and hath conferred upon them superiority over all created things. Therefore, elevation and abasement, increase and decrease, depend upon one's endeavor. The more one strives, the further one advances.

Subject: universal language
Quotation: Lack of intercourse and communication created differences of language and customs. Little by little they were more and more stranged from each other.

Subject: universal language
Quotation: should any person of understanding become acquainted with the divine teachings, he would be attracted and yield momentous results, for the new teachings are the spirit of this age and the light of this century.... Among them is the unity of language.

Subject: universal language
Quotation: espouse the cause of an international auxiliary language

Subject: universal language
Quotation: The matter of the Esperantists is more important than the League assembly. Perhaps Mr. Yazdani can sow a seed among them.

Subject: universal language
Quotation: The unifying force among humans may be language; you see different peoples speaking the same language. Unity of language is a cause of fellowship.

Subject: universal language
Quotation: Among the confirmations in this century is the universal language which we see spreading. Without doubt a universal language will remove misunderstandings, for every individual will become informed of the thoughts of all humanity, and this is among the means for the unity of humankind.

Subject: universal language
Quotation: you are giving instruction in English, and are corresponding with a number of quarters in the universal language. Your communications with the Esperanto newspaper in England will be a source of inspiration and encouragement to that journal. There is no doubt of the benefit of learning this language at this time

Subject: universal language
Quotation: Some parties in the world have striven to speak in their particular languages and have considered this matter a cause of their elevation and exaltation... However, in the view of the Wronged One, what is beloved is that all the world be seen as one homeland, and that effort be made to promote one language or two, as mentioned before, so that all regions may attain to the light of unity

Subject: universal language
Quotation: As for the Esperanto association, mix with them and whoever you find receptive, breathe into them the breath of life... It appears that the Esperanto society has capacity, and you are knowledgeable and skilled in the Esperanto language. Correspond also with the German Esperantists and others... It is hoped that henceforth there will be strong effect in the souls through the Esperanto language.

Subject: universal language
Quotation: Among the things which are conducive to unity and concord and will cause the whole earth to be regarded as one country is that the divers languages be reduced to one language and in like manner the scripts used in the world be confined to a single script. It is incumbent upon all nations to appoint some men of understanding and erudition to convene a gathering and through joint consultation choose one from amongst the various existing languages, or create a new one, to be taught to the children in all the schools of the world.

Subject: universal language
Quotation: Writing on this subject, 50 years ago, His Holiness Baha'o'llah said that complete union between the various sections of the world would be an unrealized dream as long as an international language was not established. The basis of knowledge and the excellencies of endeavor in this world are to teach and to be taught. To acquire sciences and to teach them in turn depends upon language and when the international auxiliary language becomes universal, it is easily conceivable that the acquirement of knowledge and instruction will likewise become universal.

Subject: universal language
Quotation: Choose ye a single language for the use of all on earth, and adopt ye likewise a common script. God, verily, maketh plain for you that which shall profit you and enable you to be independent of others. He, of a truth, is the Most Bountiful, the All-Knowing, the All-Informed. This binding command has been revealed from the Ancient Realm for the people of the world in general and the members of parliaments in particular. Each year ye add to your expenditures and place this burden upon your subjects - this is utterly remote from justice and equity. It is observed that due to the diversity of languages among the peoples of the earth, most nations are deprived of association, fellowship, and the acquisition of knowledge and wisdom from one another. Therefore, through pure bounty and grace, all are commanded to choose a language - whether newly created or selected from existing tongues of the earth - and all shall speak it. In this way, the whole earth shall be seen as one city, for all will understand each other's speech and comprehend one another's intent.

Quotation: Previously we spoke of universal peace and people laughed...but in the days of the Blessed Beauty the requirements of the realities of things is universal peace

Quotation: our pursuit of peace does not stem from mere thoughts but is a matter of religious belief and among the eternal divine foundations.

Quotation: Demolish the foundation of war and lay the basis of peace

Subject: universal peace; world unity
Quotation: raise the pavilion of universal peace and unity of the world of humanity

Subject: universal peace; world unity
Quotation: thereby may eternal peace, harmony, welfare, and prosperity be realized on earth

Subject: universal peace; world unity
Quotation: He speaks with rational proofs and arguments about the promotion of universal peace

Subject: universal peace; world unity
Quotation: You must become distinguished for removing prejudices and promoting international peace.

Subject: universal peace; world unity
Quotation: when this Cause is fully spread in Europe, warfare will be a thing of the past, universal peace will be realized, the oneness of the world of humanity will be recognized

Subject: universal peace; world unity
Quotation: Therefore wherever we see the lights of peace and welfare we must worship and welcome them, even if they come from any region or language.

Subject: universal peace; world unity
Quotation: that wars and strifes may be eliminated from the world of man; that there be no more wars and strifes and that reconciliation and peace appear

Subject: universal peace; world unity
Quotation: By what process will this peace on earth be established? Will it come at once after a universal declaration of the Truth? No, it will come about gradually.

Subject: universal peace; world unity
Quotation: Universal Peace is the best panacea for the diseases of the Islamic world... They can save what is left to them through the proclamation of Universal Peace.

Subject: universal peace; world unity
Quotation: He advocated the establishment of universal peace and the oneness of humanity...Until such events cease, humanity will find no rest, the tabernacle of universal peace will not be raised

Subject: universal peace; world unity
Quotation: Among the principles of divine civilization He came to proclaim is the Most Great Peace of mankind...He wrote special Epistles covering these facts to all the kings and rulers of nations.

Subject: universal peace; world unity
Quotation: "Having heard of the numerous organizations for peace and arbitration, and because of My great interest in these subjects, I have come here to advocate the unity and solidarity of humanity."

Subject: universal peace; world unity
Quotation: Now behold they themselves have formed peace societies in this country, there are international associations...in the days of the Blessed Beauty the requirements of the realities of things is universal peace

Subject: universal peace; world unity
Quotation: Make thyself a host of the Lord of Hosts so that thou mayest become the cause of salvation to the people, give sight to the blind, hearing to the deaf and life to the dead. This is the divine bestowal, this is the heavenly grace, this is the divine guidance.

Subject: universal peace; world unity
Quotation: The aim, of course is the realization of universal Peace, but with what power or what executive force will you be able to bring it about? In the matter of universal Peace, a great universal Power is necessary, what we may name a "Universal Collective Center."

Subject: universal peace; world unity
Quotation: "The peace of the world must be brought about by international agreement. All nations must agree to disarm simultaneously." "It will be established in this century," he answered, 'It will be universal in the twentieth century. All nations will be forced into it."

Subject: universal peace; world unity
Quotation: Be united, O kings of the earth, for thereby will the tempest of discord be stilled amongst you, and your peoples find rest, if ye be of them that comprehend. Should any one among you take up arms against another, rise ye all against him, for this is naught but manifest justice.

Subject: universal peace; world unity
Quotation: The matter of universal peace is but one of the principles of Baha'u'llah's teachings. Now is the first gleaming of the dawn of universal peace. It is hoped that the sun of universal peace will shine forth with such splendor as to utterly disperse the darkness of war, strife and conflict.

Subject: universal peace; world unity
Quotation: Thou must awaken them in regards to the Divine Kingdom, for their intentions are good but they do not know that all the powers in the world are incapable of establishing universal peace and promulgating the oneness of the world of man save the power of the Word of God and the breaths of the Holy Spirit.

Subject: universal peace; world unity
Quotation: War is the most preventable accident... The greatest intelligence of man is being expended in the direction of killing his fellow-man. The discovery of high explosives, perfecting of death-dealing weapons of war, the science of military attack, all this is a wonderful manifestation of human intelligence; but it is in the wrong direction.

Subject: universal peace; world unity
Quotation: Their purpose is the peace of the world, not war; and love between all, not enmity. They are commanded to obey the government and to wish well for all rulers and subjects. One who holds such a glorious purpose in his heart will not sully himself with these trivial matters. One who seeks universal peace and serves humanity will not interfere in regional conflicts and disputes.

Subject: universal peace; world unity
Quotation: These delegates who have gathered in the Peace Conference are like merchants. Each strives to compete for victory with his rival. Even if peace were established, it would be but temporal. Years ago there was an international peace agreement, but wars have continued notwithstanding. If such conferences were endowed with the power to establish an enduring peace, the world would have been at rest long ago.

Subject: universal peace; world unity
Quotation: For the world of Humanity has acquired, as a result of this great carnage a great capacity for the propagation of Universal Peace. Ears are longing to hearken to the call of the oneness of the world of Humanity, to Universal Reconciliation, and to the rejection of ignorant prejudices. In fine, if all the friends of God engage in the promulgation of Heavenly Teachings, the establishment of Universal Peace shall be a foregone conclusion.

Subject: universal peace; world unity
Quotation: Your present effort will bring most great results in the future. What you have written is true. The first plan "the alliance of Humanity for the attainment of Universal Peace" did not bring any result: for the question of Universal Peace is one Teaching of the Teachings of His Holiness Baha'ollah, It must be along the Principles of the Bahais and not the Principles of the Bahais to be along (or consider as of secondary importance to) the question of Universal Peace.

Subject: universal peace; world unity
Quotation: I have come to America to promote universal peace and the unity of humankind, not for sightseeing and tourism... peace is today the greatest matter in the human world. There is no matter more important than it. It is the cause of comfort for the world of creation. It is the cause of happiness for humankind. It is the cause of fellowship among all created things. It is the cause of connection between East and West. It is the cause of true freedom and is the greatest divine gift.

Subject: universal peace; world unity
Quotation: O people! Baha'u'llah laid the foundation of universal peace fifty years ago. He even addressed Epistles to the kings wherein He declared that war could destroy the foundation of the world of humanity, that peace was conducive to everlasting life and that dire peril awaited mankind. Now is the dawn of universal peace, and the first streaks of its light are beginning to appear. We earnestly hope that its effulgent orb may shine forth and flood the East and the West with its radiance. The establishment of universal peace is not possible save through the power of the Word of God.

Subject: universal peace; world unity
Quotation: O people of the earth! Make not the religion of God a cause of variance among you. Verily of a truth, it was revealed for the unifying of the whole world.

Subject: universal peace; world unity
Quotation: "Fifty years ago BAHA'O'LLAH wrote that there must be a league of nations to establish universal peace."

Subject: universal peace; world unity
Quotation: Soon East and West will embrace like two lovers...All peoples of the world become friends and embrace each other.

Subject: universal peace; world unity
Quotation: That which has been the cause of the unity of the world and its peoples has been revealed and sent down from the Most Exalted Pen in various Tablets

Subject: universal peace; world unity
Quotation: peace and amity, justice and equity, the progress of humankind, advancement in the degrees of illumination, the proclamation of the oneness of the world of humanity

Subject: universal peace; world unity
Quotation: He should know himself as a servant of human society of all the countries in the world. He should see God as the heavenly father and all the servants, as his children, counting all the nations, parties and sects as one family.

Subject: universal peace; world unity
Quotation: The greatest need of this century is universal peace. Baha'u'llah has instituted it. The most urgent need of human kind is the declaration of the oneness of the world of humanity, this is the first principle of the Bahai Teachings.

Subject: universal peace; world unity
Quotation: It is clear and evident to the daysprings of justice and the dawning-places of equity that this Wronged One hath desired, through the power of the Kingdom, to remove strife, conflict, contention, discord and division from among the peoples of the world.

Subject: universal peace; world unity
Quotation: "that all mankind may be united with each other; that all wars and battles may be abolished from among the nations and powers of the world; that the standard of universal peace or the Most Great Peace shall be raised; that estrangement may cease entirely"

Subject: universal peace; world unity
Quotation: We have neither enmity with any party nor friendship with other parties. Our path is to walk the straight way and proceed upon the right path. In this transient world, we seek to raise the banner of human unity and pursue universal agreement, unity, and peace.

Subject: universal peace; world unity
Quotation: He proclaimed that Universal Peace must become a fact between the religions and between the various nations. Those people and those nations who hearken sincerely to the Teachings of Baha'u'llah are today living together with the utmost spirit of love and spiritual grace.

Subject: universal peace; world unity
Quotation: The chief objects of Green Acre conferences must be the furtherance of universal peace, investigation of reality, brotherhood, tolerance, sympathy to all mankind, the cultivation of a better understanding between the nations of the world, the elimination of dogmas and superficialities, the illumination of the hearts with the light of truth, mutual assistance and co-operation, social service, the study of the fundamental principles of all religions and their comparative co-ordination.

Subject: universal peace; world unity
Quotation: Every heart will then be refreshed, all eyes will be opened, the most wonderful power will be given, the happiness of humanity will be assured. This will be the paradise which is to come on earth, when all mankind will be gathered together under the tent of unity in the Kingdom of Glory.

Subject: universal peace; world unity
Quotation: The unity of mankind was not realize, perfect connection was not produced amongst mankind, for there was no means for this; they could not meet each other. But in the Cause of the Blessed Perfection, Baha'u'llah, the greatest preparations are in evidence. The means for the unity and harmony of mankind is found in the most complete way.

Subject: universal peace; world unity
Quotation: The Cause of God is the only panacea which will heal for all time to come the social, economic and political diseases of mankind. The revelation of Baha'o'llah is the tree which will send its outstretched branched to all the countries and under its cool shade all the religious sects will gather there to fraternize and associate with one another.

Subject: universal peace; world unity
Quotation: Consider how Jesus Christ united the divergent peoples, sects and denominations of the early days. In Persia Baha'u'llah was able to unite people of varying thought, creed and denomination. The inhabitants of that country were Christians, Muslims, Jews, Zoroastrians and a great variety of subdivided forms and beliefs together with racial distinctions.

Subject: universal peace; world unity
Quotation: In such a time of amusement and play, to be in the utmost state of sanctity and holiness - how radiant that would be then. Like a candle it would shine. Why? All people are occupied with amusements, stained with carnal desires. A soul there enkindled with the fire of God's love, attracted to holy fragrances, sanctified and purified from all defilements - how radiant that would be.

Subject: universal peace; world unity
Quotation: The bonds of friendship and unity between the children of men must be strengthened, and religious differences and racial strife must be eliminated - what fault can be found in these things?... Yea, thus shall it be: these fruitless contentions, these destructive wars, shall all pass away, and the Most Great Peace shall be established in their stead... These contentions and wars and bloodshed and differences must cease, and all people must live together as one family.

Subject: universal peace; world unity
Quotation: The republic of men become the manifestors of the bounty of the most glorious Lord; the East and the West be brought nearer together; and that the Turk and Tajik, Iran and America, India and Arabia, Japan and Persia, China and Germany; in brief, all the nations and peoples of the world become as one soul and one spirit, in order that strife and warfare be entirely removed and the rancor and hostility disappear so that all become as the waves of one ocean, the drops of one sea, the flowers of one rose-garden, the trees of one orchard, the grains of one harvest and the plants of one meadow.

Subject: universal peace; world unity
Quotation: Praised be the Blessed Beauty and the Greatest Name for He hath conferred such connection and harmony unto the human race, and established such a mighty foundation, and promoted such a sublime aspiration, and raised aloft such a tabernacle in the midmost heart of the world that its results have caused the various nations of the earth to be united and devoted to one another, and for the whole world to become as one country and its numerous lands to become as one common fatherland, and for all the different governments to join together in unity and harmony, so that the roots of oppression are eradicated and the foundations of war, conflict, pillage and plunder, hatred and hostility are destroyed.

Subject: universal peace; world unity
Quotation:
Note then: if every clan, tribe, community, every nation, country, territory on earth should come together under the single-hued pavilion of the oneness of mankind, and by the dazzling rays of the Sun of Truth should proclaim the universality of man; if they should cause all nations and all creeds to open wide their arms to one another, establish a World Council, and proceed to bind the members of society one to another by strong mutual ties, what would happen then? There is no doubt whatsoever that the divine Beloved, in all His endearing beauty, and with Him a massive host of heavenly confirmations and human blessings and bestowals, would appear in His full glory before the assemblage of the world.  AB00175
He continued to reveal divine teachings and wrote numerous tablets and books, proclaiming the principles of the oneness of humanity, universal peace, and the unity of religion. From His prison cell, He addressed letters to the kings and rulers of the world, calling them to justice and urging them to establish universal peace.

Subject: universality of the Cause
Quotation: Every universal matter is from God; and limitations are from man. Therefore, if people's services and efforts are undertaken for the benefit of all, they are acceptable to God and leave lasting traces.

Subject: universality of the Cause
Quotation: It is good that this church is open to everyone, and is the cause of fellowship among every sect and creed, inasmuch as whatever is universal is of God, and that which is particular is of humanity.

Subject: universality of the Cause
Quotation: This Cause embraceth the aspirations of all souls. It is for the spiritualists, the theosophists and all the peoples of the world, that no excuse may remain for anyone before God. The Cause must be all-embracing, so that every sufferer may find therein his remedy - a divine elixir.

Subject: universality of the Cause
Quotation: The Baha'i Cause is comprehensive. Every community finds the reality of its principles in this Cause. The Baha'i Cause is like a tree and these various communities, or gatherings or societies, are branches. When you compare the tree with the branches you find every branch in the tree, and this is the Baha'i Cause.

Subject: universality of the Cause
Quotation: Our aim is to spread the knowledge of reality, and diffuse the fragrance of the rose. Let us have all the sweet roses we can get. We can never have enough roses. Besides this, the Baha'i movement is not an organization. It is the fresh Breeze of the Garden of God. You can never organize the Baha'i Cause. It cannot be located in one single place or centered in one individual. The Baha'i movement is the spirit of this age. It is everywhere. It has no geographical limits. It is the essence of all the highest ideals of this century.

In short, the explicit command of Baha'u'llah is that every child, whether rich or poor, aristocrat or democrat, high or low must learn a trade, an art or a craft. This law must be incorporated in the constitution of every school.

Learn to do something in this world, no matter how small it may be. it is better to be a good carpenter, a fine shoemaker, a skillful physician, an accomplished engineer, an excellent gardener, a brilliant artist, a superior teacher, an inspired writer than to be an angel in heaven with nothing to do but to sing hallelujah and play on golden harp.

Subject: veiling [hijab]
Quotation: Q. Did Kurratu’l Ayn habitually discard the veil after that meeting? Abdu'l-Baha: No. In the presence of some of the more intimate friends who used to visit her, she would unveil but not in public.

Subject: veiling [hijab]
Quotation: As in the question of the veil, nothing should be done contrary to wisdom. You need to be calm and composed, so that the work will proceed with wisdom, otherwise there will be such chaos that ye will leave everything and run away.

Subject: veiling [hijab]
Quotation: In this Dispensation the veil is stricter than before. In the Islamic Dispensation, the veil had become such that women could not walk in the streets and bazaars - they were like purchased slaves. Therefore, just so they could engage in work and acquire knowledge, in every Dispensation showing hands and face was permitted. But in these days there is no requirement for such matters, and perhaps someday the Spiritual Assembly will permit something like the Iranian women's head covering that covers all four sides of the face so that no non-related man can see their hair - not like Western women who go out with uncovered heads, with head and neck and half their arms exposed. The veil in this Dispensation is such that if there is a woman alone in a house, no one can enter that house without the owner present, unless one of the woman's relatives is present there, like a son or daughter or brother. The intention is that if a woman is alone in the house, an unrelated man must not enter.
