Quotation: In the Name of God, the Most Unapproachable, the Most Holy. Visitation for the Other, upon him be the Glory of God, the Sovereign, the Subduer

Subject: visitation Tablets
Quotation: Visitation prayer for the blessed martyr, the radiant light, His Holiness Mulla ?adiq... The first visitation should be performed on behalf of this servant

Subject: visitation Tablets
Quotation: O faithful ones! Should ye visit the resting-place of the Most Exalted Leaf...stand ye and say: 'Salutation and blessing and glory upon thee, O Holy Leaf...'

Subject: visitation Tablets
Quotation: Visitation prayer for the one who ascended to God, Mr. Mulla 'Ali...God's mercy be upon one who visits your grave, God's aid be upon one who walks in the vicinity of your resting place

Subject: visitation Tablets
Quotation: This is a visitation prayer to be recited by the divine friends of Isfandabad from the tongue of 'Abdu'l-Baha for the illustrious martyr Aqa Rida, upon him be the lights of martyrdom and sacrifice in the path of God.

Subject: visitation Tablets
Quotation: This is explicitly a visitation tablet, ending with a prayer for those who visit his grave: "Blessed is the seeker who seeks your tomb, and the lover who visits your grave and recites what the tongue of your Lord has uttered"

Subject: visitation Tablets
Quotation: Mashad through Mirza Ahmad - Jinab-i-'Inayatu'llah son of Katkhuda Isma'il-i-Namaqiy should observe this visitation tablet for one who was martyred in the path of God, Katkhuda Isma'il, upon him be the Most Glorious Beauty of God

Subject: visitation Tablets
Quotation: The Ancient Beauty was well pleased with 'Abdu'?-?ali?, and after his ascension revealed a Visitation Tablet in his honor, also delivering an address concerning him, which was taken down and published together with other Scriptures.

Subject: visitation Tablets
Quotation: God hath ordained the fourfold in the fourfold from the paths of visitation in the visitation, in truth upon truth, and the matter in the Mother Book was decreed around the Fire... He it is Who hath promised His visitor the meeting with Himself, and God's promise was in truth, upon truth, fulfilled.

Subject: visitation Tablets
Quotation: If on such a day - a Friday - thou art in the presence of Him Whom God shall make manifest, blessed art thou! This shall suffice thee in lieu of visiting the Letters of Unity and performing all good deeds. Yet all understand this, but deprive themselves of this supreme bounty and this greatest triumph.

Subject: visitation Tablets
Quotation: He is God, the Light radiating from the Most Glorious Kingdom and the Beam shining forth from the Supreme Concourse. May it encompass your uttermost Tree and your furthest Tree, and may it encircle your radiant, pure, and brilliant tomb whose precincts are perfumed, for you hastened to the place of sacrifice in the path of your Beloved, the Luminary of the highest horizon.

Subject: visitation Tablets
Quotation: This is the Tablet of Visitation which hath been sent down from the heaven of grace for the First Name of God, that through it he may visit the Most Great Maiden and those who have believed in God and His signs and were among the triumphant. When thou desirest to commence thy visitation of the Dawning-Place of Names and their Source, the Day-Spring of Attributes and their Treasury, arise and turn thy face toward Paradise, the Place wherein was interred the First Name, which God made the Shrine of His hallowed, mighty and resplendent Temple.

Subject: visitation Tablets
Quotation:
In the name of God, the Most Merciful, the Most Compassionate! [...] And furthermore, when thou desirest to visit the Beloved of God or any of the Imams of the Faith, purify thy body from all that thy heart abhorreth. Then perform ablutions with seven handfuls of water upon the head, then four handfuls upon the right side, then three handfuls upon the left side. When thou hast finished, don thy finest garments, face the Qiblih and seek God's forgiveness two hundred and two times. Then walk with dignity and tranquility, magnifying God along thy path until thou reachest the gate of the sanctuary. There pause and magnify thy Lord two hundred and two times. Then enter without uttering a word and walk in tranquility until thou reachest seven paces beneath the feet.  BB00049
O servant of Baha! Praise be to God that thou hast reached the luminous Shrine, inhaled the holy fragrances from the blessed earth, prostrated thyself upon the sacred dust of that Threshold, and raised thy voice in prayer and supplication to the Kingdom of the All-Merciful.

Subject: walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life.txt
Quotation: After ascending to the heavens of inner meanings, the wayfarers attain to three stations, meaning that the manifest Sun shines and becomes revealed in the mirrors of existing things according to these three ranks, although some consider the ranks of determinations to be five and have named them the five presences. Were I to explain in detail, a book would not suffice and I would not be able to fulfill it, just as that divine mystic and knower of divine mysteries, the lordly Imam, mentioned a drop from these stations in defining the world of the heart, which has surely come to your noble attention - that the final rank of these three stations is the journey from God unto God. In this station and rank, existence is effaced from self and subsists through the Truth. All are from God and unto God shall they return, and "Say: All things are from God" is sufficient witness and adequate proof of this point, as the mystic of Rum has said:  "The seeker's attributes are annihilated in His attributes, While his essence remains through the survival of His Essence."  This station certainly has no laws and seeks no customs, meaning all His deeds are pure justice even if outwardly they appear as injustice, and pure knowledge even if in form they appear as ignorance.

Subject: walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life.txt
Quotation: Know thou that the seeker, at the outset of his quest for God, must enter the Garden of Search. In this journey it behoveth the wayfarer to detach himself from all save God and to close his eyes to all that is in the heavens and on the earth. There must not linger in his heart either the hate or the love of any soul, to the extent that they would hinder him from attaining the habitation of the celestial Beauty.

Subject: walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life.txt
Quotation: The seekers of truth and the yearners for the Absolute Beauty sought the rising of the Sun of Truth in the horizons of the world and within themselves. Some beheld a gleam, others a flame, while yet others became bewildered and wandered astray. They searched in the dust of the mystery of "were it not for Thee" and sought in the realities and essences of animal, plant and mineral the all-encompassing truth of origin and return. When the divine Dhu'l-Qarnayn traversed the East and West of existence and unveiled the horizon of the unseen and the visible, He saw the Sun of Truth rising and setting in the dawning-place of lights of the human temple and elemental frame, "He found it setting in a murky spring."

Subject: walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life.txt
Quotation: day by day you will progress in the Kingdom until you become a heavenly angel and are confirmed by the breaths of the Holy Spirit

Subject: walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life.txt
Quotation: When man discovers the Path of the Heavenly Kingdom, he must strive day and night to develop along the line of spiritual Realities.

Subject: walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life.txt
Quotation: With complete sincerity, be engaged in the remembrance of the Intended One in the nights and days, and be detached and severed from all else.

Subject: walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life.txt
Quotation: He hath guided thee to the straight path and the right way. Seek ever greater measure, at every moment and instant, of the grace of thy Ancient Lord.

Subject: walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life.txt
Quotation: O seeker! The Sought One calls out to you, saying: Leave mankind behind you, then drink the wine of inner meanings from the cup of your Lord's countenance.

Subject: walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life.txt
Quotation: This is the heavenly ladder and the highest degrees in the human world. When one sets his face toward this station and yearns for this rank, all existence stands beneath its shade.

Subject: walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life.txt
Quotation: When, in the wilderness of deprivation, the intensity of your thirst increased, you hastened to the wellspring of the Water of Life and drank from the fountain of the All-Merciful.

Subject: walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life.txt
Quotation: Strike a melody in the path of the Friend and direct thyself to the realm of the holy valley, that thou mayest witness the greatest signs in the blessed spot of the Valley of Security.

Subject: walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life.txt
Quotation: Does material pursuit prevent spiritual progress?... Spiritual powers always come to the assistance of such affairs, they increase the moral insight and responsibility of man and add to his awareness and mindfulness.

Subject: walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life.txt
Quotation: Therefore, we must all strive to become spiritual, heavenly, and of God. However far we may advance in the world of nature and in material civilization, we will remain imperfect unless we progress in spiritual perfections as well.

Subject: walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life.txt
Quotation: Since this is a month in which the seekers of the true goal, the wayfarers on the spiritual path, the drinkers of the choice wine of inner meanings, and the circumambulators of the divine Ka'bah are all in a state of attraction, passion and joy

Subject: walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life.txt
Quotation: I hope that you may become the manifestation of the favors of the Blessed Beauty and day by day increase in faith, certitude and spiritual knowledge. At night engage in devotion, supplication and prayer, and during the day carry out whatever is necessary.

Subject: walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life.txt
Quotation: Until thou traversest the world in a single breath, Until thou art freed from the prison of this cage, Before thou enterest the shade of the Friend, No knowledge hast thou of core or shell. Thy spiritual feet are sunk in clay, Unaware of the radiance of that beauteous Face.

Subject: walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life.txt
Quotation: through the effects of thy entrance into the Divine Kingdom thou art progressing day by day. When this progress shall become perpetual and continual, then thou shall find the Most Great Center in the Universe of God, and shall clearly behold the Confirmations of the Holy Spirit.

Subject: walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life.txt
Quotation: I have no object save Thee, nor any purpose except Thee. Indeed, my striving, my endeavor, the utmost of my desire and my elevation lie in performing a deed which Thou lovest or wherewith Thou art well-pleased with me, for that is the highest chamber of Paradise for him who hath known Thee

Subject: walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life.txt
Quotation: At dawn, with wondrous and melodious voices, they will be engaged in the mention of God. On foot and bareheaded, and with humility and modesty, and in a state of supplication and entreaty, chanting divine verses and prayers, they will attain to a visit of the Shrine of the Exalted One [the Bab].

Subject: walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life.txt
Quotation: That is, when Moses attained the most exalted stations and traversed the paths of immortality and was illumined by the lights of grandeur and majesty, he desired to draw nigh unto the Tree of Divine Decree and the Lote-Tree of Accomplishment, that he might witness what was ordained in the Preserved Tablet.

Subject: walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life.txt
Quotation: This is the true meaning of ascension in the stages of journeying and the ultimate bounty of God, the Powerful, the Supreme, the Compelling, that thou mayest become the narrator of the sun of His beauty, the guide to the moon of His majesty, the beholder of the garments of His Essence, and the witness to the light of His mystery.

Subject: walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life.txt
Quotation: Know thou that there are seven degrees of knowledge. First is the knowledge of God, to which reference has been made, and verses have been revealed for the knowers in the first sermon and second gate, that all might acquire knowledge through separation from the point of union to distinction. The four stations of unity return to the essence of unity itself.

Subject: walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life.txt
Quotation: O wanderer of Abdu'l-Baha! Thou who art lost in mountain and desert, straying in wilderness and plain, thou who art homeless and enraptured, passionately devoted to the All-Merciful! What bounty is this, and what virtue! May dust be on the head of every soul who wanders not in His path, and death be sweeter than life to every honored one who suffers not abasement in His way.

Subject: walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life.txt
Quotation: Turn not to anything in the kingdom, but seek ye a way unto God, the Most High, the Most Great. Then follow what God hath commanded you in the perspicuous tablets of glory, and turn not unto anyone, and fear no soul. Set your faces toward the shore of the wondrous sea, then drink of what God hath ordained for you from the laws of wisdom, and be not of the patient ones.

Subject: walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life.txt
Quotation: Therefore purify what ye wear with water as soon as ye are able, that ye may find the mercy of your Lord within yourselves and then be thankful. Say: All this is that ye may be pleased with yourselves regarding yourselves and not be averse, but God hath more authority over you than your own selves, then the Prophet and those who are witnesses after Him, then the Gates of Guidance, if ye act.

Subject: walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life.txt
Quotation: Verily Thy servant Husayn was born in the bosom of harmony and suckled at the breast of love throughout all regions. He was born in the cradle of faith and raised in the nest of certitude. He grew into a radiant youth through the light of Thy love, and a pure young man through the outpouring of Thy knowledge, and a distinguished elder speaking Thy praise, until his head was whitened with age in Thy path.

Subject: walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life.txt
Quotation: The figurative world and the physical world are both pure nonexistence, but they appear in the garb of being. The first is the grief of the wayfarers and the second is the test of those who have attained. Therefore, it is necessary that a supreme effort be made, so that the compassionate spirit might overcome these two spiritual obstacles by the power of the All-Praised and find repose in the incomparable shelter of union.

Subject: walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life.txt
Quotation: And if thou desirest to traverse that most exalted path and to abide near the throne or nearer still, then make thyself as though thou wert on the day when thou wert nothing. Then make thyself as one living whom thy Lord created in His own image - naught is like unto Him - without regarding aught beside Him. There shalt thou abide near the throne of grandeur and commune with thy Lord with thy inner and outer tongue, morning and evening.

Subject: walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life.txt
Quotation: That river represents the currents of world events, thoughts, and the flow of earthly and human nature's requirements, wherein all creatures are drowning - that is, they are captive to the world of nature, which is corrupted and darkness upon darkness. Praise be to God that, guided by one mounted upon the Phoenix of the East, thou hast been delivered from that terrifying and perilous river, and now traversest the straight path and the right way.

Subject: walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life.txt
Quotation: When thou art certain of this matter, look to the proof and be patient concerning the signs of the All-Glorious, for the mystery of this ocean is profound, profound[...] Be patient with the verses of the All-Glorious, for the mystery of this ocean is profound, most profound, and the wisdom of that mystery is exquisite, most exquisite, and the veil of that Cause is subtle, most subtle, and the attributes of that servant are delicate, most delicate.

Subject: walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life.txt
Quotation: In the ascending scale man travels the opposite path and passes through all the conditions of spirit which correspond with the conditions of matter on the first half. He begins with the body - the lowest spiritual condition - then reaches the point where he perceives God, just as he reached the point where he perceived matter. Then he reaches a higher condition where power is added to perception, just as in the beginning sensation was added to growth.

Subject: walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life.txt
Quotation: Verily God hath ordained for Joseph a journey from Gate to Gate according to the decree of the Book around the Fire, concealed. And God hath made the pilgrims to Husayn a caravan unto the Sacred Precinct, save by leave of God, the Most High (and He is God, the Mighty, the Wise). They who journey from the Gate unto God in the depths of Oneness, upon the truth with the truth, in the precincts of the Gate, alone - these have found Husayn upon the edge of the hidden mystery, with truth, in the depths of the well, witnessed.

Subject: walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life.txt
Quotation: He was the first to drink the pure wine of divine favors from the hands of grace and bounty, and tasted the sweetness of the fruit of eternity from the Tree whose root is firm in the earth and whose branch reaches unto heaven. He was the first dawn to shine forth with the effulgence of God's lights, the Mighty, the Self-Subsisting; the first river to branch forth from God's vast ocean, the King, the Protector, the All-Forgiving; the first soul to arise from the slumber of idle fancies and to emerge and shine forth from the dayspring of certitude.

Subject: walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life.txt
Quotation: The entire Law is but a path for the servant to journey toward his Lord, but through movement toward the pivot We have indicated. As for the way to reach this pivot, know thou that attaining unto the station of thine own reality is attaining unto thy Lord, and it is the station of pure God-fearing, as one of the Prophets asked about God, saying: How can one reach Thee? God, the Exalted, replied: Cast away thyself and come unto Me. This station is for beginners, to turn away from what the soul desireth and to bear what it detesteth, for there is no veil more forbidding than one's own self.

Subject: walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life.txt
Quotation: Regarding what you wrote about the dervishes of the venerable Shaykh, the matter is exactly as you have written. You too should in all circumstances show forth love, for between the venerable Shaykh and our Master, His Holiness the Most Great Branch - may my spirit be a sacrifice for the dust of His footsteps - there exists friendship and love. The metaphorical is a bridge to the real. God willing, they shall be illumined by the light of reality and attain the station of "extinguish the lamp for the morn has dawned." When a person of insight enters the path of spiritual wayfaring, after purifying and sanctifying the soul from all that God loveth not, multiple paths appear and he traverses them. This is why they have said "The paths to God are as numerous as the breaths of created things." However, if through God's grace the eye is blessed with the light of truth, it will be observed that the Truth is one, the Path is one, and the Cause is one. This is the station of unity that makes the limbs of the polytheists tremble and the root of heedlessness quake.

Subject: walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life.txt
Quotation: The first state of the perceiving soul is that in which it is engrossed in the gratification of desire. In this state its nature is like that of animals: animal lusts predominate in it....  After a man has come under the care of the Teachers, after he has perceived and understood the nature of man in its purity, then, having gained discrimination, he learns what virtue is. Such a man realises his faults. He takes himself to task because of his unworthy and evil qualities.... This is the second state or condition of the perceiving soul; it is the first stage of the progress of the soul to God. This repentance, this longing for the virtues of God, is the means whereby are acquired the inner sight of enlightenment.... Then he comprehends the mysteries of God; without instruction from any, he penetrates the real Divine mysteries; without a teacher he receives understanding and learns the realities of all things. When he has reached this stage he receives assurances and confirmations; he attains steadfastness and constancy....  When he has attained to this estate, he is satisfied; he is content in God into whatsoever conditions he may be thrown. This is for him the state of contentment in God. He feels himself drawn into the ocean of grace. At that time, also, God is content with him. The host of the Supreme Concourse is content with him. The angels of heaven (of course, when I say "angels," I mean holy human souls) are content with him. He himself will be one of the angels, whether in or out of the body. In this estate he becomes a centre for receiving the power of the Holy Spirit. In this estate his spirit bears to the Holy Spirit the relation which, before, his body bore to his spirit. He becomes like a polished mirror. When he speaks, he gives forth the rays of the Sun of Reality. All the light which is reflected from this mirror is the light of the Holy Spirit. Therefore was it that Jesus counselled his disciples to speak and teach without fear, since the Holy Spirit would come to them and put words into their mouths.

Subject: walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life.txt
Quotation: Reveal Thyself, O Lord, and help me to look evermore to Thy Beauty.

Subject: walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life.txt

Quotation: clinging to the hem of grandeur, concentrate your thoughts and remembrance, day and night, upon service to the All-Forgiving Lord.

Subject: walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life.txt

Quotation: Under all conditions place thy trust in God and conduct thyself with the utmost gentliness and forbearance toward thy relatives and others.

Quotation: It behooveth the Friend to be tranquil, that he may hold fast to wisdom lest mischief arise. Thus hath the matter been decreed in the Book.

Subject: walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life

Quotation: The heart that is sanctified from concerns and desires, and the tongue that is purified from mentioning aught else, is worthy of remembrance and mention.

Subject: walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life.txt

Subject: walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life.txt
Quotation: The effulgences of the light of the Sun of knowledge requireth another eye to behold them, and the call raised from the most exalted station requireth another ear.

Subject: walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life.txt
Quotation: Take hold of the Book with the strength bestowed by Us in such wise that neither the clamor of the world nor the doubts of any veiled learned one shall deter thee.

Subject: walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life.txt
Quotation: This confession of powerlessness and humility is the essence of true knowledge in the eyes of them that possess divine verities and mysteries in the world of being.
