Subject: walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life.txt
Quotation: If thou wert to occupy thyself in praise and thanksgiving to the number of the drops of the seas and the atoms of the earth, it would not equal this most great bounty.

Subject: walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life.txt
Quotation: O Lord! Cause his tongue to speak through the breaths of the Holy Spirit, and perfume the gardens of his inner being with the outpourings from the clouds of Thy bounties.

Subject: walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life.txt
Quotation: I supplicate God to make thine eyes spiritual, thy ears attentive and hearing to the Voice of God, and thy heart a pure mirror for the reflection of the splendors of Deity

Subject: walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life.txt
Quotation: The world is evanescent and all that is seen therein shall pass away. Strive ye that ye may attain unto everlasting stations and an enduring remembrance and an eternal name.

Subject: walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life.txt
Quotation: Blessed are they whom the smoke of idle fancies hath not deprived of the effulgent rays of the Sun of certitude, and whom vain imaginings have not kept back from the Lord of Days.

Subject: walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life.txt
Quotation: If ye were certain that this is Him Whom God shall make manifest, ye would believe without doubt and would aid Him. But ye doubt without proof or evidence, and think yourselves God-fearing.

Subject: walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life.txt
Quotation: Today the banner of divine victory calls, and likewise the standard of transcendent glory, but the hosts beneath this standard are wisdom and utterance, and their commander is the fear of God.

Subject: walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life.txt
Quotation: We have created the tongue for the recitation of My verses, and the eyes for turning towards My direction, and the ears for hearkening unto My Call which hath been raised betwixt earth and heaven.

Subject: walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life.txt
Quotation: They have purified their countenances for Thee, have detached themselves from all else but Thee, have been illumined by Thy light and warmed themselves at the fire kindled in the Tree of Thy Manifestation.

Subject: walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life.txt
Quotation: O Lord! Purify them, O my God, from the promptings of self and passion, and adorn them with the ornament of Thy good-pleasure, O Thou Lord of all humanity and King of the throne on high and of the dust below.

Subject: walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life.txt
Quotation: The text lists spiritual qualities needed: "whose conduct is pure, whose inner being is goodly, whose reality is refined, whose hearts are expanded, whose souls are perfected, whose spirits are devoted to God"

Subject: walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life.txt
Quotation: Purify thyself from all save God, then take the cup of faithfulness from the Youth of Glory through My Most Exalted Name. Drink thou therefrom, then give the people to drink of this holy, pure, and radiant nectar.

Subject: walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life.txt
Quotation: We counsel thee to be steadfast in this momentous Announcement... Aid thy Lord through the fear of God through deeds from which the near ones perceive the fragrance of thy Lord's commandments, the Ancient Commander.

Subject: walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life.txt
Quotation: O thou who gazest upon His Countenance! Adorn thy heart with the remembrance of this Most Great Remembrance, and thy temple with the ornament of detachment. Thus hast thou been commanded by the Creator of all things.

Subject: walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life.txt
Quotation: Pilgrimage must take place in a state of utmost entreaty and fervent supplication, otherwise it is not pilgrimage and merely a tour. Pilgrimage must be in a condition of supplication for it to have benefit and influence.

Subject: walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life.txt
Quotation: One must have insight to gaze upon the Most Great Horizon. Hearts and eyes that are veiled and sullied by the signs and limitations of men shall never succeed in comprehending divine knowledge, save whom thy Lord willeth.

Subject: walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life.txt
Quotation: Were ye to discover the sweet-scented breezes of your Lord's love in that which hath been sent down in truth, ye would soar upon the wings of yearning through all regions and would arise to help this wronged and lonely One.

Subject: walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life.txt
Quotation: Purify, then, the mirror of thy heart that this Beauty, radiant, brilliant and gleaming, might be reflected therein, that thou mayest witness what thou hast not witnessed before and know what none among the worlds hath known.

Subject: walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life.txt
Quotation: This association must gradually attain such organization and connection that truly no similar association shall have been established from the beginning of history until now...otherwise it will be fruitless and without result.

Subject: walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life.txt
Quotation: This servant beseeches God to increase their sincerity, humility, submissiveness, resignation and contentment, and to assist them in performing good deeds. Verily, He is the Generous, the Bountiful, the Forgiving, the Merciful.

Subject: walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life.txt
Quotation: By God, besides Whom there is none other God! If the veil were lifted in the slightest degree, and if all the earth were offered to a single soul to cause the least harm to the loved ones of God, that soul would assuredly refuse.

Subject: walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life.txt
Quotation: Pure love hath emboldened this servant to be forthright and submit matters with utmost brevity. It is observed that mention of certain matters is necessary, nay obligatory, for souls of the idolaters exert their utmost to cast doubts.

Subject: walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life.txt
Quotation: Rather must one continually say Lord, increase my wonderment in Thee, for human perfections are a bounty from the infinite divine bounties. Standing still is not permitted; rather, progress must be continuous, else after halting comes the descent.

Subject: walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life.txt
Quotation: Today, those souls are confirmed by the outpourings of the Abha Kingdom and the confirmations of the Supreme Realm who banish every thought and fancy from themselves, become detached from every desire, and strive to raise the call of divine unity.

Subject: walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life.txt
Quotation: Therefore in all things look to the Essence of essences and the Beauty of all beauty, if ye be able to comprehend. For that is none other than Him Whom God shall make manifest, Who will speak to you the two words whereby ye shall comprehend all beauty.

Subject: walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life.txt
Quotation: O servant, stand firm in the Cause when there cometh unto thee a mighty command and a perspicuous Book. Beware lest thou turn unto the world and what hath been created therein, and turn not thy gaze from the vision of God, the Most High, the Great.

Subject: walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life.txt
Quotation: God beareth witness that there is no God but Him. Say: They who purify their hearing, their sight, their hearts, their tongues and their hands - unless their hearts bear witness to that which God hath permitted in His Book - these are they who fear God.

Subject: walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life.txt
Quotation: When the heart is purified and sanctified by the water of Divine unity, its words become penetrating, its utterance attractive, and its mention stirring -- yet not a stirring that gives rise to mischief, but rather one that brings tranquility to the world.

Subject: walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life.txt
Quotation: Rend asunder the veils by the command of the Lord of Names and Attributes, and fear not those who have denied God, the Lord of the First and the Last. Take thou the chalice of immortality in My Most Glorious Name, then drink therefrom the most pure Kawthar.

Subject: walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life.txt
Quotation: Turn ye toward the Mashriqu'l-Adhkar, for this shall profit you. When it is joined unto your remembrance, your mention shall be established throughout all regions, shall be confirmed throughout all cycles, and your word shall be fulfilled throughout all ages.

Subject: walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life.txt
Quotation: Souls must be believing and assured so they may arise to follow those teachings. Until souls are believing and assured, they will not arise to follow those teachings. First, faith is necessary. Until faith is achieved, following the Cause will not be achieved.

Subject: walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life.txt
Quotation: Blessed is he who effaceth from the tablet of his heart all that he hath heard from the veils of glory, and, sanctified from impressions, doubts and allusions, turneth toward the horizon of the Lord of Names and Attributes, and findeth himself free and detached.

Subject: walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life.txt
Quotation: In truth, today relationships are severed. Whatever is deemed beneficial to the Cause and conducive to the exaltation of the Word, that should be pursued. Praise be to God, you have been under the shadow of the Cause for years and are counted among the righteous.

Subject: walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life.txt
Quotation: Assuredly the hope of the wanderers at the threshold of Divine Oneness shall be answered, and what is needed is humility and entreaty at the court of the Incomparable Lord in all matters, for supplication and trust in God cause successive aid and grace to arrive.

Subject: walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life.txt
Quotation: He who desireth to ascend unto the heaven that ruleth over all heavens must be detached from the world and its vanities, its affairs, its bounties, its adornments, its doubts, its allusions, and its tales. Thus have We made manifest the Way and sent down the Guide.

Subject: walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life.txt
Quotation: When they turn towards the Abha Kingdom and receive the outpourings of the Holy Spirit, the verities and meanings surge like an ocean in their hearts. Therefore, draw forth whatsoever thou desirest from the bounty of thy Lord, the Most Merciful, the Most Compassionate.

Subject: walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life.txt
Quotation: Pilgrimage has to do with one's soul and, depending on one's approach, one benefits accordingly. If one was to approach pilgrimage with the utmost devotion and consecration, then spiritual rapture would appear and benefits would be manifested. Otherwise, it is of no use.

Subject: walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life.txt
Quotation: Despite such might whereby through one word from His Most Exalted Pen He seized the Chief and those who had wronged, and rained down upon them from the clouds of destiny the arrows of tribulation in such wise that the tribes lamented - thou beholdest Him today, silent, calm, and patient.

Subject: walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life.txt
Quotation: From your determined intention to spread the holy fragrances among the tribes, the utmost joy was obtained. For today the hosts of the Kingdom confirm such persons and souls who, like fierce lions in the jungle of the world, raise their cry and roar and surge forth, and strive and endeavor.

Subject: walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life.txt
Quotation: This is so that ye may testify concerning your own selves that ye are indeed the creation of God, that He is the Possessor of all things, that ye are His servants, and that ye worship Him alone. This is so that ye may believe in God and bear witness that all else besides Him is His creation.

Subject: walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life.txt
Quotation: Give a portion of thine illumination to this yearning servant and exhilarate his spirit. Disencumber his heart from attachment to clay. Render him radiant as a flower, make him tearful with joy as pouring clouds so that he may burn in the fire of Thy love and sing Thy praises with sweet melodies.

Subject: walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life.txt
Quotation: Many souls recite them but never think of acting upon them. I hope that the friends of that village will act according to them so that village may become renowned as Baha-Abad (the Abode of Light), and the lights of unity may so shine forth that it may become a tower of light and a dawning-place of mysteries.

Subject: walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life.txt
Quotation: These, O my God, are servants whose inner secrets have been purified, whose hearts have found rest, whose consciences have been cleansed by the lights of Thy unity, whose character has been beautified by the fragrances of Thy holiness, and whose eyes have been gladdened by beholding the signs of Thy divine unity.

Subject: walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life.txt
Quotation: The way to acquire this thirst is to meditate upon the future life. Study the Holy Words, read your Bible, read the Holy Books, especially study the Holy Utterances of Baha'u'llah; Prayer and Meditation, take much time for these two. Then will you know this Great Thirst, and then only can you begin to Live the Life!

Subject: walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life.txt
Quotation: God willing, thou wilt observe with thine own eyes and ponder with the utmost fairness upon that which hath been revealed, that perchance the hand of divine bounty may take hold of thee, grant thee deliverance from the depths of idle fancies and vain imaginings, and guide thee to the dawning-place of certitude.

Subject: walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life.txt
Quotation: I ask of Thee, O Lord, my God, by the splendours of the Light of Thy Lovingkindness, by the billows of the Ocean of Thy Knowledge and Wisdom, and by Thy Word wherewith Thou swayed the peoples of Thy Dominion, to cause me to become of them that have been graciously aided to observe that which Thou hast commanded in Thy Book.

Subject: walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life.txt
Quotation: Them who are not prevented by the veils of glory and their eyes are not obscured by the temporal allusions; they verily perceive the Cause with the eye of God. Naught will bar them from beholding His beauty and they verily ponder the signs of the Lord in the souls of the holy ones and meditate upon the wonders of His Revelation.

Subject: walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life.txt
Quotation: Your several letters have been received and the contents have made me very happy. I have asked for confirmation for thee from the Kingdom of Abha because all the contents proved conclusively that thou art of the Kingdom; thou art divine, thou art heavenly and my dear daughter; night and day engaged in the service of the Kingdom.

Subject: walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life.txt
Quotation: Praise be to God, the hands of grace saved them and guided them from the wilderness of vain imaginings to the Dayspring of certitude. Through the grace of the True One, exalted be His glory, they have rent asunder the veils and barriers of conjecture and idle fancy, and have attained the effulgences of the light of the Luminary of certitude.

Subject: walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life.txt
Quotation: Do thou think at all times to practice the Advices and Exhortations of God. If we characterize ourselves in a befitting manner with the Fragrances of Divine Holiness and live according to the instructions of the Blessed Perfection, undoubtedly we will hear with the ear of the mind, the melody of the Holy Spirit, and the Harmony of the Kingdom.

Subject: walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life.txt
Quotation: It behooveth thee to detach thyself wholly unto God, thy Lord, in such wise that all the worlds shall come under thy shadow. This is the station We desired for Our servants aforetime and desire hereafter, that the grace might be fulfilled upon thee and upon those who preceded thee in this most mighty, most ancient, and most trustworthy station.

Subject: walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life.txt
Quotation: Say: Who gave thee permission to take what God had ordained for His Proof and to spend it on the House or on those who know not God their Lord, or in the path of thine own self? And you would take possession of the house, or deal with those who know not God their Lord, or use it for your own purposes, thinking yourself to be among the sincere ones.

Subject: walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life.txt
Quotation: Sanctify thine ears from the utterances of the deniers and thine eyes from gazing upon the faces of them that have disbelieved... And when thou hast adorned thyself with that which the Spirit hath bidden thee and purified thy soul with this Salsabil which hath flowed from the right hand of the Throne and doth purify the hearts of them that are nigh unto God

Subject: walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life.txt
Quotation: It behooveth the people of Baha to exhort mankind through deeds and goodly character. In these days when the Euphrates of mercy is flowing and the pavilion of grace is raised up, this servant and your honor must at all times be occupied with improving our existence, so that all may adorn the world and its peoples with truthful words and pure and goodly deeds.

Subject: walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life.txt
Quotation: For divine nearness is conditional upon the love of God; divine nearness is conditional upon attaining the knowledge of God; it depends on detachment from all else save God; divine nearness requires sacrifice of life; divine nearness requires the sacrifice of self, soul, and wealth in all conditions; divine nearness requires baptism by spirit, fire and water.

Subject: walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life.txt
Quotation: Praise be to God that through your good judgement and endeavour, Jahrum was preserved from the assaults of friend and foe. This was a confirmation from the Ancient Lord, and assuredly a new success shall be achieved - namely the diffusion of the divine fragrances and the promotion of the religion of God with the wisdom mentioned in the scriptures and tablets.

Subject: walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life.txt
Quotation: One must at all times take refuge in truth, lest the armies of ignorance prevail over knowledge and wisdom, and the hosts of conjecture and doubt triumph over certitude. You must, through the power of the Lord of Names and Attributes, rend asunder all veils completely, in such wise that should all the world arise in opposition, it would but increase your certitude.

Subject: walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life.txt
Quotation: Today the Most Great Luminary hath dawned from the horizon of the heaven of Iran. Praise be to God, exalted be His glory, Who hath assisted His servants and granted them success, that they might turn unto Him in days when most of the people of the earth were found to be heedless. They who have attained must know the value of this most great bounty and supreme generosity

Subject: walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life.txt
Quotation: We beseech Thy tender mercies beneath the shade of the Divine Lote Tree, and implore eternal life through Thy mercy in the Garden of Paradise, entrance into Thy most secure shelter, steadfastness in Thy most perfect Covenant, attainment of the most abundant portion from the Fountain of Thy bounty, and firmness in Thy Cause whose laws have penetrated both earth and heaven.

Subject: walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life.txt
Quotation: This servant testifies that they have repeatedly been counseled to conduct themselves among the servants of God with perfect morals, courtesy, truthfulness and sincerity. However, it is most essential that they act in accordance with the morals and conduct they have been enjoined to observe, that the fragrance of passing through the lane of the Friend may be inhaled from them.

Subject: walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life.txt
Quotation: Purify thine eyes from beholding aught else but God, and sanctify thine ears from hearing any voice save His. Thus mayest thou observe with illumined vision the evidences of the manifestations of the Ancient Beauty in all things, and hear with purified ears His sweet melodies from every direction. This is the station wherein whosoever attaineth unto it hath attained unto all good.

Subject: walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life.txt
Quotation: O Mahmud! Mighty is the Cause, yet the people are heedless, nay, as dead. Beseech God, exalted be His glory, that He may guide all to the Most Exalted Horizon and deprive them not of the breezes of His days. Blessed are they whom the wine of pride hath not withheld from the Lord of the Manifestation, and whom the cawing of the enemies hath not debarred from the Most Exalted Horizon.

Subject: walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life.txt
Quotation: Those who appear from the holy horizon with hosts of angels, and who bring to life every decayed bone, will not believe nor will they be aware... They who have on this day entered the garden of the spirit, this court which hath appeared in this realm of immortality--these have been so overtaken by the holy fragrances that their eyes overflow with tears for love of God their Creator.

Subject: walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life.txt
Quotation: Speak not according to desire, but be observers of truth, speakers of truth, and adherents of truth, that the lights of goodly deeds and praiseworthy character may encompass the world. The unseen hosts mentioned aforetime were and ever shall be praiseworthy character. This is the host of God and is mightier than the hosts of earth. Say: Open ye the cities of hearts with these mighty ones.

Subject: walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life.txt
Quotation: The God-fearing are those who grieve not anyone in all the worlds. And when they hear words they ponder them, then reflect, and if they comprehend not aught therein, they ask him who revealed it and judge not concerning him. These are they who fear God in religion and are sincere. If they understand not the words of one above them, they testify to their own powerlessness and judge not concerning him.

Subject: walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life.txt
Quotation: I swear by My wronged Beauty Who is imprisoned in the well of envy and concealed in the pit of hatred, that if in any heart there be found the least trace of love for aught else but God, that soul shall never attain to the most distant seat and the most glorious horizon. And whosoever is found to have attachment to anything in the heavens or on earth shall surely be deprived of the dominion of My Cause.

Subject: walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life.txt
Quotation: Now hear the divine verses in the Persian tongue. From the beginning of this Cause until now, We have summoned all on earth - kings and subjects, learned and ignorant - to the Lord of all beings, without any veil or barrier. The path is clear, the proof manifest, the verses revealed, and the evidences apparent. Yet the people cling to vain imaginings and remain heedless of the truth, save whom thy Lord willeth.

Subject: walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life.txt
Quotation: Should all who dwell in the unseen and visible realms gather together and attempt to utter a word of their own making, when the money-changers of the Abha Kingdom separate pure gold from the adulterated and distinguish between them - the nostrils that are purified, perfumed and sweetened by holy fragrances will never be disturbed by changing, repugnant odors, nor will they be unsettled by the casting of doubts.

Subject: walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life.txt
Quotation: Say: Whomsoever God preserveth from what He loveth not, these are they who fear Him, and whomsoever God inspireth with His good, these are they who are guided. Say: That which God is pleased with from you, these are the paths of righteousness if ye be God-fearing, not that with which your souls are pleased, for God desireth to teach you the paths of knowledge and wisdom that ye may be assured of God and His signs.

Subject: walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life.txt
Quotation: According to letters from the Holy Land you are safe and protected under the shelter of Truth, and this is a cause of joy. I hope that through the grace of the Blessed Beauty you may ever be stirred by the breeze from the rose-garden of His bounty, and that night and day you may supplicate and seek aid and protection from His Divine Unity, so that you may be assisted to attain the good-pleasure of the Blessed Beauty.

Subject: walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life.txt
Quotation: If ye desire to distinguish truth from falsehood, then look unto those who believe in Him Whom God shall make manifest and those who, at the time of His manifestation, believe not. For these are the embodiments of truth in the Book of God, and those are the embodiments of falsehood in the Book of God. Therefore fear ye God, lest ye place yourselves outside of truth after ye have been raised up in the Bayan in the name of truth.

Subject: walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life.txt
Quotation: Be patient, for verily the morn hath in truth dawned with luminous radiance from around the Sun. O Solace of the Eye! Deal not harshly with the people of blindness, for they are orphans bereft of the remembrance of the Most Great Remembrance. Guide them to the subtlest waters in a glass vessel most delicate, for they are indeed bondservants to the mystery, and thou art the Truth, possessed of great bounty, and God is witness over all things.

Subject: walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life.txt
Quotation: My God, my God! I cover my face in the dust of lowliness and self-effacement, detaching myself from glory and pride, and press my brow seeking refuge at the Most Exalted Threshold, beseeching Thee to confirm Thy servant Mahmud in assisting Thy Cause, sheltered under the extended shade, gathered beneath the unfurled standard, acquiring the light of witness from the Lord of existence, leading to the approaching waters, seeking the proffered assistance.

Subject: walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life.txt
Quotation: I implore the Lord of Hosts to increase thy faith day by day, to strengthen thee with His Holy Spirit, to grant thee capacity to acquire the lights of wisdom and knowledge, to make thee a herald of the Covenant in those regions, and to teach thee that which thou knowest not, until thou becomest a physician of bodies and souls - healing bodies with beneficial remedies and treating hearts and spirits with an antidote that quickeneth hearts and souls.

Subject: walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life.txt
Quotation: The servant beseecheth his Lord to aid them to truthfulness and sincerity, trustworthiness and fidelity. We make mention of all Our loved ones and counsel them to observe trustworthiness, which is God's trust amongst all things, and righteousness, which God hath made a shelter for such of His servants as are nigh unto Him and a stronghold for such of His bondsmen as are sincere in their faith, and whatsoever will exalt their stations among the peoples.

Subject: walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life.txt
Quotation: Through the grace and bounty of the Ancient Beauty, may my spirit be sacrificed for His loved ones, I hope that such a flame will be ignited from the land of Kha that will illumine all those regions. The days of life are passing and this lamp of life shall be extinguished. Therefore we must strive that when this lamp departs from the niche of contingent being, it may shine in the glass of the Kingdom and radiate in the gathering of the Concourse on High.

Subject: walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life.txt
Quotation: If thou expandest the heart of any soul in His Cause, this is better for thee than every deed, since deeds are but branches of faith in Him and certitude in His Reality. Be thou not veiled from this most exalted attribute and lofty geometry, and be not veiled from the shadow. For when thou expandest the heart of any soul, thou wilt behold a satan in human form constricting the heart of another, desiring to cast doubt upon the Cause of Him Whom God shall make manifest.

Subject: walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life.txt
Quotation: This is the Day of vision and hearing, for the Call hath been raised, and the Most Exalted Horizon hath dawned and become manifest. Hearken unto the Voice of the Wronged One and hold fast unto that which beseemeth thee. Blessed is the soul that hath this day quaffed the choice wine of the utterance of the All-Merciful and been set ablaze with the fire of His love, in such wise that the unseemly words and sayings of the peoples have failed to deter him from the Ancient Lord.

Subject: walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life.txt
Quotation: Say: The good-pleasure of Him Whom God shall make manifest is the good-pleasure of God, and whatever He detesteth is detested by God. Seek ye refuge in God's good-pleasure from that which God detesteth. Say: The signs of His good-pleasure are those who believe in Him and are convinced of His truth, while the signs of His displeasure are those who, when they hear the verses of God from His presence or behold the words of God from His presence, do not at once believe and are not convinced.

Subject: walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life.txt
Quotation: If ye desire to drink of pure crystal waters then glorify God in your hearts and be assured of your Lord. And if ye desire to drink of milk whose taste changeth not, then give thanks unto God through His remembrance, and praise Him in your spirits, and believe in the Messenger of God. And if ye desire to drink of crimson wine then profess the unity of God and believe in the Imams of Truth. And if ye desire to drink of clarified honey then magnify God and exalt Him and believe in the Gates of Guidance from God.

Subject: walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life.txt
Quotation: The differences among the loved ones have caused the greatest sorrow. O Zayn! Can the lips of the Spirit smile in the Most Exalted Paradise while the lips of God do not part due to the sorrows that have befallen Him? Thou seest Me among all, while He seeth Me as one alone among the servants. Beseech God that those who have turned to Him may become aware of His good-pleasure. For if awareness is attained, none would transgress what God hath willed, nor would they open their lips to that which beseemeth not His days.

Subject: walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life.txt
Quotation: Therefore, O thou sanctified servant, immerse thyself in the depths of this sea, but thou must enter the fathomless deep naked and bare, in such wise that thou close thine eyes to the world and purify thine ears from the clamor of the people of aversion and denial, and, sanctified from all the people of the world and whatsoever is therein, enter into this Most Great Sea and Mightiest Deep, that thou mayest attain unto the mysteries deposited therein and the pearls that lie hidden, concealed by the Sovereign of the Cause.

Subject: walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life.txt
Quotation: Your detailed letter sent through Wilhelm, that distinguished herald of Truth, Mr. Fazel, upon him be Baha'u'llah's glory, was received. Its contents were as sweet as honey, filling the heart and soul with endless delight. Praise be to God that, as explicitly promised to you, divine confirmations and heavenly assistance have encompassed you from all directions. Today, detachment from all save God, attraction to the divine fragrances, and complete sanctification and purification are the magnets that attract divine confirmation.

Subject: walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life.txt
Quotation: O Khalil! Stand firm in this fire and let not the greatness of the Cause nor its mighty signs prevent thee from entering it. Turn not thy gaze upon anyone in this Day, even if he be the essence of creation among all worlds. Close thine eyes to all thou dost witness and behold in this Day, and to all that thou hast done and known aforetime of the veils of fancy and tradition. Then open them, through the light of lights and the spirit of spirits and the radiance of radiances, unto this resplendent, luminous, and shining prospect.

Subject: walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life.txt
Quotation: today in the hearts of men the flames of conscience and of God are quenched and the obscurity of the animal world, namely, the characteristics and requisites of the world of nature, are all-surrounding and paramount.  All peoples are captives of nature and thus effort with heart and soul, must be exerted in order to emancipate from this thralldom of nature the world of humanity and cause it to become the manifestation of the Light of the Realm of Reason and of the Kingdom; that they may not be satisfied with the few days of life in this earthly abode but rather seek everlasting life and eternal glory and sovereignty.

Subject: walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life.txt
Quotation: We counsel thee to don the robe of modesty, that thou mayest not cause grief to any soul forever. For hadst thou not earned what thou didst earn, God would not have sent down such a book upon thee, causing all who read it to curse thee until the Day of Resurrection. Fear God with true fear, lest thou be veiled on the day of Him Whom God shall make manifest from God Who created thee, sustained thee, causeth thee to die and giveth thee life, by being veiled from a Soul Who showeth forth clear signs from His presence, that thou mayest be among those who are saved on that day.

Subject: walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life.txt
Quotation: For man is like unto a tree, and trees yield diverse fruits. A goodly tree must needs bring forth delectable fruits, that its true nature and essence may emerge from behind the veil of potentiality and become clear and manifest. For this is the age of resurrection and gathering, when the reality of all things becomes evident and apparent. Every blessed tree must needs bear sweet and sugary fruit, and this fruit is love and kindness, heavenly attachment, divine bounty, attraction to the luminous Beauty, godly conduct and behavior, conscientious character, fellowship with all humanity, truthfulness and trustworthiness, pure intention, and service to every ruler and subject, every leader and follower.

Subject: walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life.txt
Quotation: The spiritual understanding is as a lighted lamp; all the prophets offered themselves as lamps. Those men around them who heard their voice were those who were capable and desirous of hearing them.

Subject: walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life.txt
Quotation: The companions of Joseph who sat with him nightly upon the same carpet and were his constant associates in all days remained deprived of his sweet fragrance, while the nostrils of Jacob the beloved perceived it from afar.

Subject: walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life.txt
Quotation: O people of Baha! Adorn yourselves with the ornament of goodly character and your heads with the crowns of trustworthiness, chastity and purity, by command of God, Who causeth the winds to blow. Beware lest ye deprive yourselves of that which ye have been commanded in the Mother Book.

Subject: walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life.txt
Quotation: For man, true happiness and exaltation consist in self respect, in high resolves and noble purposes, in integrity and moral quality, in immaculacy of mind. Those whose standard of worth is material benefits are regarded as low, ignorant and worthless, no matter how extensive their learning and qualifications may be.

Subject: walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life.txt
Quotation: With this class of divine Artists the world is a school and all the children must be trained and educated so that they may also rise to that standard of altruistic and economic perfection. Opportunities must be given to every soul,- so that he may adorn himself with the virtues and qualities of contentment, truth, rectitude, integrity and the love of advancement in the light of God.

Subject: walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life.txt
Quotation: That which endures is the love of the Lord, service to the righteous, goodly conduct, and kindness toward all the servants of God, be they friend or stranger, heedless or aware.

Subject: walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life.txt
Quotation: There are various grades of evil habits. There are certain souls whose moral lives are petrified and are immersed in a sea of immorality. Immorality is like leprosy. It is contagious.

Subject: walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life.txt
Quotation: O people of God! Know ye and recognize the station of religion, trustworthiness and truthfulness. These mentioned attributes are each the foremost adorning of the human temple. Ye must preserve them in the name of God from thieves and betrayers.

Subject: walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life.txt
Quotation: O My loved ones! We have commanded you to righteousness and piety, and forbidden you oppression and wickedness and whatsoever causeth the servants to grieve in the realm of creation. Make it your concern to aid the servants and that whereby their hearts may be gladdened. Your Lord commandeth you to that which profiteth you and forbiddeth you from that which harmeth you.

Subject: walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life.txt
Quotation: In all Tablets, Scriptures, Books and Holy Writings, all the friends have been commanded to manifest religiosity, trustworthiness, truthfulness, high endeavor, justice and fairness - as all the divine friends can bear witness to what has been stated. For those souls who are truly gazing toward the Most Exalted Horizon today and have reached the supreme heights are the dawning-places of goodly attributes, the rising-points of pure deeds, and the sources of actions that are pleasing and acceptable.

Subject: walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life.txt
Quotation: "Become pure, become watchful"

Subject: walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life.txt
Quotation: One pure soul is a world of men.

Subject: walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life.txt
Quotation: True greatness in man is his spiritual attributes.

Subject: walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life.txt
Quotation: He is ever cheerful and smiling, full of joy and delight

Subject: walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life.txt
Quotation: Kindness is a ray of the Divine and good nature is the light of heaven

Subject: walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life.txt
Quotation: Proof of spiritual station comes through service and bearing hardships

Subject: walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life.txt
Quotation: reform morals, and seek to surpass all others in character and conduct

Subject: walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life.txt
Quotation: Verily, the happiness of the world of humanity is based on heavenly character.

Subject: walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life.txt
Quotation: This is the Day for pure deeds, goodly character and praiseworthy attributes - it has been and still is.

Subject: walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life.txt
Quotation: Praises qualities of purity, radiance, freedom from worldliness, and refusal to participate in oppression

Subject: walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life.txt
Quotation: You must be adorned with divine morals. The basis of eternal happiness is spirituality and divine virtue.

Subject: walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life.txt
Quotation: Sincerity of intention, goodness of character, faith and certitude attract the confirmations of the Lord God.

Subject: walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life.txt
Quotation: The loftiness of man lies in his comprehension of universal meanings, and power lies in bearing the Most Great Trust

Subject: walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life.txt
Quotation: Divine qualities are unlimited. For this reason you must not be satisfied with one quality but must try to gain all.

Subject: walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life.txt
Quotation: The heaven of human station hath been and shall ever be illumined by two luminaries: trustworthiness and steadfastness

Subject: walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life.txt
Quotation: Therefore, while physical characteristics will perish, divine qualities will endure. Upon you be the divine attributes.

Subject: walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life.txt
Quotation: The seven qualifications: Knowledge, Faith, Steadfastness, Truthfulness, Faithfulness, Fidelity, Evanescence and humility

Subject: walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life.txt
Quotation: A truthful person must flee from all blameworthy characteristics and attitudes which are opposed to truth and integrity.

Subject: walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life.txt
Quotation: By my life, the sword of good character and kindness is sharper than a sword of iron. Those men are truly wise who are decorated with the ornaments of learning and character; these are the head of the body of mankind.

Subject: walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life.txt
Quotation: Having "attraction and rapture, purity and detachment, freedom from defilement, and sanctification and holiness" as spiritual qualities

Subject: walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life.txt
Quotation: We counsel thee and those who have believed to manifest such virtues as shall diffuse the fragrance of God's loving-kindness and bounty.

Subject: walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life.txt
Quotation: The virtues, excellences, and noble characteristics of that one who ascended unto God must needs be reflected in thee and become manifest.

Subject: walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life.txt
Quotation: To live the Life you must be the very kindest woman, you must be the most pure, you must be absolutely truthful, and live a perfectly moral life.

Subject: walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life.txt
Quotation: all have pure and radiant hearts from the bounties of heaven, and their collars are rent with divine love. They are detached from the world of dust

Subject: walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life.txt
Quotation: He called people to the Kingdom of Your mercy morning and evening with good character, pure nature, illumined heart and breast expanded by Your greatest verses

Subject: walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life.txt
Quotation: This vicegerency means adorning oneself with the attributes of the Most Merciful and acquiring the characteristics of the Lord, the Beloved of all possibility.

Subject: walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life.txt
Quotation: Adorn yourselves, O people, with the virtues of God, and commit not that which would cause the dignity of His Manifestation to be diminished among His creatures.

Subject: walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life.txt
Quotation: Be set aglow with the fire of the love of God, so that the hearts of the people will become enlightened by the light of thy love. Be humble and submissive to God

Subject: walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life.txt
Quotation: they must conduct themselves with such purity, detachment and wisdom as to become a model for other organizations and a cause of awareness and learning for all people

Subject: walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life.txt
Quotation: Suppressing anger is among the characteristics of the righteous and the qualities of the noble ones. As far as you can, be patient and endure the cruelty of the wicked.

Subject: walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life.txt
Quotation: Praise be to God that until now, the sweet fragrance of thy steadfastness and firmness hath been diffused abroad, and the taste and flavor of thy constancy and joy made manifest.

Subject: walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life.txt
Quotation: Praised for believing in God, being attracted by divine fragrances, chanting verses, verifying divine words, showing humility, accepting proof, following commands with steadfast heart

Subject: walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life.txt
Quotation: that they may shine like unto brilliant stars in this darksome world, teach all the peoples of the world the mores of love, and show everyone kindliness and friendship, sympathy and courtesy

Subject: walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life.txt
Quotation: The excellence of lions lies in their ferocity, sharp claws and fearlessness. But the lions of the jungle of divine knowledge are distinguished by their freedom, generosity, servitude and oneness.

Subject: walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life.txt
Quotation: that ye are luminous and joyous and beauteous, that on this triumphant day ye are speaking and hearing and seeing, that ye have adorned your hearts and souls with the radiance of the celestial Sun

Subject: walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life.txt
Quotation: We counsel you to be compassionate, merciful, forbearing, trustworthy and truthful, that perchance the darkened world may be illumined through the lights of praiseworthy character and goodly deeds.
