Quotation: They are characterized by truthfulness and sincerity in their nature and conduct...they are ancient friends, of good character and fine disposition, deserving of confirmation and prepared to walk the straight path

Subject: walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life.txt
Quotation: A jewel must be rich in essence, for the purity and delicacy of all things depend upon their essence. If thou art a pearl in the divine ocean's shell, manifest thy essence and show forth thy radiance and brilliance.

Subject: walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life.txt
Quotation: Consort with the people at all times with divine characteristics, with heavenly dispositions and noble susceptibilities, with a fire reminiscent of his holiness Quddus and a fire recalling the Burning Bush on Sinai.

Subject: walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life.txt
Quotation: That believing soul is indeed a cherished handmaiden of God, attracted to the divine fragrances. I beseech God that day by day ye may advance in longing, rapture, attraction, wonderment, enthusiasm and spiritual magnetism.

Subject: walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life.txt
Quotation: Follow the path of the righteous ones, that thou mayest be nurtured beneath the shade of the Lord. Be thou as an angel, sweetened with the honey of love and faithfulness. Let thy qualities be those of wisdom and understanding.

Subject: walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life.txt
Quotation: O Javad! Strive that all souls may, through divine grace, be adorned with heavenly characteristics, for verily every virtuous quality is in truth a messenger, herald and summoner from God, calling mankind to the highest horizon.

Subject: walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life.txt
Quotation: Be quick in doing good deeds; be assiduous toward God; be a veiler of people's faults; be an avoider of lust. Be a runner after truth, a cloud of bounty to the servants of God; be kindly to thy debtors; be a forgiver to the transgressors

Subject: walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life.txt
Quotation: How many servants there are who throughout their lives wear only rough cotton or wool, yet because they have donned the garment of guidance and piety, they have been clothed in the robes of God's good-pleasure and find delight in His satisfaction.

Subject: walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life.txt
Quotation: Through divine bounty and gift you have attained such endless favors and reached such boundless bestowal. Therefore, fill your spiritual pocket with these pearls of bestowal and these merciful gems, and know their worth and understand their value.

Subject: walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life.txt
Quotation: May they become quickened through Thy remembrance and attain everlasting life through Thy love. Make fragrant their nostrils that they may become worthy of Thy Most Holy Court and engage in worship, service, supplication, and utter humility and need.

Subject: walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life.txt
Quotation: The excellence of the servants of Truth is of two kinds: some are in the station of excellence (hasan) and others in that of greater excellence (ahsan). Excellence is attained through obligatory acts, and greater excellence through supererogatory deeds.

Subject: walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life.txt
Quotation: Today the loved ones must be illumined with the light of righteousness and set ablaze with the fire of detachment. The teacher must be adorned with the ornament of detachment, godliness, trustworthiness and piety. This is the command of God, before and after.

Subject: walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life.txt
Quotation: Today, whatsoever deed is manifested from those who are nigh and the monotheists for the sake of God is effective and influential in the world. We counsel all to observe chastity, trustworthiness, faithfulness, mercy, compassion, generosity, and likewise wisdom.

Subject: walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life.txt
Quotation: Be thou God's gift and the bestowal of the Abha Beauty, that thou mayest become a mercy unto the world of humanity and a gift from the Lord God, guiding every lover of fellowship to truthfulness, reconciliation, love, kindness, fellowship, oneness, freedom and purity.

Subject: walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life.txt
Quotation: Today must the loved ones of God appear with such radiance as to illumine the world, and with such a fire as to set ablaze the hearts of the peoples. Blessed is the soul whom the affairs of men have not debarred from the ocean of grace nor held back from the Sun of Truth.

Subject: walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life.txt
Quotation: to be a well-wisher for the ill-wisher; an intimate companion for the wicked enemy; a loving friend for the erring foe who stabbeth the dagger into the middle of the heart; to meet the ill-tempered slanderer with favour and praise; and not to offend, hurt, annoy or avoid anyone

Subject: walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life.txt
Quotation: O thou who art pure in heart, sanctified in spirit, peerless in character, beauteous in face! Thou art dark in countenance and bright in character. Thou art like unto the pupil of the eye which is dark in color, yet it is the fount of light and the revealer of the contingent world.

Subject: walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life.txt
Quotation: The strangers have become estranged, while thou hast become a bird of this nest and a flower of this rose-garden. Therefore, diffuse sweet fragrances, show forth a goodly character, and let thy radiant face shine forth, that thou mayest adorn the world and be as a soul to the universe.

Subject: walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life.txt
Quotation: Man must adorn himself with that which befits him and be embellished with conduct worthy of him. In the nights and days the Pen of Counsel has not ceased, and has revealed that which is the cause of the exaltation and elevation of souls and the comfort and tranquility of the people of the world.

Subject: walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life.txt
Quotation: We ask God graciously to grant that all may evince such fairness of character, such goodliness of deed and kindliness of word as will meet with His good pleasure. It hath been decreed that the citadels of men's hearts should be subdued through the hosts of a noble character and praiseworthy deeds.

Subject: walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life.txt
Quotation: All on earth know that good character is praiseworthy and acceptable while bad character is condemned and rejected, that justice and fairness are acceptable and familiar while tyranny and inequity are rejected and condemned. Despite this, all people except a few souls are deprived of praiseworthy character and justice.

Subject: walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life.txt
Quotation: Adorn your temples with good conduct, your tongues with truthfulness, and your hearts with the ornament of virtues whereby the Cause of God hath been made manifest throughout all ages.

Subject: walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life.txt
Quotation: When morals are reformed and established, progress in all ranks becomes inevitable. No nation finds prosperity and success without moral reform. Through moral improvement, sciences and arts flourish, thoughts become infinitely enlightened, truthfulness and trustworthiness and zeal and honor and high endeavor surge forth

Subject: walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life.txt
Quotation: A man must characterize ourselves with the attributes of divinity.

Subject: walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life.txt
Quotation: A good character is, verily, the best mantle for men from God. With it He adorneth the temples of His loved ones. By My life! The light of a good character surpasseth the light of the sun and its effulgence. Whoso attaineth unto it is accounted as a jewel among men. The glory and the upliftment of the world must needs depend upon it.

Subject: walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life.txt
Quotation: A goodly word is like unto a goodly tree whose roots are firmly fixed and whose branches reach unto heaven. Know thou that when noble character traits and refined qualities that spread and diffuse throughout all regions are joined with nobility of lineage, this constitutes a universal divine relationship and a luminous spiritual reality.

Subject: walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life.txt
Quotation: Become a sign of the love of God and inhale a fragrance from the rose-garden of Abha, that thou mayest attain eternal life and seek everlasting joy and delight. Like unto a star, thou shalt shine, and like a candle, thou shalt be aflame. Thou shalt become a manifestation of bounty and the essence of sanctity, detachment and supreme purity.

Subject: walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life.txt
Quotation: This capability is faith, certitude, insight, love, spirituality, luminosity, purity, freedom, sanctification, holiness, loftiness of purpose, and nobility of virtue. I hope that the members of that assembly will be adorned with these characteristics and virtues, and each day provide new proof of the existence of this gift in their own reality.

Subject: walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life.txt
Quotation: True spirituality is like unto a lake of clear water which reflects the divine. That which is truly spiritual must light the path to God, and must result in deeds. We cannot believe the call to be spiritual when there is no result. Spirit is reality, and when the spirit in each of us seeks to join itself with the Great Reality, it must in turn give life.

Subject: walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life.txt
Quotation: They are the children of the Kingdom. They have pure hearts. They have spiritual faces. The effect of the divine teachings is manifest in the perfect purity of their hearts. The hearts of all children are of the utmost purity. They are mirrors upon which no dust has fallen. They cannot display any great intelligence. They have neither hypocrisy nor deceit.

Subject: walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life.txt
Quotation: They give life, they win hearts. They are the cause of life, not death. They are the cause of the world's prosperity, not its destruction. They are builders, not instruments of ruin. This is what God has specially given to men whom neither commerce nor trade can divert from the remembrance of God. God is well-pleased with them and they are well-pleased with Him.

Subject: walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life.txt
Quotation: They have spirit and consciousness. They have understanding. They are intoxicated from the cup of the wine of the All-Merciful. They are overcome by the wine of address of the Lord God. They are occupied with the remembrance of God. They are intimate in the sanctuary of infinite mysteries. They are detached from all else save God. They are aware in the Cause of God.

Subject: walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life.txt
Quotation: These creative verses, letters and words are the realities of the beloved ones and the most refined essences of those near to God. Such as the revealed verses are testimonies and miracles, the creative verses and words must also be extraordinary and distinguished realities. That is, creation must conform to revelation and revelation must possess the qualities of creation.

Subject: walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life.txt
Quotation: Through you the springtime of inner meaning appeared in the world of utterance and the All-Merciful shed His effulgent splendour upon all created things. Through you the daystars of knowledge dawned forth, the heavens of all religions were illumined, the lights of the sciences shone brightly amongst the nations, and the sphere of the arts was expanded throughout the world.

Subject: walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life.txt
Quotation: The intention is that from all may be diffused the sweet savors of holiness, and that they may become the cause of sanctification and detachment among the handmaidens of the earth. This is My bidding and My counsel. Blessed is the servant who has held fast to the command of his Lord, and the handmaiden who has held fast to the cord of the will of her Lord, the All-Merciful, the Generous.

Subject: walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life.txt
Quotation: Through this mighty power, leaves were raised up who, like the greatest of men, rode forth in the arena of sacred glory and were confirmed with such power that they withstood all who exist. They never became sorrowful at the ascension of their children, nor did they weep at separation and deprivation from their offspring. Therefore, you too should be patient and forbearing like those pure essences.

Subject: walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life.txt
Quotation: Be thou loving to every afflicted one, a dispeller of sorrows to every grieved one, a refuge to every fearful one, a heavenly food to every destitute one, a balm to every wounded one, a consolation to dejected hearts, a blessing to unfortunate souls, a treasure to every begging one and a succor to every lamenting one--so that thou mayest be a banner of guidance and the essence of piety among the maid-servants of thy Supreme Lord.

Subject: walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life.txt
Quotation: It behooveth every soul, upon hearing the call from the Kingdom of his Lord, the Most Glorious, to detach himself wholly from all things created between earth and heaven, to turn with radiant countenance toward the Supreme Horizon, and to say with his inner and outer tongue - nay, with every member which God hath created within him - "Here am I, here am I, O Lord of Names! Here am I, here am I, O Thou Who art the Promised One in all the Tablets!"

Subject: walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life.txt
Quotation: Today all things are adorned and illumined with the lights of true unity. The glance of His loving-kindness hath ever been and continueth to be directed towards His loved ones - they who are detached from all else save God, who hold fast unto the cord of divine love, who act according to that which hath been sent down in the Book, and who are so steadfast in the Cause that the deniers, the barking ones, and the deceivers find no occasion to speak.

Subject: walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life.txt
Quotation: When his carriage had come only part of the way from Haifa to 'Akka, one could already perceive his spirit, his light. He was nothing but light from head to foot. Just to look at that face made one happy; he was so confident, so assured, so rooted in his faith, and his expression so joyous. He was truly a blessed being. He was a man who made progress day by day, who added, every day, to his certitude and faith, his luminous quality, his ardent love.

Subject: walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life.txt
Quotation: He was of excellent conduct. From the day he accepted this Cause he served until his final breath - truly, he did not pause for a moment. His movements, his conduct, his interactions - everything was teaching. He possessed learning and perfection. All enemies testified to his lofty station, saying that truly this person is unequaled in terms of character, conduct, speech, piety, trustworthiness and religious devotion. In all qualities he is unique and peerless.

Subject: walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life.txt
Quotation: This distinguished man was erudite, wise, and eloquent of speech. His native genius was pure inspiration, his poetic gift like a crystal stream. Throughout all his life, from earliest youth till he was feeble and old, he spent his time serving and worshiping the Lord. He bore hardships, he lived through misfortunes, he suffered afflictions. From the lips of the Manifestation he heard marvelous things. He was shown the lights of Paradise; he won his dearest wish.

Subject: walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life.txt
Quotation: We hope that the beloved of God and the handmaids of the Merciful will, in accordance with the heavenly Teachings, serve the oneness of the world of humanity, regard religion as the basis of love and fellowship amongst the people, strive to harmonize religion and science, become a treasury of riches for the poor and a shelter and asylum for the fugitive, bring joy and radiance to the destitute, and aid the needy through the strengthening grace of the All-Merciful

Subject: walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life.txt
Quotation: Put not on garments that cause grief to any soul, but rather wear such attire as bringeth joy to hearts when they behold it. Let your garments be refined, then grow more refined; let your garments be beautiful, then grow more beautiful. For whoso weareth garments that cause fear in any soul, or walketh upon earth in such manner as to cause apprehension in any soul, or moveth his face or hands in ways that cause fear in any soul - such are among those whom God loveth not to mention.

Subject: walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life.txt
Quotation: Rather, this physical happiness is secondary, while the foundation of human glory lies in those virtuous qualities and perfections that adorn human reality. These are divine inspirations, heavenly bounties, heartfelt emotions, love of God, knowledge of the Divine, universal knowledge, intellectual perceptions and scientific discoveries. These are justice and equity, truthfulness and benevolence, innate courage and natural bravery, the protection of rights and the keeping of covenants.

Subject: walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life.txt
Quotation: These are souls who have been purified, and men whom neither commerce nor trade can divert from Thy remembrance. Rather, they have been attracted by Thy holy fragrances, set ablaze with the fire of Thy love, illumined by Thy lights, and have partaken of the clouds of Thy mercy. Their inner secrets have become pure, their consciences refined, their eyes have been solaced, their ears have heard, and their spirits have rejoiced at the signs of Thy unity and the standards of Thy sanctity.

Subject: walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life.txt
Quotation: Contrary to this, that Manifestation of Divine Perfection and the Dawning-place of the lights of the Merciful should be the quickener of souls and reviver of bodies. Should instill life, not take it away. Should be the cause of existence, not death; should build, not destroy; He should shed light to the east and fragrance to the west. He should become a haven and a refuge to the downtrodden and enlighten those who are bereft of understanding. He should make the oppressors just, and the heedless wise.

Subject: walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life.txt
Quotation: Consider the mole beneath the ground. He constructs galleries and tunnels there, he builds with faultless art, yet he is a creature who lives in darkness, under the earth, not able to bear the sunlight, not able to work in the sweet air. Again, look at the spider. What artist could create anything better made than a spider's web? Even so those artists whose creations are perfect, and who themselves are ignorant of the life of the spirit, are like the mole and the spider, far below the level of the man of faith.

Subject: walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life.txt
Quotation: As for the deeds thou didst inquire about, their mention is not permitted in tablets such as these, due to the weakness of the servants. However, the deeds and actions of God are manifest and evident, as revealed and inscribed in all the heavenly Books - such as trustworthiness, truthfulness, purity of heart in remembering God, forbearance, contentment with what God hath ordained, satisfaction with what He hath decreed, patience in tribulations - nay, rather gratitude for them - and reliance upon Him in all conditions.

Subject: walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life.txt
Quotation: Today the sun of bounty is shining and the orb of loving-kindness is dawning and the heaven of mercy is raised up. Blessed are they who, for the sake of these two fleeting days, have not deprived themselves of the immortal Kingdom. Say: O friends! God willing, may ye appear before the faces of men adorned with the ornaments of trustworthiness, truthfulness and steadfastness, that all may be illumined and adorned by the effulgences of the light of these suns. Every deed that appeareth purely for the sake of God is as a shining and luminous sun.

Subject: walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life.txt
Quotation: Today is the day of pure deeds and service to the Cause, that perchance the lights of goodly character may encompass the world and the hosts of righteous acts may capture heedless hearts and draw them to the direction of awareness. They should meet all with the utmost kindliness, forbearance and love, and present the Word. If it is accepted and the radiance of the All-Merciful is observed in their countenance, let them be thankful to God the Exalted. Otherwise, they should leave such a one to himself, without allowing him to perceive any lack of love.

Subject: walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life.txt
Quotation: Nobility of character is a divine bounty, inherent dignity, natural magnanimity, protection of rights, observance of covenant and testament, truthfulness in all matters, and love of reality in all conditions. It is sacrifice for the good of all, kindness and compassion towards all peoples of humanity, and adherence to divine teachings. It is service to the Kingdom of the All-Merciful, guidance of creation, and education of peoples and nations. This is the happiness of the human world, this is the exaltation of humanity in the contingent world, this is eternal life and heavenly glory.

Subject: walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life.txt
Quotation: Be steadfast in the Cause of thy Lord in such wise that the whisperings of the devils may not cause you to slip - they who, when asked "Who is your Lord?" say "God Who created us by His command," yet when He appeared with the truth and came upon the clouds of destiny, they denied Him. Hold fast unto this sublime, exalted, mighty and all-knowing Tree. Verily it is the Sidrat al-Muntaha, the Ultimate Tree, and the Beauty of the All-Glorious in this Temple which is mentioned as the All-Glorious among the Concourse on High, lest thou be shaken by the winds of trials which blow from the direction of Satan.

Subject: walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life.txt
Quotation: Through Him hath ended all that began from God, the Lord of the worlds. And upon His children and companions, whom God made the horsemen in the arena of wisdom and utterance, and the rivers of knowledge and exposition, through whom every idolator wailed and every idol cried out, every proud one fell and every oppressor was restrained, through whom the horizons gained the light of unity and the herald called from the most exalted station, through whom every hidden thing was revealed and every concealed thing emerged, every abased one was honored and every vainglorious one was humbled, and every haughty one submitted

Subject: walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life.txt
Quotation: O peoples, do not spill blood and do not seize the goods of others. By my life, the sword of good character and kindness is sharper than a sword of iron.

Subject: walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life.txt
Quotation: To live the life.

Subject: walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life.txt
Quotation: When Moses cleansed the Man of the divine Spirit, Who was deposited in human form, from the sandals of incidental doubts, and revealed the Hand of divine Power from the Bosom of Grandeur and the Mantle of Grace, He entered the holy, goodly, blessed Valley of the Heart, which is the seat of the Throne of the Divine Manifestation and the Chair of holy lordly utterance. And when He reached that Mount of Sinai which stretched forth from the right side of the Spot of Light, He inhaled the sweet fragrance of the Spirit from the everlasting Orient, and perceived the lights of the Ancient Being from all directions without direction.

Subject: walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life.txt
Quotation: Enter into the Cause of Baha'u'llah and act in accordance with His counsels.

Subject: walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life.txt
Quotation: that dying which continues on throughout life, giving life to other souls, is the station of 'living martyrdom'.

Subject: walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life.txt
Quotation: the ultimate desire of the soul of the wise one is to shine forth in the Abha Kingdom and attain eternal victory and triumph

Subject: walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life.txt
Quotation: We must strive with heart and soul to drink full cups of this divine wine and engage in the words, deeds and actions of the righteous.

Subject: walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life.txt
Quotation: Well is it with the handmaidens who have in this day drunk deep from the sealed wine of unity and have fixed their gaze upon the horizon of the Peerless Lord.

Subject: walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life.txt
Quotation: Show love and kindness to all, become heavenly and radiant beings, befitting of the divine Kingdom, worthy of reaping your rewards from the tree of existence.

Subject: walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life.txt
Quotation: The earth is my couch and heaven my canopy, in following His good-pleasure and in love for His loved ones. This is the path of the righteous and this is the way of the free.

Subject: walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life.txt
Quotation: Say unto him: Gird up thy loins and strengthen thine arms to serve those who call upon God in the morn of Identity and remember Him in the eventide in the Temple of Eternity.

Subject: walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life.txt
Quotation: We counsel them to manifest supreme steadfastness...guide them to the momentous News...We beseech God to assist His loved ones that they may remind the people through their deeds and character.

Subject: walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life.txt
Quotation: You must live in accordance with the teachings of Baha'o'llah. Be loving to all mankind. Consort with all religions in amity and fragrance. You must be the cause of the education of the world of humanity.

Subject: walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life.txt
Quotation: We beseech God that His confirmation may assist and His grace may accompany you, that in these fleeting days you may attain unto everlasting stations and be occupied with His remembrance in the nights and days.

Subject: walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life.txt
Quotation: Look not upon those who walk upon the earth, for the living are they who obey God and work for His sake. In the sight of God, whosoever merely eateth and drinketh is not counted among the living - this is but the way of animals.

Subject: walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life.txt
Quotation: A room must be lighted up, and a heart must of a necessity be spiritual. A person whose tree of life produces such fruits is a Baha'i: otherwise he is of the earth earthly, self-occupied and following the dictates of his own desire and is 'man' only by name.

Subject: walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life.txt
Quotation: Believers must show their belief in their daily lives, so that the world might see the light shining in their faces. Let the Light of Truth and Honesty shine from them, so that all who behold them may know that their word in business or pleasure will be a word to trust and depend upon.

Subject: walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life.txt
Quotation: Through the appearance of the Blessed Perfection the theories are abrogated and the facts established. The time of superficiality is gone by and the cycle of reality has appeared. One must become the incarnation of servitude, the personification of love, the embodiment of spirituality, and the mirror of mercy.

Subject: walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life.txt
Quotation: "This is true progress and this is what beseems the reality of man. My hope is that ye may become true Baha'is and ye may walk in the path of God with the utmost sincerity so that from your behaviour, your character and your aims, sweet fragrances may be inhaled that are redolent with the love of the Abha Beauty"

Subject: walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life.txt
Quotation: Well is it with them, and blessed are they! We have made mention of all in various Tablets through verses that have enraptured the Concourse on High and the denizens of Paradise. We beseech God to aid them all, both men and women, in that which He loveth and is pleased with. In all matters let them act with justice.

Subject: walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life.txt
Quotation: Your faces are the gates of God's bounty, and whoso entereth not the garden of submission and resignation hath departed from the stronghold of God, and whoso departeth from God's stronghold is blind to the vision of God's light. Say: Fear ye God and spend upon your poor what God hath ordained for you, then seek God's help that He may send down upon you the rains of His mercy.

Subject: walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life.txt
Quotation: The friends must at all times be counseled and reminded, that they may all conduct themselves in such wise that others may inhale from them the sweet fragrances of sanctity, holiness and pure servitude unto God, the True One. O friends! Aid ye the Cause of God through the hosts of goodly spiritual qualities, the ranks of holy deeds, and the banners of humility, submissiveness and supplication.

Subject: walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life.txt
Quotation: His life was an example of honesty and activity. He was a flame of the love of God and a true lover of humanity. By profession he was a coppersmith and often worked till midnight in order to make enough money to support the poor believers. While he worked he chanted the poems and Tablets of the Blessed Perfection and wept in such a heart-moving manner that all those who heard him were stirred.

Subject: walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life.txt
Quotation: When thy feet are made firm upon this path, thou shalt see the bounty of God encompassing thee even as the rays from the Sun of Truth encompass the moons - a star rising from the dawning-place of lights, flowing forth in the ocean of mysteries, and sailing upon the ark of salvation, until thou shalt find thyself a trusted keeper of the mysteries of the Kingdom and a mirror reflecting the effulgence of the realm of divinity.

Subject: walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life.txt
Quotation: The loved ones of God must at all times occupy themselves with that which conduceth to the refinement of souls, the elevation of beings, and the exaltation of the Word of God. Its manifestation dependeth upon the consultation of the trustees of the House of Justice. Blessed are they who have arisen to serve the world. The effects of such souls shall lead the world from hardship to comfort, from poverty to wealth, and from abasement to glory.

Subject: walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life.txt
Quotation: Wherefore, it is incumbent upon us to strive to act in accordance with the teachings of Baha'u'llah. Day by day let us endeavor to become more spiritual, to become more luminous, and to serve the cause of the oneness of humanity. Let us promote equal rights amongst all men, spread far and wide the divine favors, and offer the love of God to all who dwell on earth, so that the power of the spirit may become manifest with the utmost splendor, bodies may become spiritualized, and souls may govern.

Subject: walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life.txt
Quotation: I am summoning you to the world of the Kingdom. I am calling you away from this world. Nothing you can ever think of here will remain. You, yourself, will pass away as the roses wither at the touch of winter's breath. I wish for you heavenly happiness. I am praying that the confirmations of God may descend upon you, that you may become His servant, that you may go forth to save mankind from the bondage of this mortal world. I wish you to escape from this hell of materialism. Be not occupied with material things. Have no anxiety about your affairs. You are under the protection of Baha'o'llah,--in His service. Live in the spiritual world as I do. Think of nothing else.

Subject: walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life.txt
Quotation: And the effect and fruit is the acquisition of those perfections which adorn human reality - namely, unity and the abandonment of estrangement, and freedom from personal interests and thoughts. Until character is reformed and human virtues and excellences are made manifest, the Beloved of eternal glory will not unveil His face.

Subject: walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life
Source file: subject_extracts/subjects_inv_length_ordered/walking the spiritual path; spiritual wayfaring; the virtuous life.txt
Quotation: A long time ago His Holiness Baha'o'llah wrote an epistle in which he said that man must attain to such a condition that his spirit will be soaring though he is sitting in a state of tranquility and serenity. That is the kind of sitting that is like unto walking. That is the kind of serenity that is really motion. That is the kind of tranquility that is really flying.

Subject: war and peace
Quotation: "At such a time when the flames of war are burning in East and West...in these days when the clouds of war have covered the horizons"

Subject: war and peace
Quotation: The nations of the world strive to increase their armaments to such an extent that they become like serpents, rushing at one another, and much blood is shed.

Subject: war and peace
Quotation: You must sow the seed of love. They destroy, you construct. They take life, you confer life. They are thinking and waging war, you practice Peace and conciliation.

Subject: war and peace
Quotation: Notwithstanding this religious kinship they have already crimsoned many battlefields with the blood of each other. Why the display of this wolf-like quality? Why the appearance of these savage and brute forces?

Subject: war and peace
Quotation: "Our aims are Universal Peace and the Oneness of the world of humanity." "By the education of the public with the sentiments of Peace. Today the full realization of Universal Peace is the panacea for every disease."

Subject: war and peace
Quotation: All people are anxious and distressed, and city dwellers have fled to mountains and villages in disarray, as they fear that ironclad warships may suddenly surge forth in tumult and utterly destroy the foundations of cities.

Subject: war and peace
Quotation: War is a grievous calamity. It begins and ends in disaster. A mother has a beautiful boy filled with every grace and promise. He develops into manhood, goes to war, and in an instant all his possibilities and usefulness are cut off.

Subject: war and peace
Quotation: "By that unity perfect peace would reign among men. Strife and animosity are due to misunderstandings. If these misunderstandings be removed then unity can be accomplished." "...then six thousand years of strife and warfare will vanish."

Subject: war and peace
Quotation: Ignorance and prejudice have encircled the nations of the earth and they are attacking each other with weapons of death instead of love... Now the nations of the world are adding daily to the means of warfare and have become military lunatics.

Subject: war and peace
Quotation: The kings and rulers, instead of expending your wealth and treasures for the betterment of countries and the comfort of the people, spend all in the destruction of humankind....These contentions and wars and bloodshed and differences must cease

Subject: war and peace
Quotation: The continuing verses mean the Great War that is to come. After this war everything will be at peace. The "great hail" means both the bombs, shells, instruments of destruction, and the calamities and hardships, which will cause people to blaspheme.

Subject: war and peace
Quotation: That is, each one tears open the breast of another, and sees their own success in another's bitterness, and seeks their own unity in another's estrangement...Give up war and sharp claws, make peace your aim and seek culture and uprightness. Seek security and peace

Subject: war and peace
Quotation: The gathering storm is most portentous! Mankind is gripped in the paroxysm of a fearful alarm. How cruel man is to send his brothers into the battle-field, so that they may cut each other to pieces! Just on the simple ground that thou art German, I am English and he is French!

Subject: war and peace
Quotation: Those who have provided the means for transporting arms and ammunition and the instruments of wars and massacres on earth will do so in the air. There will come to exist such instruments as to cause all the means of destruction in the past to be looked upon as children's playthings.

Subject: war and peace
Quotation: They send their own people to the field of war and battle while they themselves live in palaces in complete comfort and ease. The leaders of nations in all their speeches expressed so much love of country and love of humanity, but they themselves ignited the world-consuming fire of war

Subject: war and peace
Quotation: Warfare will be changed to peace. Disloyalty will give place to faithfulness. Religious prejudice and sectarian strife, national conflict and racial estrangements will not remain. All parties will unite as one and people of different tribes and cultures will drink from a single fountain.

Subject: war and peace
Quotation: This recent terrible war proved that modern weapons of war exceed human capacity. The future cannot be compared to the past, for while ancient weapons and implements of war were very mild, modern weapons and implements of war can uproot human society in a short time and are beyond human endurance.

Subject: war and peace
Quotation: In this century the voices of peace must drown the clamors for battle, and the principle of arbitration must gain sway over the arbitrement of the sword. Man must learn war no more neither must he let the brutal and barbaric forces of passion and lust control the humane intellectual and moral powers.

Subject: war and peace
Quotation: Warfare has ever been the cause of separation, disunion and discord. What destruction and loss befalls both in one year of strife and conflict -- the undoing of centuries. How urgent their necessity and demand for peace, with its comfort and progress, instead of war, which blasts and destroys the foundation of all human attainment.

Subject: war and peace
Quotation: They set two warring powers against each other, and how many souls - men, women and children - and how many cities and villages were destroyed and obliterated. Had other kings prevented this and considered the good of all, these matters would not have occurred, save what was destined in the Book of God, the All-Knowing, the All-Wise.

Subject: war and peace
Quotation: After silence He has stirred up ferment and passion...We hope that the universal war will lead to universal peace, and that this bloodshed and violation and recklessness will yield purity and freedom. May the world find rest and the universe adornment. May the tumult of conflict and war be transformed into the jubilation of melody and song.

Subject: war and peace
Quotation: We have tried war and witnessed its consequences which are devastation, confusion, and eternal loss. Now, according to divine teachings, let us for a time promote universal peace and lay the foundation of love and reconciliation among nations. Let us transform weapons into instruments of peace, and implements of wrath into tools of agriculture.

Subject: war and peace
Quotation: "war destroys the foundation of humanity, causes the ruin of the world, and has absolutely no benefit - both victor and vanquished are harmed" ... "from the beginning of recorded history until now, no one has ever been harmed by good fellowship, love and peace."

Subject: war and peace
Quotation: In this severe war and grievous torment it became firmly established that nothing but divine teachings are the cause of success and prosperity, and nothing but heavenly law can preserve the human world. This was the outcome of the great civilization that came to pass. The flood of this devastating war has not yet subsided when fear of other difficulties has arisen and preparation of war materiel is in view.

Subject: war and peace
Quotation: Similarly, all these nations who are fighting each other and forming red rivers of the blood of their fellowmen - are defeated - one and all. For all of them are captives in the claws of lust and passion, are prompted by greed and cupidity and are imbued with the spirit of jealousy and hatred. The Army of the oneness of the world of humanity conquers over all, the Flag of Universal Peace shall wave over all.

Subject: war and peace
Quotation: However, in certain areas unsuitable for women, such as in defending society from enemy attack, women are not obligated to engage in military defense. Perhaps someday savage and barbaric tribes may attack society to kill everyone - in such cases defense is necessary, but it is obligatory for men, not women. For women's hearts are tender and cannot bear warfare, even in defense. In this matter women are exempt.

Subject: war and peace
Quotation: These governments, without remembering the difficulties of this war, or considering its consequences, or taking into account the gravity of the situation, rush recklessly into war. Now both sides are remorseful. Had they known it would come to this, they would not have acted so rashly. In their hearts they say the world was at peace and we were at peace. We have cast both the world and ourselves into calamity.

Subject: war and peace
Quotation: Fifty people have been slain in the twinkling of an eye, yet they know not why they rush headlong to their doom. Like in these days when so many in Europe are being annihilated, so many fathers are being rendered sonless, so many children fatherless, so many homes are being laid waste, so many mothers throughout the world are crying and lamenting for their children--it has no importance. Soon no trace of it remains.

Subject: war and peace
Quotation: destroy ye the fabric of strife and war from the face of the earth... The Kingdom of peace, salvation, uprightness and reconciliation is founded in the Invisible World... that by the power of the Most Great Name, the friends of God may conquer this world through love, friendship and the strength of the Kingdom of peace; the human race become compassionate, and bloodshed and carnage be completely effaced from the universe

Subject: war and peace
Quotation: But nowadays material civilization invents Krupp guns, rifles, destructive war implements, vices and corruptions are increased etc. All these things are the results of material civilization...But we cannot live in these days without war...No doubt there will be a great war...Now Europe is waging a moral war in Balkans...Right! May God protect Europe. I pray to God that this fire of war may not become enkindled in Europe.

Subject: war and peace
Quotation: Yet again you see the human world is at war and conflict from end to end - there is war between religions, war between peoples, war between nations, war between rulers. How wonderful it would be if these black clouds would disperse from the horizon of the world and the light of reality would shine forth, if the dust of war and bloodshed would settle and the breeze of providence would waft from the direction of peace and tranquility.

Subject: war and peace
Quotation: We have the history of the world for nearly six thousand years. During these six thousand years there has been constant war, strife, bloodshed. We can see at a glance the results, achievements and outcomes of war. The history of warfare and strife is known, the effect apparent. Let us now try peace for awhile. If good results follow, let us adhere to it. If not let us throw it away and fight again. Nothing will be lost by the experiment.

Subject: war and peace
Quotation: This is why Christ says the body is sorrowful because it belongs to the material world and has attachment to the material world, but the spirit is joyful because it partakes of the effusions of the divine realm... the Great War is the cause of destruction while peace is the cause of prosperity; war demolishes the edifice of humanity while peace establishes the divine foundation; war is death while peace is life; war is satanic suggestions while peace is divine inspirations.

Subject: war and peace
Quotation: God willing, this sun of rest and tranquility shall soon dawn from the horizon of this world, and humanity shall repose in the cradle of ease and joy. From this city, whence the call of peace should be raised, the sound of drums and cymbals is heard. From this city, whence the spirit of brotherhood and kindness should flow to other regions, the spirit of war and strife is spread abroad. The city of peace has become the city of discord, and the land of Christ has been stained with blood.

Subject: war and peace
Quotation: A thousand times alas! that this glorious century has been besmeared with war and strife, hatred and rancor. Bloodthirsty wolves are tearing the sheep of God. Destruction is more widespread than in all the ages of the past. What mediaeval age held the horror of a Krupp gun, a Mauser rifle or a shrapnel shell that kills a whole camp? On the sea we have the submarine and the dreadnaught. If you compare the past with this age, impartial judgment will call this the age of human fratricide.

Subject: war and peace
Quotation: When we look into the pages of history, past and present, we see the black earth reddened by human blood. Men kill each other like the savage wolves, and forget the laws of love and tolerance. Look at the present Turco-Italian war; consider for a moment the fate of these unhappy people! How many have been killed during this sad time? How many homes are ruined, wives desolate, and children orphans! And what is to be gained in exchange for all this anguish and heartache? Only a corner of the earth!

Subject: war and peace
Quotation: The law of peace has come to stay. We are living in the radiant age of peace. We are daily advancing in the path of peace. The army of peace is being recruited from among all nations and people. From now on less and less will be the magic spell of war, greater and greater will be the influence of peace. The day is coming when the dove of peace will reign over all the continents, the laws of peace will rule all nations and the resources of war will be expended upon that which will be conducive to the spiritualizing of mankind.

Subject: war and peace
Quotation: Yes, since they have disobeyed the blessed instructions [of BahÃ¡'u'llÃ¡h]. Only a few countries have representatives in the League of Nations, whereas the representatives must be appointed and ratified by the nation, the government, the monarch and the Senate. They do not even consult. On the other hand, some governments are deprived of membership, and this has precipitated their fury and prompted their feeling of revenge. Governments have secret alliances with each other of which no one is aware, but these schemes will reach nowhere.

Subject: war and peace
Quotation: Yet even now warfare prevails. Envy and hatred have arisen between nations. Observe what is taking place in Tripoli: men cutting each other into pieces, bombardment from the sea, attacks from the land and the hail of dynamite from the very heaven itself. The contending armies are thirsting for each other's blood. How they can do this is inconceivable. They have fathers, mothers, children; they are human. What of their wives and families? Think of their anguish and suffering. How unjust, how terrible! Human beings should prevent and forbid this.

Subject: war and peace
Quotation: The world is engaged in war and struggle, and mankind is in the utmost conflict and danger. The darkness of unfaithfulness has enshrouded the earth and the illumination of faithfulness has become concealed. All nations and tribes of the world have sharpened their claws and are warring and fighting with each other. The edifice of mankind is shattered. Thousands of families are wandering disconsolate. Thousands of thousands of souls are besmeared with dust and blood in the arena of battle and struggle every year, and the tent of happiness and life is overthrown.

Subject: war and peace
Quotation: These soldiers are in reality prisoners. They are restricted in all their affairs. They cannot deviate one hair's breadth from the prescribed rules. They are circumscribed in their eating, sleeping and walking. They are not at all free. These men are prisoners in everything save the name. Because they are called soldiers and are summoned to defend what the demagogues call "Fatherland" they willingly go through all these hardships. The battle-fields of the world have been crimsoned with the blood of millions of soldiers, all to no purpose. Today no one knows their names.

Subject: war and peace
Quotation: In the name of God, the Most Merciful, the Most Compassionate! O ye beloved of God, dearly cherished friends! The darkness of heedlessness hath encompassed the world, and sombre clouds have concealed the horizon of humanity. The human world hath fallen into tribulation and hardship, and all the peoples of the earth are bewildered and lost. From the dawn of human history until now, never hath such a soul-consuming flame been kindled, nor such a conflagration spread to all horizons. All eyes are weeping and all hearts are burning. The whole continent of Europe hath become a field of bloodshed and an arena of savagery.

Subject: war and peace
Quotation: "No nation can follow a peace policy, while its neighbor remains warlike. For example, if France should cease to maintain her armaments while Germany should maintain hers, France would not be able to offer resistance to attack and would simply invite her own destruction. If France added to her armaments and Germany did not do the same, France would be the victor as soon as the armed nation fell upon the disarmed one." "Disarmament, as I have said, must be by international agreement and it must be done at the same time. The nations must agree to abandon the ancient pursuit of war and lay down their arms simultaneously."

Subject: war and peace
Quotation: Discord and rebellion have intensified in all regions, and the calamities of sedition and corruption have arisen in every land. The multitudes are contending, the roots and branches are disputing, the tribes are attacking each other, the clans are fighting, the peoples are battling, and the high and low are warring. No harmony or concord remains - every group has drawn a sharp sword and every company has raised thirsty spears. Nothing is heard save the rumbling of cannons and the rolling of thunder and lightning. O Lord! The lands are laid waste, the traces are obliterated, the palaces are demolished, and the graves are filled.

Subject: war and peace
Quotation: Nearly fifty years ago, Baha'u'llah promulgated teachings and raised the call of universal peace. In all His Tablets and epistles, He explicitly foretold these present events, warning that humanity was in grave danger and that a universal war was impending and inevitable, for the inflammable materials stored in the infernal arsenals of Europe would be ignited by a single spark. War, He explained, destroys the divine edifice of humanity, while man is the divine foundation. Peace is embodied life; war is death personified. Peace is the divine spirit; war is satanic whisperings. Peace is the light of the horizons; war is absolute darkness.

Subject: war and peace
Quotation: All mankind was held in the grip of anguish, and calamities afflicted every soul, while the safety of the friends constituted one of the greatest gifts. For that we thank God and pray that He may confer upon every one that which will illumine the hearts, refresh the souls, bestow light to the eyes and brighten the visions; and that is the dawn of the Sun of the Truth upon all lands, from the horizon of universal peace. Undoubtedly the standard of universal peace shall be unfurled, its legions shall conquer, its call shall be raised, its rays shall beam forth upon all lands. At present it is only the dawn of its morn, for its sun shall shine in full splendor upon all regions.

Subject: war and peace
Quotation: This war has been instrumental in partly awakening mankind and it has exposed the virtues of Universal Peace. All people are desirous of having Universal Peace because they have suffered from this universal war. They do not want another war like it. Gradually racial prejudice will be dispelled. There will come a day when the German will say to the Frenchman: 'I am a Frenchman.' And the Frenchman will say: 'I am a German.' If the Government should like to wage war the people would not agree to it. They would say: 'If ye leaders have any war go and fight it out. We will not go.' All have understood that war is the destruction of the foundation of humanity. It has no benefit save loss.

Subject: wealth inequality and its moderation
Quotation: From him nothing will be taken because he needs it all. From him one-tenth is taken. Again, one needs two thousand kilos, but his income is ten thousand kilos. From him two-tenths will be taken. He needs two thousand kilos. If two thousand are taken from him he still has six thousand remaining. One has fifty thousand kilos, from him one-third is taken. One may have ten thousand kilos expenses, but has one hundred thousand kilos income. One-half is taken. The greater the income, the greater is the ratio (of taxation).

Subject: wealth inequality and its moderation
Quotation: In every village there must be founded a general storehouse which shall be the general or universal storehouse which shall have a number of revenues...All these revenues will be collected in this storehouse...A certain farmer whose expenses run to $10,000 and whose income is only $5,000, he has necessary expenses; from this storehouse $5,000 will be directed to him, so that he will not be in need.

Subject: wealth inequality and its moderation
Quotation: The civilizations of the past have all been founded upon the enslavement of mankind and the poor working class has suffered every oppression for the sake of the enrichment of the few. This limited wealthy class has alone had the privilege of developing individuality. The down trodden worker after laboring long hours each day, has not had sufficient mental capacity at the conclusion of his task to do anything but eat and sleep.

Subject: wealth inequality and its moderation
Quotation: "Indeed, sound views regarding the comfort of the human world were observed therein. In brief, among the teachings of Baha'u'llah is beneficence, and this is greater than equality. Equality is something forced whereas beneficence is voluntary...And beneficence is voluntary goodness, which means that the wealthy should show beneficence to the poor - that is, give to the poor, but of their own free will, not that the poor should compel the wealthy."

Subject: wealth inequality and its moderation
Quotation: From every direction destitution has surrounded man. Our affairs are presently such that we cannot offer substantial help. "God will not burden any soul beyond its power." However the wealthy person who is not held back by his riches, provides charity to the needy and spends generously in the path of God, he is preferred to the patient poor. Subject: wealth inequality and its moderation

It must be improved and such laws established that all have comfort and wellbeing - neither should one be afflicted with poverty nor another have extreme wealth. For example, a wealthy person who has utmost wealth should not let another person have utmost poverty, but should take care of them so they too can be comfortable.

Subject: wealth inequality and its moderation

This is the result of the sweat of the poor's brow. This is the outcome of the destitute workers' lives - that someone has employed a commercial trick to hoard this wealth. All should be equal. The ultimate solution is to arrange things so there is less poverty and all can live comfortably in their own rank, and wealth is not hoarded in one place.

Subject: wealth inequality and its moderation
Quotation: The first means of income is the tithe, which must be administered as follows: If a person's average income is $500 and his necessary expenses amount to the same sum, no tithe will be collected from him. If another person has an income of $1,000 and his necessary expenses amount to $500, he will be able to pay the tithe because he will have more than he needs. If he pays the tithe there will be no decline in his standard of living. Another has an income of $5,000 and his expenses are only $1,000, so he will have to pay one and one-half times the tithe because he has an even greater amount than he needs. Another has an income of $10,000 and his necessary expenses amount to $1,000; therefore he will have to pay two times the tithe because his surplus is larger. Another person has an income of $100,000 and expenses amounting to $4,000 or $5,000; he will have to pay one-fourth of his income. Another has an income of $200 but the expenses he requires to live at subsistence level amount to $500. He spares no pains in working and laboring for his livelihood but the fruit of his labor is inadequate. He must be helped from the treasury so that he may not be in want and may live in comfort.
